To complement our rapid growth, we are actively sourcing for a Network Engineer to operate in a 24/7 Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) environment maintaining IP Networking components in a production setting. 

In this role you will: 

- Design, engineer, and oversee highly scalable CI/CD pipelines for automated testing, digital-twin dry-running, and zero-downtime deployment of configurations across massive physical and virtual network fabrics

 - Design the automation of complex security and traffic management policies across enterprise-grade firewalls (Palo Alto/Fortinet) and load balancers (F5 BIG-IP/Cloudflare/Octavia)

 - Deep design and operational expertise with massive-scale software-defined networks (SDN) and overlays, specifically VXLAN, OVN, and Project Calico
 - Advanced mastery of Kubernetes networking designs (CNIs, Ingress controllers, Service Mesh, Kube-Proxy behaviors) at an enterprise scale
 - Extensive, expert-level experience engineering and automating enterprise edge, routing, and security fabrics, including Cisco Nexus (9k/7k/5k/2k), Arista, Versa SD-WAN, and firewalls (Palo Alto and Fortinet)

 - CCIE-level (or equivalent) mastery of core routing protocols (BGP, OSPF, MPLS, EVPN) and a comprehensive understanding of how virtual/container overlay networks map to physical underlays
 - Extensive experience designing and scaling CI/CD platforms (e. g. , GitLab CI, Jenkins, GitHub Actions) and implementing test-driven development (TDD) for infrastructure changes
 - Unparalleled troubleshooting capabilities utilizing advanced packet analysis (tcpdump/Wireshark), NetFlow, and log aggregation platforms to trace asymmetric routing and microburst traffic across hybrid fabrics
 - Proven track record of technical leadership, including mentoring mid-level engineers, leading design review boards, and driving cross-functional engineering initiatives
 - Deep telecommunications background, specifically VoIP, RTP, SIP peering/trunking, and Session Border Controllers (SBC), is highly advantageous

Job Description Summary

As a Staff Reltio Architect, you will serve as the principal technical authority for our enterprise Master Data Management (MDM) ecosystem. You will lead the architectural design, configuration, and integration of the cloud-native Reltio Connected Data Platform. In this role, you will bridge the gap between complex business data needs and cutting-edge cloud architecture, ensuring high-performance entity resolution, robust data governance, and seamless real-time data streaming. 

Job Description

You will play a pivotal role in shaping the technical direction and architecture of our cutting-edge enterprise master data and healthcare data platform solutions. You will be responsible for designing and guiding the implementation of complex, cloud-native master data management (MDM) systems, ensuring scalability, reliability, and performance across various platforms. 

Responsibilities: **

- Lead the architectural design and development of enterprise MDM solutions, translating complex healthcare data requirements into robust and scalable technical designs using the Reltio Connected Data Platform. 
 - Define and enforce best practices for API Development, ensuring seamless real-time data integration, streaming, and interoperability across downstream and upstream healthcare systems. 
 - Architect and optimize MDM solutions leveraging Cloud Technology, aligning multi-tenant SaaS capabilities with organizational considerations for cost, security, compliance, and performance. 
 - Provide expert guidance in Computer Programming and Databasing, selecting appropriate graph database concepts, NoSQL stores, and data structures to optimize Reltio L1/L2/L3 configurations. 
 - Drive the adoption of DevOps principles and practices, fostering continuous integration, deployment, and automated configuration management (JSON/UI) across tenant environments. 
 - Design and implement solutions incorporating Edge Computing and Embedded Systems Architecture, ensuring real-time data syndication and golden-record lookup capability for connected medical devices. 
 - Contribute to Full Stack Development efforts, ensuring architectural coherence from data-layer crosswalks and survivorship strategies to backend integrations and customer-facing UI/data steward consoles. 
 - Integrate Machine Learning (ML) capabilities into software products, utilizing advanced probabilistic matching, anomaly detection, and automated entity resolution. 
 - Design and evolve Microservices Architecture, promoting modularity, resilience, and independent deployability of data connectors and event-driven data streaming pipelines. 
 - Ensure adherence to Network Protocols and stringent healthcare security standards (including HIPAA, HITRUST, and data encryption) in all software designs. 
 - Champion Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) principles, promoting clean, maintainable, and extensible codebases for custom integration wrappers and data handlers. 
 - Oversee Performance Testing strategies and execution, ensuring high-throughput batch loading and low-latency API response times meet stringent performance requirements. 
 - Lead Software Design Architecture reviews, mentoring and guiding data engineering and MDM development teams on match/merge and survivorship logic. 
 - Provide technical leadership and oversight in Software Project Management, ensuring successful delivery of enterprise data-domain and architectural initiatives. 

Qualifications: **

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field. 
 - 10+ years of progressive experience in software development, with at least 3 years in a lead architect role specifically focused on master data management (MDM) platforms. 
 - Proven expertise in API Development and designing robust REST APIs and event-driven architectures (e. g. , Kafka, AWS SQS/SNS). 
 - Extensive experience with Cloud Technology (e. g. , AWS, Azure, GCP) and cloud-native architectures; direct experience with the Reltio SaaS environment is highly preferred. 
 - Strong proficiency in various Computer Programming languages and paradigms (e. g. , Java, Python). 
 - Deep understanding of Databasing technologies, including graph databases, document stores, relational systems, and cloud data warehouses like Snowflake or Databricks. 
 - Solid experience implementing DevOps practices, automated tenant deployments, and CI/CD tools. 
 - Familiarity with Edge Computing and Embedded Systems Architecture principles as they relate to real-time distributed data consumption. 
 - Proficiency in Full Stack Development concepts, including data modeling, pipeline architecture, and front-end interface adjustments (JSON configuration). 
 - Experience with Machine Learning (ML) integration, matching algorithms, and automated data curation deployment. 
 - Demonstrated expertise in Microservices Architecture design and enterprise integration patterns. 
 - Strong understanding of Network Protocols, secure data transmission, and distributed systems. 
 - Mastery of Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) principles. 
 - Experience with Performance Testing methodologies, API load testing, and volume data optimization. 
 - Exceptional skills in Software Design Architecture, data modeling, pattern recognition, and entity resolution framework design. 
 - Proven ability in Software Project Management and leading technical initiatives. 
 - Excellent communication, leadership, and interpersonal skills to collaborate with data stewards, product managers, and executive stakeholders. 

Additional Information

Relocation Assistance Provided: Yes

Senior DevOps / Cloud Platform Engineer - ML & AI Infrastructure

Job Summary

We are looking for a Senior DevOps / Cloud Platform Engineer with strong experience in AWS, Kubernetes, CI/CD, infrastructure automation, and ML/AI infrastructure to design, deploy, manage, and optimize cloud infrastructure supporting our machine learning and AI services. 

The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience with AWS EKS, SageMaker, Bedrock, Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, Helm, GitHub Actions, Databricks, Elasticsearch, and self-hosted LLM deployments. This role will work closely with Data Engineering, Machine Learning, and Software Engineering teams to build reliable, scalable, secure, and cost-efficient platforms for ML services across development and production environments. 

In this role you will. . . 

Key Responsibilities

AWS & Kubernetes Infrastructure

- Design, deploy, and administer AWS infrastructure supporting ML and AI workloads. 
 - Manage Amazon EKS clusters, including cluster provisioning, upgrades, scaling, networking, and troubleshooting. 
 - Work with AWS SageMaker, AWS Bedrock, EKS, ECS, and related AWS services. 
 - Configure and manage Kubernetes Ingress controllers such as NGINX and AWS ALB. 
 - Manage Cloudflare Tunnels, DNS, Cloudflare configuration, networking, and security. 
 - Troubleshoot application, networking, compute, and infrastructure issues across AWS and Kubernetes environments. 
 - Implement best practices for security, reliability, availability, and scalability. 

CI/CD & Azure-to-AWS Migration

- Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines for ML and AI services. 
 - Develop and manage GitHub Actions and Azure DevOps pipelines using YAML. 
 - Migrate repositories and CI/CD workflows from Azure DevOps to GitHub/AWS. 
 - Automate build, test, containerization, deployment, and release processes. 
 - Establish deployment strategies across development, staging, and production environments. 

ML Service Deployment

- Deploy and manage ML services across AWS EKS/ECS and SageMaker. 
 - Build and maintain Docker containers and Kubernetes deployments. 
 - Manage environment segregation and configuration across Dev, QA, and Production. 
 - Develop and maintain Kubernetes manifests and Helm charts. 
 - Troubleshoot ML service deployment, networking, scaling, and runtime issues. 

App Runner to EKS Migration

- Lead migration of existing services from AWS App Runner to Amazon EKS. 
 - Containerize applications and develop Kubernetes manifests/Helm charts. 
 - Design appropriate Kubernetes architecture, networking, ingress, scaling, and deployment strategies. 
 - Ensure minimal service disruption during migration and establish operational best practices on EKS. 

Self-Hosted LLM & AI Infrastructure

- Deploy and manage self-hosted Large Language Models and inference services. 
 - Work with model serving frameworks such as vLLM. 
 - Design containerized infrastructure for GPU-based model serving and inference. 
 - Manage model versions, deployments, configurations, and rollback strategies. 
 - Support migration of ML services from managed APIs/services to self-hosted models. 
 - Work with engineering teams on API integration and inference infrastructure. 

Databricks Administration

- Administer Databricks workspaces, clusters, permissions, and access controls.

 - Support LMI Insights and related ML/AI workloads. 
 - Troubleshoot Databricks infrastructure and connectivity issues. 
 - Implement appropriate security and access-control practices. 

Elasticsearch Infrastructure

 - Perform cluster sizing, scaling, configuration, and performance optimization. 
 - Manage indices, mappings, retention, and data lifecycle requirements. 
 - Support Kibana configuration, dashboards, and troubleshooting. 
 - Monitor Elasticsearch health, capacity, and performance.

data.description:
Job Description Summary

Systems Engineering ist eine funktionsübergreifende technische Disziplin, die sich auf einen Ansatz, eine Denkweise und einen Prozess konzentriert. Alle Tätigkeiten, die sowohl die geschäftlichen als auch die technischen Anforderungen der Kunden berücksichtigen, mit dem Ziel, ein Qualitätsprodukt bereitzustellen, das die Anforderungen der Benutzer erfüllt. Die Disziplin zur Umsetzung eines soliden Prozesses zum Entwerfen, Erstellen und Optimieren von Systemen, der aus der Identifizierung und Quantifizierung von Systemanforderungen, der Erstellung alternativer Systementwurfskonzepte, der Durchführung von Design-Trade-off-Studien, der Auswahl und Implementierung der besten Entwürfe und der Überprüfung der Tatsache besteht, dass das Design ordnungsgemäß integriert ist und ausgeführt wird. Prozess, der vom Konzept über die Produktion bis zum Betrieb verläuft. 

Verantwortlich für die Planung/Ausführung des Abteilungsbetriebs oder konzentriert sich auf die Ausführung von beruflichen Tätigkeiten innerhalb einer technischen Disziplin. Hat eine gewisse Autonomie, wird jedoch von festgelegten Richtlinien oder der Überprüfung der Endergebnisse geleitet. 

Die Stelle ermöglicht die Änderung von Arbeitsabläufen und Praktiken, sofern die Endergebnisse den Standards der Akzeptanz (Qualität, Umfang, Aktualität usw. ) entsprechen. 

Job Description

Rollen und Verantwortlichkeiten

- Stellt die Übereinstimmung der Leistung, der funktionalen und physikalischen Eigenschaften eines Produkts mit den Anforderungen, dem Design und den Betriebsinformationen her und verwaltet Änderungen über den gesamten Systemlebenszyklus hinweg. Bietet Transparenz und Kontrolle der Systemleistung sowie der funktionalen und physischen Attribute. Überprüft, ob ein System die beabsichtigte Leistung erbringt und ausreichend detailliert identifiziert und dokumentiert wird, um den projizierten Lebenszyklus zu unterstützen. Unterstützt die ordnungsgemäße Verwaltung von Systeminformationen und Systemänderungen zu vorteilhaften Zwecken, etwa um die Funktionsfähigkeit zu überprüfen, die Leistung, Zuverlässigkeit oder Wartbarkeit zu verbessern; die Lebensdauer zu erhöhen, Kosten zu reduzieren; Risiko und Haftung zu reduzieren oder Mängel zu korrigieren. 
 - Nutzt vertiefte Kenntnisse einer technischen Disziplin sowie analytisches Denken und technische Erfahrung zur Umsetzung von Richtlinien/Strategien. 
 - Hat Kenntnisse über Best Practices und darüber, wie sich der eigene Bereich in andere integriert; ist sich des Wettbewerbs und der Faktoren bewusst, die das Unternehmen auf dem Markt auszeichnen
 - Nutzt ein gewisses Urteilsvermögen und hat die Fähigkeit, verschiedene Lösungen außerhalb der festgelegten Parameter vorzuschlagen, um kompliziertere Herstellungsprozesse mit technischer Vielfalt und/oder voneinander abhängigen Produktionszyklen anzugehen. Verwendet technische Erfahrung und analytisches Denken. Verwendet mehrere interne und begrenzte externe Quellen außerhalb der eigenen Teams, um Entscheidungen zu treffen. 
 - Dient als Ressource für Kollegen mit weniger Erfahrung. Kann kleine Projekte mit geringen Risiken und Ressourcenanforderungen leiten. Erklärt Informationen; Entwicklung von Fähigkeiten, um Teammitglieder zu einem Konsens über Themen innerhalb des Feldes zu bewegen. Vermittelt Leistungserwartungen und kann vertrauliche Themen behandeln. 

Grundqualifikationen

- Diese Rolle erfordert fortgeschrittene Erfahrung. Der Wissensstand ist vergleichbar mit einem Bachelor-Abschluss einer akkreditierten Universität oder Hochschule (oder einem Abitur mit relevanter Erfahrung). 

Gewünschte Eigenschaften

- Sehr gute mündliche und schriftliche Kommunikationsfähigkeiten. Ausgeprägte Sozialkompetenz und Führungsqualitäten. Fähigkeit, andere zu beeinflussen und kleine Teams zu führen. Initiativen von mittlerem Umfang und mittlerer Wirkung leiten. Fähigkeit, mehrere Projekte gleichzeitig zu koordinieren. Effektive Erkennung und Lösung von Problemen. Nachweisliche analytische und organisatorische Fähigkeiten. Hinweis: Um die Einwanderungsbestimmungen der USA und andere gesetzliche Anforderungen zu erfüllen, muss die Mindestanzahl der Jahre an Erfahrung angegeben werden, die für eine Tätigkeit in den USA erforderlich sind. Für Rollen außerhalb der USA sollten sich die JDs auf das für die Rolle erforderliche inhaltliche Erfahrungsniveau konzentrieren, um die Einhaltung der geltenden Rechtsvorschriften zu gewährleisten, und eine Mindestanzahl von Jahren sollte NICHT verwendet werden. Diese Stellenbeschreibung soll einen allgemeinen Leitfaden für die Rolle liefern. Sie soll jedoch nicht die von jedem Mitarbeiter gemäß dem jeweiligen Arbeitsvertrag und/oder gemäß einer anderweitigen Vereinbarung zwischen einem Mitarbeiter und seinem Vorgesetzten geforderten Pflichten ändern oder anderweitig einzuschränken/erweitern. 

Additional Information

Relocation Assistance Provided: Yes

Matillion is the company behind Maia, the AI Data Automation platform.

Organisations like Cisco, DocuSign, and Slack are already using it to deliver real business impact, faster. 

We started in Manchester and now we're global - with teams across the UK, US and India. 

We are driven, curious, energetic people who move fast, think big and hold ourselves to a high standard. We're here to make a dent in the universe bigger than ourselves. And we're looking for people who want to be part of it. 

About the role

We're looking for a Staff Software Engineer to join our Billing team in Hyderabad, where you'll be the most senior technical voice on a team of five, guiding day-to-day delivery, unblocking the team, and acting as the main technical point of contact for the Engineering Manager and Product Manager. This role is based from our Hyderabad office four days a week, with one day working from home. 

You'll lead on third-party and marketplace integrations, help mature our microservices and observability practices, and work at pace across two-week sprints. You'll also collaborate closely with Finance, GTM and Data Science teams, including contributing to exciting ML capability work for Maia. 

What you will be doing

- Acting as technical lead for the Billing team, guiding and unblocking two junior engineers, two mid-level engineers and one QA engineer, and leading design reviews to set technology direction. 
  

- 
Owning integrations with third-party billing and marketplace platforms, with significant hands-on time across production services from design through to deployment and ongoing support. 

- 
Reviewing code and guiding the team to Matillion's engineering standards with a Product, Quality, DevOps and Security mindset, while translating sprint requirements from the Engineering Manager and Product Manager into clear technical direction. 

- 
Becoming the subject matter expert in the billing domain and architecture, supporting triage and incident response, participating in out-of-hours on-call, and proactively engaging customer-facing colleagues to avoid exposing customers to issues. 

- 
Mentoring team members, fostering a culture that aligns engineering and product strategy, and contributing to cross-team work such as ML capability development with Data Science for Maia. 

What we are looking for

- 
Proficient in Java (core priority for this role) with a solid grounding in object-oriented design, distributed systems and best practices such as testability, observability, scalability and security; working React knowledge in a full-stack capacity. 

- 
Experience across the full software development lifecycle via CI/CD tooling and agile methodologies (Kanban/Scrum), with hands-on experience in at least one major cloud platform (AWS, GCP or Azure). 

- 
Proven experience integrating with multiple third-party or marketplace platforms; billing or usage-based/credit-consumption experience is a bonus, not essential. 

- 
A clear bias for action, leading initiatives and mentoring others, with the autonomy to solve problems independently and the inquisitiveness to dig into root causes rather than just symptoms. 

- 
A proactive, self-sufficient technical leader with integrity and a growth mindset, comfortable representing the team cross-functionally and staying calm under pressure during incidents. 

More about Matillion

  

We operate a flexible working culture that promotes work-life balance, with benefits including: 

- Company Equity

- 27 days paid time off

- 12 days of Company Holiday

- 5 days paid volunteering leave

- Group Mediclaim (GMC)

- MacBook Pro

We will never ask for money, fees, or bank details at any point in the hiring process. If something feels off, trust that instinct. Don't click any links. Go straight to  matillion. com/careers to verify open roles or reach us at talent@matillion. com. 

  

  

Want to know more?

  

Don't tick every box? Apply anyway. We hire for potential, not just experience. A member of our Talent Acquisition team will be in touch. 

Cannot find a suitable role right now? We still want to hear from you. Drop us a line at  talent@matillion. com. 

Find out more about life on #TeamGreen here.   

  

  

Matillion is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and we are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all of our team. Matillion prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type. Matillion does not discriminate on the basis of race, colour, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by law.

data.description:
About The Role And Team

Engineering at Uber means building for real-world impact under real-world constraints. As a Senior Staff Backend Engineer, you will lead the architecture and implementation of next-generation distributed systems that power the bedrock of Uber. This is a high-stakes, high-impact role where you'll tackle some of the most complex infrastructure challenges in the industry: building sub-50ms latency systems that handle 1M+ requests per second, and designing resilient platforms that power tens of billions of dollars in global marketplace transactions across 70+ countries. 

This isn't just about writing code; it's about setting the technical direction for an entire organization in a fast-moving, high-ambiguity environment. You will need to move the needle for the business by building systems that are not only highly available and reliable but also developer-friendly, enabling rapid innovation across ML and Product teams. If you think in systems, stay calm under the pressure of global scale, and are motivated by the "messy" reality of solving hard problems-this is where you'll grow. 

What You'll Do

- Lead the design and implementation of highly available, resilient, and cost-efficient distributed systems that serve millions of users with strict sub-50ms latency requirements. 
 - Architect systems capable of handling 1M+ requests per second while maintaining 99. 99% availability and strong consistency guarantees for critical financial and pricing flows. 
 - Drive technical strategy for platform evolution, microservices architecture, and API design to simplify integration for new lines of business and third-party partners. 
 - Build platform abstractions and developer tools that hide massive underlying complexity, enabling ML and product teams to iterate rapidly on core algorithms. 
 - Spearhead architectural transitions toward "Dual-rail" resiliency, ensuring every mission-critical payment or pricing flow has redundant processing options to maximize reliability. 
 - Partner cross-functionally with Product, Data Science, and Ops at the Director and VP levels to translate commercial requirements into scalable, hardened platform solutions. 
 - Own technical excellence by driving architecture reviews, identifying and reducing systemic technical debt, and raising the bar for observability and incident response across the organization. 

Basic Qualifications

- 10+ years of professional experience in backend development and building world-class distributed systems in large-scale production environments. 
 - Proven ability to solve strategically important problems by leading organization-wide development and adoption of key frameworks and coding best practices. 
 - Experience foreseeing architectural problems or opportunities a year in advance and working with leadership to address them before they impact the business. 
 - Demonstrated track record of leading large-scale engineering projects through all lifecycle stages, from inception and requirement gathering to global productionization. 
 - Expertise in defining standards for testing, monitoring, and alerting systems, while overseeing the execution of complex incident management at an organizational level. 
 - Proven experience in identifying architectural gaps and creating org-wide frameworks that improve developer velocity and reduce systemic technical debt. 
 - Demonstrated leadership in building strategic relationships with internal stakeholders and external partners to rally an organization around a technical vision. 
 - Education: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Expert-level proficiency in Go, Java, or Python with experience in real-time marketplace platforms requiring high consistency and global reliability. 
 - Experience building hardened developer tools, SDKs, and abstractions (e. g. , streaming data with Flink/Kafka) used by hundreds of engineers. 
 - Proficiency in cloud-native infrastructure (GCP) and containerization (Kubernetes) at a massive global scale. 
 - Strategic architecture mindset: Ability to balance near-term execution with long-lasting engineering artifacts that improve reliability within an organization. 
 - Experience as a technical brand ambassador, serving as a representative for the organization to the broader internal and external technical community. 

Ready to Ride?

This isn't the kind of place where you follow a playbook - it's where you help write one. If you're driven by impact, energized by challenge, and ready to shape how the world moves - we'd love to hear from you. 

You may be eligible for bonuses, equity, and other compensation, as well as a range of benefits. Explore our benefits. 

Offices remain key to collaboration and Uber's culture. Unless approved for full remote work, employees must spend at least 50% of their time in-office. Some roles, like those at greenlight hubs, require full-time in-office presence. Ask your Recruiter for details about this role's requirements. 

Uber is proud to be an Equal Opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, religion, national origin, disability, protected Veteran status, age, or any other characteristic protected by law. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing this form.

Blitzy is a Cambridge, MA based AI software development platform on a mission to revolutionize the software development life cycle by autonomously building custom software to unlock the next industrial revolution. We're transforming how enterprises build software, turning enterprise requirements into enterprise grade code with an agentic software development platform that can autonomously execute 80% of the quantum of software development work. We're backed by multiple tier 1 investors, and have proven success as founders of previous start-ups. 

Our Culture

Who We Are

Led by two pioneering co-founders we are one of the fastest growing companies in the U. S. , creating our own category of enterprise autonomous software development. We automate thousands of hours of software development for our customers, which includes strong representation within the Fortune 500. 

How We Work

- We move Blitzy Fast: Time is both our company's and our clients' most precious asset. We move quickly and decisively to innovate internally and deliver exceptional software externally. 
 - Championship Mindset: We operate like a professional sports team. We win as a team by holding ourselves and each other to high standards, collaborating in-person, and remaining focused on the mission. 
 - Passion for Invention: We're pushing the frontier of what's possible, requiring constant innovation and iteration. 
 - We Work for the Customer: We focus on delivering outsized value to the customers we work with and expanding those relationships into deep, meaningful partnerships. 

About The Role

We are hiring a Principal Engineer to take full, hands-on ownership of Blitzy's most critical production-grade systems and to deliver high-leverage features that materially improve customer outcomes and engineering velocity. 

This is the most senior individual contributor role at the company today. 

This is not a Senior-plus role, an architecture-only role, or a promotion-track role. We are looking for someone who has already operated at Principal / Staff+ scope in a highly technical environment and expects to spend their time writing, reviewing, and shipping production code. 

This role is 100% hands-on. Leverage comes from system ownership, execution quality, and durable technical decisions - not people management or process. 

Responsibilities

- Own mission-critical production systems end-to-end, ensuring correctness, scalability, performance, reliability, and operational excellence. 
 - Design, build, and ship high-impact backend systems and features that improve product reliability, performance, and customer value.

 - Build and operate LLM-powered systems and validation loops that evaluate correctness, consistency, durability, and production performance.

 - Modernize and improve complex enterprise systems while balancing reliability, maintainability, scalability, and delivery speed. 
 - Set and uphold engineering quality standards through hands-on technical leadership, sound technical judgment, and ownership of long-term technical decisions. 

Qualifications

- 12+ years of direct experience with Python as a primary language, including backend frameworks and microservices architecture at scale
 - Expertise in API architectures including REST and gRPC; working proficiency in Node. js and JavaScript
 - Advanced proficiency with cloud infrastructure: GCP required, with experience in at least one additional platform (AWS or Azure)
 - Advanced, production-grade experience with Kubernetes and Terraform
 - Proven experience operating highly available production systems, including monitoring, scalability, reliability, performance optimization, and operational tooling
 - Strong knowledge of relational and NoSQL databases, including PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, Cassandra, or DynamoDB

 - Full-stack capability, including strong frontend architecture fundamentals and the ability to design, debug, and ship across frontend, backend, infrastructure, and AI systems

data.description:
Job Description

We're hiring a Full Stack Software Engineer to build the infrastructure that powers our AI agents and ML systems end-to-end - from UX/UI, fine-tuning foundation models to shipping production-grade agent harnesses. You'll work across the stack: Creating UX design and UI in ReactJS/TS, building MLOps pipelines, customizing LLMs, and deploying scalable agent systems on Kubernetes. This role sits at the intersection of UX design, ML engineering, platform engineering, and applied AI. 

How You Will Contribute And What You Will Learn

- Design UX and build UI for Agentic Ops
 - Design and build agent harnesses in Python - the runtime scaffolding that enables AI agents to perceive, reason, plan, and act reliably 
 - Develop and maintain a robust MLOps framework using Kubeflow and complementary tooling (MLflow, Argo, Airflow, or similar) to orchestrate training, evaluation, and deployment workflows 
 - Fine-tune foundation LLMs using techniques such as LoRA/QLoRA, SFT, and RLHF; manage datasets, training runs, and evaluation pipelines 
 - Deploy and operate services on Kubernetes, including model serving, autoscaling, and observability

Key Skills And Experience

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Engineering, along with around 8+ years of experience in Python development, including building and supporting production systems
 - Hands-on experience working with agent-based or agentic systems, using at least one framework such as LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen, LangChain, or LlamaIndex
 - Exposure to designing or contributing to MLOps pipelines, with familiarity with tools like Kubeflow
 - Practical experience in fine-tuning large language models (for example, open-source models like Llama, Mistral, Qwen, or similar)
 - Experience deploying containerized applications on Kubernetes, including areas like Helm, operators, networking, and resource management
 - Familiarity with at least one major cloud platform (AWS, GCP, or Azure), including services related to compute, storage, identity access management, and machine learning

Nice to Have: 

- Exposure to distributed training approaches, using tools such as DeepSpeed, FSDP, or Accelerate

data.description:
More than 3 billion people in over 180 countries use WhatsApp to stay in touch with friends and family, anytime and anywhere. As a full-stack product engineer at WhatsApp you will use your start-up mindset and your full range of engineering skills to produce elegantly simple products. data.title: Sr. Principal SQA Engineer
data.description:
About Us

Gen is a global company dedicated to powering Digital Freedom through its trusted consumer brands including Norton, Avast, LifeLock, MoneyLion and more. Our combined heritage is rooted in financial empowerment and cyber safety for the first digital generations, and today we deliver award-winning cybersecurity, online privacy, identity protection and financial wellness solutions to nearly 500 million users in more than 150 countries. 

Together, we share a collective passion and vision to protect consumers and help them grow, manage and secure their digital and financial lives. We're always looking for smart, fearless and high-impact talent who see AI as a teammate - leveraging it to move faster and deliver meaningful results. 

When you're part of Gen, you'll have the flexibility, tools and support to do your best work and grow your career - from flexible working options and time off to competitive pay, benefits and well-being programs. 

At Gen, we are scrappy and relentlessly customer driven. We create room for healthy debate, experimentation and continuous learning, and we seek out people with different experiences, identities and ideas to join our team. You'll work with people who back each other, respect each other and understand that our differences are a competitive advantage. 

If this sounds like you, we'd love you to be part of Gen. 

About The Role

We are pioneering an AI-first development culture. Every aspect of our product development lifecycle is infused with AI adoption - from ideation and design to coding, testing and deployment. Our mission is to lead the industry in AI-powered mobile innovation. 

Quality assurance is a critical leverage point for AI-driven productivity in mobile engineering. In this role, you will help transform QA into a strategic, AI-enabled function that drives both velocity and quality across the mobile engineering organization. 

As a Senior Principal SQA Engineer, Mobile, you will be a key technical leader driving this transformation across our mobile engineering organization. You will define and evolve our mobile quality engineering strategy, champion AI-powered testing practices, and build scalable automation capabilities that improve engineering productivity and product quality. 

You'll join our Mobile Development organization, building secure, highly scalable applications that protect the digital lives of millions of users worldwide. This is a hands-on technical leadership role where you'll combine deep mobile testing expertise, architectural thinking and engineering influence to raise the quality bar across our Android and iOS portfolio. 

In This Role, You Will

- Define and drive the mobile quality engineering strategy across Android and iOS, establishing technical standards, automation architecture and best practices across the organization. 
 - Champion AI-first testing practices, using tools such as Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor and generative AI frameworks to accelerate test development, generate test scenarios, optimize coverage, analyze failures and improve defect detection. 
 - Lead the evolution of mobile test automation frameworks using technologies such as Appium, Espresso, and XCUITest, ensuring scalable, reliable and maintainable automation solutions. 
 - Drive the integration of intelligent test automation into CI/CD pipelines, enabling faster feedback cycles, continuous quality validation and confident releases. 
 - Establish comprehensive testing strategies covering functional, integration, API, performance, reliability and security aspects of mobile applications. 
 - Provide technical leadership and mentorship to mobile QA automation engineers, fostering engineering excellence, technical growth and a culture of continuous learning. 
 - Stay hands-on by designing automation architecture, writing test code, reviewing implementations and solving complex technical challenges. 
 - Partner closely with engineering, product, design and DevOps leaders to embed quality throughout the development lifecycle and promote shared ownership of product quality. 
 - Define and drive meaningful quality metrics, including automation effectiveness, test reliability, defect escape rates and release readiness, using data to guide continuous improvement. 
 - Influence engineering strategy and remove organizational and technical barriers that impact quality, delivery velocity and engineering productivity. 

About You

- You are a strong technical leader who can influence engineering organizations, develop talent, communicate effectively and build trust across teams. 
 - You have an AI-native mindset and practical experience leveraging AI tools to transform software testing, automation and quality engineering practices. 
 - You bring deep technical expertise in mobile test automation across Android and iOS, including mobile application architecture, device fragmentation, OS-specific challenges and complex integration scenarios. 
 - You have extensive experience designing, building and evolving mobile test automation frameworks using technologies such as Appium, Espresso and XCUITest. 
 - You have strong programming skills in Kotlin or Java. Experience with Python, Swift or similar programming languages is a plus. 
 - You have experience integrating test automation into modern CI/CD pipelines and building scalable, reliable and maintainable test infrastructure. 
 - You understand modern quality engineering practices, including shift-left testing, risk-based testing, API testing, performance testing and production quality monitoring. 
 - You are a hands-on technical leader who enjoys solving complex engineering problems, writing automation code, conducting technical reviews and mentoring other engineers. 
 - You have 10+ years of experience in test automation with demonstrated senior or principal-level technical leadership and organizational impact scope, and a track record of delivering high-quality, consumer-facing software at scale. 
 - You thrive in cross-functional collaboration, building strong partnership with engineering, product, design, and DevOps teams. 
 - You are curious, adaptable, and committed to continuously learning, particularly in AI technologies, mobile engineering and emerging quality engineering practices. 

What's Next

If you're excited about this opportunity, we'd love to hear from you!

The hiring process includes two technical interview rounds and one managerial interview. 

Throughout the process, you'll have the opportunity to meet the hiring manager and future team members.

Job Title: Program Analyst Sr - Generative AI, Prompt Engineering & Validation

Location: Bangalore

Experience: 2-6 years

Employment Type: Full-time

About The Role

We are looking for a proactive and detail-oriented Program Analyst to support Generative AI initiatives focused on prompt engineering, feature validation, test execution, output quality evaluation, and program tracking. The role will support internal GenAI platforms and tools, including search, summarization, RAG-based workflows, analytical agents, and domain-specific AI assistants. 

The ideal candidate should combine strong program coordination skills with a practical understanding of GenAI systems, structured prompt-based testing, multi-source data validation, and clear reporting for engineering and leadership stakeholders. 

Key Responsibilities

- GenAI Program Tracking & Coordination
 - Track GenAI feature validation plans, deliverables, owners, dependencies, and closure status across teams. 
 - Maintain dashboards, trackers, action item logs, risk registers, and validation status reports. 
 - Coordinate with engineering, product, platform, and domain expert teams to drive timely completion of testing and feedback cycles. 
 - Consolidate weekly progress updates, blockers, risks, and recommendations for program reviews. 
 - Ensure validation documentation, prompt libraries, and issue logs are accurate, current, and accessible. 
 - Prompt Engineering & Prompt Test Design
 - Create, refine, and maintain prompts for GenAI features, search workflows, summarization use cases, and analytical agents. 
 - Develop zero-shot, few-shot, role-based, multi-turn, edge-case, and negative test prompts. 
 - Build reusable prompt templates and feature-wise prompt libraries. 
 - Compare prompt variants and document impact on accuracy, relevance, completeness, consistency, and latency. 
 - Translate domain expert feedback into improved prompts and updated test scenarios. 
 - Feature Validation & Test Execution
 - Design and execute structured test cases for GenAI features, including functional, sanity, regression, negative, and exploratory testing. 
 - Validate end-to-end behavior from user prompt to retrieved context, generated response, and final output format. 
 - Map feature requirements to prompts, expected outputs, acceptance criteria, and validation evidence. 
 - Identify defects, usability gaps, hallucinations, incomplete answers, inconsistent responses, and low-confidence outputs. 
 - Support release readiness assessment using clear status indicators such as Go / Watch / Risk. 
 - Data, Search & RAG Validation
 - Validate AI outputs against structured, semi-structured, and unstructured data sources such as SharePoint, Confluence, Jira, documents, JSON/XML, and internal knowledge bases. 
 - Check search relevance, context quality, source completeness, and data freshness before summarization. 
 - Support validation of RAG-based workflows, semantic search, keyword search, global filters, and domain filters. 
 - Identify data gaps, indexing issues, retrieval failures, and source-quality problems impacting AI response accuracy. 
 - Maintain golden datasets, expected-answer sets, and benchmark queries for repeatable validation. 
 - Output Quality Evaluation & Defect Analysis
 - Evaluate GenAI responses for factual correctness, relevance, completeness, clarity, format quality, and consistency across repeated runs. 
 - Log defects with clear reproduction steps, prompt used, expected output, actual output, severity, and owner. 
 - Perform first-level root cause analysis to distinguish prompt issues, data issues, retrieval issues, model limitations, and product defects. 
 - Work with SMEs to validate technical correctness and define acceptance thresholds for complex responses. 
 - Track quality improvements over time and report trends in accuracy, hallucination reduction, and feature readiness. 
 - Reporting, Documentation & Stakeholder Communication
 - Prepare weekly validation summaries, risk updates, action item trackers, and executive-ready status reports. 
 - Document prompt libraries, test suites, validation evidence, known issues, and improvement logs. 
 - Facilitate review meetings, capture minutes of meeting, document decisions, and follow up on action items. 
 - Communicate clearly with cross-functional stakeholders across engineering, platform, product, and program management teams. 
 - Support leadership reviews with concise summaries, dashboards, and recommendations. 
 - Automation & Productivity Support
 - Use Excel, Power BI, Jira, Confluence, SharePoint, or similar tools to maintain trackers, dashboards, and reporting views. 
 - Support basic scripting or automation for batch prompt execution, response capture, comparison, and reporting where applicable. 
 - Help improve validation efficiency through reusable templates, structured checklists, and repeatable test processes. 
 - Track productivity metrics such as test coverage, closure rate, defect aging, prompt reuse, and feature readiness. 

Required Skills & Competencies

- 2-6 years of experience in program analysis, project coordination, validation, QA, data analysis, or technical operations. 
 - Hands-on exposure to Generative AI tools, LLM-based applications, prompt engineering, or AI-assisted workflows. 
 - Strong ability to create structured test cases, validation reports, action trackers, and executive summaries. 
 - Good understanding of prompt-response behavior, hallucinations, context limitations, and output evaluation methods. 
 - Working knowledge of search, summarization, RAG concepts, information retrieval, or knowledge-base validation. 
 - Strong Excel skills; Power BI, Jira, Confluence, SharePoint, or dashboarding experience is preferred. 
 - Basic Python, SQL, or scripting knowledge is preferred but not mandatory. 
 - Excellent written and verbal communication skills with strong attention to detail. 

Preferred Qualifications

Education & Background

- Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Electronics, Data Science, Information Systems, or a related discipline. 
 - Prior experience in semiconductor, SoC, embedded systems, platform engineering, enterprise AI, or technical program management is preferred. 
 - Experience supporting validation of internal tools, AI platforms, search systems, summarization tools, or workflow automation platforms is a plus. 
 - Exposure to responsible AI, data privacy, model evaluation, or enterprise GenAI governance is desirable. 

Success Metrics

- Completeness and accuracy of GenAI feature validation coverage. 
 - Quality, reusability, and effectiveness of prompt test suites. 
 - Timely closure of validation defects, risks, action items, and stakeholder feedback. 
 - Improvement in output accuracy, relevance, consistency, and hallucination reduction.

Software Backend Test Engineer

Our Purpose

TERADYNE - where experience meets innovation and driving excellence in every connection. We foster an inclusive culture that values diversity, collaboration, and continuous learning, enabling us to deliver advanced robotics solutions with real‐world impact. 

Opportunity Overview

In this role, you will contribute directly to the quality and reliability of robot platform and its core components. You would be responsible for testing the core operating system components of the Robot, including networking features, firewall features etc. You will work closely with developers, product managers, and other stakeholders to ensure that our solutions meet the highest standards of performance, safety, and usability. 

We are looking for a Backend Test engineer with strong Python automation skills who enjoys working close to the product and the code. You should be comfortable combining hands-on manual testing with Linux Based platforms using Python-based automated testing, while also bringing a strong understanding of ROS. If you are motivated by improving product quality through robust test coverage, fast feedback loops, and close collaboration with developers, this could be the right role for you. 

Responsibilities

- Design, write, and maintain automated tests in Python for new and existing features of the operating system components of the Robot 
 - Develop and maintain unit, integration, and regression tests to ensure stable and reliable releases 
 - Work closely with developers to understand the changes being made in the controller operating system layer or the network layer, investigate failures, and improve testability 
 - Contribute to and improve test frameworks 
 - Help define effective test strategies and quality practices across the development lifecycle in an agile setup 
 - Build tests that have hardware in the loop (not all flakiness comes from software)

Qualification, Experience, Skills And Educational Background

To succeed in this role, we imagine you have a strong background in software test engineering and a practical mindset when it comes to combining automation with hands-on validation. You understand how software is built, how systems fail, and how to create effective tests that increase quality and confidence. 

Skills Required

- 4 to 6 years of experience in software backend testing, software quality engineering of OS level software components, or a similar role 
 - Strong experience writing and maintaining automated tests in Python for backend components using tools like pytest and FastAPI. 
 - Experience with Penetration testing 
 - Experience with API Testing 
 - Familiarity with GoLang and its frameworks. 
 - Familiarity with Containerization technique (Docker, Podman) 
 - Proficient with linux environment and linux commands 
 - Linux networking stack + systemd (services, journald, network namespaces) 
 - Network analysis tooling: Wireshark/tcpdump and nmap and traffic shaping for resilience tests. 
 - Hands-on experience with manual testing of complex systems, ideally involving hardware, robotics, or integrated software-hardware solutions 
 - Experience creating and maintaining unit, integration, and regression tests 
 - Good understanding of test frameworks, debugging, and finding root causes 
 - Experience working with CI/CD pipelines, build servers, or DevOps practices such as Jenkins or similar tools 
 - Ability to understand complex systems, identify risks, and design effective test coverage 
 - Experience working in agile or scrum environments

It Will Be Considered An Advantage If You Have

- Familiarity with ROS2, Industrial Communication Protocols 
 - Familiarity with Firewall (NF Tables/IP Tables) 
 - Experience building or improving test automation frameworks 
 - Hardware-in-the-loop test frameworks such as labgrid, bench hardware, networked power for automated power-cycling, serial console capture, etc. 
 - Automating through the robot's own interfaces (Dashboard Server, RTDE, the primary/secondary/real-time client ports, URScript) 
 - Strong knowledge of DevOps practices, pipelines, and build servers 
 - Knowledge of safety standards and regulations relevant to robotics or industrial systems

Communication Skills

- Strong communication and collaboration skills and fluency in English 
 - Experience working with distributed and international teams 
 - Working across teams and locations 
 - You will be part of a setup where engineers in India and Denmark work closely together. 
 - This requires: 
 - Clear and conscientious communication 
 - Ability to explain technical issues to both technical and non-technical stakeholders 
 - A collaborative mindset and willingness to contribute across team boundaries

We are only considering candidates local to the position location. This position does not offer relocation or visa sponsorship.

Job Requirements

At Quest Global, it's not just what we do but how and why we do it that makes us different. With over 25 years as an engineering services provider, we believe in the power of doing things differently to make the impossible possible. Our people are driven by the desire to make the world a better place-to make a positive difference that contributes to a brighter future. We bring together technologies and industries, alongside the contributions of diverse individuals who are empowered by an intentional workplace culture, to solve problems better and faster. 

This position involves developing PLC and HMI control systems for semiconductor gas/chemical delivery equipment. Responsibilities include designing control logic, system integration, commissioning, and troubleshooting. The role involves designing control architectures based on customer requirements and leading the improvement of equipment stability and performance, as well as the standardization of automation. 

As a Senior Engineer, Lead the software programming, system design, and technical direction for chemical and specialty gas delivery equipment used in semiconductors. 

Proficient in PLC, HMI, C/C++, Java, and other PC-based languages at an expert level. Hold a technical vision for the assigned product areas in chemical equipment and translate complex requirements into scalable, high-performance, manufacturable solutions. Through cross-team collaboration, they contribute to engineering standardization and reliability and demonstrate technical leadership in both systems engineering and PLC software development. 

Key Responsibilities

PLC Software Development

- Understand PLC Software Development
 - Develop and maintain PLC software based on IEC 61131-3 standards. 
 - Design, program, test, and validate PLC logic for semiconductor gas and chemical delivery systems. 
 - Support Omron, Siemens, and LS PLC platforms. 
 - Develop reusable software modules and engineering standards

HMI & System Integration

- Configure and maintain HMI systems (Pro-face, MXon/M2I). 
 - Implement alarms, diagnostics, state monitoring, and data logging functions. 
 - Integrate PLC, HMI, instruments, motion devices, and network systems. 

System Engineering

- Analyze customer and product requirements and translate them into software and control system architecture. 
 - Define software-hardware interfaces and control philosophies. 
 - Support system design reviews and risk assessments. 

Troubleshooting & RCA

- Investigate field issues and implement corrective actions. 
 - Lead root cause analysis (RCA) activities. 
 - Optimize system performance, reliability, and maintainability. 

Manufacturing & Customer Support

- Support manufacturing, FAT, SAT, commissioning, and startup activities. 
 - Provide technical support during customer escalations. 
 - Develop manufacturing packages and technical documentation. 

Cross-Functional Collaboration

- Work closely with Mechanical, Electrical, Quality, Project Management, and Manufacturing teams. 
 - Collaborate with global engineering teams on platform standardization and product improvements. 
 - Participate in engineering change management (ECR/ECO) activities. 

Continuous Improvement

- Drive software standardization and code modularization. 
 - Contribute to technology roadmaps for next-generation control systems. 
 - Mentor junior engineers and share technical best practices

We are known for our extraordinary people who make the impossible possible every day. Questians are driven by hunger, humility, and aspiration. We believe that our company culture is the key to our ability to make a true difference in every industry we reach. Our teams regularly invest time and dedicated effort into internal culture work, ensuring that all voices are heard. 

We wholeheartedly believe in the diversity of thought that comes with fostering a culture rooted in respect, where everyone belongs, is valued, and feels inspired to share their ideas. We know embracing our unique differences makes us better, and that solving the worlds hardest engineering problems requires diverse ideas, perspectives, and backgrounds. We shine the brightest when we tap into the many dimensions that thrive across over 21, 000 difference-makers in our workplace. 

Work Experience

Minimum Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Automation Engineering, Software Engineering, Computer Science, or related field. 
 - Minimum 5 years of PLC software development experience. 
 - Strong hands-on experience with: Omron / Siemens / LS PLC
 - Experience with HMI development (Pro-face, MXon, M2I or equivalent). 
 - Knowledge of industrial communication protocols: Ethernet/IP, Modbus TCP/RTU, Profinet, EtherCAT
 - Experience in troubleshooting and debugging industrial automation systems. 
 - Ability to communicate effectively in an international engineering environment

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with semiconductor equipment, gas delivery systems, chemical delivery systems, or process equipment. 
 - Experience supporting customer sites, installation, and commissioning activities. 
 - Experience with SCADA or industrial software platforms. 
 - Knowledge of functional safety and industrial cybersecurity. 
 - Experience leading technical projects or system architecture reviews. 
 - Experience collaborating with global engineering organizations.

data.title: Staff Engineer - AI Platform
data.description:
About HighLevel: 

HighLevel is an AI-powered business operating system that gives agencies, entrepreneurs and SMBs the infrastructure to build, automate and scale. Today, HighLevel supports SMBs across 150+ countries, fueling community-driven growth rooted in real customer outcomes. 

To date, businesses operating on HighLevel have generated over $7 billion in ecosystem value, demonstrating the impact of shared infrastructure at scale. By centralizing conversations, automation and intelligence into one system, we help businesses move faster, reduce complexity and execute efficiently. 

Behind the platform, HighLevel powers more than 4 billion API hits and 2. 5 billion message events daily. With 250 terabytes of distributed data, 250+ microservices and over 1 million domain names supported, our architecture is built for performance, resilience and long-term scalability. 

Our People

With over 2, 000 team members across 10+ countries, HighLevel operates as a global, remote-first organization built for speed and ownership. We value initiative, clarity and execution, creating space for ambitious people to build systems that support millions of businesses worldwide. Here, innovation thrives, ideas are celebrated and people come first, no matter where they call home. 

Our Impact

Every month, HighLevel enables more than 1. 5 billion messages, 200 million leads and 20 million conversations for the more than 1 million businesses we support. Behind those numbers are real people building independence, expanding opportunity and creating measurable impact. We're proud to be a part of that. 

Learn more about us on our YouTube Channel or Blog Posts . 

About the Role: 

We're looking for a Staff Engineer (AI) to architect and build the agentic systems and AI foundations within our Platform Services team - the team responsible for the shared infrastructure, internal tooling, and core services that other product teams build on. 

This is a deeply hands-on individual contributor role: you will set technical direction, write and review code, and own the design of systems that let HighLevel engineering teams build, ship, and operate AI-driven capabilities reliably at enterprise scale. 

What You'll Build: 

- Production-grade agentic systems - multi-step, tool-using agents with orchestration, planning, memory and context management, and human-in-the-loop controls - for platform automation and internal engineering workflows. 
 - A shared AI platform for product teams: reusable agent frameworks, tool and MCP integrations, an LLM gateway (routing, rate limiting, caching, fallbacks), and prompt/model versioning. Evaluation and observability for AI systems - eval harnesses, tracing of agent runs, and metrics for quality, latency, cost, and safety. 
 - AI-driven engineering practices that improve developer velocity - agentic developer workflows, AI-assisted tooling, and automation of operational toil. 
 - Cloud infrastructure for AI workloads across GCP/AWS, including provisioning, scaling, security, and cost governance for inference and token spend. 

What You'll Drive: 

- Architecture & Scale: Own and evolve the architecture of agentic systems and AI platform services, ensuring they are reliable, extensible, and performant under enterprise-scale load. 
 - AI-First Culture: Set and drive an AI-first culture within the Platform Services team - making AI tools and agentic workflows the default way the team builds and operates. 
 - Reliability & Safety: Build agents that fail safely - with guardrails, scoped permissions, sandboxing, defenses against prompt injection, audit trails, graceful degradation, and clear incident management practices. 
 - Evaluation & Data-Driven Decisions: Establish rigorous evaluation practices - offline evals, regression suites, and production monitoring - so agent behavior is measurable and comparable across model and prompt changes. Use that data to prioritize, evaluate trade-offs, and report on agent quality, platform health, and cost. 
 - Cost & Efficiency: Drive continuous optimization of inference, token, and infrastructure cost without compromising quality or reliability - with measurable, sustained impact. 
 - Technical Leadership & Mentorship: Set technical standards, lead design reviews, mentor engineers, and build a culture of ownership and craftsmanship in AI engineering across the org. 
 - Cross-Functional Collaboration & Communication: Partner closely with product engineering teams, SRE/infra, security, and leadership to align AI platform capabilities with organizational needs, and communicate technical direction, risks, and progress clearly across the org. 

What Success Looks Like: 

- Agentic systems run reliably in production at growing scale, with clear quality, latency, and safety targets that are tracked and met. 
 - Agent changes ship with evals and observability in place, so regressions are caught before customers see them. 
 - Product and platform teams adopt a shared AI platform and see it as a trusted, well-documented foundation to build on. 
 - AI-related costs are optimized and predictable, with clear ownership of spend against usage. 
 - The Platform Services team works AI-first, and engineering teams measurably gain velocity from AI-driven workflows and automation. 
 - Engineers around you grow technically and recognize you as a go-to authority on agentic system design. 

Requirements: 

- 12+ years of overall software engineering experience, including significant time as a senior or staff-level individual contributor. 
 - At least the last 1+ year spent architecting agentic systems in production - designing multi-step, tool-using agents, orchestration, memory and context management, and guardrails, not just integrating LLM APIs. A champion of AI agent orchestration at scale, running many agents and workflows reliably across teams. 
 - AI-first mindset (must have) - actively using AI tools in your own engineering workflow, with the ability to set and drive an AI-first culture within the Platform Services team. 
 - Expert-level proficiency in either Go, Python or Nodejs. 
 - Strong hands-on orientation - comfortable writing and reviewing code, debugging production issues, and going deep on architecture. Candidates in a purely managerial (non-hands-on) role for the last 1+ year will not be considered a fit. 
 - Strong working knowledge of LLM application fundamentals - tool/function calling, MCP, retrieval and context engineering, prompt and model management, and evaluation methodologies for non-deterministic systems. 
 - Strong observability fundamentals, with deep experience in AI observability - tracing agent runs and monitoring quality, latency, cost, and safety in production - using tools like Prometheus, Grafana, ELK/OpenSearch, or equivalent. 
 - Strong understanding of distributed systems architecture - consistency, availability, fault tolerance, scaling patterns, and trade-offs at scale. 
 - Cost-aware by design - a track record of measurable cost optimization in an enterprise cloud environment, including managing LLM inference and token spend through model routing, caching, and budgets. 
 - Practical experience with GCP and/or AWS service management - provisioning, scaling, IAM, networking, and cost governance. 
 - Prior experience working as an individual contributor on platform teams for at least 3+ years, at enterprise scale. 
 - Proven ability to lead technically without authority - writing design docs, driving cross-team alignment, and mentoring engineers. 
 - A data-driven approach to decision-making, prioritization, and performance reporting. 
 - Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to influence both technical and non-technical stakeholders. 
 - Good to have: open-source contributions or published work on agentic systems.

 - Deliver and review technical design, code and documentation. 
 - Drive ongoing efficiency and reliability improvements through design and automation: availability, performance, scaling, monitoring and capacity.

What You Will Need

 - Provide initiative and technical leadership to build reliable, high-quality solutions that scale with Uber's engineering processes. 
 - Deliver and review technical design, code and documentation. 
 - Drive ongoing efficiency and reliability improvements through design and automation: availability, performance, scaling, monitoring and capacity. 
 - Manage upstream and downstream dependencies, collaborate with other engineering teams
 - Coach and mentor engineers to help with their learning and career growth
 - Define standards in Coding, testing, monitoring, and alerting systems and lead team to complete them. 

Basic Qualification

- BS or MS degree in computer science, similar technical field of study or equivalent practical experience.

 - Coding chops, clean, elegant, bug-free code in languages like JS, Java, GO

 - Strong desire to learn and grow, while building the best-in-class systems
 - Experienced at Cross Team Communication: Strong flair for effective communication and collaboration - you know when to push on and when to step back. We work closely with several groups and supporting these other groups is a key part of scaling our business.

We welcome people from all backgrounds who seek the opportunity to help build a future where everyone and everything can move independently. If you have the curiosity, passion, and collaborative spirit, work with us, and let's move the world forward, together.

 - Product Mindset: A strong "product-first" approach with a critical eye for UI/UX detail, user-centric problem solving, and overall app performance.

Role Description

This is a people-manager and portfolio-delivery role accountable for people, capacity, portfolio delivery, quality oversight, and escalation. GCF6A owns project/molecule MDR strategy and integrated outputs; GCF5 owns study MDR strategy and delivery unless assigned otherwise; GCF4 performs assigned primary reviews. The Medical Monitor retains accountable medical oversight and medical decisions, while the Clinical Scientist supports study scientific execution. A typical planning span is approximately 12-15 direct reports where portfolio complexity, capability, and coverage needs permit; adjust for risk, workload peaks, or specialized expertise. 

Roles And Responsibilities

- Lead and develop the MDR team; set clear expectations and maintain a fair, inclusive, accountable, and scientifically rigorous working environment. 
 - Own hiring, onboarding, goal setting, performance management, development planning, succession, readiness, recognition, retention, and appropriate performance intervention for direct reports. 
 - Translate portfolio demand into transparent capacity and allocation decisions using study complexity, phase, exposure, review strategy, milestone clustering, quality history, and demonstrated capability. 
 - Assign and rebalance MDR capacity across studies, projects, molecules, and adjacent therapeutic areas; resolve competing priorities and manage delivery risk. 
 - Assure portfolio delivery through oversight of quality, timeliness, milestone readiness, risk escalation, and fit-for-purpose MDR controls without duplicating L6A or L5 technical accountability. 
 - Review portfolio-level performance and risk indicators, identify repeated or systemic issues, and sponsor proportionate corrective or capability actions with accountable partners. 
 - Ensure that teams provide scientifically strong IDRP contributions and appropriate medical-interpretation inputs to Medical Monitoring Plans through the designated L6A and L5 roles. 
 - Lead portfolio adoption of ACT FAST, risk-based review, approved analytics, visualization, and digital capabilities; use evidence to sustain effective practices and stop low-value activity. 
 - Build effective relationships with TA/CDD and GDO leaders, Medical Monitors, Clinical Scientists, Medical Monitoring Groups, study teams, Data Management, Safety, Clinical Operations, Biostatistics, Quality, Regulatory, HR, and technology partners. 
 - Establish governance and communication cadences for portfolio capacity, delivery health, quality, risks, dependencies, and decisions. 
 - Escalate material participant, quality, delivery, compliance, or capacity risks promptly and ensure actions have clear owners and follow-through. 
 - Support audit and inspection readiness by ensuring role clarity, consistent practices, and availability of MDR evidence. 
 - Use portfolio insights to guide workforce planning, capability development, succession, and future hiring priorities. 
 - Responsible for people training, mentoring, and development as per career framework and supporting in individual development plan of each employee, with driving timely feedback
 - Responsible for team's performance management as per Amgen's MAP process and calibration. 
 - Responsibility for portfolio or program delivery capacity decisions, resource projection and efficient management, quality oversight, and senior stakeholder engagement. 
 - Role model Amgen culture and drive the same within the department
 - Responsible for participating in cross functional initiatives, process improvement, driving leadership activities, driving active change management and technology application advancement in MDR process
 - Owns MDR Business Process as assigned and drives operational implementation
 - Drives Scientific discussion (e. g. Journal Club) within TAs and encourage scientific and technical expertise for operation execution and efficiency

STAKEHOLDER RELATIONSHIPS AND ROLE BOUNDARIES

Acts as the MDR portfolio-delivery partner for TA/CDD and GDO leadership and maintains effective links with Medical Monitoring Groups and study teams. The Associate Director assures that the right MDR capability is deployed and that delivery and quality risks are addressed. The role does not take over accountable medical decisions, project/molecule MDR technical strategy, or study MDR strategy from the designated roles. 

Basic Qualifications And Experience

- MD/Diploma with 8-10 years of relevant experience
 - MBBS from an MCI/NMC-recognized medical institution in India with 10-12 years of relevant experience
 - Substantial experience in clinical development, medical data review, medical monitoring, pharmacovigilance, clinical operations, or a closely related regulated environment. 
 - Demonstrated readiness to lead people, including evidence of setting expectations, giving feedback, supporting development, planning work, and addressing issues fairly. Prior formal line-management experience is preferred; first-time managers may be considered with a structured transition and support plan. 
 - Demonstrated responsibility for portfolio or program delivery, capacity decisions, resource projection and efficient management, quality oversight, and senior stakeholder engagement. 
 - Ability to interpret medical-review risks and make fair, evidence-based people and resource decisions. 

Placement reflects the breadth of portfolio accountability, leadership scope, complexity, and demonstrated competencies required for the role. 

Preferred Qualifications And Experience

- MBBS, MD/Diploma, or another relevant medical or clinical qualification. 
 - Experience managing medically or scientifically qualified professionals across multiple studies, projects, or therapeutic areas. 
 - Experience with RBQM, integrated data review, analytics, Spotfire, digital adoption, and inspection readiness. 
 - Experience partnering with Clinical Development, Medical Monitoring, Data Management, Safety, Quality, and HR. 
 - Experience leading organizational change, workforce planning, or capability build in a regulated environment.

Why Consider this Opportunity?

 - Drive measurable improvements in customer experience, operational quality, and partner performance across diverse functions. 
 - Own end-to-end quality and process excellence initiatives with direct influence on strategic CX outcomes and business metrics.

Our trading capability, deep market knowledge, global portfolio and end-to-end integration within Shell creates opportunities to deliver value for our customers and for Shell across Upstream, Downstream, Integrated Gas and New Energies. Through our main trading offices in London, Houston, Singapore, Dubai and Rotterdam we trade crude oil, natural gas, LNG, electricity, refined products, chemical feedstocks and environmental products. With more than 125 distribution terminals and hundreds of outside supply points in around 25 countries, our supply and distribution infrastructure is well positioned to make deliveries around the world. Trading is at the centre of the Shell's Energy Transition and Decarbonisation plans, working closely with New Energies and the wider business to develop lower carbon solutions, driven through technology and data. 

The Trading and Supply CC is a delivery organization in IDE that enables business products to deliver value faster than before via long enduring teams who retain deep business domain knowledge and expertise. Together we will work to deliver customer focused solutions, effectively manage risk and controls and act as leaders in the energy transition through developing integrated power and trading capabilities. If you would like to be at the centre of Shell's future, join our Trading & Supply Competency Centre and play a part in the delivery of our energy future. 

What's the role?

You bring your skills and experience to Shell and in return you work with talented, committed people on one of the most important challenges facing our planet. data.title: Senior Full-Stack Engineer (Java+React)
data.description:
Multitude is hiring a Senior Full-Stack Engineer (Java + React) to help design and build its Loan Management System end to end, from Java/Spring services and Kafka integrations to the React interfaces used by partners and operations teams. We're looking for an experienced engineer with a strong background in lending technology and LMS/LOS implementations, who writes reliable production code and uses AI coding assistants thoughtfully as part of their daily work. 

Responsibilities

- Together with Lead Engineer and Tech Lead, design and build the LMS end-to-end - Java/Spring backend services and React operations/partner UIs - on the latest technologies. 
 - Deliver production-grade code: pull-request reviews, high test coverage and production observability (Kibana, Elastic APM, Prometheus/Grafana). 
 - Work effectively with AI coding assistants - use them to accelerate implementation, review, refactoring, and documentation while remaining accountable for the correctness, security, and maintainability of everything that ships. 
 - Contribute to the spec-first workflow: read and refine feature specifications, break specs into JIRA stories, flag missing scope early. 
 - Own features across the stack - from Kafka event contracts and REST endpoints down to the React screens partner staff and Bhawana operators actually use. 
 - Go the extra mile: stay current on tooling and techniques (including AI tooling), share what you learn, and push technical improvements proactively. 

Required Skills And Experience

- 5+ years building production systems in Java (17+) and the Spring ecosystem (Boot, REST, JPA/Data, Security, Integration). You know why @Transactional is more subtle than it looks, you have debugged classloader and GC issues in anger, and you can reason about JVM behaviour under load. 
 - 3+ years of hands-on React user interfaces - not prototypes, not admin screens generated from a template. You understand rendering, state, forms at scale, accessibility, and the cost of every dependency you add. 
 - Demonstrable fluency with AI coding assistants (e. g. GitHub Copilot, Claude, Cursor, Codex, or equivalent) as part of your daily workflow - able to prompt effectively, review AI output critically, and know when not to trust it. 
 - Clean-code habits: patterns/anti-patterns awareness, well-structured, testable, maintainable, documented code. 
 - Distributed-systems maturity - you reason about failure modes, retries, backoff, poison messages, and what happens when the network partitions during a disbursement. You've built and operated microservices in production and know when not to use them. 
 - Solid grasp of REST API design, integrations, refactoring, secure coding, APM and troubleshooting. 
 - understanding JIRA and able to write specifications there with Acceptance Criteria. 
 - Hands-on experience with asynchronous messaging (Kafka or other)
