data.description:
Job Description

Job Summary

NextPower is seeking an experienced Senior Manufacturing Test Engineer to lead the transition of New Product Introduction (NPI) test solutions into stable, scalable, high-volume mass production test systems. This role is responsible for developing robust manufacturing test architectures, optimizing yield performance, and deploying standardized test systems across global Contract Manufacturers (CMs). 

The ideal candidate will drive Design for Test (DFT), oversee tester development through Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT) and Site Acceptance Testing (SAT), and ensure production test systems are capacity-optimized, change-controlled, and scalable to meet aggressive production yield and ramp targets. 

Key Responsibilities

- Lead manufacturing test strategy development during NPI to ensure seamless transition into high-volume production environments. 
 - Partner with NPI Test Design Engineering to drive Design for Test (DFT) improvements that enhance coverage, reduce cycle time, and improve yield. 
 - Define and implement test coverage strategy across ICT, BFT, and SFT platforms to ensure robust product validation. 
 - Collaborate with Test Design team and tester suppliers during tester development, qualification, FAT, and SOP phases. 
 - Develop scalable test architectures capable of supporting high-volume manufacturing ramps and long-term production growth. 
 - Analyze installed tester capacity and forecast future capacity needs to support demand allocation plans. 
 - Optimize test cycle time, throughput, and station balancing to meet takt time and production targets with our CM partners. 
 - Lead structured change management processes for ECO/ECN product revisions, firmware updates, and test program releases. 
 - Evaluate impact of product updates on test coverage, cycle time, yield, and capacity, ensuring controlled global rollouts. 
 - Drive continuous test program optimization to reduce cycle time, eliminate non-value-added steps, and improve yield while maintaining full coverage. 
 - Maintain strict version control, validation, and regression testing processes for all test program changes prior to production release. 
 - Deploy and qualify standardized test systems across multiple CMs to ensure global consistency. 
 - Establish preventive maintenance, calibration, and long-term support strategies to ensure sustained tester performance and uptime. 
 - Monitor and improve First Pass Yield (FPY) and Final Yield (FY) across global manufacturing sites. 
 - Analyze test data to identify trends, systemic failures, and yield detractors, lead root cause and corrective action initiatives. 
 - Manage tester inventory, spare parts strategy, and documentation including BOMs, schematics, block diagrams, and electrical drawings. 
 - Maintain governance of test sequences and ensure compliance with quality management systems and regulatory standards. 
 - Develop dashboards and executive-level reporting to provide real-time production and yield visibility. 

Qualifications

- Bachelor's or Master's degrees in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related field. 
 - 5+ years of experience in manufacturing test engineering within power electronics or related high-volume industries. 
 - Experience transitioning NPI programs into high-volume mass production. 
 - Strong expertise in ICT, BFT, and SFT test methodologies. 
 - Demonstrated experience scaling test operations across multiple global manufacturing sites. 
 - Proficiency in at least one mainstream programming language: C#, Python, or C++. 
 - Proficiency with test automation platforms such as Python, LabVIEW, and TestStand. 
 - Ability to read schematics, identify test point requirements, and perform Design for Test (DFT) analysis. 
 - Experience with Quality Management tools and methodologies: PFMEA, PPAP, APQP, QRQC. 
 - Experience working with global contract manufacturers. 
 - Excellent problem-solving, leadership, and cross-functional communication skills. 

At Nextpower, we are driving the global energy transition with an integrated clean energy technology platform that combines intelligent structural, electrical, and digital solutions for utility-scale power plants. Our comprehensive portfolio enables faster project delivery, higher performance, and greater reliability, helping our customers capture the full value of solar power. Our talented worldwide teams are redefining how solar power plants are designed, built, and operated every day with smart technology, data-driven insights, and advanced automation. Together, we're building the foundation for the world's next generation of clean energy infrastructure. 

We are Nextpower

data.title: Senior Cloud Platform Engineer
data.description:
The Senior Cloud Platform Engineer designs, builds, and operates automated, secure, and scalable cloud platforms across AWS and Azure for enterprise clients. This is a hands-on engineering role - owning landing zone architecture, Infrastructure as Code, CI/CD pipelines, container platforms, and observability - with the technical depth to troubleshoot production issues and the maturity to mentor junior engineers and influence platform standards across client engagements. 

Key Responsibilities

- Platform & Landing Zone Engineering
 - Design and build secure, multi-account/multi-subscription landing zones on AWS (Control Tower, Organizations) and Azure (Landing Zones, Management Groups). 
 - Implement network architecture - VPCs/VNets, transit gateways, hybrid connectivity, DNS, and security group / NSG design. 
 - Define and enforce account/subscription governance guardrails, tagging standards, and cost controls. 
 - Infrastructure as Code & Automation
 - Author and maintain infrastructure using Terraform (primary) and/or CloudFormation / ARM / Bicep, structured as reusable modules. 
 - Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, GitLab CI, or Jenkins) for both infrastructure and application deployments. 
 - Drive GitOps practices for environment provisioning and change management. 
 - Containers & Orchestration
 - Deploy, operate, and troubleshoot Kubernetes clusters (EKS, AKS) including networking (CNI), ingress, autoscaling, and RBAC. 
 - Support containerization of legacy and modernized workloads in partnership with application and modernization teams. 
 - Implement service mesh, secrets management, and workload identity patterns where applicable. 
 - Observability & Reliability
 - Implement monitoring, logging, and alerting using CloudWatch, Azure Monitor, Prometheus/Grafana, or equivalent. 
 - Define and track SLIs/SLOs for platform services; participate in on-call rotation and incident response. 
 - Conduct root-cause analysis for production issues and drive permanent fixes, not just workarounds. 
 - Security & Compliance
 - Implement identity and access management (IAM roles/policies, Azure AD/Entra ID RBAC), least-privilege access, and secrets management (Secrets Manager, Key Vault, HashiCorp Vault). 
 - Embed security controls into pipelines (SAST/DAST, image scanning, policy-as-code with tools such as OPA/Sentinel). 
 - Support compliance requirements relevant to client engagements, including DPDP Act 2023, ISO 27001, and client-specific regulatory frameworks under Minfy's Kavach360 programme. 
 - Cost & Operational Efficiency
 - Monitor and optimize cloud spend using native cost tools (Cost Explorer, Azure Cost Management) and rightsizing recommendations. 
 - Identify automation opportunities to reduce manual operational toil across managed environments. 
 - Client & Cross-Functional Engagement
 - Work directly with client engineering and infrastructure teams as a trusted technical resource on managed services and migration engagements. 
 - Partner with the MiMo and Cloud Advisory teams to implement platforms that support migration and modernization roadmaps. 
 - Produce clear runbooks, architecture diagrams, and platform documentation. 
 - Mentorship & Technical Contribution
 - Mentor junior and mid-level platform engineers; review their IaC and pipeline contributions. 
 - Contribute reusable modules, scripts, and accelerators to Minfy's internal platform engineering toolkit. 
 - Participate in architecture reviews and champion platform engineering best practices across the BU. 

Required Qualifications

- Experience
 - 5-8 years of experience in cloud infrastructure, platform engineering, DevOps, or Site Reliability Engineering roles. 
 - Demonstrated hands-on experience operating production workloads on both AWS and Azure (multi-cloud experience required). 
 - Core Technical Skills
 - Strong hands-on expertise with Terraform for multi-cloud Infrastructure as Code. 
 - Production experience with Kubernetes (EKS and/or AKS) - deployment, troubleshooting, and day-2 operations. 
 - Strong CI/CD skills - designing and building end-to-end pipelines (GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, GitLab CI, or Jenkins) with automated testing, security gates, and deployment strategies (blue-green, canary, rolling). 
 - Strong containerisation skills - Docker image build and optimization, multi-stage builds, container registries (ECR, ACR), and container security scanning. 
 - Scripting proficiency in Python, Bash, or Go for automation and tooling. 
 - Solid networking fundamentals - VPC/VNet design, routing, DNS, load balancing, and hybrid connectivity. 
 - Security & Governance
 - Working knowledge of IAM/RBAC design, secrets management, and policy-as-code. 
 - Familiarity with security and compliance frameworks relevant to enterprise cloud environments (Well-Architected Framework, ISO 27001, DPDP Act 2023 or equivalent). 
 - Collaboration & Communication
 - Comfortable working directly with client technical stakeholders and cross-functional Minfy teams (advisory, MiMo, security). 
 - Able to produce clear technical documentation and communicate incident/root-cause findings effectively. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Certifications: AWS Certified Solutions Architect / DevOps Engineer, Microsoft Certified: Azure Administrator / DevOps Engineer Expert, or CKA/CKAD. 
 - Experience with GitOps tooling (ArgoCD, Flux). 
 - Exposure to service mesh technologies (Istio, Linkerd). 
 - Prior experience in a partner/SI or managed services environment (AWS Premier/Advanced Partner or Microsoft Solutions Partner). 
 - Familiarity with FinOps practices and cloud cost optimization. 

KEY COMPETENCIES

- Ownership - treats production platforms as their own; drives issues to permanent resolution. 
 - Automation-first mindset - defaults to codifying repeatable work rather than manual intervention. 
 - Technical depth with pragmatism - balances best practice with delivery timelines and client constraints. 
 - Collaboration - works effectively across client teams, internal BUs, and junior engineers. 
 - Continuous learning - stays current across a fast-moving, multi-cloud technology landscape.

Cloud Infrastructure (AWS)

and Amazon Bedrock (foundation model access, guardrails, provisioned throughput).

DevSecOps

scanning, dependency and IaC scanning in pipelines.

Observability & SRE

improvements.

AI-first platform.

• CI/CD pipeline design and implementation at scale; container image best practices. 

• Hands-on DevSecOps: pipeline-integrated scanning, secrets management, IAM, and hardening. 

• Experience running AI/ML workloads on AWS - SageMaker, Bedrock, and/or deploying ML models to

EKS/Kubernetes (GPU scheduling, model serving). 

• Strong communicator who documents runbooks and works with product + AI teams without needing to be

managed. 

Good to Have

• FinOps experience - AWS cost dashboards, Savings Plans/Spot strategy, unit economics of LLM inference. 

• KServe/Seldon/Triton/vLLM, Ray on Kubernetes, MLflow, feature stores. 

• ArgoCD/Flux GitOps, Istio/service mesh, EKS Anywhere or hybrid cloud. 

• EdTech/LMS/high-traffic consumer platform experience; experience in a listed-company/compliance

environment. 

• Certifications: AWS DevOps Engineer Professional, AWS Solutions Architect Associate/Professional, CKA, 

Kubernetes Security Specialist (CKS).

Thales is a global technology leader trusted by governments, institutions, and enterprises to tackle their most demanding challenges. From quantum applications and artificial intelligence to cybersecurity and 6G innovation, our solutions empower critical decisions rooted in human intelligence. data.description:
We are seeking a Fraud Operations QA & Enablement analyst to join our 24×7 fraud operations function and help protect our customers through rigorous quality standards, transaction auditing, and operational enablement. 

You will serve as the quality anchor and "connective tissue" of our fraud team. You won't just be clearing alerts; you will drive high decision standards across the entire function. Your mission is to establish and maintain robust QA frameworks, ensure every analyst makes high-quality, compliant decisions, and turn audit insights into actionable training, SOP updates, and process improvements

What You'll Do

- Quality Assurance & Auditing (Primary Focus): Perform regular, comprehensive audits of analyst transaction decisions, risk scores, and case notes to ensure consistency, accuracy, and strict adherence to compliance standards. 
 - Root-Cause & Pattern Analysis: Analyze QA audit data to identify recurring decision errors, knowledge gaps, and emerging fraud typologies, transforming findings into actionable team insights. 
 - Calibration & Coaching: Lead regular quality calibration sessions for the team and provide constructive feedback and targeted coaching to analysts to elevate decision quality. 
 - Knowledge Architecture & SOPs: Own and maintain the central "Source of Truth" (Knowledge Base) for Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), updating guidelines based on QA findings and evolving fraud tactics. 
 - Training & Onboarding: Design and deliver onboarding modules for new hires and ongoing "delta training" to address quality trends and process updates. 
 - Process Excellence & System Gap Analysis: Monitor team-wide quality metrics and SLAs. Act as a feedback loop between Operations and Product/Engineering to fix system limitations causing manual error or security risks. 
 - Operational Visibility: Aggregate and report QA scores, error trends, and compliance metrics to provide leadership with clear visibility into operational health. 

What We're Looking For

- At least 5 years of experience in fraud operations, transaction monitoring, payments risk, or trust and safety. This must include hands-on experience developing Quality Assurance (QA) frameworks, sampling strategies, conducting audits, and coaching analysts. 
 - Proven expertise in evaluating transaction reviews, case documentation, and fraud determinations against established compliance and operational standards. 
 - Strong background in building or maintaining decision frameworks, QA scorecards, and SOP documentation. 
 - Hands-on background leveraging artificial intelligence technologies to streamline, enhance, and scale manual quality auditing workflows. 
 - Comfort reviewing complex transactions and conducting outbound customer verifications when needed. 
 - Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with a track record of delivering constructive feedback and leading training sessions. 
 - High attention to detail and strong analytical skills to translate QA data into operational improvements. 
 - Ability to work in a high-volume, fast-paced operational environment while maintaining high quality standards. 
 - Willingness and flexibility to work across three rotating shifts as part of a 24×7 operations team. 
 - Experience in fintech, travel, payments, or e-commerce environments is strongly preferred.

The Role

As an FCT Lead within the Physical Design organisation, you will lead Full Chip Timing (FCT) execution and timing signoff activities for complex SoC and subsystem designs. You will work closely with Architecture, Design, PD, STA, DFT, CAD and Methodology teams to achieve first-pass silicon success and deliver timing closure for industry-leading products

The Person

A successful candidate will work with senior silicon design engineers. The candidate will be highly accurate and detail-oriented, possessing good communication and problem-solving skills.

- Lead the Full Chip Timing team responsible for timing constraints development and timing signoff. 
 - Own end-to-end timing closure and signoff for SoC and subsystem integration projects. 
 - Define, develop and validate SDC constraints, clocks and timing methodologies. 
 - Drive timing convergence across synthesis, P&R, CTS, route and post-route ECO stages. 
 - Partner with Architecture and STA teams to establish timing budgets, statistical timing targets and signoff criteria. Analyze and manage advanced-node timing margins including LVF, SSTA, OCV/AOCV/POCV and variation-aware signoff methodologies. 
 - Lead timing ECO planning and execution to ensure on-time tapeout. 
 - Collaborate with CAD and EDA vendors to improve timing closure flows, automation and methodologies. 
 - Mentor engineers and provide technical leadership for timing closure activities across multiple projects.

 - 14+ years of experience in Physical Design, Static Timing Analysis, Constraints Development and Timing Signoff.

Full Chip Timing Closure

STA Signoff

Timing Constraints (SDC)

Timing ECO Methodologies

Advanced Node Timing Signoff

Clock Architecture and Clock Implementation

MCMM Timing Analysis

DFT Timing and MBIST Timing Verification

Hands-on experience with Synopsys PrimeTime (PT) and GCA. 

Experience with Fusion Compiler and/or ICC2 is highly desirable. 

Strong understanding of floorplanning, placement, CTS and routing interactions with timing. 

Proficiency in Tcl, Perl, Shell and Python scripting

data.description:

Join a team of passionate thinkers, innovators, and dreamers - and help us connect people and build communities to create economic opportunity for all. 

Job Type: Full-time

About The Team

Traffic Engineering powers secure, scalable, highly available traffic systems that support eBay's global commerce platform. We build and operate traffic management and security capabilities across edge and service layers, including PoP strategy, caching, Kubernetes networking, and reliability improvements based on monitoring insights. 

Role Summary

As a Traffic Engineering Architect, you will own architecture and technical direction across eBay's traffic engineering platform, spanning traffic management, load balancing, service connectivity, PoP/caching optimization, and traffic security (rate limiting, bot mitigation, etc. ). You will lead cross-team design, guide execution on critical initiatives, and drive measurable improvements in latency, availability, resilience, and security. 

Key Responsibilities

- Define architecture and technical strategy for global traffic systems: traffic management, load balancing, service connectivity, PoP optimization, caching, and traffic security controls. 
 - Architect and deliver rate limiting and bot mitigation solutions across edge/service layers in partnership with Security. 
 - Design and build high-performance, low-latency distributed systems using C/C++ and Go (Java in relevant components as needed). 
 - Drive Kubernetes networking and platform patterns at scale, including CNI integrations, service mesh, IPAM, and production-grade deployment models. 
 - Own technical tradeoffs across performance, scalability, reliability, security, operability, maintainability, and delivery timelines. 
 - Establish/advance observability and engineering metrics; use production signals to improve SLOs, reduce incidents, and increase efficiency. 
 - Lead operational excellence: incident prevention, resiliency design, capacity/performance tuning, and automated remediation where appropriate. 
 - Align roadmaps and execution across Product, Infrastructure, SRE/Operations, and Security; resolve cross-team dependencies and drive technical consensus. 
 - Mentor senior engineers/tech leads through architecture reviews, design reviews, and code reviews; raise engineering standards and consistency. 
 - Contribute to innovation via open-source engagement, patents, and forward-looking exploration relevant to traffic systems. 

Required Qualifications

- Bachelor's or Master's degree or equivalent experience in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field (or equivalent practical experience). 
 - 15+ years of software engineering experience with significant depth in networking/traffic engineering, distributed systems, and/or cyber security. 
 - Strong proficiency in C/C++ and Go (Java acceptable/valuable for specific subsystems); experience building production-grade, high-performance systems. 
 - Deep knowledge of Linux networking, traffic management fundamentals, and systems performance optimization. 
 - Strong experience with Kubernetes and cloud-native infrastructure at scale. 
 - Proven experience designing secure, scalable, observable distributed platforms and operating them in production. 
 - Demonstrated cross-team technical leadership: driving architecture across multiple systems, influencing partners, and delivering large initiatives. 
 - Strong communication, mentoring, and technical decision-making skills in ambiguous environments. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with Envoy, service mesh, control plane/data plane architectures, NGINX/HAProxy, SDN, eBPF, or comparable technologies. 
 - Experience with rate limiting, bot management, abuse prevention, and traffic security patterns (edge and service). 
 - Background in PoP design, caching strategies, and internet-scale traffic optimization. 
 - Vendor tool integration experience and operation in globally distributed environments. 
 - Open-source contributions, patents, or externally visible technical leadership. 

What Success Looks Like

- Improved global traffic platform outcomes (latency, throughput, availability, resilience, security). 
 - Reduced incident frequency/impact through architecture, observability, and operational rigor. 
 - Strong architectural alignment across teams with higher engineering quality and execution velocity. 

Additional Details

eBay is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, and disability, or other legally protected status. data.title: Engineering Manager (Backend)
data.description:
Engineering Manager - Backend

Experience: 5-8 years

Reports to: 

Head of Engineering

About the role

You will own backend services for our digital lending platform, which runs both our own NBFC and an LSP that routes loans across multiple lending partners. You will lead one or more backend pods across Onboarding & KYC, Decision Engine, Disbursal & Collection(LMS, Collections CRM) and Payments. You stay hands-on (roughly 40-50% coding and design reviews) while building and growing the team. 

What you will do

- Own architecture, delivery and uptime for your pods' services, from design doc toproduction. 
 - Design systems that serve both LSP and NBFC roles cleanly: multi-lender routing andlender-specific configs. 
 - Build for money-safety: idempotent APIs, double-entry style ledgers, exactly-oncedisbursal and debit processing, daily reconciliation. 
 - Integrate and manage third parties: bureaus (CIBIL, Experian, CRIF, Equifax), CKYC/KRA, Aadhaar/PAN/Video KYC vendors, Account Aggregators, NPCI/sponsorbanks, payment gateways and payout partners. 
 - Bake compliance into the product with Product, Risk and Compliance: RBI DigitalLending rules (KFS, APR disclosure, cooling-off, direct-to-borrower disbursal andrepayment, grievance redressal), KYC Master Directions, fair-practice collections, and DPDP Act consent and data localisation. 
 - Set engineering standards: code reviews, testing strategy, observability, on-call, incident post-mortems, security reviews and audit readiness (RBI IT framework, ISO27001/SOC 2 where applicable). 
 - Hire, mentor and retain engineers; run 1: 1s, goal-setting and performance reviews; grow SSEs into tech leads. 

What you bring

- 5-8 years of backend engineering, including 1. 5+ years leading a team or owning acritical service end to end. 
 - Strong in at least one of Java/Kotlin (Spring Boot), Go, or Node. js/TypeScript; comfortable reviewing the others. 
 - Microservices and event-driven design: REST/gRPC, Kafka/RabbitMQ/SQS, sagas, retries, dead-letter handling, distributed locks. 
 - Databases: PostgreSQL/MySQL at depth (transactions, isolation, indexing, partitioning), Redis, plus a document store; data modelling for financial records. 
 - Cloud (AWS/GCP/Azure): containers, Kubernetes/ECS, CI/CD, infra-as-code basics, secrets management, encryption at rest and in transit. 
 - Production experience in fintech, lending, payments, banking or insurance in India. 
 - Clear written communication: design docs, RFCs, incident reports. 

Nice to have

- Built or scaled an LMS, loan origination system, BRE, or collections platform. 
 - Hands-on with eNACH, UPI AutoPay, NACH/ECS, IMPS/NEFT/RTGS payouts, or PGintegrations. 
 - Rules engines (Drools or in-house), workflow engines (Temporal, Camunda) or MLmodel serving. 
 - Experience going through an RBI inspection, statutory audit, or partner-bank techdue diligence.

data.description:

Primary Job Responsibilities

We are seeking an experienced Senior Site Reliability Engineer (SRE) to ensure the reliability, scalability, performance, and operational stability of our enterprise Contact Center platforms. 

The ideal candidate will have strong hands-on experience with Genesys Cloud, Genesys Cloud APIs, AWS services (particularly EventBridge), contact center technologies, database systems, and observability tools such as Grafana and Sherlock. 

This role will focus on proactive monitoring, incident management, automation, performance optimization, and continuous improvement of mission-critical contact center services and integrations. 

Key Responsibilities

 - Develop and maintain dashboards covering service health, API latency, error rates, throughput, and availability. 
 - Analyze logs, metrics, and distributed traces to identify performance bottlenecks and recurring production issues. 
 - Implement proactive alerting and anomaly detection to reduce Mean Time to Detect (MTTD) and Mean Time to Resolve (MTTR). 
 - Correlate events across Genesys Cloud, AWS, databases, and integrated services to identify root causes. 
 - Database & Data Reliability
 - Working knowledge of NuData and NuGraph databases or data platforms. 
 - Experience investigating data inconsistencies, missing records, processing delays, and integration failures. 
 - Ability to develop and execute queries for troubleshooting, reconciliation, and operational analysis. 
 - Monitor data processing pipelines, ingestion failures, and database performance. 
 - Collaborate with data engineering teams to ensure data integrity, consistency, and availability across contact center systems. 

Required Qualifications

- Minimum 6+ years of hands-on experience in Site Reliability Engineering, production engineering, or a closely related reliability-focused role. 
 - Strong hands-on experience with Genesys Cloud APIs, including API authentication, analytics queries, conversation details, routing, and platform integrations. 
 - Solid understanding of enterprise contact center technologies, including ACD, IVR, CTI, voice, digital channels, and interaction routing. 
 - Experience working with AWS, particularly EventBridge and event-driven architectures. 
 - Knowledge of NuData and NuGraph databases or internal data platforms. 
 - Familiarity with Grafana and Sherlock for monitoring, observability, and troubleshooting. 
 - Strong troubleshooting skills across distributed applications, APIs, cloud services, and data integrations. 
 - Experience with scripting and automation using Python, Shell, or equivalent languages. 
 - Solid understanding of REST APIs, JSON, OAuth 2. 0, and asynchronous integration patterns. 
 - Demonstrated experience in incident management, root cause analysis, performance tuning, and production support. 
 - Strong communication, analytical thinking, and cross-functional collaboration skills. 

Preferred Qualifications

 - Experience with Terraform, Jenkins, GitHub Actions, or other infrastructure automation and CI/CD tools. 
 - Knowledge of AWS CloudWatch, OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, and distributed tracing. 
 - Experience with load testing, capacity planning, resilience testing, and disaster recovery. 
 - Familiarity with contact center integrations involving CRM, workforce management, recording, quality management, and speech/text analytics platforms. 
 - Experience building operational automation or AI-assisted incident detection and troubleshooting solutions. 

Additional Details

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, and disability, or other legally protected status. •  Experience with Google Analytics, Tag Manager, Hotjar and A/B testing tools. 

•  Understanding of CRO (conversion rate optimization) and technical SEO. 

•  Exposure to AI-assisted development tools to speed up delivery. 

Qualifications and Experience

•  3-4 years of professional experience in website development, with live projects across at least three of the platforms listed above.

•  Good communication skills in English and the ability to explain design and technical choices to non-technical stakeholders. 

•  Ability to manage multiple projects, meet deadlines and work independently as well as in a team. 

•  Attention to detail, a problem-solving mindset and eagerness to keep learning new tools.

Want to join the leader in AI-powered data security?

Seeking an accomplished and strategic Director, Solution Test Engineering to lead our global solution validation and end-to-end customer workflow testing organization. This role will be responsible for ensuring that Company's products and platforms are validated in real-world customer environments and complex enterprise ecosystems before reaching production. 

As organizations increasingly deploy Company across hybrid cloud, cybersecurity, AI, data protection, and modern application environments, solution-level quality has become a key differentiator. This leader will establish and execute the strategy for validating integrated customer solutions spanning product engineering, cloud services, ecosystem partners, hyperscalers, security platforms, enterprise applications, and modern workloads. 

The successful candidate will build and scale a world-class Solution Test Engineering organization that focuses on customer use cases, deployment architectures, interoperability, upgradeability, scalability, resiliency, and business continuity outcomes. 

HOW YOU'LL SPEND YOUR TIME HERE: 

Strategy & Leadership

- Define and execute the long-term vision and strategy for Company's Solution Test Engineering function. 
 - Build, lead, and mentor a globally distributed team of managers, architects, solution test engineers, and automation specialists. 
 - Establish a customer-centric testing strategy focused on real-world deployment scenarios and business outcomes. 
 - Drive organizational excellence through metrics, operational rigor, and continuous improvement. 

Solution Validation

- Lead end-to-end testing of integrated solutions across Data Security, Cyber Resilience, AI, Cloud, SaaS, and Data Management platforms. 
 - Validate customer deployment architectures across on-premises, hybrid cloud, and multi-cloud environments. 
 - Ensure comprehensive coverage of deployment, upgrades, migration, backup, recovery, DR, security, and operational workflows. 
 - Develop validation strategies for complex enterprise ecosystems involving VMware, Kubernetes, cloud platforms, security vendors, databases, and enterprise applications. 

Engineering Excellence

- Drive automation-first practices across solution testing, deployment validation, interoperability certification, and lifecycle testing. 
 - Build scalable test frameworks, simulation environments, and solution labs that accurately represent customer deployments. 
 - Improve release quality through earlier identification of system-level risks and cross-product integration defects. 
 - Establish meaningful KPIs around solution readiness, customer-impacting defects, interoperability coverage, and deployment success rates. 

Cross-Functional Collaboration

- Partner closely with Product Engineering, Product Management, Customer Success, Technical Support, Professional Services, Sales Engineering, and partner organizations. 
 - Influence product architecture and roadmap decisions through test-driven insights and customer deployment learnings. 
 - Collaborate with strategic technology partners to certify and validate integrated solutions. 
 - Serve as a trusted advisor to executive leadership on solution quality, release readiness, and customer adoption risks. 

Customer & Market Focus

- Champion customer experience by proactively validating mission-critical workflows before product releases. 
 - Utilize customer escalations, field feedback, and operational telemetry to continuously improve testing coverage. 
 - Support strategic customer engagements and executive escalations by providing solution quality leadership. 
 - Drive validation for emerging AI-powered capabilities and next-generation customer workloads. 

WE'D LOVE TO TALK TO YOU IF YOU HAVE MANY OF THE FOLLOWING: 

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical discipline. 
 - 15+ years of experience in software engineering, quality engineering, solution engineering, systems engineering, or platform validation. 
 - 5+ years of leadership experience managing managers and large engineering organizations. 
 - Proven track record building and scaling Solution Test Engineering, Systems Validation, Integration Testing, or Customer Validation organizations. 
 - Deep understanding of enterprise storage, backup, disaster recovery, cybersecurity, cloud infrastructure, or data management platforms. 
 - Strong experience with test automation, CI/CD pipelines, observability, and release engineering. 
 - Experience validating solutions across hybrid cloud environments, including AWS, Azure, and GCP. 
 - Demonstrated success collaborating across Product, Engineering, Support, Customer Success, and Executive Leadership teams. 
 - Excellent executive communication and stakeholder management skills. 

WE ARE EXTRA EXCITED IF YOU HAVE MANY OF THE FOLLOWING: 

- Experience in data protection, cyber resilience, enterprise storage, SaaS platforms, or security products. 
 - Hands-on experience with Kubernetes, virtualization platforms, distributed systems, and cloud-native architectures. 
 - Experience building customer-scale solution labs and interoperability certification programs. 
 - Familiarity with AI/ML-enabled platforms and validation of AI-powered workflows. 
 - Track record of improving customer adoption, deployment success, and release quality through systemic solution testing initiatives. 

In-Office Expectations

Employees who are within a reasonable commute (e. g. within a forty-five (45) minute average travel time) work out of our core offices 2-3 days a week of their choosing. 

We strongly prefer candidates who are currently located in or near the designated job location. Candidates outside the area should apply only if they are committed to relocating prior to their start date and have the legal right to work in the job location.

data.title: Sr Staff High-Speed Interface Verification Engineer
data.description:
We Are

Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI-powered products. We deliver industry-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow. 

You Are

You have spent years in the trenches of mixed-signal verification, and you know that the hardest problems live at the boundary where digital meets analog. You are the engineer who can read a waveform, spot the timing violation that three others missed, and trace it back to a testbench assumption made two months ago. You do not just run regressions, you architect verification strategies that catch the subtle, the corner case, the thing that only shows up at 56 Gbps under specific PVT conditions. 

What You'll Be Doing

- Lead verification of high-speed SerDes IP using UVM and SystemVerilog testbenches in mixed-signal co-simulation environments
 - Define, track, and execute verification test plans for PCIE, Ethernet, USB3. 1, and other high-speed protocols from architecture through tapeout
 - Debug simulation failures across digital and analog domains, working directly with waveform viewers, mixed-signal simulators, and protocol analyzers
 - Build and extend UVM testbenches with constrained random sequences, coverage models, and checkers that target real-world corner cases
 - Collaborate daily with digital, analog, and mixed-signal design teams to align verification strategy with design intent and silicon bring-up realities
 - Manage customer escalations by reproducing issues, root-causing failures, and driving resolution with engineering and field teams
 - Drive pre-sales and post-sales technical discussions with customers, translating verification results into confidence and clarity

The Impact You Will Have

- Ensure that SerDes IP shipping to customers meets performance, functionality, and reliability targets before it ever reaches silicon
 - Reduce post-silicon debug cycles by catching mixed-signal integration issues early through rigorous co-simulation and coverage-driven verification
 - Set the technical direction for verification methodology across current and next-generation SerDes products
 - Accelerate customer adoption and satisfaction by resolving escalations quickly and providing clear, actionable technical guidance
 - Mentor and elevate the verification team by establishing best practices, code reviews, and a culture of ownership and quality
 - Contribute directly to Synopsys IP competitiveness by delivering verification environments that scale across protocol variants and process nodes
 - Influence product roadmaps by surfacing verification insights that shape architecture and design decisions upstream

What You'll Need

- MTech or BTech in Electronics, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or equivalent with 7+ years of hands-on verification experience in ASIC or mixed-signal environments
 - Deep expertise in UVM, SystemVerilog, and verification methodologies including constrained random testing, functional coverage, and assertions
 - Proven experience with digital/analog co-simulation tools and methodologies, including AMS simulators and mixed-signal verification flows
 - Working knowledge of high-speed interface protocols such as PCIE, Ethernet, or USB3. 1, including protocol-level verification and compliance
 - Strong understanding of the full ASIC development flow from architecture specification through RTL design, verification, and hardware bring-up
 - Experience writing complex system-level testbenches in UVM, including sequence libraries, scoreboards, and protocol monitors
 - Hands-on experience debugging waveform-level failures in both digital logic and analog circuit behavior

Who You Are

- You can walk into a room with analog designers discussing CDR loop dynamics and digital engineers debating clock domain crossings, and contribute meaningfully to both conversations
 - You have managed customer escalations before and know how to balance urgency with thoroughness, reproducing the issue, isolating root cause, and communicating status without overselling or underselling
 - You lead by setting the example, whether that is writing cleaner testbench code, asking the hard question in a design review, or staying late to close a critical bug before tapeout
 - You make decisions with incomplete information, prioritize what matters, and course-correct when new data arrives without losing momentum
 - You can explain a complex verification failure to a field applications engineer in two sentences and to a design lead in a ten-minute whiteboard session, adjusting depth and framing to the audience
 - You build relationships across functions because you know that the best verification strategies come from understanding what design, applications, and customers actually need

The Team You'll Be Part Of

You will be part of a highly skilled team of digital, analog, and mixed-signal engineers responsible for delivering high-end mixed-signal designs from specification to implementation. This team thrives on collaboration, excellence, and pushing the boundaries of technology to deliver top-notch SerDes products to customers worldwide. 

Rewards and Benefits

We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. Our total rewards include both monetary and non-monetary offerings. Your recruiter will provide more details about the salary range and benefits during the hiring process.

data.description:
Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI-powered products. About the team

You will join a team of Product Engineers and Product Specialists focused on advancing semiconductor design methodologies and delivering measurable value to customers. This team works closely with Application Engineers and R&D to ensure customer needs are met with solutions that are reliable, scalable, and grounded in real-world design challenges. The work you do here protects Synopsys' reputation for excellence in the semiconductor industry and directly influences how customers experience and adopt our DFT toolset. 

What You'll Be Doing

- Work directly with semiconductor customers to understand their DFT challenges, design constraints, and tool flow requirements, then translate those into technical solutions using Synopsys DFT tools including TestMAX Manager
 - Configure, customize, and deploy DFT tool flows tailored to customer designs, including scan insertion, ATPG, and verification using TestMAX ATPG, Formality, and VCS
 - Deliver hands-on technical demos and proof-of-concept implementations that show customers exactly how the toolset solves their specific design and test problems
 - Script automation solutions in TCL, Python, or Perl to streamline customer workflows, improve tool adoption, and address gaps in existing flows
 - Collaborate with Account teams to gather requirements, align on customer priorities, and provide regular technical updates throughout the engagement lifecycle
 - Partner with R&D to surface customer feedback, reproduce tool issues, and influence product roadmap decisions based on real-world design challenges
 - Stay current on DFT methodologies, semiconductor design trends, and emerging test strategies to ensure the solutions you deliver remain relevant and scalable

What You'll Need

- Master's degree (M. Tech or equivalent) in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related technical field
 - 8 to 12 years of hands-on experience in semiconductor design, DFT engineering, or related domains with direct exposure to VLSI design principles and design flows
 - Deep working knowledge of Design for Testability methodologies, including scan insertion, ATPG, and DFT verification techniques
 - Proficiency in scripting languages such as TCL, Python, or Perl for automation, tool customization, and workflow optimization
 - Direct experience with semiconductor design tools and flows, exposure to TestMAX Manager, Formality, VCS, or TestMAX ATPG is a strong plus
 - Demonstrated ability to work directly with customers, gather technical requirements, and deliver solutions that meet both technical and business objectives
 - Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a track record of diagnosing complex tool or design issues and finding practical paths forward

data.title: MTS – ASIC Device Technology & Silicon Yield Engineering
data.description:
Our vision is to transform how the world uses information to enrich life for all. 

Micron Technology is a world leader in innovating memory and storage solutions that accelerate the transformation of information into intelligence, inspiring the world to learn, communicate and advance faster than ever. 

Key Responsibilities

Post-Silicon Yield & RMA Leadership

- Lead end-to-end investigation of silicon yield loss, field returns, customer escalations, and reliability failures. 
 - Drive root-cause analysis for complex silicon issues spanning process, design, test, package, and system interactions. 
 - Develop hypothesis-driven debug strategies and coordinate multi-functional execution. 
 - Own resolution of critical yield and quality issues through containment, corrective actions, and prevention plans. 

Device Technology & Process Interaction Analysis

- Analyze device-level failure mechanisms and process sensitivities impacting ASIC functionality and yield. 
 - Evaluate design-process interactions affecting analog, mixed-signal, memory, high-speed I/O, and PCIe PHY performance. 
 - Partner with foundry teams to understand process variations, excursions, reliability risks, and technology limitations. 
 - Translate silicon learning into actionable design and process improvements. 

Advanced ASIC Design Interaction & Silicon Debug

- Lead root-cause investigations involving design-process interactions affecting SRAM, PCIe PHY, ONFI interfaces, SerDes, analog/mixed-signal circuits, and high-speed digital subsystems. 
 - Analyze silicon failures across transistor, circuit, block, die, package, and system levels. 
 - Drive post-silicon debug activities involving design teams, DFT, product engineering, quality, reliability, foundry, and customer support organizations. 
 - Debug complex failure mechanisms including: 
 - SRAM single-bit and multi-bit failures
 - Read/write margin failures
 - Timing and voltage sensitivity issues
 - PCIe PHY performance degradation
 - Signal integrity and jitter-related failures
 - Yield excursions linked to process variation
 - Field-return and RMA failures
 - Develop silicon characterization plans to isolate process, design, and test-related contributors. 
 - Drive silicon learning feedback into next-generation ASIC architecture and design methodologies. 

Failure Analysis & Physical Debug

- Drive advanced FA activities including: 
 - FIB
 - SEM/TEM
 - EFA
 - OBIRCH
 - LVP
 - Emission microscopy
 - Physical cross-section analysis
 - Correlate failure signatures with design, process, and manufacturing data. 
 - Interpret FA results and convert findings into clear engineering actions. 

multi-functional Technical Leadership

- Lead technical reviews with Product Engineering, DFT, Design, Reliability, Quality, Operations, Foundry, and external partners. 
 - Present complex technical findings to executive leadership. 
 - Influence design and technology roadmaps to improve future product robustness and yield learning. 

Required Qualifications

Education

- Ph. D. or M. S. or equivalent experience in: 
 - Electrical Engineering
 - Materials Science
 - Physics
 - Semiconductor Engineering
 - Related technical rigor
Experience

- 12+ years of semiconductor industry experience. 
 - Strong background in advanced CMOS technology and silicon product development. 
 - Proven success leading yield improvement, RMA, and failure analysis efforts. 
 - Experience working directly with foundries and OSAT partners. 

Technical Expertise

- Deep understanding of CMOS device physics and advanced semiconductor process technologies. 
 - Strong expertise in SRAM architecture, memory design fundamentals, memory margin analysis, and failure mechanisms. 
 - Strong understanding of high-speed interface technologies including PCIe, ONFI, LPDDR, SerDes, and clocking architectures. 
 - Experience with post-silicon debug and characterization of complex ASIC devices. 
 - Expertise in process-design interaction analysis and variation-aware design methodologies. 
 - Strong knowledge of: 
 - Signal Integrity (SI)
 - Power Integrity (PI)
 - Timing closure methodologies
 - Device variability and mismatch analysis
 - Reliability-induced failure mechanisms
 - Experience correlating: 
 - Wafer Acceptance Test (WAT)
 - Electrical test data
 - Yield data
 - Reliability data
 - Failure Analysis results
 - Customer-return information
Preferred Qualifications

- Experience supporting SSD controller, AI accelerator, networking, or high-performance compute ASICs. 
 - Expertise in PCIe PHY, SerDes, memory subsystem, or analog mixed-signal debug. 
 - Track record resolving field-quality issues visible to executive leadership and customers. 
 - Experience applying AI/ML tools for yield analytics, anomaly detection, and RCA acceleration. 
 - Experience mentoring engineering teams and driving multi-site technical investigations. 

Success Metrics

- Reduction in RMA investigation cycle time. 
 - Faster closure of silicon root-cause investigations. 
 - Yield improvement driven through systematic learning. 
 - Improved containment and corrective action effectiveness. 
 - Reduced repeat excursions through preventive actions. 
 - Increased multi-functional execution efficiency. 
 - Enhanced customer confidence through timely and technically sound issue resolution.

data.title: AI Automation -Lead Managed Services Engineer II
data.description:
Summary

Position Summary

Artificial Intelligence & Engineering

AI & Engineering leverages cutting-edge engineering capabilities to help build, deploy, and operate integrated/verticalized sector solutions in software, data, AI, network, and hybrid cloud infrastructure. These insights are powered by engineering for business advantage, helping transform mission-critical operations. 

Join our AI & Engineering team to help transform technology platforms, driving innovation, and help make a significant impact on our clients' achievements. You'll work alongside talented professionals reimagining and re-engineering operations and processes that could be critical to businesses. 

Level: Lead Managed Services Engineer II

As a Lead Managed Services Engineer II, you will lead the design, implementation, and scaling of AI-powered and automation solutions across IT and business operations. This role requires a hands-on leader who can move from strategy to execution by identifying high-value opportunities, shaping solutions, and delivering production-grade outcomes. The ideal candidate combines experience in AI implementation with a strong background in infrastructure and operations and is comfortable leading teams and stakeholders in enterprise hybrid infrastructure environments. 

Work you'll do

As a Lead Managed Services Engineer II on the Hybrid Cloud Infrastructure team, you will be responsible for: 

- Identify opportunities to apply AI and automation by analyzing operational data, service trends, workflow bottlenecks, and business pain points. 
 - Lead end-to-end delivery of AI and automation initiatives, from discovery and design through deployment, stabilization, and continuous improvement. 
 - Design and implement AI-powered solutions, including AI agents, that leverage LLMs, enterprise tools, APIs, and workflow platforms to automate complex processes. 
 - Partner with business, operations, infrastructure, and security teams to translate requirements into practical implementation plans and technical roadmaps. 
 - Oversee environments, integrations, observability, incident handling, and deployment readiness for AI solutions in production. 
 - Lead client and stakeholder discussions, present operational insights, manage escalations, and drive adoption of new solutions. 
 - Improve operational performance across infrastructure and service delivery by applying automation to incident management, requests, knowledge access, monitoring, and remediation workflows. 
 - Establish KPIs and success metrics such as efficiency gains, latency, completion rates, user satisfaction, SLA performance, and service quality. 
 - Develop documentation, runbooks, and handoff materials to support long-term sustainment and scale. 

The team

At Hybrid Cloud Infrastructure we deliver solutions spanning Hybrid Cloud, Advanced Connectivity, AI Data Centers, High-Performance Computing, and AI Infrastructure to help clients achieve their desired outcomes. Our offerings include engineered transformation services for hybrid cloud infrastructure and platforms, prioritizing resiliency, optimization, and extensive automation. We integrate advanced connectivity with AI infrastructure and enterprise networks to boost operational efficiency and enable real-time data processing. Additionally, we provide comprehensive management of all facets of operations for hybrid cloud infrastructure and field operations. 

Location: Bengaluru/Hyderabad/Pune/Chennai

Shift Timings: 24/7 as per business requirements

Qualifications

Required: 

- 10 - 14 years of hands-on experience in Proven experience leading AI and automation implementations in enterprise or production environments. 
 - Significant experience in IT operations, infrastructure, automation, AI engineering, or related technology delivery roles. 
 - Strong knowledge of infrastructure operations, including cloud, networks, servers, virtualization, backup, disaster recovery, and end-user support. 
 - Good understanding of observability frameworks , self-healing platforms , and AIOPS 
 - Experience using data and operational analytics to identify automation and AI opportunities and build business cases for change and own the execution to deliver automation to meet efficiency targets 
 - Ability to lead cross-functional teams and work effectively with engineering, operations, product, security, and business stakeholders. 
 - Strong client-facing communication and presentation skills, including experience managing expectations and driving executive-level conversations. 
 - Familiarity with ITIL-based service management, including incident, change, and problem management. 
 - Experience working in regulated environments with awareness of governance, risk, and compliance requirements such as SOX, HIPAA, or GDPR. 
 - Prior people leadership or program leadership experience in a manager-level role strongly preferred. 
 - ITSM and Hybrid Infrastructure experience 
 - Infrastructure as Code tools such as Terraform, Ansible, or CloudFormation 
 - Cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP 
 - APIs, webhooks, event-driven integrations, CI/CD, and containers 
 - Observability and monitoring platforms such as Dynatrace , ITOM or AppDynamics 
 - BE/B. Tech/M. C. A. /M. Sc (CS) degree or equivalent from accredited university

Preferred -

- AI agent frameworks such as LangChain, Semantic Kernel, AutoGen, or CrewAI 
 - Vector databases such as Pinecone, Weaviate, FAISS, or Qdrant

Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities.

Our inclusive culture empowers our people to be who they are, contribute their unique perspectives, and make a difference individually and collectively. It enables us to leverage different ways of thinking, ideas and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients' most complex challenges. This makes Deloitte one of the most rewarding places to work. 

Professional development

At Deloitte, professionals have the opportunity to work with some of the best and discover what works best for them. Here, we prioritize professional growth, offering diverse learning and networking opportunities to help accelerate careers and enhance leadership skills. Our state-of-the-art DU: The Leadership Center in India, located in Hyderabad, represents a tangible symbol of our commitment to the holistic growth and development of our people. Explore DU: The Leadership Center in India . 

Benefits To Help You Thrive

At Deloitte, we know that great people make a great organization. Our comprehensive rewards program helps us deliver a distinctly Deloitte experience that helps that empowers our professionals to thrive mentally, physically, and financially-and live their purpose. To support our professionals and their loved ones, we offer a broad range of benefits. Eligibility requirements may be based on role, tenure, type of employment and/ or other criteria. Learn more about what working at Deloitte can mean for you. 

Recruiting tips

From developing a stand out resume to putting your best foot forward in the interview, we want you to feel prepared and confident as you explore opportunities at Deloitte. Check out recruiting tips from Deloitte recruiters.

You Are

You have spent years building enterprise systems that actually solve business problems, not just demonstrate technical capability. You understand that the real challenge is not deploying an AI model, it is designing the solution architecture that makes it trustworthy, scalable, and maintainable across Finance, HR, Sales Operations, and Legal teams who need it to work every single day. You think in systems, not features. When someone describes a manual process, you are already mapping the integration points, data flows, governance requirements, and failure modes before they finish talking. 

You are equally comfortable whiteboarding an agentic AI architecture with a VP of Finance and writing Python code to integrate Azure OpenAI with SAP. You have built enough automation solutions to know when a workflow needs intelligent document processing versus a simple API call, and you can explain that tradeoff clearly. You do not wait for perfect requirements. You ask the right questions, prototype quickly, and iterate with stakeholders who may not speak your technical language but absolutely know their business pain. 

At Synopsys, you will architect AI and automation solutions that reduce manual work for 30, 000 employees across critical business functions, and the platform you build will matter. 

What You'll Be Doing

- Design and build enterprise AI solutions using Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Document Intelligence, Azure AI Search, and Copilot Studio that automate Finance, Sales Operations, HR, Order Management, and Legal processes

 - Lead end-to-end solution delivery from requirements gathering and architecture design through development, testing, deployment, and production support
 - Build reusable frameworks, integration patterns, and engineering standards for AI agent development that other developers can adopt across the enterprise automation portfolio
 - Partner directly with business stakeholders in Finance, GTM, HR, and Operations to identify automation opportunities, assess feasibility, prioritize initiatives, and translate requirements into technical solutions
 - Establish and enforce governance, security, Responsible AI practices, and DevOps standards using Azure DevOps or GitHub for CI/CD and source control
 - Mentor developers on AI solution design, Azure architecture, integration patterns, and automation best practices

The Impact You Will Have

- Reduce manual effort across Finance, Sales Operations, HR, and Order Management by deploying AI-powered automation that handles document processing, data extraction, workflow orchestration, and decision support at scale
 - Accelerate Synopsys' enterprise AI strategy by establishing reusable frameworks and patterns that enable faster, more consistent delivery of intelligent automation solutions across business functions
 - Improve operational accuracy and compliance by building governed, auditable AI systems with proper security controls, error handling, and monitoring
 - Enable business growth without proportional headcount increases by creating scalable automation platforms that handle increasing transaction volumes and process complexity
 - Strengthen cross-functional collaboration by translating technical capabilities into business value that Finance, HR, and Operations leaders can understand and trust
 - Build institutional knowledge and capability by mentoring developers and establishing engineering standards that raise the quality and maintainability of the entire automation portfolio
 - Drive measurable ROI through solutions that demonstrably save time, reduce errors, and improve process efficiency in production environments

What You'll Need

- Bachelor's or Master's in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience
 - 8-12+ years building enterprise applications, automation solutions, or integration platforms, with at least 3 years working directly with AI or Generative AI technologies in production environments
 - Deep hands-on experience with Azure AI Services including Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Document Intelligence, and Azure AI Search, plus Azure Integration Services like Logic Apps, Functions, Service Bus, and API Management
 - Proven ability to design and deploy intelligent automation using platforms like UiPath, Power Automate, Power Apps, Copilot Studio, and Dataverse
 - Strong development skills in Python, C#, and JavaScript, with solid understanding of REST APIs, SOAP, webhooks, SQL, and data modeling
 - Direct experience integrating enterprise applications such as SAP, Salesforce, Oracle, SuccessFactors, or Workday in complex business environments
 - Working knowledge of AI governance, Responsible AI practices, cloud security, DevOps, CI/CD pipelines, and source control using Azure DevOps or GitHub, experience with JIRA for project management is a plus

Who You Are

- You can sit in a room with a Finance Director who describes a month-end close process and walk out with a solution architecture that addresses the real bottleneck, not just the symptom they mentioned
 - You write code that other developers can actually maintain, you document your integration patterns, you build error handling that helps operations teams diagnose issues without calling you at midnight
 - You push back when a stakeholder asks for an AI agent but the problem actually needs a well-designed workflow, and you can explain why in terms they understand and respect
 - You have shipped enough production systems to know that governance, security, and supportability are not afterthoughts, they are design constraints you bake in from the start
 - You mentor junior developers by showing them how you think through a problem, not just handing them the answer, and you genuinely care about raising the technical capability of the team
 - You stay current with AI and automation technology not because it is trendy but because you know the difference between a useful new capability and vendor hype, and you can evaluate both critically

The Team You'll Be Part Of

You will join the Enterprise Agentic Process Automation team, which drives business transformation through AI, intelligent automation, process optimization, and enterprise integration. The team delivers capabilities across Finance, Sales Operations, Order Management, HR, Business Operations, and other functions, with emphasis on operational efficiency, scalability, governance, and innovation. Current initiatives include AI agents, document intelligence, finance automation, process orchestration, and enterprise platform integrations. The team operates in Bengaluru and collaborates closely with business stakeholders and IT teams across Synopsys globally. 

Rewards And Benefits

We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. Our total rewards include both monetary and non-monetary offerings. Your recruiter will provide more details about the salary range and benefits during the hiring process.

data.description:
Engineering Manager - Frontend (Mobile & Web)

Experience: 5-8 years

Reports to: 

Head of Engineering

About the role

You will own every screen a borrower, partner or internal user touches: the borrower app(Android/iOS), web loan journeys, the DSA/partner portal, and ops dashboards for credit, collections and customer support. Your work directly drives conversion from lead to disbursal, so speed, trust and drop-off are your core metrics. You stay hands-on (roughly40-50%) while leading the team. 

What you will do

- Own frontend architecture across mobile and web: a shared design system, reusable journey components and a config-driven flow engine so new loan products and lenders launch without rewrites. 
 - Build high-conversion onboarding: OTP login, consent capture, KYC (Aadhaar, PAN, selfie/liveness, Video KYC SDKs), Account Aggregator consent, bank account verification, eNACH/UPI AutoPay mandate set-up and e-sign. 
 - Deliver compliant borrower experiences: KFS and APR display before acceptance , cooling-off/exit options, loan statements, grievance flows, and clear lender (NBFC) disclosure on every screen per RBI Digital Lending rules. 
 - Keep the app lean and secure: minimal permissions (no contacts/media access), root/jailbreak detection, SSL pinning, secure storage, obfuscation, and DPDP-compliant consent handling. 
 - Drive performance on low-end Android devices and patchy networks: app size, cold-start time, crash-free rate, offline/retry handling. 
 - Instrument every funnel with product analytics and run A/B tests with Product andGrowth to reduce drop-offs. 
 - Set standards for code review, testing (unit, integration, E2E), release management, feature flags, staged rollouts and Play Store/App Store compliance (including GooglePlay's personal loan app policy). 
 - Hire, mentor and grow frontend engineers; run 1: 1s and performance reviews. 

What you bring

- 5-8 years in frontend/mobile engineering, including 1. 5+ years leading a team owning a consumer app end to end. 
 - Deep expertise in React Native or Flutter, plus strong React/Next. js and TypeScript for web. 
 - Native awareness (Kotlin/Swift) to integrate KYC, payment and device SDKs and debug native crashes. 
 - State management, offline-first patterns, deep linking, push notifications and WebView bridges. 
 - CI/CD for mobile (Fastlane, Bitrise, GitHub Actions), OTA updates(CodePush/Shorebird), crash and performance tooling (Firebase Crashlytics, Sentry). 
 - Shipped a consumer fintech, lending, payments or banking app at scale in India. 
 - Strong product sense and close working style with designers and backend teams. 

Nice to have

- Built a server-driven UI or low-code journey builder. 
 - Experience with micro-frontends or white-label/SDK journeys embedded in partner apps. 
 - Accessibility, vernacular (multi-language) support and Tier 2/3 user research. 
 - Mobile app security audits (OWASP MASVS) and VAPT remediation.

Employment Type: Full-time internship

Duration: 1 to 3 months

Role at a glance

Software engineering is more than just writing syntax-it is about designing resilient systems, managing data integrity, and proving that every feature behaves predictably under load. When relational models are poorly normalized, query performance bottlenecks appear, or integration tests miss edge cases, system reliability falters. This internship immerses you in end-to-end computer science engineering practices at Medinex Workforce. You will write structured code, design and query relational database schemas, execute automated test suites, and troubleshoot system workflows, learning how engineering teams apply core CS fundamentals to solve production problems. 

What you will work on

⚬ Write, refactor, and maintain modular software features using modern programming languages (Java, Python, C++, or JavaScript)

⚬ Design, normalize, and manage relational database schemas (tables, keys, indexes, constraints)

⚬ Write, optimize, and test SQL queries, joins, and stored procedures to ensure fast data retrieval

⚬ Design and execute functional, unit, and integration test cases to validate business logic and prevent regressions

⚬ Trace software defects, inspect application logs, and debug unexpected system failures across environments

⚬ Document database entity-relationship (ER) diagrams, technical specifications, and API data models

⚬ Manage code changes, feature branching, and pull requests using Git and GitHub workflows

⚬ Share progress in a short daily check-in and attend weekly technical architecture reviews

What we expect from you

⚬ Strong foundational grasp of core Computer Science principles (Object-Oriented Programming, Data Structures, Algorithms)

⚬ Hands-on familiarity with Database Management Systems (DBMS) and writing SQL queries in PostgreSQL, MySQL, or SQL Server

⚬ Working knowledge of at least one core programming language (Java, Python, C++, or JavaScript)

⚬ Methodical approach to testing software, isolating edge cases, and logging reproducible bugs

⚬ Clear written English for writing code documentation, technical summaries, and test plans

⚬ A laptop and a stable internet connection

Helpful but not required

⚬ Familiarity with automated testing frameworks (JUnit, PyTest, or Selenium)

⚬ Basic understanding of RESTful APIs, networking fundamentals, and operating systems (Linux commands)

⚬ An active GitHub profile, coursework projects, or open-source contributions demonstrating core CS concepts

Who can apply

⚬ Final-year students and recent graduates from B. Tech/B. E. in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, BCA, B. Sc (CS/IT), MCA, or related disciplines

⚬ Freshers seeking practical, full-lifecycle exposure across programming, database management, and quality assurance

⚬ Candidates available to commit full-time for the duration of the internship

What you gain

⚬ Real-world experience applying core CS fundamentals across production applications and relational databases

⚬ Direct code reviews, query optimization guidance, and mentoring from senior software engineers

⚬ Production-grade code modules, schema designs, and test documentation to showcase in technical interviews

⚬ Internship completion certificate

⚬ The freedom to work remotely from anywhere in India

Work schedule

Full-time, Monday to Saturday or as assigned by your reporting manager. 

How to apply

Apply on this listing with your updated resume. 

Medinex Workforce is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants of every gender, background, and community.

Cluster hardware components like ML wafer scale accelerators, CPU runtime nodes, High speed swarmx interconnect, High speed data transfer of weights through memoryx interconnect

data.title: Lead Data / ML Engineer
data.description:
About The Role

We are looking for a Lead Data / ML Engineer to take end-to-end technical ownership of a large-scale data and ML platform on AWS. You will design and build PySpark pipelines, bring ML models and LLM and agent-based capabilities into production, and own what you build from first design through to running it reliably in production. 

This is a hands-on role. Architecture and leadership experience is welcome, but you will still write code every day, and you will be the person others turn to when a pipeline breaks, a job slows down, or a design needs a second opinion. 



About The Work

You will work with high-volume consumer transaction data, turning it into insights and predictive models that help understand and anticipate consumer behaviour. The work spans large-scale data processing, feature engineering, machine learning, and applying LLMs and agents to enrich and make sense of the data. 



Experience: 7+ Years

Location: Kolkata (Rajarhat-Newtown)

Mode of Working: WFO / Hybrid / Remote

Timing: Ability to work in the US Eastern time zone. This may be relaxed to half day IST and half day US EST based on project needs. 

What We Are Looking For

- End-to-end ownership: you take a problem from design to production and stay accountable for it once it is live
 - Hands-on depth: you write, review and debug production code yourself, not only design it
 - Troubleshooting leadership: you help teammates diagnose failing jobs, performance problems and data issues, and leave them better at solving the next one
 - Practical judgement on LLMs and agents: you know where they add real value in a data pipeline and how to measure whether they are working



Key Responsibilities

- Design, build and optimize large-scale ETL/ELT pipelines in PySpark on AWS (EMR, Glue), with strong attention to partitioning, skew, shuffle and cost. 
 - Productionize ML models and feature pipelines, including training data pipelines, batch and real-time inference, and model serving on SageMaker. 
 - Build LLM and agent-powered capabilities into data workflows, such as document and entity extraction, classification and enrichment at scale, RAG pipelines, and tool-calling agents, along with evaluation and monitoring of their output quality. 
 - Orchestrate complex workflows with Apache Airflow (MWAA or self-managed), ensuring reliability, observability and SLA adherence. 
 - Architect storage across S3 (data lake), Redshift (warehouse) and RDS, applying best practices for data modeling, partitioning, compression and cost optimization. 
 - Build containerized data services with Docker and ECS/Fargate, with CI/CD through GitHub Actions. 
 - Develop event-driven and serverless processing with Lambda, SQS, SNS and EventBridge. 
 - Use AI coding assistants (Claude Code, Cursor, Kiro) to speed up delivery, and set the team's standards for reviewing and validating AI-generated code. 
 - Be the go-to person for production issues: lead root-cause analysis on failing or slow jobs, data quality incidents and model problems, and help teammates debug their own work. 
 - Review code, guide design decisions and help engineers on the team grow technically. 
 - Implement data quality, monitoring and alerting frameworks, and enforce data governance, security and access-control policies. 
 - Contribute to infrastructure as code using Terraform, CloudFormation or CDK. 



Required Qualifications

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science or a related field. 
 - 7+ years in data engineering or ML engineering, with at least 4 years of hands-on PySpark on production workloads at scale. 
 - Strong AWS production experience across EMR, S3, Redshift, RDS, Lambda, SageMaker and ECS. 
 - Practical, hands-on experience building with LLMs: prompt design, embeddings and vector search, RAG, agent or tool-calling frameworks, and evaluating LLM output quality. 
 - Solid understanding of the ML lifecycle: feature engineering, training and validation, model deployment and monitoring. 
 - Experience working with large transactional or behavioural datasets is a strong plus. 
 - Strong Python and SQL. TypeScript is a plus. 
 - Experience with Apache Airflow and Docker in production. 
 - A track record of owning systems end to end in production, including on-call or production support, and of helping other engineers troubleshoot. 
 - Strong grasp of data modeling, governance and security best practices. 



Good To Have

- AWS certifications (Data Engineer Associate, Machine Learning Specialty, Solutions Architect)
 - Experience with feature stores, MLOps tooling or model serving at scale
 - Infrastructure as code (Terraform, CloudFormation, CDK)
 - Experience optimizing costs for large AWS data workloads



Tech Stack At a Glance

- Compute & Processing: PySpark on EMR, Glue, Lambda, ECS/Fargate, SageMaker
 - LLM & Agents: LLM APIs, embeddings and vector stores, RAG, agent frameworks
 - Orchestration: Apache Airflow (MWAA), Step Functions
 - Storage & Warehousing: S3, Redshift, RDS (PostgreSQL / MySQL)
 - Containers & DevOps: Docker, ECS, GitHub Actions, Terraform
 - AI-Assisted Dev: Claude Code, Cursor, Kiro
 - Languages: Python, SQL, Bash

data.title: Senior QA Engineer
data.description:

You will be responsible for ensuring the quality, stability, and performance of our Salesforce Commerce Cloud (SFCC) storefronts through rigorous manual testing across the full commerce journey - from browsing and checkout to order management and different APIs.

Location: 

Bangalore, IND

Location: Bangalore

Applied Materials is the leader in materials engineering solutions used to produce virtually every new chip and advanced display in the world.

Full time

Assignee / Regular

data.title: Software Application Engineer
data.description:
Education: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related technical discipline. 

Professional Experience: 3+ years of experience in software engineering, with a direct focus on containerized Linux microservices, IoT systems, or edge software development

JOB DESCRIPTION: 

Department: Software / Industrial IoTAbout the Role: 

*About the Role: *

We are looking for an experienced Edge Application Software Engineer to build, package, and deploy containerized microservices on industrial edge computing platforms. 

In this role, you will bridge shop-floor operational data with enterprise IT systems. You will design microservice architectures, integrate industrial telemetry into local time-series databases, and manage edge hardware container lifecycles. 

If you love working on Linux, Docker, IoT protocols, and real industrial machines, this role is for you. 

*What You Will Do: *

* Develop, package, and maintain containerized applications using Docker & Docker Compose for Linux edge hardware

* Build backend microservices in Python / Go / C++ / Node. js and RESTful / gRPC APIs for data processing and edge analytics

* Connect edge applications with plant machinery and industrial controllers using OPC UA, MQTT, Modbus TCP

* Configure local message brokers (Mosquitto MQTT) and time-series databases (InfluxDB, TimescaleDB, SQLite)

* Deploy app packages, monitor container resource limits (CPU/RAM), and manage software updates across remote edge fleets

* Implement secure communications (mTLS, TLS/SSL, X. 509) and set up CI/CD pipelines for edge devices

*What We Are Looking For: *

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related field

* 3+ years of experience in software engineering with focus on containerized Linux microservices, IoT, or edge software

* Advanced expertise in Docker, multi-stage Dockerfile builds, multi-architecture builds (x86_64 vs ARM64), Docker Compose

* Hands-on experience in at least two languages: Python, Go, C++, Node. js / TypeScript

* Strong knowledge of Embedded Linux / Ubuntu, systemd, Bash scripting, non-root container security

* Deep working knowledge of OPC UA client/server and MQTT pub/sub messaging

* Solid understanding of subnets, reverse proxies (NGINX), firewall, TLS/SSL, REST API authentication

*Good to Have: *

* Experience with Node-RED, Grafana, InfluxDB Dashboards

* Exposure to AWS IoT Core / Azure IoT Hub

* Experience with Git, GitHub Actions / GitLab CI/CD

*Why Join Us?*

Work on real Industrial IoT products, cloud architectures, and cutting-edge containerized deployments used in live plants.
