data.title: Lead Engineer (Manager), Microsoft Power Platform
data.description:
Your Journey at Crowe Starts Here: 

At Crowe, you can build a meaningful and rewarding career. With real flexibility to balance work with life moments, you're trusted to deliver results and make an impact. We embrace you for who you are, care for your well-being, and nurture your career. Everyone has equitable access to opportunities for career growth and leadership. Over our 80-year history, delivering excellent service through innovation has been a core part of our DNA across our audit, tax, and consulting groups. That's why we continuously invest in innovative ideas, such as AI-enabled insights and technology-powered solutions, to enhance our services. Join us at Crowe and embark on a career where you can help shape the future of our industry. 

Job Description: 

Role Overview

We are seeking an experienced Power Platform engineer to design and deliver complex enterprise solutions for clients while helping raise the technical capability of our broader Power Platform team. 

This is a hands-on player coach role with significant client delivery responsibility. The Manager will remain deeply involved in solution architecture, software development, troubleshooting, implementation, technical reviews, and client discussions. This is not a primarily administrative or people management position. 

The ideal candidate is a software engineer with deep Microsoft Power Platform expertise who can combine low code capabilities with custom development, enterprise architecture, and strong consulting skills. 

Key Responsibilities

- Serve as a hands-on engineer and technical lead for complex client engagements involving Microsoft Power Platform. 
 - Design and build enterprise applications using Power Apps, Dataverse, Power Automate, and related Microsoft technologies. 
 - Develop custom solutions using C#/. NET, JavaScript or TypeScript, plugins, custom APIs, PCF components, custom connectors, Azure Functions, and other extensibility approaches. 
 - Design scalable Dataverse architectures, including data models, security, integrations, business logic, and performance considerations. 
 - Integrate Power Platform solutions with Azure, Microsoft 365, SharePoint, Teams, Dynamics 365, SQL, APIs, and other enterprise systems. 
 - Implement strong ALM practices including source control, solution management, deployment automation, environment strategy, and CI/CD. 
 - Lead technical discovery sessions and translate business requirements into practical, well-designed solutions. 
 - Communicate architecture decisions, tradeoffs, risks, estimates, and recommendations clearly to both technical and nontechnical stakeholders. 
 - Provide technical leadership across multiple engagements and act as an escalation point for complex engineering challenges. 
 - Establish and promote engineering standards, reusable patterns, code quality expectations, and delivery best practices. 
 - Mentor engineers and technical leads and help improve engineering quality across the broader team. 
 - Help teams determine when Power Platform is the right solution and when custom development or other technologies are more appropriate. 

Required Qualifications

- 8 or more years of professional software engineering, application development, solution architecture, or related technology experience. 
 - 4 or more years of substantial hands-on Microsoft Power Platform engineering experience. 
 - Strong software development experience using C#/. NET and JavaScript or TypeScript. 
 - Experience extending Power Platform through plugins, custom APIs, PCF components, custom connectors, Azure Functions, or similar technologies. 
 - Strong understanding of Dataverse architecture, security, data modeling, integration patterns, solution management, and performance. 
 - Experience designing and consuming REST APIs and integrating with enterprise systems. 
 - Experience with Azure services, Microsoft 365, SharePoint, Teams, Dynamics 365, SQL, and related technologies. 
 - Strong experience with ALM, source control, deployment automation, managed solutions, and CI/CD. 
 - Strong understanding of professional software engineering practices including code review, testing, debugging, monitoring, and production support. 
 - Demonstrated experience leading technical delivery on complex enterprise application projects. 
 - Strong client facing communication, consulting, and facilitation skills. 
 - Ability to lead technical discussions, challenge assumptions, explain tradeoffs, and provide clear recommendations. 
 - Experience mentoring engineers and improving technical practices across a team. 
 - Experience working with global clients and distributed delivery teams, including appropriate overlap with US based stakeholders when required. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with Power Platform governance, environment strategy, security standards, or Center of Excellence practices. 
 - Experience with Azure technologies such as Functions, Logic Apps, API Management, Service Bus, Key Vault, or Application Insights. 
 - Experience working in consulting or professional services environments. 
 - Experience supporting presales, estimation, technical proposals, demonstrations, or workshops. 
 - Microsoft Power Platform or Azure certifications such as PL 400, PL 600, or related credentials. 

What Success Looks Like

Successful engineers in this role remain highly engaged in client delivery while also raising the technical capability of the broader team. They are trusted by clients, comfortable solving difficult engineering problems, able to make sound architecture decisions, and capable of guiding others through complex technical challenges. 

They approach Power Platform as an enterprise application development platform and combine its native capabilities with strong software engineering practices to deliver secure, scalable, maintainable solutions. 

What It Means To Be a Consultant At Crowe

Consulting is a dynamic business focused on solving problems for our clients and serving our core markets through innovative solutions. As technology and AI continue to reshape the consulting landscape, we are looking for individuals who are curious, adaptable, and eager to learn. At Crowe, consultants are expected to build both technical and transferable skills, think critically, and use technology to solve real business problems. In this role, you will continuously learn, collaborate across teams, and explore how tools, including emerging AI capabilities, can improve efficiency, insights, and client outcomes. 

In management at Crowe, you play a pivotal role in leading teams, guiding project execution, and deepening client relationships. You are expected to contribute to account planning, identify opportunities to add value, and ensure high-quality delivery. As your responsibilities expand, you take on broader account ownership, balancing project leadership with growing involvement in client strategy and solution development. 

Success in this role comes from a growth mindset, strong communication skills, advanced critical thinking, and the ability to navigate new challenges with confidence. 

We expect the candidate to uphold Crowe's values of Care, Trust, Courage, and Stewardship. These values define who we are. We expect all of our people to act ethically and with integrity at all times. 

Our Benefits: 

At Crowe, we know that great people are what makes a great firm. We value our people and offer employees a comprehensive benefits package. Learn more about what working at Crowe can mean for you!

How You Can Grow: 

We will nurture your talent in an inclusive culture that values diversity. You will have the chance to meet on a consistent basis with your Career Coach that will guide you in your career goals and aspirations. Learn more about where talent can prosper!

More about Crowe: 

Crowe Capability Center - India, operating under the legal entity C3 India Delivery Centre LLP (formerly known as Crowe Horwath IT Services LLP) is a wholly owned subsidiary of Crowe LLP (U. S. A. ), a public accounting, consulting and technology firm with offices around the world. Crowe LLP is an independent member firm of Crowe Global, one of the largest global accounting networks in the world. The network consists of more than 200 independent accounting and advisory firms in more than 130 countries around the world. 

Crowe does not accept unsolicited candidates, referrals or resumes from any staffing agency, recruiting service, sourcing entity or any other third-party paid service at any time. Any referrals, resumes or candidates submitted to Crowe, or any employee or owner of Crowe without a pre-existing agreement signed by both parties covering the submission will be considered the property of Crowe, and free of charge. 

We are committed to a merit-based hiring process, evaluating all candidates consistently using objective, job-related criteria such as relevant experience, demonstrated skills, measurable impact, and alignment with the role's responsibilities, and making employment decisions in a fair and inclusive manner free from discrimination.

What We Need To See

Ateme is looking for a permanent AI Solutions & Automation Engineer to design, develop, and deploy internal tools that reduce repetitive tasks, streamline access to information, and improve team efficiency, particularly across Sales, Pre-Sales, Support, Product, and Operations. 

Your role will sit at the intersection of full-stack development, generative AI, automation, and business understanding. You will work from real business needs to develop reliable, measurable solutions that are easy for teams to adopt.

 - Measure impact: Define adoption, quality, and operational efficiency metrics with business teams and track the value delivered after deployment. 
 - Build reusable solutions: Document components and agents, avoid duplication, and contribute to a shared architecture that enables solutions to be reused across multiple teams. 

Examples of Solutions you may build

- Assistants for meeting preparation, meeting summaries, and action tracking. 
 - Intelligent search across commercial and technical documentation. 
 - Automation of RFP responses and generation of scoping documents. 
 - Tools to support proposal preparation, opportunity tracking, and consolidation of information from multiple sources. 
 - Support agents capable of suggesting contextualized resolutions and enriching the knowledge base. 
 - Simple internal applications to automate checks, calculations, reporting, and recurring workflows. 

Required Skills and Experience

You hold a Master's degree (Bac+5), engineering degree, or equivalent qualification, and have at least 5 years of relevant experience in application development, automation, or the implementation of AI solutions in an enterprise environment. 

- Full-stack development: Python and/or TypeScript, REST APIs, web applications, databases, and user-focused interface design. 
 - Generative AI and agents: LLMs, prompt engineering, RAG, semantic search, tool calling, orchestration, and response quality evaluation. 
 - Integration: OAuth 2. 0 / OIDC, SSO, enterprise APIs and connectors, identity and permission management. 
 - Cloud & DevOps: Docker, Git, CI/CD, automated testing, logging, monitoring, and deployment on cloud or internal platforms. 
 - Product thinking: Ability to start from a business need, define an MVP, balance simplicity and robustness, and support user adoption.

Additionall Skills that would be an advantage

- Microsoft Copilot Studio, Power Platform, Microsoft Graph, Azure AI, or Azure OpenAI.

 - Agent interoperability protocols and standards, particularly MCP. 
 - Experience in media, video, B2B SaaS, or enterprise software environments. 
 - UX practices, change management, and user training. 

How your work matters

Curiosity, pragmatism, autonomy, and a results-oriented mindset are essential. You enjoy understanding how people actually work, simplifying complex problems, and delivering useful solutions. 

You can clearly explain your decisions, collaborate with both technical and non-technical stakeholders, experiment quickly without compromising security, and understand that a solution only creates value when people actually use it. 

Location

We consider different locations in Europe and Asia (our offices locations) but we do not consider 100% remote. This job is not eligible for mobility or relocation opportunities. 

At Ateme, onboarding is much more than a process. It is a complete experience designed to set you up for success: immersive training, regular meetings with your manager and HR, a collaborative culture, and stimulating projects. 

Join us for a rewarding professional journey where your development and success matter.

About the right team member

At Playlist, we value team members who are curious, practical, and-openminded, and who care about our product, their teammates, and their own personal growth. We're faced with an interesting set of technical challenges, and we believe in giving our engineers the freedom to create solutions based on their unique perspective. 

Much of our team comes from non-traditional computing backgrounds. In bringing together diverse voices, we'll build a better product, and a better company. We care less about which languages or frameworks you know, and more that you're excited to produce high-quality code and be consciously evolving. Our engineers work in cross-functional, collaborative teams focused on impact. We work very closely with our brilliant product team to deliver a world-class user experience, and ultimately to empower our users to create and grow successful businesses. 

You'll thrive in this role with experience in

- 7 to 12 years engineering experience. 
 - 6+ years of industry experience in programming web applications, mobile and/or large-scale enterprise products. 
 - Experience with NoSQL databases. 
 - Experience in Visual Studio. 
 - Familiar with AWS services including EKS, EC2, Elastic cache, Non-RDBMS, SNS, SQS.

 - Familiar with Agile methodology. 
 - Familiar with DevOps principles. 
 - Skilful at reviewing new feature impact on an application and recognizing potential risks. 
 - Skilled at analysing performance in a service. 
 - Uses time effectively and efficiently. 
 - Quickly learns new technologies. 
 - Capable of forming new software teams. 
 - Detailed oriented, professional and possesses a positive work attitude. 
 - Communicate professionally both verbally and in writing. 
 - Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent. 

Technologies you'll be working with

While we value experience with these technologies, we're primarily looking for team members with strong technical skills and the ability to quicky pick up new tools and frameworks

- C#, ASP, . NET, . NET Core, MVC, ADO/ADO. NET, LINQ, REACT, Ruby

Have we piqued your curiosity?

Sound like the role for you? We'd love to hear from you! Even if you're not 100% sure about potential fit, we still encourage you to apply. We're looking for the right person, not the perfect series of checkboxes. 

The Company is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We highly value diversity at our company and encourage people of all different backgrounds, experiences, abilities and perspectives to apply. If you are a California resident or reside outside the United States then by submitting your application you confirm that you have read, understood, agree and - where applicable - grant your prior, free, informed and express consent for the processing of your personal information, including sensitive personal information, as described in our California Applicant Privacy Notice or International Applicant Privacy Notice (as applicable).

Cisco's Industrial IoT (IIoT) Business Unit powers the critical infrastructure of the world-connecting and securing the smart grids, automated factories, connected roadways, and energy systems that keep society running. We bridge the gap between complex industrial operational technology (OT) data and intuitive, high-performance software. 

We are a collaborative, forward-thinking global team building the next generation of user-centric management interfaces and on-premise solutions (such as Field Network Director) that manage industrial routing and switching networks. Here, you'll work in an AI-empowered engineering culture alongside passionate software engineers to turn complex network telemetry into seamless customer experiences.

- Design, develop, and maintain high-performance Java backend services and intuitive, responsive ReactJS front-end interfaces to simplify complex industrial and network management workflows.

We are looking for a passionate Software Engineer with 8+ Years of relevant experience and a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

Why Cisco?

At Cisco, we're revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era - and beyond. We've been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.

To ensure that we hire the best talent in the right way, we follow a strict hiring process and recently, Cisco has been made aware of fraudulent recruiters claiming to be from the company. Please be advised that any communication from Cisco about careers will:

data.title: DevOps Engineer
data.description:
Job Description: DevOps Engineer

Department: Engineering & Infrastructure

Location: Mohali

Employment Type: Full-time

Experience: 1-2 Years

About the Role

We are looking for a skilled DevOps Engineer to manage, automate, secure, and optimize our cloud and server infrastructure. The candidate will be responsible for deployment pipelines, server management, application reliability, security, monitoring, and infrastructure scalability across cloud and local environments. 

The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience with AWS, GCP, Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD pipelines, Linux servers, and production infrastructure management. 

Key Responsibilities

1. Cloud & Server Infrastructure

* Manage and maintain infrastructure on AWS and Google Cloud Platform (GCP). 

* Configure and manage EC2 instances, cloud networking, storage, and server environments. 

* Set up and maintain local/on-premises servers alongside cloud infrastructure. 

* Manage Linux servers, system resources, firewalls, ports, DNS, and networking. 

2. CI/CD & Deployment Automation

* Build, maintain, and optimize CI/CD pipelines using GitLab CI/CD and GitHub Actions. 

* Automate application builds, testing, deployments, and rollbacks. 

* Manage GitLab/GitHub runners and deployment environments. 

* Ensure reliable deployments with minimal downtime. 

3. Containerization & Orchestration

* Containerize applications using Docker. 

* Deploy and manage containerized applications using Kubernetes. 

* Configure application scaling, load balancing, resource allocation, and service availability. 

* Troubleshoot container, deployment, and orchestration issues. 

4. Web Servers & Application Infrastructure

* Configure and manage Nginx as a reverse proxy and web server. 

* Manage domains, SSL/TLS certificates, routing, and load balancing. 

* Configure and troubleshoot WebSockets and persistent application connections. 

* Support backend APIs and production application infrastructure. 

5. Security & Access Management

* Secure cloud infrastructure, servers, and deployment environments. 

* Manage IAM roles, permissions, access policies, and service accounts. 

* Secure environment variables, API keys, credentials, and application secrets. 

* Work with JWT-based authentication infrastructure and secure service-to-service communication. 

* Implement server hardening and access-control best practices. 

6. Monitoring, Logging & Troubleshooting

* Implement infrastructure and application monitoring. 

* Configure centralized logging, alerts, and crash reporting. 

* Monitor CPU, memory, disk utilization, network traffic, and application health. 

* Use Grafana and Prometheus or similar tools for monitoring and observability. 

* Investigate production incidents, identify root causes, and implement permanent fixes. 

7. Infrastructure Optimization

* Optimize AWS and GCP infrastructure costs. 

* Identify underutilized resources and improve server performance. 

* Improve deployment speed, uptime, reliability, and resource utilization. 

* Establish backup, recovery, and disaster-recovery procedures. 

Required Skills & Qualifications

* 2-5 years of hands-on DevOps or infrastructure engineering experience. 

* Strong practical knowledge of AWS, particularly EC2 and cloud infrastructure management. 

* Experience with Google Cloud Platform (GCP). 

* Strong understanding of Docker and Kubernetes. 

* Experience with GitLab CI/CD, GitHub Actions, and pipeline automation. 

* Good knowledge of Linux administration and server troubleshooting. 

* Hands-on experience with Nginx, reverse proxies, SSL/TLS, and networking. 

* Experience managing local/on-premises servers and cloud deployments. 

* Understanding of IAM, JWT, environment variables, secrets management, and infrastructure security. 

* Experience troubleshooting APIs, WebSockets, application crashes, and production incidents. 

* Familiarity with logging, monitoring, alerting, and Grafana. 

* Working knowledge of Git, Bash scripting, and Python automation. 

* Understanding of cloud cost optimization and production reliability. 

Good to Have

* Infrastructure as Code using Terraform. 

* AWS Secrets Manager or equivalent secrets-management solutions. 

* Prometheus, Grafana, and centralized logging platforms. 

* Kubernetes Helm charts, autoscaling, and cluster management. 

* Automated security scanning and vulnerability management. 

* Disaster recovery, backup automation, and high-availability architecture. 

* Experience managing infrastructure for AI/ML workloads and GPU-based applications. 

What We Expect

* A hands-on engineer who can independently manage production infrastructure. 

* Strong debugging and problem-solving skills. 

* A security-first approach to deployments and infrastructure. 

* Ability to build reliable, scalable, and cost-efficient systems. 

* Ownership of infrastructure issues from diagnosis through resolution. 

* Ability to collaborate closely with backend, mobile, AI, and product engineering teams. 

How to Apply: Share your resume along with a brief description of the infrastructure you have managed, the cloud platforms you have worked with, and the CI/CD systems you have implemented.

data.title: Senior Staff Azure Cloud Infrastructure Engineer
data.description:
At Toku, we create bespoke cloud communications and customer engagement solutions that help enterprises deliver mission-critical customer experiences. Headquartered in Singapore, we combine strategic consulting, technology, regional infrastructure, connectivity and global reach to support enterprises across APAC and beyond. 

We are looking for a highly experienced, hands-on Cloud Infrastructure Engineer to take on the most senior individual-contributor role within our Infrastructure team. Working alongside the VP of Infrastructure, you will help set technical direction, architecture and engineering standards while remaining deeply involved in solving complex technical challenges. 

This is a cloud-agnostic role with a strong current emphasis on Microsoft Azure. You will play a leading role in establishing and maturing our Azure platform while also working across our existing AWS environment. You will drive modern cloud architecture, Infrastructure as Code, Kubernetes, observability, CI/CD and automation, combining strong architectural judgement with hands-on engineering capability. 

What you will be doing

- Azure cloud architecture: Lead the design and evolution of secure, scalable and highly available Azure infrastructure, including Landing Zone architecture, governance, networking, identity, security guardrails and reusable infrastructure patterns. 
 - Multi-cloud architecture: Apply strong cloud architecture principles across Azure and AWS, establishing appropriate standards for scalability, resilience, security and operational effectiveness. 
 - AWS platform architecture: Continue to evolve our AWS estate across multi-account / AWS Organizations architecture, networking, IAM, security guardrails and core production services. 
 - Technical direction: Act as a senior technical authority for Infrastructure, owning key architectural decisions, establishing engineering standards and identifying opportunities to improve existing approaches. 
 - Infrastructure as Code: Own and improve Terraform-based infrastructure provisioning, developing reusable modules, consistent multi-environment patterns, testing and policy controls for reliable, repeatable deployment. 
 - Kubernetes: Architect, operate and improve production Kubernetes environments across Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) and Amazon EKS, ensuring they are scalable, resilient, secure and operationally robust. 
 - CI/CD & GitOps: Design and improve infrastructure delivery pipelines using technologies such as GitHub Actions and Jenkins, integrating IaC, version control, automated testing, policy enforcement and deployment automation. 
 - Observability: Build and improve monitoring and observability using technologies such as Datadog, Grafana, Prometheus, Cortex, Loki and Azure-native observability services, including dashboards, monitors, alerting and integrations. 
 - Automation & scripting: Use Python and automation to reduce repetitive operational work, integrate infrastructure tooling and improve reliability. Review automation code and provide technical direction on how infrastructure automation should be structured. 
 - Platform engineering: Build reusable infrastructure capabilities that enable engineering teams to provision, deploy and operate applications efficiently with less manual dependency on Infrastructure. 
 - Reliability & security: Engineer for high availability, disaster recovery and production resilience while embedding strong cloud security, IAM, networking, access controls and security guardrails into infrastructure design. 
 - Technical leadership: Mentor infrastructure engineers through hands-on collaboration, technical and design reviews and knowledge sharing, raising engineering capability while remaining an individual contributor. 
 - Cross-functional engineering: Work closely with Software Engineering, Security and other technical teams to understand requirements and design appropriate infrastructure solutions. 

We'd love to hear from you if you have

- Experience: Approximately 8-14 years of relevant cloud, infrastructure, DevOps or platform engineering experience, including significant hands-on responsibility for production cloud environments and experience operating at Staff, Senior Staff, Principal, Architect or equivalent technical level. 
 - Microsoft Azure: Strong hands-on Azure infrastructure architecture, implementation and operational experience. You should be comfortable designing and establishing Azure environments rather than only administering existing services. Azure Landing Zone, governance, networking, identity and security experience is particularly relevant. 
 - AWS: Good hands-on AWS architecture and production experience across services such as EC2, ECS/EKS, VPC, IAM, S3, RDS, CloudWatch, CloudFront and Route53. Multi-account / AWS Organizations experience would be valuable. 
 - Terraform: Advanced hands-on Terraform experience, including reusable modules, state management, multi-environment infrastructure, testing and scalable IaC patterns. 
 - Kubernetes: Strong production Kubernetes experience, ideally across AKS and EKS, with the ability to architect, troubleshoot and improve containerised environments. 
 - CI/CD: Strong experience designing and operating infrastructure CI/CD workflows using GitHub Actions, Jenkins or comparable technologies. ArgoCD, Flux, Helm or other GitOps experience would be advantageous. 
 - Observability: Hands-on experience configuring monitoring and observability using Datadog, Grafana, Prometheus, Cortex, Loki, Azure-native services or comparable platforms, including dashboards, alerting and integrations. 
 - Python & automation: Practical hands-on Python experience for infrastructure scripting and automation, with the ability to understand, develop and review automation code. 
 - Cloud architecture: Strong architectural judgement across cloud networking, security, IAM, scalability, availability, disaster recovery and production reliability, combined with the hands-on capability to implement and validate your designs. 
 - Technical leadership: Experience influencing architecture and engineering standards, reviewing technical designs and mentoring engineers while remaining deeply hands-on. 
 - Experience with policy-as-code, FinOps, service meshes, hybrid/on-premise infrastructure, or telecom/CPaaS and regulated/data-residency-sensitive environments would be an advantage. 
 - Location: This role can be remote, based in India or Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia. 

Toku has been recognised as a LinkedIn Top Startup and by the Financial Times as one of APAC's Top 500 High Growth Companies. If you're looking to join a growing company where you can have meaningful technical influence while solving complex real-world infrastructure challenges, we'd love to hear from you.

data.title: Head of Product & Platform Engineering
data.description:
STRATACACHE Asia Pacific | AMP-X

Location: SOUTH EAST ASIA

Reporting to: Managing Director

Employment: Full-time  

About the role

STRATACACHE Asia Pacific is seeking a Head of Product & Platform Engineering to lead the product strategy, engineering execution and ongoing development of AMP-X, our digital signage content management platform. This role brings together product leadership and technical delivery. You will translate customer and partner needs into a clear roadmap, build a disciplined engineering organisation, and ensure our software, media players and cloud services work reliably together. Working across Japan, Southeast Asia, India, Australia and New Zealand, you will help establish AMP-X as a scalable enterprise platform supported by a strong partner ecosystem. 

Key responsibilities  

Product strategy and roadmap

- Own the AMP-X product vision, roadmap and release priorities in alignment with business objectives. 
 - Translate customer, partner and market requirements into defined product capabilities and acceptance criteria. 
 - Balance new features, customer commitments, platform reliability and technical debt. 
 - Establish a structured process for evaluating feature requests and communicating roadmap decisions. 
 - Define product success measures, including adoption, deployment time, reliability and customer satisfaction.   

Engineering leadership and delivery

- Lead software development, platform engineering, quality assurance and DevOps teams. 
 - Establish clear ownership, realistic delivery commitments and accountability for results. 
 - Introduce consistent engineering practices covering architecture, code reviews, testing, documentation and release management. 
 - Build team capability through hiring, coaching, performance management and succession planning.   
 - Manage external development partners and specialist vendors where required.   

Platform architecture and operations

- Own the technical architecture across the CMS, APIs, device management, media players and supporting infrastructure. 
 - Ensure the platform supports enterprise requirements for scalability, security, availability and maintainability. 
 - Define supported deployment models and maintain clear compatibility standards across software and hardware. 
 - Establish monitoring, incident response, disaster recovery and capacity planning. 
 - Manage infrastructure costs and improve the efficiency of development and production environments. 

Quality, security and release readiness

- Be accountable for release quality, supported upgrade paths and production readiness. 
 - Establish testing across functionality, performance, security, device compatibility and real-world playback conditions. 
 - Ensure secure development practices, access controls and vulnerability management are embedded in delivery. 
 - Lead technical investigation of critical defects and recurring incidents, with documented corrective actions. 
 - Set clear release criteria, rollback procedures and support handover requirements. 

Hardware and player integration

- Coordinate software and firmware integration with media players and approved hardware platforms. 
 - Own technical validation of device onboarding, remote management, content playback and offline operation. 
 - Work with hardware, procurement and operations teams on chipset changes, component availability and product lifecycle planning. 
 - Ensure hardware substitutions and firmware changes are validated before customer deployment.   

Partner and customer enablement

- Build the technical foundations for a partner-led sales and delivery model. 
 - Oversee API documentation, integration guides, deployment standards and technical training materials. 
 - Support partner certification, solution validation and complex enterprise deployments. 
 - Work with sales and support teams on technical feasibility, solution design and escalations. 
 - Ensure regional requirements, including localisation and Japan-specific delivery needs, are reflected in product planning. 

Business leadership and governance

- Own engineering budgets, resource planning and delivery reporting. 
 - Provide leadership with clear visibility into progress, dependencies, risks and decisions required. 
 - Establish measurable service expectations between engineering, product, support and commercial teams. 
 - Maintain company ownership and control of source code, technical documentation, repositories and development environments. 

Experience and qualifications

- Typically 12+ years of experience in software engineering or enterprise technology, including 5+ years leading engineering teams. 
 - Demonstrated ownership of an enterprise software product from roadmap through development, launch and ongoing operation. 
 - Strong technical understanding of cloud platforms, SaaS architecture, APIs, databases, automated testing and CI/CD. 
 - Experience building reliable systems that manage distributed devices, edge applications or connected hardware. 
 - Proven ability to improve delivery predictability, product quality and team performance. 
 - Experience working directly with enterprise customers, channel partners and geographically distributed teams. 
 - Strong commercial judgement, including prioritisation, budgeting and build-versus buy decisions. 
 - Degree in computer science, engineering or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.   

Preferred experience

- Digital signage, content management, media playback, IoT or device management platforms. 
 - Multi-tenant platforms and enterprise identity integrations. 
 - Android, Linux or Windows player environments. 
 - APAC enterprise deployments, particularly in Japan. 
 - Building technical enablement for distributors, resellers and systems integrators. 

Leadership expectations

We are looking for an individual who: 

- Takes ownership of outcomes and follows commitments through to completion. 
 - Remains close enough to the technology to challenge architectural and delivery decisions. 
 - Communicates clearly and raises risks early. 
 - Builds capable teams with clear standards and responsibilities. 
 - Makes practical decisions that balance customer value, engineering effort and business priorities. 
 - Brings discipline and urgency to a business operating under new ownership.   

Success in the first six months

- Establish an agreed product roadmap, platform architecture baseline and resource plan. 
 - Introduce a predictable release cadence with clear quality and readiness criteria. 
 - Resolve the highest-priority reliability, security and deployment issues. 
 - Strengthen delivery against critical customer commitments, particularly in Japan. 
 - Put partner technical documentation, training and escalation processes in place. 
 - Establish a leadership dashboard covering delivery, platform reliability, defects, adoption and engineering costs.

data.title: Senior Backend Developer (.Net)
data.description:
Daxko builds the software that powers fitness, wellness, and community organizations-everything from member management and payments to digital engagement and analytics. From small studios to the largest associations, we help thousands of fitness businesses streamline operations, enhance member experiences, and drive sustainable revenue growth. 

You'll join Grip Technologies Pvt. Ltd. , a Daxko subsidiary, working on FitnessForce, the club management platform used by gyms and fitness businesses around the world. 

About The Role

FitnessForce runs the daily operations of gyms and fitness clubs globally, from recurring membership billing to point-of-sale retail. As a senior backend developer on our revenue operations team, you'll own the payment and billing infrastructure that keeps transactions secure, accurate, and reliable across dozens of markets. 

You'll work directly with global payment gateways, PCI compliance, and financial data at scale, using AI coding tools like Cursor to move fast without compromising security. 

What You'll Do

- Architect integrations with global payment gateways, including Stripe and Razorpay, to handle recurring subscriptions, retail transactions, and refunds
 - Build reliable webhook processing and idempotency safeguards that prevent duplicate charges and keep transactions consistent
 - Design and maintain REST APIs in . NET Core that support our Angular and Flutter apps
 - Enforce PCI-DSS compliance through server-side tokenization and secure credential vaulting, so raw card data never touches our servers
 - Build event-driven services with Apache Kafka to keep financial ledgers and billing states in sync in real time
 - Architect data models and optimize MySQL performance across a multi-tenant platform
 - Use AI coding tools to accelerate delivery of complex financial systems, while owning the security and maintainability of everything you ship

What You'll Bring

- 6 to 8 years of backend engineering experience in a SaaS product
 - Deep hands-on expertise in C# and . NET Core
 - A strong track record integrating payment gateway APIs, including subscription lifecycles, webhooks, and multi-currency transactions
 - Experience using AI coding assistants in production, with the fundamentals to debug and support AI-generated code in sensitive financial workflows
 - Strong relational database skills, including transaction management and query optimization in MySQL
 - Experience building multi-tenant systems and working with event-streaming platforms like Kafka

Nice to have

- Familiarity with Docker, container registries, and CI/CD pipelines
 - Experience in the fitness, club management, or membership software industry
 - Understanding of how backend APIs connect with Flutter and Angular front ends

We're hiring a Software Engineer to design, develop, and maintain SOAR connectors that integrate third-party security platforms with Falcon Fusion, and build/maintain platform services that provide core orchestration and workflow capabilities to all users of CrowdStrike's flagship Falcon Platform. 

Falcon Fusion - a core 'tier one' offering in our Flagship Platform, Falcon - is used by customers to automate breach remediations within their environments. data.title: Manager, Network Development
data.description:
Job Description

Guides team in the design and development of network systems for large-scale enterprise, data center, or cloud-based environments, leading strategy for production network and collaborating with vendors and internal quality assurance (QA) teams. Manages the maintenance of advanced automation frameworks for testing and operations, guiding the team in automating network tasks and monitoring health metrics. Guides moderately complex test strategies at the team level, driving testing protocol development, break-fix validation, and compliance with standards through cross-functional collaboration. Improves network health monitoring systems based on team feedback, connects with monitoring teams for anomaly detection enhancement, offers technical leadership during support rotations, and identifies tools for frontline support. Ensures team meets milestones, mentors technical excellence, guides customer-facing incident response and root cause analysis (RCA), contributes to roadmap execution, and resolves technical issues to meet networking standards. Provides guidance on network efficiency remediation strategies and collaborates for scalable solutions and capacity planning. 

Responsibilities

Network Design, Development, and Validation: 

- Offers guidance and direction on moderately complex test cases and test strategies that enhance network integrity at the team level. 
 - Acts as a technical resource for test practices and strategies, driving efforts towards the development of testing protocols within the team. 
 - Enables the team to perform break-fix validation support and post-event root cause analysis (RCA), offering solutions to resolve escalated issues and cascades lessons learned across the team. 
 - Guides the creation and completion of corrective and preventive actions (CAPA) items. 
 - Attends change management and technical change advisory (TCAB) or review board meetings. 
 - Collaborates with stakeholders across the group (e. g. , engineering, quality assurance) to explain practices and procedures needed for compliance with standards prior to deployment. 
 - Reviews and communicates governance and security requirements. 

Automation and Scripting: 

- Gathers team feedback to improve dashboards, telemetry systems, and alerting mechanisms to monitor network health, including defining metrics, trends, and thresholds to ensure service level objectives (SLOs). 
 - Connects with monitoring teams to communicate feedback and enhance the detection and diagnosis of network anomalies for the team. 
 - Offers technical leadership on support rotations, and gathers details to develop solutions for moderately complex investigations. 
 - Leverages incident response protocols to provide guidance on root cause investigations. 
 - Helps others identify appropriate tools to support the frontline support team.

- Ensures the team is able to meet critical test and deployment milestones, according to templated project plans for large projects. 
 - Provides mentorship and fosters technical excellence and growth across the team.

 - Contributes to the roadmap and software architecture, and helps the team execute according to documentation. 
 - Engages with vendors and internal teams to review, troubleshoot, and resolve product/equipment technical issues and ensure adherence to networking standards.

Id: 20973

Type: FullTime

Location: Chennai, India

At Husky TechnologiesTM, our success is based on your success. Our ability to keep our customers in the lead is based on building the strongest team possible. 

Husky TechnologiesTM has a strong foundation built on innovation, close customer relationships and a unique culture and values. We are dedicated to offering our customers the highest quality products and services and are looking for people with the inspiration and talent to develop with us as we pursue our ambitious growth strategy. We are a leader in developing state-of-the-art technology and it is this technology base that uniquely positions us to serve customers who seek differentiation through solutions that provide speed, flexibility and maximum productivity. This capability is at the core of our mission and competitive strategy. 

Husky TechnologiesTM offers a wealth of opportunity for personal growth and development. Most importantly, Husky Technologies TM offers an opportunity to work with - and be challenged by - a team of great people. Our success is possible because of the creativity, intelligence and passion of our people around the world and their desire to lead change. At the same time, we are not afraid to expect a lot and strive for leadership in all of our key markets. We are a company taking on new challenges and for the right people this means exceptional career development opportunities, the chance to be part of a team that is the best in the world at what we do and the experience that comes from working in an environment that demands constant transformation and innovation. 

Husky TechnologiesTM is an exciting company with tremendous potential. We have a great team and great expectations. If you are attracted to bold goals, believe in uncompromising honesty, support mutual respect, care about environmental responsibility, have a passion for excellence and a desire to make a positive contribution - then we want you to join the Husky TechnologiesTM team!

Job Description

As a Test Automation Engineer, you will design and implement automation solutions that validate system behavior across UI, APIs, and integrations. You will contribute to building a robust quality engineering ecosystem by integrating automated testing into CI/CD pipelines and supporting continuous delivery. 

In this role, you will translate requirements into effective test strategies, combining automation with manual, exploratory, and integration testing to ensure comprehensive quality coverage across all application layers. 

This role is ideal for an engineer who enjoys hands-on coding, solving complex validation challenges, and improving system quality at scale, while taking ownership of end-to-end quality outcomes and collaborating closely with cross-functional teams. 

Responsibilities

Automation Development & Framework Ownership

- Design, develop, and own scalable test automation frameworks and reusable components
 - Build automated test suites across: 
 - UI (Web/Mobile)
 - API and integration layers
 - Ensure automation solutions are maintainable, reliable, and extensible across teams

Test Strategy & Implementation

- Translate requirements into automation-ready test scenarios, test data, and validation strategies
 - Contribute to test strategy, coverage planning, and quality goals
 - Identify test gaps and proactively mitigate risks
 - Perform automation feasibility analysis to determine optimal test approach (manual vs automated)

Delivery & Execution Excellence

- Execute a balanced mix of automated and manual tests aligned with sprint goals, ensuring comprehensive validation across functional, integration, and edge-case scenarios. 
 - Contribute to task breakdown, estimation, and sprint commitments
 - Proactively raise risks, blockers, and testability concerns
 - Identify, log, prioritize, and track defects through resolution lifecycle
 - Perform root cause analysis and collaborate with development teams for fixes

Manual & Functional Testing

- Design, document, and execute detailed test cases and test scenarios
 - Perform functional, exploratory, and regression testing across features
 - Validate end-to-end workflows and business scenarios
 - Identify edge cases and usability issues through exploratory testing
 - Ensure test coverage for areas not suitable for automation

Quality, Standards & Engineering Practices

- Write clean, testable, and maintainable automation code
 - Participate in code reviews and continuous improvement of automation frameworks
 - Ensure adherence to Definition of Ready (DoR) and Definition of Done (DoD)
 - Take ownership of end-to-end quality outcomes across assigned areas
 - Follow established DevOps, security, and quality engineering practices

CI/CD & DevOps Integration

- Integrate automation into CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps preferred)
 - Enable continuous testing and shift-left quality practices
 - Monitor and improve pipeline stability, execution time, and reliability
 - Validate and troubleshoot system integrations, data flows, and error handling based on defined architectural designs and interfaces

Non-Functional Testing

- Contribute to performance, reliability, and resilience testing
 - Validate system behavior under load, stress, and failure scenarios

Observability & Debuggability

- Leverage logs, metrics, and traces to improve test reliability
 - Support root cause analysis of failures and improve system observability

Test Data & Environment Management

- Design and manage test data strategies and datasets
 - Ensure availability of stable, production-like test environments

Incident & Operational Support

- Assist in troubleshooting defects across environments
 - Support maintenance and continuous improvement of automation suites
 - Analyze and reduce flaky tests and unstable scenarios

Collaboration & Growth

- Collaborate with developers, QA, Product Owners, and Tech Leads
 - Actively learn and adopt new tools, frameworks, and best practices
 - Contribute to team knowledge sharing and a strong quality culture

Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in computer science, IT, or related field
 - 5+ years of experience in software testing with strong automation focus
 - Experience in designing and implementing test automation frameworks
 - Strong understanding of testing principles, SDLC, STLC, and Agile practices

Technical Skills

- Programming experience in one or more: C#, Java, Python, JavaScript, Swift
 - Experience with automation tools such as Selenium, Katalon, Playwright, Cypress
 - Experience with: 
 - API testing (REST, Postman, etc. )
 - Version control (Git)
 - CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps)
 - Familiarity with: 
 - Test data management
 - Test reporting and logging tools
 - Debugging and root cause analysis
 - Release Management
Assets

- Experience with: 
 - Performance testing tools (JMeter, k6)
 - Security testing (SAST, DAST, SCA)
 - Exposure to: 
 - Cloud platforms (Azure preferred)
 - DevSecOps practices
 - Experience using AI-assisted tools responsibly (e. g. , GitHub Copilot)
Key Expectations

- Drive an automation-first approach (target 60-80% regression automation), while ensuring critical flows and edge cases are validated through manual testing where automation is not feasible or cost-effective. 
 - Own and evolve automation frameworks and quality engineering practices
 - Ensure high reliability, scalability, and stability of automation pipelines
 - Take accountability for quality outcomes, not just test execution
 - Ensure alignment with organizational quality, security, and compliance standards

Why Husky?

- Regulated Working Hours: Enjoy a structured work schedule that promotes a healthy work-life balance, allowing you to excel professionally while maintaining personal well-being. 
 - Visible Impact: Experience the satisfaction of seeing the direct outcomes of your work, as you contribute to projects that visibly enhance our company's technological capabilities and efficiency. 
 - Strategic Influence: Participate in architectural and technical reviews, contributing to the strategic direction of our cloud initiatives and making a tangible impact on our company's technological landscape. 
 - Empowered Involvement: Take an active role in decision-making processes and architectural reviews, where your expertise helps shape the future of our cloud solutions and overall business strategy. 
 - Valued Contributions: Be more than just a number in a large organization; at our company, every individual's input is valued and can lead to significant, tangible improvements in our operations and services. 
 - Impactful Role: Play a crucial part in both developing new applications and maintaining existing systems, ensuring their optimal performance and reliability. 
 - Cutting-Edge Projects: Work on innovative cloud solutions that are transforming our and our customer's business, giving you the opportunity to be at the forefront of technological advancements. 
 - Supportive Community: Work in an environment that recognizes and celebrates individual achievements, fostering a sense of community and mutual respect among team members. 
 - Collaborative Environment: Join a global team of skilled professionals around the globe where your ideas are valued, and collaboration is encouraged to solve complex challenges and drive success. 

Husky TechnologiesTM offers a competitive compensation and benefits package and excellent opportunities for growth and advancement. We are committed to equal employment opportunity and respect, value and welcome diversity in our workplace. Husky TechnologiesTM also values being a great place to work and strives to maintain a safe workplace. Accordingly, Husky TechnologiesTM conditions all offers of employment on satisfactory completion of background checks. No agency or telephone inquiries please.

data.title: Principal Software Engineer - Trusted Data Platform
data.description:
Overview

Working at Atlassian

Atlassians can choose where they work - whether in an office, from home, or a combination of the two. That way, Atlassians have more control over supporting their family, personal goals, and other priorities. We can hire people in any country where we have a legal entity. Interviews and onboarding are conducted virtually, a part of being a distributed-first company. 

Our office is in Bellevue, WA, but we offer flexibility for eligible candidates to work remotely across the West US. Whatever your preference - working from home, an office, or in between - you can choose the place that's best for your work and your lifestyle. We call this TEAM anywhere . 

Responsibilities

As a Principal Software Engineer, you will be a technical leader and hands-on contributor, designing and optimizing high-scale, distributed storage systems built on AWS storage technologies. You will play a pivotal role in shaping the architecture, performance, and reliability of backend storage solutions that power critical applications at scale. 

Your primary responsibilities will include designing, implementing, and optimizing backend storage services that support high throughput, low latency, and fault tolerance. You will work closely with senior engineers, architects, and cross-functional teams to drive scalability, availability, and efficiency improvements in large-scale storage solutions. You will also lead technical deep dives, architecture reviews, and root cause analyses to resolve complex production issues related to storage performance, consistency, and durability. 

As a thought leader, you will drive best practices in distributed system design, security, and cloud cost optimization. You will also mentor senior engineers, contribute to technical roadmaps, and help shape the long-term storage strategy. Your expertise in storage consistency models, data partitioning, indexing, and caching strategies will be instrumental in improving system performance and reliability. 

Additionally, you will collaborate with Site Reliability Engineers (SREs) to implement observability, monitoring, and disaster recovery strategies, ensuring high availability and compliance with industry standards. You will advocate for automation, Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC), and DevOps best practices, leveraging tools like Terraform, AWS CloudFormation, Kubernetes (EKS), and CI/CD pipelines to enable scalable deployments and operational excellence. 

Qualifications

Basic Requirements

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field. 
 - 8+ years of experience in backend software development, focusing on distributed systems and storage solutions. 
 - 5+ years of experience working with AWS storage services (S3, DynamoDB, EBS, EFS, FSx, Glacier). 
 - Strong expertise in system design, architecture, and scalability for large-scale storage solutions. 
 - Proficiency in at least one major backend programming language (Kotlin, Java, Go, Rust, or Python). 
 - Experience designing and implementing highly available, fault-tolerant, and cost-efficient storage architectures. 
 - Deep understanding of distributed systems, replication strategies, sharding, and caching. 
 - Knowledge of data security, encryption best practices, and compliance requirements (SOC2, GDPR, HIPAA). 
 - Experience leading engineering teams, mentoring senior engineers, and driving technical roadmaps. 
 - Proficiency with observability tools, performance monitoring, and troubleshooting at scale. 

Core Requirements

Expertise in Large-Scale Storage Systems

- Deep knowledge of AWS storage services (S3, DynamoDB, EBS, EFS, FSx, Glacier) and their performance characteristics. 
 - Experience designing and optimizing object storage, block storage, and file storage solutions at scale. 
 - Strong understanding of storage durability, consistency models, replication, and erasure coding for fault tolerance. 
 - Experience implementing tiered storage solutions and cost-optimized data retention strategies. 

Distributed Systems & Scalability

- Deep understanding of distributed storage architectures, CAP theorem, and consistency models. 
 - Expertise in partitioning, sharding, and replication strategies for low-latency, high-throughput storage. 
 - Experience designing and implementing highly available, fault-tolerant distributed systems using consensus algorithms (Raft, Paxos, Gossip Protocol). 
 - Hands-on experience with high-performance NoSQL databases (DynamoDB, Cassandra, RocksDB). 

High-Performance Backend Engineering

- Strong programming skills in Kotlin, Java, Go, Rust, or Python for backend storage development. 
 - Experience building event-driven, microservices-based architectures using gRPC, REST, or WebSockets. 
 - Expertise in data serialization formats (Parquet, Avro, ORC) for optimized storage access. 
 - Experience implementing data compression, deduplication, and indexing strategies to improve storage efficiency. 

Cloud-Native & Infrastructure Automation

- Strong hands-on experience with AWS Well-Architected Framework and cloud storage best practices. 
 - Proficiency in Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Terraform, AWS CDK, or CloudFormation. 
 - Experience with Kubernetes (EKS), serverless architectures (Lambda, Fargate), and containerized storage workloads. 
 - Expertise in CI/CD automation for storage services, leveraging GitHub Actions, CodePipeline, Jenkins, or ArgoCD. 

Performance Optimization & Observability

- Experience with benchmarking, profiling, and optimizing storage workloads. 
 - Proficiency in performance monitoring tools (CloudWatch, Prometheus, OpenTelemetry, Grafana) for storage systems. 
 - Strong debugging and troubleshooting skills for latency bottlenecks, memory leaks, and concurrency issues. 
 - Experience designing observability strategies (tracing, metrics, structured logging) for large-scale storage systems. 

Security, Compliance, and Data Protection

- Deep knowledge of data security, encryption at rest/in transit, and IAM policies in AWS. 
 - Experience implementing fine-grained access controls (IAM, KMS, STS, VPC Security Groups) for multi-tenant storage solutions. 
 - Familiarity with compliance frameworks (SOC2, GDPR, HIPAA, FedRAMP) and best practices for secure data storage. 
 - Expertise in disaster recovery, backup strategies, and multi-region failover solutions. 

Leadership & Architectural Strategy

- Proven ability to design, document, and drive large-scale storage architectures from concept to production. 
 - Experience leading technical design reviews, architecture discussions, and engineering best practices. 
 - Strong ability to mentor senior and mid-level engineers, fostering growth in distributed storage expertise. 
 - Ability to influence technical roadmaps, long-term vision, and cost optimization strategies for backend storage.

Secfix automates security compliance for SMBs and mid-market companies in Europe and gets them compliant with ISO 27001, GDPR, TISAX and SOC 2 in weeks instead of months. We're a fast-growing team of 36 people, backed by a $12M Series A from Alstin Capital, Neosfer (Commerzbank) and Bayern Capital.

Today, everyone runs their own setup for data, outreach and communication. You'll replace that with one central, reliable system that scales with us. This is a hands-on engineering role: you'll write code (Python, SQL) every day, connect APIs and build data pipelines and AI workflows, not configure tools or run RevOps. You report to our Head of GTM, work closely with Sales and exchange with our Engineering team on architecture and best practices. We own products and outcomes, not Jira tickets. 

What You'll Do

- Data pipelines: Design and build pipelines that pull account and contact data from multiple sources and APIs, clean, deduplicate and score it, and sync it to our CRM as the single source of truth. 
 - Data layer: Design the data model and central database behind our GTM, connecting CRM, outreach and product data. 
 - Integrations & services: Integrate internal and third-party tools via REST APIs and webhooks, and build small internal services and tools where off-the-shelf tools fall short. 
 - Signals & automation: Build signal detection, lead scoring and routing, and alerts that tell the right rep which account to call today and why. 
 - AI agents: Build AI-powered tools and agents that take repetitive work off our AEs, from research to proposals to CRM updates. 
 - Reliability: Deploy, schedule, monitor and maintain everything you build: error handling, retries, rate limits, logging and alerts when something breaks. 
 - Ownership end-to-end: Investigate problems, find the root cause, ship the fix and document it so nothing depends on one person. 

Your success: reps spend less time on manual work and more time with customers, and more pipeline comes from systems that run reliably and are actually used. 

About You

You're a backend engineer who loves building things real people use every day, and curious about the business: why a customer buys, which signal means a company is ready. You build systems that run reliably at 10x volume, not one-off scripts. 

- Recent graduate (0-2 years) in Computer Science or a related engineering field with a strong academic record. 
 - 1+ years of backend experience through your first full-time job or internships in a startup environment. 
 - Strong engineering fundamentals: solid Python (or another backend language), SQL and data modeling. 
 - Experience building and consuming REST APIs and working with webhooks. 
 - You know how to run code in production: Git, deployment, scheduling, testing, logging and debugging. 
 - You think in systems: you understand how components depend on each other and what breaks when you change one part. 
 - Hands-on experience with AI coding tools and LLM APIs (e. g. Claude Code or the Claude API). 
 - You've built and shipped real things (a feature, service, data pipeline or internal tool) and can show them. 
 - Smart, structured problem solver and fast learner: you pick up new tools on your own and bring complexity down. 
 - Independent, proactive and comfortable communicating remotely, especially in writing. 

Nice to have: Experience with a cloud platform (AWS or GCP), a data warehouse, a CRM and its API, or GTM tools like Clay. 

You should not apply if: 

- You need detailed tickets telling you what to build. 
 - You only want to write code and don't care about business impact. 
 - You don't want to test, monitor and maintain what you ship. 
 - You'd rather be led than lead your own projects. 
 - You don't want to work closely with Sales and the people who use your tools. 

Interview Process

- ~30 min - Introductory call with our Talent team
 - Technical take home challenge (~8-10h, 7 days to submit)
 - ~90 min - Interview incl. live coding with our Head of GTM
 - Final interview with our co-founder and Head of GTM

What we offer

- Remote Work: 100% remote work with a virtual office in Gather. 
 - Competitive Salary: Industry-competitive local salaries. We pay local rates that are at or above the market. We share this philosophy with GitLab. 
 - Equity: Generous equity package - we're all owners of Secfix and beneficiaries of our collective success. 
 - Holidays: 26 days holiday + local public holidays. 
 - Health Insurance: Comprehensive health coverage. 
 - Development Budget: €1, 000 annual personal development budget. 
 - Workspace Budget: Remote workspace budget and access to co-working spaces. 
 - Annual Retreat: Annual retreat to build connections and inspire ideas (this year we're headed to Alicante, Spain!). 
 - Tech Equipment: Latest tech equipment (MacBook, monitors, headphones). 
 - Company Events: Company-wide events to build relationships and have some fun!
 - Mentorship: We are backed by top VCs and accelerators and have direct access to world-class mentors. 

Our values: we are obsessed with our customers, we build smart, we create trust, we are hacky, we take ownership, and we are leaders of remote. 

We are an equal-opportunity employer and remote-only company. We work in sync using Gather as our virtual office and therefore cannot support 100% asynchronous work. Read more about our Remote Culture here.

data.title: Exerp - QA Engineer II
data.description:
Xplor Technologies powers the experiences at the heart of everyday life. Through modern vertical software, embedded payments, and AI-powered capabilities, we help businesses in fitness, recreation, golf and club, field services, laundry, education, and other membership-based and service-based industries simplify operations, uncover insights, and elevate customer and member experiences. 

We unite popular brands such as Clubessential, foreUP, myFitApp, Vermont Systems, Momence, Exerp, and many more. 

Join Exerp as QA Engineer II to make a real impact every day. We say that because we know that every conversation we have, every interface we design, and every new feature we ship is another opportunity for us to elevate everyday life experiences for our customers and the people and communities they serve. 

Purpose

As a Quality Assurance (QA) Engineer, you will be essential to all aspects of quality assurance and testing processes within our organization. Leveraging your experience and expertise in software quality, you will help define and implement strategic initiatives to enhance product quality, improve testing efficiency, and drive continuous improvement. You will be part of one of our software engineering teams where you will be writing and executing the test scripts for the new features that the team is responsible for. You will help ensure the quality and understanding of often complex business requirements. Additionally, you will be part of our QA community that continuously assesses the current state of the system and is driving the strategy for QA going forward, including both how to test already existing functionality, and how to ensure proper QA on future development (incl. the tools and practices used for testing). 

Key Responsibilities

- Collaborate with product managers, developers, and stakeholders to understand project requirements and define test objectives, scope, and timelines. 
 - Develop and maintain detailed test plans, test cases, and test scenarios to validate software functionality, performance, and security. 
 - Execute manual and automated tests to verify software functionality, detect defects, and ensure adherence to quality standards. 
 - Analyze test results and quality metrics to identify areas for improvement and implement enhancements to testing processes, methodologies, and tools. 
 - Collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams to ensure alignment between testing activities and project goals, priorities, and timelines. 

Experience And Skills

- Minimum 3 years of experience in manual testing and understanding of test automation. 
 - Problem-Solving: Ability to analyze requirements and identify gaps in test coverage. 
 - Manual Testing: Solid experience in writing, executing, and reviewing test cases. 
 - Experience supporting complex ERP systems. 
 - QA Process Knowledge: Strong understanding of SDLC, Agile methodologies and defect lifecycle. 
 - Knowledge of version control and build management tools (Git, Maven/Gradle). 
 - CI/CD & Tools: Exposure to Jenkins, GitHub Actions or similar. 
 - Hardware peripherals and network troubleshooting. 
 - Automation Expertise: knowledge of Java, Cucumber, BDD, and Gherkin is a plus. 
 - Experience in implementing automation test cases is a plus. 
 - Database Knowledge: Proficiency in SQL is a plus. 
 - Knowledge or experience of the Health and Fitness industry is a plus. 

Qualities we appreciate

- Can-do attitude
 - Proactive
 - Team player
 - Self-motivated
 - Well organized
 - Process-oriented but at the same time, flexible to circumstances
 - Adaptability
 - People Person: Natural relationship builder with integrity, reliability and maturity
 - Keen attention to detail and adherence to deadlines

Working Conditions

Enjoy the flexibility to organize your workday while staying aligned with your team for collaboration and key meetings. You'll thrive in a fast-paced environment where our senior development team drives rapid product evolution. We invest in your growth through dedicated Exerp Time, empowering you to learn, explore new ideas, and make a meaningful impact beyond your day-to-day work. Quality is at the heart of everything we build. As a QA Engineer, you'll play a key role in delivering software our customers can trust, helping shape a product that powers fitness businesses around the world. 

At Xplor, we believe that the best innovation and ideas happen at the intersections of our differences - people of diverse cultures, generations, disciplines, and lived experiences. So even if you think you do not tick all the boxes, we still encourage you to apply. 

Values and Life at Xplor

Our Five Core Values Guide Us From How We Hire And Recognise Our Team Members To How We Interact With Our Customers Day To Day

- Find a better way
 - Do the right thing
 - Say it straight
 - Win together
 - Own the outcome

If these values sound like you and describe people you want to work with, you will thrive at Xplor. 

As an Xplorer, you will be part of a global network of talented colleagues who will support your success. We look for commonalities and shared passions and give people the tools they need to deliver great work and grow at speed. 

Ready to apply?

To start your application, please submit your resume, and we will be in touch as soon as we can. 

Got questions? You can email us at talentsupport@xplortechnologies. com.

At Capital One India, we are creating responsible and reliable AI systems, changing banking for good. The Intelligent Foundations and Experiences (IFX) team is at the center of bringing our vision for AI at Capital One to life. data.title: GTM Engineer (Fresh grad)
data.description:
Location: 100% Remote from India, min. 4h overlap with CET (e. g. 9: 00-13: 00 CET). Fluent English, spoken and written. German is not required. 

Compensation: 20k-32k USD per year (depending on location) + Shares + Generous Benefits. We pay local rates that are at or above the market. We share this philosophy with GitLab. 

About Secfix

Secfix automates security compliance for SMBs and mid-market companies in Europe and gets them compliant with ISO 27001, GDPR, TISAX and SOC 2 in weeks instead of months. We're a fast-growing team of 36 people, backed by a $12M Series A from Alstin Capital, Neosfer (Commerzbank) and Bayern Capital. 

About The Role

You'll be our first GTM Engineer and build the system our entire go-to-market team runs on, from BDRs to AEs. Today, everyone runs their own setup for data, outreach and communication. You'll replace that with one central, automated system and keep it reliable as we grow. This is a hands-on engineering role: you'll write code (Python, SQL) every day, connect APIs and build data pipelines and AI workflows, not configure tools or run RevOps. You report to our Head of GTM, talk to everyone in GTM, spot the biggest bottlenecks and decide together what to build next. We own products and outcomes, not Jira tickets. 

What You'll Do

- Data: Make our CRM the single source of truth for every target account. Model accounts, contacts and buying committees, and build automated pipelines that pull data from multiple sources, deduplicate, score and write it back. 
 - Pipeline generation: Build signal-based outbound, inbound scoring and routing, and alerts that tell the right rep which account to call today and why. 
 - Sales automation: Build AI tools and agents that take repetitive work off our AEs, from research to proposals to CRM updates. 
 - GTM infrastructure: Design our central data layer, integrate new tools via APIs and webhooks, and make sure everything runs reliably: scheduled jobs, error handling, monitoring and alerts when something breaks. 
 - Ownership end-to-end: Investigate problems, find the root cause, ship the fix and document it so nothing depends on one person. 

Your success: reps spend less time on manual work and more time with customers, and more pipeline comes from systems that run reliably and are actually used. 

About You

You're an engineer who loves building things real people use every day, and are curious about the business. You build systems that run reliably at 10x volume, not one-off scripts. 

- Recent graduate (0-2 years) in Computer Science or another engineering field with a strong academic record. 
 - 1+ years of experience through your first full-time job or internships in a startup environment. 
 - Solid Python and hands-on experience with APIs and webhooks. 
 - You know how to run code in production: version control (Git), scheduling, handling errors and rate limits, logging and debugging. 
 - You think in systems: you understand how components depend on each other and what breaks when you change one part. 
 - Smart, structured problem solver and fast learner: you pick up new tools and technologies on your own and bring complexity down. 
 - Hands-on experience with Claude (incl. Claude Code or the API). This is a must-have. 
 - You've built and shipped real things (an automation, scraper, data pipeline or internal tool) and can show them. 
 - Independent, proactive and comfortable communicating remotely, especially in writing. 

Nice to have: SQL and data modeling, experience with a CRM, GTM tools like Clay, a data warehouse or a cloud platform. 

You should not apply if: 

- You need detailed tickets telling you what to build. 
 - You only want to write code and don't care about business impact. 
 - You don't want to test, monitor and maintain what you ship. 
 - You'd rather be led than lead your own projects. 
 - You don't want to work closely with Sales and the people who use your tools. 

Interview Process

- ~30 min - Introductory call with our Talent team
 - Technical take-home challenge (~8-10h, 7 days to submit)
 - ~90 min - Interview incl. live coding with our Head of GTM
 - Final interview with our co-founder and Head of GTM

What we offer

- Remote Work: 100% remote work with a virtual office in Gather. 
 - Competitive Salary: Industry-competitive local salaries. We pay local rates that are at or above the market. We share this philosophy with GitLab. 
 - Equity: Generous equity package - we're all owners of Secfix and beneficiaries of our collective success. 
 - Holidays: 26 days holiday + local public holidays. 
 - Health Insurance: Comprehensive health coverage. 
 - Development Budget: €1, 000 annual personal development budget. 
 - Workspace Budget: Remote workspace budget and access to co-working spaces. 
 - Annual Retreat: Annual retreat to build connections and inspire ideas (this year we're headed to Alicante, Spain!). 
 - Tech Equipment: Latest tech equipment (MacBook, monitors, headphones). 
 - Company Events: Company-wide events to build relationships and have some fun!
 - Mentorship: We are backed by top VCs and accelerators and have direct access to world-class mentors. 

Our values: we are obsessed with our customers, we build smart, we create trust, we are hacky, we take ownership, and we are leaders of remote. 

We are an equal-opportunity employer and remote-only company. We work in sync using Gather as our virtual office and therefore cannot support 100% asynchronous work. Read more about our Remote Culture here.
