We are looking for a highly experienced Database Reliability Engineer (DBRE) with deep expertise in MongoDB, PostgreSQL, and Elasticsearch to own and support mission-critical database platforms serving enterprise SaaS applications. This role is not suitable for candidates with only development or basic DBA experience. The ideal candidate has extensive hands-on experience designing, operating, troubleshooting, and optimizing large-scale production environments containing millions of records, supporting 24x7 high-availability systems with strict uptime SLAs. The engineer will independently diagnose complex database failures, perform failovers, optimize performance under load, ensure business continuity, influence technical direction, and mentor junior engineers. 

Responsibilities

Database Design & Architecture

- Architect and implement scalable, high-availability MongoDB solutions including replica sets, sharded clusters, Atlas deployments, and disaster recovery architectures. 
 - Design, implement, and manage MongoDB, PostgreSQL, and Elasticsearch environments across development, staging, and production. 
 - Define schema design standards, sharding strategies, indexing approaches, data lifecycle management, and capacity planning. 

Production Reliability & Operations

- Own 24x7 production database operations with accountability for uptime, reliability, and SLA compliance. 
 - Diagnose and resolve complex database incidents, execute failovers, recovery activities, root-cause analysis, and business continuity procedures. 
 - Lead rolling upgrades, patching, migrations, and maintenance with minimal or zero downtime. 

Performance & Optimization

- Analyze query patterns, design optimal indexes, tune aggregation pipelines, and eliminate bottlenecks. 
 - Monitor performance metrics and drive continuous improvements using profiler, explain plans, Atlas tools, and observability platforms. 
 - Optimize high-volume databases containing millions of records and heavy workloads. 

Security & Reliability

- Implement RBAC, TLS/SSL, encryption, LDAP integration, auditing, backup, recovery, and disaster recovery strategies. 
 - Ensure enterprise-grade database security, resilience, and operational governance. 

Leadership & Collaboration

- Define database best practices, review data models, and provide technical leadership. 
 - Mentor junior engineers and collaborate with development, platform, SRE, and DevOps teams. 

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

- 8-12 years of database engineering, DBRE, DBA, or related experience. 
 - 5+ years of hands-on MongoDB production support experience. 
 - Deep expertise in replica sets, sharding, Atlas, replication, failover, query tuning, and aggregation framework. 
 - Strong PostgreSQL and Elasticsearch administration and performance tuning experience. 
 - Experience managing databases supporting enterprise SaaS applications and millions of records. 
 - Cloud experience on Azure , AWS, or GCP and strong Linux administration skills. 
 - Programming experience in . NET, Java, Python, JavaScript/Node. js, or similar technologies. 

Preferred Qualifications

- MongoDB Certified DBA or Developer certification. 
 - MongoDB Atlas Vector Search, time-series collections, Ops Manager, or Cloud Manager experience. 
 - Experience with Kafka, Spark, Redis, Elasticsearch, Azure Cosmos DB, and database migrations. 
 - Background in SaaS, telemetry, IoT, or large-scale enterprise data platforms. 

About Us

Honeywell Technologies is a global, pure-play automation company with a legacy of innovating to help solve the world's most mission-critical challenges, enhancing the quality of life for people and communities around the world. We serve the building, industrial and process sectors with a broad portfolio of services, solutions and products, underpinned by our Honeywell Technologies Accelerator operating system and Honeywell Technologies Forge intelligence layer. By combining the deep domain expertise of our more than 50, 000 employees with decades of data from our global installed base, we are uniquely positioned to lead the industrial sector's transition from automation to autonomy.

data.title: Director, Issue Validation Testing and Advisory
data.description:
PFI Innovation Centre India is an exciting new innovation center. We're building a future that helps people live better lives longer - and we're looking for bold thinkers and team players to help us do it. 

Here, you'll tackle complex challenges, collaborate with brilliant minds across the globe, and grow your career while helping millions achieve financial security. 

a Purpose Driven Company - 150 Years

While the PFI Innovation Centre brand is new to India, you'll be a part of the Prudential Financial, Inc. family. Founded in Newark, NJ, we serve 50 million customers across more than 50 countries. With $1. 334 trillion in assets, we're a global leader in institutional asset management. The 2nd largest life insurer in the US and the 9th largest institutional global asset manager. 

At the PFI Innovation Centre India, you'll find high-performance culture that's flexible, collaborative, and grounded in respect. We engage with candor, take calibrated risks, and hold ourselves accountable - always focused on delivering for our customers. It's the standard we choose every day as we grow, perform, and win as one team. We offer valuable leadership, mentoring and learning opportunities, paired with flexibility and support to help you thrive. 

Whether you're just starting out or ready to take your next step, we'll help you grow with purpose and do the best work of your career. 

What You Will Do

The Director, Issue Validation Testing and Advisory, serves as a trusted partner within the First Line Information Technology Operational Risk (ITOR) group and is accountable for issue validation testing, risk and controls advisory, governance, and reporting across Global Technology and Operations (GTO). The role leads multiple concurrent validation and control reviews to assess whether remediation addresses root causes, controls are designed and operating effectively, and risk outcomes are sustainable. The individual partners with business and technology leaders identify emerging risks, shape risk strategies and remediation priorities, and strengthen risk and control inventories. The role assists with risk and control governance forums, develops meaningful metrics and executive reporting, communicates risk themes and issue status to senior management, and escalates matters requiring timely decisions or intervention. The role also coordinates regulatory assessments and responses, client reviews, and SOC/SOX activities, supports the Privacy team as needed, and provides leadership, coaching, and quality oversight to ensure work is completed in accordance with department and industry standards. 

What You Can Expect

The Director, Issue Validation Testing and Advisory, leads the planning and execution of issue validation and control testing to confirm remediation addresses root causes and delivers sustainable outcomes. The role, as a risk advisor, partners with business and technology leaders to identify and assess emerging risks, shape risk strategies, clarify risk acceptance decisions, and align remediation priorities with enterprise standards and business objectives. The role strengthens the control environment by advising on control design, evaluating design and operating effectiveness, maintaining accurate risk and control inventories, identifying thematic gaps and trends, and driving clear ownership, monitoring, and timely remediation. The role also supports effective governance by facilitating risk and control forums, establishing meaningful metrics and reporting, communicating risk themes and issue status to senior management, and escalating matters requiring timely decisions or intervention. It coordinates regulatory assessments and responses, client reviews, and SOC/SOX activities across Global Technology and Operations, and supports the Privacy team with privacy-related risk assessments, incident response, data mapping, and privacy-by-design activities. 

- Lead issue validation and testing engagements to confirm that root causes are addressed and remediation is sustainable. 
 - Plan and schedule validation reviews for open issues, prioritizing work based on risk, target closure dates, and validation readiness. 
 - Coordinate validation activities with issue owners, control design functions, First Line management, and Audit to confirm scope, evidence requirements, dependencies, and review timelines. 
 - Assess remediation evidence and control implementation to determine whether corrective actions address root causes and operate as intended. 
 - Track validation progress, resolve evidence gaps, and escalate delays or risks that could affect timely issue closure. 
 - Partner with business and technology leaders to assess technology, cyber, data, resilience, and third-party risks; shape risk strategies; and align risk acceptance and remediation decisions with enterprise standards and business objectives. 
 - Lead risk assessments, maintain accurate process, risk, control, and issue inventories, and analyze trends and control gaps to strengthen control design, monitoring, remediation, governance, and reporting. 
 - Coordinate responses to risk events and emerging issues with business, Technology, Legal, Compliance, and control partners; provide executive reporting and escalation; facilitate root-cause and after-action reviews; and track corrective actions through sustainable resolution. 
 - Remain current on industry developments in cybersecurity, cloud, DevOps, information security, third-party risk management, and resilience. 
 - Lead and execute engagements that meet the department's methodologies and quality standards. 
 - Invest in professional development, educate others on key risks and controls, and support staff development, recruiting, performance management, and succession planning. 
 - Leverage data analytics and develop review programs to support risk assessments, review design, and testing of key GTO risks. 
 - Guide the team on continuous monitoring, year-over-year review coverage, aggregation of key issues for senior leadership, and stakeholder governance meetings. 
 - Support the Privacy team, as needed, with incident response and escalation, awareness activities, Privacy Impact Assessments, data mapping, and privacy-by-design engagement with Technology Product Owners. 
 - Lead and support regulatory gap assessments and responses, SOC/SOX activities, and client assessments in partnership with Technology, business, Legal, Compliance, and Audit stakeholders. 

What You Will Bring

- 8+ years of relevant experience gained through a combination of information security/technology, risk and/or audit related roles, including leading complex engagements and managing multiple concurrent deliverables. Specifically, experience in cloud operations, cyber security operations, vulnerability management or other IT operation-based specialist roles. 
 - Demonstrated expertise in the intricacies associated with a global company and its information technology/cyber security risk profile, including expanding regulatory requirements
 - Strong knowledge of emerging topics and current analytical methods and techniques used to monitor and manage relevant risks. 
 - Track record of supervising, coaching, and developing talent; experience with work planning, staffing, and reviewing team deliverables for quality and consistency. Proven stakeholder management and influencing skills, with experience communicating complex topics to senior management and driving alignment on issues, ownership, and remediation. 
 - Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including the ability to leverage data, metrics, and analytics to inform scoping, testing strategy, and thematic insights. 
 - Executive level communication skills, both oral and written, and the ability to partner effectively with multiple business groups, corporate areas, and second and third lines teams. 
 - Bachelor's degree related to technology, risk management, finance, or other quantitative fields of study

What will set you apart?

- Experience in leveraging and/or performing data analysis in support of internal auditing. 
 - Advanced degrees in information technology or cyber security are preferred: An MBA, CIA, CISA, CISSP and/or designations/certifications (e. g. , AI, AWS Cloud Practitioner) that demonstrate proficiency in information technology, information security, and/or cyber security related risks and controls is a plus. 
 - PFI Innovation Centre India welcomes all applicants, even if you don't meet every requirement. If your skills align with the role, we encourage you to apply.

Ventra is a leading business solutions provider for facility-based physicians practicing anesthesia, emergency medicine, hospital medicine, pathology, and radiology. Come Join Our Team!

Help Us Grow Our Dream Team - Join Us, Refer a Friend, and Earn a Referral Bonus!

Job Summary

- The Vendor Performance and Operations Analyst play a critical operational role in the Patient Responsibility Center of Excellence by providing real-time data monitoring, quality assurance, and performance analytics across all self-pay vendors. This position is responsible for continuously validating vendor input and output data, developing and maintaining performance scorecards, identifying trends and anomalies, and delivering actionable insights to support vendor management and operational optimization. 

Essential Functions And Tasks

 - Design, build, and maintain standardized vendor performance scorecards across all vendor categories, tracking KPIs including eligibility hit rates, clean claim rates, denial rates, and match rates. 
 - Compile and analyze monthly vendor performance data, identifying trends and variances; perform month-over-month, quarter-over-quarter, and year-over-year performance comparisons. 
 - Create and maintain automated performance dashboards using BI tools (Power BI, Tableau, or similar) that provide real-time visibility into vendor performance and operational metrics. 
 - Investigate data discrepancies and quality issues across vendor interfaces, documenting findings and coordinating resolution with appropriate teams. 
 - Develop and maintain escalation protocols for data quality issues, vendor performance problems, and SLA breaches. 
 - Provide evidence-based reporting to support vendor management decisions and escalations to executive leadership. 
 - Document and maintain workflows for all self-pay stages 
 - Manage client/vendor configurations

 - Support client onboarding and implementation of vendor workflows 
 - Identify and execute on process improvement opportunities 
 - Handle vendor workflow exception and issue resolution 
 - Produce documentation and training for internal teams

 - Familiarity with SQL and ability to query databases to extract and analyze data. 
 - Experience with healthcare billing systems or platforms (Epic, Cerner, Athena, or similar). 
 - Knowledge of healthcare compliance requirements and billing regulations. 
 - Excellent attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy. 
 - Strong written and verbal communication skills; ability to present data to non-technical audiences. 
 - Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities simultaneously. 
 - Collaborative team player with strong cross-functional communication skills. 
 - Proactive approach to identifying and addressing issues before they escalate. 
 - Ability to learn new systems and tools quickly. 
 - Customer service orientation with focus on delivering value to internal stakeholders. 
 - Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Outlook). 
 - Ability to read, understand, and apply state/federal laws, regulations, and policies. 
 - Ability to communicate with diverse personalities in a tactful, mature, and professional manner.

- Build and evolve modern web experiences for Compensation Collection, Shadow Payroll, and Equity products using Next. js, React, and TypeScript with a focus on performance, reliability, and clarity for tax, payroll, and mobility operators. 
 - Design and implement backend services and APIs using C#, . NET, and WebAPI to support compensation data ingestion, cross-border payroll calculations, equity event processing, and integrations with client HR, payroll, and equity administration systems (e. g. , Workday, SAP, ADP, Shareworks, E*TRADE, Carta).

 - Contribute to system architecture and technical design for multi-country payroll, compensation, and equity domains, including integration patterns using REST, file-based feeds, and event-driven approaches. 
 - Own production readiness for your work including logging, monitoring and alerting, reconciliation tooling, incident response support, and operational documentation-critical for payroll cycles and equity event deadlines that cannot slip. 
 - Apply secure development practices appropriate for handling sensitive compensation, payroll, and equity data including privacy, auditability, segregation of duties, and country-specific data protection requirements (GDPR, SOC 2, country-level payroll regulations).

 - Use agentic development practices including agent-driven development with Claude Code, Codex, or similar AI coding agents to accelerate design, implementation, testing, and operations across the SDLC.

 - Design and implement AI-powered features within Compensation Collection, Shadow Payroll, and Equity products including intelligent data extraction from compensation statements, anomaly detection on payroll inputs, LLM-assisted user workflows, and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) over tax and payroll guidance. 
 - Evaluate, integrate, and operationalize AI APIs, models, and toolchains within application architectures, ensuring responsible AI usage, cost management, and observability-especially where AI touches financially material outputs. 
 - Mentor and support other engineers through code reviews, pairing, and technical guidance on payroll, compensation, and equity domain patterns. 

Required Qualifications

- 5+ years professional software development experience building enterprise web applications and services, ideally including payroll, compensation, equity, HR, finance, or tax domains.

 - Strong backend development experience in C# and . NET (ASP. NET, WebAPI, MVC) including API design and service patterns for high-integrity calculation and data-processing systems. 
 - Proven experience with Microsoft Azure designing and building cloud solutions using PaaS services, frameworks, and operational tooling. 
 - Experience delivering systems in regulated or compliance-oriented environments (security controls, auditability, privacy, sensitive financial or personal data handling). 
 - Strong engineering fundamentals including design patterns, separation of concerns, scalable architecture, and pragmatic trade-offs-with attention to accuracy and reconciliation in calculation-heavy systems. 
 - Experience with agentic or AI-assisted development workflows such as spec-driven development, agent-driven development using tools like Claude Code or Codex, or similar AI coding agent practices. 
 - Demonstrated ability to build products that incorporate AI capabilities including prompt design, LLM API integration, or AI-augmented user experiences. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Direct experience building or integrating with payroll, shadow payroll, compensation collection, equity administration, or global mobility tax platforms. 
 - Familiarity with cross-border compensation concepts: gross-to-net calculations, hypothetical tax, tax equalization, modified shadow payroll, and equity-related compensation events (RSU vest, ISO/NSO exercise, ESPP). 
 - Experience integrating with HCM, payroll, and equity systems such as Workday, SAP SuccessFactors, ADP, Ceridian/Dayforce, Shareworks, E*TRADE, Carta, or country-specific payroll engines.

 - Strong testing discipline including TDD and BDD, xUnit, Jest or Mocha, CI/CD automation, and quality gates-especially for calculation engines requiring reconciliation and regression coverage. 
 - Experience building analytics and reporting with BI and data visualization tools, including payroll reconciliation, compensation analytics, and equity reporting.

Technical Skills We Value

data.description:
Company Description

Join the leader in global work. Vialto helps leading organizations identify, develop, and execute their workforce priorities with confidence. Our practice areas include global tax, immigration, rewards, advisory and Vialto private and our team is the gold standard in navigating the complexities of cross-border compliance, and workforce strategies. We look for people our clients and assignees can count on to thoughtfully deliver clear solutions to complex problems. 

To be the best in the business, we cultivate a dynamic, highly collaborative culture that fuels the growth of our people. We invite you to inquire boldly, learn deeply, and grow endlessly with us. You'll work alongside recognized experts, shaping people-first, technology-driven solutions that drive the future of work. We help our clients achieve their goals and imagine new possibilities. And we can do the same for you. Whatever your aspirations, Vialto can help you find your way. 

Job Description

We are hiring a hands-on Solutions Architect to design, build, and operate complex, regulated, global solutions across payroll, tax, and immigration domains. This role is technical-first: you will own the end-to-end architecture for a product or suite of products and contribute directly to implementation (spikes, reference services, critical-path features), while partnering with a global, cross-functional team to drive delivery, deployments, and production support across time zones. You will also lead the adoption of AI-powered development practices-including spec-driven development and agentic coding tools (e. g. , Claude Code, Codex)-and design AI-enabled solutions using Azure OpenAI APIs and intelligent agents to automate business process flows. 

What You'll Do (Hands-On)

- Architecture + Build: Produce architecture designs and implement key components (reference implementations, platform libraries, integration adapters, critical workflows). 
 - Distributed Systems: Design and build event-driven services (messaging, async workflows, idempotency, retries, backpressure, eventual consistency), including well-defined event contracts and versioning strategies. 
 - Azure Solution Design: Build using Azure PaaS services and patterns (identity, networking, storage, messaging, API management, monitoring), with practical tradeoffs across cost, scalability, resilience, and latency. Design and integrate AI capabilities using Azure OpenAI APIs (GPT, embeddings, assistants) to enable intelligent features and agent-driven automation within business process flows. 
 - Front-End Architecture: Architect and ship large Next. js/React applications (routing, state strategy, data-fetching patterns, performance, accessibility, modularization, micro-frontend considerations where relevant). 
 - Integration Architecture: Define secure integration patterns (REST and event-based), build connectors/adapters, and establish operational runbooks for partner/client integrations. 
 - Security by Design: Implement secure SDLC practices-threat modeling, secrets management, encryption, least-privilege access, audit logging, and secure defaults aligned to regulated environments. 
 - Authentication & Authorization: Implement end-to-end authn/authz using OAuth2/OIDC, SSO, and token-based access. Design RBAC/ABAC/ReBAC, tenant-aware authorization, API scopes/claims, and service-to-service identity (e. g. , managed identities). 
 - Operational Readiness: Own observability and reliability patterns (structured logging, metrics, tracing, SLOs, alerting, incident response) and participate in troubleshooting production issues. 
 - Documentation that Ships: Create actionable architecture artifacts (ADRs, sequence diagrams, domain flows, deployment diagrams, runbooks) that teams can execute against. 
 - AI Agent Design; Process Automation: Design, build, and deploy AI agents that automate business process flows-using Azure OpenAI APIs, function calling, orchestration frameworks, and RAG pipelines-with appropriate guardrails, evaluation, and human-in-the-loop controls for regulated environments. 
 - Technical Leadership: Drive peer architecture/code reviews, coach engineers, and raise engineering standards across onshore/offshore teams. Lead and mentor teams in agentic development practices-spec-driven workflows, AI-assisted coding (Claude Code, Codex), and automated test/review generation-to accelerate delivery velocity while maintaining quality and governance. 

Patterns We Expect You to Use

- Event-based systems (pub/sub, workflow orchestration, event sourcing where appropriate) 
 - Distributed systems (partitioning, resiliency, failure-mode design, consistency tradeoffs) 
 - Domain-driven integration approaches (bounded contexts, contracts, anti-corruption layers) 
 - Agentic AI patterns including plan/execute/verify loops, tool/function calling, RAG, verifier/critic steps, guardrails, evaluation, and agent observability/auditability. Experience applying these patterns to automate business process flows using Azure OpenAI APIs and orchestration frameworks. 

AI-Enabled Delivery Expectations

- Experience working in environments using AI for development, build, and operations (coding assistants such as Claude Code and Codex, automated PR reviews, test generation, incident support). 
 - Comfortable using a spec-driven AI development workflow: translating requirements into structured specs, acceptance criteria, diagrams, and prompts that accelerate delivery while maintaining governance. Ability to lead teams in adopting agentic development practices-spec-driven development, AI-assisted coding, and agent-based automation-as standard ways of working. 

Required Qualifications

- 10+ years in software engineering, including 3+ years in architecture/solution design (or equivalent scope). 
 - Proven experience designing and operating solutions in a regulated global environment (privacy, auditability, security controls, cross-border considerations). 
 - Strong Azure experience designing and building cloud-native solutions using Microsoft PaaS and frameworks, including Azure OpenAI APIs for AI-enabled features and agent-based automation. 
 - Strong experience architecting Next. js and/or React applications at scale. 
 - Demonstrated experience with event-driven and distributed system design and production operations. 
 - Hands-on experience with agentic development tools and practices (e. g. , Claude Code, Codex, spec-driven development) and a track record of leading engineering teams in AI-assisted delivery workflows. 
 - Strong communication skills: can explain tradeoffs clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with enterprise integrations (HRIS, payroll providers, finance systems) and/or iPaaS patterns. 
 - Strong testing and automation mindset (TDD/BDD, CI/CD quality gates). 
 - Experience with data modeling, SQL, and reporting/analytics. 
 - Microsoft certifications (Azure Solutions Architect or similar) a plus. 
 - Experience designing AI agents to automate business process flows (e. g. , using Azure OpenAI Assistants API, LangChain, Semantic Kernel, or similar orchestration frameworks). 
 - Bachelor's degree required; Master's degree preferred. 

Additional Information

- This job is based in our Bangalore office, with the possibility of a hybrid work mode
 - We are an equal opportunity employer that does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected status
 - Please note that AI is used as part of the application process

data.description:
Job Purpose

To design system solutions, prepare user document and monitor UAT plan execution, aid in prioritization of projects and UATs and monitoring production issue resolution on a daily basis. 

The role is also responsible for designing and documenting the workflow and making appropriate recommendations that will positively impact operational effectiveness. 

Job Context & Major Challenges

Job Context: To design system solutions, prepare user document and monitor UAT plan execution, aid in prioritization of projects and UATs and monitoring production issue resolution on a daily basis. 

The role is also responsible for designing and documenting the workflow and making appropriate recommendations that will positively impact operational effectiveness. 

Job Challenges: 

- Understanding and gathering user requirement and preparing a business requirement document despite inadequate clarity of thought from the users
 - Downloading the business requirement to IT team who lacks the required end to end process expertise. 
 - Downloading the business needs/criticalities to the vendors who lack the required domain expertise to address BSLI system requirements. 
 - Executing multiple projects simultaneously within their defined timelines with various iterations and limited resources. 
 - Aligning the work schedule basis constantly shifting organisational priorities. 
 - Managing user expectations considering the system limitations and process constraints. 

Key Result Areas

KRA (Accountabilities) (Max 1325 Characters)Supporting Actions (Max 1325 Characters)

KRA1 Understanding business process management and business requirements of the Operations team and translating them to specific user requirements. 1. Gathering user requirements for all sub verticals within operations related to various core and peripheral systems existing in BSLI. 

- Understand the business needs, and ensure that requirement is accurately documented in requirement template. 
 - Defining the scope basis business needs and system constraints. 
 - Obtaining Sign-off from the stakeholders on the final UR and scheduling the same for development. 

KRA2 Planning and monitoring UAT and ensure that timelines are met with expected quality parameters. 1. Planning and assigning of UAT's received within the team

- Analysing and preparing Modal test points and downloading the testing scope to the team
 - Reviewing the defects raised by the team and raising it with IT and follow up for resolution. 
 - Monitoring the execution of test cases as planned and signing-off the UAT within set timeline and quality parameters. 
 - Preparing System Manuals, Imparting training to the team members & stakeholders
 - Maintaining repository of test packs and requirement documents for all system changes for effective utilisation in future
 - Monitoring Post production movement and ensuring smooth handover of activity to the stakeholders. 

KRA3 Monitoring the production issues and providing timely resolution as per the set quality standard. 1. Monitoring the production issues raised by users and providing timely resolution with set quality standards. 

- Reporting of system bugs to IT identified at the time of production issues analysis and following up with IT team for timely resolution. 
 - Proactively raise change request with IT for strengthening system validations in order to avoid/minimise the recurrence of the errors. 

KRA4 Monitor the readiness of BSLI and vendor systems before product launch 1. Preparing and maintaining phase 1 and phase 2 system features basis the occurrence of the event. 

- Raising the change request at vendors end and at IT for immediate and vital changes within set timelines. 
 - Monitoring and coordinating UAT of new product for all internal and vendor systems and signing-off within set timeline and quality parameters. 
 - Documenting the process changes and imparting training on new product features to the stakeholders. 

KRA5 Monitor the performance of team to ensure the objectives of the department are accomplished. 1. Analyzing the roles and responsibility of various team members and design the Key responsibility Areas for the team based on the expertise and designations. 

- Guiding team to achieve the company and personal goals. 
 - Identify exceptional performance and recommend for further elevations to reporting manager.

This team focuses on the highest-impact workflows, creating standardized, repeatable capabilities that can be deployed globally. Operating with a mandate for speed and measurable outcomes, VLabs works alongside service line, product, and platform leaders. 

About The Role

AI Test Engineering is a hands-on role within VLabs Quality Engineering, responsible for validating the performance, reliability, and integrity of AI-enabled solutions in production environments. This role operates at the intersection of AI engineering and quality assurance, ensuring that outputs from LLMs, OCR pipelines, document classification models, and agentic workflows perform as expected at scale and meet defined business performance thresholds. Working closely with the Programme Test Manager and partnering with engineering, product, and delivery teams, this role translates AI testing strategy into executable frameworks, evaluation pipelines, and reusable assets embedded into the delivery lifecycle. 

Success requires independent execution, strong technical depth, and the ability to proactively identify risks, patterns, and performance gaps while enabling rapid, production-grade deployment of AI capabilities. 

Key Responsibilities

AI Evaluation & Test Design

- Translate AI testing strategy into executable test scenarios across LLM outputs, document classification, extraction accuracy, agent workflows, and edge cases 
 - Design adversarial and boundary test inputs to expose hallucination, misclassification, and failure modes 
 - Validate AI outputs for structure, consistency, accuracy, and production readiness against defined performance thresholds

Evaluation Engineering & Automation

- Build reusable Python-based evaluation frameworks, including output validation, hallucination detection, and scoring mechanisms 
 - Develop parameterized test scripts reusable across features, models, and releases 
 - Implement AI-as-Judge frameworks, including prompt design, scoring logic, and calibration of evaluation reliability 
 - Embed evaluation frameworks into CI/CD pipelines to support continuous testing and deployment

Drift Detection & Quality Monitoring

- Design and operate drift detection frameworks using fixed baseline datasets and scheduled re-evaluation 
 - Establish thresholds to distinguish acceptable variation from performance degradation 
 - Enable release gating by identifying regressions prior to production deployment

Ground Truth & Data Quality

- Build and maintain ground truth datasets in partnership with subject matter experts 
 - Define standards for classification, extraction accuracy, and acceptable output characteristics 
 - Continuously update datasets to reflect evolving business requirements and use cases

Workflow & Integration Testing

- Test end-to-end agentic workflows, validating data integrity, error propagation, and fallback behavior 
 - Perform API-level testing of AI pipeline endpoints using Python and Postman/Newman 
 - Validate data persistence and integrity across system layers using SQL 
 - Partner with engineering teams to ensure testability, observability, and system reliability

Standardization & Scaling

- Define and scale standardized AI evaluation patterns and reusable quality frameworks across VLabs 
 - Contribute to enterprise AI quality standards and reference architectures

Governance & Responsible AI

- Ensure adherence to Responsible AI, data privacy, and governance requirements 
 - Support auditability, traceability, and transparency of AI outputs and evaluation processes

Stakeholder Enablement

- Translate evaluation results into actionable insights for engineering, product, and business stakeholders 
 - Support decision-making on model readiness, release risk, and performance trade-offs 
 - Proactively identify risks, patterns, and systemic issues and escalate appropriately

Qualifications & Experience

Professional Experience

- 7+ years in software testing, including 2-3 years focused on AI/ML-enabled systems in production environments 
 - Proven experience designing and executing AI evaluation frameworks and quality strategies 
 - Strong track record building ground truth datasets, drift detection systems, and scalable evaluation pipelines 
 - Experience testing multi-step agentic workflows and AI-driven automation systems 
 - Experience operating in fast-paced, iterative delivery environments 
 - Background in regulated or compliance-driven environments preferred

Technical Expertise

- Advanced Python programming for evaluation frameworks, batch processing, and data analysis 
 - Experience with LLM evaluation tools such as deepeval, RAGAS, promptfoo, or similar 
 - Strong capabilities in: 
 - AI output validation, hallucination detection, and grounding checks 
 - Drift detection frameworks and statistical evaluation methods 
 - OCR, VLM, and document AI testing (classification, extraction, edge cases) 
 - API testing using Python (requests/httpx) and Postman/Newman 
 - SQL for data validation and pipeline integrity checks 
 - Familiarity with LangChain, LlamaIndex, or similar frameworks

Operating Capabilities

 - Proactive communicator who identifies risks and drives resolution

Education

data.title: Senior Core Infrastructure Engineer
data.description:
Job Summary

JOB DESCRIPTION

As a Core Infrastructure Engineer, you will design, build, and optimize the software and systems that power OCI AI compute infrastructure, including the GPU control plane and GPU data plane. You will combine software development and systems expertise to improve how GPU and bare metal resources are tested, provisioned, and operated. You will work with engineering, operations, and product teams to solve infrastructure problems, improve workload performance, and deliver a reliable customer experience. 

Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

- Design and develop scalable infrastructure services and features for the GPU control plane, GPU data plane, and bare metal systems supporting customer AI workloads. 
 - Build and improve automation for testing, provisioning, and validating GPU and bare metal compute resources to support reliable customer delivery. 
 - Develop modular, reusable infrastructure components with clear interfaces, security and compliance controls, diagnostics, telemetry, and production monitoring. 
 - Apply system design and distributed systems principles to resolve infrastructure bottlenecks and improve scalability, reliability, and workload performance. 
 - Collaborate with development, operations, and product management teams to translate requirements into practical infrastructure and orchestration solutions. 
 - Define benchmarks and automate performance and reliability measurements across customer workloads and the underlying infrastructure stack. 
 - Provide technical guidance on ambiguous problems, mentor junior developers, and strengthen design reviews, coding standards, code reviews, unit testing, and integration testing. 
 - Provide operational support and drive continuous improvements to enable GPU delivery to customers at scale. 
 - Collaborate across geographies to deliver features, bug fixes, and operational enhancements. 

Qualifications & Skills Mandatory

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. 
 - 5+ years of software development experience using one or more languages such as Java, Go, C, C++, C#, or Rust. 
 - At least 3 years of experience designing and developing large-scale infrastructure, distributed systems, and services. 
 - At least 1 year of experience providing technical leadership and bringing clarity to cross-functional projects while collaborating with stakeholders. 
 - Strong software engineering and systems fundamentals, including system design, distributed systems concepts, and systematic troubleshooting across software and infrastructure. 
 - Clear communication, ownership of outcomes, and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment. 

Good-to-Have

- Hands-on software development experience in Java or Go; these are the preferred languages for the team. 
 - Experience combining GPU infrastructure knowledge with software development, particularly in testing, provisioning, or operating GPU systems. 
 - Experience developing software for bare metal systems or cloud infrastructure, providing a relevant foundation for GPU infrastructure work. 
 - Cloud native engineering experience, including Docker, Kubernetes, or related containerization and orchestration technologies. 
 - Experience scheduling high-performance workloads using Kubernetes or Slurm. 
 - Experience building or managing cloud infrastructure at very large scale, including environments with hundreds of thousands of servers. 

Self-Assessment Questions

- Do I meet the required software development experience, and can I explain software I have built and maintained in a relevant programming language? 
 - Can I describe at least 3 years of work designing or developing large-scale infrastructure, distributed systems, or services, including key design tradeoffs? 
 - Can I demonstrate how I used both software and systems knowledge to diagnose an infrastructure problem and improve reliability or performance? 
 - Can I share examples from at least 1 year of providing technical direction and resolving ambiguity while working with cross-functional stakeholders? 
 - Can I explain how I take ownership of delivery, communicate technical decisions clearly, and manage competing priorities?

About Us

Only Oracle brings together the data, infrastructure, applications, and expertise to power everything from industry innovations to life-saving care. And with AI embedded across our products and services, we help customers turn that promise into a better future for all. Discover your potential at a company leading the way in AI and cloud solutions that impact billions of lives.

Domain-Specific AI Integration

data.title: AI Architect
data.description:
The AI Architect designs, governs, and delivers production-grade AI capabilities, including LLM integration, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and agentic workflows, as part of secure, scalable, and maintainable healthcare products. The role is weighted toward AI/GenAI architecture and core system architecture: distributed systems, microservices, APIs, data, cloud infrastructure, security, and operations. The AI Architect translates product goals, customer commitments, and engineering constraints into architecture that works end to end, from user experience and service boundaries through data pipelines, model and retrieval layers, integrations, deployment, and runtime monitoring. 

This is not a prompt-engineering or agent-building role in isolation. Prompts, models, and agents are components of a larger system, and this role is accountable for everything around them: service decomposition, contracts, data flow, state management, latency and cost budgets, failure handling, security and PHI protection, observability, evaluation, and long-term maintainability. The ideal candidate is a hands-on architect who has shipped GenAI to production and can defend the full system design, not only the model layer. 

Essential Duties And Responsibilities

- Lead the architecture of GenAI, RAG, and agentic AI solutions, including model selection, prompt and context design, retrieval strategy, tool/function calling, multi-agent orchestration, memory and state management, and human-in-the-loop controls. 
 - Design and evolve a shared enterprise AI platform: LLM gateway and model abstraction, prompt and configuration management, embedding and vector search services, agent orchestration (e. g. , LangGraph, Semantic Kernel), guardrails, and evaluation services. 
 - Define RAG and knowledge architectures end to end: ingestion, chunking, embedding, indexing, hybrid search, re-ranking, access control on retrieved content, data freshness, and grounding/citation strategy. 
 - Establish AI evaluation and LLMOps practices, including offline and online evaluation, golden datasets, regression testing of prompts and models, hallucination and quality metrics, A/B testing, and controlled model/version rollout and rollback. 
 - Drive AI governance, safety, and security: prompt-injection and data-exfiltration defenses, PII/PHI redaction, content filtering, auditability, model risk assessment, and alignment with Responsible AI and healthcare regulatory requirements such as HIPAA. 
 - Make and document build-vs-buy and model trade-off decisions (managed services such as AWS Bedrock vs. open-weight or self-hosted models) based on quality, latency, cost, data residency, and vendor risk. 
 - Own end-to-end system design for AI-enabled features: service decomposition, microservice boundaries, API and event contracts, synchronous vs. asynchronous patterns, data ownership, and integration with existing product and legacy systems. 
 - Design for non-functional requirements across the full stack: scalability, availability, resiliency (timeouts, retries, circuit breakers, fallbacks, and graceful degradation when models fail), performance, latency and token-cost budgets, multi-tenancy, and disaster recovery. 
 - Define data architecture for AI workloads, including operational and analytical stores, vector databases, caching, streaming and event pipelines, data lineage, retention, and secure handling of clinical and patient data. 
 - Architect cloud-native deployment on AWS containers and Kubernetes/ECS, serverless, networking, identity and access, secrets management, infrastructure as code, and CI/CD for both application and AI artifacts. 
 - Define observability across AI and non-AI components together: distributed tracing across services and model calls, prompt/response logging with privacy controls, quality and drift monitoring, cost tracking, SLOs, and alerting. 
 - Define architecture standards, reference architectures, design patterns, API guidelines, and service templates that product teams can adopt consistently. 
 - Analyze current-state architecture, technical debt, and integration constraints to identify where AI can be introduced safely and where modernization must come first. 
 - Partner with product management to translate business priorities and customer commitments into technically feasible AI roadmaps, implementation strategies, and incremental releases with measurable outcomes. 
 - Build proofs of concept and reference implementations hands-on to validate feasibility, and define the path from proof of concept to production-hardened service. 
 - Lead architecture reviews and lightweight governance aligned to agile delivery, covering both AI-specific risks and core design quality. 
 - Mentor senior engineers and engineering managers in GenAI engineering, system design, distributed systems, service ownership, and accountable AI practices. 
 - Document architecture decisions (ADRs), system and sequence diagrams, service catalogs, AI model and prompt inventories, technical risks, and roadmaps in formats usable by engineers and product stakeholders. 
 - Use AI-assisted engineering tools such as GitHub Copilot, Claude, and ChatGPT Enterprise to accelerate codebase exploration, design comparison, and documentation while retaining accountability for decisions. 
 - Track the evolving AI landscape (models, agent frameworks, protocols such as MCP, and evaluation methods) and turn relevant advances into pragmatic architecture guidance. 

Key Outcomes

- Production GenAI and agentic AI capabilities delivered as reliable, secure, observable product features rather than isolated prototypes or demos. 
 - A reusable enterprise AI platform (model gateway, retrieval/RAG services, agent orchestration, evaluation, and guardrails) that product teams adopt consistently. 
 - End-to-end architectures in which AI components are properly integrated with microservices, APIs, event flows, data stores, identity, and cloud infrastructure, with clear service boundaries and contracts. 
 - AI systems that meet defined targets for quality, latency, availability, cost, and safety, with governance, PHI protection, and Responsible AI practices built in from the start. 
 - Stronger alignment among product, engineering, QA, DevOps, data, security, and leadership stakeholders around feasible and sustainable AI-enabled solutions. 

Education And Experience

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Technology, Software Engineering, or a related discipline is required; equivalent deep technical experience may be considered. 
 - Master's degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence/Machine Learning, Data Science, Software Engineering, or a related discipline is preferred. 
 - Certifications such as AWS Solutions Architect, AWS Machine Learning/GenAI, TOGAF, AI Engineer, or CKA/CKAD are preferred when supported by practical implementation experience. 
 - Overall Experience of fourteen (14)+ years in software development and architecture. 
 - Eight (8)+ years of architecture or technical design experience across distributed systems, microservices, APIs, data, and cloud platforms. 
 - Three (3)+ years architecting and delivering AI/GenAI solutions, including at least one LLM, RAG, or agent-based system running in production with real users. 
 - Proven experience designing end-to-end architectures for complex, high-scale applications, from service decomposition and data modeling through deployment, observability, and operations. 
 - Hands-on experience integrating AI components into existing products and legacy systems, including reliability, latency, cost, and security trade-offs. 
 - Experience with AI evaluation, LLMOps/MLOps, and AI governance in a regulated industry; healthcare/EHR experience is preferred. 

Skills, Knowledge, And Abilities

- Expert knowledge of GenAI architecture: LLM integration, prompt and context engineering, RAG, embeddings and vector search, agentic and multi-agent patterns, tool/function calling, and frameworks such as LangGraph, Semantic Kernel, LangChain, or LlamaIndex. 
 - Expert knowledge of system design and distributed systems: microservices, domain-driven design, API design (REST, gRPC, GraphQL), event-driven architecture, messaging and streaming, consistency and state management, caching, and scalability patterns. 
 - Strong understanding of AI quality and safety: evaluation frameworks, hallucination mitigation, guardrails, prompt-injection defenses, AI observability, and Responsible AI principles. 
 - Strong understanding of full-stack product engineering, relational, NoSQL, and vector databases, CI/CD, containers and Kubernetes, infrastructure as code, security architecture (identity, encryption, zero trust), and performance engineering. 
 - Ability to reason about and quantify trade-offs across accuracy, latency, cost, reliability, and maintainability, and to explain them clearly. 
 - Ability to create architecture decision records, reference architectures, system and sequence diagrams, service catalogs, and reusable engineering patterns. 
 - Strong communication skills with the ability to align technical and non-technical stakeholders around architecture decisions and trade-offs. 
 - Thinks in systems: designs the full request path, data flow, and failure modes around AI components, not only the model or prompt. 
 - Influences across engineering, product, QA, DevOps, data, security, and leadership teams without relying only on formal authority. 
 - Balances innovation speed with production readiness, customer commitments, and regulatory obligations. 
 - Converts ambiguity into clear architecture direction, incremental delivery plans, and executable engineering guidance. 
 - Mentors teams toward full-cycle ownership, reusable patterns, and accountable AI engineering practices. 
 - Maintains practical governance that improves quality and speed rather than increasing unnecessary process overhead. 

Tools and Technologies

- GenAI and LLM platforms: AWS Bedrock, Anthropic Claude, OpenAI models, and open-weight models (e. g. , Llama, Mistral); Model Context Protocol (MCP). 
 - Agent and orchestration frameworks: LangGraph, Semantic Kernel, LangChain, LlamaIndex, and AWS Bedrock Agents. 
 - Vector and knowledge stores: pgvector, OpenSearch/Elasticsearch, Pinecone, Weaviate; knowledge graphs and graph databases such as Neo4j or Neptune. 
 - AI evaluation and observability: LangSmith, Langfuse, Ragas, or similar; OpenTelemetry, CloudWatch, and APM tools. 
 - Java, Python, TypeScript, JavaScript, SQL, REST/gRPC APIs, microservices, Angular/React, Node. js, and legacy technologies relevant to existing products. 
 - AWS services including Lambda, ECS/EKS, API Gateway, S3, IAM, Cognito, Step Functions, SQS/SNS, EventBridge, CloudWatch, Aurora, DynamoDB, Glue, and SageMaker. 
 - Kafka/streaming, relational and NoSQL databases, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, DynamoDB, Redis, data lakes, and distributed computing tools where applicable. 
 - CI/CD and platform tools such as Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, Jenkins, GitHub Actions, Git/GitHub, NuGet, NPM, and feature management tools. 
 - AI-assisted engineering tools: GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT Enterprise/Team, Claude, and approved AI assistants; architecture and documentation tools for diagrams, ADRs, and service catalogs. 

AI Usage And Accountability Requirements

- AI capabilities must be designed as part of the full system, with defined service boundaries, fallbacks, and ownership; prompts and agents are not shipped as standalone artifacts. 
 - Every production AI feature must have defined evaluation criteria, quality thresholds, monitoring, and a rollback path before release. 
 - PHI/PII handling, access control on retrieved data, audit logging, and human-in-the-loop controls must be designed in from the start, aligned with HIPAA and organizational AI policy. 
 - Architecture decisions must remain traceable to business goals, quality attributes, cost, implementation feasibility, and known trade-offs. 
 - AI-assisted recommendations, including those from coding and architecture assistants, must be validated against product context, engineering constraints, performance needs, maintainability, and operational risk. 
 - Reusable prompts, agent patterns, evaluation datasets, reference architectures, and design-review checklists should be maintained as organizational assets. 

Success Measures / Accountable Outcomes

- Number of GenAI and agentic capabilities moved from proof of concept to production, and time from proof of concept to production. 
 - AI quality and reliability against agreed targets: groundedness/accuracy, hallucination and escalation rates, latency, availability, and cost per transaction. 
 - Adoption of the shared AI platform and reference architectures across product teams, and reduction in duplicated or one-off AI implementations. 
 - Reduction in production incidents, integration defects, and technical debt attributable to architecture, including in AI-enabled services. 
 - No critical AI security or PHI incidents, with audit-ready AI governance documentation. 
 - Improvement in delivery readiness for strategic AI product initiatives and customer-committed capabilities. 

AI Competency Alignment

Competency

Target Proficiency

Expert

Agentic AI and Multi-Agent System Design

Advanced to Expert

RAG and Knowledge Architecture

Advanced to Expert

End-to-End System Design and Distributed Systems

Advanced

Authority and Autonomy

- Leads AI and system architecture decisions for product areas and complex initiatives. 
 - Determines AI platform direction, architecture approaches, standards, service models, and model and vendor choices in partnership with engineering, product, security, and compliance leadership. 
 - Holds authority to require architecture and AI readiness review before AI capabilities reach production. 
 - Work is reviewed through alignment with business goals, technical outcomes, product objectives, and departmental strategy. 

Work Environment / Physical Demands

This position is primarily sedentary and requires regular use of a computer, keyboard, financial systems, collaboration tools, and data visualization platforms. The role requires the ability to review information on a computer screen for extended periods and communicate clearly with internal stakeholders, external partners, and team members.

data.title: Engineering Director
data.description:
Job Description

About Us

Sage is a global leader in accounting and business management software, trusted by millions of businesses worldwide. Together with our Bengaluru engineering team, we are building a finance, accounting, payroll and expense management solutions solution that simplifies how businesses track and reconcile spending. 

Thousands of finance teams globally use our product to streamline expense management, integrate seamlessly with leading accounting platforms, and are recognized for its clean design, usability, and speed. 

We're investing heavily in AI, building the platform that lets AI agents and assistants do real engineering work, reliably and at scale. This team owns coding agents, review agents, skills and plugins, context and memory systems, evaluation frameworks, and the feedback loops that make them better over time. 

What We're Looking For

We're looking for someone with 12+ years of software engineering experience and 6+ years leading engineering teams, including a track record of building and scaling platforms or infrastructure teams. 

Leadership

- Experience leading managers or multiple teams, and building teams from the ground up: recruiting, developing, and retaining engineers with care and candor. 
 - Experience leading distributed teams across multiple time zones and regions. 
 - Strong stakeholder management and the ability to influence without authority across a complex organization. 
 - Excellent written and verbal communication, from engineers to executives, comfort setting direction and making decisions with incomplete information. 
 - Experience managing budgets, headcount planning, and vendor relationships. 

Technical Skills

- Deep experience in platform, infrastructure, or developer tooling, hands-on background building and operating production systems in the cloud including containers, Kubernetes, and infrastructure as code. 
 - Strong grounding in distributed systems: reliability, scalability, async workflows, and failure handling. 
 - Working knowledge of how LLM-based systems are built: agents and tool use, prompt and context engineering, RAG, memory, evaluation, and observability. 
 - Familiarity with agent protocols and ecosystems and fluency with AI coding tools. 
 - Experience scaling AI-assisted development tools across a large engineering organization. 
 - Understanding of the SDLC and developer productivity systems: CI/CD, code review, testing, and deployment. 

Mindset & Collaboration

- Growth mindset: curious, always learning, and open to feedback. 
 - Leads by example and raises the bar for everyone around them, works well across disciplines and time zones. 

Nice to Have

- Experience with developer productivity metrics and tying platform investments to business results. 
 - Background in security, governance, or compliance for AI systems: data handling, access control, and auditability. 
 - Experience with trace analysis, online and offline evaluation, model routing, and cost optimization. 
 - Open-source or public contributions to AI infrastructure or developer tooling. 

What to Expect

- We value humility and collaboration, we're looking for people who can work as part of a team, not in silos. 
 - We expect leaders to take ownership beyond delivery, including team health, engineering culture, and long-term platform quality. 

Key Responsibilities

The Impact You'll Make

- Define the vision, strategy, and multi-quarter roadmap for our AI infrastructure and agent platform, tied to measurable outcomes: developer productivity, quality, and time to production. 
 - Make build-vs-buy and architecture decisions across models, orchestration, retrieval, and evaluation, define how we measure success through evaluation standards, quality signals, and developer productivity metrics. 
 - Recruit, hire, and retain strong engineers and engineering managers, coach and develop managers and senior ICs with clear expectations, regular feedback, and career growth paths. 
 - Build a team culture that works well across time zones: clear ownership, strong written communication, and healthy handoffs. 
 - Own delivery of platform capabilities: agent orchestration, tool and skill registries, plugin frameworks, context and memory management, RAG, trace mining, observability, and developer tooling. 
 - Keep delivery predictable: spot risks and blockers early, and balance near-term wins with foundational investments, ensure reliability, security, cost control, and operational excellence for production AI systems. 
 - Work with engineering, product, security, data, and infrastructure leaders to find high-value workflows and integrate agents into the SDLC. 
 - Lead adoption: onboarding, enablement, documentation, and feedback channels so teams adopt the platform and keep using it. 
 - Communicate clearly with executives and stakeholders about progress, tradeoffs, risks, and results.

 - You are results oriented, self-motivated, flexible, collaborative and able to adapt in a fast-paced, changing environment
 - Effective in influencing and using effective collaborative relationships for success

Preferred Qualifications

- Good business sense/discernment and a strong foundation of business analytics/financial skills
 - You are results oriented, self-motivated, flexible, collaborative and able to adapt in a fast-paced, changing environment
 - Effective in influencing and using effective collaborative relationships for success

Why Cisco?

At Cisco, we're revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era - and beyond. We've been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.

Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you'll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

About

To ensure that we hire the best talent in the right way, we follow a strict hiring process and recently, Cisco has been made aware of fraudulent recruiters claiming to be from the company. Please be advised that any communication from Cisco about careers will:

Engineer reliable, secure and scalable cloud services by combining production operations with software engineering, automation, observability and cloud platform expertise. The role owns service reliability outcomes across the application lifecycle and partners with development, infrastructure, security and support teams to prevent incidents, reduce toil and improve customer experience. 

Role Overview

We are seeking an experienced Site Reliability and Cloud Engineer with strong hands-on expertise in AWS and/or Microsoft Azure. The successful candidate will design, deploy, operate and continuously improve production services, with a focus on availability, performance, resilience, security and operational efficiency. 

This is an engineering-led production role. The engineer will use automation, infrastructure as code, telemetry and disciplined incident/problem management to create sustainable services, accelerate safe change and reduce manual operational effort. 

Key Responsibilities

- Own the reliability, availability, performance and operational readiness of cloud-hosted applications and platform services
 - Define and maintain service level indicators (SLIs), service level objectives (SLOs), availability targets and actionable service-health dashboards
 - Build monitoring and alerting around customer-impacting symptoms, golden signals and service dependencies; reduce alert noise and improve diagnostic quality
 - Automate repeatable operational work, remediation, deployments, configuration, evidence collection and environment validation using code and pipelines
 - Design, build and maintain cloud infrastructure using infrastructure as code, reusable modules, policy guardrails and secure engineering standards
 - Participate in incident response and on-call support, including rapid triage, stabilisation, technical escalation and clear stakeholder communication

 - Engineer resilience through high-availability patterns, backup and restore validation, disaster-recovery runbooks, failover testing and dependency mapping
 - Manage production risks including vulnerabilities, patching, certificates, secrets, access controls, audit evidence and cloud security findings
 - Create and maintain runbooks, standard operating procedures, architecture records and operational knowledge that support consistent 24x7 service delivery
 - Analyse operational data and trends to reduce mean time to detect and restore service, eliminate recurring failure modes and improve capacity and cost efficiency
 - Mentor support and engineering colleagues in SRE practices, automation, observability, troubleshooting and operational ownership

- Three or more years of experience in cloud engineering, production engineering, DevOps, platform engineering or Site Reliability Engineering

 - Strong incident and problem management experience, including technical triage, root cause analysis, corrective actions and production communications
 - Understanding of distributed systems, scalability, high availability, capacity management, performance bottlenecks and failure modes

 - Working knowledge of cloud security, least privilege, certificate and secrets management, vulnerability remediation, auditing and compliance controls
 - Experience with ServiceNow or a comparable IT service management platform for incidents, problems, changes and operational work tracking
 - Clear written and verbal communication, disciplined documentation, strong ownership and the ability to work across engineering and business teams

Desirable Skills

- Cloud certification in AWS or Microsoft Azure; Kubernetes or Terraform certification is advantageous
 - Experience with Akamai, API gateways, web application delivery, DNS, load balancing, VPNs and enterprise network connectivity
 - Knowledge of event-driven and service-oriented architectures, domain-driven design and messaging platforms
 - Experience in regulated financial services or another environment with formal change, risk, audit, resilience and data-protection obligations
 - Experience implementing policy as code, security scanning, automated compliance controls, FinOps or cloud cost optimisation
 - Experience supporting globally distributed services, customer onboarding and follow-the-sun operational models

Success Measures

Outcome

Evidence of Success

Reliability

Services have defined health measures, meaningful alerts, tested recovery procedures and improving availability trends. 

Engineering efficiency

Manual toil and recurring incidents are reduced through automation, reusable tooling and preventive engineering. 

Operational readiness

Releases and services meet documented production-readiness, security, observability and support requirements. 

Incident learning

Major incidents produce clear root causes, owned corrective actions and measurable risk reduction. 

Collaboration

Development, platform, security and support teams share clear ownership and use consistent operational practices.

The Core Engineering builds and operates the platforms, applications, data solutions, models, and analytics that power critical processes for The Core divisions of the firm (e. g. , Risk, responsible for the risk profile of firm activities; Controllers, responsible for the financial control and reporting obligations; Compliance, responsible for the firm's compliance, regulatory, and reputational risks; Corporate Treasury, responsible for the firm's liquidity, funding, balance sheet, etc. ; and Human Capital Management, responsible for attracting, developing, and managing a global workforce). A centralized engineering structure in support of The Core enables a common platform model and operating framework that promotes consistent governance and scalable solutions, leveraging cloud, AI, and machine learning for innovation and efficiency. The Core Engineering's 2, 000+ engineers and strats deliver engineering, data, analytics, and quantitative capabilities within six business units: 

- Metrics & Analytics Platforms: responsible for the measurement and management of the firm's risk, capital, and liquidity for The Core functions 
 - The Core Strats: responsible for the development and implementation of models and other quantitative methodologies, including the accuracy and attribution of modeled metrics 
 - Financials & Reporting: responsible for facilitating the production of the firm's financials and a wide range of reporting functions 
 - Non-Financial Risk & Controls: responsible for non-financial risk and control processes 
 - Enterprise Platforms: responsible for platforms and applications that support critical operational processes across The Core such as payments, people processes, and procurement 
 - Shared Services: responsible for driving the adoption of consistent engineering strategy, including data platforms, cloud, and AI enablement, as well as the management of technology risk

YOUR IMPACT

Are you passionate about developing mission-critical, high quality software solutions, using cutting-edge technology, in a dynamic environment?

OUR IMPACT

We are Compliance Engineering, a global team of more than 300 engineers and scientists who work on the most complex, mission-critical problems. 

We

- build and operate a suite of platforms and applications that prevent, detect, and mitigate regulatory and reputational risk across the firm. 
 - have access to the latest technology and to massive amounts of structured and unstructured data. 
 - leverage modern frameworks to build responsive and intuitive front end and Big Data applications. 

How You Will Fulfill Your Potential

As a member of our team, you will: 

- partner globally with sponsors, users and engineering colleagues across multiple divisions to create end-to-end solutions, 
 - learn from experts

 - be able to innovate and incubate new ideas 
 - have an opportunity to work on a broad range of problems, often dealing with large data sets, including real-time processing, messaging, workflow and UI/UX 
 - be involved in the full life cycle; defining, designing, implementing, testing, deploying, and maintaining software across our products. 

AI‐Assisted Engineering & Productivity

In Addition, You Will

- Effectively use AI‐assisted software development tools (e. g. , GitHub Copilot, Devin, Claude Code, or equivalent) to improve developer productivity and reduce development cycle time. 
 - Apply AI tools to accelerate: 
 - code generation and refactoring, 
 - test creation and coverage improvement, 
 - debugging, root‐cause analysis, and performance optimization. 
 - Use AI‐assisted reasoning to understand complex codebases, rapidly prototype solutions, and improve code quality while maintaining strong engineering standards. 
 - Partner with peers and reviewers to validate, harden, and productionize AI‐generated outputs, ensuring correctness, security, maintainability, and regulatory compliance. 
 - Identify opportunities where AI tooling can reduce manual effort, minimize rework, and support faster, higher‐quality delivery to production. 
Qualifications

A successful candidate will possess the following attributes: 

- A Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a similar field of study. 
 - 2. 5+ years professional software development experience 
 - Expertise in Java development. 
 - Experience in automated testing and SDLC concepts. 
 - The ability (and tenacity) to clearly express ideas and arguments in meetings and on paper. 

Experience in some of the following is desired and can set you apart from other candidates: 

- Demonstrated experience or a strong interest in leveraging AI-assisted developer tools to enhance engineering productivity and accelerate software delivery. 
 - Ability to critically evaluate AI‐generated outputs and enhance them to production‐grade quality. 
 - Proven ability to critically evaluate AI-generated outputs and refine them to meet production-grade standards of quality, reliability, and maintainability. 
 - Hands-on proficiency with AI coding assistants such as GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, and Devin to expedite code authoring, refactoring, and debugging across all phases of the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC). 
 - Effective utilization of AI pair-programming tools to generate boilerplate code, unit tests, and technical documentation, enabling greater focus on architectural design and complex problem-solving. 
 - Application of established prompt engineering best practices to elicit high-quality, context-aware code recommendations and reduce iteration cycles during development. 
 - Practical integration of autonomous AI agents (e. g. , Devin) for routine engineering tasks, including bug triage, dependency upgrades, and minor feature implementations, thereby freeing engineering bandwidth for higher-impact initiatives. 
 - Adoption of AI-driven code review tools to proactively identify defects, security vulnerabilities, and performance bottlenecks earlier in the development cycle, strengthening overall quality gates. 
 - Experience with:

 - API design, such as to create interconnected services 
 - message buses or real time processing

 - influencing and collaborating with stakeholders.

data.description:
Key Responsibilities

- Optimisation of Raw Mix: Monitor raw mix consistency against available fuel for productivity and cost improvement, plan medium and long-term mix maximising in-house and local sources, work with the Mines and Material teams on low-cost limestone and additives, plan low-cost fuel usage, oversee deposit testing against mines reserve life, and monitor LSF standard deviation in the limestone stockpile and kiln feed
 - Quality of Coal, Raw Material, AFR and Packing Bags: Plan and monitor the quality control and assurance system for full conformance to grinding unit and marketing requirements, oversee inspection and control of incoming, in-process and finished materials against the quality plan, monitor material ratios against established parameters, and ensure finished goods meet government norms and UTCL standards
 - Legal and Statutory Compliance: Monitor compliance of legal requirements covering quality and bag artwork, and plan proactive renewals with full BIS compliance implemented at the QC laboratories at zero tolerance
 - Cost Optimisation: Plan effective resource utilisation to optimise cost, identify cheaper sources and types of fly ash, analyse use of alkali bypass through addition in cement, raw mix additives, the thermal power plant and sale, and optimise power consumption through controlled monitoring of blaine and residue
 - System Management: Drive implementation of quality management systems and build a culture of system compliance, oversee NABL compliance, secure quality improvement through IMS objectives, EMS targets and WCM (ABOE) criteria score, monitor WCM (ABOF) MIS against 5S, BCE and hygiene audits, evaluate Kaizen and suggestions, and manage stack monitoring and government approvals
 - Safety, Health and Environment: Plan for zero accidents and build a safety culture within the department, monitor compliance with all applicable safety standards to create a hazard-free system, build awareness of industrial waste usage in raw mix and its impact, ensure abnormalities from daily walkthroughs are reported, and close out FPSA, SPSA, TPSA and external audit findings along with RCN and BCN recommendations before target date
 - People Management: Build a conducive work culture that lifts productivity, growth and motivation in the quality function, enable SMART goal setting and performance reviews with HR, identify common training needs for current and future competency requirements, and develop the talent pipeline within the function

Location: multiple locations across India

Reporting Structure

Reporting To: Unit Head (Function: Strategy & Planning)

Reported By: Section Head QC (Quality), Section Head QC (material Handling)

Business and Unit Brief

UltraTech Cement Limited is the cement flagship company of Aditya Birla Group. A USD 9. 9 billion company, UltraTech is the world's largest Cement Company by sales volume and capacity, excluding China. 

The Company has a consolidated production capacity of 205. 5 Million Tonnes Per Annum (MTPA) of grey cement. The Company's business operations span UAE, Bahrain, Sri Lanka and India. 

UltraTech's manufacturing footprint comprises of 34 integrated manufacturing units, one Clinkerisation unit, 36 grinding units and 10 bulk packaging terminals. With 465 Ready Mix Concrete (RMC) plants in 167 cities, UltraTech is the largest manufacturer of Ready Mix Concrete in India. It has a slew of speciality concretes that meet specific needs of discerning customers. 

UltraTech has a network of over 1. 45 lakh channel partners across the country and has a market reach of more than 80% across India. In the white cement segment, UltraTech goes to market under the brand name of Birla White. It has two White Cement units and four Wall Care putty units, with a current capacity of 3. 3 MTPA. 

In 2025, UltraTech extended its footprint in the construction value chain, through wires and cables segment with a planned capital expenditure of ~ INR 1, 800 crore over the next 2 years. 

The Company's social initiatives focus on education, healthcare, sustainable livelihoods, community infrastructure and social causes. Through its CSR initiatives, UltraTech reaches out to more than 1. 8 million beneficiaries in over 500 villages across India. 

Global Manufacturing Leadership Program

This role is part of the Global Manufacturing Leadership Program (GMLP). 

The Global Manufacturing Leadership Program (GMLP) is Aditya Birla Group's flagship leadership hiring initiative focused on building the next generation of manufacturing leaders. Designed for high-potential professionals with a proven track record in manufacturing and operations, GMLP offers accelerated career growth through challenging leadership roles across the Group's diverse businesses, including Cement, Metals, Chemicals, Carbon Black, Pulp & Fibre, Mining, and other global manufacturing operations.
