data.title: Senior AI Business Automation Engineer (Dot Compliance) - Technology IT
data.description:
About Signant Health

At Signant Health, we help bring life-changing treatments to patients faster. We are a global evidence generation company that supports clinical trials with smart technology, scientific expertise, and hands-on operational support - so better data leads to better decisions in healthcare. We embrace AI and advanced technologies to enhance every aspect of what we do, from data analysis to operational efficiency. 

Our teams work at the intersection of science, technology, and patient experience, delivering digital solutions powered by AI innovation that make clinical trials more efficient, more accurate, and more accessible around the world. Trusted by leading pharmaceutical companies and CROs, our platforms and services support studies across more than 90 countries and have contributed to hundreds of new drug approvals. 

If you are motivated by meaningful work, global impact, and innovation in clinical research and digital health - including the opportunity to work with cutting-edge AI technologies - you will find purpose and opportunity at Signant Health. 

About The Role

Signant Health is seeking a Senior AI Business Automation Engineer who works in two modes. In one, you embed with functional Subject Matter Experts - learning their workflows, including the workarounds and group knowledge that never appear in process documents, then designing, prototyping, and delivering the custom technical solutions that transform how those teams operate. In the other, you work on a small, focused delivery squad - leading or contributing - shipping AI-driven automation into a business unit at pace. 

Both modes share the same spirit: find business processes ripe for reinvention, rebuild them with an AI-first mindset, and put working code in front of real users fast. The role sits inside IT and carries the full weight of our infrastructure, data, integration, automation, and information security standards required of a clinical-trial technology provider. Code ships to production through regular, incremental delivery against real workflow data - not to a slide deck. Success is measured by how many workflows you've permanently transformed and how consistently your business teams start every task with an AI tool. 

KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES - Function

- Flex between two modes: embedded with an assigned cohort of business SMEs, observing how work actually happens - the workarounds, shared spreadsheets, group knowledge - to find the highest-leverage workflows for an AI-first redesign; and contributing to or leading small delivery squads shipping AI-driven automation into a business unit at pace. Either way, the discipline is the same: get close to the real work, find the leverage, rebuild rather than automate as-is. 
 - Design, prototype, and deliver working solutions - custom tools, AI agents, automations, reusable skills - tailored to each engagement's workflows, delivered incrementally against real workflow data so value lands continuously, not just at project end. 
 - Coach and partner with the business users you work alongside - SMEs or squad stakeholders - through a progression: awareness, first win, regular AI integration, full workflow transformation. 
 - Develop and deploy AI agents using LLMs and Model Context Protocol (MCP) integrations, end-to-end automations across REST APIs, webhooks, and third-party SaaS, and secure data pipelines - built to enterprise standards. 
 - Build every solution for handoff from day one - documentation, observability, and runbooks so other engineers can operate, diagnose, and evolve it without you. 
 - Recognise patterns across engagements and scale what works: a tool built for one SME should become reusable for peers; a proven pattern should be documented for other engineers. 
 - Translate observed business problems into technical solutions and share wins visibly with your cohort and leadership, articulating ROI, effort, and risk honestly enough to make prioritisation easy. 
 - Participate in end-to-end testing and quality validation of AI, automation, and integrated solutions before production deployment. 
 - Use AI development tools fluently throughout the build lifecycle - coding assistants (Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot) for rapid prototyping, LLMs for mining workflow signals from tickets and transcripts, AI-assisted drafting of designs, runbooks, and tests - while applying rigorous evaluation discipline (golden datasets, eval harnesses, regression suites, hallucination/grounding checks, human-in-the-loop checkpoints) before production deployment. 
 - Ensure automation solutions meet enterprise standards for security, scalability, and maintainability, with working knowledge of SOC 2 and ISO 27001 compliance requirements. 
 - Mentor both directions: upskill business users to build and maintain their own AI-assisted workflows, and support junior engineers with reusable patterns, solution designs, runbooks, and executive-ready status reports. 
 - Participate in and extend internal automation platforms to support more advanced workflows, reusable modules, and greater process autonomy. 

Knowledge, Skills & Attributes

Essential: 

- 5+ years of experience in enterprise automation, software development, or IT engineering. 
 - Hands-on experience designing and operating workflow automation (self-hosted or cloud) with REST API and webhook integrations across enterprise SaaS platforms. 
 - 2+ years building with the modern AI development toolkit: LLM APIs (Anthropic, OpenAI, or equivalent), MCP servers and clients, agent frameworks and agentic workflow patterns, AI coding assistants as a daily driver, structured prompt engineering, retrieval-augmented generation grounded in enterprise data, and eval harnesses for measuring agent accuracy and safety in production. 
 - Proficiency in JavaScript/TypeScript and Python; experience with Git, CI/CD pipelines, and cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP). 
 - Ability to communicate technical solutions clearly to engineering teams and executives; experience authoring business cases, solution designs, and implementation roadmaps. 
 - Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a passion for continuous improvement and delivering measurable business outcomes through technology. 
 - Demonstrated ability to discover real workflows by working closely with practitioners - surfacing workarounds, shared spreadsheets, and undocumented group knowledge that determine whether an AI solution works on real edge cases. 
 - Comfortable operating in small, high-velocity delivery teams - able to lead or contribute on a squad of 2-4 engineers, hold a clear delivery line under time pressure, and partner well with stakeholders who expect working software fast. Desirable: 

- Relevant professional certifications in IT service management, project management, or enterprise automation platforms (e. g. ITIL, PMP, or platform-specific). 
 - Experience with iPaaS integration platforms (Boomi, MuleSoft, or Workato) connecting ERP, HRIS, CRM, and ITSM systems. 
 - Global experience collaborating with distributed teams to deliver enterprise technology initiatives. 
 - Experience using AI itself to discover and redesign workflows - analysing transaction histories, ticket logs, or content repositories with LLMs to surface bottlenecks, or building agentic prototypes in hours to test a hypothesis before a full build. 

Platform-Specific Requirements - Dot Compliance Track

Essential: 

- 3+ years of hands-on experience configuring and extending the Dot Compliance eQMS (built on Salesforce), including CAPA, Deviations, Audits, Change Control, Document Control, and Training Management workflows. 
 - Proven experience building and deploying custom Salesforce Apex triggers/classes, Lightning Web Components, and Flow automations in a validated Dot Compliance production environment. 
 - Proficiency in Apex and SOQL, plus JavaScript/TypeScript and Python, for scripting and integration on the Salesforce/Dot Compliance platform. 
 - Experience integrating AI/LLM APIs into Dot Compliance quality workflows (e. g. automated CAPA root-cause drafting, deviation triage, audit-readiness summarisation) grounded in regulated GxP data. Desirable: 

- Salesforce Platform Developer I/II certification and/or Dot Compliance administrator or configuration credentials. 

Why Signant Health?

At Signant Health, your work has real impact. Everything we build, support, and deliver helps advance clinical research and bring new treatments to patients faster - improving lives around the world. Our teams combine science, technology, and operational expertise to solve complex clinical trial challenges, and every role contributes to that mission. 

We offer a collaborative, global environment where you can grow your career while working alongside experts across clinical, technology, data, and operations, with opportunities to learn, take ownership, and drive meaningful innovation - not just maintain the status quo. 

If you are looking for purpose-driven work, smart colleagues, and the opportunity to help shape the future of clinical research and digital health, Signant Health is the place to do it. 

At Signant Health, accepting difference isn't enough - we celebrate it, we support it, and we nurture it for the benefit of our team members, our clients, and our community. We are proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and an affirmative action employer, committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or veteran status. Prior to their start date, all new hires are required to be verified through a thorough background check and identity verification to confirm eligibility for employment. 

Unsolicited resumes submitted by agencies or third-party recruiters directly to hiring managers or any Signant Health employee will not be considered and will not obligate Signant Health to any fees or terms associated with the submission.

Automation (~50%)

data.title: Senior QA Engineer
data.description:
Job Purpose

The Senior QA Engineer plays a critical role in ensuring the quality, reliability, and performance of the Valuation Analytics application portfolio - including WebAVM, Hoku, and Kokua - by applying advanced QA methodologies and sound judgment to solve complex testing challenges. With a strong foundation in software testing, real estate / AVM domain knowledge, and analytical thinking, this role actively contributes to shaping QA practices across both legacy . NET Framework codebases and modern Angular front-ends. It involves mentoring junior team members, driving process improvements, and fostering a culture of quality throughout the development lifecycle. A proactive mindset and leadership in both technical and collaborative capacities are essential to delivering product excellence in a regulated, data-intensive valuation domain. 

Responsibilities

- Assist in leading QA Activities: Plan, design, and execute comprehensive test strategies - including functional, regression, integration, and exploratory testing - across the Valuation Analytics application portfolio. Cover both legacy ASP. NET Web Forms / Web API surfaces and the modern Angular 19 SPA. Perform performance and security testing aligned with organizational standards. 
 - Review and Analyze Requirements: Collaborate with Business Analysts, Developers, and End-Users to understand business needs and technical impacts, ensuring test coverage aligns with UAD 3. 6, MISMO, and URAR 1004 form requirements, and with downstream partner contracts (Fannie Mae, Chase, Xome). 
 - Apply Advanced QA Knowledge: Participate in design reviews to gain a deep understanding of the multi-database architecture (11+ federated SQL Server databases), REST + SOAP integration points, and data workflows. Evaluate requirements for clarity and testability, prioritize high-risk areas - including 800+ UAD validation rules and ML inference paths - contribute to bug triaging to balance quality with delivery timelines, and support release readiness assessments. 
 - Develop AI-powered Test Automation Initiatives: Leverage AI-driven tools and techniques to identify and prioritize high-impact test cases for automation. Lead the migration from deprecated Protractor to modern E2E frameworks (Playwright preferred, Cypress, or Selenium 4). Contribute to maintaining code quality and reusability by following established coding standards. Integrate AI-enhanced automation into CI/CD pipelines via Octopus Deploy and Azure DevOps to promote continuous testing across the AVM stack. 
 - Problem Solving and Decision Making: Identify, analyze, and provide well-reasoned solutions to complex QA issues - including thread-blocking synchronous code paths, geospatial edge cases, PDF generation timeouts, and combinatorial rule-engine explosion - using established procedures and professional judgement. Recommend improvements to prevent recurrence. 
 - Mentorship and Team Development: Guide and train junior QA team members on real estate / AVM domain concepts, test design for federated data sources, and modern automation tooling. Provide feedback and support their professional development. 
 - Cross-Team Collaboration: Work closely with Engineering, Data Science, Product, and Operations teams to ensure quality is embedded throughout the development lifecycle for AVM and appraisal workflows. Communicate risks and issues clearly to stakeholders and management. 
 - Process Improvement: Contribute to the evaluation and enhancement of QA processes, tools, and metrics across legacy and modern test suites. Wire automated coverage into Octopus Deploy and Azure DevOps pipelines, gate releases on coverage thresholds, and assist in debugging and improving application performance and reliability. 
 - System Monitoring and Analysis: Monitor system behavior across DEV / QA / UAT / PRE / PRD / DR environments, analyze trends in valuation throughput, PDF generation pipelines, and ML inference outputs, and proactively identify potential quality issues before they reach production. 

Knowledge And Experience

- Bachelor's degree in accredited institution. 
 - 6+ years of experience in software quality assurance, with demonstrated test ownership across both legacy and modern web stacks. 
 - Hands-on C# / . NET test authoring - unit and integration tests for ASP. NET Web Forms and Web API codebases (NUnit, Moq, EF6 in-memory). 
 - TypeScript / Angular testing - component, service, and observable tests with Jasmine, Karma, TestBed, and HTTP mocking. 
 - API testing across REST and SOAP - fluent with both JSON and XML payloads and envelope-aware assertions (Postman, SoapUI, REST Assured, Bruno). 
 - SQL Server fluency - query and seed federated databases (KOKUA01, REF01, MLS02, HPT01, DQ02, and 6+ others); strong T-SQL, SSMS, and test-data management. 
 - UI automation with modern frameworks - Playwright (preferred), Cypress, or Selenium 4; able to replace deprecated Protractor suites. 
 - Hands-on experience writing Python scripts for API testing and data testing - comfortable with data science libraries such as pandas, numpy, scipy, etc. 
 - Strong analytical skills and test case design skills; meticulous attention to detail. 
 - Solid understanding of the software development life cycle (SDLC) and QA's role in it. 
 - Effective communication and collaboration skills with stakeholders. 
 - Strong organizational and time management skills with the ability to work on multiple priorities. 
 - Demonstrated ability to solve complex QA problems using sound judgement and existing procedures. 
 - Exposure to automation frameworks and scripting languages. 
 - Experience using AI tools such as GitHub Copilot, Cursor, or Claude. 

Preferred Knowledge And Experience

- Real estate / AVM domain literacy - familiarity with comparables, adjustments, complexity profiles, market trends, URAR 1004, UAD 3. 6, MISMO, and MLS data shape. 
 - CI/CD pipeline integration - wiring automated suites into Octopus Deploy and Azure DevOps, with coverage gating via ReportPortal or Allure. 
 - Document & PDF generation testing - Syncfusion + XSLT pipelines; pixel-diff and structured PDF assertions (pdfplumber, diff-pdf, Applitools). 
 - UI automation experience - writing scripts in Playwright (JS), Cypress (JS), and/or Selenium (Java). 
 - Familiarity with performance, security, and usability testing. 
 - Knowledge of ROI-driven testing strategies. 
 - Domain knowledge in finance, mortgage, or real estate.

data.description:
#JLLTechAmbitions

JLL, an international real estate management company, is building AI into the way its teams work with enterprise data. As an AI Engineer you will turn proofs of concept into reliable, governed, production services: agents that can call tools, remember context, respect user permissions, and be traced, evaluated, and costed. 

You will work across both technology tracks as project priorities shift: agent engineering on AWS (Amazon Bedrock and AgentCore) and data and AI engineering on Oracle (AI Data Platform and AI Database). The ideal candidate is a hands-on builder with a "Get it done" attitude, strong engineering discipline, and a habit of asking the right questions before building. 

Responsibilities

- Build agents on AWS: design, deploy, and operate AI agents on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore, using AgentCore Runtime for hosting, Gateway to expose APIs and Lambda functions as tools (including MCP), Memory for short- and long-term context, Identity for secure agent access, and Observability for tracing and debugging. 
 - Build RAG and agent solutions with Amazon Bedrock: implement foundation-model integrations, Knowledge Bases, Agents, and Guardrails, and manage prompts and model selection for cost, latency, and quality. 
 - Build on Oracle AI Data Platform (AIDP): develop in the AIDP Workbench using Master Catalog assets, Spark notebooks, and workflows; apply medallion (bronze, silver, gold) data patterns; and build knowledge bases and agent flows on governed enterprise data. 
 - Build on Oracle AI Database: implement AI Vector Search, hybrid (vector + relational) retrieval, Select AI natural-language-to-SQL interfaces, and in-database ML, with embedding pipelines and PL/SQL where needed. 
 - Integrate across platforms: connect Oracle data services with AWS-hosted AI applications through secure, well-defined APIs and swappable service interfaces. 
 - Engineer retrieval quality: own chunking and embedding strategy, metadata filtering, reranking, and retrieval tuning, and measure results with repeatable evaluations. 
 - Secure and govern AI: apply IAM least privilege, database-enforced access control (such as role-based access and data redaction), PII handling, and guardrails that screen for prompt injection and unsafe output. Keep audit trails of agent actions and outcomes. 
 - Test and evaluate: build evaluation and regression suites for LLM output, track hallucination and accuracy, and verify behavior end to end against real services, not only with unit tests. 
 - Deploy and operate: ship Python services (for example FastAPI) to production on AWS using Lambda, API Gateway, S3, ECS/EKS, Step Functions, and Secrets Manager. Monitor latency, quality, and cost with CloudWatch and AgentCore Observability. 
 - Collaborate and document: take part in sprint ceremonies and code and design reviews, and maintain documentation, runbooks, and knowledge-transfer material. 

Experience & Education

- 4-8 years of software, data, or AI/ML engineering experience, with hands-on delivery of generative AI or LLM-based applications in production or near-production. 
 - Bachelor's degree or higher in Computer Science, AI, or a related field is preferred. 
 - Proven experience building RAG pipelines and agentic workflows, including tool calling and multi-step orchestration. 
 - Experience with Amazon Bedrock and AWS-native deployment. Hands-on AgentCore experience is strongly preferred. 
 - Experience with Oracle Database or Oracle AI Database. Experience with the Oracle AI Data Platform is strongly preferred. 
 - Strong debugging and root-cause analysis skills, including tracing non-deterministic model behavior. 
 - Clear written and verbal communication, and the ability to work independently in a distributed team. 

Technical Skills & Competencies

- Generative AI on AWS: Amazon Bedrock foundation models, Knowledge Bases, Agents, Guardrails, prompt engineering, and model evaluation; Amazon Bedrock AgentCore (Runtime, Gateway, Memory, Identity, Observability, and built-in tools such as Code Interpreter). 
 - Oracle data and AI: Oracle AI Database (AI Vector Search, Select AI, in-database ML, PL/SQL) and Oracle AI Data Platform (Master Catalog, notebooks, workflows, knowledge bases, agent flows, OCI Generative AI integration). 
 - AI application engineering: RAG pipelines, agentic workflows, LangChain, LangGraph, or LlamaIndex, Model Context Protocol (MCP), embedding strategy, chunking, reranking, and structured LLM output. 
 - AWS cloud: Lambda, API Gateway, S3, ECS/EKS, Step Functions, IAM, VPC, CloudWatch, and Secrets Manager. 
 - Programming: Python (primary), REST APIs, and SQL; FastAPI or similar async frameworks. 
 - Security and governance: IAM least privilege, data privacy controls, PII handling, and responsible-AI guardrails. 
 - Delivery: Agile/Scrum, Git and CI/CD, Docker, Jira and Confluence, and clear documentation. 

Preferred (Nice To Have)

- Experience with AgentCore Identity and Gateway for secure, tool-enabled agents. 
 - Experience with Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI), Apache Spark, or medallion-architecture data pipelines. 
 - Infrastructure as code (for example Terraform) and Kubernetes experience. 
 - Experience with agent frameworks such as Strands Agents, or with migrating Bedrock Agents to a code-first framework. 
 - Experience with LLM gateways, token and cost tracking, and usage analytics. 
 - Relevant certifications, such as AWS or Oracle Cloud Infrastructure Generative AI certifications.

data.title: System Software Manager - Power Profiling and Infrastructure
data.description:
NVIDIA is a global leader in accelerated computing, powering breakthroughs in AI, graphics, autonomous vehicles, and scientific simulation. 

Inside NVIDIA, the Software Power Profiling team is the power measurement authority for our most strategic platforms - RTX Spark, DGX Spark, discrete GPU desktop and notebook, and data center. The team measures power and performance-per-watt, qualifies power targets, co-engineers battery life with OEMs, runs nightly regression farms across the device fleet, and builds the profiling infrastructure - frameworks, analytics dashboards, and automated regression farms - that the rest of NVIDIA relies on to understand and optimize power. 

What you'll be doing

- Lead, grow, and mentor a cross-site team of power and infrastructure engineers across Pune and Bangalore - setting individual and team roadmaps, development plans, and clear ownership across all mandates. 
 - Drive the team's power profiling authority across the full product lifecycle: pre-silicon power engagement, power target qualification, regression monitoring, battery-life validation, and external software release qualification - including nightly development-branch and release-branch power and perf/watt monitoring across discrete GPU and data-center platforms. 
 - Own the physical lab - run a temperature-controlled, instrumented measurement lab across two sites, covering DUT fleet management, board procurement, intake and logistics, board instrumentation and rework, DAQ and power-path integrity, rack build-out, and cross-geo capacity planning. 
 - Shape measurability from pre-silicon through production - engage pre-silicon to challenge power modelling assumptions and establish measurement confidence levels; drive instrumented boards, rail maps, on-board sensors, and DAQ adapter design; specify, track, and escalate measurement prerequisites (telemetry, software build, validation, and agreed power targets with guard band policy), holding the requirement and escalating when it slips. 
 - Close power gaps and own release readiness - quantify and attribute power gaps to rail, IP, feature, and residency; drive debug and optimization alongside software and hardware power owners through experiments and recovery confirmation; deliver the power verdict that feeds program go/no-go decisions, backed by qualification data on every external software drop. 
 - Lead cross-company power engagement - converge measurement methodology and tooling with OEMs and software power owners; co-engineer shared battery-life targets, conduct joint root-cause analysis where measurements diverge, and maintain a common bug-and-analysis stream. 
 - Own the team's infrastructure portfolio and energy compliance - drive the in-house power profiling framework, power analytics dashboard, and automated power regression farm as production-grade shared assets; deliver energy-regulation compliance evidence (idle, standby, and off-mode power) required to clear product release gates. 

What we need to see

- BS or MS in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field with 8+ years of overall industry experience. 
 - 5+ years of engineering management experience, with a proven track record of delivering complex software and infrastructure at velocity across distributed teams. 
 - Deep background in power systems, computer architecture, and SoC/platform power - with hands-on experience in power measurement, analysis, or power-stack debugging. 
 - Experience running or closely supporting a hardware measurement lab - instrumentation, device fleet, and the logistics that keep it productive. 
 - Demonstrated ability to engage across the full program lifecycle - from pre-silicon power modeling through bring-up, qualification, and post-commercialization sustaining. 
 - Strong communication and interpersonal skills to operate across engineering teams, program management, partner labs, OEM customers, and executive stakeholders. 
 - Commitment to measurement quality and the defensibility of data that drives product decisions. 

Ways to stand out from the crowd

- Hands-on power profiling experience - DAQ-based external rail capture, on-board sensor validation, or telemetry-driven regression root cause. 
 - Intimate knowledge of Windows on Arm or client SoC platforms - battery-life scenario methodology, Modern Standby measurement, or energy-efficiency regulatory compliance. 
 - Experience leading silicon bring-up power profiling - firmware sensor validation, first-power baselines, and bring-up-phase engagement with hardware teams. 
 - Track record of building or leading power regression infrastructure or automated test/analysis pipelines at scale. 
 - Experience with AI/agentic workflow development applied to lab automation, failure triage, or report generation. 
 - Prior cross-company lab convergence work - aligning methodology, build synchronization, and shared tooling between two or more power or validation labs.

Netspend Corporation is a global, vertically-integrated financial services and technology company dedicated to the delivery of innovative financial empowerment solutions to consumers worldwide. Netspend provides prepaid and debit account solutions that connect customers with secure, convenient access to global payment networks so they can manage their money and make everyday purchases. With a nationwide U. S. retail network, customers can purchase and reload Netspend products at 130, 000 reload points and over 100, 000 distributing locations. 

Since our founding in 1999 by industry pioneers, Netspend products have processed billions of dollars in transaction volume and served millions of customers worldwide. The company is headquartered in Austin, Texas with employees worldwide.

You will lead a world-class engineering organization responsible for our core Fintech and Banking portfolios. You will bridge the gap between complex business requirements and elite engineering execution, pioneering an AI-first development culture (AIDLC) to set a new industry standard for productivity. 

As the Director of Application Development, you will function as a high-impact technical executive. This role is designed for a technologist who can manage large-scale portfolios, lead multi-disciplinary teams (Front-end & Back-end), and navigate the complexities of the Fintech and Banking sectors. 

You are expected to be a "technologist first"- a leader who can sit in an architectural review or a deep-dive debugging session and add immediate value, while simultaneously presenting digital transformation roadmaps for your portfolios. 

The Director of Application Development will serve as a pivotal leader within the Netspend Product & Technology organization, reporting directly to the Engineering Leader. This highly visible Senior leadership role requires an accomplished engineering leader with deep expertise in building and scaling consumer products. 

The Director of Application Development will shape the long-term technology vision, drive SaaS-first engineering excellence, and ensure our product's solutions remain the industry benchmark for innovation, reliability, and customer value. This leader will inspire high-performing global teams and foster strong cross-functional partnerships. 

II. The Core Mandate

- Strategic Technical Leadership & Stakeholder Management
 - The Bridge: Act as the primary interface between business units and engineering. You will translate high-level commercial objectives into executable technical strategies. 
 - Portfolio Oversight: Manage a comprehensive portfolio of applications, ensuring that cross-functional teams are aligned, unblocked, and delivering high-value features. 
 - Agile Transformation: Lead the evolution of the engineering org into a high-performing, fast-paced Agile environment, optimizing for both speed-to-market and system stability. 
 - Technical Depth & Innovation (AIDLC)
 - Hands-on Guidance: While not required to write daily production code, you must possess the technical depth of a former Solution Architect or Dev Lead. You will guide teams through complex technical hurdles and ensure code quality standards. 
 - AI-Augmented Engineering: A core focus will be the AIDLC (AI-driven Development Life Cycle). You will be expected to implement AI tools and frameworks to drastically enhance team productivity and developer experience. 
 - Cloud Strategy: Direct the architecture and migration initiatives within the AWS ecosystem, ensuring cost-efficiency, scalability, and security. 
 - Move Fast with Stability: Transition teams into high-performing, autonomous units that ship code daily without compromising the integrity of financial transactions. 
 - Metric-Driven Results: Define and track KPIs that correlate engineering output with actual business revenue and user engagement. 
 - Organizational Mentorship
 - Leader of Leaders: Provide direct mentorship and career development for Senior Managers and Associate Directors. 
 - Culture of Excellence: Foster an environment of continuous learning, psychological safety, and technical curiosity. 
 - Bottom-Up Leadership: Empower Senior Managers and Associate Directors to take extreme ownership. Foster a culture where the best ideas win, regardless of hierarchy. 

III. Educational & Foundation (Mandatory)

- Academic Excellence: B. Tech / B. E. from a reputed, top-tier institute or a Master of Computer Applications (MCA). 

IV. Experience & Skills

- Years of Experience: 12+ years in Software Development with a progressive track record of leadership. 
 - Domain Expertise: Deep experience in Fintech and Banking (High-volume transactions, security protocols, regulatory compliance). 
 - Full-Stack Vision: Proven experience leading both Front-end and Back-end initiatives simultaneously. 
 - Technical Stack: Strong foundational knowledge in modern microservices, distributed systems, and AWS Migration. 
 - Communication: Elite communication skills; able to influence senior business stakeholders and inspire junior engineers. 

High-Weightage Qualifications

- Demonstrated success in using AI to enhance team efficiency (e. g. , LLM-integrated workflows, automated code synthesis, or AI-driven testing). 
 - Experience transitioning legacy banking systems into modern, cloud-native architectures. 
 - A "Consultative Mindset": The ability to analyze problems from a first-principles perspective and drive data-backed decisions. 

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

- Operational Efficiency: 30% improvement in development velocity via AIDLC tools. 
 - System Reliability: Maintaining 99. 99% uptime for critical banking portfolios. 
 - Talent Retention: Reducing attrition among high-potential Senior Managers and Directors. 
 - Stakeholder Satisfaction: High NPS from business partners on the "transparency and predictability" of the delivery pipeline. 

V. Why This Role?

This is a rare opportunity to build an engineering org within the high-stakes world of Finance. You will have the budget of a Tier-1 firm and the autonomy to rewrite the rules of how software is built using AI.

You will lead the team and stay close to the work: shaping solutions, reviewing designs and code, removing delivery barriers, and ensuring what reaches production is secure, scalable, accessible, and supportable. You will establish the engineering practices that make quality repeatable rather than dependent on individual projects or implementation partners. 

You will partner closely with product, UX, architecture, Enterprise AI, HR, Communications, and business teams. You will translate the Associate Portal vision into an executable engineering roadmap and build the internal capability needed to operate and continuously improve the product after implementation. 

What you will do

Engineering Leadership and Team Development

- Lead, mentor, and grow a team of ServiceNow engineers and technical leads responsible for the Associate Portal and related employee experience capabilities. 
 - Establish clear ownership, performance expectations, development plans, and engineering objectives for the team. 
 - Build a culture of accountability, technical excellence, collaboration, continuous improvement, and strong customer focus. 
 - Manage work across employees, contingent resources, and implementation partners while retaining clear internal accountability for engineering outcomes. 
 - Develop the internal knowledge and capability required to own, operate, and enhance the portal following implementation and knowledge transfer. 

Associate Portal Engineering

- Own engineering delivery for the Associate Portal built on ServiceNow Employee Center Pro and HR Service Delivery. 
 - Lead the configuration, development, testing, deployment, and enhancement of portal pages, widgets, microsites, application launchers, navigation, taxonomy, and responsive experiences. 
 - Ensure a consistent, intuitive, and consumer-grade experience across desktop, mobile, manufacturing, field, and corporate environments. 
 - Guide the use of audience groups, user criteria, HR criteria, personas, roles, regions, and language preferences to deliver relevant and personalized experiences. 
 - Oversee capabilities including enterprise search, knowledge, content, services, requests, approvals, tasks, communications, and conversational assistance. 
 - Partner with UX leaders to ensure implemented experiences match approved designs and meet accessibility, usability, and performance expectations. 

Architecture and Technical Governance

- Partner with ServiceNow platform architecture and enterprise architecture to define and enforce technical standards for the Associate Portal. 
 - Translate complex business and experience requirements into secure, scalable, maintainable, and upgrade-friendly ServiceNow solutions. 
 - Apply a configuration-first approach and ensure custom development is used only where it creates clear business or experience value. 
 - Lead technical design reviews covering portal components, integrations, data flows, security, performance, and cross-platform dependencies. 
 - Maintain clear solution designs, integration specifications, data flows, operational documentation, and technical decision records. 
 - Actively manage customization risk, technical debt, unsupported components, platform upgrades, and lifecycle dependencies. 

Software Engineering Standards and Quality

- Establish and enforce standards for coding, peer review, source control, testing, documentation, deployment, and release management. 
 - Ensure solutions are designed for maintainability, reusability, security, performance, accessibility, and platform upgrades. 
 - Drive automated testing using ServiceNow Automated Test Framework and other approved testing capabilities. 
 - Implement quality gates across development, system integration testing, user acceptance testing, regression testing, and production deployment. 
 - Lead disciplined defect management, root-cause analysis, corrective action, and technical debt reduction. 
 - Ensure delivery partners meet Ecolab engineering, security, documentation, and quality standards before work is accepted. 

Agile Delivery and Execution

- Partner with Product Management and the Product Owner to translate roadmap priorities, user needs, and approved designs into an executable engineering backlog. 
 - Lead estimation, backlog refinement, sprint planning, dependency management, release planning, and delivery reviews. 
 - Ensure commitments reflect clear requirements, realistic estimates, available capacity, technical dependencies, and quality expectations. 
 - Coordinate delivery across portal development, UX, integrations, content, search, AI, testing, deployment, hypercare, and ongoing support. 
 - Communicate delivery status, technical risks, decisions, and blockers early, with clear ownership and a practical path to resolution. 

Integrations and Enterprise Experience

- Oversee integrations supporting employee data, content, services, requests, approvals, search, digital assets, communications, analytics, and workflow execution. 
 - Define reusable integration patterns using IntegrationHub, REST and SOAP APIs, MID Servers, and other approved enterprise technologies. 
 - Partner with system owners to define interface ownership, data contracts, security, monitoring, exception handling, and support responsibilities. 
 - Ensure integrations are observable, resilient, loosely coupled, and designed so failures do not become recurring user experience issues. 
 - Provide technical oversight for integrations with platforms such as Workday, Microsoft 365, SharePoint, Viva Engage, enterprise content systems, and digital asset platforms. 

AI, Search, and Automation

- Partner with Enterprise AI and platform teams to integrate conversational assistance, enterprise search, knowledge-grounded responses, and task automation into the portal. 
 - Provide engineering leadership for the portal-side integration and presentation of EVA and other approved AI capabilities. 
 - Ensure AI and search capabilities meet enterprise requirements for security, privacy, governance, performance, observability, and supportability. 
 - Evaluate ServiceNow AI Search, Now Assist, Virtual Agent, and automation capabilities where they improve associate outcomes and align with platform strategy. 

Content, Knowledge, and Experience Governance

- Partner with content and business leaders to implement capabilities for content creation, approval, publishing, personalization, localization, lifecycle management, and archival. 
 - Provide engineering oversight for ServiceNow Knowledge Management, content experiences, searchability, metadata, and audience targeting. 
 - Establish clear technical ownership for templates, components, microsites, navigation structures, taxonomies, and reusable portal capabilities. 
 - Use analytics, user feedback, defects, and operational data with Product and UX teams to continuously improve the experience. 

Reliability and Operations

- Own engineering outcomes for portal availability, performance, stability, security, scalability, and maintainability. 
 - Define monitoring, alerting, support, release, and escalation practices for the portal and its integrations. 
 - Partner with platform operations and support teams to establish clear support boundaries, service expectations, and incident ownership. 
 - Ensure the team is prepared to support deployments, stabilization, hypercare, upgrades, and ongoing production operations. 
 - Lead proactive remediation of vulnerabilities, recurring incidents, unsupported technologies, and lifecycle risks. 

Minimum Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent relevant professional experience. 
 - 10+ years of progressive experience in software engineering, enterprise application development, or platform engineering. 
 - 7+ years of hands-on ServiceNow experience spanning solution design, configuration, development, integration, testing, and production support. 
 - 3+ years leading software engineers, technical leads, or complex cross-functional engineering delivery teams. 
 - Strong experience with ServiceNow Employee Center, Employee Center Pro, Service Portal, or comparable ServiceNow portal technologies. 
 - Experience with ServiceNow HR Service Delivery, including employee experiences, HR services, knowledge, user criteria, HR criteria, and related security considerations. 
 - Strong knowledge of JavaScript, Glide APIs, Flow Designer, IntegrationHub, REST and SOAP APIs, UI Builder, and ServiceNow development practices. 
 - Experience delivering responsive, personalized, accessible, and high-performing user-facing enterprise applications. 
 - Demonstrated experience establishing coding standards, testing practices, quality gates, architecture guardrails, and release controls. 
 - Strong Agile delivery, stakeholder management, and communication skills, including the ability to explain technical decisions and tradeoffs to executive and nontechnical audiences. 
 - Proven people leadership, including coaching, performance management, capability development, and work across globally distributed teams. 

Preferred Qualifications

- ServiceNow Certified System Administrator, Certified Application Developer, or Certified Implementation Specialist in HR Service Delivery. 
 - Experience implementing Employee Center Pro in a large, global enterprise. 
 - Experience with ServiceNow Knowledge Management, Content Experiences, Curated Experiences, taxonomy, audience targeting, AI Search, and analytics. 
 - Experience with Virtual Agent, Now Assist, generative AI, enterprise search, or conversational employee experiences. 
 - Experience integrating ServiceNow with Workday, Microsoft 365, SharePoint, Viva Engage, content platforms, or digital asset management solutions. 
 - Experience with ServiceNow mobile capabilities, WCAG accessibility standards, multilingual experiences, and dynamic translation. 
 - Experience transitioning delivery from a systems integrator to an internal product engineering and operating model. 
 - Experience leading globally distributed engineering teams supporting enterprise portals, intranets, digital workplaces, or employee experience platforms. 

Our Commitment to a Culture of Inclusion & Belonging

Ecolab is committed to fair and equal treatment of associates and applicants and furthering the principles of Equal Opportunity to Employment. We will recruit, hire, promote, transfer and provide opportunities for advancement based on individual qualifications and job performance in all matters affecting employment, compensation, benefits, working conditions, and opportunities for advancement. Ecolab will not discriminate against any associate or applicant for employment because of race, religion, color, creed, national origin, citizenship status, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity and expressions, genetic information, marital status, age, or disability.

data.title: Senior Software Engineer II - Storage
data.description:
Dive in and do the best work of your career at DigitalOcean. Journey alongside a strong community of top talent who are relentless in their drive to build the simplest scalable cloud. If you have a growth mindset, naturally like to think big and bold, and are energized by the fast-paced environment of a true industry disruptor, you'll find your place here. We value winning together-while learning, having fun, and making a profound difference for the dreamers and builders in the world. 

Position Overview

We are looking for an engineer who will help lead the development and support of current and future storage platforms at scale, with a particular focus on Network File System (NFS) and scalable file storage solutions. 

The Storage Team supports the operations and development of block volumes, backups, image management, object storage, and scalable file systems like NFS. Our goal is to create a cohesive, singular interface to hypervisor storage, where storage class placement decisions are transparent to the hypervisor client and leverage the full range of block and file storage classes to best satisfy customer needs. 

The selected candidate will have the opportunity to make impactful contributions to key software, contribute to the open source community, and debug interesting problems at cloud scale. 

What You'll Do

- Design, build, and maintain scalable NFS solutions and distributed file systems. 
 - Support the creation and operations of distributed systems at scale. 
 - Program in Go and other languages to develop high-performance storage solutions. 
 - Collaborate with a motivated team of peers to architect, develop, and optimize storage services. 
 - Contribute to and consume from free/open-source software communities, particularly in the file storage space. 
 - Solve complex, large-scale problems in a technically rewarding environment. 

Key Metrics

- Service availability (SLO/SLA): Monthly uptime for control plane and data plane (e. g. , control plane ≥99. 9%, data plane ≥99. 95%); reported monthly. 
 - Mean time to detect / recover (MTTD / MTTR): Median detection and recovery times for Sev-1/Sev-2 incidents; tracked per quarter. 
 - Incident volume & change-failure rate: Number of incidents by severity and percentage of releases that cause rollbacks or incidents; tracked per release and monthly. 
 - Customer adoption & usage growth: Growth in active NFS customers, number of active mounts/clients, and total provisioned capacity (GiB/TiB) - measured QoQ. 
 - Operational efficiency / automation: Reduction in manual ops (on-call time, manual runbooks, toil) measured as % decrease in operational tickets or hours. 
 - Feature delivery: % of planned milestones delivered on time and meeting acceptance criteria. 

What You'll Add To DigitalOcean

- Deep knowledge of NFS, scalable file systems, and distributed storage architectures. 
 - Experience designing, deploying, and operating highly available file storage solutions. 
 - Familiarity with Object Storage and distributed File Systems and how to scale those solutions. 
 - Expertise in concurrency/parallelism models in modern programming languages like Go. 
 - A passion for open-source contributions and collaborating with the storage community. 
 - This job is located in Bengaluru, India

You'll be a part of a cutting-edge technology company with a high-growth trajectory, who are proud to simplify cloud and AI so builders can spend more time creating software that changes the world. As part of our team, you'll embody our "Shark" mindset: bold, ambitious, and scrappy. You'll lead with a bias for action and take true ownership of our products, customer success, and team culture.

You will join a community of exceptional talent, collaborating closely with some of the brightest and most interesting people in the industry. We are a high-performance and fast-paced organization that will always challenge you to think big. Our talent development team prioritizes your professional development and provides resources to support your growth. Our benefits are designed to support you and may include flexible time off, local team meetups, and mental health and well being support. Our benefits philosophy is consistent globally, but specific benefits and eligibility vary by location to reflect local needs and regulations.

Eligible employees may also receive equity compensation, which may include a new hire equity grant and, in participating countries, the opportunity to participate in our Employee Stock Purchase Program. Headquartered in Dublin, Ohio, Cardinal Health, Inc. (NYSE: CAH) is a is a global, integrated healthcare services and products company, providing customized solutions for hospitals, health systems, pharmacies, ambulatory surgery centers, clinical laboratories, and physician offices worldwide. 

The company provides clinically proven medical products and pharmaceuticals and cost-effective solutions that enhance supply chain efficiency from hospital to home. Cardinal Health connects patients, providers, payers, pharmacists and manufacturers for integrated care coordination and better patient management. Backed by nearly 100 years of experience, with approximately 50, 000 employees in 46 countries and Fiscal 2024 revenues of $226 billion, Cardinal Health ranks among the top 25 on the Fortune 500. 

In Bangalore we are excited to create an Innovation and Capability Centre that allows us to further inhouse talent and scale that talent across our business. Our ambition is to build differentiated opportunities that allows our organization to advance rapidly, across Software-defined networking, machine learning and big data. 

What Quality Control contributes to Cardinal Health

Information Technology oversees the effective development, delivery, and operation of computing and information services. This function anticipates, plans, and delivers Information Technology solutions and strategies that enable operations and drive business value. 

Quality Control analyzes and inspects Information Technology products and processes for compliance with internal and external specifications and standards. This job family collaborates with IT Project Management, Business Integration, and Application Development & Maintenance teams, among others, during implementation and integration projects to proactively identify compliance requirements and risks. Quality Control also conducts regular audits and develops and communicates new quality control procedures for the function. 

Job Summary - Manager - IT Quality Control, Test Lead - SAP

We are seeking a highly experienced leader who can lead day-to-day activities in software testing lifecycle and oversee a team responsible for developing & executing processes and methodologies on quality assurance across a diverse technological landscape. In this role you need to manage testing capabilities in a new and existing IT landscape while also focusing on emerging technologies to deliver world-class solutions. 

The primary focus for this role is to lead a team of specialists focused on testing capabilities in SAP business process, testing solution design and configuration standards, and work on cross-functional teams for business outcomes. You will also need to roll up your sleeves to design and build solutions and stay current with industry trends. The ideal candidate will oversee testing across multiple projects, design scalable testing architectures, and build solutions that drive efficiency and innovation to align with the organization's strategic goals. This role requires strong leadership, stakeholder management, and technical expertise to ensure seamless integration across a diverse application landscape. 

This role will be responsible for ensuring the highest quality of solution design in our current enterprise IT landscapes along with testing strategies at the same time to oversee and drive large-scale organizational change initiatives by implementing the latest technologies. This role will also establish and implement functional and configuration standards and methodologies, product roadmaps, solution standards, and frameworks for application reuse. This role requires strong leadership, to lead development teams of 12-15 SMEs, stakeholder management, and technical expertise to ensure seamless integration across diverse application landscapes. 

Responsibilities

Strategic Leadership: 

- Support and implement the overall testing strategy aligned with business objectives
 - Support defining roadmaps and corresponding financial plans for technological investments to stay current with the technological trends
 - Serve as a trusted advisor to executive leadership, providing insights into testing capabilities and trends

Team Leadership And Collaboration

- Build and lead cross-functional teams, including employees, consultants, and third-party vendors
 - Foster collaboration among IT, business units, and external partners to ensure smooth integration and user adoption
 - Provide mentorship and training to team members on domain knowledge, configuration standards, and advanced technology solutions
 - Monitor project progress, manage resources, and ensure alignment with quality standards

Functional Expertise

- Strong to very strong understanding of SAP business process (Customer Onboarding, Order to Deliver, Pricing and R&I, Supply chain planning, inventory management, logistics, warehousing, procurement, SCN, RTR)
 - Knowledge of healthcare industry standards and regulations related to end-to-end enterprise solutions
 - Proficiency in test automation and testing tools 
 - Experience with various testing methodologies including functional, non-functional, and performance testing
 - Integrate AI technologies in Testing solution development to improve quality, faster to market, and reduce costs 
 - Collaborate cross-functionally with enterprise, infrastructure, architecture, and cross-functional leaders to achieve results
 - Develop and maintain configuration standards and establish KPIs to measure the design and configuration quality and track post-implementation performance
 - Elevate Testing COE team members skills and knowledge of the latest technologies and trends using various forums like training sessions and hackathons
 - Documents and manages SOPs for software and information platform systems

Qualifications

- Bachelor's Degree with equivalent experience
 - Minimum 15 years of IT and 12 years of hands-on experience in Testing ecosystem with extensive knowledge in SAP and associated integration
 - Proven record of accomplishment of leading testing capability on multi-tier applications and other major implementation projects
 - Strong knowledge of advanced technologies in Testing and Automation
 - Experience in governing development across multiple projects simultaneously to ensure adherence to development standards
 - Effective program management
 - Ability to communicate complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders
 - Strong stakeholder and people management skills
 - Expertise in change management and user adoption strategies
 - Timing - 1: 00pm to 10: 00pm IST OR 2: 30am to 11: 30am EST (to cover extended US period). This schedule may vary depending on the business requirements
 - Demonstrated ability to lead, motivate, and manage diverse teams along with innovation and driving change
 - Enjoys detailed and challenging puzzles, thrives in a fast-paced dynamic environment, and possesses the aptitude to work independently
 - Experience working in an onshore-offshore development model
 - Excellent communication skills with the ability to switch contexts between highly technical and business-focused topics quickly and easily
 - Someone that embraces diversity, and values people not just for what they do but who they are
 - Actively foster an environment where people can bring their authentic selves to work

Highly desired

- Experience collaborating in global/geographically diverse teams
 - Strategic mindset and critical thinking
 - Process oriented - grasps process flows and can translate them to Business impact. Must be driven to seek intent, draw meaningful conclusions and drive value
 - Excellent written and verbal communication skills
 - Self-motivated. Must be flexible and willing to adapt to change
 - Ability to lead meetings/calls - must be comfortable leading large meetings, presenting
 - Must be very thorough with day-to-day planning and keeping oneself organized
 - Willingness to work off hours, as requested (minimal)

What is expected of you and others at this level

- Manages department operations and supervises professional employees, front line supervisors and/or business support staff. 
 - Participates in the development of policies and procedures to achieve specific goals. Ensure employees operate within guidelines. 
 - Decisions have a short-term impact on work processes, outcomes and customers. 
 - Interacts with subordinates, peers, customers, and suppliers at various management levels; may interact with senior management; Interactions normally involve resolution of issues related to operations and/or projects; Gains consensus from various parties involved
 - Applies advanced knowledge and understanding of concepts, principles, and technical

capabilities to manage a wide variety of projects

- Participates in the development of policies and procedures to achieve specific goals
 - Recommends new practices, processes, metrics, or models
 - Works on or may lead medium to complex projects of large scope
 - Projects may have significant and long-term impact
 - Provides solutions which may set precedent
 - Persuades others into agreement in sensitive situations while maintaining positive relationships
 - Independently determines method for completion of new projects
 - Receives guidance on overall project objectives
 - Acts as a mentor to less experienced colleagues

Job Location: Bangalore, India

Work mode: Flex Hybrid - 3 days per week, work from office

Candidates who are back-to-work, people with disabilities, without a college degree, and Veterans are encouraged to apply. 

Cardinal Health supports an inclusive workplace that values diversity of thought, experience and background. We celebrate the power of our differences to create better solutions for our customers by ensuring employees can be their authentic selves each day. Cardinal Health is an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, ancestry, age, physical or mental disability, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, pregnancy, veteran status, marital status, creed, status with regard to public assistance, genetic status or any other status protected by federal, state or local law.

These interactions will feed a planning process to create a technology roadmap and pipeline of projects to be delivered. The Engineering Director is responsible for pipeline management and project delivery. This leader will be an expert in one or more business and technical domains such as sales, customer service, order processing, web services, business intelligence, server vitualization, containerization and resiliency engineering. The Engineering Director role may tilt toward broad responsibilities (20+ staff) or focus at a deeper level on strategic technology capabilities that require unique skills to implement. data.title: Staff Software Engineer, macOS
data.description:
Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human

Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence. 

This is an opportunity to do career-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk. 

Device Identity and Access OrganizationThe Device Identity and Access organization is at the forefront of Okta's Zero Trust vision. As a foundational pillar within Okta Research and Development (ORD), our mission is to transform the device itself into a secure, trusted, and effortless identity factor. We are the teams responsible for ensuring users can seamlessly interact with their work from any endpoint, anywhere in the world. 

  

Our organization is composed of engineers who thrive at the intersection of deep client-side platform engineering and massive-scale distributed systems. The work we do secures millions of enterprise endpoints globally, prevents modern identity attacks, and fundamentally changes how people work by making world-class security completely invisible to the end user. 

OpportunityWe seek a highly impactful and influential Software Engineer to join our Device Authenticators engineering team. The ideal candidate will leverage their deep expertise in Apple (macOS and iOS) client software development to architect, build, and scale the critical software and services at the heart of our security and identity platform. This is a high-visibility, hands-on opportunity to define the architectural vision, pioneer new capabilities, and drive the technical strategy to solve complex, company-wide challenges and shape the future of Okta's device identity ecosystem. You will act as a key technical leader-a player-coach and force multiplier-by setting the technical standard, mentoring and coaching engineers, and partnering with engineering leadership and product management to translate strategic business objectives into actionable, scalable technical roadmaps. This role requires an engineer who believes in designing for high performance, secure by design, rigorous code reviews, automated testing, and an iterative process to build high-quality enterprise software. 

What you'll be doing
 - Partner closely with Product Management, Engineering Directors, and Principal Architects to translate strategic business objectives into technical roadmaps. 
 - Drive cross-functional collaboration with Product, Design, and QA to ensure the seamless delivery of our most critical engineering initiatives. 
 - Lead the design and implementation of new features and services taking ownership from conception to deployment. 
 - Act as a force multiplier across multiple teams, mentoring Senior engineers, guiding technical design reviews, and raising the engineering bar across the entire pillar. 
 - Raise the technical bar through rigorous code standards, comprehensive automated testing, and modernized CI/CD pipelines, while championing engineering best practices and architectural standards. 
 - Create and maintain high-quality technical documentation and foster a culture of knowledge sharing within the team and the broader organization. 
 - Work within an environment that leverages AI-native engineering practices, utilizing AI coding assistants to accelerate delivery. 
 - Spearhead technical innovation, identifying emerging industry trends (such as advanced device security or AI-native development paradigms) and prototyping solutions to keep Okta ahead of the curve. Minimum Requirements
 - 7+ years of progressive software development experience, with a proven track record of designing and building Apple (macOS or iOS) features using Swift. 
 - Deep expertise with Apple (macOS or iOS) software environments, including design and performance optimization, security considerations. 
 - Proven expertise in advanced debugging and performance optimization using Xcode, LLDB, and Instruments to resolve complex memory issues and concurrency bugs. 
 - Experience in fast-paced agile environments, with a strong understanding of CI/CD and automated testing. 
 - Excellent communication skills with the ability to articulate complex technical concepts to diverse audiences and influence technical direction. 
 - Proficiency in leveraging AI coding assistants (e. g. , GitHub Copilot) to accelerate the development lifecycle. 
 - Cross-Platform context with strong conceptual understanding of Apple (macOS or iOS) security features. Nice-to-haves
 - Security Domain Expertise such as Cryptography, endpoint security concepts (e. g. , Secure Enclave, Device Management/MDM protocols, and endpoint detection). 
 - Understanding of Identity and Access Management protocols and technologies (e. g. , FIDO, OIDC/OAuth, or similar modern authentication frameworks). 
 - Knowledge of cybersecurity principles, secure coding practices, and certifications like CISSP or Security+. EducationBachelor's degree in Computer Science or equivalent experience. 

The Okta Experience

- Supporting Your Well-Being  
 - Driving Social Impact  
 - Developing Talent and Fostering Connection + CommunityWe are intentional about connection. Our global community, spanning over 20 offices worldwide, is united by a drive to innovate. Your journey begins with an immersive, in-person onboarding experience designed to accelerate your impact and connect you to our mission and team from day one. 

Okta is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, ancestry, marital status, age, physical or mental disability, or status as a protected veteran. We also consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and convictions records, consistent with applicable laws.

Provides advanced level system analysis, design, development, and implementation of applications and databases, under general direction.

Vanguard India

data.title: Principal Software Engineer
data.description:
Description

Trintech is an award-winning AI-driven Fintech SaaS organisation transforming the way finance teams operate. 

We are looking for a Principal Software Engineer to build and own backend services in the Platform Team at Trintech's AI Platform. The Platform Team delivers the foundational capabilities that all AI agents depend on - event-driven orchestration, multi-tenant data architecture, API gateway integration, immutable audit framework, and the billing and metering engine. This is the next career level above Senior Software Engineer. The step-up is defined by deeper technical ownership, higher quality output, and greater independence - not a change in tools or scope. 

A Principal Engineer on this team owns their service implementations end to end, requires no guidance on complex backend problems, sets the code quality bar that others follow, and contributes meaningfully to low-level design decisions. The Platform Team builds infrastructure that other teams depend on - platform services must be reliable, observable, well-documented, and designed to be consumed by agent squads who did not build them. 

What You'll Do

Backend Engineering Delivery

- Own backend service implementation end to end - design, build, test, deploy, and maintain production-grade Python services using FastAPI. Does not wait to be told how to build something. 
 - Design service internals from first principles - data structures, API contracts, error handling, retry strategies, and observability instrumentation. 
 - Build event-driven services that produce and consume events correctly - message ordering, delivery guarantees, idempotency, and failure handling in event-driven platform systems. 
 - Design and implement multi-tenant data access patterns - row-level isolation, tenant-scoped queries, and per-tenant configuration at the service level. 
 - Design immutable data models and append-only event patterns - the engineering foundation for the platform's compliance and audit capabilities. 
 - Own CI/CD pipeline integration for services - every service ships with automated tests, quality gates, and reliable deployment. 

Quality & Craft

- Set the code quality bar within the Platform Team - write clean, maintainable, well-structured code that others reference as the standard. 
 - Drive test coverage as a first-class engineering concern - unit, integration, and contract tests are part of delivery, not an afterthought. 
 - Instrument services for observability - structured logging, distributed tracing, and health metrics built in from the start. 
 - Identify and address technical debt proactively - does not wait to be asked to flag quality issues or design debt in owned services. 

Technical Contribution

- Contribute to low-level design discussions - bring clear reasoning on component design, data model trade-offs, and API contract decisions. 
 - Support and mentor Senior Engineers on the Platform Team - review code with depth, share knowledge, and raise the team's technical level through example. 
 - Collaborate with the Platform Software Architect on implementation decisions - understands where the Architect's design direction is heading and builds toward it. 

Who You Are

Python Backend Engineering - Primary Gate

- Production-grade Python backend engineering using FastAPI - owns implementation decisions independently, sets the quality bar, and requires no guidance on complex backend problems. 
 - Low-level system design - designs individual components, data structures, service internals, and API contracts from first principles. Can articulate and defend trade-offs with depth and clarity. 

Experience

- Event-driven architecture - building services that produce and consume events correctly. Message ordering, delivery guarantees, idempotency, and error handling in event-driven systems. 
 - Immutable data design and append-only patterns - designing data models where every state change is traceable and tamper-evident. The engineering foundation for compliance-grade platform capabilities. 
 - Multi-tenant data patterns - tenant-scoped data access, row-level isolation, and per-tenant configuration at the service level. 
 - API design and OpenAPI contracts - designing and versioning platform APIs that downstream consumers can build against reliably. 
 - SQL and NoSQL databases at production scale - schema design, query optimisation, indexing strategies, and knowing when to use each. 
 - Kubernetes, Docker, and Helm - deploying and releasing containerised services in production, including CI/CD pipeline integration. Code quality: maintainable, readable, well-tested code with error handling, observability instrumentation, and service resilience patterns. 

Awareness

- API gateway concepts - how platform services are exposed through a gateway layer. Sufficient to design services that integrate correctly without owning the gateway. 
 - Security and IAM patterns - OAuth flows and token propagation at the service level. Platform Architect owns security architecture depth. LLM tooling concepts: what the platform must support for agents to operate on it. 

Nice to Have

- Experience building audit or compliance-grade systems - immutable logs, decision trails, tamper-evident data. 
 - Workflow orchestration tools - Temporal or equivalent, learnable on the job. AI-native SDLC: familiarity with Human-led Agentic SDLC practices. 
 - Azure cloud experience. 

What You'll Learn & Gain

- End-to-end ownership of backend services on a foundational platform that every AI agent team builds on - with full accountability for reliability, observability, and production-readiness of the infrastructure you ship. 
 - Deep hands-on experience in event-driven architecture, immutable data design, and multi-tenant patterns in a production context where correctness, compliance, and scalability are all non-negotiable simultaneously. 
 - Exposure to building audit and compliance-grade infrastructure in a SOX-governed environment - learning to design systems where every state change is traceable, tamper-evident, and queryable under enterprise audit requirements. 
 - Close collaboration with the Platform Software Architect on implementation decisions, and the opportunity to mentor Senior Engineers - the Principal level is where individual technical excellence directly shapes the quality standards of the broader team. 

If you are an engineer who owns their implementations completely, sets quality standards that others follow, and is ready to build the infrastructure foundation that an enterprise AI platform depends on - we encourage you to apply. 

At our core, Trintechers stand committed to fostering a culture rooted in our core values - Humble, Empowered, Reliable, and Open. Together, these values guide our actions, define our identity, and inspire us to continuously strive for excellence in everything we do. 

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin or disability.

data.description:
At EY, you'll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we're counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all. 

EY GDS - RCT

Senior - Actimize & Java Engineering

Senior - Software Engineering

Experience: Strictly 4+ years

Mandatory eligibility: Candidates must have 4 or more years of relevant professional experience and hands-on experience in Actimize, Java, SQL, cloud, and the Financial Crime Compliance domain. Candidates below 4 years or without any mandatory skill or domain experience are not eligible. 

The opportunity

Join a Financial Crime Technology team delivering enterprise solutions for global financial services clients. The role requires strong hands-on engineering capability across NICE Actimize, Java, advanced SQL, and cloud platforms, supported by practical Financial Crime Compliance domain knowledge. The successful candidate will contribute to solution design, development, integration, deployment, optimization, and production support while guiding junior engineers and working directly with technical and business stakeholders. 

Role Overview

We are seeking a Senior Software Engineer with proven experience implementing or supporting NICE Actimize solutions and building Java-based services and integrations. The role involves working with customer, account, transaction, alert, case, and screening data across KYC, AML, Transaction Monitoring, Sanctions, and Fraud use cases. Cloud and domain experience are mandatory. AI skills are an added advantage for accelerating engineering, analytics, documentation, testing, and investigation-support use cases. 

Key Responsibilities

- Design, configure, develop, enhance, and support NICE Actimize solutions and related Financial Crime applications. 
 - Build and maintain Java applications, microservices, REST APIs, batch components, and integration services. 
 - Develop complex and optimized SQL for data ingestion, transformation, reconciliation, alerting, investigation, and reporting use cases. 
 - Integrate Actimize with upstream and downstream systems, including customer, account, transaction, case-management, screening, and reporting platforms. 
 - Deploy and support applications and data workloads on Azure, AWS, or GCP using appropriate cloud-native services. 
 - Translate compliance requirements into technical designs, rules, scenarios, data mappings, interfaces, and acceptance criteria. 
 - Perform performance tuning, defect analysis, root-cause analysis, code reviews, unit testing, release support, and production troubleshooting. 
 - Ensure secure coding, auditability, data protection, logging, monitoring, version control, and CI/CD practices. 
 - Collaborate with compliance SMEs, solution architects, data engineers, QA teams, infrastructure teams, and client stakeholders. 
 - Provide technical guidance to junior team members and take ownership of assigned modules and delivery outcomes. 

Mandatory Skills

- Actimize: Strong hands-on experience with NICE Actimize implementation, configuration, customization, integration, enhancement, or production support.
