Overview

About the Team

The Audit Platform team is at the forefront of how Atlassian builds, maintains, and scales customer trust. In an era where work is performed by both humans and autonomous AI agents, our mission is to deliver trustworthy, real-time visibility into every meaningful action across the Atlassian ecosystem empowering organizations to answer "who (or what) did what, when, where, and why" with absolute confidence. 

We build high-throughput, distributed streaming and storage systems that capture billions of activity and policy decision events at massive scale. Beyond defensible compliance logging, our platform acts as the intelligence backbone powering AI & Non-Human Identity governance, Insider Risk Management, and real-time security investigations across Cloud products. 

About The Role

Atlassian is looking for an experienced and talented Principal Fullstack Engineer to join the Audit Platform team. You'll help build the platform that captures, stores, and surfaces audit events at massive scale, powering compliance, security investigations, and customer trust across the Atlassian ecosystem. 

You'll be part of a team at the spearhead of how Atlassian earns and keeps customer trust. As an engineer well into your career, you're an expert at what you do, with a breadth of experience across frontend and backend technologies and a track record of architecting and building large-scale distributed systems. You have a deep understanding of scale, performance, cost, maintainability, and extensibility in production systems used by millions of users daily. In this role, you'll take on a high level of technical responsibility and ownership while acting as a role model and mentor to the engineers around you. 

Your greatest responsibility will be to ensure timely delivery of projects with utmost quality spanning multiple teams, identifying and managing dependencies, creating win-win-win situations for all teams involved, in turn creating win for Atlassian. 

This is a unique role which requires a combination of engineering excellence, operational excellence and execution excellence while balancing quality and speed. You will have a lot of autonomy and accountability and a team of brilliant engineers to support you in this journey. 

Responsibilities

- Define the architecture and roadmap that continuously support hyper customer growth at Atlassian
 - Regularly tackle the largest and most complex problems on the team, from technical design to launch
 - Propose libraries and shared components that unlock the potential of other Atlassian teams
 - Routinely solve complex architecture challenges and set the standards that new projects are built on
 - Champion a high technical bar across the org, and evangelize engineering best practices
 - Partner across engineering teams to drive company-wide initiatives spanning multiple projects
 - Transfer your depth of knowledge and raise the level of engineering excellence around you
 - Grow the people around you, coaching engineers, elevating their skills, and helping them do the best work of their careers

Qualifications

- Expert-level fullstack proficiency, with strong command of both frontend (TypeScript/React/Javascript/Html/CSS) and backend (Kotlin/Java) technologies
 - Strong backend engineering experience building and operating scalable, high-availability services and APIs
 - Experience architecting and building large-scale distributed systems, with a solid grasp of scale, performance, cost, and reliability trade-offs
 - Experience with event-driven or streaming architectures and high-throughput data pipelines
 - Experience with modern frontend frameworks (e. g. , React)

 - Expertise building shared libraries and components used across multiple web applications
 - Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to clearly explain complex technical concepts and trade-offs to a wide range of audiences, from engineers to senior stakeholders
 - A passion for solving complex problems with users in mind
 - A passion for mentoring and collaborating with others on the team
 - A passion for learning and continuously improving yourself and the team around you

data.title: Software QA Engineer - Medical Devices
data.description:
We're looking for QA engineers who enjoy hunting down the one edge case nobody thought of, tracing a failure from the UI all the way down to a sensor or actuator, or building automation that catches bugs while everyone else is asleep, you'll fit right in. 

We're building the software that powers surgical robotics at Articulus Surgical, where reliability, precision, and thoughtful engineering matter. 

As a Software QA Engineer, you'll design and execute testing strategies across software, robotics, and integrated medical-device systems, working closely with Software, Robotics, Embedded, Systems, and Clinical teams to find defects early and make sure every release is truly ready. 

What you'll actually be doing

- Developing and executing functional, regression, integration, system, and end-to-end test cases for robotic and medical-device software. 
 - Testing across individual software components as well as complete integrated robotic systems. 
 - Identifying, reproducing, documenting, tracking, and verifying defects through their complete lifecycle. 
 - Performing hardware-software integration testing across robotic systems, embedded controllers, sensors, actuators, and associated software. 
 - Building and maintaining automated testing frameworks, scripts, and test utilities to improve coverage and efficiency.

We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

About

To ensure that we hire the best talent in the right way, we follow a strict hiring process and recently, Cisco has been made aware of fraudulent recruiters claiming to be from the company. Please be advised that any communication from Cisco about careers will:

Cisco will never make a job offer without conducting an interview process or ask you for money in any way. Start Date: ASAP (30-60 day notice period is max. . . ideally sooner)

Shift Time: 4: 30 pm to 1: 30 am IST

Note: Must have at least 8 years of total experience - Need an engineer who can handle both frontend and backend development

Job Description: 

We are looking for a Full-Stack Developer to build production-ready, goal-driven AI agents that reduce the administrative and digital workload placed on technicians, along with the technician-facing interface people use to work with them. 

This is not a traditional data science or LLM experimentation role. The ideal candidate is a hands-on AI engineer who has built agents that reason toward a goal, interact with applications and APIs, take actions, and run reliably in production. 

Strong full-stack skills matter equally. You will build both the AI and agent capabilities and the front-end experience that lets technicians review, approve, and act on what the agents do. 

What You'll Be Doing

AI agents

- Design, build, and enhance goal-driven AI agents that take real-world digital actions. 
 - Turn an initial proof of concept into a production-ready agentic solution. 
 - Build workflows where agents complete multi-step tasks independently, with human approval when required. 
 - Work with Anthropic's enterprise Claude platform to develop and enhance AI capabilities. 

Front end

- Build intuitive, technician-facing interfaces, not just back-end AI functionality. 
 - Turn design specifications and Figma prototypes into responsive, accessible UI components. 
 - Show agent activity, status, and approval requests clearly, so technicians stay in control. 

Back end and integration

- Develop integrations between AI agents and enterprise systems through APIs. 
 - Use Python and Java for AI, automation, integration, and application development. 
 - Partner with colleagues focused on AI engineering, Snowflake and data engineering, and ServiceNow. 

Architecture and quality

- Help decide the right architecture and technical approach as the project evolves, rather than implementing predefined features. 
 - Build for production readiness, scalability, reliability, security, and maintainability. 

Required Qualifications

AI engineering

- Strong hands-on AI engineering experience, with agents that have moved beyond experimentation or basic LLM usage into production. 
 - Strong understanding of agentic AI concepts and terminology. 
 - Experience building solutions where agents reason, work toward goals, invoke tools or APIs, and take actions. 
 - Understanding of LLMs and modern generative AI architectures, plus solid data science fundamentals. 

Front end (required)

- Hands-on experience building user-facing applications with React and TypeScript, including Next. js or a similar framework. 
 - Strong HTML5, CSS3, and modern JavaScript (ES6+), including responsive layouts with Flexbox and Grid. 
 - Experience with a utility or component styling approach such as Tailwind CSS. 
 - Ability to turn Figma designs into pixel-accurate, accessible, cross-browser interfaces. 
 - Experience consuming REST APIs and managing client-side state, loading states, and error handling. 

Back end and integration

- Strong full-stack software development experience across back-end and user-facing development. 
 - Strong Python and Java knowledge, and an understanding of how Python applies to AI-driven solutions. 
 - Experience designing, developing, and consuming APIs. 

Working style

- Comfortable in an evolving environment where requirements and technical approaches change as the team learns. 
 - Strong communication skills, able to discuss technical decisions, trade-offs, and the future of AI with both technical and business stakeholders. 

Nice to Have

- Experience with Anthropic's Claude platform, Model Context Protocol (MCP), RAG, or workflow tools such as n8n. 
 - Familiarity with Snowflake or other data platforms, and with ServiceNow integrations. 
 - Experience with Node. js, GraphQL, or Django alongside Python and Java. 
 - Cloud and delivery experience: AWS, Docker, CI/CD, and automated testing such as Cypress or Jest. 
 - Experience designing human-in-the-loop approval flows for AI-driven actions.

Job Summary

Synechron is seeking a Senior QA Automation Engineer to lead quality assurance for a payment clearing platform. The role will validate payment processing, financial messaging, settlement, and reconciliation workflows while building reliable automation for continuous delivery. You will also support AI-driven testing and collaborate with Product, Engineering, and DevOps teams to improve platform quality and release confidence. 

Software Requirements

Required

- Java, Python, or JavaScript/TypeScript: 3+ years. 
 - Selenium, Playwright, Cypress, or equivalent: 2+ years. 
 - API testing using REST Assured, Postman, Karate, or equivalent. 
 - SQL and relational database validation. 
 - Git and pull-request workflows. 
 - Jenkins, GitLab CI, Azure DevOps, or equivalent CI/CD tools. 
 - Test management and defect tracking tools. 
 - Docker or equivalent container technology. 
 - XML, JSON, CSV, ISO 20022, or SWIFT message validation. 

Preferred

- JUnit, TestNG, PyTest, Robot Framework, or equivalent. 
 - Kafka, RabbitMQ, or other messaging platforms. 
 - JMeter, Gatling, or equivalent performance-testing tools. 
 - Service virtualization and mocking tools.

Overall Responsibilities

- Develop and execute a risk-based QA strategy for payment clearing systems.

 - Apply AI-supported testing for test generation, script maintenance, and defect analysis. 
 - Collaborate with Product Managers, Developers, DevOps, and Business Analysts.

Technical Skills (By Category)

- Programming - Essential: Java, Python, or JavaScript/TypeScript. Preferred: Experience with more than one language and event-driven systems. 
 - Databases and Data - Essential: SQL, relational databases, data validation, reconciliation, synthetic test data, and data masking. Preferred: Data warehouses, distributed databases, and event-stream validation. 
 - Cloud Technologies - Essential: Cloud-hosted environments, service dependencies, logs, and access controls. Preferred: Containers, orchestration, managed cloud services, and infrastructure as code.

Experience Requirements

- 3-5 years of experience in QA automation or quality engineering.

 - Practical experience with automated regression testing, APIs, databases, distributed services, and CI/CD.

Day-to-Day Activities

- Design payment and clearing test scenarios, including negative and recovery cases. 
 - Develop, execute, and maintain automated tests. 
 - Validate messages, transaction statuses, settlement results, and reconciliation outputs. 
 - Create test data and manage test environments. 
 - Review failures, logs, database records, and service responses. 
 - Participate in planning, refinement, defect triage, release discussions, and retrospectives. 
 - Review automation code and document test results, risks, and dependencies. 
 - Recommend quality improvements and escalate issues affecting payment accuracy, security, compliance, or release readiness. 

Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. 
 - ISTQB, Agile, DevOps, cloud, or payment-industry certifications are preferred. 
 - Completion of Synechron training in security, data protection, compliance, quality practices, and responsible AI. 
 - Ongoing development in payment technology, automation, cloud delivery, security, and AI-assisted testing is expected. 

Professional Competencies

- Analytical problem-solving and root-cause investigation. 
 - Clear communication with technical and business stakeholders.

 - Adaptability to changing technologies and requirements.

data.title: Lead Product Engineer
data.description:
Location: Bengaluru, India

Work Model: Hybrid

We're looking for a Lead Product Engineer to anchor our engineering team - someone who works across the full stack, owns the quality, performance, and reliability of the systems they build, and raises the bar for the engineers around them. We practice product-engineering-driven development: engineers work directly from customer problems to shippable prototypes, using modern AI tooling to move fast and iterate in the open. As a lead, you set the standard for how that is done well - shipping product yourself, defining how we validate and operate what we ship, and mentoring engineers as the team grows. 

Responsibilities

Product Engineering & AI-Driven Development

- Take ambiguous customer problems from discovery to production: partner directly with product and design, prototype quickly, validate with real users, and iterate to a shippable solution without waiting on fully specified requirements
 - Use AI coding tools (e. g. , Cursor, Claude Code) as a daily accelerant, and set the standard for using them responsibly - AI-generated code is reviewed, tested, and validated with the same rigor as hand-written code
 - Define and evolve the team's practices for AI-assisted development: prompting patterns, review gates, guardrails, and the metrics that show where the tooling actually helps
 - Own technical design and trade-off decisions for your area; balance product requirements against maintainability, release risk, and operational readiness

Full Stack

- Design, build, and ship features across the frontend and backend of our product, and own them through release and into production
 - Lead API design and data modeling decisions; write clean, well-tested code and hold the team to the same standard through code review
 - Identify cross-system dependencies early and drive solutions that work across services, teams, and environments
 - Debug and resolve issues surfaced by users or monitoring, and fix the class of problem rather than the single instance

Quality & Performance Engineering

- Own the quality strategy for your area: automated E2E, API, regression, and post-deployment validation integrated into CI/CD so releases ship on evidence, not manual sign-off
 - Plan and run load, performance, and soak testing ahead of peak-traffic periods; define load profiles from production telemetry, find and close bottlenecks before they become incidents, and sign off on environment readiness
 - Drive measurable efficiency gains - shorter regression cycles, fewer rollbacks, higher automated coverage of critical flows - and report on them

SRE & Production Operations

- Own system health for your services: define SLOs, set up and tune alerting, build the dashboards and runbooks on-call actually uses, and participate in the on-call rotation
 - Lead incident response and blameless postmortems; drive root-cause fixes and the follow-through that keeps them from recurring
 - Improve deployment pipelines, observability tooling, and infrastructure-as-code; contribute to Kubernetes/cloud migrations and infrastructure cost optimization
 - Identify reliability, performance, and scalability gaps proactively and get them on the roadmap with a clear business case

Technical Leadership

- Mentor and grow engineers across product, quality automation, and SRE practices; raise the team's bar through review, pairing, and example
 - Align Product, UX, Engineering, SRE, and Customer teams on scope, release activities, and cross-functional dependencies
 - Coordinate third-party engagements where needed (e. g. , penetration testing, static analysis), including scoping and remediation tracking

Qualifications

- 8+ years of software engineering experience, including hands-on ownership of production systems and at least 2 years leading technical direction for a team or area

data.title: ServiceNow Lead IT QA Analyst
data.description:
Lead IT QA Analyst

Job Summary

We are seeking a Lead IT QA Analyst to lead quality assurance efforts for enterprise technology initiatives, with a strong focus on the ServiceNow platform. In this role, you will own QA planning and execution across projects, releases, enhancements, platform upgrades, and test automation enablement to ensure solutions meet business requirements, user expectations, and quality standards before deployment. You will partner closely with business stakeholders, process analysts, developers, and delivery teams to develop test strategies, coordinate testing activities, automate repeatable test scenarios, manage defects, support UAT, and drive continuous improvement in testing practices. This position is ideal for a detail-oriented QA leader who can translate business needs into testable outcomes, communicate risks clearly, and help deliver reliable, scalable technology solutions. 

Key Responsibilities

Test Strategy & Planning

- Define and own the end-to-end QA strategy for ServiceNow projects, releases, and enhancements in collaboration with the Lead Business Process Analyst. 
 - Develop test plans, test cases, and test scripts aligned to business requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria. 
 - Establish and maintain QA standards, templates, and best practices for the ServiceNow platform. 
 - Define the automation approach for repeatable regression, smoke, and high-risk business process test scenarios, including prioritization criteria and expected coverage. 

Test Execution & Defect Management

- Lead functional, regression, integration, and user acceptance testing (UAT) for ServiceNow modules (e. g. , ITSM, ITOM, HRSD, CSM, SPM). 
 - Identify, document, and track defects through the full lifecycle using ServiceNow or designated defect-tracking tools. 
 - Prioritize and manage defect resolution in partnership with development and configuration teams. 
 - Execute performance, load, and smoke testing as required. 
 - Build, execute, and maintain automated test scripts for critical workflows to reduce manual testing effort and improve release confidence. 

ServiceNow Platform QA

- Validate workflows, business rules, UI policies, notifications, and integrations configured in ServiceNow. 
 - Ensure data integrity and accuracy across ServiceNow tables and integrations with upstream/downstream systems. 
 - Review and test configuration changes, updates, and platform upgrades including ServiceNow version upgrades and patches. 

Collaboration & Stakeholder Engagement

- Partner with the Lead Business Process Analyst to translate process requirements into testable acceptance criteria. 
 - Facilitate UAT sessions with business stakeholders; provide coaching and support to business testers. 
 - Communicate QA status, risks, and defect metrics to project teams and leadership in a clear and timely manner. 

Continuous Improvement

- Drive adoption of automated testing tools and frameworks within the ServiceNow environment. 
 - Actively expand automated test coverage across ServiceNow workflows, integrations, and regression suites using approved automation tools and frameworks.

data.title: USB Lead Engineer
data.description:
USB Lead Engineer - Linux Enablement & AVV (Pre/Post-Silicon) - RISC‐V MPU Platform

Location: Pune / Bangalore, India

Own USB enablement on Linux - driver bring-up, compliance, and AVV from FPGA to first silicon. 

About GlobalFoundries

GlobalFoundries is a leading full-service semiconductor foundry providing a unique combination of design, development, and fabrication services to some of the world's most inspired technology companies. With a global manufacturing footprint spanning three continents, GlobalFoundries make possible the technologies and systems that transform industries and give customers the power to shape their markets. For more information, visit www. gf. com. 

About The Role

We're building a next-generation, application-class RISC‐V MPU SoC platform for Linux systems - bringing together multimedia, industrial connectivity, security, and high-speed I/O. 

In the Platform Software team, you will be the technical owner for USB across the stack: boot-to-user-space enablement, kernel/driver integration, and automated validation (AVV) on virtual platforms/FPGA and first silicon. You'll partner closely with architects and hardware teams to de-risk the USB subsystem, drive bring-up readiness and deliver a production-quality SDK experience. 

Key Responsibilities

- USB Linux enablement & integration: enable and maintain USB host/device/dual-role functionality on a 64-bit RISC‐V MPU Linux platform. 
 - Bring up USB controllers (e. g. , xHCI/EHCI for host, UDC for device/gadget), PHY integration, clocks/resets, and interrupts. 
 - Drive kernel/BSP enablement: Device Tree bindings, power management (runtime/PM QoS), suspend/resume, and performance tuning. 
 - Develop/debug USB drivers and related subsystems: USB core interactions, hub behavior, gadget framework, and class drivers as needed. 
 - Enable and validate user-space workflows: enumeration, throughput/latency, storage/networking classes, and reliability over hot-plug scenarios. 
 - Deliver USB-ready SDK releases: integration, regression validation, and developer-facing documentation/debug guides. 
 - AVV & silicon validation (pre/post-silicon): create test plans and automation to validate USB functionality, performance, and compliance on FPGA/emulation and first silicon. 
 - Contribute to shift-left validation using virtual platforms/emulation/FPGA; build reusable USB validation apps/tests to exercise data paths and corner cases. 
 - Debug and root-cause USB issues across HW/FW/kernel using logs, traces, and lab equipment (e. g. , JTAG, logic/protocol analyzers); drive fixes to closure. 
 - Cross-functional ownership: partner with architects, RTL/PHY, board, and platform teams to define requirements, de-risk schedules, and land USB features. 
 - Own USB feature planning: role/port matrix, power & charging considerations, compliance goals, and bring-up milestones. 
 - Provide bring-up and validation feedback that influences USB architecture decisions (controller/PHY selection, debug hooks, observability, testability). 
 - Align with internal and external stakeholders on deliverables, bug triage, and release readiness for USB enablement. 
 - Customer & ecosystem engagement: support early adopters and upstream fixes when appropriate (kernel, Device Tree, test collateral). 
 - Work with OEMs/Tier‐1s during bring-up and USB interoperability; contribute patches upstream when it improves maintainability. 
Required Qualifications

- B. E. /B. Tech or M. E. /M. Tech in Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related field. 
 - Strong experience with minimum 8-15 years in Embedded Linux platform/BSP and device-driver development. 
 - Expert-level C programming; comfortable reading and modifying kernel, driver, and low-level firmware code. 
 - Strong Linux internals knowledge: boot flow, memory/interrupt subsystems, concurrency, and performance debugging. 
 - Hands-on SoC/platform bring-up experience, including high-speed I/O enablement and ownership mindset for subsystem quality. 
 - Hands-on with U‐Boot, Linux kernel, Device Tree, and Yocto/OpenEmbedded; experience integrating and validating USB in BSP/SDK releases. 
 - Strong debugging skills with GDB and at least one OpenOCD/JTAG, Lauterbach, or similar tools; able to debug complex HW/SW interactions. 
 - Experience working on FPGA, emulation, or early-silicon platforms for bring-up/validation. 

Good to Have

- Deep USB knowledge (USB2/USB3) and familiarity with Linux USB architecture (usbcore, HCD, gadget framework). 
 - Experience with USB compliance/interoperability testing and post-silicon triage (throughput, link stability, suspend/resume, hot-plug). 
 - Exposure to USB Type‐C/PD, retimers, and/or Alt Modes (e. g. , DisplayPort) is a plus. 
 - Familiarity with platform security boundaries relevant to USB (secure boot, firmware/OS boundaries, attack surface considerations). 
 - Experience with QEMU, virtual platforms, or emulation workflows used for early driver/test development. 
 - Exposure to CI/CD and automated validation (Python/shell test frameworks, dashboards, regressions) for continuous USB quality. 

What We Offer

- Build a RISC‐V MPU platform from the ground up and see it shipped in real products. 
 - End-to-end ownership across pre-silicon → FPGA → first silicon → production SDK releases. 
 - Work closely with CPU architects and SoC teams, your data drives decisions. 
 - Deep technical work, strong peer group, and long-term growth on a strategic platform

MIPS - GlobalFoundries company is an equal opportunity employer, cultivating a diverse and inclusive workforce. We believe having a multicultural workplace enhances productivity, efficiency and innovation whilst our employees feel truly respected, valued and heard. 

As an affirmative employer, all qualified applicants are considered for employment regardless of age, ethnicity, marital status, citizenship, race, religion, political affiliation, gender, sexual orientation and medical and/or physical abilities. 

All offers of employment with GlobalFoundries are conditioned upon the successful completion of background checks, medical screenings as applicable and subject to the respective local laws and regulations.

About The Role

As a Senior Automation QA Engineer, become a part of a cross-functional development team engineering experiences of tomorrow. 

We are seeking an experienced QA Automation Engineer to design and demonstrate an end-to-end quality engineering framework for an enterprise Microsoft Fabric data and semantic model platform. 

The candidate will validate enterprise data across the Microsoft Fabric Medallion Architecture (Bronze, Silver, and Gold layers), automate data quality checks, verify Power BI semantic models, and test reports and AI-powered agents. 

The role requires strong expertise in test automation, data validation, SQL, and modern quality engineering practices, with hands-on experience in Playwright and TypeScript. Experience integrating automated testing into Azure DevOps CI/CD pipelines and leveraging AI-assisted development tools such as Claude will be highly desirable. 

Responsibilities

- Data Observability Architecture: Setting up dashboards or alerts to track data health trends, pipeline failures, and schema change impacts in real time. 
 - Source-to-Target Reconciliation: Check data completeness, null values, duplicates, and business rule transformations across ingestion tiers. 
 - Automated Regression Suites: Write scripts to automatically test pipelines and data outputs after every schema or code change. 
 - Root Cause Analysis (RCA): Investigate discrepancies across ETL jobs, semantic models, and visual dashboards. 
 - Data & Schema Integrity Testing
 - Schema Drift & Integrity: Test pipeline resilience against upstream column or data type changes, and validate primary/foreign keys, constraints, and boundary conditions across Lakehouse and Warehouse tables
 - Null & Duplicate Checks: Automate validation for unauthorized nulls, truncation, formatting anomalies, and duplicate records across Medallion layers
 - Data Observability & Monitoring
 - SLAs & Lineage: Track metrics for freshness, volume anomalies, and latency, and audit end-to-end lineage from raw sources to Power BI models
 - Alerting Frameworks: Configure automated alerts via Azure Log Analytics, Fabric monitoring hubs, or webhooks for data quality threshold failures
Requirements

- Platform Architecture & Scripting
 - Fabric Architecture: Utilize deep knowledge of OneLake, Lakehouse, Data Warehouse, Dataflows Gen2, Pipelines, Medallion architecture, and Delta Lake formats
 - Automation & Scripting: Write SQL, T-SQL, Python, PySpark, or Spark SQL for reconciliation and regression testing using frameworks like Great Expectations or Soda
 - Pipeline & Power BI Validation
 - Error Handling: Test data movement, retry logic, failure handling, and incremental, delta, or historical load scenarios
 - Semantic Models & CI/CD: Validate report metrics, complex DAX, relationships, RLS, and integrate automated quality checks into Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, or Fabric Git
 - Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience
 - Typically 5-8 years of QA or test automation experience
 - Demonstrated hands-on experience building automation frameworks rather than only executing existing test scripts
 - Ability to independently design test strategies, implement automation, troubleshoot failures, and communicate results
 - Strong collaboration skills when working with data engineering, BI, AI, and DevOps teams
What's in it for you?

- Strong community: Work alongside top professionals in a friendly, open-door environment

data.title: Lead Solution Architect – Digital Solutions
data.description:
Position Summary

Ecolab Digital develops connected, data-driven and AI-enabled solutions that improve customer operations, quality, compliance and decision-making. The Lead Solution Architect - Digital Solutions will provide hands-on, end-to-end architecture leadership for enterprise digital products and regulated operational workflows, working closely with Product, Engineering, Quality, Data & AI, shared-platform and enterprise technology teams. 

The role will initially focus on digital capabilities for regulated manufacturing and pharmaceutical operations, including electronic logbooks, guided/batch execution, cleaning validation and evidence workflows, together with AI-enabled inspection and edge/cloud solutions. The architect will independently drive bounded solution decisions from business intent through engineering-ready designs, within the portfolio architecture direction established by the Senior Director, Solution Architecture. The position remains part of a centrally managed Digital Solutions Architecture team. 

Key Responsibilities

- Own solution architecture for digital products and operational workflows, translating business, Product and intended-use requirements into implementable end-to-end designs. 
 - Architect modular digital workflow capabilities such as electronic logbooks, guided or batch execution, cleaning validation, exception handling, evidence capture, review and approval, with clear integration and data boundaries. 
 - Embed regulated-system needs into designs, including audit trails, electronic records/signatures where applicable, role-based access, data integrity, traceability, retention, controlled change and validation evidence; partner with Quality on control interpretation and acceptance. 
 - Define clean interfaces among enterprise digital platforms, shared identity/user services, domain applications, APIs/events, data services and operational systems; prioritize reuse and avoid duplicating enterprise capabilities. 
 - Partner closely with Engineering to establish architecture decision records, component boundaries, interface contracts, non-functional requirements, deployment patterns and engineering-ready solution guidance. 
 - Architect cloud-native and hybrid solutions spanning applications, event-driven integration, containerized services, data platforms and, where needed, customer-site edge processing with intermittent connectivity. 
 - Evaluate production AI/ML capabilities-including computer vision and inference-through clear service boundaries, model lifecycle, human review, decision traceability, monitoring and integration into trusted operational workflows. 
 - For edge-enabled use cases, define connectivity, local buffering/offline behavior, remote deployment and update, rollback, security, observability and recovery responsibilities across edge and cloud. 
 - Work with Product, Quality, Engineering and business stakeholders to distinguish product requirements, architecture decisions, validation responsibilities and delivery ownership. 
 - Assess build/reuse/buy and partner proposals; validate architecture assumptions, technical feasibility, delivery dependencies and alignment to Ecolab enterprise patterns without ceding architecture decision rights. 
 - Guide solution implementation and technical validation, surface architecture risks early, and support design decisions through release readiness and operational handover without taking on project management accountability. 
 - Contribute reusable patterns, reference designs and architecture decisions to the broader Digital Solutions portfolio; communicate trade-offs clearly to senior stakeholders and globally distributed teams. 

Required Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related technical discipline. 
 - 15+ years of progressive technology experience, including at least 5 years in solution/technical architecture or comparable technical leadership roles. 
 - Demonstrated ability to independently architect complex enterprise digital solutions across application, integration, data, cloud and platform boundaries, and translate designs into executable engineering direction. 
 - Experience with regulated manufacturing, pharmaceutical, quality-controlled or similarly governed operational environments; practical understanding of GxP/GMP-style controls, auditability, traceability, data integrity and controlled change. 
 - Experience designing enterprise workflow or transactional applications with role-based access, review/approval, exception handling, evidence capture and integration to operational systems. 
 - Strong cloud and distributed-systems architecture experience, including APIs/microservices, event-driven patterns, secure integration, data services, containerized workloads and resilient application design. 
 - Ability to design security, identity/authorization, data protection, availability, scalability, observability, supportability and disaster-recovery requirements into production solutions. 
 - Practical understanding of production AI/ML integration, including model/service boundaries, data governance, monitoring, quality controls and human accountability; not necessarily hands-on model development. 
 - Ability to work effectively with Product, Engineering, Quality, Data & AI, cybersecurity, infrastructure, enterprise-platform teams and external technology partners. 
 - Strong architecture judgment: can make bounded day-to-day solution decisions independently and escalate cross-platform, enterprise or material regulatory decisions with clear options and trade-offs. 
 - Excellent written and verbal communication, including the ability to explain architecture decisions to both technical and non-technical stakeholders in globally distributed teams. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience in pharmaceutical manufacturing, biotechnology, medical devices, cleanrooms or other regulated production environments. 
 - Working knowledge of 21 CFR Part 11, EU Annex 11, ALCOA+ principles, computer system validation/assurance and associated evidence expectations. 
 - Architecture experience with electronic logbooks, electronic batch records/execution, cleaning validation, eQMS, MES, LIMS or related digital manufacturing/quality systems. 
 - Hybrid edge/cloud and connected-site architecture, including camera/video systems, GPU inference, offline operation, remote fleet management or secure edge deployment. 
 - Experience with computer vision, AI-assisted inspection, MLOps/model lifecycle, human-in-the-loop workflows or AI governance in production. 
 - Experience with Azure, AWS, Databricks or equivalent enterprise cloud/data platforms, with a platform-agnostic architecture mindset. 
 - Experience modernizing legacy systems and defining reusable enterprise platform/service boundaries during phased coexistence and migration. 
 - Experience reviewing vendor-led solution proposals, technical proofs of concept, deployment readiness and integration/validation dependencies. 

Our Commitment to a Culture of Inclusion & Belonging

Ecolab is committed to fair and equal treatment of associates and applicants and furthering the principles of Equal Opportunity to Employment. We will recruit, hire, promote, transfer and provide opportunities for advancement based on individual qualifications and job performance in all matters affecting employment, compensation, benefits, working conditions, and opportunities for advancement. Ecolab will not discriminate against any associate or applicant for employment because of race, religion, color, creed, national origin, citizenship status, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity and expressions, genetic information, marital status, age, or disability.

Description

Amazon is building India's Quick Commerce offering - Amazon Now - delivering everyday essentials to customers in minutes. We build world-class technology that powers store launches at scale, curates hyper-local selection, and drives seamless operations across our network. We are looking for a seasoned Software Development Engineer to serve as the senior technical leader for the team, owning the architecture and engineering direction across all of our charters - with a primary focus on the Selection experience: how we curate, manage, and scale the right assortment for every customer, in every city. This is a high-impact role where your technical decisions directly fuel Amazon Now's expansion across India. You will set the technical bar for the team, drive the hardest design problems end-to-end, and multiply the impact of every engineer around you. 

Key job responsibilities

- Own the technical strategy and architecture for Selection - curating city-specific assortments, managing per-store catalogs, and simplifying the experience of listing and onboarding new items at scale
 - Provide senior technical oversight across all of the team's charters - store launches, catalog and selection, inventory, picking, staging, and store operations - ensuring architectural coherence across them
 - Architect systems that onboard new stores rapidly across cities, and that scale reliably to hundreds of stores while maintaining low operational latencies
 - Lead the hardest design decisions end-to-end: evaluate trade-offs, simplify complexity, and set patterns the rest of the team builds on
 - Mentor and coach engineers, raise the technical bar, and drive adoption of engineering best practices across the team
 - Partner closely with product, operations, and business teams to translate ambiguous, complex business problems into durable technical solutions
 - Champion operational excellence (CI/CD, monitoring, on-call), lead design reviews, and own a high quality bar for all deliverables

A day in the life

You'll review operational metrics to ensure system health across live stores, unblock engineers on their toughest technical challenges, and dive deep into system designs - weighing trade-offs and cutting complexity. You'll lead design reviews across the team's charters, mentor engineers on architecture patterns, and shape deployment plans for features rolling out across multiple cities, ensuring rollback strategies, monitoring, and alarms are in place before launch. As a senior, you'll help set technical direction and priorities, with Selection as your primary canvas. 

About The Team

Amazon Now builds the technology behind India's Quick Commerce experience - from the moment a store goes live, to how selection is curated for each neighborhood, to how every order is picked and staged for delivery in minutes. We work at the intersection of technology and physical retail, solving hard problems in real-time inventory, catalog and selection management, store automation, and partner enablement. Our work reaches millions of customers who count on us for everyday essentials, fast. 

This role is the senior technical anchor of the team, setting architectural direction across every charter we own - with Selection as the primary focus. It's a rare scope: deep ownership of one of our most important problem spaces, combined with technical influence across the whole team. 

We embrace our differences and are committed to furthering our culture of inclusion. We have employee-led affinity groups reaching thousands of employees globally. We are dedicated to supporting new members through mentorship and knowledge sharing, and we strive to assign opportunities that help each team member develop into a well-rounded contributor. 

Basic Qualifications

- 5+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
 - 5+ years of programming with at least one software programming language experience
 - 5+ years of leading design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
 - Experience as a mentor, tech lead or leading an engineering team
 - Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

Preferred Qualifications

- 5+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. data.title: Senior Backend Engineer, NIRA
data.description:
Join the Tilt team

At Tilt, we see a side of people that traditional lenders miss. Our mobile-first products and machine learning-powered credit models look beyond credit scores, using over 250 real-time financial signals to recognize real potential. With millions of customers worldwide, we're not just changing how people access financial products - we're creating a new credit system that backs the working, whatever they're working toward. 

NIRA is building a consumer credit platform for Middle India, targeting ~200m underservied people. Active in 5000+ cities and processing 15, 000+ loan applications/day, NIRA is backed by and integrated with US-based Tilt. 

The opportunity - Senior Backend Engineer, NIRA

We're looking for a strong Senior Software Engineer to join NIRA's engineering team. You will have the opportunity to shape strategy for the infrastructure and product roadmap. This role will give you the ability to have a direct and outsized impact on technical projects, leading to enormous potential for career-growth. 

How You'll Make An Impact

- Work closely with the local NIRA Engineering team, and partner with the broader APAC Engineering team to increase the scale our platform can handle. 
 - Expand the platform to support multiple financial products and underlying instruments. 
 - Drive iterations on credit policy and improve credit decision systems. 
 - Collaborate with product, credit/finance, compliance, support and analytics teams. 

Why you're a great fit

- 7+ years of experience 
 - Strong experience using Java (ideally . net too). 
 - Demonstrated experience working in AWS-native environments, using tools like DynamoDB, Athena and Lambda. 
 - You have experience with scaled technical solutions - have worked on projects to increase the scaleability of a platform. 
 - Clear communicator, ability to clearly articulate technical solutions and collaborate with colleagues globally. 
 - Product Engineer mentality - own your solutions from start to finish. 

Don't meet every qualification? We care about potential over your past. If you're bringing ambition and drive to what we're building, we want to hear from you. 

What You'll Get At Tilt

- Virtual-first teamwork: The Tilt team is collaborating across 14 countries, 12 time zones, and counting. You'll get started with a WFH office reimbursement. 
 - Competitive pay: We're big on potential, and it's reflected in our competitive compensation packages and generous equity. 
 - Complete support: Find flexible health plans at every premium level, and substantial subsidies that stand up to global standards. 
 - Visibility is yours: You can count on direct exposure to our leadership team - we're a team where good ideas travel quickly. 
 - Paid global onsites: Magic happens IRL: we gather twice yearly to reconnect over shared meals or kayaking adventures. (We've visited Vail, San Diego, and Mexico City, to name a few. )
 - Impact is recognized: Growth opportunities follow your contributions, not rigid promotion timelines. 

The Tilt Way

We're looking for people who chase excellence and impact. Those who stand behind their work, celebrating the wins and learning from the missteps equally. We foster an environment where every voice is valued and mutual respect is non-negotiable - brilliant jerks need not apply. We're in this together, working to expand access to fair credit and prove that people are incredible. When you join us, it's not just another day at the [virtual] office, you're helping millions of hardworking people reach better financial futures. 

You're pushing ahead in your career? We can get behind that. Join us in building the credit system that people deserve.

Join us to put AI to work for people.

We're looking for a Staff Software Engineer to set technical direction for a team building AI-native products on the ServiceNow platform. You'll shape how we design, build, and operate systems where AI agents, LLM-driven workflows, and traditional platform engineering work together. This is a hands-on role with broad influence: you'll make architectural calls, raise the engineering bar, and help the team move from AI-assisted development to AI-native delivery.

Qualifications

- Experience in leveraging or critically thinking about how to integrate AI into work processes, decision-making, or problem-solving. This may include using AI-powered tools, automating workflows, analyzing AI-driven insights, or exploring AI's potential impact on the function or industry. 
 - 8+ years of software engineering experience, with a track record of technical leadership at the staff level or equivalent. 
 - Strong proficiency in Java, JavaScript, or another language relevant to the platform, plus solid system design skills. 
 - Hands-on experience building or integrating LLM-based features: prompt design, retrieval or context management, evaluation, and cost/latency tradeoffs. 
 - Working knowledge of agentic architectures, including tool use, orchestration, and human-in-the-loop controls.

TimeHub is chartered to build a world-class Time & Attendance platform that powers the full lifecycle of time tracking and pay computation for over 1. 8 million hourly associates across Amazon's global operations - spanning Fulfillment Centers, Delivery Stations, Customer Service and other business lines. Our systems sit on the critical path of Amazon operations: every shift worked, every time-off request, every accrual balance, and every paycheck generated flows through our platform. Getting it right matters - accuracy, reliability, and speed directly impact associate trust, pay correctness, and regulatory compliance across 65+ countries. 

Are you a seasoned engineering leader who thrives on building high-performing teams and solving complex, real-world problems at massive scale? In this role, you will own a multi-year technical strategy for your team's domain, drive engineering excellence, and partner closely with product management, Amazonian Experience technology, and operations stakeholders to deliver meaningful outcomes for Amazon's workforce worldwide. You will tackle challenges unique to this space - computing pay accurately across thousands of policy configurations, ensuring sub-second latency for real-time time capture, and scaling systems that process hundreds of millions of transactions weekly. 

Key job responsibilities

- Own the technical vision and architecture for Amazon time-off management and pay policy execution - designing scalable, fault-tolerant systems that compute accurately across thousands of policy configurations and regional regulations. 
 - Build and lead a high-performing team - recruit, coach, and retain top talent; mentor engineers across levels.

 - Define and prioritize the product roadmap - make crisp trade-offs between new capability development, tech debt reduction, and operational hardening in partnership with product, payroll, and compliance stakeholders. 
 - Drive cross-team alignment across TimeHub, Scheduling, DLS, WSTT, PXT, and Operations - removing blockers and ensuring seamless delivery across the time-to-pay pipeline. 

About The Team

We build low-latency, highly scalable policy computation and storage layers that power the full spectrum of Time-Off and Pay processing across multiple businesses and regions. We use cutting edge technologies from AWS and continuously challenge ourselves in building the right solution.

data.title: MES Opcenter Execution Core Architect Position
data.description:
MES Opcenter Execution Core Architect 8+ Yrs

Enterprise Performance

The Enterprise Performance Portfolio is a collection of Offerings that helps clients achieve the maximum possible impact and value from their investments in Finance, Supply Chain and IT operations. By taking a holistic view of these key business functions from strategy articulation through process design and technology enablement, we can help our clients navigate their challenges while operating components of their business. As our clients drive towards their digital future, Finance, Supply Chain, and IT play an increasingly important role in how these organizations interact with their customers, suppliers, and other key stakeholders. By combining our strategy, operations improvement, implementation, and operate capabilities, we can be more creative in how we deploy our resources and drive innovation at market pace. 

The Team - Supply Chain & Network Operations

The Enterprise Performance team brings rich industry experience, rigorous analytical capabilities and a pragmatic mindset to solve clients' most complex business problems. Our professionals are aligned to the Supply chain Network operations (SCNO) service line within Enterprise Performance. The SCNO service line helps companies build lasting competitive advantage at every level of their operations across product development, planning, sourcing, manufacturing, logistics and distribution. We specialize in connecting high-level strategies to measurable results on the front lines. 

Work you'll do

Responsibilities

As a Professional in our team you'll work side by side with innovative and strategic thought leaders and stay ahead of the rapidly evolving world of business. You'll get the training to be confident and prepared to help tackle some of our clients' most complex business issues. You'll work with diverse global clients across a wide range of industries. You should have exceptional communication and analytical skills with the ability to communicate findings to clients and team members and the ability to manage and lead teams independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced environment. Direct experience in MES Project Management, or MES Requirements Analysis or as a MES Solution Architect in discrete and process manufacturing is desirable. You will work with teams and responsibilities may include: 

- Provide functional and technical support for Siemens manufacturing execution systems (Opcenter, APS, AIP, Connect MOM, etc. ) deployed in various manufacturing domains. 
 - Architect enterprise, customer and operating model strategies and develop proposals and eminence around Siemens Opcenter solutions. 
 - Act as technical and solution architect for fast-paced supply chain projects leveraging the Siemens MOM suite. 
 - Lead individual project teams in identifying business requirements, functional design, prototyping, process design (including scenario design, flow mapping), testing, training, defining support procedures and supporting Siemens implementations. 
 - Conduct workshops for requirements validation, data model design and configuration validation, and lead customer design sessions to formulate and document Opcenter solutions. 
 - Interaction with Subject Matter Experts / plant users / various stake holders for AS-IS study of current landscape and define, design TO-BE plan for Opcenter MES. 
 - Provide Industry standard best practices and align Enterprise Architecture to the Siemens MES Roadmap defined for the clients. 
 - Work with Deloitte Team members/ Project Managers/Senior Managers on end-to-end high-level design discussions and long-term approach for sustaining the Opcenter solution. 
 - Design and development of Integration with systems like Plant control systems, ERP, PLM, APS, and LIMS. 
 - Be the SME for the development and deployment phases of the project, providing technical work-around options to fill the gaps in the application/functional requirements specific to Siemens tools. 
 - Help implement and maintain processes for Master data setup for products and processes within Opcenter. 
 - Work with teams to deliver system solutions for customers and participate in the entire sales cycle from proposals, support through deployment of the customers solution. 
 - Contribute to the growth and development of Deloitte's Siemens Manufacturing Execution System (MES) offering and provide market driven product requirements to internal teams. 
 - Assist project teams and business teams to verify the configurations/customizations during development, testing, and deployment phases to verify an end-to-end solution for our clients. 

Required Experience

- 10+ years of hands-on experience on Siemens products - Opcenter Execution Core or Camstar and MOM Connect. 
 - Strong hands-on experience in configuration and customization of Opcenter Execution Core functionalities - Experience on modelling, Designer & Portal studio
 - Experience of Mendix and Opcenter-Mendix integration
 - Hands-on experience of developing interfaces using CN MOM / MOM Connect
 - In-depth knowledge of ISA-95/S88 standards and their application in Opcenter MES design. 
 - Knowledge of GxP, GAMP, and 21 CFR Part 11 standards. 
 - Strong functional understanding of Level 3 and Level 4 systems, and familiarity with SAP-MES integration and Level 2 automation systems. 
 - Solid knowledge on BOM, Manufacturing Work Plans, MBOM and BOP is needed. 
 - Strong experience with Java and C# . NET, Oracle / SQL Database, and good working knowledge of Database like SQL Server & SQL Store Procedures. 
 - MES to ERP integration; Restful API and Webservices development experience. 
 - Familiar with Quality Management, Dispatch Management, Scheduling, WIP Tracking, Resource Tracking, Maintenance Management, etc. 
 - In touch with industry 4. 0 trends, with emerging digital supply networks and exponential technologies, with industry automation tools and where the market and technology are pointing. 
 - Strong oral and written communication skills, including presentation and documentation skills (Excel, Visio, PowerPoint, etc. ). 
 - Strong problem solving, troubleshooting, and debugging skills with the ability to exercise mature judgment. 
 - Able to work independently and efficiently to meet deadlines, and multi-task multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment. 
 - Willingness to work in shifts to support different regions. 

Preferred

- Experience in Siemens MES Global Manufacturing Suites, specifically Opcenter, APS, AIP, and Connect MOM. 
 - Exposure to Siemens products like DIS, Insights Hub, Opcenter Intelligence, APS is an advantage. 
 - Exposure to customization using Mendix is an advantage. 
 - Knowledge of MES Design, Development, Testing and Implementation processes. 
 - Experience in interface development. 

Qualifications Required

- Undergraduate degree/Professional Degree, with First Class/Distinction in B Tech or B E
 - MCA/M Tech/MSc

How You'll Grow

At Deloitte, we've invested a great deal to create a rich environment in which our professionals can grow. We want all our people to develop in their own way, playing to their own strengths as they hone their leadership skills. data.description:
Bring more to life. 

Are you ready to accelerate your potential and make a real difference within life sciences, diagnostics and biotechnology?

At Pall Corporation, one of Danaher's 15+ operating companies, our work saves lives-and we're all united by a shared commitment to innovate for tangible impact.

As a global leader in high-tech filtration, separation, and purification, Pall Corporation thrives on helping our customers solve their toughest challenges. Our products serve diverse, global customer needs across a wide range of applications to advance health, safety and environmentally responsible technologies. From airplane engines to hydraulic systems, scotch to smartphones, OLED screens to paper-everyday Pall is there, helping protect critical operating assets, improve product quality, minimize emissions and waste, and safeguard health. For the exponentially curious, Pall is a place where you can thrive and amplify your impact on the world. Find what drives you on a team with a more than 75-year history of discovery, determination, and innovation. 

Learn about the Danaher Business System which makes everything possible. 

The SAP BTP Integration Architect owns the architecture, engineering standards, and technical governance for integrations across Pall's global SAP and non-SAP landscape. The role leads secure, scalable integration design on SAP Business Technology Platform, with particular focus on SAP S/4HANA, SAP Document and Reporting Compliance, business applications, external partners, and government e-invoicing platforms. 

This position reports to the IT Director, Enterprise Applications and is part of the global Information Technology team. The role is based in India, and will operate in a onsite work model, subject to local site requirements. 

In this role you will have the opportunity to

- Define and maintain the enterprise integration strategy and architecture, including standards, principles, reusable patterns, and governance using SAP Integration Suite and SAP best practices. 
 - Lead end-to-end integration architecture and solution design across SAP Integration Suite capabilities, selecting the appropriate API, event-driven, synchronous, asynchronous, batch, file, and B2B/EDI approaches based on business needs. 
 - Architect secure integrations across the SAP and enterprise technology landscape, including SAP S/4HANA, DRC, Ariba, BTP solutions, third-party applications, suppliers, customers, and government platforms. 
 - Establish integration, API, event, and security governance, including identity and access, authentication, authorization, encryption, versioning, lifecycle management, reuse, privacy, and segregation of duties. 
 - Enable AI-assisted and emerging technology solutions, including Joule and Joule Studio, by providing secure APIs, events, business context, appropriate controls, observability, and human oversight. 
 - Ensure integration reliability, compliance, and modernization, including monitoring, error handling, performance, service levels, clean-core alignment, regulatory requirements, global e-invoicing, and migration of legacy interfaces such as SAP PI/PO. 
 - Provide technical leadership and oversight, including architecture reviews, design documentation, technical risk assessments, partner deliverables, developer/consultant mentoring, complex issue resolution, root-cause analysis, and continuous improvement. 

The Essential Requirements Of The Job Include

- Bachelor's degree in computer science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience. 
 - 10+ years of SAP architecture experience, including at least 5 years delivering solutions on SAP BTP, with hands-on experience with Joule. 
 - Demonstrated leadership of complex SAP transformation programs, including at least three end-to-end SAP BTP integration implementations or comparable enterprise initiatives. 
 - Deep expertise in SAP Integration Suite and BTP architecture, including Cloud Integration, API Management, event-driven integration, hybrid connectivity, identity services, environments and runtimes, monitoring, CI/CD, and secure operations. 
 - Strong SAP and enterprise integration expertise, including integration of SAP S/4HANA with SAP and non-SAP platforms using REST, SOAP, OData, IDoc, RFC, SFTP, messaging technologies, XML, JSON, XSLT, and Groovy. 
 - Experience designing secure, reliable, and AI-enabled enterprise integrations, including Joule/AI agents, API and tool access, authorization, auditability, OAuth 2. 0, SAML, certificates, mutual TLS, exception handling, performance, availability, and responsible AI controls. 
 - Strong technical leadership and communication skills, with the ability to translate business, technical, security, and compliance requirements into architecture decisions and lead internal teams and external partners through design, build, testing, deployment, hyper care, and operational transition. 

Travel

- Up to 20 percent travel, including international travel, based on project and deployment needs. 

It would be a plus if you also possess previous experience in

- SAP Integration Advisor, Trading Partner Management, Advanced Event Mesh, SAP Cloud ALM, or comparable observability and service-management tooling. 
 - Current SAP certification in Integration Suite, BTP solution architecture, or a closely related discipline. 

Note: No amount of pay is considered to be wages or compensation until such amount is earned, vested, and determinable. The amount and availability of any bonus, commission, benefits, or any other form of compensation and benefits that are allocable to a particular employee remains in the Company's sole discretion unless and until paid and may be modified at the Company's sole discretion, consistent with the law. 

Join our winning team today. Together, we'll accelerate the real-life impact of tomorrow's science and technology. We partner with customers across the globe to help them solve their most complex challenges, architecting solutions that bring the power of science to life. 

For more information, visit www. danaher. com.

data.title: Senior Software Engineer in AI - FrontEnd React/Redux, Java
data.description:
Join us in bringing joy to customer experience. Five9 is a leading provider of cloud contact center software, bringing the power of cloud innovation to customers worldwide. 

Living our values everyday results in our team-first culture and enables us to innovate, grow, and thrive while enjoying the journey together. We celebrate diversity and foster an inclusive environment, empowering our employees to be their authentic selves. 

Senior Software Engineer in AI - Front End React/Redux, Java

Five9 is a leading provider of cloud software for the enterprise contact center market, bringing the power of the cloud to thousands of customers and facilitating more than three billion customer interactions annually. Five9 has led the cloud revolution in contact centers, helping organizations transition from legacy premise-based solutions to the cloud. The cloud contact center market has become the hot space for innovation in real-time communications, and is the tip of the spear for the application of Artificial Intelligence. Five9 has led the charge with its Genius AI platform. Five9 offers a high-energy environment with lots of room for personal and professional growth. Our innovative AI team is seeking a talented and experienced Senior Full Stack Software Engineer to join our Voice of Customer (VOC) team. AI experience is required for this role - you will work hands-on with AI technologies from vendors like Azure, OpenAI, Google, Databricks, IBM, and Amazon, and continue to build on some of the hottest skills on the market. An ideal candidate for us is an experienced engineer who is passionate about building high performance web platforms and applications, a brilliant problem solver and a creative self-starter. 

Voice of Customer (VOC) is Five9's AI-powered customer insights product. Every day, contact centers handle enormous volumes of voice and chat conversations that hold the clearest signal about what customers actually want - and almost none of it gets read. VOC applies AI to those conversations at scale to surface why customers are reaching out, how those reasons cluster and shift over time, and where the business should act. The result is a set of insights and analytics that CX and operations leaders use to make decisions, with the ability to trace any insight back to the conversations behind it. 

Key Responsibilities: 

- Implement UX designs by working with UX Designers on a day-to-day basis, using React/Redux based framework
 - Build the customer-facing insights experience for VOC - interactive dashboards, charts, and drill-down views over AI-generated insights
 - Be part of an agile team to develop a scalable, highly available application platform using modern PaaS platforms such as GCP
 - Participate and contribute to requirements analysis and grooming
 - Understand how to leverage PaaS components, such as CDN, noSQL databases when developing software in order to achieve scalability, reliability, and operability
 - Ability to build custom widgets for dashboards developed using Google Looker Studio plugins is a plus, but not required
 - Document and communicate clearly architecture and implementation solutions
 - Have ownership of your code in production, including on-call, troubleshooting

Key Skills: 

- 5+ years software development experience (mandatory)
 - React/Redux focus
 - Highly proficient in JavaScript and Java
 - Hands-on experience building AI-powered product interfaces - presenting model output to users and supporting human review and correction of it
 - Experience building data-heavy or analytics interfaces - charts, dashboards, filtering, and large result sets
 - Experience with PaaS hosted relational and no-SQL databases
 - Desirable, but not required, experience with custom widget development using Google Looker Studio
 - Experience in operational code ownership - on-call, troubleshooting, uptime
 - Experience in applying modern UI design patterns and separating concerns in a distributed system
 - Familiarity with vibe coding using different AI tools like Claude Code
 - Must have experience working within an Agile/Scrum team
 - Positive, self-motivated and enthusiastic attitude with a strong sense of ownership
 - Strong pro-active communication skills, both verbal and written
 - AI skills in speech recognition and natural language processing are a plus but not required
 - Experience in contact center software is a plus but not required

This role is hybrid and requires 3 days a week in office. 

Five9 embraces diversity and is committed to building a team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills. The more inclusive we are, the better we are. Five9 is an equal opportunity employer. 

Five9 is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities throughout the application and interview process. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please contact us at accommodations@five9. com to request an accommodation. Requests will be handled confidentially and in accordance with applicable law. 

View our privacy policy, including our privacy notice to California residents here: https: //www. five9. com/pt-pt/legal. 

Note: Five9 will never request that an applicant send money as a prerequisite for commencing employment with Five9.

data.title: Senior Engineer (frontend)
data.description:
About the Role

As a Senior Frontend Engineer at Sage, you will contribute and lead in the design, development, and delivery of features for a high-quality SaaS solution that exceeds customer and business partner expectations. You will work closely with product managers and designers and proactively share your own knowledge of frontend technologies and practices with the wider team. We are looking for someone with 7+ years of professional experience in frontend engineering. Proficiency in English, written and verbal, is required. 

We value humility and collaboration. We are looking for people who can work as part of a team, not in silos. We expect engineers to take ownership beyond just writing code, including tests, documentation, and long-term code quality. 

Location: Bangalore, India. This is a hybrid role, three days per week in the office. 

Required Skills

- 7+ years of professional experience in software development for scalable, web-based applications. 
 - Proficiency in English, written and verbal, is required. Core languages & frameworks

- Strong TypeScript (strict) and modern JavaScript (ES Modules, async). 
 - Deep React experience (hooks, composition, performance); React 19 / React Compiler a plus. 
 - Solid HTML5, CSS3, and responsive/accessible UI fundamentals. Build & tooling

- Modern build tooling Vite (or Webpack/Rollup); code splitting and bundle optimization. 
 - Git and pull-request workflows; monorepo experience (Nx) a plus. 
 - Linters/formatters (Biome, ESLint/Prettier) and CI discipline. State & data

- State management with Redux Toolkit, XState (state machines), and/or TanStack Query. 
 - RxJS / reactive streams. 
 - Consuming REST APIs; JWT/OAuth2 bearer auth on the client; robust error handling. Styling & design systems

- Tailwind CSS, MUI (Material UI), styled-components/Emotion. 
 - Working with a design-token system for brand consistency. Data grids & performance

- Complex data grids (ag-Grid Enterprise preferred, or TanStack Table/Handsontable): virtualization, server-side row model, custom renderers/editors. 
 - Frontend performance profiling and optimization (rendering, memoization, main-thread work). 
 - Web Workers for off-main-thread compute. Accessibility & i18n

- WCAG 2. 1/2. 2 AA accessibility practices; ARIA, keyboard, focus management. 
 - Internationalization (i18next or similar), including locale-aware date/number formatting. Testing & quality

- Unit/component testing (Vitest/Jest + Testing Library), API mocking (MSW), and Playwright E2E. 
 - Secure client-side coding against the OWASP Top 10 (XSS, token handling, safe storage). AI Tooling

- Productive use of AI-assisted developer tooling (e. g. GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Cursor) to accelerate day-to-day frontend development. 
 - Building AI-assisted / generative-AI UX: in-app copilots, natural-language querying, or smart suggestions surfaced to the user. 
 - Integrating LLM APIs on the client (e. g. OpenAI, Anthropic, AWS Bedrock) with streaming/token-by-token rendering, cancellation, and graceful error/loading states. Soft skills

- Strong problem-solving abilities and an eagerness to learn. 
 - Excellent communication skills and the ability to work well in a team. 
 - High attention to detail and a commitment to delivering high-quality work. 

Nice to Have

- Web Crypto / AES-GCM application-level encryption and client-side key management. 
 - Lexical (or ProseMirror/Slate) rich-text/formula editors; grammar parsing (ohm-js). 
 - Dependency-graph / DAG modeling (graphlib/graphology). 
 - CRDT / operational-transform real-time collaboration. 
 - Storybook and visual regression testing. 
 - New Relic browser RUM, Pendo, and web-vitals (INP/FPS) instrumentation. 
 - Experience meeting enforced performance budgets and SLOs in CI. 
 - Domain knowledge in finance, ERP, FP&A, budgeting, or spreadsheet-like applications. 
 - Designing accessible, trustworthy AI interaction patterns, such as citations, confidence indicators, and human-in-the-loop review for sensitive outputs. 

Key Responsibilities

- Collaborate with cross-functional teams to design, develop, and maintain new features for our SaaS platform, applying a broad knowledge of frontend principles and practices to difficult assignments. 
 - Write clean, maintainable, and well-documented code, and act as a source of technical guidance in code reviews and best-practice discussions. 
 - Mentor and coach junior members of the development team. 
 - Debug and resolve issues reported by users or identified in the production environment. 
 - Improve the performance, scalability, and security of the platform. 
 - Implement and maintain automated tests to ensure software reliability. 
 - Work closely with the design team to ensure the platform is user-friendly and follows UI/UX best practices. 
 - Partner effectively with product, design, and engineering peers to deliver assigned work. 
 - Stay up-to-date with the latest trends in web development and cloud-based SaaS technologies.
