data.title: Data Engineering Operations Lead
data.description:
Team Overview

We are looking for a Data Engineering Operations Lead to join our growing Data Engineering and Analytics Practice who will drive building next generation suite of products and platforms by designing, coding, building, and deploying highly scalable and robust data solutions. The team reports to the Head of Data Engineering & Analytics and is part of the wider Global Technology function. 

Role Overview and Core Responsibilities

The role exists to own and manage the internal function responsible for development, support and operation of our ingestion pipelines as well as the assets created and owned by the team across our cloud (GCP) and on-premises environments. As Data Engineering Operations lead, you will be responsible to ensure the quality and robustness of the developed pipelines, operational resilience, SLA compliance for all of our main data assets created by our team. As a lead engineer most of your time will be spent on hands-on engineering work with expected ~25% spent on operational activities. 

Responsibilities include: 

- Own and manage daily Data Engineering operations, including data ingestion workflows, pipeline monitoring, and incident resolution. 
 - Oversee end-to-end pipeline health - proactively monitor, triage, and resolve failures, bottlenecks, and data quality issues across all ingestion layers. 
 - Organize and prioritize the engineering operations function's daily workload - assign tasks, track progress, and remove blockers to ensure smooth operational delivery. 
 - Maintain and improve ingestion pipelines from various data sources into data lakes, warehouses, and real-time streaming systems. 
 - Act as the first point of escalation for pipeline failures, SLA breaches, and data anomalies - driving root cause analysis and permanent fixes. 
 - Define and enforce operational standards - runbooks, alerting thresholds, on-call procedures, and incident management practices. 
 - Coordinate with upstream data providers and downstream consumers to manage dependencies and communicate pipeline status. 
 - Lead daily stand-ups and work organization for the function under the wider Data Engineering practice. 
 - Mentor and guide junior engineers on operational best practices, debugging, and pipeline development. 
 - Collaborate with data scientists, analysts, and product partners to onboard new data sources and meet ingestion SLAs. 
 - Drive continuous improvement in pipeline reliability, observability, and efficiency. 
 - Implement best practices in data governance, data quality monitoring, and compliance across all pipelines. 
 - Design, build, test, and deploy Data solutions at scale, including data lakes, data warehouses, and real-time analytics. 
 - Lead technical delivery on use cases, plan and delegate tasks to junior team members, and oversee work from inception to final product. 

Required Knowledge and Experiences

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Statistics or a related field
 - 10 years of data engineering experience with at least 3 years in lead roles. 
 - 6+ years of experience in Big Data technologies (e. g. , Spark, Hive, Hadoop, Databricks). 
 - Excellent knowledge of data engineering concepts and best practices. 
 - Proven experience leading, mentoring and supporting junior team members. 
 - Ability to lead technical deliverables autonomously and guide junior data engineers. 
 - Ability to organize and manage daily engineering workload - task assignment, prioritization, and delivery tracking. 
 - Strong attention to detail and adherence to best practices and defined policies. 

Essential Technical Skills: 

- Advanced proficiency with Apache Spark (PySpark) including tuning and performance optimisation experience. 
 - Proficiency in Python, Pandas (Scala/Java knowledge is desirable). 
 - Working knowledge of Apache Hive. 
 - Strong SQL knowledge and experience (T-SQL, working with SQL Server, SSMS, GCP BigQuery). 
 - Expertise in designing and implementing scalable data pipelines and ETL processes using the GCP data stack, including BigQuery, Dataflow, Pub/Sub, Cloud Storage, Cloud Composer, Cloud Functions, Dataproc (Spark). 
 - Experience with batch, real-time streaming, and ETL processes, including incident resolution and pipeline recovery. 
 - Experience building and managing ETL workflows using Apache Airflow, including DAG creation, scheduling, and error handling. 
 - Source control with Git. 
 - Knowledge of CI/CD concepts and experience designing CI/CD for data pipelines. 
 - Knowledge of Delta Lake concepts and common data formats, Lakehouse architecture. 
 - Software engineering principles including OOP, design patterns, SDLC, Agile, TDD, and performance optimization. 

Desirable Technical Skills: 

- Experience designing logical data models and physical data models, including data warehouse and data mart designs. 
 - Relevant certifications (e. g. Google Cloud Professional Data Engineer). 
 - Experience with streaming services such as Kafka is a plus. 
 - R & Sparklyr experience is a plus. 
 - Knowledge of MLOps concepts, AI/ML lifecycle management, and MLflow. 
 - Harness experience is a plus. 

We're also looking for the preferred skills below. Whether you are proficient or could use

some brushing up, we're happy to support your career development and growth in: 

- AI engineering fundamentals.

Azure AI Knowledge is looking for a passionate Software Engineer to join the Azure AI Search backend team. In this role, you will build large-scale, developer-facing cloud services and solve complex engineering problems across search engines, distributed systems, information retrieval, reliability, and performance. You will work in an agile, customer-obsessed environment and contribute to the core systems that index, store, and serve data for demanding search and AI workloads. 

Azure AI Search is a global managed search solution. As the hosted search engine on Azure, we make it quick and easy for developers to integrate a robust set of search capabilities into their applications; Think e-commerce sites, data catalogs, large enterprise applications. 

Over the last few years, the service has gone through tremendous growth, expanding into new market segments, and enabling new customer scenarios. Currently, we are sitting right in center of the AI wave enabling knowledge retrieval scenarios driving future growth, we're working to support a broader range of customer workloads in terms of data and query volume, usage patterns, and hosting modes. Independently, we're investing heavily to improve key drivers of customer satisfaction including search relevance and developer experience. 

This is a great opportunity for anyone looking to take the next step in their career and be at the forefront of what Microsoft cares about most: Data, Cloud and AI. 

As a team we're proud of what we build and how we build it. We run lean, obsess about customers and use an evidence-based approach to decision making. Every single week we talk to customers to make sure we build what they want. We leverage open-source technologies, develop in C#, Java and C++, our codebase builds in minutes, and we ship new bits regularly. We hire self-driven engineers ready to take on new challenges, develop ownership, and learn quickly. We reduce the process to a minimum. As an engineer on the team, you'll spend most of your time writing code, contributing improvements in different dimensions of the service value proposition: core search, manageability, scale, availability, performance, developer experience. 

Responsibilities

Responsibilities: 

- Design, implement, test, and deliver backend capabilities that enable new search and AI retrieval workloads in Azure, taking ownership from technical design through production deployment and operation.

 - Experience coordinating resources across diverse teams to restore service and maintain SLA's

data.title: Engineering Manager, Payment Services
data.description:
About Tide

At Tide, we help SMEs save time and money in the running of their businesses by not only offering business accounts and related banking services, but also a comprehensive set of highly usable and connected administrative solutions, from invoicing to accounting. 

Tide is transforming the small business banking market and now supports over 2 million members globally across the UK, India, Germany and France. 

Using advanced technology, all solutions are designed with SMEs in mind. With quick onboarding, low fees and innovative features, we thrive on making data driven decisions to serve our mission: to help SMEs save time and money so they can get back to doing what they love. 

Tide Facts

- Tide is available for UK, Indian, German and French SMEs
 - Over 2 million members globally and rapidly growing
 - Over $300 million raised in funding
 - 3, 000 Tideans globally
 - Recognised with Great Place to Work certification three years in a row, and among India's Top 50 Best Workplaces in Banking, Financial Services, and Insurance in 2026
 - We have offices in Central London, with a member support and technology centre in Sofia, Bulgaria, technology centres in Serbia, Romania, Lithuania and Hyderabad and offices in Gurugram, New Delhi, Berlin, Paris and Luxembourg

About The Team

The Accounts team is the platform layer behind how members open, manage, and understand their accounts at Tide. It owns account opening, regulatory compliance, account management, account switching (CASS), and the full transaction experience: the timeline at the centre of the app, transaction details and counterparty information, transaction history, statements, and exports. Every member who opens the app and looks at their balance or recent activity relies on this team. Tide is a global product used across regions, so the team works with different banking partners, regulatory regimes, and account structures, and it sits on top of Tide's core ledger. 

About The Role

As an Engineering Manager at Tide, you will lead the Accounts team. You will set its technical direction, own its delivery and reliability, and grow its engineers across backend, mobile, and web. 

This is a product-facing platform team. A large share of the work shows up directly in the app, so you will work closely with product and design. It is also a financial system: a transaction that renders wrongly, a statement that does not reconcile, or an export that misses a record is a correctness problem, not a cosmetic one. 

What You'll Be Doing

- Leading the Accounts team across backend, Flutter mobile, and Angular web, setting its technical direction and holding it to delivery. 
 - Defining and maintaining the interface with the ledger: what the ledger guarantees, how Accounts services consume it, and who owns which data and schemas. 
 - Owning account opening, account management, and account switching (CASS), including the regulatory compliance that comes with them. 
 - Owning the member-facing transaction experience end to end: the timeline, transaction details, counterparty information, transaction history, statements, and exports. 
 - Setting technical direction for services that are read-heavy, data-rich, and tightly coupled to the app: performance, pagination and search at scale, data consistency with the ledger, and long-term architecture. 
 - Owning system stability and operational reliability for your services: SLOs, observability, on-call practice. 
 - Partnering with product, design, compliance, and operations to make sure what we ship is accurate, supportable, and compliant across all markets. 
 - Growing engineers at every level, across backend, mobile, and web. The team spans early-career through senior. 
 - Partnering with other teams at Tide that build on the Accounts platform, such as investment accounts and savings accounts, so the platform meets their needs. 
 - Aligning with other EMs across Banking on shared platform and infrastructure decisions. 

What We Are Looking For

Experience and background

- Meaningful engineering management experience. You have led teams through real delivery, not just been a strong tech lead. What matters is the quality of that experience, not the number of years
 - Experience leading product-driven teams. You have worked closely with product and design and been accountable for customer outcomes, not just output
 - A solid backend engineering foundation before moving into management, enough to earn credibility with the team and get into the detail when it matters
 - Experience leading distributed, remote-first teams across time zones
 - Proven experience aligning with senior leadership on deliveries and managing dependencies with neighbouring teams
 - Strong grasp of distributed systems: data consistency across services, reliability patterns, SLOs and SLAs, observability tooling

Technical depth

- Technically fluent: you can read the code, follow the architecture, and engage meaningfully with design decisions and production problems. You do not need to be shipping features regularly, but you need to understand what your team is building and why. 
 - Backend engineering in a strongly-typed language. Our stack is Java/Spring Boot, but Java experience is not a requirement. We want someone who can learn and work in our stack with confidence. 
 - Experience with microservices in a cloud-native environment (we are AWS heavy). 
 - Designing and operating APIs and data services that feed mobile and web clients: latency, pagination, caching, and backwards compatibility with released app versions. 
 - Relational database engineering, including data modelling and query performance for read-heavy workloads over large transaction histories. 
 - Event-driven and async systems experience. 
 - Familiarity with mobile and web delivery (Flutter and Angular, or similar), enough to make good trade-offs with client engineers. 
 - Exposure to agentic or AI-integrated systems, and engineering practises. 

How You Work

- You set technical direction and hold others to it. You are the person the team turns to when something is hard. 
 - You care about the member experience and about correctness in equal measure, and you do not let one erode the other. 
 - You are a good neighbour to other teams. You make interfaces explicit, agree expectations early, and treat partner teams across Banking as close collaborators. 
 - You communicate clearly with non-technical stakeholders (product, design, compliance, operations) without losing precision. 
 - You develop engineers at every level, with a plan for each person. 

Our Tech Stack

- Java, Spring Boot and JOOQ to build the RESTful APIs of our microservices (but we welcome people who are used to any strongly typed general purpose programming language!) 
 - Event-driven architecture with messages over SNS+SQS and Kafka to make them reliable 
 - Primary datastores are PostgreSQL via RDS or Aurora (we are heavy AWS users) 
 - Docker, Terraform, ArgoCD and, EKS provided by the Cloud team to run the platform 
 - DataDog for monitoring, observability and automated SLOs
 - GitHub, Semgrep and solid testing to power the CI/CD pipelines - new joiners are encouraged to have something deployed to production in their first week
 - Angular on Web, Flutter for our mobile app, but from time to time we use Swift and Kotlin
 - Fivetran/BigQuery/Looker for the BI insights and Python/FastAPI/Faust + some ML libs for the automated decisioning and risk management

What You'll Get In Return

- Competitive Compensation - competitive salary and share options
 - Time Off - Generous annual leave on top of bank holidays. 
 - Parental Leave - Paid maternity, paternity, and adoption leave to support your family journey. 
 - Sabbatical - Extended unpaid and paid leave options after completing milestone years with Tide. 
 - Health Insurance - Private family insurance with additional OPD coverage and top-up options. 
 - Life & Accident Cover - Comprehensive accidental and life insurance protection. 
 - Mental Wellbeing - Access to therapy sessions, courses, meditations, and workshops. 
 - Volunteering & Development Days - Paid days annually for volunteering or personal growth. 
 - Learning & Development - Annual budget for books, courses, coaching, and more. 
 - WOO (Work Outside the Office) - Work from abroad for up to 90 days annually. 
 - Home Office Setup - Contribution towards setting up your home office
 - Laptop Ownership - Keep your old laptop and get a new one when it's time for a replacement. 
 - Snacks & Meals - Office perks with snacks, coffee, tea, and lunch (location dependent). 

Tidean Ways of Working

At Tide, we're Member First and Data Driven, but above all, we're One Team. Our Working Out of Office (WOO) policy allows you to work from anywhere in the world for up to 90 days a year. We are remote first, but when you do want to meet new people, collaborate with your team or simply hang out with your colleagues, our offices are always available and equipped to the highest standard. We offer flexible working hours and trust our employees to do their work well, at times that suit them and their team. 

TIDE IS A PLACE FOR EVERYONE

At Tide, we believe that we can only succeed if we let our differences enrich our culture. Our Tideans come from a variety of backgrounds and experience levels. We consider everyone irrespective of their ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, veteran, neurodiversity or differently-abled status. We celebrate diversity in our workforce as a cornerstone of our success. Our commitment to a broad spectrum of ideas and backgrounds is what enables us to build products that resonate with our members' diverse needs and lives. 

We are One Team and foster a transparent and inclusive environment, where everyone's voice is heard. 

At Tide, we thrive on diversity, embracing various backgrounds and experiences. We welcome all individuals regardless of ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, or disability. Our inclusive culture is key to our success, helping us build products that meet our members' diverse needs. We are One Team, committed to transparency and ensuring everyone's voice is heard. 

Disclaimer

It Has Come To Our Attention That Individuals Or Agencies Are Falsely Claiming To Represent Tide And Are Reaching Out To Candidates Regarding Job Opportunities. Please Be Aware That

- Tide does not charge any fees at any stage of the recruitment process. 
 - All official Tide job opportunities are listed exclusively on our Careers Page and applications should be submitted through this channel. 
 - Communication from Tide will only come from an official @tide. co email address. 
 - Tide does not work with agencies or recruiters without prior formal engagement, and we do not authorize third parties to make job offers on our behalf. 

If you are contacted by anyone misrepresenting Tide or requesting payment, please treat it as fraudulent and report it to us immediately at talent@tide. co

Your safety and trust are important to us, and we are committed to ensuring a fair and transparent recruitment process. 

Tide leverages AI to enhance our hiring experience. You can read more about how we use AI in our recruitment process in our AI Policy. 

Your personal data will be processed by Tide for recruitment purposes and in accordance with Tide's Recruitment Privacy Notice.

Tide is a global product used across regions, so the team works with different banking partners, regulatory regimes, and account structures, and it sits on top of Tide's core ledger. 

About The Role

As an Engineering Manager at Tide, you will lead the Accounts team. You will set its technical direction, own its delivery and reliability, and grow its engineers across backend, mobile, and web. 

This is a product-facing platform team. A large share of the work shows up directly in the app, so you will work closely with product and design. It is also a financial system: a transaction that renders wrongly, a statement that does not reconcile, or an export that misses a record is a correctness problem, not a cosmetic one. 

What You'll Be Doing

- Leading the Accounts team across backend, Flutter mobile, and Angular web, setting its technical direction and holding it to delivery. 
 - Defining and maintaining the interface with the ledger: what the ledger guarantees, how Accounts services consume it, and who owns which data and schemas. 
 - Owning account opening, account management, and account switching (CASS), including the regulatory compliance that comes with them. 
 - Owning the member-facing transaction experience end to end: the timeline, transaction details, counterparty information, transaction history, statements, and exports. 
 - Setting technical direction for services that are read-heavy, data-rich, and tightly coupled to the app: performance, pagination and search at scale, data consistency with the ledger, and long-term architecture. 
 - Owning system stability and operational reliability for your services: SLOs, observability, on-call practice. 
 - Partnering with product, design, compliance, and operations to make sure what we ship is accurate, supportable, and compliant across all markets. 
 - Growing engineers at every level, across backend, mobile, and web. The team spans early-career through senior. 
 - Partnering with other teams at Tide that build on the Accounts platform, such as investment accounts and savings accounts, so the platform meets their needs. 
 - Aligning with other EMs across Banking on shared platform and infrastructure decisions. 

What We Are Looking For

Experience and background

- Meaningful engineering management experience. You have led teams through real delivery, not just been a strong tech lead. What matters is the quality of that experience, not the number of years
 - Experience leading product-driven teams. You have worked closely with product and design and been accountable for customer outcomes, not just output
 - A solid backend engineering foundation before moving into management, enough to earn credibility with the team and get into the detail when it matters
 - Experience leading distributed, remote-first teams across time zones
 - Proven experience aligning with senior leadership on deliveries and managing dependencies with neighboring teams
 - Strong grasp of distributed systems: data consistency across services, reliability patterns, SLOs and SLAs, observability tooling

Technical depth

- Technically fluent: you can read the code, follow the architecture, and engage meaningfully with design decisions and production problems. You do not need to be shipping features regularly, but you need to understand what your team is building and why. 
 - Backend engineering in a strongly-typed language. Our stack is Java/Spring Boot, but Java experience is not a requirement. We want someone who can learn and work in our stack with confidence. 
 - Experience with microservices in a cloud-native environment (we are AWS heavy). 
 - Designing and operating APIs and data services that feed mobile and web clients: latency, pagination, caching, and backwards compatibility with released app versions. 
 - Relational database engineering, including data modelling and query performance for read-heavy workloads over large transaction histories. 
 - Event-driven and async systems experience. 
 - Familiarity with mobile and web delivery (Flutter and Angular, or similar), enough to make good trade-offs with client engineers. 
 - Exposure to agentic or AI-integrated systems, and engineering practices. 

How You Work

- You set technical direction and hold others to it. You are the person the team turns to when something is hard. 
 - You care about the member experience and about correctness in equal measure, and you do not let one erode the other. 
 - You are a good neighbor to other teams. You make interfaces explicit, agree expectations early, and treat partner teams across Banking as close collaborators. 
 - You communicate clearly with non-technical stakeholders (product, design, compliance, operations) without losing precision. 
 - You develop engineers at every level, with a plan for each person. 

Our Tech Stack

- Java, Spring Boot and JOOQ to build the RESTful APIs of our microservices (but we welcome people who are used to any strongly typed general purpose programming language!) 
 - Event-driven architecture with messages over SNS+SQS and Kafka to make them reliable 
 - Primary datastores are PostgreSQL via RDS or Aurora (we are heavy AWS users) 
 - Docker, Terraform, ArgoCD and, EKS provided by the Cloud team to run the platform 
 - DataDog for monitoring, observability and automated SLOs
 - GitHub, Semgrep and solid testing to power the CI/CD pipelines - new joiners are encouraged to have something deployed to production in their first week
 - Angular on Web, Flutter for our mobile app, but from time to time we use Swift and Kotlin
 - Fivetran/BigQuery/Looker for the BI insights and Python/FastAPI/Faust + some ML libs for the automated decisioning and risk management

What You'll Get In Return

- Competitive Compensation - competitive salary and share options
 - Time Off - Generous annual leave on top of bank holidays. 
 - Parental Leave - Paid maternity, paternity, and adoption leave to support your family journey. 
 - Sabbatical - Extended unpaid and paid leave options after completing milestone years with Tide. 
 - Health Insurance - Private family insurance with additional OPD coverage and top-up options. 
 - Life & Accident Cover - Comprehensive accidental and life insurance protection. 
 - Mental Wellbeing - Access to therapy sessions, courses, meditations, and workshops. 
 - Volunteering & Development Days - Paid days annually for volunteering or personal growth. 
 - Learning & Development - Annual budget for books, courses, coaching, and more. 
 - WOO (Work Outside the Office) - Work from abroad for up to 90 days annually. 
 - Home Office Setup - Contribution towards setting up your home office
 - Laptop Ownership - Keep your old laptop and get a new one when it's time for a replacement. 
 - Snacks & Meals - Office perks with snacks, coffee, tea, and lunch (location dependent). 

Tidean Ways of Working

At Tide, we're Member First and Data Driven, but above all, we're One Team. Our Working Out of Office (WOO) policy allows you to work from anywhere in the world for up to 90 days a year. We are remote first, but when you do want to meet new people, collaborate with your team or simply hang out with your colleagues, our offices are always available and equipped to the highest standard. We offer flexible working hours and trust our employees to do their work well, at times that suit them and their team. 

TIDE IS A PLACE FOR EVERYONE

At Tide, we believe that we can only succeed if we let our differences enrich our culture. Our Tideans come from a variety of backgrounds and experience levels. We consider everyone irrespective of their ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, veteran, neurodiversity or differently-abled status. We celebrate diversity in our workforce as a cornerstone of our success. Our commitment to a broad spectrum of ideas and backgrounds is what enables us to build products that resonate with our members' diverse needs and lives. 

We are One Team and foster a transparent and inclusive environment, where everyone's voice is heard. 

At Tide, we thrive on diversity, embracing various backgrounds and experiences. We welcome all individuals regardless of ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, or disability. Our inclusive culture is key to our success, helping us build products that meet our members' diverse needs. We are One Team, committed to transparency and ensuring everyone's voice is heard. 

Disclaimer

It Has Come To Our Attention That Individuals Or Agencies Are Falsely Claiming To Represent Tide And Are Reaching Out To Candidates Regarding Job Opportunities. Please Be Aware That

- Tide does not charge any fees at any stage of the recruitment process. 
 - All official Tide job opportunities are listed exclusively on our Careers Page and applications should be submitted through this channel. 
 - Communication from Tide will only come from an official @tide. co email address. 
 - Tide does not work with agencies or recruiters without prior formal engagement, and we do not authorize third parties to make job offers on our behalf. 

If you are contacted by anyone misrepresenting Tide or requesting payment, please treat it as fraudulent and report it to us immediately at talent@tide. co

Your safety and trust are important to us, and we are committed to ensuring a fair and transparent recruitment process. 

Tide leverages AI to enhance our hiring experience. You can read more about how we use AI in our recruitment process in our AI Policy. 

Your personal data will be processed by Tide for recruitment purposes and in accordance with Tide's Recruitment Privacy Notice.

data.title: Quality Manager
data.description:
About The Role

As Quality Manager, you lead the plant quality function to deliver zero-defect manufacturing, exceed customer expectations, and ensure compliance with OEM, IATF, and regulatory standards. You drive a culture of continuous improvement by leveraging robust quality systems, data-driven decision-making, and disciplined problem-solving. Through strong leadership and collaboration across manufacturing, engineering, supplier quality, and customer teams, you enable operational excellence in quality performance and customer satisfaction while developing a high-performing quality organization. 

Key Responsibilities

- Lead the site quality function to consistently achieve world-class quality performance, customer satisfaction, and compliance with OEM and industry standards. 
 - Champion zero-defect manufacturing by driving proactive quality planning, risk mitigation, and continuous improvement initiatives across welding and assembly operations. 
 - Lead customer quality management activities, including customer complaints, audits, issue resolution, and timely closure of corrective actions. 
 - Ensure effective implementation, maintenance, and continuous improvement of the Quality Management System (QMS) in compliance with IATF 16949, ISO standards, and customer-specific requirements. 
 - Drive defect reduction initiatives through structured problem-solving methodologies and implementation of Cost of Poor Quality (COPQ) reduction strategies. 
 - Oversee Advanced Product Quality Planning (APQP), Production Part Approval Process (PPAP), Process Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (PFMEA), Statistical Process Control (SPC), Measurement System Analysis (MSA), Control Plans, and implementation of 7QC tools. 
 - Lead root cause analysis, corrective and preventive action (CAPA) processes, and systematic containment activities for internal and external quality concerns. 
 - Partner with manufacturing, engineering, maintenance, supplier quality, and customer teams to resolve quality issues and improve process capability.

data.title: Principal AI Engineer
data.description:
Company: TechGrove By Banyan Software

Website: Visit Website

LinkedIn: Visit LinkedIn

Business Type: Small/Medium Business

Company Type: Product

Business Model: B2B

Funding Stage: Private Equity

Industry: Information Technology

Job Description

Principal AI Engineer

TechGrove AI Engineering Pod

You build the intelligent features that make software feel like magic, and you make them work in production. You are equally at home shipping a clean API, standing up a RAG pipeline, evaluating an agent, or tuning guardrails so an LLM behaves safely at scale. You are excited by the current moment in AI and pragmatic about where it actually adds value. 

As Principal AI Engineer, you design and build the AI capabilities that differentiate an OpCo's modernized applications: GenAI features, agentic workflows, and ML-powered functionality, integrated safely and reliably. You work side by side with the Technical Lead / Architect, contribute as a strong full-stack engineer, and help the whole pod raise its game in AI-native development. 

If you want to turn the frontier of applied AI into shipped, dependable product features, this role is for you. 

About The Pod

A TechGrove AI Engineering Pod is a self-contained, AI-native software delivery team that we embed inside one of our Operating Companies (OpCos) to build, modernize, and ship production software. Each pod pairs senior engineering talent with agentic AI tooling such as Claude Code, plus the accelerators of Banyan's AI Application Modernization Factory, to deliver at a velocity and quality bar a traditional team cannot match. 

A pod is typically four to eight people, and OpCos add more pods as their ambitions grow. You will work as part of a tight, high-trust team with real ownership of what you build. Pods are delivered from Banyan's India-based TechGrove. 

What You Will Do

- Ship production AI/ML features: Design, build, and deploy GenAI integrations, agentic workflows, RAG and GraphRAG systems, and ML-powered functionality into the OpCo's modernized applications. 
 - Orchestrate and integrate LLMs: Implement LLM orchestration, prompt and context engineering, guardrails, and evaluation to deliver reliable, safe, production-grade AI. 
 - Engineer cloud-native services: Build scalable, secure, resilient services that host and serve AI capabilities, as a strong hands-on contributor. 
 - Build agents and tooling: Develop AI agents and tooling, including building and connecting MCP servers and tools, and champion agentic development practices across the pod's SDLC. 
 - Own data and retrieval: Design the data, retrieval, and vector or knowledge-graph infrastructure that powers GenAI features, with quality, performance, and security built in. 
 - Own technical design and quality: Lead design and implementation for AI features, write clean, well-tested code, and uphold engineering standards, security, and observability. 
 - Collaborate and mentor: Partner with the Architect and senior engineers, and coach the team on AI/ML engineering best practices. 
 - Apply pragmatic judgment: Know where AI adds real value versus risk, and navigate a fast-moving landscape with a clear head. 

What You Bring

- Experience: 8+ years in software engineering, with significant hands-on experience implementing ML/AI features in production. 
 - Production experience on AWS or Azure (required): You have designed and built cloud-native applications on AWS or Azure, including containers, serverless, and Infrastructure-as-Code (Terraform). Experience limited to GCP alone does not meet this requirement, although GCP in addition to AWS or Azure is a plus. 
 - Applied AI/ML: Demonstrated experience implementing GenAI capabilities (RAG and GraphRAG, LLM orchestration, prompt and context engineering, guardrail design) and/or ML features in production systems. 
 - Agentic and GenAI frameworks: Hands-on experience with GenAI frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex), multi-agent frameworks (crewAI, AutoGen, or similar), and developing AI agents and MCP servers and tools. 
 - Software engineering depth: Strong full-stack ability with solid SQL/No-SQL and API design skills. 
 - Modern tech stacks: Hands-on production experience with at least two of: . NET Core, Python, TypeScript, and Java. 
 - AI-native tooling: Fluency with AI-assisted development tooling (Claude Code or similar) as a daily, core part of your workflow. 
 - Engineering principles: Solid grounding in DDD, design patterns, clean code, test-driven development, and application security. 
 - DevSecOps: Experience with CI/CD (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI) and cloud-native observability. 
 - Collaboration: Strong communication and an ownership mindset, comfortable with ambiguity and rapid change. 
 - Education: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience. 

Nice to Have

- Deep LLM and vector database expertise: hybrid vector databases, knowledge graphs, and advanced prompt and guardrail design for enterprise AI safety. 
 - Experience fine-tuning or evaluating models, building eval harnesses, or implementing LLM observability. 
 - Experience building and operating multi-tenant SaaS at scale. 
 - Prior experience modernizing or re-platforming enterprise or B2B applications. 

What Success Looks Like

- First 90 days: You have shipped your first production AI feature, established reliable patterns for orchestration, retrieval, and evaluation, and the pod has a clear, safe approach to building with LLMs. 
 - First 6 months: AI capabilities are a dependable, differentiating part of the product, with measured quality and guardrails, and the team is meaningfully more capable in applied AI because of your mentorship. 

Why TechGrove, Why Banyan

- Permanent home, long-term thinking: Banyan acquires great software businesses and keeps them for good. We invest for the long term, which means you build software meant to last, not to flip. 
 - Real ownership: You own outcomes end to end inside a small, senior team. The OpCo owns the "what"; the pod owns the "how. "
 - AI-native by default: You work every day with agentic tooling and the AI Application Modernization Factory, not as a side experiment but as the core of how we build. 
 - Variety with stability: Pods work across a portfolio of real products and domains, so you keep learning, with the security of a permanent employer behind you. 
 - Growth and excellence: A Banyan Director of Engineering Excellence supports every pod with coaching, standards, and continuous improvement, so your craft compounds over time. 

Should You Apply?

We have written this role to be honest about what it takes, not to describe a mythical perfect candidate. If you meet most of what is listed and you are excited by the work, we want to hear from you. Strong engineers grow into the rest, and we will help you do exactly that. 

We are building diverse, inclusive teams, and we welcome applicants of every background. What matters most is the quality of your engineering, your curiosity about AI-native development, and your appetite to own outcomes.

Job Summary

JOB DESCRIPTION

As a Core Infrastructure Engineer, you will design, build, and optimize the software and systems that power OCI AI compute infrastructure, including the GPU control plane and GPU data plane. You will combine software development and systems expertise to improve how GPU and bare metal resources are tested, provisioned, and operated. You will work with engineering, operations, and product teams to solve infrastructure problems, improve workload performance, and deliver a reliable customer experience. 

Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

- Design and develop scalable infrastructure services and features for the GPU control plane, GPU data plane, and bare metal systems supporting customer AI workloads. 
 - Build and improve automation for testing, provisioning, and validating GPU and bare metal compute resources to support reliable customer delivery. 
 - Develop modular, reusable infrastructure components with clear interfaces, security and compliance controls, diagnostics, telemetry, and production monitoring. 
 - Apply system design and distributed systems principles to resolve infrastructure bottlenecks and improve scalability, reliability, and workload performance. 
 - Collaborate with development, operations, and product management teams to translate requirements into practical infrastructure and orchestration solutions. 
 - Define benchmarks and automate performance and reliability measurements across customer workloads and the underlying infrastructure stack. 
 - Provide technical guidance on ambiguous problems, mentor junior developers, and strengthen design reviews, coding standards, code reviews, unit testing, and integration testing. 
 - Provide operational support and drive continuous improvements to enable GPU delivery to customers at scale. 
 - Collaborate across geographies to deliver features, bug fixes, and operational enhancements. 

Qualifications & Skills Mandatory

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. 
 - 5+ years of software development experience using one or more languages such as Java, Go, C, C++, C#, or Rust. 
 - At least 3 years of experience designing and developing large-scale infrastructure, distributed systems, and services. 
 - At least 1 year of experience providing technical leadership and bringing clarity to cross-functional projects while collaborating with stakeholders. 
 - Strong software engineering and systems fundamentals, including system design, distributed systems concepts, and systematic troubleshooting across software and infrastructure. 
 - Clear communication, ownership of outcomes, and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment. 

Good-to-Have

- Hands-on software development experience in Java or Go; these are the preferred languages for the team. 
 - Experience combining GPU infrastructure knowledge with software development, particularly in testing, provisioning, or operating GPU systems. 
 - Experience developing software for bare metal systems or cloud infrastructure, providing a relevant foundation for GPU infrastructure work. 
 - Cloud native engineering experience, including Docker, Kubernetes, or related containerization and orchestration technologies. 
 - Experience scheduling high-performance workloads using Kubernetes or Slurm. 
 - Experience building or managing cloud infrastructure at very large scale, including environments with hundreds of thousands of servers. 

Self-Assessment Questions

- Do I meet the required software development experience, and can I explain software I have built and maintained in a relevant programming language?

data.title: Manual QA Tester - Junior QA Engineer
data.description:
Ahmedabad, Gujarat - applications welcome from across Gujarat

  Fully remote currently; hybrid working in Ahmedabad planned

  Engineering graduates and freshers welcome | Typically 0-2 years' experience

Full-time | Four openings

  

Start your software testing career with Script AssistScript Assist is hiring four Manual QA Testers / Junior QA Engineers to help test software connecting clinics, pharmacies and patients across the UK. 

Our platform supports tens of thousands of prescriptions every month. Behind each prescription are connected workflows: consultations, prescribing, stock availability, payments, dispensing, delivery updates and repeat requests. Those workflows need to work correctly for the people relying on them. 

We're looking for engineering graduates and junior candidates who notice inconsistencies, enjoy investigating problems and can explain their findings clearly. If you want to build a career in manual testing, software testing and quality assurance, this is an opportunity to work on a live product where careful testing matters. 

What you'll be testing

You'll test connected clinic, pharmacy and patient applications, checking both individual features and complete user journeys. 

Does a saved change appear correctly when the record is reopened? Does an order move through the right stages? Can each user access the right information? Does a new release fix the original problem without breaking a related workflow?

Your job will be to turn questions like these into organised tests, investigate unexpected behaviour and give developers clear evidence they can act on. 

What you'll do

•        Functional testing: Check features, forms, validation rules, user permissions and complete workflows against their requirements. 

•        Test cases and scenarios: Turn requirements into practical tests covering normal use, boundary conditions, invalid inputs and exceptions. 

•        Exploratory testing: Investigate unfamiliar features, try different sequences of actions and identify problems that straightforward checks might miss. 

•        Regression, smoke and sanity testing: Check new builds and confirm that changes have not disrupted existing functionality. 

•        Bug reporting and defect tracking: Record clear reproduction steps, expected and actual results, and supporting evidence. 

•        Retesting and release checks: Verify fixes, check related behaviour and communicate test results to the product and engineering team. 

Who we're looking for

•        A completed B. E. , B. Tech or equivalent engineering degree, in any engineering discipline. 

•        Strong attention to detail and logical reasoning. 

•        An organised approach to investigating problems and following requirements. 

•        The ability to distinguish what you have observed from what you are assuming. 

•        Clear written and spoken English, especially when explaining a problem. 

•        A current base in Gujarat and the ability to work in Ahmedabad when the role moves to a hybrid arrangement. 

Freshers are welcome. Previous professional manual testing experience is not required. Relevant college projects, internships, testing courses or junior QA experience are useful, but your ability to think carefully and perform in the practical assessment matters. 

You do not need programming or test automation experience to apply. 

  

Why join Script Assist?

You'll work on a live healthcare software platform with connected workflows and real operational complexity. Your findings will help improve the experience of clinic staff, pharmacy teams and patients. 

You'll develop practical experience across test design, exploratory testing, defect investigation, regression testing and release verification. As your product knowledge grows, you'll be able to take ownership of more complex features and user journeys. 

This is an opportunity to build the foundations of a software QA career through hands-on product work. 

Location and working arrangement

The role is fully remote at present. We plan to introduce hybrid working in Ahmedabad, so applicants must be able to attend the Ahmedabad office when that arrangement begins. 

How to apply

Apply through LinkedIn and complete the short screening questions. Suitable applicants will receive an online practical assessment covering observation, reasoning and manual testing tasks. The strongest candidates will then be invited to a remote interview.

Manager - Integration Solutioning & Technical Leadership (US Shift)

Role Overview

We are looking for a hands-on Manager to lead Integrations for a portfolio of US-based clients, working in the US shift. You will lead and grow a team of Technical Consultants responsible for integration solutioning and development - owning technical direction, guiding solution design, and ensuring high-quality delivery of new and enhanced integration interfaces. You will be the primary integrations point of contact for client leadership during US business hours, drive periodic leadership connects through demos and meetups, and step in hands-on to help the team solve complex issues on integration interfaces when needed. Our team already uses AI for solutioning and writing code - as a quick learner, you will deepen and scale this practice across the team. 

Key Responsibilities

- 1. Lead and manage a team of 2-4 Technical Consultants - set priorities, plan capacity, run performance reviews, hire and develop talent, mentor on solutioning, and drive accountability for integration outcomes. 
 - 2. Own integration solutioning end to end - translate client requirements and change requests into robust designs (APIs, file-based flows, middleware patterns) and guide the team through build and delivery. 
 - 3. Lead and review the solutioning work done by Technical Consultants - ensure code quality, reusability, maintainability, and alignment with platform and integration standards. 
 - 4. Act as the technical lead for key integration engagements - drive architecture decisions, design reviews, and complex solutioning discussions with clients and internal stakeholders. 
 - 5. Drive client leadership connects with US clients through demos and meetups, in their time zone - showcase integration capabilities, walk through solution approaches, align on roadmap priorities, and strengthen executive-level confidence in delivery. 
 - 6. Own escalations and production issues on integration interfaces during US hours - debug failures, unblock consultants on complex interface problems, restore stable data flows, and communicate status to client stakeholders. 
 - 7. Stay hands-on with Python and integration tooling to review, guide, and when required , contribute to builds and troubleshooting on integration interfaces. 
 - 8. Build on the team's existing use of AI for solutioning and writing code - as a quick learner, strengthen AI-assisted design, coding, review, and documentation practices so the team delivers faster with consistent quality. 
 - 9. Partner with India-based Product/Engineering teams on platform capabilities, ensuring clean handoffs across time zones on integration patterns and enhancements needed for scalable client solutions. 
 - 10. Build and maintain solutioning standards, reusable patterns, and technical documentation so the team can deliver consistently as engagement volume grows. 

Required Skills & Experience

- 6-10 years of experience in technical consulting, integration solutioning/development, or similar roles within HRTech/SaaS or enterprise software. 
 - Proven experience managing Technical Consultants or similar delivery teams (3+ years in a people-management role) - including hiring, performance management, quality oversight, and owning delivery outcomes. 
 - Strong hands-on programming ability in Python - comfortable writing, reading, reviewing, and debugging integration code. 
 - Solid expertise in system integrations (REST/SOAP APIs, file-based integrations, middleware) with the ability to design and solution complex integration landscapes. 
 - Demonstrated ability to help teams diagnose and resolve issues on integration interfaces in production environments. 
 - Experience engaging client leadership through demos, technical meetups, and executive-facing solution discussions. 
 - Experience working with US/North American clients, and willingness to work the US shift on a sustained basis. 
 - A quick learner who already uses AI tools for solutioning and writing code (e. g. , LLM-based assistants, coding copilots) and can strengthen this practice across a delivery team. 
 - Excellent client-facing communication and stakeholder management skills - able to explain technical designs clearly and lead solution discussions with both technical and leadership audiences. 
 - Strong analytical and problem-solving mindset with the ability to balance leadership responsibilities and hands-on technical contribution. 

Good to Have

- JavaScript experience - a plus for integration builds, scripting, and related client-side or middleware work. 
 - Prior direct experience with the Darwinbox platform or similar HRMS/HCM products. 
 - Exposure to standard and custom integration patterns (SFTP, REST/SOAP APIs, middleware tools). 
 - Experience scaling AI-assisted solutioning and coding practices across a consulting or engineering team. 

What Success Looks Like

Within the first two quarters, this person will have become the trusted integrations lead for US client leadership, established clear ownership of integration solutioning and development quality across their team, built a strong rhythm of client leadership demos and meetups, helped stabilize and resolve complex integration interface issues, and strengthened the team's existing AI-driven approach to solutioning and coding - leaving behind a high-performing US-shift Technical Consultant team capable of scaling delivery with consistent quality.

data.title: Director of Quality Assurance
data.description:
About the Role

We are seeking a Director of QA to lead our QA automation engineering strategy across multiple client accounts and delivery teams. You will build scalable automation capabilities, establish technical standards and integrate continuous testing into software delivery. 

This role requires a technically strong leader who can guide automation architecture, review frameworks and resolve complex testing challenges while leading QA managers, automation architects and SDETs. You will partner with engineering, DevOps, product and delivery leaders to improve test coverage, shorten feedback cycles and increase release confidence. 

Key Responsibilities

- Automation Strategy and Roadmap: Own the QA automation vision and execution roadmap across client engagements. Assess automation maturity, prioritize investments and define measurable goals for coverage, reliability, execution time and maintenance effort. 
 - Framework Architecture: Lead the design and evolution of reusable automation frameworks for web, mobile, API and backend services. Establish standards for modularity, maintainability, configuration, reporting and parallel execution. 
 - Technical Leadership: Provide architectural direction, review automation code and framework designs, and guide teams through complex implementation challenges. Promote software engineering practices within QA, including version control, code reviews and reusable libraries. 
 - CI/CD and Continuous Testing: Partner with DevOps and engineering teams to embed automated tests into build and deployment pipelines. Define appropriate test suites and quality gates for pull requests, integration builds and releases. 
 - Automation Coverage: Establish a balanced approach across unit, component, API, integration and end-to-end testing. Work with developers to test at the appropriate layer and prioritize automation based on business risk. 
 - Test Reliability and Execution: Reduce flaky tests, improve failure diagnostics and optimize execution through parallelization, cross-browser testing and cloud-based device platforms. Establish clear ownership for test failures and maintenance. 
 - API and Integration Testing: Drive automation for REST and GraphQL APIs, microservices and third-party integrations, including contract testing, authentication, data validation and negative scenarios. 
 - Test Data and Environments: Establish reliable approaches to test data creation, environment readiness, service virtualization and dependency management to support repeatable automated testing. 
 - Performance and Non-Functional Testing: Oversee performance and load-testing strategies using tools such as JMeter or k6. Partner with specialists to incorporate security and accessibility checks into delivery pipelines. 
 - Team and Practice Development: Build and mentor distributed automation teams. Define hiring standards, technical competency frameworks and development plans, and create reusable accelerators across accounts. 
 - Metrics and Improvement: Track automation effectiveness through risk coverage, escaped defects, flaky-test rates, execution duration and feedback speed. Use findings to improve frameworks and demonstrate business value. 
 - Client and Delivery Leadership: Present automation strategies, investment proposals and quality risks to clients and senior leadership. Support proposals, estimates, staffing plans and delivery commitments. 
 - AI-Assisted Testing: Evaluate practical uses of AI for test generation, maintenance and failure analysis, with clear validation and measurable outcomes. 

Qualifications

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related field. 
 - 14+ years of experience in software quality engineering, with substantial experience in test automation and at least 5 years leading multiple teams or programs. 
 - Proven experience defining and scaling automation strategies across enterprise applications and client engagements. 
 - Strong background in designing automation frameworks, reusable libraries and testing infrastructure. 
 - Strong programming skills in one or more languages such as Java, JavaScript/TypeScript, Python or C#. 
 - Deep expertise in relevant automation tools such as Selenium, Playwright, WebdriverIO or Appium, with the ability to select tools based on application needs. 
 - Experience with API automation tools and libraries such as REST Assured, Karate, Postman/Newman or equivalent. 
 - Demonstrated experience integrating automated testing with CI/CD platforms such as Azure DevOps, Jenkins or GitHub Actions. 
 - Strong understanding of test architecture, test pyramid principles, contract testing, mocking and service virtualization. 
 - Experience with BrowserStack, Sauce Labs or equivalent platforms for cross-browser and mobile testing. 
 - Working knowledge of performance testing, SQL, backend validation and cloud-based application testing. 
 - Experience leading distributed teams within an onshore-offshore delivery model, preferably in technology consulting or digital engineering services. 
 - Proven ability to manage automation investments, staffing and tooling costs while improving delivery outcomes. 
 - Strong client communication, stakeholder management and leadership development skills. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience establishing an Automation or Quality Engineering Centre of Excellence. 
 - Familiarity with Docker, Kubernetes and containerized test execution. 
 - Experience testing AI-enabled applications and evaluating AI-assisted automation tools. 
 - Experience modernizing legacy automation suites and reducing maintenance overhead. 

About Us

TechBlocks is a global digital product development firm that brings together strategy, design and technology to build digital solutions for Fortune 500 companies and global brands. Our clients include Bell Telecom, Bausch Health, Honda Motors, AES Corp, Thomson Reuters Carswell, First American and Colliers International. 

Headquartered in Toronto, with offices in the U. S. and India, we help organizations improve efficiency, collaboration and user experience through consulting, product engineering and ongoing support.

About Us

Embrace owns the software running inside 16% of the Fortune 500, 45+ state agencies, and 450+ banks and credit unions. We acquire entrenched vertical software businesses and rebuild them around AI - products, operations, go-to-market, all of it. Our Venture Lab launches new AI-native products into those same markets, using the distribution and customer relationships our portfolio already owns. 

You'll ship AI into production against real workflows, real customers, and a P&L you can see move within a quarter. 

We hire people who want scope, speed, and ownership, and who are tired of working on AI that never reaches a customer. If you want to spend the next five years shipping into software that already runs the economy, talk to us. 

Job Description

This is a remote position. 

Embrace Industrial Group supports some of the world's largest and most complex manufacturers-serving 8 of the Top 10 global Chemical companies, 3 of the Top 10 Automotive companies, and 3 of the Top 5 Oil & Gas companies, along with industry leaders in Heavy Machinery and Food Manufacturing. 

Radiant RFID is a next-generation IoT platform under the Embrace umbrella, focused on enterprise-grade asset tracking. Our technology empowers organizations to manage and monitor critical and mobile assets in real time-boosting visibility, accountability, and operational efficiency, all while requiring minimal IT infrastructure. 

We are seeking a Lead Engineer/ Architect (. NET) who is equally at home writing production code and leading a team. This is a hands-on role: you will spend a significant portion of your time doing software architecture and development, while also owning the team's engineering process, mentoring engineers, and championing AI adoption. You will bridge technical execution and business strategy, helping our cloud-based IoT asset tracking platform scale to meet enterprise customer demand. 

What You'll Do

Hands-On Development & Architecture (core focus)

- Design and implement critical features and platform components - this is an active coding role. 
 - Own technical architecture decisions: system design, service boundaries, data modelling, and API contracts. 
 - Lead code and design reviews, setting the technical bar and coaching engineers through them. 
 - Resolve complex engineering challenges, performance bottlenecks, and cross-cutting concerns. 
 - Drive adoption of engineering best practices: TDD, CI/CD, observability, and security-by-design. Team & Process Leadership

- Lead a small agile team - run sprints, set goals, unblock engineers, and manage delivery commitments. 
 - Mentor and develop engineers through regular 1: 1s, feedback, and pair programming. 
 - Collaborate with Product and Operations to refine roadmaps and translate requirements into technical plans. 
 - Hire and onboard engineering talent in partnership with leadership. AI Adoption

- Lead the team's adoption of AI development tools (e. g. GitHub Copilot, AI-assisted testing) and build internal best practices. 
 - Identify opportunities to embed AI/ML capabilities into the Radiant platform to enhance customer value. 
 - Evaluate emerging AI tools and partner with leadership to define an AI strategy roadmap for engineering. 

Requirements

Technical

- 8+ years of professional software development experience, including production systems at scale. 
 - Expert-level C# and . NET (Framework & Core); strong SQL and Microsoft SQL Server. 
 - Experience with ASP. NET Web API, React, and modern JavaScript frameworks. 
 - Proven track record designing concurrent, scalable, fault-tolerant distributed systems. 
 - Solid OOP fundamentals, design patterns, and experience with message brokers (MQTT, RabbitMQ). 
 - TDD mindset with strong unit and integration testing practices. Leadership & AI

- 3+ years in a technical lead or senior engineering lead role with direct team ownership. 
 - Demonstrated ability to manage people, run agile processes, and deliver complex software projects. 
 - Hands-on experience with AI coding assistants and a genuine drive to advance AI adoption in engineering teams. 
 - Strong communicator - able to convey technical decisions clearly to both engineers and business stakeholders. 

Preferred Qualifications

AWS or other cloud platforms • Docker/Kubernetes • Redis • ORMs (NHibernate, Dapper) • IoT protocols • RFID/BLE/GPS technologies • ML model integration or AI-powered feature development

Benefits

data.title: Senior Staff Software Architect
data.description:
Job Description Summary

As a Senior Staff Software UI / Design System Architect you will define and evolve the architecture of shared UI platforms used across multiple products and teams. The role requires strong architectural ownership beyond individual framework development, with experience scaling design systems across React, Angular, TypeScript, and Web Components ecosystems. 

The ideal candidate should combine strong UI architecture, governance, performance engineering, quality strategy, technical leadership, and practical AI-assisted engineering experience. 

GE Healthcare is a leading global medical technology and digital solutions innovator. Our mission is to create a world where healthcare has no limits. Unlock your ambition, turn ideas into world-changing realities, and join an organization where every voice makes a difference, and every difference builds a healthier world. 

Job Description

About the Ethos Design System (EDS)

EDS is the unified digital platform that powers GE HealthCare's global software portfolio. It serves as a comprehensive library of reusable UI components, design patterns, and accessibility standards that bridge the critical gap between User Experience (UX) and Engineering. By fostering a philosophy of "reduce, reuse, and recycle, " EDS enables hundreds of product teams to eliminate redundant coding and design work. We provide the foundational building blocks that ensure our clinical and operational applications are intuitive, consistent, and accessible, allowing teams to focus on patient safety. 

The Mission: Scale and Empowerment

We are in a phase of hyper-growth, scaling from 25 adopting products to over 100. This requires an architect who thinks like a platform owner, not just a component builder. You must look beyond individual implementation details to think about scale, governance, and empowerment. You will define the architectural foundations and self-service patterns that let teams move fast without breaking the consistency, compatibility, and accessibility standards required for patient safety. 

Core Responsibilities

- Architecture & Platform Design
 - Platform Architecture: Define and evolve scalable architecture for shared UI and design system platforms. 
 - Framework-Agnostic Foundations: Establish framework-agnostic foundations such as design tokens, styling, shared behavior, and interaction patterns. Drive architectural consistency across Web Components. 
 - Adapter & API Strategy: Define the right approach for framework adapters, native implementations, package structure, and component APIs. Own public API boundaries, backwards compatibility, versioning, deprecation, and migration strategy. 
 - Quality, Performance & Technical Debt
 - Quality Strategy: Define quality strategy across unit, component, accessibility, visual regression, integration, and E2E testing. Establish release-blocking quality gates and compatibility expectations. 
 - Performance Engineering: Diagnose and improve rendering, DOM, memory, bundle-size, and framework-integration performance. Define measurable performance baselines, budgets, and engineering health metrics rather than subjective assessments. 
 - Debt Prioritization: Prioritize technical and QA debt based on customer impact, adoption, risk, and maintainability. 
 - Roadmap & Cross-Team Enablement
 - Architecture Roadmap: Create architecture roadmaps and guide long-term evolution without unnecessary rewrites, aligning with product priorities. 
 - Cross-Functional Partnership: Partner with Leadership, Product, UX, QA, DevOps, and engineering teams to drive architecture decisions and adoption across organizational boundaries. 
 - Migration Support: Support consuming teams with migration, integration, and compatibility challenges. Drive adoption across consuming applications rather than focusing only on platform implementation. 

Core Competencies

- Communicating Trade-offs & Alignment: Exceptional ability to communicate complex architectural concepts by clearly explaining options, technical trade-offs, risks, and long-term implications. Works closely with internal customers across cross-functional engineering, UX, and product teams to ensure alignment and secure buy-in. 
 - Architectural Ownership: Acts as the clear architectural owner for the UI and Design System platform. Demonstrates cross-team architectural ownership rather than experience limited to individual contributor delivery. 
 - Applied AI for Development: Uses AI-assisted engineering for refactoring, testing, migrations, documentation, debugging, and code review. Understands model selection and context/token management. Can define safe team-level AI development practices (validation, security, human-review controls) and demonstrate measurable improvements in productivity. 
 - Evidence-Based Direction: Challenges existing architecture when required and can demonstrate examples where technical direction was corrected based on evidence. 
 - Mentorship: Mentors senior engineers and Tech Leads, raising architectural capability across the team. Balances scalability, compatibility, performance, developer experience, security, and delivery needs. 

Education Qualification

- Bachelor's Degree or equivalent in Computer Science or "STEM" Majors (Science, Technology, Engineering and Math)

Required Skills

- Experience: 10-14 years of experience in front-end/UI engineering. 
 - Mandatory: Proven experience architecting enterprise-scale UI platforms or large design systems used by multiple teams and applications. 
 - UX Collaboration: 
 - Mandatory: 6+ years of experience partnering closely with UX, Product, and Design teams to define architecture that scales across products. 
 - Deep understanding of React, Angular, TypeScript, Web Components, HTML, CSS, and browser fundamentals. 
 - Strong knowledge of multi-framework architecture, framework-agnostic design principles, and supporting multiple framework versions simultaneously. 
 - Experience with design tokens, theming, styling architecture, shared behavior, and component composition. 
 - Tooling & Process: 
 - Strong understanding of API design, package architecture, dependency management, changesets, semantic versioning, and migration planning/codemods. 
 - Experience with design-system governance, component lifecycle, release management, and adoption analytics. 
 - Strong understanding of CI/CD, build pipelines, package publishing, cloud infrastructure, monitoring, and release governance. 
 - Good understanding of backend systems, APIs, authentication, integration patterns, and distributed application architecture. 

Inclusion And Diversity

GE Healthcare is an Equal Opportunity Employer where inclusion matters. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, colour, religion, national or ethnic origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, protected veteran status or other characteristics protected by law. 

We expect all employees to live and breathe our behaviours: to act with humility and build trust; lead with transparency; deliver with focus, and drive ownership - always with unyielding integrity. 

Our total rewards are designed to unlock your ambition by giving you the boost and flexibility you need to turn your ideas into world-changing realities. Our salary and benefits are everything you'd expect from an organization with global strength and scale, and you'll be surrounded by career opportunities in a culture that fosters care, collaboration, and support. 

#Everyroleisvital

Engineering Manager - Backend (PHP/Laravel)

About The Role

We are looking for an experienced Engineering Manager - Backend to lead our backend engineering team and take ownership of the delivery, quality, scalability, performance, and reliability of our web-based telecommunications testing platform. 

Our platform enables customers to test and validate telecommunications services, including IVR (Interactive Voice Response) and related telecom workflows, across different networks and environments. This is a hands-on engineering leadership role. The successful candidate will combine strong PHP/Laravel backend expertise with engineering management, system-design, troubleshooting, delivery management, and people-leadership skills. 

You will work closely with frontend engineering, QA, Product, DevOps/Platform, and other stakeholders to build and operate reliable, secure, and scalable systems. 

Key Responsibilities

Engineering & Architecture

- Own the technical direction and day-to-day execution of backend engineering. 
 - Design, review, and evolve scalable backend architecture using PHP and Laravel. 
 - Own backend APIs, databases, integrations, background processing, and related services. 
 - Make sound architectural decisions considering scalability, maintainability, performance, reliability, and security. 
 - Review technical designs and provide guidance for complex implementations. 
 - Identify and address architectural weaknesses and technical debt. 
 - Ensure appropriate logging, monitoring, exception handling, and observability are incorporated into backend services. 
 - Drive continuous improvement and modernization of existing systems. 

Delivery & Execution

- Lead planning and execution of backend engineering work. 
 - Break business and product requirements into appropriate technical solutions and implementation plans. 
 - Provide and review engineering estimates and ensure commitments are realistic. 
 - Coordinate priorities and workload across backend engineers. 
 - Track delivery risks, dependencies, and technical blockers and address them proactively. 
 - Ensure backend deliverables are completed with appropriate quality and testing. 
 - Work with Product and other stakeholders to communicate technical trade offs, dependencies, risks, and timelines. 

Code Quality & Engineering Excellence

- Establish and maintain backend engineering standards and best practices. 
 - Drive effective code reviews and maintain high standards for production code. 
 - Promote clean architecture, reusable components, maintainable code, and appropriate design patterns. 
 - Ensure effective automated testing and continuously improve backend test coverage. 
 - Lead refactoring initiatives and manage technical debt systematically. 
 - Improve API performance and application/database efficiency. 
 - Investigate production issues and ensure appropriate root-cause analysis and preventive actions. 

Reliability, Performance & Security

- Ensure backend systems remain reliable and performant as usage grows. 
 - Monitor and improve API response times and backend service performance. 
 - Design systems with appropriate availability, resilience, failure handling, and recovery mechanisms. 
 - Work with DevOps/Platform teams on CI/CD, deployments, monitoring, infrastructure, and production reliability. 
 - Ensure backend development follows secure coding and data-protection practices. 
 - Participate in incident investigation and improvements following production issues. 

Telecommunications Domain

- Develop a strong understanding of telecommunications testing workflows and customer requirements. 
 - Work with systems that interact with telecommunications services such as IVR, voice/call flows, SMS and related communication workflows, where applicable. 
 - Help engineering teams diagnose issues spanning web applications, APIs, integrations, telecom workflows, and external systems. 
 - Previous telecommunications experience is desirable but strong candidates from other complex SaaS/platform environments are also encouraged to apply. 

Team Leadership & Development

- Lead, mentor, and develop backend engineers. 
 - Conduct regular technical and performance discussions with team members. 
 - Help engineers grow in architecture, coding, debugging, ownership, and decision- making. 
 - Support onboarding and development of new engineers. 
 - Build a culture of accountability, collaboration, continuous learning, and engineering excellence. 
 - Identify skill gaps and contribute to hiring and team-development plans. 
 - Participate in technical interviews and hiring decisions for backend engineering roles. 

Required Skills & Experience

- Strong professional software engineering experience, including significant experience building backend web applications. 
 - Strong hands-on experience with PHP and Laravel. 
 - Experience leading or managing backend software engineering teams. 
 - Strong understanding of REST APIs and API design. 
 - Strong knowledge of relational databases such as MySQL/MariaDB, including schema design, indexing, query optimization, and performance troubleshooting. 
 - Experience designing scalable, reliable web-based/SaaS applications. 
 - Strong knowledge of software architecture, design patterns, and clean-code principles. 
 - Experience with automated testing and backend testing strategies. 
 - Experience with Git-based development and code-review workflows. 
 - Understanding of CI/CD and modern software deployment practices. 
 - Experience diagnosing complex production and performance issues. 
 - Understanding of application security and secure software-development practices. 
 - Strong problem-solving and debugging abilities. 
 - Strong communication and stakeholder-management skills. 
 - Ability to balance hands-on technical leadership with people and delivery management. 

Preferred Qualifications

Experience in one or more of the following would be advantageous: 

- Telecommunications or telecom testing platforms. 
 - IVR, telephony, voice, SMS, or communication platforms. 
 - High-volume API or transaction-processing systems. 
 - Redis, queues, caching, scheduled/background jobs, and asynchronous processing. 
 - Docker/containerized applications. 
 - Cloud infrastructure. 
 - Application and infrastructure monitoring/observability. 
 - CI/CD and deployment automation. 
 - Performance tuning and load testing. 
 - Working with distributed or geographically dispersed engineering teams. 

Skills: laravel, ivr, aws, telephony, php, docker, ci cd, mysql
