As a Staff Software Engineer at GE Precision Healthcare, you will play a pivotal role in designing, developing, and deploying innovative software solutions that enhance the precision and efficiency of healthcare delivery. You will contribute to the full software development lifecycle, working on complex systems that directly impact patient care. 

GE Healthcare is a leading global medical technology and digital solutions innovator. Our mission is to improve lives in the moments that matter. Unlock your ambition, turn ideas into world-changing realities, and join an organization where every voice makes a difference, and every difference builds a healthier world. 

Job Description

Key Responsibilities: 

- Lead the design, development, testing, and deployment of robust, scalable, and secure software applications for medical imaging, diagnostics, and healthcare IT platforms. 
 - Collaborate with product management, clinical experts, and cross-functional engineering teams to define requirements, architecture, and technical specifications for new features and products. 
 - Drive technical excellence and best practices, including code reviews, unit testing, integration testing, and continuous integration/continuous deployment (CI/CD) pipelines. 
 - Mentor junior engineers, providing technical guidance and fostering a culture of innovation and continuous improvement. 
 - Troubleshoot and resolve complex software defects and performance issues in production environments. 
 - Evaluate and integrate new technologies, tools, and frameworks to improve development processes and product capabilities. 
 - Contribute to technical documentation, design specifications, and architectural diagrams. 
 - Ensure compliance with relevant regulatory standards (e. g. , FDA, HIPAA) and internal quality processes. 

Job Qualifications

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field. 

Required Skills

- Minimum of 8 years of progressive experience in software development, with a strong track record of delivering high-quality software products. 
 - Expert proficiency in at least one programming language (e. g. , C++, Java, Python, Angular) and experience with object-oriented design and development. 
 - Good experience in working with container based applications. 
 - Demonstrated expertise in designing and implementing scalable, reliable, and secure software solutions. 
 - Strong understanding of data structures, algorithms, and software design patterns. 
 - Familiarity with agile software development methodologies (Scrum, Kanban). 
 - Excellent problem-solving, analytical, and communication skills. 
 - Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, dynamic, and collaborative environment. 
 - Prior experience in the healthcare domain or with medical device software development is a significant plus. 

Inclusion and Diversity

GE Healthcare is an Equal Opportunity Employer where inclusion matters. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, colour, religion, national or ethnic origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, protected veteran status or other characteristics protected by law. 

We expect all employees to live and breathe our behaviours: to act with humility and build trust; lead with transparency; deliver with focus, and drive ownership - always with unyielding integrity. 

Our total rewards are designed to unlock your ambition by giving you the boost and flexibility you need to turn your ideas into world-changing realities. Our salary and benefits are everything you'd expect from an organization with global strength and scale, and you'll be surrounded by career opportunities in a culture that fosters care, collaboration, and support. 

#Everyroleisvital

Additional Information

Relocation Assistance Provided: No

data.title: Principal Software Engineer, Data Processing
data.description:
Aliases: Principal Engineer, Senior Principal Engineer, Technical Architect, Principal Architect, Enterprise Architect (Engineering), Senior Technical Architect, Distinguished Engineer or Chief Architect at a smaller company

About Truveta

Truveta is the world's first health provider-led data platform with a vision of Saving Lives with Data. Our mission is to enable researchers to find cures faster, empower every clinician to be an expert, and help families make the most informed decisions about their care. Achieving Truveta's ambitious vision requires an incredible team of talented and inspired people with a unique combination of health, software, and big data expertise who share our company values. 

This opportunity

Join the founding team of the Truveta India Development Center and play a pivotal role in shaping its future. As one of the early members, you will help build and scale a high-impact organization while contributing to the products and platforms that advance healthcare through data and AI. This is an unusual chance to influence both the technical direction and the culture of a growing global engineering hub. 

The Data Platform group in India owns parts of the pipeline that ingests, processes, stores, and serves healthcare data at a scale very few organizations operate at. Patients, doctors, and medical researchers deserve the same engineering rigor that has transformed other industries, and that is the work: correctness under volume, reliability under failure, and speed without cutting the corners that regulated health data does not allow anyone to cut. 

What You Will Do

- Define architecture across ingestion, processing, storage, serving, governance, and observability for the India-owned parts of the platform, aligned with Seattle. 
 - Set multi-platform technical strategy along with the sequencing that makes it achievable rather than aspirational. 
 - Remain hands-on where it counts: critical designs, prototypes, deep reviews, and the worst production problems. 
 - Resolve technical disagreements that span teams and write down the decision and it's reasoning so that it holds afterwards. 
 - Establish architecture governance that engineers experience as a useful framework. 
 - Raise the technical bar of the IDC through hiring, interview calibration, and mentoring of Senior and SDE3 engineers. 
 - Represent Truveta's engineering thinking to partners, candidates, and the wider technical community. 

Key Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience. 
 - 10 to 16 or more years of professional software engineering experience, with eight considered exceptional candidates. 
 - Architecture ownership across multiple teams or platforms, with results that are demonstrably durable. 
 - Deep expertise in large-scale distributed data systems across the full lifecycle, from ingestion through serving. 
 - Continuing hands-on practice: you still write code and review designs in detail. This is an IC role, not a management role. 
 - Evidence of technical strategy that was adopted and executed, not only proposed. 
 - Sound judgment about build versus buy, migration risk, and technical debt at organization scale. 
 - Ability to influence senior engineering and product leadership across geographies and time zones. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Healthcare data, clinical informatics, or a comparably regulated domain. 
 - Experience as the most senior individual contributor at a site or within a platform organization. 
 - Track record of hiring and calibrating senior engineering talent. 
 - Prior work on privacy, security, or compliance architecture at scale.

data.title: Angular Principal Developer, IT Solutions
data.description:
Edwards Lifesciences is expanding its global technology capabilities with the launch of a new IT Innovation Hub in Pune, India. The Hub strengthens the technology foundation that supports our business worldwide, working in close partnership with teams across regions to deliver reliable, high-quality solutions at scale. Designed as a long-term investment, the Pune Hub will advance newer digital capabilities such as automation, data, AI, and cloud, and will include roles spanning end user services, application development, and enterprise platform teams. Together, these teams will help Edwards operate more efficiently and accelerate innovation in support of our mission of advancing patient care. 

How you'll make an impact: 

- Lead hands-on Angular development using modern UI/UX and Angular best practices; build repeatable, executable design strategies for tactical initiatives, guiding the application team to create new features, design scalable solutions, and address technical debt
 - Provide design and architecture recommendations for medium- to large-scale initiatives, guiding less experienced team members through development, implementation, and support activities in line with IT design and development methodology and technology standards
 - Define and enforce development team standards for code quality and source code control
 - Lead efforts to analyze, diagnose, and resolve performance, functional software, and end-user issues, and produce technical documentation, diagrams, and clear code for moderately complex problems
 - Evaluate operational feasibility of proposed solutions and translate business requirements into scalable technical designs and application architectures
 - Perform manual and automated testing, including UI/UX regression risk assessments related to code changes, and lead peer code reviews across the team
 - Lead the adoption of AI tools across the team to drive improved productivity and accelerated outcomes
 - Lead Angular framework upgrades, coordinating across regional development leads
 - Evaluate integration opportunities for offline applications based on Ionic Framework, Angular, Capacitor, Electron, and Salesforce, including new technology evaluation, tool selection, and definition of shared data, code resources, and interfaces
 - Act as subject-matter expert across system platform design, business process, and software/hardware architecture, representing IT on relevant committees
 - Coordinate with cross-disciplinary teams - Design, Quality Management, and Business - to ensure product requirements are aligned and all departments are represented
 - Up to 10% travel

What you'll need (Required): 

- Bachelor's degree in a related field, with 8 years of experience in IT
 - 8+ years of experience developing responsive, cross-browser compatible web applications
 - Expertise in Angular Reactive Form development with complex dynamic fields and validations
 - Broad technical knowledge across hardware, software, web/mobile/desktop applications, databases, cloud platforms, systems engineering, and QA/testing
 - Knowledge of automated unit testing for Angular using Playwright, Tricentis, or similar toolsets
 - Advanced experience with Angular 17+, JavaScript/TypeScript, SQLite, Node JS, HTML5, CSS, Electron, Ionic Capacitor, and mobile/desktop app security
 - Advanced expertise in SQL database architecture, particularly for offline applications using SQLite, including distributed database systems and denormalized data models
 - Expertise in CI practices using Git-based source control, pipelines (Bitbucket, Azure DevOps), PowerShell/Node JS scripting, and automated unit/e2e testing
 - Experience developing offline Windows (UWP/Win32) and iOS applications using Hybrid Web technologies (Apache Cordova, Ionic Capacitor)
 - Expertise in the Apple developer program
 - Expertise in enterprise Angular 17+ best practices, including global architecture, monorepo/library architecture, OOP, and reactive design patterns
 - Knowledge of UI/UX best practices across devices and screen sizes, and familiarity with Angular UI libraries such as Ionic
 - Knowledge of best practices related to IT governance, operations, and administration
 - Expert-level technical documentation skills (UML, BPML, ERD, wireframes/mockups, test scripts)
 - Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with proven fluency in English
 - Strong analytical, detail-oriented, and organized skills, with strong negotiation and relationship management ability

What else we look for (Preferred): 

- Full-stack Angular experience with SQLite
 - Certificates. dev Angular Certification (Senior or Expert/Lead tier), or equivalent architecture-level credential (e. g. , TOGAF, solution architecture certification), demonstrating technical leadership in enterprise Angular application design
 - Understanding of standard business workflows for Sales, Marketing, and Inventory Management of high-value products, and related CRM/ERP ecosystems
 - Knowledge of Salesforce CRM capabilities (queries, reports, permissions, custom objects, REST APIs, workflows, Apex triggers) as related to connected application development

data.title: Backend Engineer – Java & Spring Boot (Microservices)
data.description:
Title - Backend Engineer - Java & Spring Boot (Microservices)

Experience: 1+ years / someone who has exceptional knowledge and hands on experience
Employment Type: Full-time
Work Environment: Fast-paced startup

About the Role
We are looking for a skilled and driven Backend Engineer with strong expertise in Java and Spring Boot to join our engineering team. This is a backend-heavy role focused on building, maintaining, debugging, and scaling reliable microservices. 
As a startup, we operate in a fast-paced environment where priorities can evolve quickly, execution matters, and engineers are expected to take ownership of their work. We are looking for someone who can move beyond simply implementing assigned requirements - someone who can understand problems, evaluate solutions, investigate unfamiliar technologies independently, and deliver high-quality results within deadlines. 
You should have a strong understanding of Java internals, hands-on experience building Spring Boot microservices, solid problem-solving skills, and the ability to use AI-powered coding tools effectively to accelerate development without compromising code quality. 

Key Responsibilities

- Backend Development: Design, develop, test, and maintain backend services using Java 17/21 and Spring Boot. 
 - Microservices Architecture: Build and maintain scalable, resilient, and maintainable microservices. 
 - Reactive Programming: Work with Spring WebFlux and reactive programming principles where required. 
 - API Development: Design, implement, and maintain RESTful APIs with appropriate validation, error handling, security, and performance considerations. 
 - Database Engineering: Work with PostgreSQL and AWS RDS to design queries, optimize database performance, and maintain data integrity. 
 - Messaging & Caching: Implement asynchronous communication and event-driven workflows using Apache Kafka and caching mechanisms using Redis. 
 - Third-Party Integrations: Integrate external services and APIs into backend applications, handling authentication, failures, retries, and edge cases. 
 - Cloud Infrastructure: Work with AWS services to support the deployment, operation, and monitoring of backend applications. 
 - Debugging & Troubleshooting: Investigate production issues, identify root causes, and implement reliable fixes. 
 - System Design: Contribute to technical discussions involving service boundaries, data flow, scalability, resilience, and architectural trade-offs. 
 - AI-Assisted Development: Use tools such as Cursor, GitHub Copilot, and other AI-powered development tools effectively to accelerate coding, debugging, testing, and code understanding. 
 - Ownership & Execution: Take responsibility for assigned tasks from requirement understanding through implementation, testing, debugging, and delivery. 
 - Cross-Functional Collaboration: Collaborate with frontend engineers and other team members to deliver end-to-end product functionality. 
Required Skills & Qualifications
Java & Spring Boot

- Strong hands-on experience with Java 17 or Java 21. 
 - A solid understanding of Java fundamentals, object-oriented programming, collections, generics, exception handling, and concurrency. 
 - Good understanding of how Java works internally, including JVM architecture, memory management, garbage collection, class loading, and multithreading. 
 - Practical experience developing backend applications using Spring Boot. 
 - Understanding of dependency injection, Spring configuration, application lifecycle, and exception handling. 
 - Familiarity with Java AOP and its practical use cases. 
 - Understanding of reactive programming and hands-on experience with Spring WebFlux. 
Microservices & System Design

- At least one year of hands-on experience developing or maintaining Java and Spring Boot applications, preferably in a microservices environment. 
 - Understanding of scalable and resilient microservices architecture. 
 - Knowledge of service-to-service communication, API design, failure handling, retries, timeouts, and fault tolerance. 
 - Decent understanding of system design fundamentals and common architectural patterns. 
 - Ability to identify edge cases and make sensible engineering trade-offs. 
Databases & Messaging

- Hands-on experience with PostgreSQL and relational database concepts. 
 - Understanding of SQL queries, joins, indexing, transactions, and query optimization. 
 - Familiarity with AWS RDS or similar managed relational database services. 
 - Working knowledge of Apache Kafka, including producers, consumers, topics, and consumer groups. 
 - Familiarity with Redis and common caching patterns. 
APIs, AWS & Integrations

- Strong understanding of REST API principles and hands-on experience implementing REST APIs in Java. 
 - Prior experience integrating third-party services or external APIs into backend applications. 
 - Basic practical knowledge of AWS and cloud-based application deployment. 
 - Understanding of API authentication, error handling, timeouts, retries, and secure handling of credentials. 
Frontend Fundamentals
 Although this is primarily a backend role, candidates should have a basic understanding of frontend development, including: 

- JavaScript fundamentals. 
 - React. js fundamentals. 
 - Next. js fundamentals. 
 - How frontend applications communicate with backend services through APIs. 
 - How to investigate and debug basic frontend-to-backend integration issues. 
 Note: Advanced frontend development skills are not required; the primary focus of this position is backend engineering. 

AI-Powered Development Tools

- Hands-on experience using AI-assisted coding tools such as Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or equivalent tools. 
 - Ability to use AI tools effectively for code generation, refactoring, debugging, test creation, and understanding unfamiliar codebases. 
 - Ability to critically review AI-generated code, identify incorrect assumptions, and ensure correctness, security, and maintainability. 
 - Willingness to continuously improve development workflows using modern engineering tools. 
What We Are Looking For
We are particularly interested in candidates who demonstrate the following qualities: 

- Strong problem-solving ability: Can break down complex problems, reason through edge cases, and develop practical solutions. 
 - Ownership mindset: Takes responsibility for tasks and drives them to completion rather than waiting for constant guidance. 
 - Ability to work in a fast-paced environment: Can adapt to changing priorities, manage competing tasks, and deliver within agreed timelines. 
 - Independent learning: Can investigate unfamiliar technologies, read documentation, debug issues, and figure things out with minimal supervision. 
 - Execution-focused approach: Understands the importance of delivering working solutions quickly without sacrificing essential engineering quality. 
 - Strong coding skills: Writes clean, readable, maintainable code and understands the underlying logic rather than relying solely on generated solutions. 
 - Adaptability: Comfortable working across different parts of the backend stack and collaborating with frontend engineers when needed. 
 - Analytical thinking: Can identify root causes instead of relying on temporary fixes. 
Preferred Qualifications

- Experience working in a startup or another fast-moving engineering environment. 
 - Experience troubleshooting backend issues in deployed or production-like systems. 
 - Familiarity with application logging, monitoring, performance analysis, and debugging tools. 
 - Understanding of CI/CD pipelines, Git workflows, automated testing, and code reviews. 
 - Familiarity with containerization and cloud-native application development. 
Technology Stack

- The primary technologies used in this role include: 
 - Languages: Java 17/21, JavaScript
 - Backend Frameworks: Spring Boot, Spring WebFlux
 - Programming Concepts: Java AOP, reactive programming, concurrency
 - Architecture: Microservices, REST APIs, system design
 - Databases: PostgreSQL, AWS RDS
 - Messaging: Apache Kafka
 - Caching: Redis
 - Cloud: Amazon Web Services (AWS)
 - Frontend Fundamentals: React. js, Next. js
 - AI Development Tools: Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or equivalent
 - Engineering Practices: Debugging, testing, performance optimization, and root-cause analysis
Why Join Us?

- Work in a startup environment where engineers can make meaningful technical contributions. 
 - Take ownership of backend services and solve real-world engineering problems. 
 - Work with modern backend technologies, cloud infrastructure, and microservices architecture. 
 - Learn quickly by working on challenging problems across the engineering stack. 
 - Use AI-powered development tools as part of a modern and productivity-focused engineering workflow. 
Who Should Apply?
This role is best suited for an engineer who has solid Java and Spring Boot fundamentals, practical backend development experience, and the motivation to take ownership in a fast-moving startup. 
If you enjoy solving difficult problems, learning independently, building scalable backend systems, and delivering solutions without waiting for every step to be prescribed, we would love to hear from you.

data.title: Software Development Engineer I
data.description:
Description

Are you a software engineer who is excited about writing clean, well-tested code that ships to production and impacts millions of customers? At Amazon, you will have the opportunity to build software that operates at massive scale while growing your technical skills alongside talented engineers. As a Software Development Engineer, you will contribute to the full lifecycle of software-from design and development through testing, deployment, and operations. You will tackle well-defined problems, learn new technologies and design patterns, and collaborate with your team to deliver solutions that create real value for customers. If you are a self-starter who thrives on learning and wants to make a meaningful impact early in your career, this is the role for you. 

Key job responsibilities

- Design, develop, test, deploy, and maintain software components that are high-quality, well-tested, and production-ready, collaborating with your team across the full software development lifecycle. 
 - Write logical, well-organized code using optimal data structures and algorithms, making thoughtful trade-offs between factors such as maintainability, efficiency, and complexity. 
 - Participate in code reviews and operational support, helping identify root causes of issues and advocating for improvements to software quality and reliability. 
 - Leverage generative artificial intelligence tools where appropriate to augment productivity, evaluating and refining outputs to ensure they meet quality standards and responsible practices. 
 - Collaborate with team members to refactor and improve existing software, contributing to a codebase that is easy for others to understand, extend, and maintain. 

A day in the life

You will start your day reviewing code changes from teammates and providing feedback during code reviews. From there, you might pick up a well-scoped feature, break it into components, and begin writing and testing your implementation. You will join standups and design discussions where you can ask questions, share progress, and learn from more experienced engineers. When operational issues arise, you will help troubleshoot and resolve them, building your understanding of the systems your team owns. 

About The Team

Our team is focused on building reliable, scalable software that directly improves the customer experience at Amazon. We value collaboration, continuous learning, and writing code we are proud of. You will work alongside engineers who are invested in helping you grow, whether through mentorship, pair programming, or constructive code reviews. We are excited about what lies ahead and are looking for curious, thoughtful engineers who want to grow with us. 

Basic Qualifications

- 1+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
 - Experience programming with at least one software programming language

Preferred Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. data.title: Lead Drive Control Engineer
data.description:
Job Description Summary

L'ingénierie des systèmes est une discipline d'ingénierie interfonctionnelle axée sur une approche, un état d'esprit et un processus. Toutes les activités qui tiennent compte des besoins à la fois commerciaux et techniques des clients dans le but de fournir un produit de qualité qui réponde aux besoins des utilisateurs. Discipline qui exécute un processus robuste de conception, de création et d'optimisation de systèmes, comprenant l'identification et la quantification des exigences système, la création de concepts de conception de système alternatifs, la réalisation d'études commerciales de conception, la sélection et la mise en œuvre des meilleures conceptions et la vérification que la conception est correctement intégrée et exécutée. Processus allant du concept à l'exploitation en passant par la production. 

Exerce une influence sur les opérations département et est responsable de la planification et/ou de l'exécution. Ce rôle jouit d'une certaine autonomie, mais est axé sur l'exécution d'activités au sein d'une discipline opérationnelle couverte par les pratiques et procédures fonctionnelles standard. Un certain discernement peut être nécessaire, mais généralement dans le cadre d'une orientation. 

Job Description

Rôles et responsabilités

- Identifie, développe, évalue, introduit et gère des solutions d'ingénierie répondant aux besoins technologiques en matière de contrôle de produits et de systèmes de contrôle. Applique la théorie du contrôle et la modélisation mathématique à la conception et au contrôle de systèmes avec les comportements souhaités. Comprend l'opérabilité, la définition des limites, l'optimisation du cycle, la logique de contrôle, les logiciels liés au contrôle, les capteurs, les algorithmes matériels et logiciels, ainsi que les informations en retour permettant de contrôler les performances des dispositifs, sous-systèmes et systèmes. 
 - Développer une connaissance approfondie d'une discipline technique. Se fonde sur une expérience antérieure et une expertise technique acquise pour mettre en œuvre une politique/stratégie. 
 - Compréhension approfondie des principaux facteurs opérationnels ; utilise cette compréhension pour accomplir son propre travail. Compréhension approfondie de la manière dont le travail de sa propre équipe s'intègre aux autres équipes et contribue à son domaine. 
 - Fait preuve de discernement et est en capacité de proposer différentes solutions en dehors des paramètres définis, dans le cadre d'une orientation. Se fonde sur une expérience antérieure et la formation professionnelle pour résoudre des tâches simples. Possède les compétences techniques et l'esprit d'analyse nécessaires à la résolution de problèmes. Peut utiliser plusieurs sources internes en dehors de sa propre équipe pour prendre des décisions. 
 - Un poste à ce niveau est susceptible d'être un contributeur individuel, avec des compétences interpersonnelles éprouvées ou un People Leader capable d'embaucher et de développer des talents. Fournit des conseils informels aux nouveaux membres de l'équipe. 

Qualifications De Base

- 
 - Pour les rôles en dehors des États-Unis - Ce rôle nécessite une expérience significative de la fonction et de la station de travail audio numérique. Connaissances de niveau équivalent à une licence dans une université accréditée (ou un baccalauréat avec une expérience dans un domaine pertinent). 
 - Pour les rôles aux États-Unis - Licence d'une université accrédité (ou diplôme d'études secondaires et/ou diplôme d'étude général avec au moins 4 ans d'expérience dans la fonction). 

Caractéristiques souhaitées

- Solides compétences en communication orale et écrite. Solides compétences relationnelles et de leadership. Capacité à influencer les autres et à diriger de petites équipes. Mener des initiatives d'envergure et d'impact modérés. Capacité à coordonner plusieurs projets simultanément. Identification efficace des problèmes et compétences en résolution de problèmes. Capacités d'analyse et d'organisation prouvées. Remarque : Pour se conformer aux exigences légales américaines en matière d'immigration et autres, il est nécessaire de préciser le nombre minimum d'années d'expérience requis pour tout poste basé aux États-Unis. Pour les rôles en dehors des États-Unis, pour assurer la conformité avec la législation applicable, les juristes doivent mentionner le niveau d'expérience requis et non PAS un nombre minimum d'années. Cette description de poste a pour but de fournir un guide détaillé du rôle. Toutefois, il n'est pas prévu de modifier ou de restreindre et/ou d'élargir de quelque manière que ce soit les tâches requises de chaque employé, telles qu'elles sont définies dans leur contrat de travail respectif et/ou convenues d'un commun accord entre un employé et son responsable.

data.title: AI Product Manager
data.description:
Product Manager - AI Platform

Experience: 9-12yrs

Location: Bangalore

About the Role

We are hiring a Product Engineering Manager to own the intersection of product, engineering velocity and software quality. The role is hands-on: you will be equally involved in product requirements, architecture, code review, API design, UX and production incidents. 

This is a leadership position for an engineer who established a strong individual contributor record before moving into management and continues to exercise technical judgment daily. The core responsibility is converting ambitious product requirements into shipped, production-grade software - quickly, predictably and with sustained attention to detail. 

Responsibilities

• Translate product requirements into clear, technically sound engineering plans, and drive features from definition through design, development, testing and production release. 

• Break ambiguous problems into concrete engineering tasks, identify blockers early and remove them. 

• Own delivery commitments, sustain execution velocity without compromising quality, and communicate risk early. 

• Establish engineering rituals for planning, code review, release and incident response. 

• Set and enforce coding and architectural standards, and review significant pull requests in depth. 

• Ensure meaningful automated test coverage, and drive observability, reliability and performance work. 

• Hold the line on detail: API contracts that do not hold up, missing edge cases and error handling, UX inconsistencies, redundant database queries, latency regressions, weak abstractions, and tests that do not

verify what matters. Working code is not the definition of done. 

• Ensure root causes are addressed rather than symptoms, and track and eliminate recurring production issues. 

• Manage technical debt continuously rather than through periodic cleanups. 

• Remain capable of reading complex code quickly, debugging difficult production issues, challenging architectural decisions, and writing prototypes or critical components when required. 

• Partner with Product Managers and designers; challenge requirements that are unclear or unnecessarily complex, and identify the simplest solution that delivers the intended customer value. 

• Balance product ambition, engineering complexity and time-to-market, and ensure the team understands why work is being undertaken, not only what to build. 

• Convert customer feedback into actionable engineering priorities. 

Required Skills

• 8+ years of software engineering experience, including at least one to two years of direct engineering leadership or team management. 

• A strong hands-on engineering background, with a demonstrated record as a high-quality individual contributor prior to moving into leadership. 

• Strong coding ability in Python, Java, Go, C++, TypeScript or a comparable modern language. 

• Excellent understanding of software architecture and engineering fundamentals. 

• Solid API, database and distributed systems fundamentals. 

• Experience building and shipping production software on modern cloud infrastructure. 

• Strong debugging and problem-solving ability across the application, data and infrastructure layers. 

• Clear written and verbal communication, and a consistently high standard of precision in technical work. 

Preferred Skills

• Experience delivering AI or ML-backed products; familiarity with LLM APIs, agentic workflows or RAG systems. 

• Experience with observability tooling and production incident management. 

• Familiarity with containerised deployment (Docker, Kubernetes) and a major cloud platform. 

• Experience in a high-growth or early-stage product environment. 

• Experience hiring, onboarding and developing engineers

data.title: Lead Drive Control Engineer
data.description:
Job Description Summary

Systems Engineering ist eine funktionsübergreifende technische Disziplin, die sich auf einen Ansatz, eine Denkweise und einen Prozess konzentriert. Alle Tätigkeiten, die sowohl die geschäftlichen als auch die technischen Anforderungen der Kunden berücksichtigen, mit dem Ziel, ein Qualitätsprodukt bereitzustellen, das die Anforderungen der Benutzer erfüllt. Die Disziplin zur Umsetzung eines soliden Prozesses zum Entwerfen, Erstellen und Optimieren von Systemen, der aus der Identifizierung und Quantifizierung von Systemanforderungen, der Erstellung alternativer Systementwurfskonzepte, der Durchführung von Design-Trade-off-Studien, der Auswahl und Implementierung der besten Entwürfe und der Überprüfung der Tatsache besteht, dass das Design ordnungsgemäß integriert ist und ausgeführt wird. Prozess, der vom Konzept über die Produktion bis zum Betrieb verläuft. 

Beeinflusst den Abteilungsbetrieb und ist verantwortlich für die Planung/Ausführung. Die Rolle hat eine gewisse Autonomie, konzentriert sich jedoch auf die Ausführung von Aktivitäten innerhalb einer operativen Disziplin, die durch funktionale Standardpraktiken und -verfahren abgedeckt wird. Möglicherweise ist ein gewisses Urteilsvermögen erforderlich, dies erfolgt jedoch in der Regel unter Anleitung. 

Job Description

Rollen und Verantwortlichkeiten

- Identifizieren, entwickeln, bewerten, führen ein und verwalten Engineering-Lösungen für die Anforderungen der Produkt- und Steuerungssystemtechnologie. Wenden die Steuerungstheorie und mathematische Modellierung auf Entwurfs- und Steuerungssysteme mit dem gewünschten Verhalten an. Beinhaltet Bedienbarkeit, Festlegen von Grenzen, Zyklusoptimierung, Steuerlogik, steuerungsbezogene Software, Sensoren, Hardware- und Softwarealgorithmen sowie Feedback zur Steuerung der Leistung von Geräten, Subsystemen und Systemen. 
 - Vertiefung der Kenntnisse einer technischen Disziplin. Verwendet vorherige Erfahrung und erworbenes technisches Fachwissen, um Richtlinien/Strategien umzusetzen. 
 - Fundiertes Verständnis der wichtigsten Geschäftstreiber; nutzt dieses Verständnis, um eigene Arbeit zu leisten. Vertiefte Kenntnisse darüber, wie sich die Arbeit des eigenen Teams in andere Teams integriert und zum Bereich beiträgt. 
 - Verwendet ein gewisses Maß an Urteilsvermögen und hat die Fähigkeit, verschiedene Lösungen außerhalb der festgelegten Parameter vorzuschlagen, aber mit Anleitung. Verwendet vorherige Erfahrung und die Ausbildung am Arbeitsplatz, um einfache Aufgaben zu lösen. Hat Zugriff auf die technischen Fähigkeiten und das analytische Denken, die zur Lösung von Problemen erforderlich sind. Kann mehrere interne Quellen außerhalb des eigenen Teams verwenden, um Entscheidungen zu treffen. 
 - Eine Stelle auf dieser Ebene ist wahrscheinlich ein einzelner Mitarbeiter mit nachgewiesenen zwischenmenschlichen Fähigkeiten oder Führungsnachwuchs, der Talente einstellen und entwickeln kann. Bietet informelle Anleitung für neue Teammitglieder

Grundqualifikationen

- Diese Rolle erfordert fortgeschrittene Erfahrung. Der Wissensstand ist vergleichbar mit einem Bachelor-Abschluss einer akkreditierten Universität oder Hochschule (oder einem Abitur mit relevanter Erfahrung). 

Gewünschte Eigenschaften

- Sehr gute mündliche und schriftliche Kommunikationsfähigkeiten. Ausgeprägte Sozialkompetenz und Führungsqualitäten. Fähigkeit, andere zu beeinflussen und kleine Teams zu führen. Initiativen von mittlerem Umfang und mittlerer Wirkung leiten. Fähigkeit, mehrere Projekte gleichzeitig zu koordinieren. Effektive Erkennung und Lösung von Problemen. Nachweisliche analytische und organisatorische Fähigkeiten. Hinweis: Um die Einwanderungsbestimmungen der USA und andere gesetzliche Anforderungen zu erfüllen, muss die Mindestanzahl der Jahre an Erfahrung angegeben werden, die für eine Tätigkeit in den USA erforderlich sind. Für Rollen außerhalb der USA sollten sich die JDs auf das für die Rolle erforderliche inhaltliche Erfahrungsniveau konzentrieren, um die Einhaltung der geltenden Rechtsvorschriften zu gewährleisten, und eine Mindestanzahl von Jahren sollte NICHT verwendet werden. Diese Stellenbeschreibung soll einen allgemeinen Leitfaden für die Rolle liefern. Sie soll jedoch nicht die von jedem Mitarbeiter gemäß dem jeweiligen Arbeitsvertrag und/oder gemäß einer anderweitigen Vereinbarung zwischen einem Mitarbeiter und seinem Vorgesetzten geforderten Pflichten ändern oder anderweitig einzuschränken/erweitern. 

Additional Information

Relocation Assistance Provided: Yes

Scope

 - Also, the individual will be responsible for analysing application behaviour and identify performance bottlenecks across application, database, infrastructure, and network layers. 

Technical Environment

- Performance Testing Tools: Jmeter
 - API/Application: REST APIs, JSON/XML, HTTP/HTTPS, Web applications, Microservices, Postman
 - Scripting & Development: JavaScript, Groovy, Python, Shell scripting
 - Databases: Oracle, MariaDb; SQL query analysis and database performance analysis
 - Database Performance: Oracle AWR/ASH, execution plans, SQL tuning, database CPU/memory/I/O analysis
 - Application & JVM Monitoring: JVM, Garbage Collection (GC), Heap/Thread Dumps, JProfiler, Eclipse MAT or equivalent tools

- Design and execute performance, load, stress, endurance, and scalability tests for enterprise applications. 
 - Develop and maintain JMeter/API performance test scripts, workload models, test data, and execution scenarios. 
 - Analyse application performance across application, database, JVM, infrastructure, and network layers. 
 - Monitor system behaviour during load tests and identify CPU, memory, database, JVM, I/O, and response-time bottlenecks.

data.description:
Job Description Summary

The Patient Care Solutions Mobile Center of Excellence (Mobile CoE) is focused on building secure, scalable and high-quality mobile solutions while establishing reusable capabilities, engineering patterns and development practices that can be adopted across multiple products. 

The Senior Software Engineer is a strong hands-on technical contributor responsible for the design, development, testing and delivery of mobile application features and shared mobile capabilities. The role works closely with Tech Leads, Architects, Product Owners, UX, Security, DevOps and engineering teams to deliver solutions aligned with Mobile CoE architecture and engineering standards. 

The individual should have strong mobile engineering fundamentals and demonstrate expertise in mobile architecture, performance, security, observability, automation, CI/CD, AWS cloud-integrated development and AI-assisted software engineering. 

Job Description

Essential Responsibilities

- Design, develop, test and deliver high-quality mobile application features, reusable components and shared capabilities. 
 - Collaborate with Product Owners, Architects, Tech Leads and UX teams to understand requirements, assess technical feasibility and translate requirements into implementable solutions. 
 - Participate actively in technical discussions, design reviews and architecture decisions, bringing a strong mobile engineering perspective. 
 - Apply established Mobile CoE architecture patterns, coding standards and engineering practices, while contributing improvements based on implementation experience. 
 - Build reusable mobile components, libraries and common capabilities that can be adopted across applications where appropriate. 
 - Maintain high code quality through clean design, code reviews, unit testing, automated quality checks and secure coding practices. 
 - Understand the end-to-end application architecture, APIs, AWS services and integrations while developing deep expertise in assigned components. 
 - Analyze and improve mobile application performance, reliability, security and user experience using appropriate profiling, diagnostics and engineering practices. 
 - Implement appropriate mobile security practices including authentication, authorization, secure storage, session/token management and protection of sensitive data. 
 - Build appropriate logging, telemetry, crash reporting and observability into mobile applications to support troubleshooting and operational monitoring. 
 - Contribute to automated build, test, CI/CD and release processes and continuously improve engineering efficiency. 
 - Troubleshoot complex technical issues, participate in root-cause analysis and implement sustainable corrective solutions. 
 - Adopt an AI-first engineering mindset, using AI-assisted tools throughout the SDLC for code generation, refactoring, debugging, test generation, code understanding, technical documentation and developer productivity. 
 - Identify opportunities to use AI to automate repetitive engineering activities, accelerate development and improve software quality, while ensuring appropriate human review and validation. 
 - Apply responsible AI-assisted development practices, ensuring generated code and recommendations are reviewed for correctness, security, maintainability and compliance. 
 - Share technical knowledge, reusable solutions, AI-enabled engineering practices and implementation learnings across the Mobile CoE. 

Desired Technical Skills / Experience

- Strong hands-on software engineering experience, preferably 7+ years, with significant experience in mobile application development. 
 - Strong experience with one or more modern mobile technologies such as Flutter, React Native, iOS/Swift or Android/Kotlin. 
 - Strong understanding of mobile application architecture, design patterns, state management, navigation, application lifecycle and API integration. 
 - Experience building reusable mobile components, SDKs, libraries or shared capabilities across applications. 
 - Strong knowledge of mobile application performance optimization including startup, responsiveness, memory/resource utilization and network performance. 
 - Good understanding of UX principles, accessibility and mobile design systems. 
 - Strong understanding of authentication, authorization, secure storage, encryption, session/token management and secure mobile development practices. 
 - Experience integrating mobile applications with REST APIs and AWS-hosted backend services. 
 - Experience with automated testing including unit, integration and mobile UI automation. 
 - Experience with mobile build automation and CI/CD pipelines. 
 - Experience with logging, telemetry, crash reporting, diagnostics and application performance monitoring. 
 - Working knowledge of AWS and cloud-integrated mobile architectures, with an understanding of reliability, performance, security and cost-conscious engineering. 
 - Experience with static code analysis, security scanning and vulnerability remediation. 
 - Strong understanding of Agile/SAFe software development practices. 
 - Strong practical experience using AI coding assistants and AI-enabled engineering tools for coding, refactoring, debugging, test generation, documentation and code review support. 
 - Ability to critically evaluate AI-generated solutions rather than accepting generated code by default, with appropriate attention to security, quality, maintainability and accuracy. 
 - Ability to identify opportunities where AI can improve developer productivity, engineering automation and software quality. 
 - Exposure to building or integrating AI-enabled application capabilities is an advantage. 
 - Experience developing healthcare, regulated or security-sensitive applications is preferred. 

Mobile CoE Mindset

- Think beyond a single application and identify opportunities for reuse and standardization across mobile products. 
 - Prefer common patterns and shared capabilities over application-specific solutions where appropriate. 
 - Contribute implementation learnings back into Mobile CoE standards, reference patterns and engineering practices. 
 - Help improve developer productivity through automation, AI-assisted engineering, tooling and common development practices. 
 - Collaborate across product teams to encourage consistent approaches to architecture, security, quality, performance and observability. 
 - Experiment with emerging mobile and AI engineering technologies, evaluate their practical value and help bring useful practices into the CoE. 
 - Share reusable approaches and engineering learnings so that improvements made for one product can benefit other mobile teams. 

Preferred Professional Training And Certifications

- Professional training or certifications related to iOS, Android, Flutter, React Native or other relevant mobile technologies. 
 - AWS cloud fundamentals or developer certification. 
 - Training or certification related to AI-assisted software development, application security, DevOps, Agile or software architecture is an advantage. 

Desired Professional Characteristics

- Strong ownership mindset with the ability to independently deliver complex technical assignments. 
 - Strong analytical, debugging and problem-solving skills. 
 - Collaborative approach and ability to work effectively across Product, Architecture, UX, Security, QA and DevOps teams. 
 - Proactive in identifying technical problems and proposing practical solutions.

Job Title: Verification & Validation Engineer (4-8 Years)

 - Proven experience in automation scripting using CAPL, Python, or Java.

data.description:
Job Description Summary

L'ingénierie des systèmes est une discipline d'ingénierie interfonctionnelle axée sur une approche, un état d'esprit et un processus. Toutes les activités qui tiennent compte des besoins à la fois commerciaux et techniques des clients dans le but de fournir un produit de qualité qui réponde aux besoins des utilisateurs. Discipline qui exécute un processus robuste de conception, de création et d'optimisation de systèmes, comprenant l'identification et la quantification des exigences système, la création de concepts de conception de système alternatifs, la réalisation d'études commerciales de conception, la sélection et la mise en œuvre des meilleures conceptions et la vérification que la conception est correctement intégrée et exécutée. Processus allant du concept à l'exploitation en passant par la production. 

Exerce une influence sur les opérations département et est responsable de la planification et/ou de l'exécution. Ce rôle jouit d'une certaine autonomie, mais est axé sur l'exécution d'activités au sein d'une discipline opérationnelle couverte par les pratiques et procédures fonctionnelles standard. Un certain discernement peut être nécessaire, mais généralement dans le cadre d'une orientation. 

Job Description

Rôles et responsabilités

- Identifie, développe, évalue, introduit et gère des solutions d'ingénierie répondant aux besoins technologiques en matière de contrôle de produits et de systèmes de contrôle. Applique la théorie du contrôle et la modélisation mathématique à la conception et au contrôle de systèmes avec les comportements souhaités. Comprend l'opérabilité, la définition des limites, l'optimisation du cycle, la logique de contrôle, les logiciels liés au contrôle, les capteurs, les algorithmes matériels et logiciels, ainsi que les informations en retour permettant de contrôler les performances des dispositifs, sous-systèmes et systèmes. 
 - Développer une connaissance approfondie d'une discipline technique. Se fonde sur une expérience antérieure et une expertise technique acquise pour mettre en œuvre une politique/stratégie. 
 - Compréhension approfondie des principaux facteurs opérationnels ; utilise cette compréhension pour accomplir son propre travail. Compréhension approfondie de la manière dont le travail de sa propre équipe s'intègre aux autres équipes et contribue à son domaine. 
 - Fait preuve de discernement et est en capacité de proposer différentes solutions en dehors des paramètres définis, dans le cadre d'une orientation. Se fonde sur une expérience antérieure et la formation professionnelle pour résoudre des tâches simples. Possède les compétences techniques et l'esprit d'analyse nécessaires à la résolution de problèmes. Peut utiliser plusieurs sources internes en dehors de sa propre équipe pour prendre des décisions. 
 - Un poste à ce niveau est susceptible d'être un contributeur individuel, avec des compétences interpersonnelles éprouvées ou un People Leader capable d'embaucher et de développer des talents. Fournit des conseils informels aux nouveaux membres de l'équipe. 

Qualifications De Base

- 
 - Pour les rôles en dehors des États-Unis - Ce rôle nécessite une expérience significative de la fonction et de la station de travail audio numérique. Connaissances de niveau équivalent à une licence dans une université accréditée (ou un baccalauréat avec une expérience dans un domaine pertinent). 
 - Pour les rôles aux États-Unis - Licence d'une université accrédité (ou diplôme d'études secondaires et/ou diplôme d'étude général avec au moins 4 ans d'expérience dans la fonction). 

Caractéristiques souhaitées

- Solides compétences en communication orale et écrite. Solides compétences relationnelles et de leadership. Capacité à influencer les autres et à diriger de petites équipes. Mener des initiatives d'envergure et d'impact modérés. Capacité à coordonner plusieurs projets simultanément. Identification efficace des problèmes et compétences en résolution de problèmes. Capacités d'analyse et d'organisation prouvées. Remarque : Pour se conformer aux exigences légales américaines en matière d'immigration et autres, il est nécessaire de préciser le nombre minimum d'années d'expérience requis pour tout poste basé aux États-Unis. Pour les rôles en dehors des États-Unis, pour assurer la conformité avec la législation applicable, les juristes doivent mentionner le niveau d'expérience requis et non PAS un nombre minimum d'années. data.title: BRIM Technical Architect
data.description:
What You'll Do: 

Own the technical architecture of the SAP BRIM platform - how it is built, integrated, and kept scalable over time. You define how the Order-to-Cash (O2C) solution is structured technically: the billing and subscription models at implementation level, the integration architecture, the cross-module technical coherence, and the extensibility patterns that keep the platform upgrade-safe and maintainable as Criteo's monetization evolves. 

Beyond delivery, you are a strategic thinking partner - contributing to the definition of the future billing platform: what monetization capabilities Criteo needs to build, what the platform should become, and how technical architecture choices today shape product options tomorrow. 

Main missions: 

- Own the end-to-end technical architecture across BRIM modules, ensuring cross-module coherence at implementation level (CI, SOM, CM, CC, FI-CA) within the O2C flow 
 - Define and own the billing and subscription model implementation: rating architecture, pricing and charging structures, contract and entitlement lifecycle at technical level. 
 - Own the integration architecture between BRIM, S/4HANA FI and non-SAP systems - interface contracts, data flows, error handling patterns, API and event-based integration. 
 - Ensure the platform remains extensible, upgrade-safe and Clean Core compliant - define the extensibility patterns (standard APIs, events) that govern how the ABAP Lead builds. 
 - Translate functional designs into implementable technical blueprints, surfacing constraints, trade-offs and platform limitations before build starts. 
 - Partner with the BRIM Product Lead to help defining the future billing platform vision - translating market, business and monetization evolutions into technical architecture directions and platform investment options. 

Tasks: 

- Define the technical implementation of monetization models: subscription structures, rating and pricing mechanics, billing cycle architecture, revenue and collection flows at system level. 
 - Design integration patterns and interface contracts (inbound/outbound, event-driven, API-based) between BRIM and adjacent systems; own technical decisions on error handling, retry, and reconciliation. 
 - Validate technical feasibility of functional designs produced by the Solution Architect; identify cross-module technical impacts and escalate conflicts or constraints before they reach build. 
 - Define extensibility standards and Clean Core guardrails for the ABAP Lead: which enhancement frameworks to use, where custom code is justified, how extensions are structured to remain upgrade-safe. 
 - Contribute to BRIM product roadmap discussions with the Product Lead: surface technical constraints, platform opportunities and build-vs-standard trade-offs that shape future product decisions. " 
 - Anticipate evolutions in Criteo's monetization model and translate them into forward-looking architecture options - new billing constructs, extensibility needs, integration patterns - before they become urgent delivery requirements. 
 - Provide technical architecture inputs to backlog refinement: effort drivers, implementation options, technical risks, dependency sequencing. 
 - Produce and maintain the BRIM technical architecture documentation: module interaction model, integration blueprint, master and transactional data architecture, key identifiers across BRIM and S/4HANA. 
 - Anticipate SAP platform evolutions (S/4HANA releases, BTP where applicable) and maintain a technical roadmap that keeps the BRIM estate extensible and forward-compatible. 
 - Lead and contribute to architecture workshops with Solution Architect, ABAP Lead and BRIM components Leads. 
 - Support delivery teams during complex build, test and hypercare phases on architecture-level technical issues. 

Who You Are: 

- 8+ years in SAP architecture and delivery, with deep end-to-end ownership of BRIM technical implementations. 
 - Strong cross-module expertise in SAP BRIM - with solid working knowledge of SOM, CC, CI and CM integration patterns. 
 - Proven track record designing and governing billing model architectures: subscription, rating, pricing, invoicing and collection flows at technical implementation level. 
 - Solid experience defining integration architectures between SAP BRIM / S/4HANA and cloud or non-SAP systems. 
 - Strong command of SAP extensibility frameworks (standard APIs, events) and Clean Core principles - able to set the standard others build to. 
 - Able to translate functional solution designs into technical blueprints and surface implementation constraints before they become delivery risks. 
 - Ability to think beyond delivery - engaging on product vision, monetization strategy and platform futures with business and product stakeholders, not just with engineering teams. 
 - Experience working in international, distributed and offshore environments; comfortable aligning remote technical teams to architectural decisions. 
 - Strong communication skills - able to engage both Business and Engineering stakeholders, and to make architecture trade-offs legible to non-architects. 

We acknowledge that many candidates may not meet every single role requirement listed above. If your experience looks a little different from our requirements but you believe that you can still bring value to the role, we'd love to see your application!

Who We Are: 

We're Criteo, the Commerce Intelligence Platform. Criteo helps businesses turn shopper signals into commerce outcomes while delivering more relevant experiences for shoppers. We use proprietary commerce intelligence and AI decisioning to drive relevance for shoppers and performance for businesses. 

At Criteo, our culture is as unique as it is diverse. From our offices across the globe or from the comfort of home, our 3, 600 Criteos collaborate together to build an open, impactful, and forward-thinking environment. 

We foster a workplace where everyone is valued, and employment decisions are based solely on skills, qualifications, and business needs-never on non-job-related factors or legally protected characteristics. 

What We Offer: 

🏢 Ways of working - Our hybrid model blends home with in-office experiences, making space for both. 

📈 Grow with us - Learning, mentorship & career development programs. 

💪 Your wellbeing matters - Health benefits, wellness perks & mental health support. 

🤝 A team that cares - Diverse, inclusive, and globally connected. 

💸 Fair pay & perks - Attractive salary, with performance-based rewards and family-friendly policies, plus the potential for equity depending on role and level. 

Additional benefits may vary depending on the country where you work and the nature of your employment with Criteo.

data.title: Deputy Director _ Global DevOps CoE Technical
data.description:
Overview

The DevSecOps CoE relies on a suite of internal tools and automation to govern the organisation's DevOps platforms at scale. This includes dashboards that surface platform health and usage, license consumption trackers, automated governance scripts that enforce controls across Azure DevOps and GitHub, and scheduled health checks that keep everything running cleanly. 

This role owns all of that. You will be the engineering lead and people manager for a small team of 2-3 backend/automation engineers, responsible for the architecture, delivery, and ongoing operation of the CoE's internal tooling. You design the backend systems, set up and manage the hosting infrastructure, mentor your engineers, and ensure the team ships reliably against a clear roadmap. 

This is a hands-on lead role - you are expected to contribute code, not just direct. You bring architecture thinking and engineering rigour to work that has historically been solved with ad hoc scripts, and you leave behind systems that are observable, maintainable, and actually documented. 

Responsibilities

- Backend Architecture & Engineering
 - Design the backend architecture for all internal CoE applications - API layer, data models, scheduler/worker patterns, storage, and integration points with Azure DevOps, GitHub, and enterprise systems. 
 - Write and review production-quality code in Python (primary) and/or Go or similar - the team's tooling stack, not prototype scripts. 
 - Establish engineering standards: code structure, testing approach, review process, dependency management, and deployment patterns that your team follows consistently. 
 - Lead the migration of legacy scripts into structured, maintainable services - proper error handling, logging, retry logic, and operational visibility built in from the start. 
 - Integrate with DevOps platform APIs (Azure DevOps REST, GitHub API, webhook events) to power automation and data pipelines. 
 - Infrastructure Setup & Ownership
 - Set up and manage the hosting infrastructure for internal applications - containerised workloads on Azure (AKS / Container Apps / App Service as appropriate), with IaC from day one. 
 - Own infra-as-code for all CoE tooling using Terraform or Bicep - no manual portal deployments that can't be reproduced. 
 - Configure CI/CD pipelines for internal applications - the CoE's own tooling must meet the same pipeline standards it enforces elsewhere. 
 - Implement secrets management, RBAC, and network controls for hosted applications in line with enterprise security policy. 
 - Set up monitoring, logging, and alerting for the internal platform (Azure Monitor, Application Insights, or equivalent) so the team knows when things break before stakeholders do. 
 - Team Leadership & Delivery
 - Lead and manage a team of 2-3 automation/backend engineers - task allocation, unblocking, code review, and keeping delivery on track. 
 - Mentor engineers day-to-day: pair programming, design feedback, code reviews, and raising the bar on engineering quality over time. 
 - Run a lightweight delivery process: maintain a clear backlog, prioritise with the CoE leadership, and give honest status updates on what is shipping and what is at risk. 
 - Write and maintain work items: user stories, tasks, and acceptance criteria in Azure DevOps Boards that reflect what is actually being built and why. 
 - Be the technical point of contact for CoE internal tooling - fielding questions from platform teams, security, and stakeholders about what the automation does and how it works. 
 - Governance Automation & Controls
 - Automate policy enforcement across Azure DevOps and GitHub: branch protection, pipeline controls, access reviews, and repo hygiene checks. 
 - Build detection and alerting for governance drift - flag when a policy is missing, a control is bypassed, or a configuration deviates from standard. 
 - Support compliance and audit processes by generating evidence, access reports, and configuration snapshots on demand or on schedule. 
 - Collaborate with Security, Risk, and Architecture teams to translate control requirements into implementable automation - not just translating policy into manual tasks. 

Qualifications

Experience & Qualifications: 

- 12-14 years of hands-on experience in DevOps engineering, platform automation, or backend/systems development. 
 - Proven track record building and owning internal tools or platform applications - not just pipeline configurations. 
 - Experience leading a small engineering team, including task management, code review, and mentoring. 
 - Deep familiarity with both Azure DevOps and GitHub - admin-level understanding of both platforms, not just using them as a developer. 
 - Strong Python development skills - enough to design and build a backend service, not just write scripts. 
 - Hands-on IaC experience (Terraform preferred) with deployed, production Azure infrastructure. 
 - Experience with containerisation (Docker) and running workloads in Kubernetes or equivalent orchestration. 

Preferred: 

- Experience building automation or governance tooling specifically for Azure DevOps or GitHub at enterprise scale. 
 - Exposure to DevSecOps frameworks, policy-as-code, or compliance automation. 
 - Familiarity with license governance, tooling cost tracking, or software asset management. 
 - Cloud certifications (AZ-204, AZ-400, AZ-305, or equivalent) are a plus.

data.title: Software Development Engineer, Tax Engine Services
data.description:
Description

You'll work on one of the world's largest transactional distributed systems, solving complex tax calculation challenges that impact millions of customers globally. Join a team building mission-critical services that process millions of requests per minute while maintaining accuracy and compliance across constantly evolving global tax regulations. 

Imagine building systems that power tax calculations for every Amazon transaction worldwide-from physical goods to digital services. In this role, you'll tackle the intricate challenge of computing correct tax amounts thousands of times per second while ensuring audit compliance across dozens of countries. You'll collaborate with peers across Amazon's business to design and operate highly scalable, reliable systems that handle hundreds of millions of records. Whether you're drawn to solving complex distributed systems problems or using technology to address real business challenges, this is an opportunity to make a tangible impact on a platform that touches billions of transactions annually. 

Key job responsibilities

- Design and implement scalable software solutions that calculate taxes accurately and efficiently across Amazon's global operations, handling millions of service requests per minute
 - Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand business requirements and translate them into technical solutions that meet tax compliance standards worldwide
 - Develop, test, and deploy high-quality distributed system software using software engineering best practices and modern development methodologies
 - Participate in the full software development lifecycle, including design reviews, code reviews, documentation, testing, and operational support of production systems
 - Contribute to system reliability and performance by monitoring production metrics, identifying optimization opportunities, and implementing improvements to ensure our services meet demanding scale and accuracy requirements

A day in the life

As a Software Development Engineer on our team, you'll engage with the full software development lifecycle-from initial design conversations through deployment and operations. You might start your day reviewing a proposal to optimize tax calculation performance, then move into code review with teammates, discussing architectural approaches to handle increased transaction volume. You'll write and test code in our Java, Linux, and Oracle-based environment, collaborate with engineers across different Amazon business units to understand their tax requirements, and participate in on-call rotations to ensure our services remain reliable. Your work directly influences how quickly and accurately customers receive tax information at checkout, and you'll see the real-world impact of your contributions through our monitoring and metrics. 

About The Team

We are a group of engineers committed to building and maintaining the tax platform that serves as the backbone for tax compliance across Amazon's global operations. Our team values technical depth, collaborative problem-solving, and a shared commitment to operational excellence. We work closely with business stakeholders, finance teams, and engineers across Amazon to understand evolving tax requirements and translate them into scalable solutions. We're focused on staying ahead of complex, ever-changing global tax regulations while continuously improving system performance and reliability. When you join us, you'll work alongside talented engineers who are passionate about distributed systems, take ownership of their work, and support one another in solving challenging problems. We're building the future of tax technology at scale, and we're excited to have you contribute your skills and perspective to this mission. 

Basic Qualifications

- 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
 - 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
 - Experience programming with at least one software programming language

Preferred Qualifications

- 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience

About Kaseya

Kaseya is the leading provider of AI-powered IT management and cybersecurity software, serving Managed Service Providers (MSPs) and internal IT organizations worldwide. Our comprehensive platform helps organizations efficiently manage, secure, and automate their IT environments, driving operational efficiency and long-term business success. 

Backed by Insight Partners, a leading global software investor, Kaseya has experienced sustained double-digit growth and continues to expand its global footprint. Today, Kaseya supports customers in more than 20 countries and manages over 15 million endpoints worldwide. 

Founded in 2000, Kaseya was built by builders - and we're still building. We look for people who create rather than wait, who see a hard problem and lean in, and who treat challenges as raw material. At Kaseya, everyone plays a role in shaping the future of IT: whether you're in engineering, product, sales, marketing, customer support, or operations, your work helps protect, defend, and optimize IT environments across the globe. 

We're building teams that grow, perform, and make an impact. If you're driven by the itch to make things better - a product, a process, a career - you'll fit right in. 

At Kaseya, we don't just raise the bar. We build it. 

Why Kaseya?

Join a fast-growing company transforming the IT management and cybersecurity industry. At Kaseya, we are modernizing how software is designed, built, tested, and operated-combining strong engineering fundamentals with AI-native development practices. 

As a Senior Staff Engineer, you will have the opportunity to shape not only our technology architecture, but also how engineering teams leverage AI to build high-quality software faster and more effectively. 

Join the Kaseya growth rocket ship and see how we are #ChangingLives!

Job Summary

We're hiring a Senior Software Engineer to provide hands-on technical leadership across our SaaS platforms and shared backend services. 

This role is for an engineer who combines deep expertise in Java, distributed systems, cloud architecture, and software design with a modern, AI-native approach to software engineering. 

You will lead complex initiatives across multiple teams, influence architecture and engineering standards, and remain deeply involved in implementation. You will also help define how engineering teams effectively use AI coding tools, including Claude Code, throughout the software development lifecycle-from understanding existing systems and designing solutions to implementation, testing, debugging, code review, documentation, and modernization. 

This is not a purely architectural role. We are looking for a technical leader who designs, codes, prototypes, reviews, mentors, and leads by example. 

Roles & Responsibilities

- Define and drive architecture for Java-based platform services, distributed systems, APIs, and event-driven applications across multiple product areas 
 - Lead complex technical initiatives spanning multiple engineering teams, services, and business domains 
 - Remain highly hands-on through architecture, prototyping, implementation of critical components, code reviews, debugging, and production troubleshooting 
 - Champion AI-native software engineering practices, using AI coding tools such as Claude Code to improve developer productivity, code quality, testing, debugging, documentation, and system understanding 
 - Establish effective patterns and guardrails for using AI-generated code in production engineering environments 
 - Help engineering teams evolve from traditional development workflows toward AI-assisted and agentic software development 
 - Identify opportunities where AI can accelerate modernization of legacy systems, test creation, refactoring, migration, and technical debt reduction 
 - Partner with Product, Engineering, Security, and Architecture leaders to translate business priorities into scalable technical solutions 
 - Guide the evolution of cloud-native architectures, microservices, data flows, integrations, and shared platform capabilities 
 - Drive improvements in system performance, availability, observability, security, and operational readiness 
 - Establish engineering standards and reusable patterns for Java development, API design, testing, CI/CD, AI-assisted development, and production operations 
 - Mentor Senior and Staff Engineers through architecture reviews, technical guidance, hands-on collaboration, and modern AI-enabled engineering practices 
 - Evaluate emerging engineering and AI technologies and determine where they can meaningfully improve our products and engineering organization

Required Qualifications

- 7+ years of software engineering experience building production SaaS applications, distributed systems, or enterprise software platforms 
 - 4+ years of experience developing production backend services using Java 
 - Strong hands-on coding skills and the ability to design, implement, review, debug, and operate complex production software 
 - Proven experience providing technical leadership across multiple engineering teams or product areas 
 - Experience designing and operating distributed systems on AWS, Azure, or GCP 
 - Experience leading architecture reviews and establishing engineering standards or practices adopted across multiple teams 
 - Demonstrated experience using AI-assisted coding tools as part of real software engineering workflows 
 - Ability to use AI effectively for code generation, codebase exploration, refactoring, testing, debugging, documentation, and technical problem-solving 
 - Strong understanding of software engineering fundamentals and the ability to critically review, validate, test, and improve AI-generated code 
 - Ability to mentor engineers and influence technical direction without relying solely on organizational authority

Preferred Qualifications

- Hands-on experience with Claude Code or similar agentic AI coding tools 
 - Experience with Java technologies such as Spring Boot, Spring Cloud, Hibernate, Kafka, or similar frameworks 
 - Experience designing cloud-native, microservices-based, or event-driven architectures 
 - Experience with relational databases such as PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQL Server, or Oracle 
 - Experience leading platform modernization, cloud migration, or large-scale re-architecture initiatives 
 - Experience using AI to accelerate modernization of large or legacy codebases 
 - Experience improving reliability, observability, performance, testing, or operational practices across production systems 
 - Experience integrating AI-enabled capabilities, LLMs, agents, or AI services into production software 
 - Experience developing engineering standards, workflows, or guardrails for AI-assisted software development 
 - Familiarity with modern AI engineering concepts such as LLM APIs, tool use, agents, RAG, evaluation, and prompt/context engineering 
 - Experience measuring and improving engineering productivity using AI-enabled development workflows

What Success Looks Like

A successful Senior Staff Engineer at Kaseya does more than design systems. You will: 

- Build: Stay close to the code and deliver critical technical solutions. 
 - Lead: Set technical direction and drive complex initiatives across teams. 
 - Modernize: Improve architecture, engineering practices, and legacy systems. 
 - Amplify: Use AI to increase the effectiveness and velocity of engineering teams. 
 - Mentor: Raise the technical capabilities of engineers around you. 
 - Own: Take responsibility for solutions from architecture and implementation through production operation. 

We are looking for engineers who see AI not as a replacement for engineering fundamentals, but as a powerful multiplier for exceptional engineers. 

Additional Information

Kaseya provides equal employment opportunity to all employees and applicants without regard to race, religion, age, ancestry, gender, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, citizenship status, physical or mental disability, veteran status, marital status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.
