We're an all-in-one financial services platform that brings together banking, high-yield savings, credit cards, point-of-sale lending, investing, and crypto in one place. We also partner with employers, HCM providers, gig platforms, and others to deliver embedded financial services to millions of employees and frontline workers. 

We're backed by Walmart, the world's largest retailer, and Ribbit Capital, one of fintech's most respected investors, giving us rare scale, distribution, and the opportunity to build something truly category-defining. 

But What Really Sets OnePay Apart Is How We Move. Our Customers Don't Have Time To Wait. . . And Neither Do We. This Place Moves Fast, And We're Looking For People Who Are

- Ready to run
 - Hungry and driven by urgency
 - Exceptional at what they do, with low ego
 - Comfortable operating in motion

The role

Software Engineers at OnePay build the products & systems that serve our customers and run our company. Besides writing, reviewing, and shipping code, engineers collaborate with others across the company, from product, design, and data to, customer support, ops, and compliance. Software Engineers at OnePay are highly technical, communicative, and emotionally intelligent. 

This Role Is Responsible For

- Working closely with other engineers to ship code. We enjoy collaboration and partnering on hard problems. 
 - Building and maintaining documentation. As a growing and remote organization, having the necessary docs are key to our success. 
 - Solving complex problems that arise at scale. We deal with real-world money movement, sensitive financial data at scale, and are creating novel financial mechanics with no real precedent. 

You bring

- 4+ years professional experience building, shipping - and growing - non-trivial products & services. 
 - Professional experience building, shipping - and growing - non-trivial products & services. 
 - We are hiring at all levels of seniority for backend engineers. 
 - Passion for your craft and care for the people you work with. You value quality across code, communication, and culture. 
 - An act-like-an-owner mentality. We have a bias toward taking action. 
 - A desire to keep growing your skills, and an ability to learn quickly. We hope you'll be here for a while, and there's no better investment than in our people. 
 - The Triple H Factor: Hungry, Humble, Honest

Tools We Use

We use Typescript front to back, with node and NestJS frameworks for server code and React Native for our iOS, Android, and Web clients. We run on a highly distributed cloud-native stack with Kubernetes and AWS, and scale and resiliency are at the heart of everything we build. We also embrace agentic development, so engineers have their choice of a variety of models and agent harnesses, including Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, and more to fit their workflow. While you don't need experience with our exact stack, familiarity with modern software engineering practices will help you ramp up quickly. 

What We Offer

- Competitive salary, stock options, and benefits from Day 1
 - Comprehensive health insurance coverage (health insurance, accident and disability insurance, term life insurance), including mental health support and wellness programs
 - Hybrid work model (Bengaluru office three days a week), various time off programs (vacation, sick, other paid leaves, and paid regional holidays)
 - Monthly transport and work-from-home allowances
 - A high-growth, mission-driven, inclusive culture where your work has real impact

Standard Interview Process

Our Process Varies By Role. Most Candidates Go Through

- AI-assisted initial screen
 - Interview with Talent Partner
 - Technical or Hiring Manager Interview
 - Team Interview
 - Executive Interview
 - Offer!

Equal Employment Opportunity

To build technology and products that are used and loved by people and solve real-world problems, we need to build a team with many different perspectives and experiences. We are an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply. Applicants in need of special assistance or accommodation during the interview process or in accessing our website may contact us at talent@onepay. com.

data.title: Principal Software Engineer
data.description:
Make Your Mark

As a Principal Software Engineer, you will play a crucial role in delivering high quality releases to our customers by defining application architecture, designing, developing, troubleshooting, maintaining, optimizing, and scaling BlackLine's cloud-based backend services and driving innovation into our product suite. In this role, you will work with management to identify strategic directions for system architecture. You will research, test, benchmark and evaluate new technologies, propose scaling solutions, collaborate with other teams to define, and build new features, optimize existing features while writing elegant code, coaching, and mentoring less experienced software engineers and communicating with people at all levels. In this position, every bit of your software design skill be drawn upon in order to drive towards and implement best of breed features in a rapid iterative environment. Your attention to detail, tenacity, and creative problem-solving and thinking ahead will directly impact the company's success, as well as the success of your peers across the organization. If you have a passion for delivering products that make a difference, are driven to make things better in all that you do and are eager to work in a collaborative agile environment where Developers are dedicated to solving customer problems and innovating, you will be a great fit for the team. 

You'll Get To

We are looking for an accomplished, hands-on Principal Engineer with 18+ years of software engineering experience and a strong record of setting technical direction in Agentic AI, Generative AI systems and Software/Data engineering. This is the most senior individual contributor role on the Agentic AI platform. You will set the multi-year technical vision and own the architecture across products, while staying close enough to the code to make the critical calls. You will guide Senior Staff Engineers, Staff Engineers and Technical Leads across several teams. 

The ideal candidate has led 5+ enterprise-scale AI programs from strategy and solution design through to production at scale, and has shaped platform architecture that several product teams build on. You can define an organization-wide AI architecture strategy and present it to executives, and you can also prototype and write production-grade Python when a problem needs it. You bring the vision to set direction across teams, the judgment to make high-stakes architecture and investment decisions, and the credibility to raise the engineering bar across the company. 

The role spans strategy, architecture and execution. You will set the AI platform roadmap, define the governance and trust frameworks that make agents enterprise-ready on a secure, compliant financial platform, and establish the engineering standards that every AI product team follows. 

Key Responsibilities

Technical Strategy & Vision

- Define and own the multi-year technical strategy and architecture roadmap for the Agentic AI platform across all product lines. 
 - Make build-vs-buy, technology selection and platform investment decisions, and present the trade-offs, risks and ROI to executive leadership. 
 - Track the agentic AI landscape: frameworks, protocols, models, regulation. Turn those shifts into strategic bets and platform direction. 
 - Identify new opportunities where AI can deliver business value across product areas, and shape them into fundable programs. 

Architecture Leadership

- Own the end-to-end architecture of the Agentic AI system: agent registry, policy engine, metrics ingestion pipeline, anomaly detection and HITL orchestration. 
 - Define the reference architecture for multi-agent systems: trust tier boundaries (T0-T3), separation of concerns, fault isolation and full observability. 
 - Set organization-wide patterns for data flows, integrations (REST, gRPC, SSE, event-driven) and storage strategies for AI workloads in a multi-tenant FinTech environment. 
 - Own the design principles for durable DAG execution, pause and resume of long-running financial close workflows, event-sourced audit trails and SLA-tracked HITL approval gates. 
 - Run the architecture governance process: ADRs, cross-team design reviews and production readiness assessments for critical systems. 

Technical Leadership & Organizational Influence

- Split the platform into programs and workstreams. Assign ownership to Senior Staff and Staff Engineers, with clear API contracts, interface definitions and success metrics. 
 - Act as the senior technical authority for Engineering, Product, Security, Compliance, Finance and Data Platform leaders, and align architecture decisions across organizations. 
 - Represent the AI Platform in executive and cross-functional technical forums, and externally at industry events, through publications and in partner discussions. 
 - Find and resolve cross-team technical dependencies and systemic risks early in planning. 

Mentorship & Talent Development

- Grow Senior Staff Engineers, Staff Engineers and Technical Leads into the next generation of technical leaders through architecture working sessions, design clinics and 1: 1 coaching. 
 - Review designs from senior engineers. Find gaps in governance, observability or compliance thinking and guide them to better solutions rather than overriding them. 
 - Shape technical hiring standards and help attract top senior talent to the organization. 

Engineering Standards & Governance

- Define and drive adoption of engineering standards across all AI product teams: agent identity patterns, audit trail requirements, HITL design principles, Kafka topic design and eval harness setup. 
 - Set the quality bars: performance benchmarks, eval thresholds, observability standards and security posture. 
 - Own the agent governance and certification framework, including the T1 agent certification pipeline and its evaluation harnesses for model quality, factuality and safety at scale. 
 - Drive the production rollouts and release readiness for all releases
 - Support the on-call and be the first point of contact for any incidents reported internally or from customers

Hands-on Technical Depth

- Step in directly on the hardest problems with code, prototypes, design sketches or paired debugging: novel system design, complex integrations, critical production incidents. This is not a review-only role. 
 - Guide the design and delivery of intelligent agents for complex, multi-step financial reasoning, using ReAct, Plan-and-Execute and other advanced reasoning strategies. 
 - Set the orchestration strategy across LangGraph, Temporal, Google Workflows or equivalent, with documented architectural reasoning. 
 - Define deployment architecture on GCP (Vertex AI Agent Builder, Cloud Run, GKE) or AWS/Azure equivalents, including Kubernetes namespace isolation for T1 certified partner agents. 
 - Shape MCP (Model Context Protocol) server and client patterns for external agent integration (T2/T3 trust tiers via SSE/HTTPS). 
 - Guide RAG architecture with vector stores (Pinecone, Weaviate, pgvector) for retrieval over domain-specific financial documents. 
 - Lead model strategy across foundation models (Gemini, GPT-4, Claude), covering fine-tuning, prompt engineering and evaluation for accounting tasks such as close commentary and variance explanation. 
 - Own the inference cost strategy: caching, batching, model routing and quantization. Keep token costs visible in Control Tower. 

Required

What You'll Bring: 

- 18+ years of software engineering experience, including significant time as a senior or principal-level technical leader. 
 - A record of setting technical strategy and architecture across multiple teams or product lines. 
 - Led 5+ enterprise-scale AI/ML or GenAI programs from strategy through to production at scale. 
 - Deep expertise in agentic AI architectures, multi-agent orchestration, LLM evaluation and AI governance. 
 - Strong hands-on proficiency in Python and distributed systems design. 
 - Extensive experience with cloud-native architecture on GCP, AWS or Azure, including Kubernetes and event-driven systems such as Kafka. 
 - Proven ability to influence executives and align technical direction across Engineering, Security, Compliance and Business stakeholders. 
 - Experience mentoring Senior Staff and Staff Engineers into senior technical leaders. 

Preferred

- Experience building AI systems in regulated industries: FinTech, financial close, accounting or audit. 
 - Familiarity with SOX, audit trail and compliance-by-design patterns. 
 - Industry visibility through patents, publications, conference talks or open-source contributions. 

Thrive At BlackLine Because You Are Joining

- A technology-based company with a sense of adventure and a vision for the future. Every door at BlackLine is open. Just bring your brains, your problem-solving skills, and be part of a winning team at the world's most trusted name in Finance Automation!
 - A culture that is kind, open, and accepting. It's a place where people can embrace what makes them unique, and the mix of cultural backgrounds and varying interests cultivates diverse thought and perspectives. 
 - A culture where BlackLiner's continued growth and learning is empowered. BlackLine offers a wide variety of professional development seminars and inclusive affinity groups to celebrate and support our diversity. 

BlackLine is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, gender identity or expression, race, ethnicity, age, religious creed, national origin, physical or mental disability, ancestry, color, marital status, sexual orientation, military or veteran status, status as a victim of domestic violence, sexual assault or stalking, medical condition, genetic information, or any other protected class or category recognized by applicable equal employment opportunity or other similar laws. 

BlackLine recognizes that the ways we work and the workplace itself has shifted. We innovate in a workplace that optimizes a combination of virtual and in-person interactions to maximize collaboration and nurture our culture. Candidates who live within a reasonable commute to one of our offices will work in the office at least 3 days a week. 

Accommodations

BlackLine is committed to creating an inclusive and accessible experience for all candidates. If you require a reasonable accommodation that would better enable your success during the application or interview process, please complete this form.

Job Title: Senior Developer

Locations: Remote/Hybrid - candidates must be based in Hyderabad, Mumbai, Pune, or Bangalore

Get To Know Us: 

As a leading financial services and healthcare technology company based on revenue, SS&C is headquartered in Windsor, Connecticut, and has more than 27, 000 employees across 35 countries. Approximately 20, 000 financial services and healthcare organizations-from some of the world's largest companies to small and mid-market firms-rely on SS&C for expertise, scale, and technology.

- Flexibility: Remote/Hybrid Work Model and Business Casual Dress Code, including jeans

 - Diversity & Inclusion: A workplace committed to welcoming, celebrating, and thriving on diversity 
 - Training: Hands-on, team-customized learning opportunities, including SS&C University 
 - Extra Perks: Diwali voucher and monthly remunerated Rewards and Recognition program

The Role: 

We are looking for a deeply technical, hands-on Blue Prism specialist who can work across automation development, production operations, solution architecture, platform engineering, and technical problem-solving. 

This is an individual contributor role. It is not a delivery-management, project-management, or people-management position. The successful candidate will be expected to personally design, build, troubleshoot, deploy, support, and improve enterprise-grade Blue Prism solutions. 

This role is suited to engineers who enjoy working directly with technology, solving complex production issues, understanding systems end to end, and expanding their skills across multiple technologies as the automation landscape evolves. 

What You Will Get To Do: 

- Design, build, test, deploy, and support complex enterprise automation solutions using Blue Prism 
 - Own automation solutions across their complete lifecycle, including discovery, feasibility assessment, design, development, release, production support, optimization, and retirement 
 - Develop reusable, scalable, and maintainable Blue Prism processes and business objects 
 - Work extensively with Process Studio, Object Studio, Control Room, Work Queues, Schedules, Credentials, Environment Variables, Releases, and Runtime Resources 
 - Design robust exception-handling, recovery, retry, logging, alerting, and operational-support frameworks 
 - Troubleshoot complex automation failures across Blue Prism, applications, databases, APIs, virtual machines, credentials, and infrastructure components 
 - Perform root-cause analysis for recurring production issues and implement permanent technical fixes 
 - Monitor live automations, analyse operational performance, and improve stability, resilience, recoverability, and throughput 
 - Design automation architecture for new and existing processes, including component design, integration patterns, deployment models, and support models 
 - Review and refactor poorly designed, unstable, or difficult-to-maintain automation solutions 
 - Integrate Blue Prism with web applications, Windows applications, Java applications, mainframe systems, Citrix environments, APIs, databases, file systems, Microsoft Excel, Microsoft Outlook, and enterprise platforms 
 - Build and consume REST and SOAP services and work with XML, JSON, authentication, certificates, tokens, and secure credentials 
 - Work closely with infrastructure, architecture, information security, database, application-support, and business teams to resolve technical dependencies 
 - Support Blue Prism environment upgrades, migrations, configuration changes, patching, capacity planning, and platform improvements 
 - Participate in technical design reviews and challenge solutions that are not scalable, secure, supportable, or operationally resilient 
 - Create clear technical documentation, including solution designs, operational runbooks, deployment instructions, support procedures, and troubleshooting guides 
 - Conduct technical code reviews and enforce Blue Prism engineering standards and reusable design patterns 
 - Support release, change, incident, and problem-management activities for production automations 
 - Contribute to automation engineering standards, platform governance, reusable frameworks, and Centre of Excellence practices 
 - Evaluate and learn additional technologies that complement Blue Prism and improve automation capability 
 - Work hands-on with adjacent technologies such as APIs, SQL, scripting, cloud services, monitoring, and platform tooling 
 - Take full technical ownership of assigned solutions without relying on separate development, support, or architecture teams to solve core engineering problems 
 - Continuously expand technical capability by learning and applying multiple technologies based on business and platform needs

What You Will Bring: 

- 7+ years of overall technology experience, with substantial hands-on experience developing enterprise automations using Blue Prism 
 - At least 5 years of recent, continuous, hands-on Blue Prism development experience 
 - Strong practical expertise in Blue Prism Process Studio and Object Studio 
 - Deep understanding of Blue Prism application modelling, spying techniques, dynamic attributes, wait stages, collections, work queues, environment variables, credentials, schedules, sessions, and runtime resources 
 - Demonstrated experience building complex Blue Prism solutions rather than only maintaining, monitoring, or coordinating automation projects 
 - Strong experience supporting Blue Prism automations in production environments 
 - Proven ability to diagnose failures involving Blue Prism, target applications, virtual machines, databases, APIs, access permissions, credentials, certificates, and infrastructure 
 - Strong understanding of exception handling, retry design, recovery stages, logging, auditability, transaction management, and operational resilience 
 - Experience designing reusable Blue Prism components, frameworks, templates, and utility objects 
 - Strong understanding of enterprise automation architecture and the technical dependencies required to run Blue Prism at scale 
 - Experience integrating Blue Prism with REST APIs, SOAP services, XML, JSON, databases, file systems, and enterprise applications 
 - Good working knowledge of SQL, including the ability to write queries, analyse data, troubleshoot database-related issues, and support integrations 
 - Experience with at least one programming or scripting technology such as C#, . NET, Python, PowerShell, JavaScript, or VBA 
 - Ability to read and troubleshoot code, scripts, API payloads, logs, configuration files, and database queries 
 - Experience automating browser-based, desktop, Java, Citrix, virtual desktop, and legacy applications 
 - Understanding of Blue Prism infrastructure, including application servers, interactive clients, runtime resources, databases, virtual machines, connectivity, and environment configuration 
 - Experience with production monitoring, incident management, problem management, change management, and release management 
 - Strong understanding of SDLC, Agile delivery, release controls, security controls, and enterprise development standards 
 - Ability to independently convert business requirements into technically sound automation designs 
 - Ability to assess automation feasibility, identify technical risks, estimate complexity, and recommend practical solutions 
 - Strong debugging, analytical, and root-cause-analysis skills 
 - High level of ownership and willingness to remain hands-on throughout the solution lifecycle 
 - Willingness and ability to learn multiple technologies beyond Blue Prism 
 - Ability to adapt to new tools, platforms, programming languages, integration methods, and automation technologies based on business needs 
 - Strong written and verbal communication skills, particularly when explaining technical issues and design decisions 
 - Ability to work effectively with globally distributed technical and business teams

This Role May Not Be Suitable for You If: 

- Your recent experience has primarily been in project management, delivery management, team management, or stakeholder coordination 
 - You have worked mainly as a Blue Prism Control Room operator or production-monitoring analyst 
 - You have limited recent hands-on experience building Blue Prism processes and business objects 
 - You prefer to hand off architecture, development, deployment, or production troubleshooting to separate teams 
 - You are looking only for a narrowly defined Blue Prism development role and are not interested in learning additional technologies 
 - You are not comfortable personally investigating and resolving complex technical and production issues 
 - Your experience is primarily with other RPA platforms and you have only limited exposure to Blue Prism

Preferred Qualifications: 

- Blue Prism Developer, Professional Developer, Technical Architect, or equivalent certification 
 - Experience working in large-scale, regulated enterprise environments 
 - Experience with Blue Prism platform upgrades, migrations, disaster recovery, infrastructure design, or environment administration 
 - Experience with Blue Prism Hub, Interact, Capture, or Process Intelligence 
 - Experience with cloud platforms such as Microsoft Azure or Amazon Web Services 
 - Exposure to CI/CD concepts, automated deployments, monitoring tools, and DevOps practices 
 - Experience working with financial services, healthcare, insurance, banking, or other regulated industries

We encourage applications from people of all backgrounds, enabling us to bring diverse perspectives to our thinking, decisions, and conversations. 

Unless explicitly requested or approached by SS&C Technologies, Inc. or any of its affiliated companies, the company will not accept unsolicited resumes from headhunters, recruitment agencies, or fee-based recruitment services. 

Applications will be accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.

data.title: Principal AI Engineer nterprise Transformation
data.description:
Organization OverviewCompany Description

QAD | Redzone is building an enterprise AI platform to support AI-enabled and agentic workflows across the organisation. The AI Centre of Excellence (CoE) is accountable for turning that ambition into deployed, measured, production workflows across priority business functions. 

The CoE is small, senior and high-leverage. It sets architecture and standards, builds reusable capability, and delivers through a combination of internal engineering and external implementation partners. This is one of six foundational hires and the first dedicated engineering hire in the team. 

Job Description

The Senior AI Engineer is the primary builder in the CoE. You will take prioritised workflows from architecture and PRD through to working, evaluated, production-grade AI systems - and, just as importantly, factor what you build into a reusable component library so that the fifth workflow costs a fraction of the first. 

This is an applied engineering role with unusually high leverage. You are not building one product; you are building the components, patterns and reference implementations that internal engineers and external partner pods will use to build many. The work spans retrieval, agent orchestration, evaluation, and the unglamorous production engineering - latency, cost, failure handling, observability - that separates a demo from a system the business can depend on. 

Where this role sits

Reports to: Head of the AI Centre of Excellence

Technical direction from: Lead AI Architect - you will work alongside them daily, and you are expected to push back when a design will not survive contact with production

Works with: The functional AI Engagement Specialists who own the workflows, PRDs and quality bar for the business functions in scope

Also partners with QAD engineering teams, Data & Platform Engineering, Security & GRC, and external system integrators

Scope: Foundational engineering hire. Expect to set the engineering standard, mentor subsequent hires, and review partner-delivered code. 

Key Responsibilities

Building AI and agentic workflows

- Build production AI and agentic workflows end to end - from PRD and architecture through implementation, evaluation, release and iteration in production. 
 - Design and implement agent orchestration: multi-step flows, tool and API invocation, planning and routing, state and memory, retries, fallbacks, timeouts and human-in-the-loop checkpoints. 
 - Make the judgement call on deterministic control flow versus model-driven control flow - and default to the former wherever it produces the same outcome more reliably and more cheaply. 
 - Integrate with enterprise systems - ERP, CRM, support, services delivery, knowledge and data platforms - including systems with imperfect APIs and imperfect data. 

Retrieval and context engineering

- Own the retrieval stack: corpus onboarding, document parsing, chunking strategy, embedding selection, hybrid lexical and vector search, reranking, metadata filtering and query transformation. 
 - Implement permission-aware retrieval so that a user or an agent can only ever retrieve what that identity is entitled to see - non-negotiable in an enterprise context. 
 - Handle freshness and incremental indexing so that retrieval reflects the state of the business rather than a snapshot from onboarding day. 
 - Measure retrieval quality explicitly and treat it as a tunable subsystem with its own metrics, not as an assumption. 

Model selection, tuning and evaluation

- Select, tune and route models across tiers based on measured quality, latency and cost - not on reputation or recency. 
 - Own prompt engineering, versioning, structured output and context strategy as versioned, tested artefacts under source control. 
 - Apply fine-tuning, adapters or distillation only where evidence shows the return justifies the operating burden - and be able to make that argument either way. 
 - Build the evaluation harness: golden datasets, offline evaluation, LLM-as-judge with human calibration, regression suites running in CI, and online quality monitoring with structured feedback capture. 
 - Work with the Engagement Specialists to turn a business quality bar into measurable criteria - and be honest when a workflow does not clear it. 

The reusable component library

- Design, build and maintain the shared component library - SDKs, shared services, templates, reference implementations and documentation - that both internal engineers and partner pods build against. 
 - Treat internal engineers and SI teams as customers of your library: versioning, backwards compatibility, examples, and documentation good enough that people use it without asking you. 
 - Review partner-delivered code and designs for conformance, quality and maintainability. 

Production engineering and operations

- Meet explicit latency and cost budgets per workflow, using caching, batching, streaming, model tiering and prompt efficiency. 
 - Build for graceful degradation: provider outages, rate limits, backpressure, partial failures and safe fallbacks. 
 - Implement observability for non-deterministic systems - full step-level tracing, token and cost telemetry, quality dashboards, and a triage path for incidents where nothing crashed but the output was wrong. 
 - Own infrastructure as code, CI/CD, environment promotion, secret and credential handling, and testing discipline for everything the CoE ships. 
 - Participate in the operational support model for live AI workflows, including post-incident review and remediation. 

Craft and team

- Set the engineering standard for the CoE and raise it as the team grows. 
 - Mentor subsequent engineering hires and partner engineers. 
 - Document decisions and trade-offs so that the next engineer inherits reasoning, not just code. 

Qualifications

What we are looking for

Essential

- 6+ years of professional software engineering, including 2+ years building and operating production LLM or GenAI systems - systems with real users and real operating cost, not notebooks or proofs of concept. 
 - Excellent Python, plus working competence in at least one other language (TypeScript, Go, Java or similar). 
 - Genuine production retrieval experience - you have built a RAG or hybrid search system, measured it, found it wanting, and improved it. 
 - Agent orchestration experience with frameworks such as LangGraph, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel, Google ADK, Strands, CrewAI or equivalent - together with the judgement to know when a framework is the wrong answer. 
 - Strong AWS and/or GCP experience, including managed AI services (Bedrock, SageMaker, Vertex AI or equivalent) alongside core compute, serverless, networking, IAM and managed data services. 
 - API design and enterprise integration, including authentication and authorisation patterns - OAuth 2. 0 / OIDC, service-to-service authentication, and delegated or on-behalf-of access. 
 - Containerisation, infrastructure as code (Terraform, CDK or equivalent), CI/CD and real testing discipline. 
 - Evaluation rigour - you can define what "good" means numerically for a subjective task, defend the definition, and act on the result. 
 - Cost and latency awareness as a design instinct, not an afterthought raised by finance. 
 - Clear written communication - design notes, documentation and honest status. 
 - Comfort with ambiguity and shifting priorities in an early-stage function. 

Strongly Preferred

- Vector and hybrid search infrastructure at production scale - OpenSearch, pgvector, Vertex AI Search, Elasticsearch, Pinecone, Weaviate or similar. 
 - Evaluation and observability tooling - LangSmith, Langfuse, Phoenix, Braintrust, Ragas, DeepEval or equivalent. 
 - Multi-tenant SaaS engineering, and the data isolation discipline that comes with it. 
 - ERP, manufacturing or supply chain data experience. 
 - Classical ML and MLOps background - feature stores, model registries, monitoring and drift. 
 - Fine-tuning, parameter-efficient adaptation, or model serving and optimisation. 
 - Experience building internal platforms or SDKs consumed by other engineers. 
 - Open-source contribution in the AI engineering ecosystem. 

The technical environment

A predominantly AWS estate with a meaningful GCP footprint, multi-tenant SaaS products, ERP and manufacturing data, and a heterogeneous set of enterprise systems across CRM, support, services delivery, marketing and data platforms. Engineering capacity is a mix of internal team and external implementation partners. 

The AI toolchain is not fixed. You will help select it - and then live with the consequences, which is the correct incentive. 

What This Role Is Not

- Not a prompt engineering role. Prompting is one component of a system that also has retrieval, orchestration, evaluation, infrastructure and an operating cost. 
 - Not a research scientist role. We are not training foundation models. We are shipping reliable systems on top of them. 
 - Not a specification-writing role. You will build, and you will read partner code line by line. 
 - Not a role where quality is somebody else's problem. If it goes to production, you own how well it works. 

What Success Looks Like

First 3 months

- The first prioritised workflow in production or at production readiness, with a working evaluation harness behind it. 
 - Baseline engineering standards operating - repository structure, CI/CD, environments, tracing, secret handling. 
 - A shared understanding with the architect and the Engagement Specialists of what "good" means, expressed as numbers. 

First 6 months

- The first version of the reusable component library in use - by you, by internal engineers, and by at least one partner pod. 
 - Multiple workflows live, with quality, latency and cost per transaction instrumented and visible. 
 - Regression evaluation running in CI, so a change that degrades quality fails before release rather than in front of a customer. 

First 12 months

- Demonstrably lower build cost and cycle time for each successive workflow, attributable to reuse. 
 - A production estate that is operable by the team - monitored, documented, supported, and not dependent on any one person. 
 - Partner-delivered code that meets the same standard as internal code, because the standard and the review are real. 

How We Assess

- Technical conversation on a production AI system you built - architecture, evaluation approach, what broke, what you would do differently. 
 - Practical exercise in retrieval or agent orchestration, discussed rather than graded in isolation. 
 - Code and design review - you review something of ours, we review something of yours. 
 - Collaboration interview with the CoE and a functional stakeholder. 

Additional Information

- Your health and well being are important to us at QAD. We provide programs that help you strike a healthy work-life balance. 
 - Opportunity to join a growing business, launching into its next phase of expansion and transformation. 
 - Collaborative culture of smart and hard-working people who support one another to get the job done. 
 - An atmosphere of growth and opportunity, where idea-sharing is always prioritized over level or hierarchy. 
 - Compensation packages based on experience and desired skill set

About QAD

QAD | Redzone is redefining manufacturing and supply chains through its intelligent, adaptive platform that connects people, processes, and data into a single System of Action. With three core pillars - Redzone (frontline empowerment), Adaptive Applications (the intelligent backbone), and Champion AI (Agentic AI for manufacturing) - QAD | Redzone helps manufacturers operate with Champion Pace, achieving measurable productivity, resilience, and growth in just 90 days. 

QAD is committed to ensuring that every employee feels they work in an environment that values their contributions, respects their unique perspectives and provides opportunities for growth regardless of background. QAD's DEI program is driving higher levels of diversity, equity and inclusion so that employees can bring their whole self to work. 

We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and do not discriminate against any employee or applicant for employment because of race, color, sex, age, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, status as a veteran, and basis of disability or any other federal, state or local protected class.

data.title: LLM & Agentic AI Performance Engineer
data.description:
Job Details

Job Description: 

The Role And Impact

Join Intel's Data Center AI organization and help shape how LLM and Agentic AI workloads perform on Intel platforms. 

Our team operates at a unique intersection of core performance optimization, AI frameworks, and customer-facing AI solutions. We bridge the gap between teams that deeply understand silicon and benchmarking and teams building real-world AI solutions, turning performance insights into software optimizations that developers and customers can use. 

In this role, you will own end-to-end performance characterization and optimization of LLM and Agentic AI workloads, from Python-level frameworks and inference runtimes down to Linux, system architecture, and hardware performance counters. 

This is not simply a benchmarking role. Benchmarking tells us what the number is. Your job is to understand why the number is what it is, identify the hardware or software bottleneck, and determine what needs to change to remove it. 

Your work will translate into code contributions, framework optimizations, best-known configurations (BKCs), customer-ready solutions, and insights that help influence future Intel hardware and software. 

If you enjoy working across the complete AI stack, from agent frameworks and LLM serving engines to NUMA, memory bandwidth, cache behavior, and silicon counters, this role provides an opportunity to work at that intersection. 

About The Team

The AI Solutions and Toolkit Engineering team is part of Intel's Data Center organization, focused on enabling modern AI workloads and solutions on Intel platforms. 

We work across the AI ecosystem, collaborating with AI framework and runtime developers, performance and optimization teams, hardware architects, open-source communities, and solution engineering teams. 

Our goal is to take deep platform capabilities and performance insights and translate them into practical, optimized AI solutions that developers and customers can deploy. 

The team works across areas including LLM inference, Agentic AI, AI frameworks and runtimes, workload optimization, open-source software, and datacenter AI systems. 

Key Responsibilities

- Characterize and optimize LLM and Agentic AI workloads across the complete software and hardware stack. 
 - Identify performance bottlenecks across AI frameworks, inference runtimes, operating systems, memory, compute, and platform architecture. 
 - Design and develop hardware-aware and hardware-agnostic optimizations for AI frameworks and runtimes. 
 - Optimize LLM inference techniques including KV-cache management, attention, continuous batching, and quantization. 
 - Work hands-on with serving stacks such as vLLM, SGLang, TGI, or equivalent technologies. 
 - Analyze host and accelerator performance using tools such as VTune, EMON/PMU, perf, top-down analysis, and roofline modeling. 
 - Debug complex performance issues spanning Python frameworks, native code, Linux, runtime libraries, and hardware. 
 - Convert performance findings into software changes, upstream contributions, BKCs, and reusable optimization guidance. 
 - Collaborate with open-source communities to upstream and integrate performance improvements. 

Translate silicon-level findings into actionable recommendations for framework developers, while bringing application and framework insights back to Intel platform and silicon teams. 

Qualifications

Minimum Qualifications: 

- BE +10 years / M. Tech +8 years in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related discipline. 
 - Significant hands-on experience in performance engineering, systems optimization, or workload characterization on server-class platforms. 
 - Demonstrated ability to identify complex performance bottlenecks and deliver measurable performance improvements. 
 - Strong programming skills in Python and C++, or equivalent systems programming experience in C/Rust. 
 - Strong understanding of server architecture including cache hierarchy, memory bandwidth, NUMA, interconnects, and system-level performance behavior. 
 - Hands-on experience with Linux performance and system technologies such as affinity, huge pages, cgroups, eBPF, ftrace, perf, or equivalent tools. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Deep understanding of LLM inference, including KV-cache, paged attention, continuous batching and quantization such as INT8, INT4, or FP8. 
 - Hands-on experience modifying or optimizing AI serving stacks such as vLLM, SGLang, TGI, OpenVINO, or equivalent. 
 - Experience building, profiling, or optimizing Agentic AI systems using technologies such as LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen, MCP-based frameworks, or similar platforms. 
 - Experience with hardware counter-level performance analysis using VTune, EMON/PMU, perf, top-down analysis, or roofline modeling. 
 - Contributions to significant open-source projects, including upstream code contributions. 
 - Ability to communicate across abstraction layers, translating silicon-level findings for software developers and application-level requirements for hardware architects. 

Why Join This Team?

This role gives you the opportunity to work across boundaries that few engineering positions span: 

Agentic AI & LLMs → AI frameworks → inference runtimes Linux → server architecture → silicon

You won't be limited to measuring performance or optimizing an isolated component. You'll help connect the entire stack, identify where the real bottlenecks are, implement improvements, and make those optimizations available to developers and customers. 

The result is tangible: better AI performance today, stronger software solutions for customers, and insights that can influence tomorrow's Intel platforms. 

Job Type

Experienced Hire

Shift

Shift 1 (India)

Primary Location: 

India, Bangalore

Additional Locations:

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, religious creed, sex, national origin, ancestry, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, military and veteran status, marital status, pregnancy, gender, gender expression, gender identity, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by local law, regulation, or ordinance. 

Position of Trust

N/A

Work Model for this Role

This role will be eligible for our hybrid work model which allows employees to split their time between working on-site at their assigned Intel site and off-site. * Job posting details (such as work model, location or time type) are subject to change. 

ADDITIONAL INFORMATION: Intel is committed to Responsible Business Alliance (RBA) compliance and ethical hiring practices. We do not charge any fees during our hiring process. Candidates should never be required to pay recruitment fees, medical examination fees, or any other charges as a condition of employment. If you are asked to pay any fees during our hiring process, please report this immediately to your recruiter.

The Team

VSP One Object and Hitachi Content Platform are Hitachi Vantara's software-defined enterprise object storage platforms. It's built to scale for cloud-native and AI workloads. The engineering scrum teams build and maintain the full

The Role

We're looking for a motivated Software Development Engineer to design, build and maintain core parts of VSP One Object and Hitachi Content Platform. You'll work with architects, product owners, QA, DevOps and Support to deliver storage features that are reliable, fast and scalable. 

What you"ll bring

- Design, develop, test and maintain features and services across the Object portfolio, including S3-compatible APIs, distributed metadata, deployment tooling and platform subsystems. 
 - Write clean, modular, maintainable code with thorough unit and integration tests, and take part in code reviews. 
 - Find and fix complex defects, performance bottlenecks and reliability problems in distributed storage components. 
 - Help with customer escalations and sustaining work: root-cause analysis, fixes and verification. 
 - Follow and promote engineering best practices for CI/CD, security, CVE remediation and observability (telemetry, metrics, dashboards). 
 - Help build and improve automated test frameworks, including functional, performance and scale testing. 
 - Work in an Agile/Scrum team to deliver high-quality releases on schedule. 
 - Write clear technical documentation, such as design notes, runbooks and RCAs. 

Required Qualifications

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering or a related field, or equivalent experience. 
 - About 2-5 years of professional software development, ideally on enterprise software, distributed systems or storage. 
 - Strong programming skills in at least one of Java, Go, Python or C/C++. 
 - Good working knowledge of Linux/Unix and scripting (Bash, Python). 
 - Hands-on experience with Docker and Kubernetes (RKE2 is a plus) and with microservice architectures. 
 - Understanding of REST APIs, distributed systems concepts and cloud storage protocols, especially the AWS S3 API. 
 - Exposure to relational or distributed databases such as PostgreSQL or YugabyteDB. 
 - Experience with Git and CI/CD tools such as GitLab CI, Jenkins or GitHub Actions. 
 - Strong problem-solving and communication skills, and comfort working in a collaborative, fast-paced team. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with enterprise storage (object, block or file), for example HCP, S3 object stores or Ceph/MinIO-style systems. 
 - Familiarity with S3 features such as Object Lock, versioning, replication and data integrity. 
 - Exposure to observability tools such as Prometheus and Grafana, and to messaging systems such as RabbitMQ. 
 - Knowledge of identity and access management, such as Keycloak or OAuth2/OIDC. 
 - Experience with performance benchmarking tools (for example WARP), containerized test harnesses or release engineering. 
 - Awareness of storage security: encryption, key management and vulnerability remediation.

 - Becomes the go-to contributor for at least one Object component, such as SDT, Transition Tool or the S3 layer.

 - Takes part in customer escalations as a reliable technical contributor.

- Work on enterprise storage at large scale that customers worldwide depend on.

data.description:
About Rimini Street, Inc. 

Rimini Street, Inc. (Nasdaq: RMNI), a Russell 2000® Company, is a proven, trusted global provider of end-to-end, mission-critical enterprise software support, managed services and innovative Agentic AI ERP solutions, and is the leading third-party support provider for Oracle, SAP and VMware software. 

Our comprehensive portfolio of unified solutions help run, manage, support, customize, configure, connect, protect, monitor, and optimize enterprise application, database and technology software, enabling our clients to achieve better business outcomes, significantly reduce costs and reallocate resources towards strategic projects. 

The Company has signed thousands of contracts with Fortune Global 100, Fortune 500, midmarket, public sector and government organizations who selected Rimini Street as their trusted, proven mission-critical enterprise software solutions provider and achieved better operational outcomes, realized billions of US dollars in savings and funded AI and other innovation investments. 

We are actively seeking a Sr. Java Full Stack Engineer, This role is based in India, Hyderabad. 

About Rimini Street, India, GCC. 

Rimini Street Inc, HQ : Las Vegas, NV, USA a disruptor in third party ERP support services, established undisputed leadership and as a natural progression, entered India with Rimini Street, India GCC India kick starting operations in Hyderabad, in 2013 with Global Client Onboarding Services, IT shared services and Global Service Development. In no time, Rimini Street, India GCC started Bengaluru operations going up the value chain with more complex product development (Oracle, SAP, Peoplesoft, JDE etc. ) & advanced services (Managed services, Professional services, Security Managed Services etc). 

Rimini Street, India GCC gained valuable share in bringing the reputation to Rimini Street Inc of being a global provider of unified support and managed service solutions for enterprise software. Today, Rimini Street, India GCC is a family of about 800+ full time talented individuals, thanks to the remarkable talent that has supported the expansion. 

Rimini Street, India has nicely emerged as Global Capability Centre (GCC), and proudly says, "if you are best of the best, you belong to Rimini". We are on a mission to contribute significantly to our "Rimini ONE" program, a turnkey Rimini Street service program that offers a comprehensive set of unified, integrated services that can run, manage, support, customize, configure, connect, protect, monitor, and optimize your Oracle and SAP ERP, database, and technology software. 

Position Summary

The Senior Software Engineer (Full Stack) is a core member of the Product Delivery engineering team building Rimini Street's Agentic ERP Platform-a strategic product that enables AI agents to interact with legacy ERP systems including SAP, Oracle E-Business Suite, and JD Edwards. This role contributes across the full technology stack, from backend platform services and MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers to AI agent integration and frontend user interfaces. 

Reporting to the Sr. Director, Engineering, this engineer will design, develop, and deliver production-quality software in a modern tech stack spanning Java, Python, and Angular. The ideal candidate is a versatile engineer who thrives working across layers of the stack, takes ownership of features end-to-end, and is energized by building a new platform from the ground up. 

Essential Duties & Responsibilities

Backend Development

- Design and develop backend services using Java 21 and Quarkus, including MCP servers, REST APIs, and platform services. 
 - Build and maintain integration components that connect AI agents to enterprise ERP systems (SAP, Oracle EBS, JD Edwards). 
 - Develop data access layers using PostgreSQL, including working with pgvector for vector storage and similarity search. 
 - Implement resilience patterns (circuit breakers, retries, bulkheads) using Resilience4j for production reliability. 
 - Write clean, testable, well-documented code following established engineering standards and architectural patterns. 

AI & Agent Integration

- Develop AI agent components using Python and frameworks such as Pydantic AI or LangChain4j. 
 - Integrate with LLM services through LiteLLM gateway, implementing prompt templates, tool calling, and response handling. 
 - Build and maintain RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) pipelines for contextual knowledge retrieval. 
 - Implement orchestration workflows using Restate for multi-step agent processes with human-in-the-loop checkpoints. 

Frontend Development

- Build user interfaces using Angular and TypeScript, contributing to the platform's component library and design system. 
 - Develop human-in-the-loop interfaces that allow users to supervise, approve, and intervene in agent actions. 
 - Implement responsive, modern layouts using CSS3, Tailwind CSS, and Angular Material or similar component frameworks. 
 - Create dashboards, admin panels, and monitoring views for agent performance and system health. 
 - Build reusable UI components with clean HTML5 semantics, SCSS/CSS architecture, and consistent styling patterns. 
 - Ensure accessible (WCAG compliant), performant frontend experiences across browsers and devices. 
 - Work with design specifications and wireframes to translate UX designs into pixel-accurate implementations. 

Engineering Practices

- Participate in code reviews, design discussions, and technical design reviews. 
 - Write unit tests, integration tests, and contribute to automated testing frameworks. 
 - Contribute to CI/CD pipeline development and deployment automation. 
 - Instrument code with OpenTelemetry for distributed tracing, metrics, and logging. 
 - Collaborate with team members across time zones in a virtual team environment. 
 - Contribute to technical documentation, architecture decision records, and knowledge sharing. 

Experience

- 3. 5+ years of professional software engineering experience in full stack development. 
 - Strong backend development experience with Java (Java 11+); experience with Quarkus or Spring Boot. 
 - Working proficiency in Python; experience building services or scripts in Python. 
 - Frontend development experience with Angular (v14+), TypeScript, and modern CSS (Tailwind, SCSS, or CSS-in-JS). 
 - Experience building component libraries or contributing to design systems. 
 - Experience with relational databases, particularly PostgreSQL. 
 - Familiarity with RESTful API design and microservices architecture. 
 - Experience with Git, CI/CD pipelines, and modern development workflows. 
 - Experience working in agile teams with iterative delivery practices. 

Technical Skills

Required

- Java 11+ (Java 17/21 preferred) with strong understanding of modern Java features. 
 - Experience with Quarkus or Spring Boot for building microservices and REST APIs. 
 - Python proficiency for AI/ML integration work and scripting. 
 - Angular (v14+) and TypeScript for frontend development; strong component architecture skills. 
 - Solid CSS3/SCSS skills including responsive design, flexbox, and grid layouts. 
 - Experience with Tailwind CSS or similar utility-first CSS frameworks. 
 - Proficiency with HTML5 semantics and modern web standards. 
 - PostgreSQL and SQL; experience with data modeling and query optimization. 
 - RESTful API design and implementation; familiarity with OpenAPI/Swagger. 
 - Git version control and collaborative development practices. 
 - Understanding of containerization (Docker) and basic Kubernetes concepts. 

Preferred

- Experience with AI/ML frameworks: Pydantic AI, LangChain, or LangChain4j. 
 - Familiarity with LLM integration patterns, prompt engineering, and tool calling. 
 - Experience with vector databases (pgvector, Qdrant) and embedding models. 
 - Experience with Angular Material, PrimeNG, or similar Angular component libraries. 
 - Knowledge of web accessibility standards (WCAG 2. 1) and cross-browser compatibility. 
 - Experience with frontend testing frameworks (Jasmine, Karma, Cypress, or Playwright). 
 - Knowledge of MCP (Model Context Protocol) or similar agent-tool integration patterns. 
 - Experience with Restate, Temporal, or similar workflow orchestration frameworks. 
 - Familiarity with OpenTelemetry, Jaeger, or Prometheus for observability. 
 - Experience with enterprise integration patterns: messaging, event-driven architecture, RFC/BAPI. 
 - Knowledge of SAP or Oracle EBS integration technologies. 
 - Experience with Resilience4j or similar resilience libraries. 
 - Familiarity with LiteLLM or similar LLM gateway tools. 

Skills & Competencies

- Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to debug complex issues across multiple layers of the stack. 
 - Ownership mentality-takes responsibility for features from design through production deployment. 
 - Ability to learn quickly and adapt to new technologies, frameworks, and domains. 
 - Good communication skills; able to discuss technical approaches clearly with team members. 
 - Attention to detail and commitment to code quality, testing, and documentation. 
 - Collaborative mindset; comfortable working in a distributed team across time zones. 
 - Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote environment. 
 - Fluent in English (written and verbal). 

Desired Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field, or equivalent practical experience. 
 - Experience in enterprise software or platform product development. 
 - Exposure to ERP systems (SAP, Oracle, JD Edwards) in any capacity. 
 - AWS or Kubernetes certifications. 
 - Contributions to open source projects. 

Location & Travel

Location: Hyderabad, India

Travel: Minimal; occasional travel for team meetings or training

Language: Fluent English required (written and verbal)

Why Rimini Street?

We are looking for talented, passionate people to help us build our future at Rimini Street. We hire only the best, the most extraordinary professionals and provide compensation, bonuses, and benefits to match the skills of our top-performing team members. Do you thrive in a fast-paced environment, enjoy growing together, and get excited about learning new skills? Are you looking for an opportunity to make a true impact as part of a team of extraordinary professionals? This is the place for you. 

Our work is challenging and meaningful. We start and end each day with a sense of achievement and purpose guided by our core values, the Four Cs:

 - We believe in leaving the world a better place than we found it. With the Rimini Street Foundation, we've made positive impacts in six continents for over 425 charities. 
Accelerating Company Growth

We are looking for an experienced Lead Software Engineer / Technical Architect (C13) to drive the technical design, backend architecture, and engineering execution for Vendor Master Central (VMC)-our enterprise platform responsible for centralizing vendor ecosystems, contracts, service catalogs, and complex data enrichment pipelines across Market Data Services. 

This role is backend-first, requiring deep expertise in modern Java microservices, high-volume data ingestion/reconciliation pipelines, relational data architecture, and resilient API design. While the core focus is backend, we are very open to candidates with solid full-stack experience (React/TypeScript) who can champion end-to-end architecture and collaborate seamlessly across the entire stack. 

As a senior technical leader, you will champion modern development practices and leverage cutting-edge GenAI tooling (Devin, GitHub Copilot, Cursor) to accelerate engineering velocity and deliver robust, scalable platforms. 

Key Responsibilities

Architecture & Backend Leadership

- Architect & Scale Core Services: Lead the technical design and implementation of distributed, cloud-ready Java microservices (Java 21/25, Spring Boot) powering high-volume data ingestion, reconciliation, and enrichment. 
 - Data Pipelines & Ingestion Engines: Architect idempotent data ingestion workflows, transactional staging mechanisms, and validation engines processing heterogeneous financial datasets and hierarchy trees. 
 - API & Domain Design: Design secure, performant RESTful APIs, domain models, and caching strategies supporting high-concurrency enterprise interfaces and downstream consumers. 
 - Full-Stack Collaboration: Partner closely with UI engineers on frontend-backend contracts and state synchronization; provide architectural oversight on React/TypeScript integration for candidate profiles with full-stack capability. 

Engineering Velocity & GenAI Adoption

- Pioneer AI-Accelerated Engineering: Spearhead team-wide adoption of autonomous and assisted AI engineering tools (e. g. , Devin, GitHub Copilot, Cursor) for rapid prototyping, automated code generation, complex refactoring, and test suite creation. 
 - Code Quality & Best Practices: Enforce modern design patterns, domain-driven design (DDD), comprehensive test automation (TDD/BDD), clean architecture, and CI/CD pipelines. 

Technical Leadership & Governance

- Team Mentorship: Lead, coach, and elevate senior engineers (C11/C12) across technical design reviews, coding standards, and architectural decisions. 
 - Enterprise Controls & Security: Ensure system designs adhere to enterprise security standards, role-based access controls (RBAC), SSO authentication, and complete audit traceability. 

What We Are Looking For

Core Backend & Architectural Expertise: 

- 10+ years of professional software engineering experience with significant experience architecting and delivering enterprise-grade distributed systems. 
 - Deep Modern Java Mastery: Expert-level knowledge of Java 21 / 25, Spring Boot, Spring Cloud, Spring Data, and Hibernate/JPA. 
 - Data Modeling & Storage: Strong experience in relational database design (PostgreSQL / Oracle / SQL), complex query optimization, indexing strategies, and transactional integrity. 
 - Pipeline & Ingestion Architecture: Proven track record designing batch/stream data ingestion pipelines, reconciliation logic, and asynchronous processing engines. 
 - RESTful API Architecture: Extensive experience creating well-documented, versioned, and secure REST APIs (OpenAPI / Swagger). 

Full-Stack Openness (Strong Advantage): 

- Experience or strong familiarity with modern frontend frameworks-specifically React, TypeScript, and modern state management-is a significant plus for driving cohesive, end-to-end architecture. 

Modern Tooling & AI Fluency: 

- Hands-on enthusiasm for modern AI-assisted engineering tools (Devin, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, LLM-driven coding workflows) to drive rapid delivery. 
 - Strong proficiency with Docker, Kubernetes/OpenShift, CI/CD automation, and cloud-native observability (Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry). 

Leadership & Competencies

- Proven ability to operate with architectural autonomy, translating complex business requirements into elegant technical designs. 
 - Exceptional problem-solving skills and ability to lead incident resolution, performance tuning, and technical strategy. 
 - Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, able to articulate technical trade-offs to senior leadership. 

Education & Experience

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.

data.title: Quality Assurance Manager (Python and selenium)
data.description:
We are looking for a QA Manager to own the QA function across Arcitech's product portfolio. This is the senior-most QA seat in the organization. You will set QA strategy across products, manage a team of 8 - 12 QA engineers (including the QA Lead who owns hands-on senior QA beneath you), run QA across 7 - 8 concurrent projects, and be the QA counterpart to product and engineering leadership. Reporting directly to the CEO, you are accountable for the release-readiness of everything Arcitech ships. 

This is a management role, not primarily a hands-on IC role. You are the strategist, the reviewer, and the leader of the function. Hands-on senior QA designing frameworks, running performance tests, writing critical automation sits with the QA Lead beneath you; your job is to set direction, hold the bar, grow the team, and represent QA at the leadership table. That said, on the hardest technical problems and the highest-risk releases, you will still be hands-on particularly on new-product launches and cross-product testing initiatives. Prior experience running QA at a SaaS / IT product company is non-negotiable. Prior experience genuinely managing a QA team of 8+ is non-negotiable. This is a role for someone who has already done this work before, not someone stepping up into it for the first time. 

You will report directly to the CEO. 

Key Responsibilities

QA Strategy & Direction

- Own the QA vision and strategy across the SaaS portfolio. 
 - Define what gets tested manually, what gets automated, and what needs performance testing per product, per release. 
 - Own release-readiness decisions in partnership with product and engineering leadership. 
 - Set priorities across 7-8 concurrent projects; make trade-offs on coverage vs speed explicit. 

Team Management

- Manage a team of 8-12 QA engineers, including the QA Lead as your direct report. 
 - Set clear expectations, run 1: 1s and reviews, and own performance conversations end-to-end. 
 - Grow the team's technical depth in manual, Python + Selenium automation, and performance testing. 
 - Own hiring for the QA team - who joins, at what level, and how they ramp up. 
 - Develop the QA Lead specifically as a senior report with their own career growth needs. 

Quality Bar & Review

- Define and hold the QA quality bar across the whole function. 
 - Review the QA Lead's work and the wider team's work on strategic / high-stakes releases; catch issues before ship. 
 - Own QA process, documentation, and best practices across the SaaS portfolio. 
 - Set the standard through your own review - not by out-executing the Lead. 

Cross-Team Leadership & Business Communication

- Partner with engineering and product leadership on release scope, quality trade-offs, and CI/CD integration. 
 - Represent QA to the CEO and leadership clearly - what's shipping, what's at risk, what needs decisions. 
 - Communicate quality risks in business terms, not QA jargon - impact, likelihood, mitigation, cost. 
 - Coordinate with DevOps on CI/CD integration of automated tests across products. 

Hands-On QA (Selective)

- Personally own the hardest technical problems on high-risk releases when it matters. 
 - Design or review critical automation frameworks and performance test strategies for new-product launches. 
 - Delegate day-to-day execution to the Lead and the team - stay in strategy and review mode by default. 

Required Skills & Experience

- Experience: 6+ years in QA, with at least 3 years in a QA management role
 - Team management (must-have, non-negotiable): proven experience managing a QA team of
 - 8+, including at least 2+ years directly leading a team - real people-management with 1: 1s, reviews, hiring, and performance calls; not just informal mentoring
 - SaaS / IT product background (must-have, non-negotiable): prior QA leadership at a technology / SaaS / IT product company
 - Manual QA depth (must-have): 6+ years of hands-on manual QA experience - deep, thorough process across test planning, execution, defect management, no shortcuts
 - Automation (must-have): 3+ years minimum, hands-on Python + Selenium (not Java). Real frameworks you have built and led teams to build. 
 - Performance testing (must-have): hands-on with performance / load testing tools (JMeter, 
 - Locust, K6, or similar); can design, run, analyze
 - QA strategy (must-have): genuine experience setting QA direction across multiple products or product lines
 - Multi-project (must-have): proven ability to run QA across 7-8 concurrent projects without dropping quality
 - CI/CD integration: hands-on with CI/CD integration of QA (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI); driven CI adoption at team level
 - Communication: clear, senior communicator; can represent QA to the CEO and cross-functional leadership

Nice to Have

- API testing depth (Postman, REST Assured with Python). 
 - SQL / database validation experience. 
 - Experience testing AI-driven products or non-deterministic outputs. 
 - Exposure to security-testing basics. 
 - Prior experience defining or scaling a QA function from small to mid-size. 
 - Experience with observability / monitoring integration for post-release quality signal. 

The Ideal Candidate

- Has genuinely managed a QA team of 8+, and can point to what specifically improved under their leadership. 
 - Has worked inside a technology / SaaS / IT product company for a meaningful part of their career. 
 - Is strong across all three testing disciplines - manual, automation, and performance - not just one. 
 - Can balance strategy, review, team management, and selective hands-on work. 
 - Communicates well with the CEO and leadership; represents QA as a business function, not a purely technical one. 
 - Runs a QA function with process and craft, not chaos and heroics.

 - Creative, flexible, dependable; champions safety and quality culture. 

Work Experience

data.title: Software Engineer - Test Automation
data.description:
Company Description

Arista Networks is an industry leader in data-driven, client-to-cloud networking for large data center, campus and routing environments. Arista is a well-established and profitable company with over $9 billion in revenue. Arista's award-winning platforms, ranging in Ethernet speeds up to 800G bits per second, redefine scalability, agility, and resilience. Arista is a founding member of the Ultra Ethernet consortium. We have shipped over 20 million cloud networking ports worldwide with CloudVision and EOS, an advanced network operating system. Arista is committed to open standards, and its products are available worldwide directly and through partners. 

At Arista, we value the diversity of thought and perspectives each employee brings. We believe fostering an inclusive environment where individuals from various backgrounds and experiences feel welcome is essential for driving creativity and innovation. 

Our commitment to excellence has earned us several prestigious awards, such as the Great Place to Work Survey for Best Engineering Team and Best Company for Diversity, Compensation, and Work-Life Balance. At Arista, we take pride in our track record of success and strive to maintain the highest quality and performance standards in everything we do. 

Job Description

Who You'll Work With

AGNI (Arista Guardian for Network Identity) is Arista's cloud-native SaaS platform for network access control and zero-trust security. It is deployed by enterprises worldwide, both as a managed cloud service and on-premises. The platform handles authentication and authorization for every device that joins a network - using protocols like 802. 1X, RADIUS, EAP-TLS, TACACS+, and PKI - and must work correctly under real network conditions, at scale, every time. 

The AGNI engineering team operates with a strong ownership culture: engineers define the feature, write the code, write the tests, and are accountable for what ships. The test automation team is a first-class engineering function - not a handoff at the end of development, but an integral part of how the team designs and validates the product. 

You will work alongside backend engineers, network protocol specialists, and CloudOps/SRE to build and maintain the automated test infrastructure that validates the entire AGNI platform. 

What You'll Do

- Design and build end-to-end automated test suites for AGNI features - authentication protocol flows, REST API correctness, network policy enforcement, and device onboarding - primarily in Go. 
 - Own test coverage for one or more product domains (e. g. , RADIUS/EAP, TACACS+, captive portal, PKI) end to-end: derive test plans from feature specs, implement the cases, triage failures, and maintain them as the product evolves. 
 - Build and extend internal test utility libraries - simulated RADIUS/EAPOL clients, browser automation, certificate helpers, and REST API wrappers - and know when a gap in the utility layer is the right fix rather than working around it in the test. 
 - Drive root-cause analysis on test failures - distinguish a flaky test from a real product bug, reproduce the bug in a lab environment, and work with backend engineers to resolve it. 
 - Review feature design specifications and write test plans that cover happy paths, boundary conditions, and failure modes before the feature is implemented - shifting quality left, not bolting it on at the end. 
 - Own and improve the Jenkins CI pipelines that run nightly e2e suites against cloud and on-prem deployments: reduce flakiness, improve signal-to-noise, and shorten the feedback loop for engineers. 
 - Contribute targeted fixes to the platform codebase (testability improvements, log clarity, small bug fixes) when the test reveals a clear, bounded issue. 
 - Mentor junior engineers and interns on test design principles, debugging methodology, and the team's test framework. 
 - Participate in incident post-mortems and customer issue reviews - identify gaps in test coverage that allowed a bug to reach production and close them. 

Qualifications

- Bachelor's or Master's in Computer Science, Electronics, or a related engineering field. 
 - 3-6 years of hands-on software engineering experience, with a significant portion in test automation or quality engineering - not just manual testing. 
 - Proficiency in Go or Python for writing production-grade automation code. Experience with Go is strongly preferred. 
 - Solid understanding of Linux from both an administration and debugging perspective: process management, networking tools (tcpdump, openssl, curl), and log analysis. 
 - Working knowledge of enterprise authentication protocols - 802. 1X, RADIUS, EAP variants (EAP-TLS, PEAP, TEAP), TACACS+, or PKI/certificate management. You need to be able to read a packet trace and understand what went wrong. 
 - Hands-on experience with REST API testing - designing test cases, validating responses, and building reliable API clients in code. 
 - Experience with CI/CD systems (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, or similar) - writing pipeline stages, triaging failures, and improving reliability. 
 - Strong debugging instinct: given a test failure and a log, you can form and test a hypothesis independently. Clear written communication - test plans, bug reports, and post-mortem write-ups that other engineers can act on without follow-up. 

Good To Have

- Experience with containerization (Docker) and basic cloud environments (GCP/AWS). 
 - Familiarity with observability tooling (Prometheus, Grafana) - knowing which metrics to pull when a test exhibits unexpected behavior. 
 - Exposure to PKI infrastructure: certificate chains, SCEP/EST enrollment, TLS handshake failure modes. Experience with browser automation frameworks for UI/captive-portal test scenarios. 
 - Familiarity with database testing (PostgreSQL or equivalent) - validating that backend state changes are correctly persisted. 

Additional Information

Arista stands out as an engineering-centric company. Our leadership, including founders and engineering managers, are all engineers who understand sound software engineering principles and the importance of doing things right. 

We hire globally into our diverse team. At Arista, engineers have complete ownership of their projects. Our management structure is flat and streamlined, and software engineering is led by those who understand it best. We prioritize the development and utilization of test automation tools. 

Our engineers have access to every part of the company, providing opportunities to work across various domains. Arista is headquartered in Santa Clara, California, with development offices in Australia, Canada, India, Ireland, and the US. We consider all our R&D centers equal in stature. 

Join us to shape the future of networking and be part of a culture that values invention, quality, respect, and fun.

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. The Position

Job Description
We are looking for a Hands-on Data Architecture & Delivery Lead to define and lead the architecture of the data solution for our US Commercial pharma business. You will set the technical direction for how commercial data (claims, sales, specialty pharmacy, payer, CRM, patient services) is ingested, governed, modeled, and served to analytics, AI, and field-facing applications. You'll own both the platform (the shared foundation) and the solutions (the architecture for specific commercial use cases). You will guide engineering teams, work with business and IT leaders, and keep the platform secure, compliant, scalable, and cost-effective. You will lead others to solve complex problems, maintain the vision and roadmap for multiple solutions, provide technical oversight to product teams, and evaluate new technologies to continuously improve existing solutions and manage technical debt. In this role, you will design solutions that meet product requirements, business priorities, and enterprise standards while managing non-functional requirements (NFR) and fitness functions.

Documents and evolves the architecture throughout the product life cycle and aligns with the architecture community for governance. Applies frameworks in a Complex or Multiple Solution or Product Context. Technical delivery owner, managing sprint velocity and engineering output alongside their architectural duties. Designing data pipelines, complex data modeling (Veeva, HCP, claims), AWS infrastructure decisions, and technical code reviews. Remains the ultimate technical authority for their domain
 - Accountability/Problem Solving: Accountability for technical delivery-sizing technical debt, breaking down their own architectures into actionable sprint tasks, and unblocking developers. Leads others to solve complex problems; uses sophisticated analytical thought to exercise judgment and identify innovative solutions. Maintains the vision, roadmap, and current landscape for multiple solutions. Assesses and consults on the impacts and dependencies of initiatives on capabilities, risk, and the application landscape. Creates Conceptual & Logical Data Models, Taxonomies, Ontologies, and Integration pathways for the product.
