data.title: AI Enterprise Architect
data.description:
As Ford accelerates its enterprise-wide digital and AI transformation, the AI Advancement Center is expanding its ability to design, build and deploy secure, high-performing AI platforms that can be reused across business functions and geographies. 

As a Principal AI Architect, you will define the architectural vision and technical standards for enterprise AI platforms, connecting strategic business requirements with engineering execution. 

You will work across engineering, data, cloud, cybersecurity and business teams to establish scalable patterns for Machine Learning Operations (MLOps), Generative AI, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), model serving, data processing and AI governance. 

This is a senior technical leadership role with significant enterprise influence. Your work will help Ford accelerate AI adoption while improving platform reliability, security, reusability and cost efficiency. 

Enterprise AI Architecture

- Define end-to-end architecture for enterprise-scale AI, ML and Generative AI platforms across cloud and distributed environments. 
 - Establish reusable architectural patterns for Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), model fine-tuning, inference, model serving, vector search and MLOps. 
 - Evaluate architectural trade-offs across scalability, performance, security, reliability and cost. 

Platform Engineering & Scale

- Define engineering standards for high-availability and low-latency AI services. 
 - Design scalable architectures using technologies such as Kubernetes, Docker, Apache Kafka, Apache Spark and cloud-native services. 
 - Establish patterns for observability, resiliency, fault tolerance, API integration and production AI operations. 
 - Guide teams in building reusable platform components instead of isolated point solutions. 

Technical Leadership

- Provide architecture leadership across multiple engineering and business teams. 
 - Translate business requirements into scalable technical roadmaps and architecture decisions. 
 - Lead technical design reviews and help engineering teams resolve complex architectural challenges. 
 - Communicate architecture strategy, trade-offs and investment priorities to senior technical and business stakeholders. 

AI Governance, Security & Responsible AI

- Establish AI architecture guardrails covering security, privacy, model governance and responsible AI. 
 - Partner with cybersecurity, privacy, legal and data-governance teams to embed appropriate controls into AI platforms. 
 - Support enterprise compliance requirements, including applicable privacy and AI regulations. 

AI FinOps & Optimisation

- Define strategies for efficient use of cloud AI infrastructure, including GPU and accelerator resources. 
 - Monitor architectural choices for cost, performance and utilisation. 
 - Establish patterns for optimising training, inference and high-compute AI workloads. 

Required

- 8+ years of relevant technology experience, including significant experience designing enterprise-scale distributed or cloud-based platforms. 
 - Proven experience architecting and deploying AI/ML and Generative AI solutions in production. 
 - Hands-on architectural experience with capabilities such as: 
 - Large Language Models (LLMs)
 - Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)
 - Vector databases/vector search
 - Model serving and inference
 - Model fine-tuning
 - MLOps and model lifecycle management
 - Strong knowledge of at least one major cloud platform: Microsoft Azure, Amazon Web Services (AWS), or Google Cloud Platform (GCP). 
 - Deep understanding of distributed systems, microservices and container orchestration using technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes. 
 - Experience with large-scale data and event processing technologies such as Apache Kafka and Apache Spark, or equivalent platforms. 
 - Experience designing highly available, fault-tolerant and performance-sensitive production systems. 
 - Demonstrated ability to influence architecture and engineering decisions across multiple teams. 
 - Strong communication skills with experience engaging senior technical and business stakeholders. 
Preferred

- Experience establishing enterprise AI governance, privacy, security and Responsible AI controls. 
 - Knowledge of regulatory frameworks relevant to AI and data protection, such as the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and EU Artificial Intelligence Act. 
 - Experience optimising GPU or accelerator-based workloads and implementing cloud Financial Operations (FinOps) practices. 
 - Experience working within an AI Centre of Excellence (CoE), enterprise platform organisation, or other central technology function. 
 - Experience leading enterprise-scale AI adoption or technology transformation programmes.

Ensure end-to-end traceability from requirements through implementation and testing, while defining review checkpoints and confidence frameworks for AI-generated outputs. 
 - Ensure that AI-generated software complies with MISRA C standards and project-specific coding guidelines, successfully passes static analysis checks, and correctly implements functional safety and security mechanisms. 
 - Define comprehensive evaluation frameworks for AI-generated firmware, including benchmark workloads, automated simulation testing, Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL) validation, and regression-testing strategies to assess the impact of changes in AI models, toolchains, and SDKs. 
 - Design and develop AI skills and automation capabilities for automotive applications such as electric motor control, Battery Management Systems (BMS), and vehicle communication networks including CAN FD, LIN, and Automotive Ethernet. 
 - Establish quality standards and best practices for AI-enabled development, conduct technical reviews of skills and solutions developed by engineering teams, mentor team members, and actively contribute to talent acquisition and team growth. 
 - Collaborate closely with Product Management, Application Engineering, and customers to gather requirements, align expectations, and clearly communicate the capabilities, limitations, and reliability of AI agents in safety-critical automotive software development environments. 

Your profile

Qualifications And Skills To Help You Succeed

- 12-15 years of hands-on embedded software development experience, including at least 8 years in automotive ECU software development and 5+ years in technical leadership or architecture roles. 
 - Proven experience delivering software for ISO 26262-compliant automotive programs at ASIL-B or higher, including development of safety requirements, implementation of safety mechanisms, and creation of required safety work products. 
 - Strong expertise in AUTOSAR Classic Platform, particularly MCAL and Basic Software (BSW) configuration, with practical experience operating within ASPICE-assessed development processes. 
 - Deep understanding of multicore automotive MCU architectures from leading vendors, such as Infineon TriCoreTM, Arm Cortex-R, and Power Architecture-based platforms, including lockstep processing, memory protection schemes, and Hardware Security Modules (HSMs). 
 - Hands-on experience implementing automotive cybersecurity solutions aligned with ISO/SAE 21434, including secure boot, secure flashing, and platform security mechanisms. 
 - Proficiency with industry-standard automotive development and validation tools, including Lauterbach TRACE32, Vector CANoe, TASKING or HighTec compilers, and static analysis tools such as Polyspace and Helix QAC. 
 - Strong Python programming skills for engineering automation, tooling, and workflow optimization. 
 - Demonstrated expertise in Generative AI applied to engineering workflows, evidenced by at least two of the following achievements, with at least one successfully led, deployed, and adopted by a broader team: 
 - Designed and implemented an AI-assisted engineering workflow that measurably improved development efficiency, product quality, or engineering productivity. 
 - Developed frameworks for evaluating AI-generated code using automated validation, testing strategies, and performance metrics tracked over time. 
 - Applied AI solutions for requirements analysis, traceability management, automated test generation, or code reviews within structured environments governed by ASPICE or ISO 26262. 
 - Established risk mitigation approaches for AI-generated software, addressing concerns related to licensing, cybersecurity, functional safety, tool confidence, and compliance. 
 - Ability to articulate a well-founded perspective on the adoption of AI in safety-critical software development, supported by practical examples and a clear understanding of verification, validation, and documentation requirements. 
 - Experience with Infineon AURIXTM TC3x/TC4x or TRAVEOTM T2G microcontroller platforms, including low-level driver development and platform-specific software libraries. 
 - Domain expertise in electric vehicle applications, particularly motor control systems and Battery Management Systems (BMS). 
 - Hands-on experience with Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL) validation platforms such as dSPACE, Vector VT System, or Typhoon HIL. 
 - Familiarity with Model-Based Development (MBD) using MATLAB/Simulink and Embedded Coder. 
 - Knowledge of automotive regulations and standards, including UN R155, UN R156, and ISO 21448 (Safety of the Intended Functionality - SOTIF). 
 - Contributions to the automotive software or AI engineering community through technical presentations, publications, conference talks, or open-source projects related to automotive tooling, embedded systems, or AI-assisted development. 

#WeAreIn for driving decarbonization and digitalization. 

As a global leader in semiconductor solutions in power systems and IoT, Infineon enables game-changing solutions for green and efficient energy, clean and safe mobility, as well as smart and secure IoT. Together, we drive innovation and customer success, while caring for our people and empowering them to reach ambitious goals. Be a part of making life easier, safer and greener.

data.description:
About Us

Engineering Manager, WMS

Summary

Anchanto, a leading global B2B SaaS enterprise, seeks an experienced Engineering Manager to lead the critical development and operations of its Warehouse Management System (WMS). This platform is central to the daily operations of brands, retailers, and logistics partners, managing complex workflows including inventory control, order fulfillment, and omnichannel commerce. The Engineering Manager will drive the engineering and quality assurance teams, fostering a culture of outcome ownership rather than mere task oversight. Reporting to the Engineering Head of WMS, this leader is responsible for ensuring the reliability, scalability, and technical excellence of a mission-critical system that supports high-volume, real-time warehouse operations across Ruby on Rails, PostgreSQL, and AWS environments. The role demands a strategic partner who can balance technical innovation with operational stability while guiding the team through a transition to an integrated, AI-first working model. 

Responsibilities

- Delivery Management: Ensure predictable engineering output by managing capacity planning, identifying risks early, and executing recovery strategies to meet 90-day commitments with high accuracy and zero delays. 
 - Quality Engineering Leadership: Establish and maintain rigorous standards for code quality, test coverage (including RSpec, integration, and load testing), and deployment frequency. Own the metrics for change failure rates and ensure independent QA sign-off remains unaffected by delivery pressures. 
 - System Reliability & Performance: Directly manage service availability and latency, overseeing incident response and root cause analysis to resolve recurring issues. Target 99. 9% uptime for owned services and sub-200ms P95 latency for critical APIs while reducing Mean Time to Recovery (MTTR). 
 - Technical Architecture & Security: Operate within established architectural and security guardrails to protect multi-tenant isolation and system performance. Enforce secure software development lifecycle practices, including threat modeling, static and dynamic analysis, and compliance with SOC 2 and ISO 27001 standards. 
 - Cost Optimization: Monitor and optimize engineering costs related to compute, storage, and AI tooling, ensuring that cost-per-delivered-item and infrastructure expenses trend downward without compromising quality. 
 - AI Integration: Drive the adoption of AI coding assistants (such as Claude Code, Cursor, and Copilot) to shift the team toward spec-driven delivery. Lead the transition of AI-enabled features, such as intelligent slotting and capacity forecasting, from pilot programs to production-grade solutions. 
 - Team Development & Staffing: Manage the full lifecycle of team members, including hiring, performance reviews, and career growth planning. Foster a culture of continuous learning that encourages engineers to evolve from specialists into versatile product builders. 
 - Hands-on Technical Contribution: Engage directly in solution design, prototyping, and complex implementation tasks where necessary to unblock the team. Gradually increase team autonomy to reduce dependency on the manager for routine decisions. 
 - Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner effectively with the Engineering Head, Product Management, Delivery Managers, and other technical leads to align on priorities, manage technical debt, and ensure smooth go-live processes. 
 - Stakeholder Alignment: Coordinate with Sales, Customer Success, Implementation teams, and Security groups to manage customer commitments, handle escalations, and ensure release readiness. 

Requirements

Requirements: 

- Experience: 9 to 18 years of software engineering background, including a minimum of 4 years in a leadership role managing engineering teams and owning delivery outcomes. 
 - Technical Proficiency: Deep expertise in Ruby on Rails backend development at scale, with strong knowledge of asynchronous processing (Sidekiq/Redis), PostgreSQL performance tuning, and high-throughput system architectures. 
 - Cloud & Infrastructure: Proven experience building distributed, event-driven systems on AWS, including EKS/Kubernetes, ECS, SQS/SNS, EventBridge, Aurora, S3, API Gateway, and Redis. 
 - System Design: Strong capability in designing scalable, multi-tenant architectures with robust handling of idempotency, retries, backpressure, and failure scenarios. 
 - Reliability Engineering: Solid background in observability (metrics, logs, traces), SLO/SLI definition, incident management, and maintaining strict on-call discipline. 
 - DevOps & Automation: Proficiency with CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, CodePipeline), containerization (Docker, Kubernetes/Helm), and Infrastructure-as-Code tools (Terraform, AWS CDK). 
 - Quality Assurance: Demonstrated experience leading QA engineers or quality practices, with a focus on maintaining independent sign-off and improving DORA metrics. 
 - AI & Modern Tooling: Practical experience utilizing AI coding tools to enhance productivity and a track record of transitioning teams to spec-driven workflows. 
 - Security Compliance: Familiarity with SOC 2 and ISO 27001 controls, GDPR, PII handling, and secure SDLC practices including threat modeling and vulnerability scanning. 
 - Leadership Skills: Ability to calibrate performance levels, coach team members, manage underperformance, and guide teams through organizational change. 
 - Preferred Qualifications: Experience with monolith-to-microservices migration and domain knowledge in WMS, OMS, TMS, or 3PL logistics. 
 - Core Behaviors: A mindset focused on outcome ownership, execution discipline, systems thinking, and the ability to collaborate effectively within a structured leadership framework while maintaining the autonomy to solve problems proactively. 

Benefits Why Join Anchanto

At Anchanto, we believe in creating an environment where people can build meaningful careers, continuously develop their capabilities and gain exposure to a truly global business. 

- Global Exposure: Work with diverse teams, customers and stakeholders across international markets and gain experience in a global B2B SaaS environment. 
 - Learning & Development: We invest in our people through sponsored learning, certifications and development opportunities aligned with your professional growth. 
 - International & Onsite Opportunities: Client-facing roles may offer opportunities to travel and work onsite with customers across our global markets. 
 - Medical Insurance: Comprehensive medical insurance coverage to support your health and well-being. 
 - Comprehensive Leave Benefits: Maternity, Paternity, Marriage and Bereavement leave, along with Comp Off and flexibility to support important personal commitments. 
 - Recognition for Long-Term Contribution: Tenured employees are eligible for additional monetary benefits, extra paid leave and company-sponsored paid vacations as part of our commitment to recognising long-term contribution. 
 - Flexibility & Work-Life Balance: A supportive and flexible work environment that enables employees to manage professional responsibilities alongside personal priorities. 
 - Meaningful Career Growth: Take ownership of challenging, high-impact work and contribute to products and solutions that serve global brands, retailers and logistics businesses.

The ideal candidate is someone who thinks beyond simply developing code or executing test cases. They should be able to build the feature, understand its dependencies, build comprehensive automation around it, troubleshoot issues across the stack, and ensure the feature is production-ready. 

Automation is a core engineering responsibility in this role and should be developed alongside the product code as part of the overall software delivery lifecycle.

Preferred Qualifications

Familiarity with emerging AI engineering concepts such as:

Education

data.description:
Senior IT QA Analyst

Job Summary

We are seeking a Sr IT QA Analyst to support quality assurance activities for enterprise technology initiatives, with a strong focus on the ServiceNow platform. In this individual contributor role, you will develop and execute test plans, validate requirements and user stories, document defects, support UAT, and contribute to reliable delivery across projects, releases, enhancements, and platform upgrades. You will partner closely with business stakeholders, process analysts, developers, and delivery teams to ensure solutions meet business requirements, user expectations, and quality standards before deployment. This position is ideal for a detail-oriented QA professional who can translate business needs into testable outcomes, communicate risks clearly, and help improve testing practices through strong execution and collaboration. 

Key Responsibilities

Test Strategy & Planning

- Contribute to QA planning for ServiceNow projects, releases, and enhancements in collaboration with the Lead Business Process Analyst and delivery team. 
 - Develop test plans, test cases, and test scripts aligned to business requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria. 
 - Apply established QA standards, templates, and best practices for the ServiceNow platform. 

Test Execution & Defect Management

- Execute functional, regression, integration, and user acceptance testing support for ServiceNow modules (e. g. , ITSM, ITOM, HRSD, CSM, SPM). 
 - Identify, document, and track defects through the full lifecycle using ServiceNow or designated defect-tracking tools. 
 - Support defect prioritization and resolution by providing clear analysis, reproducible steps, and timely updates to development and configuration teams. 
 - Execute performance, load, and smoke testing as required. 

ServiceNow Platform QA

- Validate workflows, business rules, UI policies, notifications, and integrations configured in ServiceNow. 
 - Ensure data integrity and accuracy across ServiceNow tables and integrations with upstream/downstream systems. 
 - Review and test configuration changes, updates, and platform upgrades including ServiceNow version upgrades and patches. 

Collaboration & Stakeholder Engagement

- Collaborate with the Lead Business Process Analyst to translate process requirements into testable acceptance criteria. 
 - Participate in UAT sessions with business stakeholders and provide testing support to business users as needed. 
 - Communicate QA status, risks, and defect trends to project teams in a clear and timely manner. 

Continuous Improvement

- Support the use of automated testing tools and frameworks within the ServiceNow environment. 
 - Identify opportunities to improve testing efficiency, coverage, and cycle time. 
 - Maintain QA documentation and contribute to a shared knowledge base. 

Subject Matter Expertise

- Serve as a QA subject matter contributor for ServiceNow-related initiatives by sharing testing knowledge, risks, and recommendations with the project team. 
 - Contribute to team knowledge-sharing by documenting lessons learned, reusable test scenarios, and platform-specific QA considerations. 

Required Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business Information Systems, or a related field (or equivalent work experience). 
 - 8+ years of QA/testing experience in enterprise IT environments. 
 - 5+ years of hands-on experience testing on the ServiceNow platform.

 - Demonstrated experience creating, maintaining, and executing automated test scripts as part of enterprise QA delivery. 
 - Experience planning and executing system performance testing, including load, volume, scalability, and response-time validation for enterprise applications.

 - Experience with Agile/Scrum delivery methodologies.

Preferred Qualifications

Competencies

 - Collaboration and Stakeholder Communication
 - Accountability and Initiative
 - Critical Thinking and Root-Cause Analysis
 - Adaptability and ability to manage competing priorities
 - Continuous Improvement Mindset

Working Conditions

 - Occasional off-hours testing may be required during major releases or platform upgrades.

We will recruit, hire, promote, transfer and provide opportunities for advancement based on individual qualifications and job performance in all matters affecting employment, compensation, benefits, working conditions, and opportunities for advancement. Business, Plant, and Cross-Functional Leadership

- Partner with global product engineering, Greenwood and Fayetteville plant engineering and operations, Sales, Project Management, Supply Chain, Quality, Manufacturing, IT, and Customer Support to align priorities and execute customer orders. 
 - Translate business growth, product strategy, plant capacity, and customer requirements into engineering capability, staffing, training, succession, and investment plans. 

Talent and Organizational Development

- Coach and develop engineering managers, team leaders, senior engineers, and technical specialists; build succession plans and clear technical and leadership career paths. 
 - Establish product-line competency matrices and structured development plans covering MVA and MCC fundamentals, ETO execution, tools, standards, manufacturing processes, and quality practices. 

Qualifications

- Bachelors/Masters in Electrical engineering or equivalent
 - 15+ years of engineering experience in power distribution, switchgear, motor control, or related electromechanical products, with substantial experience in Engineer-to-Order, Customer Order Engineering, Customer Order Design, Application Engineering, or Requisition Engineering. Minimum 5 years of people-leadership experience leading multi-disciplinary electrical and mechanical engineering teams; experience leading leaders or multiple product-line teams is preferred. 

Skills

- Extensive knowledge of ETO order engineering, including specification review, configuration, feasibility assessment, drawings, bills of material, approvals, manufacturing release, change management, and plant support. 
 - Demonstrated product knowledge in both Medium Voltage Assembly and Low Voltage Motor Control Center engineering, or deep expertise in one product line with proven ability to build capability in the other. 
 - MVA knowledge: metal-clad and arc-resistant switchgear; 5/15 kV, 27 kV, and 38 kV classes; breakers, bus, grounding, CTs, VTs, CPTs, relays, metering, communication, interlocks, source-transfer and protection schemes, one-lines, three-lines, wiring diagrams, and indoor/outdoor applications. 
 - LV MCC knowledge: Freedom 2100, Freedom+, FlashGard, Freedom Fast and legacy/aftermarket configurations; starters, feeder units, breakers, contactors, fuses, overload devices, soft starters, VFDs, control power, pilot devices, PLC/communication interfaces, bus ratings, structures, wireways, interlocks, wiring, and thermal/enclosure requirements. 
 - Strong understanding of applicable ANSI, IEEE, UL, NEMA, NEC, NFPA, and IEC requirements, including product-specific test and arc-resistant requirements. 
 - Strong understanding of manufacturing processes, panel and structure assembly, bus and wiring fabrication, inspection, testing, quality systems, engineering changes, and product lifecycle management. 
 - Experience with BidManager or comparable configuration tools; AutoCAD/AutoCAD Electrical; EPLAN; Inventor or comparable 3D CAD; ENOVIA/3DX or comparable PLM; Design Automation; and ERP/manufacturing-release systems. 
 - Proven ability to lead design automation, digital-thread, reusable product-definition, configuration-validation, workflow-optimization, and engineering-quality initiatives. 
 - Demonstrated application of Lean, DMAIC, Design for Six Sigma, Agile, and continuous-improvement methods; Green Belt or Black Belt certification is preferred. 
 - Ability to evaluate competitor offerings, market and customer trends, and technology developments relevant to medium-voltage assemblies and low-voltage motor control. "

Executive communication and stakeholder management; customer and plant focus; strategic thinking; technical judgment; influencing without authority; decision-making under ambiguity; problem solving; drive for results; change leadership; talent development; collaboration across cultures and time zones; and strong written and verbal English communication.

We are hiring a Lead Data Engineer for a strongly Python-first profile, complemented by solid depth across Databricks, data modelling, T-SQL,   and data architecture. Lakehouse platform, while also setting technical direction on pipeline architecture, data modelling, and platform performance, and mentoring  

a team of engineers.

schema validation, and testing frameworks (pytest, CI/CD).

pipeline-scale problems.

Databricks/Spark when Python alone won't scale.

• Design and deliver Bronze/Silver/Gold Medallion pipelines on Databricks - Delta Lake, Structured Streaming/Auto Loader, and Unity  

Catalog governance. 

• Own dimensional data modelling decisions - star/snowflake schema design and SCD strategy - for the platform's core data models. 

• Write and review advanced T-SQL for platform workloads - window functions, MERGE/upsert logic, and execution-plan-based  

performance tuning. 

• Partner with Data Architects and stakeholders on ETL vs. ELT, orchestration, and cost/performance trade-offs across the platform; mentor  

Data Engineers and Senior Data Engineers through design and code reviews. 

MUST-HAVE QUALIFICATIONS

8-12 years in data engineering, including at least 2 years in a technical leadership or mentoring capacity. This role carries a strong Python emphasis,   

complemented by hands-on depth in: 

Python & Data Engineering (Primary Focus)

• Strong hands-on Python: OOP, generators, decorators, concurrency (multiprocessing/asyncio), exception handling, and unit testing  

(pytest). 

• Experience building production ETL/ELT pipelines, schema validation, and reusable internal Python packages/frameworks. 

• Proven ability to profile, debug, and optimize Python code for performance at data-pipeline scale. 

Databricks & Lakehouse

• Deep, hands-on Databricks experience: Delta Lake (ACID, time travel, OPTIMIZE/ZORDER/VACUUM), Structured Streaming, Auto Loader,   

and Unity Catalog.

Data Modelling & Warehousing

• Strong grounding in dimensional modelling: star/snowflake schema, SCD Types 1/2/3, fact/dimension grain, and conformed dimensions.

T-SQL

Data Architecture

GOOD TO HAVE

EDUCATION

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. 

SOFT SKILLS

Strong stakeholder communication; able to explain technical trade-offs to both engineering and business audiences; comfortable owning ambiguous, enterprise-scale design decisions end to end.

Job Description

We are looking for a Senior Full Stack Engineer with deep expertise in backend application development and Microsoft Azure deployment engineering. The role will primarily own backend services, APIs, integrations, data access, application security, CI/CD, cloud hosting, observability, and production readiness. The ideal candidate will also have working exposure to AWS and/or Google Cloud Platform and enough frontend understanding to collaborate effectively with React and TypeScript engineers. 

Responsibilities

- Backend Engineering and API Ownership

Develop and maintain scalable backend services using . NET, C#, and ASP. NET Core. 

Build secure REST APIs, integrations, and core business logic. 

Implement authentication and authorization using OAuth 2. 0, OpenID Connect, and Microsoft Entra ID. 

Design and optimize data models, repositories, and data access layers. 

Develop resilient integrations with internal and external systems using secure and asynchronous patterns. 

- Azure Deployment and Platform Engineering

Design, deploy, and maintain cloud solutions on Microsoft Azure. 

Build and manage services using Azure App Service, Functions, API Management, Storage, SQL, and Key Vault. 

Develop CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps and GitHub Actions. 

Implement monitoring, security, configuration management, and production readiness practices. 

Contribute to containerization and Infrastructure as Code using Docker, Bicep, Terraform, or similar technologies. 

Apply Azure best practices for security, scalability, reliability, and cost optimization.

Apply cloud architecture principles across Azure, AWS, and GCP. 

Contribute to cloud deployment, security, and operational practices. 

Collaborate with frontend teams to integrate backend services with React and TypeScript applications. 

Support end-to-end application integration, troubleshooting, and AI-enabled solutions.

Contribute to solution design, architecture, and technical estimations. 

Develop high-quality, secure, and maintainable code following engineering best practices. 

Perform code reviews and contribute to technical standards and reusable solutions. 

Implement automated testing and support performance, security, and reliability. 

Support end-to-end delivery, deployment, and production operations.

data.title: AI Forward Deployed Engineer
data.description:
Overview of Role: 

The AI Forward Deployed Engineer partners directly with business stakeholders to identify high-value opportunities and convert them into secure, scalable and measurable AI solutions. The role combines strong software engineering, generative AI and machine learning capability with stakeholder-facing delivery. It owns the journey from discovery and rapid prototyping through enterprise integration, production deployment, adoption and continuous improvement. 

KPIs: 

- Business Impact: Measured value delivered through AI solutions, including efficiency, quality, revenue, cost or risk outcomes. 
 - Time to Production: Speed and predictability in progressing priority use cases from discovery and proof of concept to production. 
 - Solution Quality and Reliability: Accuracy, relevance, latency, availability, scalability and operational stability of deployed solutions. 
 - Adoption and Stakeholder Satisfaction: Active usage, stakeholder feedback and successful integration into business workflows. 
 - Security and Governance: Adherence to data privacy, access control, responsible AI and enterprise governance requirements. 
 - Reusability and Enablement: Reusable accelerators, reference implementations, documentation and knowledge transfer created for broader adoption. 

Key Year One Deliverables: 

- Opportunity and Current-State Assessment: Assess priority business opportunities, existing AI capabilities, data sources, platforms, integrations and delivery constraints. 
 - Stakeholder Needs Analysis: Define business objectives, user needs, success measures, adoption barriers and technical requirements with key stakeholders. 
 - Prioritized Delivery Roadmap: Create and maintain a roadmap based on business value, feasibility, data readiness, risk and resource needs. 
 - Prototypes and Proofs of Concept: Develop rapid prototypes to validate technical feasibility, user value and solution direction. 
 - Production AI Solutions: Build, deploy and operationalize selected AI solutions with appropriate security, scalability, reliability and support readiness. 
 - Enterprise Integration: Integrate AI capabilities with enterprise applications, identity systems, APIs, data sources and operational workflows. 
 - Evaluation and Observability: Establish evaluation, error-analysis, logging, metrics, tracing, usage and cost-monitoring mechanisms. 
 - Documentation and Enablement: Deliver architecture documentation, runbooks, reusable patterns, training and knowledge transfer for users and support teams. 

Qualifications: 

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science , Engineering, Data Science or a related technical discipline, or equivalent practical experience. 
 - Hands-on experience developing software, machine learning or generative AI solutions through internships, academic projects or professional environments; production deployment experience is preferred. 
 - Demonstrated ability to translate business requirements into practical technical solutions and communicate effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders. 

Experience and Skills: 

- Software Engineering: Strong Python programming; backend and API development using FastAPI, Flask REST or equivalent; REST APIs, SQL, relational databases, Git, testing, debugging and code review. 
 - Generative AI and Context Engineering: Large language models, prompt and context engineering, RAG and Graph RAG, embeddings, semantic search, vector databases, tool/function calling, memory, agent orchestration and evaluation. 
 - Machine Learning: ML and deep-learning fundamentals, natural language processing, model evaluation, data preprocessing and experience with PyTorch and/or TensorFlow. 
 - Production Engineering: Containerization, CI/CD, cloud or on-premises deployment, observability, performance tuning, scalability, resilience and production troubleshooting. Familiarity with multi-model architectures, AI gateways, model routing, token and cost management, and model selection is preferred. 
 - Data and Integration: Data pipelines, enterprise application integration, identity and access management, secure configuration and interoperability across systems. 
 - AI Quality and Governance: Evaluation frameworks, error analysis, guardrails, responsible AI, data privacy, security, access control, lifecycle management and usage/cost monitoring. 
 - Forward Deployed Delivery: Stakeholder discovery, problem decomposition, rapid prototyping, ambiguity management, end-to-end ownership, documentation and knowledge transfer. 
 - Good to Have: Microsoft Azure and Azure OpenAI; LangGraph, LangChain or comparable frameworks; Qdrant, Milvus, pgvector or FAISS; Docker, Kubernetes, PostgreSQL and Redis; OpenTelemetry, Prometheus and Grafana; LiteLLM or comparable AI gateways. 

Key Behaviors: 

- Customer and Business Focus: Builds trusted stakeholder relationships and keeps solutions anchored to measurable user and business outcomes. 
 - Ownership: Takes responsibility from discovery through production stabilization, adoption and continuous improvement. 
 - Problem Solving: Uses structured analysis and hands-on troubleshooting across application, model, data, integration and infrastructure layers. 
 - Agility and Adaptability: Works effectively with ambiguity, changing priorities and evolving AI technologies. 
 - Collaboration and Communication: Explains complex topics clearly and works effectively across Product, Engineering, Architecture, Infrastructure, Security and business teams. 
 - Continuous Learning: Actively evaluates new approaches while applying sound engineering judgment, governance and evidence-based decision-making. 
 - Attention to Detail: Maintains high standards for quality, security, documentation and operational readiness. 

Reporting Structure: 

This role reports to the Innovation department lead. 

Visteon Culture

If you thrive in a fast-paced organizational culture that requires agility, adaptability and a growth mindset to stay ahead of the curve, Visteon is the place. We value high performance and a drive for results. Innovation, risk-taking and continuous learning help us keep pace with the ever-changing landscape of our industry and remain market leaders. At Visteon, you can be more.

data.title: Compiler Performance Engineer
data.description:
Falcon is the optimizing just in time (JIT) compiler in Azul Platform Prime. It compiles hot Java bytecode into highly optimized machine code and delivers Java performance that standard JVMs do not reach. Falcon is built on LLVM. 

We are looking for a Compiler Performance Engineer to make Falcon generate even faster code. This is not a compiler front end role and not a compiler built from scratch: the compiler exists, runs in production at large enterprises, and your job is to find where the generated code is slower than it should be and fix it in the optimizer and code generator. 

You will join a distributed team of compiler experts and work on real workloads with direct, measurable impact on customer performance. 

What You Will Do (aka Responsibilities)

- Analyze performance of Java benchmarks and customer workloads, find gaps in generated code and trace them to their root cause in the compiler

- Implement and improve optimizations in Falcon's middle end and back end: inlining, loop optimizations, vectorization, redundancy elimination, speculative optimizations and their interaction with the runtime

- Improve code generation for x86_64 and AArch64

- Write tests and benchmarks that prove the improvement and protect it from regressions

- Contribute changes upstream to LLVM where it makes sense

What You'll Bring (Experience, Skills)

- 2+ years of professional experience in compilers, JIT compilers or low level performance engineering

- Strong C++ design and coding skills

- Solid understanding of compiler optimization theory: SSA, data flow analysis, loop transformations

- Ability to read assembly and reason about why one instruction sequence is faster than another

Very Nice to Have

- Experience with LLVM IR and LLVM optimization passes, or with another optimizing compiler such as HotSpot C2, Graal, GCC or V8

- Experience with profilers such as perf, VTune or async profiler

- Knowledge of x86_64 and/or AArch64 microarchitecture

- Experience with Java, Scala or Kotlin, or with JVM internals

- MSc or PhD in Computer Science with a compiler or performance focus

data.description:
This is a leadership role in our engineering team - not just a cog in the wheel. 

This is not a "maintenance" role. This is engineering leadership-owning the backend architecture of a global, privacy-first communication platform. You'll lead by example, guide a high-calibre team, and ensure our backend systems remain blazing-fast, rock-solid, and uncompromising on security. You'll be at the intersection of code and leadership-mentoring engineers, driving architectural decisions, and setting engineering standards that define how a global product is built. 

Who are we?

We are a young product company scaling fast and outgrowing the startup tag-with global scale in our crosshairs. We don't do "okay. " We give everything we've got to build the best communication platform in the world. Our team includes engineers from IIT and other top institutions-people who care deeply about the craft, performance, and purpose. You'll learn more in 6 months here than most engineers do in 3 years elsewhere. We're intense. High-strung. Focused. Our team includes engineers from IIT and other top-tier

backgrounds. But what defines us is not our degrees-it's our refusal to compromise on quality, performance, or privacy. 

What are we building?

WrkTalk is the world's first zero-access, zero-spam enterprise communication product that operates on a structural privacy architecture. One that's already earned the trust of large enterprises like L&T Finance, Adani Group, and Kalyan Jewellers - just to name a few of our enterprise clients. This is not an MVP. This is production-grade software that secures communication for thousands-and soon, millions-of professionals worldwide. 

What's the role?

• Architect backend systems in NestJS and Golang to meet global scale and enterprise-grade performance. 

• Drive design for microservices, real-time comms (WebSockets, WebRTC), and data stores (PostgreSQL, Redis). 

• Lead code reviews, enforce coding standards, and maintain CI/CD discipline. 

• Mentor and upskill backend engineers. 

• Collaborate cross-functionally with frontend, DevOps, and product leaders. 

• Own technical problem-solving-anticipate bottlenecks, make hard calls, and prevent tech debt from being parked for "later. "

• Manage task allocation, workflow discipline, and ensure smooth collaboration with frontend and DevOps. 

The tech here is serious. 

We work on socket-driven comms infrastructure, distributed control towers, multi-category encryption, root detection, app kill-switches, dynamic guest access, device-level lockout, and OOO/ DND logic layered with smart whitelisting. This is not lightweight app dev. This is protocol-layer decision-making. 

Who should apply?

• 6-8+ years in backend engineering, with at least 2 years in a leadership role. 

• Expertise in Golang and Node. js (NestJS). 

• Strong database tuning skills (PostgreSQL, Redis). 

• Solid understanding of Docker, Kubernetes, and scalable deployment. 

• Experience building real-time systems at scale. 

• Proven ability to lead technical discussions and inspire engineering teams. 

• Track record of shipping production-grade, high-performance systems. 

Why should you join?

• Because you want to own backend architecture-not just follow it

• Because you'll work directly with established founders, not buried under layers

• Because you'll ship real, deeply engineered features used by large number of enterprise users

• Because you'll grow 10x faster here-in experience, learning, and impact

• And because if you walk this road with us for 3-4 years, it'll catapult you into a tech orbit or fame and glory you never imagined

Where are we located?

We're based in Navi Mumbai and building for the world.

data.description:
Job Details

Job Description: 

Overview

We are seeking a dynamic and passionate AI software engineer to join Intel's Data Center and AI group (DCAI). In this role, you will design and develop optimizations for high-performance AI serving and training frameworks such as SGLang, vLLM, and PyTorch. You will contribute to Intel's AI framework software stack and help enable and optimize state-of-the-art solutions for Intel's AI accelerators and next-generation GPUs. This position requires deep expertise in framework internals, scheduling, memory management, and kernel optimization for production AI workloads. 

Roles And Responsibilities

- Design and develop custom GPU kernels for AI framework operations including attention mechanisms, collective operations, and computation primitives to optimize performance on Intel accelerators and GPUs. 
 - Optimize and enhance framework components including scheduling, memory management, and execution pipeline architecture to improve throughput, latency, and resource utilization. 
 - Write and integrate high-performance kernels using GPU programming frameworks to maximize throughput and minimize latency. 
 - Identify and implement optimization opportunities in the framework stack for production AI workloads. 
 - Collaborate with the open-source community (SGLang, vLLM, PyTorch, and others), participate in upstream development, and integrate new innovations into production software. 
 - Debug and optimize complex multi-layered systems involving kernel execution, memory hierarchies, and distributed AI scenarios. 

Qualifications

Qualifications: 

- Bachelor's degree (B. Tech) or Master's degree (M. S. /M. Tech) in Computer Science, Electronics and Communications Engineering (ECE), or a related field, with 6 to 12 years of professional experience. 
 - Advanced proficiency in C++ (C++14/17) and intermediate skills in Python and parallel programming. 
 - Proven, hands-on experience writing and optimizing GPU kernels. Demonstrated expertise in kernel development for machine learning operations such as GEMM, attention mechanisms (including Flash Attention), collective operations, and sampling. 
 - In-depth, hands-on experience with AI frameworks-SGLang, vLLM, PyTorch, or similar production-grade serving and training systems. Deep understanding of their internal architecture, scheduling mechanisms, and memory management strategies is essential.

Join the team as Staff Backend Engineer on Twilio's Flex Engineering.

You will operate as the senior technical leader across multiple services, owning the architecture for problems that span multiple quarters and organizational boundaries, and you will be accountable for how the platform scales, performs, and stays available as customer demand grows. In this role, you'll:

data.description:
About Freshworks: 

Organizations everywhere struggle under the crushing costs and complexities of "solutions" that promise to simplify their lives. To create a better experience for their customers and employees. To help them grow. Software is a choice that can make or break a business. Create better or worse experiences. Propel or throttle growth. Business software has become a blocker instead of ways to get work done. 

There's another option. Freshworks. With a fresh vision for how the world works. 

Freshworks Inc. builds uncomplicated service software that delivers exceptional employee and customer experiences. Our people-first approach to AI eliminates friction, helping businesses reduce complexity, lower cost-to-serve, and deliver faster, more human support through enterprise-grade yet easy-to-use CX and IT solutions. Nearly 75, 000 companies, including Bridgestone, New Balance, Nucor, S&P Global, and Sony Music, trust Freshworks to power their Employee Experience (EX) and Customer Experience (CX) operations. 

Fresh vision. Real impact. Come build it with us. 

Job Description

Role Overview

We are seeking a highly experienced Principal Engineer to lead the design and evolution of the enterprise-scale platform architecture that powers Freshworks' multi-tier SaaS products. This role will define the architecture strategy for a major platform domain, drive modernization initiatives, and establish best practices across service design, reliability, engineering quality, and cost. 

The ideal candidate combines deep technical expertise in distributed systems, multi-tenant SaaS architecture, microservices, event-driven design, and large-scale production operations with strong leadership and stakeholder management capabilities - and remains genuinely hands-on, writing production code and leading deep debugging when it matters. 

Key Responsibilities

Architecture & Strategy

- Define and own the platform architecture roadmap for your domain, including the target state and a realistic path to it. 

- Design scalable, secure, and cost-efficient architectures supporting high-throughput, low-latency, multi-tenant workloads. 

- Establish architecture standards, design principles, decision records, and review practices. 

- Evaluate emerging technologies and own build-versus-buy decisions with measurable outcomes. 

Platform Engineering

- Architect and build cloud-native services and APIs that scale with global growth. 

- Design service decomposition, API contracts, messaging and event-driven flows, caching strategies, and database-layer design. 

- Treat multi-tenancy as a first-class design concern: isolation models, noisy-neighbour control, per-tenant limits, and cost attribution. 

- Lead platform modernization - monolith decomposition, migrations, and deprecations carried through to completion. 

Reliability, Performance & Operations

- Drive platform reliability, availability, performance optimization, and observability. 

- Take ownership of complex production issues in distributed SaaS environments, leading deep root-cause analysis and implementing permanent preventive safeguards. 

- Define SLOs, failure modes, resilience patterns, and capacity planning for the systems you own. 

Engineering Excellence & Quality

- Write clean, maintainable, high-performance production code and build proof-of-concepts that settle architectural questions. 

- Establish rigorous engineering standards through code reviews, automated testing, and CI/CD integration. 

- Identify architectural bottlenecks and technical debt, and drive practical, iterative refactoring without compromising business delivery. 

Security, Privacy & Compliance

- Ensure platform designs and team practices align with information security standards and regulatory requirements. 

- Design for tenant isolation, access control, auditability, and data residency from the outset. 

Technical Leadership

- Provide architectural guidance across multiple engineering teams. 

- Lead architecture reviews, design discussions, and technical decision-making. 

- Mentor senior and staff engineers, raising the bar through reference implementations and sponsorship rather than authority. 

- Influence engineering strategy and long-term technology investments; articulate complex trade-offs to both technical panels and executive stakeholders. 

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related discipline - or equivalent practical experience. 

- 14+ years of experience in software engineering, platform engineering, or systems architecture within modern distributed SaaS environments. 

- Expert-level backend engineering in Java, Python, Go, or equivalent - currently hands-on. 

- Proven experience designing and operating enterprise-scale, multi-tenant SaaS platforms, with real numbers for throughput, latency, availability, and behaviour under failure. 

- Strong understanding of distributed systems fundamentals: consistency and idempotency, retries and backpressure, concurrency, caching, and database design and optimization. 

- Demonstrated ownership of large-scale migrations or modernization initiatives with measurable outcomes. 

- Advanced production debugging skills - Linux internals, profiling, log analysis, and telemetry in distributed cloud environments. 

- Experience leading cross-functional architecture initiatives in SaaS or product organizations. 

Good to Have

Data Platform & Analytics

- Batch and real-time data ingestion, transformation, and serving architectures; streaming and CDC (Kafka, Kinesis, Debezium). 

- Lakehouse and modern data platform technologies such as Delta Lake, Iceberg, Databricks, Snowflake, and cloud-native data services. 

- Reusable data models, semantic layers, and curated data products enabling self-service analytics. 

- Data governance practice - metadata management, cataloging, lineage, and data quality frameworks. 

- Feature and training data architectures supporting AI/ML initiatives. 

Adjacent Experience

- ClickHouse, OpenSearch, or similar analytical and search engines. 

- AI-native product capabilities - RAG, agentic workflows, and LLM integration in production. 

- FinOps practice: cost attribution, showback, and efficiency guardrails at platform scale. 

Additional Information

At Freshworks, we have fostered an environment that enables everyone to find their true potential, purpose, and passion, welcoming colleagues of all backgrounds, genders, sexual orientations, religions, and ethnicities. We are committed to providing equal opportunity and believe that diversity in the workplace creates a more vibrant, richer environment that boosts the goals of our employees, communities, and business. Fresh vision. Real impact. Come build it with us.

Role Definition

An experienced quality assurance contributor who independently plans and executes standard software testing assignments and supports complex quality engineering activities under guidance. The QA Engineer helps ensure that application changes, integrations and releases meet agreed functional, technical, security and usability expectations. 

Key Responsibilities

Test analysis and planning

- Analyze business requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria and solution designs to identify test conditions, dependencies and quality risks. 
 - Prepare and maintain test scenarios, test cases, test data, traceability and execution plans for assigned features or applications. 
 - Estimate standard testing activities and complete them within agreed delivery timelines and quality standards. 
 - Apply approved quality processes, test standards, security requirements and documentation practices. 

Test execution and defect management

- Execute functional, integration, regression, system and user-acceptance support testing across supported applications and interfaces. 
 - Record clear test evidence and results, including reproducible steps, expected outcomes and actual outcomes. 
 - Log, classify, track, retest and close defects in coordination with developers, business analysts and application support teams. 
 - Escalate high-risk defects, environment issues, data concerns and release blockers with appropriate diagnostic information. 

Quality engineering and release support

- Develop and maintain reusable automated tests for suitable regression scenarios using approved tools and frameworks. 
 - Execute automated test suites, analyze failures and maintain scripts as applications change. 
 - Participate in release-readiness reviews and verify entry criteria, exit criteria, defect status and test completion. 
 - Support smoke testing, production validation and post-release verification for planned deployments. 

Collaboration and continuous improvement

- Coordinate with product owners, business users, developers, architects, infrastructure teams and external service providers. 
 - Participate in requirement reviews, design reviews, sprint ceremonies, defect triage and quality-improvement activities. 
 - Share lessons learned, update test assets and knowledge articles, and contribute to consistent QA practices.

data.title: Senior Java Software Engineer
data.description:
Senior Java Backend Engineer

Total Experience: 9-12 Years

Location: Bangalore and Pune

We are looking for a Senior Java Backend Engineer to design, develop and deliver backend services for a software engineering team that uses Generative AI in its daily work. 

You will quickly learn a new product, its architecture, integrations and business context, and deliver production-ready changes through a Spec-Driven Development process. You will use GenAI for coding, refactoring, debugging, testing, documentation and codebase exploration, while you keep full technical understanding and ownership of each result. 

The role is focused on backend engineering, service integrations, data processing and the delivery path to production. You will be responsible for the complete result, not only an individual backend task. You will own the CI/CD pipelines of the applications that you develop until they produce artifacts that are ready for production. 

This is a hands-on engineering role. Product priorities remain with the product owners. Cross-system architecture, infrastructure, security and release decisions remain with their authorised owners. 

Team & Transformation Context

The team is moving towards GenAI-first development and Spec-Driven Development. Some practices are already in place, while others are still being developed. 

You will use specifications, code, automated tests, CI/CD and AI tools in one engineering workflow. You will help the team find reliable ways to use GenAI and make sure that AI-generated work is checked independently before it goes to production. 

Key Responsibilities

- Use a Spec-Driven Development process for coding, refactoring, debugging, testing, documentation and codebase exploration. Keep specifications, implementation, tests and documentation consistent. 
 - Review and validate AI-generated solutions critically before they are used in production. Modify or reject them when they are not correct or not suitable. 
 - Design and develop backend services, APIs, integrations and data-processing solutions with Java and Spring Boot. 
 - Define service contracts with OpenAPI and AsyncAPI. Design for validation, compatibility, security, error handling and partial failure. 
 - Work with databases, distributed systems and service-to-service integrations. 
 - Learn unfamiliar codebases, architecture, dependencies and product context quickly. Understand how the system works from end to end. 
 - Own the CI/CD pipelines for the applications that you develop, and produce artifacts that are ready for production. 
 - Use monitoring and runtime evidence to find the cause of problems in distributed systems. 
 - Contribute to architecture, code reviews, technical decisions, mentoring and engineering quality. 
 - Work closely with frontend, QA, product, architecture and infrastructure teams. Required Experience

- Strong production experience with Java and Spring Boot, typically nine years or more of backend software engineering with senior-level ownership and technical judgement. 
 - Strong hands-on experience using GenAI in everyday software development, with examples of how you checked its output. 
 - Ability to understand, explain, validate, modify or reject AI-generated code without relying only on generated tests, compilation or an AI self-review. 
 - Good knowledge of the Spec-Driven Development process and frameworks such as OpenSpec. 
 - Ability to turn an incomplete change request into a clear specification with expected behaviour, examples, errors and open decisions. 
 - Strong understanding of REST APIs, OpenAPI, AsyncAPI, microservices, integrations, data models, databases, error handling, security and distributed systems. 
 - Ability to understand complex systems and unfamiliar technical domains quickly. 
 - Strong systems thinking and interest in the product beyond individual backend tasks. 
 - Good understanding of DevOps practices such as CI/CD, containers, deployment, monitoring and troubleshooting. 
 - Ability to explain technical decisions, risks and trade-offs clearly to technical and non-technical people. 
 - Professional working proficiency in English (B2 level or above). Preferred Experience

- Experience with Kubernetes and cloud platforms. 
 - Experience with messaging systems and asynchronous integrations. 
 - Experience with infrastructure as code and observability tools. 
 - Experience with industrial or manufacturing software. 
 - Frontend development experience. Familiarity with Angular and modern frontend development principles. 
 - Good understanding of GenAI internals and related tools such as MCP, LangChain or CrewAI, and of when these tools are not necessary. 
 - Experience with AI coding agents such as Claude Code, Codex, Cursor or GitHub Copilot. 
 - Experience helping other engineers adopt GenAI or Spec-Driven Development practices. Engineering judgement matters more than experience with a specific technology. 

The successful candidate will use sound technical judgement, show strong curiosity and learn fast. They will take end-to-end ownership of the product results that they deliver, use GenAI as a tool without giving it responsibility for the result, and deliver backend changes that work correctly in production.

data.description:
Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way. 

The Community You Will Join

The Quality team ensures that Community Support, AirCover, Payments, Compliance, and Supply operations consistently meet the highest standards, blending rigorous QA frameworks with AI-enabled AutoQA to catch issues early, protect trust, and keep experiences safe and reliable at global scale. 

The Difference You Will Make

This senior leader is accountable for the end-to-end quality program at the Airbnb Capability Center (ACC), which spans multiple business functions: 

- Community Support - Volume Tiers, Safety, Premium Support, CS Labs Annotation, Regulatory Response, Payments, and Executive Escalations
 - AirCover
 - Compliance/ZTP
 - Payments Risk & Ops
 - Supply

This leader oversees a team of ~71 employees, with seven direct reports, and carries quality accountability for both internal ACC teams and a network of external partner/vendor sites. 

Additionally, this leader needs to support Quality transformation efforts, including: 

- Migration to a new quality management system
 - Shifting from manual QA to AI enabled AutoQA
 - Establishing a Human in the Loop program, that monitors AI model accuracy

The successful candidate will arrive with a clear point of view on what world-class quality looks like when AI is doing most of the volume and humans are doing the highest-judgment work; and can hold the line on the legal and ethical guardrails that come with it. This role reports to the Director of Quality for Global Operations, and represents ACC ("Airbnb India / Team India") quality in global forums. 

A Typical Day

Strategic Leadership & Program Ownership

- Own and execute the ACC quality strategy across all supported functions. 
 - Drive alignment with the global quality framework, working in collaboration with various stakeholders, including the Quality and Delivery leadership
 - Represent ACC Quality in Weekly Ops Reviews, MBRs, Enablement Ops Reviews, Leadership Group Connects, and QBRs; deliver a proactive narrative that surfaces emerging risk rather than reporting lagging metrics. 
 - Thought leadership on new programs, such as continuous calibration of AI-based Auto QA

Measurement & Quality Execution

- Oversee QA evaluation execution across all ACC functions, ensuring consistent application of frameworks as the organization migrates to COPC-aligned frameworks
 - Operate Audit-the-Auditor as an ongoing control
 - Work with Delivery and other stakeholders to improve quality performance

Insights, Reporting & Stakeholder Partnership

- Proactively share insights with Delivery on performance deepdives and analysis
 - Partner with analytical teams on anomaly-detection and quality dashboards
 - Implement detractor-analysis frameworks (global detractor / NPS patterns) so systemic issues surface in real time

AI, AutoQA & Technology Enablement

- Drive AutoQA adoption across ACC tiers 
 - Partner with Engineering on calibration model for AutoQA
 - Drive and sponsor high-value process automation at ACC

People & Culture Leadership

- Lead a large team that spans multiple business functions (Volume Tier, Safety, AirCover, Compliance, Premium Support, Payments, Supply, CS Labs, Insights); grow leaders through active development planning
 - Foster a One-Quality-Team culture across internal ACC and partner sites: shared best practices, cross-functional calibration, and proactive knowledge sharing
 - Set high expectations for output quality, insight delivery, and stakeholder engagement, and hold the team accountable. 
 - Partner closely with global Quality peers to ensure one consistent quality

Required

Your Expertise: 

- Experience in Customer/Community Support, Quality, Operations, or Trust & Safety, including direct experience leading quality programs in sensitive, high-stakes, or regulated support environments. 
 - Demonstrated experience building or transforming quality programs for complex, multi-function support portfolios. 
 - Deep expertise in quality methodologies (COPC, AQS, Six Sigma, Lean) and the ability to apply them across high-volume and high-complexity support alike. 
 - Hands-on ownership of QA tooling: form design, calibration management, and AutoQA deployment. 
 - Experience managing globally distributed quality teams across multiple functions, languages, and partner organizations in a 24/7 environment. 
 - Experience deploying or scaling AI/ML-assisted QA (AutoQA, predictive NPS/CSAT). 
 - Strong executive presence: able to influence senior stakeholders, present a unified quality narrative in leadership forums, and drive cross-functional alignment. 
 - Experience with vendor/partner governance: calibration oversight, performance-improvement plans, and escalation frameworks. 
 - Bachelor's degree required. 

Preferred

- Master's degree or equivalent in Business, Operations, Law, Risk Management, Engineering, or a related field. 
 - COPC certification; Six Sigma Green or Black Belt. 
 - Experience with Observe. AI (and migration off legacy platforms such as NICE/Nexidia). 
 - Background in program management, change management, or organizational design in a high-growth tech environment. 
 - Experience operating within BPO/vendor governance models at scale (1, 000+ partner FTEs across multiple sites and geographies). 
 - Experience operating in a global capability center. 

Our Commitment To Inclusion & Belonging

Airbnb is committed to working with the broadest talent pool possible. We believe diverse ideas foster innovation and engagement, and allow us to attract creatively-led people, and to develop the best products, services and solutions. All qualified individuals are encouraged to apply. 

How We'll Take Care Of You

Our job titles may span more than one career level. The actual base pay is dependent upon many factors, such as: training, transferable skills, work experience, business needs and market demands. The base pay range shown below is annualized, is inclusive of allowances and is subject to change and may be modified in the future. This role may also be eligible for bonus or incentives, one or more equity programs, benefits, and Employee Travel Credits. 

India Annual Pay Range

₹5, 900, 000-₹8, 500, 000 INR

Reasonable Accommodations: We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the recruitment process for applicants with disabilities. If you need assistance, or an accommodation, please let your recruiter know once you are contacted about a role. 

A Note on Recruiting Scams: Scammers sometimes pose as Airbnb recruiters to get money or personal information from candidates. A few things that will always be true for Airbnb's hiring process: our open roles are posted on Airbnb's Career's Page at careers. airbnb. com, and our recruiters correspond only from @airbnb. com or @ext. airbnb. com email addresses. Our recruiters will never ask for your Social Security number, bank account details, passport, or payment app information while you are interviewing. We'll also never ask you to pay a fee, send money, deposit or cash a check, or purchase work-related equipment (such as a company laptop) during the interview process. The Zscaler Zero Trust Exchange platform protects thousands of customers from cyberattacks and data loss by securely connecting users, devices, and applications in any location. Distributed across 200+ public data centers globally and thousands of private sites at the edge, the SASE-based Zero Trust Exchange is the world's largest in-line cloud security platform. 

We believe the future of work is Human + AI and are building an AI-native enterprise where human potential is amplified by machine intelligence to solve the world's hardest security challenges. Driven by deep customer obsession, we are committed to the mission, outcome, and to each other. We bring these commitments to life through three core behaviors: ownership and collaboration, trust through outcomes and impact, and a challenge culture with ongoing feedback. Ready to make an impact at the company pioneering security transformation in the AI era? Join us at Zscaler. 

Role

We are looking for a Staff Software Development Engineer to join our team. This is a hybrid role based in Bangalore, reporting to the Director, of Engineering. 

What You'll Do (Role Expectations)

- Develop automation frameworks and automate test cases for the various features of Zscaler Client Connector. 
 - Expand automation coverage and infrastructure to improve the quality and efficiency of testing. 
 - Understand requirements, develop an exhaustive test plan, execute manual and automated test cases, dig deeper into issues, identify root causes and articulate defects clearly. 
 - Deliver a high-quality robust product in a fast-paced environment. 
 - Work closely with the Development, Product Management, and cloud Operations teams from design to release of the product/ feature. 
 - Recreate complex customer and production reported issues to determine root cause and verify the fixt

Who You Are (Success Profile)

- You thrive in ambiguity. You're comfortable building the path as you walk it. You thrive in a dynamic environment, seeing ambiguity not as a hindrance, but as the raw material to build something meaningful. 
 - You act like an owner. Your passion for the mission fuels your bias for action. You operate with integrity because you genuinely care about the outcome. True ownership involves leveraging dynamic range: the ability to navigate seamlessly between high-level strategy and hands-on execution. 
 - You are a problem-solver. You love running towards the challenges because you are laser-focused on finding the solution, knowing that solving the hard problems delivers the biggest impact. 
 - You are a high-trust collaborator. You are ambitious for the team, not just yourself. You embrace our challenge culture by giving and receiving ongoing feedback-knowing that candor delivered with clarity and respect is the truest form of teamwork and the fastest way to earn trust. 
 - You are a learner. You have a true growth mindset and are obsessed with your own development, actively seeking feedback to become a better partner and a stronger teammate. You love what you do and you do it with purpose. 

What We're Looking For (Minimum Qualifications)

- Foundational understanding of AI/ML technologies and experience leveraging, securing, or positioning AI-driven solutions to optimize outcomes within your functional domain
 - 5+ years' experience as Software QA Engineer working on VPN related products or network traffic related testing / automation
 - Proficient programming skills (python preferred) and good amount of hands-on experience developing automation frameworks, CICD pipelines and leading automated test case development
 - Good knowledge of TCP/IP stack, ICMP/UDP, HTTP/HTTPS, SSL/ TLS, DNS and DHCP
 - Proficient in Networking fundamentals (L3, L4, L7) , Proxies, Firewalls, Routers and Load Balancers

What Will Make You Stand Out (Preferred Qualifications)

- Experience implementing AIOps, AI-driven predictive scaling, or automated anomaly detection to optimize cloud infrastructure performance and reliability

At Zscaler, we are committed to building a team that reflects the communities we serve and the customers we work with. We foster an inclusive environment that values all backgrounds and perspectives, emphasizing collaboration and belonging. Join us in our mission to make doing business seamless and secure. 

Benefits

Our Benefits program is one of the most important ways we support our employees. Zscaler proudly offers comprehensive and inclusive benefits to meet the diverse needs of our employees and their families throughout their life stages, including: 

- Various health plans

- Architect, build, and operate production AI/ML systems and agentic workflows, including the tooling, infrastructure, and processes needed to develop, test, and deploy them reliably.

data.title: Embedded QA & Test Engineer
data.description:
Major Responsibilities

Embedded Gateway & IoT Connectivity Testing: 

- Test embedded C++ firmware on Linux/RTOS-based IoT gateways. 
 - Validate Azure IoT Hub communication workflows, including: 
 - Telemetry messaging
 - Cloud-to-device (C2D) commands
 - Device Twins
 - Device Provisioning Service (DPS)
 - Certificate rotation and secure connectivity
 - Validate message queueing, offline buffering, reconnect logic, and retry behavior under real-world network conditions

Industrial Protocol Testing: 
 - Develop and execute test cases for: 
 - Modbus Serial (RTU): timing behavior, register maps, function codes, exception handling. 
 - Modbus TCP: multi-client scenarios, socket recovery, error handling. 
 - CAN bus: arbitration, extended/standard IDs, error frames, bus overload, and edge-case behavior. 
 - Uses protocol analyzers, CAN interfaces, Modbus simulators, and logic analyzers to capture and analyze traffic. 
Firmware Update & OTA Lifecycle Validation: 

- Test firmware and system updates using hawkBit (deployment orchestration) and SWUpdate (A/B updates, failover, signing, rollback)
 - Validate update workflows under stress, including: 
 - Interrupted updates (power loss, network drop)
 - Corrupted image scenarios
 - Update rollback and fallback behavior
 - Ensure secure update chain-of-trust, signature verification, and partition layout integrity. 
Automation & CI/CD Integration: 

- Develop automated test suites using Python or C++ to validate firmware, protocols, OTA processes, and system services. 
 - Build hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) automated test setups for regression, protocol simulation, and device behavior testing. 
 - Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, GitLab, Azure DevOps, Jenkins). 
 - Maintain automation tools for serial logging, bus capture, cloud message verification, and gateway diagnostics. 

Debugging & Quality Reporting: 

- Investigate firmware and system issues via logs, traces, core dumps, serial output, and protocol captures. 
 - Reproduce field issues in controlled environments and collaborate with engineering teams to diagnose root causes. 
 - Generate test reports, defect metrics, and release readiness assessments. 
 - Contribute to continuous improvement of testing tools, processes, and standards. 

Minimum Job Requirements

Education

- Bachelor of Computer Science or Engineering or equivalent years of experience. 

Certification / License

Work Experience

- 3 years of experience in embedded system testing, QA engineering, or IoT device validation. 
 - Experience testing embedded Linux or RTOS-based gateways. 
 - Hands-on experience with Azure IoT Hub (telemetry, C2D, twins, DPS), hawkBit and SWUpdate, Modbus Serial (RTU) and Modbus TCP, and CAN bus testing and analysis

Knowledge / Skills / Abilities

- Strong understanding of C++ firmware behavior (reading & analyzing code, debugging tests). 
 - Strong Python scripting capability for automation and test tool development. 
 - Proficiency with lab equipment (CAN analyzers, Modbus simulators, USB-to-serial tools, oscilloscopes). 
 - Solid networking knowledge (TCP/IP, TLS, certificates, provisioning flows). 

Preferred Job Requirements

Education

Certification / License

Work Experience

- Experience with IoT cloud platforms, fleet management, or gateway deployments
 - Experience with MQTT, AMQP, REST APIs, or proprietary field protocols
 - Experience building HIL / automated protocol simulation frameworks (pytest, Robot Framework, custom rigs). 

Knowledge / Skills / Abilities

- Familiarity with secure boot, signed firmware images, and SBOM/security compliance. 
 - Knowledge of Yocto, Buildroot, systemd, and Linux internals. 
 - Familiarity with J1939, CANOpen, or other industrial stacks. 
 - Exposure to DevOps practices for firmware CI pipelines. 
 - Knowledge of SQL server and general database management concepts
