As a Software Quality Engineer (IC IV) and member of a multi-functional Agile team, you will identify user-centric scenarios and build & execute automation to ensure quality across our scientific and healthcare products. 

You will report, track, and validate issues discovered during design and development, and coach less-experienced analysts. Success requires a strong passion for quality, a customer-first mindset, problem-solving skills, and effective communication across a product organization. 

Key Responsibilities

- Design, maintain, and execute manual and automated test cases using appropriate test management tools. 
 - Analyze defects, perform root-cause analysis, and collaborate with engineering to drive timely resolution and preventive measures. 
 - Leverage domain knowledge (scientific/healthcare) to devise thorough test coverage across end-to-end workflows and user experience. 
 - Participate in Scrum ceremonies (planning, reviews, retrospectives) and client feedback sessions to align quality goals with delivery timelines. 
 - Document clear steps to reproduce, expected vs. actual results, and traceability to requirements/user stories. 
 - Apply risk-based testing techniques to prioritize effort and optimize coverage within deadlines. 
 - Adhere to internal quality standards and processes; track effort and surface impediments proactively. 
 - Review technical documentation for accuracy, completeness, and clarity. 
 - Perform other related duties as assigned. 

Required Skills

- Experience with UI automation tools: Playwright. 
 - Familiarity with AI-based testing tools or applying AI to improve test efficiency (automation and/or manual). 
 - Basic to intermediate Java knowledge for automation scripting. 
 - Understanding of the Software Testing Life Cycle (STLC) and defect management. 
 - Strong time management; ability to work independently with minimal supervision. 

Good To Have (Preferred)

- Experience with UIPath tools (including test automation and workflow automation). 
 - Healthcare domain exposure, including awareness of HIPAA and common healthcare workflows. 
 - Basic to intermediate knowledge of performance testing (e. g. , workload modeling, baseline validation). 

Soft Skills

- Strong ownership mindset and positive, collaborative attitude. 
 - Willingness to learn new tools and technologies, especially in AI and automation. 
 - Clear, concise communication and cross-functional collaboration. 

Experience & Education

- Bachelor's degree in Software Engineering, Mathematics, or related field, or equivalent relevant experience. 
 - 2-5 years of experience across SDLC, testing methodologies, and quality assurance. 
 - Design, develop, and maintain automated tests using type script. 
 - Collaborate with development teams to understand requirements and ensure comprehensive test coverage. 
 - Perform database validation and write SQL queries for Microsoft SQL Server or Oracle. 
 - Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines (e. g. , Azure DevOps). 
 - Debug automation scripts and provide detailed defect reports. 
 - Use IDEs such as IntelliJ IDEA or Eclipse for development and testing. 
 - Hands-on with AI-driven testing tools/frameworks for automated test generation, defect prediction, and intelligent regression analysis. 
 - Apply ML/NLP techniques for test data creation, anomaly detection, and predictive quality assurance. 

Tools & Technologies (Working Knowledge)

- Playwright, Selenium WebDriver, UIPath
 - Java, Cucumber (BDD)
 - SQL (SQL Server/Oracle)
 - Azure DevOps (Boards, Repos, Pipelines) for CI/CD integration
 - IntelliJ IDEA, Eclipse
 - AI-driven testing platforms/techniques

Supervisory Responsibilities

None

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications analyzing resumes, or assessing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. data.title: Consultant - Operational Technology Data Operations
data.description:
Company Overview

We exist to make food the world loves. But we do more than that. Our company is a place that prioritizes being a force for good, a place to expand learning, explore new perspectives and reimagine new possibilities, every day. We look for people who want to bring their best - bold thinkers with big hearts who challenge one another and grow together. Because becoming the undisputed leader in food means surrounding ourselves with people who are hungry for what's next. 

Overview

The GIC Supply Chain team manages end-to-end operations, encompassing planning, sourcing, manufacturing, logistics, and analytics. They strategically plan to meet market demands, optimize sourcing, ensure efficient production, and oversee the seamless movement of goods from production to delivery. The team employs advanced analytics throughout these processes, fostering adaptability and operational excellence. This collaborative approach ensures a well-coordinated supply chain that aligns with both organizational goals and dynamic market conditions. This role requires you to operate in 1. 30 pm to 10. 30 pm. 

Key Accountabilities

- Design, configure, and deploy Ignition-based OT Data Operations gateways at the manufacturing edge, including virtual machines, Windows Server environments, plant networks, drivers, tags, MQTT brokers, historians, and security roles. 
 - Implement and standardize sensor-to-signal workflows from PLC/SCADA connectivity through calculations and contextualization into MES and analytics platforms. 
 - Collaborate with MES engineers, solution architects, and site controls engineers to ensure smooth integration of the OT Data Operations layer with TrakSYS MES, existing MQIS capabilities, and future MOM solutions. 
 - Apply and maintain ISA-95-aligned data models for assets, materials, orders, and events, ensuring consistency across plants and use cases. 
 - Partner with IT integration teams to design scalable and supportable integration patterns between OT systems, SAP, PLM, and enterprise analytics platforms. 
 - Support the configuration, performance, and storage strategy of time-series databases, including SQL Server historian, QuestDB, and future platforms. 
 - Define and implement monitoring, alerting, security controls, and operational runbooks for Ignition gateways, MQTT brokers, and associated infrastructure across pilot and production sites. 
 - Support site rollout activities including lab validation, plant commissioning, troubleshooting, infrastructure sizing, and continuous improvement of deployment patterns. 
 - Develop and maintain documentation, standards, playbooks, and training materials in partnership with Digital Controls & IS, Digital Core, plant engineering, and vendor teams to enable scalable deployment and local support. 

Minimum Qualifications

- Education: Bachelor's degree in Instrumentation, Electronics, Electrical, or IT Engineering from an accredited university. 
 - Experience: 10+ years of experience in Controls Engineering, Manufacturing Systems Engineering, and Data Analytics, including 5+ years of relevant experience in OT Data Operations on Ignition. 
 - Technical Skills: Strong experience in OT/industrial automation engineering, including PLC/SCADA, historians, industrial networks, and manufacturing data integration/MES implementation. 
 - Platform Expertise: Direct hands-on experience with Inductive Automation Ignition, including gateway configuration, tag historian, alarming, MQTT modules, security/SSO, Perspective, and Jython scripting. 
 - Data & Integration Knowledge: Knowledge of ISA-95 modeling concepts, Unified Namespace (UNS), asset hierarchy, and OT-to-IT integration architecture. 
 - System & Connectivity Skills: Hands-on experience with PLC/SCADA connectivity, protocols such as OPC-UA, Modbus, vendor-specific drivers, scripting/configuration using Python, SQL, and Ignition scripting, and Windows/Linux server environments with virtualization. 
 - Analytical & Technical Capability: Experience with time-series databases/historians, IIoT and MQTT broker technologies, and the ability to read and interpret P&IDs, control narratives, and plant network diagrams. 
 - Soft Skills: Strong problem-solving, cross-functional collaboration, and written/verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain technical architectures to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. 
 - Industry Experience: Experience working in regulated or highly controlled environments such as food manufacturing, pharma, or CPG

Preferred Qualifications

- Exposure to MES platforms such as TrakSYS or similar, and integration patterns with SAP or other enterprise systems
 - GCP certification
 - Background in Mathematics or Statistics

ELIGIBILITY

Applicants must meet minimum age qualifications in the country in which the job is located.

data.title: Lead Security Research Engineer
data.description:
Come work at a place where innovation and teamwork come together to support the most exciting missions in the world!

Job Description

We are seeking an experienced and technically exceptional Lead Security Research Engineer to drive our Vulnerability Detection Signature Research team. In this role, you will set the technical direction for how we research, develop, and deliver advanced vulnerability detection libraries for our scanning product suite, while mentoring engineers and raising the bar for detection quality across the team. 

Beyond hands-on research, you will own the roadmap for detection coverage, champion automation to scale our research capabilities, and partner with leadership and cross-functional teams to solve the hardest problems in vulnerability detection. Exposure to AI/ML is a strong plus. If you combine deep vulnerability research expertise with the ability to lead people and technical strategy, this role is for you. 

Responsibilities

- Set technical direction and own the roadmap for vulnerability detection libraries (signatures) across Qualys Scanner product suite. 
 - Lead the research, design, and development of new detection logic and the enhancement of existing content for databases, applications, operating systems, TCP/IP protocols, and network devices. 
 - Mentor and technically guide Senior and mid-level Research Engineers, conducting design and code reviews and establishing best practices and standards for high-quality detection content. 
 - Explore and, where valuable, drive the adoption of AI/ML techniques to accelerate research, development, and validation such as automated signature generation, false positive/negative reduction, anomaly detection, and intelligent triage of emerging vulnerabilities. 
 - Design and scale automation frameworks for recurring research, development, and validation tasks. 
 - Continuously evaluate emerging technologies and threat trends, and collaborate with customers, vendors, and internal stakeholders to expand detection coverage. 
 - Partner with Customer Support and Research teams to lead the resolution of complex customer issues, such as false positives/negatives, and drive systemic fixes. 
 - Represent the team in cross-functional planning, providing technical estimates, risk assessments, and delivery commitments. 
 - Champion strong documentation, knowledge sharing, and a culture of engineering excellence. 

Qualifications

- 7+ years of experience in network and systems security, including demonstrated technical leadership or team mentorship. 
 - Deep understanding of common protocols: TCP/IP, HTTP, FTP, SSH, SSL/TLS. 
 - Strong knowledge of common security vulnerabilities and mitigation techniques. 
 - Hands-on experience with Python and Bash scripting. 
 - Hands-on working experience with containers and orchestration tools (Docker, Kubernetes). 
 - Familiarity with network analysis tools and packet capture analysis. 
 - Strong ability to prioritize, plan, and manage multiple workstreams and people in a fast-paced environment. 
 - System administration experience on Windows or Unix/Linux platforms. 
 - Strong understanding of VPNs, Firewalls, and IDS/IPS technologies. 
 - Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate technical concepts to both engineers and non-technical stakeholders. 

Additional Plus Competencies

- Exposure to applying AI/ML to security problems - e. g. , using machine learning for detection, classification, anomaly detection, or pattern recognition, or leveraging LLMs to automate research, code, or content-generation workflows. 
 - Knowledge of Lua (preferred) or Java. 
 - Experience with virtualization platforms such as VMWare, VirtualBox, XEN, etc. 
 - Understanding of cloud platforms (e. g. , AWS, Azure, Oracle Cloud), including their AI/ML services. 
 - Experience using or developing vulnerability scanners, IDS/IPS, and other security tools. 
 - Prior experience building security-related tools or automation at scale. 
 - Industry certifications such as OSCP, CISSP, and GIAC. 
 - Track record of leading projects and small teams independently with minimal supervision. 

Why Join Us?

- Lead cutting-edge security research and shape how AI/ML transforms vulnerability detection alongside a talented, collaborative engineering team. 
 - Directly influence the security posture of thousands of customers. 
 - Opportunities for professional development, certifications, and continuous learning. 
 - Inclusive culture that values innovation, ownership, and customer impact.

data.description:
ADVANCE YOUR CAREER. ADVANCE THE WORLD. 

At AMD, we believe technology has the power to solve the world's most important challenges. From advancing healthcare and scientific discovery to powering AI and the technologies people rely on every day, innovation at AMD is shaping the future. 

Whether you're designing next-gen processors, enabling AI breakthroughs, or bringing leading edge products to market, every role at AMD contributes to something bigger - technology that moves the world forward. Join us and, together, we'll advance your career. 

Staff Software Development Engineer - Yocto / Embedded Linux

The Role

AMD is seeking a highly motivated Software Development Engineer to join our Embedded System Software team, building the Yocto-based build infrastructure and board support software that enable AMD Adaptive SoCs and FPGAs. You will own the layers, distributions, and toolchains that turn new AMD silicon into a buildable, supportable software platform for Linux, OpenBMC, and real-time workloads. 

Working alongside AMD silicon architects, hardware designers, kernel and firmware teams, and the Yocto and OpenEmbedded communities, you will take new silicon from first power-on to a supportable, upstreamable platform, and build the images, SDKs, and reference designs customers develop against. 

The Person

The ideal candidate is passionate about embedded Linux and build systems, and enjoys solving complex system-level challenges that span hardware and software boundaries. You possess strong software engineering fundamentals, deep expertise in Yocto and board support package development, and a proven ability to drive features from concept through silicon bring-up and into production. 

You are comfortable across the full stack, from a device tree node to a released SDK, and collaborate effectively with architects and engineering teams across AMD. 

Key Responsibilities

- Yocto Build Infrastructure: Design and maintain the Yocto and OpenEmbedded layers that enable new AMD silicon - SoC family definitions, machine configurations, tunes, and layer architecture across BSP and distro layers. 
 - Kernel, Bootloader and Boot Image Integration: Integrate recipes for the Linux kernel, U-Boot, TF-A, and platform firmware, and build the boot artifact pipeline - device tree packaging, flash layout, signing, secure boot, and golden-image recovery. 
 - Multi-Domain Builds and SDKs: Define multiconfig builds that produce Linux, RTOS, firmware, and programmable logic artifacts together, and deliver the SDKs and toolchains teams develop against. 
 - Adaptive SoC and Programmable Logic: Integrate programmable logic into the software stack, including bitstream packaging, device tree overlays, and enabling PL interfaces from Linux. 
 - Silicon and Board Bring-Up: Participate in new silicon and board bring-up from first power-on, holding the integrated image and driving issues to root cause with hardware and firmware teams. 
 - CI, Release and Technical Leadership: Maintain QEMU-based virtual platforms and continuous integration, deliver release artifacts and software bills of materials, mentor junior engineers, and contribute to architecture reviews. 

Required Qualifications

- Deep hands-on experience with the Yocto Project, OpenEmbedded, and BitBake - authoring recipes, bbappends, and classes, building BSP and distro layers, SDK generation, and diagnosing complex build failures. 
 - Strong embedded Linux and board support package background: the Linux kernel from a platform integration standpoint, device trees, kernel configuration and fragments, driver enablement, and bootloaders and early firmware such as U-Boot and TF-A. 
 - Familiarity with BMC products and the platform management domain, and interfaces such as I2C, SPI, eSPI, and PECI. 
 - Strong programming skills in C and C++, and proficiency in Python or shell scripting for build and automation work. 
 - Experience debugging complex system-level issues spanning build systems, operating systems, drivers, bootloaders, and firmware, and familiarity with Git and CI/CD workflows. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with AMD Adaptive SoCs and FPGA technologies, including AMD VivadoTM or VitisTM and hardware/software co-design. 
 - Zephyr or another embedded RTOS, and RISC-V or other non-x86 architectures, including board enablement and toolchain integration. 
 - Inter-processor communication frameworks such as OpenAMP in heterogeneous multi-core systems. 
 - Experience with OpenBMC or a comparable BMC software stack and its integration into a Yocto distribution. 
 - QEMU or comparable virtual platforms for pre-silicon development and continuous integration. 
 - Experience developing reference designs or proof-of-concept solutions, and release engineering at scale including SBOM and CVE triage. 
 - Contributions to the Yocto Project, OpenEmbedded, or Linux open-source projects, with strong analytical and communication skills and demonstrated technical leadership. 

Academic Credentials

Bachelor's degree + 8 years of experience or Master's degree + 6 years of experience in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical discipline.

AMD does not accept unsolicited resumes from headhunters, recruitment agencies, or fee-based recruitment services. AMD and its subsidiaries are equal opportunity, inclusive employers and will consider all applicants without regard to age, ancestry, color, marital status, medical condition, mental or physical disability, national origin, race, religion, political and/or third-party affiliation, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We encourage applications from all qualified candidates and will accommodate applicants' needs under the respective laws throughout all stages of the recruitment and selection process.

About the job

Job Description: PLC/SCADA Development Engineer

Experience:   5-10 years

Job Summary

We are looking for an experienced PLC/SCADA Development Engineer with hands-on expertise in designing, developing, and commissioning automation systems for large-scale industrial process applications. Job Title: Senior Manager - AI Platform Engineering

 - This role reports to the Director of Applied AI and partners closely with applied AI and data engineering teams, cloud infrastructure, security, data governance, and Responsible AI to deliver a secure, cost-efficient, production-grade platform in a regulated MedTech environment. 

Key Responsibilities: 

AI Platform Architecture & Engineering: 

- Define and own the target-state architecture for the AI platform, covering data ingestion and storage, feature and vector stores, model training and serving, orchestration, agent frameworks, and API layers
 - Build and maintain shared platform services and reusable components: retrieval pipelines, model gateways, prompt and evaluation services, guardrail integration, and authentication and entitlement enforcement
 - Establish LLMOps and MLOps foundations, including evaluation harnesses, automated testing, quality gates, and release criteria for AI applications
 - Set engineering standards, coding practices, peer-review processes, and definition-of-done criteria for platform deliverables

Data & AI Solution Architecture: 

- Design enterprise data architecture across lakehouse, warehouse, streaming, and integration layers, including modeling standards, storage and compute patterns, and data contracts
 - Design AI solution architectures including multi-agent and orchestration patterns, retrieval-augmented generation, tool and function calling, and integration of LLMs with enterprise data and applications
 - Publish reference architectures, architecture decision records, blueprints, and reusable patterns that accelerate delivery and enforce consistency across teams
 - Define integration architecture and API standards across enterprise systems, and guide build-versus-buy and vendor technology evaluations

AI Platform Operations & Reliability: 

- Own end-to-end operations of the enterprise AI and data platform, including capacity, performance, availability, and incident and problem management. Own model and prompt versioning, artifact registries, deployment strategies (blue/green, canary), and rollback procedures for AI workloads

 - Design and operate the observability stack for AI and data workloads: logging, metrics, tracing, alerting, and dashboards across pipelines, models, and applications. Instrument AI-specific telemetry, including accuracy and groundedness, latency, token consumption, cost per transaction, drift, guardrail triggers, and user feedback

 - Set cost guardrails, quotas, budget alerts, and tagging and allocation standards, and enforce them through platform controls

Security, Compliance & Governance: 

- Embed security by design into platform architecture, including identity and access management, secrets management, network isolation, encryption, and least-privilege enforcement
 - Ensure platform and AI workloads meet data privacy, security, and regulatory requirements, and are auditable and traceable end-to-end
 - Partner with Responsible AI and data governance teams to operationalize guardrails, approved-model controls, registry integration, and human-in-the-loop enforcement at the platform layer
 - Support audits, assessments, and validation activities with platform evidence, controls documentation, and remediation plans

Leadership & Stakeholder Management: 

- Manage vendors and delivery partners end-to-end, including selection, contracting, and performance management
 - Manage senior stakeholders across business, functional, and technology leadership, communicating roadmap, risk, cost, and platform value
 - Collaborate across applied AI, data science, analytics engineering, and data engineering to share standards, patterns, and reusable components

 - Experience building and operating a cloud AI/data platform at scale, including MLOps and LLMOps, CI/CD, infrastructure-as-code, and release engineering
 - Deep expertise in cloud data and AI platforms (Azure: Databricks, Data Factory, Azure ML/AI Foundry, App Services, AKS, or equivalent on AWS/GCP)

data.title: Platform Engineer — MySQL DBA / Linux / Networking / AWS
data.description:
Role Overview

We are seeking a hands-on Platform Engineer with MySQL DBA expertise first and Linux

administration second, ideally Red Hat and Ubuntu. The role also covers networking, AWS, and

production support, with end-to-end ownership of troubleshooting, maintenance, recovery, and

improvement. GitHub, CI/CD, and DevSecOps are supporting skills. 

Working expectations: Perform patching and troubleshooting during agreed customer

maintenance windows. Adjust availability to workflow and maintenance schedules, including

outside regular business hours when scheduled work requires it. 

Key Responsibilities

1. MySQL Database Administration (Primary Focus)

• Administer MySQL replication, backups, recovery, and performance tuning; investigate

issues and implement lasting fixes. 

• Execute database patching and maintenance, including preparation, recovery planning, 

and post-change validation. 

2. Linux Systems Management (Red Hat / Ubuntu)

• Administer, secure, patch, and troubleshoot Linux environments, ideally Red Hat and

Ubuntu. 

• Automate recurring system administration and maintenance tasks through scripting. 

3. Production Support & Operational Ownership

• Support production and non-production platforms; troubleshoot across database, Linux, 

network, application, and cloud layers. 

• Own incidents through recovery, validation, and follow-up; lead root cause analysis and

preventive improvements. 

4. Platform, Network & Maintenance Operations

• Set up, configure, and manage platform networks; resolve connectivity issues. 

• Plan and execute patching and troubleshooting within customer maintenance windows; 

coordinate dependencies, recovery steps, health checks, and follow-up. 

5. AWS Cloud Infrastructure

• Maintain AWS environments (EC2, VPC, IAM, S3, RDS), troubleshoot infrastructure, and

monitor security, availability, and cost. 

• Manage infrastructure changes using Terraform or CloudFormation. 

6. Stakeholder Communication

• Coordinate maintenance scope, timing, and availability with internal teams and customer

stakeholders. 

• Provide incident and maintenance updates; document changes, validation, resolutions, 

and handoffs, and participate in operational reviews. 

7. GitHub & CI/CD (Supporting Responsibilities)

• Support GitHub repositories, branching, reviews, pull requests, branch protection, and

The company's technology has earned recognition at several industry competitions, including the Celent Model Insurer Awards, ITC Asia Awards and SBR Technology Excellence Awards. 

As an ISO27001 certified organisation, Amplify Health maintains clearly defined policies, structured oversight mechanisms and ongoing risk assessments that ensure alignment with global best practices on enterprise data security. 

Our Vision and Ambition

To build the leading healthcare AI and platform services company in Asia that transforms the delivery of health and wellness for patients and communities by combining and leveraging the distinctive and complementary assets and strengths of AIA and Discovery. 

Amplify Health will simplify access to health data and AI Innovation to accelerate distinct and disruptive healthcare value insights and resulting improvements in health outcomes through value-based care, personalised care plans and aligning individuals' lifestyle/ behavioural choices. 

By 2028, Amplify Health will have in place one of Asia's strongest health-tech and AI capabilities; a comprehensive, integrated health technology stack supported by precision insights derived from proprietary data pools. 

The Position

Role Overview

As a Senior Specialist, AI Data Engineer, you will lead a small team that designs and delivers AI-ready data platforms and GenAI data solutions on Azure and Databricks. You stay hands-on, writing code, reviewing designs and unblocking the team, while owning the technical direction, delivery quality and people development for one or two projects. You will make the architecture trade-offs that decide whether AI solutions are accurate, secure, governed and cost-effective in production. 

Role at a Glance

Experience: 9 to 12 years in data engineering, including 2+ years leading engineers and 2+ years delivering AI/ML or GenAI data solutions to production

Team Leadership: Leads a team of 3 to 6 engineers; may line-manage some. Accountable for technical delivery and team health

Project scope: Leads 1 to 2 projects at a time

Stakeholder / client exposure: Primary technical point of contact for project stakeholders and client teams; presents designs, demos and progress

Hands-on expectation: About 50 to 70% hands-on engineering

Responsibilities

Technical Leadership and Architecture

- Own the end-to-end solution design for data and AI workloads on 1 to 2 projects: ingestion, lakehouse modelling, unstructured-data processing, retrieval, serving and evaluation. 
 - Make and document architecture decisions (for example, as architecture decision records) on trade-offs such as batch versus streaming, Databricks Vector Search versus Azure AI Search, chunking and embedding strategy, model and endpoint selection, and build versus buy. 
 - Define project engineering standards: coding conventions, testing strategy, CI/CD, infrastructure-as-code, environment promotion and release management. 
 - Stay hands-on: build critical or complex components, prototype new patterns and lead deep-dive troubleshooting of production issues. AI and GenAI Delivery

- Lead delivery of RAG, agentic and ML data pipelines from proof of concept to production, including permission-aware retrieval, freshness service levels and fallbacks. 
 - Set up evaluation and observability for AI solutions (golden datasets, offline and online evaluation, tracing, guardrails, quality dashboards) and use them as release gates. 
 - Design how governed data is exposed to AI agents (MCP servers, tools and functions, semantic layers, Genie spaces or Fabric data agents) with the right access controls and human-in-the-loop checkpoints. 
 - Manage AI cost and capacity: token budgets, model routing, caching, AI gateway policies and GPU / serverless sizing. Governance, Security and Responsible AI

- Ensure solutions meet data governance, privacy and security requirements: Unity Catalog / Purview, classification, masking and de-identification, lineage and audit. 
 - Embed responsible-AI practices (risk assessment, data and model documentation, bias and quality checks, transparency) aligned to frameworks such as the NIST AI RMF, ISO/IEC 42001 and applicable regulations. 
 - Work with information security and data protection teams on AI threat modelling, including prompt injection, data leakage and excessive agent permissions. Delivery and Stakeholder Management

- Translate business and client requirements into technical scope, estimates, plans and milestones; manage risks, dependencies and change. 
 - Act as the main technical contact for project stakeholders; present designs, demos and progress to technical and non-technical audiences. 
 - Work with product owners, data scientists, AI engineers, architects and platform teams to align priorities. People Leadership

- Lead a team of 3 to 6 engineers: allocate work, set clear goals, run code and design reviews, and remove blockers. 
 - Coach and develop team members through regular feedback and development plans, and contribute to performance reviews. 
 - Drive team adoption of AI-assisted engineering with clear guardrails (review standards, security, IP and data-handling rules) and measure its impact. 
 - Take part in hiring through interviews, technical assessments and onboarding. 

Candidate Profile

Required Qualifications

- 9 to 12 years in data engineering, with 2+ years leading a team or workstream of engineers. 
 - Expert Python, PySpark and SQL, with strong system design and distributed data processing fundamentals. 
 - Proven delivery of production lakehouse platforms on Azure and Databricks (Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, Lakeflow, streaming, CI/CD, infrastructure-as-code). 
 - Proven delivery of at least two AI or GenAI data solutions to production (for example, RAG, document intelligence, agentic data access, feature / ML pipelines), including evaluation and monitoring. 
 - Strong retrieval design knowledge: embeddings, chunking, hybrid search, re-ranking, index freshness and access control. 
 - Experience with MLOps / LLMOps tooling (MLflow, model serving, AI gateway, prompt management) and AI evaluation methods. 
 - Solid grasp of data governance, privacy, security and responsible-AI practices for sensitive data. 
 - Experience planning and estimating work, managing delivery risk and communicating with senior stakeholders. 
 - Demonstrated ability to coach engineers and to set and enforce engineering standards. 

Technology stack: Primary stack (Azure + Databricks)

- Cloud & storage: ADLS Gen2, Azure Data Factory, Event Hubs, Azure SQL, Cosmos DB, Key Vault, Microsoft Fabric / OneLake
 - Lakehouse & processing: Azure Databricks: Delta Lake, Lakeflow (Connect, Spark Declarative Pipelines, Jobs), Structured Streaming, Photon, serverless compute
 - Governance & catalog: Unity Catalog (lineage, tags, ABAC, row/column security), Microsoft Purview
 - AI, retrieval & agents: Databricks Vector Search, Model Serving, Agent Bricks, Lakebase; Azure AI Search; Microsoft Foundry (Azure OpenAI and other models, Agent Service); Azure AI Document Intelligence
 - MLOps / LLMOps: MLflow 3 (tracking, tracing, evaluation, prompt registry), Feature Store, Unity AI Gateway, inference tables
 - Engineering & DevOps: Python, PySpark, SQL, Git, GitHub Actions or Azure DevOps, Terraform / Bicep, Databricks Asset Bundles, Docker
 - AI-assisted engineering: GitHub Copilot, Databricks Genie Code / Assistant

Nice to have

- Multi-agent systems and MCP server design; Databricks Agent Bricks or Microsoft Foundry Agent Service. 
 - Microsoft Fabric and OneLake interoperability with Databricks. 
 - Ontology, knowledge graph or semantic layer design for AI agents. 
 - Experience in healthcare, insurance or other regulated industries; familiarity with HL7 FHIR and privacy regulations (for example, PDPA, HIPAA, GDPR). 
 - Agile delivery certification or formal leadership training. 

Preferred Qualifications & Certifications

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. 
 - Databricks Certified Data Engineer Professional. 
 - Databricks Certified Generative AI Engineer Associate. 
 - Microsoft Certified: Azure AI App and Agent Developer Associate (AI-103) or MLOps Engineer Associate (AI-300). 
 - HashiCorp Certified: Terraform Associate (optional). 

How you Lead

- Lead by example: you still ship code and hold yourself to the standards you set. 
 - Clarity: you turn ambiguous requests into clear plans, decisions and trade-offs. 
 - Growth mindset: you invest in each team member's development and give honest, timely feedback. 
 - Responsibility: you make AI risk, quality and cost visible and act on them before release. 

How success is measured

- Projects delivered to the agreed scope, quality, timeline and budget, with production service levels met. 
 - AI solutions go live with defined evaluation thresholds, monitoring and guardrails, and keep meeting them in production. 
 - Engineering standards adopted across the team: test coverage, CI/CD, infrastructure-as-code and documentation. 
 - A motivated, growing team: engineers build new skills, earn certifications and stay engaged. 
 - Positive stakeholder and client feedback on technical leadership and communication. 
 - Measurable productivity or cost gains from AI-assisted engineering and platform optimisation. 

Join Us

If you are passionate about leveraging data to drive healthier outcomes across Asia and thrive in a dynamic, mission-driven environment, we encourage you to apply. 

Amplify Health is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

About Amplify Health

Who We Are

Amplify Health Asia Pte. Limited (Amplify Health) is a pan-Asian health technology and analytics company which brings together health technology assets, proprietary data analytics and healthcare expertise to support innovation across the healthcare value chain. 

Headquartered in Singapore, Amplify Health operates in 10 markets across the region: Australia, Hong Kong, India, Indonesia, Malaysia, New Zealand, the Philippines, Singapore, Thailand and Vietnam. 

Amplify Health develops integrated solutions that empower healthcare payors, providers and policymakers across Asia to identify value and drive new partnerships, understand variation and address systemic inefficiencies-with the aim of improving outcomes for individuals and the sustainability of health systems. 

Powered by a clinically enriched data foundation, Amplify Health's health intelligence platform combines modular AI solutions, context-aware automation and deep regional insights to offer localised, AI-powered health solutions spanning health payment integrity to chronic disease management. The company's technology has earned recognition at several industry competitions, including the Celent Model Insurer Awards, ITC Asia Awards and SBR Technology Excellence Awards. 

As an ISO27001 certified organisation, Amplify Health maintains clearly defined policies, structured oversight mechanisms and ongoing risk assessments that ensure alignment with global best practices on enterprise data security. 

Our Vision and Ambition

To build the leading healthcare AI and platform services company in Asia that transforms the delivery of health and wellness for patients and communities by combining and leveraging the distinctive and complementary assets and strengths of AIA and Discovery - shaping the lens of "only Amplify Health can do". 

Amplify Health will simplify access to health data and AI Innovation to accelerate distinct and disruptive healthcare value insights and resulting improvements in health outcomes through value-based care, personalised care plans and aligning individuals' lifestyle/ behavioural choices. 

By 2028, Amplify Health will have in place one of Asia's strongest health-tech and AI capabilities; a comprehensive, integrated health technology stack supported by precision insights derived from proprietary data pools. 

Why Amplify Health and this Opportunity

Amplify Health is shaping the future of healthcare in the Asia. Joining Amplify Health means joining one of the region's largest and strongest health-tech and AI companies. 

Through our unique brain-bank, technology and strength of vision, as well as the distinctive and complementary assets and strengths of AIA and Discovery, we are able to deliver value to our customer in the way "only Amplify Health can do". 

Amplify Health is a place for courageous entrepreneurs, who believe in working as a collaborative team to build industry-defining products and are committed to transforming healthcare through technology. 

The Position

Role Overview

The Senior Backend Engineer is a hands-on product engineering role responsible for designing, developing, testing and evolving secure, scalable backend capabilities for Amplify Health products, with an initial focus on Core Claims. 

The role combines deep Java and Spring engineering expertise with end-to-end ownership of product features, APIs, integration services, domain logic, databases, performance and production quality. The successful candidate will work closely with Product Managers, Business Analysts, Architects, QA Engineers, Frontend Engineers and Platform/DevOps colleagues to turn product requirements into reusable, maintainable capabilities for multiple customers and markets. 

Responsibilities

1) Product Feature Engineering

- Design, develop, test and maintain backend product capabilities using Java and the Spring ecosystem, including Spring Boot, Spring MVC, Spring Data, Spring Security, Spring Integration and Spring Cloud. 
 - Own medium-to-complex product deliverables from technical discovery and solution design through implementation, automated testing, release and post-release validation. 
 - Turn product epics, user stories and acceptance criteria into maintainable engineering designs and clearly scoped technical tasks. 
 - Build reusable product capabilities that can support multiple markets and customers while avoiding unnecessary customer-specific customisation. 
 - Contribute to the evolution of Core Claims capabilities across claims adjudication, benefits, rules, utilisation, pre-authorisation and associated workflows. 

2) Backend Architecture, APIs and Integration

- Design and implement scalable microservices, RESTful APIs and service-to-service integrations using well-defined contracts, OpenAPI/Swagger and JSON. 
 - Develop product integration layers and reusable gateway capabilities that connect Core Claims with internal and external services. 
 - Apply appropriate patterns for synchronous and asynchronous processing, validation, error handling, retries, idempotency and transaction management. 
 - Work with identity and access-management capabilities, including OAuth 2. 0, JWT, API gateways and role-based access control. 
 - Contribute to technical design decisions and ensure new services align with product architecture, security and operational standards. 

3) Claims, Benefits and Domain Engineering

- Implement and enhance product logic for claims processing, benefit matching, exclusions, limits, accumulations, calculations, tariffs and pre-authorisation. 
 - Understand relationships between benefit configuration, clinical/reference data, product rules and transactional claims data when designing new capabilities. 
 - Collaborate with Product Managers and Business Analysts to clarify business rules, edge cases and expected outcomes before and during development. 
 - Develop domain-aware solutions that are testable, explainable and suitable for extension across different product and market needs. 

4) Data, Persistence and Migration

- Design and maintain relational data models and persistence logic using PostgreSQL, SQL, Hibernate and JPA. 
 - Write efficient queries and optimise database access patterns, indexing, transactions and data-processing logic. 
 - Develop controlled schema changes and data migrations using Flyway or equivalent migration tooling. 
 - Assess data integrity and backward-compatibility impacts when changing identifiers, configuration structures or domain models. 
 - Create clear migration, verification and rollback instructions where product changes require data transformation. 

5) Engineering Quality and Automation

- Create comprehensive unit, integration and component tests using JUnit, Mockito and related testing frameworks. 
 - Participate actively in code reviews and maintain high standards for readability, modularity, testability, security and maintainability. 
 - Use static analysis, dependency scanning and engineering quality gates to identify and resolve defects and vulnerabilities early. 
 - Partner with QA engineers to define test strategy, support automated regression coverage and resolve defects efficiently. 
 - Maintain accurate technical documentation in source repositories, Jira, Confluence, API specifications and engineering runbooks. 

6) Performance, Reliability and Observability

- Analyse and improve API, service and database performance, including high-volume processing and concurrency-sensitive scenarios. 
 - Design resilient services with appropriate timeout, retry, fallback, caching and failure-recovery approaches. 
 - Implement structured logging, health checks, metrics and tracing so that services can be monitored and diagnosed effectively. 
 - Investigate complex defects and production issues using logs, traces, database evidence and code-level debugging, and implement sustainable corrective actions. 
 - Contribute to non-functional requirements covering scalability, availability, resilience, security and supportability. 

7) Cloud-Native Delivery and DevOps Collaboration

- Build and support services deployed on Microsoft Azure and Kubernetes-based environments. 
 - Work with Docker, Kubernetes, Helm, Azure DevOps or equivalent CI/CD tooling to package, deploy and validate product services. 
 - Collaborate with Platform and DevOps engineers on environment configuration, secrets, connectivity, deployment pipelines and operational readiness. 
 - Support controlled product releases, including release notes, deployment dependencies, verification steps and rollback considerations. 
 - Participate in application modernisation, framework upgrades and dependency remediation while managing compatibility and regression risk. 

8) Senior Engineering Contribution

- Provide technical guidance to developers, review pull requests and help resolve complex design, code, integration and data issues. 
 - Break down complex features, identify dependencies and contribute realistic engineering estimates during product planning and refinement. 
 - Raise technical risks early and present pragmatic solution options and trade-offs to the Technical Lead, Technology Development Manager and product stakeholders. 
 - Share knowledge of the codebase, product architecture and healthcare claims domain to improve team capability and reduce reliance on individual experts. 
 - Demonstrate ownership, collaboration and clear written and verbal communication within a distributed Agile product team. 

Experience and Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology or a related discipline. 
 - Minimum 7 years of professional software engineering experience, with substantial hands-on backend development responsibility in enterprise products. 
 - Strong hands-on experience with Java, including modern Java versions, and the Spring ecosystem: Spring Boot, Spring MVC, Spring Data, Spring Security, Spring Integration and Spring Cloud. 
 - Demonstrated experience designing and delivering microservices, server-side business logic and enterprise integrations. 
 - Strong understanding of object-oriented design, design patterns, clean-code principles and distributed-system fundamentals. 
 - Advanced experience with RESTful APIs, JSON and OpenAPI/Swagger; experience with SOAP or enterprise integration patterns is advantageous. 
 - Strong PostgreSQL and SQL skills, including relational modelling, query optimisation, transactions and controlled database migration. 
 - Hands-on experience with Hibernate/JPA, JUnit, Mockito, Maven or Gradle, Git and CI/CD pipelines. 
 - Practical experience with Microsoft Azure, Docker, Kubernetes and Helm. 
 - Experience with secure application development, authentication/authorisation and dependency or vulnerability remediation. 
 - Experience with application monitoring, structured logging, metrics, tracing and production troubleshooting. 
 - Experience modernising legacy applications or upgrading Java/Spring frameworks while maintaining backward compatibility is advantageous. 
 - Experience with asynchronous messaging, Kafka, Redis, Camunda, Drools or other workflow/rules technologies is advantageous. 
 - Experience in health insurance, claims processing, benefit configuration, pre-authorisation or healthcare technology is strongly preferred. 
 - Familiarity with HL7 FHIR and healthcare integration patterns is advantageous. 
 - Excellent written and spoken English, with the ability to explain technical decisions and risks to both engineering and non-engineering stakeholders. 
 - Ability to work independently, mentor colleagues and collaborate effectively across a distributed Agile product team. 

What You Will Gain in This Role

- Ownership of business-critical product capabilities supporting healthcare claims across multiple Asian markets. 
 - Opportunity to shape reusable backend architecture, API standards, product performance, reliability and engineering quality. 
 - Exposure to complex healthcare domain engineering across claims, benefits, utilisation, pre-authorisation, rules and integrations. 
 - A pathway to broader technical leadership through solution design, mentoring and ownership of complex product deliverables. 

Join Us

If you are a passionate individual who thrives in a collaborative environment of bar raisers, and where courage, innovation and resilience are celebrated; we invite you to join our team. Together, we will shape the future with our unwavering commitment to excellence and the determination to make a difference.

Working style

data.title: Senior, Clinical Coding & Assets
data.description:
About Amplify Health

Who We Are

Amplify Health Asia Pte. Limited (Amplify Health) is a pan-Asian health technology and analytics company which brings together health technology assets, proprietary data analytics and healthcare expertise to support innovation across the healthcare value chain. 

Headquartered in Singapore, Amplify Health operates in 10 markets across the region: Australia, Hong Kong, India, Indonesia, Malaysia, New Zealand, the Philippines, Singapore, Thailand and Vietnam. 

Amplify Health develops integrated solutions that empower healthcare payors, providers and policymakers across Asia to identify value and drive new partnerships, understand variation and address systemic inefficiencies-with the aim of improving outcomes for individuals and the sustainability of health systems. 

Powered by a clinically enriched data foundation, Amplify Health's health intelligence platform combines modular AI solutions, context-aware automation and deep regional insights to offer localised, AI-powered health solutions spanning health payment integrity to chronic disease management. The company's technology has earned recognition at several industry competitions, including the Celent Model Insurer Awards, ITC Asia Awards and SBR Technology Excellence Awards. 

As an ISO27001 certified organisation, Amplify Health maintains clearly defined policies, structured oversight mechanisms and ongoing risk assessments that ensure alignment with global best practices on enterprise data security. 

Our Vision and Ambition

To build the leading healthcare AI and platform services company in Asia that transforms the delivery of health and wellness for patients and communities by combining and leveraging the distinctive and complementary assets and strengths of AIA and Discovery. 

Amplify Health will simplify access to health data and AI Innovation to accelerate distinct and disruptive healthcare value insights and resulting improvements in health outcomes through value-based care, personalised care plans and aligning individuals' lifestyle/ behavioural choices. 

By 2028, Amplify Health will have in place one of Asia's strongest health-tech and AI capabilities; a comprehensive, integrated health technology stack supported by precision insights derived from proprietary data pools. 

The Position

Role Overview

We are seeking a strategic and experienced healthcare leader to own the end-to-end Clinical Coding & Assets portfolio. 

The role combines leadership of clinical annotation and encoded-data optimization with the creation, acquisition, validation, integration, maintenance and governance of clinical coding assets, ontology development, crosswalks, reference lists and grouper systems. 

The successful candidate will ensure that the encoded clinical data is accurate, clinically meaningful, scalable and fit for use across products, analytics, automation and client implementations. This role requires deep expertise in international healthcare coding, billing and terminology standards, automation tools, together with strong leadership and stakeholder engagement across APAC and global markets. 

Responsibilities

1. Portfolio strategy, governance and roadmap

- Own the strategy, roadmap and operating model for the Clinical Coding & Assets portfolio. 
 - Prioritize portfolio initiatives based on client needs, market requirements, product value, regulatory considerations and scalability. 
 - Establish governance for asset development, acquisition, ingestion, annotation, validation, implementation, versioning, monitoring and retirement. 
 - Track portfolio performance and identify opportunities to improve coverage, accuracy, usability, automation and operational efficiency. 
 - Prepare quarterly management updates and lead roadmap planning, sprint planning and backlog grooming. 

2. Clinical coding & encoded-data optimization

- Lead end-to-end clinical annotation and validation processes across international, regional and client-specific coding systems. 
 - Lead and manage initiatives to improve encoded-data coverage, clinical accuracy, usability and scalability across markets and implementations. 
 - Lead the definition of clinical and operational logic underpinning encoded data and supervise its alignment with business workflows and intended product use. 
 - Manage and supervise audits to assess completeness, accuracy and alignment with expected outputs, and lead resolution of escalated discrepancies or anomalies. 
 - Partner with coding, terminology, interface and data science teams to improve automation, modelling, ground-truth datasets and scalable data workflows. 
 - Support product teams in improving coding accuracy and enabling responsible use of generative AI and other automation models. 

3. Clinical assets ingestion, integration and lifecycle management

- Lead the onboarding of new clinical coding assets into the central database and ensure data integrity, consistency and alignment with established models and standards. 
 - Oversee the creation, acquisition, validation, maintenance and controlled release of classifications, code sets, reference lists, crosswalks and related terminology assets. 
 - Collaborate with terminology, engineering and data science teams to define and implement scalable schemas, properties and data structures. 
 - Serve as the subject matter expert for schema scalability and localization across countries, clients and products. 
 - Ensure seamless and traceable integration of clinical assets and encoded data into databases and downstream product workflows. 

4. Clinical Ontology development and governance

- Lead and manage the end-to-end development, implementation and lifecycle governance of clinical and billing ontologies that support coding, claims, analytics, automation and product use cases. 
 - Supervise the design of ontology domains, concept hierarchies, properties, relationships, modifiers and metadata, ensuring structures are clinically valid, mutually exclusive where required, scalable and reusable across markets. 
 - Lead the definition of ontology principles, modelling standards, naming conventions, semantic rules and acceptance criteria, and ensure consistent application across the team. 
 - Manage the mapping and alignment of ontology concepts to source terminologies, classifications, local code sets, reference lists and billing constructs while preserving provenance and traceability. 
 - Supervise clinical annotation, expert review, testing and quality assurance of ontology content, including the resolution of ambiguous, overlapping or conflicting concepts. 
 - Lead collaboration with product, engineering, data science, coding and operational teams to translate business and clinical requirements into implementable ontology schemas and data models. 
 - Manage ontology versioning, change control, release documentation, impact assessment and communication to downstream users and systems. 
 - Lead the development of reusable ontology assets and decision logic that improve semantic interoperability, encoded-data consistency, explainability and automation readiness. 
 - Supervise ontology performance monitoring and continuous improvement using coverage, accuracy, usability, consistency and implementation feedback. 

5. Clinical Assets - Crosswalks, classifications and grouper systems

- Lead and supervise the development, validation and refinement of crosswalks between coding systems, including SNOMED CT, ICD variants, CPT and other relevant classifications. 
 - Manage mapping governance, version control, traceability and documented rationale for mapping decisions. 
 - Lead comparative analyses of Diagnosis-Related Group systems and other clinical or reimbursement groupers across markets. 
 - Supervise documentation of differences between grouper methodologies and lead assessment of implications for product configuration, analytics, reimbursement and reporting. 
 - Translate international standards and methodologies into practical, market-relevant recommendations. 

6. Clinical data assessment and standardization

- Lead reviews of market-specific clinical and claims data and recommend suitable standardization and coding approaches. 
 - Define and validate schemas, property structures and data rules against clinical, operational and business requirements. 
 - Support harmonization of heterogeneous source data while preserving source meaning, traceability and market-specific requirements. 
 - Establish repeatable quality controls for data assessment, standardization and encoded-data releases. 

7. Product and solution enablement

- Lead cross-functional engagement with product, clinical, actuarial, analytics and data science teams during requirement gathering and solution design. 
 - Manage ongoing subject matter support for coding, terminology, ontology, assets and grouper-related queries across portfolios such as Provider Management, Member Risk Profile, Chronic Disease Management, Rules and Benefits, and Asset Management. 
 - Ensure that portfolio outputs are clinically relevant, usable by clients and aligned with product strategy. 
 - Lead clarification of coding, terminology and ontology logic, manage communication of updates, and supervise effective adoption by internal and external users. 

8. Research, licensing and external standards

- Monitor international and APAC developments in coding classifications, terminologies, crosswalks, reference lists, groupers, healthcare billing and regulatory standards. 
 - Lead and supervise structured research into concepts and methodologies from recognized healthcare organizations and regulatory bodies in leading jurisdictions. 
 - Recommend building, acquire or license strategies for priority assets, considering business value, scalability, permitted use and maintenance requirements. 
 - Manage licensing engagements, requirements gathering and vendor coordination, and supervise compliance with licensing terms and data-use agreements. 
 - Supervise evidence-based documentation of sources, assumptions, decisions and implementation implications. 

9. Stakeholder engagement

- Lead engagement with internal stakeholders, including product managers, data scientists, analysts, medical coders, clinicians and operational teams. 
 - Collaborate with clients, regulators, providers, vendors and industry bodies to align expectations and uphold applicable standards. 
 - Facilitate workshops, working groups and feedback loops to build shared understanding of requirements and drive continuous improvement. 
 - Act as the primary liaison for complex coding, terminology, assets and grouper matters across the organization. 

10. Leadership, team management and ways of working

- Lead and mentor a multidisciplinary team of coding and terminology specialists, with the ability to operate across a large delivery function and smaller specialist asset teams. 
 - Set clear priorities, quality expectations and development plans, and provide regular coaching and constructive feedback. 
 - Develop and maintain SOPs, principles, guidelines and workflows covering the full portfolio lifecycle. 
 - Ensure documentation remains current with standards, regulatory expectations and operational practices. 
 - Deliver training on client and market requirements, coding validation, asset recommendation, grouper interpretation and subject matter standards. 
 - Promote international and regional knowledge sharing, consistency and collaboration across Clinical Informatics. 
 - Provide critical subject matter support to other clinical portfolios through expert review, actionable feedback and strategic alignment. 

Candidate Profile

Experience and Qualifications

Essential

- Graduate healthcare qualification, preferably a medical degree with at least 05 years of post-qualification experience. 
 - At least 8 years of relevant experience spanning health insurance, clinical coding and validation, healthcare data or database management, and stakeholder engagement. 
 - At least 3 years of experience in a leadership role. 
 - Deep knowledge of clinical terminologies, coding assets, healthcare billing practices, crosswalks, classifications and grouper systems. 
 - Demonstrated experience leading annotation, validation, data-quality or clinical asset lifecycle processes. 
 - Strong stakeholder management and communication skills across clinical, product, operational, technical and regulatory domains. 

Preferred

- Master's degree in Health Informatics, Clinical Sciences, Public Health, Health Administration or a related discipline. 
 - Private healthcare or health insurance experience in Asia or other international markets. 
 - Experience managing distributed, multidisciplinary teams and supporting multiple concurrent products or markets. 
 - Experience with licensing, vendors and controlled use of third-party clinical content. 

Competencies & Core Characteristics: 

Technical Understanding

Core requirements

- Strong understanding of healthcare-specific data claims data and encoded clinical information. 
 - Detailed working knowledge of international coding systems and terminologies, including ICD, CPT, SNOMED CT, LOINC and ATC, together with client-specific classifications where relevant. 
 - Detailed knowledge of groupers, crosswalks, reference lists, coding schemas and version-control practices. 
 - Understanding of healthcare billing, patient health management, provider profiling, healthcare reporting and related technologies. 
 - Competence in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel, Access and PowerPoint. 

Advantageous

- SQL, Python and advanced Excel skills. 
 - Understanding of advanced statistics, risk adjustment, health outcomes indices and related metrics. 
 - Knowledge of data science and generative AI applications in healthcare. 
 - Experience with Microsoft Azure services such as Databricks, Synapse and Data Factory. 

Behavioral capabilities

- Strategic leadership with the ability to translate complex clinical content into scalable portfolio priorities. 
 - Strong analytical thinking, clinical judgment and rigorous problem-solving capability. 
 - High attention to detail and a consistent focus on quality, traceability and continuous improvement. 
 - Exceptional communication and facilitation skills across diverse stakeholder groups. 
 - Ability to challenge assumptions constructively and convert feedback into improved delivery. 
 - Resilience, energy, accountability and a positive, collaborative approach. 
 - Excellent planning and coordination skills, with the ability to balance multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment. 

Join Us

If you are passionate about leveraging data to drive healthier outcomes across Asia and thrive in a dynamic, mission-driven environment, we encourage you to apply. 

Amplify Health is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Test Manager - Output/CCM/Document Management Systems based in India. 

We are seeking an experienced Test Manager to lead quality assurance activities for a major Customer Communication Management (CCM) and document management system replacement project. 

In this 50% part-time freelance role, you will define and oversee the testing strategy, ensuring that the new platform delivers accurate and reliable document outputs. 

A key focus will be comparing outputs from legacy and replacement systems using identical data streams. 

You will coordinate testing activities across technical teams, business stakeholders, and project leadership, from initial planning through implementation. 

The role also involves establishing effective test data management practices and designing solutions for documents generated through automated or scheduled processes. 

You will oversee multiple testing phases, manage defects, and provide clear reporting to support informed go/no-go decisions. 

The position may potentially be combined with a 50% Test Engineer assignment. 

Accountabilities

Responsibilities

As Test Manager, you will take ownership of the overall testing approach and ensure that all activities are properly planned, coordinated, and executed throughout the system replacement project. Your responsibilities will include: 

- Develop and own the test strategy and test concept for replacing the existing Customer Communication Management (CCM) platform. 
 - Define and manage legacy-versus-new system comparisons, ensuring documents are generated using identical data streams across both environments. 
 - Plan, coordinate, monitor, and control all testing activities from initial design through implementation. 
 - Work closely with the Product Owner, development teams, solution architects, and business departments to align testing objectives and priorities. 
 - Design approaches for testing documents that cannot be triggered manually, such as payment reminders and month-end processing outputs, using simulations, scheduled execution, or batch testing environments. 
 - Establish and maintain test data management processes, including use-case-based datasets such as real estate financing scenarios, while ensuring compliance with data protection requirements. 
 - Coordinate integration testing, end-to-end testing, performance and volume testing, and User Acceptance Testing (UAT). 
 - Lead defect management activities, ensuring issues are documented, prioritized, tracked, and resolved effectively. 
 - Provide transparent test progress reports to project management and steering committees. 
 - Assess implementation readiness and provide recommendations for go/no-go decisions. 

Requirements

The ideal candidate is an experienced Test Manager with a strong background in complex system replacement or migration projects. You should combine technical testing expertise with the ability to coordinate multidisciplinary teams and communicate effectively with business and IT stakeholders. The following qualifications are expected: 

- Several years of experience working as a Test Manager on large-scale system replacement or migration projects. 
 - Experience in the banking sector is an advantage. 
 - Knowledge of Customer Communication Management (CCM), output management, or document management platforms. 
 - Familiarity with solutions such as OpenText Exstream, Quadient Inspire, Compart, Messagepoint, or comparable technologies. 
 - Strong understanding of software development lifecycles and agile delivery methodologies, particularly SAFe and Scrum. 
 - Proven leadership, coordination, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work across business, IT, and operational teams. 
 - ISTQB Advanced Level Test Manager certification or an equivalent qualification. 
 - A clean background record, with no debt enforcement proceedings or criminal convictions. 
 - Fluent German and English communication skills. 

Benefits

- 50% part-time freelance engagement. 
 - Fully remote working arrangement, open to candidates worldwide. 
 - Potential to combine this assignment with a separate 50% Test Engineer role. 
 - Opportunity to contribute to a major CCM and document management system replacement project.

data.title: Staff Quality Engineer
data.description:
All roles at JumpCloud® are Remote unless otherwise specified in the Job Description. 

About JumpCloud®
JumpCloud® is the AI-powered unified IT management platform designed to secure the modern workforce. By consolidating identity, device, and access management, JumpCloud provides intelligent, secure IT that scales from human users to autonomous AI agents. We help organizations around the globe eliminate complexity and turn AI risk into an optimized advantage, ensuring the right people and agents have secure access to the right resources at all times. 

  

JumpCloud is Intelligent, Secure IT. 

About the role: 
As a Staff / Principal Quality Engineer (Pillar Lead) on our Engineering team in India, you will serve as the primary quality coordinator and strategic anchor for one of our core product pillars. You will not just test software; you will act as an "Internal Product Manager for Quality. " You will work closely with Engineering Directors and Product Managers to align quality initiatives with Pillar OKRs, ensure developers share accountability for automation, and guide the overarching test strategy for your domain. This role is designed for a highly experienced technical authority and proactive risk mitigator who thrives on driving cross-module alignment, adopting cutting-edge AI testing solutions, and ensuring every release meets the highest standards of enterprise excellence. 

What you'll be doing: 

- 
Serve as the local expert and ultimate technical authority for your Pillar's test processes, feature interactions, and quality standards. 

- 
Engage early in the SDLC, contributing significantly to refinement, planning meetings, and RFC/Design reviews. Challenge Product Managers and Engineering Leads to consider testability, competitive edge, and integration risks before a single line of code is written. 

- 
Review and influence Pillar OKRs (e. g. , engineering velocity, reliability) to identify partnership opportunities where QE tactics directly drive business objectives. 

- 
Take accountability for the quality of your Pillar by proactively identifying weak spots, automation blockers, and resource gaps, and aggressively escalating these to leadership to request support. 

- 
Represent your Pillar in the Cross-Module Leadership Team to coordinate cross-team impacts, share industry-leading practices, and align on standardized test plans and tooling across all pillars. 

- 
Architect and lead non-functional testing strategies across the pillar, explicitly championing performance, load, and scale testing to ensure the platform reliably handles enterprise-level concurrency and data volumes. 

- 
Drive AI Adoption & Standardization: Champion the use of AI in the testing lifecycle. Collaborate with the Internal Tools (Autobots) team to contribute to, adopt, and standardize common AI-based testing solutions across your pillar (e. g. , leveraging AI for test script generation, intelligent failure triage, and pipeline optimization). 

- 
Champion the philosophy that quality is a shared engineering goal, ensuring development teams are equally accountable for automation maintenance and preventing the anti-pattern of "throwing it over the wall to QA. "

- 
Intelligently allocate QE efforts within your Pillar, prioritizing high-value user journeys and guiding your team to swarm on the most critical initiatives. 

- 
Contribute test code, audit Developer Unit/Integration tests for coverage gaps, and actively write complex End-to-End (E2E) automation scripts alongside your team. 

- 
Establish and enforce best practices for unit and functional testing frameworks to ensure comprehensive component and flow validation. 

- 
Develop and execute strategies to consistently augment unit, functional, and acceptance test coverage across the pillar, tying coverage goals directly to release quality gates. 

- 
Partner closely with your Pillar's dedicated Automation Enablement engineer to ensure framework gaps are closed and flaky tests are managed urgently. 

- 
Act as a strong mentor and teacher of nuanced testing principles to both Feature QEs and Developers, empowering others to do the work while continuing to deliver impact yourself. 

We're looking for: 

- 
8-12+ years of experience in Quality Engineering, Software Development in Test, or a related field, with a proven track record of leading quality initiatives across multiple teams. 

- 
Deep expertise in multiple technical disciplines, programming languages (Python, Pytest, Playwright and Typescript preferred), test tools, and automation frameworks. 

- 
Proven experience defining and executing performance, scale, and load testing strategies for complex distributed systems. 

- 
Demonstrated ability to evaluate "build vs. buy" decisions and develop entirely new implementations of industry solutions. 

- 
Strong strategic problem-solving perspective, with the ability to balance release risk vs. schedule to maximize test execution without sacrificing the speed of delivery. 

- 
High EQ and emotional maturity; an active listener who accepts feedback willingly, seeks opposing points of view, and prioritizes the best solution over being right. 

- 
Proactive and humble ownership, with a focus on raising the visibility of your team's work, sharing credit, and asking for help when facing insurmountable risks. 

- 
Excellent communication and influence skills, capable of representing the engineering organization internally and externally. 

- 
A collaborative, team-oriented mindset with the ability to unblock teams and coordinate actions across the organization. 

Bonus Points: 

- 
Practical experience leveraging Generative AI or LLMs in the software testing lifecycle, or actively contributing to AI-driven test frameworks and internal AI tooling. 

- 
Deep domain expertise in areas relevant to the Pillar.   

- 
Experience driving large-scale organizational transformations or shifts in quality methodologies. 

- 
Prior experience in dynamic, fast-paced startup environments. 

- 
Experience with API and web app UI test automation tools like Gherkin, Cypress, or similar. 

- 
Experience deploying, installing, and configuring applications on cloud-based servers (AWS experience is a plus). 

Where you'll be working/Location: 

JumpCloud is committed to being Remote First, meaning that you are able to work remotely within the country noted in the Job Description. 

  

You must be located in and authorized to work in the country noted in the job description to be considered for this role.   

  

Please note: There is an expectation that our engineers participate in on-call shifts. You will be expected commit to being ready and able to respond during your assigned shift, so that alerts don't go unaddressed. 

  

Language: 

JumpCloud has teams in 15+ countries around the world and conducts our internal business in English. The interview and any additional screening process will take place primarily in English. To be considered for a role at JumpCloud, you will be required to speak and write in English fluently.   Any additional language requirements will be included in the details of the job description. 

  

Why JumpCloud?   

If you thrive working in a fast, SaaS-based environment and you are passionate about solving challenging technical problems, we look forward to hearing from you! JumpCloud is an incredible place to share and grow your expertise! You'll work with amazing talent across each department who are passionate about our mission. We're out of the box thinkers, so your unique ideas and approaches for conceiving a product and/or feature will be welcome. You'll have a voice in the organization as you work with a seasoned executive team, a supportive board and in a proven market that our customers are excited about.     

  

One of JumpCloud's three core values is to "Build Connections. " To us that means creating " human connection with each other regardless of our backgrounds, orientations, geographies, religions, languages, gender, race, etc. We care deeply about the people that we work with and want to see everyone succeed. " - Rajat Bhargava, CEO

  

Please submit your résumé and brief explanation about yourself and why you would be a good fit for JumpCloud.   Please note JumpCloud is not accepting third party resumes at this time.     

  

JumpCloud is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status. 

  

Scam Notice: 

Please be aware that there are individuals and organizations that may attempt to scam job seekers by offering fraudulent employment opportunities in the name of JumpCloud. These scams may involve fake job postings, unsolicited emails, or messages claiming to be from our recruiters or hiring managers. Please note that JumpCloud will never ask for any personal account information, such as credit card details or bank account numbers, during the recruitment process. Additionally, JumpCloud will never send you a check for any equipment prior to employment. 

  

All communication related to interviews and offers from our recruiters and hiring managers will come from official company email addresses (@jumpcloud. com) and will never ask for any payment, fee to be paid or purchases to be made by the job seeker. If you are contacted by anyone claiming to represent JumpCloud and you are unsure of their authenticity, please do not provide any personal/financial information and contact us immediately at recruiting@jumpcloud. com with the subject line "Scam Notice"
