data.title: Senior Automation QA Engineer (Customer Implementation & Quality Engineering)
data.description:
About Amplify Health

Who We Are

Amplify Health Asia Pte. Limited (Amplify Health) is a pan-Asian health technology and analytics company which brings together health technology assets, proprietary data analytics and healthcare expertise to support innovation across the healthcare value chain. 

Headquartered in Singapore, Amplify Health operates in 10 markets across the region: Australia, Hong Kong, India, Indonesia, Malaysia, New Zealand, the Philippines, Singapore, Thailand and Vietnam. 

Amplify Health develops integrated solutions that empower healthcare payors, providers and policymakers across Asia to identify value and drive new partnerships, understand variation and address systemic inefficiencies-with the aim of improving outcomes for individuals and the sustainability of health systems. 

Powered by a clinically enriched data foundation, Amplify Health's health intelligence platform combines modular AI solutions, context-aware automation and deep regional insights to offer localised, AI-powered health solutions spanning health payment integrity to chronic disease management. The company's technology has earned recognition at several industry competitions, including the Celent Model Insurer Awards, ITC Asia Awards and SBR Technology Excellence Awards. 

As an ISO27001 certified organisation, Amplify Health maintains clearly defined policies, structured oversight mechanisms and ongoing risk assessments that ensure alignment with global best practices on enterprise data security. 

Our Vision and Ambition

To build the leading healthcare AI and platform services company in Asia that transforms the delivery of health and wellness for patients and communities by combining and leveraging the distinctive and complementary assets and strengths of AIA and Discovery - shaping the lens of "only Amplify Health can do". 

Amplify Health will simplify access to health data and AI Innovation to accelerate distinct and disruptive healthcare value insights and resulting improvements in health outcomes through value-based care, personalised care plans and aligning individuals' lifestyle/ behavioural choices. 

By 2028, Amplify Health will have in place one of Asia's strongest health-tech and AI capabilities; a comprehensive, integrated health technology stack supported by precision insights derived from proprietary data pools. 

Why Amplify Health and this Opportunity

Amplify Health is shaping the future of healthcare in the Asia. Joining Amplify Health means joining one of the region's largest and strongest health-tech and AI companies. 

Through our unique brain-bank, technology and strength of vision, as well as the distinctive and complementary assets and strengths of AIA and Discovery, we are able to deliver value to our customer in the way "only Amplify Health can do". 

Amplify Health is a place for courageous entrepreneurs, who believe in working as a collaborative team to build industry-defining products and are committed to transforming healthcare through technology. 

The Position

Role Overview

The Senior Automation QA Engineer is a hands-on implementation quality engineering role responsible for defining, automating, executing and governing testing across customer implementations. The role is based in India and reports to the Implementation Lead. 

The successful candidate will combine strong automation engineering skills with practical ownership of system integration testing, end-to-end regression, API validation, release readiness and defect management. The role works closely with customer QA and business teams, Senior Automation QA Engineers, backend engineers, Product Engineering, Platform/DevOps and Service Management to ensure implemented healthcare solutions are reliable, traceable to agreed requirements and ready for controlled production release. 

Responsibilities

1) Implementation Test Strategy and Planning

- Own the implementation test approach for assigned customer workstreams, covering functional testing, system integration testing, end-to-end testing, regression, sanity and release verification. 
 - Review business requirements, functional specifications, user stories, acceptance criteria, API mappings and solution designs to identify test scope, dependencies and quality risks. 
 - Create test plans, test scenarios, traceability, entry and exit criteria, test-data needs, schedules and evidence requirements aligned with implementation milestones. 
 - Distinguish functional acceptance testing from regression, performance and security testing, and ensure each activity has clear objectives and ownership. 
 - Raise test-environment, data, configuration and dependency risks early and provide clear recommendations to the Implementation Lead. 

2) Test Automation Framework and Engineering

- Design, enhance and maintain reusable automation frameworks for web, API and end-to-end implementation testing. 
 - Develop automated tests using Java or JavaScript/TypeScript with tools such as Selenium, Playwright or Cypress, TestNG or JUnit, Cucumber and REST Assured. 
 - Build stable, maintainable automation using page-object or equivalent design patterns, reusable test utilities, externalised test data and clear reporting. 
 - Integrate automated suites with Git and CI/CD pipelines such as Azure DevOps or Jenkins for repeatable execution and regression feedback. 
 - Analyse flaky tests, environment-related failures and framework defects, and implement sustainable corrections rather than repeated manual workarounds. 

3) API, FHIR and Integration Testing

- Design and execute API tests using Postman, REST Assured or equivalent tools, validating status codes, schemas, payloads, mappings, authentication, error handling and response behaviour. 
 - Validate end-to-end claims and pre-authorisation flows across customer systems, FHIR gateways, data-enrichment services, integration layers and Core Claims. 
 - Validate HL7 FHIR request and response structures, required fields, business validations and mappings to internal claim models. 
 - Use SQL and database queries to verify processing results, configuration, audit records and downstream persistence where authorised. 
 - Test positive, negative, boundary, invalid-data, retry and failure-recovery scenarios across connected systems. 
 - 4) Functional, SIT and End-to-End Regression Testing

- Execute and coordinate functional, SIT, regression, sanity and end-to-end scenarios across agreed implementation scope. 
 - Validate claims outcomes, benefit matching, calculations, rules, tariffs, reason codes, status transitions, user interfaces and downstream responses against documented expectations. 
 - Prepare representative test data that covers valid, invalid, conflicting and boundary conditions while complying with applicable data-handling requirements. 
 - Re-test resolved defects and assess regression impact across related workflows before recommending release readiness. 
 - Maintain clear execution evidence and status reporting for customer and internal review. 

5) Defect Triage and Root-Cause Support

- Log defects with reproducible steps, input data, expected and actual results, logs, screenshots and supporting evidence. 
 - Lead or support structured defect triage with customer QA, business analysts, developers and product teams. 
 - Differentiate code defects from configuration, test-data, environment, integration or requirement issues and route them to the correct owner. 
 - Track defects through investigation, resolution, retesting and closure, and escalate critical blockers and ageing issues promptly. 
 - Use logs, API traces, database evidence and test results to support efficient root-cause analysis. 

6) Release Readiness and Production Validation

- Define and execute pre-release regression, deployment sanity, smoke testing and post-deployment verification across sandbox, UAT, pre-production and production environments. 
 - Confirm that critical scenarios have passed, defects are appropriately resolved or accepted, and testing evidence is available before deployment approval. 
 - Coordinate with implementation engineers and Platform/DevOps teams on build versions, environment readiness, endpoints, test accounts and release dependencies. 
 - Support controlled go-live, hypercare and production incident validation, including reproduction and verification of corrective fixes. 
 - Prepare test completion summaries and clearly communicate residual risks, deferred items and recommended follow-up actions.

data.title: Senior Software Engineering Manager, Product Security
data.description:
This role has been designed as 'Hybrid' with a requirement that you will work on average 2 days per week from an HPE office. 

Who We Are

Hewlett Packard Enterprise is the global edge-to-cloud company advancing the way people live and work. We help companies connect, protect, analyze, and act on their data and applications wherever they live, from edge to cloud, so they can turn insights into outcomes at the speed required to thrive in today's complex world. Our culture thrives on finding new and better ways to accelerate what's next. We know varied backgrounds are valued and succeed here. We have the flexibility to manage our work and personal needs. We make bold moves, together, and are a force for good. If you are looking to stretch and grow your career our culture will embrace you. Open up opportunities with HPE. 

Job Description

About the Role

As a Senior Software Engineering Manager within HPE's Product Security Office (PSO), you will build and lead a high-performing development team responsible for designing, developing, testing, deploying, and operating secure, reliable, and scalable software. Your team will deliver applications, platforms, APIs, automation, and integrations that enable product teams to identify, manage, and reduce security risk across the product lifecycle. 

This is a build-and-scale people leadership role. You will create the team environment, delivery discipline, and engineering practices needed to turn product security priorities into dependable capabilities used across HPE. You will set clear priorities, develop engineering talent, establish repeatable operating mechanisms, and ensure the team delivers measurable outcomes with strong security, quality, reliability, and maintainability. 

Operating within PSO's matrixed model, you will balance shared engineering capacity across multiple product security capabilities, partnering with capability owners who define business outcomes and priorities while retaining accountability for people leadership, engineering execution, and technical delivery. You will bring enough technical depth to guide decisions, challenge approaches, review engineering quality, and remove obstacles while holding engineers accountable for technical ownership and execution. 

You will partner with PSO leaders, product and capability owners, architects, program managers, product engineering teams, and adjacent cybersecurity organizations to align roadmaps, manage dependencies, and scale solutions across diverse product environments. The role manages individual contributors and succeeds by building a capable team-not by acting as the primary architect or personally owning every technical decision. 

What You'll Do

Build and Lead the Engineering Team

- Hire, onboard, lead, and develop a team of individual-contributor software and security engineers, setting clear expectations, goals, development plans, and accountability for results. 
 - Create an inclusive, high-trust engineering culture grounded in ownership, collaboration, technical excellence, continuous learning, and constructive challenge. 
 - Provide regular coaching, feedback, career development, and performance support while building succession strength and expanding the team's technical capabilities. 
 - Match work to skills and development needs, delegate meaningful ownership, and ensure senior engineers lead design and implementation within clear decision boundaries. 
 - Plan team capacity, workload, and skill coverage; identify resourcing risks and recommend hiring, development, or partner strategies. 

Drive Engineering Delivery and Operations

- Translate Product Security Office priorities and capability roadmaps into clear engineering plans, milestones, ownership, and measurable outcomes. 
 - Lead day-to-day engineering execution, including prioritization, sprint and release planning, dependency management, risk tracking, escalation, and delivery reviews. 
 - Ensure the team builds and operates secure, reliable, maintainable, and scalable software, services, automation, APIs, data integrations, and product security tooling. 
 - Establish effective engineering practices for design review, source control, testing, CI/CD, secure development, release management, observability, incident response, and operational support. 
 - Balance new capability development with operational reliability, technical debt reduction, defect remediation, platform modernization, and lifecycle maintenance. 
 - Define and monitor meaningful measures for delivery predictability, quality, reliability, security, adoption, and engineering effectiveness. 

Shape Product Security Capabilities

- Partner with product and capability owners to understand user needs, clarify requirements, prioritize engineering investments, and sequence delivery across the Product Security Office capability portfolio. 
 - Guide development of reusable product security platforms and services that improve vulnerability management, security assessment, secure development, reporting, workflow automation, or related security outcomes. 
 - Promote automation and responsible use of AI-assisted engineering where they improve speed, consistency, coverage, or user experience while preserving validation, traceability, security, and human accountability. 
 - Ensure security, privacy, data-handling, resilience, and compliance considerations are incorporated into solution design and delivery. 
 - Use stakeholder feedback, operational data, and engineering insights to identify opportunities for simplification, reuse, integration, and continuous improvement. 

Lead Across Teams and Boundaries

- Build strong working relationships across Product Security, product engineering, security research, vulnerability response, infrastructure, architecture, and enterprise technology teams. 
 - Align stakeholders on priorities, scope, tradeoffs, dependencies, and delivery commitments, escalating material risks with clear options and recommendations. 
 - Provide transparent capacity, dependency, and engineering investment tradeoffs across the PSO portfolio, helping leadership determine when capabilities should be built, integrated, scaled, modernized, consolidated, or retired. 
 - Coordinate effectively with globally distributed teams and partners while establishing clear ownership, handoffs, documentation, and operating rhythms. 
 - Communicate engineering progress, risks, decisions, and outcomes clearly to technical teams, product leaders, and senior stakeholders. 
 - Represent the team in planning, architecture, operational, and leadership forums while ensuring individual contributors retain appropriate technical visibility and ownership. 

What You Need To Bring

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in computer science, software engineering, cybersecurity, information systems, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. 
 - Typically 10 or more years of relevant software engineering, security engineering, or technology experience, including 3+ years of people management experience directly managing software engineers. 
 - Proven experience leading teams that design, build, release, and operate enterprise software, platforms, services, automation, or developer-facing capabilities. 
 - Demonstrated ability to manage individual contributors, develop talent, set clear priorities, address performance issues, and create accountability for delivery and engineering quality. 
 - Experience establishing or improving engineering practices across software design, code review, testing, CI/CD, secure development, release management, observability, and operational support. 
 - Experience managing roadmaps, delivery plans, dependencies, technical debt, operational risk, and competing stakeholder priorities in a complex or matrixed organization. 
 - Strong technical understanding of modern software architecture, APIs, cloud environments, containers, data platforms, source control, CI/CD, and secure software development practices. 
 - Strong communication, facilitation, and stakeholder-management skills, including the ability to explain technical risks and tradeoffs to non-technical audiences. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience leading globally distributed engineering teams and collaborating across time zones, cultures, and organizational boundaries. 
 - Experience with Python, Java, JavaScript or TypeScript, React, Node. js, SQL or NoSQL data platforms, REST APIs, Linux, GitHub, Jenkins or GitHub Actions, Docker, Kubernetes, or comparable technologies. 
 - Experience applying AI-assisted development, intelligent automation, or agentic methods within secure engineering workflows, including appropriate validation and human oversight. 
 - Experience improving engineering operating models, building a new team or capability, or scaling a platform from project-based delivery to sustainable operations. 
 - Working knowledge of common software weaknesses, OWASP guidance, threat modeling, software supply-chain security, and secure development lifecycle principles. 
 - Relevant engineering, cloud, agile, or security certifications are helpful but not required. 

What Success Looks Like

- A capable, engaged engineering team has clear priorities, meaningful ownership, strong development support, and accountability for outcomes. 
 - Product security capabilities move from ambiguous needs to predictable delivery through clear roadmaps, operating rhythms, engineering standards, and decision ownership. 
 - Software and automation are secure, reliable, maintainable, measurable, and supported through disciplined lifecycle and operational practices. 
 - Product and capability owners have a trusted engineering partner that provides transparent delivery commitments, credible tradeoffs, and timely escalation of risks. 
 - Reusable platforms, integrations, automation, and engineering practices reduce fragmentation and improve the scale and effectiveness of Product Security Office capabilities. 
 - The team becomes increasingly self-sufficient as engineers grow in technical ownership, judgment, collaboration, and leadership. 

Accessibility

HPE is committed to creating an inclusive and accessible workplace and encourages applications from all qualified individuals, including those with disabilities. If you believe you require accommodation during any stage of the application or interview process, please submit your request by completing our secure form linked here. 

Note: This option is reserved for applicants needing assistance/reasonable accommodation related to a disability. 

What We Can Offer You

Health & Wellbeing

We strive to provide our team members and their loved ones with a comprehensive suite of benefits that supports their physical, financial and emotional wellbeing. 

Personal & Professional Development

We also invest in your career because the better you are, the better we all are. We have specific programs catered to helping you reach any career goals you have - whether you want to become a knowledge expert in your field or apply your skills to another division. 

Unconditional Inclusion

We are unconditionally inclusive in the way we work and celebrate individual uniqueness. We know varied backgrounds are valued and succeed here. We have the flexibility to manage our work and personal needs. We make bold moves, together, and are a force for good. 

Let's Stay Connected

Follow @HPECareers on Instagram to see the latest on people, culture and tech at HPE.

data.title: Principal Engineer & AI-Native Engineering Lead
data.description:
Flexera saves customers billions of dollars in wasted technology spend. A pioneer in Hybrid ITAM and FinOps, Flexera provides award-winning, data-oriented SaaS solutions for technology value optimization (TVO), enabling IT, finance, procurement and cloud teams to gain deep insights into cost optimization, compliance and risks for each business service. Flexera One solutions are built on a set of definitive customer, supplier and industry data, powered by our Technology Intelligence Platform, that enables organizations to visualize their Enterprise Technology BlueprintTM in hybrid environments-from on-premises to SaaS to containers to cloud. 

We're transforming the software industry. We're Flexera. With more than 50, 000 customers across the world, we're achieving that goal. But we know we can't do any of that without our team. Ready to help us re-imagine the industry during a time of substantial growth and ambitious plans? Come and see why we're consistently recognized by Gartner, Forrester and IDC as a category leader in the marketplace. Learn more at flexera. com

We are building a new model for software engineering: a small, highly autonomous engineering team that combines experienced technical leadership, talented developers, and AI coding agents to deliver high-quality software with exceptional speed. 

We are looking for a hands-on Principal Engineer & Technical Lead to establish and lead this team. You will be responsible for technical direction, architecture, engineering quality, and delivery outcomes while actively developing software alongside two supporting engineers and AI tools such as Claude Code and OpenAI Codex. 

This is not a traditional engineering management position. You will remain deeply involved in design, implementation, code review, debugging, and production delivery. Your leverage will come from making sound technical decisions, decomposing complex problems into manageable work, building effective AI-assisted workflows, and enabling a small team to operate with significant independence. 

You will own outcomes rather than simply oversee tasks. 

What You'll Do

Technical Leadership and Architecture

- Own the technical architecture, design decisions, and implementation strategy for the team's applications, services, and systems
 - Translate business objectives and product requirements into pragmatic, maintainable technical solutions
 - Make sound trade-offs between delivery speed, reliability, security, scalability, and long-term maintainability
 - Establish lightweight engineering standards, architectural patterns, coding conventions, and documentation practices
 - Identify opportunities to simplify systems, eliminate unnecessary complexity, and accelerate delivery
 - Ensure the team builds software that can be understood, tested, operated, and evolved by engineers beyond its original authors

AI-Native Software Engineering

- Make AI coding agents a first-class part of the development lifecycle, using tools such as Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, and other appropriate AI engineering tools
 - Develop effective workflows for AI-assisted requirements analysis, code generation, test creation, debugging, refactoring, code review, and documentation
 - Decompose work into clear, bounded tasks that AI agents can execute independently, in parallel, and with measurable results
 - Establish project context, repository instructions, reusable prompts, agent skills, automated checks, and other mechanisms that improve the consistency of AI-generated work
 - Evaluate AI-generated code critically, recognizing when to accept, modify, or reject its output
 - Continuously improve the team's engineering workflow based on actual delivery results rather than AI usage or code-generation volume

End-to-End Delivery and Ownership

- Take responsibility for delivering production-ready capabilities from problem definition through deployment and operational support
 - Collaborate with business stakeholders, product owners, users, and other engineering teams to clarify requirements and prioritize work
 - Break larger initiatives into small, independently testable increments that can be delivered frequently
 - Identify and resolve technical blockers without introducing unnecessary meetings, dependencies, or handoffs
 - Establish appropriate observability, deployment automation, rollback procedures, and operational safeguards
 - Monitor production outcomes and use feedback to improve the product and engineering process

Quality, Security, and Reliability

- Define a practical quality strategy covering automated testing, code review, integration testing, and production validation
 - Ensure AI-generated changes are verified through appropriate tests, static analysis, security checks, and human review
 - Establish guardrails for AI access to source code, credentials, production systems, customer data, and other sensitive resources
 - Prevent shortcuts that create unacceptable security, reliability, compliance, or maintainability risks
 - Make quality controls increasingly automated so that a small team can move quickly without relying on manual inspection for every routine check

Team Development and Enablement

- Lead by example through hands-on engineering, thoughtful technical decisions, and disciplined execution
 - Mentor two supporting engineers through pairing, code reviews, design discussions, and progressively more challenging assignments
 - Build a culture of ownership, experimentation, direct communication, accountability, and continuous learning
 - Help engineers develop the judgment to direct AI agents, validate their work, and solve problems independently
 - Avoid becoming a bottleneck by delegating meaningful ownership and creating reusable patterns and automated guardrails
 - Share successful AI engineering practices with the broader engineering organization

Required Qualifications

- Significant professional software engineering experience, typically 8+ years, with demonstrated technical leadership appropriate to a Principal or Staff+ engineer
 - Strong software design and architecture skills, with the ability to balance simplicity, delivery speed, maintainability, and operational needs
 - Demonstrated experience delivering and operating production software end to end
 - Strong programming skills in at least one of our primary technology stacks, with the ability to work across application layers when needed
 - Deep understanding of testing strategies, CI/CD, version control, observability, application security, and production troubleshooting
 - Practical experience using AI coding agents such as Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, or comparable tools in real engineering workflows
 - Ability to break ambiguous business problems into well-defined technical tasks and independently drive them to completion
 - Excellent technical communication, problem-solving, mentoring, and decision-making skills
 - A track record of taking ownership of outcomes rather than limiting responsibility to assigned implementation tasks

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience building or leading small, autonomous, cross-functional engineering teams
 - Experience with agentic coding workflows, parallel AI task execution, repository-level instructions, and automated validation pipelines
 - Experience establishing internal developer platforms, reusable engineering templates, or AI-enabled development infrastructure
 - Experience in our relevant industry, domain, and technology stack
 - Experience improving delivery lead time, software quality, operational reliability, or engineering productivity through measurable changes

Qualified applicants will be considered for open roles regardless of age, ancestry, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by local/national laws, policies and/or regulations.

data.description:
About Us: Apptware is a leading technology solutions provider dedicated to delivering innovative digital products and services. Our team of creative thinkers, tech enthusiasts, and strategic experts is committed to transforming businesses and enhancing user experiences with cutting-edge technology. We are passionate about enabling our partner's success and invite you to be a part of our exciting journey!

Job Description : Python Backend Engineer - FastAPI & Agentic AI

Experience : 3-5 Years

Employment Type : Full-time

Work Mode : Hybrid

Work Location - PUNE

About the Role : 

We are looking for a skilled Python Backend Engineer with hands-on experience in FastAPI, asynchronous backend development, data ingestion pipelines, and Agentic AI systems. The role involves designing and maintaining high-performance backend services, building multimodal data processing pipelines, developing LLM evaluation frameworks, and implementing intelligent agentic workflows. The ideal candidate should have strong Python programming skills, practical experience with AI-powered systems, and the ability to write clean, simple, scalable, and maintainable code. 

Roles & Responsibilities

1. Backend Development & API Engineering

- Design, develop, optimize, and maintain asynchronous backend services using Python and FastAPI. 
 - Build high-performance APIs capable of handling high-volume requests with minimal latency. 
 - Implement non-blocking operations using asyncio and Uvicorn. 
 - Manage database connection pools and optimize backend performance. 2. LLM Evaluation & Regression Testing

- Develop deterministic LLM evaluation and regression testing pipelines. 
 - Validate model consistency, output quality, and structured response schemas using Pydantic. 
 - Monitor agent stability and identify inconsistencies in AI-generated responses. 3. Multimodal Data Processing

- Develop data ingestion pipelines for processing text, images, and videos. 
 - Handle media decoding, validation, extraction, and processing of unstructured data. 
 - Build reliable pipelines to transform multimodal inputs into structured data. 4. Agentic AI & Workflow Development

- Design and implement stateful, graph-based agent workflows. 
 - Develop multi-step agent execution processes involving tool calling and state reconstruction. 
 - Handle hallucinations, prevent infinite loops, and improve agent reliability. 
 - Implement context-window and token management, including dynamic context pruning, summary compression, and retrieval optimization. 5. Data Ingestion & Quality Pipelines

- Build data extraction, validation, filtering, and cleansing pipelines. 
 - Convert raw web data into structured, high-quality inputs. 
 - Develop high-volume ingestion systems using request queues and API rate-limit handling. 
 - Implement failure management and Redis-based backpressure control. 6. Testing & Code Quality

- Develop comprehensive unit and integration test suites. 
 - Follow test-driven development practices. 
 - Write clean, modular, documented, and maintainable code. 
 - Focus on simplicity, readability, performance, and reliability. Required Skills & Qualifications

- 3-5 years of experience in Python Backend Development. 
 - Strong hands-on experience with Python, FastAPI, asyncio, and Uvicorn. 
 - Experience building asynchronous and non-blocking backend services. 
 - Understanding of database connection pooling and API performance optimization. 
 - Experience with multimodal data processing, including images, videos, media buffers, and unstructured data. 
 - Hands-on experience with Pydantic and structured data validation. 
 - Strong understanding of data extraction, parsing, filtering, and cleansing. 
 - Experience with unit testing, integration testing, and Test-Driven Development (TDD). 
 - Practical experience with Redis, API rate limiting, request queuing, and high-volume data ingestion. 
 - Experience building production AI/Agentic AI systems. 
 - Understanding of tool calling, hallucination handling, infinite-loop prevention, and context-window management. 
 - Strong problem-solving and debugging skills. Ideal Candidate Profile

- Strong backend engineering fundamentals with practical Python development experience. 
 - Experience building scalable, asynchronous backend infrastructure. 
 - Exposure to production-grade LLM applications and Agentic AI workflows. 
 - Ability to handle complex data processing and ingestion requirements. 
 - Passion for writing simple, efficient, testable, and maintainable code.

The Infrastructure as a Service (IaaS) team is responsible for managing and supporting the organization's core IT infrastructure, including servers and virtual machines. The team focuses on infrastructure provisioning, configuration, monitoring, maintenance, and troubleshooting to ensure high availability, reliability, security, and performance. 

The IaaS team also supports infrastructure automation, capacity planning, incident resolution, and infrastructure optimization. Its primary goal is to provide a stable, scalable, secure, and cost-effective infrastructure platform that enables applications and business services to run smoothly. 

We are seeking a highly skilled and motivated Software Engineer III to design, develop, test, and deliver scalable, secure, and high-performance software solutions within IAAS Team. The ideal candidate will have strong technical expertise, excellent problem-solving abilities, and experience working in Agile development environments. 

The role involves collaborating with cross-functional teams, contributing to technical design decisions, ensuring engineering best practices, and delivering reliable solutions that support business objectives. 

Responsibilities

- Design, develop, test, and maintain scalable, reliable, and secure software applications. 
 - Develop high-quality, reusable, and maintainable code following established engineering standards. 
 - Participate in technical design discussions, architecture reviews, and solution development. 
 - Build and maintain RESTful APIs, microservices, and distributed applications. 
 - Collaborate with Product Owners, Architects, QA Engineers, and other stakeholders to translate business requirements into technical solutions. 
 - Perform code reviews and ensure adherence to coding standards and security best practices. 
 - Identify and resolve complex technical issues, performance bottlenecks, and production defects. 
 - Implement automated unit, integration, and functional testing to ensure software quality. 
 - Contribute to CI/CD pipelines, deployment automation, and DevOps practices. 
 - Monitor application performance, reliability, and operational health. 
 - Participate in Agile ceremonies, including sprint planning, backlog refinement, and retrospectives. 
 - Mentor junior engineers and contribute to continuous improvement initiatives. 
 - Take ownership of assigned features and deliverables from development through production deployment. 
 - Required Technical Skills
 - Strong programming experience in Java, Python, JavaScript, or other object-oriented programming languages. 
 - Hands-on experience with Spring Boot, REST APIs, and microservices architecture. 
 - Good understanding of data structures, algorithms, object-oriented design, and design patterns. 
 - Experience with relational and NoSQL databases such as Oracle, PostgreSQL, MySQL, or MongoDB. 
 - Familiarity with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud. 
 - Experience with Git, Maven, Jenkins, Docker, Kubernetes, or equivalent development and deployment tools. 
 - Knowledge of automated testing frameworks such as JUnit, Mockito, or similar tools. 
 - Understanding of distributed systems, asynchronous processing, and messaging technologies such as Kafka. 
 - Familiarity with application security, authentication, authorization, and secure coding practices. 
 - Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments. 

Qualifications

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline.

 - Demonstrated experience delivering enterprise-grade applications. 
 - Strong analytical, debugging, and troubleshooting skills. 
 - Excellent communication and collaboration skills. 
 - Ability to work independently and take ownership of technical deliverables.

 - Experience with cloud-native application development. 
 - Understanding of system scalability, resilience, observability, and performance optimization.

data.title: Senior QA & Release Manager
data.description:
Mission

We are seeking an experienced Senior QA & Release Manager to provide enterprise-level quality and release leadership across Adecco technology initiatives. The role will define and govern testing strategy, coordinate release readiness across multiple programs, and ensure that business, product, engineering, vendor and operations teams have a clear, evidence-based view of quality risk before production deployment. The successful candidate will combine strategic governance with hands-on delivery oversight, build consistent quality standards, and develop strong QA and release-management capability across the organization. 

Responsibilities

- Own and evolve the end-to-end QA and release-management framework across multiple Adecco programs, products and platforms. 
 - Define testing strategies, quality gates, entry and exit criteria, release-readiness checkpoints, and sign-off governance aligned with business risk. 
 - Lead integrated planning and oversight across functional, system integration, end-to-end, regression, user acceptance, performance, security and production-validation activities, based on program needs. 
 - Coordinate release calendars, deployment dependencies, change readiness, go/no-go forums, production verification and post-release reviews. 
 - Provide independent quality assurance and challenge delivery teams where evidence, coverage, defect status or operational readiness does not support release approval. 
 - Establish consistent governance across internal teams and delivery partners, including clear roles, responsibilities, escalation paths, service expectations and quality controls. 
 - Partner with business, product, engineering, architecture, security, operations and vendor stakeholders to align quality priorities with business outcomes. 
 - Govern defect management, triage, root-cause analysis, leakage analysis and corrective actions, with transparent ownership through closure. 
 - Drive continuous improvement through risk-based testing, shift-left quality practices, reusable assets, automation, CI/CD controls and lessons learned. 
 - Oversee test environments, test data, tooling and resource demand, supporting effective planning, forecasting and cost-conscious delivery. 
 - Promote a quality-first culture in which quality is a shared responsibility across business and technology teams. 

Work Experience

- 8+ years of experience in software quality assurance, testing or release management, including at least 3-5 years in a senior leadership or management role. 
 - Proven experience leading QA and release delivery across multiple projects, products or enterprise programs. 
 - Strong knowledge of SDLC, STLC, Agile, Hybrid and DevOps delivery models, with practical experience applying risk-based quality governance. 
 - Experience defining test strategies, governance models, quality gates, release criteria and executive reporting. 
 - Demonstrated capability across functional, integration, end-to-end, regression, user acceptance and non-functional testing. 
 - Experience coordinating complex releases involving multiple business units, systems, vendors, markets or deployment dependencies. 
 - Strong understanding of defect management, root-cause analysis, environment and test-data management, and production validation. 
 - Practical experience with test and delivery management tools such as Azure DevOps, Jira, Confluence or equivalent platforms. 
 - Experience managing external delivery partners, service expectations, escalations and quality outcomes. 
 - Strong stakeholder management, negotiation, decision-making and communication skills, including the ability to communicate quality risk to senior leadership. 
 - Ability to balance strategic direction with detailed delivery oversight and to remain effective in high-pressure release situationsGood to Have

- Experience in a large, global or regulated enterprise environment. 
 - Knowledge of enterprise platforms such as Salesforce, Microsoft Dynamics, ERP, web, mobile, integration and data solutions. 
 - Experience shaping automation strategy using tools such as Playwright, Tosca, Selenium or similar frameworks. 
 - Understanding of CI/CD quality controls, API testing, cloud environments, observability and production-quality monitoring. 
 - Experience with performance, security, accessibility, data-quality or AI-enabled solution testing. 
 - Relevant certification such as ISTQB Test Manager, SAFe, ITIL, Scrum, DevOps or a recognized release-management qualification. 
 - Experience contributing to resource planning, financial forecasting, supplier governance or testing-tool strategy. 

Behaviour associated with success

- Strategic ownership with the ability to translate business risk into practical quality and release decisions. 
 - Credibility and confidence to challenge constructively, escalate evidence-based concerns and protect release integrity. 
 - Calm, structured decision-making under pressure, particularly during critical defects, deployment issues and go/no-go discussions. 
 - Inclusive leadership and cultural awareness when working across global teams, markets and external partners. 
 - Clear, concise communication with strong executive-reporting and stakeholder-influencing capability.

This role requires you to have significant technical breadth and deep understanding of low-level system software specifically in server class systems. 

You will be part of a new team responsible for integration of different system software deliverables and development of system tests spanning all the components. You will

 - Contribute to improvement in validation framework, CI/CD systems, testing methodologies and packaging pipelines. 
 - Drive root-cause investigations and long-term corrective actions along with the component teams for all incoming issues. 

Mentorship

 - Raise quality and coding standards through guidance, best practices and setting an example. 
 - Contribute to long term improvements in culture and team ceremonies.

data.title: Senior High Speed IO Validation Engineer
data.description:
NVIDIA has been transforming computer graphics, PC gaming, and accelerated computing for more than 25 years. Today, we are tapping into the unlimited potential of AI to define the next era of computing - an era in which our GPUs act as the brains of computers, robots, and self-driving cars that understand the world. Doing what has never been done before takes vision, innovation, and the world's best talent. 

NVIDIA's Silicon Co-Design Group is the team that gets every GPU, SoC, and CPU silicon program from first power-on to high-volume production. We are hiring an HSIO Validation Engineer to own characterization and qualification of high-speed I/Os - PCIe, NVLink, NVLink-C2C, UCIe, USB, UFS, and Ethernet - on brand-new silicon serving datacenter, AI, and client markets. Your bench is where silicon meets the signal - where every link train, jitter sweep, eye diagram, and protocol corner gets exercised before the part ships. You drive characterization and debug for IO interconnects across silicon, board, firmware, and driver - designing tests that anticipate rack-scale deployment so marginality surfaces at die-and-board scale, never in a rack. Your decisions show up in link margin, BER, power per lane, and the go/no-go calls that gate samples and production. 

What You Will Be Doing

- Own end-to-end characterization and validation of high-speed IO - PCIe, NVLink, NVLink-C2C, UCIe, USB, UFS, Ethernet - from silicon die through package and board, on NVIDIA GPUs, CPUs, and SoCs. 
 - Develop and execute validation test plans for silicon and SoC-level HSIO features - bring-up, corner qualification, stress, productization, and structured DOE across PVT, board, cable/connector, thermal, and firmware variables - left-shifting silicon failures before deployment. 
 - Drive power characterization and optimization across IO interconnects under workload-representative stimuli (MLPerf-class patterns at silicon/board level) - analyze trade-offs across V/F, lane config, and protocol state - and feed back into design, firmware, and binning. 
 - Drive systematic root-cause analysis for complex HSIO bugs - isolating contributions across silicon, package, board, firmware, and driver, with platform/thermal/mechanical partners when system context matters. Convert rack-observed failures into silicon/board reproducers so future spins fix the root cause upstream. 
 - Assess manufacturing and yield implications of HSIO margin distributions - identify gaps in scaling from chip to product, and feed back into binning and design. 
 - Develop and improve validation methodologies, automation frameworks, and margin-tracking infrastructure - increase efficiency and coverage as platform complexity grows. 

What We Need To See

- BS or MS in Electrical or Computer Engineering (or equivalent), with 6+ years in post-silicon HSIO validation, characterization, or a closely related discipline. 
 - Deep understanding of high-speed serial link protocols (PCIe Gen5+, NVLink, NVLink-C2C, UCIe, CXL) and the underlying SERDES architecture - equalization, link training, electrical characterization - with strong signal integrity and jitter knowledge. 
 - Strong SI and PI fundamentals - S-parameters, eye diagrams, channel margin, crosstalk, return loss, PDN noise, jitter decomposition - and validation experience across silicon and platform boundaries (CoWoS/interposer/substrate, board), translating rack-environment effects into silicon/board characterization. 
 - Hands-on with lab instrumentation (DSOs, BERTs, VNAs, protocol/logic analyzers, TDR), DOE/shmoo/margin-trending, and Python-based test automation - with a track record of driving cross-functional debug across chip, package, board, firmware, driver, and system teams. 

Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd

- Hands-on experience with PCIe Gen5/Gen6 or NVLink validation on production silicon - link training, equalization tuning, BER margining, or compliance debug. 
 - Prior SERDES, mixed-signal, or analog circuit design experience - sufficient to independently form hypotheses, design Sim-to-Si correlation experiments, and propose silicon/system-side fixes during debug. 
 - Track record of translating rack-environment conditions (thermal, connector reliability, neighbor noise) into silicon/board characterization - finding marginality at die-and-board scale before it appears in the field. 
 - Comfortable using AI productivity tools (Claude, Copilot, or equivalent) to compress log triage, regression analysis, scripting, and reporting workflows.

data.title: Platform & Infrastructure Engineer
data.description:
About the Role

We are looking for a highly skilled and hands-on Lead Platform & Infrastructure Engineer to take end-to-end ownership of our infrastructure, right from the bare-metal hardware and hypervisor layers up to container orchestration and application delivery. 

In this role, you will act as the technical anchor for our architecture, automation, security, and day-to-day IT operations across virtualized and on-premise/bare-metal environments. You will be responsible for building a hardened, production-ready Kubernetes cluster from the ground up, implementing zero-trust network security, managing storage solutions, and driving automated CI/CD pipelines. 

Key Responsibilities

Systems & Virtualization Engineering: 

- Provision, tune, and manage bare-metal hosts and Linux-based virtual machines (VMs). 
 - Drive the shift from manual configurations to declarative Infrastructure as Code (IaC) and configuration management. 
 - Perform L3 troubleshooting across physical servers, guest OS, and virtualized storage volumes. Network Security & Access Management: 

- Architect, scale, and maintain secure mesh overlay networks and point-to-point VPNs. 
 - Implement least-privilege IAM policies, network micro-segmentation, and identity-aware routing across hosts, developer endpoints, and infrastructure tiers. 
 - Debug end-to-end network connectivity, routing partitions, MTU mismatches, and firewall/access control issues in hybrid setups. Production Kubernetes (K8s) Architecture & Hardening: 

- Design, bootstrap, secure, and operate high-availability (HA), production-grade Kubernetes clusters on self-managed infrastructure. 
 - Enforce strict InfoSec baselines: cluster RBAC, secret management/rotation, runtime security, admission controllers, and pod-to-pod network policies. 
 - Architect highly durable persistent storage solutions, integrate Container Storage Interface (CSI) drivers, and manage volume encryption, snapshots, and Disaster Recovery (DR). Observability, Monitoring & SRE: 

- Deploy and scale a comprehensive, full-stack observability platform for metrics, distributed tracing, and centralized log aggregation. 
 - Instrument proactive alerting, health checks, and dashboards across hosts, hypervisors, and container workloads to drastically reduce MTTR. CI/CD & DevSecOps Implementation: 

- Build, optimize, and maintain automated CI/CD pipelines for seamless delivery of both application and infrastructure code. 
 - Integrate automated security checkpoints (Shift-Left security), including container image scanning, vulnerability assessments, and policy-as-code validations. 

Experience & Qualifications

- Educational Background: B. Tech/B. E. in Computer Science, IT, MCA, or related field. 
 - Core Experience: 7+ years of hands-on, progressive experience in DevOps, Systems Engineering, SRE, or Platform Engineering. 

Required Skills

- Linux Mastery: Deep internal knowledge of Linux OS, kernel tuning, networking primitives, block devices, and file systems. 
 - Bare-Metal & Private Cloud: Proven capability in deploying, securing, and maintaining self-managed hypervisors and virtualization ecosystems natively (without reliance on public cloud managed services). 
 - Self-Hosted Kubernetes: Extensive hands-on experience bootstrapping and troubleshooting production-grade bare-metal/on-prem K8s clusters (managing control planes, etcd quorums, CNI plugins, CSI drivers, and Ingress). 
 - Networking & Security: Strong grasp of encrypted overlay networks, modern VPN protocols, SDN, and advanced firewalling. Practical experience with zero-trust architectures, mTLS, credential management, and workload isolation. 
 - Automation/IaC: Expert-level proficiency in automating infrastructure provisioning and configuration management. 

Preferred Skills

- Prior experience setting up and managing GitOps-driven workflows for cluster and infrastructure lifecycle management. 
 - Hands-on expertise with configuring distributed, clustered, or networked storage backends for container ecosystems.

data.title: Head of AI Engineering & Center of Excellence (CoE)
data.description:
JOB DESCRIPTION

Head of AI Engineering

& Center of Excellence (CoE)

1. Role Overview

Our company is seeking a senior technology leader to establish and lead its AI Engineering Center of Excellence (CoE), driving the adoption of AI across enterprise engineering, insurance technology platforms, product development, and operational workflows. 

The Head of AI Engineering & CoE will define AI engineering strategy, establish reusable AI architectures and frameworks, enable AI-assisted software development, and deliver scalable, secure, measurable AI solutions. The role combines technical leadership, architecture governance, engineering enablement, and people development. 

A core objective is to turn individual AI experiments and isolated implementations into reusable enterprise capabilities that support Solartis's product-platform strategy. 

1. Key Responsibilities

A. AI Engineering Strategy and CoE Leadership

Establish the CoE charter, operating model, service offerings, engagement model, and delivery priorities. 

Develop an AI engineering roadmap aligned with product strategy, technology priorities, and business objectives. 

Identify opportunities to standardize AI capabilities and reduce duplicated implementations. 

Define reference architectures, reusable patterns, implementation guidelines, and approved technology frameworks. 

Partner with the CTO and engineering leadership to prioritize AI investments based on business value, feasibility, risk, and expected return. 

Establish processes to evaluate AI initiatives, productionize successful pilots, and retire ineffective or duplicated solutions. 

B. Enterprise AI Architecture and Shared Frameworks

Define scalable architectures for LLMs, SLMs, RAG, vector search, orchestration, and model integration. 

Design reusable AI services, APIs, SDKs, libraries, reference implementations, and deployment patterns. 

Establish patterns for model selection, prompt management, context engineering, embeddings, document processing, inference, and lifecycle management. 

Evaluate AI frameworks, models, infrastructure, and platforms for performance, cost, security, scalability, and maintainability. 

Define integration patterns for AI capabilities within existing platforms, services, applications, and development workflows. 

Guide build-versus-buy decisions across managed AI services, open-source models, and internally developed capabilities. 

C. AI-Assisted Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC)

Define and implement AI-assisted SDLC practices across requirements analysis, code generation, code understanding, test generation, code review, documentation, debugging, and maintenance. 

Establish standards for responsible use of AI coding assistants and developer productivity tools. 

Build reusable workflows and accelerators integrated with development environments, repositories, CI/CD pipelines, and quality processes. 

Measure impact on cycle time, defect rates, rework, code quality, and developer experience. 

Ensure AI adoption complements peer review, automated testing, security scanning, and release governance. 

Work with engineering leaders to drive adoption and develop team-level enablement plans. 

D. RAG, MCP, Agentic AI, and Reusable AI Services

Architect production-grade RAG solutions covering ingestion, parsing, chunking, metadata extraction, indexing, retrieval, reranking, and grounded generation. 

Establish reusable patterns for agents, tool orchestration, workflow automation, context management, and human-in-the-loop processing. 

Define appropriate Model Context Protocol (MCP) patterns for controlled access to enterprise tools, data, and services. 

Develop common components for model access, prompt/context management, retrieval, tool integration, evaluation, telemetry, and error handling. 

Define safeguards for permissions, data access, execution boundaries, auditability, failure recovery, and human approval. 

Apply agentic AI selectively where it delivers measurable value and avoid unnecessary complexity in deterministic workflows. 

E. AI-Assisted Insurance Content Processing and Parser Initiatives

Lead architecture for processing insurance documents, policy forms, underwriting guidelines, rating manuals, and related content. 

Guide pipelines that transform semi-structured and unstructured content into validated, structured insurance product definitions. 

Establish reusable capabilities for classification, parsing, extraction, semantic interpretation, rule identification, and structured output generation. 

Ensure extracted content is traceable to source documents and suitable for downstream product configuration and processing. 

Design human review and exception handling for ambiguous, incomplete, conflicting, or low-confidence outputs. 

Define evaluation datasets and measures for extraction precision/recall, completeness, rule interpretation, and downstream usability. 

Promote reusable parsers and validation components over isolated customer-specific implementations, in collaboration with insurance domain and platform teams. 

F. AI Engineering Standards, Quality, and Governance

Define standards for AI design, implementation, testing, deployment, monitoring, and maintenance. 

Establish evaluation frameworks for accuracy, groundedness, robustness, reliability, latency, cost, and use-case suitability. 

Implement safeguards against prompt injection, unauthorized data exposure, insecure tool execution, and other AI-specific threats. 

Define model and prompt versioning, traceability, observability, regression evaluation, and controlled production releases. 

Establish practices for sensitive data handling, access control, retention, audit logging, and external AI services. 

Partner with security, compliance, legal, and enterprise architecture stakeholders on applicable requirements. 

Ensure solutions have appropriate fallbacks, exception handling, human oversight, and production-readiness reviews. 

G. Technical Leadership, Mentoring, and Enablement

Provide technical leadership to AI architects and designated AI engineering teams, with accountability for architecture quality and capability development. 

Mentor existing architects in AI solution design, reusable architecture, model integration, evaluation, and production engineering. 

Establish architecture reviews, technical communities of practice, learning paths, workshops, and hands-on reference projects. 

Guide teams in evaluating alternatives, challenging assumptions, conducting impact analysis, and making sound technical decisions. 

Develop architecture decision records, implementation templates, reusable documentation, and engineering playbooks. 

Build internal capability so teams can implement AI solutions independently within agreed standards. 

H. Business Value, Delivery, and Continuous Improvement

Translate opportunities into prioritized initiatives with defined outcomes, milestones, resource needs, and success measures. 

Partner with product, engineering, and business teams to improve developer productivity, reduce manual effort, accelerate content processing, and strengthen platform scalability. 

Maintain visibility into AI initiative status, adoption, risks, operating costs, and realized benefits. 

Track production outcomes beyond proof-of-concept delivery and optimize duplicated capabilities, infrastructure, and model costs. 

Communicate progress, risks, decisions, and measurable outcomes to the CTO and senior leadership. 

3. Leadership and Decision-Making Expectations

Establish and execute the AI engineering roadmap within priorities agreed with the CTO. 

Own the technical direction and engineering standards of the AI CoE. 

Lead and develop AI architects and designated AI engineering resources. 

Make decisions within agreed enterprise architecture principles and delegated authority; escalate material cross-platform, security, and investment decisions as required. 

Challenge designs that introduce unnecessary customization, duplication, operational complexity, or technical risk. 

Balance innovation with engineering discipline, production readiness, maintainability, and measurable business outcomes. 

Influence teams beyond the direct reporting line and enable adoption across the organization. 

4. Required Qualifications and Experience

Bachelor's or master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, AI, Data Science, or a related discipline. 

Typically 15+ years of relevant software engineering, architecture, or technology experience, including substantial practical experience with AI/ML and modern AI application architectures. 

Demonstrated experience leading AI engineering initiatives, architecture practices, technical teams, or enterprise AI programs. 

Strong practical knowledge of LLM applications, RAG, embeddings, vector databases, prompt engineering, and model evaluation. 

Experience designing production-grade AI services, APIs, orchestration workflows, and reusable frameworks. 

Practical understanding of agentic AI, tool integration, workflow orchestration, and MCP where relevant. 

Experience with Python, APIs, distributed systems, CI/CD, automated testing, and cloud-based application deployment. 

Experience evaluating AI models and frameworks for quality, latency, cost, security, and operational complexity. 

Knowledge of AI application security, data protection, observability, model lifecycle management, and responsible AI practices. 

Demonstrated ability to mentor architects and engineers, influence technical direction, and establish standards across teams. 

Strong communication skills, including the ability to explain technical decisions to executives, business stakeholders, and engineering teams. 

5. Preferred Qualifications

Experience establishing an enterprise AI Engineering CoE or equivalent AI enablement function. 

Experience with comparable enterprise AI platforms and cloud-native AI services. 

Experience integrating AI-assisted software development tools into engineering workflows. 

Experience in insurance technology, policy administration, rating, product configuration, or document-intensive enterprise platforms. 

Experience with intelligent document processing, information extraction, rules extraction, or structured-content generation. 

Experience with enterprise knowledge systems, metadata-driven architectures, and reusable platform services. 

Familiarity with AI governance frameworks, evaluation methodologies, and production risk management. 

6. Leadership Profile

The ideal candidate combines deep technical credibility with the ability to establish a sustainable engineering practice. They can move between architecture design, hands-on problem solving, technical mentoring, organizational enablement, and executive communication. 

The candidate should build systems and teams that scale, establish standards without unnecessary bureaucracy, and translate emerging AI technologies into practical business capabilities. 

Ultimate expectation: Establish an AI Engineering CoE that strengthens Solartis's product-platform strategy, improves engineering effectiveness, accelerates AI adoption, and builds long-term organizational capability.

data.title: Senior Reporting QA & Data Validation Analyst (RCM)
data.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Reporting QA & Data Validation Analyst (RCM) based in India. 

As a Senior Reporting QA & Data Validation Analyst, you will play a key role in ensuring the accuracy, consistency, and reliability of healthcare reporting across multiple systems and platforms. You will work closely with reporting, business intelligence, operational, and technical teams to validate data, reconcile figures, and investigate discrepancies. Your work will help ensure that financial, operational, productivity, and revenue cycle reports provide dependable insights for business decisions. You will use SQL and advanced Excel to trace data issues, identify root causes, and support effective resolutions. In this remote role, you will also help strengthen quality controls, improve validation processes, and promote secure handling of sensitive healthcare information. This is an opportunity to contribute to a collaborative, learning-oriented environment where accountability, curiosity, and continuous improvement are valued. 

Accountabilities

- Independently validate reports, dashboards, and datasets before distribution to clients, leadership, and operational stakeholders. 
 - Reconcile reported figures against source systems, including electronic health records (EHRs), practice management platforms, billing applications, internal databases, and automated data extracts. 
 - Perform record-level and aggregate-level checks to identify missing, duplicate, inaccurate, or inconsistent data. 
 - Verify calculations, business rules, filters, date ranges, and metric definitions across financial, operational, productivity, and revenue cycle reports. 
 - Investigate discrepancies related to posting dates, transaction dates, adjustments, voids, refunds, and reporting cutoffs, distinguishing legitimate reporting differences from actual errors. 
 - Trace reporting issues through data extraction, transformation, and reporting processes, collaborating with analysts, developers, and data engineers to identify root causes and drive resolution. 
 - Conduct regression testing when reporting logic, data pipelines, or source systems are updated. 
 - Develop repeatable testing procedures, reconciliation templates, and validation checklists for recurring reports. 
 - Create exception reports and identify opportunities to automate repetitive validation activities. 
 - Document testing results, supporting evidence, business impact, recommended corrections, and resolutions to maintain clear records and support audit readiness. 
 - Work with operational stakeholders to clarify reporting requirements, confirm expected results, and escalate material inaccuracies promptly. 
 - Monitor recurring reporting defects and recommend improvements to strengthen data quality, accuracy, and reporting reliability. 
 - Follow applicable policies and procedures for patient confidentiality, HIPAA compliance, and secure handling of sensitive healthcare information. 

Requirements

- At least 3 years of experience in data analysis, reporting quality assurance, data validation, reconciliation, or a related analytical role. 
 - Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including pivot tables, XLOOKUP, SUMIFS, conditional formulas, and large-dataset comparisons. 
 - Strong SQL skills, including the ability to query, compare, aggregate, reconcile, and validate data. 
 - Demonstrated experience investigating discrepancies across reports, databases, or business systems and identifying underlying causes. 
 - Ability to interpret complex business rules and translate them into practical data validation scenarios. 
 - Strong analytical thinking, troubleshooting, and problem-solving abilities, with consistent attention to detail and accuracy. 
 - Ability to independently investigate issues, follow through on findings, and manage multiple reporting validation assignments. 
 - Strong written communication and documentation skills, including the ability to explain technical findings and business impact clearly. 
 - Reliable computer access and a stable, high-speed internet connection suitable for remote work. 
 - Experience in healthcare revenue cycle management (RCM), medical billing, or healthcare reporting is preferred, particularly with knowledge of accounts receivable, charges, payments, adjustments, denials, collections, and financial reconciliation. 
 - Familiarity with EHR or practice management platforms such as ModMed, Tebra, Nextech, DrChrono, AdvancedMD, athenahealth, or OpenPM is an advantage. 
 - Experience with Power BI, Tableau, or similar business intelligence platforms is beneficial. 
 - Familiarity with Python, Power Query, automated data validation tools, data quality monitoring, or exception reporting is an advantage. 
 - Experience validating ETL/ELT pipelines, APIs, or database integrations is preferred. 
 - Knowledge of HIPAA requirements and experience handling sensitive healthcare information are beneficial. 
 - Strong ownership, curiosity, accountability, adaptability, and collaboration skills, with a willingness to ask questions, verify assumptions, welcome feedback, and pursue continuous learning. 

Benefits

- Remote-first working environment with an established work-from-home culture. 
 - Support for continuing education and professional development. 
 - Funding or reimbursement support for continuing education, as described in the original posting. 
 - Charitable donation matching. 
 - A people-focused culture that encourages collaboration, learning, and team connection. 
 - Emphasis on work-life balance and a healthy approach to professional and personal commitments. 
 - Opportunities to participate in remote team activities, including informal social events and a book club. 

How Jobgether Works

We use an AI-powered matching process to ensure your application is reviewed quickly, objectively, and fairly against the role's core requirements. Our system identifies the top-fitting candidates, and this shortlist is then shared directly with the hiring company. The final decision and next steps (interviews, assessments) are managed by their internal team. 

We appreciate your interest and wish you the best!

data.title: Salesforce Application Architect
data.description:
SOVOS

Salesforce Application Architect

Accounting/Finance·Full-Time·India

Build Your Future With Us

The digitization of tax compliance is fundamentally changing global commerce and how businesses need to operate and grow. Governments now have real-time visibility into business data, creating new challenges and new opportunities for organizations around the world. At Sovos, we're transforming tax compliance from a business requirement into a driver of growth through AI-powered technology that delivers the accurate, real-time insights businesses need to make smarter decisions. 

We're solving more than today's tax compliance challenges. We're helping reshape global economies by enabling organizations to navigate increasingly complex and rapidly changing regulatory environments with confidence - and helping communities thrive. 

AI is accelerating what's possible, enabling tax and technology professionals to more effectively drive critical regulatory decisions. That's where Sovos excels, combining intelligent technology with human expertise to help customers stay ahead of change. 

Don't worry if you don't check every box. We're focused on hiring great people, not perfect resumes. It's less about what you've done elsewhere and more about what you're capable of doing here. 

The Role

At Sovos, we're building the platform that makes tax compliance simple for thousands of global enterprises. As Salesforce Application Architect, you'll own the technical architecture and engineering of our Salesforce ecosystem, designing scalable solutions that power our go-to-market operations and integrate AI-powered automation directly into production. This is a senior technical leadership role where you'll balance deep platform engineering, CPQ expertise, and modern AI tooling to deliver reliable, maintainable systems at global scale. Don't worry if you don't check all the boxes - apply anyway! We're focused on hiring the right people, not just the "right" resume. It's not about what you've done elsewhere; it's all about what you're capable of doing here. 

More Specifically, You Will

- Own the Salesforce technical architecture across Sales Cloud, CPQ, and Service Cloud, designing scalable, maintainable solutions that balance declarative and programmatic approaches with a strong focus on long-term platform health and org simplicity. 
 - Govern platform engineering standards for Apex, LWC, SFDX, and Flow automation, including coding standards, architecture and code reviews, bulkification patterns, metadata hygiene, and technical debt remediation to keep the platform performant as it scales. 
 - Design and maintain the Salesforce security model including org-wide defaults, role hierarchy, permission sets, permission set groups, field-level security, and sharing rules; conduct periodic security audits and enforce least-privilege access. 
 - Architect and engineer the Salesforce CPQ platform, including product catalogue, pricing rules, QCP (JavaScript quoting processes), MDQ (multi-dimensional quoting), Advanced Approvals, amendment and renewal logic, and ARR categorisation; own end-to-end Quote-to-Cash process integrity and integrations with Zuora and NetSuite via middleware. 
 - Design, build, and deploy AI-powered features directly on the Salesforce platform using LLM APIs (Claude, Copilot), including agentic data-quality workflows, deal and quoting chatbots grounded in CPQ data, and AI-assisted development workflows; evaluate and govern Salesforce-native AI capabilities including Agentforce agents, Einstein Copilot, and Prompt Builder. 
 - Architect and govern Salesforce integration patterns including REST/SOAP APIs, platform events, named credentials, and External Services; set clear standards for declarative versus programmatic callout patterns and partner with data and integrations teams on middleware strategy. 
 - Lead Salesforce DevOps practices using Salesforce DX and CI/CD pipelines; govern platform health via Salesforce Health Check, Code Analyser in the CI pipeline, and org limits monitoring; enforce sandbox strategy, environment governance, and AppExchange package evaluation. 
 - Serve as the technical escalation point for the Salesforce team; conduct code and architecture reviews, mentor administrators and developers, and partner with Sales Operations, Finance, and executive stakeholders to translate business requirements into sound technical design, communicating decisions clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences. 
 - Lead Salesforce workstreams for M&A due diligence and post-close integration; own platform controls aligned to SOX ITGC requirements including change management controls, access review evidence, and audit log configuration. 

What You Bring to Sovos

- You've built deep platform expertise across Salesforce Sales Cloud, CPQ, Service Cloud, and integrations in a global SaaS environment, with solid architecture and engineering skills demonstrated over the course of your career. 
 - Salesforce Certified Application Architect required; Certified Data Architect or Sharing and Visibility Architect strongly preferred; strong data architecture skills including large data volume (LDV) management (skinny tables, custom indexes, archiving), SOQL query optimisation, and data migration design. 
 - Salesforce Certified CPQ Specialist required or equivalent experience; deep hands-on experience with QCP (JavaScript quoting processes), MDQ (multi-dimensional quoting), amendment and renewal logic, and ARR categorisation across upsell, cross-sell, churn, migration, and recontracting scenarios. 
 - Demonstrated experience building AI/LLM integrations directly on the Salesforce platform using Claude API, Gemini API, or equivalent, including agentic workflows and AI-powered automation in production CRM environments; familiarity with Salesforce-native AI capabilities including Agentforce, Einstein Copilot, Prompt Builder, and Einstein Trust Layer. 
 - Strong Apex, LWC, and Flow development expertise; ability to set and enforce coding standards, perform code reviews, design complex Flow automation (screen flows, Flow Orchestration), and govern the declarative automation layer at scale. 
 - Experience with Salesforce integration architecture including REST/SOAP APIs, platform events, External Services, and middleware platforms (Boomi, MuleSoft); Zuora and NetSuite integration experience a strong plus; proficiency with Salesforce DevOps (SFDX, CI/CD, Copado, Prodly, or Gearset) and platform governance. 
 - Comfort with AI-assisted development workflows and leveraging AI tools to improve platform architecture, engineering quality, and delivery speed; strong written and verbal English communication skills for cross-time-zone executive stakeholder engagement. 
 - Due to client contractual obligations, the successful candidate will be asked to clear a background check upon hire. 

The Process

We believe in a transparent and comprehensive hiring process. Here's what you might expect: 

1

Pre-Employment Assessment

Regionally specific assessments we use to mitigate bias and give every applicant a fair shot. 

2

Video Interview

A chance to meet as many qualified applicants as possible and get to know you beyond your resume. 

3

Meeting with a Recruiter

A conversation to talk through the role, your experience, and your goals. 

4

Live Interviews with the Hiring Team

Meet the people you'll work with and dig into the day-to-day of the role. 

Life at Sovos

The tools to enhance your life - because we want you to enjoy your life outside of work and inside!

- Global Mentoring Programs
 - AI Tools and Technology from Day 1
 - Continuous Learning and Development
 - Language Learning Support
 - Global Employee Recognition Platform and Programs
 - Global Parental Leave Policy
 - Comprehensive Health Insurance (Day 1, company paid)
 - Life and Accidental Insurance (company paid)
 - Hybrid Work Arrangement
 - Annual Health Check-up

Equal Opportunity Employer

Sovos is an equal opportunity employer committed to providing an environment that celebrates diversity and where equal employment opportunities are available to all applicants and employees. We do not discriminate against race, colour, religions, national origin, age, sex, marital status, physical or mental disability, veteran status, gender identity, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic provided by law. At Sovos, all employees are encouraged to bring their whole selves to work. 

Company Background

Sovos is transforming tax compliance from a business requirement to a force for growth. Our flagship product, the Sovos Compliance Cloud platform, enables businesses to identify, determine, and report on every tax obligation across the globe. Sovos processes nearly 20 billion transactions per year, helping companies scale their compliance strategy in 150+ countries. 

More than 100, 000 customers - including half the Fortune 500 - trust Sovos' tax and regulatory expertise and unparalleled integration with their business applications. Learn more at sovos. com. 

Ready to make your move?

We'd love to hear from you. Use the Apply button at the top of this page to submit your application
