data.title: Director of Engineering (AI Inference Platform)
data.description:
Job Overview

We are hiring a Director of Engineering to establish a new team in India for Arm's AI inference platform. You will set its engineering strategy and build an initial organization of approximately 20 people, with responsibility for the capabilities it delivers and operates. 

Changes in AI models and hardware create open engineering questions about how inference services should be built and run. Long-context and agentic workloads bring different demands on memory, compute, and response time. This role offers the chance to shape the software that makes these systems practical to operate at scale. 

You will help determine where the India organization should lead. Early opportunities include the systems that bring new inference capabilities into production and improve their performance, efficiency, and reliability. The remit will develop through your assessment of platform needs and the expertise you build within the team. 

Responsibilities

- Set the engineering strategy for the India organization. Identify the capabilities it should lead, make investment choices, and translate platform priorities into a roadmap that can adapt as the technology develops. 
 - Recruit and develop the technical leadership and engineering expertise needed to deliver that strategy. Shape the organization as its responsibilities grow, and build a record of developing talent alongside hiring it. 
 - Establish an engineering approach suited to a team tackling an evolving platform, using AI throughout development and keeping the path from an idea to a reliable release short. 
 - Lead architecture decisions with enough technical depth to challenge assumptions and evaluate new approaches. Help teams make progress on unfamiliar systems problems through experimentation and sound engineering judgment. 
 - Give engineering leaders clear responsibility for complete platform capabilities, including their operation in production. Coach them to make decisions and build teams that can deliver independently. 
 - Partner with Arm teams in the US and UK to shape platform direction, agree ownership, and resolve dependencies. Represent the India organization's priorities in broader engineering and planning decisions. 

Required Skills and Experience

- Experience building engineering organizations, including recruiting senior talent and developing managers and technical leaders. 
 - A record of setting technical strategy, choosing priorities, and delivering production software as requirements and technology change. 
 - Technical depth in distributed systems, AI infrastructure, performance engineering, or related platform software, with the ability to assess architecture and guide difficult decisions. 
 - Understanding of AI inference and the relationship between workload, hardware, and system performance. 
 - Practical experience improving software development with AI, supported by judgment about quality and reliability. 
 - Experience leading across organizational and geographic boundaries, with clear ownership and productive technical partnerships. 

Nice-to-Have Skills and Experience

- Inference engines, accelerator-based systems, or tools for profiling and tuning model performance. 
 - Kubernetes, cloud platforms, or software deployed across different compute environments. 
 - Distributed tracing, large-scale data processing, or usage accounting systems. 
 - Establishing an engineering team in India and recruiting senior technical talent locally. 

In Return

You'll have opportunities to shape Arm's AI inference platform, build a new engineering team in India, and collaborate with teams across the US and UK. The role also offers scope to influence technical direction and grow your leadership impact while tackling evolving challenges in AI infrastructure, performance and reliability. 

Our 10x Mindset

At Arm, we believe progress happens when people are empowered to think bigger and push beyond what seems possible. Our 10x mindset is about curiosity, ambition and creating impact that will be used by millions. We learn fast, prioritise collaboration and turn bold ideas into real technology. We look for people who are inspired by this way of working and want to grow in an environment where bold ideas are welcomed. Discover how the 10x mindset shapes life at Arm: https: //careers. arm. com/10x-mindset

Use of AI in Your Application

At Arm, we embrace the benefits AI can bring, including in recruitment. You may use AI to support your preparation, such as improving the clarity of written responses, practicing interview questions, or learning more about our industry. However, your application and interview responses must reflect your own thinking, experience, and abilities. We want to understand your authentic perspective, creativity, and approach to problem solving. As such, you may not use AI to complete assigned tasks as part of any assessments. If you plan to use AI-supported or assistive technologies as part of a reasonable adjustment, please contact accommodations@arm. com so we can support you. 

Recruitment Adjustments and Accommodations

At Arm, we want to build extraordinary teams. If you need an adjustment or an accommodation during the recruitment process, please email accommodations@arm. com . To note, by sending us the requested information, you consent to its use by Arm to arrange for appropriate accommodations. All accommodation or adjustment requests will be treated with confidentiality, and information concerning these requests will only be disclosed as necessary to provide the accommodation. Although this is not an exhaustive list, examples of support include breaks between interviews, having documents read aloud, or office accessibility. Please email us about anything we can do to accommodate you during the recruitment process. 

Hybrid Working

Arm's approach to hybrid working is designed to create a working environment that supports both high performance and personal wellbeing. We believe in bringing people together face to face to enable us to work at pace, whilst recognizing the value of flexibility. Within that framework, we empower groups/teams to determine their own hybrid working patterns, depending on the work and the team's needs. Details of what this means for each role will be shared upon application. In some cases, the flexibility we can offer is limited by local legal, regulatory, tax, or other considerations, and where this is the case, we will collaborate with you to find the best solution. Please talk to us to find out more about what this could look like for you. 

Equal Opportunities

Arm is an equal opportunity employer, committed to providing an environment of mutual respect where equal opportunities are available to all applicants and colleagues. We are a diverse organization of dedicated and innovative individuals, and don't discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran.

Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365 - all within 90 seconds.

Rippling is building core AI Platform infrastructure that will power intelligent and automated experiences across the company. data.title: Software Developer (Market Setup)
data.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Software Developer (Market Setup) based in India. 

As a Software Developer (Market Setup), you will play a key role in bringing new trading venues onto a high-performance trading platform, taking integrations from initial technical assessment through to the first live trade. You will work across connectivity engineering, binary protocol adaptation, historical market data processing, and latency optimization. Collaborating with infrastructure engineers and other technical teams, you will ensure that each venue is properly integrated, tested, and ready for production. You will work with technologies such as C++, Python, Linux, and specialized low-latency networking infrastructure. This role combines hands-on software development, systems engineering, and technical problem-solving in a demanding trading environment. You will also help establish repeatable integration processes that make future market launches faster and more efficient. 

Accountabilities

You will own the technical integration of individual trading venues, coordinating each stage from initial requirements analysis and infrastructure design to certification, production deployment, and operational handover. 

- Technical Scoping: Analyze exchange specifications, assess existing platform capabilities, identify missing functionality, and estimate the development and integration effort required. 
 - Connectivity Engineering: Design and implement connectivity solutions in collaboration with infrastructure teams, covering colocation, proxies, network lines, IP addresses, multicast groups, firewall configurations, and failover mechanisms. 
 - Protocol Adaptation: Develop and adapt market data and order entry connectors to exchange-specific binary protocols, including SBE, FAST, ITCH, OUCH, Eurex ETI, EOBI, LSE native protocols, and proprietary exchange protocols. 
 - Session and Order Management: Implement and validate session handling, recovery mechanisms, throttling, and order rejection management to ensure reliable exchange communication. 
 - Market Data and Risk Parameters: Extract and interpret raw product definitions, margin rates, price limits, lot and tick tables, and position limits, providing complete and accurate information to the team responsible for data normalization. 
 - Historical Data Processing: Convert large volumes of historical exchange archives and captured market feeds into the platform's required format and validate the results against live market data. 
 - Latency Optimization: Measure system performance using hardware timestamps, compare results against exchange benchmarks and strategy requirements, and optimize host placement, network interface cards, kernel bypass settings, CPU pinning, connector execution paths, and gateway selection. 
 - Performance Documentation: Establish and document latency baselines to support ongoing operational monitoring and performance consistency. 
 - Certification and Testing: Complete exchange conformance procedures and internal certification tests, including replay testing, soak testing, order-flow scenarios, and failover validation. 
 - Operational Preparation: Develop detailed operating instructions covering exchange sessions, schedules, trading limits, startup and shutdown procedures, failure scenarios, escalation processes, and exchange contacts. 
 - Go-Live and Handover: Coordinate the first live trading activity, provide initial production support during the hypercare period, and ensure a smooth transition to the operations and trading desk teams. 
 - Continuous Improvement: Help make future exchange integrations more efficient by applying lessons learned and improving technical implementation processes. 

Requirements

The ideal candidate will have strong software engineering fundamentals, a solid understanding of low-level systems, and the ability to work independently on complex, project-based technical integrations. 

- Strong understanding of data structures, algorithms, and object-oriented programming principles in C++. 
 - Good knowledge of Linux system internals and operating system fundamentals. 
 - Ability to understand complex technical specifications and translate them into reliable software implementations. 
 - Familiarity with software development, debugging, and testing practices. 
 - Good written and spoken English, with the ability to collaborate effectively in an international environment. 
 - Ability to work effectively in a remote or hybrid team with changing priorities and project-based responsibilities. 
 - Strong problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and a results-oriented mindset. 
 - Ability to review, validate, and test code generated with AI-assisted development tools. 

Nice To Have

- In-depth experience with low-latency or real-time software development, particularly systems targeting sub-microsecond latency. 
 - Knowledge of lock-free data structures, containers, and concurrent programming patterns. 
 - Strong C programming skills. 
 - Experience developing Linux drivers or working with Linux kernel internals and core system components. 
 - Familiarity with high-performance networking, trading infrastructure, or exchange connectivity. 

Benefits

- Fully remote working opportunities from anywhere in the world. 
 - Access to global offices whenever needed. 
 - Flexible working schedule. 
 - 40 paid days off. 
 - Competitive salary. 
 - Results-oriented environment with minimal bureaucracy. 
 - Challenging technical projects with fast feedback loops. 
 - Collaboration with a welcoming international team of highly qualified professionals. 
 - Access to cutting-edge hardware, tools, and technologies. 
 - Opportunities to work on complex, high-performance systems and develop expertise in advanced trading infrastructure.

data.description:
Job Specification: 

We are seeking a Lead Java Engineer to head the XiP Compute Service (XCS) team - the engine room of Citi's enterprise-scale XiNG Platform (XiP), responsible for orchestrating and executing 1. 5 billion risk calculations every day. 

As the lead of the XCS team, you will own the design, development, and evolution of the most performance-critical component within XiP. XiP is Citi's unified risk calculation platform built on the XiNG quantitative libraries standard, and XCS sits at its core - providing the powerful compute paradigms and guardrails that enable calculations to run reliably at massive scale. 

Your team is the engine that daily coordinates hundreds of thousands of pods, consumes tens of thousands of compute nodes, utilises hundreds of TB of memory, and distributes hundreds of millions of calculations across Citi's private cloud and Public cloud infrastructures. The platform is both highly performant and rapidly evolving, and your leadership will be central to driving it to its next generation of scale, efficiency, and capability. 

You will work closely with other software engineers, DevOps, and our customers to define technical strategy and ensure the reliable, secure, and scalable operation of the platform. 

Responsibilities

Take a lead in defining the long-term strategic direction of the XiP Platform: 

Apply your experience and skills to develop the future versions of the calculation engine. This means making it faster, utilize resources better, and scale to even greater sizes. This means adding new features without impacting performance of the platform in an undesirable manner, as small changes multiplied by millions of calculations have a high cost. This means solving hard problems like transferring small amounts of data to a huge number of machines. 

Take on the day-to-day leadership of the development team: 

Lead the team's Agile/Scrum ceremonies, including sprint planning, daily stand-ups, and retrospectives, to ensure a smooth and effective development workflow. Manage the project backlog, prioritize tasks, and coordinate development efforts to align with the product roadmap and strategic goals. Provide hands-on technical leadership, guiding the team in architectural decisions and enforcing coding standards. 

Serve as advisor or coach to team members, allocating and overseeing work: 

Mentor and guide developers, providing technical advice, code reviews, and career development support. Allocate tasks based on skill sets and project priorities, ensuring balanced workloads and timely delivery. Foster a collaborative and growth-oriented team environment, encouraging best practices and continuous learning. 

Lead the implementation of changes and improvements to Citi's Risk Calculation Engine: 

Lead the design, development, and implementation of enhancements to the Risk Calculation Engine, focusing on optimizing its distribution mechanisms. Analyze current parallelization strategies, which regularly handle 250, 000 hours of compute in a single 90-minute execution, and identify opportunities to further improve efficiency, scalability, and throughput. 

Plan, coordinate, and execute strategic changes to the engine to reach the next scaling milestone: 

Develop and manage strategic initiatives aimed at scaling the Risk Calculation Engine to meet future business demands. Coordinate with stakeholders to ensure that all scaling efforts are aligned with customer needs. 

Qualifications

- Should be a Graduate from a recognized University
 - 10+ years of professional software development experience with Java. 
 - Solid experience with Java frameworks (e. g. , Spring, Spring Boot, Quarkus). 
 - Proven experience designing, building, and maintaining large-scale, distributed systems. 
 - Exposure to cloud platforms (e. g. , AWS, Azure, GCP) and containerization (e. g. , Docker, Kubernetes).

 - Strong understanding of object-oriented programming and design patterns.

 - Exposure to NoSQL databases (e. g. , MongoDB, Cassandra) is a plus.

data.title: Lead Architect - C++ and Java - Vice President
data.description:
Role Summary

The Applications Development Technical Lead Analyst is a senior engineering and architectural leadership role based in India, operating as a key regional anchor within the global Position Management technology organization. 

In this capacity, you will serve as the principal designer, systems architect, and hands-on lead engineer for mission-critical, low latency, and high-throughput platform. This platforms powers real-time controls, intraday position aggregation, P&L, commissions, anomaly detection, and live risk enforcement across global trading desks. 

As an engineering leader, you will collaborate extensively with other global teams and stakeholders across Asia, Europe, and Americas. You will champion modern engineering practices - actively designing, building, and prototyping using AI-augmented tools such as GitHub Copilot, Devin to accelerate development of lifecycles, elevate code quality, and modernize enterprise architectures. Additionally, you will serve as the primary regional and global technical contact for Risk Managers, Product Owners, Front-Office Trading Desks, and cross-functional technology partners. 

Key Responsibilities

- Architecture, System Design & Core Engineering (Hands-on)
 - Architect & Design: Lead the end-to-end technical architecture and low-level design for distributed, fault-tolerant, high-concurrency risk calculation and position management engines supporting global trading sessions. 
 - Hands-on Development: 10+ years of experience to actively write, review, and optimize high-performance, multi-threaded production code primarily in C++, with targeted high-performance/low-latency modules in Java and exploring Rust where ultra-low latency memory safety and deterministic execution are required. 
 - AI-Augmented Engineering: Champion the adoption of modern AI development workflows (e. g. , GitHub Copilot, Devin, AI-driven code review, and automated test generation) to enhance developer productivity, modernize legacy components, and accelerate time-to-market. 
 - Middleware & Event Streams: Design resilient, low-latency, event-driven pipelines using enterprise messaging backbones such as Apache Kafka, Solace PubSub+, and other low-latency middleware fabrics. 
 - Relational Databases: Proficiency in SQL writing queries and improve efficiency
 - Performance Tuning: Profile, benchmark, and optimize CPU usage, memory layout, network serialization, and IPC for low latency. 

Global Stakeholder Collaboration & Technical Advisory

- Key Technical Liaison: Act as a technical contact and subject matter expert (SME) for Risk Managers, Product Owners, Trading Desks, Quantitative Analysts, and Operations across APAC and global hubs. 
 - Global Team Alignment: Partner closely with regional and global engineering pods across Singapore, London, New York, and other tech centers to ensure seamless platform rollouts, operational stability, and cohesive architecture standards. 
 - Cross-Technology Coordination: Interface closely with upstream Order Management Systems (OMS), Execution Management Systems (EMS), Market Data feeds, and downstream Clearing/Settlement and Regulatory reporting platforms across multiple asset classes (FX, Equities, Rates, Commodities, Credit). 
 - Requirement Translation: Translate complex quantitative risk models, margin methodologies, and regional/global regulatory requirements into scalable, deterministic technical architecture

Mentorship & Regional/Global Leadership

- Lead, coach, and mentor junior engineers in regional teams in distributed systems design, clean code practices, and modern AI-assisted engineering techniques. 
 - Lead architectural design reviews and rigorous peer code reviews to ensure reliability, security, and maintainability across distributed codebases. 
 - Partner with engineering managers and Scrum Masters across time zones on sprint planning, technical estimations, dependency resolution, and milestone delivery. 

Technical Proficiencies: 

- Java: Practical experience or working knowledge of Java for performance-critical, memory-safe, or low-latency system components and cross-language interoperability
 - C++: Proficiency in modern C++, memory management/profiling, lock-free data structures, concurrent programming, and low-latency tuning in Linux platforms. 
 - SQL: Hands-on experience writing SQL procedures, and practical knowledge of indexes

Education: 

- Bachelor's degree / University degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, or equivalent STEM discipline. 
 - Master's degree (Desirable) in Computer Science, Financial Engineering, or related quantitative field

data.title: Lead Developer - Java and Microservices
data.description:
We are seeking a highly experienced and technically accomplished Application Dev Lead to join our team, responsible for architecting, developing, and leading our core banking integration strategies and modern microservices ecosystem. The ideal candidate will be a subject matter expert in integration technologies, possess deep, hands-on expertise in Java Microservices and enterprise Database engineering (Oracle/SQL), have extensive knowledge of the financial services domain, and demonstrate a proven track record of leading technical teams to deliver robust, scalable, and secure solutions. 

This role requires a unique blend of hands-on technical excellence, architectural vision, database performance optimization, and strong people management skills to drive the modernization and stability of our mission-critical banking systems. 

Key Responsibilities: 

Leadership & People Management

- Team Leadership & Mentorship: Lead, manage, and mentor a high-performing team of developers, backend engineers, and integration specialists, fostering technical capability, career growth, and engineering excellence across Java microservices and middleware platforms. 
 - Project & Delivery Ownership: Take full ownership of technical delivery across complex integration initiatives, including architectural scoping, task breakdown (WBS), accurate sprint estimation, resource planning, and milestone prioritization. 
 - Quality Assurance & Engineering Governance: Enforce best-in-class engineering practices by conducting rigorous code reviews, pull request audits, and comprehensive architectural design reviews (TDRs). 
 - Stakeholder Collaboration: Collaborate seamlessly across business lines, enterprise architecture, database administrators, infrastructure, Information Security, and third-party vendor teams to align technical delivery with strategic business goals. 
 - SME & Agile Delivery: Act as the primary Subject Matter Expert (SME) for complex escalations, production incident triage (Sev-1/MIM), and root-cause analysis, while driving Agile/Scrum ceremonies to ensure predictable, high-quality, and timely delivery. 

Technical & Domain Responsibilities

- Java Microservices Architecture: Architect, build, and deploy production-grade, containerized Java microservices using Spring Boot, Spring Cloud, and RESTful/gRPC APIs, implementing distributed resilience patterns (Saga orchestrations, Circuit Breakers, Bulkheads, Outbox pattern). 
 - Database Engineering & Query Performance: Design robust database models and persistence layers (Spring Data JPA, Hibernate, JDBC), execute query tuning, analyze execution plans (EXPLAIN PLAN), optimize indexing strategies (B-Tree, Bitmap, composite), and resolve connection pool (HikariCP) and row-level locking contentions in enterprise Oracle/SQL environments. 
 - High-Availability Integration Design: Design and implement resilient, distributed integration solutions prioritizing active-active high availability (HA), fault tolerance, multi-region disaster recovery (DR), recoverability, and minimal business disruption. 
 - Legacy-to-Cloud Modernization: Lead the architectural evolution and phased decomposition of legacy centralized middleware (TIBCO BusinessWorks, IBM MQ) into distributed, event-driven architectures utilizing Apache Kafka and cloud-native Java microservices. 
 - Banking Domain Systems Integration: Apply deep expertise in banking and financial services to integration architecture, specifically in real-time fraud detection, payment processing rails (ISO 20022, SWIFT, Fedwire, ACH), clearing and settlement, and core enterprise banking ledgers. 
 - Security, Audit & Regulatory Compliance: Ensure all integration services strictly comply with enterprise security baselines, audit controls, regulatory mandates (OCC, Fed, PRA, MAS), data protection rules (PII, PCI-DSS), Mutual TLS (mTLS) certificate management, and operational resilience standards. 
 - High-Volume Real-Time Messaging: Oversee the architecture, throughput tuning, and management of real-time transaction flows, high-volume messaging pipelines, dead-letter queue (DLQ) automation, and sub-second SLA routing. 

Recommended Qualifications

Core Technical Skills

- Java & Microservices: 
 - Advanced proficiency in Core Java (Java 11/17/21), Multithreading, Concurrency, and JVM tuning (Memory management, Garbage Collection - G1GC/ZGC). 
 - Hands-on mastery of Spring Framework (Spring Boot, Spring Cloud, Spring Data, Spring Security, Spring Batch). 
 - Deep experience with Microservices patterns (Saga Orchestration/Choreography, CQRS, Circuit Breaker via Resilience4j, API Gateway routing). 
 - Containerization and orchestration experience using Docker, Kubernetes, and OpenShift. 
 - Database & Data Persistence: 
 - Advanced expertise in Relational Databases: Oracle (19c+), SQL, PL/SQL, stored procedures, functions, packages, and triggers. 
 - Deep knowledge of Query Performance Tuning, Execution Plan analysis (EXPLAIN PLAN), index design, partitioning, and stats gathering. 
 - Mastery of connection pool management (HikariCP), lock contention mitigation, deadlock resolution, and transaction isolation levels (READ COMMITTED, SERIALIZABLE). 
 - Solid understanding of ORM frameworks (Hibernate, JPA) and mitigation of ORM antipatterns (N+1 queries, dirty checks). 
 - Enterprise Middleware & Messaging:

data.title: Principal Voice Platform Engineer (Conversational AI)
data.description:
About Birdeye

Birdeye builds AI coworkers for multi-location brands. Jay for marketing, Myna for operations, and Robin for customer experience orchestrate AI agents to win AI visibility, book appointments, and drive consistent CX at every location. They run on BirdAI, the Agent OS built on 13 years of multi-location data infrastructure and 3, 000+ integrations. BirdAI consolidates every signal, reasons with industry, brand and location context, and acts autonomously or with a human in the loop. 

Birdeye is trusted by the world's largest multi-location brands across healthcare, dental, restaurants, financial services, auto, retail, and property management. G2 ranks Birdeye #1 in Enterprise Multi-Location Marketing Platforms and named it to the 2026 Best Agentic AI Products list. Learn more at birdeye. com. 

Role Overview

We are looking for a Senior Real-Time Voice Engineer to design, build, and optimize high-performance voice infrastructure that powers millions of automated, interactive AI voice experiences. In this role, you will own the end-to-end media pipeline-handling everything from edge routing and WebRTC streaming to real-time audio synchronization. 

You will work closely with our engineering teams to ensure that real-time voice interactions across phone lines and web/mobile apps are seamless, ultra-low-latency, and highly resilient under heavy enterprise scale. 

What You'll Do

- Build Streaming Media Pipelines: Design and implement highly concurrent, real-time backend systems that ingest, buffer, and process live audio streams with sub-second latency. 
 - Optimize Interactive Voice Systems: Implement core voice-handling features, including real-time speech detection, interruption handling, and streaming audio playback systems. 
 - Manage Communications Infrastructure: Configure and scale session border controllers (SBCs), media gateways, and WebRTC media servers to route multi-channel audio traffic reliably. 
 - Integrate Applied AI Frameworks: Develop secure, performant integrations with industry-leading Speech-to-Text (STT) and Text-to-Speech (TTS) streaming APIs. 
 - Own Platform Telemetry: Establish deep observability across the voice stack to track packet health, system latency, and audio quality, ensuring a high-fidelity experience for every user. 

What We're Looking For

WebRTC & Digital Media Streaming

- WebRTC Protocol Internals: Strong understanding of the WebRTC stack, including SDP negotiation, ICE, STUN/TURN, and DTLS/SRTP security. 
 - Media Server Deployments: Hands-on experience working with open-source WebRTC media servers and SFU/MCU frameworks (e. g. , Janus, Mediasoup, LiveKit, or Pion). 
 - Audio Optimization: Experience tuning network congestion algorithms, managing 
 - Telephony Infrastructure & Protocolsnetwork jitter buffers, and handling packet loss concealment. 
 - SBC & Gateway Management: Practical experience deploying and managing carrier-grade SBCs (e. g. , AudioCodes, Ribbon) or open-source SIP proxies (Kamailio, OpenSIPS). 
 - Telephony Protocol Mastery: Deep knowledge of SIP, RTP/RTCP, and SDP state machines, including experience writing header manipulation rules. 
 - Media Capture & Transcoding: Experience with media duplication techniques (SIPREC / media forking) and audio codec mechanics (Opus, G. 711) to normalize streaming data formats. 
 - Packet-Level Troubleshooting: Fluency using packet analyzers like Wireshark to diagnose signaling drops, media stream anomalies, and network delays. 

Modern Software & AI Infrastructure Engineering

- Production Coding: Fluency in either Go (Golang) or Java for building resilient backend middleware. 
 - Streaming Media Architectures: Hands-on experience with WebSockets and WebRTC for real-time bi-directional data and audio streaming. 
 - AI & Speech Models: Experience integrating streaming API endpoints with modern STT (Speech-to-Text) frameworks and TTS (Text-to-Speech) providers like ElevenLabs. 
 - Engineering Best Practices: Strong background in writing clean code, designing clean SDK/API abstractions, and managing code via Git-driven CI/CD pipelines.

data.title: Software Engineer (Platform/EOS/Networking)
data.description:
Company Description

Arista Networks is an industry leader in data-driven, client-to-cloud networking for large data center, campus and routing environments. Arista is a well-established and profitable company with over $8 billion in revenue. Arista's award-winning platforms, ranging in Ethernet speeds up to 800G bits per second, redefine scalability, agility, and resilience. Arista is a founding member of the Ultra Ethernet consortium. We have shipped over 20 million cloud networking ports worldwide with CloudVision and EOS, an advanced network operating system. Arista is committed to open standards, and its products are available worldwide directly and through partners. 

At Arista, we value the diversity of thought and perspectives each employee brings. We believe fostering an inclusive environment where individuals from various backgrounds and experiences feel welcome is essential for driving creativity and innovation. 

Our commitment to excellence has earned us several prestigious awards, such as the Great Place to Work Survey for Best Engineering Team and Best Company for Diversity, Compensation, and Work-Life Balance. At Arista, we take pride in our track record of success and strive to maintain the highest quality and performance standards in everything we do. 

Job Description

Who You'll Work With

You will work with the Platform team who work closest to the hardware and programming chips. 

What You'll Do

As a Software Engineer your core responsibility is to deliver new cutting edge product features. A major part of this is writing and owning design/implementation of the code that drives our products. However, the role of a Software Engineer is much bigger than 'simply' writing code. Software engineers work on the whole development process, including: 

- Suggesting and deciding what features to build
 - Driving the design and architecture
 - Pushing, testing, documenting the feature
 - Working alongside customers in the field if needed

Are you right for this role?

This Is An Interesting And Exciting Opportunity To Be a Part Of The Software Development Team That Is Redefining Data Center Switching. For Success At Arista All You Need Is

- Strong industry experience of 5+ years
 - Extensive background in algorithms and strong software architecture skills
 - Fluency in C/C++ programming
 - Hands-on experience with designs and implementations in a strong product-engineering environment. 

Qualifications

- Strong software debugging skills especially in embedded systems. 
 - Experience with software development for the forwarding ASICs, FPGAs, Network Processors etc
 - Experience with hardware abstraction layer
 - Datapath forwarding for ACLs, QoS, Unicast, Multicast, EVPN MPLS, VXLAN, OAM etc
 - Strong communication skills and the ability to work in a team environment
 - Experience working through the complete software development life cycle right from requirements gathering to deliver the fully developed feature. 
 - Experience in Network Systems Software development is a plus

Additional Information

Arista stands out as an engineering-centric company. Our leadership, including founders and engineering managers, are all engineers who understand sound software engineering principles and the importance of doing things right. 

We hire globally into our diverse team. At Arista, engineers have complete ownership of their projects. Our management structure is flat and streamlined, and software engineering is led by those who understand it best. We prioritize the development and utilization of test automation tools. 

Our engineers have access to every part of the company, providing opportunities to work across various domains. Arista is headquartered in Santa Clara, California, with development offices in Australia, Canada, India, Ireland, and the US. We consider all our R&D centers equal in stature. 

Join us to shape the future of networking and be part of a culture that values invention, quality, respect, and fun.

data.title: Unix Scripting Specialist Officer
data.description:
The Reconciliation Developer - Officer (C11) is a hands-on technical individual contributor responsible for developing, configuring, testing, and supporting data reconciliations and automated data controls. 

Working under the guidance of senior technical leads, the developer focuses on implementing matching rules, maintaining data feeds, resolving technical breaks, and executing scheduled and ad-hoc reconciliation requests across financial systems and data distribution pipelines. 

Hybrid Schedule: 2 or 3 full days per week on-site in the office, with remaining days worked remotely in accordance with enterprise hybrid work policies. 

Reconciliation Rule Build: Configure, test, and maintain multi-way matching rules, tolerance checks, and automated exception routing on enterprise reconciliation platforms (e. g. , TLM SmartStream, Duco, Gresham, or internal reconciliation engines). 

Break Analysis & Triage: Investigate reconciliation breaks and discrepancies, identify root causes in data transformations, and apply rule adjustments or fixes. 

Data Processing & Scripting: Write and optimize Python scripts and SQL queries to extract, transform, and load transactional and ledger data into reconciliation engines. 

Requirements Implementation: Review Business Requirement Documents (BRDs) and technical specifications to implement mapping rules, data schemas, and validation checks. 

Data Feed Maintenance: Monitor daily reconciliation runs, batch feeds, and automated jobs, ensuring successful data ingestion from upstream systems. 

Assisting Backlog Remediation: Actively deliver user stories and tasks to address the operational backlog of scheduled and ad-hoc reconciliation requests. 

Testing & Deployment Support: Perform unit testing, assist with User Acceptance Testing (UAT), and prepare deployment artifacts using Git and CI/CD pipelines

Team Participation: Participate in daily stand-ups, sprint planning, and backlog refinement sessions within an Agile framework. 

Operational Collaboration: Work closely with operations users, business analysts, and quality assurance testers to clarify requirements and resolve defect tickets. 

Technology Adoption: Learn and apply emerging tools and automation techniques, including data processing utilities (e. g. , PySpark, Airflow) and automated anomaly detection workflows. 

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, Data Analytics, or related field. 
 - 4-8 years of hands-on software development, data manipulation, or reconciliation configuration experience in Financial Services or IT. 
 - Solid foundation as a technical individual contributor executing assigned tasks with quality. 
 - Python: Practical experience with data manipulation (pandas, numpy), data parsing, and scripting. 
 - SQL: Strong proficiency in writing queries, joins, aggregations, subqueries, and working with relational databases (Oracle, PostgreSQL, etc. ). 
 - Basic Understanding: Familiarity with Java, Scala, or C# is a plus. 
 - Working knowledge of batch data processing (e. g. , Apache Spark/PySpark basics). 
 - Familiarity with scheduled workflow tools (e. g. , Apache Airflow) and messaging/event concepts (e. g. , Kafka). 
 - Exposure to cloud data platforms (e. g. , Snowflake, AWS, or GCP) is advantageous.

The ideal candidate should possess strong hands-on experience in Python, Unix/Linux, SQL, Oracle, ETL technologies, and automation framework development. Experience working on Ab Initio, Big Data platforms, and high-volume transaction processing systems is strongly preferred.

data.title: Performance Tester - Assistant Vice President
data.description:
Position Overview

Citi Treasury and Trade Solutions (TTS) provides services across the globe covering 96 markets and transacting in 144 currencies. Recognized by Global Finance as one of the World's Best Financial Innovation Labs, TTS relies on robust performance engineering to establish service level agreements and deliver excellent user experiences. 

The Non-Functional Testing (NFT) group supports 100+ applications across multiple lines of business within the TTS Cash Management group. This senior role demands SME-level expertise to own performance testing solutions for complex, distributed payment architectures. 

The TTS Cash NFT team is looking for an IT Quality Senior Analyst - C12 (AVP - Performance Testing & Engineering) who will take ownership of more than 2 application performance testing solutions and play an SME role to engage with Development, Architecture, and Business teams to gather requirements and design the performance testing approach to certify application changes before production deployments. 

This role requires close collaboration with the Global NFT team and is expected to lead a team alongside the NFT Practice Manager on a need basis. The candidate should have strong knowledge to lead Non-Functional Testing (Performance Testing & Engineering) for applications with complex architecture and should have exposure in monitoring, profiling, and analyzing with industry-standard tools. 

Primary Skills

Performance Testing & Engineering

LoadRunner Enterprise (MF Performance Center)

Load Testing

Web, Web Services (REST/Microservices), MQ (Java), Database

AppDynamics

APM / Profiling

Full-stack application profiling, transaction tracing, bottleneck identification

Kibana & ELK Stack

Log aggregation, correlation, and visualization during test runs

BMC TrueSight

Monitoring

Infrastructure and system health monitoring

SQL (Oracle, MS SQL, PostgreSQL)

MongoDB

NoSQL Database

NoSQL performance testing, and data management

ECS (Elastic Container Service)/AWS (Cloud)

Container Orchestration

Containerized application performance testing

Apache Kafka

Messaging / Streaming

Performance testing of event-driven and streaming architectures

IBM MQ

Message Queue

MQ-based load testing, throughput validation, and queue performance analysis

C Programming

Programming

Low-level scripting, system-level performance analysis, and driver development

Java

Programming

Test script development, and framework automation

Key Responsibilities

This role is for a IT Quality Senior Analyst - C12 (AVP - Performance Testing & Engineering) and is expected to have SME-level knowledge to drive non-functional testing solutions for applications with complex architecture, middleware applications, along with service virtualization and data management. 

Performance Engineering & Testing

- Lead end-to-end impact assessments, testing approach design, planning, execution, application profiling, metrics analysis, reporting, and risk management for assigned projects and applications. 
 - Implement and execute a performance test framework for non-functional testing covering load, volume, stress, capacity, and scalability testing to validate business non-functional requirements. 
 - Assess and design standalone component or end-to-end testing approaches connecting multiple components in complex payments flows. 
 - Profile application performance end-to-end and identify application and hardware/OS-level bottlenecks using AppDynamics and other monitoring tools. 
 - Perform AWR analysis for Oracle database performance tuning and provide recommendations. 
 - Conduct SQL query performance analysis and optimize database interactions for high-throughput scenarios. 
 - Validate MongoDB query performance, indexing strategies, and data access patterns under load. 
 - Chaos/Resiliency for Kafka, MQ, Application, Mongo, AWS cloud

Messaging & Streaming Systems

- Design and execute performance tests for Kafka-based event-driven architectures, including producer/consumer throughput, partition performance, and lag analysis. 
 - Conduct IBM MQ performance testing including queue depth analysis, message throughput, and latency benchmarking. 
 - Test ECS containerized workloads, including auto-scaling behavior, container resource utilization, and service mesh performance. 

Monitoring & Analysis

- Leverage a strong knowledge of monitoring tools - AppDynamics, Kibana, BMC TrueSight - to analyze system health and identify potential bottlenecks. 
 - Produce and maintain Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) around testing performed. Manage best-in-class service quality and SLA/OLA compliance. 
 - Provide tuning recommendations for infrastructure components including Application Servers, Database Servers, Message Buses, and Web Servers. 

Framework & Continuous Improvement

- Identify, recommend, and implement frameworks, strategies, and toolsets to optimize test execution, expand test coverage, and reduce risk. 
 - Drive continuous process improvement and test framework/script optimization to achieve efficient, repeatable testing solutions. 
 - Automate repetitive tasks
 - Support active contribution in creating performance testing artefacts including Performance Test Strategy, Test Plans/Estimates, Optimization Reports, and KPI Dashboards. 
 - Work in an Agile testing methodology environment

Technical Skills & Competencies

Core Performance Engineering Skills (Required)

- Load, volume, stress, capacity, and scalability testing design and execution
 - End-to-end application profiling and bottleneck identification
 - Performance test strategy, planning, and documentation
 - SLA definition, measurement, and reporting
 - Infrastructure tuning (Application Servers, Database Servers, MQ, Web Servers)
 - AWR analysis for Oracle database performance
 - SQL performance analysis
 - MongoDB query analysis
 - Kafka performance testing (producer/consumer throughput, lag analysis)
 - IBM MQ performance and throughput testing
 - ECS/AWS Cloud containerized workload performance testing
 - Chaos/Resiliency testing
 - C programming for system-level scripting and driver development
 - Java programming for test framework development and automation
 - Agile testing methodology

Monitoring & Tooling (Required)

- AppDynamics - full-stack APM and profiling
 - Kibana / ELK Stack - log analysis and visualization
 - LoadRunner Enterprise (MF Performance Center)
 - BMC TrueSight / HP SiteScope - infrastructure monitoring

Good to Have

- Additional programming languages: JavaScript, Python, C#, Ruby
 - Business domain knowledge: Corporate Digital Channels, Payments, Receivables, Treasury & Trade
 - Knowledge of containerization and microservices architectures

Qualifications

- 10-12 years of experience in an IT Quality role with demonstrated ability to work independently or within cross-functional teams on complex projects. 
 - Requires in-depth knowledge, understanding, and analytical thought. Exhibits comprehensive knowledge of several areas within IT Quality and has a good understanding of the industry. 
 - Strong understanding of testing processes. In-depth understanding of the Systems Development Lifecycle (SDLC) and solid experience in several phases of systems development, preferably in testing program management. 
 - Must demonstrate confidence and ownership in their area of expertise.

data.title: Software Engineer - AVP
data.description:
As a Software Engineer - AVP , Senior Agentic UI Engineer, you will lead the design and delivery of next-generation AI-powered banking experiences across React Native, React, Android, and iOS platforms while driving the evolution of Agent-to-UI (A2UI) experiences that enable AI agents to dynamically surface, personalise and orchestrate customer interactions. Working on the Agentic UI ecosystem, you will help shape how customers interact with intelligent assistants, personalised journeys, conversational experiences, and AI-driven recommendations within the Barclays mobile and web applications. 

You will work at the intersection of Mobile/Web Engineering, Agentic AI, A2UI, Conversational Experiences and Customer Journey Design, building experiences that help customers complete banking tasks through personalised assistance, proactive insights and intelligent interactions. 

You will be responsible for building scalable, accessible, and reusable UI capabilities that integrate seamlessly with backend AI services and enterprise platforms. This role combines hands-on engineering, technical leadership, and close collaboration with Product, Design, AI, and Platform teams to deliver innovative customer experiences. 

You Will

- Support platform capabilities across multiple business domains, enabling product teams to deliver consistent and scalable customer experiences. 
 - Own the end-to-end lifecycle of frontend platform capabilities, from architecture and design through implementation, adoption and continuous improvement across React Native, React, Android and iOS. 
 - Act as a bridge between platform engineering and product teams, ensuring alignment on standards, frameworks, technical strategy and delivery requirements. 
 - Enable engineering productivity through reusable components, shared frameworks, tooling, automation and best practices, accelerating feature development across digital channels. 
 - Support continuous platform evolution, identifying opportunities to improve developer experience, release processes, observability and operational resilience. 

Key Responsibilities

- Lead the design and development of Agentic UI experiences across mobile and web channels. 
 - Design and implement A2UI capabilities that enable AI agents to dynamically render and adapt customer experiences based on intent, context and journey state. 
 - Design and implement reusable React, React Native, Android, and iOS components that enable AI-powered customer journeys across APP and Web. 
 - Support the end-to-end delivery lifecycle from discovery and design through to production deployment and optimisation. 
 - Partner with Product, UX, Accessibility and Architecture teams to create intuitive and trusted customer experiences. 
 - Contribute to platform strategy, engineering standards, and innovation initiatives within the Agentic UI space. 
 - Ensure solutions meet performance, security, accessibility and governance standards. 
 - React Native, React, Android & iOS Expertise, Strong experience building scalable, high-performance cross-platform mobile and web applications. 
 - Proven experience designing and maintaining reusable frameworks, shared libraries, A2UI capabilities, UI component systems and developer tooling, enabling AI agents to dynamically orchestrate customer experiences across platforms. 
 - Mobile and Web Architecture & Engineering Excellence Strong understanding of architecture, accessibility, performance optimisation, CI/CD, and platform governance component systems and developer tooling, enabling AI agents to dynamically orchestrate customer experiences across platforms. 
 - Mobile and Web Architecture & Engineering Excellence Strong understanding of architecture, accessibility, performance optimisation, CI/CD, and platform governance. 

Desired Skills

- AI/ML & Agentic AI Exposure
 - Experience with Python for automation, prototyping, tooling, or AI/ML integrations. 
 - Cloud & AI Platform Exposure

You may be assessed on key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen, strategic thinking and digital and technology, as well as job-specific technical skills. 

The role is based out of Pune. 

Purpose of the role

To design, develop and improve software, utilising various engineering methodologies, that provides business, platform, and technology capabilities for our customers and colleagues. 

Accountabilities

- Development and delivery of high-quality software solutions by using industry aligned programming languages, frameworks, and tools. Ensuring that code is scalable, maintainable, and optimized for performance. 
 - Cross-functional collaboration with product managers, designers, and other engineers to define software requirements, devise solution strategies, and ensure seamless integration and alignment with business objectives. 
 - Collaboration with peers, participate in code reviews, and promote a culture of code quality and knowledge sharing. 
 - Stay informed of industry technology trends and innovations and actively contribute to the organization's technology communities to foster a culture of technical excellence and growth. 
 - Adherence to secure coding practices to mitigate vulnerabilities, protect sensitive data, and ensure secure software solutions. 
 - Implementation of effective unit testing practices to ensure proper code design, readability, and reliability. 

Assistant Vice President Expectations

- To advise and influence decision making, contribute to policy development and take responsibility for operational effectiveness. Collaborate closely with other functions/ business divisions. 
 - Lead a team performing complex tasks, using well developed professional knowledge and skills to deliver on work that impacts the whole business function. Set objectives and coach employees in pursuit of those objectives, appraisal of performance relative to objectives and determination of reward outcomes
 - If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L - Listen and be authentic, E - Energise and inspire, A - Align across the enterprise, D - Develop others. 
 - OR for an individual contributor, they will lead collaborative assignments and guide team members through structured assignments, identify the need for the inclusion of other areas of specialisation to complete assignments. They will identify new directions for assignments and/ or projects, identifying a combination of cross functional methodologies or practices to meet required outcomes. 
 - Consult on complex issues; providing advice to People Leaders to support the resolution of escalated issues. 
 - Identify ways to mitigate risk and developing new policies/procedures in support of the control and governance agenda. 
 - Take ownership for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work done. 
 - Perform work that is closely related to that of other areas, which requires understanding of how areas coordinate and contribute to the achievement of the objectives of the organisation sub-function. 
 - Collaborate with other areas of work, for business aligned support areas to keep up to speed with business activity and the business strategy. 
 - Engage in complex analysis of data from multiple sources of information, internal and external sources such as procedures and practises (in other areas, teams, companies, etc). to solve problems creatively and effectively. 
 - Communicate complex information. 'Complex' information could include sensitive information or information that is difficult to communicate because of its content or its audience. 
 - Influence or convince stakeholders to achieve outcomes. 

All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship - our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset - to Empower, Challenge and Drive - the operating manual for how we behave.

Qualifications: 

- 5-7 years of relevant experience
 - Exposure to CYARA automation software preferred
 - Exposure to Gen AI tools, Prompt Engineering Certifications will be an added advantage
 - Experience in Chat Ops, IVR, Cust Service in a banking industry would be an advantage
 - Technical experience - Sound knowledge on query & rational Data base

 - Experience in the writing of testing scripts/scenarios

 - Ability to work independently, multi-task, and take ownership of various parts of a project or initiative
 - Ability to work under pressure and manage to tight deadlines or unexpected changes in expectations or requirements
 - Proven track record of operational process change and improvement
 - Working knowledge of software programming and algorithms
 - Comprehensive knowledge of the Cyara Tool will be an advantage
 - Primary Job Hours: 3: 30 PM - 12: 30 AM India Time M-F. Some weekend work necessary for install coverage to be determined on as needed basis

To be successful as a QA Analyst, you should have experience with: 

- Hands on experience with Selenium web driver with Web/ Angular based applications, Playwright . 
 - Thorough knowledge of BDD with cucumber/feature files
 - Experience and Extensive Knowledge on API automation tools using REST Assured tool /Postman, Karate etc
 - Experience in CI/CD tools like GITLAB. 
 - Extensive knowledge of Testing lifecycle and core testing process/techniques using different test approaches and manual testing
 - Relevant experience with implementation of test strategy and frameworks needed to test all the dimensions of a complex, high-throughput distributed system including functional correctness, performance, scale, and security. 
 - Good understanding of NFT - Performance testing tools (Jmeter and Load Runner)
 - Good understanding of Database design with ability to write complex Sql queries
 - Interactions with Business Analyst, business stakeholders and developers to understand various test cases. 
 - Contribute to the strategy to automate the test cases via suitable test framework. 
 - Train and mentor junior testers within the team and manage their performance. 
 - Drive best practices for end to end automation via selenium, cucumber, rest assured and related technologies. 

Some Of Highly Valued Skills May Include

- Candidates with experience in Banking Compliance domain preferred. 
 - Specific knowledge of financial products such as Equities or Commodities. 
 - Experience of working with UI testing tools like Selenium, Playwright
 - Experience of working with API Automation like Rest Asurred, Karate , Postman. 
 - Ability to identify issues and risks with projects which may impact delivery timelines; and cognizance to escalate issues with vendors/management as required. 
 - Good to know performance testing tool like loadrunner , jmeter
 - Extremely organized, excellent oral and written communication skills, particularly in documenting system architectures and workflows

You may be assessed on the key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen strategic thinking and digital and technology, as well as job-specific technical skills. 

The location of the role is Pune.

To design, develop, and execute testing strategies to validate functionality, performance, and user experience, while collaborating with cross-functional teams to identify and resolve defects, and continuously improve testing processes and methodologies, to ensure software quality and reliability. 

Accountabilities

data.title: Senior Automation Engineer - Assistant Vice President
data.description:
About The Role

We are seeking a highly skilled and hands-on QA Engineer to drive modern quality engineering practices within our teams. You will be instrumental in ensuring the highest software quality by leveraging test automation, TDD, BDD, trunk-based development, security testing, and modern ways of working. 

This role requires deep technical expertise in automation frameworks, system design for testing, and vulnerability assessment to build reliable, scalable, and secure applications. 

Key Responsibilities

Quality Engineering & Automation

- Design and implement automated test strategies for functional, integration, performance, and security testing. 
 - Drive test-first development approaches such as TDD (Test-Driven Development) and BDD (Behavior-Driven Development). 
 - Develop and maintain high-quality automated test scripts using modern testing frameworks (e. g. , Selenium, Cypress). 
 - Develop and execute comprehensive test plans, test cases, and test scripts to ensure product quality and reliability. 
 - Ensure unit, API, and end-to-end test coverage to maintain product reliability. 
 - Integrate automated tests within CI/CD pipelines for continuous validation. 

Engineering Excellence & Best Practices

- Champion trunk-based development, ensuring testing is embedded throughout the development lifecycle. 
 - Collaborate closely with developers to conduct code reviews with a focus on testability, security, and performance. 
 - Perform vulnerability assessments and implement security testing best practices. 
 - Enhance observability by integrating real-time monitoring, logging, and reporting into the QA process. 

Technical Leadership & Collaboration

- Partner with software engineers, architects, and product teams to design scalable, testable, and resilient systems. 
 - Mentor junior QA engineers, fostering a culture of continuous learning and quality-first mindset. 
 - Work closely with DevOps teams to optimize automated test execution in cloud environments. 
 - Define and implement modern ways of working, driving innovation in testing methodologies. 

Skills And Qualifications

Must-Have Skills: 

- Strong hands-on experience in test automation using tools like Selenium, Cypress, Playwright, or similar. 
 - Proficiency in building robust test frameworks. 
 - Deep understanding of system design for scalable test automation. 
 - Expertise in TDD, BDD, and test automation best practices. 
 - Experience in trunk-based development and continuous testing within CI/CD pipelines. 
 - Strong knowledge of code review practices, security testing, and vulnerability scanning. 
 - Familiarity with performance, load, and stress testing tools like JMeter. 
 - Experience with cloud-based testing environments (AWS, Kubernetes). 

Good-to-Have Skills: 

- Experience with contract testing (PACT) in microservices architecture. 
 - Knowledge of containerization (Docker, Kubernetes) for testing environments. 
 - Exposure to shift-left testing strategies.

Title: Test Automation Engineer- Husky (India) Guindy, Chennai-Immediate joiners only

Type: FullTime

At Husky TechnologiesTM, our success is based on your success. Our ability to keep our customers in the lead is based on building the strongest team possible. 

Husky TechnologiesTM has a strong foundation built on innovation, close customer relationships and a unique culture and values. We are dedicated to offering our customers the highest quality products and services and are looking for people with the inspiration and talent to develop with us as we pursue our ambitious growth strategy. We are a leader in developing state-of-the-art technology and it is this technology base that uniquely positions us to serve customers who seek differentiation through solutions that provide speed, flexibility and maximum productivity. This capability is at the core of our mission and competitive strategy. 

Husky TechnologiesTM offers a wealth of opportunity for personal growth and development. Most importantly, Husky Technologies TM offers an opportunity to work with - and be challenged by - a team of great people. Our success is possible because of the creativity, intelligence and passion of our people around the world and their desire to lead change. At the same time, we are not afraid to expect a lot and strive for leadership in all of our key markets. We are a company taking on new challenges and for the right people this means exceptional career development opportunities, the chance to be part of a team that is the best in the world at what we do and the experience that comes from working in an environment that demands constant transformation and innovation. 

Husky TechnologiesTM is an exciting company with tremendous potential. We have a great team and great expectations. If you are attracted to bold goals, believe in uncompromising honesty, support mutual respect, care about environmental responsibility, have a passion for excellence and a desire to make a positive contribution - then we want you to join the Husky TechnologiesTM team!

Job Description

As a Test Automation Engineer, you will design and implement automation solutions that validate system behavior across UI, APIs, and integrations. You will contribute to building a robust quality engineering ecosystem by integrating automated testing into CI/CD pipelines and supporting continuous delivery. 

In this role, you will translate requirements into effective test strategies, combining automation with manual, exploratory, and integration testing to ensure comprehensive quality coverage across all application layers. 

This role is ideal for an engineer who enjoys hands-on coding, solving complex validation challenges, and improving system quality at scale, while taking ownership of end-to-end quality outcomes and collaborating closely with cross-functional teams. 

Responsibilities

Automation Development & Framework Ownership

- Design, develop, and own scalable test automation frameworks and reusable components
 - Build automated test suites across: 
 - UI (Web/Mobile)
 - API and integration layers
 - Ensure automation solutions are maintainable, reliable, and extensible across teams

Test Strategy & Implementation

- Translate requirements into automation-ready test scenarios, test data, and validation strategies
 - Contribute to test strategy, coverage planning, and quality goals
 - Identify test gaps and proactively mitigate risks
 - Perform automation feasibility analysis to determine optimal test approach (manual vs automated)

Delivery & Execution Excellence

- Execute a balanced mix of automated and manual tests aligned with sprint goals, ensuring comprehensive validation across functional, integration, and edge-case scenarios. 
 - Contribute to task breakdown, estimation, and sprint commitments
 - Proactively raise risks, blockers, and testability concerns
 - Identify, log, prioritize, and track defects through resolution lifecycle
 - Perform root cause analysis and collaborate with development teams for fixes

Manual & Functional Testing

- Design, document, and execute detailed test cases and test scenarios
 - Perform functional, exploratory, and regression testing across features
 - Validate end-to-end workflows and business scenarios
 - Identify edge cases and usability issues through exploratory testing
 - Ensure test coverage for areas not suitable for automation

Quality, Standards & Engineering Practices

- Write clean, testable, and maintainable automation code
 - Participate in code reviews and continuous improvement of automation frameworks
 - Ensure adherence to Definition of Ready (DoR) and Definition of Done (DoD)
 - Take ownership of end-to-end quality outcomes across assigned areas
 - Follow established DevOps, security, and quality engineering practices

CI/CD & DevOps Integration

- Integrate automation into CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps preferred)
 - Enable continuous testing and shift-left quality practices
 - Monitor and improve pipeline stability, execution time, and reliability
 - Validate and troubleshoot system integrations, data flows, and error handling based on defined architectural designs and interfaces

Non-Functional Testing

- Contribute to performance, reliability, and resilience testing
 - Validate system behavior under load, stress, and failure scenarios

Observability & Debuggability

- Leverage logs, metrics, and traces to improve test reliability
 - Support root cause analysis of failures and improve system observability

Test Data & Environment Management

- Design and manage test data strategies and datasets
 - Ensure availability of stable, production-like test environments

Incident & Operational Support

- Assist in troubleshooting defects across environments
 - Support maintenance and continuous improvement of automation suites
 - Analyze and reduce flaky tests and unstable scenarios

Collaboration & Growth

- Collaborate with developers, QA, Product Owners, and Tech Leads
 - Actively learn and adopt new tools, frameworks, and best practices
 - Contribute to team knowledge sharing and a strong quality culture

Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in computer science, IT, or related field
 - 5+ years of experience in software testing with strong automation focus
 - Experience in designing and implementing test automation frameworks
 - Strong understanding of testing principles, SDLC, STLC, and Agile practices

Technical Skills

- Programming experience in one or more: C#, Java, Python, JavaScript, Swift
 - Experience with automation tools such as Selenium, Katalon, Playwright, Cypress
 - Experience with: 
 - API testing (REST, Postman, etc. )
 - Version control (Git)
 - CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps)
 - Familiarity with: 
 - Test data management
 - Test reporting and logging tools
 - Debugging and root cause analysis
 - Release Management
Assets

- Experience with: 
 - Performance testing tools (JMeter, k6)
 - Security testing (SAST, DAST, SCA)
 - Exposure to: 
 - Cloud platforms (Azure preferred)
 - DevSecOps practices
 - Experience using AI-assisted tools responsibly (e. g. , GitHub Copilot)
Key Expectations

- Drive an automation-first approach (target 60-80% regression automation), while ensuring critical flows and edge cases are validated through manual testing where automation is not feasible or cost-effective. 
 - Own and evolve automation frameworks and quality engineering practices
 - Ensure high reliability, scalability, and stability of automation pipelines
 - Take accountability for quality outcomes, not just test execution
 - Ensure alignment with organizational quality, security, and compliance standards

Why Husky?

- Regulated Working Hours: Enjoy a structured work schedule that promotes a healthy work-life balance, allowing you to excel professionally while maintaining personal well-being. 
 - Visible Impact: Experience the satisfaction of seeing the direct outcomes of your work, as you contribute to projects that visibly enhance our company's technological capabilities and efficiency. 
 - Strategic Influence: Participate in architectural and technical reviews, contributing to the strategic direction of our cloud initiatives and making a tangible impact on our company's technological landscape. 
 - Empowered Involvement: Take an active role in decision-making processes and architectural reviews, where your expertise helps shape the future of our cloud solutions and overall business strategy. 
 - Valued Contributions: Be more than just a number in a large organization; at our company, every individual's input is valued and can lead to significant, tangible improvements in our operations and services. 
 - Impactful Role: Play a crucial part in both developing new applications and maintaining existing systems, ensuring their optimal performance and reliability. 
 - Cutting-Edge Projects: Work on innovative cloud solutions that are transforming our and our customer's business, giving you the opportunity to be at the forefront of technological advancements. 
 - Supportive Community: Work in an environment that recognizes and celebrates individual achievements, fostering a sense of community and mutual respect among team members. 
 - Collaborative Environment: Join a global team of skilled professionals around the globe where your ideas are valued, and collaboration is encouraged to solve complex challenges and drive success. 

Husky TechnologiesTM offers a competitive compensation and benefits package and excellent opportunities for growth and advancement. We are committed to equal employment opportunity and respect, value and welcome diversity in our workplace. Husky TechnologiesTM also values being a great place to work and strives to maintain a safe workplace. Accordingly, Husky TechnologiesTM conditions all offers of employment on satisfactory completion of background checks. No agency or telephone inquiries please.

data.title: Software Engineer II
data.description:
The Software Engineer-II for Ads builds the data, analytics, and product experiences that help Merchants and Brands understand advertising performance and decide where to invest next. This role will strengthen the Ads experience across the customer-facing Brand Experience platform and the internal Merchant Station platform by turning complex advertising data and business logic into clear, actionable insights. 

Ads, together with DART and margin calculators, is a critical input into day-to-day Merchant decisions. The current Ads experience is one of the least-used areas in Brand Experience because it does not yet provide essential data, including keyword-level detail, or a compelling explanation of performance. This engineer will help overhaul that experience, support rapid proofs of concept, and build scalable capabilities that contribute to Merchandising's goal in additional programmatic Brand support across Ads, Promotions, and Pricing Support. 

What Success Looks Like
• Delivers a significantly improved Ads experience in Brand Experience and Merchant Station, increasing engagement with a page that currently has the lowest usage on the platform. 

• Provides Merchants and Brands with accurate, decision-ready advertising data, including keyword-level performance insights. 

• Enables Merchants to audit advertising spend, explain the impact of Project Astra, and present a clear story about Spreetail's advertising strategy and results. 

• Builds actionable recommendations that help Brands understand when and where additional advertising investment can create value. 

• Runs focused proofs of concept quickly, incorporates feedback, and scales successful approaches into reliable product capabilities. 

• Contributes to Merchandising's goal of securing $1 million in additional programmatic Brand support across Ads, Promotions, and Pricing Support. 

• Improves the reliability, clarity, and usability of advertising data across both internal and Brand-facing workflows. 

Key Responsibilities
Design, build, test, and maintain full-stack features for Ads across Brand Experience and Merchant Station. 

• Develop data services and visualizations that show advertising performance, spend, impact, and opportunities for action. 

• Translate advertising strategy, Project Astra outputs, and complex business rules into clear product experiences for Merchants and Brands. 

• Create keyword-level and other detailed views needed to diagnose performance and support investment decisions. 

• Integrate advertising data into existing Merch Tech workflows while maintaining accuracy, freshness, and consistency. 

• Partner with Merchants, Product, Design, Data, and engineering teammates to clarify user needs and prioritize the highest-value capabilities. 

• Develop proofs of concept to test how Ads insights and storytelling can increase Brand engagement and support dollars. 

• Improve deployment workflows so new data, metrics, and product enhancements can reach users faster and more safely. 

• Apply strong engineering practices, including code reviews, automated testing, monitoring, documentation, and maintainable system design. 

• Investigate production issues, resolve data or experience gaps, and continuously improve platform performance and usability. 

Key Metrics You Will Impact  
• Engagement and adoption of Ads capabilities in Brand Experience and Merchant Station. 

• Availability and completeness of decision-critical Ads data, including keyword-level information. 

• Merchant ability to audit advertising spend and communicate advertising performance to Brands. 

• Speed and quality of proofs of concept, experiments, and subsequent production releases. 

• Contribution toward $1 million in additional programmatic Brand support across Ads, Promotions, and Pricing Support. 

• Data accuracy, platform reliability, defect rates, and time to resolve issues. 

• Cycle time for introducing new Ads data, insights, and user actions into the platforms. 

Skills and Experience  

• Strong 3-5 years of full-stack development skills, with experience connecting backend data services to intuitive front-end experiences. 

• Experience developing analytics, reporting, or data-visualization products that help users make decisions. 

• Ability to translate complex business logic and large datasets into accurate, understandable, and actionable product features. 

• Experience working with APIs, data integrations, data quality checks, and modern software delivery practices. 

• Strong understanding of automated testing, code quality, monitoring, and maintainable system design. 

• Comfort working in ambiguity, testing ideas quickly, learning from users, and iterating toward scalable solutions. 

• Clear communication and effective collaboration with technical and non-technical stakeholders. 

• Experience with e-commerce, pricing, promotions, or merchant-facing platforms is preferred.
