data.title: Robot programmer
data.description:
TechnipFMC is committed to driving real change in the energy industry. Our ambition is to build a sustainable future through relentless innovation and global collaboration - and we want you to be part of it. You'll be joining a culture that values curiosity, expertise, and ideas as well as equal opportunities, inclusion, and authenticity. Bring your unique energy to our team of more than 21, 000 people worldwide, and discover a rewarding, fulfilling, and varied career that you can take in anywhere you want to go. 

Position Summary

Experienced Robot Programmer to develop, optimize, troubleshoot, and support KUKA and FANUC robotic systems used in advanced manufacturing operations. 

This is a remote role, with the majority of programming, simulation, troubleshooting, and process development performed using digital manufacturing and offline programming tools. The position may require international travel for up to approximately 20% of working time to support manufacturing plants with process development, commissioning, prove-out, optimization, troubleshooting, and production ramp-up. 

The successful candidate will work closely with Manufacturing Engineering, CNC Programming, Automation and Controls, Maintenance, Production, Quality, equipment suppliers, and system integrators to deliver reliable, standardized, and production-ready robotic processes. 

Key Responsibilities

Develop, modify, troubleshoot, and optimize programs for KUKA and FANUC industrial robots. 

Develop robotic applications for automated deburring cells, CNC machine automation, component/material handling, and automated production processes. 

Perform robot programming, simulation, testing, and validation offline wherever practical before deployment to production equipment. 

Use Visual Components and robot-specific programming/simulation environments to develop and validate robotic processes. 

Use Siemens Teamcenter, JT2Go, and Siemens NX CAD/CAM to work with engineering data, 3D models, manufacturing layouts, tooling, fixtures, and equipment configurations. 

Develop and validate robot paths, reach, accessibility, tool orientation, clearances, collision conditions, and automated sequences. 

Troubleshoot robot programs, alarms, I/O, PLC handshakes, interlocks, communication, sequencing, and machine-interface issues. 

Integrate robots with CNC machine tools, PLCs, pallet systems, grippers, fixtures, sensors, vision systems, and automation equipment. 

Optimize robot movements and sequences to improve safety, quality, cycle time, equipment utilization, reliability, and productivity. 

Develop standardized, maintainable robot programs with robust fault handling and recovery routines. Maintain program backups, revision control, documentation, and change traceability. 

Provide remote technical support and support commissioning, process qualification, manufacturing readiness, and production ramp-up. 

Capture lessons learned and incorporate improvements into standard programs and future applications. 

Required Qualifications

Degree, diploma, or equivalent technical experience in Robotics, Automation, Mechatronics, Electrical Engineering, Controls Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, or related field. 

6+ years of relevant experience. 

Strong practical experience programming industrial robotic systems. 

Experience programming and troubleshooting primarily KUKA and secondarily FANUC robots and control systems. 

Working knowledge of KUKA KRL and FANUC robot programming. 

Experience with offline robot programming and simulation. 

Visual Components: Must have. 

Working knowledge of Siemens Teamcenter, JT2Go, and Siemens NX CAD/CAM. 

Strong understanding of robot coordinate systems, tooling, frames, motion programming, I/O, PLC interfaces, interlocks, and automated sequences. 

Experience integrating robots with PLC-controlled manufacturing equipment. 

Ability to understand 3D CAD models, manufacturing layouts, tooling, fixtures, and robotic-cell configurations. 

Strong troubleshooting, problem-solving, remote-support, and communication skills. 

Willingness and ability to travel internationally for up to approximately 20% of working time. 

Preferred Experience

Robotic CNC machine tending and automated machining operations. High-mix, low-volume, complex, tight-tolerance, or high-value manufacturing. 

KUKA and FANUC offline programming/simulation environments. 

Siemens PLC-controlled automation and PROFINET. 

Robotic grippers, end-of-arm tooling, automated pallet handling, vision systems, and material handling. SAT, commissioning, and production ramp-up. 

Robot and machinery safety principles. Structured problem-solving methods such as 8D, 5-Why, or DMAIC. 

Key Behaviours

Technical Ownership: Takes responsibility from initial diagnosis through implementation and verification. 

Digital Manufacturing Mindset: Uses CAD, simulation, offline programming, and controlled engineering data before deployment wherever practical. 

Bias for Action: Responds quickly to production issues and moves solutions into implementation. 

Programming Discipline: Develops standardized, maintainable, documented, and robust robot programs. 

Practical Problem Solving: Uses robot data, engineering models, simulation, diagnostics, and onsite feedback to resolve root causes. 

Collaboration: Works effectively across manufacturing sites, engineering teams, OEMs, and system integrators. 

Continuous Improvement: Improves robot reliability, cycle time, process stability, standardization, and productivity. 

What Success Looks Like

A successful Robot Programmer can take a robotic application from engineering data and digital concept through offline programming, simulation, onsite prove-out, optimization, and stable production operation. 

The role is remote-first, not remote-only. Most development should be completed digitally and offline, with onsite time focused on activities where direct access to manufacturing equipment adds value. 

Understand the requirement. Develop digitally. Program and simulate offline. Validate. Deploy onsite when required. Prove out. Optimize. Standardize. Support production. 

Being a global leader in the energy industry requires an inclusive and diverse environment. TechnipFMC promotes diversity, equity, and inclusion by ensuring equal opportunities to all ages, races, ethnicities, religions, sexual orientations, gender expressions, disabilities, or all other pluralities. ELLKAY started out providing connectivity solutions to laboratories and within a few years, grew to also provide data management solutions to ambulatory organizations. ELLKAY's solutions continue to serve laboratories and ambulatory practices and have expanded to empower hospitals and health systems, healthcare IT vendors, ambulatory practices, health plans, and other healthcare organizations with cutting-edge technologies and solutions that drive their growth and interoperability strategies. 

Today, ELLKAY remains true to our core values, building strong partner relationships and offering unparalleled service and support while providing innovative, scalable solutions to the challenges our customers face in today's data-rich world. 

ELLKAY's experience, customer-focused approach, and reputation for innovation, speed, and accuracy differentiate ELLKAY as a premier partner for your interoperability needs and data management strategy. 

Job Description

Develop, execute, and maintain automated tests for healthcare data pipelines, integrations, transformations, and reporting outputs. Use SQL and Python to validate data mappings, reconcile source and target records, and identify missing, duplicate, inconsistent, or incorrectly transformed data. Work within established frameworks to provide dependable validation evidence and timely feedback on data quality.

Report to the Senior Manager QE Technology and Innovation and receive technical guidance from the Senior Data Quality Engineer and Principal Quality Architect. Collaborate with Data Engineering, product QEs, analysts, and the Healthcare SME to validate assigned data flows against documented business rules. 

Key Responsibilities

Review data requirements, source-to-target mappings, business rules, and acceptance criteria to identify test scenarios and expected results. 

Develop and maintain SQL- and Python-based automated checks using approved data-testing frameworks and reusable utilities. 

Validate data completeness, accuracy, consistency, timeliness, uniqueness, and referential integrity across assigned datasets. 

Reconcile source and target records, counts, totals, and key attributes across ingestion, transformation, and reporting layers. 

Test batch and incremental loads, schema changes, error handling, retries, and recovery scenarios under senior technical guidance. 

Prepare approved synthetic or masked datasets and follow access, privacy, and sensitive healthcare data-handling procedures. 

Execute data regression tests within CI/CD pipelines, analyze failures, and maintain clear validation results and test evidence. 

Document reproducible data defects, collaborate with Data Engineers on investigation, and verify fixes and affected downstream outputs. 

Use approved AI tools to assist with SQL, Python, test scenarios, and failure analysis while validating generated outputs and protecting sensitive data. 

Maintain existing data-quality checks and alerts, contribute to code reviews, and add regression coverage for assigned production data issues. 

Page

Experience And Qualifications

3+ years in software testing, quality engineering, or data validation, including 2+ years of hands-on ETL/ELT or database testing and SQL-based validation. Experience may overlap. 

Required Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, information systems, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. 

3+ years of relevant testing or data-validation experience, including 2+ years validating data pipelines, transformations, or databases. 

Hands-on SQL skills, including joins, aggregations, subqueries, and reconciliation queries across related datasets. 

Working Python skills for automated data checks, test execution, result comparison, and debugging. 

Understanding of ETL/ELT, relational data models, source-to-target mappings, data-quality dimensions, and batch or incremental processing. 

Experience using Git, defect-tracking tools, and automated testing practices; familiarity with CI/CD workflows. 

Ability to explain data discrepancies, produce reproducible evidence, collaborate with engineers, and handle confidential information responsibly. 

Preferred Qualifications

Healthcare data experience involving clinical, laboratory, patient, provider, claims, eligibility, or other relevant workflows. 

Exposure to a cloud data platform such as Databricks, Snowflake, Azure, AWS, or GCP and frameworks such as pytest, dbt tests, or Great Expectations. 

Familiarity with API or file-based integrations, HL7/FHIR where relevant, and approved AI coding or testing assistants. 

Success measures

Reliable automated coverage of assigned critical data rules and reconciliation controls, with timely completion of planned validation work. 

Clear, reproducible evidence for data defects and dependable verification of fixes and regression outcomes. 

Reduced manual reconciliation effort and growing independence in SQL, Python, data testing, and failure investigation. 

Working expectations

Collaborate with India engineering teams and U. S. stakeholders with agreed working-hour overlap. Follow shared testing standards and approved data-access policies, and support release validation and production data investigations under senior guidance.

At ELLKAY, we are committed to operating as a hybrid workplace, offering employees flexibility in how they structure their time between in-office and remote work. We recognize the significance of fostering connections, collaboration, and creativity within our office culture and its positive impact on our business. Our philosophy of operating as a hybrid workplace underscores our dedication to enabling employees to tailor work-life balance to their individual preferences. data.title: Forward Deployed AI / ML Engineer
data.description:
Forward Deployed AI / ML Engineer - Evaluations (Product + Engineering)

Website: ai. joshtalks. com and voicearena. com

Location: Gurugram

About us

Josh Talks AI builds and licenses audio datasets to leading AI labs. We've been deliberately quiet for the last year and just built. The product has earned the right to be expanded; we are now hiring the people who will own what gets built next. 

About the role

This is an Evaluations PM + Engineer role. You will own how we measure the quality of our speech, voice, and image data, and of our customers' models: ASR, TTS, speech-to-speech (S2S), and voice agents. You will define what "good" means for each dataset and model, build and run the evaluations yourself, and turn the results into clear decisions for the product, research, and business teams. 

You don't hand evaluations off. You plan them, run them end to end, and own the outcome. 

What you'll do

Evaluation product ownership

- Own the evaluation roadmap across ASR, TTS, S2S, and voice-agent models. 
 - Work with research, product, and business teams to understand use cases and define what quality means for each one. 
 - Turn quality goals into clear evaluation plans: test sets, metrics, pass/fail thresholds, and timelines. 
 - Prioritise which models, languages, and use cases to evaluate first, based on impact. 
 - Share results through clear reports and dashboards, and make go/no-go recommendations on model releases. 
 - Track model quality over time and flag regressions early. 

Hands-on evaluation (done by you)

- Run end-to-end evaluations of ASR, TTS, S2S, and voice-agent models yourself. 
 - Set up and run open-source and in-house models locally and on cloud GPUs for inference. 
 - Integrate and run models from different vendors and customers through their APIs (batch and streaming), and compare them fairly. 
 - Manage cloud GPU instances (GCP/AWS/Azure) to run large-scale evaluation and inference jobs efficiently. 
 - Build and curate evaluation datasets, including multilingual, Indian-language, noisy, and real-world audio. 
 - Design and run human evaluations: listening tests, rating guidelines, annotator training, and agreement checks. 
 - Write reproducible evaluation pipelines in Python and automate recurring benchmarks. 
 - Analyse errors to find failure patterns and feed them back to the research and data teams. 
 - Benchmark in-house models against third-party and open-source models. 

What we're looking for

Skills

- Hands-on evaluation of ASR, TTS, S2S, or voice/LLM agent models. 
 - Strong Python, with Pandas/NumPy, Hugging Face, and audio libraries (librosa, torchaudio). 
 - Running ML model inference (PyTorch / Hugging Face) on GPUs. 
 - Working with third-party model APIs (REST, WebSocket/streaming). 
 - Cloud platforms (GCP, AWS, or Azure), including GPU instances. 
 - Evaluation metrics, test-set design, and statistical significance. 
 - Designing human evaluation studies and rating guidelines. 
 - Clear written and verbal communication, and explaining results to technical and non-technical people. 
 - Strong ownership, and the ability to work independently in a fast-moving team. 

Nice to have

- Experience fine-tuning speech models (ASR, TTS, or S2S). 
 - Experience with Indian languages, code-mixed, or low-resource speech data. 
 - Familiarity with Whisper, NeMo, pyannote, ESPnet, or commercial speech APIs. 
 - Experience evaluating LLMs or voice agents (ASR → LLM → TTS pipelines). 
 - Experience building evaluation dashboards or automated regression testing. 

Why join us

- Own how quality is defined and measured for speech AI used at scale. 
 - Work closely with research and product, and directly shape which models ship. 
 - High ownership and real impact from day one.

Description

We are seeking a Software Development Manager to lead the One EU Listing initiative, a transformative program that fundamentally redefines how product selection enters the European catalog. Today, a single item exists as up to 10 fragmented entities across EU marketplaces. One EU Listing inverts this model: one EU ASIN with 10 language variants, born as an EU-wide entity from inception and available across all eligible marketplaces from Day 1, with no expansion step required. This role will drive the end-to-end strategy and execution for One EU Listing program, and the SDM III will build Amazon first experience where sellers provide their catalog in one language and our platform automatically fans out locale-appropriate listings across EU10 simultaneously. This will involve building and scaling an architecture capable of providing real time processing of multi-country listing requests, building bespoke capabilities like multi-countries attribute modeling, processing, image generation, real time compliance checks and resolution, language translation etc. All of this will be built with GenAI as the core pillar, providing large scale processing and automation of seller's inputs, with the north star goal of having 1 click EU wide listings workflows. The SDM III will play the role of a technology leader, coordinating across multiple engineering teams, product managers, compliance, and seller experience stakeholders to eliminate cross-listing friction and unlock the massive EU selection opportunity, with 90% of Buyable ASINs being Pan-EU eligible, the opportunity is significant, yet only 15-50% of the 25MM available ASINs exist across EU5/EU10 today.

data.title: Sr. Post Silicon Validation Engineer
data.description:
Job Title: Post-Silicon Validation Engineer

---

Job Summary: 

We are seeking a detail-oriented and technically strong Post-Silicon Validation Engineer to join our hardware engineering team. This role involves validating and debugging complex SoCs or mixed-signal ICs after silicon manufacturing. You will work closely with design, verification, DFT, and test teams to ensure product performance, functionality, and compliance with specifications through lab-based testing and analysis. 

---

Roles & Responsibilities: 

· Develop and execute post-silicon validation plans for analog, digital, and mixed-signal IPs and SoCs. 

· Design and automate test setups for functionality, performance, and stress testing. 

· Use lab equipment (oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, spectrum analyzers, etc. ) for signal integrity, timing, and power measurements. 

· Debug silicon issues by analyzing waveforms, logs, and failure patterns, and provide root cause analysis. 

· Collaborate with design and verification teams to drive bug resolution and silicon fixes (ECOs). 

· Write Python/MATLAB/LabVIEW-based automation scripts to improve validation efficiency. 

· Document test cases, procedures, results, and validation reports for internal and customer use. 

· Perform silicon characterization across process, voltage, and temperature (PVT) corners. 

· Support bring-up and system integration activities involving FPGA platforms or evaluation boards. 

· Participate in customer debug and yield improvement efforts when required. 

· Support pre-tapeout activities such as validation readiness reviews, DFT strategy, and board planning. 

---

Education and Experience Required: 

· Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electronics/Electrical Engineering, or equivalent. 

· 2-6 years of hands-on experience in post-silicon validation, RF testing, or mixed-signal test development. 

· Prior exposure to ASIC/SoC design validation, board bring-up, or silicon characterization is highly desirable. 

---

Competencies Description: 

· Strong understanding of digital/analog/mixed-signal circuit behavior. 

· Proficient in using lab equipment (e. g. , oscilloscopes, VNAs, AWGs, signal generators, spectrum analyzers). 

· Proficient in scripting languages such as Python, MATLAB, TCL, or C for lab automation. 

· Familiarity with communication protocols (I2C, SPI, UART, PCIe, MIPI, etc. ). 

· Knowledge of RTL design (Verilog/VHDL) and FPGA prototyping/debug is a plus. 

· Analytical and structured problem-solving skills with attention to detail. 

· Good communication skills and ability to work in cross-functional, multi-site teams. 

---

Must-Have Skills: 

· Solid understanding of analog/mixed-signal IPs: RFIC, ADC, DAC, PLL, Oscillators, Voltage Regulators, Temperature Sensors. 

· Post-silicon validation and debugging experience on real silicon or evaluation boards. 

· Experience with PVT testing, statistical analysis, and corner case validation. 

· Proficiency in lab instruments: Oscilloscope, Logic Analyzer, Spectrum Analyzer, Network Analyzer, Signal Generator, Power Supply, DMM. 

· Strong automation skills using Python, MATLAB, or equivalent. 

· Solid knowledge of SoC/ASIC architecture, clocks, resets, and power domains. 

· Hands-on experience with bench-level testing, PCB schematics, and soldering/debugging. 

· Exposure to signal processing, RF, or high-speed serial interfaces is a strong advantage. 

· Good grasp of semiconductor fundamentals, signal integrity, power analysis, and board-level validation

Job Title: Senior Engineer, AVP

Location: Pune, India

Role Description

- Corporate Banking is a technology centric business, with an increasing move to real-time processing, an increasing appetite from customers for integrated systems and access to supporting data. This means that technology is more important than ever for business. 
 - Deutsche Bank is one of the few banks with the scale and network to compete aggressively in this space, and the breadth of investment in this area is unmatched by our peers. Joining the team is a unique opportunity to help rebuild the core of some of our most mission critical processing systems from the ground-up. 
 - Our Corporate Bank Technology team is a global team across 30 countries. The primary businesses that we support within Corporate Bank are Cash Management, Securities Services, Trade Finance and Trust & Agency Services. CB Technology supports these businesses through 'vertical' CIO aligned teams and by 'horizontals' such as Client Connectivity, Surveillance and Regulatory, Infrastructure, Architecture, Production, and Risk & Control. 

What We'll Offer You

As part of our flexible scheme, here are just some of the benefits that you'll enjoy

- Best in class leave policy
 - Gender neutral parental leaves
 - 100% reimbursement under childcare assistance benefit (gender neutral)
 - Sponsorship for Industry relevant certifications and education
 - Employee Assistance Program for you and your family members
 - Comprehensive Hospitalization Insurance for you and your dependents
 - Accident and Term life Insurance
 - Complementary Health screening for 35 yrs. and above

Your Key Responsibilities

As a Senior Engineer in the Channel Security team, you will be a core individual contributor responsible for the hands-on development of our mission-critical platform. You will focus on writing high-quality, scalable code for the backend services that power our real-time channel security capabilities. You will work closely with the Lead Engineer to build, test, and deploy a resilient and performant system. 

Key Responsibilities

- Design, develop, test, and deploy high-quality, scalable backend microservices for the Channel Security platform using Java, Spring Boot, Kafka, and related technologies. 
 - Partner with the Lead Engineer on solution design and participate actively in code reviews to ensure alignment with architectural principles and maintain high code quality standards.

 - Contribute to the operational health of the platform by participating in troubleshooting, and incident resolution as part of our "you build it, you run it" culture. 
 - Collaborate with the DevOps engineer to ensure services are observable, easy to deploy, and meet non-functional requirements for performance and reliability. 

Your Skills And Experience

- Strong, hands-on backend programming experience with the modern Java ecosystem (Java 17+, Spring Boot). 
 - Overall experience of 9-14 years in software engineering, with a strong focus on building robust, scalable backend systems. 
 - Hands-on Experience using AI coding assistants such as GitHub Copilot, or experimenting with LLMs/AI APIs to improve engineering productivity, testing, troubleshooting, or automation
 - Solid understanding of microservices architecture, RESTful APIs, and distributed systems principles. 
 - Practical experience with event-driven architecture and messaging systems, specifically Kafka. 
 - Experience with relational databases (PostgreSQL) and an understanding of in-memory data stores/caches (Redis). 
 - A strong commitment to quality with hands-on experience in writing various levels of automated tests (unit, integration, E2E, BDD). 
 - Experience working in a cloud-native environment (GCP preferred) and familiarity with containerization (Docker, Kubernetes). 
 - Working knowledge of Git, CI/CD pipelines, and agile development methodologies. 
 - Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to debug complex issues across multiple services. 
 - A collaborative mindset with strong communication skills and the ability to work effectively within a lean, focused engineering team. 

Proven ability to leverage AI tools to enhance productivity, optimise workflows to solve business problems, while applying critical judgment to ensure responsible and ethical use of data and AI outputs. 

How We'll Support You

- Training and development to help you excel in your career
 - Coaching and support from experts in your team
 - A culture of continuous learning to aid progression
 - A range of flexible benefits that you can tailor to suit your needs

About Us And Our Teams

https: //www. db. com/company/company. html

About The Role

We're building an enterprise ERP system from scratch where AI isn't a feature-it's the foundation. 

Join Deltek's Engineering and Technology team to create the first truly AI-native SMB ERP. Users will chat with their system instead of clicking through forms. Intelligent agents will handle routine tasks autonomously. And you'll use AI to write better code faster. 

This is a greenfield project. No legacy constraints. No technical debt. Just the opportunity to reimagine what enterprise software can be when designed for AI from day one. 

As a principal engineer, you'll solve the hardest technical problems, create reference implementations that set the standard, and mentor engineers in a development paradigm that's still emerging. You'll prove that AI-native enterprise software isn't just possible-it's superior. 

Key Responsibilities

- Implement the most technically challenging features of the AI-powered ERP platform, serving as the go-to expert for complex integration and performance challenges
 - Develop reference implementations and coding patterns that other engineers follow when building AI-enhanced features
 - Implement sophisticated prompt engineering and LLM integration solutions, ensuring security, performance, and cost-effectiveness
 - Build production-ready ML integration code utilizing infrastructure provided by the dedicated AI/ML infrastructure team
 - Provide deep technical expertise on critical implementation challenges affecting multiple teams, offering solutions based on extensive hands-on experience
 - Collaborate with architects to validate technical approaches through proof-of-concepts and prototypes
 - Champion code quality, comprehensive testing, security best practices, and operational excellence
 - Identify and resolve complex technical debt that impacts multiple teams
 - Serve as technical advisor to architects and engineering leadership on implementation feasibility and development best practices

data.title: Software Engineer II
data.description:
About Kaseya

Kaseya is the leading provider of AI-powered IT management and cybersecurity software, serving Managed Service Providers (MSPs) and internal IT organizations worldwide. Our comprehensive platform helps organizations efficiently manage, secure, and automate their IT environments, driving operational efficiency and long-term business success. 

Backed by Insight Partners, a leading global software investor, Kaseya has experienced sustained double-digit growth and continues to expand its global footprint. Today, Kaseya supports customers in more than 20 countries and manages over 15 million endpoints worldwide. 

Founded in 2000, Kaseya was built by builders - and we're still building. We look for people who create rather than wait, who see a hard problem and lean in, and who treat challenges as raw material. At Kaseya, everyone plays a role in shaping the future of IT: whether you're in engineering, product, sales, marketing, customer support, or operations, your work helps protect, defend, and optimize IT environments across the globe. 

We're building teams that grow, perform, and make an impact. If you're driven by the itch to make things better - a product, a process, a career - you'll fit right in. 

At Kaseya, we don't just raise the bar. We build it. 

Why Kaseya?

Join a fast-growing company transforming the IT management and cybersecurity industry. At Kaseya, we are modernizing how software is designed, built, tested, and operated-combining strong engineering fundamentals with AI-native development practices. 

As a Senior Staff Engineer, you will have the opportunity to shape not only our technology architecture, but also how engineering teams leverage AI to build high-quality software faster and more effectively. 

Join the Kaseya growth rocket ship and see how we are #ChangingLives!

Job Summary

We're hiring a Software Engineer II to provide hands-on technical leadership across our SaaS platforms and shared backend services. 

This role is for an engineer who combines deep expertise in Java, distributed systems, cloud architecture, and software design with a modern, AI-native approach to software engineering. 

You will lead complex initiatives across multiple teams, influence architecture and engineering standards, and remain deeply involved in implementation. You will also help define how engineering teams effectively use AI coding tools, including Claude Code, throughout the software development lifecycle-from understanding existing systems and designing solutions to implementation, testing, debugging, code review, documentation, and modernization. 

This is not a purely architectural role. We are looking for a technical leader who designs, codes, prototypes, reviews, mentors, and leads by example. 

Roles & Responsibilities

- Define and drive architecture for Java-based platform services, distributed systems, APIs, and event-driven applications across multiple product areas 
 - Lead complex technical initiatives spanning multiple engineering teams, services, and business domains 
 - Remain highly hands-on through architecture, prototyping, implementation of critical components, code reviews, debugging, and production troubleshooting 
 - Champion AI-native software engineering practices, using AI coding tools such as Claude Code to improve developer productivity, code quality, testing, debugging, documentation, and system understanding 
 - Establish effective patterns and guardrails for using AI-generated code in production engineering environments 
 - Help engineering teams evolve from traditional development workflows toward AI-assisted and agentic software development 
 - Identify opportunities where AI can accelerate modernization of legacy systems, test creation, refactoring, migration, and technical debt reduction 
 - Partner with Product, Engineering, Security, and Architecture leaders to translate business priorities into scalable technical solutions 
 - Guide the evolution of cloud-native architectures, microservices, data flows, integrations, and shared platform capabilities 
 - Drive improvements in system performance, availability, observability, security, and operational readiness 
 - Establish engineering standards and reusable patterns for Java development, API design, testing, CI/CD, AI-assisted development, and production operations 
 - Mentor Senior and Staff Engineers through architecture reviews, technical guidance, hands-on collaboration, and modern AI-enabled engineering practices 
 - Evaluate emerging engineering and AI technologies and determine where they can meaningfully improve our products and engineering organization

Required Qualifications

- 4+ years of software engineering experience building production SaaS applications, distributed systems, or enterprise software platforms 
 - 2+ years of experience developing production backend services using Java 
 - Strong hands-on coding skills and the ability to design, implement, review, debug, and operate complex production software 
 - Proven experience providing technical leadership across multiple engineering teams or product areas 
 - Experience designing and operating distributed systems on AWS, Azure, or GCP 
 - Experience leading architecture reviews and establishing engineering standards or practices adopted across multiple teams 
 - Demonstrated experience using AI-assisted coding tools as part of real software engineering workflows 
 - Ability to use AI effectively for code generation, codebase exploration, refactoring, testing, debugging, documentation, and technical problem-solving 
 - Strong understanding of software engineering fundamentals and the ability to critically review, validate, test, and improve AI-generated code 
 - Ability to mentor engineers and influence technical direction without relying solely on organizational authority

Preferred Qualifications

- Hands-on experience with Claude Code or similar agentic AI coding tools 
 - Experience with Java technologies such as Spring Boot, Spring Cloud, Hibernate, Kafka, or similar frameworks 
 - Experience designing cloud-native, microservices-based, or event-driven architectures 
 - Experience with relational databases such as PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQL Server, or Oracle 
 - Experience leading platform modernization, cloud migration, or large-scale re-architecture initiatives 
 - Experience using AI to accelerate modernization of large or legacy codebases 
 - Experience improving reliability, observability, performance, testing, or operational practices across production systems 
 - Experience integrating AI-enabled capabilities, LLMs, agents, or AI services into production software 
 - Experience developing engineering standards, workflows, or guardrails for AI-assisted software development 
 - Familiarity with modern AI engineering concepts such as LLM APIs, tool use, agents, RAG, evaluation, and prompt/context engineering 
 - Experience measuring and improving engineering productivity using AI-enabled development workflows

What Success Looks Like

A successful Senior Staff Engineer at Kaseya does more than design systems. You will: 

- Build: Stay close to the code and deliver critical technical solutions. 
 - Lead: Set technical direction and drive complex initiatives across teams. 
 - Modernize: Improve architecture, engineering practices, and legacy systems. 
 - Amplify: Use AI to increase the effectiveness and velocity of engineering teams. 
 - Mentor: Raise the technical capabilities of engineers around you. 
 - Own: Take responsibility for solutions from architecture and implementation through production operation. 

We are looking for engineers who see AI not as a replacement for engineering fundamentals, but as a powerful multiplier for exceptional engineers. 

Additional Information

Kaseya provides equal employment opportunity to all employees and applicants without regard to race, religion, age, ancestry, gender, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, citizenship status, physical or mental disability, veteran status, marital status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

data.title: Principal Engineer – Design Verification
data.description:
Why join Upscale, Inc. 

Upscale, Inc. , is building the high-performance infrastructure powering the next generation of artificial intelligence. Backed by over $500M in funding and rapid global adoption, we are scaling systems designed for the world's most demanding AI workloads. 

We focus on first-principles engineering across silicon, systems, and networking-where performance, scale, and execution are critical. Our team is talent-dense and high-performing. We value ownership, technical rigor, and speed, and we offer the opportunity to work on foundational problems with immediate, real-world impact. 

If you're looking to do high-impact work, move fast, and help define the infrastructure behind the future of AI-Upscale is where you can produce meaningful work at the frontier-and operate at a high standard. 

We are looking for a highly technical, hands-on Principal DV Engineer to anchor the verification of our next-generation, high-performance networking silicon. In this role, you will be the primary technical driver for complex IPs and critical sub-systems. You will balance advanced architectural environment creation with rigorous execution, leading by example on the engineering floor. This position is ideal for a veteran engineer who loves breaking complex designs, building elite UVM environments, and mentoring the next generation of verification talent. 

Key Responsibilities

- IP & Sub-system Leadership: Own the complete verification lifecycle for critical high-performance networking IPs and large-scale sub-systems. 
 - UVM Environment Architecture: Architect, develop, and maintain advanced, scalable constrained-random verification environments from scratch using System Verilog and UVM. 
 - Test Planning & Execution: Author comprehensive, bulletproof verification plans. Drive test case development, regressions, triage, and coverage closure (functional, code, and assertion-based metrics). 
 - Advanced Debugging: Serve as the team's go-to expert for isolating and resolving the most complex, deep-seated hardware bugs. 
 - Lead by Example: Actively participate in design and verification code reviews. Maintain high standards of code quality, reuse, and documentation within the execution team. 
 - Cross-Functional Alignment: Partner closely with Design and Architecture teams to resolve ambiguities early in the design cycle and ensure high-quality delivery. 

Required Qualifications & Skills

- Experience: 15+ years of solid experience in ASIC/SoC Design Verification with a proven track record of successful tape-outs. 
 - Domain Expertise: Extensive experience in the networking domain, verifying high-throughput, data-intensive designs. 
 - Methodology Expert: Mastery of System Verilog and UVM. Must have a proven history of writing complex testbenches and VIP integrations from scratch. 
 - Verification Scope: Proven experience leading verification at the IP and Sub-system level, with strong exposure to SoC integration. 
 - Education: B Tech/M Tech in Electronics/Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field. 

Preferred / Added Advantages

- Hands-on experience with Formal Property Verification (FPV) to exhaustively verify block-level control logic. 
 - Proficiency in Python or Perl for testbench automation and triage scripting. 

Where you fall within that range depends on your experience, skills, and impact-we benchmark against internal levels to keep things fair and consistent. 

Equal Opportunity

Upscale, Inc. , is building a team that reflects a wide range of perspectives, backgrounds, and experiences. We're proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer and consider all qualified applicants regardless of race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, or veteran status. 

Accessibility & Accommodations

We're committed to making our hiring process accessible to everyone. If you need accommodations at any stage, just reach out to us at hiring@upscaleai. com-we're happy to help. Note: This inbox is only for accommodation requests. 

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

data.description:
Responsibilities

a { text-decoration: none; color: #464feb; } tr th, tr td { border: 1px solid #e6e6e6; } tr th { background-color: #f5f5f5; }

Quality Management & Assurance

- Ensure adherence to quality standards and specifications throughout the solar cell manufacturing process. 
 - Develop, implement, and monitor quality control plans, inspection methodologies, and testing procedures. 
 - Drive in-process quality checks and final product audits to ensure compliance with customer and regulatory requirements. 
 - Lead quality improvement projects to reduce defects, enhance yield, and improve process capability. 

Process Monitoring & Control

- Analyze quality trends, process deviations, and manufacturing parameters to identify improvement opportunities. 
 - Monitor key quality KPIs such as yield, defect density, scrap rates, reliability performance, and customer complaints. 
 - Collaborate with production and process engineering teams to establish robust process controls. 

Defect Analysis & Corrective Actions

- Lead root cause analysis (RCA) for quality failures, product non-conformities, and customer complaints. 
 - Implement CAPA (Corrective and Preventive Actions) to eliminate recurring quality issues. 
 - Utilize quality tools such as 8D, Fishbone Analysis, FMEA, SPC, Six Sigma, and Statistical Analysis techniques. 

Reliability & Product Performance

- Support reliability testing and validation activities to ensure product performance and long-term durability. 
 - Monitor cell efficiency trends and performance metrics to achieve quality and yield targets. 
 - Coordinate failure analysis activities with relevant stakeholders and laboratories. 

Supplier & Incoming Quality Management

- Review incoming material quality and collaborate with suppliers to resolve quality concerns. 
 - Conduct supplier performance assessments and quality improvement initiatives as required. 
 - Ensure compliance of raw materials with defined specifications and standards. 

Audits & Compliance

- Ensure adherence to ISO 9001, ISO 14001, ISO 45001, and other relevant quality management systems. 
 - Participate in internal, external, customer, and certification audits. 
 - Maintain quality documentation, SOPs, process records, and audit readiness. 

Stakeholder Management

- Work closely with Production, Process Engineering, Maintenance, Technology, and Supply Chain teams. 
 - Support product qualification, process transfers, and new technology implementation projects. 
 - Mentor and guide team members on quality standards, best practices, and continuous improvement methodologies. 

Reporting & Continuous Improvement

- Prepare and present quality dashboards, reports, and performance reviews to management. 
 - Lead Kaizen initiatives focused on manufacturing excellence and operational efficiency. 
 - Drive a culture of quality awareness and continuous improvement across the manufacturing organization. 

Qualifications

Educational Qualification

- B. E. /B. Tech in Electrical, Electronics, Chemical, Materials Science, Mechanical Engineering, or related discipline. 
 - M. Tech/MBA in Operations, Quality, or Manufacturing Management will be an added advantage. 

Experience

- Minimum 4-6 years of experience in Solar Cell Manufacturing, Semiconductor, Electronics Manufacturing, or High-Technology Manufacturing industries. 
 - Hands-on experience in solar cell manufacturing processes, defect reduction, yield improvement, and quality management systems.

data.title: High Speed IO Validation Engineer
data.description:
NVIDIA is widely considered to be one of the world's most desirable employers in the technology field. We have some of the most forward-thinking and hardworking people in the world working for us. The NVIDIA Silicon Co-Design Group is seeking a versatile engineer to join our High Speed SERDES IO electrical validation team. Your bench is where silicon meets the signal - where every link train, jitter sweep, eye diagram, and protocol corner gets exercised before the part ships. You drive characterization and debug for IO interconnects across silicon, board, firmware, and driver - designing tests that anticipate rack-scale deployment so marginality surfaces at die-and-board scale, never in a rack. Your decisions show up in link margin, BER, power per lane, and the go/no-go calls that gate samples and production. 

This role focuses on industry-leading high-speed interconnects such as PCIe, USB3, Ethernet, and UFS. You will perform bring-up and electrical validation with a strong emphasis on quality, stability, and efficiency. Additionally, you will leverage AI-assisted workflows, automation, and advanced analytics to enhance validation quality, accelerate root cause analysis, and improve engineering efficiency. This position offers the opportunity to make a significant impact in a dynamic, technology-driven environment influencing product lines that span artificial intelligence, consumer graphics, self-driving cars, and more. 

What You'll Be Doing

- Execute electrical validation for PCIe, Ethernet, USB3, and UFS interfaces for NVIDIA GPUs, CPUs, and SOCs, ensuring adherence to signal integrity standards. 
 - Engage with cross-functional engineering teams to facilitate the design and development process, leveraging your knowledge of firmware/driver interactions and circuit design. 
 - Analyze complex HSIO bugs by applying strong debugging techniques and collaborating with various teams for rapid resolution. 
 - Diagnose issues and validate high-speed interfaces using modern lab equipment, including DSOs and BERT, with expert-level proficiency. 
 - Develop and apply test/debug programs using scripting languages (such as Perl and Python) to perform stress and failure analysis on high-speed interfaces. 
 - Innovate methodologies that leverage AI-assisted workflows and data-driven analytics to enhance debugging efficiency and improve validation quality. 

What We Need To See

- BS or MS in Electronics Engineering (or equivalent experience) with at least 3 years of relevant experience. 
 - Deep high-speed/SERDES electrical validation and tuning experience, with strong SI and PI fundamentals - S-parameters, eye diagrams, channel margin, crosstalk, return loss, PDN noise, jitter decomposition - and validation experience across silicon and platform boundaries (CoWoS/interposer/substrate, board), translating rack-environment effects into silicon/board characterization. 
 - Expert-level proficiency in electrical validation of PCIe (or similar) protocols, hands-on with lab equipment (DSOs, BERT, protocol analyzers), and scripting skills (Perl, Python) for developing test/debug programs. 
 - Proven experience in building AI solutions specifically in the context of electrical and silicon validation, including designing and implementing AI-assisted workflows and automation frameworks to enhance engineering productivity and validation quality. 

If you are energized by challenging problems, real ownership, deep work, and AI-enabled engineering at scale, we'd love to talk to you. 

, , JR2025319

data.title: Principal Mobile Engineer
data.description:
About Payoneer

Founded in 2005, Payoneer is the global financial platform that removes friction from doing business across borders, with a mission to connect the world's underserved businesses to a rising global economy. We're a community with over 2, 500 colleagues all over the world, working to serve customers, and partners in over 190 countries and territories. 

By taking the complexity out of the financial workflows-including everything from global payments and compliance to multi-currency and workforce management, to providing working capital and business intelligence-we give businesses the tools they need to work efficiently worldwide and grow with confidence. 

Principal Mobile Engineer

AI-Native Cloud Platform

Team: Mobile Platform Team

Reports to: Sr. Director of R&D, Cloud Platform

Location: [Gurgaon / Hybrid]

About The Role

Payoneer is investing in the next generation of its mobile application: lightweight, high-performance, and designed as a platform that lets product teams contribute features independently while the app remains coherent, fast, and stable as a whole. The host application will provide the common foundations - observability, logging, navigation, identity, networking, feature flags, release tooling, automation - and product teams will plug into it through a clear contribution model. 

We are hiring two Principal Mobile Engineers to define and build this foundation alongside the existing mobile team. Together you will own the tech stack decision - native iOS and Android, Flutter, React Native or a hybrid - and you will shape the platform every product team at Payoneer ships mobile features on top of. The two-Principal structure gives us the capacity to build the platform properly, and the optionality to specialize one Principal per native platform if we go that route. 

What You'll Own

You will own the tech stack decision and the rationale behind it. You will run the evaluation - native (Swift / Kotlin) vs Flutter vs React Native vs hybrid - against real constraints: performance, binary size, hiring market, team contribution model, build and release velocity, long-term maintenance cost. You will make the call jointly with your peer Principal and you will be expected to defend it under scrutiny from engineering, product, and executive leadership. 

You will build the host application foundation. The architecture, the module boundaries, the navigation and lifecycle model, the dependency injection approach, the state management patterns, the threading and concurrency model, the network stack, the persistence layer, the observability and logging backbone, the release and rollout machinery, the testing strategy at every level of the pyramid. Every product team's first impression of mobile at Payoneer will be the abstractions you ship. 

You will define the contribution model that product teams use to deliver features into the host app. Module boundaries, public API surface, lifecycle hooks, dependency policy, build and integration patterns, version compatibility, and the developer experience that makes contributing a feature fast and contributing a bad one hard. You will own the standards every contributing team writes against. 

You will own performance, binary size, startup time, frame rate, memory, and battery as first-class engineering disciplines with measured budgets and gates. You will own crash-free rate and stability as platform commitments. You will own the CI/CD, signing, release, and rollout pipeline for the app, and the observability that makes a production issue debuggable in minutes rather than days. 

You will partner with the Application Foundations Crew and the Cloud Platform Base, DevEx, and Network and Security teams to make sure mobile integrates cleanly with the platform - APIs, events, identity, secrets, automation and the shift-left controls that apply on the mobile side as much as the server side. You will partner with product engineering across the company to bring contributing teams into the platform and keep them productive in it. 

What We're Looking For

You have ten or more years of mobile engineering experience and you have built mobile applications from the ground up - not joined them, not iterated on them, but defined the foundation and shipped it to production at scale. You have an honest, scarred view of what mobile platform decisions cost three years after you make them. 

You are deeply expert in at least one of iOS or Android, and seriously fluent in the other. On iOS that means Swift, the Swift concurrency model, UIKit and SwiftUI, the Apple toolchain and release process, and the parts of the ecosystem most engineers learn the hard way. On Android that means Kotlin, coroutines and Flow, the Android lifecycle, Jetpack and Compose, Gradle in earnest, RxJava where it still lives, and the same hard-won understanding of the ecosystem. 

You understand the cross-platform landscape with the same honesty. You have an opinion on Flutter, KMP, and React Native that goes beyond preference - performance characteristics, ceiling, where each shines, where each fails - and you can defend the recommendation you would make for a fintech app at Payoneer's scale. 

You have built and operated a modular mobile platform before, or something close enough that you understand the trade-offs: how to define module boundaries that survive ten product teams contributing in parallel, how to keep the host app coherent when contributors disagree, how to version a contribution model without breaking everyone, and how to keep the binary lean as the surface grows. 

You think in budgets and measurements. You have driven startup time, frame rate, binary size, and crash-free rate as numbers on a dashboard. You understand mobile observability at a level beyond crash reporting, and you have shipped the instrumentation needed to debug productio. 

You communicate clearly with engineers, product partners, and executives. You can write a one-page architecture proposal, run an RFC that actually converges, demo what you built so other engineers want to use it, and explain a stack decision to a CPO in language they care about. You handle disagreement well - including with your peer Principal - and you know how to land a joint decision. 

Nice to have

Experience integrating AI capabilities into mobile applications - on-device models, conversational and agent UI patterns, latency-sensitive AI features, and the privacy and offline considerations that come with them - is a strong plus, given Payoneer's AI-native platform direction. 

Why this role matters

The mobile app is the surface Payoneer customers touch after Web. The foundation you build will compound for years. You will have unusual scope to define what good looks like for Payoneer, and credibly for the industry, at the point where regulated payments, mobile engineering at scale, and AI-native development converge. 

The Payoneer Ways of Working

Act as our customer's partner on the inside

Learning what they need and creating what will help them go further. 

Do it. Own it. 

Being fearlessly accountable in everything we do. 

Continuously improve

Always striving for a higher standard than our last. 

Build Each Other Up

Helping each other grow, as professionals and people. 

If this sounds like a business, a community, and a mission you want to be part of, apply today. 

We are committed to providing a diverse and inclusive workplace. Payoneer is an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment no matter your race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. If you require reasonable accommodation at any stage of the hiring process, please speak to the recruiter managing the role for any adjustments. Decisions about requests for reasonable accommodation are made on a case-by-case basis.

You'll own end-to-end quality across complex, distributed systems and low-code workflows, establish robust automation strategies, and partner closely with engineering and product to deliver high-quality, compliant releases at speed. 

Responsibilities

- Test Strategy & Ownership
 - Define and execute test strategies for Web, API, and Appium
 - mobile testing of applications across functional, regression, integration, accessibility, and UAT phases. 
 - Translate business/regulatory requirements into clear, testable acceptance criteria and coverage plans. 
 - Automation & Tooling
 - Build and maintain scalable Selenium WebDriver frameworks (Java) with robust page-object design, data-driven tests, and parallel execution. 
 - Design and automate Appium
 - Mobile testing, test scenarios (end-to-end process verification, expression rules, interfaces, working in iOS and Android driven environments). 
 - Prior work with SauceLabs for cloud-based app testing. 
 - Test data generation and management using TestDataManagement and TestDataServices. 
 - Implement CI/CD quality gates in GitLab (pipelines, runners, test reports, artifacts, triggers). 
 - Quality Engineering
 - Create and maintain comprehensive test assets (test plans, test cases, RTMs, test data, environments). 
 - Implement API testing (e. g. , Postman/REST Assured), mocking, and contract tests; contribute to performance test setup where needed. 
 - Drive defect triage with clear reproduction steps, root cause analysis, and risk-based prioritization. 
 - Proven ability to create custom dashboards, test plans, and execution reports within Jira to provide real-time visibility into software quality and testing progress. 
 - Compliance & Risk
 - Ensure test coverage for UK regulatory and product obligations-privacy, security, auditability, records retention, customer outcomes, and accessibility (e. g. , WCAG). 
 - Contribute to audit evidence and change control documentation aligned with UK regulatory expectations. 
 - Collaboration & Leadership
 - Partner with product, developers, business analysts, and compliance to align on release quality criteria. 
 - Mentor peers, uplift QA practices, and advocate for shift-left testing and observability. 

Mandatory skills

- Experience: 8+ years in QA/Quality Engineering with a focus on automation and enterprise-grade delivery. 
 - Web Automation: Advanced Selenium WebDriver skills (preferably Java or Python), solid test design patterns, cross-browser testing, and parallelization. 
 - Mobile Automation: At least 3-4 years' Mobile Automation experience using Appium. 
 - DevOps/CI: Hands-on with GitLab (repositories, branching strategies, merge requests, pipelines, runners, quality gates, test reporting). 
 - Test Management & Integration: Expert in driving QA workflows within Jira, using Xray or Zephyr to design, execute, and track test cases, ensuring seamless traceability between requirements, tests, and defects. 
 - UK Domain: Demonstrable knowledge of UK products and regulations relevant to the domain (e. g. , financial services: FCA/PRA/PSD2/UK GDPR; public sector: assurance, accessibility standards; healthcare: data protection, auditability). 
 - APIs & Data: API testing (REST/GraphQL), Oracle SQL proficiency for test data creation and validation, and environment configuration. 
 - Quality Practices: Risk-based testing, RTM/traceability, defect lifecycle, release readiness, and non-functional awareness (performance, security, accessibility). 
 - Soft Skills: Clear communication, stakeholder management, analytical problem-solving, and mentoring capability. 

Nice to have skills

- Exposure to AI/ML-based systems and their validation approaches. 
 - Hands on experience with TestMaster tool for Avaloq automation. 
 - Experience working with Kiro AI and leveraging it in testing delivery.

data.title: Principal Quality Assurance Engineer
data.description:
Job Title: Principal Quality Assurance Engineer

Deltek is seeking a Principal Quality Assurance Engineer who brings deep ERP and accounting domain expertise to ensure the correctness, reliability, and real-world fidelity of our Startpoint platform. This is not a traditional testing role - the primary value is domain authority, not test execution. You will act as the customer proxy, owning end-to-end correctness of the ERP system and elevating quality thinking across the entire engineering organization. 

The ideal candidate thinks like a real user navigating complex accounting workflows, surfaces issues that engineering wouldn't anticipate, and partners with Product and Engineering as a domain authority who can validate that the system behaves correctly for real-world ERP scenarios. 

If you have a deep background in accounting or ERP systems, can reason across full business workflows, and want to own quality from first principles rather than execute scripts, we invite you to join our team. 

Responsibilities

- Own end-to-end correctness of ERP workflows in Startpoint - from data entry to financial output - ensuring GAAP compliance and real-world fidelity. 
 - Act as the domain authority and customer proxy, validating complex ERP scenarios that go beyond feature behavior: purchase order variations, billing workflows, payroll runs, multi-entity financials. 
 - Identify gaps between specification and reality, feeding actionable improvements back to Product and Engineering. 
 - Evaluate full-flow scenarios - not just UI or API behavior - including dataset correctness, cross-feature interactions, and data migration fidelity. 
 - Serve as the quality catalyst for the team: raise the bar on quality thinking, help level up engineers and testers, and define what "good" looks like for ERP correctness. 
 - Build and maintain a deep knowledge base of system behavior that can evolve into support readiness and product validation authority. 
 - Collaborate with Product Managers, Engineers, and QE leads to define quality requirements grounded in real customer usage patterns and ensure they are consistently met. 
 - Analyze defect trends, patterns, and root causes to identify systemic quality issues and drive improvements across the product. 
 - Analyze fleet usage data to pinpoint future investment opportunities. 

As the recognized global standard for project-based businesses, Deltek delivers software and information solutions to help organizations achieve their purpose. Our market leadership stems from the work of our diverse employees who are united by a passion for learning, growing and making a difference. At Deltek, we take immense pride in creating a balanced, values-driven environment, where every employee feels included and empowered to do their best work. Our employees put our core values into action daily, creating a one-of-a-kind culture that has been recognized globally. Thanks to our incredible team, Deltek has been named one of America's Best Midsize Employers by Forbes, a Best Place to Work by Glassdoor, a Top Workplace by The Washington Post and a Best Place to Work in Asia by World HRD Congress. www. deltek. com

[#video#https: //player. vimeo. com/video/1088518081?h=b4a4b95128&amp%3bbadge=0&amp%3bautopause=0&amp%3bplayer_id=0&amp%3bapp_id=58479{#550, 300#}#/video#]

The Deltek Engineering and Technology team builds best-in-class solutions to delight customers and meet their business needs. We are laser-focused on software design, development, innovation and quality. Our team of experts has the talent, skills and values to deliver products and services that are easy to use, reliable, sustainable and competitive. If you're looking for a safe environment where ideas are welcome, growth is supported and questions are encouraged - consider joining us as we explore the limitless opportunities of the software industry. 

Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field. 
 - Professional accounting qualification (CPA, ACCA, or equivalent) is a strong differentiator. 
 - Relevant certifications in software quality or ERP systems are advantageous. 

Experience: 

- 8+ years of experience working with ERP systems - as a practitioner, implementer, consultant, or quality engineer with deep domain knowledge. 
 - Proven expertise in at least two of: Project Accounting, Financial Accounting, Accounts Payable/Receivable, Payroll, Time & Expense, Purchasing, or Inventory. 
 - Experience validating complex, real-world business scenarios end-to-end - not just feature-level test cases. 
 - Track record of identifying systemic quality gaps and driving improvements at the process and engineering level. 
 - Experience working in Agile/Sprint environments with globally distributed teams. 
 - Prior experience with Ajera, Costpoint, Vantagepoint, or comparable AEC/GovCon ERP systems is highly desirable. 

Technical Qualifications

- Deep understanding of ERP data models, accounting transaction flows, and financial reporting logic. 
 - Ability to write SQL queries for data validation and scenario verification - comfortable working directly with database outputs. 
 - Familiarity with API testing concepts and tools (e. g. , Postman) to validate system integrations. 
 - Ability to interpret and validate data migration results for schema comparison and record fidelity. 
 - Familiarity with AI-assisted testing concepts or willingness to work within an AI-native QE pipeline is a plus. 
 - Basic understanding of version control (Git) and issue tracking (ADO/TFS or equivalent). 

Soft Skills

- Exceptional domain reasoning - can think through a complex accounting scenario from first principles, not just pattern-match to test scripts. 
 - Strong communication skills: able to articulate correctness concerns clearly to engineers, PMs, and leadership. 
 - Customer-zero mindset: naturally simulates real user behavior and surfaces the issues a real customer would encounter. 
 - Proactive and self-directed - identifies what needs validating without being told. 
 - High ownership mentality: comfortable being the sole domain authority on ERP correctness in a fast-moving product team. 
 - Collaborative and constructive: elevates others' quality thinking rather than policing defects. 

Join Deltek and take ownership of what matters most in an ERP platform: that it works correctly for the customers who depend on it every day. You will partner with engineers, product managers, and QE leads to ensure Startpoint meets the standard of a world-class project-based ERP - not just in features shipped, but in real-world correctness validated end-to-end. 

No

Deltek is committed to the protection and promotion of your privacy. In connection with your application for employment with us at Deltek, it is necessary for us to collect, store and use information about you ("Personal Data") to administer and evaluate your application. We are the "controller" of the Personal Data you provide us and will process any such Personal Data in accordance with applicable law and the statements contained in this

Candidate Privacy Notice

Additionally, we have not sold and do not sell Personal Data you provide to us through the job application process. 

Important: Protect Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Bad actors or scammers may try to impersonate Deltek and send fake job offers to people. Messages from Deltek about employment opportunities will be from an @deltek. com account or Enterprise@trm. brassring. com, never from free services like Gmail or Yahoo. Please look carefully at the email address that provides any job offer, as some fake accounts are created to look like a legitimate domain name or email address. We will also never ask you to pay money at any point in the hiring process, whether for training, equipment, background checks, or anything else. If you receive a suspicious offer claiming to be from Deltek, do not share personal or financial information. Report any suspicious communication to Secure@deltek. com and consider reporting it to law enforcement.
