data.title: Senior Enterprise Software Engineer (JD Edwards)
data.description:
Position Overview

We are seeking a highly accomplished, hands-on Senior Lead Operations Manager to join our enterprise technology leadership team. This pivotal role blends deep technical execution with strategic leadership across four core disciplines: JD Edwards EnterpriseOne (JDE E1), IBM Integration technologies, Cloud Architecture, and emerging Artificial Intelligence practices. 

The ideal candidate is not a bystander manager - they roll up their sleeves, architect solutions, and directly contribute to development, configuration, and administration while simultaneously guiding a team of engineers and analysts. You thrive in fast-paced environments, absorb new technologies at exceptional speed, and champion a culture of continuous innovation. 

Key Responsibilities

Operational Leadership & Team Management

- Lead, mentor, and manage a cross-functional team of developers, CNC administrators, integration engineers, and cloud architects. 
 - Define operational KPIs, SLAs, and delivery roadmaps for all enterprise platform areas. 
 - Drive Agile/DevOps delivery practices including sprint planning, backlog grooming, and retrospectives. 
 - Act as escalation point for critical incidents and ensure timely resolution with root-cause analysis. 
 - Partner with business stakeholders, functional analysts, and C-suite to translate business needs into technology solutions. 

JD Edwards EnterpriseOne - Development, Architecture & CNC Administration

- Provide hands-on technical leadership across the complete JDE E1 stack spanning custom development, functional configuration, CNC infrastructure, and Oracle database administration. 
 - Architect and develop JDE customizations using Business Functions (BSFNs), Named Event Rules (NERs), Report Design Aid (RDA), Form Design Aid (FDA), Table Design Aid (TDA), and Data Dictionary extensions. 
 - Design and deploy JDE Orchestrator Framework solutions - building orchestrations, connectors, cross-reference rules, and form requests to automate business workflows and expose JDE services as REST APIs. 
 - Lead User Defined Object (UDO) governance: Composite Pages, Watchlists, Notifications, One View Reports, and EnterpriseOne Pages configuration and lifecycle management. 
 - Architect and implement JDE integrations via Business Function calls, Interoperability (XML/Z-files), RESTful and SOAP web services, and third-party middleware adapters. 
 - Own and lead end-to-end JDE EnterpriseOne upgrade projects - from current-release assessment and gap analysis through to production cutover - including major application releases (e. g. , 9. 0 to 9. 2) and incremental Application Service Packs (ASPs). 
 - Plan and execute JDE Tools Release upgrades (e. g. , TR 9. 2. x. x series): download and stage ESU/ASU bundles from Oracle Update Center, run the Tools Release installer on Enterprise and HTML Web Servers, validate planner and spec merge, and post-upgrade regression test all critical business objects. 
 - Manage the full Application Service Update (ASU) and Electronic Software Update (ESU) lifecycle: evaluate Oracle support patches, assess object conflicts using the Object Management Workbench (OMW) conflict checker, apply updates through Change Management, and produce post-apply validation reports. 
 - Perform and document pre-upgrade checklist activities: hardware and OS prerequisite validation, Oracle Database version compatibility matrix review, JVM and WebLogic/JBoss version alignment, disk capacity planning, and backup verification. 
 - Coordinate co-existence environments during upgrade cycles - maintaining multiple tools release levels across DV, PY, and PD path codes to support parallel development, QA testing, and production stability simultaneously. 
 - Perform deep CNC administration across all JDE server tiers: Enterprise Server (Logic Server), HTML Web Server, Deployment Server, and Batch Processing / UBE Server on both Linux (RHEL / Oracle Linux) and Windows Server platforms. 
 - Provision, configure, and maintain JDE environments from scratch: stand up new logic server instances, configure jde. ini / jdbj. ini / jas. ini, define server maps, configure ports and JMX monitoring, and register environments in the Server Manager Management Console (SMMC). 
 - Administer the Deployment Server: manage path codes (PRISTINE, DEMO, DV733, PY733, PD733, and custom path codes), configure package build INI settings, maintain the Central Objects business data source, and control check-in/check-out workflows in OMW. 
 - Execute full package builds - both Full and Partial packages - including: setting package build definitions, resolving spec merge errors, monitoring Package Assembly and Deploy logs, managing the deployment queue, and validating successful client and server package deployment. 
 - Configure and manage JDE Change Management: define environments and path codes, set up promotion paths (DV -> PY -> PD), govern Object Librarian (OL) projects, manage OMW user roles and activity rules, and enforce promotion approval workflows. 
 - Administer JDE Security: configure Application Security (Action, Row, Column, Tab, Version security), Orchestrator token-based security, Single Sign-On (SSO) via SAML/LDAP integration, and Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) aligned with SOX and audit requirements. 
 - Manage the JDE Scheduler: configure and monitor UBE job queues, set host and subsystem job priorities, tune concurrent job limits, diagnose stuck/failed jobs, and manage batch version control and interactive server routing. 
 - Monitor and tune JDE system performance: analyze HTML Server heap dumps and GC logs, tune JVM parameters (Xmx/Xms/MaxPermSize), review logic server kernel configuration, diagnose slow UBE execution, and optimize jde. log / jdedebug. log verbosity and rotation policies. 
 - Lead new JDE environment provisioning projects end-to-end: requirements scoping, server sizing, OS-level prerequisite configuration, Oracle DB schema creation, JDE Planner installation, workbench environment setup, and handoff to development or QA teams. 
 - Build and configure additional path codes for specialized purposes (e. g. , RETROFIT, TRAINING, UAT, REPORT-DEV) - including creating new business data sources, system data sources, and object librarian data sources, and configuring server map entries accordingly. 
 - Establish and maintain Disaster Recovery (DR) and Business Continuity (BCP) environments: configure replication or restore procedures for Enterprise Server, Deployment Server, and Oracle databases; document and periodically test failover runbooks. 
 - Administer Oracle Database (versions 12c, 19c, and 21c) supporting JDE EnterpriseOne on both Oracle Linux / RHEL and Windows Server platforms - including installation, patching (PSU/CPU/RU), listener configuration, and TNS connectivity. 
 - Manage JDE-specific Oracle DB objects: Central Objects (COCTL), Business Data, Control Tables, and Versions data sources - including tablespace sizing, index management, and regular schema statistics gathering (ANALYZE / DBMS_STATS) to ensure query plan stability. 
 - Perform Oracle DBA tasks in support of JDE operations: export/import using DataPump (expdp/impdp) for environment refreshes, RMAN backup and restore, Flashback operations, AWR and ADDM performance report analysis, and deadlock/latch contention investigation via V$ views. 
 - Tune Oracle SQL performance for JDE: review execution plans using EXPLAIN PLAN and SQL Trace / TKPROF, identify and resolve full table scans on high-volume JDE tables (F0911, F4211, F43121 etc. ), create or rebuild indexes, and gather optimizer statistics on schedule. 
 - Configure and manage Oracle Data Guard or Oracle RAC (Real Application Clusters) to provide high availability for JDE production database tiers on Linux; manage redo log shipping, standby switchover/failover procedures, and TAF (Transparent Application Failover) settings. 
 - Administer Oracle networking on Linux: configure tnsnames. ora, listener. ora, sqlnet. ora; manage Oracle Wallet for encrypted database connections; and control OS-level oracle user permissions, ulimits, and kernel parameter tuning (shmmax, semaphores, open file limits). 
 - Manage Oracle databases on Windows Server: configure Oracle Windows Services, OracleDBConsole, NTFS permission structures for Oracle homes, Windows Scheduler tasks for backup jobs, and Event Log integration for Oracle alert log monitoring. 
 - Perform periodic JDE database health checks: purge JDE log tables (F9861, jdeDebug), archive obsolete versions, compress historic business data, and manage tablespace free-space thresholds with proactive alerting. 

IBM Integration - Integration Developer & MQ/IIB Administration

- Architect, develop, and administer IBM Integration Bus (IIB) / App Connect Enterprise (ACE) message flows, policies, and deployment BAR files. 
 - Design and manage IBM MQ infrastructure including queue managers, channels, topic-based messaging, and high-availability clustering. 
 - Lead integration governance - define patterns, reusable components, and API management policies. 
 - Implement end-to-end monitoring for integration pipelines using MQ Explorer, IBM Operations Console, and third-party observability tools. 
 - Troubleshoot production integration failures, analyze message flows, and lead performance optimization efforts. 
 - Evaluate and plan migration paths from IIB to IBM App Connect Professional/Enterprise or cloud-native alternatives. 

Cloud Solution Architecture & Automation

- Design, implement, and govern multi-cloud and hybrid-cloud architectures (AWS, Azure, or GCP) aligned with enterprise security and compliance standards. 
 - Lead cloud-native solution design including microservices, serverless computing, containerization (Docker/Kubernetes), and API Gateway strategies. 
 - Drive cloud automation initiatives using Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools - Terraform, Ansible, CloudFormation, or equivalent. 
 - Develop CI/CD pipelines and DevSecOps practices to accelerate delivery velocity while maintaining quality gates. 
 - Oversee cloud cost optimization, FinOps practices, and capacity planning. 
 - Establish cloud security posture management (CSPM), identity and access policies, and compliance guardrails (SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR). 
 - Lead cloud migration strategies for on-premises JDE and IBM workloads into cloud environments. 

AI Strategy & Emerging Technology Adoption

- Champion an AI-first mindset across the operations and engineering team - identifying automation, efficiency, and insight opportunities. 
 - Evaluate, pilot, and operationalize AI/ML tools and platforms (e. g. , AWS , Azure AI Services, OpenAI APIs). 
 - Integrate generative AI and intelligent automation into business workflows, JDE processes, and integration pipelines. 
 - Stay current with the rapidly evolving AI landscape; rapidly acquire new skills and facilitate team enablement workshops. 
 - Partner with data engineering and analytics teams to build AI-ready data pipelines and governance practices. 

Our Interview Practices

To maintain a fair and genuine hiring process, we kindly ask that all candidates participate in interviews without the assistance of AI tools or external prompts. Our interview process is designed to assess your individual skills, experiences, and communication style. We value authenticity and want to ensure we're getting to know you-not a digital assistant. To help maintain this integrity, we ask to remove virtual backgrounds and include in-person interviews in our hiring process. Please note that use of AI-generated responses or third-party support during interviews will be grounds for disqualification from the recruitment process. 

Applicants may be required to appear onsite at a Wolters Kluwer office as part of the recruitment process.

Company Description

ServiceNow

It all started in sunny San Diego, California in 2004 when a visionary engineer, Fred Luddy, saw the potential to transform how we work. Fast forward to today - ServiceNow stands as a global market leader, bringing innovative AI-enhanced technology to over 8, 100 customers, including 85% of the Fortune 500®. Our intelligent cloud-based platform seamlessly connects people, systems, and processes to empower organizations to find smarter, faster, and better ways to work. But this is just the beginning of our journey. Join us as we pursue our purpose to make the world work better for everyone. 

Moveworks is the Agentic AI Assistant platform that empowers the entire workforce. 

Our platform enables employees to converse with all of their business systems through natural language to quickly find answers and automate tasks. Powered by the world's most advanced LLMs, our proprietary models, and a sophisticated Agentic AI platform, we're transforming how work gets done by allowing AI to take initiative, streamline complex workflows, and continuously learn and adapt. 

Moveworks is trusted by over 5. 5 million employees at more than 350 of the world's largest companies, including 10% of the Fortune 500, to automate everyday tasks and streamline business operations. Recognized on the Forbes Cloud 100 and AI 50 lists, Moveworks was also named one of Fast Company's 2025 Most Innovative Companies and Inc's Best in Business, in the Best in Innovation category. Moveworks was also recognized at Microsoft's 2025 Partner of the Year and in 2024, received the AI Breakthrough Award. 

In December 2025, Moveworks was acquired by ServiceNow, marking a pivotal milestone in our journey to create a single front door to work for all business systems. By combining ServiceNow's leading workflow automation with Moveworks' Reasoning Engine and natural language capabilities, we deliver the AI platform for every person and every workflow. Built to go beyond basic summaries to deliver meaningful business impact. Together, our AI acts across enterprise systems to turn conversations into completed work. 

By joining our team, you'll be at the forefront of the AI transformation, backed by the global scale of ServiceNow and the agility of a high-growth company. We are looking for world-class talent to help us extend agentic AI to every employee across every corner of the business. 

Come join us!

Job Description

Engineering Manager

As an Engineering Manager on the Product and Platform org at Moveworks, you will lead a team of strong engineers. The team will focus on developing user facing product features that leverage our advanced Machine Learning platform. In addition, you will design scalable frameworks to support rapid feature development and deployment. You will be working cross-functionally with other teams regularly to design and deploy features and tools that our customers use every day. Your role is absolutely critical here at Moveworks, and you will see the immediate impact of your work on both customers and other engineers. 

If you are passionate about full-stack product development, curious about machine learning, enjoy working alongside equally driven colleagues, and are an experienced engineer looking for a new challenge, we should have a conversation!

- Work across Moveworks' full-stack and API platforms
 - Design and implement frameworks to support development of product features that are highly reliable, performant and secure
 - Develop user facing product features using both open source libraries and internal building blocks
 - Collaborate with other software engineers to diagnose, fix and prevent production issues
 - Work in a highly-concurrent platform where quality, scalability and reliability matter
 - Regularly participate in peer code and design reviews

Qualifications

- Experience in leveraging or critically thinking about how to integrate AI into work processes, decision-making, or problem-solving. This may include using AI-powered tools, automating workflows, analyzing AI-driven insights, or exploring AI's potential impact on the function or industry. 
 - 10-12+ years of experience designing, building, shipping, and maintaining distributed systems
 - 2+ years of people management or TLM experience. 
 - You have familiarity with building and managing high-scale user products in ML domain
 - You have an understanding of REST and or other RPC based systems
 - You feel at home developing on Linux with languages like Python and/or Golang

 - Desire to work at a startup pace with a high degree of ownership

data.description:
Who We Are

Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963. Today, we help clients with total transformation-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom-line impact. 

To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading-edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures-and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive. 

What You'll Do

We are looking for a Senior Manager - GenAI Engineering to lead the engineering, architecture, and delivery of enterprise-grade Generative AI and AI products within BCG's Internal People function and will play a critical role in driving the technical strategy, engineering delivery from build, QA to production and global adoption of AI/GenAI capabilities for various BCG's internal digital products that supports HR/People processes. 

The Senior Manager will lead a multidisciplinary team of GenAI engineers, ML engineers, and data scientists while remaining hands-on in architecture, solution design, Python development, technical reviews, and production engineering. 

The role requires a combination of deep GenAI technical expertise, strong software engineering fundamentals, product thinking, delivery leadership, and the ability to influence senior technical and business stakeholders. 

We are looking for a Senior Manager - GenAI Engineering to lead the engineering, architecture, and delivery of enterprise-grade Generative AI and AI products within BCG's Internal People function and will play a critical role in driving the technical strategy, engineering delivery from build, QA to production and global adoption of AI/GenAI capabilities for various BCG's internal digital products that supports HR/People processes. 

The Senior Manager will lead a multidisciplinary team of GenAI engineers, ML engineers, and data scientists while remaining hands-on in architecture, solution design, Python development, technical reviews, and production engineering. 

The role requires a combination of deep GenAI technical expertise, strong software engineering fundamentals, product thinking, delivery leadership, and the ability to influence senior technical and business stakeholders. 

Product & Stakeholder Partnership

- Partner closely with product owners, functional leaders, and stakeholders within the People function to define requirements, shape backlog items, and translate business problems into technical solutions. 
 - Work with global and local market teams during rollouts to understand adoption, identify gaps, and continuously improve the solution. 
 - Partner with enterprise teams across architecture, security, Responsible AI etc. to seek approvals for the AI solutions during deployments and rollouts 
 - Communicate clearly and effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders. 
 - Ensure GenAI solutions are designed and delivered in accordance with Responsible AI, security, privacy, data governance, and regulatory requirements. 
 - Establish appropriate AI guardrails covering areas such as prompt injection, data leakage, unauthorized tool access, unsafe outputs, and inappropriate model behaviour. 
 - Partner with Responsible AI, Security, Privacy, Legal, Risk, and Enterprise Architecture teams to obtain necessary approvals and establish production-readiness standards. 
 - Ensure appropriate documentation of AI system architecture, model usage, data flows, risks, evaluations, and operational controls. 
 - Embed responsible AI and security considerations throughout the product lifecycle rather than treating them as post-development activities. 

GenAI Architecture & Technical Strategy

- Define the technical vision, architecture, and engineering strategy for enterprise GenAI products. 
 - Design and guide implementation of LLM-powered applications, RAG architectures, agentic workflows, LLM orchestration, tool/function calling, and AI-powered decision-support solutions. 
 - Evaluate and select appropriate foundation models, embedding models, AI platforms, retrieval technologies, orchestration frameworks, and cloud services based on business and technical requirements. 
 - Establish reusable GenAI architecture patterns, reference architectures, engineering standards, and technical accelerators across the AI CoE. 
 - Make pragmatic build-vs-buy, model-selection, and platform decisions considering quality, scalability, security, latency, and cost. 
 - Conduct architecture and design reviews and provide technical direction across multiple engineering teams and workstreams. 

AI Evaluation & Quality

- Define evaluation frameworks for GenAI applications covering accuracy, relevance, groundedness, hallucination, safety, robustness, latency, and cost. 
 - Establish automated evaluation and regression-testing strategies for models, prompts, RAG pipelines, and agentic workflows. 
 - Partner with Product and business stakeholders to define AI quality and product success metrics. 

LLMOps / MLOps & Production Engineering

- Establish production-grade LLMOps/MLOps practices covering model and prompt versioning, deployment, monitoring, observability, and continuous improvement. 
 - Define operational metrics covering AI quality, latency, reliability, usage, and cost. 
 - Establish CI/CD and automated testing practices for GenAI applications, prompts, RAG pipelines, and agentic workflows. 
 - Design AI systems for scalability, availability, reliability, latency, and cost efficiency. 

Delivery & Team Leadership

- Lead and coach a team of GenAI/ML engineers and data scientists delivering enterprise AI solutions end to end-from problem definition and design through development, deployment, and rollout. 
 - Own execution and delivery: planning, prioritization, agile ceremonies, timelines, and quality of outcomes. 
 - Provide technical direction, unblock teams, and ensure pragmatic, scalable solutions aligned with business needs. 

Hands-on Technical & Full-Stack Engineering

- Remain hands-on in full-stack development, solution design, code reviews, and technical architecture. 
 - Guide development of production-grade GenAI-enabled applications across the frontend, backend, AI/ML, and data layers. 
 - Design and develop scalable backend services, REST APIs, microservices, and integrations required to support AI-powered products. 
 - Guide development of modern frontend applications and user experiences that integrate GenAI capabilities into enterprise workflows. 
 - Work effectively across frontend technologies such as React/TypeScript or equivalent frameworks, and backend technologies such as Python/Java or equivalent technologies. 
 - Guide integration of LLMs, AI agents, enterprise APIs, business systems, and data platforms into end-to-end product experiences. 
 - Remain hands-on in Python-based GenAI/ML development while providing technical direction across the broader application stack. 
 - Work effectively with modern cloud-native development stacks, including GitHub-based workflows, containers/Kubernetes, Airflow, CI/CD, observability, and data pipelines. 
 - Promote modern software engineering practices across full-stack, AI, and ML development. 
 - Remain hands-on in Python-based development, code reviews, and solution design. 
 - Guide development of GenAI-enabled features and applied ML solutions in a product context. 
 - Work effectively with modern cloud-native development stacks (e. g. , GitHub-based workflows, Airflow, containerized/Kubernetes-based deployments, data pipelines). 
 - Promote modern software engineering practices across AI/ML development. 

What You'll Bring

- 10+ years of experience in software engineering, ML/AI engineering, or data science, including significant experience designing and delivering production-grade GenAI/AI products and leading engineering teams. 
 - Hands on engineering development expertise to build and deploy production grade digital products. 
 - Demonstrated ability to lead delivery teams and grow into broader leadership responsibilities. 
 - Strong problem-solving skills with a pragmatic, outcomes-oriented approach. 
 - Proven experience leading teams of data scientists, ML engineers, or GenAI engineers delivering enterprise AI or digital products for internal or commercial products. 
 - Strong delivery and execution mindset, with experience owning timelines, dependencies, and outcomes. 
 - Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to engage product owners, functional leaders, and senior stakeholders. 
 - Strong hands-on experience with: Python /Applied AI / ML / GenAI in production environments 
 - Cloud-based development and deployment environments 
 - Data pipelines and production-grade systems 
 - Ability to identify the right technical approach to solve business problems and guide teams accordingly. 

Who You'll Work With

You will work closely with the People function & AI CoE leadership, Team Builder Product Owner, Tech owner, AI engineers, data scientists and stakeholders across the People function. You'll partner with product functional and technical teams to ensure successful delivery and global adoption of AI solutions. 

Additional info

At BCG, our people and relationships are at the heart of everything we do. We believe that in-person collaboration plays an important role in our culture, mentorship, and professional development. 

For this role, you will generally be expected to work from a BCG office or in person with clients on a regular basis (typically around 50% of working time), depending on business needs and in line with local policies and practices. 

We aim to provide a dynamic and collaborative environment that fosters connection and teamwork. 

Boston Consulting Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, age, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity / expression, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected under national, provincial, or local law, where applicable, and those with criminal histories will be considered in a manner consistent with applicable state and local laws.

Job Summary

Black & Veatch is expanding its Power SCADA team to support a strategic grid modernization initiative focused on IEC 61850‐based substation automation and virtual substation technologies. As a founding member of the Virtual Protection, Automation, and Control (vPAC) Alliance, Black & Veatch is collaborating with industry leaders to advance open, secure, and vendor‐agnostic digital substation solutions that replace traditional, hardware‐intensive architectures with virtualized, software‐defined platforms. Following successful pilot efforts, BV is now transitioning virtual substations into production environments. This role is being created to bring in experienced SCADA professionals who can help design, implement, standardize, and support production‐ready Power SCADA solutions that enable resilient, flexible, and future‐ready grid infrastructure

In this role, you may have the opportunity to: 

- Lead the transition of IEC 61850‐based digital and virtual substations from pilot to production, shaping real-world grid modernization outcomes. 
 - Design and standardize secure, vendor‐agnostic substation automation architectures that improve resilience, flexibility, and scalability. 
 - Serve as a technical leader and subject‐matter expert, influencing system architecture, best practices, and emerging standards. 
 - Collaborate with utilities, technology partners, and industry groups (including vPAC Alliance) to help define the future of protection, automation, and control

Key Responsibilities

IEC 61850 Engineering & Modeling

- Develop SCL engineering artifacts including ICD, CID, and SCD files, datasets, logical node mappings, reporting and control blocks, and GOOSE publications and subscriptions. 
 - Configure and validate MMS, GOOSE, and SV messaging for protection, automation, monitoring, and SCADA applications. 

Substation Networking & Time Synchronization

- Design and document station-bus and process-bus network architectures using PRP/HSR, VLANs, QoS, multicast management, and traffic segmentation practices. 
 - Design deterministic real-time networking paths for time-sensitive protection and automation applications, incorporating latency budgeting, PTP timing performance, and behaviors defined for substation-class devices meeting IEC 61850-3 and IEEE 1613 environmental and EMC requirements. 
 - Diagnose and optimize real-time network behavior through traffic-capture analysis, timing-accuracy evaluation, and system-level tuning techniques for time-critical digital-substation workloads. 
 - Develop PTP-based time-synchronization architectures including grandmaster, boundary, and transparent clock configurations and incorporate timing considerations into the system design. 

Protection, Automation & SCADA Integration

- Integrate multi-vendor IEDs with protection settings and logic, coordinating measurements, controls, alarms, and event data with SCADA and HMI systems. 
 - Apply IEC 61850 data-modeling concepts to confirm interoperability across mixed fleets of protection and control devices. 

Cybersecurity & System Hardening

- Incorporate cybersecurity principles into system architecture, including authentication, role-based access control, network segmentation, secure communications, and device hardening. 
 - Apply cyber-informed engineering principles by identifying high-consequence functions and integrating protective measures directly into system architecture, embedding security decisions from the earliest stages of engineering rather than treating them as add-on controls. 

Virtualization of Substation Functions

- Develop and configure virtualized protection, HMI, gateway/RTU, and related substation applications on platforms including VMware ESXi with vCenter, vSAN, and NSX; Red Hat KVM or OpenShift Virtualization; and SEAPATH's real-time, high-availability hypervisor platform designed to run virtualized protection, automation, and control workloads with deterministic performance and PTP-synchronized operation on industrial servers meeting IEC 61850-3 and IEEE 1613 criteria. 

Industry Engagement & Technical Leadership

- Contribute to, or develop toward contributing to, IEEE and IEC standards and collaborative initiatives related to IEC 61850, digital substations, time synchronization, and cybersecurity. 
 - Support participation in technical bodies and industry groups such as IEC, IEEE, CIGRE, ISA99, and vPAC Alliance workstreams. 
 - Support the advancement and practical application of virtualized protection, automation, and control concepts in alignment with the architectural direction established by the vPAC Alliance. 

Project Delivery & Collaboration

- Produce engineering documentation including network specifications, SCL models, timing plans, interface definitions, and system diagrams used across design, laboratory validation, and field implementation. 
 - Collaborate with project managers, technical leads, clients, and vendors to align designs with project goals, operational requirements, and industry best practices. 

Management Responsibilities

Preferred Qualifications

- Familiarity with cybersecurity frameworks for operational technology environments, including secure communications and system-hardening practices. 
 - Interest or participation in IEEE and IEC standards development related to IEC 61850, time synchronization, digital substations, and cybersecurity. 
 - Experience deploying or supporting virtualized protection, automation, and control applications on VMware ESXi/vCenter/vSAN/NSX, Red Hat KVM or OpenShift Virtualization, and SEAPATH's real-time, high-availability hypervisor platform for vPAC workloads. 
 - Experience deploying virtualized substation workloads on industrial servers certified to IEC 618503 and IEEE 1613 environmental and EMC requirements. 
 - Familiarity with vPAC architectural principles and emerging practices for hosting protection, automation, and control systems on virtualized platforms. 
 - Interest in or experience with virtualized protection, automation, and control concepts. 

Minimum Qualifications

- Bachelor's Degree in Engineering from either a recognized accredited program in their home country or the country in which the professional is practicing or equivalent experience in Engineering work. 
 - Minimum of 11 years related work experience. 
 - All applicants must be able to complete pre-employment onboarding requirements (if selected) which may include any/all of the following: criminal/civil background check, drug screen, and motor vehicle records search, in compliance with any applicable laws and regulations. 
 - Holds an active engineering registration or licensure to support engineer of record (EOR) requirements for BV projects in applicable countries, and supports where necessary. 

Certifications

Work Environment/Physical Demands

The position may entail prolonged periods of sitting and computer use, and the professional would ideally be able to maintain focus and attention to detail throughout the workday. The position may also be require physical tasks during site visits, including crouching, grasping, and standing/walking for extended periods of time.

data.title: Lead Response Technology and Automation Security Engineer
data.description:
Our Purpose

Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we're helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential. 

Title And Summary

Lead Response Technology and Automation Security Engineer

Overview

The Corporate Security Threat and Response Management product ownership team is looking for a Lead Level Security Engineer to help drive our Security Operations modernization strategy. The ideal candidate is passionate about the modern security tools, capabilities, and strategies. 

The RESPOND product team executes on the multi-year strategy and roadmap set by the RESPOND product owner to evolve and modernize SecOps incident investigation and response technology, capabilities, tools, and process. 

Response product team members work closely with regional SOC teams to execute the RESPOND product strategy on the ground. This role is the connective tissue between product vision and operational reality: building, tuning, and operationalizing response automation, AI-augmented workflows, and analyst tooling that SOC and DFIR teams rely on every day. The RESPOND product team is hands-on with SOAR development, agentic AI integration, notebook-based investigation tooling, and continuous improvement of analyst workflows. 

Core Responsibilities

- Execute the RESPOND product roadmap in close partnership with SOC and Incident Response teams in the region. 
 - Design, build, test, and maintain SOAR playbooks used for incident triage and response scopes to collect and process digital evidence and artifacts at speed and scale. 
 - Build and operationalize AI-augmented response capabilities, including: 
 - Agentic AI workflows integrated into triage, enrichment, and response. 
 - Prompt books and prompt libraries tuned for SOC and Incident Response use cases. 
 - Prompt-book/code notebook (Jupyter, etc) development for repeatable investigation, hunt, and DFIR workflows. 
 - LLM-driven enrichment and summarization integrated into case management. 
 - Define strategic requirements and oversee management for connectors, apps, and integrations between SOAR, SIEM, EDR, identity, ticketing, threat intelligence, and AI/LLM platforms (including MCP servers where applicable) for build through our dedicated engineering partners. 
 - Build and maintain response tooling: scripts, live-response packages, enrichment services, and automation utilities deployable via EDR and SOAR. 
 - Embed with SOC and DFIR analysts to identify high-toil workflows and convert them into automated, AI-assisted, or fully autonomous playbooks with appropriate guardrails. 
 - Tune and optimize playbooks and AI-assisted workflows against measurable outcomes (MTTR, false-positive rate, analyst touch time, AI-assist accuracy). 
 - Contribute to the centralized response tooling, prompt book, and notebook libraries, ensuring code quality, documentation, version control, and reusability across regions. 
 - Support major incident response activities by deploying and operating response tooling and AI-assisted investigation workflows under pressure. 
 - Provide feedback into the product backlog and partner with the PO on requirements refinement. 
 - Document playbooks, prompt books, notebooks, and technical designs to enterprise standards. 

All About You

- 5+ years in security operations, incident response, detection engineering, or security automation engineering
 - Prior experience as a SOC analyst, Security Engineer, Digital Forensics Examiner, SOAR engineer, and/or threat hunter preferred. 
 - Hands-on SOAR development experience with low-code/no-code or hyper-automation tools and concepts. Must be able to define and build reliable, scalable response capabilities. 
 - Demonstrated enterprise experience executing on AI-augmented SOC concepts, including at least two of: 
 - Building and maintaining AI prompt books for analyst workflows. 
 - Developing Jupyter notebooks for investigation, hunt, or DFIR. 
 - Integrating LLMs or agentic AI into XDR, SOAR, case management, or response tooling. 
 - Leveraging IDEs with AI connectors to process data and execute AI workflows
 - Deploying agent-based AI workflows for triage or enrichment in production. 
 - Strong scripting skills in Python and PowerShell. Comfortable with basic code repo management using Git or equivalent. 
 - Working knowledge of REST APIs, JSON, webhooks, and authentication patterns (OAuth, API keys, managed identities). 
 - Solid grounding in incident response fundamentals and the IR lifecycle. 
 - Hands-on experience with: EDR platforms (CrowdStrike, SentinelOne, Defender for Endpoint), SIEM (Splunk ES, Microsoft Sentinel), identity platforms (Entra ID, Okta), cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP), and cloud protection products (CNAPP, CWPP, CSPM). 
 - Familiarity with MITRE ATT&CK and the ability to map response actions to adversary techniques. 
 - Demonstrated ability to operate inside an agile delivery model with a product backlog. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in computer science, cybersecurity, or IT-focused disciplines (or equivalent experience). 
 - At least two Industry certifications: GCFA, GCIH, GNFA, GCFR, GREM, or equivalent. 
 - Experience with SecOps focused MCP server architectures, agentic frameworks, or tools
 - Experience building EDR live-response scripts and tool libraries. 
 - Exposure to detection-as-code and response-as-code practices, including CI/CD for security content. 
 - Background in regulated financial services or Fortune 500 SOC environments. 

Corporate Security Responsibility

All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must: 

- Abide by Mastercard's security policies and practices; 
 - Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed; 
 - Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
 - Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard's guidelines.

data.title: DevOps & Azure Cloud Engineer
data.description:
About The Opportunity

Netrix Global is looking for a client-facing DevOps Engineer to design, automate, and operate reliable delivery environments across Azure cloud, on-premises infrastructure, and modern application platforms. The role focuses on CI/CD, GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, infrastructure operations, deployment automation, and production readiness. 

The engineer will support cloud and on-premises server administration, networking fundamentals, identity and access management, secrets management, monitoring, and release troubleshooting. The role also requires working knowledge of database administration concepts to coordinate deployments, backups, connectivity, access management, and operational diagnostics with application and data teams. 

The ideal candidate brings strong operational ownership and can deploy traditional applications, Microsoft platform solutions, and AI workloads securely and repeatably. Success in this role means stable environments, automated delivery pipelines, clear observability, controlled releases, and faster recovery from incidents. 

How You Will Make An Impact

- Assess client environments and define practical source-control, branching, pull-request, CI/CD, release, and environment-management standards. 
 - Build and maintain Azure DevOps YAML pipelines and GitHub Actions workflows for applications, infrastructure, data, and AI solutions. 
 - Automate provisioning and configuration using PowerShell, Python, and infrastructure-as-code tools such as Bicep or Terraform. 
 - Administer and troubleshoot Azure resources, Windows/Linux servers, on-premises environments, hybrid connectivity, and core networking components. 
 - Implement secure secrets management, certificates, service connections, managed identities, role-based access controls, and release approval processes. 
 - Support database operational needs, including connectivity, access management, deployment scripts, backup and restore coordination, monitoring, and basic performance diagnostics. 
 - Deploy and operationalize AI solutions, including dependent APIs, containers, model endpoints, agent services, configuration management, monitoring, and rollback controls. 
 - Establish monitoring, alerting, and diagnostics using Azure Monitor, Application Insights, Log Analytics, and platform telemetry. 
 - Coordinate environment readiness, deployment validation, capacity planning, incident response, root-cause analysis, and recovery planning. 
 - Communicate infrastructure risks, release status, dependencies, and remediation plans to clients and internal stakeholders. 

What You Will Bring To The Table

We are looking for a professional who combines technical ownership with strong client partnership. Success in this role requires curiosity, accountability, practical judgment, and the ability to move work forward while keeping stakeholders informed. 

- Communicate clearly with clients and internal stakeholders, including during discovery, delivery updates, risk discussions, and project handoffs. 
 - Take ownership of outcomes, follow work through to completion, and escalate risks early with supporting evidence. 
 - Use documentation, experimentation, and collaboration to solve unfamiliar problems rather than waiting for step-by-step direction. 
 - Adapt to evolving technologies, priorities, and responsibilities while maintaining quality and security standards. 
 - Contribute to a supportive engineering culture through peer reviews, knowledge sharing, and professional client interactions. 

Qualifications

- 3-5 years of relevant professional experience. 
 - Strong hands-on experience with Azure DevOps, Git, CI/CD, YAML pipelines, GitHub Actions, and branching/pull-request strategies. 
 - Practical Azure cloud experience covering compute, networking, storage, identity, monitoring, and security, along with Windows/Linux server support across cloud, on-premises, or hybrid environments. 
 - Experience with PowerShell or Python automation, secrets management, release troubleshooting, and infrastructure-as-code fundamentals. 
 - Working knowledge of networking concepts including DNS, TCP/IP, firewalls, routing, load balancing, VPN/private connectivity, and certificates, along with basic DBA knowledge covering connectivity, permissions, deployments, backup/restore, and monitoring. 
 - Ability to work directly with clients and cross-functional teams, take ownership of incidents, and communicate technical risks clearly. 
 - Experience with Bicep or Terraform, Docker, Kubernetes/AKS, Key Vault, Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, and Application Insights. 
 - Experience deploying AI services, Azure OpenAI/Foundry solutions, APIs, containers, Copilot Studio integrations, or agent workloads. 
 - Experience with Power Platform ALM, CI/CD, data-platform deployments, security scanning, quality gates, and disaster recovery practices. 
 - Exposure to SQL Server administration, hybrid infrastructure, VMware or comparable virtualization platforms, and enterprise network operations. 
 - Automated and repeatable deployments across Azure, on-premises, and hybrid environments. 
 - Stable infrastructure with controlled access, comprehensive monitoring, backup, and recovery practices. 
 - Production-ready AI and application deployments with traceable configuration management and rollback paths. 
 - Faster incident diagnosis, reduced release risk, and clear operational ownership. 

Work Schedule: This is a client-facing role. The successful candidate will be expected to participate in client meetings, discovery sessions, demonstrations, delivery reviews, and issue-resolution discussions during the assigned shift. 

Standard Shift: 1: 00 PM to 10: 00 PM India Standard Time (IST), equivalent to 2: 30 AM to 11: 30 AM Eastern Standard Time (EST). During U. S. daylight saving time, the equivalent schedule is 3: 30 AM to 12: 30 PM Eastern Daylight Time (EDT). 

About Us

At Netrix Global, our values are the philosophies and principles that we live by. They support our vision, help us achieve our goals, and commit us to a common purpose. 

We Own Outcomes, Win Together, Make An Impact, Enjoy The Journey, and Respect All!

Netrix Global is a mission-driven organization with the goal of providing the people, processes, and technology needed to run and scale modern, data-driven businesses that are always on and always secure. Our breadth of capabilities allows us to provide holistic offerings that solve even today's most complex business challenges, delivering to you an integrated, optimized, and future-proof solution. 

We work with clients of all sizes and specialize in solutions for healthcare, manufacturing, government, education, financial services, and legal industries. Netrix is consistently ranked in the CRN VAR500, detailing the country's top system integrators. 

At Netrix, we're driven to solve business problems with innovative technology solutions. We focus on end-users and are committed to client satisfaction. 

What You Can Expect From Us

We offer a competitive compensation package, comprehensive group benefits to meet the needs of you and your family, flexibility, and time off when you need it, and a casual work environment. The role can be remote/home office, with some travel required. 

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or veteran status. As part of this commitment, we will ensure that persons with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodations. If you need reasonable accommodations, please let us know by contacting NetrixHR@Netrixglobal. 

To learn more about Netrix Global, please go to www. netrixglobal. com

data.title: Sr Principal Architect  Ads Platform
data.description:
Overview

Microsoft Advertising makes billions of decisions every day across search, native, shopping, display, audience, and AI-powered advertising experiences. 

We are looking for a Principal Software Architect to define the technical direction for Ads Quality at global scale. 

Quality decisions can depend on ads, landing pages, advertisers, businesses, account history, behavioral patterns, and signals that may be incomplete, delayed, noisy, or changing. The challenge is to turn this evidence into systems that are accurate, scalable, measurable, and continuously improving. 

This is a hands-on software engineering role spanning distributed systems, production AI, decision systems, entity intelligence, agentic workflows, and measurement. 

Responsibilities

Define the long-term architecture for Ads Quality across signals, entity understanding, model execution, decisioning, feedback, and measurement. 

Establish how quality systems should reason across ads, landing pages, advertisers, businesses, relationships, and behavior over time. 

Design architectures that support heterogeneous AI systems including lightweight models, multimodal models, LLMs, agents, and deterministic systems. 

Define how evidence, model outputs, confidence, calibration, thresholds, and decision policies come together in production. 

Set technical direction across real-time, nearline, and offline systems, balancing quality, latency, freshness, cost, and reliability. 

Drive convergence where common abstractions create leverage and challenge unnecessary duplication or complexity. 

Partner with Applied Science on how new model capabilities should shape system architecture. 

Prototype difficult ideas when that is the fastest way to establish technical feasibility. 

Influence implementation through design reviews, architecture guidance, and hands-on engagement with critical systems. 

Qualifications

15+ years of software engineering experience, or equivalent technical depth. 

Deep experience architecting large-scale production systems spanning multiple teams. 

Strong expertise in distributed systems, production AI/ML systems, decision systems, or large-scale data platforms. 

Strong understanding of model serving, experimentation, evaluation, observability, rollout, and feedback loops. 

Ability to reason across software architecture and model behavior without treating ML as a black box. 

Track record of simplifying complex systems and turning ambiguous technical problems into durable architecture. 

Ability to influence senior engineers and technical leaders across organizational boundaries. 

Experience with advertising, quality systems, entity intelligence, multimodal AI, agentic systems, behavioral systems, or large-scale inference is valuable. 

This position will be open for a minimum of 5 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.

data.description:
About Sibros Technologies

Who We Are

Sibros is accelerating the future of SDV excellence with its Deep Connected PlatformTM that orchestrates full vehicle software update management, vehicle analytics, and remote commands in one integrated system. Our mission is to help our customers get the most value out of their connected devices. 

Follow us on

LinkedIn | Youtube | Instagram

About The Role

Job Title: Engineering Manager, Validation

Location: Pune, India

Experience: 8 to 12 years, including 2 to 4 years managing a validation or test team

Job Type: Full-time

As a Engineering Manager you will lead our Validation team in Pune, which validates every release of the Deep Connected Platform before it reaches customer vehicles: embedded firmware on telematics units and gateways, the cloud platform, and the bundled solutions we deliver to OEMs. You will own release quality from the branch cut to customer delivery. This is a player coach role for someone who wants to manage people and stay close to the technical work, with a strong firmware lean, since that is where most of our hardest problems sit. 

What you'll do

- Lead the Validation Team: Manage, coach, and grow validation engineers and squad leads, setting clear goals and providing regular feedback and career development. 
 - Own Release Validation: Validate every firmware release branch on our biweekly cadence and give a clear go or no go before a release ships to customers. 
 - Grow Test Automation: Expand automated regression on HIL benches, LabCar, and virtual vehicles, wired into CI/CD so each release cut is tested without manual steps. 
 - Drive V Model Validation: Build full V model traceability from customer and product requirements down to test cases and automated runs, define a clear Definition of Done for release validation, and keep validation compliant with Automotive SPICE (SYS. 5 system qualification testing and SWE. 6 software qualification testing). 
 - Lead Stress and Fault Testing: Run end to end black box validation, fault injection, negative scenarios, and multiday endurance and stress tests across virtual vehicles, HIL benches, and cloud interfaces, to catch edge case bugs before customer delivery. 
 - Raise Test Quality: Find gaps in test plans and run bug escape analysis so the same class of issue does not reach a customer twice. 
 - Support Customer Programs: Plan validation for OEM releases with Program Management and Solutions, and deliver test reports customers can trust. 
 - Partner Across Functions: Work closely with Firmware, Cloud, and Product teams on testability, triage, and fix verification. 
 - Scale with AI: Bring AI tools into test design, automation, reporting, and analysis, and help the team adopt them in daily work. 

What you should know

- Professional Experience: 8 to 12 years in validation, QA, or test engineering, including 2 to 4 years directly managing a team. 
 - Embedded Validation: Hands on experience validating firmware on real hardware (ECUs, telematics units, or IoT devices), with working knowledge of CAN and vehicle diagnostics (UDS). 
 - HIL and Automation: Experience setting up and running HIL rigs or test benches, and building Python test automation integrated into CI/CD (GitLab or similar). 
 - People Leadership: Demonstrated ability to manage, coach, and grow engineers, including performance conversations and hiring. 
 - Release Ownership: Track record of owning release sign off across several products or customer programs at once without dropping quality. 
 - Communication: Strong written and verbal communication, comfortable representing the team to engineers, program managers, and customers. 
 - On Site in Pune: Based in Pune and working from our office, close to the labs and test benches. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Cloud and API Testing: Experience testing SaaS platforms and REST APIs, to validate end to end from vehicle to cloud. 
 - OTA/Update Systems: Familiarity with over the air update systems or vehicle software management platforms. 
 - Standards Exposure: Familiarity with automotive process and safety standards (e. g. , ASPICE, ISO 26262, ISO/SAE 21434). 
 - AI in Testing: Experience using AI tools to speed up test design, automation, or analysis. 

What We Offer

- Competitive Compensation: A package inclusive of performance incentives. 
 - Growth Environment: A dynamic work environment with a flat hierarchy and rapid career advancement. 
 - Learning & Development: Access to continuous learning and professional development opportunities. 
 - Work-Life Balance: Flexible working hours and a culture that promotes balance. 
 - Comprehensive Benefits: Health insurance and wellness programs. 
 - Modern Policy: Flexible vacation and paid time off, you decide when you need a break. 
 - Team Culture: Regular team events, off-sites, and a budget for online courses, books, and conferences.

data.description:
About Analog Devices

Analog Devices, Inc. (NASDAQ: ADI) is a global semiconductor leader that bridges the physical and digital worlds to enable breakthroughs at the Intelligent Edge. ADI combines analog, digital, AI, and software technologies into solutions that combat climate change, reliably connect humans and the world, and help drive advancements in automation and robotics, mobility, healthcare, energy and data centers. With revenue of more than $11 billion in FY25, ADI ensures today's innovators stay Ahead of What's Possible. Learn more at www. analog. com and on LinkedIn and X. 

Staff Design Evaluation Engineer - Automotive Networking

Role Overview

Analog Devices International is seeking an experienced Staff Design Evaluation Engineer to join the Automotive Networking team in Hyderabad, India. In this senior technical role, you will lead the definition and execution of evaluation strategies for FPGA prototypes and automotive networking ASICs, from initial platform bring-up through system-level validation, characterisation, and release readiness. You will combine hands-on laboratory expertise with strong software development, test automation, data analysis, and technical leadership skills to deliver robust, repeatable, and high-quality evaluation solutions. 

You will work closely with design, verification, applications, systems, software, and product engineering teams to identify technical risks, resolve complex issues, and ensure that silicon and supporting platforms meet product and system requirements. As a Staff Engineer, you will provide technical direction, mentor engineers, and drive improvements in evaluation methodologies, tools, and laboratory practices. 

Key Responsibilities

- Define and lead comprehensive evaluation strategies, test plans, coverage goals, methodologies, and release criteria for FPGA prototypes and automotive networking ASICs. 
 - Translate product, architecture, and system requirements into measurable laboratory tests, including functional, performance, interoperability, robustness, and corner-case evaluation. 
 - Architect, develop, bring up, and maintain hardware and software evaluation platforms, test fixtures, reference systems, and supporting infrastructure. 
 - Develop modular, maintainable test and automation software in C and Python, including instrument control, data acquisition, regression execution, result processing, and report generation. 
 - Execute and analyse complex silicon and FPGA test cases; debug failures across hardware, firmware, software, interfaces, and system boundaries. 
 - Perform electrical and functional measurements using oscilloscopes, logic analysers, protocol analysers, signal generators, power supplies, and other laboratory equipment. 
 - Lead structured root-cause investigations, clearly document findings, and work with cross-functional teams to drive issues to resolution. 
 - Evaluate Automotive Ethernet T1S and related networking functionality, including link behaviour, data-path performance, timing, error handling, diagnostics, and interoperability.

data.description:
Job Description

Designs, implements, and optimizes components in distributed systems with an emphasis on scalability, resiliency, and operability. Delivers features and load/performance tests; leverages data plane platforms and distributed state tools for high-volume retrieval, storage, and processing; and reviews peers' implementations for scalability compliance. Builds fault-tolerant paths (redundancy, replication, automatic failover), applies recovery‐oriented principles, and implements retries, circuit breakers, and timeouts. Proactively detects and mitigates issues via tests, alarms, dashboards, and telemetry; authors runbooks and participates in incident response and RCAs. Implements standard replication and synchronization, develops automation/IaC for troubleshooting and maintenance, and applies advanced security controls (encryption, access, remediation) while ensuring change, compliance, and documentation standards are met. 

Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

System Design & Architecture - System Scalability: 

-Implements and contributes to the development for components of distributed systems that support horizontal and vertical scaling including leveraging distributed state management tools. 

-Optimizes code and/or systems for large-scale data processing in large-scale systems. 

-Implements scalability requirements for assigned components and reviews implementation of team members. 

-Leverages components of data plane platforms to handle large-scale data retrieval, storage, and processing. 

-Implements performance and load testing. 

System Design & Architecture - System Reliability Design: 

-Collaborates with team to build fault-tolerant components capable of withstanding in-service updates by implementing redundancy, replication, and automatic failover mechanisms. 

-Applies recovery oriented computing principles to design components that effectively handle service disruptions. 

-Implements retry mechanisms, circuit breakers, and timeouts to help handle network unreliability. 

System Design & Architecture - System Reliability Performance: 

-Implements tests and alarm configurations to proactively detect and address issues/failures. 

-Supports efforts to recover from failures by drafting and executing runbooks and operational procedures. 

-Builds and customizes dashboards, telemetry systems, and alerting mechanisms to monitor component health.

-Designs and implements functional requirements and testing for assigned features within an existing system. 

-Implements tests scenarios (e. g. , fault-injection, brown-out) to evaluate system correctness. 

-Implements standard data replication and synchronization techniques to maintain data integrity and availability. 

Operational Troubleshooting & Incident Management: 

-Diagnoses, debugs, and resolves issues in system components to support ongoing operation. 

-Implements basic strategies to prevent interruptions, ensuring no maintenance windows are required for customers and users when resolving issues. 

-Designs and implements automation scripts and tooling used to troubleshoot operational issues. 

-Participates in operational support rotations, assisting in incident responses and root cause investigations. 

Compliance & Security: 

-Applies advanced security measures to protect data and applications in multi-tenant environments, including encryption and access controls. 

-Implements remediation plans to continuously improve security. 

-Collaborates with the team to ensure cloud infrastructure complies with relevant industry standards and regulations and that documentation is up-to-date

Automation & Change Management: 

-Maintains automation scripts and tools (e. g. , Infrastructure as Code (IaC)) for managing cloud infrastructure. 

-Adheres to change management plans for patching, updating, and rolling back applications. 

Core Responsibilities

Planning & Execution: 

-Track timelines with minimal supervision, ensuring work is completed in a timely manner and is in alignment with project requirements. 

-Prioritize and adjust work as resources or timelines change, with some guidance

Collaboration & Partnership:

Builds and maintains a comprehensive understanding of business, stakeholder, and/or customer needs to build and support effective partnerships. Actively listens to diverse perspectives and asks questions to ensure understanding of others. 

Problem Solving:

Analyzes data and/or information from multiple sources to troubleshoot standard and non-standard errors. Contributes to knowledge sharing and best practices

Continuous Learning: 

-Embraces continuous learning by actively seeking to build knowledge and new skills and/or tools, and staying current with industry trends and best practices. Seeks out and leverages feedback and training to improve skills. Contributes to a culture of continuous learning and knowledge sharing with team members. . 

Continuous Improvement: 

-Develops ideas and recommends updates to increase the efficiency and effectiveness of processes, protocols, and workflows within a team. Seeks input from team members on alternative approaches and methods for improving work.

data.description:
About The Company

Netspend Corporation is a global, vertically-integrated financial services and technology company dedicated to the delivery of innovative financial empowerment solutions to consumers worldwide. Netspend's financial products and services span prepaid, debit, cross-border payments, and loyalty solutions for consumers and enterprise partners. 

Netspend provides prepaid and debit account solutions that connect customers with secure, convenient access to global payment networks so they can manage their money and make everyday purchases. With a nationwide U. S. retail network, customers can purchase and reload Netspend products at 130, 000 reload points and over 100, 000 distributing locations. 

Since our founding in 1999 by industry pioneers, Netspend products have processed billions of dollars in transaction volume and served millions of customers worldwide. The company is headquartered in Austin, Texas with employees worldwide. 

About The Role

We are looking for an experienced Associate Senior Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET) to drive quality engineering, test automation, and reliability across a fintech technology ecosystem. The ideal candidate will have strong programming expertise, hands-on experience building scalable automation frameworks, and a deep understanding of API-driven, distributed, and cloud-native systems. You will work closely with development, DevOps, and product teams to ensure the quality, security, performance, and reliability of financial applications, payment workflows, and transaction-processing systems. 

Key Responsibilities

- Design, develop, and maintain scalable, reusable test automation frameworks for UI, API, integration, and end-to-end testing. 
 - Develop automated test solutions using Java, Python, or other suitable programming languages. 
 - Build and maintain automated test suites for REST APIs, microservices, GraphQL, databases, and asynchronous workflows. 
 - Validate financial transaction workflows, payment processing, transaction status updates, data integrity, and error-handling scenarios. 
 - Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines to enable continuous testing and reliable releases. 
 - Perform functional, regression, integration, performance, scalability, and reliability testing. 
 - Design and execute load and stress tests to evaluate system behaviour under peak transaction volumes. 
 - Investigate and troubleshoot complex defects across distributed systems and cloud-native applications. 
 - Collaborate with developers, architects, product managers, and DevOps teams to define test strategies and quality standards. 
 - Develop reusable automation libraries, test utilities, service mocks, and test data management solutions. 
 - Work with containerised applications and Kubernetes-based environments to validate service reliability and deployment quality. 
 - Monitor test execution results, analyse failures, and provide actionable insights through test reports and quality metrics. 
 - Test security-sensitive workflows, access controls, data validation, and negative scenarios. 
 - Mentor junior SDETs and contribute to automation best practices, code reviews, and continuous improvement initiatives. 
 - Own quality engineering activities from test planning and design through execution and release validation. 

Technical Skills - Requirements

- 6+ years of experience in software testing, test automation, and quality engineering, including substantial hands-on automation development. 
 - Must have strong coding experience of Java/ groovy, Selenium and Database(relational) Unit Testing framework and performance testing. 
 - Hands on experience in building testing framework(s) BDD Cucumber/TestNG
 - Must have hands on experience in Frontend automation using Selenium/appium or any other tool
 - Must have hands-on experience in Web Services Automation using Java/groovy. 
 - Must have hands-on experience in Database testing. Well versed with writing complex SQL. 
 - Must have knowledge of any build tool Gradle/Maven/ANT etc. 
 - Must have good knowledge of CI/CD on Jenkins/ Gitlab
 - Experience with Agile Methodologies, Tools (JIRA, Confluence). 
 - Must have hands-on knowledge in AI usage and AI tools. 
 - Must have exposure to design custom automation framework
 - Must have exposure in Continuous Integration using Bamboo/Jenkins
 - Must have exposure of Agile Methodology
 - Strong understanding of microservices architecture, distributed systems, asynchronous processing, and event-driven workflows. 
 - Good to have knowledge in performance & Security testing
 - Exposure of stored procedure and PL/SQL
 - Working knowledge of Unix commands
 - Good to have exposure in Mobile Automation using Appium/browserstack. 
 - Exposure of monitoring tools such as Splunk , Dynatrace etc. 
 - Excellent communication, documentation, and analytical skills; attention to detail, thoroughness and strong ownership of work. 
 - Strong expertise in API automation and REST API testing; familiarity with GraphQL is an advantage. 
 - Experience in performance and scalability testing, including load generation, bottleneck identification, and system behaviour analysis. 
 - Proficiency with Git-based workflows, debugging, troubleshooting, and code reviews. 
 - Strong ownership mindset and the ability to work independently in a fast-paced engineering environment. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or related field with 6+ years of experience
 - Experience in fintech, payments, digital banking, prepaid cards, or other financial technology platforms. 
 - Familiarity with payment processing workflows, transaction lifecycle management, reconciliation, and financial data validation. 
 - Knowledge of security testing principles, OWASP guidelines, authentication, authorisation, and secure API testing. 
 - Experience with performance testing tools such as JMeter, Gatling, or k6. 
 - Familiarity with service virtualisation and mocking tools such as WireMock. 
 - Experience with Helm, service mesh technologies, and cloud platforms such as AWS or Azure. 
 - Exposure to observability and monitoring tools such as Datadog, New Relic, or Splunk. 
 - Experience with test reporting, quality metrics, and automation coverage analysis. 

What We're Looking For

- A quality-focused engineer who builds robust automation solutions rather than relying solely on manual testing. 
 - A proactive problem-solver who identifies risks early and improves product reliability through effective test strategies. 
 - An engineering professional who can troubleshoot complex technical issues across services and infrastructure. 
 - Someone who values clean code, reusable frameworks, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

This role drives the delivery of high-quality software solutions by defining and executing effective test strategies, automation frameworks, and engineering best practices. Working closely with product, engineering, and business stakeholders, the position ensures successful project execution, risk mitigation, and alignment with organizational objectives. 

As per company policy, this role requires presence in the office 4 days per week. 

Responsibilities

Leadership, Mentorship & Cultural Awareness

- Lead, mentor, and inspire a team of software test engineers, fostering professional growth and technical mastery. 
 - Conduct regular one-on-one sessions, performance reviews, and provide constructive feedback. 
 - Demonstrate strong communication, empathy, and active listening skills to build trust and cohesion within the team.

 - Adapt leadership approaches to different cultural contexts, ensuring collaboration across global or cross-functional teams.

Onboarding & Knowledge Transfer

- Drive effective onboarding processes for new team members, ensuring they quickly gain the technical and domain knowledge needed to contribute successfully. 
 - Establish and maintain clear documentation, coding standards, and best practices to support long-term team efficiency. 
 - Promote structured knowledge-sharing sessions, pair programming, and cross-training to reduce single points of failure and build resilience within the team. 
 - Foster a culture where expertise is openly shared, enabling smooth transitions when responsibilities shift and ensuring continuity across projects. 
 - Leads and develops employees through strong influential skills & using a performance management and development process that provides an overall context and framework to engage employee contribution with goal setting, feedback, and performance development planning. 
 - Collaborates with Human Resources to build and develop capabilities, reduce 'single points of failure', depth, and diverse team to deliver against the product and technical roadmaps. 
 - Leverage resource capacity including assignments, training, leave management, telecommuting and administers continuous performance review program to ensure effectiveness, compliance, and equity within the organization. 

Technical Ownership & Project Delivery

- Oversee the design, development, and deployment of software solutions. 
 - Ensure adherence to coding standards, best practices, and architectural guidelines. 
 - Participate in reviews and contribute to hands-on development when needed. 
 - Collaborate with product managers, product owners, designers, and stakeholders to define requirements and translate them into technical solutions. 
 - Manage sprint planning, task allocation, and delivery timelines. 
 - Identify risks, resolve blockers, and ensure projects are delivered on time and within scope. 
 - Strive for 100% say-do ratio, meaning we deliver on our commitments. 
 - Owner of technical competencies within assigned area and facilitator/promoter to ensure these technologies are leveraged across the wider organization. 
 - Suggests and supports changes to systems, tools and processes to optimize overall business performance. 
 - Participates in strategic planning process for the relevant product. 
 - Works with Service to implement service concepts and requirements into new designs, technology and development. 
 - Works with Quality to ensure product quality during design and production. 
 - Collaborates closely with product line teams to transfer digital technologies from development into the new product introduction process. 
 - Adheres to the digital development process as well as the product lifecycle process whilst also actively driving improvements for best practice. 

Innovation & Continuous Improvement

- Stay updated with emerging technologies and industry trends. 
 - Drive process adherence, improvements, automation, and efficiency within the team. 
 - Champion a culture of innovation, knowledge sharing, and continuous learning. 

Troubleshooting & Problem Solving

- Act as the escalation point for complex technical issues, guiding the team in diagnosing and resolving problems efficiently. 
 - Apply and teach structured problem-solving techniques to identify root causes and implement sustainable solutions. 
 - Encourage a proactive mindset within the team, ensuring potential issues are anticipated and mitigated before they impact delivery. 
 - Balance short-term fixes with long-term improvements to maintain system stability and scalability. 
 - Think solutions rather than problems. 

Qualifications

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related field. 
 - Proven experience (5+ years) in software quality assurance, with at least 2 years in a leadership role. 
 - Strong proficiency in testing methodologies, test management and automation tools. 
 - Certificate of ISTQB Certified Tester Advanced Level Test Management advantageous. 
 - Solid understanding of software architecture, design patterns, and agile methodologies. 
 - Excellent problem-solving, communication, and interpersonal skills. 
 - Ability to balance technical depth with strategic leadership.
