Job Description

I&O Platform Infrastructure Application Performance Management and Logging (ELK) SME

Assistant Director | Enterprise Technology

The opportunity

In a plan to strengthen and extend our footprint in EY Enterprise Technology, we are looking for a proven Application Performance Management (APM) and Logging SME to support and evolve EY's monitoring and observability platforms globally. The role will provide engineering leadership, operational support, automation and lifecycle management for the firm's APM tooling and the ELK (Elasticsearch, Logstash, Kibana) stack. The successful candidate will work with cutting-edge observability technologies, driving platform maturity, operational excellence and engineering innovation across EY's global infrastructure estate. 

Your Key Responsibilities

The I&O Platform Infrastructure APM and Logging SME provides technical leadership and engineering of complex nature for the firm's application performance monitoring and centralized logging platforms. This professional applies knowledge of APM solutions, the ELK stack, log management, metrics pipelines and distributed tracing to support enterprise-scale workloads and enable rapid incident response. 

The role requires deep knowledge of the firm's infrastructure monitoring landscape to implement platform enhancements, lifecycle management activities, onboarding programs, security initiatives and operational improvements. The SME will serve as the subject matter authority for APM and logging platforms, partnering with application teams, infrastructure engineers and security stakeholders across global locations to ensure observability coverage, data quality and platform reliability. 

Skills And Attributes For Success

- Strong experience designing, deploying and administering ELK stack (Elasticsearch, Logstash, Kibana) at enterprise scale. 
 - Deep knowledge of APM tooling (e. g. , Dynatrace, AppDynamics, Elastic APM, New Relic or equivalent). 
 - Experience architecting centralized logging solutions and log aggregation pipelines. 
 - Strong understanding of metrics, traces and logs as the three pillars of observability. 
 - Experience with Elasticsearch cluster management, index lifecycle management (ILM) and snapshot/restore. 
 - Knowledge of Logstash pipeline development and Beats (Filebeat, Metricbeat, Winlogbeat) deployment. 
 - Experience building Kibana dashboards, visualizations and alerting rules. 
 - Experience with log parsing, field extraction, grok patterns and data enrichment. 
 - Knowledge of distributed tracing frameworks and instrumentation approaches. 
 - Strong scripting and automation skills, including: 
 - Python
 - PowerShell
 - Bash / Shell scripting
 - Experience integrating monitoring platforms with ITSM tooling (e. g. , ServiceNow). 
 - Ability to produce high-quality technical documentation, runbooks and operational procedures. 
 - Strong working knowledge of DevOps, Agile, Kanban, SCRUM and ITIL frameworks. 
 - Ability to work effectively with clients, management and global engineering teams across multiple time zones. 

To qualify for the role, you must have experience with

- ELK stack (Elasticsearch, Logstash, Kibana) - enterprise-scale deployment and administration. 7+ years. 
 - APM platform engineering and administration (Dynatrace, AppDynamics, Elastic APM or equivalent). 7+ years. 
 - Centralized logging architecture design and operations. 7+ years. 
 - Elasticsearch cluster management, performance tuning and capacity planning. 7+ years. 
 - Logstash pipeline development and Beats agent fleet management. 5-7 years. 
 - Kibana dashboard and visualization development. 5-7 years. 
 - Index lifecycle management (ILM), hot-warm-cold architecture and data tiering. 5-7 years. 
 - Log parsing, grok pattern development and field enrichment. 5-7 years. 
 - Metrics collection frameworks (Prometheus, InfluxDB, StatsD or equivalent). 
 - Distributed tracing - implementation, instrumentation and analysis. 
 - Alert management and notification workflows across monitoring platforms. 
 - SIEM integration and security event log forwarding. 
 - TLS/SSL configuration and security hardening of ELK components. 
 - Role-based access control (RBAC) within Elasticsearch and Kibana. 
 - Containerized deployment of ELK components (Docker, Kubernetes or OpenShift). 
 - CI/CD pipeline integration for monitoring-as-code and configuration management. 
 - Disaster Recovery and Business Continuity planning for monitoring platforms. 
 - Performance troubleshooting of high-ingestion Elasticsearch clusters (50 GB+/day). 
 - Onboarding application and infrastructure teams onto APM and logging platforms. 
 - Windows and Linux systems administration supporting ELK infrastructure. 

Ideally, you'll also have

- Elastic Certified Engineer or Elastic Certified Analyst certification (desired). 
 - Dynatrace Associate or Professional certification (desired). 
 - Microsoft Azure Administrator or equivalent cloud certification (desired). 
 - ITIL v4 Foundation certification (exclusionary). 
 - Experience with OpenTelemetry (OTel) standards and collector configuration. 
 - Experience with Elastic Cloud or Elastic Cloud on Kubernetes (ECK). 
 - Familiarity with cloud-native logging solutions (Azure Monitor, AWS CloudWatch, GCP Cloud Logging). 
 - Experience operating in a managed service or large enterprise shared services environment. 

What We Look For

An experienced and technically deep observability engineer and leader to help build, operate and modernize EY's APM and centralized logging platforms. We are looking for an individual with proven expertise in ELK stack engineering, strong APM platform knowledge, a passion for operational excellence and automation, and the ability to serve as the technical authority for monitoring and observability across EY's global infrastructure estate. 

What We Offer

We offer a competitive remuneration package where you'll be rewarded for your individual and team performance. Our comprehensive Total Rewards package includes support for flexible working and career development. Plus, we offer: 

- Continuous learning: You'll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.

 - Diverse and inclusive culture: You'll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.

 - Mentor and onboard new team members to support successful ramp-up and ongoing development. 
 - Collaborate with engineers, teams across Inovalon, and external customers to understand requirements, maintain a tight data-driven feedback loop, and participate in an on-call rotation to resolve critical issues within defined SLAs. 

What You'll Need

- Minimum 8+ years of related professional experience, with prior software engineering experience preferred. 
 - Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or Information Technology, or equivalent combination of education and experience required. 
 - 2+ years of experience leading design or architecture for new or existing services and systems, including design patterns, reliability, and scaling. 
 - Excellent programming skills in object-oriented programming languages, including . NET and C#, with experience in RESTful API development and EF Core mapping. 
 - Proficiency with Angular and TypeScript.

 - Demonstrate leadership by setting technical direction, influencing design decisions, mentoring engineers, and collaborating effectively across teams and with external customers. 
 - Demonstrate adaptability by adjusting to changing priorities, evolving architectures, production needs, and phased delivery requirements while staying focused on outcomes. 
 - Demonstrate creative thinking by identifying practical, innovative ways to improve service reliability, infrastructure, automation, and engineering efficiency. 
 - Demonstrate analytical skills by using metrics, engineering analysis, and sound judgment to diagnose issues, evaluate tradeoffs, and optimize system performance. 

Our Shared Commitments

- Maintain compliance with Inovalon's policies, procedures and mission statement. 
 - Adhere to all confidentiality and HIPAA requirements as outlined within Inovalon's Operating Policies and Procedures in all ways and at all times with respect to any aspect of the data handled or services rendered in the undertaking of the position. 
 - Fulfill those responsibilities and/or duties that may be reasonably provided by Inovalon for the purpose of achieving operational and financial success of Employer. 

Work Environment

- This is primarily a computer-based role performed in a remote, hybrid, or office environment. The role requires prolonged periods of computer use and frequent communication and interaction with others, either virtually and/or in person. The role may occasionally require transporting or moving work-related equipment weighing up to 10 pounds, such as a laptop and related materials. Some travel may be required, depending on the needs of the role. Reasonable accommodations may be provided to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the position, consistent with applicable law. 

This position is not eligible for immigration sponsorship (e. g. H-1B, TN, or E-3). Applicants must be authorized to work in the United States as a condition of employment. (This is only applicable for US-based positions)

If you don't meet every qualification listed but are excited about our mission and the work described, we encourage you to apply. Inovalon is most interested in finding the best candidate for the job, and you may be just the right person for this or other roles. 

By embracing inclusion, we enhance our work environment and drive business success. Inovalon strives to provide equal opportunities to the communities where we operate and to our clients and everyone whom we serve. We endeavor to create a culture of inclusion in which our associates feel empowered to bring their full, authentic selves to work and pursue their professional goals in an equitable setting. We understand that by fostering this type of culture, and welcoming different perspectives, we generate innovation and growth. 

Inovalon is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirement.

data.title: Senior Full Stack Engineer
data.description:
Job Description

Ciklum is looking for a Senior Full Stack Engineer to join our team full-time in India. 

We are a custom product engineering company that supports both multinational organizations and scaling startups to solve their most complex business challenges. With a global team of over 4, 000 highly skilled developers, consultants, analysts and product owners, we engineer technology that redefines industries and shapes the way people live. 

About The Role

As a Senior Full Stack Engineer become a part of a cross-functional development team engineering experiences of tomorrow. We are seeking an experienced Senior Full Stack Engineer with a proven background in Generative AI, Agentic Workflows, and Cloud Systems to design and deploy enterprise-grade intelligence platforms for our Pharmaceutical and Life Sciences portfolio. 

Responsibilities

- Agentic AI & GenAI Systems Architecture
 - Autonomous Multi-Agent Systems: Design, orchestrate, and deploy robust multi-agent graphs using LangGraph and LangChain for complex pharma workflows (e. g. , automated literature synthesis, adverse event extraction, clinical trial protocol drafting, internal code/data validation)
 - Enterprise RAG Architectures: Build and benchmark advanced RAG pipelines incorporating hybrid semantic search, domain-specific embeddings (e. g. , BioBERT, PubMedBERT), reranking, and chunking strategies on AWS OpenSearch and vector datastores
 - AWS Bedrock & Model Orchestration: Integrate foundation models (Claude/Anthropic, Llama, custom fine-tuned bio-LLMs) via AWS Bedrock. Experience implementing AWS Bedrock Agents / AgentCore and custom Action Groups for structured downstream execution
 - Agent Governance & Safety: Build deterministic guardrails using Amazon Bedrock Guardrails, automated citation attribution, hallucinations detection, human-in-the-loop (HITL) checkpoints, and audit trails required for clinical reproducibility
 - Full-Stack Microservices & Platform Engineering
 - Backend Development: Build production-grade, asynchronous RESTful and streaming APIs using Python (FastAPI), managing complex state lifecycles and background worker processes (Celery/Redis/SQS)
 - Frontend Engineering: Engineer rich, responsive web applications in React. js (TypeScript), crafting intuitive interfaces for complex clinical dashboards, token-streaming chats, graph visualizations, and validation workflows
 - Database & Persistence: Design high-throughput relational and non-relational schemas (PostgreSQL/PGVector, DynamoDB, DocumentDB/MongoDB) handling structured metadata and unstructured clinical assets
 - Cloud, Security & Regulatory Compliance (GxP / Healthcare)
 - Cloud Infrastructure: Architect containerized solutions using Docker, orchestrated via AWS ECS (Fargate) or Kubernetes, paired with serverless triggers (Lambda, Step Functions, EventBridge, S3)
 - Pharma & Healthcare Compliance: Implement end-to-end data security controls for PHI/PII protection in compliance with HIPAA, GDPR, GxP, and 21 CFR Part 11
 - Auditability & Validation: Implement immutable audit logging, SOUP (Software of Unknown Provenance) scanning, anti-malware workflows, SonarQube quality gates, and automated test pipelines using pytest and Playwright/Selenium

Requirements

- Total Experience: 6+ years of full-stack software development, with at least 2 years of direct experience building and deploying GenAI and Agentic workflows in production
 - Python Mastery: Expert in Python 3. x, FastAPI, async programming, and enterprise API design patterns
 - Modern Frontend: Strong hands-on proficiency in React. js, state management (Redux Toolkit/Zustand), WebSockets/Server-Sent Events (SSE) for real-time model streaming, and scientific data visualization libraries
 - Production Agentic AI
 - Proven production deployment of agentic workflows using LangGraph (state graphs, cyclical workflows, reflection, and multi-agent debate/handoffs) and LangChain
 - Deep experience in Tool Calling, Function Calling, Dynamic Routing, and Model Context Protocol (MCP)
 - Hands-on expertise building enterprise RAG systems with query rewriting, self-correction, and hybrid search
 - AWS Ecosystem: Deep hands-on experience with AWS Bedrock, OpenSearch, ECS, Lambda, S3, IAM, CloudWatch, and EventBridge
 - DevOps & Testing: Solid containerization expertise (Docker), GitLab CI/CD or GitHub Actions, static security analysis, unit testing (pytest), and integration testing

Desirable

- Domain Knowledge: Prior exposure to Pharmaceutical, Biotech, Clinical Trials, Pharmacovigilance, or Medical Imaging (DICOM standards, AWS HealthImaging, clinical data formats such as CDISC/FHIR/HL7)
 - AWS Agentic Specialization: Hands-on experience with AWS Bedrock Agents / AgentCore configuration and OpenAPI schemas
 - Model Training & Fine-Tuning: Familiarity with hosting and experimenting with specialized open-weight models (BioMistral, Med-PaLM, Ollama, Hugging Face) using AWS SageMaker
 - Certifications: AWS Certified Solutions Architect (Associate/Professional) or AWS Machine Learning Specialty

What's in it for you?

- Strong community: Work alongside top professionals in a friendly, open-door environment
 - Growth focus: Take on large-scale projects with a global impact and expand your expertise
 - Tailored learning: Boost your skills with internal events (meetups, conferences, workshops), Udemy access, language courses, and company-paid certifications
 - Endless opportunities: Explore diverse domains through internal mobility, finding the best fit to gain hands-on experience with cutting-edge technologies
 - Care: We've got you covered with company-paid medical insurance, mental health support, and financial & legal consultations

About Us

At Ciklum, we are always exploring innovations, empowering each other to achieve more, and engineering solutions that matter. With us, you'll work with cutting-edge technologies, contribute to impactful projects, and be part of a One Team culture that values collaboration and progress. 

India is a strategic innovation hub for Ciklum, with growing teams in Chennai and Pune leading advancements in EdgeTech, AR/VR, IoT, and beyond. Join us to collaborate on game-changing solutions and take your career to the next level. 

Explore, empower, engineer with Ciklum!

Interested already? We would love to get to know you! Submit your application. We can't wait to see you at Ciklum.

data.title: Principal Test Engineer
data.description:
Renesas is a global semiconductor company providing hardware and software solutions for advanced automotive, industrial, infrastructure, data-centre and smart-home applications. We are a dynamic, multicultural technology company where employees learn, mentor, innovate and thrive while helping shape what is next in electronics. 

Job Description

IFI (India for India) organization is seeking a Principal Test Engineer to define and deliver robust, cost-effective production test solutions for new semiconductor products from concept through mass production and sustaining support. In this lead role, the principal test engineer owns the test strategy, ATE test development, test hardware, test validation, qualification and production release, test-cost optimization and industrial activities. 

Key Responsibilities

- Define the production test strategy and manufacturing test flow for assigned products including tester selection
 - Own the test planning
 - Provide testability input to DFT, DFM and design reviews before tapeout
 - Define detailed test plan covering ATE implementation
 - Lead test hardware requirements and development, including loadboards, probe cards, sockets, interface hardware and related fixtures. 
 - Develop and review ATE test programs, test methods, production patterns and supporting software. 
 - Lead first-silicon ATE bring-up, test program debug and sample generation. 
 - Execute ATE characterization across process, voltage and temperature conditions in alignment with the product characterization plan. 
 - Support qualification and customer sample generation by developing dedicated test programs
 - Identify test coverage gaps and potential escapes, then implement containment and permanent corrective actions

data.description:
About CertifyOS

CertifyOS is building the data infrastructure that powers modern healthcare. 

Today, healthcare organizations rely on fragmented and outdated provider data. This creates unnecessary administrative work, regulatory risk, and higher costs across the system. We're solving that problem. 

Our API-first platform automates provider licensing, enrollment, credentialing, and network monitoring by connecting directly to hundreds of primary data sources. We help healthcare organizations maintain accurate, compliant, and reliable provider networks at scale. 

Our vision is simple: One API. One provider ID. Frictionless provider data. 

We're backed by leading investors and built by a team with deep experience in provider data systems. At CertifyOS, we value authenticity, accountability, collaboration, results, and openness to feedback. We're building a high-ownership team focused on solving real infrastructure problems that impact millions of patients. 

About The Role

We are looking for an AI-first Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET) to help us build reliable, scalable, and high-quality software. 

This role goes beyond traditional QA and test automation. You will leverage AI-assisted engineering and agentic workflows to accelerate test development, improve test coverage, automate quality checks, and identify performance and scalability issues. 

You will work closely with developers, product managers, and engineering leaders to embed quality throughout the software development lifecycle. 

We expect you to think like a software engineer, automate like an SDET, and use AI as a force multiplier. 

Key Responsibilities

- AI-First Quality Engineering
 - Adopt AI-assisted and agentic approaches across the testing lifecycle. 
 - Use AI coding agents to generate, execute, debug, and maintain automated tests. 
 - Build AI-assisted workflows for test case generation from product specifications and acceptance criteria. 
 - Explore agentic testing approaches that can independently execute workflows, identify failures, and report defects. 
 - Use AI to analyse test failures, identify patterns, and suggest potential root causes. 
 - Continuously identify opportunities to reduce manual effort through AI and automation. 
 - Test Automation
 - Build and maintain scalable automation frameworks for UI, API, integration, and end-to-end testing. 
 - Develop reusable test components and automation libraries. 
 - Automate critical business workflows and regression suites. 
 - Integrate automated testing into CI/CD pipelines. 
 - Use Playwright, Cypress, Selenium, or equivalent frameworks. 
 - Performance & Load Testing
 - Design and execute load, stress, spike, and endurance tests. 
 - Simulate real-world traffic, concurrent users, and high-volume API requests. 
 - Establish performance benchmarks and service-level objectives. 
 - Identify bottlenecks across APIs, databases, microservices, and infrastructure. 
 - Use tools such as k6, JMeter, Locust, or Gatling. 
 - Analyse latency, throughput, resource utilisation, and error rates. 
 - Work with developers to identify and resolve performance bottlenecks. 
 - Scalability & Reliability Engineering
 - Validate application behaviour as traffic, data volume, and workloads increase. 
 - Identify scalability limitations across distributed systems. 
 - Test asynchronous workflows, queues, event processing, retries, and failure recovery. 
 - Evaluate database performance and query efficiency under load. 
 - Identify resource constraints and potential points of failure. 
 - Contribute to capacity planning and reliability improvements. 
 - Engineering Collaboration
 - Work with developers and product managers to identify quality risks early. 
 - Participate in technical design and code reviews. 
 - Define quality gates and automation standards. 
 - Build a culture where quality is everyone's responsibility. 

Required Skills & Experience

- 3-6 years of experience in software testing and automation engineering. 
 - Strong programming skills in Python, Java, or JavaScript/TypeScript. 
 - Hands-on experience with Playwright, Cypress, or Selenium. 
 - Strong API automation and backend testing experience. 
 - Experience with performance testing tools such as k6, JMeter, or Locust. 
 - Understanding of microservices and distributed systems. 
 - Good knowledge of SQL and database testing. 
 - Experience integrating automated tests into CI/CD pipelines. 
 - Practical experience using AI coding assistants and AI agents. 
 - Ability to analyse logs, metrics, and performance bottlenecks. 

AI & Emerging Engineering Practices

We Expect Candidates To

- Be comfortable working with AI coding agents such as Claude Code, Cursor, or GitHub Copilot. 
 - Use AI to generate test scenarios, automation scripts, and test data. 
 - Understand how to validate AI-generated code and prevent unreliable tests. 
 - Explore agentic workflows for autonomous test execution and failure analysis. 
 - Build reusable AI-powered testing workflows rather than relying only on manual prompting. 

Good to Have

- Experience with AWS or GCP. 
 - Familiarity with Docker and Kubernetes. 
 - Experience with Kafka or other messaging systems. 
 - Exposure to Grafana, Prometheus, Datadog, or similar observability tools. 
 - Knowledge of chaos engineering and resilience testing.

What Success Looks Like

 - Reliable performance benchmarks for critical APIs and workflows. 
 - Early detection of performance and scalability bottlenecks. 
 - Improved release confidence as product traffic and data volumes grow. 
 - Continuous improvement in engineering productivity through AI adoption. 

Benefits Of Working At Certify

Our US-based team benefits from unlimited PTO, with at least two weeks off each year to recharge.  - Make organizational, staffing, prioritization, and delivery decisions with medium- to long-term impact. 
 - Create alignment across senior engineers, Product, Architecture, Security, and business stakeholders. 
 - Improve delivery predictability, platform adoption, engineering quality, and operational reliability. 
 - Scale the organization through clear ownership, repeatable engineering practices, and strong technical leadership. 
 - Ensure the team can deliver effectively without depending excessively on any single individual. 

Must Have Qualifications

- 15+ years of experience in software engineering, with at least 4+ years in an engineering people-management or team-leadership role.

 - Experience with AI evaluation platforms, model gateways, vector databases, prompt lifecycle management, or AI observability tools.

 - Experience in enterprise middleware, workflow orchestration, ERP, automation, or integration platforms. 
 - Experience balancing greenfield platform development with the modernization of existing enterprise products. 
 - Experience working in regulated, security-sensitive, or high-availability environments.

Bristlecone India Limited is seeking a seasoned Technical Lead for its Smart Integration (API) - Delivery team. The role involves leading the design, development, and deployment of scalable Java‐based integration solutions, guiding architecture decisions across microservices, SOA, and cloud‐native environments, and collaborating closely with clients to translate business needs into robust, secure APIs. 

Responsibilities

- Architect and develop high‐performance Java APIs and integration services (REST, SOAP, OData). 
 - Lead a team of developers, providing mentorship, code reviews, and technical guidance. 
 - Design data models and implement solutions using relational (PostgreSQL) and NoSQL (MongoDB) databases. 
 - Define and enforce security best practices throughout the software lifecycle. 
 - Drive CI/CD pipelines, containerization (Docker) and orchestration (Kubernetes) initiatives. 
 - Collaborate with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud) to design scalable, resilient solutions. 
 - Lead technical discussions and solution presentations with clients and stakeholders. 
 - Evaluate and integrate Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC) or comparable integration platforms. 
 - Establish architectural standards, design patterns, and documentation for the integration portfolio. 
 - Monitor production systems, troubleshoot issues, and continuously improve performance and reliability. 

Qualifications

- 8-12 years of software development experience, with at least 3-5 years in a senior or lead role. 
 - Strong proficiency in core Java and building scalable Java applications. 
 - Deep understanding of software design patterns, microservices, monolithic, SOA, and cloud‐native architectures. 
 - Hands‐on experience building and consuming REST, SOAP, and OData web services. 
 - Proficiency with relational (PostgreSQL) and NoSQL (MongoDB) databases and data modeling. 
 - Knowledge of software security principles and ability to embed security into designs. 
 - Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud) and associated architecture patterns. 
 - Hands‐on experience with CI/CD pipelines, Docker, and Kubernetes. 
 - Familiarity with Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC) or similar integration platforms (highly preferred). 
 - Excellent communication skills for client interaction and technical leadership. 

About Us

ABOUT US

Bristlecone is the leading provider of AI-powered application transformation services for the connected supply chain. We empower our customers with speed, visibility, automation, and resiliency - to thrive on change. 

Our transformative solutions in Digital Logistics, Cognitive Manufacturing, Autonomous Planning, Smart Procurement and Digitalization are positioned around key industry pillars and delivered through a comprehensive portfolio of services spanning digital strategy, design and build, and implementation across a range of technology platforms. 

Bristlecone is ranked among the top ten leaders in supply chain services by Gartner. We are headquartered in San Jose, California, with locations across North America, Europe and Asia, and over 2, 500 consultants. Bristlecone is part of the $19. 4 billion Mahindra Group. 

Equal Opportunity Employer

Bristlecone is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status . 

Information Security Responsibilities

- Understand and adhere to Information Security policies, guidelines and procedure, practice them for protection of organizational data and Information System. 
 - Take part in information security training and act while handling information. 
 - Report all suspected security and policy breach to InfoSec team or appropriate authority (CISO). 
 - Understand and adhere to the additional information security responsibilities as part of the assigned job role.

data.description:
Company Description

It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. That moment inspired Fred to build a company that could do that for everyone-freeing people from busywork so they could focus on meaningful work. Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention. Our ServiceNow AI platform brings together any AI, any data, and any workflow- helping 85% of the Fortune 500® work smarter, faster, and better. We're building an AI-native culture where technology and talent are unstoppable together. And we're just getting started. 

Join us to put AI to work for people. 

Job Description

Staff Software Engineer - ITAM and AI Cost

We're looking for a Staff Full Stack Developer to help build and scale our AI-powered tools for application development. You'll work at the intersection of UI, backend, and AI-driven engineering - architecting solutions that improve developer experience, expand platform capabilities, and drive engineering excellence across the team. 

The Software Asset Management product(ITAM) empowers organizations to manage software licensing and compliance with precision. Our engineers build performance-efficient algorithms that help customers achieve the most accurate licensing position possible. You'll be responsible for the full software development lifecycle-from design and implementation to testing and delivery-while partnering closely with product managers, architects, and quality engineers. Together, we improve product quality, efficiency, and performance. The SAM team is deeply aligned with company priorities and market expectations, delivering solutions that matter. 

You will be building the next generation of AI Cost Management capabilities that help enterprises understand, govern, optimise, and control AI spending across large-scale AI ecosystems. The product provides visibility into AI consumption, cost attribution, budgeting, forecasting, spend controls, alerts, and vendor integrations across AI services such as Anthropic, OpenAI, Microsoft Copilot, and future AI providers. 

What You Get To Do In This Role

- Design and implement AI-Native product development, using cutting-edge technical approaches to deliver business value
 - Build high-quality, clean, scalable, and reusable code by enforcing best practices around software engineering architecture and processes (Code Reviews, Unit Testing, etc. )
 - Own your code from design through implementation, test automation, and delivery
 - Collaborate with product managers to define feature sets that solve real customer problems
 - Work with architects to shape product design and with QE to enhance quality and performance
 - Contribute to new product features and enhance existing offerings
 - Mentor peers and promote knowledge-sharing across the team

Qualifications

To be successful in this role you have: 

- Experience in leveraging critical thinking about how to integrate AI into work processes, decision-making, or problem-solving. This may include using AI-powered tools, automating workflows, analyzing AI-driven insights, or exploring AI's potential impact on the function or industry. 
 - 8+ years of experience in software engineering, with a track record of delivering high-quality products. 
 - Hands-on experience with columnar/analytical data stores (e. g. , ClickHouse, Apache Druid, Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift, or Vertica), including schema design, partitioning, and query optimization for large-scale analytical workloads. 
 - Experience building and operating distributed data pipelines for high-volume ingestion, transformation, and reconciliation (e. g. , Apache Spark, Kafka, Flink, Airflow, or dbt). 
 - Experience creating dashboards and analytic reports with tools such as Power BI, Tableau, or Looker. 
 - Proficiency in Python, Java, or similar object-oriented languages. 
 - Experience with modern front-end frameworks such as Angular, React, or Vue. 
 - Strong knowledge of data structures, algorithms, object-oriented design, design patterns, and performance optimization 
 - Familiarity with automated testing frameworks (e. g. , JUnit, Playwright, TestNG) and integrating tests into CI/CD pipelines 
 - Understanding software quality principles including reliability, observability, and production readiness. 
 - Ability to troubleshoot complex systems and optimize performance across the stack. 
 - Experience with AI-powered tools or workflows, including validation of datasets, model predictions, and inference consistency. 
 - Comfort with development tools such as IDEs, debuggers, profilers, source control, and Unix-based systems

Why Join Us

- Build and deliver high-impact AI Native products that powers digital experiences for millions of users. 
 - Collaborate in a culture that values craftsmanship, quality, and innovation. 
 - Work as AI Native engineer and us AI productivity and automation tools that enhance engineering excellence and drive product reliability. 
 - Be part of a culture that encourages innovation, continuous learning, and shared success. 

Additional Information

Work Personas

We approach our distributed world of work with flexibility and trust. Work personas (flexible, remote, or required in office) are categories that are assigned to ServiceNow employees depending on the nature of their work and their assigned work location. Learn more here. To determine eligibility for a work persona, ServiceNow may confirm the distance between your primary residence and the closest ServiceNow office using a third-party service. 

Equal Opportunity Employer

ServiceNow is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, gender identity, veteran status, or any other category protected by law. In addition, all qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with legal requirements. 

Accommodations

We strive to create an accessible and inclusive experience for all candidates. If you require a reasonable accommodation to complete any part of the application process, or are unable to use this online application and need an alternative method to apply, please contact globaltalentss@servicenow. com for assistance. 

Export Control Regulations

For positions requiring access to controlled technology subject to export control regulations, including the U. S. Export Administration Regulations (EAR), ServiceNow may be required to obtain export control approval from government authorities for certain individuals. All employment is contingent upon ServiceNow obtaining any export license or other approval that may be required by relevant export control authorities.

Company Description

Experian is a global data and technology company, powering opportunities for people and businesses around the world. We operate across a range of markets, from financial services to healthcare, automotive, agribusiness, insurance, and many more. Experian invests in people and new advanced technologies to unlock the power of data. We have an amazing team of 25, 200 people in 32 countries. 

Our uniqueness is that we celebrate yours. Experian's people first, inclusive and purpose driven culture is multi award-winning; World's Best WorkplacesTM 2025 (Fortune Global Top 25), Great Place To WorkTM in 26 countries to name a few. 

Check out Experian Life on social or explore our Careers Site (experian. com/careers) to understand why. 

Job Description

- We are building a shared Agentic AI Platform that enables teams across the enterprise to design, deploy, and operate AI-powered agents and workflows safely, consistently, and at scale. 
 - This role is for a builder-architect, someone with software and systems foundations who can operate hands-on while also shaping architectural direction across teams. 
 - You will design and build core agentic AI platform capabilities while actively ensuring teams adopt shared primitives rather than creating fragmented, one-off solutions. 
 - The role combines hands-on engineering, Platform architecture, and cross-enterprise influence, with a emphasis on reuse, cohesion, and long-term sustainability. 
 - You will be based in Hyderabad and reporting to Director Engineering. 
 - This is Individual contributor role ( Non Managerial ). 
 - What you'll do here: 
 - Design and build foundational platform capabilities for agentic AI systems, including orchestration, lifecycle management, memory patterns, runtime policy and human-in-the-loop controls. 
 - Establish agent discovery, registration, and reuse mechanisms (e. g. , registries, marketplaces, protocol integration) as shared platform capabilities. 
 - You will define and evolve durable architectural patterns, reference architectures, and golden paths for multi-agent coordination, bounded autonomy, failure handling, and system evolution. 
 - Design secure-by-default architectures that embed governance, policy enforcement, auditability, and access control into agentic systems and AI workflows. 
 - You will build reusable AI workflow primitives that teams can adopt consistently across the enterprise. 
 - Partner with enterprise teams (e. g. , Cloud, Security, ITSM etc. ) to integrate AI workflows into existing enterprise systems and platforms. 
 - Maintain a bird's-eye view of Agentic AI and AI Workflow initiatives across the enterprise, identifying the opportunities to reduce fragmentation and promote convergence. 
 - Mentor engineers and influence technical direction through hands-on contribution, design leadership, and clear reasoning. 

Qualifications

Must have skills: 

- 8+ years of experience in designing, building, and operating cloud-native software systems in production environments, with depth in platform, infrastructure, or distributed systems. 
 - Expertise to tradeoffs across scalability, reliability, security, cost, and developer experience. 
 - Experience designing or operating systems that incorporate LLMs or AI models as core components, including managing model interaction, control flow, and failure modes. 
 - Proficiency in Python (and/or Java or Scala) for building backend services, frameworks, or SDKs. 
 - Experience with public cloud platforms (AWS preferred), including compute, networking, storage, and security primitives. 
 - Demonstrated experience owning and evolving shared platform architectures over time, including setting boundaries, managing tradeoffs, and adapting designs as scale and requirements change. 
 - Proven ability to drive architectural alignment across teams through technical influence, design reviews, reference architectures, and hands-on collaboration rather than formal authority. 
 - Exposure to agent frameworks, multi-agent systems, or AI orchestration tools. 
 - Experience designing systems with explicit state management, lifecycle control, and correctness guarantees across asynchronous and long-running workflows. 
 - Experience working with orchestration systems, workflow engines, or event-driven architectures. 
 - Experience with authentication, authorization, and delegated access patterns, including OAuth 2. 0 and related standards, as applied to service-to-service and user-mediated workflows. 
 - Experience building internal developer platforms, shared services, or reusable runtime frameworks. 
 - Staying hands-on with emerging AI capabilities and tools that informs system and platform design decisions. 

Who Thrives In This Role

- You think beyond individual teams and care deeply about ecosystem health. 
 - You enjoy influencing architecture across organizational boundaries. 
 - You are comfortable operating in designing systems that must evolve. 
 - You value reuse, cohesion, and long-term sustainability over short-term speed. 

Additional Information

Our uniqueness is that we celebrate yours. Experian's culture and people are important differentiators. We take our people agenda very seriously and focus on what matters; DEI, work/life balance, development, authenticity, collaboration, wellness, reward & recognition, volunteering. . . the list goes on. Experian's people first approach is award-winning; World's Best WorkplacesTM 2024 (Fortune Global Top 25), Great Place To WorkTM in 24 countries, and Glassdoor Best Places to Work 2024 to name a few. Check out Experian Life on social or our Careers Site and Glassdoor to understand why. 

Experian is also proud to be an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know at the earliest opportunity. 

Recruitment Fraud Awareness - Experian's recruitment process is conducted only through authorised channels. Recruitment communications will only be sent from an @experian. com email address. Experian will never ask candidates to make any payment as part of an application, interview, assessment, onboarding, or recruitment process. To apply for roles or verify opportunities, please visit experian. com/careers. 

Benefits

Experian care for employee's work life balance, health, safety and wellbeing. In support of this endeavor, we offer best-in-class family well-being benefits, enhanced medical benefits and paid time off. 

This is a hybrid role.

data.description:
Introduction

A career in IBM Consulting is built on long-term client relationships and close collaboration worldwide. You'll work with leading companies across industries, helping them shape their hybrid cloud and AI journeys. With support from our strategic partners, robust IBM technology, and Red Hat, you'll have the tools to drive meaningful change and accelerate client impact. At IBM Consulting, curiosity fuels success. You'll be encouraged to challenge the norm, explore new ideas, and create innovative solutions that deliver real results. Our culture of growth and empathy focuses on your long-term career development while valuing your unique skills and experiences. 

Your Role And Responsibilities

As an Application Developer: AWS Cloud FullStack, you will work in a modern cloud-native environment, building solutions around microservices, API-driven architectures, and continuous release cycles. You will collaborate with teams to deliver scalable and resilient applications using Agile methodologies. 

Your Primary Responsibilities Will Include

- Develop Rich UI Applications: Design and implement rich user interface applications using Single Page Applications (SPA) or microfrontends, utilizing frameworks such as ReactJS or Angular. 
 - Build Scalable Backend Microservices: Develop scalable and resilient backend microservices based on 12-factor principles, exposing functionality via API and event interfaces, using programming languages such as Java, NodeJS, or Python. 
 - Implement Data Modeling: Design and implement data models using modern SQL and No-SQL modeling techniques, ensuring data consistency and integrity. 
 - Develop Event-Driven Applications: Build event-driven applications using Kafka, Zookeeper, and other hyperscaler cloud services, ensuring seamless communication between microservices. 
 - Manage AWS Services: Run and manage services on AWS, including PaaS, routing services, databases, event-driven services, observability, and DevSecOps tools, ensuring efficient and secure application deployment. 

Preferred Education

Master's Degree

Required Technical And Professional Expertise

- Cloud-Native Development Experience: Exposure to developing applications in a modern cloud-native environment, utilizing microservices, API-driven architectures, and continuous release cycles via Agile methodologies. 
 - Programming Language Proficiency: Experience with one or more programming languages, including Java, NodeJS, Python, or . Net, and proficiency in frameworks such as Springboot, Quarkus, Django, or Express Js. 
 - Data Modeling Knowledge: Experience with modern SQL and No-SQL modeling techniques, including data model design and implementation. 
 - Hyperscaler Cloud Services: Exposure to hyperscaler cloud services, including Kafka, Zookeeper, and AWS services such as EKS, ECS, Fargate, Lambda, and API Gateway. 
 - DevSecOps Tools: Experience with DevSecOps tools, including CodeBuild, CodeDeploy, CodePipeline, CodeCommit, and observability tools such as CloudWatch and X-Ray. 

Preferred Technical And Professional Experience

- Proficiency in Additional Frameworks: Experience with frameworks such as Quarkus, Django, or Express Js, in addition to Springboot, is beneficial for building scalable and resilient backend microservices. 
 - Knowledge of Multiple Programming Languages: Exposure to multiple programming languages, including Java, NodeJS, Python, or . Net, can enhance development capabilities in a modern cloud-native environment. 
 - Familiarity with AWS Services: Experience with various AWS services, including CloudFront, Lambda@Edge, and AWS MSKafka, can be advantageous in managing and deploying applications on AWS.

data.title: Senior Software Developer - Mobile (Kotlin)
data.description:
Job Type

Full-time

Description

Veryon is a global information services and software company that exists to make flying safer and more reliable. Our products help reduce operating costs, improve aircraft reliability, and support technical knowledge sharing and collaboration within the general, business, and commercial aviation, as well as military/defense and OEM industries. 

Reporting to the Manager of Engineering, the Senior Software Engineer will contribute to the design and development of modern mobile applications using Kotlin Multiplatform (KMP/KMM). We are looking for someone with strong hands-on technical expertise, a passion for clean, scalable code, and solid problem-solving skills. This role will focus on designing, writing, and reviewing shared and platform-specific code, while collaborating closely with product, design, and quality teams to deliver high-quality mobile software that meets business objectives. 

The Day To Day

- Design and develop cross-platform mobile applications using Kotlin Multiplatform, sharing business logic across Android and iOS while leveraging native platform capabilities where appropriate. 
 - Build and maintain shared KMP modules (networking, domain, data, caching) and integrate them with Android (Jetpack/Compose) and iOS (Swift/SwiftUI/UIKit) layers. 
 - Write clean, efficient, testable, and well-documented Kotlin code, ensuring high performance and maintainability. 
 - Collaborate with product managers, designers, QA, and backend engineers to translate business requirements into scalable mobile solutions. 
 - Participate actively in Agile ceremonies including sprint planning, daily stand-ups, backlog grooming, and retrospectives. 
 - Conduct and participate in code reviews, ensuring adherence to mobile and KMP/KMM best practices. 
 - Continuously evaluate new mobile technologies, KMP/KMM libraries, and tooling to improve development efficiency and product quality. 
 - Provide technical guidance and mentoring to junior engineers, especially around mobile architecture and shared code strategies. 

Requirements

- 2-5 years of hands-on experience in mobile application development using Kotlin multi platform. 
 - Proven experience with Kotlin Multiplatform (KMP), including sharing business logic across Android and iOS. 
 - Strong proficiency in Kotlin, including coroutines, flows, and modern language features
 - Solid understanding of mobile architecture patterns (MVVM, MVI, Clean Architecture). 
 - Experience integrating KMP/KMM modules with Android (Compose / XML) and iOS (Swift / SwiftUI / UIKit). 
 - Experience implementing platform-specific functionality using expect/actual patterns or native interop with Swift and Android APIs. 
 - Strong experience in RESTful API integration, including authentication, error handling, and performance optimization. 
 - Demonstrated ability to optimize mobile app performance and handle scalability challenges. 
 - Experience building offline-capable mobile applications, including local persistence, caching strategies, and data synchronization. 
 - Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, Git-based version control, and mobile build/distribution workflows. 
 - Experience providing technical guidance or mentoring to peers or junior engineers. 
 - Exposure to cross-platform frameworks such as . NET MAUI, Xamarin, or Flutter is an added advantage. 
 - Bachelor's degree in computer science, Computer Engineering, or a related field. 

What You'll Accomplish - Your Performance ObjectivesObjective #1 In your first 30 days: 

- Develop a basic understanding of applications by working with the team
 - Familiarize yourself with the technical implementations of mobile apps
 - Approve your first merge request through our peer review process. 

Objective #2 In your first 3 months: 

- Work with the development and QA teams to deliver your first feature to production
 - Work with the dev ops team to support the automation of our build and deployment processes, and to implement feature flagging
 - Ramp up on the existing codebase, tools, and development workflows. 
 - Participate in code reviews and team discussions to share insights and learn best practices. 
 - Contribute to identifying areas of technical improvement and begin proposing solutions or enhancements. Objective #3 In your first 12 months: 
 - Consistently contribute to the on-time delivery of features and bug fixes using Agile methodologies. 
 - Take ownership of key components or modules, ensuring their quality, scalability, and maintainability. 
 - Collaborate across teams to support technology and process improvements within engineering and related functions. 
 - Actively participate in architectural discussions, code reviews, and continuous improvement initiatives. 
 - Contribute to the knowledge base by documenting best practices and mentoring newer team members. Who We're Looking For - The Personal Competencies That Matter Collaborative: You have empathy for your colleagues and customers. You demonstrate cross-functional collaboration within the engineering teams and seek out opportunities to build relationships with others throughout the company. You understand we are all on the same team working towards the same goals. Intellectually Curious: You have a strong level of curiosity and care about learning. You understand that learning is a continuous part of being an engineering manager and are always looking for ways to sharpen and/or broaden your skillset. Flexibility: You understand that priorities and requirements will evolve, and you may have to be flexible in your approach and in your expectations. You are open-minded and adapt well to changing environments as a company grows and scales. You aren't afraid to step outside your comfort zone and take the initiative to help the team succeed. Technical Skills: You have technical expertise across numerous technologies, and the ability to train and mentor your team on how and when to utilize them. How We Work - The Core Values That We Live By
 - Fueled By Customers: We work hard so our customers can get more uptime. A customer-centered approach is on the forefront of our minds. We're big on transparent communication with our customers, and we celebrate their wins internally because we love the positive impact we're making on their lives. 
 - Win Together: We focus on the "we" and not the "me". Collaboration is key, we value diverse backgrounds and skill sets. Our mission is to win as a team; we think everyone plays an integral part in our success. 
 - Make it Happen: When we make a commitment, we get it done. We take a proactive approach, we commit, we adapt to evolving landscapes and problems, we tackle problems at every difficulty level. 
 - Innovate to Elevate: We set the standard in aviation by embracing and advancing cutting edge technology. We take a fail-forward approach using everything as a learning experience. We encourage creativity and experimentation within our teams. This helps us set the bar high and provide world class expertise in aviation. 

Notice of AI Use in Job Application Review

As part of our commitment in creating a fair, efficient, and consistent hiring process we may use artificial intelligence (AI) to help our recruiting teams organize, summarize, and analyze information provided by candidates, including resumes, application responses, and other materials submitted during the application process. AI may be used to identify patterns, highlight relevant skills, and experience, and assist in comparing a candidate's qualifications with the requirement of a specific role. These tools are to improve efficiency and consistency while supporting more informed hiring decisions, which will ultimately be made by the hiring team.

data.title: Software Dev Engineer II,  Detail Page
data.description:
Description

The Detail Page is where Amazon customers decide what to buy. Every day, hundreds of millions of shoppers land on a product page to discover, evaluate and compare products and offers on mobile, desktop and app, and this surface drives the majority of purchase decisions on Amazon. The Detail Page team builds that experience, along with the platform that lets hundreds of partner teams across Amazon ship features to the page safely and quickly. We are reinventing how the page is built, moving to a modern federated architecture and making AI agents a first-class part of how we design, test and ship software. 

As an SDE II, you will own the design and delivery of significant features and services on one of Amazon's highest-traffic pages, where every millisecond of latency and every point of availability matters to customers. You will work on real distributed-systems problems at a scale few places can offer, see your code reach customers worldwide within days, and help shape the technical direction of a page that nearly every Amazon shopper sees. If you love building for customers at massive scale and want your work to matter on day one, we would love to hear from you. 

Key job responsibilities

- Design, build and own features and services end to end, from requirements and design through launch and operations. 
 - Build for scale, writing high-quality, well-tested code that is fast, reliable and safe to deploy on a tier-1 customer surface. 
 - Improve latency, availability and operational health, and take part in on-call, especially through peak events like Prime Day. 
 - Partner with Product, UX and partner teams across Amazon to turn ambiguous ideas into shipped, measurable customer experiences, and use experiments to prove impact. 
 - Contribute to the evolution of the Detail Page architecture, and use AI-native tools and agents to speed up development, testing and operations. 
 - Review designs and code, mentor junior engineers, and help raise the engineering bar across the team. 

Basic Qualifications

- 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience

data.title: Principal Engineer – Software Architecture and Modernization
data.description:
Join ABC Fitness and become part of a culture that's as ambitious as it is authentic. Let's transform the future of fitness-together!

Our Values

Best Life

We believe great work begins with great people. That's why our culture is built on respect, trust, and belonging. We create an inclusive environment where every team member can bring their authentic self to work-because diverse perspectives drive innovation and meaningful impact. 

Growth Mindset

We are doers, thinkers, and dreamers. At ABC Fitness, your growth is our investment. Through continuous learning, mentorship, and professional development opportunities, we empower you to reach new heights-personally and professionally. 

One Team

From day one, you'll be part of a team that collaborates, celebrates, and cares. We move fast, support one another, and have fun along the way. Because when you thrive, we all thrive. 

This role requires working from our office 2-3x a week

What You'll Do

- Lead software architecture and modernization

Shape the evolution of legacy applications into well-structured, domain-oriented software. Define target architecture, module and service boundaries, migration seams, compatibility strategies, and incremental paths that teams can implement safely. 

- Stay deeply hands-on in code

Contribute directly to critical implementations, prototypes, refactoring, code reviews, and production fixes. Work comfortably in backend code and frameworks such as Java/Springboot, Golang, Node/TypeScript, or similar backend ecosystems, and help teams improve application structure, runtime behavior, and maintainability. 

- Design strong domain models and APIs

Create clear domain abstractions, ownership boundaries, service contracts, and APIs. Improve how business rules are represented in code and keep consumers insulated from legacy storage and implementation details. 

- Modernize application foundations

Guide framework and runtime upgrades, dependency modernization, concurrency and lifecycle improvements, and the decomposition of tightly coupled code. Use practical refactoring strategies that keep large systems releasable throughout the work. 

- Engineer for correctness, performance, and reliability

Diagnose difficult behavior through code, runtime evidence, database interactions, and dependency flows. Fix root causes in implementation and design, including concurrency defects, inefficient data access, resource contention, failure propagation, and recovery behavior. 

- Improve data access and integration design

Move business logic out of database-centric implementations and into testable application code. Design effective persistence, transaction, caching, messaging, and event-consumer patterns while preserving historical, reporting, and audit needs. 

- Raise the bar for code quality and testing

Establish strong practices for unit, integration, contract, and functional testing. Improve code review, static analysis, dependency management, feature controls, and validation so teams can change complex software with confidence. 

- Create reusable engineering patterns

Turn successful designs into clear patterns, reference implementations, libraries, and architecture decisions that help teams solve recurring software problems consistently. 

- Turn technical strategy into cross-team execution

Translate architectural risk into clear code-level priorities, decisions, ownership, and sequenced implementation plans. Partner with engineering, product, security, and data teams to move complex software initiatives from design through working code. 

What This Is Not

- This is not a people-management or architecture-only role. The engineer is expected to contribute directly to implementation and production outcomes. 
 - This is not limited to greenfield design or modernization for its own sake. Decisions must balance long-term software quality with migration safety, business value, and the realities of changing production applications. 

What You Bring

- Deep backend and distributed-systems engineering

You have substantial experience designing, building, operating, and evolving production backend systems, services, APIs, and distributed applications. 

- Credible hands-on implementation depth

You can move from architecture into code, configuration, instrumentation, and diagnosis. Exact experience with Java/Springboot or Golang or Node/Typescript is relevant, but the key here is moving ideas into shippable software solutions and not on the technology. 

- Service transformation and architecture judgment

You can define service boundaries, domain ownership, migration strategies, integration patterns, and practical architecture decisions for complex existing environments. 

- Production reliability and performance expertise

You can trace difficult behavior through application code, runtime state, database interactions, and dependency flows, then implement fixes that improve correctness, concurrency, performance, and recovery behavior. 

- Software design and refactoring depth

You can improve large codebases through domain modeling, modular design, dependency management, incremental refactoring, and carefully chosen abstractions. You know how to create better seams without forcing risky rewrites. 

- Data and integration depth

You understand relational databases, SQL behavior, messaging, event consumers, data movement, caching, and the tradeoffs involved in separating applications from legacy data dependencies. 

- Strong testing and code-quality discipline

You treat automated testing, code review, static analysis, dependency health, secure coding, and production validation as essential parts of software design-not downstream concerns. 

- Principal-level technical leadership

You create clarity across teams, challenge weak assumptions constructively, communicate risk in business terms, and help groups converge on decisions they can execute. 

- An opportunity-focused approach to AI-assisted engineering

You actively look for ways AI can expand engineering leverage across code comprehension, design exploration, implementation, refactoring, test generation, debugging, documentation, and planning. You help turn promising uses into repeatable practices that make strong engineers more effective. 

BONUS POINTS

- Experience modernizing large complex software systems, including runtime and framework upgrades. 
 - Experience decomposing monoliths, extracting services, or establishing modular boundaries within large existing applications. 
 - Experience with Oracle or other enterprise relational databases, Kafka or similar messaging systems, and complex data migration or reporting dependencies. 
 - Experience with profiling, runtime instrumentation, concurrency analysis, database-performance diagnosis, or tuning. 
 - Experience applying AI coding agents for codebase analysis, implementation, testing, and software modernization. 

What Success Looks Like

- Modernization advances without destabilizing the business

Critical migrations have clear boundaries, sequencing, ownership, and safety controls. Teams retire legacy constraints while maintaining compatibility and operational continuity. 

- Critical software becomes easier to change

Codebases have clearer boundaries, stronger tests, healthier dependencies, and fewer hidden couplings. Teams can add capabilities and modernize incrementally without destabilizing unrelated behavior. 

- Architecture decisions become executable

Teams understand the target state, the next practical step, and the tradeoffs behind key decisions. Cross-team dependencies and risks are surfaced early and actively managed. 

- Engineering quality improves across the lifecycle

Test coverage, code review, static analysis, dependency health, and production validation become stronger and more consistent across the software in scope. 

- AI expands engineering leverage

AI becomes an effective part of how teams understand code, explore designs, implement changes, generate tests, diagnose problems, and document systems. 

WHY THIS MATTERS

ABC Fitness depends on critical software and data flows that must evolve without compromising the businesses and members they support. Strong architecture is valuable only when it produces clearer code, better behavior, and software that teams can continue to change. 

This role connects long-term technical direction with hands-on software engineering. Done well, it will help teams reduce codebase complexity, modernize with confidence, resolve production problems at their source, and build a stronger foundation for future product development. 

WHAT'S IN IT FOR YOU: 

- Purpose led company with a Values focused culture - Best Life, One Team, Growth Mindset
 - Time Off - competitive PTO plans with 15 Earned accrued leave, 12 days Sick leave, and 12 days Casual leave per year
 - 11 Holidays plus 4 Days of Disconnect - once a quarter, we take a collective breather and enjoy a day off together around the globe. #oneteam
 - Group Mediclaim insurance coverage of INR 500, 000 for employee + spouse, 2 kids, and parents or parent-in-laws, and including EAP counseling

At ABC Fitness, we don't just build technology-we build communities and transform lives. Your work matters here, your growth is supported, and your voice is heard. We welcome diverse talent and encourage you to apply, even if you don't meet every requirement. 

ABC'S COMMITMENT TO DIVERSITY, EQUALITY, BELONGING AND INCLUSION: ABC is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion. We strive to create a workplace where every employee, client, and partner feels valued, inspired, and empowered to reach their full potential. data.title: Senior AI Evals Engineer
data.description:
About The Role

The Senior AI Evals Test Engineer is a hands-on technical role responsible for defining, developing, and executing robust evaluation frameworks and test strategies for AI agents built using the Google Agent Development Kit (ADK) or similar sort of agentic frameworks. This role bridges AI development and reliable deployment - ensuring our agents are safe, ethical, effective, and meet high-quality performance standards. A significant focus of the role is on Responsible AI and Safety Evals, including adversarial testing, red-teaming, bias detection, and toxicity measurement. The engineer will design scalable evaluation pipelines, build synthetic test environments, and work closely with AI/ML Engineers, Researchers, and policy teams to ensure agents are production-ready and compliant with regulatory and ethical standards. The role is 70% Automation and 30% Manual Testing, and sits within the Applied AI: Test Engineering team as a key technical authority. 

Key Responsibilities

- Design and build agent evaluation frameworks - create end-to-end infrastructure for evaluating LLM-based agents across correctness, latency, cost, safety, and task completion rate
 - Build synthetic testing environments and simulation strategies to stress-test AI agents under diverse real-world conditions, with specific focus on agents built on Google ADK and related Google AI/ML services (e. g. , Vertex AI, Gemini models)
 - Build golden datasets and test harnesses - curate domain-specific evaluation sets for Rubrik's product verticals (data security, SaaS protection, cyber recovery, compliance)
 - Establish eval-as-a-service - build and enhance centralized evaluation platform that any IT team members can self-serve to test their agents against standardized and custom benchmarks
 - Automate regression and drift detection - implement CI/CD-integrated eval pipelines that catch regressions on every model or prompt change before production deployment
 - Define eval taxonomies and rubrics - establish structured scoring criteria for agentic workflows (tool use accuracy, multi-step reasoning, hallucination rate, policy adherence, error recovery)
 - Instrument production observability - build real-time monitoring for agent quality in production: success rates, user corrections, fallback triggers, escalation patterns
 - Benchmark and select models - run structured model comparisons (cost, quality, latency trade-offs) to inform model selection decisions across agent use cases
 - Analyze and interpret evaluation results, providing clear, actionable quality and safety reports to stakeholders and development teams, with specific focus on risk metrics, trend analysis, and mitigation recommendations
 - Define comprehensive end-to-end QA strategies - functional, integration, regression, and user acceptance testing (UAT) - tailored for conversational and goal-oriented AI agents with tool-use, memory, and multi-turn reasoning capabilities
 - Develop and maintain detailed test artifacts (test plans, test cases, test scenarios, automated test suites) covering agent features, tool invocation, memory persistence, and reasoning accuracy across evolving model versions
 - Identify, document, prioritize, and track defects, performance regressions, and alignment failures using Jira, collaborating closely with Applied AI Engineers to analyze root causes and validate fixes
 - Evaluate new technologies and patterns (e. g. , new tools for Agent Evals), run proofs-of-concept, and influence the platform roadmap
 - Partner with policy and legal teams to ensure agent evaluations systematically cover regulatory compliance, fairness objectives, and emerging AI governance requirements
 - Provide technical leadership to engineers, including solutioning, design reviews, code reviews, pair programming, and mentoring of junior and contract engineers
 - Collaborate cross-functionally - work closely with ML engineers, product teams, platform engineers, and security to embed eval-driven quality gates into the agent development lifecycle

Required Qualifications

Education & Experience

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience
 - 8+ years of overall software Test engineering experience, with 5+ years focused on test engineering, QA automation, or developer tooling, and demonstrated ability to build evaluation systems across multiple AI/ML domains, conversational agents, or Large Language Models (LLMs)
 - 2+ years working with ML/AI systems, building, testing, or evaluating models in production environments, including hands-on experience with LLM-based applications, prompt engineering, RAG pipelines, or agentic workflows
 - 2+ years as a senior/lead, owning evaluation strategy, quality frameworks, and technical decisions for complex AI agent systems in an enterprise product environment
 - 1+ years in designing or operating evaluation frameworks specifically for generative AI / LLM agents, including benchmarking, red-teaming, and production quality monitoring in the AI ADLC model

Technical Skills

- Deep hands-on experience with LLM evaluation - familiarity with frameworks and libraries such as LangSmith, DeepEval, LLM as a Judge, Promptfoo, RAGAS, Hugging Face evaluation tooling, custom eval harnesses
 - Strong understanding of agentic AI patterns - tool use, function calling, multi-step planning, ReAct/CoT reasoning chains, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG)
 - Production experience with eval pipelines - building automated, CI-integrated evaluation infrastructure (not just notebooks)
 - Proficiency in Python - strong scripting and tooling skills; experience with pytest, async patterns, and data processing at scale
 - Familiarity with Google Cloud Platform (GCP) or any Cloud Service relevant to AI/ML (e. g. , Vertex AI) and experience integrating testing into MLOps workflows
 - Statistical literacy - ability to design experiments, interpret eval metrics with appropriate confidence, and avoid common pitfalls (overfitting to benchmarks, metric gaming)
 - Enterprise product sensibility - understanding of how AI quality translates to customer trust in a B2B/enterprise context (security, compliance, reliability SLAs)
 - Excellent communication - ability to present eval results and quality trade-offs to engineering leadership, articulate risks and safety findings to non-technical audiences, and drive alignment on ship/no-ship decisions
 - Hands-on experience with CI/CD pipelines and Git-based workflows, including automated testing, static analysis, deployment automation, and environment configuration for our DevTestOps

Tech Stack

- Languages: Python(Must), TypeScript, Java (Optional)
 - Test Automation: Selenium, Playwright
 - LLM Providers: Anthropic Claude, OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, open-source models
 - Eval Tooling: DeepEvals(Must), LLM as a Judge (Must), Promptfoo/RAGAS/LangSmith/ Custom harnesses
 - Agent Evals Frameworks/libraries: LangGraph, Claude Agent SDK, custom orchestrators
 - Infrastructure: DevOps (Basic), Kubernetes, CI/CD (Jenkins/GitHub Actions), observability stacks (Datadog/Grafana)

Preferred Qualifications

- Deep Learning/NLP Knowledge: Fundamental understanding of how LLMs work, including concepts like RAG, prompting, and the technical challenges related to alignment
 - Data Analysis: Experience with data analysis and visualization tools (e. g. , Pandas, SQL) for analyzing evaluation and safety results
 - Policy Background: Familiarity with AI ethics principles and industry standards for responsible AI development
 - Garbage-in/Garbage-out (GIGO) Tools: Any tool or framework that specializes in testing the model's response to highly ambiguous, misleading, or malformed inputs to test for robustness and safety failures
 - Experience testing complex APIs, especially for tool-integration and function-calling scenarios in agentic workflows
 - Experience with prompt injection (Must) and data poisoning skills is a plus
 - Certifications in AI/ML, cloud platforms (GCP, AWS), AWS Machine Learning Specialty, Google Professional ML Engineer, DeepLearning. AI specializations and software testing methodologies

Soft Skills

- Proven ability to lead without direct authority, influencing cross-functional teams and driving technical decisions through clarity and data rather than hierarchy. 
 - Experience working in agile environments, collaborating closely with product owners, scrum teams, and distributed stakeholders across time zones. 
 - Excellent communication and documentation skills, comfortable presenting solutions and trade-offs to engineers, managers, and senior business stakeholders. 
 - Strong architectural thinking and problem-solving skills, including the ability to decompose complex business processes into simple solutions

Nice to have

- Experience evaluating agents in cybersecurity, data protection, or infrastructure domains
 - Familiarity with Rubrik's product portfolio or similar enterprise data management platforms
 - Hands-on with human-in-the-loop eval workflows (annotation platforms, inter-rater reliability)
 - Experience with model fine-tuning evaluation (pre/post quality comparison)
 - Background in building internal developer platforms or tooling teams
 - Contributions to open-source eval frameworks or published work on AI evaluation methodology
 - Drive red-teaming and adversarial testing - design adversarial evaluation suites for jailbreak resistance, data leakage prevention, and boundary enforcement in enterprise-grade agents

Join Us in Securing and Accelerating the World's AI Transformation

The platform enables agentic cyber resilience and trusted AI operations for enterprises worldwide, built to recover before disruption strikes and stay a step ahead, so security is never the reason ambition stalls.
