A career in IBM Consulting is built on long-term client relationships and close collaboration worldwide. You'll work with leading companies across industries, helping them shape their hybrid cloud and AI journeys. With support from our strategic partners, robust IBM technology, and Red Hat, you'll have the tools to drive meaningful change and accelerate client impact. At IBM Consulting, curiosity fuels success. You'll be encouraged to challenge the norm, explore new ideas, and create innovative solutions that deliver real results. Our culture of growth and empathy focuses on your long-term career development while valuing your unique skills and experiences. 

Your Role And Responsibilities

As an Application Developer: AWS Cloud FullStack, you will work in a modern cloud-native environment, building solutions around microservices, API-driven architectures, and continuous release cycles. You will collaborate with teams to deliver scalable and resilient applications using Agile methodologies. 

Your Primary Responsibilities Will Include

- Develop Rich UI Applications: Design and implement rich user interface applications using Single Page Applications (SPA) or microfrontends, utilizing frameworks such as ReactJS or Angular. 
 - Build Scalable Backend Microservices: Develop scalable and resilient backend microservices based on 12-factor principles, exposing functionality via API and event interfaces, using programming languages such as Java, NodeJS, or Python. 
 - Implement Data Modeling: Design and implement data models using modern SQL and No-SQL modeling techniques, ensuring data consistency and integrity. 
 - Develop Event-Driven Applications: Build event-driven applications using Kafka, Zookeeper, and other hyperscaler cloud services, ensuring seamless communication between microservices. 
 - Manage AWS Services: Run and manage services on AWS, including PaaS, routing services, databases, event-driven services, observability, and DevSecOps tools, ensuring efficient and secure application deployment. 

Preferred Education

Master's Degree

Required Technical And Professional Expertise

- Cloud-Native Development Experience: Exposure to developing applications in a modern cloud-native environment, utilizing microservices, API-driven architectures, and continuous release cycles via Agile methodologies. 
 - Programming Language Proficiency: Experience with one or more programming languages, including Java, NodeJS, Python, or . Net, and proficiency in frameworks such as Springboot, Quarkus, Django, or Express Js. 
 - Data Modeling Knowledge: Experience with modern SQL and No-SQL modeling techniques, including data model design and implementation. 
 - Hyperscaler Cloud Services: Exposure to hyperscaler cloud services, including Kafka, Zookeeper, and AWS services such as EKS, ECS, Fargate, Lambda, and API Gateway. 
 - DevSecOps Tools: Experience with DevSecOps tools, including CodeBuild, CodeDeploy, CodePipeline, CodeCommit, and observability tools such as CloudWatch and X-Ray. 

Preferred Technical And Professional Experience

- Proficiency in Additional Frameworks: Experience with frameworks such as Quarkus, Django, or Express Js, in addition to Springboot, is beneficial for building scalable and resilient backend microservices. 
 - Knowledge of Multiple Programming Languages: Exposure to multiple programming languages, including Java, NodeJS, Python, or . Net, can enhance development capabilities in a modern cloud-native environment. 
 - Familiarity with AWS Services: Experience with various AWS services, including CloudFront, Lambda@Edge, and AWS MSKafka, can be advantageous in managing and deploying applications on AWS.

data.title: Senior Engineer- CAD SW
data.description:
Job Overview

Arm is leading the vision to unlock a broad ecosystem of silicon required for AI, Data centers, mobile, compute and IoT. As a member of Solution engineering team you will be delivering optimized design flow, methodology, and full CAD solution for industry leading compute subsystem and SoCs. We are seeking outstanding expertise in algorithms and automation specifically tailored for meticulous optimization of power, performance, area, signoff and silicon quality. The role brings opportunity to collaborate with foundry, EDA and ecosystem partners in 3nm/2nm technodes and multi-die. 

The Software Engineer is responsible for designing, developing, testing, deploying, and maintaining reliable and scalable software solutions. The role involves working with cross-functional teams to translate requirements into high-quality software while following engineering best practices. 

Responsibilities

- Design, develop, test, and maintain software applications and tools. 
 - Write clean, maintainable, efficient, and well-documented code. 
 - Develop automation to improve engineering productivity and reduce manual processes. 
 - Debug complex software, system, and performance issues. 
 - Participate in code reviews and contribute to coding standards and best practices. 
 - Design and maintain APIs, databases, command-line tools, and supporting infrastructure as required. 
 - Build automated unit, integration, and regression tests. 
 - Use Git and established CI/CD workflows for software development and delivery. 
 - Monitor software reliability and improve performance, scalability, and robustness. 
 - Collaborate with engineers, architects, product teams, and other stakeholders. 
 - Evaluate new technologies and improve existing software architecture and development processes. 
 - Create and maintain technical documentation. 

Required Skills and Experience : 

- Strong programming skills in one or more languages such as Python, TCL, C/C++. 
 - Good understanding of data structures, algorithms, object-oriented programming, and software design principles. 
 - Experience with Linux/Unix, Git, debugging, scripting, and automation. 
 - Understanding of databases such as PostgreSQL, MySQL, or SQLite. 
 - Familiarity with REST APIs, distributed systems, CI/CD, containers. 
 - Knowledge of software testing methodologies and development lifecycle practices. 

"Nice To Have" Skills and Experience : Working knowledge of agentic workflow models from OpenAI and Claude. Experience with RTL synthesis tools, process technology design rules, STA, and power estimation and analysis methodologies. Prior experience in SoC design, CAD engineering, or related areas, with a focus on physical design and signoff, is highly desirable. 

Our 10x Mindset

At Arm, we believe progress happens when people are empowered to think bigger and push beyond what seems possible. Our 10x mindset is about curiosity, ambition and creating impact that will be used by millions. We learn fast, prioritise collaboration and turn bold ideas into real technology. We look for people who are inspired by this way of working and want to grow in an environment where bold ideas are welcomed. Discover how the 10x mindset shapes life at Arm: https: //careers. arm. com/10x-mindset

Use of AI in Your Application

At Arm, we embrace the benefits AI can bring, including in recruitment. You may use AI to support your preparation, such as improving the clarity of written responses, practicing interview questions, or learning more about our industry. However, your application and interview responses must reflect your own thinking, experience, and abilities. We want to understand your authentic perspective, creativity, and approach to problem solving. As such, you may not use AI to complete assigned tasks as part of any assessments. If you plan to use AI-supported or assistive technologies as part of a reasonable adjustment, please contact accommodations@arm. com so we can support you. 

Recruitment Adjustments and Accommodations

At Arm, we want to build extraordinary teams. If you need an adjustment or an accommodation during the recruitment process, please email accommodations@arm. com . To note, by sending us the requested information, you consent to its use by Arm to arrange for appropriate accommodations. All accommodation or adjustment requests will be treated with confidentiality, and information concerning these requests will only be disclosed as necessary to provide the accommodation. Although this is not an exhaustive list, examples of support include breaks between interviews, having documents read aloud, or office accessibility. Please email us about anything we can do to accommodate you during the recruitment process. 

Hybrid Working

Arm's approach to hybrid working is designed to create a working environment that supports both high performance and personal wellbeing. We believe in bringing people together face to face to enable us to work at pace, whilst recognizing the value of flexibility. Within that framework, we empower groups/teams to determine their own hybrid working patterns, depending on the work and the team's needs. Details of what this means for each role will be shared upon application. In some cases, the flexibility we can offer is limited by local legal, regulatory, tax, or other considerations, and where this is the case, we will collaborate with you to find the best solution. Please talk to us to find out more about what this could look like for you. 

Equal Opportunities

Arm is an equal opportunity employer, committed to providing an environment of mutual respect where equal opportunities are available to all applicants and colleagues. We are a diverse organization of dedicated and innovative individuals, and don't discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran.

data.title: Software Engineer
data.description:
Overview

Microsoft is a company where passionate innovators come to collaborate, envision what can be and take their careers further. This is a world of more possibilities, more innovation, more openness, and the sky is the limit thinking in a cloud-enabled world. 

Microsoft's Azure Data engineering team is leading the transformation of analytics in the world of data with products like databases, data integration, big data analytics, messaging & real-time analytics, and business intelligence. The products our portfolio include Microsoft Fabric, Azure SQL DB, Azure Cosmos DB, Azure PostgreSQL, Azure Data Factory, Azure Synapse Analytics, Azure Service Bus, Azure Event Grid, and Power BI. Our mission is to build the data platform for the age of AI, powering a new class of data-first applications and driving a data culture. 

Within Microsoft Fabric, the Data Integration team enables organizations to connect, move, and shape data across their entire data estate. As data is generated across applications, devices, and systems, our integration capabilities make it easy to ingest, transform, and prepare data for downstream use. Fabric's unified integration experience simplifies how customers bring data together, ensuring it is trusted, usable, and ready to power analytics, real-time insights, and AI scenarios. 

The Azure Messaging team builds and operates the infrastructure behind Azure Event Hubs and Azure Service Bus, enabling customers around the world to stream events and reliably connect applications. 

We are looking for a Software Engineer to help make this platform easier to deploy, operate, and scale. You will develop software and automation for cluster provisioning, safe upgrades, fleet health, and capacity management. You will also improve the engineering systems our team uses every day - from deployment pipelines and automated validation to diagnostics and developer tooling. 

Working alongside experienced engineers, you will own well-defined projects from implementation through testing and deployment. You will have opportunities to contribute to new region and cloud buildouts, evaluate emerging Azure infrastructure, and develop capabilities such as cluster autoscaling. 

This role combines software development with hands-on experience operating distributed cloud services. Your contributions will reduce manual effort, improve reliability, and help the platform grow safely. 

We do not just value differences or different perspectives. We seek them out and invite them in so we can tap into the collective power of everyone in the company. As a result, our customers are better served. 

Responsibilities

Develop and maintain software for cluster provisioning, configuration, upgrades, and lifecycle management. 

Build automation and self-service tooling that simplify recurring operational workflows and reduce manual intervention. 

Improve deployment pipelines, automated tests, release validation, diagnostics, and developer workflows. 

Use telemetry and debugging tools to investigate failures, identify root causes, and implement lasting improvements. 

Contribute to fleet health, capacity management, free-pool optimization, and cluster autoscaling. 

Support new region and cloud deployments and help validate new compute, storage, and Service Fabric capabilities. 

Collaborate with experienced engineers and partner teams to design, test, deploy, and support scoped features. 

Document solutions, participate in code reviews, and apply secure and reliable engineering practices. 

Embody Microsoft's culture and values. 

Embody our culture and values

- This position will be required to pass the Microsoft Cloud background check upon hire/transfer and every two years thereafter. 

Strong foundations in data structures, algorithms, object-oriented programming, and asynchronous programming. 

Experience developing and debugging software in C#, Java, C++, Python, or a comparable language. 

Familiarity with a cloud platform such as Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud. 

Interest or experience in infrastructure automation, deployment pipelines, automated testing, or developer tooling. 

Ability to use logs, metrics, and experiments to investigate problems and evaluate solutions. 

Clear communication, collaborative problem-solving, and willingness to learn unfamiliar systems. 

Familiarity with distributed systems, messaging services, or infrastructure lifecycle management is helpful, but not required.

data.description:
Razorpay is one of India's leading full-stack financial technology companies, powering the way businesses move, manage, and grow money. Founded in 2014 by Harshil Mathur and Shashank Kumar with a simple vision - to simplify payments for Indian businesses - we've since grown into a fintech powerhouse driving India's digital payment revolution. 

Razorpay powers millions of businesses with a smarter, scalable stack that goes beyond transactions to help them truly build and grow. 

From building AI-native agentic payments, to AI-assisted fraud detection and real-time risk intelligence to automated reconciliation, smart payouts, and predictive financial insights, we are embedding intelligence across our stack to make money movement faster, safer, and more efficient. In close collaboration with ecosystem partners - including banks, networks, regulators - we are pioneering industry-first solutions that are shaping the next era of fintech

Across India, Singapore and Malaysia, our products span everything from seamless checkouts to payroll automation - powering a fintech ecosystem that's redefining how money moves across Asia. 

Today, that ecosystem supports everyone from early-stage startups to some of India's largest enterprises, enabling them to accept, process, and disburse payments at scale while expanding into new ways of managing money more efficiently. 

Our scale speaks volumes: Razorpay processes $180+ billion in annualized transactions, powering leading businesses like Airbnb, Facebook, WhatsApp, Airtel, CRED, BookmyShow, Zomato, Swiggy, Lenskart, Mirae Asset Capital markets, Indian Oil, National Pension Scheme - and over 100 of India's unicorns. With strong roots in India and growing operations in Southeast Asia, we are shaping the next chapter of financial technology across the region. 

We are backed by global investors including GIC, Peak XV Partners (formerly Sequoia Capital India & SEA), Tiger Global, Ribbit Capital, Matrix Partners, MasterCard, and Salesforce Ventures, having raised over $740 million to date. Strategic acquisitions - including Ezetap (POS and offline payments), Curlec (Malaysia expansion), BillMe (digital invoicing), and POP (rewards-first UPI) - along with earlier moves in fraud prevention, payroll, and lending, have further strengthened our platform and widened our footprint across Asia. 

But what truly sets Razorpay apart is our culture. At Razorpay, ownership is our oxygen - you own what you build, with no micromanagement or red tape, just the runway to make your ideas fly. Learning is a lifestyle - if you're curious, you'll feel at home here. People > Pedigree - we hire for attitude, hustle, and hunger more than degrees. data.title: Manager, Infrastructure Engineering (Linux Platforms)
data.description:
Why we need this role

The Manager, Infrastructure Engineering, Linux Platforms leads the team responsible for designing, deploying, automating and maintaining the secure Linux-based infrastructure that supports critical telecommunications network services. The platform scope includes DNS, routing control infrastructure, authentication and identity services, network observability, monitoring and related network-management capabilities. 

The role combines people leadership, service ownership and technical governance. It is accountable for team capability, technology roadmaps, platform lifecycle, operational performance, security, resilience, automation and managed-service outcomes. The Manager works closely with Network Engineering, Security, Infrastructure, Architecture and Operations to ensure platforms are secure by design, operationally supportable and aligned with network strategy. 

The successful candidate will manage a team of approximately four Linux specialists and managed-service resources located in India and the UK, supporting a distributed estate of hundreds of Linux systems that underpin critical telecommunications operations. 

Platforms and Services

The team designs, deploys, automates and maintains Linux infrastructure supporting: 

- Authoritative, recursive and caching DNS services. 
 - Route reflectors and other routing control-plane services. 
 - Authentication, authorisation and accounting services. 
 - Identity management, directory and privileged-access integrations. 
 - Network observability, telemetry, logging and monitoring platforms. 
 - Network-management and automation services. 
 - Virtualised and, where appropriate, containerised infrastructure. 
 - Supporting services such as NTP, PKI, certificate management, secure repositories and configuration services. 

What You Will Do

Leadership and Team Management

- Lead, recruit, mentor and develop Linux engineers and managed-service resources, building sustainable capability and succession. 
 - Set clear accountabilities, priorities and objectives and foster a culture of ownership, collaboration, technical excellence and continuous improvement. 
 - Maintain sufficient technical depth to lead engineering decisions, challenge designs and support major incidents, while developing Senior Engineers as the primary technical authorities for assigned platforms and services. 
 - Allocate resources across operational, project and lifecycle demand and ensure effective knowledge sharing across UK and India locations. 

Service Ownership, Strategy and Governance

- Own the strategy, roadmap and service lifecycle for Linux-based network infrastructure and associated services. 
 - Set platform standards, reference architectures, operating procedures and governance for technical exceptions. 
 - Own service performance, availability, capacity, continuity, recoverability and operational readiness outcomes. 
 - Manage platform currency, technical debt, upgrades, obsolescence and decommissioning plans. 
 - Prioritise investment and demand across Network Engineering, Security, Infrastructure, Architecture and Operations. 
 - Govern managed-service and supplier performance, including service quality, delivery commitments and improvement actions. 

Engineering, Resilience and Operational Excellence

- Drive standardisation and automation using Ansible, scripting and infrastructure-as-code principles to reduce manual effort and operational risk. 
 - Ensure monitoring, logging, security controls, backup and support documentation are included as part of every platform build. 
 - Define measurable objectives for availability, capacity, recoverability, vulnerability remediation, lifecycle risk and automation coverage. 
 - Ensure critical services have tested backup, restoration, failover, continuity and disaster-recovery arrangements. 
 - Lead major-incident response, risk escalation and stakeholder communications when required. 
 - Ensure effective problem, change, capacity, availability and continuity management across the service portfolio. 

Security, Compliance and Risk

- Own the platform security roadmap, control outcomes, risk posture and governance of security exceptions. 
 - Ensure secure-by-design practices, threat modelling and appropriate segregation of administrative access are applied. 
 - Oversee vulnerability remediation, privileged access, secrets, keys, certificates, centralised audit logging and software repository security. 
 - Ensure the team can support security incidents while preserving relevant operational and forensic evidence. 
 - Ensure compliance evidence is complete, repeatable and available for audit and regulatory review. 

Collaboration and Documentation

- Partner with Network Engineering, Security, Infrastructure, Architecture, Operations and application teams to align platform priorities and dependencies. 
 - Ensure technical designs, service documentation, support models, runbooks and audit evidence are maintained throughout the lifecycle. 
 - Communicate technical risk, performance, investment needs and roadmap progress clearly to technical and senior leadership audiences. 

Operational Support

- Participate in the Infrastructure Operations on-call rota and provide leadership for priority incidents. 

What We Are Looking For

Required Skills and Experience

- Extensive experience leading or engineering enterprise Linux platforms such as RHEL and Ubuntu; CentOS or compatible distributions are beneficial. 
 - Proven people leadership, coaching, resource planning and cross-functional stakeholder management skills. 
 - Strong understanding of service ownership, platform lifecycle, operational governance and managed-service delivery. 
 - Strong Linux automation skills using Ansible, Bash or Python and infrastructure-as-code principles. 
 - Strong understanding of TCP/IP, IPv4/IPv6, DNS, routing principles and BGP. 
 - Knowledge of network segmentation, firewalls, load balancing, NTP, PKI, TLS, certificate lifecycle, authentication and identity services. 
 - Experience managing high availability, backup, restoration, continuity and disaster recovery. 
 - Strong knowledge of ISO 27001 and CIS benchmarks, including vulnerability, privileged-access and audit controls. 
 - Excellent analytical, problem-solving and communication skills. 

Desirable Skills And Knowledge

- Experience in adjacent technologies is beneficial but not required across all areas. 
 - Network observability and monitoring, including metrics, logs, telemetry, alerting and capacity management. 
 - Virtualisation platforms such as VMware and KVM. 
 - Container technologies such as Docker or Podman and awareness of Kubernetes. 
 - Enterprise storage technologies such as SAN and NAS. 
 - Oracle databases and Linux integration. 
 - Windows Server environments. 
 - On-premises and cloud environments, including Microsoft Azure and Google Cloud Platform. 

Leadership and Behaviours

- Ownership and accountability: takes responsibility for service outcomes, team effectiveness and technical excellence. 
 - Leadership: influences and collaborates effectively across teams. 
 - Outcome-driven: focuses on measurable results aligned with business and network objectives. 
 - Strategic thinking: aligns technical decisions with network and business strategy. 
 - Problem-solving: develops solutions for current needs while supporting future scale and evolution. 
 - Communication: communicates clearly with technical, non-technical and senior leadership audiences. 
 - Collaboration: builds strong relationships across architecture, security, infrastructure, network engineering and operations. 
 - Adaptability: responds effectively to change and identifies continuous improvement opportunities. 

Preferred Qualifications / Education And Experience

- Degree in Computer Science, Network Engineering or a related discipline, or equivalent industry experience. 
 - Seven or more years of Linux or infrastructure engineering experience, including leadership responsibility. 
 - RHCE, LFCS, LFCE or relevant network/security certifications are beneficial. 

Summary

- Management role accountable for people, services, platform strategy, lifecycle, security, resilience and operational performance of Linux-based infrastructure supporting critical telecommunications network services.

Designs, implements, and optimizes components in distributed systems with an emphasis on scalability, resiliency, and operability. Builds fault-tolerant paths (redundancy, replication, automatic failover), applies recovery‐oriented principles, and implements retries, circuit breakers, and timeouts. Proactively detects and mitigates issues via tests, alarms, dashboards, and telemetry; authors runbooks and participates in incident response and RCAs. Implements standard replication and synchronization, develops automation/IaC for troubleshooting and maintenance, and applies advanced security controls (encryption, access, remediation) while ensuring change, compliance, and documentation standards are met. 

Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

System Design & Architecture - System Scalability: 

-Implements and contributes to the development for components of distributed systems that support horizontal and vertical scaling including leveraging distributed state management tools. 

-Optimizes code and/or systems for large-scale data processing in large-scale systems. 

-Implements scalability requirements for assigned components and reviews implementation of team members. 

-Leverages components of data plane platforms to handle large-scale data retrieval, storage, and processing. 

-Implements performance and load testing. 

System Design & Architecture - System Reliability Design: 

-Collaborates with team to build fault-tolerant components capable of withstanding in-service updates by implementing redundancy, replication, and automatic failover mechanisms. 

-Applies recovery oriented computing principles to design components that effectively handle service disruptions. 

-Implements retry mechanisms, circuit breakers, and timeouts to help handle network unreliability. 

System Design & Architecture - System Reliability Performance: 

-Implements tests and alarm configurations to proactively detect and address issues/failures. 

-Supports efforts to recover from failures by drafting and executing runbooks and operational procedures. 

-Builds and customizes dashboards, telemetry systems, and alerting mechanisms to monitor component health.

-Implements tests scenarios (e. g. , fault-injection, brown-out) to evaluate system correctness. 

-Implements standard data replication and synchronization techniques to maintain data integrity and availability. 

Operational Troubleshooting & Incident Management: 

-Diagnoses, debugs, and resolves issues in system components to support ongoing operation. 

-Implements basic strategies to prevent interruptions, ensuring no maintenance windows are required for customers and users when resolving issues. 

-Designs and implements automation scripts and tooling used to troubleshoot operational issues. 

-Participates in operational support rotations, assisting in incident responses and root cause investigations. 

Compliance & Security: 

-Applies advanced security measures to protect data and applications in multi-tenant environments, including encryption and access controls.

-Collaborates with the team to ensure cloud infrastructure complies with relevant industry standards and regulations and that documentation is up-to-date

Automation & Change Management:

Core Responsibilities

Planning & Execution: 

-Track timelines with minimal supervision, ensuring work is completed in a timely manner and is in alignment with project requirements.

Job Title - Senior Back-End Developer

Location - Bangalore (Whitefield)

Experience - 3 to 5 years

Allocated Budget: 10 - 12 LPA (Non Negotiable)

For This is a senior back-end role - we expect depth in Python and in relational databases, and the ability to run what you build. 

About the Role: 

We are looking for a hands-on Senior Back-End Developer who writes production-grade server-side code. You will design and build the services and data layer behind our applications using Python, with relational databases underneath - all deployed and operated on AWS. This is a builder's role, not a coordinator's. You should be comfortable writing complex SQL by hand, designing REST APIs that other teams depend on, reasoning about performance and failure, and owning your code through testing, deployment and production support. 

What You'll Do: 

• Design, build, and maintain Python (Flask/FastAPI) services and REST APIs consumed by our front ends and partners. 

• Write and optimise advanced SQL - multi-table joins, subqueries, CTEs, and window functions - without leaning on an ORM to do the thinking for you. 

• Model and evolve relational schemas, design indexes, and tune slow queries using EXPLAIN / EXPLAIN ANALYZE. 

• Plan and run schema migrations safely against live data. 

• Handle authentication, authorisation, and the security of the endpoints you expose. 

• Build background jobs, queues, and scheduled work, and make them safe to retry. 

• Write meaningful unit and integration tests for the code and modules you ship. 

• Deploy, monitor, and troubleshoot services on AWS, and improve build and release pipelines. 

• Review peers' code, uphold quality standards, and mentor less experienced developers. What

We're Looking: 

• 5+ years of relevant, hands-on back-end development experience. 

• Python - solid backend experience building REST APIs (Flask or FastAPI), not just scripting. 

• SQL - ability to write advanced queries from scratch and reason about how they execute; PostgreSQL and/or MySQL in production. 

• Schema design, indexing, and query optimisation on real data volumes. 

• AWS - practical experience deploying and running workloads (e. g. ECS/Fargate, Lambda, RDS). 

• API security - authentication and authorisation (JWT, OAuth2) and common OWASP risks. 

• Testing - able to write proper unit and integration tests with pytest. 

• Comfort with Git workflows, Docker, and CI/CD pipelines. 

This Role Is Not a Fit If. . . 

• You work only in Java and have no Python experience or familiarity. 

• You rely entirely on ORMs and cannot write raw SQL queries yourself. 

• Your Python is scripting and automation only - you have never built and run a production service. • You have never worked with AWS. (Experience on GCP or Azure is a plus, but AWS experience is required. )

• You have never written tests for your own code. 

• You are looking for a role that is mostly front-end work. 

Nice to Have

• Async Python (asyncio) and an understanding of concurrency trade-offs. 

• Queues and background processing - Celery, SQS, or Kafka. 

• Caching strategies with Redis, and knowing when not to cache. 

• Infrastructure as code (Terraform or AWS CDK). 

• Observability - structured logging, metrics, tracing, and useful alerts. 

• NoSQL stores (MongoDB, DynamoDB) alongside relational databases. 

• Enough front-end familiarity (Angular or React) to debug an integration end to end.

Read more on the Bitwarden blog. 

As a Senior TypeScript/Electron Engineer on the Desktop Native team, you will build secure, reliable desktop experiences that connect the Bitwarden Electron application with native OS capabilities. You will focus on the TypeScript and Electron side of features such as Autotype, the SSH agent, and the DuckDuckGo integration, collaborating closely with Rust engineers and teams working on the vault and desktop platform. This role is primarily for someone strong in TypeScript, Electron, and modern application development who enjoys solving cross-platform challenges in a zero-knowledge, end-to-end encrypted product. Rust expertise is a plus, not a requirement. 

What You Will Do

- Design, build, and maintain TypeScript/Electron components for Desktop Native features, including Autotype, the SSH agent, and the DuckDuckGo integration. 
 - Develop end-to-end desktop workflows across Angular/TypeScript UI, Electron main and preload processes, and Node. js integrations. 
 - Work with Rust engineers to integrate native modules, well-defined application interfaces, and OS-level capabilities on Windows, macOS, and Linux. 
 - Design and maintain secure IPC and native integration boundaries, with particular care for sensitive credential data. 
 - Partner with product, design, QA, Platform, and Vault teams to deliver reliable, user-friendly experiences across the desktop application. 
 - Improve performance, reliability, accessibility, and maintainability through automated tests and cross-platform debugging. 
 - Review pull requests and help raise the quality of TypeScript/Electron engineering, including community contributions on GitHub. 
 - Identify technical debt and contribute to pragmatic refactoring, architecture improvements, and technical documentation. 
 - Participate in technical design discussions, code reviews, and sharing knowledge across the team. 
 - Independently plan, estimate, and deliver new feature work and bug fixes in a collaborative, distributed engineering environment. 

What You Bring To Bitwarden

- Strong production TypeScript/JavaScript experience - 4-6+ years of professional software engineering experience. 
 - Hands-on experience developing Electron desktop applications, including main and renderer processes, preload scripts, and IPC. 
 - Experience with Angular or a comparable modern front-end framework, and building maintainable user-facing applications. 
 - Strong understanding of Node. js, asynchronous application code, and secure handling of sensitive data across process boundaries. 
 - Experience testing, debugging, and shipping applications across desktop operating systems such as Windows, macOS, and Linux. 
 - Experience using AI tooling in your development and testing workflow (Anthropic Claude preferred). 
 - Familiarity with Rust, native Node. js modules (N-API), or OS-level integrations is a plus, not a requirement. 
 - Collaborative and adaptable mindset. 
 - Openness and authenticity combined with excellent communication skills. 
 - Excitement and enthusiasm for open source and for better internet security. 
 - Excellent problem-solving skills - you might not know all the answers, but you know how to find and communicate the solution. 

WHY WORK WITH US

- Our user community loves us and we love them. Come to work each day with a sense of purpose as we bring a more secure internet experience to everyone from our friends and family to the world's largest organizations.

Project Role : Quality Engineering Lead

Project Role Description : Leads a team of quality engineers through multi-disciplinary team planning and ecosystem integration to accelerate delivery and drive quality across the application lifecycle. Applies business and functional knowledge to develop end-to-end testing strategies through the use of quality processes and methodologies. Applies testing methodologies, principles and processes to define and implement key metrics to manage and assess the testing process including test execution and defect resolution. 

Must have skills : Automated Testing

Good to have skills : NA

Minimum 5 Year(s) Of Experience Is Required

Educational Qualification : 15 years full time education

Summary: 

As a Quality Engineering Lead, a typical day involves guiding a team of quality engineers by coordinating multi-disciplinary planning and integrating various ecosystem components to enhance delivery speed and maintain high standards of quality throughout the application lifecycle. The role requires applying comprehensive business and functional insights to design and implement thorough testing strategies. Throughout the day, the lead oversees the application of testing methodologies and quality processes, ensuring that key performance metrics are established and monitored to evaluate test execution and defect management effectively. Collaboration and strategic oversight are central to driving continuous improvement and delivering reliable software solutions. 

Roles & Responsibilities: 

Drive the end-to-end software quality assurance lifecycle within an Agile environment, from test strategy and planning through execution and reporting

Design, implement, and maintain automated test frameworks and suites across UI, API, data, and integration layers (e. g. Selenium, Cypress, Playwright, REST-assured, JUnit/TestNG, Cucumber, Robot Framework, PyTest)

Develop and maintain test automation for Java/Spring Boot services and REST APIs, including regression, integration, and end-to-end tests

Contribute to Java development (feature development, bug fixing, code reviews), working closely with engineers on Spring Boot microservices, when required. 

Design test strategies, test plans, and functional use cases based on business and technical requirements, ensuring full coverage of critical HR and analytics use cases. 

Collaborate with product owners, business analysts, data engineers, and developers to understand requirements and translate them into effective test scenarios

Work with data and integration components including Databricks, Azure Data Factory (ADF), and DVP, validating data flows, transformations, and interfaces. 

Implement and/or enhance AI-driven and intelligent test solutions (e. g. smart test selection, self-healing tests, ML-based test analytics) where applicable. 

Ensure high-quality documentation of test strategies, test cases, test data, and test results, and contribute to technical documentation where needed

Proactively identify quality risks, defects, and process improvements, and drive their resolution with the team

Professional & Technical Skills: 

5+ years of hands-on software engineering experience, including: 

Strong Java development skills, ideally with Spring Boot (microservices, REST APIs)

Experience developing code using Python would be plus point. 

Manual and automated testing across unit, integration, system, and end-to-end functional testing

Test automation frameworks and web testing frameworks such as Selenium, Cypress, or Playwright

API testing and integration testing

5+ years of experience in software testing, including: 

Solid experience designing and implementing test automation frameworks (e. g. JUnit/TestNG, Cucumber/BDD, Robot Framework, PyTest, or similar)

Experience with data-centric and integration testing, ideally involving Databricks, Azure Data Factory (ADF), DVP, and REST APIs

Familiarity with AI-driven or intelligent test automation solutions (e. g. ML-based test selection, self-healing locators, test analytics) is a strong plus

Strong understanding of Agile methodologies and continuous integration/continuous delivery practices. 

Hands-on experience with: 

Version control: Azure Gitlab

CI/CD: Azure Gitlab CI/CD and UBS Deploy (or similar tool). 

Defect tracking and test management: Gitlab, Squash (or similar tools)

Ability to understand business requirements and translate them into test strategies, test plans, and functional use cases

Excellent documentation skills and attention to detail. 

Proactive, self-driven, and comfortable taking ownership of quality topics across the lifecycle

Strong communication and collaboration skills in a global, cross-functional team

Understanding of the HR domain is an advantage

Additional Information: 

- The candidate should have minimum 5 years of experience in Automated Testing. 
 - This position is based at our Pune Kharadi office and 3 days WFO every week is mandatory. 
 - A 15 years full time education is required.

data.title: Senior Ironclad CLM Solution Architect and Workflow Developer
data.description:
Join us in bringing joy to customer experience. Five9 is a leading provider of cloud contact center software, bringing the power of cloud innovation to customers worldwide. 

Living our values everyday results in our team-first culture and enables us to innovate, grow, and thrive while enjoying the journey together. We celebrate diversity and foster an inclusive environment, empowering our employees to be their authentic selves. 

Senior Ironclad CLM Solution Architect and Workflow Developer

Join us in bringing joy to customer experience. Five9 is a leading provider of customer experience software, bringing the power of AI and cloud innovation to customers worldwide. 

Living our values every day results in our team first culture and enables us to innovate, grow, and thrive while enjoying the journey together. 

We are seeking a Senior Ironclad CLM Solution Architect and Workflow Developer to join our Business Technology team. This role leads the design, implementation, and administration of Ironclad as Five9's contract lifecycle management platform and serves as the technical lead for replacing DocuSign CLM with Ironclad. You will architect the target-state solution, build and maintain the Workflow Designer workflows, templates, and clause libraries used to generate, route, negotiate, and execute Five9's customer agreements, and guide the migration of existing templates, workflows, and executed agreements from DocuSign CLM. 

The ideal candidate is a senior business systems professional with seven or more years of experience, including at least three years of hands-on CLM implementation or administration and at least two years configuring Ironclad in production. The candidate holds the Ironclad Core Administration Certification and, ideally, has completed Ironclad's Implementation Bootcamp and Verification Exam (Verified Partner Consultant, Implementation), with prior experience leading a CLM migration or platform replacement strongly preferred. 

The position is a hybrid role combining in-office and work-from-home days, based in Chennai or Bengaluru, India, and requires regular overlap with United States business hours, including work until approximately 11: 30 PM India Standard Time when needed. 

Key Responsibilities

- Lead the solution design and implementation of Ironclad CLM, defining the target-state architecture for contract intake, generation, review, negotiation, approval, signature, repository, and reporting, and serving as the subject matter expert for Legal, Deal Desk, Sales Operations, and Finance
 - Own the replacement of DocuSign CLM with Ironclad, including migration strategy and roadmap, template and workflow inventory and rationalization, repository and metadata migration of executed agreements, parallel run, cutover, in-flight agreement handling, and decommissioning of legacy DocuSign CLM components
 - Design, build, and maintain Ironclad workflows in Workflow Designer, including launch forms, conditional logic, approval routing, notifications, escalations, signature routing, and exception handling
 - Create and maintain commercial document templates and clause libraries - including Master Services Agreements, service orders, order forms, amendments, and renewals - using legal language and clauses approved by the Legal team, with conditional content based on product, pricing, transaction type, and geography
 - Administer and configure the Ironclad platform, including users, groups, roles and permissions, SSO and provisioning, repository structure, metadata and record types, and environment and release management
 - Design and maintain the integrations between Salesforce, Salesforce CPQ, and Ironclad, including Workflow Sync and Record Sync, field mappings, and generation of service orders from CPQ quotes and quote lines, ensuring contract status and executed agreements are accurately returned to Salesforce
 - Define the electronic signature approach for the future state, including Ironclad Signature and any external eSignature provider retained during or after the transition, and manage the related configuration and signature coordination
 - Use the Ironclad API and webhooks to build custom integrations, automations, and data migration tooling with other Five9 systems as required
 - Partner with Legal, Deal Desk, Sales Operations, Finance, and IT to translate business and legal requirements into scalable solutions, and lead change management, documentation, user training, and adoption
 - Troubleshoot workflow, document generation, data mapping, integration, and signature issues, and drive them to resolution
 - Establish administration standards, governance, and best practices, and mentor team members and partner consultants on Ironclad configuration and design
 - Identify opportunities to simplify contract processes, reduce manual effort, and accelerate contract execution, and track outcomes through Ironclad reporting and analytics

Key Requirements

Required Qualifications: 

- Seven or more years of business systems experience, including at least three years of hands-on CLM implementation or administration and at least two years of hands-on Ironclad configuration in production
 - Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
 - Ironclad Core Administration Certification required. Completion of the Ironclad Implementation Bootcamp and Verification Exam (Verified Partner Consultant, Implementation) strongly preferred
 - Demonstrated experience leading a CLM implementation or migration, ideally replacing DocuSign CLM or a comparable platform, including template and workflow rationalization, repository and metadata migration, and cutover planning
 - Advanced hands-on experience designing and building Ironclad workflows in Workflow Designer, including launch forms, conditional logic, approval routing, notifications, escalations, and exception handling
 - Experience building and maintaining commercial document templates (e. g. , Master Services Agreements, service orders, order forms, amendments, renewals) and clause libraries using legal language approved by the Legal team
 - Experience designing and supporting Salesforce and Salesforce CPQ integrations with a CLM platform, including generating documents from quotes and quote lines and syncing contract data and status back to Salesforce (Account, Opportunity, Quote, Quote Line, Product, Contract)
 - Experience with the Ironclad API, webhooks, and integration patterns, plus working knowledge of REST APIs, JSON, XML, HTML, basic JavaScript, and SQL
 - Working knowledge of electronic signature platforms, including DocuSign eSignature and Ironclad Signature, covering templates, recipients, signing order, and authentication
 - Basic Salesforce administrator-level knowledge (objects, fields, relationships, and permission sets) and familiarity with the Salesforce CPQ data model and document generation process
 - Proficiency with Microsoft Word template formatting, including tables, styles, sections, headers, and conditional content
 - Strong solution design, analytical, troubleshooting, and communication skills, with the ability to lead initiatives independently, influence stakeholders across Legal, Deal Desk, Sales Operations, Finance, and IT, and work across a distributed, global team

Preferred Qualifications: 

- Salesforce Certified Administrator or Salesforce CPQ Specialist certification is a plus
 - Prior experience with DocuSign CLM and DocuSign eSignature administration, which helps with migration scoping, is a plus
 - Experience with project delivery methodologies, enterprise change management, and mentoring or leading consultants is a plus

Why You'll Love This Role: 

- You will lead the move to Ironclad and play a central role in shaping how Five9 generates, negotiates, and executes customer contracts at scale
 - You will partner closely with Legal, Deal Desk, Sales Operations, and Finance, gaining broad visibility into the commercial contracting process
 - You will work at the intersection of Salesforce, Salesforce CPQ, and Ironclad, solving practical, cross-system problems that directly impact deal velocity
 - If you enjoy simplifying complex processes, setting technical direction, and building reliable, well-documented systems, this role offers a strong opportunity to grow as a CLM architect

Workplace location: This role is fully remote for candidates who reside further than a 30 kilometer driving distance from either our Bangalore or Chennai offices. Candidates who reside within a 30 kilometer driving distance of one of our office locations would be required to work in-office 3 days a week. 

Workplace location: This role is hybrid and requires 3 days a week in office. 

Five9 embraces diversity and is committed to building a team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills. The more inclusive we are, the better we are. Five9 is an equal opportunity employer. 

Five9 is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities throughout the application and interview process. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please contact us at accommodations@five9. com to request an accommodation. Requests will be handled confidentially and in accordance with applicable law. 

View our privacy policy, including our privacy notice to California residents here: https: //www. five9. com/pt-pt/legal. 

Note: Five9 will never request that an applicant send money as a prerequisite for commencing employment with Five9.

data.description:
About Us

We're rebuilding vertical software with AI - from the inside. 

Embrace owns the software running inside 16% of the Fortune 500, 45+ state agencies, and 450+ banks and credit unions. We acquire entrenched vertical software businesses and rebuild them around AI - products, operations, go-to-market, all of it. Our Venture Lab launches new AI-native products into those same markets, using the distribution and customer relationships our portfolio already owns. 

You'll ship AI into production against real workflows, real customers, and a P&L you can see move within a quarter. 

We hire people who want scope, speed, and ownership, and who are tired of working on AI that never reaches a customer. If you want to spend the next five years shipping into software that already runs the economy, talk to us. 

Job Description

This is a remote position. 

Embrace Healthcare Group powers some of the most innovative healthcare technology solutions in North America, with a focus on enhancing clinical efficiency and compliance across emergency care settings. 

EPOWERdoc, a leading SaaS platform within the Embrace Healthcare Group portfolio, specializes in Emergency Department Information Systems (EDIS) tailored for hospitals of all sizes. Designed by clinicians for clinicians, EPOWERdoc streamlines emergency room documentation with intuitive workflows, customizable templates, peer-reviewed clinical content, and real-time coding assistance-helping providers reduce documentation time and focus more on patient care. 

We're looking for a Senior QA Engineer to build EPOWERdoc's next-generation quality engineering practice, AI-native from day one. This is a hands-on builder role: you'll choose and architect our test automation stack, write much of the code yourself, and use AI coding agents every day to design, generate, maintain, and triage tests. 

You'll also own how we test AI itself. You'll design the evaluation harnesses and guardrails that show EPOWERdoc's AI-powered capabilities are accurate, safe, and dependable enough for an emergency department. You'll partner closely with developers, product managers, designers, and clinical content experts. 

Key Responsibilities: 

- Lead QA strategy: Own the end-to-end quality strategy for EPOWERdoc, defining test plans, risk-based coverage goals, and quality gates for every release. 
 - Architect the QA tech stack: Evaluate, select, and document the tooling for UI, API, performance, accessibility, and security testing, recording each decision and its trade-offs in architecture decision records. 
 - Build automation and expand coverage: Design and maintain scalable test frameworks for web applications, APIs, and integrations. Set standards clear enough that engineers and AI agents can extend them reliably. Use these frameworks to replace manual regression with automated coverage of critical clinical workflows such as triage, documentation, orders, and discharge. 
 - Performance and reliability: Build load, stress, and soak tests that model real emergency department peak volumes, establish performance baselines, and catch regressions before they reach production. 
 - Own CI/CD quality: Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines so every pull request and build is validated quickly. Use parallel execution and AI-assisted test impact analysis to keep feedback loops short as the suite grows. 
 - Defect management: Work with engineering teams to identify, document, prioritise, and resolve defects early in the development lifecycle, and drive root-cause analysis. 
 - Exploratory testing: Lead exploratory testing of new features and complex clinical user flows, combining human judgement with AI-driven exploration where automation alone adds less value. 
 - Agile partnership: Bring a quality perspective to sprint planning, refinement, and retrospectives, including estimates, acceptance criteria, and release readiness. 
 - Quality advocacy: Champion a quality-first culture from code reviews to release management. Report on quality metrics and trends such as escaped defects, flakiness, and test cycle time. 
 - Security and compliance: Ensure testing practices, test data, and the use of AI tools meet HIPAA and healthcare data security standards, with no real PHI in test environments or AI prompts. 

AI-NATIVE QUALITY ENGINEERING

AI is part of how this team works every day. In this role you will: 

- AI-assisted test design: Use LLMs to turn user stories, acceptance criteria, and clinical specifications into test scenarios, edge cases, and boundary conditions, then review and sharpen them with sound test-design judgement. 
 - Agentic test authoring: Use AI coding agents and Playwright's MCP server and test agents (planner, generator, and healer) to create and maintain automated tests. Hold generated code to the same review and quality bar as production code. 
 - Self-healing and failure triage: Apply AI to locator healing, flaky-test detection, and automated failure analysis: clustering failures, summarising likely root causes, and routing defects to the right owner. 
 - Synthetic test data: Make realistic, PHI-free synthetic patient records and clinical scenarios the default for functional, performance, and AI evaluation testing, using tools such as Synthea or LLM-driven generators. 
 - Testing AI features: Design evaluation frameworks for AI-powered EPOWERdoc capabilities. These include golden datasets, scoring rubrics, LLM-as-judge grading calibrated against human review, and regression gates that run whenever a model, prompt, or knowledge source changes. 
 - AI safety and guardrails: Test AI features for hallucination, clinical and coding accuracy, bias, PHI leakage, prompt injection, and graceful failure. Work with clinical experts to define what "good enough for the ED" means in measurable terms. 
 - Measure and share impact: Track how AI changes test authoring time and maintenance effort, and share what works with other Embrace engineering teams. 

THE STACK YOU'LL SHAPE

This is our starting point, not a mandate. You'll own the final decisions and the reasoning behind them. 

- UI and end-to-end: Playwright with TypeScript, including visual regression and automated accessibility checks (axe-core). 
 - API and integration: Playwright API testing, contract testing (for example Pact), and validation of HL7 and FHIR interfaces. 
 - Performance: Locust or k6 for load, stress, and soak testing. 
 - Security: OWASP ZAP and dependency scanning in CI, plus the OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications as the baseline for AI features. 
 - AI tooling: AI coding agents (such as Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, or Cursor), Playwright MCP and test agents, and LLM evaluation frameworks such as Promptfoo, DeepEval, or Ragas, with tracing through Langfuse or LangSmith. 
 - CI/CD and reporting: Tests running on every pull request, with Allure or a similar dashboard for trends, flakiness, and release readiness. WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

- First 30 days: You understand EPOWERdoc's clinical workflows, existing test assets, and release process. You've proposed the target QA stack and AI-native approach as written architecture decision records. 
 - By 90 days: Playwright smoke and regression suites cover the most critical clinical workflows and run on every pull request. A performance baseline exists for peak load. AI-assisted test authoring is in daily use with measured results. 
 - By 6 months: Manual regression effort is a small fraction of today's. Flaky tests are tracked and trending down. An evaluation harness gates every release of AI-powered features. 

Requirements

- Experience: 5+ years of professional QA or software testing experience, including at least 3 years building test automation, ideally in a SaaS or web application environment. 
 - QA foundations: Solid understanding of QA methodologies, risk-based testing, test design techniques, and software development life cycles. 
 - Programming: Strong coding skills in TypeScript or JavaScript and working proficiency in Python. You write test code with the same care as production code. 
 - Test automation: Hands-on experience with modern automation tools, with Playwright strongly preferred (Cypress or Selenium also considered). This includes building scalable frameworks from the ground up, managing test data, keeping suites stable and fast, and a record of well-reasoned tooling decisions. 
 - AI-native practice: Daily use of AI coding agents in test engineering, with examples you can walk us through, and the judgement to spot when AI output is wrong or shallow. 
 - Testing AI systems: Understanding of how LLM features fail and how to test non-deterministic outputs with eval datasets, rubric or model-based grading, and pass thresholds. 
 - Performance testing: Hands-on experience with Locust, k6, JMeter, or similar tools, including designing realistic workload models and interpreting the results. 
 - API and CI/CD: Solid experience with API testing, CI/CD tools, and Git, and with running automated suites within build pipelines. 
 - Communication and ownership: Ability to explain quality risks clearly to engineers, product managers, and leadership, with strong analytical skills and a proactive, self-starter attitude. 
 - Ways of working: Experience working in a highly remote, fast-paced, and agile environment across time zones. 
 - Education: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent experience). Nice to have

- Healthcare experience: Work in healthcare or health tech, especially EHR, EDIS, or other regulated clinical software (for example, ONC Health IT certification testing). This includes familiarity with HL7 v2, FHIR, and HIPAA requirements for test data and environments. 
 - AI tooling experience: Hands-on experience with LLM evaluation and observability tools, or building MCP servers and custom AI agents for engineering teams. 
 - Security and accessibility testing: Experience testing web and AI applications, including prompt-injection testing, red-teaming, and WCAG. 

Benefits

- Competitive salary aligned with UK working hours, ensuring fair and transparent compensation. 
 - Global Team Collaboration-work alongside extremely talented professionals from around the world. 
 - Professional Growth Support with access to training programs designed to enhance your skills and expand your knowledge. 
 - Clear Career Progression and excellent opportunities for long-term advancement within the organization. 
 - Comprehensive Health Benefits to support your wellbeing and peace of mind. 
 - Flexible Remote Work Options that empower you to balance work and life effectively.

QAD is building a world-class SaaS company, and we are growing. We are looking for talented individuals who want to join us on our mission to help solve relevant real-world problems in manufacturing and the supply chain.

Job Description

QAD is seeking a Sr QA Engineer to own the continuous validation and quality of Champion Assist, a multi-

agent AI product with ~20 evolving agents. You will test the agents themselves: their reasoning, tool use, 

orchestration and handoffs, and the quality of their responses. This goes beyond UI and API checks. 

You will design evaluation frameworks and regression suites that catch failures unique to non-deterministic, LLM-

driven systems. 

Responsibilities

- Design, run and maintain end-to-end business scenarios that exercise multi-step agentic workflows, 

including agent routing, tool/function calls, and multi-turn conversations. 

- Evaluate agent outputs for correctness, relevance, groundedness, consistency, tone and

completeness, using both human review and automated methods. 

- Build and maintain eval datasets (golden sets, edge cases, adversarial prompts) and automated

regression suites that run as agents, prompts, models and tools change. 

- Identify cross-agent, orchestration and integration issues: wrong agent selection, broken handoffs, 

tool-call failures, context loss, looping or runaway behavior. 

- Test for hallucination, prompt injection, jailbreaks, data leakage and unsafe or out-of-scope responses. 
 - Detect regressions caused by model upgrades, prompt changes or retrieval/knowledge changes, and

quantify them with metrics. 

- Triage and root-cause issues with Engineering and Product, separating prompt, model, retrieval, tool

and orchestration causes. 

- Re-test fixes, validate the end-user experience, and keep evals current as the product evolves. 
 - Document test strategy, eval results and quality trends clearly for global stakeholders. 

Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in software engineering, computer science or a related field. 
 - 3-5 years of QA experience, with at least 1-2 years testing LLM-based applications, AI agents or

agentic workflows. 

- Hands-on experience evaluating non-deterministic outputs: defining pass/fail criteria, rubrics, and

acceptance thresholds for AI responses. 

- Experience building or maintaining AI eval or regression suites (e. g. , LLM-as-judge, golden datasets, 

scoring rubrics). 

- Understanding of agentic concepts: tool/function calling, multi-agent orchestration, planning,

- Experience with test automation tools (Selenium, Playwright, TestComplete or similar) and API testing.

 - Separate defects from configuration issues, clarification requests, and enhancement ideas, working with product and technical teams to agree next steps. 
 - Document reproducible issues, including expected and actual results, supporting evidence, and business impact, and coordinate retesting after fixes. 
 - Report progress, coverage, blockers, and residual risks so decision-makers can clearly assess readiness. 
 - Coordinate acceptance evidence and follow-up while keeping approval and validation accountability with the relevant Business Units. 

Support release communication and continuous improvement

- Prepare business-facing release updates that explain what changed, why it matters, and any relevant limitations or actions. 
 - Keep testing guidance, feedback records, and supporting documentation accessible to global stakeholders. 
 - Create reusable scenarios and checklists to improve consistency and reduce repeated effort across releases. 
 - Apply lessons from UAT and production issues to strengthen future acceptance coverage and identify gaps earlier.

 - Strong analytical skills and attention to detail, with the ability to explain business impact as well as technical symptoms. 
 - Clear written and verbal communication skills, including experience producing user guidance, test summaries, and release updates. 
 - Experience with issue-tracking and collaborative documentation tools such as Jira and Confluence, or equivalents.

 - Experience with test-management tools, basic data queries, or API-testing tools to support investigations. 

What Success Looks Like

- Business users know what to test, how to participate, and where to provide feedback. 
 - Critical business journeys have clear acceptance coverage and traceable results. 
 - Defects and feedback are actionable, assigned, and followed through, with unresolved risks visible before release decisions. 
 - Business approvers receive concise evidence to support acceptance decisions.

data.title: SDET Analyst
data.description:
Job Description

Summary of This Role

Performs and participates in application development and testing to apply continuous quality and testability of code throughout the software development lifecycle. Builds quality within the software development process with automated testing suites providing a comprehensive view from code quality to functionality. Uses quality paradigms to provide real time quality with use of automation and frequent regression testing. Designs / develops and maintains automation frameworks and automation test suites and scripts with continuous integration, testing, deployment and delivery. Conducts performance, load, security and service virtualization testing. 

What Part Will You Play?

- Participates in all steps of the software development life cycle and is accountable for producing quality code. Participates within a collaborative software development approach to identify and recommend practices for quality assurance at the source using automation. Conducts basic impact analysis, evaluates and identifies affects to regression test suites, testability of code, and application performance to reduce negative influences on continuous testing. Performs quality checks along with updating of automation scripts. Identifies and designs basic testing suites for test driven development (TDD) and behavior driven development (BDD) to allow early and frequent testing as the software is developed. 
 - Writes and executes moderately complex application tests at the source code level to prevent hidden errors (i. e. , white box testing) within unit and component testing. Identifies and suggests moderate improvements for code quality to improve deficiencies from functionality through structure of code for performance and maintainability. Builds, maintains and reviews mid-level unit and component test suites and conducts automated white box tests. Identifies basic improper coding and code quality issues. Integrates white box test suites with continuous integration (CI) tools. Programs and creates basic to mid-level test cases using unit and component testing tools for code level testing. 
 - Develops standard software tools, frameworks and utilities for validation / verification activities and end-to-end functional testing of software. Identifies and recommends tools and frameworks for testing and creates automated tools for generic use and maintainability. Writes standard code that uses / exercises non-user interface (UI) components like application program interface's (API's), representational state transfer API (RESTful API), and web services similar to the end user to develop frameworks for testing. Integrates automated suites with continuous integration (CI) tools for frequent execution. 
 - Installs and uses basic to moderately complex CI frameworks in continuous testing and continuous deployment / delivery. Builds, customizes, and deploys basic to moderately complex test environments and test automation frameworks. Performs basic to moderately complex scripting, data generation, and other methods to maintain automation infrastructure throughout the development. Integrates CI tools with other testing infrastructure and develops basic to moderately complex reporting / metrics on CI. 
 - Uses performance, load, security, and service virtualization testing tools to conduct basic testing, analysis and results interpretation. Builds, scripts, and generates data used in testing. Analyzes moderately complex system performance and responses during loads. Applies a basic knowledge of procedures, methodology and/or application standards to include payment card industry and security related compliance to testing activities using automation. Applies knowledge of service virtualization concepts and its applicability for application testing. 
 - Works with stakeholders, business, developers and other analysts to develop test plans, conditions and cases (set of inputs, execution preconditions, and expected outcomes developed for a particular objective, such as to exercise a particular program path or to verify compliance with a specific requirement) to be used in testing, and learns to perform test data conditioning and execution of test sets. Begins to build a base knowledge of using multiple environments to validate test conditions and reviews data values while learning the various components of the systems and the applications. Reports, tracks defects and defect resolutions, closure and participates in root cause analysis. 
 - Acts as a single point of contact for assigned small, less complex client projects with regard to test activities. Coordinates the test activities assigned to the test team to include, reviewing of client test plans cases and scripts, prioritizing test execution when necessary and providing feedback to internal and external clients. 
 -

What Are We Looking For in This Role?

Minimum Qualifications

- Bachelor's Degree - Software Engineering, Information Systems or other Technical degree; additional experience in lieu of degree will be considered
 - Typically Minimum 2 Years Relevant Exp - Professional experience with software testing, coding, designing, and developing

Preferred Qualifications

- Master's Degree - Software Engineering, Information Systems or other Technical degree
 - Typically Minimum 4 Years Relevant Exp - Experience developing automated testing strategies in a variety of environments and frameworks

What Are Our Desired Skills and Capabilities?

- SKILLS / KNOWLEDGE - Developing professional expertise, applies company policies and procedures to resolve a variety of issues. 
 - JOB COMPLEXITY - Works on problems of moderate scope where analysis of situations or data requires a review of a variety of factors. Exercises judgment within defined procedures and practices to determine appropriate action. Builds productive internal/external working relationships. 
 - SUPERVISION - Normally receives general instructions on routine work, detailed instructions on new projects or assignments. 
 - Software Development Life Cycle / Testing Methodologies - Agile - Scrum, Kanban, Test Driven Development, Behavior Driven Development, etc. 
 - Programming Languages - Java, C#, Perl, Python, Groovy, Oracle, SQL, etc. 
 - Testing tools - Application Lifecycle Management, Unit Testing, Security, Application Programming Interface, Mobile, Continuous Integration, Service Virtualization, etc.

Essential Duties And Responsibilities

Design, Build, and Enhance Automation Solutions

- Design, develop, test, deploy, and maintain automation solutions using Microsoft Power Automate (cloud and desktop flows).

data.title: Associate Engineering Director
data.description:
Careers that change lives start here. Medtronic is a global leader in healthcare technology with a Mission to alleviate pain, restore health, and extend life. Our 95, 000 employees work across more than 150 countries to put patients first - developing innovative medical technologies that improve the lives of 72+ million patients each year. Your unique talents will help shape the future of healthcare while building a career grounded in purpose, growth, and impact. 

A Day in the Life

The Endoscopy Operating Unit has created a business out of disrupting the status quo in the detection, prevention, and treatment of gastrointestinal cancers and chronic diseases. We've done this by commercializing transformational technologies that improve patient management and standards of care, while increasing access to our innovations across the globe. 

We improve patient outcomes by empowering every gastroenterologist across the globe with artificial intelligence and disruptive therapeutic technologies. Our talent is the foundation, and we will continue to bring deep clinical expertise, patient-centric innovation, and powerful digital capabilities to achieve this vision. 

As an Associate Engineering Director at Medtronic, you will be a second-line leader accountable for a software organization spanning multiple teams and product areas. You will lead through both engineers and other managers, owning the health, capability, and delivery performance of your organization. Where an Engineering Manager drives a team, you will shape the technical and organizational strategy across teams, build the leadership bench beneath you, and serve as a primary partner to R&D, Quality, Regulatory, and Program Management leadership on multi-year roadmap. 

Primary Responsibilities

- Lead and develop a software engineering organization of 40+ engineers across multiple product and platform teams. 
 - Coach Engineering Managers and technical leaders, building leadership capability, succession plans, and organizational depth. 
 - Drive end-to-end portfolio execution including resource planning, prioritization, dependency management, risk mitigation, and delivery governance. 
 - Establish technical direction and architectural standards in partnership with Principal Engineers and Architects. 
 - Partner with Quality, Regulatory, Systems, Clinical, and Program Management teams to support product development, verification and validation, and regulatory readiness. 
 - Define and scale software development processes, engineering practices, and quality frameworks across multiple teams. 
 - Oversee workforce planning, hiring strategies, vendor engagement, and budget planning for the organization. 
 - Represent software engineering in leadership reviews, design reviews, audits, and cross-functional decision-making forums. 

Required Qualifications

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field. 
 - Minimum of 18+ years of applicable work experience in a SW product development & Global team environment. 
 - Minimum 8+ years of people-management experience, including 2+ years leading multiple teams simultaneously. 
 - Deep understanding of enterprise application full stack development (desktop, mobile, cloud) and V&V strategy, including automated verification. 
 - Experience in developing and maintaining a deep technical understanding of product lines and technologies. 
 - Experience in developing departmental budget and manages expenses in line with organizational objectives; approves departmental expenditures including capital and manpower expense. 
 - Excellent Technology management, project management skills; demonstrated success executing complex engineering projects with diverse technical teams. 
 - Proven ability to lead programs within a global matrix structure, including influencing peers and leaders without direct authority. 
 - Demonstrated ability to blend organizational leadership with credible technical depth - able to set strategy and to engage substantively in architecture and design decisions. 
 - Track record of developing engineers with measurable outcomes in retention, promotion, and capability growth. 
 - Excellent communication skills, including the ability to present status, risk, and strategy to senior leadership. 
 - Good financial acumen; strong mathematical and financial capabilities. 
 - Must have leadership skills and personal strength to protect projects from unsubstantial change requests while ensuring project focus remains in place. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience developing software for medical devices or regulated industries compliant with IEC 62304, ISO 13485, ISO 14971, or similar standards. 
 - Experience building and scaling platform software organizations supporting commercial product portfolios. 
 - Experience with Agile delivery frameworks including Scrum, Kanban, or Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe). 
 - Experience with Application Lifecycle Management (ALM) and traceability tools such as Jira, Azure DevOps, Git, Team Foundation Server (TFS), or Polarion. 
 - Experience in software risk management, cybersecurity risk assessment, hazard analysis, or software Failure Modes and Effects Analysis (FMEA). 

Physical Job Requirements

The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by employees assigned to this position, but they are not an exhaustive list of all the required responsibilities and skills of this position. 





Recruitment Fraud Alert

We are aware of phishing scams targeting job seekers. Please keep the following in mind: 

Apply only through official Medtronic channels. All legitimate Medtronic recruiting communications come from approved Medtronic platforms and official @medtronic. com email addresses. 

Medtronic will never ask for payment or sensitive personal information (such as bank account or Social Security details) during early stages of the hiring process. Any such requests are not legitimate. 

If you receive a suspicious message claiming to be from Medtronic, do not respond, click links, or open attachments. 

If you have any questions, concerns regarding the authenticity of a communication alleged to have been made by or on behalf of Medtronic, please contact us immediately at AskHR@medtronic. com. 

Benefits & Compensation

Medtronic offers a competitive Salary and flexible Benefits Package

A commitment to our employees lives at the core of our values. We recognize their contributions. They share in the success they help to create. We offer a wide range of benefits, resources, and competitive compensation plans designed to support you at every career and life stage. 



This position is eligible for a short-term incentive called the Medtronic Incentive Plan (MIP).
