data.title: Full Stack Engineering Lead (Python, Angular/React), US Wealth Advisory, Vice President
data.description:
About This Role

Business Unit Overview: 

US Wealth Advisory (USWA) Business delivers BlackRock's full set of capabilities - iShares, alpha-seeking and alternative products, portfolio solutions and technology services - to wealth management firms and financial advisors in the US. 

The Advisor Engagement group within the USWA Business delivers a broad set of services and client engagement approaches that amplify the work of our client teams. This includes digital client engagement, business consulting, thought leadership, advisor growth programs, and advisor education. The team also works closely with Global Marketing to design an integrated USWA marketing strategy. WEA (Wealth Enablement and Analytics) Engineering team within Advisor Engagement group is responsible for developing new tools and capabilities which enable Sales, Portfolio Consulting, and other Wealth Distribution partners to self-service their advisor engagements, and drive innovation and scale. 

Job Purpose/Background

We are seeking an energetic professional to lead a team of Full Stack developers and have hands on technical experience in design and development of Python based Applications and Angular based Interactive Data Visualization solutions. 

The successful candidate will play a key role in advancing the organization's Applied AI strategy by integrating AI-powered capabilities into portfolio design platforms, engineering workflows, and business processes. The individual will identify opportunities where AI can create measurable business value, improve productivity, and enhance client and advisor experiences while ensuring responsibility and governed adoption of AI technologies. 

The individual must have a solid understanding of the software development lifecycle and extensive experience building multi-tier applications. The ideal candidate will thrive in a work environment that requires strong problem-solving skills and independent self-direction, coupled with an aptitude for team collaboration and open communication. Attention to detail and creativity in problem solving are critical skills. 

Key Responsibilities

- Lead and develop a high-performing team of Full Stack engineers, providing both technical leadership and people management while fostering a culture of accountability, collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement. 
 - Drive the successful delivery of strategic technology initiatives and complex programs, ensuring high-quality execution, operational excellence, and timely delivery in partnership with business stakeholders and cross-functional engineering teams. 
 - Define and execute the technical strategy, architecture, and roadmap for portfolio design platforms and applications, leveraging enterprise capabilities and promoting scalable, reusable solutions that maximize business value. 
 - Champion Agile software development practices including planning, prioritization, backlog management, sprint execution, and continuous improvement to enhance team effectiveness and delivery outcomes. 
 - Establish and maintain engineering best practices across software development, production readiness, operational resilience, risk management, and platform governance. 
 - Lead the adoption of Applied AI technologies and AI-assisted engineering practices to improve developer productivity, accelerate delivery, and enhance business and client experiences. 
 - Identify, evaluate, and deliver AI-enabled solutions, intelligent workflows, and automation opportunities that drive advisor engagement, operational efficiency, and measurable business impact. 
 - Partner closely with enterprise technology teams and business stakeholders to evaluate emerging technologies and translate innovative capabilities into scalable, production-ready solutions. 
 - Promote responsible AI adoption by establishing best practices around governance, security, model evaluation, risk management, and compliance with enterprise standards. 
 - Serve as a strategic thought partner to business and technology leaders by challenging the status quo, identifying opportunities for innovation, and driving transformational initiatives that advance organizational objectives. 
 - Mentor and coach engineers and technical leaders, promoting AI literacy, technical excellence, and professional development across the organization. 
 - Adapt priorities and execution plans to meet evolving business needs while supporting firm-wide initiatives and delivering high-impact outcomes. 

Qualifications

- Bachelors or Master's Degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related discipline. 

Eligibility Criteria

- 9-12 years of software engineering experience, preferably within the financial services industry, with at least 4 years leading high-performing Full Stack development teams. 
 - Strong hands-on expertise in Python and modern web application development using frameworks such as Angular or React, with a solid understanding of APIs, HTTP, and REST-based architecture. 
 - Proven experience designing, building, and supporting enterprise-scale applications, including production infrastructure, deployment architectures, resiliency strategies, and business continuity planning. 
 - Experience leveraging AI-assisted development tools and delivering AI-enabled applications, intelligent workflows, or automation solutions that improve business outcomes and engineering productivity. 
 - Strong understanding of Generative AI technologies, including Large Language Models (LLMs), prompt engineering, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), AI agents, and enterprise AI architectures. 
 - Hands-on experience with AI, Machine Learning, Generative AI, or Agentic AI solutions, including exposure to vector databases, semantic search, AI orchestration frameworks, and enterprise AI platforms. 
 - Familiarity with Responsible AI principles, governance frameworks, model risk management, and the practical application of AI to software engineering, analytics, advisor engagement, and workflow automation. 
 - Demonstrated ability to make sound technical and business decisions by balancing risk, governance, operational considerations, and long-term strategic objectives. 
 - Strong stakeholder management, communication, and influencing skills, with a proven ability to collaborate effectively across business and technology organizations globally. 
 - Track record of delivering high-impact solutions, building strong partnerships, and achieving high levels of business stakeholder satisfaction. 
 - Passion for technology and business innovation, with the ability to connect strategic objectives to technical execution and identify opportunities to drive scale and efficiency. 
 - Knowledge of the financial services industry and wealth management domain is strongly preferred. 
 - Flexibility to collaborate across global teams and support varying business and delivery schedules as needed. 

Our Benefits

To help you stay energized, engaged and inspired, we offer a wide range of benefits including a strong retirement plan, tuition reimbursement, comprehensive healthcare, support for working parents and Flexible Time Off (FTO) so you can relax, recharge and be there for the people you care about. 

Our hybrid work model

BlackRock's hybrid work model is designed to enable a culture of collaboration and apprenticeship that enriches the experience of our employees, while supporting flexibility for all. Employees are currently required to work at least 4 days in the office per week, with the flexibility to work from home 1 day a week. Some business groups may require more time in the office due to their roles and responsibilities. We remain focused on increasing the impactful moments that arise when we work together in person - aligned with our commitment to performance and innovation. As a new joiner, you can count on this hybrid model to accelerate your learning and onboarding experience here at BlackRock. 

Guidance on AI use for candidates

At BlackRock, AI has long been part of how we work - enhancing decision-making, improving operations, and helping us deliver better outcomes for clients. We encourage candidates to use AI thoughtfully to learn, prepare, and work more effectively; but during our interview process, we want to focus on getting to know you through your own experiences, thinking, and judgment. To support you, we've provided guidance on when and how to use AI during our hiring process so you can approach each step with confidence and showcase your best self. 

About BlackRock

At BlackRock, we are all connected by one mission: to help more and more people experience financial well-being. Our clients, and the people they serve, are saving for retirement, paying for their children's educations, buying homes and starting businesses. Their investments also help to strengthen the global economy: support businesses small and large; finance infrastructure projects that connect and power cities; and facilitate innovations that drive progress. 

This mission would not be possible without our smartest investment - the one we make in our employees. It's why we're dedicated to creating an environment where our colleagues feel welcomed, valued and supported with networks, benefits and development opportunities to help them thrive. 

To learn more about BlackRock, please visit Careers. BlackRock. com. We also encourage you to get to know us on LinkedIn, Instagram, YouTube, X, and TikTok. 

BlackRock is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to age, disability, family status, gender identity, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation and other protected attributes at law.

data.title: Senior DataOps Engineer
data.description:
DataOps Engineer

Experience: 5-8yrs

Location: Bangalore / Chennai / Hyderabad / Gurgaon/ Pune / Kolkata

Role Overview

We are seeking experienced DataOps Engineers to ensure our data platforms remain reliable, observable, secure, and production ready. This role bridges Data Engineering, Operations, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), and Platform Operations, with a strong focus on operational excellence and continuous improvement. 

You will be responsible for building and maintaining observability solutions, managing incidents, developing operational processes, and enabling support teams. A key expectation is to embed operational readiness into the software delivery lifecycle through a shift-left approach, ensuring that monitoring, supportability, automation, and resilience are designed into solutions from the outset rather than addressed after production deployment. 

This is a highly hands-on role requiring close collaboration with engineering, support, platform, and business teams. Candidates should be comfortable articulating technical decisions, operational trade-offs, and business impact to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. 

Key Responsibilities

- Design, implement, and maintain monitoring, alerting, observability frameworks, and operational dashboards for data platforms and pipelines using tools such as Datadog, Splunk, CloudWatch, or equivalent. 
 - Own the end-to-end incident management lifecycle, including detection, triage, escalation, communication, resolution, root cause analysis (RCA), and post-incident reviews. 
 - Develop and maintain runbooks, operational playbooks, knowledge articles, and troubleshooting guides; enable L1/L2 support teams through training and knowledge transfer. 
 - Embed shift-left operational readiness into CI/CD processes, including observability standards, automated operational checks, deployment validation, release readiness reviews, and support handovers. 
 - Build and maintain integrations using REST APIs, ServiceNow, OKTA, and other enterprise platforms to automate operational workflows, ticket routing, access management, and alert remediation. 
 - Troubleshoot, optimize, and improve the performance, reliability, and scalability of data workloads, including Databricks jobs, SQL workloads, and data pipelines. 
 - Define, measure, and continuously improve operational metrics and service reliability indicators, including SLAs, SLOs, MTTD, MTTR, incident trends, and platform availability. 
 - Collaborate closely with Data Engineers, Architects, Product Owners, Platform/DevOps teams, and business stakeholders to ensure operational excellence across the platform landscape. 
 - Document platform architecture, system dependencies, data flows, operational procedures, and support processes to ensure maintainability and knowledge sharing. 
 - Contribute to platform reliability initiatives by implementing automation, resiliency patterns, self-healing mechanisms, and operational best practices. 

Required Qualifications

- 4+ years of experience in Data Operations, DataOps, SRE, Production Support, or Platform Operations roles. 
 - Strong hands-on experience with at least one enterprise monitoring platform such as Datadog, Splunk, CloudWatch, Dynatrace, or New Relic. 
 - 2+ years of experience in incident management, operational support, runbook development, and support team enablement. 
 - Experience building integrations using REST APIs, ServiceNow, OKTA, or similar enterprise platforms. 
 - Proven experience implementing operational readiness and observability practices within software delivery pipelines. 
 - Strong working knowledge of SQL and Databricks, including troubleshooting, debugging, and performance optimization. 
 - Experience defining and tracking operational KPIs, reliability metrics, and service-level objectives. 
 - Ability to clearly explain system architecture, data flows, design decisions, operational risks, and business impact. 
 - Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, particularly during incident and escalation scenarios. 

Preferred Skills

- Experience with DevOps, Platform Operations, or Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) practices. 
 - Hands-on experience with CI/CD tools such as Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, GitLab CI/CD, or similar platforms. 
 - Experience with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools such as Terraform, ARM Templates, CloudFormation, or Bicep. 
 - Automation and scripting skills using Python, PowerShell, Bash, or Shell scripting. 
 - Cloud platform experience in AWS, Azure, or GCP, including monitoring and operational tooling. 
 - Familiarity with container and orchestration technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes. 
 - Experience supporting enterprise platforms, platform engineering teams, or shared services environments. 
 - Familiarity with ITIL processes, Service Management practices, and on-call support models. 
 - Experience with data observability, lineage, governance, and data quality tooling.

data.title: Principal Software Engineer - AI Native UX
data.description:
Company Description

It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. That moment inspired Fred to build a company that could do that for everyone-freeing people from busywork so they could focus on meaningful work. Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention. Our ServiceNow AI platform brings together any AI, any data, and any workflow- helping 85% of the Fortune 500® work smarter, faster, and better. We're building an AI-native culture where technology and talent are unstoppable together. And we're just getting started. 

Join us to put AI to work for people. 

Job Description

What you'll do: 

UX Architecture & Strategy - Define and own the long-term architecture for AI-native user experiences across the platform, making critical build-vs-buy decisions (design systems, agent-to-UI interaction patterns, real-time/streaming UX for AI-generated content) to ensure the experience layer stays resilient and coherent as the platform scales. 

AI-Native Intelligent Experiences - Design and build user-facing surfaces where agentic backends - recommendations, autonomous triage, generated fixes/insights, multi-step agent reasoning - are exposed to end users through fast, trustworthy, low-friction interaction patterns. Own the hard UX problems unique to AI-native products: progressive disclosure of agent reasoning, graceful handling of uncertainty/latency, human-in-the-loop review flows, and making autonomous system behavior legible and controllable to end users rather than a black box. 

UXC & Workspace Platform - Deep ownership of the UXC (User Experience/Workspace, UI16) surface - component architecture, design system consistency, and performance - as the primary canvas AI-native features are built on top of. 

Agentic Pipeline Awareness - Partner closely with platform/ML teams building the agent orchestration and tool-calling infrastructure underneath (multi-agent dispatch, MCP-style tool integration, reasoning traceability) - translating what these backends can do into UX patterns that make them usable, safe, and trustworthy for real users. 

Business Alignment - Align UX and technical architecture with business goals, ensuring engineering velocity, experience quality, and adoption of AI-native features directly support customer acquisition, retention, and time-to-market. 

Hands-on Engineering - Write high-performance, clean, production-grade code primarily across the frontend/experience stack (Lit. js, React/TypeScript, design systems, component architecture), with working fluency in backend/platform code (Java, Python, Postgres, K8s) to collaborate effectively with platform teams. 

Cross-functional Execution - Drive business-critical UX and platform outcomes in close collaboration with ML, backend platform, and product teams. 

Engineering Culture - Mentor senior engineers, champion UX and engineering excellence, and foster a culture of rapid, impact-driven innovation in AI-native product development. 

Ownership & Initiative - Proactively identify UX and platform gaps in the AI-native experience, propose solutions, align stakeholders, and drive execution with a high degree of ownership. 

Qualifications

- Experience leveraging or critically thinking about how to integrate AI into engineering and platform work-AI-powered tooling, automated operational workflows, agentic systems for fleet visibility and operations, or reasoning about AI's impact on how infrastructure is built and run. 
 - 15+ years of software engineering experience with demonstrated progression into senior technical leadership, and a track record concentrated in user experience and frontend platform engineering. 
 - Deep UXC / AI-native UX expertise - has shipped intelligent, AI-driven user experiences (not just consumed an LLM API), with strong intuition for how agent/model output should surface to real users. 
 - Hands-on experience with agentic/multi-agent systems from the consumer side - understands agent orchestration, tool-calling protocols (MCP or equivalent), and reasoning traceability well enough to design UX around them, even if platform-layer implementation sits with another team. 
 - Strong hands-on coding ability with deep design thinking in the frontend/experience stack (React/TypeScript, component/design systems), working proficiency in backend fundamentals (K8s, Java, Python, Postgres) to bridge into platform architecture conversations. 
 - Demonstrated ability to connect UX and engineering decisions to business outcomes - adoption, retention, time-to-market, not just technical metrics. 
 - Self-driven with strong ownership, able to identify UX and system gaps, propose solutions, align stakeholders, and execute at startup pace. 
 - Experience integrating or critically evaluating AI tools/agentic workflows in product and engineering decision-making, particularly from a user-experience and trust/legibility angle. 

Good to Have

- Prior experience in distributed systems performance/scalability, even if not the primary focus of recent roles. 
 - Open-source contributions to major AI-native UX, design-system, or agent-framework projects. 
 - Prior startup experience working closely with Product and Growth teams in an early-stage environment. 

Additional Information

Work Personas

We approach our distributed world of work with flexibility and trust. Work personas (flexible, remote, or required in office) are categories that are assigned to ServiceNow employees depending on the nature of their work and their assigned work location. Learn more here. To determine eligibility for a work persona, ServiceNow may confirm the distance between your primary residence and the closest ServiceNow office using a third-party service. 

Equal Opportunity Employer

ServiceNow is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, gender identity, veteran status, or any other category protected by law. In addition, all qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with legal requirements. 

Accommodations

We strive to create an accessible and inclusive experience for all candidates. If you require a reasonable accommodation to complete any part of the application process, or are unable to use this online application and need an alternative method to apply, please contact globaltalentss@servicenow. com for assistance. 

Export Control Regulations

For positions requiring access to controlled technology subject to export control regulations, including the U. S. Export Administration Regulations (EAR), ServiceNow may be required to obtain export control approval from government authorities for certain individuals. All employment is contingent upon ServiceNow obtaining any export license or other approval that may be required by relevant export control authorities.

data.title: Infrastructure Automation Specialist – Python, Ansible, F5 LTM/GTM & Network APIs
data.description:
Job Summary

Synechron is seeking an Infrastructure Automation Engineer to implement and maintain automation solutions for infrastructure certification, plant management, and infrastructure-on-demand services. The role requires hands-on experience with Python, Ansible, infrastructure APIs, F5 load balancers, networking protocols, Linux-based environments, and lab-based testing. The Infrastructure Automation Engineer will work with internal clients and stakeholders to understand business requirements and design well-architected solutions. The role contributes to business objectives by improving infrastructure provisioning, certification efficiency, operational consistency, test coverage, deployment speed, and service reliability. 

Software Requirements

Required Software Skills

- Python: Hands-on experience automating infrastructure installation, configuration, management, certification, and testing activities. 
 - Ansible: Practical experience developing and maintaining playbooks, roles, automation workflows, and infrastructure configuration processes. 
 - Shell scripting: Experience using shell or other scripting/programming languages to automate repetitive infrastructure tasks. 
 - F5 LTM and GTM: Expertise in configuration, administration, troubleshooting, and API-based integration. 
 - F5 TMSH, iControl, and iRules: Practical experience using these capabilities for configuration, automation, service management, and integration. 
 - Networking technologies: Strong understanding of TCP/IP, BGP, HTTP, SSL, and networking concepts across all relevant layers. 
 - Linux command line: Comfort working in Linux-based environments for configuration, troubleshooting, automation, testing, and operational support. 
 - Infrastructure APIs: Experience extending and integrating APIs to provide infrastructure-on-demand capabilities. 
 - Lab-based testing: Experience performing and automating testing for new hardware and software certification. 
 - Software versions: Experience working with the Python, Ansible, Linux, F5, networking, API, automation, and testing tool versions used by the assigned Synechron project. Ability to assess compatibility and upgrade considerations is required. 

Preferred Software Skills

- Experience with additional programming or scripting languages. 
 - Hands-on experience deploying and configuring network infrastructure, including Cisco, Arista, or comparable platforms. 
 - Experience with the Infoblox suite of DNS and DHCP products. 
 - Knowledge of virtualized and containerized infrastructure. 
 - Understanding of software version control, deployment, build tools, and software development lifecycle practices. 
 - Experience with infrastructure testing, continuous integration, continuous delivery, or automated release tools. 
 - Recognized industry certifications from F5, Cisco, or other relevant technology vendors. 

Equivalent tools and platforms may be considered where they provide comparable capabilities. 

Overall Responsibilities

- Implement automation for certification and plant management using Python and Ansible. 
 - Automate repetitive infrastructure installation, configuration, provisioning, management, and validation tasks. 
 - Extend and integrate APIs to provide infrastructure-on-demand capabilities. 
 - Design, develop, test, document, and maintain automation workflows and reusable components. 
 - Perform and automate lab-based testing as part of new hardware and software certification. 
 - Configure, manage, integrate, and troubleshoot F5 LTM and GTM load balancers. 
 - Use TMSH, iControl, and iRules to support F5 configuration, automation, integration, and operational requirements. 
 - Apply knowledge of TCP/IP, BGP, HTTP, SSL, and other networking concepts when designing and troubleshooting solutions. 
 - Work with distributed web applications and understand the infrastructure required to support their availability, performance, scalability, and connectivity. 
 - Use Linux command-line tools for infrastructure configuration, automation, testing, monitoring, and issue resolution. 
 - Communicate with internal clients and stakeholders to identify new business requirements. 
 - Translate stakeholder requirements into well-architected, secure, scalable, supportable, and maintainable infrastructure solutions. 
 - Collaborate with infrastructure, network, software, testing, security, and operations teams to deliver automation initiatives. 
 - Investigate failures, resolve defects, improve automation reliability, and document technical findings. 
 - Support infrastructure certification outcomes by ensuring that test activities are repeatable, traceable, and aligned with defined requirements. 
 - Evaluate new technologies and recommend improvements to infrastructure automation, testing, deployment, and service delivery. 
 - Consider sustainability by reducing manual rework, improving resource utilization, reusing automation components, and minimizing unnecessary infrastructure provisioning and test activity. 
 - Deliver automation solutions that meet agreed requirements for functionality, reliability, security, maintainability, and operational support. 

Technical Skills (By Category)

Programming Languages

Essential

- Python for infrastructure automation, API integration, configuration management, testing, and operational tooling. 
 - Shell scripting or another scripting/programming language for infrastructure automation and command-line operations. 
 - Ability to write maintainable, reusable, testable, and well-documented automation code. 
 - Ability to troubleshoot scripts, automation workflows, API interactions, and infrastructure-related failures. 

Preferred

- Experience with additional programming languages used for automation, infrastructure management, testing, or software development. 
 - Familiarity with structured data formats and API data exchange, including JSON or YAML. 
 - Experience developing reusable libraries, modules, or automation frameworks. 

Databases/Data Management

Essential

- Understanding of configuration data, infrastructure inventory, service metadata, test results, and certification records. 
 - Ability to manage, validate, and document data used by automation workflows and infrastructure APIs. 
 - Experience working with structured configuration files and data exchanged through APIs. 

Preferred

- Experience integrating automation with relational or non-relational databases. 
 - Familiarity with configuration databases, infrastructure inventories, DNS data, DHCP data, or asset-management systems. 
 - Experience maintaining data consistency, traceability, and auditability across infrastructure processes. 

Cloud Technologies

Essential

- Understanding of infrastructure-on-demand concepts and automated provisioning. 
 - Ability to apply infrastructure automation principles in distributed or cloud-enabled environments. 
 - Understanding of scalability, availability, networking, configuration, and operational requirements for infrastructure services. 

Preferred

- Knowledge of virtualized and containerized infrastructure. 
 - Experience automating cloud infrastructure or integrating infrastructure APIs with cloud services. 
 - Familiarity with infrastructure-as-code, container orchestration, or cloud-based testing environments. 
 - Awareness of resource-efficient infrastructure design and cloud cost considerations. 

Frameworks and Libraries

Essential

- Experience with Ansible playbooks, roles, modules, variables, templates, inventories, and automation workflows. 
 - Experience with F5 TMSH, iControl, and iRules. 
 - Experience extending and integrating infrastructure APIs. 
 - Ability to build reusable automation components for infrastructure management and certification. 

Preferred

- Familiarity with Python libraries for API integration, networking, testing, logging, or automation. 
 - Experience with infrastructure-as-code frameworks and configuration-management tools. 
 - Exposure to libraries or platforms supporting virtualized, containerized, or cloud-based infrastructure. 

Development Tools and Methodologies

Essential

- Experience automating infrastructure installation, configuration, management, and certification activities. 
 - Understanding of software version control, deployment, build tools, and software development lifecycle practices. 
 - Experience performing and automating lab-based testing for hardware and software certification. 
 - Ability to document automation processes, configuration requirements, test results, dependencies, and operational procedures. 
 - Experience troubleshooting automation failures, infrastructure issues, networking problems, and API errors. 
 - Ability to work with Linux-based command-line tools and operational processes. 

Preferred

- Experience with Git or equivalent version-control systems. 
 - Familiarity with continuous integration, continuous delivery, automated testing, build pipelines, and release-management tools. 
 - Experience with test automation frameworks, infrastructure validation, performance testing, or service monitoring. 
 - Familiarity with Agile or iterative delivery practices. 

Security Protocols

Essential

- Strong understanding of SSL and its role in secure network communication. 
 - Awareness of authentication, authorization, access control, secure API integration, and protection of infrastructure credentials. 
 - Ability to apply secure configuration and operational practices when automating infrastructure. 
 - Understanding of security considerations for distributed web applications, load balancers, APIs, and Linux environments. 

Preferred

- Experience with certificate management, encryption, secrets management, network security controls, or secure automation practices. 
 - Familiarity with security testing, vulnerability remediation, auditability, and infrastructure compliance requirements. 
 - Experience incorporating security validation into hardware, software, or infrastructure certification processes. 

Experience Requirements

- 5+ years of experience in infrastructure automation, network automation, systems engineering, DevOps, infrastructure engineering, or a related field. 
 - Experience automating repetitive tasks related to infrastructure installation, configuration, certification, or management using Ansible, Python, shell, or another scripting/programming language. 
 - Expertise with F5 LTM and GTM load-balancer configuration and APIs, including TMSH, iControl, and iRules. 
 - Strong understanding of networking concepts and protocols, including TCP/IP, BGP, HTTP, and SSL. 
 - Experience with distributed web applications and knowledge of their underlying infrastructure. 
 - Practical experience working with Linux-based command-line environments. 
 - Experience extending and integrating APIs to support infrastructure-on-demand services. 
 - Experience performing or automating lab-based testing for new hardware and software certification. 
 - Preferred experience with additional programming languages, network infrastructure, Infoblox DNS and DHCP products, virtualized infrastructure, containerized infrastructure, version control, deployment tools, build tools, and SDLC practices. 
 - Candidates may also qualify through equivalent combinations of network engineering, systems administration, DevOps, platform engineering, test automation, infrastructure development, or technical operations experience that demonstrate the required capabilities and outcomes. 

Day-to-Day Activities

- Develop and maintain Python and Ansible automation for infrastructure certification, plant management, installation, configuration, provisioning, and infrastructure-on-demand services. 
 - Configure and troubleshoot F5 LTM and GTM environments, use TMSH, iControl, and iRules, and collaborate with network, infrastructure, software, testing, and operations teams. 
 - Perform and automate lab-based hardware and software certification tests, review results, investigate failures, and document technical findings and delivery status. 
 - Engage with internal clients and stakeholders to clarify requirements, recommend solution designs, prioritize work, and make technical decisions within the agreed architecture and governance boundaries. 

Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Networking, or a related field; equivalent relevant professional experience may be considered. 
 - Recognized industry certification from F5, Cisco, or another relevant technology vendor is preferred but not mandatory. 
 - Relevant training in Python, Ansible, Linux, networking, F5 technologies, API integration, automation, testing, cloud, virtualization, or containerization is preferred. 
 - Demonstrated experience delivering infrastructure automation, network automation, infrastructure certification, API integration, or lab-based testing solutions is required. 
 - Commitment to continuous professional development through technical training, hands-on learning, certification maintenance, knowledge sharing, and awareness of evolving infrastructure technologies. 

Professional Competencies

- Apply structured problem-solving and technical analysis to diagnose automation failures, network issues, API errors, configuration defects, and certification risks. 
 - Collaborate effectively with infrastructure, network, software, testing, security, operations, and stakeholder teams to deliver shared outcomes. 
 - Communicate requirements, solution designs, technical risks, testing results, dependencies, and delivery updates clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders. 
 - Adapt to new hardware, software, infrastructure platforms, networking technologies, automation tools, APIs, and evolving business requirements. 
 - Identify opportunities to improve automation coverage, infrastructure reliability, testing repeatability, provisioning speed, resource efficiency, and long-term maintainability. 
 - Manage multiple automation, certification, testing, support, and stakeholder priorities while maintaining technical accuracy, documentation quality, and agreed delivery timelines.

Our Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion (DEI) initiative 'Same Difference' is committed to fostering an inclusive culture - promoting equality, diversity and an environment that is respectful to all. data.title: Senior Software Engineer (Automation & AI Agentic Engineer)
data.description:
What You'll Do

What You'll do

We are seeking an Automation & AI Agentic Engineer to design, build, and support a hybrid automation portfolio that spans traditional RPA and next-generation agentic AI solutions. The ideal candidate is hands-on across Microsoft Copilot / Copilot Studio, Agent Core, Power Automate, and UiPath (including UiPath Agentic Automation/Agentic Orchestration) evaluate which platform and approach - rule-based bot, low-code flow, or autonomous AI agent - best fits a given business process. 

Automation & AI Agentic Engineer (Intelligent Automation Developer)

You'll Have Opportunity To

- Design, develop, test, and deploy automation solutions using UiPath and Microsoft Power Automate, following CoE development standards and reusable component libraries. 
 - Build and orchestrate AI agents using Agent Core, UiPath Agentic Automation (agentic orchestration, agent-to-agent/human-in-the-loop workflows), and Microsoft Copilot Studio for goal-driven, autonomous or semi-autonomous process automation. 
 - Use GitHub Copilot (chat, inline completion, agent mode) to accelerate development, code review, and testing across automation and supporting application code. 
 - Assess incoming automation requests and recommend the right-fit solution (deterministic RPA bot vs. low-code Power Platform flow vs. AI agent vs. hybrid) based on process complexity, data variability, and exception handling needs. 
 - Integrate automations with enterprise systems via APIs, databases, message queues, and connectors; manage credentials/secrets securely (vault integration, least-privilege access). 
 - Implement AI components where required: document/IDP processing, LLM-based reasoning steps, prompt design, and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) patterns for knowledge-grounded agents. 
 - Apply governance, security, and responsible-AI practices: exception handling, logging/observability, human-in-the-loop checkpoints, data privacy, and bias/hallucination mitigation for agentic components. 
 - Participate in solution design reviews (PDD/SDD), UAT, hypercare, and production support/incident triage for deployed bots and agents. 
 - Maintain documentation for developed solutions, including agent decision logic, guardrails, and rollback/fallback procedures. 
 - Collaborate with Solution Leads/Architects on scalability, CI/CD pipeline integration, and CoE standards adoption; mentor junior developers on both RPA and agentic development practices. 
 - Stay current on platform releases (UiPath, Agent Core, Microsoft Power Platform/Copilot, GitHub Copilot) and recommend adoption of new capabilities. 

Who You Are

Who You are: 

Experience: 4 to 7 total automation experience (RPA + AI agentic), or equivalent demonstrated skill for internal candidates transitioning from a traditional RPA Developer/Sr. Developer role. 

Education

Bachelor's(Engineering)/Master's in computer science or a related field. 

Must Have

- 3+ years of hands-on RPA development experience with UiPath (workflow design, exception handling, reusable components, and orchestrator administration). 
 - Working experience with Microsoft Power Automate (cloud/desktop flows) and familiarity with the broader Power Platform (Power Apps, Dataverse, connectors). 
 - Hands-on exposure to Agent Core, UiPath Agentic Automation, or comparable agentic/AI-agent orchestration capability (goal-driven agents, agent-to-agent workflows, autonomous decisioning). 
 - Practical experience using GitHub Copilot (or similar AI coding assistant) in day-to-day development. 
 - Understanding of GenAI/LLM fundamentals: prompt engineering, tokens/context windows, RAG concepts, and where AI agents outperform (or underperform) deterministic bots. 
 - Proficiency with REST APIs, JSON/XML, SQL, and at least one scripting/programming language (Python, VB. NET, or C#). 
 - Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills for both rule-based and non-deterministic (AI agent) failure modes. 
 - Excellent communication skills to translate business requirements into automation/agent solutions. 

Preferred Qualifications

- UiPath Agentic Automation certification (Associate/Professional) or relevant Agent Core certification. 
 - Microsoft Certified: Power Platform Developer Associate (PL-400) or Power Platform Functional Consultant Associate (PL-200). 
 - GitHub Copilot certification or GitHub Agentic AI Developer certification. 
 - Exposure to cloud AI platforms (Azure AI Foundry, AWS Bedrock, Google Vertex AI).

Category

Skills

RPA Platform

UiPath

Low-Code / AI Agent Platforms

Microsoft Power Automate, Copilot Studio, Agent Core, UiPath Agentic Automation

GitHub Copilot (chat, inline completion, agent mode), Claude Code

data.title: Migrations Operations Manager
data.description:
Location: Trivandrum

About us

At Arbor, we're on a mission to transform the way schools work for the better.   

We believe in a future of work in schools where being challenged doesn't mean being burnt out and overworked. Where data guides progress without overwhelming staff. And where everyone working in a school is reminded why they got into education every day.   

Our MIS and school management tools are already making a difference in over 12, 000 schools and trusts. Giving time and power back to staff, turning data into clear, actionable insights, and supporting happier working days.   

At the heart of our brand is a recognition that the challenges schools face today aren't just about efficiency, outputs and productivity - but about creating happier working lives for the people who drive education everyday: the staff. We want to make schools more joyful places to work, as well as learn.   

About the role

We are looking for an experienced and collaborative Migration Operations Manager to join our Engineering team and lead the team responsible for the operational health of the migration journey for Arbor products, primarily Arbor MIS, alongside other products such as Arbor Finance. The remit and focus of the role is to line-manage and develop a team of Migration Operations Engineers, ensure smooth day to day operations, and drive lasting improvements across the migration pipeline. You will work closely with Onboarding, Support, and the Migration Product, and Platform teams to ensure migrations are executed at scale with high quality. . It's a broad and exciting role, so we're looking for someone up for a challenge - if you're an effective leader and a good communicator, this is the role for you. 

Core responsibilities

People Management & Leadership

- Line-manage and support the development of Migration Operations Engineers, including conducting 1: 1s, performance reviews, and fostering a collaborative and high-performing team culture
 - Recruit, onboard, and retain strong operational engineers, building a team that can scale with migration volume
 - Set the bar for operational quality, defining what "good" looks like for migration operations and holding the team to that standard
 - Mentor and coach team members in migration best practices, triage, root cause analysis, and escalation, delivering constructive feedback that balances recognition of strengths with actionable development areas
 - Foster a culture of ownership, continuous improvement, and learning from both successes and failures
 - Champion knowledge sharing across the team and wider organisation through tech talks, playbooks, and structured learning
 - Manage team capacity against migration volume, ensuring timely and high-quality delivery across multiple products and countries
 - Oversee project planning for migration operations work, lead estimation and feasibility assessments, and take ownership of resource allocation and execution
Delivery & Execution

- Ensure that migrations complete well within SLA, organising the team and on-call rota to ensure we have coverage during critical migration events
 - Own operational readiness for large-scale and time-sensitive migration windows, including risk assessments, checklists, and go/no-go decisions
 - Lead root cause analysis on failed or delayed migrations, identifying recurring failure patterns and systemic issues. Run post-incident reviews and ensure lessons learned are applied to prevent recurrence
 - Define and maintain triage frameworks, severity classification, prioritisation criteria, and escalation paths
 - Ensure migrations meet defined SLAs and quality benchmarks, contributing to the definition and evolution of those standards
 - Drive automation initiatives to reduce operational toil, improve data integrity checks, and increase migration throughput
 - Maintain and improve migration operational documentation, playbooks, and best practices
 - Adapt plans quickly when circumstances change mid-migration, making sound judgement calls under pressure

Collaboration & Communication

- Provide structured, prioritised operational feedback and requirements to the Migration Product and Migration Platform team, acting as the voice of operations in platform decisions
 - Act as the migration operations function's primary liaison with Onboarding, Support teams, proactively driving communication
 - Proactively flag migration risks, blockers, and timeline impacts to stakeholders, managing expectations and negotiating timelines when needed
 - Build strong working relationships with customer-facing teams to understand the school's perspective, feeding that insight back into how migrations are prioritised and executed
 - Run or contribute to regular cross-team syncs to maintain alignment and surface issues early
 - Communicate migration status, risks, and decisions clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders, translating complex migration issues into understandable updates tailored to the audience

Requirements

About you

- Demonstrated experience leading technical operations for complex production systems, with a track record of managing risk, improving reliability, and coordinating delivery across multiple workstreams
 - Demonstrated ability in people management, including 1: 1s, performance reviews, hiring, and developing engineers
 - Understanding of SLAs, operational metrics, and service reliability concepts (SLOs/SLIs)
 - Proven ability to deliver through others while maintaining the technical depth required to contribute hands-on when appropriate
 - Significant experience operating or supporting data migration processes in production environments
 - Deep experience with monitoring and observability platforms (e. g. , Datadog, Prometheus, or equivalent)
 - Experience with incident management, operational triage, and post-incident review processes
 - Strong stakeholder management skills with experience working directly with customer-facing teams
 - Proven ability to manage multiple workstreams, prioritise effectively under pressure, and adapt when circumstances change
 - Excellent written and verbal communication skills
 - Experience using AI tooling to increase team productivity, or a strong interest in doing so

Desirable

- Experience in SaaS environments, particularly education technology or school MIS systems
 - Experience with data migrations between competing platforms at scale (ETL, cutovers, decommissioning of legacy systems)

Benefits

What we offer

The chance to work alongside a team of hard-working, passionate people in a role where you'll see the impact of your work every day. 

We also offer: 

- Flexible work environment (3 days work from office)
 - Group Term Life Insurance paid out at 3x Annual CTC (Arbor India)
 - 32 days holiday (plus Arbor Holidays). This is made up of 25 days annual leave plus 7 extra companywide days given over Easter, Summer & Christmas
 - Work time: 9. 30 am to 6 pm (8. 5 hours only)
 - Compensation - 100% fixed salary disbursement and no variable component

Blue Dart Express Limited, a listed company, is a leader in courier, integrated air express package distribution, and eCommerce in South Asia, offering a wide range of logistics solutions. Founded in 1983, it is recognised for reliable, time-bound, and secure delivery services across 55, 000+ locations in India as well as internationally. Blue Dart Express Limited is a part of the DHL Group's DHL eCommerce division, leveraging this global logistics leader's network across 220 countries and territories to provide comprehensive express and logistics solutions to our clients. The Inbound Shift In-charge is responsible for leading all inbound operations within the assigned Service Centre, ensuring timely receipt, unloading, scanning, sorting, reconciliation and processing of shipments while meeting Blue Dart's service commitments and operational standards.

Location: Mumbai, India

Employment Type: Full-Time

We are looking for engineers who have built and owned complex production systems - not simply contributed to them. 

Industry: Financial Technology (FinTech), Fund Accounting, Financial Services, AI-Driven Enterprise Applications

About The Role

We are seeking a highly skilled, hands-on Senior Backend Engineer with demonstrated experience designing, developing, and owning complex enterprise-grade backend applications. The ideal candidate is a proven builder who has independently taken a substantial software service or application module from initial requirements through architecture, development, testing, deployment, and production support. You will contribute to an AI-assisted financial operations platform designed for fund controllers, supporting trial balances, reconciliation workflows, financial calculations, multi-level approvals, and accounting processes. This position requires strong backend engineering fundamentals, database architecture expertise, production AI agent development experience, and a commitment to financial data accuracy, consistency, and auditability. 

Key Responsibilities

Backend Engineering & Architecture

 - Translate complex business requirements into technical specifications and architecture.

 - Implement authentication, authorization, role-based access control, and secure data access. 
 - Build APIs supporting both traditional web applications and AI-driven agents.

Financial Application Development

- Develop backend services supporting fund accounting and financial operations. 
 - Implement workflows involving trial balances, general ledgers, journal entries, and accounting period close.

 - Design systems capable of handling currency precision, rounding, financial dates, and accounting periods. 
 - Ensure financial calculations are deterministic, reproducible, and auditable.

AI Agent Development

- Design, develop, and deploy production-grade AI agents integrated with enterprise applications. 
 - Build LLM-powered workflows involving multiple steps, tools, and contextual information. 
 - Implement structured outputs with schema validation. 
 - Develop evaluation frameworks to measure AI agent accuracy, reliability, and performance. 
 - Integrate human-in-the-loop approval mechanisms for sensitive financial actions. 
 - Ensure AI agents retrieve information, identify exceptions, and support decision-making while deterministic backend services perform financial calculations. 
 - Persist agent workflow state, execution results, and relevant audit information in databases. 

Database, Infrastructure & Quality Engineering

- Design and implement scalable database architectures and optimized schemas. 
 - Work with PostgreSQL, Snowflake, and other enterprise data platforms. 
 - Implement infrastructure-as-code for consistent application deployments. 
 - Develop comprehensive unit and integration tests. 
 - Mock external services and network calls during automated testing. 
 - Maintain production quality through code reviews, performance optimization, and systematic debugging. 

Required Technical Skills

Python and Java; comparable enterprise backend technologies considered

FastAPI, Pydantic, SQLAlchemy

Java Frameworks

Spring Boot, Maven

Databases

Unit testing, integration testing, mocking

LLM agents, tool calling, workflow orchestration, structured outputs

 - Production backend development experience using Python, Java, or comparable technologies.

Important: Specific programming languages and frameworks are flexible for exceptional backend engineers who demonstrate genuine end-to-end ownership. Production AI agent development and substantial backend service ownership remain essential. 

Preferred Domain Experience

Candidates with experience in one or more of the following areas will receive priority consideration: 

- Private Equity, Private Credit, Hedge Funds, and Alternative Asset Management

data.title: Senior Staff Engineer
data.description:
Sprinto is an Autonomous Trust Platform that centralizes trust requirements across security frameworks, vendors, and customers. 
Sprinto autonomously executes tasks needed to maintain trust across compliance, audits, risk management, vendor risk, privacy, and AI governance, enabling organizations to maintain a strong, reliable trust posture without draining operational bandwidth and resources on repetitive tasks. 

Backed by top-tier investors such as Accel, Elevation, and Blume Ventures, we've raised $31. 8M in funding to fuel our mission. Trusted by over 4, 000 organizations across 75 countries, Sprinto helps organizations stay audit-ready, manage real-time risks, and scale fearlessly. With 300+ native integrations and AI-driven automation, Sprinto supports 200+ global security standards natively, including SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, HIPAA, PCI-DSS, and more. Sprinto's extensible architecture enables organizations to build and support an infinite number of custom integrations and frameworks. 

Founded in 2020 by second-time founders Girish Redekar and Raghuveer Kancherla, Sprinto powers compliance for organizations like Whatfix, Encora, Anaconda, Whatnot, Ultrahuman, WeWork, Everstage, AI Foundation, HackerRank, and many more. 

Life as a Sprinter -
Nobody succeeds at Sprinto by staying in their lane. 

We are organized around problems, not job titles. Sprinters take ownership beyond their role, solve hard problems, and care deeply about the impact they create. If something can be improved, fixed, or built, we don't wait for permission; we step in. 

Being remote means we rely less on proximity and more on trust. We write things down, communicate openly, and move quickly because great teams aren't built by sitting together; they're built by pulling in the same direction. 

We believe progress beats perfection, feedback is a gift, and doing the right thing matters, even when nobody is watching. 

And while we move with urgency, we never move alone. 

The mission -
Autonomy is the easy half. Making it defensible is the hard half. 

What the platform produces is not a suggestion that a customer can take or leave. It's used as fact by auditors and enterprise buyers whose decisions depend on us being right. Wrong in one direction, a customer loses a certification because of us. Wrong in the other, we bury them in noise until they stop reading anything we send. 

Your mission is to make a defensible half, making agent judgment something a third party will accept. 

Where you'll leave your mark?

Agents whose output nobody re-checks. You'll see how we prove an agent is trustworthy: evaluation harnesses that gate releases rather than run quarterly, golden sets built with real compliance experts, regression suites assembled from production traces, and drift detection that fires before a customer notices. Not a set of scripts - a platform every other team builds on. You'll know it works when a compliance lead stops reviewing a category of output, and nothing breaks. 

A system that can prove what it said, and admit when it didn't know. Compliance is a claim about the past, which means state as of a date has to be held separately from when we learned it, and every artefact has to carry unbroken provenance from the source system to the audit package. The other half of the problem is honesty under failure. At several hundred connectors, partial failures are normal, and a connector returning nothing because Okta is down must never look like a control genuinely failing. Passing, failing and unknown are three different states, and that distinction has to survive all the way to the interface. 

Beyond those two, there are surfaces you'll work across without owning alone: tenant isolation and enterprise identity as we move upmarket, the inference economics that decide whether continuous monitoring is viable at scale, and how we model 200 frameworks so the next one is cheap. And since every engineer here will be building with agents within a year, we'll expect the practice to be better across the org because you joined. 

The kind of builder we're looking for -

- Someone who has built something that changed the shape of the work. Not a prototype - a system where an LLM took autonomous, multi-step action against real data and real users, and displaced something people used to do by hand. We'll want to hear what it replaced, what it cost, what its failure rate was, and how you measured it. 
 - An engineer who treats the model as an untrusted subsystem. Constrained outputs, independent verification, thresholds that escalate rather than guess, a clear line between what the model decides and what it only proposes. We're more interested in how your system detected and contained a bad output than in how it tried to prevent one. 
 - Depth in at least two of these, with room to pick up the rest here: production LLM and agent systems; temporal and provenance data modeling; high-fan-out integration reliability; multi-tenant and enterprise identity; inference cost engineering; domain modeling for messy regulatory rules. 
 - 10+ years building software, at least two of them at Staff scope - setting technical direction that engineers outside your reporting line followed. 
 - Range. Some quarters this role is an architect setting direction, some quarters it's the person taking on the problem nobody has cracked, some quarters it's carrying a team through a hard delivery. The people who do well here read what the company needs and adapt. 
 - Willingness to challenge how we build, and to hold the line when it counts. We're hiring partly for disagreement - on our architecture, our agent design, our standards. That includes telling go-to-market what we can't yet defend, and offering a path rather than a refusal. 
 - Influence without authority. Nobody on this team reports to you. Your leverage is clarity, credibility and the quality of your reasoning across Engineering, Product, Security and CX - and since we're remote-first, most of that happens in writing. 

How we care for our Sprinters?

- Work wherever you are: We are 100% remote, so you get to choose if you want to work from home, a cafe, the hills, or the beach
 - Co-working, on the house: If co-working is your jam, we offer a generous annual allowance
 - We care about your learning: We are invested in seeing you grow and commit USD 1, 000 annually to help you level up your skills
 - We count your spark, not your leaves: Unlimited leave so you can reset when you need to
 - Your Safety Net, Woven In: Health insurance with coverage up to INR 10 lakh for you and your family, accident protection of an additional INR 10 lakh, and life insurance worth 3x your annual salary
 - Workspace setup of your dreams: We chip in INR 35, 000 to help you build a setup that works for you

Inclusion & Diversity -
At Sprinto, talent, curiosity, and ownership matter more than where you come from. We hire people for the problems they can solve, the impact they create, and the way they help others succeed-not their background, identity, or personal circumstances. We believe the best teams are built when people with different perspectives come together around a shared ambition to build something meaningful. 

We're proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to creating a fair, inclusive, and accessible hiring process for everyone. 

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

About Redwood

Redwood Software helps the world's largest enterprises automate mission-critical business processes. Our platforms support complex enterprise workloads across ERP systems, business applications, cloud infrastructure, and on-premises environments. 

Redwood is building reusable AI infrastructure, agentic capabilities, developer tools, and platform services that enable enterprise-ready AI features across its product portfolio. 

Role Mission

As a Principal Software Engineer, you will lead the design and delivery of complex, production-grade AI and agentic capabilities that can be reused across Redwood products. 

You will solve ambiguous engineering problems, establish standards for reliability and AI evaluation, and contribute to important technical decisions. This is a hands-on role with ownership of significant systems and platform capabilities. 

Key Responsibilities

- Design and deliver complex services, agentic workflows, and shared AI platform capabilities. 
 - Build multi-step agentic systems that combine reasoning, tool use, retrieval, memory, policy controls, and human oversight. 
 - Establish robust approaches for AI evaluation, observability, model selection, fallback behaviour, and failure recovery. 
 - Lead technical delivery across multiple contributors and coordinate dependencies with product and platform teams. 
 - Review designs and code for scalability, security, performance, reliability, maintainability, and cost. 
 - Resolve complex production issues and implement corrective actions that prevent recurrence. 
 - Create reusable frameworks, reference implementations, and engineering standards that accelerate development. 
 - Partner with Product, Architecture, Security, Data, and Operations teams to translate business problems into durable platform solutions. 
 - Evaluate emerging AI technologies and recommend adoption based on technical evidence, enterprise requirements, and business value. 
 - Contribute directly to implementation while influencing important architectural and engineering decisions. 

Scope and Expected Impact

- Own complex systems or platform capabilities that affect the immediate team and multiple partner teams. 
 - Operate independently when requirements, risks, or implementation approaches are not fully defined. 
 - Influence technical direction through architecture, working software, design reviews, and measurable outcomes. 
 - Drive improvements that reduce technical and operational risks across multiple services or product areas. 
 - Lead the technical execution of initiatives involving multiple contributors and cross-functional stakeholders. 
 - Balance short-term delivery requirements with long-term platform maintainability and scalability. 

Must Have Qualifications

- 12+ years of professional software engineering experience, including ownership of production systems. 
 - Advanced programming skills in Python, Java, or another relevant production language. 
 - Strong experience building distributed systems, APIs, integrations, cloud services, and production-grade applications. 
 - Hands-on experience delivering generative AI or agentic systems into production. 
 - Experience with agent orchestration, tool calling, retrieval-augmented generation, prompt management, or model integration. 
 - Experience implementing AI evaluation, tracing, monitoring, security controls, and reliability mechanisms. 
 - Strong understanding of software architecture, automated testing, CI/CD, cloud deployment, and production operations. 
 - Ability to lead complex technical work while remaining hands-on. 
 - Strong technical judgement and clear written and verbal communication. 

Strong Plus

- Experience with LangGraph, AutoGen, Semantic Kernel, or custom agent orchestration frameworks. 
 - Working knowledge of transformer architectures, model fine-tuning, inference strategies, or model evaluation. 
 - Experience with vector databases, model gateways, prompt lifecycle platforms, or AI observability tools. 
 - Experience with Kubernetes, Docker, messaging systems, event-driven architectures, or distributed systems. 
 - Experience in enterprise middleware, workflow orchestration, ERP, or integration platforms. 
 - Experience building internal platforms, developer tools, or reusable capabilities used across engineering teams. 
 - Exposure to regulated, security-sensitive, or high-availability enterprise environments. 

What Success Looks Like

- Delivers significant AI systems or platform capabilities with measurable adoption and operational reliability. 
 - Creates reusable engineering patterns that can be adopted across multiple teams. 
 - Improves technical decisions by clearly documenting trade-offs and validating them with evidence. 
 - Leads complex initiatives from technical design through production deployment and operational ownership. 
 - Maintains strong individual technical contribution while influencing broader engineering outcomes. 
 - Becomes a trusted technical contributor across the AI and Agentic Engineering organization. 

If you like growth and working with happy, enthusiastic over-achievers, you'll enjoy your career with us!

data.description:
SENIOR AI ENGINEER

Azure Agents  |  Python & Claude  |  Power Platform  |  Intelligent Automation

Experience 8 to 12 years            

Location Hyderabad (Hybrid)

Employment  Full-time

Start date - November 16th

  

About the role

We are looking for a senior, hands-on AI engineering leader to design, build and deploy enterprise AI applications, intelligent automation solutions and production-grade AI agents on Microsoft Azure. You will combine strong Python/software engineering with Microsoft Agent Framework (MAF), Claude and other open-source agent technologies, along with deep Power Apps and Power Automate implementation skills. You will lead a small engineering team, remain directly involved in code and solution design, and take solutions from discovery through production and support. 

What you will do

Own solution design and hands-on delivery of AI-enabled business applications, multi-agent workflows and enterprise automation programs; convert business processes into secure, scalable technical designs. 

Build and orchestrate AI agents using Microsoft Agent Framework (MAF), Python, Microsoft Foundry/Azure OpenAI, Anthropic Claude and suitable open-source frameworks; implement tool calling, MCP integrations, state management, RAG and human-in-the-loop controls. 

Develop Power Apps (canvas and/or model-driven), Power Automate cloud flows, Dataverse-backed applications, approval journeys, exception queues, notifications, audit trails and reusable portal/landing-zone components. 

Engineer solutions for document and data extraction, forecast/presentation preparation, invoice and payment processing, asset and fleet onboarding, incentive/commission processing and cross-functional workflow tracking. 

Integrate solutions with enterprise systems such as ERP, finance, HR, operations and legacy/on-premise applications using REST APIs, custom connectors, Azure Functions, Logic Apps, API Management, SQL and secure identity patterns. 

Build reliable cloud services and data/AI pipelines; apply CI/CD, automated testing, logging, observability, evaluation, cost controls, access management and production troubleshooting. 

Lead and mentor engineers, review code and architecture, split work into deliverable increments, manage technical risks, collaborate with customer stakeholders and own quality through go-live. 

Identify opportunities for future predictive AI/ML, document intelligence, knowledge assistants, decision support and process optimization; prototype and productize the strongest use cases. 

Required technical experience

10-12+ years in software/cloud engineering, including substantial hands-on Azure development and 3+ years of technical leadership or ownership of end-to-end delivery. 

Expert Python development (APIs, FastAPI or equivalent, SDKs, integrations, testing, background processing and production debugging); solid SQL, data modeling and software engineering fundamentals. 

Hands-on enterprise experience with Power Apps, Power Automate, Dataverse, SharePoint/Microsoft 365 integrations, custom connectors, approvals, environment management, security and ALM. 

Practical GenAI/agent engineering: LLM APIs, prompt and context engineering, tool/function calling, RAG, embeddings/vector search, agent orchestration, structured outputs, evaluations and safeguards. 

Ability to build with Microsoft Agent Framework or demonstrate equivalent production multi-agent/workflow engineering using frameworks such as LangGraph, Semantic Kernel or AutoGen, with willingness to work directly in MAF. 

Experience with Claude models and APIs; ability to build repeatable workflows using Claude Code/Claude Skills or comparable agent tooling. 

Azure services such as Microsoft Foundry/Azure AI, Azure AI Search, Functions, Logic Apps, Storage, Key Vault, Entra ID, API Management, Application Insights and Azure DevOps/GitHub CI/CD. 

Demonstrated expertise in REST/API integration, RBAC, secrets, environment separation, failure handling, monitoring, approval gates and enterprise-grade auditability. 

Good to have

Experience with ML use cases including forecasting, anomaly detection, classification, recommendation or optimization using scikit-learn, PyTorch or other appropriate tools. 

Familiarity with Microsoft Fabric, Power BI, Azure Data Lake, data pipelines, Document Intelligence, Copilot Studio and AI Builder. 

Experience modernizing finance/operations workflows connected to NetSuite, Oracle, SAP or other enterprise applications. 

Experience deploying containerized services or working with Kubernetes, infrastructure as code and cloud architecture best practices. 

What success looks like

Working AI/automation solutions delivered in short increments, with measurable business value and reliable production operations. 

Reusable engineering patterns for agents, applications, connectors, approval workflows, security, evaluation and observability. 

An effective engineering team that produces high-quality code and can support both current automation programs and emerging AI/ML initiatives. 

Who will thrive here

You are a builder and technical leader-not only a low-code developer, prompt engineer or high-level architect. You are comfortable writing code, designing systems, coaching engineers and presenting your solution choices to business and technology stakeholders. You select deterministic automation when it is the safer choice and AI agents when reasoning, unstructured data or dynamic decision-making add clear value.
