data.title: Senior Solutions Automation Engineer
data.description:
Description

Hungry, Humble, Honest, with a Heart. 

The Opportunity

Nutanix Validated Designs (NVDs) certify Nutanix Solutions cross-product interoperability at scale. Solutions Automation Engineers build the software behind that certification: the programmatic environment builds and validation workflows that Solutions Architects and Quality Engineering rely on. 

We are changing how that work gets done. Standing up infrastructure is already a solved problem for us, because our Python infrastructure-as-code tooling builds the same environment the same way every time. Judgment is the harder part, and it covers reading a validated design, catching the contradictions buried in it, and justifying every design decision before anything gets built. That is the work we are handing to agents. 

In this role you will write the deterministic Python that has to be correct on every run, and you will build the agentic workflows around it: the prompts, the skills, the guardrails, and the evaluations that decide when an agent can act on its own and when control belongs to a pipeline or to a person. 

You will work on hard problems at scale, with the freedom to deliver, alongside engineers who care about getting it right. 

Your Role

- Design, build, and maintain Python software that deploys, configures, and validates Nutanix private and hybrid cloud environments. 
 - Build agentic workflows around that software, including prompt engineering, agent skill and tool development, and the evaluation harnesses that show a workflow works before we rely on it. 
 - Decide what belongs in deterministic code and what belongs to an agent, and be able to defend that decision. Most of what you deliver should be deterministic and repeatable, with agents used where the problem involves ambiguity, synthesis, or design judgment. 
 - Use agentic coding tools in your daily work, and help raise the team's practice as the tooling changes. 
 - Build and operate cloud native, automated pipelines, covering containerized workloads, CI/CD, and infrastructure as code, so that builds and validations run without manual intervention. 
 - Automate validation as part of building the feature, and catch regressions before a release reaches a customer. 
 - Analyze failures, determine root cause, and drive fixes to closure. 
 - Demo your work to Solutions Architects, product teams, and customers, and write documentation that other people can actually use. 
 - Engage with customers and support when needed to solve production issues. 

What You'll Bring

- Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or a related field. 
 - 6+ years building production software, with real depth in at least one role. 
 - Python is required. We are looking for production-grade depth and the ability to own a Python codebase that other people depend on. 
 - Hands-on experience building with LLMs and agentic tooling: prompt engineering, agent skills or tool definitions, and testing and evaluating non-deterministic systems. 
 - Good judgment about where automation should be deterministic and where an agent adds value, and the discipline to keep the trusted path in code. 
 - Strong fundamentals in Object-Oriented Programming, algorithms, data structures, and problem solving. 
 - Cloud native delivery experience: containerized applications (Docker, Kubernetes) and automated CI/CD pipelines. 
 - Experience working against REST APIs and building infrastructure as code. 
 - Experience with a "systems" product such as storage, virtualization, networking, databases, or operating systems. 
 - Skill in debugging complex distributed applications. 
 - Excellent written and verbal communication, and the confidence to present technical work to customers and senior stakeholders. 
 - A self-starter who can work independently, juggle competing priorities, respect differences, and maintain professionalism under pressure. 

Nice to Have

- Additional languages beyond Python: Golang, JavaScript, TypeScript, Node. js, React, Angular, etc. 
 - Experience with Terraform, Ansible, or comparable infrastructure as code tooling. 
 - Background as a platform engineer, SRE, or solutions architect who writes production code. 
 - Experience with Jira, GitHub, Artifactory, and modern CI systems. 
 - Public evidence of your work: GitHub projects, open source contributions, or published technical writing. 

Work Arrangement

Hybrid: This role operates in a hybrid capacity, blending the benefits of remote work with the advantages of in-person collaboration. In locations where our workplace policy applies (i. e. San Jose, Durham, Mexico City, Bangalore, Pune, Hoofddorp, Belgrade, Barcelona, Singapore, Sydney and Tokyo), employees are expected to work onsite a minimum of 3 days per week to foster collaboration, team alignment, and access to in-office resources. Workplace type may vary based on location and team requirements. Please speak with your recruiter for details. Additional team-specific guidance and norms will be provided by your manager. 

--

data.title: SASE Firewall QA Automation Engineer
data.description:
Role Overview

NETGEAR is looking for a QA Automation Engineer to help validate our next-generation firewall and cybersecurity platform. In this role, you will build and maintain automated tests that verify firewall behavior across critical security domains including Next-Generation Firewall (NGFW), Secure Access Service Edge (SASE), Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA), Secure Web Gateways (SWG), Virtual Private Networks (VPN), and Software-Defined Wide Area Networks (SD-WAN). 

Working alongside firewall developers and senior QA engineers, you will automate functional, regression, and performance testing against real and simulated network traffic. You will not be expected to know every area of the stack on day one - we will support you in growing across it. 

Key Responsibilities

- Develop and maintain automated test suites that validate firewall functionality - policy and rule evaluation, NAT, stateful session handling, and traffic filtering across NGFW, SASE, ZTNA, SWG, VPN, and SD-WAN features. 
 - Build and maintain test topologies and lab environments, including virtual machines, containers, and physical firewall appliances. 
 - Generate and shape realistic network traffic to exercise the firewall data plane, and verify observed behavior against expected policy outcomes. 
 - Run test suites in CI, triage failures, distinguish product defects from environment and test issues, and file clear, reproducible defect reports with supporting packet captures and logs. 
 - Contribute to test plans and test-case design from firewall requirements, and help keep automation coverage mapped to those test cases. 
 - Support performance and scale testing - throughput, connections per second, and concurrent sessions - and help identify regressions. 
 - Work with developers to improve testability, and stay current with automation tooling, including AI-assisted test generation, maintenance, and failure triage. 

Required Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in computer science, Engineering, or a related technical field. 
 - 2-4 years of professional experience in QA automation or test engineering, preferably for networking or security products. 
 - Strong automation scripting ability in Python and Bash, comfort working in Ubuntu or other Linux environments from the command line, and day-to-day use of Git. 
 - Working knowledge of networking protocols and traffic flows - TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP/HTTPS, TLS/SSL, NAT, and routing fundamentals. 
 - Understanding of firewall fundamentals such as packet filtering, stateful connection tracking, NAT, and rule and policy evaluation. 
 - Hands-on experience with Linux networking and firewall tooling - iptables and nftables rule configuration, conntrack for session inspection, and iproute2 (ip addr, ip route, network namespaces, bridges, VLANs) for building and inspecting test topologies. 
 - Proficient in analyzing logs and network captures using tools such as Wireshark, tshark, and tcpdump. 
 - Experience with a test framework and runner such as pytest or Robot Framework. 
 - Experience with REST API testing using Postman, REST Assured, or scripted HTTP clients, for validating firewall management and policy APIs. 
 - Experience running automated tests in CI/CD pipelines (e. g. , Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI). 
 - Familiarity with defect tracking and test management tools (e. g. , Jira, TestRail, Xray), and good communication skills in an agile, cross-functional team. 

Preferred Qualifications (optional)

- Experience with traffic generation, shaping, and impairment tools such as iperf3, Scapy, hping3, tc/netem, TRex, or commercial testers like Spirent or Ixia. 
 - Contributions to open-source security or networking projects. 
 - Exposure to firewall security testing - IPS/IDS signature validation, TLS/SSL inspection, URL filtering, and threat-feed verification. 
 - Familiarity with virtualization and container tooling for building test labs - Docker and Docker Compose, VMware or KVM, Kubernetes - and with infrastructure-as-code such as Ansible or Terraform. 
 - Exposure to performance and scale testing, and to high-availability and failover validation. 
 - Familiarity with AI-assisted and agentic testing tools - for example LLM-assisted test generation, self-healing test maintenance, or agent-based exploratory testing - and an interest in applying them to network security test suites. 
 - Experience automating network devices and appliances over SSH and CLI using libraries such as Paramiko or Netmiko. 
 - Familiarity with certificate and PKI tooling such as OpenSSL, for generating test certificates and validating TLS/SSL inspection behavior. 
 - Experience validating firewall logging and telemetry - syslog, NetFlow, or IPFIX export - against expected policy events. 

Company Statement

At NETGEAR, we are on a mission to unleash the full potential of connectivity with intelligent solutions that delight and protect. We turn ideas into innovative networking products that connect people, power businesses, and advance the way we live. 

We're a performance-driven, talented and connected team that's committed to delivering world-class products for our customers. As a company, we value our employees as the most essential building blocks of our success. And as teammates, we commit to taking our work to the Next Gear by living our values: we Dare to Transform the future, Connect and Delight our customers, Communicate Courageously with each other and collaborate to Win It Together. You'll find our values woven through our processes, present in our decisions, and celebrated throughout our culture. 

We strive to attract top talent and create a great workplace where people feel engaged, inspired, challenged, proud and respected. If you are creative, forward-thinking, passionate about technology and are looking for a rewarding career to make an impact, then you've got what it takes to succeed at NETGEAR. Join our network and help us shape the future of connectivity. 

NETGEAR hires based on merit. All qualified applicants will receive equal consideration for employment. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

data.title: Engineering Manager
data.description:
Engineering Manager

Lead engineering excellence, high-velocity delivery and enterprise platform transformation by building high-performing engineering teams, driving automation and delivering scalable, reliable and secure platform solutions across ITSM, ITOM, CMDB and Observability ecosystems. 

Opportunity to be one of our first team members in Woolworths Group India in Bangalore. 

Woolworths Group India is partnering exclusively with Zinnov Group to recruit for this position. 

About this role

As an Engineering Manager, you will play a pivotal role in leading a high-performing platform engineering squad, combining hands-on technical leadership with people management to drive engineering excellence, delivery velocity and operational reliability. 

Working closely with Platform Managers, Product Owners, Architects and cross-functional engineering teams across Sydney and Bangalore, you will translate strategic platform roadmaps and architectural blueprints into high-quality, scalable and production-ready engineering solutions. 

With a strong focus on enterprise platform engineering, ServiceNow, ITSM, ITOM, CMDB, Observability and DevSecOps, you will lead engineers and technical specialists to deliver robust platform capabilities, automated workflows, seamless integrations and reliable enterprise services. 

You will champion engineering craftsmanship, automation-first practices, Service Management as Code (SMaC), continuous integration and delivery, and comprehensive automated testing. Alongside technical delivery, you will coach and develop engineering talent, build an inclusive high-performance culture and take accountability for the quality, stability and continuous improvement of your squad's engineering outcomes. 

What you'll do

Engineering Leadership & Agile Delivery: Lead a high-performing squad of engineers, platform specialists and QA automation professionals to translate product backlogs, architectural designs and business requirements into secure, scalable and maintainable software releases. Own technical sprint planning, backlog refinement, effort estimation, delivery forecasting and execution in partnership with Product Owners, Platform Managers and Scrum Masters. 

Enterprise Platform Engineering: Provide technical leadership across one or more enterprise platform domains, including ServiceNow ITSM, ITOM, CMDB/CSDM and Observability. Drive technical solution design, implementation standards, code reviews and engineering best practices to deliver reliable and reusable platform capabilities. 

ITSM & Employee Experience Engineering: Lead engineering across ServiceNow Incident, Problem, Change, Request, Service Catalog, Employee Center, Service Portal and Virtual Agent capabilities. Enable seamless employee experiences, omni-channel self-service and integrated enterprise IT workflows. 

ITOM, Event Management & Automation: Drive engineering across ServiceNow ITOM, Event Management, ITOM Health, Discovery, Service Mapping and Cloud Automation. Implement intelligent event correlation, alert noise reduction, automated remediation playbooks and operational automation across hybrid cloud and retail environments. 

CMDB, CSDM & Configuration Governance: Lead engineering and governance across ServiceNow CMDB, Common Service Data Model (CSDM), Hardware Asset Management (HAM) and Software Asset Management (SAM). Drive configuration data accuracy, completeness, automated discovery, reconciliation and service dependency mapping. 

Observability & Telemetry Engineering: Lead the implementation and optimisation of enterprise observability solutions using Dynatrace, Splunk, PagerDuty and OpenTelemetry. Establish end-to-end tracing, metrics collection, log analytics, dashboarding and synthetic monitoring to improve visibility across critical retail and digital customer journeys. 

DevSecOps & Service Management as Code: Champion Service Management as Code (SMaC) and DevSecOps practices by embedding infrastructure and service configuration into code repositories. Build and maintain REST/GraphQL APIs, ServiceNow Integration Hub spokes and event-driven integrations with GitHub Actions, Jenkins and Terraform. Embed security scanning, code quality checks and automated release controls into engineering workflows. 

Automated Testing & Release Engineering: Establish comprehensive automated testing and regression frameworks using ServiceNow Automated Test Framework (ATF) and modern testing tools. Drive reliable platform deployments, ServiceNow family upgrades, security patching and telemetry collector upgrades while maintaining platform stability and minimising operational disruption. 

Site Reliability Engineering & Platform Operations: Partner with Architecture, SRE and Operations teams to establish platform health monitoring, automated health checks and synthetic testing. Drive performance optimisation, capacity management, API efficiency and high availability. Act as a senior technical escalation point for critical incidents, leading root cause analysis, blameless post-mortems and permanent corrective actions. 

Engineering Metrics & Continuous Improvement: Establish and monitor engineering performance metrics, including DORA metrics such as Deployment Frequency, Lead Time for Changes, Change Failure Rate and Mean Time to Restore (MTTR). Improve sprint velocity, engineering throughput, release stability and operational maturity while balancing feature delivery with technical debt reduction and platform modernisation. 

People Leadership & Talent Development: Directly manage, coach and mentor a team of approximately 510 engineers and technical specialists across Bangalore and Sydney. Conduct regular one-on-ones, establish performance objectives, support career development, facilitate technical upskilling and build a culture of accountability, collaboration and continuous learning. 

Cross-Functional & Stakeholder Collaboration: Partner closely with Platform Managers, Product Owners, Principal Engineers, Architects, Scrum Masters, Cyber Security and SRE teams. Build strong relationships with business stakeholders and external technology partners to align engineering priorities with enterprise platform objectives and business outcomes. 

What you'll bring

Hands-On Engineering Leadership: Demonstrated experience leading software engineering, platform engineering or observability teams within enterprise Agile environments. Ability to combine technical authority and architectural understanding with pragmatic delivery execution. 

Enterprise Platform Expertise: Strong technical experience in at least one of the following domains: ServiceNow Enterprise Platform (ITSM, ITOM, CMDB, CSDM), Observability platforms (Dynatrace, Splunk, OpenTelemetry) or enterprise IT operations and automation ecosystems. 

ServiceNow Engineering: Practical experience with ServiceNow platform development, scripting, Flow Designer, Integration Hub, Service Catalog, CMDB, CSDM, Automated Test Framework (ATF) and enterprise integrations, particularly for candidates specialising in ServiceNow engineering. 

ITOM & AIOps Engineering: Understanding of event management, service mapping, automated discovery, intelligent event correlation, alert management and operational remediation workflows. 

Observability & Monitoring: Hands-on experience with observability and telemetry platforms such as Dynatrace, Splunk, PagerDuty and OpenTelemetry, including monitoring architecture, distributed tracing, log analytics and performance optimisation. 

DevSecOps & CI/CD Engineering: Strong understanding of Git-based development, automated CI/CD pipelines, REST/GraphQL APIs, containerised environments, automated security scanning, Infrastructure as Code and Service Management as Code practices. 

Agile Delivery & Engineering Metrics: Proven ability to lead Scrum/Kanban delivery, facilitate sprint ceremonies, manage technical backlogs, perform effort estimation and optimise engineering throughput using DORA metrics and delivery performance indicators. 

Quality Engineering & Automation: Experience establishing automated testing frameworks, regression testing, code quality standards, release governance and automated deployment controls to ensure reliable production releases. 

Site Reliability & Operational Excellence: Understanding of SRE principles, incident management, root cause analysis, performance optimisation, platform health monitoring and operational reliability within complex enterprise environments. 

People Management & Team Development: Demonstrated ability to manage, mentor and develop engineering teams, establish performance objectives, conduct talent reviews and foster an inclusive, collaborative and high-performing engineering culture. 

Stakeholder Management & Communication: Strong communication and stakeholder engagement skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with Product Owners, Architects, Platform Managers, business teams and distributed engineering squads across locations. 

Career Experience: 7+ years of progressive software or platform engineering experience, including at least 24 years of demonstrated experience leading, mentoring or managing engineering teams within complex enterprise environments. A proven track record of delivering enterprise-grade platform capabilities, API integrations, automated testing pipelines or observability solutions. 

Education: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology or a related quantitative discipline. 

Certifications (Desirable): 

- ServiceNow: Certified System Administrator (CSA), Certified Application Developer (CAD) or Certified Implementation Specialist (CIS) in ITSM, Discovery, Event Management or Service Mapping. 
 - Observability: Dynatrace Certified Professional, Splunk Certified Administrator or Google Cloud certifications. 
 - Agile & IT Service Management: Certified ScrumMaster (CSM), SAFe Practitioner or ITIL v4 Foundation. 

What you'll experience

- Be part of Australia's largest retailer and contribute to its growing technology and engineering capabilities in India. 
 - Opportunity to build and lead high-performing engineering teams within a large-scale enterprise technology ecosystem. 
 - Work across strategic platform engineering domains, including ServiceNow, ITSM, ITOM, CMDB, CSDM and Observability. 
 - Collaborate directly with senior engineering leaders, Platform Managers, Architects and Product Owners across Australia and India. 
 - Drive engineering transformation through DevSecOps, CI/CD, Service Management as Code and automation-first practices. 
 - Influence technical architecture, engineering standards, platform modernisation and enterprise delivery roadmaps. 
 - Lead initiatives focused on platform reliability, operational excellence, engineering quality and measurable business outcomes. 
 - Opportunity to mentor and develop engineering talent while building a strong, collaborative engineering culture. 
 - Exposure to leading enterprise technologies and global technology partners, including ServiceNow, Dynatrace, Splunk and Google Cloud. 
 - Continuous technical learning, leadership development and opportunities for professional growth. 
 - A flexible approach to work.

Diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging are key to realising our purpose of better together for a better tomorrow. We recognise the value our team's diversity brings to our business, customers, and communities and that teams with diverse experiences and backgrounds enrich our group and are better able to innovate and solve problems.

data.description:
Who We Are

At Bluehost, we believe all small businesses deserve the opportunity to succeed online. Our mission is to give small businesses the confidence to think big. We're the all-in-one platform for small businesses to grow online with powerful simplicity, premium performance, smart tools and human support. 

As Bluehost scales, reliability and good data both depend on strong platform engineering. You'll lead the team that keeps our infrastructure resilient and our data trustworthy - from cloud architecture and containerized hosting to backup/disaster recovery, observability, and the pipelines that turn raw data into insight for product and growth teams across a fast-growing SMB SaaS platform. 

What You'll Do & How You'll Make Your Mark

This is a player-coach role: you'll manage a small team while staying hands-on as a software engineer yourself. 

As a manager

- Lead and develop a team of ~4 engineers spanning data engineering, devops, cloud infrastructure, hosting solutions, and observability - hiring, mentoring, and owning performance and career development. 
 - Set technical direction and priorities across the team's full portfolio: data pipelines, public cloud configuration, containerized hosting, backup/disaster recovery, observability, and internal automation. 
 - Partner directly with product, analytics, security, and engineering leadership to translate ambiguous business needs into infrastructure and data roadmaps. 
 - Drive on-call and incident-response practices so pipeline, cloud, and hosting issues are caught before they hit customers or a dashboard. 
 - Report on team health, system reliability, and roadmap progress to leadership. 

As an engineer

- Personally design, build, and maintain production systems across the team's domains - pipelines, cloud infrastructure, containerized services, and automation - not just review others' work. 
 - Write and review code for data pipelines, devops tooling, cloud configuration (infrastructure-as-code), observability instrumentation, and backup/recovery solutions. 
 - Own or co-own the most complex or cross-cutting technical problems - architecture decisions, major incidents, and backup/DR strategy and testing. 
 - Use AI-assisted tools (Copilot, Cursor) to speed up your own development and debugging, and help the team adopt them effectively. 
 - Write tested, version-controlled code and contribute to CI/CD practices that catch regressions - data-quality, infrastructure, or otherwise - before they ship. 
 - Document architecture, data models, lineage, and operational runbooks so other teams can self-serve with confidence. 

Who You Are & What You'll Need To Succeed

- 4-6 years of hands-on engineering experience across data pipelines, cloud infrastructure, or devops, including some experience leading projects, mentoring engineers, or formally managing a team. 
 - Real experience building and operating production systems - not just one-off scripts - across at least two of: data pipelines, devops, cloud infrastructure, containerized hosting, observability, or backup/DR. 
 - Solid experience with relational databases and dimensional data-warehousing concepts, and strong SQL skills. 
 - Experience with public cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP, or Oracle Cloud) - configuration, cost management, and security fundamentals. 
 - Experience with containerized hosting (Docker, Kubernetes, or similar). 
 - Experience with observability tooling (Datadog, Prometheus/Grafana, ELK, or similar) and backup/disaster-recovery practices. 
 - Working proficiency in Python (preferred) or another language commonly used for data or platform engineering. 
 - Comfortable using AI-assisted tools (Copilot, Cursor) to speed up development, debugging, and validation. 
 - Strong communicator, able to translate ambiguous business needs into technical plans for both your team and stakeholders. 

Bonus

- Experience with cloud data warehouses (Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift, or ClickHouse), orchestration tools (Airflow, Dagster, Prefect), or event-streaming tools (Kafka). 
 - Prior experience formally managing an engineering team. 

Why You'll Love Us

- We've evolved. we provide three work environment scenarios. You can feel like a Newfolder in a work-from-home, hybrid, or work-from-the-office environment. 
 - Work-life balance. Our work is thrilling and meaningful, but we know balance is key to living well. 
 - We celebrate one another's differences. We're proud of our culture of diversity and inclusion. We foster a culture of belonging. Our company and customers benefit when employees bring their authentic selves to work. We have programs that bring us together on important issues and provide learning and development opportunities for all employees. We have 20 + affinity groups where you can network and connect with Newfolders globally. 
 - Where can we take you? We're fans of helping our employees learn different aspects of the business, be challenged with new tasks, be mentored, and grow their careers. Unfold new possibilities with Bluehost #OTOD!

Role SummaryWe are hiring a Full Stack Engineer to build and run data-driven web applications end to end: Java/Spring Boot services, React/TypeScript front ends, MongoDB and MySQL data stores, and the web scraping pipelines that feed them. You will own features from data acquisition through API to UI. 

- Experience: 3 years
 - Location: Bangalore
 - Employment type: Full-time
 - Reports to: Technical Lead
 - Core stack: Java, Spring Boot, React, TypeScript, MongoDB, MySQL, Web ScrapingKey Responsibilities
 - Design, build and maintain RESTful services and microservices in Java and Spring Boot. 
 - Build responsive, reusable UI components and pages in React with TypeScript. 
 - Design data models and write efficient queries for MongoDB (documents, indexes, aggregation pipelines) and MySQL (schemas, joins, query tuning). 
 - Build and maintain web scraping and crawling pipelines that collect, clean, normalise and store data from websites and APIs at scale. 
 - Handle scraping challenges: dynamic JavaScript pages, pagination, rate limits, retries, proxies, and changes to site structure. 
 - Integrate scraped and third-party data into backend services and expose it through APIs and the UI. 
 - Write unit and integration tests; take part in code reviews and keep code quality high. 
 - Monitor, debug and improve the performance and reliability of applications in production. 
 - Work with product, QA and data teams to turn requirements into shipped features. 
 - Follow responsible scraping practice: respect robots. txt, site terms and data-privacy rules. Required Skills
 - Java: Strong core Java (Java 11+) - OOP, collections, streams, concurrency, exception handling. 
 - Spring Boot: REST APIs, Spring Data (JPA and MongoDB), Spring Security, dependency injection, scheduled jobs. 
 - React: Hooks, component design, state management (Redux, Zustand or Context), routing, form handling. 
 - TypeScript: Typed components and API clients, interfaces and generics, strict mode. 
 - MongoDB: Document schema design, indexing, aggregation framework, performance tuning.

data.description:
About Rippling

Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system. 

Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365-all within 90 seconds. 

Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1. 8B+ from the world's top investors-including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock-and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes. 

We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling. com addresses. 

About The Role

The Monetization Platform team owns the systems behind how Rippling sells, contracts, bills, collects, and recognizes revenue across products and countries. 

This is the platform behind the Quote -> Contract -> Entitlement -> Subscription -> Usage -> Bill -> Revenue lifecycle. It supports a $1B+ sales base, manages entitlements, metering, and usage-based billing rules, and enables localized billing for new country launches. The team gives Rippling the foundation to launch new products, pricing models, and markets without rebuilding monetization logic each time. 

Our vision: "Let any team monetize any product, anywhere, without writing code. "

We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer to build the next generation platform. This is an Individual Contributor role for someone who can own broad, ambiguous, multi-team technical charters, influence technical direction without relying on formal authority, and stay close to the code. 

You will work on systems where errors are expensive: contracts, entitlement state, subscription state, usage meters, invoices, payments, taxes, revenue data, audit trails, and customer-facing billing experiences. You will define architecture, make hard tradeoffs, mentor technical leaders, and build a platform that lets Rippling monetize new products faster and with more confidence.

- System Design: Design scalable, reliable systems that handles contracting, subscription management, invoicing, billing and revenue recognition

As a Senior Backend Engineer on the Authentication team, you'll build authentication features across the Rails monolith and GATE. GATE is our new service for issuing and validating tokens and managing identities, designed to support every GitLab deployment model. 

You'll expand authentication mechanisms, including support for identities used by artificial intelligence (AI) agents. You'll also help keep GitLab and its customers secure by building access management tooling and addressing vulnerabilities reported through our HackerOne program. 

GATE will become the foundation for token issuance, validation, and identity services across GitLab. com multi-tenant software as a service (SaaS), Self-Managed, Dedicated, and air-gapped environments. Your work will affect core components that customers, users, and GitLab teams rely on. 

Some Of Our Projects Include

- Building GATE as the centralized service for token issuance and validation
 - Consolidating tokens and migrating authentication paths out of the Rails monolith
 - Building passkeys and passwordless authentication
 - Developing composite identities that combine machine and human authorization for AI
 - Improving service accounts and secure automation
 - Enhancing Security Assertion Markup Language (SAML), Lightweight Directory Access Protocol (LDAP), OpenID Connect (OIDC), and System for Cross-domain Identity Management (SCIM) capabilities for automated user provisioning and single sign-on (SSO)

What you'll do

- Shape the roadmap for GATE and GitLab's authentication services with the team. 
 - Design and implement token issuance, validation, and identity services in Go and Ruby across the Rails monolith and GATE, including new authentication mechanisms such as Workload Identity Federation. 
 - Migrate authentication and token management paths from the monolith into GATE while maintaining reliability across all deployment models. 
 - Build authentication mechanisms from the ground up, such as Workload Identity Federation. 
 - Strengthen security for users and organizations through access management tooling and by addressing vulnerabilities reported through our HackerOne program. 
 - Define and improve standards for style, maintainability, and engineering practices in a high-scale environment, and advocate for them through code review. 
 - Communicate publicly about GitLab initiatives, projects, and contributions from people not working for GitLab Inc. Reflect GitLab's values in these communications. 
 - Ship moderately sized features and improvements with moderate guidance and support from other team members, and collaborate on larger projects, including the build-out of GATE. 
 - Participate in the maintainer trainee program at your own comfortable pace while working toward becoming a project maintainer. 

What you'll bring

- Professional experience with Go and/or Ruby in scaling or mission-critical SaaS products. 
 - Familiarity with authentication and authorization technologies or techniques, such as OAuth, OIDC, SAML, SSO, SCIM, LDAP, JSON Web Tokens (JWTs), role-based access control (RBAC), or identity and access management (IAM). 
 - Knowledge of token systems, cryptographic signing, and key management. 
 - Experience building or contributing to a service from concept to production, including proposal, discussion, and execution. 
 - Proficiency in written and verbal English, with the ability to communicate complex problems and solutions clearly in a remote, largely asynchronous work environment. 
 - Experience diagnosing, preventing, and resolving performance and optimization problems. 
 - Experience working in an iterative software development process, managing your work effectively, staying organized, and following through on priorities. 

About The Team

Our mission is to empower GitLab system administrators with the toolkit they need to create their desired balance of security and accessibility for their GitLab experience. 

Authentication is the first impression a new customer has when they configure a new GitLab instance. We aim to make it as seamless as possible, from that first login to onboarding users and managing security rules for their instance in a secure, flexible, and scalable way.

Become part of a winning team and help to deliver the Green Energy transition.

In that context and for Germany, Grid Solutions is partnering with German TSOs which plans to invest more than $30B by 2030 in deploying new HVDC converter stations to bring Offshore Wind energy into Germany and the Netherlands.

Senior Product Validation Engineer - Aprisa

Company Overview

Siemens EDA is a global technology leader in Electronic Design Automation software. Our software tools enable companies around the world to develop highly innovative electronic products faster and more cost-effectively. Our customers use our tools to push the boundaries of technology and physics to deliver better products in the increasingly complex world of chip, board, and system design. 

Position Overview

Join the Aprisa Product Validation Engineering team and take on a leadership role in qualifying one of the industry's most advanced digital implementation platforms. You'll work across the complete backend design flow to validate and benchmark Aprisa features, ensuring functional correctness, performance, and quality of results for leading semiconductor companies. This is an opportunity to grow as a technical expert in digital physical design while collaborating with R&D, Product Engineering, and Customer Support teams globally. You'll influence product quality and drive innovation in advanced-node semiconductor design. 

Key Responsibilities

- Validate Aprisa functionality across the complete digital implementation flow, including floorplanning, placement, clock tree synthesis, routing, timing closure, power optimization, and signoff convergence
 - Develop and implement comprehensive validation plans for new tool features, technology nodes, and customer-reported issues
 - Build and maintain automated regression environments for product qualification and continuous testing
 - Analyze quality of results differences, identify root causes, and collaborate with R&D teams to verify product fixes
 - Validate Aprisa on advanced process technologies including FinFET and Gate-All-Around nodes
 - Benchmark Aprisa against internal reference designs and customer workloads to ensure competitive performance
 - Collaborate with Application Engineering and Customer Support teams to understand real-world design challenges and incorporate them into validation workflows
 - Contribute to continuous improvement of validation methodologies, automation frameworks, and testing infrastructure

Qualifications

Required: 

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electronics Engineering, Microelectronics, VLSI Design, Electrical Engineering, or related field
 - Experience in physical design, product validation, backend implementation, timing closure, EDA tool development, or application engineering
 - Strong understanding of the digital ASIC implementation flow and physical design concepts
 - Working knowledge of static timing analysis, timing optimization, power analysis and optimization, and advanced process technologies
 - Proficiency in scripting languages: Tcl, Perl, Python, or Shell scripting
 - Experience creating automation, regression, and benchmarking environments
 - Strong debugging and root-cause analysis skills

Preferred: 

- Hands-on experience with industry-standard EDA tools such as Aprisa, Innovus, ICC2, PrimeTime, or Calibre
 - Experience developing automated validation frameworks and regression systems
 - Knowledge of machine learning techniques applied to physical design
 - Familiarity with version control systems and software development workflows

Technical Competencies

- Strong Linux/Unix working experience
 - Understanding of semiconductor manufacturing processes, design rules, and physical effects impacting implementation quality
 - Ability to work with floorplanning, placement, CTS, routing, physical verification, and timing closure workflows

Behavioral Competencies

- Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities
 - Self-driven learner with interest in semiconductor technology and EDA innovation
 - Verbal and written communication skills
 - Collaboration and ability to work effectively across global teams
 - Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced product development environment
 - Demonstrated ownership and accountability for quality

Why Us

At Siemens Software, flexibility is how we work-hybrid by default, built on trust and autonomy. Together, 30, 000 people across more than 200 countries build technology that shapes the real world. You'll grow through real projects, strong technical peers, and global mobility, backed by the scale and benefits of an industrial software leader. We are fully committed to providing equitable opportunities and building a workplace that reflects the diversity of society, while ensuring that we attract the best talent based on qualifications, skills, and experiences. We welcome you to bring your authentic self and transform the everyday with us.

data.title: Android Automation Engineer
data.description:
An Automation Engineer (Android) builds and maintains the automated tests and tooling that keep our Android app stable and releases on schedule. The role centers on using Appium with TypeScript (e. g. WebdriverIO) to automate native Android app workflows on emulators and real devices, backed by API checks that validate what happens behind the UI. AI coding agents (Copilot, Cursor, etc. ) are part of the daily routine, used to write tests faster, investigate failures, and keep suites maintainable over time. This engineer owns Android testing for their product areas and decides how best to cover them, while sharing frameworks, standards, and code reviews with the wider automation team. 

Roles and Responsibilities: 

- Design and develop automated tests for Android app features, workflows, and regression testing using Appium and TypeScript 
 - Implement and maintain test frameworks, and tools, including screen objects, device and capability configuration, and shared utilities. 
 - Collaborate with Android developers and cross-functional teams to improve app testability (e. g. stable accessibility IDs) and identify automation opportunities. 
 - Troubleshoot, stabilize, and enhance existing automated tests, with a focus on reducing flakiness caused by timing, device state, and environment issues. 
 - Ensure automated solutions align with business and technical requirements. 
 - Integrate mobile tests into release pipelines, including app build handling and emulator or device provisioning, and help keep them reliable. 
 - Stay up to date on emerging AI technologies and mobile testing best practices. Skills Required: 

- Strong proficiency in TypeScript, with hands-on experience automating native Android apps using Appium (UiAutomator2 driver) and WebdriverIO or a similar client. 
 - Solid working knowledge of the Android platform: app lifecycle, permissions, ADB, Android Studio, emulators (AVDs), and inspecting UI hierarchies with tools such as Appium Inspector. 
 - Experience building CI/CD pipelines in GitHub and/or GitLab, including running mobile test suites on emulators or device clouds. 
 - Independently diagnose and resolve complex test failures using device logs (logcat), screenshots, and screen recordings. 
 - Comfortable with API testing and writing SQL to validate backend state, verify data integrity after app and API operations, and manage test data across environments. 
 - Working skills with at least one coding agents.

About AlphaSense

AlphaSense is the AI platform redefining market intelligence and workflow orchestration, trusted by thousands of leading organizations to drive faster, more confident decisions in business and finance. The platform combines domain-specific AI with a vast content universe of over 500 million premium business documents - including equity research, earnings calls, expert interviews, filings, news, and internal proprietary content. Purpose-built for speed, accuracy, and enterprise-grade security, AlphaSense helps teams extract critical insights, uncover market-moving trends, and automate complex workflows with high-quality outputs. With AI solutions like Generative Search, Generative Grid, and Deep Research, AlphaSense delivers the clarity and depth professionals need to navigate complexity and obtain accurate, real-time information quickly. For more information, visit www. alpha-sense. com. Come join us. 

About The Role

As a Staff Quality Engineer on the Content Portfolio team, you will own and drive test strategy, build automation frameworks, and embed a culture of quality ownership across the engineering organization. Your deep expertise in automation, cloud services, Kubernetes, and modern programming languages will directly shape how we test, release, and deliver reliable software at scale. You will partner closely with developers, product managers, and platform teams to define test requirements, architect quality infrastructure, and ensure AlphaSense ships with confidence at velocity. 

You Will

- Lead the development of test automation frameworks across UI, API, and GraphQL layers, focusing on reliability, maintainability, and speed 
 - Design and integrate AI evaluation frameworks to assess accuracy, consistency, and reliability of LLM-powered features 
 - Leverage AI-assisted development tools such as Cursor and Claude to accelerate test creation, debugging, and code generation 
 - Lead technical implementation of performance testing and monitoring solutions 
 - Develop custom reporting and analytics tools to provide insights into test coverage, flaky test rates, and quality metrics 
 - Drive adoption of newer testing technologies and approaches 
 - Optimize test execution pipelines for faster feedback in CI/CD environments 
 - Partner with development teams to implement shift-left testing practices and embed quality ownership within teams 
 - Lead root cause analysis for critical issues and drive systematic improvements to prevent recurrence 
 - Participate in code reviews to ensure testability and quality considerations are addressed early 
 - Provide technical mentorship to QE engineers on automation best practices, framework usage, and AI tooling

Desired Skills

- 8+ years of hands-on experience in software quality engineering roles with at least 2 years operating at a Staff/Lead level. 
 - Deep proficiency in testing TypeScript/JavaScript and modern frontend ecosystems (React, Webpack, or similar). 
 - Expert-level experience with Playwright or comparable browser automation frameworks (Cypress, Selenium WebDriver) for end-to-end testing. 
 - Strong experience with unit and component testing frameworks such as Vitest, Jest, or React Testing Library. 
 - Proven track record of designing and building test automation frameworks from scratch or significantly evolving existing ones at scale. 
 - Solid understanding of CI/CD systems (GitHub Actions, Jenkins, Buildkite, Gitlab or similar) and how to integrate and optimize test suites within them. 
 - Experience with GraphQL APIs - Writing integration tests, mocking schemas, and validating query/mutation contracts. 
 - Familiarity with performance and load testing tools (k6, Lighthouse, Artillery). 
 - Experience with visual regression testing (Percy, Chromatic, Playwright visual comparisons). 
 - Hands-on experience with Allure or similar test reporting/analytics platforms. 
 - Understanding of AI/ML-powered products and the unique testing challenges they present (non-deterministic outputs, data quality, model evaluation). 
 - Experience in SaaS, fintech, or market intelligence domains. 
 - Track record of contributing to developer experience improvements like test tooling plugins, custom ESLint rules for test quality, documentation-as-code practices. 
 - Familiarity with Docker, Kubernetes, and cloud infrastructure (AWS/GCP). 
 - Familiarity with AI/LLM evaluation frameworks 
 - Hands-on experience with AI-assisted development tools such as Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or Claude for accelerating test authoring, code review, and debugging. 
 - Experience building or configuring MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers

You have strong Python skills, hands-on experience testing LLM-powered features (prompt regression, tool/function-call validation, RAG correctness, and structured-output schema checks), and working knowledge of evaluation frameworks such as RAGAS, DeepEval, LangSmith or Langfuse. About The Role

As a Staff Backend Engineer, you will provide technical leadership across your team and adjacent teams, solving the highest-scope and most complex problems in your area. You will lead large, cross-cutting backend initiatives, drive our modular architecture strategy, and define the standards that let teams move faster without compromising quality, security, reliability, or operability. 

This is a technical leadership role that combines deep backend expertise, systems judgment, product judgment, and influence across organizational boundaries. You will work with Product, Frontend, Infrastructure, Security, Data, Engineering Managers, and engineers across product groups, bringing subject matter expertise, and you will do it without relying on formal authority. 

Why you'll love this role

- Leverage: Your work multiplies across teams. The platforms, standards, and architectural decisions you lead determine how quickly everyone else can ship. 
 - Genuinely Hard Problems: You'll lead the modernization of a large monolith toward modular, reusable, appropriately independent systems - at the scale of a platform used by millions of users. 
 - Influence Without Bureaucracy: You'll shape technical direction across teams through clear written proposals and decision records, and partner with Product and Engineering leadership on platform roadmap and investment trade-offs. 
 - Frontier AI Work: You'll lead adoption of AI-assisted and agentic engineering workflows and define the review, quality, security, and privacy guardrails that make them safe to rely on. 
 - Autonomy: You'll thrive in our remote-first, asynchronous organization, where clear written communication and self-direction are the pillars of success. 

What You'll Do

- Lead Cross-Cutting Initiatives: Lead the technical design and delivery of large backend initiatives that span teams, and identify and remove systemic bottlenecks across product and infrastructure groups. 
 - Own Architecture Strategy: Drive modular backend, service, data, and platform architecture. Lead modernization of the monolith and legacy backends toward modular, reusable, and appropriately independently operated systems - while preventing fragmentation and service sprawl. 
 - Set the Standards: Define and improve standards for APIs, contracts, compatibility, schema evolution, testing, security, performance, observability, operability, and maintainability - plus the build, test, deploy, release, rollback, and production-readiness practices needed to operate modular features safely. 
 - Establish Shared Patterns: Create the patterns for dependency management, data ownership, eventing, failure isolation, service maturity, and operational documentation. Establish Go service patterns and Kubernetes operating practices where they matter to our production estate, and guide Rust adoption where it solves a real systems, security, performance, or supply-chain problem. 
 - Own What You Build in Production: Take part in on-call and incident response for the systems your teams own, act as a technical escalation point during complex incidents, and turn what you learn into architectural and operational improvements that prevent recurrence. 
 - Influence and Partner: Shape technical direction across teams without formal authority, and partner with Product and Engineering leadership on platform-level roadmap decisions and investment trade-offs. 
 - Grow Engineers: Mentor Senior and Intermediate engineers, shepherd technical debt reduction and reusable patterns that improve throughput, and raise the technical capability of the wider team. 
 - Lead AI Adoption: Lead team-level adoption of AI-assisted and agentic workflows, including the quality, security, privacy, and operational guardrails, and help engineers direct, validate, reject, and course-correct agent output. 

What You'll Bring

- Cross-Team Technical Leadership: A sustained record of technical leadership across more than one team or a broad product area. 
 - Deep Architecture Experience: Deep backend architecture and production experience in complex applications, services, or platforms, including scaling or governing APIs, service platforms, data systems, modular monoliths, or shared backend components. 
 - Modularization in Production: Experience modernizing a monolith or legacy backend architecture in production, and with modular architecture such as bounded contexts, package encapsulation, ports and adapters, service extraction, event-driven boundaries, or an equivalent approach. 
 - Influence Without Authority: A strong ability to create alignment through clear written proposals and decision records, so decisions are documented, understood, and adopted without constant escalation. 
 - Product Judgment: The ability to balance customer outcomes, delivery speed, technical health, reliability, and long-term platform investment. 
 - Mentorship: Experience mentoring engineers and shaping standards through code review, documentation, and example. 
 - Agentic AI Leadership: Production experience with AI-assisted or agentic engineering workflows, including the ability to evaluate and improve how a team adopts them. 

Helpful Experience

- Go services and APIs at scale. 
 - Kubernetes and cloud-native operations, including deployment, scaling, observability, rollback, and production readiness. 
 - Rust adoption or production ownership for systems, security, performance, or platform components. 
 - Ruby/Rails modularization and large-monolith modernization. 
 - PostgreSQL scaling, data partitioning, queues, messaging, or distributed systems. 
 - Security-sensitive product or software supply chain engineering. 
 - Experience across SaaS, single-tenant, self-managed, or air-gapped deployment constraints.

Founded in 2014, Circles is a global technology company reimagining the telco industry with its innovative SaaS platform, empowering telco operators worldwide to effortlessly launch innovative digital brands or refresh existing ones, accelerating their transformation into techcos. 

Today, Circles partners with leading telco operators across multiple countries and continents, including KDDI Corporation, Etisalat Group (e&), AT&T, and Telkomsel, creating blueprints for future telco and digital experiences enjoyed by millions of consumers globally. 

Besides its SaaS business, Circles operates three other distinct businesses: 

- Circles. Life: A wholly-owned digital lifestyle telco brand based in Singapore, Circles. Life is powered by Circles' SaaS platform and pioneering go-to-market strategies. It is the digital market leader in Singapore and has won numerous awards for marketing, customer service, and innovative product offerings beyond connectivity. 
 - Circles Aspire: A global provider of Communications Platform-as-a-Service (CPaaS) solutions. Its cloud-based Experience Cloud platform enables enterprises, service providers and developers to deliver and scale mobile, messaging, IoT, and connectivity services worldwide. 
 - Jetpac: Specializing in travel tech solutions, Jetpac provides seamless eSIM roaming for over 200 destinations and innovative travel lifestyle products, redefining connectivity for digital travelers. Jetpac was awarded Travel eSIM of the Year. 

Circles is backed by renowned global investors, including Peak XV Partners (formerly Sequoia), Warburg Pincus, Founders Fund, and EDBI (the investment arm of the Singapore Economic Development Board), with a track record of backing industry challengers. 

Job Role - Principal Architect

Location - Bangalore , India

Job Description

We are looking for a Principal Architect to provide architecture leadership for our Japan market engineering team supporting povo, KDDI's digital telecommunications platform. 

As a Principal Architect, you will shape the overall technical vision and evolution of the povo platform, working horizontally across product and technology domains. 

You will lead architecture for complex and strategic initiatives, connect business objectives with long-term platform direction, and ensure solutions remain scalable, resilient, maintainable, and cost-efficient. 

You are expected to maintain strong engineering depth, stay close to implementation and production systems, and provide practical technical leadership from strategy through delivery. 

You will also provide technical leadership across engineering teams, aligning them around shared goals, guiding execution of complex initiatives, and building a culture of ownership, collaboration, and engineering excellence. 

Key Responsibilities

- Define and evolve the overall technology and architecture vision for the povo platform. 
 - Lead end-to-end architecture for the most complex, cross-domain, and strategic initiatives. 
 - Ensure individual solution designs align with the long-term platform roadmap and architecture principles. 
 - Act as a senior technical advisor to Engineering Leads, Architects, Product teams, and leadership. 
 - Drive architecture alignment across domains such as identity, subscriber management, billing, payments, promotions, provisioning, usage, plans, and SIM/eSIM. 
 - Own architectural engagement from early requirements and solution shaping through implementation and production readiness. 
 - Lead stakeholder discussions with Circles Product, Engineering, SRE, leadership, and KDDI technology stakeholders. 
 - Present solution options, trade-offs, risks, dependencies, and recommendations clearly to technical and non-technical audiences. 
 - Challenge short-term solutions that create unnecessary complexity, scalability limitations, or long-term platform risk. 
 - Drive platform modernization, architectural simplification, technical debt reduction, and adoption of reusable platform capabilities. 
 - Establish architecture patterns and standards across APIs, integration, data, messaging, resilience, security, and observability. 
 - Lead cross-functional engineering teams through complex initiatives, setting clear technical direction, aligning ownership, resolving dependencies, and driving delivery quality and production readiness. 
 - Coach and develop Architects, Engineering Leads, and senior engineers, strengthening technical judgment, ownership, collaboration, and their ability to lead independently. 
 - Remain hands-on through technical reviews, prototyping, troubleshooting, critical design validation, and complex production problems. 

Job Requirements

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent practical experience. 
 - 14+ years of software engineering experience, including significant architecture and technical leadership responsibility. 
 - Proven experience already working in an Architect, Principal Engineer, or equivalent architecture-focused role for large-scale production systems. 
 - Strong track record defining architecture and technical direction across multiple domains, teams, or major platform capabilities. 
 - Deep expertise in distributed systems, microservices, API architecture, asynchronous processing, messaging, and event-driven architectures. 
 - Strong hands-on engineering background with technologies such as Go and/or Node. js. 
 - Deep understanding of system design patterns including caching, rate limiting, idempotency, retries, concurrency, fault tolerance, and graceful degradation. 
 - Strong experience with relational and NoSQL databases, Redis, data ownership, and distributed data consistency. 
 - Strong understanding of cloud-native architectures, Kubernetes, CI/CD, and AWS or equivalent cloud platforms. 
 - Strong knowledge of scalability, performance, reliability, security, observability, and production architecture. 
 - Demonstrated ability to design systems serving high-volume, mission-critical workloads. 
 - Strong ability to evaluate architecture trade-offs across business value, engineering complexity, delivery speed, operational risk, scalability, and cost. 
 - Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, including working with senior engineering, product, business, and external partner stakeholders. 
 - Proven ability to lead and influence multiple engineering teams without relying on direct reporting authority, building alignment, resolving disagreements, and driving shared outcomes. 
 - Demonstrated experience developing technical leaders and guiding geographically distributed teams through complex delivery challenges, ambiguity, and competing priorities. 
 - Ability to move comfortably between platform-level strategy and detailed technical problem solving. 

Good to Have

- Strong experience with telecommunications or large-scale digital telco platforms. 
 - Knowledge across billing, charging, subscriber management, provisioning, identity, payments, promotions, or network integrations. 
 - Experience defining and executing multi-year platform modernization or architecture roadmaps. 
 - Experience evolving complex legacy platforms while maintaining business continuity. 
 - Experience with platforms serving millions of customers and high-volume transactional workloads. 
 - Experience operating in environments with multiple internal teams and large external enterprise partners. 

What's On Offer

In this role, you can expect: 

- Significant influence over the architecture and long-term evolution of the povo technology platform. 
 - The opportunity to shape technical strategy across multiple business and engineering domains. 
 - Direct involvement in large-scale, business-critical technology initiatives. 
 - Close collaboration with senior Circles and KDDI technology stakeholders. 
 - Exposure to complex distributed systems and real-world telecom scale. 
 - The ability to combine strategic architecture leadership with continued hands-on engineering. 
 - Opportunities to develop Architects and senior engineering leaders across the organization. 
 - High autonomy and visibility in solving some of the platform's most important technical challenges. 
 - Competitive compensation and continued growth along the senior technical leadership path. 

Circles is committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace. We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, national origin, gender, disability or age. 

Data Protection and Privacy Statement

By submitting an application for this position, you, as the applicant, or your authorised representative(s), consent to Circles' Candidate Data Protection and Privacy Policy. You also agree to the collection, use, and/or disclosure of your personal data by us solely for recruitment purposes as specified in the Policy. You acknowledge that you have read and understood the Policy, are aware of your rights regarding your personal data, and accept the terms relating to international data transfers, where applicable. You further understand that you may withdraw consent at any time, which may affect our ability to consider your application. In instances where your personal data or application is submitted by a third party, it is understood that such third party has been duly authorised by you to disclose the relevant personal data and provide consent on your behalf, and that you have been made aware of this Policy.

Please do not forward resumes to our jobs alias, Circles, employees or any other company location. Circles will not be held accountable for any fees related to unsolicited resumes not uploaded via our ATS.

Job Description

- About the Company/Team

Oracle Health Data Intelligence (HDI) is a newly established organization within Oracle Health, created to revolutionize how healthcare and technology intersect. HDI is focused on building a next-generation platform to support modernized, automated healthcare through data-driven innovation and cloud-scale engineering. - Job Summary

As a Principal Software Engineer, you will design, build, and scale complex cloud-based applications and services that power Oracle Health Data Intelligence products. You'll be responsible for defining system architecture, developing robust and secure applications, and mentoring junior engineers. This role demands a deep technical understanding, strong problem-solving abilities, and a passion for building impactful software that drives the healthcare industry forward. 

- Qualifications & Skills

Mandatory: 

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field. 
 - 8+ years of hands-on experience in software development. 
 - Proficiency in Java and any Major java script framework for application development. 
 - Strong experience with Relational Databases (SQL, MySQL). 
 - Experience designing and consuming RESTful APIs. 
 - Experience with Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) or other cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP). 
 - Knowledge of microservices architecture, CI/CD pipelines, and containerization (Docker, Kubernetes). 
 - Solid understanding of software design principles, distributed systems, and cloud-based architectures. 
 - Strong problem-solving and debugging skills. 
 - Excellent communication and collaboration abilities. 

Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

Application Software Development: 

- Drives feature development within an application. 
 - Provides global production support to cloud-based applications as needed for critical issues by applying a working knowledge of at least one specialty area. 
 - Troubleshoots and debugs routine and non-routine Oracle applications services and Oracle Cloud infrastructure, end-user application integrations, or acquisitions. 
 - Partners across QA and engineering teams to discuss changes impacting an application's functionality and ensures quality and consistency across specific applications. 
 - Considers designs of the existing software architecture when developing code for applications. 
 - Translates requirements and features into a structured, scalable, maintainable, and performant code plan for an application. 
 - Contributes to establishing the dependencies (e. g. , API) associated with the functionality of an application. 
 - Discusses application requirements with the customer while considering scalability and reliability, and recommends build priorities within teams and defines build priorities within team. 
 - References and shares other sources of feedback (e. g. , online forums, live site maintenance reports) to refine application requirements. 
 - Collaborates with Designers, Product Managers, Software Engineers, and stakeholders when evaluating and integrating customer specifications and business requirements. 

Software Development and Coding - Design, Testing, and Optimization: 

- Designs software solutions and analyzes and identifies requirements to achieve business and operational goals, sharing results with manager upon completion. 
 - Adheres to and improves execution of all phases of the software development lifecycle; provides guidance and coaching to engineers to drive improvements. 
 - Utilizes advanced knowledge to develop and guide new software features and enhancements leading design specifications, ensuring accessibility, and develops documents to clarify software design and code. 
 - Leads code reviews in multiple areas to help drive improvements. 
 - Conducts debugging and troubleshooting to identify and fix complex software issues. 
 - Develops fixes for identified issues. 
 - Implements comprehensive software testing (e. g. , functional and non-functional testing), quality assurance processes, software error logging, monitoring, and observability for effective debugging, sharing work with manager and/or lead upon completion. 
 - Conducts performance profiling and optimization of coding, building scalable solutions, and anticipating and resolving potential outcomes. 
 - Troubleshoots and resolves complex issues related to application programming interface (API) functionality and integration. Implements complex API versioning, lifecycle, and interoperability strategies. 

Software Architecture - Software System Structural Design: 

- Implements and contributes to developing software, systems, and services, ensuring review by manager and/or senior technical leaders upon completion. Recommends project or design scope. 
 - Provides technical guidance and coaching to less experienced developers in existing software architecture. 
 - Contributes to periodic reviews and ensures adherence to architectural standards. 
 - Collaborates with stakeholders and networks externally to ensure work aligns with software architecture. 
 - Implements complex performance optimization and scalability strategies in software design.

Issue/Defect Collaboration - Software Products Support:

 - Advocates for customers' interests and suggests product enhancements based on feedback. 
 - Provides input to ensure customer satisfaction through timely resolution of issues and effective communication. 
 - Identifies and implements customer issue and/or defect handling and training processes. 
 - Investigates and troubleshoots complex and broad-reaching/scoped maintenance issues to ensure customer agreement on short- and long-term solutions (e. g. , future enhancements). 

Practices and Standards Compliance - Security and Compliance: 

- Collaborates with the team and externally to follow development practices and coding standards, providing coaching to less experienced team members. 
 - Participates in peer review processes, provides technical leadership, and ensures code quality and adherence to broad acceptance criteria during development, independently. 
 - Demonstrates and shares advanced knowledge of industry best practices and applies them to software development processes. 
 - Implements complex secure coding practices to prevent security vulnerabilities. 

Development Operations - System Maintenance: 

- Performs periodic maintenance and testing operations for systems that require upgrading or patching (e. g. , for critical vulnerabilities), sharing results with manager upon completion. 
 - Drives improvements, ensures automation, testing, and debugging of systems to ensure service/product availability, health, support, and reliability. 

Core Responsibilities

Planning & Execution: 

- Manages and coordinates moderately complex tasks, monitoring timelines and deliverables to ensure timely completion and adherence to requirements for a moderately sized project or initiative. Efficiently delegates, monitors, and prioritizes work across multiple projects, providing technical oversight and adjusting plans to address shifts in resources or timelines. 

Collaboration & Partnership: 

- Collaborates across the organization to align on expectations and achieve shared objectives. Leverages understanding of business leaders, stakeholders, and/or customers to ensure proposed solutions meet their needs. Supports inclusivity by actively seeking and listening to diverse perspectives, ensuring others feel heard and respected. 

Problem Solving: 

- Identifies and addresses moderately complex issues by analyzing a wide range of data and/or information to identify solutions in accordance with standard practices. Proactively escalates unresolved or critical issues with a thorough assessment and suggests potential solutions. Reviews, contributes to, and documents problem-solving strategies. 

Continuous Learning: 

- Pursues learning opportunities to expand knowledge and skills and/or tools in new areas and stays abreast of the latest industry trends and best practices. Proactively seeks and leverages ongoing feedback and training to improve skills. Coaches and mentors junior team members, fostering continuous learning and knowledge sharing within and across teams. 

Continuous Improvement: 

- Develops ideas, recommends updates, and/or collaborates on the implementation of process improvements to increase the efficiency and effectiveness of processes, protocols, and workflows across teams, and evaluates the impact on key stakeholders. Solicits feedback from others on ideas for alternative approaches and methods for continued improvement. 

Performance and Development:

data.title: Lead Full-Stack Engineer (Java+React)
data.description:
We're hiring a Lead Full-Stack Engineer (Java + React) to help build an end-to-end Loan Management System at Multitude, an international fintech company. You'll lead development across Java/Spring services and React applications, shaping reliable lending workflows and partner-facing products while working closely with engineering and domain teams. We're looking for an experienced engineer with strong lending technology expertise who can use AI coding tools thoughtfully and deliver secure, production-ready software. 

Responsibilities

- Together with Lead Engineer and Tech Lead, design and build the LMS end-to-end - Java/Spring backend services and React operations/partner UIs - on the latest technologies. 
 - Deliver production-grade code: pull-request reviews, high test coverage and production observability (Kibana, Elastic APM, Prometheus/Grafana). 
 - Work effectively with AI coding assistants - use them to accelerate implementation, review, refactoring, and documentation while remaining accountable for the correctness, security, and maintainability of everything that ships. 
 - Contribute to the spec-first workflow: read and refine feature specifications, break specs into JIRA stories, flag missing scope early. 
 - Own features across the stack - from Kafka event contracts and REST endpoints down to the React screens partner staff and Bhawana operators actually use. 
 - Go the extra mile: stay current on tooling and techniques (including AI tooling), share what you learn, and push technical improvements proactively. 

Required Skills And Experience

- 10+ years building production systems in Java (17+) and the Spring ecosystem (Boot, REST, JPA/Data, Security, Integration). You know why @Transactional is more subtle than it looks, you have debugged classloader and GC issues in anger, and you can reason about JVM behaviour under load. 
 - 5+ years of hands-on React user interfaces - not prototypes, not admin screens generated from a template. You understand rendering, state, forms at scale, accessibility, and the cost of every dependency you add. 
 - Demonstrable fluency with AI coding assistants (e. g. GitHub Copilot, Claude, Cursor, Codex, or equivalent) as part of your daily workflow - able to prompt effectively, review AI output critically, and know when not to trust it. 
 - Clean-code habits: patterns/anti-patterns awareness, well-structured, testable, maintainable, documented code. 
 - Distributed-systems maturity - you reason about failure modes, retries, backoff, poison messages, and what happens when the network partitions during a disbursement. You've built and operated microservices in production and know when not to use them. 
 - Solid grasp of REST API design, integrations, refactoring, secure coding, APM and troubleshooting. 
 - understanding JIRA and able to write specifications there with Acceptance Criteria. 
 - Hands-on experience with asynchronous messaging (Kafka or other)
 - Analytical and problem-solving skills - able to break down complex domain problems and communicate solutions clearly. 
 - 6+ years in lending technology or NBFC/bank ops-tech roles, with at least one LMS/LOS implementation done end to end (FinnOne, Pennant, Lentra, M2P, Finflux or similar - lender side or vendor side)
 - Knows the RBI digital lending guidelines well enough to spec a KFS or an FLDG ledger without being handed the circular
 - Strong team player, comfortable working independently, solid written and spoken English. 

Nice to have

- Familiarity with microservice architecture, event sourcing, distributed systems, authentication (OAuth 2. 0 / OIDC). 
 - Experience with multi-tenant SaaS or B2B2C platforms (partner isolation, tenant-scoped data access). 
 - Financial-services or lending-domain background (loans, EMI, disbursement, DPD, collections). 
 - Working knowledge of: Kafka, Docker, Kubernetes, Camunda BPM, Kotlin, Liquibase, Kibana, Elastic APM, MySQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, ElasticSearch, Prometheus, Grafana. 
 - Frontend depth: state management (Redux Toolkit / Zustand / React Query), component libraries, accessibility, i18n. 
 - Experience with spec-driven or contract-first development (OpenAPI, AsyncAPI, Avro). 
 - Comfort with Gitflow, SonarQube, Maven/Gradle, Swagger/OpenAPI, JIRA, GitHub)

We Offer

- A Truly Global Workplace - collaborate with 40+ nationalities across 25+ countries, embracing diversity, inclusion, and cross-cultural innovation
 - Hybrid & Flexible Work - balance your life and career with remote-friendly policies and modern offices across Europe
 - A Culture of Growth - accelerate your development with access to LinkedIn Learning, structured mentorship, and internal leadership programmes (HiPo & People Leader tracks)
 - Workation Programme - work remotely from abroad for up to 2 months per year and experience new cultures while staying connected and productive
 - Financial Growth Opportunities - invest in your future with our share purchase matching programme, doubling your contributions and fostering long-term rewards
 - Medical Coverage - group medical insurance covering hospitalisation and essential care
 - Accident Protection - personal accident insurance for peace of mind

These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. All final hiring decisions are made by human recruiters.
