data.title: Platform Engineering Head / Architect
data.description:
Educational Qualification

- B. Tech. /B. E. in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related engineering discipline (Must have; full-time regular course)
 - MTech. /M. S. in Computer Science, Information Technology, or Software Engineering desirable
 - Certifications (at least one required at deployment - Must have): AWS Solutions Architect Professional, AWS DevOps Engineer Professional, Azure Solutions Architect Expert, Google Cloud Professional Cloud Architect, or CKA (Certified Kubernetes Administrator)
 - Certifications (Desirable): CKAD, CKS, HashiCorp Terraform Associate, Certified Backstage Associate (if available), TOGAF 9, SAFe Architect, ITIL 4 Foundation

Experience

- 12+ years in software engineering, platform engineering, or DevSecOps, with minimum 4 years in a Lead Architect or Head of Platform role owning a production platform end-to-end
 - Minimum 2 years of hands-on experience with an Internal Developer Platform (IDP) - Backstage or equivalent - covering plugin architecture, software catalogue, scaffolder templates, and SSO integration
 - Demonstrated experience architecting and operating cloud-native platforms at scale, serving 500+ developers across multiple business units or tenants
 - Demonstrated experience with source-code and DevSecOps platforms (GitLab, GitHub Enterprise, Bitbucket) as the CI/CD backbone, and with an OSS or licensed project management tool (OpenProject, Jira, Azure DevOps Boards)
 - Prior experience delivering platform engineering initiatives for government, PSU, BFSI, or regulated enterprise programmes preferred
 - Prior experience owning migration of a large SDLC / ALM estate - repositories, work packages, users, pipelines, audit logs - to a new platform desirable

Key Responsibilities

Platform Architecture & Strategy

- Own the end-to-end reference architecture of the platform across the developer portal (IDP), source-code and CI/CD layer, project management layer, and observability, operations & security layer
 - Define and publish the platform's guiding principles - federated custody with central governance, end-toend traceability by default, policy enforcement as code, open-source preferred, and AI-integrated delivery with human-in-the-loop guardrails
 - Approve HLD/LLD, integration designs, IaC governance standards, GitOps workflows, Kubernetes reference designs, active-passive DR architecture, and network topology
 - Own the platform's scalability baseline, NFR validation approach, and technology-obsolescence / refresh plans across the engagement lifecycle

Internal Developer Platform Ownership

- Own the developer portal roadmap - software catalogue, golden path scaffolder, TechDocs, plugin strategy, SSO/MFA, superadmin and admin consoles, self-registration, and integration with enterprise tools (HRMS, KMS, document management, SharePoint)
 - Define golden paths and platform patterns that consumer teams must adopt; approve tenant-specific customisations
 - Approve the plugin model for on-demand tool onboarding to the observability, operations & security layer without disruption to existing integrations

Governance of the Implementation Agency

- Act as the single point of technical authority for the implementation agency; review deliverables against contracted scope and phase-gate validation criteria
 - Chair architecture review boards and technical acceptance sessions across all phases; recommend acceptance, conditional acceptance, or rework to leadership
 - Track SLA adherence (uptime, RTO/RPO, incident resolution) and quality metrics; drive corrective action

Migration, Onboarding & Stakeholder Interface

- Approve the migration strategy from legacy platforms covering repositories, work packages, users, CI/CD pipelines, audit logs, wiki content, and attachments - with zero data loss and full auditability
 - Serve as the technical interface with consumer administrators, developer and vendor teams, external contributors, and the internal stakeholder community during discovery, onboarding waves, and hypercare
 - Approve onboarding plans, dedicated / isolated deployment configurations, and tenant-specific integrations with external tools

AI & Emerging Technology Integration

- Evaluate and approve introduction of AI capabilities across developer productivity (AI code review, test generation, intelligent search), delivery intelligence (predictive risk, release summaries), security intelligence (AI-augmented vulnerability prioritisation), and operations (predictive alerting, capacity forecasting) - with appropriate governance, audit logging, and human-in-the-loop controls

Knowledge Transfer, Exit Management & Sustainability

- Ensure the agency delivers complete runbooks, TechDocs, operational SOPs, and training to prevent lockin at exit
 - Own the exit and handover framework at the end of the engagement, including data / configuration handover and secure deletion by the agency; ensure core data and configurations remain exportable in open, documented formats

Technical Competencies

- Internal Developer Platform (IDP): Backstage architecture, plugin strategy and development, catalogue model, scaffolder templates, TechDocs, permission framework; IDP design patterns and developerexperience principles
 - DevSecOps Platform: GitLab (or equivalent) architecture - Runners, CI/CD pipelines, SAST/DAST, container registry, releases; branch protection, merge request workflows, supply-chain security (SBOM, artefact signing)
 - Project Management Layer: OpenProject, Jira, or equivalent - architecture and integration; workpackage-to-commit traceability; Agile boards (Kanban/Gantt); release and version planning Cloud & Infrastructure Architecture: AWS (EKS, IAM, ALB, Route 53, Secrets Manager, KMS, S3, CloudWatch) or equivalent hyperscaler; hybrid, on-premise, and sovereign-cloud deployment patterns; NIC / MeghRaj familiarity desirable
 - Container & Orchestration: Kubernetes (production-grade), Docker, Helm, service mesh basics, cluster capacity and health governance
 - IaC & GitOps: Terraform / OpenTofu, Ansible, Argo CD or Flux; GitOps deployment patterns and governance
 - Identity & Access: SSO, OIDC, SAML, LDAP, MFA design; Keycloak, Auth0, AWS IAM Identity Center, Microsoft Entra ID
 - Programming & Runtime: Node. js, TypeScript, React, Express, PostgreSQL, YAML; ability to read and review production code (not required to code full-time)
 - APIs & Integration: REST / OpenAPI, GraphQL basics, webhook design, event-driven integration, API gateway patterns
 - Observability & SRE: Prometheus, Grafana, Loki, OpenTelemetry, Jaeger / Tempo; SLI/SLO/errorbudget methodology; RTO/RPO planning; incident management
 - Security & Compliance: OWASP Top 10, NIST CSF, Zero Trust Architecture, ISO/IEC 27001: 2022, CIS controls, CERT-In guidelines, DPDP Act 2023
 - AI/ML Understanding: Working understanding of LLMs, RAG architectures, MLOps, and AI-assisted developer tooling (not required to code, but must make platform-level trade-offs)
 - Communication: Executive presentation to leadership and consumer stakeholders; ability to defend architectural positions in review boards; ability to translate technical trade-offs for non-technical audiences and build consensus across engineering, security, and business stakeholders

Please Note: NeGD invites applications for the following position on a purely contractual basis, initially for a period of three (3) years, which may be extended subject to the requirements of the project.

Working closely with governance specialists, product owners, and engineers, you will translate business requirements into scalable technology solutions, contribute to architecture decisions, and drive innovation through AI and automation. Additionally, you will mentor team members and help foster engineering best practices across the team. 

What You Offer

You'll be someone who enjoys solving complex problems, working across both technology and business domains, and building solutions that create meaningful business outcomes. 

We're Looking For

- Strong 6-9 years experience building and maintaining Collibra workflows and governance process automation. 
 - Full-stack engineering experience using technologies such as Python, JavaScript, React, TypeScript, or similar. 
 - Experience with AI-enabled coding and modern software engineering practices
 - Strong understanding of cloud technologies, application development, testing, CI/CD, security, and operational support. 
 - Excellent stakeholder engagement and communication skills. 
 - A collaborative approach and willingness to coach and mentor others. 

We love hearing from anyone inspired to build a better future with us, if you're excited about the role or working at Macquarie we encourage you to apply. 

What We Offer

Benefits

At Macquarie, you're empowered to shape a career that's rewarding in all the ways that matter most to you. Macquarie employees can access a wide range of benefits which, depending on eligibility criteria, include: 

- 1 wellbeing leave day per year
 - 26 weeks' paid maternity leave or 20 weeks' paid parental leave for primary caregivers along with 12 days of paid transition leave upon return to work and 6 weeks' paid leave for secondary caregivers
 - Company-subsidised childcare services
 - 2 days of paid volunteer leave and donation matching
 - Benefits to support your physical, mental and financial wellbeing including comprehensive medical and life insurance cover, the option to join parental medical insurance plan and virtual medical consultations extended to family members
 - Access to our Employee Assistance Program, a robust behavioural health network with counselling and coaching services
 - Access to a wide range of learning and development opportunities, including reimbursement for professional membership or subscription

About Technology

Technology enables every aspect of Macquarie, for our people, our customers and our communities. We're a global team that is passionate about accelerating the digital enterprise, connecting people and data, building platforms and applications and designing tomorrow's technology solutions. 

Inclusion at Macquarie

We are committed to providing an inclusive environment for all, where different experiences, skills and perspectives are valued and respected. data.title: Senior Software Engineer [Java + Angular] - 1630
data.description:
Role: Senior Software Engineer (Java + Angular)

Location: Hyderabad, India (Hybrid)

Department: Product Development

Job Req ID: 1630

About GHX: 

GHX (Global Healthcare Exchange) is a leading healthcare technology company on a mission to simplify the business of healthcare and improve patient outcomes. Founded in 2000, GHX has built the GHX Global Network - the world's largest cloud-based supply chain community connecting healthcare providers, suppliers, distributors, and partners to automate key processes, reduce costs, and increase operational efficiency. Its solutions span electronic trading, procurement automation, inventory and contract management, business intelligence, and data synchronization, helping healthcare organizations improve productivity and focus more on patient care. Over the years, GHX has enabled significant cost savings for the industry and continues to innovate with intelligent automation and AI-driven capabilities. 

Website: https: //www. ghx. com/

LinkedIn: https: //www. linkedin. com/company/ghx/

About The Role

GHX's trading platform handles millions of documents to facilitate business transactions between healthcare providers, suppliers, and trading partners. The Exchange Engineering team is seeking a seasoned Senior Software Engineer to strengthen its Hyderabad team. You will design, develop, and scale the platform that supports millions of transactions, working across the stack in Java, Spring Boot and Angular, and using AI coding tools and agents as a core part of how you build and operate. 

Principal Duties and Responsibilities

- Define, design, and develop components using Java, Spring Boot, Angular and AWS Cloud. 
 - Implement all aspects of development, including database, presentation, middle tier, and system interfaces. 
 - Collaborate with architects, Systems Engineering, Product Management, and other technical and non-technical stakeholders throughout the product development lifecycle. 
 - Formulate and communicate technical vision and strategy to business and technical stakeholders. 
 - Design and develop data architecture, data definitions, and data manipulation structures across MySQL, MongoDB, Elasticsearch, and Redis. 
 - Work daily with the Agile delivery team and Product, and respond quickly and effectively to changing requirements. 
 - Participate in project planning and provide detailed, accurate estimates. 
 - Develop and maintain system, technical, and architectural documentation. 
 - Execute architectural design spikes and proof-of-concept implementations, and evaluate third-party software as needed. 
 - Perform code, design, and architectural reviews, and mentor junior developers on best practices, coding standards, and problem-solving. 
 - Assist with testing and release processes, including writing unit and integration tests. 
 - Monitor AWS services and overall system behavior to ensure reliability, performance, and availability. 
 - Support production issues as required, including on-call support. 
 - Use AI tools daily (e. g. , GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code) to accelerate code generation, refactoring, unit test creation, log analysis, anomaly detection, and incident troubleshooting, while ensuring code quality, security, and compliance with organizational standards. 
 - Use AI-assisted tools to shorten delivery timelines, speed up root cause analysis for production issues, and improve system observability. 
 - Continuously evaluate and adopt emerging AI tools and practices, and coach teammates on responsible AI use. 

Required Qualifications

- BS in Computer Science or a related degree (Math, Engineering, Computers), or equivalent education and experience. 
 - 6+ years of professional development experience in Java/J2EE. 
 - Java (must-have): strong experience with Java/J2EE, Spring, Spring Boot, and Hibernate. 
 - Angular (must-have): strong hands-on experience building applications with Angular and TypeScript, plus HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. 
 - AI-assisted development (must-have): demonstrated, hands-on experience using AI coding tools and AI agents in real project delivery, and the ability to explain how they improved your productivity, quality, or troubleshooting speed. 
 - Strong experience with unit testing frameworks such as JUnit. 
 - Experience in system design. 
 - Experience with cloud architecture (AWS preferred) and distributed systems. 
 - Experience writing unit, integration, automation, and API tests. 
 - Strong problem-solving, analytical, and troubleshooting skills, with the ability to work under pressure. 
 - Strong written and oral communication skills. 
 - Experience working in an Agile/Scrum environment. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Demonstrated initiative beyond assigned tasks, identifying and driving product improvements. 
 - Experience with AWS services, including RDS and DocumentDB. 
 - Experience with rules engines and/or event-driven architecture. 
 - Exposure to performance tuning and scalability improvements. 
 - Experience with CI/CD tools such as GitHub, Bitbucket, Bamboo, or similar. 
 - Experience with Selenium, Playwright, or similar modern automation frameworks. 
 - Experience building AI-powered features or agentic workflows (e. g. , LLM integrations, prompt design, RAG). 
 - Familiarity with Linux. 
 - Experience in the healthcare or invoicing domain. 

Skills

- Languages and frameworks: Java/J2EE, Spring, Spring Boot, Hibernate, Angular, TypeScript
 - Testing: JUnit, Selenium/Playwright (preferred)
 - CI/CD: Bitbucket, Bamboo
 - Infrastructure: AWS (EC2, DynamoDB, Route 53, S3, SQS, SNS, RDS, DocumentDB)
 - Databases: MySQL, MongoDB, Elasticsearch, DynamoDB, Redis

Global Healthcare Exchange (GHX) enables better patient care and billions in savings for the healthcare community by maximizing automation, efficiency and accuracy of business processes.

- Build and ship production software for Enterprise Technology initiatives, including services, APIs, data models, user interfaces, integrations, tests, and operational tooling.

A plus if you have: 

- Experience with enterprise systems, business applications, workflow platforms, data platforms, or internal tools. 
 - Experience with media, streaming, content platforms, or complex business domains. 
 - Experience building developer-facing tools, templates, or internal platforms that help engineers ship software faster and more safely. 
 - Experience with LLM or agent observability tools such as Datadog, LangSmith, Langfuse, or similar systems. 
 - Experience with data migration, compliance-sensitive systems, SOX controls, audit-heavy environments, or complex enterprise integrations. 

Why you will love working at Crunchyroll

data.title: Senior Staff Software Engineer — SaaS Platform & Cross-Product Architecture
data.description:
About Us

At Netwrix, our mission is to revolutionize data security by placing identity at the core - providing unparalleled visibility and control. Engineered and supported by over 900 highly talented, motivated employees and hundreds of trusted partners in nearly every geography, Netwrix solutions are relied upon daily by security professionals across more than 13, 500 organizations in over 100 countries around the world. 

Over the past two decades, Netwrix has expanded its market presence through innovation, organic growth, and strategic acquisitions, and are proud to be backed by renowned private equity firms, TA Associates and Centerbridge Partners. Netwrix maintains a global presence, fostering a remote-first work environment while encouraging and facilitating frequent face-to-face interaction with colleagues, customers, and partners. 

What You'll Do

- Own technical decision-making for the teams you support: evaluate technology options, run POCs and benchmarks, and make evidence-based recommendations on frameworks, datastores, and infrastructure -including partition strategies, migration plans, and performance validation at SaaS scale
 - Shape platform-level architecture: Kubernetes (AKS) deployment topology, Kafka-based messaging, durable workflow orchestration, and multi-tenant data models
 - Serve as an embedded architecture partner for . NET product teams: review technical designs, code, author/critique RFCs, guide teams through scalability and cloud-readiness problems, and help converge products toward shared platform standards
 - Mentor engineers across teams and raise the bar on engineering standards (GitOps, golden pipelines, observability, supply-chain security)
 - Assess established on-premises products for scaling, performance, resiliency, code quality, technology choices, supported environments, interoperability, security, and third-party dependencies, and define a realistic migration path to SaaS that does not disrupt on-premises delivery
 - Partner with Product Management, Support, and Professional Services to ground architecture recommendations in real customer and field issues, and review findings with those teams before publishing
 - Produce architecture artifacts - C4 diagrams, RFCs, design reviews, benchmarks - and present trade-offs to engineering leadership
 - Design, build, and improve microservices and backend systems for the SaaS platform using related technologies such as Java, Spring Boot, JDK 21+, and . NET. Follow sound cloud-native development principles, including API-first design, resilience patterns, and comprehensive unit, integration, and performance testing. 
 - Turn recurring solutions into shared libraries, tooling, and examples that other teams can adopt. 
 - Use AI-assisted development tools for coding, testing, and design exploration. Review generated code with the same care as any other contribution, including correctness, security, and maintainability. 

Skills And Experience

- 10+ years in software engineering, with a track record of technical leadership
 - Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field - or equivalent practical experience
 - Hands-on expertise in Java (Spring ecosystem)
 - Hands-on experience with C#/. NET and sound architectural judgment, with the ability to review designs and code, provide design guidance, and help product teams address scalability and cloud-readiness challenges. 
 - Working familiarity with Active Directory and Entra ID: domain services, LDAP, authentication protocols, and directory data models, with the appetite to go deeper
 - Comfortable reasoning about Windows-centric on-premises products (agents, domain controllers, customer-installed footprints) and the constraints of dual on-premises and SaaS delivery
 - Production Kubernetes experience: service design, Helm/GitOps deployment, jobs, autoscaling, multi-tenant SaaS operations
 - Comfortable with distributed-data fundamentals: partitioning, consistency trade-offs, high-volume ingestion/ETL, query performance tuning; hands-on with a relational database at scale (PostgreSQL, SQL Server or similar), plus exposure to at least one analytical or NoSQL store
 - Event-driven architecture experience (Kafka, RabbitMQ or similar), API-first design, and modern resilience/observability practices
 - Good documentation skills - comfortable producing RFCs and design docs and influencing teams you don't manage

Nice to have

- Go, Azure, workflow engines (e. g. Temporal)
 - Experience with Spring Reactive
 - Exposure to identity security, such as ITDR, privileged access management, or identity governance

Our Values

At Netwrix, Our Values Guide Every Action

- Next-Level Customer Focus -Customers first, always. We listen, protect, and go the extra mile- because their success is our mission. 
 - Excellence - We set high standards and take pride in delivering exceptional results. We celebrate wins, seek constant improvement, and address shortcomings professionally. 
 - Transparent Ownership - We celebrate our successes, own up to our mistakes, communicate openly, and face challenges head-on with a genuine commitment to doing the right thing. 
 - Winning with Clear Thinking - We value clarity, find straightforward solutions to complex problems, and make swift, effective decisions. 
 - Relentless Innovation - We continually seek better ways to serve our customers and stay ahead. We foster creative thinking, and we embrace new approaches. 
 - Industry-Leading Expertise - We take pride in our expertise and continuously seek to learn and share knowledge, striving to be the trusted experts our customers rely on. 
 - eXceptional Together - We believe in the power of collaboration and diverse perspectives. By valuing each other's strengths, we achieve outcomes that surpass individual contributions. 

Join us in a culture where integrity, respect, and hard work are foundational. Be part of a team dedicated to making a lasting impact. 

Why You'll Love Working at Netwrix

- Competitive Health Benefits
 - Continuous Learning and Development Opportunities
 - Team-Oriented, Collaborative, and Innovative Work Environment
 - Regular Company Town Halls to Keep You Informed
 - Opportunities for Career Growth and Advancement

We pride ourselves on a culture that truly values employee input across various backgrounds and experiences. We look forward to welcoming new talent who can help us further our mission. 

Netwrix Corporation and its wholly owned subsidiaries are Equal Opportunity Employers (EEO) and welcome all applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic under applicable law. 

Please let us know if you require any accommodation.

data.title: Site Reliability Engineer,Senior
data.description:
We are Progress (Nasdaq: PRGS) - the trusted provider of software that enables our customers to develop, deploy and manage responsible, AI-powered applications and experience with agility and ease. 

We're proud to have a diverse, global team where we value the individual and enrich our culture by considering varied perspectives because we believe people power progress. Join us as a Senior Site Reliability Engineer and help us do what we do best: propelling business forward. Know more about us. 

We're looking for a Senior Site Reliability Engineer (SRE) to help ensure the reliability, security, and performance of our customer-facing systems and infrastructure. This role bridges development and operations, applying engineering principles to improve system resilience and scalability. 

In This Role, You Will

- Security & Compliance: Safeguard systems against breaches and ensure compliance with PCI-DSS, HIPAA, SOC2, and other standards. 
 - Cloud Infrastructure: Build and maintain scalable, secure services in Azure, AWS, or GCP using cloud-native tools. 
 - Automation & System Admin: Automate routine tasks, manage backups, and configure servers for high availability and disaster recovery. 
 - Monitoring & Performance: Implement observability tools, optimize system performance, and proactively address issues. 
 - Incident Response: Participate in on-call rotations, troubleshoot service incidents, and lead postmortem reviews. 
 - Collaboration: Work closely with developers, QA, and support teams in agile environments. 
 - Customer Provisioning: Handle complex customer account setups in coordination with Sales and Professional Services. 
 - Infrastructure as Code: Champion IaC practices using tools like Terraform, Ansible, Chef, or Puppet. 

Your Background

- Bachelor's degree in computer science, Information Systems, or related field. 
 - 6+ years of Proven experience in a Senior SRE or similar role in production environments. 
 - Strong skills in Windows/Linux, scripting (Shell, Python, PowerShell), and cloud services (ECS, EKS, S3, etc. ). 
 - Good to have hands-on experience with Kubernetes, Docker, Rancher, and container orchestration. 
 - Familiarity with security protocols, network concepts (TCP/IP, HTTP, TLS), and compliance frameworks. 
 - Ability to debug, optimize, and automate to reduce operational toil. 
 - Excellent communication skills and a proactive, problem-solving mindset. 
 - Experience with PCI, HIPAA, and SOC2 compliance. 
 - Experience with cloud-hosted apps/services (Azure/AWS)
 - Ability to debug and optimize code and automate routine tasks to eliminate toil. 
 - Willing to work in APJ Time zone [7: 00 AM to 4: 00 PM IST]

Compensation

If this sounds like you and fits your experience and career goals, we'd be happy to chat. What we offer in return is the opportunity to experience a great company culture with wonderful colleagues to learn from and collaborate with and also to enjoy: 

- Competitive remuneration package 
 - Employee Stock Purchase Plan Enrolment

Vacation, Family, and Health

- 30 days of earned leave
 - An extra day off for your birthday
 - Various other leaves like marriage leave, casual leave, maternity, and paternity leave
 - Premium Group Medical Insurance for employees and five dependents, personal accident insurance coverage, life insurance coverage
 - Professional development reimbursement 
 - Interest subsidy on loans - either vehicle or personal loans
 - Health club reimbursement

Apply now!

Your Impact

We are looking for a DevOps Engineer (G8) with strong expertise in Python, AWS, Infrastructure as Code, and CI/CD pipelines to build and operate scalable, automated platforms. 

This role is focused on hands-on implementation, automation, system reliability, and platform support, with exposure to data platforms, streaming systems, and AI/ML workloads. 

Key Responsibilities

Design, develop, and maintain scalable backend systems using Python flask, sqlalchemy, apscheduler, cache. 

- Design and manage AWS cloud infrastructure (EC2, S3, RDS, VPC, IAM)
 - Implement Infrastructure as Code using Terraform and Ansible
 - Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins and GitHub
 - Automate infrastructure provisioning, deployments, and operational workflows
 - Monitor system performance, reliability, and availability; troubleshoot production issues
 - Support and manage streaming platforms such as Kafka
 - Build or support backend utilities/services using Python and/or Java
 - Support infrastructure for data platforms and AI/ML workloads (including GenAI/LLM systems)
 - Collaborate with engineering teams to improve deployment velocity and system efficiency

Minimum Qualifications

- Design, develop, and maintain scalable backend systems using Python flask, sqlalchemy, apscheduler, cache.

 - Support and manage Elasticcache/Redis , Valikey

 - Proven experience with Terraform (Infrastructure as Code)
 - Strong experience with Ansible (configuration management and automation)

Preferred Qualifications

 - Familiarity with OpenSearch / Elasticsearch , Cassandra (NoSQL systems)
 - Proficiency in Python and/or Java for automation or backend support
 - Experience with Docker and Kubernetes
 - Exposure to AI/ML workloads, data pipelines, or GenAI systems. 

Why Cisco?

Combining a flexible, intelligent platform with end-to-end payments capabilities and services developed through its deep industry experience, NCR Voyix empowers retailers and restaurants to accelerate new possibilities for their operations, experiences and business outcomes. NCR Voyix is headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia, and serves customers in more than 35 countries worldwide. 

NCR Voyix is seeking a Senior Software Engineer with strong C# and . NET expertise to build, modernize, and operate mission-critical payment and commerce platforms. The role involves ownership of complex technical capabilities from design through production support across legacy and modern technology stacks. 

Key Responsibilities: 

- Design, develop, test, deploy, and support secure, reliable applications using C#, . NET Framework, modern . NET, ASP. NET, ASP. NET Core, and Web APIs. 
 - Maintain and modernize legacy applications built with ASP. NET Web Forms and . NET Framework 4. 7. 2. 
 - Lead or contribute to service rewrites, platform modernization, system integrations, and complex data migrations. 
 - Build scalable, low-latency, event-driven services using messaging platforms such as RabbitMQ, Kafka, Azure Service Bus, or NATS JetStream. 
 - Design distributed caching and state-management solutions using Redis or Valkey. 
 - Build and operate containerized workloads using Docker, Kubernetes, and Azure Kubernetes Service. 
 - Design secure integrations involving Azure Key Vault, HSMs, encryption services, certificates, TLS, and mutual TLS. 
 - Apply asynchronous programming, concurrency, parallel processing, and multithreading techniques safely in high-throughput systems. 
 - Troubleshoot application, database, networking, performance, and production issues. 
 - Improve throughput, latency, reliability, scalability, and resource utilization through profiling, testing, and optimization. 
 - Build automation and operational tooling using PowerShell or similar scripting technologies. 
 - Build and maintain CI/CD workflows using GitHub Actions and Git-based source control. 
 - Contribute to database design, optimization, migration, and troubleshooting, including MySQL-based systems. 
 - Implement observability using structured logging, metrics, distributed tracing, dashboards, and actionable alerts. 
 - Use tools such as Splunk, AppDynamics, Jaeger, Grafana, Prometheus, Datadog, Elastic, or Kibana to monitor applications and investigate production behavior. 
 - Write architecture and design documentation, including sequence diagrams, flow diagrams, interface contracts, runbooks, and Architecture Decision Records. 
 - Apply sound software design principles including OOP, SOLID, DRY, Clean Architecture, dependency injection, and appropriate design patterns. 
 - Develop automated unit, integration, component, contract, and performance tests. 
 - Participate in code reviews and ensure quality, security, reliability, and operational readiness. 
 - Use AI coding tools and agentic workflows to improve design, development, testing, debugging, review, troubleshooting, documentation, and automation. 
 - Mentor junior and mid-level engineers through pairing, design discussions, technical guidance, and code reviews. 
 - Participate in on-call support, incident response, and post-incident reviews. 
 - Collaborate with product managers, architects, engineers, and stakeholders to convert ambiguous goals into reliable production systems. 

Required Qualifications: 

- 7 to 10 years of professional software engineering experience. 
 - Strong production experience with C# and the . NET ecosystem. 
 - Experience with ASP. NET or ASP. NET Web Forms, . NET Framework 4. 7. 2 or later, modern . NET preferably . NET 8 or later, ASP. NET Core, and Web API development. 
 - Strong knowledge of software design and architecture principles including OOP, SOLID, DRY, Clean Architecture, dependency injection, and maintainable design patterns. 
 - Experience designing and supporting backend APIs, distributed services, or integration platforms. 
 - Demonstrated ownership of technical capabilities from design through production support. 
 - Experience writing automated tests and building operationally supportable software. 
 - Strong troubleshooting, debugging, root-cause analysis, and performance-improvement skills. 
 - Practical knowledge of asynchronous programming, concurrency, and multithreading. 
 - Working knowledge of HTTP and TCP-based communication. 
 - Experience with GitHub or another Git-based source-control and code-review platform. 
 - Ability to clearly explain architectural decisions and engineering trade-offs. 
 - Experience creating design documents, sequence diagrams, and data-flow diagrams. 
 - Experience mentoring engineers and conducting high-quality code reviews. 
 - Experience using logs, metrics, traces, dashboards, and alerts to diagnose production systems. 
 - Experience using AI coding tools such as GitHub Copilot, Claude, Claude Code, or equivalent tools. 
 - Hands-on experience or strong working knowledge of AI agents, automation agents, AI-assisted internal tooling, or multi-step agentic workflows. 

Preferred Qualifications: 

- React or another modern front-end framework. 
 - Entity Framework Core in high-volume production systems. 
 - xUnit, NUnit, or comparable . NET testing frameworks. 
 - PowerShell or another scripting and automation language. 
 - Experience modernizing legacy . NET applications into modern . NET services. 
 - Experience with RabbitMQ, Kafka, Azure Service Bus, or NATS JetStream. 
 - Knowledge of event-driven architecture, asynchronous messaging patterns, message ordering, idempotency, retries, dead-letter handling, backpressure, and eventual consistency. 
 - Experience with Azure, AWS, AKS, Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, and GitHub Actions. 
 - Experience with Redis, Valkey, MySQL, distributed caching, database optimization, and complex data migrations. 
 - Knowledge of HSMs, encryption, tokenization, key management, TLS, mTLS, certificates, and PCI-DSS or other regulated environments. 
 - Experience with observability tools such as Splunk, AppDynamics, Jaeger, Grafana, Prometheus, Datadog, Elastic, Kibana, OpsGenie, or OpenTelemetry. 
 - Knowledge of Retrieval-Augmented Generation, Model Context Protocol, multi-agent orchestration frameworks, prompt engineering, and AI-assisted internal tooling. 
 - Experience in payment processing, financial transaction platforms, retail commerce, hospitality commerce, e-commerce, marketplace platforms, real-time decisioning, or high-availability regulated systems. 

Technology Landscape: 

C#, . NET Framework 4. 7. 2, . NET 8 or later, ASP. NET Web Forms, ASP. NET Core, Web API, React, Entity Framework Core, xUnit, NUnit, RabbitMQ, Kafka, Azure Service Bus, NATS JetStream, Redis, Valkey, Azure, AWS, AKS, Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, Azure Key Vault, HSMs, TLS, mTLS, PowerShell, GitHub Actions, MySQL, GitHub Copilot, Claude, MCP, RAG, Splunk, AppDynamics, Jaeger, Grafana, Prometheus, Datadog, Elastic/Kibana, Jira, Confluence, and Slack. 

Offers of employment are conditional upon passage of screening criteria applicable to the job

EEO Statement

Integrated into our shared values is NCR Voyix's commitment to equal employment opportunity. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, age, race, color, creed, religion, national origin, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, military service, genetic information, or any other characteristic or conduct protected by law. NCR Voyix is committed to being a globally inclusive company where all people are treated fairly, recognized for their individuality, promoted based on performance and encouraged to strive to reach their full potential. We believe in understanding and respecting differences among all people. Every individual at NCR Voyix has an ongoing responsibility to respect and support a globally diverse environment. 

Statement to Third Party Agencies

To ALL recruitment agencies: NCR Voyix only accepts resumes from agencies on the preferred supplier list. Job Description

Join Nokia's SDK team and contribute to the development of next-generation Software Development Kits (SDKs) for advanced DSP ASICs. As part of our SDK team, you will develop software solutions for Ethernet and OTN client applications on cutting-edge DSP ASIC platforms. Working alongside ASIC, hardware, and system architects, you will contribute to feature development, validation, and integration of next-generation coherent pluggable products, gaining hands-on experience across the complete product development lifecycle. 

How You Will Contribute And What You Will Learn

- Build innovative SDK software that powers Nokia's next-generation coherent DSP ASICs and optical networking solutions
 - Develop high-performance C/C++ software on Linux platforms for cutting-edge networking products. 
 - Work with industry-leading ASIC, firmware, hardware, and architecture teams throughout the entire product lifecycle, from pre-silicon development to post-silicon validation. 
 - Solve complex technical challenges involving hardware-software interaction, performance optimisation, and system integration. 
 - Contribute to advanced SDK APIs, software frameworks, and automation solutions that enable faster product development and deployment. 
 - Drive software quality through testing, debugging, automation, and continuous improvement initiatives. 
 - Collaborate with global engineering teams to deliver innovative technologies that power the future of networking. 

Key Qualifications

KEY SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE

- B. Tech/BE with CSE & ECE
 - 2-4 years of experience in software development using C/C++. 
 - Strong programming, debugging, and troubleshooting skills in Linux environments. 
 - Solid understanding of data structures, algorithms, operating systems, and embedded software concepts. 
 - Knowledge of Ethernet, OTN, networking protocols, or telecommunications systems. 
 - Familiarity with DSP, ASIC-based systems, or embedded networking platforms is advantageous. 
 - Experience with Python and/or Shell scripting for automation and testing is desirable. 
 - Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills. 
 - Ability to collaborate effectively in a fast-paced, cross-functional engineering environment.

data.description:
Job Family

Software Application & Development (India)

Travel Required

None

Clearance Required

None

Junior Software Engineer, HR Applications

The Senior Software Engineer supports delivery by building and enhancing enterprise application components, integrations, and data structures using an AI‐first engineering approach-where automation and AI‐enabled workflows are treated as default solution patterns when appropriate. This role sits within IT, aligned to HCM Portfolio Leadership, and supports forward‐deployed engineering (FDE) delivery teams, contributing to both initial builds and ongoing sustainment under the guidance of senior engineers. 

What You Will Do

- Build and enhance full stack application components across front‐end, back‐end, and integration layers, under the guidance of senior engineers supporting enterprise solution delivery, including initial releases and iterative enhancements. 
 - Contribute to solutions using an AI‐first mindset, incorporating AI‐enabled workflows and automation where appropriate and supportable within IT standards. 
 - Develop and support API‐based integrations and batch/mass data processing workflows under established architectural patterns. 
 - Assist with data modeling, database design, and data structuring to support scalable and maintainable solutions. 
 - Collaborate with senior engineers, business stakeholders, and IT delivery partners in a cross‐functional, FDE model to move solutions from concept to production. 
 - Support testing, deployment, and post‐release sustainment activities, including defect resolution and minor enhancements. 
 - Follow enterprise standards and controls (e. g. , security, access, change/release, testing), including additional controls for systems subject to ITGC/SOX where applicable. 
 - Learn and apply enterprise platforms and emerging AI‐enabled capabilities aligned to the broader application ecosystem. 

What You Will Need

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field. 
 - 4 + years of experience in software engineering or application development roles. 
 - Hands‐on experience developing or contributing to full stack applications, including back‐end services (e. g. , Python) and modern JavaScript frameworks (e. g. , React. js, Next. js, TypeScript). 
 - Experience building or consuming APIs and supporting system integrations. 
 - Foundational understanding of databases and data structures. 
 - Experience using source control tools such as GitHub. 
 - Exposure to SDLC practices, including development, testing, deployment, and sustainment. 
 - Interest in learning and applying AI‐enabled workflows and automation in real‐world enterprise solutions. 
 - Ability to work within cross‐functional delivery teams and take direction from senior engineering leads. 
 - Strong written and verbal communication skills and willingness to learn the HR business domain supported by the applications. 

What Would Be Nice To Have

- Familiarity with HR or workforce platforms such as Workday or related staffing, finance, or resource management systems. 
 - Exposure to cloud platforms such as Microsoft Azure. 
 - Experience with CI/CD tools (e. g. , GitHub Actions, Azure Pipelines). 
 - Experience working in iterative, pod‐based delivery models with reusable patterns and enterprise controls. 
 - Demonstrated curiosity, coachability, and desire to grow technical depth over time. 

About Guidehouse India

At Guidehouse India, we're redefining what's possible by creating opportunities that change lives. Guidehouse is a global professional services firm that delivers advisory, technology, and managed services to clients across both the commercial and public sectors. Our teams turn bold ideas into solutions that transform industries, strengthen communities, and drive meaningful impact worldwide. 

Across our Chennai, Trivandrum, and Gurugram locations, you'll find opportunities where your passion and curiosity help shape what comes next. With cutting edge benefits, innovative learning and development programs, and a people first culture, we empower our people to lead with purpose. 

We continue to expand our teams and capabilities across India, investing in state-of-the-art offices and high impact work. Here, you'll collaborate with experts from around the world, build deep expertise, explore new domains, and accelerate your professional growth while making a real impact.

data.title: Full Stack JS Web Framework Developer (REMOTE)
data.description:
At Charles River, we are passionate about improving the quality of people's lives. When you join our global family, you will help create healthier lives for millions of patients and their families. 

Charles River employees are innovative thinkers, who are dedicated to continuous learning and improvement. We will empower you with the resources you need to grow and develop in your career. 

As a Charles River employee, you will be part of an industry-leading, customer-focused company at the forefront of drug development. Your skills will play a key role in bringing life-saving therapies to market faster through simpler, quicker, and more digitalized processes. Whether you are in lab operations, finance, IT, sales, or another area, when you work at Charles River, you will be the difference every day for patients across the globe. 

Job Overview

Responsible for the modernization and continued development of enterprise application frontends built on the legacy . NET platform and Java J2EE/Swing. This role involves frontend UI development using Svelte or other modern JavaScript/TypeScript frameworks and some backend development using C#/ASP. NET Core and Java. You will contribute to refactoring legacy systems into modular, API-driven architectures and help transition desktop-based WinForms UIs to responsive, maintainable, modern web interfaces. This position requires experience with Microsoft technologies, modern front-end frameworks, and development in a regulated (e. g. , cGMP) environment. 

Essential Duties And Responsibilities

- Contribute to the migration of legacy . NET applications (Web Forms, WCF, etc. ) and J2EE application frontends to modern JS Web Frameworks
 - Support the transformation of UIs from WinForms, Java Swing, or older technologies to Svelte or another JS web framework. 
 - Help to build and maintain backend services using C#, Entity Framework, Java, and PostgreSQL or SQL Server. 
 - Help refactor monoliths into modular APIs and services. 
 - Write and maintain unit, integration, and end-to-end tests. 
 - Contribute to DevOps pipelines and CI/CD processes. 
 - Collaborate with QA, Security, and Regulatory teams to maintain compliance with FDA 21 CFR Part 11, GAMP5, and cGMP standards. 
 - Participate in Agile development practices and sprint ceremonies. 
 - Document code and processes thoroughly. 
 - Share knowledge and support less-experienced developers. 

Qualifications

Education & Experience: 

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related field. 
 - 3+ years of experience in full-stack development with: 
 - JavaScript/TypeScript Web Frameworks - Svelte strongly preferred
 - CSS expertise
 - C# / ASP. NET Core / . NET 6+ / Java J2EE
 - SQL databases (PostgreSQL or SQL Server)
 - REST API design and implementation

Technical Skills

- Object-oriented programming (OOP) and design patterns
 - Modern JavaScript/TypeScript web frameworks (Svelte preferred)
 - Test automation frameworks (xUnit, Playwright, or Cypress)
 - Git, Azure DevOps, or equivalent ALM tools

Preferred Experience

- GxP or regulated software environment
 - Laboratory systems (LIMS, automation tools)
 - Docker, OpenShift, or Kubernetes environments

About Corporate Functions

The Corporate Functions provide operational support across Charles River in areas such as Human Resources, Finance, IT, Legal, Sales, Quality Assurance, Marketing, and Corporate Development. They partner with their colleagues across the company to develop and drive strategies and to set global standards. The functions are essential to providing a bridge between strategic vision and operational readiness, to ensure ongoing functional innovation and capability improvement. 

About Charles River

Charles River is an early-stage contract research organization (CRO). We have built upon our foundation of laboratory animal medicine and science to develop a diverse portfolio of discovery and safety assessment services, both Good Laboratory Practice (GLP) and non-GLP, to support clients from target identification through preclinical development. data.title: Application Development & Support Analyst
data.description:
Job Description

Short Description for Internal Candidates

Vertiv is seeking an Application Developer to support the development and maintenance of the Site Scope (ITS) site requirements platform within Digital. This individual contributor role is responsible for executing development tasks across the React web application, React Native mobile application, and Node. js backend API, assisting with integration troubleshooting, and contributing to feature delivery under the guidance of the Tech Lead. The role will contribute to keeping the Site Scope (ITS) platform stable by performing hands-on development work, resolving defects, and supporting platform operations. This role supports Vertiv's Operational Excellence and Customer Focus strategic priorities by helping ensure the Site Scope platform delivers reliable site requirements capture and assessment capabilities for Vertiv's global sales and technical teams. 

Description for Internal Candidates

Vertiv is seeking an Application Developer to support the development and maintenance of the Site Scope (ITS) site requirements platform within Digital. This individual contributor role is responsible for executing development tasks across the React web application, React Native mobile application, and Node. js backend API, assisting with integration troubleshooting, and contributing to feature delivery under the guidance of the Tech Lead. The role will contribute to keeping the Site Scope (ITS) platform stable by performing hands-on development work, resolving defects, and supporting platform operations. This role supports Vertiv's Operational Excellence and Customer Focus strategic priorities by helping ensure the Site Scope platform delivers reliable site requirements capture and assessment capabilities for Vertiv's global sales and technical teams. 

As a member of the Digital organization's Site Scope team, this role contributes to platform development including React web components, React Native mobile features with SQLite offline support, Node. js RESTful API endpoints, and Microsoft SQL Server database interactions. The Application Developer will assist with integration testing, participate in code reviews, and support deployment activities under the direction of senior team members. This role requires use of AWS AI services (Transcribe, Textract, Bedrock), Snowflake data integration, and Microsoft Entra authentication flows (migrating from Okta). This position is based at Vertiv's India office. 

2 Key Responsibilities

- React Frontend Development & Customization: Develop and customize frontend React components and TypeScript for the Site Scope web portal; implement feature enhancements and bug fixes to meet business requirements for sales and technical team workflows under the direction of the Tech Lead. 
 - React Native Mobile Development: Build and maintain React Native mobile application features for iOS and Android platforms; implement offline-capable functionality using SQLite, queue/retry mechanisms, and conflict resolution to enable field teams to capture site requirements without connectivity. 
 - Backend API Development & Integration Support: Develop and maintain Node. js RESTful API endpoints; work with Sequelize ORM for SQL Server database operations; assist with troubleshooting JWT authentication flows, SMTP email notifications, and Snowflake data connectivity. 
 - Database & Data Integration: Write and maintain SQL queries, stored procedures, and views in Microsoft SQL Server; support Snowflake integration for extracting deal and opportunity details; ensure data integrity across the platform's relational data layers and reporting functions. 
 - AWS AI Services Integration: Support integration with AWS Transcribe (speech-to-text for audio recordings), AWS Textract (image/PDF-to-text extraction), and AWS Bedrock (AI-based data model generation); assist with data flow implementation between the Node. js API and AWS services for site assessment automation. 
 - PDF Generation & Document Processing: Implement and maintain PDF generation pipelines using Docxtemplater, PizZip, and LibreOffice for converting site requirement data into formatted documents; support template management and document output quality assurance. 
 - Deployment & CI/CD Support: Support deployment activities using on-premises GitLab CI/CD pipelines; assist with web application builds, Android deployments via internal testing tracks, and iOS builds using Xcode on Mac VM; follow established version control processes and support TestFlight distributions for non-production testing. 
 - Authentication, Security & Collaboration: Support Microsoft Entra ID (Okta being retired) authentication configurations; collaborate with the Tech Lead, senior developers, IT infrastructure teams, and cross-functional stakeholders; document issues and resolutions in ServiceNow. 

3 Requirements

Education

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or related field; equivalent practical experience considered. 

Experience

- 1-5 years of hands-on software development experience with exposure to React and/or React Native application development. 
 - Experience building web or mobile application components with React/React Native and TypeScript in a professional or project-based setting. 
 - Familiarity with supporting web applications in a production or staging environment, including basic troubleshooting and defect resolution. 
 - Exposure to Node. js backend development or RESTful API concepts is a plus. 

Technical Skills

- Familiarity with the React framework including component architecture, hooks, state management, and lifecycle concepts. 
 - Proficiency with TypeScript, HTML, CSS, and modern web development fundamentals including responsive, mobile-friendly design. 
 - Basic understanding of REST APIs and HTTP communication; familiarity with Axios or equivalent HTTP clients and API testing tools (Postman). 
 - Exposure to version control systems (GitLab) and CI/CD pipeline concepts. 
 - Basic familiarity with Linux/Windows server environments and command-line operations. 
 - Understanding of SQL fundamentals and relational database concepts (Microsoft SQL Server preferred); familiarity with ORMs (Sequelize) is a plus. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with React Native mobile development including offline storage (SQLite) and sync/queue patterns. 
 - Exposure to Node. js backend development with JWT authentication and middleware patterns. 
 - Familiarity with Microsoft Entra ID, Okta, or OIDC-based authentication and authorization flows. 
 - Experience with AWS services (Transcribe, Textract, Bedrock, or similar AI/ML services). 
 - Familiarity with PDF generation libraries (Docxtemplater, PizZip) or document automation workflows. 
 - Experience with Zod or Joi validation frameworks. 
 - Agile/Scrum experience in team-based delivery environments. 

Working Conditions

Primary Work Location: India. 

About Us

The successful candidate will embrace Vertiv's Core Principles & Behaviors to help execute our Strategic Priorities. 

OUR CORE PRINCIPLES: Safety. Integrity. Respect. Teamwork. Inclusion. 

OUR STRATEGIC PRIORITIES

- High-Performance Culture
 - Customer Focus
 - Operational Excellence
 - Innovation
 - Financial Strength

VERTIV BEHAVIORS

- Own it
 - Act with urgency
 - Foster a customer-first mindset
 - Think big and execute
 - Lead by example
 - Drive continuous improvement
 - Learn and seek out development
 - Promote transparent & open communication

About Vertiv

Vertiv (NYSE: VRT) brings together hardware, software, analytics and ongoing services to enable its customers' vital applications to run continuously, perform optimally and grow with their business needs. Vertiv solves the most important challenges facing today's data centers, communication networks, and commercial and industrial facilities with a portfolio of power, cooling and IT infrastructure solutions and services that extend from the cloud to the edge of the network. Headquartered in Westerville, Ohio, USA, Vertiv employs around 34, 000 people and does business in more than 130 countries. Visit Vertiv. com to learn more. 

Equal Opportunity Employer

Vertiv is an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action employer. We promote equal opportunities for all with respect to hiring, terms of employment, mobility, training, compensation, and occupational health, without discrimination as to age, race, color, religion, creed, sex, pregnancy status (including childbirth, breastfeeding, or related medical conditions), marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity / expression (including transgender status or sexual stereotypes), genetic information, citizenship status, national origin, protected veteran status, political affiliation, or disability. Role: Senior Tech Lead/Architect

Location: Noida

Experience: 10 Year+

Confirmed Job Title (per hiring breakup): Tech Architect

Band: 4D

Headcount: 

Experience: 16+ years, including 4+ years in an architect-level role on Java/cloud-native platforms

The Technical Architect owns end-to-end architecture for the scalable, secure, Java-based and AI-enabled insurance broking platform, including the multi-agent pipeline built on Microsoft Agent Framework (Python) and running on Azure. This role bridges business, product, data science, and engineering, and is accountable for the platform's architecture, security, and delivery quality end to end. 

Responsibilities

Architecture & Design

- Own end-to-end architecture for the Java-based, AI-enabled insurance broking platform, including the multi-agent pipeline built on Microsoft Agent Framework (Python) - covering workflow design in the framework's visual designer and the migration from Semantic Kernel to Microsoft Agent Framework. 
 - Define reference architectures, design standards, and best practices. 
 - Design scalable solutions using microservices, APIs, event-driven architecture, and cloud-native patterns. 
 - Ensure architecture aligns with enterprise NFRs (scalability, availability, security, performance). 
 - Evaluate and recommend AI/ML integration approaches (LLM invocation via Azure OpenAI and Azure AI Foundry, model deployment versioning, token and cost governance), including Azure AI Content Understanding, Azure AI Translator, and Azure AI Search. Implementation Leadership

- Lead hands-on implementation and guide engineering teams through complex technical decisions. 
 - Review and approve low-level designs, code architecture, and integration patterns. 
 - Mentor senior engineers and technical leads; drive CI/CD, DevSecOps, and automation best practices. 
 - Troubleshoot and resolve complex production issues and performance bottlenecks. AI, Security & Stakeholder Collaboration

- Enable AI-led capabilities responsibly - data privacy, bias mitigation, and compliance. 
 - Embed security-by-design principles across the platform. 
 - Work closely with Product Owners, Business Leaders, and Enterprise Architects. Minimum Qualifications

Core Technologies

- Strong, hands-on Java (11+/17): Spring Boot, Spring Cloud, RESTful APIs, JSON, OpenAPI/Swagger, microservices - deep coding ability expected, not just design-level familiarity. 
 - Strong, hands-on Python (PRIMARY language for this role): FastAPI, Pandas, Azure SDK for Python, async/await, and agent development with Microsoft Agent Framework and Azure OpenAI / AI Foundry integration - Python is the primary and dominant coding language for the AI/agentic layer; this role must be genuinely expert in Python, with Java as a strong supporting skill for the platform layer. 
 - Azure platform fundamentals as a primary requirement: Microsoft Entra ID and managed identities (RBAC scoping), Azure Key Vault, virtual networking, Azure Storage, Azure database services, and Azure Monitor / Application Insights - in addition to the Azure AI services stack: Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Foundry, Azure AI Content Understanding, Azure AI Translator, and Azure AI Search (including RAG/vector-search patterns), with model deployment management, token budgeting, and guardrails. 
 - Containers: Docker; Kubernetes for orchestration. 
 - Cloud platform requirement: Azure is the primary and required cloud platform for this role. AWS and GCP familiarity is optional / a nice-to-have, never mandatory. 
 - Integration with insurance broking systems: AIM API, ImageRight, carrier portals, and Cora Sequence REST APIs - including REST/OpenAPI integration design and authentication patterns. 
 - CI/CD (Azure DevOps/GitHub Actions or equivalent), IaC (Terraform/Bicep/ARM), observability, and performance tuning. Preferred Qualifications / Skills

- Event-driven architecture (Kafka/RabbitMQ); MLOps; Azure Database for PostgreSQL; externalized rules engines (Drools). Azure AI Content Understanding - hands-on experience with document field extraction schemas, classifier configuration, and result confidence scoring is strongly preferred for this role.

data.description:
Job Description

About the role: 

Our team builds the tools and runs the tests that support Oracle Database patch releases, including RUs, PSUs, CPUs, MRPs, and CSPUs. The work spans multiple release lines and involves changes across a large, complex codebase. 

In this hands-on role, you'll build and own test automation, investigate failures, and work with development and testing teams to resolve issues. You'll also use AI coding tools and explore ways to bring AI agents into day-to-day engineering workflows. 

What will you do ?

- Build and maintain test frameworks and tools for database patch validation. 
 - Automate test runs, result collection, failure detection, and issue tracking across release lines. 
 - Investigate failures by examining test results, source code, logs, stack traces, and dumps. 
 - Debug programs that are part of the Oracle Database server. 
 - Turn customer use cases into tests and improve existing test applications. 
 - Work with development, testing, and release teams to understand issues and keep patch validation moving. 
 - Use AI coding tools for tasks such as exploring code, writing or updating tests, refactoring, and documentation. Review and test generated code before using it. 
 - Build AI agent workflows for tasks such as summarizing failures, grouping similar issues, and connecting test results with code changes or known bugs. 
 - Build connectors that let AI agents work with approved test systems, diagnostic data, and issue tracking tools. 
 - Evaluate AI workflows and make their results traceable, with engineers reviewing findings before action is taken. 
 - Track whether automation is improving test coverage, repeatability, and the time it takes to investigate failures. 

Why the work matters ?

Each patch can include hundreds of fixes, and every fix needs to be checked for unintended effects. Several database releases are tested at the same time, while customers depend on patches arriving on schedule. Better automation and faster, clearer failure analysis can catch regressions earlier and make validation more predictable. 

Required skills : 

- Proficiency in Python, Java, SQL, and PL/SQL. 
 - Strong foundations in data structures and algorithms (DSA) and object-oriented programming (OOP). 
 - Experience developing software, test tools, or automation. 

Preferred skills : 

- Perl or JavaScript. 
 - Familiarity with Oracle Database concepts such as server architecture, background processes, instances, shared and dedicated servers, connectivity, and configuration. 
 - Experience reading alert logs, stack dumps, or other database diagnostics. 
 - Experience building test harnesses, automation frameworks, or workflow tools. 
 - Experience with AI coding assistants or integrating AI into software development. 
 - Familiarity with LLMs, AI agents, or connectors between agents and engineering tools. 
 - Experience testing AI workflows and making their results traceable and reviewable. 
 - Experience working across multiple operating systems and platforms. 

What will you learn ?

You'll have opportunities to build knowledge of Oracle Database areas such as Consolidated Database, Grid Computing, Real Application Clusters (RAC), transaction management, query optimization, recovery, and data warehousing.

Data Systems Software Development:

Software Architecture - Software System Structural Design: 

- Implements and contributes to developing software, systems, and services, ensuring review by manager and/or senior technical leaders upon completion. Recommends project or design scope.

Development Operations - System Maintenance:

Job Summary**

We are seeking a highly motivated and innovative R&D Engineer to join our dynamic team at Hitachi, Ltd. This role involves contributing to the research, design, and development of cutting-edge technologies and products, pushing the boundaries of innovation within our diverse industrial sectors. 

Job Responsibilities**

- Perform verification and validation of Substation Automation and Protection products, systems, and engineering tools. 
 - Design, execute, and document functional, integration, interoperability, regression, performance, and system-level test cases. 
 - Validate IEC 61850 services and system engineering, including MMS, GOOSE, Sampled Values, SCL files, and time synchronization where applicable. 
 - Test communication interfaces and protocols such as IEC 61850, IEC 60870-5-101/104, DNP3, OPC UA, SNMP, and other relevant industrial protocols. 
 - Analyze network communication and troubleshoot system-level issues using tools such as Wireshark and protocol/test tools. 
 - Validate integration between IEDs, protection and control devices, SCADA systems, gateways, engineering tools, and communication networks. 
 - Integrate the industry standard redundancy protocols and time synchronization between devices. 
 - Identify, reproduce, document, and track defects, working closely with development teams through resolution and verification. 
 - Contribute to test automation using Python or similar scripting technologies to improve test coverage and efficiency. 
 - Participate in cybersecurity and secure communication validation, including authentication, secure protocols, certificates, role-based access, and network security features where applicable. 
 - Prepare clear test specifications, test reports, defect reports, and technical documentation. 
 - Collaborate with local and global R&D teams to continuously improve test methods, automation, product quality, and validation efficiency. 

Job Qualifications**

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics, Instrumentation, Power Systems, or a related engineering discipline. 
 - Good understanding of Substation Automation, Protection & Control, or power automation systems. 
 - Knowledge of IEC 61850 concepts and communication architecture. 
 - Familiarity with at least some industrial protocols such as IEC 60870-5-101/104, DNP3, OPC UA, Modbus, or SNMP. 
 - Basic understanding of Ethernet networking, TCP/IP, VLANs, redundancy, and time synchronization concepts. 
 - Experience with system testing, product validation, integration testing, or troubleshooting. 
 - Ability to analyze communication/network traces using Wireshark or similar tools. 
 - Basic programming or scripting knowledge, preferably Python. 
 - Strong analytical, problem-solving, documentation, and communication skills.

data.title: Software Engineer III
data.description:
Software Engineer - III

About The Role

GHX is building a next-generation Intelligent Process Automation (IPA) platform powered by LLMs and AI-native document understanding. We extract structured data from complex healthcare procurement documents - Purchase Orders, invoices, contracts - at scale across cloud environments. As a member of the IPA engineering team, you will bridge strong software engineering with applied AI. You will design and ship Python services, integrate LLM APIs, build AI agents, create skills and validate the output of LLMs to build document extraction pipelines, and own evaluation infrastructure that ensures production quality. This is not a research role - it is a hands-on engineering role where AI fluency amplifies solid software craft. 

Core Responsibilities

Python Development & Automation

- Build and maintain Python-based automation services and IPA workflows 
 - Develop platform-agnostic solutions supporting future migration across automation tooling 
 - Build reusable libraries, frameworks, and components for automation projects 
 - Integrate automation solutions with REST APIs and enterprise applications 
 - Deploy and monitor automation bots on AWS (Lambda, ECS, SQS, S3)

AI & LLM Integration

- Integrate LLM APIs (like Anthropic Claude, OpenAI, Azure AI) into production pipelines 
 - Design classification and extraction prompts for diverse document types (POs, invoices, contracts) 
 - Write prompts that function as formal specifications - unambiguous, edge-case-aware 
 - Build and iterate few-shot, chain-of-thought, and structured output templates 
 - Own prompt library versioning, rollback strategy, and prompt lifecycle management

AI & LLM Integration

- Integrate LLM APIs (like Anthropic Claude, OpenAI, Azure AI) into production pipelines 
 - Design classification and extraction prompts for diverse document types (POs, invoices, contracts) 
 - Write prompts that function as formal specifications - unambiguous, edge-case-aware 
 - Build and iterate few-shot, chain-of-thought, and structured output templates 
 - Own prompt library versioning, rollback strategy, and prompt lifecycle management

Document Processing & IDP

- Implement OCR/IDP workflows to extract and validate structured and unstructured data 
 - Build confidence scoring frameworks for extracted fields with multi-factor validation 
 - Design and curate ground truth datasets for classification and extraction tasks 
 - Build automated evaluation pipelines tracking precision, recall, and field-level accuracy 
 - Validate model outputs against intent - catch what is technically correct but conceptually wrong

Software Engineering

- Design and build production-grade APIs and services around LLM capabilities 
 - Apply Clean Architecture or equivalent - design for testability and maintainability 
 - Contribute to CI/CD pipelines, observability tooling, and deployment processes 
 - Conduct code reviews, establish coding standards, and mentor junior engineers 
 - Troubleshoot and optimize existing automation workflows and Python services

Collaboration & Communication

- Work closely with business analysts and stakeholders to understand process requirements 
 - Participate in Agile ceremonies - sprint planning, retrospectives, and estimation 
 - Communicate system constraints in product language; translate product needs into system boundaries 
 - Surface quality metrics and model behaviour clearly to non-technical stakeholders

Required Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field 
 - 5-9 years of software engineering experience, with at least 4 years in Python 
 - Strong Python skills - Pandas, NumPy, Flask/Django, async programming 
 - Hands-on experience with LLM APIs (like Anthropic Claude, OpenAI, or Azure AI) 
 - Prompt engineering experience - structured outputs, few-shot, chain-of-thought 
 - 2+ years of experience with SQL and NoSQL databases 
 - Experience deploying applications on AWS - Lambda, SQS, S3, ECS 
 - Knowledge of Docker, Git, and CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins or equivalent) 
 - Familiarity with REST API design and tools like Swagger and Postman 
 - Understanding of OCR/IDP tools - AWS Textract, UiPath Document Understanding, or ABBYY

Desired Qualifications

- Experience with AI agent orchestration frameworks - LangChain, LlamaIndex, or MCP 
 - Familiarity with evaluation frameworks for LLM outputs (precision, recall, F1 at field level) 
 - NLP / text classification background 
 - UiPath Associate or Advanced RPA Developer certification (or equivalent) 
 - Exposure to Clean Architecture, DDD, or equivalent design patterns 
 - Understanding of Agile/Scrum methodologies

What Good Looks Like

- Prompt as specification - treats prompts like contracts: precise, unambiguous, edge-case-aware from the start 
 - Verification instinct - reads AI output critically; catches the subtly wrong answer before it becomes a data quality incident 
 - Evaluation-first mindset - doesn't trust a prompt in production without a test suite; builds measurement as part of the feature 
 - Engineering rigour - applies the same discipline to Python services as to LLM pipelines; Clean Architecture is the default, not the exception 
 - Communication range - can speak to a non-technical ops manager and a distributed system design at the same level of precision

data.title: Core Infrastructure Engineer 2
data.description:
Job Description

Implements and optimizes components within existing distributed systems under guidance. Applies basic scalability requirements, conducts performance/load testing, and configures resiliency features (retries, circuit breakers, timeouts) to handle network variability. Builds telemetry, alerts, and runbook-driven procedures; delivers scoped features and fault-injection tests; and helps implement basic data replication and synchronization. Assists with on-call rotations, uses automation/IaC scripts to troubleshoot, and follows change, security, and compliance procedures (encryption, access controls, remediation plans) while escalating complex issues to senior engineers. 

Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

System Design & Architecture - System Scalability: 

-Assist in the implementation of components of distributed systems that support horizontal and vertical scaling under the guidance of senior engineers. 

-Optimize code segments and/or systems for large-scale data processing with oversight from senior engineers. 

-Implement scalability requirements for assigned components. 

-Learn about the use of data plane platforms for large-scale data retrieval, storage, and processing. 

-Execute performance and load testing, with guidance. 

System Design & Architecture - System Reliability Design: 

-Collaborate with the team to build fault-tolerant components capable of withstanding in-service updates by learning about redundancy, replication, and automatic failover mechanisms. 

-Learn about recovery oriented computing principles and assist in applying them to component designs. 

-Configure and test retry mechanisms, circuit breakers, and timeouts to help handle network unreliability, with guidance

System Design & Architecture - System Reliability Performance: 

-Implement testing and alarming configurations to detect issues/failures. 

-Support efforts to recover from failures by drafting and executing runbooks and operational procedures, under guidance. 

-Help build dashboards, telemetry systems, and alerting mechanisms to monitor component health. 

System Design & Architecture - Correctness / Availability: 

-Implement functional requirements and testing for assigned features within an existing system. 

-Implement test scenarios (e. g. , fault-injection, brown-out) to evaluate system correctness, under guidance. 

-Help implement basic data replication and synchronization techniques to maintain data integrity and availability. 

Operational Troubleshooting & Incident Management: 

-Assist in diagnosing and debugging issues in system components to support ongoing operation, under supervision. 

-Follow protocols to prevent interruptions, ensuring no maintenance windows are required for customers and users when resolving issues. 

-Run basic automation scripts and tooling to troubleshoot operational issues. 

-Participate in operational support rotations, assisting in incident responses and root cause investigations. 

Compliance & Security: 

-Assist in implementing basic security measures to protect data and applications in multi-tenant environments, including encryption and access controls. 

-Assist in the execution of remediation plans to address identified security gaps, under supervision. 

-Support the creation and updating of documentation to ensure cloud infrastructure is in compliance with relevant industry standards and regulations. 

Automation & Change Management: 

-Assist in maintaining basic automation scripts and tools (e. g. , Infrastructure as Code (IaC)). 

-Adhere to change management plans for patching, updating, and rolling back applications, under guidance

Core Responsibilities

Planning & Execution: 

-Track timelines with minimal supervision, ensuring work is completed in a timely manner and is in alignment with project requirements. 

-Prioritize and adjust work as resources or timelines change, with some guidance

Collaboration & Partnership: 

-Collaborate within the team to better understand expectations and achieve shared objectives.

Problem Solving: 

-Identify and address issues, escalating problems to senior staff as needed in accordance with standard procedures. 

-Compile and review data and/or information from multiple sources to troubleshoot standard and non-standard errors. 

Continuous Learning: 

-Seek opportunities to gain knowledge and learn new skills and/or tools aligned with industry trends and best practices. 

-Utilize feedback and training to improve skills.

Continuous Improvement: 

-Implement updates to processes, protocols, and workflows to increase efficiency and effectiveness as directed, with some guidance.

You are an expert C coder with networking experience. You value simplicity and scale, work comfortably in a collaborative, agile environment, and are excited to learn.
