data.title: Principal Data Systems Software Engineer
data.description:
Job Description

About the role: 

Our team builds the tools and runs the tests that support Oracle Database patch releases, including RUs, PSUs, CPUs, MRPs, and CSPUs. The work spans multiple release lines and involves changes across a large, complex codebase. 

In this hands-on role, you'll build and own test automation, investigate failures, and work with development and testing teams to resolve issues. You'll also use AI coding tools and explore ways to bring AI agents into day-to-day engineering workflows. 

What will you do ?

- Build and maintain test frameworks and tools for database patch validation. 
 - Automate test runs, result collection, failure detection, and issue tracking across release lines. 
 - Investigate failures by examining test results, source code, logs, stack traces, and dumps. 
 - Debug programs that are part of the Oracle Database server. 
 - Turn customer use cases into tests and improve existing test applications. 
 - Work with development, testing, and release teams to understand issues and keep patch validation moving. 
 - Use AI coding tools for tasks such as exploring code, writing or updating tests, refactoring, and documentation. Review and test generated code before using it. 
 - Build AI agent workflows for tasks such as summarizing failures, grouping similar issues, and connecting test results with code changes or known bugs. 
 - Build connectors that let AI agents work with approved test systems, diagnostic data, and issue tracking tools. 
 - Evaluate AI workflows and make their results traceable, with engineers reviewing findings before action is taken. 
 - Track whether automation is improving test coverage, repeatability, and the time it takes to investigate failures. 

Why the work matters ?

Each patch can include hundreds of fixes, and every fix needs to be checked for unintended effects. Several database releases are tested at the same time, while customers depend on patches arriving on schedule. Better automation and faster, clearer failure analysis can catch regressions earlier and make validation more predictable. 

Required skills : 

- Proficiency in Python, Java, SQL, and PL/SQL. 
 - Strong foundations in data structures and algorithms (DSA) and object-oriented programming (OOP). 
 - Experience developing software, test tools, or automation. 

Preferred skills : 

- Perl or JavaScript. 
 - Familiarity with Oracle Database concepts such as server architecture, background processes, instances, shared and dedicated servers, connectivity, and configuration. 
 - Experience reading alert logs, stack dumps, or other database diagnostics. 
 - Experience building test harnesses, automation frameworks, or workflow tools. 
 - Experience with AI coding assistants or integrating AI into software development. 
 - Familiarity with LLMs, AI agents, or connectors between agents and engineering tools. 
 - Experience testing AI workflows and making their results traceable and reviewable. 
 - Experience working across multiple operating systems and platforms. 

What will you learn ?

You'll have opportunities to build knowledge of Oracle Database areas such as Consolidated Database, Grid Computing, Real Application Clusters (RAC), transaction management, query optimization, recovery, and data warehousing. 

Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

Data Systems Software Development: 

- Own a feature area's data model across Online Transaction Processing/Online Analytical Processing, JSON, spatial, or graph. 
 - Define performance budgets and enforce query patterns that meet latency targets at scale. 
 - Partner with product management to design experiments that drive adoption, conversion, and retention; analyze results to inform roadmap. 
 - Architects existing and complex new services. 

Software Development and Coding - Design, Testing, and Optimization: 

- Designs software solutions and analyzes and identifies requirements to achieve business and operational goals, sharing results with manager upon completion. 
 - Adheres to and improves execution of all phases of the software development lifecycle; provides guidance and coaching to engineers to drive improvements. 
 - Utilizes advanced knowledge to develop and guide new software features and enhancements leading design specifications, ensuring accessibility, and develops documents to clarify software design and code. 
 - Leads code reviews in multiple areas to help drive improvements. 
 - Conducts debugging and troubleshooting to identify and fix complex software issues. 
 - Develops fixes for identified issues. 
 - Implements comprehensive software testing (e. g. , functional and non-functional testing), quality assurance processes, software error logging, monitoring, and observability for effective debugging, sharing work with manager and/or lead upon completion. 
 - Conducts performance profiling and optimization of coding, building scalable solutions, and anticipating and resolving potential outcomes. 
 - Troubleshoots and resolves complex issues related to application programming interface (API) functionality and integration. 
 - Implements complex API versioning, lifecycle, and interoperability strategies. 

Software Architecture - Software System Structural Design: 

- Implements and contributes to developing software, systems, and services, ensuring review by manager and/or senior technical leaders upon completion. Recommends project or design scope. 
 - Provides technical guidance and coaching to less experienced developers in existing software architecture. 
 - Contributes to periodic reviews and ensures adherence to architectural standards. 
 - Collaborates with stakeholders and networks externally to ensure work aligns with software architecture. 
 - Implements complex performance optimization and scalability strategies in software design. 
 - Occasionally conducts technology research and evaluation for potential architectural changes that may have an impact on results for the team. 

Issue/Defect Collaboration - Software Products Support: 

- Collaborates with stakeholders to understand customer issues and align solutions. 
 - May provide advanced technical guidance and support to customers regarding customer-reported issues. 
 - Advocates for customers' interests and suggests product enhancements based on feedback. 
 - Provides input to ensure customer satisfaction through timely resolution of issues and effective communication. 
 - Identifies and implements customer issue and/or defect handling and training processes. 
 - Investigates and troubleshoots complex and broad reaching/scoped maintenance issues to ensure customer agreement on short- and long-term solutions (e. g. , future enhancements). 

Practices and Standards Compliance - Security and Compliance: 

- Collaborates with the team and externally to follow development practices and coding standards, providing coaching to less experienced team members. 
 - Participates in peer review processes, provides technical leadership, and ensures code quality and adherence to broad acceptance criteria during development, independently. 
 - Demonstrates and shares advanced knowledge of industry best practices and applies them to software development processes.

Job Title: Senior Performance Engineer

Role Summary

We are seeking a highly skilled Senior Performance Engineer with deep expertise in application and infrastructure performance testing, performance engineering, and observability. The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience with industry-standard performance testing tools such as LoadRunner, NeoLoad, JMeter, and K6, along with strong familiarity with observability platforms like Datadog and AppDynamics. 

This role requires a strong engineering mindset, solid development skills, and the ability to work closely with application, infrastructure, DevOps, and product teams to ensure systems are scalable, stable, and performant under load. The candidate should also possess good working knowledge of Unix/Linux and Python, along with excellent communication and stakeholder management skills. 

Key Responsibilities

- Design, develop, and execute performance test strategies, scripts, and scenarios for web, API, middleware, and enterprise applications. 
 - Analyze performance test results, identify bottlenecks, and provide actionable recommendations for tuning and optimization. 
 - Work with development and infrastructure teams to troubleshoot performance issues across application, database, network, and server layers. 
 - Use observability tools such as Datadog and AppDynamics to monitor system health, trace transactions, and correlate performance metrics during testing and production incidents. 
 - Build and maintain performance testing frameworks and reusable assets to improve efficiency and standardization. 
 - Collaborate with engineering teams to support performance improvements during design, development, testing, and release cycles. 
 - Participate in capacity planning, scalability assessments, and performance risk analysis. 
 - Develop scripts, utilities, and automation in Python and/or shell scripting to support performance engineering activities. 
 - Work effectively in Unix/Linux environments for test execution, log analysis, troubleshooting, and automation. 
 - Communicate findings, risks, and recommendations clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders. 
 - Support continuous improvement of performance engineering processes, practices, and tooling. 

Required Skills And Experience

- Strong experience in performance engineering and performance testing. 
 - Hands-on expertise with: LoadRunnerNeoLoadJMeterK6
 - Practical experience with observability/monitoring tools such as: DatadogAppDynamics
 - Strong engineering and development skills, with the ability to understand application architecture and code behavior. 
 - Good working knowledge of Unix/Linux. 
 - Hands-on experience with Python for automation, analysis, or tooling. 
 - Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving abilities. 
 - Excellent verbal and written communication skills. 
 - Ability to work collaboratively across cross-functional teams and manage multiple priorities. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience in cloud and microservices-based environments. 
 - Knowledge of CI/CD pipelines and integrating performance tests into release workflows. 
 - Familiarity with APM, log analytics, distributed tracing, and synthetic monitoring. 
 - Experience with database and middleware performance analysis. 
 - Exposure to containerized environments such as Docker and Kubernetes. 

Education

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

data.title: Staff Software Engineer (Mobile, iOS)
data.description:
About Outreach

Outreach, founded in 2014, is the only complete agentic AI platform for revenue teams. Outreach infuses agentic AI, conversation intelligence, and assistive AI to power hundreds of use cases across revenue motions. From new logo prospecting to expansions, deal acceleration, driving retention, and forecasting, Outreach AI automates workflows and frees sellers to focus on more strategic conversations and actions. Revenue leaders benefit from connected account visibility, performance insights, and higher forecasting accuracy across every GTM team. World leading enterprise organizations use Outreach to power their revenue teams, including Databricks, SAP, Siemens, and Verizon to name a few. 

About The Team

On the Mobile team, the goal is to give sellers everything they need to work their pipeline when they're away from their desk. Our iOS app brings Outreach tasks, calling, email, SMS, meetings, conversation recordings, forecasting and Ask Outreach, our AI assistant, to the iPhone. It's a large Swift codebase built on UIKit, with SwiftUI growing, Apollo GraphQL, and real-time voice through Twilio and CallKit. It ships to enterprise customers on a regular release train. 

As our Staff iOS Engineer, you'll lead the technical direction of the iOS app. You'll evolve its architecture toward modern Swift, build the testing and release foundations, and own complex features from design to the App Store. The visibility of the work is immense. We have plenty of tough challenges which require creative minds like yours to help us solve!

Your Daily Adventures Will Include

- Partnering with mobile product managers, designers and team to deeply understand the needs of sellers on the go and build a product that serves those needs
 - Setting technical direction for the iOS app and evolving a large UIKit codebase toward SwiftUI, the Observation framework and Swift Concurrency, one feature area at a time, toward an agreed north star
 - Owning complex features end to end, such as voice calling with Twilio Voice, CallKit and PushKit, real-time SMS, push notifications, and recording and playback
 - Leading our GraphQL client work on Apollo iOS 2. x: async APIs, a deliberate caching strategy, and a reproducible codegen workflow
 - Building the iOS delivery foundations, including automated code signing, unit and UI test gates in CI, and TestFlight and App Store release automation
 - Making sure the app is observable and issues are easy to diagnose, through symbolicated crash reports, structured logging and release-health dashboards
 - Raising the bar on accessibility (VoiceOver, Dynamic Type), localization and privacy across the app
 - Finding quick ways to prototype and test possible solutions to large problems
 - Owning relationships with other engineering teams, such as Voice, Identity and Android, and collaborating with other functions within Outreach

Basic Qualifications

- 6+ years of professional software development experience, with 4+ years building iOS apps in Swift
 - Expert knowledge of UIKit and SwiftUI, including incrementally migrating UIKit screens to SwiftUI
 - Strong command of Swift Concurrency (async/await, actors, @MainActor) and experience moving callback-based code to it
 - Proven success shipping and operating apps on the App Store: code signing, TestFlight, App Store Connect, review and phased releases
 - Experience with networking and auth on iOS: GraphQL or REST clients, OAuth/OIDC (e. g. AppAuth) and Keychain
 - Solid testing practice with XCTest or Swift Testing, XCUITest, and dependency injection for testability
 - Proven senior technical leadership: setting direction for a team, breaking down quarter-long projects and delivering them
 - CallKit, PushKit, AVAudioSession or Twilio Voice (plus)
 - Microsoft Intune App SDK and MSAL (plus)
 - Swift Package Manager modularization and fastlane (plus)

Why You'll Love It Here

- Highly competitive salary
 - 25 days annual vacation time + sick time and casual leave
 - Group medical policy coverage available to employees and up to 5 eligible family members
 - OPD benefit covered up to INR 10, 000
 - Life insurance and personal accident insurance at 3x annual CTC
 - 26 weeks of maternity leave pay, and 15 days of paternity leave pay
 - Opportunity to be part of company success via the RSU program
 - Diversity and inclusion programs that promote employee resource groups like OWN+ (Outreach Women's Network), Adelante (Latinx community), OBX (Outreach Black Connection), Mosaic (AAPI community), Pride (LGBTQIA+), Gender+, Disability Community, and Veterans/Military
 - Employee referral bonuses to encourage the addition of great new people to the team
 - Fun company and team outings because we play just as hard as we work

Outreach is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status. 

Our success is reliant on building teams that include people from different backgrounds and experiences who can elevate assumptions and ideas with fresh perspectives. We're dedicated to hiring the whole human, not just a resume. To that end, we look for a diverse pool of applicants-including those from historically marginalized groups. We would like to invite you to apply even if you don't think you meet all of the requirements listed below. We don't want a few lines in a job description to get between us and the opportunity to meet you. 

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

data.title: Regulatory, Compliance & Controls Testing & Validation - Analyst
data.description:
Summary

Position Summary

Regulatory, Risk & Forensic | Testing & Validation Utility

Our Regulatory, Risk & Forensic team supports client leaders to translate multifaceted risk and an evolving regulatory environment into defensible actions that help strengthen, protect, and transform organizations. Join our team and use advanced data, AI and emerging technologies with industry insights to help client service teams bring clarity from complexity and accelerate their path to value creation. 

The Testing & Validation Utility delivers integrated regulatory, compliance, and controls testing and validation services, along with regulatory reporting, across Controls Testing, Conformance Testing, Compliance Testing, Regulatory Reporting QA & Testing, Risk & Control Self-Assessment (RCSA) and Post-Effectiveness Testing, Issue Management & Remediation Validation, and Regulatory Reporting for global clients across industries, with a particular focus on Banking, Capital Markets, Investment Management, and Insurance. We expect our professionals to bring exposure across the end-to-end risk management lifecycle - Transactions, Conformance, Controls, Compliance, RCSA, and Issue Management - and to apply that breadth across the components they support. 

Position Summary

Regulatory, Compliance & Controls Testing & Validation | Analyst

Level: Analyst (2-4 years of relevant experience)

As an Analyst within the Testing & Validation Utility at Deloitte Consulting Services, you will support execution of high-quality regulatory, compliance, and controls testing and validation activities, along with regulatory reporting, across the Regulatory, Risk & Forensic portfolio. You will deliver assigned work products within due timelines under the supervision of senior team members. 

About

At Deloitte, we do not offer you just a job, but a career in the highly sought-after Risk Management field. We are one of the business leaders in the risk market. We work with a vision to make the world more prosperous, trustworthy, and safe. Deloitte's clients, primarily based outside of India, are large, complex organizations that constantly evolve and innovate to build better products and services. In the process, they encounter various risks and the work we do to help them address these risks is increasingly important to their success-and to the strength of the economy and public security. 

By joining us, you will get to work with diverse teams of professionals who design, manage, and implement risk-centric solutions across a variety of domains. In the process, you will gain exposure to the risk-centric challenges faced in today's world by organizations across a range of industry sectors and become subject matter experts in those areas. 

Work you'll do: 

Our Regulatory, Risk & Forensic Operate professionals help organizations effectively navigate business risks and opportunities - from strategic, reputation, and financial risks to operational and regulatory risks - to gain competitive advantage. We apply our experience in ongoing business operations and corporate lifecycle events to help clients become stronger and more resilient. Our market-leading teams help clients embrace complexity to accelerate performance, disrupt through innovation, and lead in their industries. 

We support clients by delivering Operate services spanning the Regulatory, Risk & Forensic portfolio. We embed continuous advantage through domain, industry, technology / Gen AI, and transformation skills to perform client business functions that manage risk and deliver value-added outcomes. 

As an Analyst within the Testing & Validation Utility, you will support delivery of regulatory, compliance, and controls testing and validation outcomes, along with regulatory reporting, across the end-to-end risk management lifecycle - helping execute control and compliance testing, test regulatory reports, support risk and control self-assessments, validate issue remediation activities, and prepare regulatory filings. You will build foundational skills across multiple risk and assurance domains while consistently delivering high-quality, audit-ready work. 

Your work will be performed for first-line control owners, second-line risk and compliance functions, and internal audit, following a standard methodology and supported by analytics and GenAI tools. Typical activities include data sourcing and reconciliation, walkthroughs, population validation, sample selection, evidence review, root cause analysis, workpaper documentation, and reporting of results and remediation status. Specific responsibilities span the following areas: 

Controls Testing

Perform end-to-end assessments of the design and operating effectiveness of operational and compliance controls - including walkthroughs, process documentation, test strategy, sample design, and population validation - with full traceability from risk through evidence to conclusion. 

- Support end-to-end control assessments under supervision, including planning, walkthroughs, design effectiveness assessment, operating effectiveness testing, documentation, and issue follow-up
 - Execute sample selection, evidence review, attribute testing, and conclusion drafting in accordance with established methodology and quality standards
 - Prepare reviewer-ready workpapers, evidence files, and draft observations with clear rationale; document process flows for assigned reviews
 - Maintain testing trackers, issue logs, and status updates; collaborate with control owners and senior team members to obtain evidence
 - Build foundational understanding of internal control concepts (manual vs. automated, preventive vs. detective, IPE, SoD, sampling)

Conformance Testing

Execute conformance reviews of reports, processes, and controls against published regulatory instructions, internal policies, and procedures; identify variances, perform root cause analysis, and drive remediation. 

- Support execution of conformance tests against regulatory reporting instructions (FFIEC, FRB, PRA, FCA, FINRA, SEC) and bank policy/procedure documents for assigned reports and processes
 - Trace report values, attribute mappings, and disclosures to underlying instructions, taxonomies, and source documentation; flag deviations from prescribed treatment
 - Document conformance test steps, evidence, and exceptions; maintain checklists, Operating Procedures, and Reports under the supervision of senior team members
 - Assist with MI creation, status reporting, and tracking of conformance issues and remediation

Compliance Testing

Test the design and operating effectiveness of compliance controls across federal and state consumer protection regulations, BSA/AML, OFAC, sanctions, KYC, and fraud, delivering independent assurance outcomes for the business. 

- Support execution of compliance testing covering federal and state consumer protection regulations (e. g. , UDAAP, RESPA, TILA / Reg Z, Reg B, FCRA, FDPA, SCRA, SAFE Act, FDCPA, Dodd-Frank), as well as BSA/AML, OFAC, sanctions, KYC, and fraud-related testing
 - Execute targeted transaction testing per established test scripts; analyze transactional, qualitative, surveillance, onsite, and employee quality review samples
 - Document defects and observations during testing; collaborate with Compliance and Operational Risk officers and Front Line Unit (FLU) process owners to validate preliminary results
 - Maintain testing timelines, workpapers, and trackers; support QA reviews and rework remediation

Regulatory Reporting QA & Testing

Perform in-line Quality Assurance and independent testing of regulatory reports to validate data lineage, conformance with reporting instructions, accuracy, completeness, and the effectiveness of report-level controls. 

- Support execution of in-line Quality Assurance (QA) testing across US and global regulatory reports (e. g. , FR Y-9C, FR Y-15, FR 2052a, LCR, CCAR, PRA 110), including data profiling, completeness checks, and conformance reviews under supervision
 - Perform sample selection, evidence gathering, and trace transactions from source systems to final report line items to validate accuracy, completeness, and conformance with reporting instructions
 - Document test steps, source-to-report mapping, exceptions, and conclusions in approved workpaper templates with reviewer-ready quality
 - Assist in maintaining the QA test calendar, scoping documents, and intake artifacts; track testing status and update trackers for stakeholders
 - Escalate exceptions, data quality issues, and interpretive questions to the team lead in a timely manner

Risk & Control Self-Assessment (RCSA) and Post-Effectiveness Testing

Facilitate and execute risk and control self-assessments - identifying inherent risks, evaluating control effectiveness, rating residual risk, and tracking action plans - and perform post-effectiveness testing of key controls, in line with the Operational Risk Management Framework. 

- Support RCSA execution under supervision: assist with risk identification workshops, evidence gathering, and documentation of inherent risks, controls, residual risks, and action plans
 - Maintain the RCSA library/inventory in the GRC platform (e. g. , Archer, ServiceNow IRM, OpenPages); update risk and control records based on agreed changes
 - Support post-effectiveness testing of controls identified in the RCSA; document test steps, evidence, and conclusions
 - Prepare MI and dashboards summarizing RCSA results and remediation status for stakeholders

Issue Management & Remediation Validation

Validate the completeness and accuracy of issue remediation activities, perform root cause analysis, and assure the sustainability of corrective actions for self-identified, audit, and regulatory issues. 

- Support issue validation activities under supervision: review remediation artifacts for completeness and accuracy against documented remediation scope
 - Analyze documents and supporting artifacts to validate completion of remediation activities for self-identified issues, audit findings, and regulatory issues
 - Assist in compiling issue closure packages; document rationale, evidence reference, and validation conclusion in approved templates
 - Maintain issue trackers, status logs, and MI; coordinate evidence requests with issue owners and Issue Execution Officers

Regulatory Reporting

Alongside testing and validation work, support the preparation, review, and timely submission of financial and non-financial regulatory filings across Banking, Capital Markets, and Investment Management clients - including FFIEC Call Reports, FR Y-series filings, CCAR/DFAST, liquidity and capital reports (LCR, NSFR, FR 2052a), broker-dealer filings (FOCUS, FINRA), and Investment Management reports (Form PF, N-PORT, Form ADV) - with appropriate accuracy, completeness, and audit-ready documentation. 

- Support preparation of financial and non-financial regulatory filings across Banking (FFIEC Call Reports 031/041/051, FR Y-9C/9LP, FR Y-14, FR Y-15, FR 2052a), Capital Markets (FOCUS Report, FINRA filings, large trader reporting), and Investment Management (Form PF, N-PORT, N-CEN, Form ADV, CPO-PQR, 1940 Act and Private Funds, liquidity and derivatives reporting) clients, under the guidance of senior team members
 - Compile, validate, and reconcile data from source systems for filings to the FRB, OCC, FDIC, SEC, CFTC, FINRA, and other regulators; flag data quality issues, lineage gaps, and timing risks early
 - Maintain process documentation, SOPs, checklists, and audit trails for assigned filings; ensure version control and audit-ready evidence
 - Coordinate with technology teams on data sourcing, triage, and ad-hoc data requests across recurring and one-off reporting cycles
 - Escalate interpretive questions and data anomalies to reviewers in a timely manner; participate in knowledge sharing on regulatory instructions and taxonomy changes

Root Cause & Thematic Analysis, Testing MI, and KCI/KRI Reporting (across all components)

Analyze why exceptions occur, surface themes across testing results, and report results and remediation status to control owners, second-line risk and compliance functions, and internal audit. 

- Support root cause analysis on test exceptions and control failures by gathering evidence, documenting contributing factors, and escalating observations to reviewers
 - Prepare testing MI and dashboards (status, exceptions, remediation) in Excel or Power BI; maintain trackers and keep stakeholders updated on progress
 - Support compilation of KCI/KRI data and track remediation status for reporting to control owners, risk and compliance functions, and internal audit

Analytics-led & GenAI-enabled Testing (across all components)

- Use approved AI / Generative AI (GenAI) tools (Microsoft 365 Copilot, Claude, ChatGPT / Azure OpenAI, Deloitte-approved AI assistants) to accelerate evidence review, document summarization, and routine drafting tasks, in line with firm AI usage policies
 - Build basic prompt-writing skills for testing tasks such as drafting walkthrough narratives, summarizing policies, and exception write-ups
 - Use Excel (pivots, lookups, conditional formatting) and basic SQL / Power Query / Alteryx Designer to prepare data, run reconciliations, and support sample selection and population analysis for testing

Required skills: 

- 2-4 years of relevant experience in any of: regulatory reporting QA, conformance testing, controls testing, compliance testing, RCSA, issue management, internal audit, operational risk, or risk management in a BFSI, other regulated-industry, or consulting environment
 - Exposure to the end-to-end risk management lifecycle - Transactions, Conformance, Controls, Compliance, RCSA, and Issue Management - with willingness to build depth across multiple components within the Testing & Validation Utility
 - Working knowledge of internal control concepts (manual vs. automated, preventive vs. detective, IPE, SoD, sampling fundamentals)
 - Awareness of the COSO 2013 framework and the broader regulatory and compliance landscape applicable to the industries we serve, particularly Banking, Financial Services & Insurance (BFSI)
 - Advanced Microsoft Excel (pivots, lookups, conditional logic) and working knowledge of Word, PowerPoint, and Outlook
 - Working knowledge of, and willingness to use, AI / GenAI tools (Microsoft 365 Copilot, Claude, ChatGPT / Azure OpenAI, or equivalents) for productivity, summarization, and analysis tasks; awareness of responsible AI usage, data privacy, and confidentiality requirements
 - Basic SQL, Power Query, or willingness to learn at least one analytical / data-prep tool (Alteryx Designer, KNIME, or equivalent) for sample selection, reconciliations, and exception analysis
 - Strong analytical skills with high attention to detail and accuracy
 - Strong written and verbal communication skills, with ability to document observations and interact with stakeholders
 - Ability to work in a fast-paced environment, manage multiple priorities, and meet deadlines with high-quality standards

Preferred skills: 

- Exposure to BFSI products and processes (banking operations, payments, lending, capital markets, insurance, or investment compliance)
 - Awareness of SOX Section 404 and ITGC fundamentals
 - Exposure to regulatory reporting across Banking (FFIEC Call Reports, FR Y-9C, FR Y-15, FR 2052a, LCR, CCAR, PRA 110, FINREP/COREP), Capital Markets (FOCUS, FINRA filings), or Investment Management (Form PF, N-PORT, Form ADV), and/or consumer compliance regulations (UDAAP, RESPA, TILA, Reg B/Z, FCRA, BSA/AML)
 - Exposure to GRC platforms (Archer, ServiceNow GRC / IRM, MetricStream, OpenPages, Workiva)
 - Awareness of Continuous Controls Monitoring (CCM) and analytics-driven assurance
 - Awareness of Deloitte AI policies and Trustworthy AI; certifications such as Microsoft AI-900 are a plus
 - Pursuing or partially completed certifications such as CIA, CISA, CRMA, CFE, FRM, CAMS, or CPA

Qualification: 

- Bachelor's degree in Commerce, Finance, Business, Accounting, Engineering, or Computer Science, or similar 3-year graduate course
 - M. Com / MBA or similar post-graduate course (Tier 2/3 colleges) is a plus

Location: 

- Hyderabad / Bengaluru / Chennai
 - Professionals are required to work from the office all 5 days of the week. 
 - Based on engagement requirements, professionals will be required to work out of a secure clean room and/or an Offshore Delivery Center (ODC). 

Shift Timings: 

- Based on the engagement, professionals will work in one of the following shifts: 9: 00 AM - 6: 00 PM, 11: 00 AM - 8: 00 PM, or 2: 00 PM - 11: 00 PM. 
 - As part of your role at Deloitte and its related entities, you may be required to work in various shift timings to support client deliverables. This could also involve working beyond standard hours, including weekends, holidays and also from Offshore Delivery Centers (ODC) or Client Location. You may be assigned to projects on different technical platforms and skills, and work at designated locations as determined by the company. 

Our purpose

Deloitte's purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities. 

Our people and culture

Our inclusive culture empowers our people to be who they are, contribute their unique perspectives, and make a difference individually and collectively. It enables us to leverage different ways of thinking, ideas and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients' most complex challenges. This makes Deloitte one of the most rewarding places to work. 

Professional development

At Deloitte, professionals have the opportunity to work with some of the best and discover what works best for them. Here, we prioritize professional growth, offering diverse learning and networking opportunities to help accelerate careers and enhance leadership skills. Our state-of-the-art DU: The Leadership Center in India, located in Hyderabad, represents a tangible symbol of our commitment to the holistic growth and development of our people. Explore DU: The Leadership Center in India . 

Benefits To Help You Thrive

At Deloitte, we know that great people make a great organization. Our comprehensive rewards program helps us deliver a distinctly Deloitte experience that helps that empowers our professionals to thrive mentally, physically, and financially-and live their purpose. To support our professionals and their loved ones, we offer a broad range of benefits. Eligibility requirements may be based on role, tenure, type of employment and/ or other criteria. Learn more about what working at Deloitte can mean for you. 

Recruiting tips

From developing a stand out resume to putting your best foot forward in the interview, we want you to feel prepared and confident as you explore opportunities at Deloitte. Check out recruiting tips from Deloitte recruiters.

data.title: Platform Engineer - Internal Developer Platform
data.description:
Your Future Evolves Here

Evolent partners with health plans and providers to achieve better outcomes for people with most complex and costly health conditions. Working across specialties and primary care, we seek to connect the pieces of fragmented health care system and ensure people get the same level of care and compassion we would want for our loved ones. 

Evolent employees enjoy work/life balance, the flexibility to suit their work to their lives, and autonomy they need to get things done. We believe that people do their best work when they're supported to live their best lives, and when they feel welcome to bring their whole selves to work. That's one reason why diversity and inclusion are core to our business. 

Join Evolent for the mission. Stay for the culture. 

What You'll Be Doing: 

Why This Role Matters

Evolent is transforming how it builds and operates infrastructure under a refreshed Platform Engineering & Operations operating model, grounded in four principles: Architecture First, Automation by Default, Reliability is a Shared Responsibility and Golden Paths Over Custom Solutions. You will turn approved designs into provisioned, automated, and documented platforms, and you will do it transparently, through formal handoffs, Office Hours reviews, and documentation your peers can actually rely on. 

Agentic AI: Platform Engineering is moving toward agentic AI as a standard part of how the organization works. As agentic AI transforms the way we work, we expect our engineers to be at the forefront of that change, designing and building intelligent solutions rather than simply consuming them. This builder mentality is a core attribute we assess from the first conversation. 

What You'll Be Doing

- Provision and change infrastructure exclusively as code, so that every environment is reproducible, reviewable, and free of manual drift. 
 - Reverse engineer the applications and infrastructure you inherit: trace dependencies, integrations, and data flows end to end until you can explain how a system actually works. 
 - Design and build agentic AI solutions for platform, delivery, and operations work: identify the toil worth automating, then build, evaluate, and harden the agent that removes it. 
 - Build security and compliance into the delivery path: least-privilege access, secrets handling, policy-as-code guardrails, and audit evidence produced by design rather than assembled under deadline. 
 - Independently design, build, and ship platform features, self-service workflows, and APIs in TypeScript, JavaScript, React, C#, or Python, applying modularity, design patterns, and sound software design principles. 
 - Own your Git and GitHub workflow end to end-feature branches, meaningful commits, rebasing, and merge conflict resolution-and both author high-quality pull requests and review others' for correctness, readability, test coverage, and security. 
 - Design and document REST APIs, including contract and schema design, versioning, error semantics, and backward compatibility. 
 - Write unit and integration tests and build CI/CD pipelines as code (GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps), with automated build, test, static analysis, and dependency scanning. 

To ensure a secure hiring process we have implemented several identity verification steps, including submission of a government issued photo ID. data.title: Senior Engineering Manager
data.description:
About Delhivery

Delhivery is India's leading logistics and supply chain infrastructure company. We are a technology-first organization operating a massive physical network. Our proprietary platforms handle millions of shipments daily across 18, 000+ pin codes, generating vast volumes of multi-modal, spatial, operational, and conversational data. As we transition toward autonomous, self-healing supply chain workflows, this role will lead the engineering frontier that builds our central intelligence and agentic platforms. 

The Mandate: 

As an SEM, you will hold the architectural blueprint and operational authority for Delhivery's ecosystem. Your mandate is to design the core platform infrastructure, establish engineering standards, and govern the deployment of autonomous agentic systems across all product lines (including Warehouse Management, Transportation, Last-Mile, and Merchant Platforms). 

You will act as the central technical authority, driving the adoption of open standards to securely and uniformly connect AI models to Delhivery's enterprise data sources and operational tools. You will enable product teams to build safe, deterministic, and highly optimized AI systems while reviewing and greenlighting all agents before they launch into production. 

Core Responsibilities

- Establish Enterprise AI Standards: Own the definition of technical blueprints, design patterns, and SDKs for agentic workflows across the organization. Establish organization-wide standards for Agentic implementations, covering orchestration, context management, structured outputs, tool invocation, security, identity, observability, evaluation, lifecycle management, and interoperability. 
 - Centralized Architecture & Launch Review: Serve as the final technical gateway for all AI agent deployments at Delhivery. Design automated governance frameworks that validate architecture compliance, tool permissions, security boundaries, model behavior, latency budgets, cost efficiency, reliability, structured output correctness, evaluation quality, and operational readiness before any AI system reaches production. 
 - Architect Production-Grade Agentic Workflows: Design and deploy core multi-agent systems optimized for large-scale enterprise problems involving planning, reasoning, workflow orchestration, long-running execution, memory, human-in-the-loop approvals, asynchronous execution, and real-time decision making across warehouse, transportation, customer experience, and operational platforms
 - Build the Central AI Control Plane & Catalog: Architect Delhivery's shared AI infrastructure layer. Develop central enterprise capabilities for unified model routing, automated prompt drift detection, vector database multi-tenancy, and a centralized catalog that allows secure, audited discovery of enterprise data and services by autonomous agents
 - Lead a High-Caliber Engineering Team: Mentor and scale a specialized engineering squad focused on foundational AI platform development. Cultivate a unified AI engineering community across Delhivery by hosting architectural reviews and upskilling product engineers on production-grade systems design and MCP-driven architectures. 

Core Capabilities & Architectural Focus

This role is centered on building the underlying infrastructure, standardized protocols, and evaluation frameworks required to scale intelligent workflows safely: 

- Platform & Gateways: Designing resilient LLM gateways, automated model failover mechanisms, and enterprise-wide token optimization telemetry, inference optimization to deliver low-latency AI services. 
 - Evaluation & Deployment Pipelines: Building continuous integration frameworks that programmatically test, benchmark, and audit the safety, retrieval accuracy, prompt regressions, safety, hallucination rates, policy compliance, and tool-calling reliability of agents developed across different business units before production deployment. 
 - State & Orchestration: Engineering custom graph architectures or leveraging advanced state-management systems optimized for high-throughput, asynchronous tool execution. 

What We Are Looking For

- Proven Engineering & Governance Leadership: 8+ years of core software engineering experience, with a significant track record of architecting, deploying, and establishing engineering standards for high-scale distributed systems or building production AI systems involving LLMs, agentic workflows, orchestration frameworks, evaluation systems, retrieval architectures, or model serving platforms. 
 - Platform Architecture & Protocol Expertise: Demonstrated success in building developer platforms, shared infrastructure SDKs, or building systems leveraging open interoperability protocols (such as gRPC, GraphQL, or Model Context Protocol). 
 - Systems-First Pragmatism: A deep commitment to engineering metrics-focusing heavily on system latency, API validation, compute cost-efficiency, secure tool execution boundaries, and predictable, deterministic software behavior. 
 - Cross-Functional Influence: The ability to effectively collaborate with, advise, and align diverse product engineering heads and business stakeholders toward a unified technical vision.

Company Overview

GobbleCube is an agentic growth operating system designed to help brands scale profitably across digital marketplaces. Founded in November 2022 by the ex- core team of Blinkit, the platform went live commercially from private beta in September 2024. 

Since then, GobbleCube has scaled rapidly, supporting 600+ brands across enterprise and D2C, growing revenue 10X, and onboarding 45 of India's largest CPG enterprises in just the last 9 months, including HUL, Nivea, Tata Consumer Products, ITC, Godrej, Beiersdorf, MTR, L'Oréal, Hershey's, and many more. 

As commerce becomes more distributed and hyperlocal, GobbleCube is building agentic solutions to help brands navigate complexity in real time, across visibility, performance marketing, supply chain, and growth strategy. Headquartered in Gurugram, the company supports brands across India, MENA, and LATAM. 

About the Role

We are looking for a hands-on technical leader who can build production grade AI systems, design scalable backend architecture, and lead a team of 3 - 4 engineers. You will balance technical execution with people management, taking ownership of complex projects while helping the team deliver high-quality software faster using AI-native development practices. 

What You'll Do

- Lead the team: Manage day-to-day execution, prioritise work, conduct 1: 1s, provide feedback, mentor engineers, and support hiring and performance reviews. 
 - Build backend systems: Design and develop scalable APIs, asynchronous services, integrations, and distributed systems using Python, FastAPI, and related technologies.

data.title: Tech Lead
data.description:
WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world's leading brands. 

We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company - powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. 

We work with the world's most valuable brands and have global reach across 100+ markets, with deep local expertise. 

Our people are the key to our success. We're committed to fostering a culture of creativity, belonging and continuous learning, attracting and developing the brightest talent, and providing exciting career opportunities that help our people grow. 

For more information, visit WPP. com. 

Minimum qualifications: 

- Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience. 
 - 11 years of professional software development in TypeScript and Node. js or Python, including 5 years of architecture across multiple systems. 
 - 3 years of experience owning engineering standards adopted beyond your own team, and mentoring senior engineers. 
 - Experience working in globally distributed teams across time zones, with engineering, product and business stakeholders in other regions. 
 - Backend language and craft. You are an expert in TypeScript with Node. js or in Python, and a practitioner in the other. You set our backend and frontend coding patterns, framework choices and upgrade path, and you are a practitioner in at least two other crafts. 
 - React and frontend. You set our full-stack conventions across teams: where logic lives, how APIs serve user interfaces, and how shared components are built and maintained. 
 - APIs and data formats. You design REST APIs with OpenAPI from first principles: resource modelling, HTTP semantics, pagination, consistent error formats, versioning, idempotency and rate limiting. You know when to use JSON and when to use Protocol Buffers, and how to evolve both without breaking consumers. You set our API and serialisation standards and decide on exceptions. 
 - Data. You are fluent in PostgreSQL, including schema design, indexing, query plans, transactions and zero-downtime migrations with Prisma, TypeORM or SQLAlchemy. You design DynamoDB and MongoDB models around access patterns, use Redis for caching, and choose the right store for each workload. You own our data-architecture standards, including how datastores are introduced and retired. 
 - Asynchronous systems and reliability. You design event-driven systems on queues and streams such as SQS, Kafka and BullMQ or Celery, using retries, dead-letter queues and idempotent consumers so that at-least-once delivery is safe. You know the outbox and saga patterns and when orchestration is better than choreography. You own our reference architecture for reliability. 
 - Cloud and platform. You have built and run production services on AWS or GCP, both as Lambda functions and as Kubernetes workloads, and you understand the trade-offs between them: cold starts, concurrency, cost, capacity and deployment risk. You define infrastructure as code with Terraform or AWS CDK and release safely with canary and blue/green deployments. With Platform Engineering, you decide when we use serverless and when we use Kubernetes, and you set the reference architectures for both. 
 - Testing and quality. You practise test-driven development and expect every team to do the same. You build balanced test suites: unit tests with Jest, Vitest or pytest, integration tests with Testcontainers, contract tests with Pact, and Playwright end-to-end tests that gate releases. You set our quality standard and approve any exceptions to it. 
 - Observability and performance. You instrument services with OpenTelemetry and use Datadog and CloudWatch to find problems before users do. You profile with flame graphs, measure p95 and p99 latency, and fix causes rather than symptoms. You set our standards for SLOs, dashboards, alerting and performance budgets, and you lead the hardest incidents to their root cause. 
 - Security and identity. You write secure code by default and apply the OWASP Top 10 and API Security Top 10 in practice. You design authentication and authorisation with OAuth 2. 0 and OIDC, secure service-to-service traffic with mTLS and workload identity, and integrate identity providers such as Okta, Keycloak and Cognito. You set our identity and security standards and own security reviews with the Security team
 - Architecture and design. You design systems that span many services and teams, and you write architecture decision records that make the trade-offs explicit. You own our technical roadmap and style guide, act as the arbiter on standards, and decide on evidence rather than authority. You are able to trace many symptoms back to a single root cause and fix it once. 
 - Engineering practices. You work trunk-based with GitHub Flow, small changes and feature flags, and you know CI/CD pipelines inside out. You have led deprecations and migrations all the way to switching the old system off. You set our Git, CI/CD and dependency policies, and you make large-scale change routine rather than exceptional. 
 - AI-first engineering and LLMs. You use Claude Code every day and understand how large language models work: tokens, context windows, cost, structured output, embeddings and retrieval. You have built production features with the Anthropic and OpenAI SDKs, including tool calling and evaluations, and designed agentic services with clear guardrails and human review. You set our AI-first operating model, covering approved models and frameworks, Claude Code conventions, evaluation and release gates, and governance. 
 - Communication, collaboration and initiative. You communicate clearly and concisely in writing and in conversation, and you adapt your message for engineers, product leaders and executives. You understand complex problems quickly, ask the right questions and confirm shared understanding before acting. You collaborate well across locations and cultures, working asynchronously and handing over cleanly between time zones. You are proactive: you spot problems and opportunities before you are asked, propose solutions and innovations of your own, and drive them through without waiting for instructions. 
 - Leadership and behaviours. You lead without authority and influence engineering heads and teams across the organisation. You define the hiring bar for each level, calibrate interviewers and give Talent Acquisition clear screening criteria. You mentor senior engineers into technical leaders, build an engineering practice that does not depend on you, and hold the bar under commercial pressure. You say "I don't know" when you don't, and you dig in until you do. 

Preferred qualifications: 

- B. Tech or B. E. in Computer Science, Information Technology or a related field. 
 - Experience maintaining a widely used open-source library. 
 - Experience with multi-region and disaster-recovery architecture. 
 - Experience mapping engineering controls to SOC 2 or ISO 27001. 
 - Experience with multi-agent systems and agentic frameworks such as LangGraph, Google ADK or the Anthropic Agent SDK. 
 - Experience running an engineering-productivity measurement programme. 
 - Experience in the second backend language. 

About the job: 

WPP Open is WPP's AI-enabled marketing operating system, used by brands and agencies around the world. Our engineering teams in India build and run it alongside colleagues in the UK and Europe. As a Principal Engineer you own architecture and engineering standards for full-stack engineering across teams. You stay hands-on and set the bar for hiring. The role is backend-heavy, and you also build the React interfaces for the features you deliver. Our interviews are practical and hands-on. 

Responsibilities: 

- Own the architecture of TypeScript and Node. js or Python systems across multiple teams, and set the technical roadmap that takes them from where they are today to where the platform needs to be. 
 - Stay hands-on: write, review and ship production code, lead by example on test-driven development, profiling and AI-first delivery, and take on the hardest technical problems yourself. 
 - Set and maintain our engineering standards for API design, data, reliability, security, observability and testing; publish them as a style guide and reference architectures, certify teams against them, and decide on exceptions. 
 - Review designs and architecture decision records across teams, challenge assumptions, and make sure decisions are made on evidence and recorded with their trade-offs. 
 - Decide, with Platform Engineering, how we use AWS Lambda and Kubernetes, and own the cost, capacity and reliability consequences of those choices. 
 - Lead the response to the most serious production incidents and performance problems, find the root cause and make sure it does not happen again. 
 - Drive large-scale change such as migrations, framework upgrades and deprecations across many codebases through to completion, including switching off what has been replaced. 
 - Define how we build with AI: the models, SDKs and agentic frameworks we use, how Claude Code is used day to day, and how AI-written code and AI features are evaluated and released. 
 - Work with product, engineering and business leaders in other regions to shape what we build, turn business goals into technical plans, and make trade-offs visible. 
 - Set the hiring bar for full-stack engineers at every level, write interview material, calibrate interviewers and give recruiters clear screening criteria. 
 - Mentor senior engineers, grow the next generation of technical leaders, and build a community of practice through reviews, talks and knowledge sharing. 

Who you are: 

You're open: We are inclusive and collaborative; we encourage the free exchange of ideas; we respect and celebrate diverse views. We are open-minded: to new ideas, new partnerships, new ways of working. 

You're optimistic: We believe in the power of creativity, technology and talent to create brighter futures or our people, our clients and our communities. We approach all that we do with conviction: to try the new and to seek the unexpected. 

You're extraordinary: we are stronger together: through collaboration we achieve the amazing. We are creative leaders and pioneers of our industry; we provide extraordinary every day. 

What we'll give you: 

Passionate, inspired people - We aim to create a culture in which people can do extraordinary work. 

Scale and opportunity - We offer the opportunity to create, influence and complete projects at a scale that is unparalleled in the industry. 

Challenging and stimulating work - Unique work and the opportunity to join a group of creative problem solvers. Are you up for the challenge. 

We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we've adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process. 

WPP is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to particular characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers. 

Please read our Privacy Notice (https: //www. wpp. com/en/careers/wpp-privacy-policy-for-recruitment) for more information on how we process the information you provide.

data.title: Principal Engineer – AI Security Developer
data.description:
Overview

Connecting clients to markets - and talent to opportunity. 

With 5, 400+ employees and over 80, 000 institutional, commercial, and payments clients, we operate from more than 80 offices spread across six continents. As a Fortune 100, Nasdaq-listed provider, we connect clients to the global markets - focusing on innovation, human connection, and providing world-class products and services to all types of investors. 

Whether you want to forge a career connecting our retail clients to potential trading opportunities, or ingrain yourself in the world of institutional investing, StoneX Group is made up of four business segments that offer endless potential for progression and growth. 

Business Segment Overview

Corporate: Engage in a deep variety of business-critical activities that keep our company running efficiently. From strategic marketing and financial management to human resources and operational oversight, you'll have the opportunity to optimize processes and implement game-changing policies. 

Position Purpose: At StoneX, defending a global financial services organization increasingly means building capabilities ourselves rather than waiting for the market to provide them. As a Principal Engineer - AI Security Developer , you'll serve as the senior technical authority for how StoneX applies AI to cybersecurity, setting the technical vision, architecture, and engineering standards for our AI security platform while personally building the hardest and highest-leverage parts of it. 

Your mission is to define how AI becomes a secure, scalable, and trusted capability across the security organization. You'll establish the reference architecture for GenAI applications, AI agents, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) platforms, advanced analytics, shared services, and the guardrails and engineering patterns that allow multiple teams to build consistently and safely. 

This is a senior individual contributor role with enterprise-wide influence, not a role removed from the technology. You'll remain a hands-on engineer while shaping technical direction across multiple security and engineering teams. You'll make the difficult architectural decisions, build shared platform capabilities, prototype new approaches , solve the hardest technical problems, and raise the engineering bar for how AI capabilities are designed and delivered across StoneX. 

From Day 1 , you'll begin shaping the technical direction of StoneX's AI security capabilities while getting hands-on with the platform and the problems our teams are trying to solve. You'll work across security, engineering, infrastructure, data, risk, and other partners to identify where AI creates meaningful value, establish the architecture and standards teams can build upon, and help turn that direction into trusted production capabilities at scale. 

Responsibilities

Primary duties will include: 

- AI Security Strategy: Define and own the multi-year technical strategy and roadmap for AI-powered security capabilities, translating business and risk priorities into a sequenced engineering direction. 
 - Reference Architecture: Design and govern the target architecture for StoneX's AI security platform, including LLM services and orchestration, agent frameworks, RAG and knowledge pipelines, evaluation infrastructure, data access patterns, and integrations across the security environment. 
 - Platform Engineering: Architect and build shared platform capabilities including secure LLM services, agent runtimes, tool and connector frameworks, retrieval services, prompt and model management, and observability that allow teams to deliver AI solutions quickly, consistently, and securely. 
 - Hands-On Engineering: Remain deeply technical by personally designing and building complex and critical components, prototyping new approaches , and helping teams solve difficult engineering problems across the full stack. 
 - Technical Decision-Making: Lead evaluation of models, frameworks, vendors, and open-source technologies and make recommendations based on security, performance, cost, maintainability, and long-term strategic value. 
 - Portfolio Prioritization: Partner with security leadership to identify , size, and prioritize high-impact AI opportunities across detection, response, vulnerability management, identity, cloud, application security, and other security domains while challenging work that does not demonstrate meaningful value. 
 - Secure Integration: Establish patterns for integrating AI services and agentic workflows with security technologies including source-code repositories, threat models, cloud platforms, SIEM, SOAR, IAM, CMDB, and vulnerability management systems while enforcing appropriate least privilege, auditability, and human oversight. 
 - Production Excellence: Establish expectations for reliability, scalability, latency, monitoring, operational readiness, and cost management across production AI workloads. 
 - AI Security & Assurance: Serve as a technical authority on securing AI systems against prompt injection, data leakage, model and supply-chain risk, agent tool misuse, adversarial manipulation, and other emerging threats. 
 - Evaluation & Quality: Establish how StoneX evaluates LLM and agent performance through benchmark datasets, automated evaluation pipelines, red teaming, regression testing, and measures of accuracy, hallucination, reliability, and analyst trust. 
 - Responsible AI: Partner with Risk, Compliance, Legal, Data Governance, and Architecture to ensure AI capabilities meet regulatory, model risk management, privacy, and data residency expectations. 
 - Engineering Standards: Set and champion standards for AI engineering, including architecture, code quality, design review, testing, CI/CD, documentation, and production readiness. 
 - Technical Leadership: Influence technical direction across security, infrastructure, data, and application engineering teams, building consensus and resolving complex cross-team technical challenges without relying on direct authority. 
 - Developing Engineers: Mentor senior and staff-level engineers, strengthen AI engineering capability across the security organization, and help shape technical hiring standards and career development. 
 - Executive Advisory: Serve as a trusted technical advisor to the CISO, security leadership, and executive stakeholders by clearly communicating technical strategy, trade-offs, risks, and measurable outcomes. 
 - Industry Leadership: Represent StoneX within the broader security and AI community through industry engagement, working groups, conferences, publications, or open-source contributions and bring relevant external thinking back into the organization. 

A typical week might include the following: 

- Spending at least four days in the office engaging directly with engineers, security teams, architects, and other stakeholders. 
 - Designing and building critical components of StoneX's AI security platform, particularly where the technical complexity or organizational leverage is highest. 
 - Working with security leadership and engineering teams to identify and prioritize AI use cases based on measurable security value, feasibility, and strategic importance. 
 - Leading architecture and design reviews for AI capabilities that span teams, security domains, or enterprise technologies. 
 - Evaluating emerging models, agent frameworks, development approaches, vendors, and open-source technologies against StoneX's security, performance, cost, and maintainability requirements. 
 - Prototyping new AI capabilities to validate difficult technical concepts before establishing reusable patterns that other engineers can build upon. 
 - Working with engineering teams to solve difficult integration, architecture, scalability, reliability, or security challenges. 
 - Reviewing production AI performance, evaluations, model behavior, observability, reliability, and cost to identify opportunities for improvement. 
 - Threat modeling AI systems and ensuring appropriate protections exist around data access, agent actions, tool execution, model behavior, and other AI-specific risks. 
 - Mentoring engineers through architecture discussions, design reviews, code reviews, and complex technical challenges. 
 - Advising security and executive leadership on AI strategy, technical trade-offs, emerging risks, and the practical implications of changes in AI technology. 

This job might be for you if: 

- You're a technical leader who still builds - you enjoy setting architecture and direction, but you still want to write production code and personally tackle the problems where your involvement creates the greatest leverage. 
 - You think beyond individual applications - you naturally look for the shared platforms, patterns, services, and standards that allow many teams to build better and faster. 
 - You're practical about AI - you can separate meaningful technological change from hype and focus teams on where AI can produce measurable security outcomes. 
 - You're comfortable making hard technical decisions - you can evaluate competing technologies and approaches, make a recommendation, explain the trade-offs, and stand behind the decision. 
 - You're security-minded by design - you treat AI as both a defensive capability and an attack surface and consider adversarial behavior from the beginning. 
 - You're a multiplier - you want the engineers and teams around you to become stronger because of the architecture, standards, mentorship, and technical guidance you provide. 
 - You lead through influence - you can establish technical direction and build alignment across teams and stakeholders even when they don't report to you. 
 - You're willing to challenge the premise - if a use case is vague, a vendor claim doesn't hold up, or AI isn't the right solution, you'll say so and redirect attention toward measurable value. 
 - You're continuously learning - you follow AI and security research closely, evaluate emerging technologies critically, and bring back what can genuinely improve StoneX's capabilities. 
 - You're a versatile communicator - you can explain complex AI concepts and strategic trade-offs to executive audiences while still being able to go deeply technical with engineers and researchers. 

Qualifications

To land this role you will need: 

- 12+ years of hands-on software engineering experience building and operating production systems, including 5+ years focused on AI/ML, security engineering, or bot h, with experience across tools and frameworks such as DSPy , LiteLLM , Datadog, and Azure. 
 - Proven experience operating as a Principal, Staff, or equivalent senior technical leader with responsibility for architecture and technical direction spanning multiple teams or an organization. 
 - Demonstrated experience architecting, deploying, and operating GenAI applications, RAG solutions, or AI agents in production at scale, including evaluation, monitoring, and cost management. 
 - Deep expertise with large language models, prompt and context engineering, embeddings and vector databases, agent frameworks and tool orchestration, and model evaluation techniques. 
 - Expert proficiency in Python and strong experience with at least one additional production language such as TypeScript/JavaScript, Go, Java, or C#. 
 - Full-stack technical credibility spanning back-end services and APIs, front-end interfaces, integrations, and data pipelines. 
 - Strong knowledge of distributed systems and cloud-native architecture across AWS, Azure, or GCP, including experience scaling and containerizing workloads in Azure, and infrastructure as code. 
 - Deep understanding of cybersecurity principles, technologies, and workflows including SIEM, SOAR, vulnerability management, IAM, cloud security, and application security. 
 - Strong working knowledge of AI-specific security risks and relevant frameworks such as the OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications, MITRE ATT&CK, and NIST AI Risk Management Framework. 
 - Demonstrated ability to influence senior technical stakeholders and executives and drive technical change across organizational boundaries. 
 - Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to communicate technical strategy, architecture, trade-offs, and risk across both deeply technical and executive audiences. 

What makes you stand out: 

- Experience within financial services or another highly regulated industry. 
 - Experience with model risk management, responsible AI, AI governance, or similar regulatory and governance requirements. 
 - Industry contributions such as publications, conference presentations, patents, standards participation, or open-source leadership. 
 - Bachelor's or M aster's degree in Computer Science , Cybersecurity, Engineering, or a related field. Equivalent practical experience and non-traditional paths are welcomed. 

Working environment: 

- 4 days' work from office.

data.title: Principal AI/ML Engineer
data.description:
Optum is a global organization that delivers care, aided by technology to help millions of people live healthier lives. The work you do with our team will directly improve health outcomes by connecting people with the care, pharmacy benefits, data and resources they need to feel their best. Here, you will find a culture guided by inclusion, talented peers, comprehensive benefits and career development opportunities. Come make an impact on the communities we serve as you help us advance health optimization on a global scale. Join us to start Caring. Connecting. Growing together. 

Primary Responsibilities

- Design, code, test, debug, document and maintain the services that make up the AI platform and agent runtime, taking systems from design review through production operation and long-term support
 - Design the public surface of the platform - APIs, SDKs, client libraries, schemas and versioning strategy - so that internal teams, client engineering teams and external builders can integrate without bespoke work for each consumer
 - Build the Capability Gateway: implement Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers and tool interfaces with typed contracts, authentication and authorization, input and output validation, quota and rate limiting, audit logging, and an automated conformance test suite that new capabilities must pass
 - Build and operate the agent harness and runtime: orchestration and tool-calling execution, state and session management, retrieval paths, concurrency, queuing and retries, timeout and failure handling, idempotency, and graceful degradation under partial outage
 - Establish engineering standards, methods and tooling for the portfolio: coding standards, code review practice, branching and release strategy, CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure as code, environment management, and automated testing at unit, contract, integration and end-to-end levels
 - Engineer the platform for cost and scale, including inference routing across models, caching, batching, connection and resource pooling, capacity planning, and per-tenant cost telemetry that ties spend to completed work
 - Code and deploy the ML and LLM components of the platform into production: model and prompt serving, retrieval and embedding pipelines, adapters and fine-tuned variants, and the deployment mechanics behind them including canary, shadow and rollback paths
 - Implement AI/ML capabilities in support of healthcare workflows, which may include natural language processing and understanding, semantic search, intent classification, information extraction, document AI and computer vision, and automatic speech recognition applied to clinical notes, claims, faxes, referrals, prior authorizations and recorded encounters
 - Build the evaluation and experimentation infrastructure the platform depends on: golden datasets, task-level benchmarks, offline and online evals, human-in-the-loop review workflows, regression gates wired into CI, and experiment tooling with defensible statistical treatment of results
 - Work with large-scale computing frameworks and data analysis systems to build the data foundation behind agent capabilities, including distributed processing, feature and vector stores, streaming ingestion, schema evolution and lineage Engineer for PHI from the first commit: data minimization and de-identification, tenant isolation, encryption in transit and at rest, secrets management, retention and access controls, and enforcement that keeps agent behavior inside approved data and action boundaries
 - Evaluate new tools, techniques and strategies - models, frameworks, orchestration approaches, serving stacks - with enough rigor to make a build, buy or adopt recommendation, and communicate the results and trade-offs to leadership and internal stakeholders
 - Partner across Platform Enablement, product management, design, security, privacy and legal, forward-deployed engineering, operations and external partners such as Azure and Databricks on one integrated backlog with explicit interfaces and SLOs
 - Raise the engineering bar through reference implementations, reusable libraries, design review participation, code review and technical mentorship, and influence thought and leadership on where the platform should go next
 - Comply with all applicable Company policies, procedures, and business directives, changes including those relating to work location, team assignments, work schedules, and flexible work arrangements

You'll be rewarded and recognized for your performance in an environment that will challenge you and give you clear direction on what it takes to succeed in your role as well as provide development for other roles you may be interested in. 

Required Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering or a related technical field, or equivalent experience
 - 10+ years of professional software engineering experience building and operating production systems
 - 5+ years of experience designing distributed services and platform-level APIs consumed by other engineering teams
 - Hands-on experience with LLM-based or agentic systems, including retrieval-augmented generation, tool and function calling, and orchestration
 - Expert-level proficiency in Python and at least one additional production language such as Java, TypeScript, Scala or C++
 - Demonstrated depth in software engineering fundamentals: testing strategy, debugging complex production issues, performance profiling, code review and technical documentation
 - Experience with cloud-native delivery, including containers and Kubernetes, CI/CD, infrastructure as code, and observability tooling
 - Experience with large-scale computing frameworks and distributed data processing such as Spark/Databricks, Ray, Kafka or equivalent
 - Experience building software subject to security, privacy or regulatory constraints
 - Demonstrated ability to explain complex technical results and trade-offs clearly to non-technical stakeholders and senior leaders

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience building multi-tenant platforms or services, including tenant isolation, quota and entitlement enforcement, and developer experience as an explicit product concern
 - Experience implementing or operating Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers, tool-calling standards, or agent frameworks such as LangGraph or equivalent
 - Experience with vector databases, embedding lifecycle management, hybrid retrieval and enterprise knowledge graphs
 - Experience with inference cost management or FinOps for AI workloads
 - Experience with responsible AI practice, including bias and fairness evaluation, model risk management, model documentation, or alignment to frameworks such as the NIST AI Risk Management Framework
 - Experience on a 0-to-1 product or platform, working directly with design partners or customers to shape what gets built
 - Experience with Azure AI services and Databricks in a regulated enterprise environment
 - Health care industry experience including provider, payer, medical device, pharmaceutical, or other health services a plus

At UnitedHealth Group, our mission is to help people live healthier lives and make the health system work better for everyone. We believe everyone - of every race, gender, sexuality, age, location and income - deserves the opportunity to live their healthiest life. Today, however, there are still far too many barriers to good health which are disproportionately experienced by people of color, historically marginalized groups and those with lower incomes. We are committed to mitigating our impact on the environment and enabling and delivering equitable care that addresses health disparities and improves health outcomes - an enterprise priority reflected in our mission.

 - Node scaling
 - Networking troubleshooting

 - Storage & ingress debugging

 - Implement AIOps-driven alert correlation, noise reduction, anomaly detection, and predictive analytics. 
 - Build automated remediation workflows and self-healing systems. 
 - Drive MTTR reduction through automation-first operations. 
 - Security Operations & DevSecOps

 - Implement DevSecOps automation for vulnerability scanning, compliance checks, and policy enforcement.

- Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA)

 - Azure DevOps Engineer Expert

Cloud & Platform
