Observability & AIOps

- Dynatrace, Datadog, Prometheus, Grafana, Splunk, ELK
 - Event correlation, anomaly detection, predictive analytics
 - AIOps platforms & auto-remediation frameworks

Security & Compliance

- IAM, secrets management, PKI & certificates
 - CSPM: Prisma Cloud, Wiz, Defender
 - Security incident response
 - Vulnerability scanning & remediation

Scripting & Automation

- Python, Bash, PowerShell, Go (any two)

SRE & Operational Excellence Skills

- SLIs, SLOs, SLAs

 - Performance engineering

Behavioral & Leadership Skills

- Strong problem-solving mindset

Corporate Security Responsibility

All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:

What You'll Bring To The Team

 - Strong skills in a backend language such as C# (. NET) or Java, and a willingness to learn new ones. 
 - A builder's mindset and a bias for action: you take initiative, turn ideas into working software quickly, and stay comfortable with ambiguity.

 - Familiarity with GraphQL or data mesh architectures. 
 - Understanding of LLMs and the AI powered API automation. 
 - Familiarity with observability tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, or Azure Monitor. 

Maybe you don't tick all the boxes above-but still think you'd be great for the job? Go ahead, apply anyway. Please. Because we know that experience comes in all shapes and sizes-and passion can't be learned.

data.title: Software Engineer
data.description:
To make electronics, you need chips, wafers, transistors, reticles, and. . . To make these, you must see, test and manufacture them at scale-faster and better than ever before. That's where KLA comes in. Whether you're early in your career or an experienced professional, you'll solve complex challenges, work alongside brilliant minds and help shape the future of technology. 

Group/Division

The Semiconductor Products and Customers (Semi PC) business unit designs, builds and sells KLA's product portfolio to help chip manufacturers meet high-quality standards for technologies like AI, data centers, automotive and electronic devices. Our inspection, metrology, and analytics systems detect and monitor defects across logic and memory chips, specialty semiconductors, wafers, reticles, advanced packaging, process equipment and materials. We also develop technologies for specialty processes, IC substrates, and PCB manufacturing, including etch and deposition, component inspection, and imaging and analytics. The LS-SWIFT division delivers high-throughput patterned wafer inspection systems that support advanced semiconductor manufacturing. Its mission is to provide industry-leading defect detection with optimal cost of ownership across a wide range of applications. LS systems enable precise, cost-effective inspection for cutting-edge process nodes, while SWIFT systems offer comprehensive macro inspection of all wafer surfaces-capabilities that are especially critical for advanced packaging, as well as logic, memory, and automotive applications. 

What You'll Do

In this role, you will play a key part in advancing business priorities by delivering high-impact work across your area of expertise. 

Company Overview

KLA is a global leader in diversified electronics for the semiconductor manufacturing ecosystem. Virtually every electronic device in the world is produced using our technologies. No laptop, smartphone, wearable device, voice-controlled gadget, flexible screen, VR device or smart car would have made it into your hands without us. KLA invents systems and solutions for the manufacturing of wafers and reticles, integrated circuits, packaging, printed circuit boards and flat panel displays. The innovative ideas and devices that are advancing humanity all begin with inspiration, research and development. KLA focuses more than average on innovation and we invest 15% of sales back into R&D. Our expert teams of physicists, engineers, data scientists and problem-solvers work together with the world's leading technology providers to accelerate the delivery of tomorrow's electronic devices. Life here is exciting and our teams thrive on tackling really hard problems. There is never a dull moment with us. 

Group/Division

With over 40 years of semiconductor process control experience, chipmakers around the globe rely on KLA to ensure that their fabs ramp next-generation devices to volume production quickly and cost-effectively. Enabling the movement towards advanced chip design, KLA's Global Products Group (GPG), which is responsible for creating all of KLA's metrology and inspection products, is looking for the best and the brightest research scientist, software engineers, application development engineers, and senior product technology process engineers. The LS-SWIFT Division of KLA's Global Products Group provides patterned wafer inspection systems for high-volume semiconductor manufacturing. Its mission is to deliver market-leading cost of ownership in defect detection for a broad range of applications in the production of semiconductors. Customers from the foundry, logic, memory, automotive, MEMS, advanced packaging and other markets rely upon high-sample wafer inspection information generated by LS-SWIFT products. LS (Laser Scanning) systems enable cost-effective patterned wafer defect detection for the industry's most sophisticated process technologies deployed in leading-edge foundry, logic, DRAM, and NAND fabs. SWIFT (Simultaneous Wafer Inspection at Fast Throughput) systems deliver all-wafer-surface (frontside, backside, and edge) macro inspection that is critical for automotive IC, MEMS, and advanced packaging processes as well as foundry/logic and memory fabs. LS-SWIFT operates from a global footprint that includes the US, Singapore, India and Germany, and serves a worldwide customer base across Asia, Europe and North America. 

Responsibilities

Job Description/Preferred Qualifications

Responsible for software development activities using C# / Angular/ C++ Good debugging skills using C#/Angular/ C++ Acquire and demonstrate technical knowledge of inspector software Participate in end to end product development lifecycle activities Acquire knowledge of key use cases in defect inspection using LS&SWIFT tools Collaborate with teams across different geographical zones to develop / deliver software solutions Being flexible with work timings, attending to technical discussions with business team/peer teams across the globe Work with team leads and groups including systems/hardware, marketing, applications and manufacturing on all aspects of software project including requirement definition, design, development, deployment, support and service Understand and apply software development best practices Travel to other KLA sites and customer sites on a needed basis

Qualifications

- Studied BE/BTech with 2+ yrs of exp (OR) MS/MCA/MTech 
 - Strong in programming fundamentals, . NET and C#/C++/Angular with good software design exposure. Design skills is a plus. 
 - Good analytical and problem-solving abilities
 - Thorough knowledge of SDLC and software engineering
 - Strong verbal and written communication and team-work skills
 - Ability to develop Software with Clean Code and SOLID principles

Minimum Qualifications

Master's Level Degree

Bachelor's Level Degree and related work experience of 2+years

Minimum Qualifications

Master's Level Degree or work experience of 0 years , Bachelor's Level Degree or work experience of 1 years

About KLA

We provide advanced inspection tools, metrology systems, process solutions, and computational analytics that make electronics possible, tackling complex challenges. From electron and photon optics to machine learning and data analytics, we seek perfection at the most fundamental level of matter in the universe. If you want to make electronics that push industries forward and make the world a better place, join us. 

Use of AI Statement

At KLA, our interviews seek to understand your individual skills, problem-solving approach and authentic thinking. To ensure a fair and consistent evaluation, the use of AI, recording tools or other technologies to generate, suggest or provide responses during interviews-whether virtual or in person-is not permitted unless explicitly approved in advance as part of a reasonable accommodation or invited by the interviewer. Use of these tools may interfere with our ability to evaluate your individual qualifications and affect your candidacy. KLA is committed to advancing innovation through responsible AI, and we value candidates who share this mindset. 

We offer a competitive, family friendly total rewards package. We design our programs to reflect our commitment to an inclusive environment, while ensuring we provide benefits that meet the diverse needs of our employees. 

KLA is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.

data.title: Senior Staff Digital Methodology Engineer - Design for Testability (DFT)
data.description:
We Are

Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI-powered products. We deliver industry-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow. 

You Are

You have spent over a decade architecting test solutions for chips that power everything from autonomous vehicles to data centers, and you understand that DFT is not an afterthought, it is the difference between a design that ships on time and one that bleeds money in yield loss. You know the nuances of scan compression versus hierarchical DFT, not from a textbook, but from making the call on a 10-billion-gate SoC where the wrong decision costs months. 

You are the person design teams call when ATPG coverage is stuck at 97% and manufacturing is demanding 99. 5%. You have debugged IJTAG networks that span multiple chiplets, written the Tcl that automated what used to take three engineers a week, and sat in rooms with VPs explaining why their test access strategy needs to change before tapeout. You do not just know the IEEE standards, you have deployed them in production silicon and lived with the consequences. 

At Synopsys, you will work on methodologies that define how the world's most complex chips get tested. The problems are hard, the customers are sophisticated, and what you build will matter. 

What You'll Be Doing

- Define and drive DFT methodologies for next-generation ASIC and SoC designs across strategic customer programs, translating architecture decisions into deployable best practices
 - Lead deployment of advanced test solutions including scan compression, hierarchical DFT, IEEE 1500 wrappers, IJTAG instrumentation networks, and embedded test IP across multi-billion-gate designs
 - Architect scalable test access infrastructures using IEEE 1149. 1, IEEE 1149. 6, IEEE 1687, and IEEE 1500 standards for complex multi-die and chiplet-based systems
 - Develop automation frameworks, signoff criteria, and reusable methodology packages using Tcl, Python, and Perl that accelerate adoption across business units
 - Serve as technical leader and subject matter expert for Synopsys TestMAX DFT, TestMAX ATPG, diagnosis, and silicon lifecycle solutions in customer engagements and internal escalations
 - Collaborate directly with R&D teams to influence TestMAX product roadmap based on real deployment challenges and customer requirements
 - Provide technical leadership for strategic customer engagements, methodology reviews, and complex DFT architecture decisions that impact tapeout schedules and silicon success

The Impact You Will Have

- Enable successful deployment of industry-leading DFT methodologies across the world's most advanced semiconductor programs in AI, automotive, and hyperscale computing
 - Drive measurable improvements in test coverage, pattern count reduction, and manufacturing yield through methodology standardization and best-practice development
 - Influence next-generation TestMAX capabilities by translating customer deployment challenges into product requirements that shape future releases
 - Accelerate adoption of standards-based test architectures across strategic accounts, reducing time-to-market and improving silicon reliability
 - Improve engineering productivity across multiple programs through automation frameworks and reusable methodology packages that eliminate redundant work
 - Establish Synopsys as the trusted technical advisor in DFT and manufacturing test, strengthening customer relationships and competitive positioning
 - Contribute to breakthrough technologies powering autonomous vehicles, AI accelerators, and next-generation networking infrastructure

What You'll Need

- Bachelor's or Master's in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related field
 - 10+ years in semiconductor or EDA industry with at least 5 years focused on DFT architecture, ATPG, and manufacturing test methodologies
 - Demonstrated expertise architecting and implementing DFT solutions for large-scale ASIC and SoC designs, including successful tapeouts
 - Hands-on experience with Synopsys TestMAX DFT and TestMAX ATPG solutions in production design environments
 - Deep technical knowledge of scan insertion, scan compression, hierarchical DFT, ATPG and diagnosis, stuck-at/transition/path-delay/bridge/cell-aware fault models, and coverage optimization techniques
 - Expertise deploying IEEE 1149. 1 (JTAG), IEEE 1149. 6 (AC JTAG), IEEE 1687 (IJTAG), and IEEE 1500 standards in complex test access architectures
 - Experience integrating DFT IP including Codec/embedded compression, OCC, LBIST, TAP controllers, JTAG and IJTAG infrastructure, TDR networks, and IEEE 1500 wrappers
 - Strong understanding of RTL-to-GDSII flows and how DFT interacts with synthesis, physical design, timing closure, and signoff
 - Proficiency with Tcl, Python, Perl, or Shell scripting for methodology automation and deployment
 - Experience defining enterprise-wide DFT standards and signoff methodologies is a strong plus
 - Background supporting advanced-node ASICs, multi-billion-gate SoCs, silicon bring-up, diagnosis, or yield improvement is highly valued
 - Knowledge of functional safety standards and automotive test requirements is a plus
 - Contributions to industry test standards, technical publications, patents, or conference presentations strengthen your candidacy

Who You Are

- You can walk into a room with a customer's design team, diagnose a coverage gap in their hierarchical DFT strategy, and sketch a solution on the whiteboard that they trust enough to implement before tapeout
 - You mentor engineers not by telling them what to do, but by asking the questions that help them see the tradeoff they missed between test time and pattern count
 - You are comfortable presenting a methodology roadmap to a VP in two slides and then diving three levels deep with an engineer debugging an IJTAG network the same afternoon
 - You push back when a proposed DFT architecture does not align with manufacturing realities, and you do it in a way that builds trust rather than friction
 - You treat automation as a first-class deliverable, not an afterthought, because you know the methodology only scales if the Tcl actually works
 - You stay current with industry trends, standards evolution, and emerging test challenges because you know that what worked on 7nm will not necessarily work on 3nm

The Team You'll Be Part Of

You will join the Digital Methodology Center of Excellence, a highly visible organization responsible for defining and advancing Synopsys' DFT methodologies, best practices, and customer deployment strategies. Working closely with R&D, product engineering, customer success, and strategic accounts, you will help shape the future of Design-for-Test and drive successful adoption of the industry's most advanced test solutions worldwide. 

Rewards and Benefits

We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. Our total rewards include both monetary and non-monetary offerings. Your recruiter will provide more details about the salary range and benefits during the hiring process.

About Birdeye Inc. 

Birdeye builds AI coworkers for multi-location brands. Jay for marketing, Myna for operations, and Robin for customer experience orchestrate AI agents to win AI visibility, book appointments, and drive consistent CX at every location. They run on BirdAI, the Agent OS built on 13 years of multi-location data infrastructure and 3, 000+ integrations. BirdAI consolidates every signal, reasons with industry, brand and location context, and acts autonomously or with a human in the loop. 

Birdeye is trusted by the world's largest multi-location brands across healthcare, dental, restaurants, financial services, auto, retail, and property management. G2 ranks Birdeye #1 in Enterprise Multi-Location Marketing Platforms and named it to the 2026 Best Agentic AI Products list. Learn more at birdeye. com. 

About The Role

Birdeye is evolving from a suite of individual products into a unified, AI-native platform. We are not just adding AI features; we are building the platform and agentic layer that lets businesses automate complex customer interactions, reason over their own data, and execute multi-step work across the customer lifecycle. 

You will lead the engineering organization behind one of Birdeye's core product lines - the platform foundations, high-scale services, and AI capabilities that power it. You will own it end to end: architecture, roadmap, delivery, reliability, and the business outcomes it drives, for a product used by tens of thousands of businesses every day. This is a hands-on leadership role: you lead through managers and senior ICs, but you stay close to the architecture, the tradeoffs, and the hard problems. 

What You'll Do

- Own the product line end to end. Set the technical strategy and multi-quarter roadmap in partnership with Product and Design; ship initiatives that move core company metrics - adoption, retention, performance, and cost-to-serve. 
 - Architect for scale. Guide the evolution of your product line into scalable, multi-tenant platform services - data pipelines (streaming and batch), retrieval and indexing, event-driven systems, and high-throughput APIs - that other product and engineering teams build on top of. 
 - Bring AI into production. Drive LLM-powered and agentic capabilities from prototype to GA - orchestration, tool use, retrieval, and context - with eval-driven development, guardrails, and feedback loops that improve quality and reliability against real customer data. 
 - Operate with a high reliability bar. Own SLOs, deep observability, healthy on-call, and prevention-first incident and post-mortem practices for services enterprise customers depend on most; treat reliability and operational excellence as a competitive advantage, not an afterthought. 
 - Scale and shape the organization. Hire, coach, and retain a high-performing team; grow your managers and senior ICs, shape team structure and ownership, and raise the technical bar continuously. 
 - Partner across the company. Work as a peer to Product, Design, and GTM; translate real customer and business needs into a defensible engineering roadmap, and represent your product line and its tradeoffs in cross-functional and executive settings. 

What You'll Bring

- You've led larger engineering organizations. 12+ years in software engineering and 5+ years leading larger organizations - including other managers and senior individual contributors - ideally across both startups and larger enterprises. You've scaled teams through real change, not just steady-state growth, and brought them through ambiguity without losing their trust or their output. 
 - Worked on and scaled Customer Experience products including Surveys, Insights, Reporting, and Ticketing. 
 - You have deep technical judgment and an IC foundation. A technically leaning leadership style: you stay close to the code and the design, can credibly debate architecture and tradeoffs with senior ICs, guide architecture, debug complex failures, and raise the technical bar of your team. 
 - You've built distributed systems at scale. Hands-on experience building and operating distributed systems, execution engines, or real-time platforms where correctness and reliability matter - large-scale data/indexing systems, retrieval, high-QPS multi-tenant services - with strong systems judgment on scalability, performance, security, and build-vs-buy. You've shipped systems that had to be fast, cheap, secure, and reliable at scale, not just functional. 
 - You've shipped AI in production. You've built and scaled features on generative AI for demanding users and understand the nuances of AI product development - evals, guardrails, and iteration loops - not just prototypes. 
 - You own a product line, not a component. A track record of shipping best-in-class products (consumer or enterprise) that drive significant user and business value, with clear ownership of both delivery and team health. 
 - You raise reliability as you scale. You've built strong service-ownership models, clear on-call practices, and durable quality bars in fast-growing orgs, and used data to make real investment tradeoffs between reactive and proactive work. 
 - You're a strong communicator and partner. You develop engineers and engineering leaders, communicate clearly (in writing by default) to align technical and non-technical stakeholders, and partner deeply with Product and Design while bringing an independent engineering point of view. 

AI-first mindset

We expect you to lead AI-native engineering, not just build AI-native products. You use AI coding agents and orchestration tools in your own work, and you have a concrete point of view on how they change what "good" engineering practice looks like - code review, on-call ownership, and quality bars all need rethinking when a meaningful share of code is agent-authored. You embed accountability into AI-assisted workflows rather than lowering the bar for velocity, and you expect the same from your teams. As part of the interview process, you'll walk us through how you use AI tools today to drive impact for you and your team.

As ADVANZ PHARMA continues to strengthen its position as the partner of choice for specialty, hospital, and rare disease medicines, we are seeking an Associate Director, Technical Services to join our Scientific Affairs function.

Our People Recommend Us

We cultivate a culture where you can express your ambition through initiatives like Purpose Day, a paid day off dedicated for you to use to invest in your growth and development. 

What You'll Be Doing (position summary): 

- The Quality Engineering Lead for Capital Markets and Collateral is the regional leader accountable for quality engineering strategy, standards and delivery across the CIBC India Global Capability Centre. The role owns the quality function for a multi platform estate spanning trading and book of record, risk and valuation, collateral and margin, and post trade domains. The incumbent sets the testing strategy, defines the engineering standards teams are measured against, and builds a quality capability that scales with the region's growing delivery footprint, leading managers and senior engineers and owning hiring, capability development, vendor relationships and the regional quality budget and headcount plan. 
 - The role sets the AI augmentation agenda for quality engineering across the function. The incumbent defines where AI is applied, spanning test generation and maintenance, coverage analysis, defect triage, requirements analysis and release risk assessment, establishes the governance, controls and validation standards that make its use safe in a regulated front office environment, and holds teams accountable for measurable improvement in coverage, cycle time and defect escape rate rather than adoption for its own sake. 
 - Operating as the senior quality voice in the region, the incumbent partners with global Technology leadership, Software Engineering, Production Support, DevOps, Risk, Operations and the business to influence release governance and shape how change is delivered safely across the estate. This is a regional leadership role within GCC India, accountable for regional strategy, capability and delivery and for its alignment to global standards, rather than a global position. At CIBC India we enable the work environment most optimal for you to thrive in your role. Details on your work arrangement (including on-site and remote work) will be discussed at the time of your interview. 

How You'll Succeed (responsibilities): 

- Own and set the quality engineering strategy for Capital Markets and Collateral across the region, covering trading and book of record, risk and valuation, collateral and margin and post trade domains, and align it to global technology strategy and regulatory obligations. 
 - Lead the regional quality engineering organization, including managers and senior engineers, owning team structure, hiring, succession, performance management and capability development across multiple domain aligned teams. 
 - Define and enforce the engineering standards for quality across the region, including automation frameworks, coverage expectations, environment and test data strategy, and the quality gates embedded in CI/CD pipelines. 
 - Set the AI augmentation agenda for the quality function, defining where and how AI is applied across test generation, coverage analysis, defect triage, requirements analysis and release risk, together with the governance, controls and validation standards that make it safe in a regulated environment. 
 - Establish the quality metrics that matter and hold the organisation to them, including automated coverage, defect escape rate, cycle time, environment stability and release success, reporting transparently to regional and global leadership. 
 - Own regional quality assurance sign off and release governance across the estate, providing an independent, evidence based view of readiness and residual risk to senior stakeholders. 
 - Build and scale regional capability in line with the GCC strategy, growing teams across domains, developing local leadership and reducing dependency on global and vendor resource. 
 - Manage the regional quality budget, headcount plan, tooling investment and vendor and partner relationships, including the commercial arrangements underpinning managed service capacity. 
 - Drive shift left and continuous delivery adoption across domains, engaging early in architecture and design so testability, observability and clear acceptance criteria are designed in rather than retrofitted. 
 - Partner with Production Support and Software Engineering to close the loop between production incidents and test coverage, ensuring systemic quality failures result in permanent and measurable prevention. 
 - Ensure the quality function meets audit, regulatory and control obligations, including evidence of testing, segregation of duties and traceability from requirement through to release. 
 - Act as the senior escalation point for quality and release risk in the region, and represent regional quality engineering in global forums, governance boards and senior business stakeholder engagement. 

COMPLIANCE REQUIREMENTS/RESPONSIBILITIES: 

- As an employee of CIBC, the incumbent must comply with all applicable CIBC and Line of Business policies, standards, guidelines and controls. 

AUTHORITIES/DECISION RIGHTS: 

- As the regional leader for the function, this job sets quality engineering standards, testing strategy and tooling direction for Capital Markets and Collateral platforms across the region. 
 - This job holds the authority to withhold or condition quality sign off for a release where evidence of readiness is insufficient or residual risk is unacceptable. 
 - This job is accountable for the regional quality budget, headcount plan, vendor selection and partner engagement within delegated authority. 

JOB DIMENSIONS: 

- Regional leadership accountability for quality engineering across multiple Tier 1 Capital Markets and Collateral platforms. 
 - Leads a multi team organization of managers, senior engineers and partner resource within the CIBC India Global Capability Centre. 
 - Accountable for the regional quality budget, headcount plan, tooling investment and vendor relationships. 
 - Supports platforms that execute 24/7/365 processing and require high availability, low latency and absolute data integrity. 
 - Influences release governance, engineering standards and AI adoption across domains and in partnership with global technology leadership. 

Who You Are (skills/qualifications): 

- Bachelor's degree in computer science, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent experience); a postgraduate or professional qualification is an advantage. 

Must Have Skills: 

- Substantial quality engineering leadership experience within Capital Markets or a comparable regulated, front office environment, including leading managers and multi team organizations. 
 - Proven track record of defining and executing quality engineering strategy across multiple platforms and domains rather than a single application. 
 - Deep technical credibility in test automation and engineering practice, able to set framework, coverage and CI/CD quality gate standards and challenge senior engineers on them. 
 - Demonstrable experience defining and governing the use of AI within an engineering or quality function, including the controls and validation standards required in a regulated environment. 
 - Strong Capital Markets domain knowledge across derivatives asset classes and the trade lifecycle, ideally including collateral and margin, risk and valuation and post trade processing. 
 - Experience building and scaling engineering capability within a Global Capability Centre or offshore delivery model, including hiring, retention and development of local leadership. 
 - Commercial and financial management experience, covering budget ownership, headcount planning, vendor selection and managed service arrangements. 
 - Experience owning release governance and quality sign off for business critical change, with the judgement and standing to withhold it. 
 - Understanding of audit, regulatory and control obligations as they apply to testing evidence, traceability and segregation of duties. 
 - Excellent stakeholder management and executive communication, credible with global technology leadership, senior business stakeholders and audit.

Overview

General Summary: 

Join Qualcomm's Platform Performance Team to drive ARMv9 server‐class CPU performance across cloud and enterprise platforms. 

In this role, you will own end‐to‐end benchmarking, regression tracking, system‐level performance analysis, and optimization to deliver industry‐leading results. You will work across hardware, firmware, OS, and software layers to measure, analyze, and improve performance, collaborating closely with kernel, compiler, silicon, and customer teams

Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in engineering, Computer Science, or Electrical Engineering

 - Hands‐on experience running and analyzing CPU Server workloads SPEC CPU, SPECrate, and SPECjbb
 - Experience with performance tools such as perf, VTune, or equivalent
 - Exposure to Linux performance tuning and basic statistical analysis

Core Technical Skills

- Strong foundation in CPU and system architecture, with an understanding of how modern processors execute workloads and how architectural choices impact performance at scale. 
 - Awareness of microarchitectural behavior, including how core execution, caching, and control mechanisms influence efficiency, latency, and throughput across diverse workloads. 
 - Solid grasp of memory and platform architecture, with the ability to reason about data movement, locality, bandwidth and latency trade‐offs, and system‐level placement effects in complex environments. 
 - Familiarity with ARM‐based platforms, including exposure to contemporary ARM architectures and an appreciation of how architectural extensions affect performance characteristics. 
 - Working knowledge of Linux internals, particularly how operating system behavior influences CPU utilization, memory performance, and I/O efficiency. 
 - Exposure to virtualization technologies, with an understanding of how virtualized environments can impact performance measurement and tuning. 
 - Experience with performance benchmarking and analysis, including designing meaningful experiments, ensuring result consistency, identifying trends over time, and applying sound analytical judgment to interpret data. 

Key Responsibilities

Benchmarking & Characterization

- Execute and analyze SPEC CPU, SPECrate, SPECjbb, and representative cloud or microservice workloads
 - Characterize CPU, cache, memory, NUMA, and I/O behavior on ARMv9 server platforms
 - Understand what each benchmark measures and how system configuration impacts results
 - Experience with ARMv9 platforms, UEFI/BIOS, PCIe/CXL, NUMA. 
 - Proficient with perf, VTune, ARM Streamline, TMA.

Performance Analysis & Root Cause Debugging

Regression Tracking & Monitoring

- Define key performance indicators (KPIs) for server workloads
 - Automate performance regression detection in CI/CD environments
 - Track performance changes across software, firmware (UEFI/BIOS), and hardware updates

Optimization

- Tune Linux kernel parameters, system configuration, and benchmark settings
 - Evaluate compiler flags and toolchains for performance impact
 - Optimize code paths where applicable using ARMv9 features and SVE/SVE2

Customer & Ecosystem Validation

- Validate performance for hyperscalers, Kubernetes, and enterprise workloads
 - Support OEM/ODM benchmarking, customer evaluations, and field issues

Automation & Infrastructure

- Develop and maintain automated benchmarking frameworks
 - Build scalable testbeds for repeatable performance testing
 - Contribute to data collection, visualization, and reporting pipelines

Desired Attributes

- Strong analytical and data‐driven problem‐solving mindset
 - Ability to explain performance trends clearly using metrics
 - Practical, structured approach to debugging complex system issues
 - Curiosity and willingness to dig across system layers
 - Strong collaboration and communication skills
 - Passion for performance engineering and system optimization

We're looking for an Engineering Manager to lead a high-performing engineering pod

management, strategic technical decision-making, and owning the delivery of features

that serve 300+ global enterprises, including Fortune 500 clients.

✅ Strategy & Technical Leadership

● Build and lead a high-performing engineering pod responsible for critical platform

capabilities.

design principles aligned with business OKRs.

well-scoped sprints. 

● Ensure systems are designed for reliability, scalability, and performance with

strong observability practices. 

✅ Delivery & Execution

● Own quarterly OKRs and feature delivery timelines; maintain visibility into team

velocity, blockers, and progress. Be accountable for customer outcomes, 

business capabilities shipped per engineer, system reliability, and operating cost. 

● Identify and mitigate technical risks early; communicate dependencies and

trade-offs proactively. 

● Define sprint cadence, conduct planning and retrospectives, and drive

continuous process improvement. 

● Ensure smooth integration with DevOps, QA, and deployment pipelines; own

quality gates for releases. 

👥 Team Building & People Leadership

● Hire, onboard, and retain a high-performing engineering team; conduct technical

interviews. 

● Lead team rituals: sprint planning, code reviews, retrospectives, and design

reviews. 

● Coach engineers on technical growth, career development, and leadership

potential. 

● Conduct regular 1-on-1s, provide feedback, and foster a culture of ownership and

learning. 

🤝 Cross-Functional Collaboration

● Partner with Product, Design, QA, DevOps, and other engineering pods on

priorities and technical constraints. 

● Communicate proactively on technical decisions, blockers, and resource needs. 

● Advocate for engineering needs while balancing business priorities and delivery

timelines. 

💻 Technical Contribution

● Write and review production code as appropriate; maintain technical credibility. 

● Unblock engineers on debugging, architecture decisions, and technical

problem-solving. 

● Lead by example in code quality and operational excellence. 

Requirements

Experience & Technical Expertise

● 6+ years of experience in software engineering, with 3+ years in engineering

leadership. 

● Proven track record leading engineering teams in high-scale SaaS or enterprise

software environments. 

● Strong foundation in backend systems: database design, API architecture, 

distributed systems, and scalability. 

● Hands-on experience with modern tech stacks (Python, Java, Go, Ruby); ability

to code-review and mentor across languages. 

● Deep understanding of testing practices: unit, integration, end-to-end, and

performance testing. 

● Experience with CI/CD pipelines, test automation, and production observability. 

● Demonstrated experience redesigning engineering workflows using AI agents

and verification controls, with measured productivity gains. Familiarity with AI

tools alone is insufficient. 

Leadership & Collaboration

● Proven ability to build, scale, and retain high-performing engineering teams. 

● Strong project management skills: breaking down requirements, estimating effort, 

managing multiple initiatives. 

● Excellent communication across technical and non-technical audiences. 

● Experience defining technical strategy and making architectural decisions with

pragmatism and long-term thinking. 

● Proven cross-functional collaboration with Product, Design, QA, and DevOps

teams. 

Soft Skills & Mindset

● Ownership mindset: Take end-to-end accountability for pod outcomes and

proactively solve problems. 

● Customer-centric thinking: Understand how your pod's work impacts customer

experience and business goals. 

● Adaptability: Comfortable in fast-growing startup environments; flexible and

iterative approach to processes. 

● Systems thinking: Aware of how your pod connects to the broader platform and

cross-team impacts. 

● Relentless commitment to quality and technical excellence. 

Ideal Candidate

You're a technical leader and builder of teams who understands that great engineering

requires both velocity and reliability. You care deeply about system design and code

quality, and you're relentless in pursuing technical excellence while unblocking your

team to move fast. You thrive in collaborative environments and are equally comfortable

pairing with an engineer on a complex bug or presenting technical trade-offs to

leadership. You mentor with intent, hire with rigor, and build cultures where ownership

and continuous learning are non-negotiable

data.title: SAP ABAP Development Lead
data.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner-and every person here makes that happen. You'll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world. 

This Position reports to: 

IS Manager

Your Role And Responsibilities

In this role, you will have the opportunity to own how SAP ABAP is built across our ERP landscape: the development standard, the quality gates, the AI-assisted development practice, and who works on what. Each day, you will spend at least half your time writing production code in SAP ECC and S/4HANA, taking on the hardest objects and the first build of every new pattern. You will also showcase your expertise by leading a central team of three developers, growing to six, who serve projects across Finance, Logistics, Operations and Sales. You will help us choose between agentic AI development platforms for SAP, such as Nova Intelligence and Conduct, and then make the chosen platform part of how the team builds every day. 

This role will be Reporting to the VP of IT and the Head of Core Business Applications (ERP), you will be the team's hands-on technical lead, not an additional management layer. 

The work model for the role is: Hybrid, minimum 3 days per week in the office. 

This role contributes to the Information Systems Core Business Applications (ERP) team, Electrification business area Installation Products division, in India. Main stakeholders are business users and project leads in Finance, Logistics, Operations, and Sales; the SAP BTP architecture and development team; the integration team; and SAP Basis. 

You will be mainly accountable for: 

- Building and finishing: delivering production ABAP in ECC and S/4HANA every week, and closing team commitments on the promised date, chasing what is blocked rather than waiting. 
 - Owning the ABAP development standard: coding guidelines, naming, enhancement rules, ABAP Test Cockpit checks, code review and transport discipline, applied the same way across the team. 
 - Leading AI-driven development: testing agentic AI platforms for SAP, such as Nova Intelligence and Conduct, hands-on with our own code; recommending one; and making it a daily practice, with rules for use, review of generated code, and automated quality and compliance checks. 
 - Allocating and growing the team: deciding who works on what across competing demand, removing single points of knowledge, coaching developers, and setting practical clean core rules for S/4HANA. 

Our team dynamics

You will join a small, hands-on expert team where everyone builds, and everyone supports. AI is expected here, not merely tolerated. Done means in use by the business, not just transported, and an honest "I don't know yet" is welcome. 

Qualifications for the role: 

- You have 12+ years of hands-on SAP development experience, with deep, current ABAP experience in ECC, and you still write code and can show recent work. 
 - You have heavy, hands-on experience with AI-assisted development, ideally with agentic SAP platforms such as Nova Intelligence or Conduct, or with SAP Joule for developers. If not, you have a strong drive to adopt them and can show what you built or automated with AI on your own initiative. 
 - You have a demonstrated track record of finishing concrete production outcomes with numbers, including work that was stuck before you picked it up. 
 - You are highly skilled in SAP S/4HANA development, including CDS, RAP, and ABAP Cloud, with a practical view of clean core from real implementations. 
 - You have established skills in defining and enforcing development standards that others followed, including rules for AI-generated code, and in leading developers technically. 
 - You are passionate about getting things done through people you don't manage, and about keeping quality and security controls intact while moving fast. 
 - You are at ease communicating in English, verbally and in writing. 

What's in it for you?

You will work hands-on with the newest agentic AI tools for SAP development and decide how a whole team uses them. You will shape the team's standards and tooling from the start, keep building rather than just reviewing, and see your decisions applied across the ERP landscape as we move to S/4HANA.

At ABB, we're pioneers in digital industries and power grids, driving sustainable transformation across industries. Our division is recognized as a trusted partner delivering forward-looking insights that fuel sustainable growth. We foster a culture of diversity, inclusion, and belonging across gender, ethnicity, LGBTQ+, abilities, and generations-creating an environment where every voice matters. 

We look forward to receiving your application (documents submitted in English are appreciated). If you want to discover more about ABB, take another look at our website www. abb. com. 

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. We welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences. 

Ready to make an impact? Apply today or visit www. abb. com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

data.description:
The Calix platform enables Communication Service Providers (CSPs) of all sizes to transform and future-proof their businesses. Through real-time data, automation, and actionable insights delivered via Calix One - our cloud-first, AI-powered platform - CSPs can simplify operations, collapse cost, and accelerate innovation. Calix One brings together the automation of everything and the experience of one, empowering customers to deliver differentiated subscriber experiences while driving acquisition, loyalty, and revenue growth. This is the Calix mission: to enable CSPs of all sizes to simplify, innovate, and grow, strengthening both their businesses and the communities they serve. 

We're at the forefront of a once in a generational change in the broadband industry. Join us as we innovate, help our customers reach their potential, and connect underserved communities with unrivaled digital experiences. 

About the Role: 

We are standing up an enterprise AI capability across our product organization, and we are looking for a seasoned technical lead to drive it end to end. This is a hands-on role: you will set the technical direction, architecture, and standards, mentor engineers, and steer external delivery partners - while still writing code, building reference implementations, and personally unblocking the hardest problems. 

What You'll Do: 

Enterprise Platform Rollout & Enablement

- Own the architecture and rollout of the enterprise AI platform across the product organization. 
 - Build and operate cost-effective infrastructure: model garden setup, budget controls and cost monitoring, model tiering, and fallback open-source models. 
 - Stand up and harden platform foundations - identity federation/SSO, IAM, tenant isolation, security and compliance guardrails, and observability. 
 - Enable users to adopt off-the-shelf capabilities (e. g. , NotebookLM, enterprise search, code assistants) and provide the training and ongoing support that drives real adoption. 
 - Design and deliver a self-service "agent factory" - patterns, templates, and in-IDE guardrails - so teams can build and maintain their own agents safely. 

Product Development Lifecycle Agents

Cross-Platform Interoperability

- Build agents that interoperate with agents on other enterprise AI platforms, including cross-platform contracts, schema/intent mapping, and cross-perimeter authentication.

Across All Tracks - Leadership & Hands-on

- Own the technical strategy, standards, patterns, and guardrails for agentic workflow development, RAG, security, and governance. 
 - Lead and mentor a team across cloud and enterprise AI tracks; raise the bar through code review, pairing, and design reviews. 
 - Steer external delivery partners - scope work, review deliverables, and hold them to quality and timeline. 
 - Stay hands-on: build reference agents, RAG pipelines, integrations, and MCP connectors, and debug the hardest pieces (including non-deterministic retrieval/generation behavior). 

Required Qualifications: 

- 10+ years of software engineering experience, with 4+ years in a technical lead or staff-level role. 
 - Strong, current hands-on coding ability - you still build and ship. Proficiency in Python (and comfort across at least one other modern language). 
 - Experience designing and operating production AI/ML or LLM-based systems: agents, RAG, prompt/eval pipelines, or similar. 
 - Deep familiarity with Google Vertex AI / Gemini and the surrounding services (IAM, networking, observability, cost management). 
 - Experience building developer-facing platforms or internal tooling, and driving adoption with training and support. 
 - Experience integrating systems via APIs and connectors; comfort with authentication and identity federation (OAuth, SSO, workload identity). 
 - A track record of leading technical initiatives across teams and influencing without authority. 
 - Strong communication skills - able to work directly with both engineers and non-technical business stakeholders. 

Preferred Qualifications: 

- Hands-on with Gemini Enterprise, Vertex AI, NotebookLM, or comparable enterprise AI tooling. 
 - Experience building agentic systems and orchestration (agent development kits, A2A protocols, MCP, tool/function calling). 
 - Experience with LLM gateways and routing (e. g. , LiteLLM), model cost optimization, and multi-model fallback strategies. 
 - Experience managing or working alongside systems integrators / delivery partners. 
 - Familiarity with the modern PDLC toolchain (Jira/Confluence, Figma, GitHub, CI/CD) and AI coding assistants.

Join the Future of Security at Netskope

Netskope (NASDAQ: NTSK) is a leader in modern security and networking for the cloud and AI era. We secure and accelerate cloud, data, and AI in real time, everywhere. Thousands of customers, including more than 30 of the Fortune 100, trust the Netskope One platform, its Zero Trust Engine, and the powerful NewEdge network to gain full visibility and control without performance trade-offs. 

At Netskope, our technology is driven by our greatest strength: our people. We believe that belonging powers innovation, and success is both personal and organizational. We embrace differences in gender, ethnicity, beliefs, ability, and identity, creating an environment where every voice is heard and respected. We empower our employees to bring their authentic selves to work, grow their careers through continuous education and mentorship, and lead with transparency and curiosity. Join a team where you belong, where you are encouraged to be an entrepreneur, and where together, we continue to redefine the landscape of security. 

Visit Careers at Netskope to learn more. Follow us on LinkedIn and Instagram. 

About The Role

Please note, this team is hiring across all levels and candidates are individually assessed and appropriately leveled based upon their skills and experience. 

Join our Enterprise Browser team at Netskope, where we're pioneering the next generation of secure web browsing. 

The Enterprise Browser team is at the forefront of developing the Netskope Enterprise Browser, a critical tool designed to direct corporate traffic securely within our network. This browser integrates advanced features that enhance both security and productivity in a corporate environment. Leveraging our Next Gen Secure Web Gateway (SWG) and Security Service Edge (SSE) solutions, we bring these powerful capabilities directly to the browser, ensuring a seamless, secure, and controlled browsing experience-all within a single cloud platform. Safe sites are allowed, malicious sites are blocked, and user actions are carefully managed. 

What's In It For You

As a member of this dynamic team, you will dive deep into the world of advanced browser technologies, particularly Chromium. You'll play a critical role in modifying and extending Chromium modules to support the full suite of Netskope Enterprise Browser functionalities. Expect to work with cutting-edge technologies such as C++ and gRPC services, and to tackle complex challenges in distributed systems-ranging from performance optimization and scalability to high availability, containerization, and advanced analytics. 

What You Will Be Doing

- Modify and enhance the Chromium engine to support new features. 
 - Using advanced data structures and algorithms in C++
 - Researching optimization algorithms and improving performance
 - Solving problems with quick and elegant solutions

Required Skills And Experience

- 3+ years of experience in Chromium environments. 
 - Strong C++ design and software implementation skills. 
 - Excellent debugging, memory profiling and performance testing skills. 
 - Experience programming multi-threaded solutions and knowledge of synchronization techniques. 
 - Good understanding of memory management and runtime optimization. 
 - Experience developing complex products with many components. 
 - Unit testing knowledge, proponent of TDD is a big plus. 
 - The ability to coach, mentor and encourage growth and career progression of team members. 
 - Strong verbal and written communication skills, as well as the ability to communicate in an open, transparent and consistent manner with team and co-workers. 
 - A can-do attitude and ability to roll up your sleeves and respond to the needs of customers proactively and promptly. 

Education

- BSCS or equivalent required, MSCS or equivalent strongly preferred

Netskope is committed to implementing equal employment opportunities for all employees and applicants for employment. Netskope does not discriminate in employment opportunities or practices based on religion, race, color, sex, marital or veteran statues, age, national origin, ancestry, physical or mental disability, medical condition, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, genetic information, pregnancy (including childbirth, lactation and related medical conditions), or any other characteristic protected by the laws or regulations of any jurisdiction in which we operate. 

Netskope respects your privacy and is committed to protecting the personal information you share with us, please refer to Netskope's Privacy Policy for more details. 

The application window for this position is expected to close within 50 days. You may apply by filling out the below information, or visiting our Netskope Careers site.

data.description:
Principal Mobile Software Engineer (P5)

Who We Are

Solera is a global leader in data and software services, transforming every touchpoint of the vehicle lifecycle into a connected digital experience. Solera processes over 300 million digital transactions annually for approximately 235, 000 partners and customers in more than 90 countries. Our teams work on mission‐critical platforms that demand reliability, scalability, and thoughtful evolution of complex systems. 

Job Summary

We're looking for a hands-on Principal Mobile Software Engineer (P5) who will lead the architecture, development, modernization, and delivery of enterprise-grade mobile platforms across iOS and Android. This role is focused on building reliable, scalable, secure, and high-performing mobile experiences while using AI-driven development practices to accelerate engineering velocity, improve quality, and unlock intelligent mobile capabilities. 

This role is ideal for a senior technologist who: 

Leads complete, high-impact mobile initiatives end-to-end across discovery, architecture, implementation, launch, and continuous improvement

Designs and builds cross-platform mobile solutions spanning iOS, Android, and shared mobile platform capabilities

Applies AI-driven development practices, AI-assisted engineering tools, and intelligent mobile workflows to improve delivery speed and product quality

Makes pragmatic architectural decisions that balance native platform excellence, cross-platform reuse, performance, security, maintainability, and time-to-market

Partners effectively with product, design, architecture, backend, security, QA, DevOps/SRE, and business stakeholders to turn ambiguous goals into mobile outcomes

Mentors mobile engineers and raises the technical standard through platform ownership, code review, architecture guidance, and hands-on implementation

You will operate with broad autonomy, lead complete mobile initiatives without requiring constant direction, influence mobile platform direction across teams, and be known as someone who ships, unblocks others, aligns stakeholders, and makes things happen. 

What You'll Do

Build, Ship, and Own Mobile Platforms

- Write production-quality mobile code regularly across iOS, Android, shared platform libraries, and mobile integration layers
 - Own and deliver high-impact mobile features, platform capabilities, and system improvements end-to-end
 - Lead modernization of legacy mobile applications, incrementally migrating toward modular, maintainable, testable, and scalable mobile architectures
 - Design and evolve mobile platform foundations, including app architecture, shared components, design systems, SDKs, offline capabilities, authentication flows, telemetry, and release infrastructure
 - Translate ambiguous business and user requirements into reliable, intuitive, and performant mobile experiences
 - Identify mobile technical risks early, including app performance, crash rates, app store constraints, OS fragmentation, security, privacy, offline behavior, and API reliability
 - Run complete project workstreams independently, including technical discovery, solution design, delivery planning, execution tracking, launch readiness, app store release coordination, and post-launch follow-through

AI-Driven Mobile Development & Intelligent Experiences

- Lead the adoption of AI-driven development practices for mobile engineering, including AI-assisted design, coding, refactoring, test generation, debugging, documentation, and code review workflows
 - Design and implement intelligent mobile experiences that responsibly leverage LLMs, AI services, on-device intelligence, contextual assistance, automation, and personalization where appropriate
 - Integrate mobile applications with AI-enabled backend services, APIs, orchestration layers, and data sources
 - Evaluate when intelligence should run on-device, at the edge, or in cloud services based on latency, privacy, cost, reliability, and user experience
 - Establish guardrails for AI-assisted mobile engineering, including prompt patterns, generated-code review standards, test expectations, security review, privacy controls, and quality gates
 - Implement hallucination mitigation and validation strategies for AI-powered mobile features, including grounding, structured outputs, user confirmation, fallback states, and telemetry-driven evaluation
 - Design monitoring and feedback loops for AI-enabled mobile behavior in production
 - Ensure AI-enabled mobile capabilities meet security, privacy, compliance, accessibility, and user trust requirements

Mobile Technical Leadership & Architecture

- Set and evolve mobile architecture standards through hands-on implementation
 - Guide platform decisions across native iOS, native Android, cross-platform frameworks, shared libraries, backend integration, data synchronization, security, and observability
 - Make principled tradeoffs between native platform depth, cross-platform reuse, delivery speed, scalability, performance, correctness, and long-term maintainability
 - Act as a technical escalation point for challenging mobile problems, including performance, memory, battery usage, offline-first behavior, crash stability, OS compatibility, release quality, and integration reliability
 - Influence technical direction across multiple teams without becoming a bottleneck
 - Provide full technical leadership for projects by coordinating architecture, engineering execution, dependency management, risk mitigation, mobile release planning, and cross-team alignment
 - Communicate clearly with product owners, UX/design, engineering leaders, backend teams, security, DevOps/SRE, QA, support, and business stakeholders to keep delivery aligned with business outcomes

AI-Assisted Mobile Engineering & Developer Productivity

- Leverage AI-powered development tools such as GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT, Claude, and mobile-specific automation to accelerate high-quality delivery
 - Establish best practices and guardrails for safe, high-quality AI-assisted mobile coding
 - Use AI tools for mobile solution design, architecture analysis, refactoring, test generation, debugging, system comprehension, documentation, and release readiness
 - Improve developer productivity through reusable mobile components, shared architecture patterns, CI/CD automation, test automation, build optimization, and platform tooling
 - Help teams adopt modern mobile workflows that improve velocity while maintaining engineering rigor, security, accessibility, and release quality

Mentorship & Team Elevation

- Mentor mobile engineers through pairing, code reviews, architecture reviews, and design discussions
 - Help senior mobile engineers grow into broader technical leadership roles
 - Coach engineers on modern mobile architecture, cross-platform development, AI-aware engineering practices, quality engineering, observability, and secure development
 - Foster a culture of continuous learning, ownership, customer empathy, and technical excellence
 - Lead by example with clear communication, humility, accountability, and hands-on technical contribution

Mobile Execution, Quality & Operations

- Build and maintain enterprise mobile applications using modern native and/or cross-platform frameworks
 - Design and implement integrations with RESTful APIs, GraphQL services, event-driven workflows, identity providers, analytics platforms, and mobile backend services
 - Optimize mobile applications for performance, memory usage, battery life, network efficiency, offline behavior, accessibility, localization, and reliability
 - Partner with DevOps/SRE and QA to ensure strong mobile CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, build signing, release automation, observability, crash reporting, and safe deployments
 - Own release quality across TestFlight, Google Play testing tracks, App Store, and Google Play production releases
 - Participate fully in the SDLC: design, coding, testing, deployment, production support, incident response, and continuous improvement

Experience

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

- 10+ years of professional software development experience, including significant hands-on mobile engineering experience
 - Proven experience owning and delivering large, complex mobile applications or mobile platform capabilities
 - Demonstrated success modernizing legacy mobile applications, mobile architectures, and mobile delivery practices
 - Hands-on experience building and shipping iOS and Android applications, with strong cross-platform mobile development experience
 - Experience applying AI-assisted development tools and AI-driven engineering practices to improve quality, speed, testing, documentation, and maintainability
 - History of hands-on technical leadership across teams or mobile domains
 - Strong track record of mentoring and developing engineers
 - Proven ability to lead a complete project independently, coordinate with cross-functional stakeholders, manage technical risks, and drive execution through delivery

Technical Skills

- Expert-level mobile engineering experience across iOS and Android
 - Strong proficiency with Swift and iOS platform development, including Apple platform conventions, app lifecycle, concurrency, networking, persistence, testing, and App Store release practices
 - Strong proficiency with Kotlin and Android platform development, including Android architecture, Jetpack, coroutines, networking, persistence, testing, and Google Play release practices
 - Hands-on experience with cross-platform mobile technologies such as React Native, Flutter, Kotlin Multiplatform, . NET MAUI, or equivalent frameworks
 - Deep understanding of mobile architecture patterns such as MVVM, MVI, Clean Architecture, modular architecture, dependency injection, and design-system integration
 - Experience integrating mobile apps with RESTful APIs, GraphQL, identity providers, telemetry platforms, crash reporting, analytics, feature flags, and remote configuration
 - Hands-on experience with AI-assisted development tools and AI-enabled engineering workflows
 - Working knowledge of LLM-powered product experiences, AI service integration, prompt-driven workflows, structured outputs, validation, and responsible AI guardrails
 - Strong understanding of mobile security, secure storage, authentication, authorization, privacy, encryption, certificate pinning, OWASP Mobile risks, and compliance-aware engineering
 - Strong experience with mobile testing strategies, including unit testing, UI automation, integration testing, contract testing, snapshot testing, and regression automation
 - Experience with mobile CI/CD, build automation, signing, provisioning, release tracks, app store submission, observability, and production monitoring
 - Comfort working with cloud environments and backend integration patterns across AWS and/or Azure
 - Proficient with Git and modern development workflows
 - Strong understanding of production-quality code, performance tuning, reliability engineering, accessibility, and user-centered mobile design

NICE TO HAVE

- Experience with React Native, Flutter, Kotlin Multiplatform, . NET MAUI, or other cross-platform mobile frameworks at scale
 - Experience building shared mobile platform libraries, SDKs, design systems, or reusable component frameworks
 - Experience with offline-first mobile applications, synchronization, conflict resolution, and intermittent connectivity scenarios
 - Experience with mobile observability, crash analytics, performance monitoring, synthetic monitoring, and SLO-driven reliability practices
 - Experience integrating AI-powered features into mobile applications, including on-device AI, cloud AI services, personalization, automation, or contextual assistants
 - Experience with regulated, security-sensitive, or compliance-driven mobile applications
 - Background with event streaming, messaging, or real-time data workflows
 - Strong background in Agile/Scrum environments

EDUCATION

Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent practical experience

What Success Looks Like

- You are consistently delivering high-impact mobile features and platform capabilities across iOS and Android
 - Mobile applications are more reliable, performant, secure, observable, accessible, and easier to release
 - Legacy mobile systems are being systematically modernized without disrupting customers or business operations
 - AI-assisted engineering practices improve team velocity, code quality, test coverage, and documentation quality
 - AI-enabled mobile capabilities are designed responsibly, monitored effectively, and trusted in production
 - Teams move faster because of the mobile platform patterns, tools, automation, and examples you establish
 - Engineers seek you out for guidance on mobile architecture, cross-platform decisions, AI-assisted development, release quality, and production issues
 - Projects you lead are well-scoped, well-communicated, and delivered through effective collaboration with product, design, engineering, operations, security, QA, and business stakeholders
 - Code quality, mobile reliability, release confidence, and development velocity improve measurably
 - You are recognized as a technical leader who ships and elevates everyone around them

Principal Software Engineer (C#. NET with Azure)

What Makes Us, Us

Join some of the most innovative thinkers in FinTech as we lead the evolution of financial technology. If you are an innovative, curious, collaborative person who embraces challenges and wants to grow, learn and pursue outcomes with our prestigious financial clients, say Hello to SimCorp!

At its foundation, SimCorp is guided by our values - Caring, Customer success-driven, Collaborative, Curious, and Courageous. Our people-centered organization focuses on skills development, relationship building, and client success. We take pride in cultivating an environment where all team members can grow, feel heard, valued, and empowered. 

If you like what we're saying, keep reading!

WHY THIS ROLE IS IMPORTANT TO US

Build the complex systems that move SimCorp's clients' data and trades. Turn continuous learning into a platform that scales with our growth. Raise the bar on development and testing so quality is designed in, not inspected in. Grow domain depth in applied finance and investment management - and turn it into products clients can't work without. Investment Operations Product Areas (Data & Post-trade Engineering Line). 

What You Will Be Responsible For

You will be a member of a self-organized scrum team consisting of software engineers, who collaborate closely with business experts. The team is responsible for developing and supporting a set of enterprise products within the Collateral Product Area. You are expected to interact with colleagues from Ukraine, Poland, Denmark, Austria, and Germany. After a comprehensive onboarding program, we expect you to: 

- Design, develop, and test solutions for a new product capabilities. 
 - Create and implement test strategy to ensure high quality of the product. 
 - Closely communicate and collaborate with Teams, Product Owners, and Architects follow and ensure architecture/technical roadmap & guidelines 
 - . Create and analyze functional and non-functional requirements during feature refinements. 
 - Ensure outstanding product support and proactively minimize it. 
 - Initiate technical and process enhancements in the team. 
 - Initiate and drive improvement of automation, tools, frameworks, etc. 
 - Work as a full stack developer, both front-end and back-end (SOA). Initiate and drive improvement of automation, tools, frameworks, etc. 
 - Work as a full stack developer, both front-end and back-end (SOA)

What We Value

Most importantly, you can see yourself contributing and thriving in the position described above. How you gained the skills needed for doing that is less important. We expect you to be good at several of the following and be able to - and interested in - learning the rest: 

- Extensive expertise in Microsoft Azure and Azure DevOps, with the ability to develop and manage CI/CD pipelines. 
 - Rich experience with Cloud Infrastructures. 
 - Extensive knowledge and experience (10+ years) in C# and Angular . 
 - Proficient in both manual and automated testing, with the ability to design and implement comprehensive test strategies and all level tests for software applications (E2E, API, UT). 
 - Understanding and adherence to XP practices (TDD, pair-programming etc. ) 
 - Readiness to learn APL. 
 - M. Sc. in Finance, Computer Science, Mathematics or a similar field (will be a plus). 
 - Curiosity and readiness to learn and improve in-house tools and frameworks 
 - Experience with Domain-Driven Design. 
 - Experience with relational databases (SQL). 
 - Ability to mentor, motivate, and guide a team toward technical excellence and efficient delivery 
 - Good English skills (upper intermediate and higher), written as well as spoken

AI-Enabled Development

- Use AI tools (Copilot, Claude, and others) fluently as part of your everyday working routines. 
 - Critically evaluate AI-generated artifacts - verify correctness and architectural fit before accepting. 
 - Guide your team on responsible AI usage: when to trust it, when to override it, and how to review it carefully 
 - Identify where AI can accelerate prototyping cycles and reduce low-value work in the team. 

Benefits

- Global hybrid work policy - We ask you to work 2 days a week from the office. If you choose you can work remotely the other days. Of course, you are welcome at the office if that is your preference. 
 - Culture - Inclusive and diverse company culture. 
 - Work-life balance - We believe that an equilibrium between professional responsibilities makes us all the best version of ourselves, both in private life and as colleagues in the workplace. 
 - Empowerment - We believe that all voices are valuable and must be heard. You will be involved in shaping our work processes. 
 - Career & Growth - Simcorp does offer opportunities for professional development: there is never just only one route - we offer an individual approach to professional development to support the direction you want to take. 

NEXT STEPS

Please send us your application in English via our career site as soon as possible, we process incoming applications continually. Please note that only applications sent through our system will be processed. At SimCorp, we recognize that bias can unintentionally occur in the recruitment process. To uphold fairness and equal opportunities for all applicants, we kindly ask you to exclude personal data such as photos, age, or any non-professional information from your application. Thank you for aiding us in our endeavor to mitigate biases in our recruitment process.
