data.title: Data Reliability Engineer [T500-30637]
data.description:
About Costco Wholesale: 

Costco Wholesale is a multi-billion-dollar global retailer with warehouse club operations in eleven countries. They provide a wide selection of quality merchandise, plus the convenience of specialty departments and exclusive member services, all designed to make shopping a pleasurable experience for their members. 

About Costco Wholesale India: 

At Costco Wholesale India, we foster a collaborative space, working to support Costco Wholesale in developing innovative solutions that improve members' experiences and make employees' jobs easier. Our employees play a key role in driving and delivering innovation to establish IT as a core competitive advantage for Costco Wholesale. 

Position Summary: 

The Data Reliability Engineer - Data Analytics & Data Reliability is responsible for ensuring the availability, reliability, performance, and trustworthiness of enterprise Data & Analytics platforms, data pipelines, data products, and business-facing reporting solutions. 

This role provides end-to-end monitoring and production support across the analytics value chain-from source data ingestion and orchestration through BigQuery, Dataflow, Dataproc, Pub/Sub, dbt transformations, GCP, Power BI semantic models and reports, and downstream business consumption. The role applies both Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) and Data Reliability Engineering (DRE) practices so that not only the platforms are available, but the data delivered through them is accurate, complete, timely, consistent, and fit for business use. 

The SRE will proactively monitor critical data flows, define reliability targets, detect data and platform anomalies, lead incident response and root cause analysis, automate operational processes, and partner with engineering teams to build reliability and observability into solutions from design through production. The role will participate in 24x7 production support and rotational on-call coverage. 

Job Duties/Essential Functions: 

- Designs, builds, and maintains end-to-end monitoring and observability across source systems, ingestion, Google Cloud Composer/Airflow, BigQuery, dbt, GCP, Power BI, and downstream reporting and analytics solutions. 
 - Monitors both system health and data health, including pipeline execution, data freshness, completeness, accuracy, reconciliation, schema changes, volume anomalies, latency, query performance, capacity, report refreshes, and business-facing availability. 
 - Defines and tracks Service Level Indicators (SLIs), Service Level Objectives (SLOs), availability targets, data freshness thresholds, data quality expectations, and operational KPIs for business-critical data products and analytics services. 
 - Builds automated controls to detect data quality failures, schema drift, unexpected row-count or volume changes, broken upstream/downstream dependencies, and stale or incomplete data before they materially impact business users. 

Data Quality, Trust & Reliability Engineering: 

- Partners with Data Engineering, BI Engineering, and Product teams to define reliability expectations for critical data products, including freshness, completeness, accuracy, consistency, and availability. 
 - Implements automated data validation, reconciliation, dbt tests, anomaly detection, and production health checks as part of the delivery lifecycle. 
 - Helps establish data contracts, ownership, and operational expectations for critical interfaces and datasets to reduce unexpected downstream impact from source or schema changes. 
 - Identifies data downtime and reliability risks, measures recurring failure patterns, and recommends engineering changes that improve confidence in enterprise reporting, self-service analytics, and AI-enabled solutions. 
 - Ensures critical business metrics and reports have observable dependencies and clearly defined support and escalation paths. 

Automation & Operational Excellence: 

- Identifies repetitive operational activities and eliminates manual toil through Python, SQL, APIs, scripting, automated health checks, alert enrichment, job recovery, dependency checks, and self-healing workflows where appropriate. 
 - Develops reusable monitoring and reliability patterns that can be adopted across Data & Analytics engineering teams. 
 - Builds self-service diagnostic capabilities that enable support and engineering teams to identify failures and business impact quickly. 
 - Evaluates opportunities for AI-assisted operations, automated anomaly detection, intelligent incident correlation, and automated remediation. 
 - Continuously improves alert quality to reduce noise and ensure alerts are actionable, prioritized, and tied to meaningful business impact. 

Reliability by Design, Performance & Capacity: 

- Partners with engineering teams to embed monitoring, logging, alerting, testing, failure handling, recovery procedures, and supportability into solution designs from the beginning. 
 - Participates in architecture, design, Technical Review Board, release, and production-readiness reviews to ensure reliability and operational requirements are addressed before deployment. 
 - Monitors and analyzes BigQuery workloads, Composer orchestration, Power BI capacities and refreshes, dbt execution, GVP services, and other platform components for performance, scalability, and capacity risk. 

Production Support, Incident & Problem Management: 

- Provides end-to-end operational support for production Data & Analytics platforms, pipelines, data products, and reporting solutions. 
 - Serves as a technical escalation point for high-priority incidents affecting data availability, freshness, quality, performance, or business reporting. 
 - Leads or actively participates in incident bridge calls, coordinates triage across internal teams and vendors, and drives incidents through restoration, validation, business communication, root cause analysis, and long-term remediation. 
 - Performs root cause analysis (RCA), identifies corrective and preventative actions, and ensures recurring failures are addressed through permanent engineering solutions rather than repeated manual intervention. 

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Communication: 

- Works closely with Data Engineering, BI Engineering, Platform Engineering, Architecture, Quality Engineering, Security, Operations Support, Product Owners, business stakeholders, and technology vendors. 
 - Communicates production health, incidents, business impact, risks, and remediation plans clearly to technical teams, management, and business stakeholders. 
 - Shares operational learnings and reliability metrics across teams and influences adoption of consistent Data Reliability and Site Reliability practices. 
 - Provides technical leadership and mentoring to engineers and support teams and helps strengthen production ownership across Data & Analytics. 

Ability to operate vehicles, equipment or machinery: 

- Computer, phone, printer, copier, fax

Non-Essential Functions: 

- Assists in other areas of the department as necessary. 
 - Assists in other areas of the company as necessary. 

Ability to operate vehicles, equipment or machinery: 

- Same as Essential Functions

Experience, Skills, Education & Licenses/Certifications: 

Required: 

- Experience in the development, maintenance, operation, or support of highly available enterprise Data & Analytics systems. 
 - Strong experience with production monitoring, observability, incident management, troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and problem management. 
 - Hands-on experience with modern Data & Analytics technologies such as Dataflow, Dataproc, Pub/Sub, Power BI, BigQuery, DBT, Google Cloud Composer/Airflow, GCP, data pipelines, and cloud data platforms. 
 - Strong SQL skills and ability to troubleshoot data issues across source, ingestion, transformation, semantic, and reporting layers. 
 - Experience with data reliability concepts including data freshness, completeness, accuracy, consistency, schema drift, lineage/dependencies, reconciliation, and data quality monitoring. 
 - Experience defining or supporting SLIs/SLOs, data SLAs, operational KPIs, availability targets, or similar reliability measures. 
 - Experience developing dashboards, alerts, health checks, and automated monitoring or diagnostic solutions. 
 - Strong understanding of incident, problem, and change-management processes and ability to lead or support critical production incidents. 
 - Ability to communicate clearly with business partners, vendors, employees, management, and technical teams and translate technical issues into business impact. 
 - Ability to work independently, demonstrate strong ownership and accountability, and operate effectively under pressure. 
 - Scheduling flexibility to meet the needs of a 24x7x365 production environment, including evening, weekend, holiday, and rotational on-call support as needed. 

Recommended: 

- Experience with Google Cloud Platform, including BigQuery, Cloud Composer, Cloud Monitoring/Logging, and related services. 
 - Experience with Power BI administration and support, including semantic models, refreshes, gateways, capacities, subscriptions, and report availability monitoring. 
 - Experience with dbt models, tests, documentation, lineage, and production job monitoring. 
 - Experience with data observability or monitoring platforms and techniques for anomaly detection, freshness, volume, schema, and quality monitoring. 

Other Conditions: 

- Management will review the Job Analysis for this position prior to a job offer.

data.title: Senior Software Engineer, AI Platform
data.description:
The AI Platform team builds, develops, and operates the Enterprise AI Platform at Thomson Reuters - a comprehensive ecosystem of services, tools, and infrastructure that empowers both technical and non-technical users to develop, evaluate, deploy, and monitor AI solutions at scale. 

We are looking for a Senior Site Reliability Engineer to take ownership of the reliability, scalability, and long-term operational architecture of the AI Platform. In this role, you will partner closely with platform and ML engineers to design and evolve infrastructure that is resilient by default, observable at every layer, and built to sustain the pace of a fast-moving GenAI platform. Beyond day-to-day operational excellence, you will be expected to make deliberate, forward-looking infrastructure decisions - establishing patterns, standards, and guardrails that scale with the platform and reduce systemic risk over time. This is a senior individual contributor role with real technical ownership and meaningful influence over how the AI Platform is built and operated at Thomson Reuters. 

About The Role

In this opportunity as a Senior Software Engineer, AI Platform, you will: 

- Own and drive the long-term infrastructure strategy for the AI Platform team - designing systems and standards that are built to scale, remain reliable under growth, and reduce operational burden over time. 
 - Own and improve the operational posture of cloud-native services including containerized workloads, serverless functions, and managed ML infrastructure. 
 - Instrument services with observability tooling (Datadog, CloudWatch, or equivalent) covering metrics, logs, and distributed tracing. 
 - Establish and enforce SLAs and error budgets; drive incident response, post-mortems, and systemic reliability improvements. 
 - Collaborate with platform engineering to harden infrastructure against security findings (Wiz, Snyk) and maintain compliance with organizational standards. 
 - Design, build, and maintain CI/CD pipelines for AI Platform services, SDKs, and infrastructure, ensuring fast and reliable delivery across environments. 
 - Automate toil - infrastructure provisioning, security remediation workflows, environment management, and deployment operations. 
 - Mentor junior team members and raise the engineering bar across DevOps practices on the team. 

About You

You're a fit for the role of Senior Software Engineer, AI Platform if you: 

- Strong communication skills and the ability to work across engineering, security, and product teams and distill unclear requirements into clear engineering goals. 
 - 5+ years of experience in cloud and infrastructure engineering roles. 
 - Strong proficiency in Python and shell scripting, with hands-on experience building and deploying automation tools that eliminate toil and streamline DevOps workflows. Infrastructure-as-code experience with CloudFormation, Terraform, ARM or SAM is expected. 
 - Deep hands-on experience with cloud infrastructure is expected. 
 - Solid experience with CI/CD tooling and infrastructure deployment automation. 
 - Familiar with containerization (Docker, Kubernetes) and cloud-native deployment patterns. 

What's in it For You?

- Hybrid Work Model: We've adopted a flexible hybrid working environment for our office-based roles while delivering a seamless experience that is digitally and physically connected. 
 - Flexibility & Work-Life Balance: Flex My Way is a set of supportive workplace policies designed to help manage personal and professional responsibilities, whether caring for family, giving back to the community, or finding time to refresh and reset. This builds upon our flexible work arrangements, including work from anywhere for up to 8 weeks per year, empowering employees to achieve a better work-life balance. 
 - Career Development and Growth: By fostering a culture of continuous learning and skill development, we prepare our talent to tackle tomorrow's challenges and deliver real-world solutions. Our Grow My Way programming and skills-first approach ensures you have the tools and knowledge to grow, lead, and thrive in an AI-enabled future. 
 - Industry Competitive Benefits: We offer comprehensive benefit plans to include flexible vacation, two company-wide Mental Health Days off, access to the Headspace app, retirement savings, tuition reimbursement, employee incentive programs, and resources for mental, physical, and financial wellbeing. 
 - Culture: Globally recognized, award-winning reputation for inclusion and belonging, flexibility, work-life balance, and more. We live by our values: Obsess over our Customers, Compete to Win, Challenge (Y)our Thinking, Act Fast / Learn Fast, and Stronger Together. 
 - Social Impact: Make an impact in your community with our Social Impact Institute. We offer employees two paid volunteer days off annually and opportunities to get involved with pro-bono consulting projects and Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) initiatives. 
 - Making a Real-World Impact: We are one of the few companies globally that helps its customers pursue justice, truth, and transparency. Together, with the professionals and institutions we serve, we help uphold the rule of law, turn the wheels of commerce, catch bad actors, report the facts, and provide trusted, unbiased information to people all over the world. 

About Us

Thomson Reuters informs the way forward by bringing together the trusted content and technology that people and organizations need to make the right decisions. We serve professionals across legal, tax, accounting, compliance, government, and media. Our products combine highly specialized software and insights to empower professionals with the data, intelligence, and solutions needed to make informed decisions, and to help institutions in their pursuit of justice, truth, and transparency. Reuters, part of Thomson Reuters, is a world leading provider of trusted journalism and news. 

We are powered by the talents of 26, 000 employees across more than 70 countries, where everyone has a chance to contribute and grow professionally in flexible work environments. At a time when objectivity, accuracy, fairness, and transparency are under attack, we consider it our duty to pursue them. Sound exciting? Join us and help shape the industries that move society forward. 

As a global business, we rely on the unique backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences of all employees to deliver on our business goals. To ensure we can do that, we seek talented, qualified employees in all our operations around the world regardless of race, color, sex/gender, including pregnancy, gender identity and expression, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, disability, age, marital status, citizen status, veteran status, or any other protected classification under applicable law. Thomson Reuters is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer providing a drug-free workplace. 

We also make reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and for sincerely held religious beliefs in accordance with applicable law. More information on requesting an accommodation here. 

Learn more on how to protect yourself from fraudulent job postings here. 

More information about Thomson Reuters can be found on thomsonreuters. com.

 - Experience writing Terraform scripts and deploying in AWS production environment

 - Test the UI: layout and behaviour against Figma, filters and cascading dropdowns, grids (sort, search, pagination, column configuration), charts, drawers, comments, exports and the chatbot flow, across supported browsers and screen sizes. 
 - Test the APIs: request and response payloads, status codes, validation and error handling, authentication tokens, pagination and filter parameters, and response times, using Postman or Swagger. 
 - Test the database: write SQL to verify that what the UI and API show matches the stored data, check calculations (KPIs, scores, percentages), data loads, snapshots and audit fields, and confirm no data is silently dropped or duplicated. 
 - Trace one business flow end to end: data in the database → API response → what the user sees → what is exported. 
 - Run SIT cycles per module, log defects with clear reproduction steps and evidence, retest fixes, and run regression before UAT. 
 - Support UAT: prepare test data and scripts for business users, triage their findings and separate defects from change requests. 
 - Maintain the requirement-to-test-case traceability matrix and share daily test status, defect counts and risks with the delivery lead. 

Must-have skills

- 3+ years of functional testing of web applications covering UI, API and database layers in the same project. 
 - Strong test design: deriving scenarios from requirements and designs, writing clear test cases, prioritising by risk. 
 - API testing with Postman (collections, environments, basic scripting) or Swagger/OpenAPI; understanding of REST, JSON, HTTP status codes and token-based authentication
 - (SSO/OAuth). 
 - SQL for test validation: joins, aggregations, filtering and comparisons against UI values, on PostgreSQL or a similar relational database, using a client such as DBeaver or pgAdmin. 
 - Defect management and test management in Jira (and Xray/Zephyr or an Excel-based test repository). 
 - Browser developer tools for inspecting network calls, console errors and element states. 
 - Clear written English for test cases, defect reports and status updates. 

Good to have

- Experience with data-heavy or analytics applications: dashboards, KPIs, charts, exception or forecast reporting. 
 - Verifying Excel exports (structure, totals, filters applied) and chart values against source data. 
 - Testing chatbots or guided question flows. 
 - Exposure to AWS-hosted applications (reading CloudWatch logs, understanding environments). 
 - Basic automation awareness (Selenium, Playwright or Cypress; Postman/Newman) to flag candidates for later automation. 
 - Pharma, supply chain or S&OP domain knowledge. 
 - Familiarity with SSO/PingID or Entra ID login flows. 

Tools you will use

Key Responsibilities

- Design, develop, and execute test strategies and test plans for Reltio MDM implementations, including unit, functional, integration, regression, and performance testing. 
 - Validate Reltio data models, entity configurations, relationships, attributes, and reference data for accuracy and completeness.

 - Validate integration pipelines (batch and real-time) between Reltio and source/target systems (ERP, CRM, data lakes, APIs) for data accuracy, completeness, and timeliness.

Preferred Qualifications

data.title: Quality Manager
data.description:
HERE Technologies is a location data and technology platform company. We empower our customers to achieve better outcomes - from helping a city manage its infrastructure or a business optimize its assets to guiding drivers to their destination safely. 

At HERE we take it upon ourselves to be the change we wish to see. We create solutions that fuel innovation, provide opportunity and foster inclusion to improve people's lives. If you are inspired by an open world and driven to create positive change, join us. Learn more about us on our YouTube Channel. 

As a Quality Manager within Platform & Technology, you will be a pivotal leader driving product and process excellence, compliance, and continuous operational improvement. Operating at the intersection of Quality Management Systems (QMS) and advanced problem-solving, you will embed risk-based thinking across engineering, data, and delivery pipelines. You will lead cross-functional initiatives to institutionalize standardized quality control frameworks, oversee global certification audits, conduct rigorous root cause investigations, and deploy scalable preventive actions that eliminate defect recurrence and elevate customer satisfaction. 

What's the Role?

In this role, you will collaborate closely with cross-divisional stakeholders across the organization-including Engineering, Product Management, Operations, and Customer-facing teams-to align and govern end-to-end processes and operating models. You will act as the principal authority on quality standards and operational reliability, serving as both a strategic governance lead and a hands-on problem solver. 

From facilitating high-stakes internal and third-party ISO audits to leading multi-stakeholder task forces during critical quality escapes, you will provide the strategic direction and technical rigor needed to protect product integrity and foster a culture of quality ownership across global, distributed teams. 

Key Responsibilities

- Process Improvement & Re-engineering: Apply advanced analytical techniques, Lean Six Sigma methodologies, and Agile practices to identify bottlenecks, eliminate waste, and optimize delivery workflows for enhanced efficiency and throughput. 
 - ISO Audits & QMS Governance: Plan, facilitate, and lead internal quality assessments and external ISO 9001 surveillance/recertification audits; establish, harmonize, and maintain Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and quality manuals across global sites. 
 - Strategic Quality Leadership: Support and drive quality governance at both local and global levels; benchmark organizational practices against industry maturity frameworks (e. g. , CMMI, ASPICE, EFQM, Malcolm Baldrige). 
 - Advanced Problem Solving & RCA: Lead cross-functional teams through complex defect escapes, customer incidents, and pipeline anomalies using structured methodologies (8D, DMAIC, 5 Whys, Fishbone / Ishikawa). 
 - Closed-Loop Corrective & Preventive Actions (CAPA): Drive the end-to-end execution, tracking, and post-implementation validation of CAPA initiatives, monitoring long-term trends to ensure systemic recurrence prevention. 
 - Quality Analytics & Statistical Process Control (SPC): Define, monitor, and report key quality performance indicators (KPIs, SLAs, Cost of Poor Quality); utilize statistical process control tools to monitor process capability (SPC) and variation. 
 - Cultural Transformation & Risk Management: Institutionalize a proactive culture of Risk-Based Thinking across the business unit, integrating proactive risk assessments (e. g. , FMEA) into project lifecycles and release pipelines. 
 - Global Team & Stakeholder Leadership: Lead and mentor global quality professionals, providing strategic vision, coaching on quality tools, and aligning cross-functional teams without formal authority. 

Key Qualifications and Skills: 

- Education: Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Technology, Computer Science, Quality Management, or a related technical discipline. 
 - Experience: 10+ years of total professional experience in quality assurance, process engineering, or operational excellence, including 7-8+ years of specialized experience in QMS governance and structured problem solving. 
 - Certifications: 
 - ISO 9001 Lead Auditor Certification is required. 
 - Lean Six Sigma Green Belt is required (Black Belt is a significant advantage). 
 - Certifications/experience in CMMI, ASPICE, or EFQM / Malcolm Baldrige Business Excellence models are highly valued. 
 - Problem Solving & Quality Tools: Demonstrated mastery of structured root cause analysis (8D, DMAIC, Fishbone, 5 Whys) and risk mitigation tools (FMEA, Hazard & Risk Analysis). 
 - Statistical & Analytical Acumen: Hands-on experience implementing Quality Assurance metrics, Statistical Process Control (SPC), control charting, and data-driven trend analysis. 
 - Agile & Change Management: Proven track record of managing organizational change and driving quality practices within Agile/DevOps and continuous integration environments. 
 - Domain Knowledge (Advantage): Domain expertise in GIS / Digital Mapping, Spatial Data pipelines, Automotive OEM data workflows, or large-scale data platform ingestion is a strong plus. 
 - Tooling Proficiency: Strong working familiarity with collaboration and analytics platforms such as Jira, Jira Service Management, Confluence, Tableau / Power BI, and statistical tools (e. g. , Minitab, Excel analytics). 
 - Communication & Influence: Exceptional executive communication, stakeholder management, and facilitation skills with the ability to influence cross-functional technical teams and present insights to senior leadership. 

HERE is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, color, age, gender identity, sexual orientation, marital status, parental status, religion, sex, national origin, disability, veteran status, and other legally protected characteristics.

data.title: Principal Firmware Engineer, High-Speed Ethernet
data.description:
Description

Invent the future with us. 

Ampere is a semiconductor design company for a new era, leading the future of computing with an innovative approach to CPU design focused on high-performance, energy efficient AIcompute. 

As a pioneer in the new frontier of energy efficient high-performance computing, Ampere is part of the Softbank Group of companies driving sustainable computing for AI, Cloud, and edge applications. 

Join us at Ampere and work alongside a passionate and growing team - we'd love to have you apply!

About the role: 

We are seeking a hands-on Principal Firmware Engineer to lead the architecture, design, development, integration, and validation of low-level firmware for high-speed Ethernet solutions, including Gigabit MAC/PCS/PHY-adjacent interfaces, PTP/gPTP timing, TSN features, DMA, QoS, and platform drivers. 

This role requires a technically strong engineer who can operate at both system and register level: define firmware architecture, develop production-quality drivers, diagnose hardware/software issues on silicon, guide firmware engineers, and collaborate closely with RTL, verification, silicon validation, applications, and customers. 

The successful candidate will own critical aspects of the Ethernet firmware stack from boot-time initialization through high-throughput data-path operation, time synchronization, traffic scheduling, error handling, diagnostics, and performance characterization. 

What you'll achieve: 

Technical Architecture and Ownership

- Define firmware architecture for high-speed Ethernet subsystems supporting high speed gigabit Ethernet modes. 
 - Lead design of low-level drivers for Ethernet MAC, DMA, PCS, SerDes/PHY control interfaces, MDIO, interrupt controllers, clock/reset, and associated IP blocks. 
 - Define scalable driver state machines for initialization, configuration, link management, normal operation, diagnostics, fault recovery, and reset handling. 
 - Establish firmware interfaces and configuration models for Ethernet QoS, PTP, TSN, packet classification, DMA queues, and traffic scheduling. 
 - Identify hardware/software integration risks early and influence hardware architecture, register design, diagnostics, and verification requirements. 
 - Design firmware for high-throughput and low-latency operation for Gigabit Ethernet. 
 - Analyze and optimize CPU utilization, DMA bandwidth, memory bandwidth, interrupt load, cache behavior, and buffer utilization. 
 - Drive root-cause analysis for packet loss, descriptor corruption, DMA stalls, RX starvation, TX underflow, FIFO overflow, bus errors, and performance regressions. 
 - Ensure correct cache-coherency and memory-ordering behavior on Arm-based SoCs with coherent or non-coherent DMA. 

PTP / gPTP / Time Synchronization

- Develop and integrate firmware support for hardware timestamping and IEEE 1588 PTP / IEEE 802. 1AS gPTP. 
 - Configure and manage PTP clocks, timestamp units, clock adjustment, rollover handling, and TX/RX timestamp correlation. 
 - Support synchronization applications requiring deterministic timing and bounded timestamp latency. 
 - Develop diagnostics and performance characterization for time synchronization accuracy, offset, drift, jitter, timestamp loss, and synchronization recovery. 
 - Collaborate with system/software teams on PTP stack integration and time-domain requirements. 

TSN and Ethernet QoS

- Lead firmware enablement for relevant TSN and QoS capabilities
 - Define queue allocation, scheduling, buffer, and congestion-management policies for mixed traffic environments. 
 - Develop traffic test scenarios to validate latency, jitter, throughput, packet loss, fairness, and isolation under congested conditions. 

Bring-Up, Debug, and Validation

- Lead pre-silicon and post-silicon firmware bring-up for Ethernet subsystems. 
 - Debug complex hardware/firmware interactions
 - Develop fault-injection and negative-test scenarios
 - Drive technical resolution of customer and field escalations. 

Leadership and Collaboration

- Provide technical leadership and mentorship to firmware engineers. 
 - Lead architecture reviews, code reviews, debug reviews, and design-for-testability discussions. 
 - Establish reusable driver frameworks, coding patterns, debug utilities, and test infrastructure. 
 - Work closely with RTL, design verification, validation, software, systems, security, safety, product, and customer engineering teams. 
 - Guide junior and senior engineers toward independent ownership of firmware subsystems. 
 - Communicate technical risks, design choices, trade-offs, and milestones clearly to engineering leadership and cross-functional stakeholders. 

About you: 

- Bachelor's degree with 8 years or Master's degree with 6 years of experience in embedded firmware, device-driver, networking, or semiconductor software development experience
 - Proven hands-on experience developing low-level drivers for Ethernet MAC, DMA, PHY/PCS control, networking accelerators, or comparable high-performance peripheral IP. 
 - Strong understanding of Ethernet fundamentals including Ethernet frame format; MAC and PHY operation; VLAN / IEEE 802. 1Q; QoS / 802. 1p; link negotiation and management; MDIO/MDC; flow control; multicast and filtering. 
 - Strong experience with DMA architectures
 - Strong understanding of embedded C/C++ and low-level programming concepts: 
 - Strong Arm SoC knowledge of Cortex-A, Cortex-R, Cortex-M; 
 - Experience with IEEE 1588 PTP, gPTP, hardware timestamping, or time synchronization systems. 
 - Demonstrated ability to debug difficult system issues using hardware and software observability tools. 
 - Ability to lead technical design and influence teams across firmware, RTL, verification, and validation. 
 - Strong written and verbal communication skills. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with 25GbE, 10GbE, 40GbE, 50GbE, or other high-speed Ethernet MAC/PCS/SerDes-based systems. 
 - Experience with TSN features including IEEE 802. 1Qav, 802. 1Qbv, 802. 1Qbu, 802. 1Qci, IEEE 802. 3br, and IEEE 802. 1AS. 
 - Experience with Ethernet MACsec / IEEE 802. 1AE, MKA, replay protection, secure association management, or secure networking. 
 - Experience with high-speed packet test equipment, traffic generators, packet analyzers, and performance benchmarking. 
 - Experience with FPGA prototyping, emulation, pre-silicon firmware development, or post-silicon validation. 

What we'll offer: 

At Ampere we believe in taking care of our employees and providing a competitive total rewards package that includes base pay, cash long-term incentive, and comprehensive benefits. 

Benefits highlights include: 

- Premium medical, dental, vision insurance, parental benefits includingcrechereimbursement, as well as a retirement plan, so thatyou can feel secure in your health, financial futureand child care during work. 
 - Generous paid time off policy so that you can embrace a healthy work-life balance
 - Fully catered lunch in our office along with a variety of healthy snacks, energizing coffee or tea, and refreshing drinks to keep you fueled and focused throughout the day. 

And thereismuch more than compensation and benefits. At Ampere, we foster an inclusive culture that empowers our employees to do more and grow more. We are excited to share more about our career opportunities with you through the interview process. 

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us. 

Ampere is an inclusive and equal opportunity employer and welcomes applicants from all backgrounds. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, national origin, citizenship, religion, age, veteran and/or military status, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, physical or mental disability, or any other basis protected by federal, state or local law.

data.title: Senior Software Engineer
data.description:
Your IT Future, Delivered. 

Senior Software Engineer

With a global team of 5600+ IT professionals, DHL IT Services connects people and keeps the global economy running by continuously innovating and creating sustainable digital solutions. We work beyond global borders and push boundaries across all dimensions of logistics. You can leave your mark shaping the technology backbone of the biggest logistics company of the world. All our locations have earned the #GreatPlaceToWork certification, reflecting our commitment to exceptional employee experience. 

Digitalization. Simply delivered. 

At IT Services, we are passionate about software development. Our Store Solutions organization is growing, and we are looking for a Senior Software Engineer with a strong focus on mobile application development to strengthen our existing team in India. 

We work in an agile, product-oriented environment. The whole team shares responsibility for sprint outcomes, product quality, and continuous improvement. Our teams have end-to-end responsibility across the product lifecycle, from design and development to rollout, production support, and ongoing software maintenance. 

We use agile practices such as daily Scrum meetings, biweekly reviews, and regular retrospectives to align our work and continuously improve how we deliver value. 

Grow together. 

Our mission in Store Solutions is: 'We strive to be a business-partner- and product-centric organization that embraces end-to-end responsibility by maximizing team empowerment'. 

Our solutions provide a competitive advantage for the DHL Group by collecting and processing data from approximately 35, 000 connected devices in DHL retail stores across Germany. To enable these stores to provide postal services and sell products, we develop and maintain software products ranging from stationary point-of-sale systems to mobile solutions. Because our work directly affects the customer experience in DHL retail stores, product quality is essential

Like our company, our teams are global. We have technical teams located in Chennai, Hyderabad, Indore, Prague, Darmstadt and Bonn, each with their individual mix of people coming from different nations and working together in a hybrid work model. To help us collaborate better, we use tools like Teams, Jira, Confluence, Azure DevOps or Mural. Most importantly, we are a team that supports each other, even in tough times, with every member striving to make things better every day. 

Ready to embark on the journey? Here's what we are looking for: 

We are expanding our existing team in India. You will contribute to the development of an Android-based mobile application built with . NET MAUI that enables DHL retail stores to sell products and postal services. 

DHL also operates an established Windows desktop application based on . NET MAUI. Our long-term goal is to create a service-based, cross-platform application that can run on both mobile and desktop devices and is prepared for the future use of Microsoft Azure cloud technologies. 

We are looking for an experienced senior developer with strong software engineering expertise and proven hands-on experience with . NET MAUI. You will further develop our mobile application, contribute to the cross-platform foundation of the future product, and provide technical guidance to the team. The role offers the opportunity to grow into a technical leadership position in the medium term. 

You will join the UI/UX team, which is responsible for implementing business functionality and user-facing features in the mobile application

Your responsibilities

- Analyze and translate business requirements into maintainable technical solutions. 
 - Design and develop new business features and user interfaces for the mobile application using . NET MAUI. 
 - Create solution designs for new components and contribute to architectural decisions. 
 - Develop prototypes and proof-of-concepts to support technical and architectural decision-making. 
 - Write clean, maintainable, and testable code, including unit tests and automated system tests. 
 - Review code, refactor existing components, and promote clean-code practices. 
 - Use AI-assisted development tools responsibly to improve engineering productivity and quality. 
 - Share technical knowledge, mentor colleagues, and gradually take on greater technical leadership responsibility within the team. 
 - Contribute to architecture discussions and cross-team alignment. 
 - Drive continuous improvement in engineering practices, development processes, and the team's use of AI tools. 
 - Share responsibility for sprint outcomes, product quality, production support, and the ongoing maintenance of the software. 

What we expect from you

- At least five years of professional experience developing production-grade mobile applications, preferably for Android. 
 - Proven hands-on experience with C#, . NET, and . NET MAUI in production environments, including modern mobile UI development. Practical . NET MAUI experience is mandatory. 
 - A strong software engineering background, including system design, clean code, refactoring, automated testing, and maintainability. 
 - Experience with Git and Visual Studio. 
 - A strong understanding of business requirements and the ability to translate them into technical solutions. 
 - An analytical mindset and a structured, solution-oriented way of working. 
 - Experience working in an agile environment, ideally with Scrum. 
 - Strong communication, documentation, knowledge-sharing, and mentoring skills. 
 - The potential and ambition to grow into a technical leadership role in the medium term. 
 - A collaborative mindset, a positive can-do attitude, and the flexibility to work in an international, hybrid team. 
 - A strong sense of ownership for team outcomes and product quality. 
 - English proficiency suitable for daily collaboration in an international team. 

Nice to have

- Experience developing cross-platform applications for both mobile and desktop environments. 
 - Experience with Microsoft Azure and cloud-based or service-oriented architectures. 
 - Experience using AI-assisted software development tools in a professional environment. 
 - German language skills at B2 level or above. 

What you can expect

- A senior engineering role with the opportunity to shape a strategic cross-platform product. 
 - End-to-end product responsibility in a collaborative agile team. 
 - Close cooperation with colleagues across India, Germany, and the Czech Republic. 
 - Opportunities to grow your technical expertise, influence engineering practices, mentor others, and develop toward a technical leadership role. 

Interested? If you are passionate about mobile application development, enjoy solving complex technical challenges, and want to grow in a multicultural hybrid team, we look forward to receiving your application. 

An array of benefits for you: 

- Hybrid work arrangements to balance in-office collaboration and home flexibility. 
 - Annual Leave: 42 days off apart from Public / National Holidays. 
 - Medical Insurance: Self + Spouse + 2 children. An option to opt for Voluntary Parental Insurance (Parents / Parent -in-laws) at a nominal premium covering pre existing disease. 
 - In House training programs: professional and technical training certifications.

data.title: Senior Engineer (Fullstack), Automation Testing
data.description:
Who Are We?

Postman is the world's leading API platform, used by more than 45 million+ developers and 500, 000 organizations, including 98% of the Fortune 500. Postman is helping developers and professionals across the globe build the API-first world by simplifying each step of the API lifecycle and streamlining collaboration-enabling users to create better APIs, faster. 

The company is headquartered in San Francisco and has offices in Boston, New York, Austin, Tokyo, London, and Bangalore - where Postman was founded. Postman is privately held, with funding from Battery Ventures, BOND, Coatue, CRV, Insight Partners, and Nexus Venture Partners. Learn more at postman. com or connect with Postman on X via @getpostman. 

P. S: We highly recommend reading The "API-First World" graphic novel to understand the bigger picture and our vision at Postman. 

About The Team

Automation Testing builds how developers test and automate their APIs, from local runs and CI pipelines to scheduled and large-scale runs in the cloud. 

About The Role

You'll work across Automation Testing, starting with API mocking and simulation. As a senior engineer, you're the lead for your area, and you own the engineering and the product together. 

What You'll Do

- Own your area end to end: decide what to build and why, then design, build and ship it across the app, backend and command line
 - Work directly with customers: run quick experiments and prototypes, and turn what you learn into product and technical decisions
 - Bring a point of view: write proposals, challenge assumptions and shape the roadmap with your peers
 - Care about the details of the developer experience: UX copy, error messages, defaults and the first five minutes with the product
 - Build the skills, agents and AI workflows that let developers and coding agents test and automate their APIs
 - Make test runs fast, reliable and easy to debug, at any scale
 - Mentor engineers and raise the bar for quality on the team

What We're Looking For

- 6+ years building and shipping production software
 - Experience leading an area as its technical owner, from design through delivery and quality in production
 - A record of building customer-facing products, ideally for developers or other engineers
 - Full-stack: strong TypeScript and React, working depth in backend services, and experience building CLIs or developer tools
 - AI-forward: you use cutting-edge AI tools and coding agents every day to automate your work and operate at scale, and have built agents, skills or AI workflows into how a team works

Nice to have

- Experience with API mocking, service virtualization or contract testing
 - Experience with API testing, developer tools or test automation

What Else?

In addition to Postman's pay-on-performance philosophy, and a flexible schedule working with a fun, collaborative team, Postman offers a comprehensive set of benefits, including full medical coverage, flexible PTO, wellness reimbursement, and a monthly lunch stipend. Along with that, our wellness programs will help you stay in the best of your physical and mental health. Our frequent and fascinating team-building events will keep you connected, while our donation-matching program can support the causes you care about. We're building a long-term company with an inclusive culture where everyone can be the best version of themselves. 

At Postman we value in person collaboration. We are in office 5 days a week for all roles based out of our hubs in San Francisco Bay Area, Boston, Austin, New York City, Tokyo and London. For roles based in Bangalore, employees currently work in the office three days a week and will transition to five days per week by the end of the year. We were thoughtful in our approach which is based on collaboration and grounded in feedback from our workforce, leadership team, and peers. The benefits of our in office model will be shared knowledge, brainstorming sessions, communication, and building trust in-person that cannot be replicated via zoom. 

Our Values

At Postman, we create with the same curiosity that we see in our users. We value transparency and honest communication about not only successes, but also failures. In our work, we focus on specific goals that add up to a larger vision. Our inclusive work culture ensures that everyone is valued equally as important pieces of our final product. We are dedicated to delivering the best products we can. 

Equal Opportunity

Postman is an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action Employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, or disability status. Headhunters and recruitment agencies may not submit resumes/CVs through this website or directly to managers. Postman does not accept unsolicited headhunter and agency resumes. Postman will not pay fees to any third-party agency or company that does not have a signed agreement with Postman.

Job Description

Experience required: 4-6 years

What you will do

- Read the functional requirements, Figma designs and business rules, and write test scenarios and test cases for each screen, API and data flow, including positive, negative, boundary and empty-data cases. 
 - Test the UI: layout and behaviour against Figma, filters and cascading dropdowns, grids (sort, search, pagination, column configuration), charts, drawers, comments, exports and the chatbot flow, across supported browsers and screen sizes. 
 - Test the APIs: request and response payloads, status codes, validation and error handling, authentication tokens, pagination and filter parameters, and response times, using Postman or Swagger. 
 - Test the database: write SQL to verify that what the UI and API show matches the stored data, check calculations (KPIs, scores, percentages), data loads, snapshots and audit fields, and confirm no data is silently dropped or duplicated. 
 - Trace one business flow end to end: data in the database → API response → what the user sees → what is exported. 
 - Run SIT cycles per module, log defects with clear reproduction steps and evidence, retest fixes, and run regression before UAT. 
 - Support UAT: prepare test data and scripts for business users, triage their findings and separate defects from change requests. 
 - Maintain the requirement-to-test-case traceability matrix and share daily test status, defect counts and risks with the delivery lead. 

Must-have skills

- 3+ years of functional testing of web applications covering UI, API and database layers in the same project.

 - API testing with Postman (collections, environments, basic scripting) or Swagger/OpenAPI; understanding of REST, JSON, HTTP status codes and token-based authentication
 - (SSO/OAuth). 
 - SQL for test validation: joins, aggregations, filtering and comparisons against UI values, on PostgreSQL or a similar relational database, using a client such as DBeaver or pgAdmin. 
 - Defect management and test management in Jira (and Xray/Zephyr or an Excel-based test repository). 
 - Browser developer tools for inspecting network calls, console errors and element states.

Good to have

Tools you will use

- As a Senior Software and Firmware QA Engineer, you will work with global firmware, software, hardware, systems, application engineering, and product teams to ensure the quality of industrial controller products. 
 - You will combine hands-on system testing, test automation, defect investigation, and quality leadership across embedded firmware, software applications, communication interfaces, and hardware-software integration. 
 - Your work will include reviewing requirements, building risk-based test coverage, operating laboratory test setups, analyzing logs and traces, and providing clear release-quality recommendations. 
 - You will help improve test methods, automation, infrastructure, and engineering practices while mentoring QA engineers and driving issues to closure.

- Owning end-to-end software, firmware, and system validation activities, including test strategy, coverage, quality metrics, risk assessment, and release recommendations.

 - Performing functional, integration, system, regression, performance, reliability, compatibility, negative, and exploratory testing.

 - Integrating automated tests into CI/CD pipelines and improving automated build, execution, reporting, and traceability workflows.

 - Analyzing software logs, crash information, network traffic, protocol traces, hardware signals, and test results to isolate system-level failures. 
 - Maintaining QA environments, hardware-in-the-loop setups, simulators, automated fixtures, laboratory equipment, and test data. 
 - Collaborating with globally distributed development teams, communicating quality risks clearly, and mentoring QA engineers. 

Skills You Bring: 

- Bachelor's degree in Electronics Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field.

 - Experience creating test strategies, test plans, test cases, test procedures, validation reports, quality metrics, and release summaries. 
 - Hands-on experience testing desktop, client-server, API, user-interface, embedded, or industrial control applications. 
 - Proficiency in Python, C#, or a similar programming language used for test automation. 
 - Experience developing maintainable automated test frameworks and integrating tests into CI/CD environments. 
 - Experience with API and UI testing tools such as Postman, Selenium, Playwright, or equivalent tools. 
 - Experience analyzing logs, traces, crash data, network traffic, and system behavior to investigate complex failures. 
 - Hands-on experience with oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, protocol analyzers, or comparable debugging equipment. 
 - Excellent analytical, problem-solving, documentation, and English communication skills, with the ability to work effectively across global teams. 

Preferred Skills: 

- Experience testing embedded systems, real-time systems, and hardware-software integrated products. 
 - Experience with defect and requirements tracking tools such as Jira, Azure DevOps, or equivalent systems. 
 - Experience with version control using Git and repository platforms such as GitLab, Azure Repos, or equivalent systems. 
 - Experience with hardware-in-the-loop testing, simulators, automated test fixtures, and laboratory infrastructure. 
 - Knowledge of industrial communication protocols such as EtherCAT, DeviceNet, Modbus TCP.

Site Reliability Engineer (GCP / GKE) - Payments Platform

Location: [City] | Work mode: [Onsite / Hybrid] | Experience: 3+ years | Employment type: Full-time

About the opportunity

Our client is building a payments platform that has to stay up and secure while it scales to 50 million transactions a day. The systems team runs the cloud foundation underneath it: GCP, Kubernetes, networking, security and monitoring. 

As a Site Reliability Engineer, you will own that infrastructure from start to finish. That means designing and building it right the first time, then keeping it reliable in production. You'll work closely with network providers, banking partners, vendor support teams and internal project teams. 

Key responsibilities

Cloud infrastructure

- Set up and build out a Google Cloud (GCP) Landing Zone
 - Make infrastructure changes through Infrastructure as Code (Terraform) and automation scripts
 - Keep environments consistent, version-controlled and audit-readyKubernetes (GKE)

- Design, set up and configure GKE clusters for production workloads
 - Handle scaling, capacity planning and troubleshooting of cluster and application errors
 - Keep clusters healthy, patched and optimisedNetworking

- Design and implement VPCs, peering, segmentation, load balancers and Cloud Interconnect
 - Find and fix connectivity issues
 - Triage incidents together with network teams, interconnect providers and banking partnersSecurity and monitoring

- Implement monitoring, logging and alerting using Cloud Monitoring/Logging (Stackdriver) and Security Command Center
 - Track access, uptime and failures, and apply security best practices
 - Build dashboards and alerts that catch problems before customers notice themThird-party tools

- Implement and manage enterprise next-gen firewalls (Check Point): rules, alerts and timely upgrades
 - Set up and configure Redis Enterprise
 - Manage Envoy Proxy configuration using Ansible
 - Work with vendor support teams to resolve issues and roll out changesIncident management and operations

- Respond to and resolve critical incidents, including outages affecting many users
 - Keep customers updated proactively under SLA-based engagements
 - Write root-cause analyses (RCAs) and put permanent fixes in place

What we're looking for

Must have

- 3+ years of hands-on experience in SRE, DevOps or cloud infrastructure, covering both building and running production systems
 - Strong hands-on experience with Kubernetes (GKE preferred) in production
 - Infrastructure as Code with Terraform
 - Solid networking fundamentals: VPCs, subnets, routing, load balancing, firewalls and DNS
 - Experience with monitoring, logging and alerting tools
 - Scripting in Bash or Python, or both
 - Real on-call and incident-handling experience in productionGood to have

- Google Cloud experience, especially Landing Zone setup and Cloud Interconnect
 - Check Point or another enterprise firewall (Palo Alto, Fortinet)
 - Redis or Redis Enterprise setup and configuration
 - Envoy Proxy, and Ansible for configuration management
 - Experience in payments, banking, fintech or another high-transaction environment
 - Exposure to chaos engineeringCertifications (preferred, not mandatory)

- Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA) / Certified Kubernetes Application Developer (CKAD)
 - Google Cloud Associate Cloud Engineer, Professional Cloud Architect or Professional Cloud Network Engineer
 - HashiCorp Certified: Terraform Associate

Work schedule - please read

- This is a production support role with rotational shifts and variable week-offs
 - You need to be available for incidents outside working hours
 - Support may be needed on national and local holidays, based on business needs
 - You should be comfortable working calmly under pressure during critical incidents

Why join

- Scale: build systems for India-scale payments, with a target of 50 million transactions a day
 - Learn from first principles: an internal "school" for distributed systems that speeds up how fast you learn
 - Production is your playground: use modern chaos engineering to break systems on purpose, find weak points and make them resilient
 - Ownership: you design it, run it and improve it, not just maintain someone else's setup
 - Team culture: work with people who want to understand how things really work

Who will thrive here

- System builders who think from first principles
 - Chaos engineers who'd rather bring a system down on purpose than have it fail by surprise
 - Responsible SREs who want to be confident that what they build stays up

We take smart risks and Innovate Boldly, setting new standards and learning from every experience. Integrity First is our cornerstone-we value humility, authenticity, and respect for diversity, building trust in all we do. We Embrace Curiosity by empowering you to experiment, learn, and grow in a dynamic environment. At Cyara, our values drive us forward, shaping a culture where innovation and excellence thrive. 

Cyara's Diversity, Equity, Inclusive and Belonging: 

At Cyara, we are dedicated to fostering a workplace that embodies equal opportunity and champions diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging (DEIB). We strive to cultivate an environment where every individual feels valued, respected, and empowered to bring their whole selves to work, contributing unique perspectives and talents. Our commitment includes continuously evaluating and enhancing our policies, practices, and culture to align with our DEIB principles. We ensure a discrimination-free environment where individuals are evaluated solely on their merits and abilities, regardless of legally protected statuses such as sex, race, color, ethnicity, national origin, age, religion, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, or medical condition. By celebrating our differences and championing inclusivity, we enrich our organization, make more thoughtful decisions, and drive collective success. 

Role Overview
The Tech Lead - NOC / Infrastructure Engineering will drive the reliability, scalability, and

operational excellence of critical systems and infrastructure. This role blends deep technical

expertise with leadership responsibilities, including guiding a team of engineers, defining best

practices, and leading automation and transformation initiatives. 

The ideal candidate will act as a technical authority across cloud (AWS), networking, telephony

(VOIP/GSM), monitoring, and incident management domains, while championing Infrastructure as

Code (IaC), AI-driven operations, and continuous improvement. 

Key Responsibilities
Technical Leadership & Strategy

 Act as the primary technical authority for NOC operations and infrastructure engineering. 

 Define architecture standards, operational best practices, and automation strategies. 

 Drive adoption of SRE principles, including reliability engineering, error budgets, and

capacity planning. 

 Lead technical decision-making and design reviews across infrastructure and operations. 

Infrastructure & Automation

 Architect, design, and implement infrastructure using Terraform (IaC). 

 Lead automation initiatives to eliminate manual tasks and improve operational efficiency. 

 Develop reusable modules, pipelines, and frameworks for scalable infrastructure

deployment. 

 Promote CI/CD practices for infrastructure and operational workflows

Cloud & Platform Engineering

Own and optimize AWS cloud environments (compute, networking, storage, security). 

 Ensure cost efficiency, high availability, and scalability of cloud resources. 

 Drive cloud governance, security best practices, and compliance adherence. 

Networking & Telephony Systems

Oversee design and operations of networking infrastructure (routing, switching, VPNs, 

firewalls). 

 Lead management of VOIP systems, SIP trunks, PSTN, and GSM gateways. 

 Troubleshoot complex telecommunication and network issues across distributed systems

Monitoring, Incident & Reliability Management

 Define and implement monitoring and observability strategy (Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, 

etc. ). 

 Lead major incident response (P1/P2), acting as Incident Commander when required. 

 Drive proactive issue detection, alert tuning, and noise reduction. 

 Ensure high-quality Root Cause Analysis (RCA) and track corrective/preventive actions. 

Change Management & Operational Governance

 Ensure adherence to ITIL processes for incident, problem, and change management. 

 Review and approve high-risk changes and deployments. 

 Continuously improve operational playbooks and SOPs. 

AI & Continuous Improvement

 Identify and implement AI/ML-driven solutions for predictive monitoring and automation. 

 Drive innovation initiatives to improve operational maturity and reduce MTTR. 

 Evaluate new tools and technologies for operational enhancement. 

Reporting & Stakeholder Communication

 Provide leadership-level reporting on system health, incidents, SLAs, and KPIs. 

 Build dashboards and insights using Excel, Power BI, or similar tools. 

 Collaborate with cross-functional teams including Product, Engineering and Support. 

Required Skills & Qualifications
Technical Expertise

 Strong hands-on experience with Terraform, AWS, and infrastructure automation. 

 Deep understanding of networking protocols (TCP/IP, VLANs, VPNs, DNS, etc. ). 

 Expertise in VOIP, SIP, PSTN, and GSM gateway systems. 

 Experience with monitoring/observability tools (Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, etc. ). 

 Working knowledge of AI/ML use cases in operations (AIOps). 

 Familiarity with ticketing systems (ServiceNow, Jira). 

 Working knowledge of MSSQL, Oracle, PostgreSQL, MySQL, and related database

technologies, including monitoring, performance analysis, troubleshooting, upgrades, 

patching, and failover activities. 

 Experience supporting highly available database environments, including backup/recovery

validation, replication monitoring, upgrade coordination, failover testing, and incident

management in collaboration with DBA teams. 

Process & Leadership
Strong expertise in ITIL processes (Incident, Change, Problem Management). 

 Proven experience in leading technical teams and handling escalations. 

 Ability to design and enforce operational standards and governance. 

Soft Skills
Excellent problem-solving and analytical thinking. 

 Strong communication and stakeholder management skills. 

 Ability to lead under pressure during critical incidents. 

Experience
6-10 years in NOC, SRE, or infrastructure roles. 

 Minimum 2-3 years in a technical lead / senior leadership role. 

Preferred Qualifications
AWS Certified Solutions Architect / SysOps Administrator

 HashiCorp Terraform Associate

 ITIL Foundation Certification

 Networking certifications (CCNA or equivalent)

 VOIP/SIP certifications

 Experience with Python/Bash scripting

 Exposure to AIOps or predictive analytics tools

Cvent is a leading meetings, events, and hospitality technology provider with more than 6, 000+ employees and 34, 000+ customers worldwide, including 60% of the Fortune 500. Founded in 1999, Cvent delivers a comprehensive event marketing and management platform for marketers and event professionals and offers software solutions to hotels, special event venues and destinations to help them grow their group/MICE and corporate travel business. Our technology brings millions of people together at events around the world. In short, we're transforming the meetings and events industry through innovative technology that powers the human connection. 

Cvent's strength lies in its people, fostering a culture where everyone is encouraged to think like entrepreneurs, taking risks and making decisions confidently. We value diverse perspectives and celebrate differences, working together with colleagues and clients to build strong connections. 

AI at Cvent: Leading the Future: 

Are you ready to shape the future of work at the intersection of human expertise and AI innovation? At Cvent, we're committed to continuous learning and adaptation-AI isn't just a tool for us, it's part of our DNA. We're looking for candidates who are eager to evolve alongside technology. If you love to experiment boldly, share your discoveries, and help define best practices for AI-augmented work, you'll thrive here. Our team values professionals who thoughtfully integrate AI into their daily work, delivering exceptional results while relying on the human judgment and creativity that drive real innovation. 

Throughout our interview process, you'll have the chance to demonstrate how you use AI to learn, iterate, and amplify your impact. If you're excited to be part of a team that's leading the way in AI-powered collaboration, we'd love to meet you. 

Recruitment Scam Notice: Beware of recruitment scams. Legitimate Cvent recruiting communications will come from accounts formatted as "name@cvent. com" email address. Cvent will never request payment or ask for sensitive personal or financial information through chat or social media platforms. Cvent is not responsible for losses or damages arising from communications, payments, or disclosures made to third parties impersonating Cvent. 

If you believe a communication may be fraudulent, we strongly recommend that you don't respond and report the incident at recruitingindia@cvent. com. 

For more information, visit Cvent's Recruitment Fraud Notice. https: //www. cvent. com/en/notice-recruitment-fraud. 

Position Description: 

As a Principal SRE, you will set the technical direction for how Cvent scales, secures and operates its platforms, and you will mentor others while helping Cvent both envision and achieve its DevSecOps goals. Strong AI and automation skills are required, and candidates with hands-on WAF and security exposure are especially valued. 

This role is open in Bangalore and Gurgaon. 

We are looking for someone with the drive, ownership and ability to take on challenging problems, both technical and process related, in a dynamic, collaborative and highly distributed, multi-disciplinary team. You will use your background as a generalist to work closely with product development teams, Information Security, Cloud Infrastructure and other SRE teams to keep our platforms secure, and you must be able to see the big picture and solve hard multi-disciplinary problems with others. Technical depth in cloud operations, the software development lifecycle and security vulnerability management will help you, but excellent mentorship, communication and the ability to drive alignment are must-haves. We use SRE principles such as blameless postmortems and a focus on automation to keep improving our knowledge and maintain a good quality of life. 

Responsibilities: 

- Enlighten, enable and empower a fast-growing set of multi-disciplinary teams across multiple applications and locations. 
 - Tackle complex development, automation and business process problems, and champion Cvent standards and best practices. 
 - Ensure the scalability, performance and resilience of security-related systems and processes. 
 - Work with product development teams, Information Security, Cloud Automation and other SRE teams to build a holistic understanding of security concerns and resolve them effectively and efficiently. 
 - Identify recurring problems and anti-pattens in development, operational and security processes. 
 - Develop build, test and deployment automation that seamlessly targets multiple on-premises and AWS regions. 
 - Give back by working on and contributing to open-source projects. What we are looking for: 

Experience: 10 to 15 years in SRE, DevSecOps or DevOps, with significant time in a lead, staff or principal role. 

- AI and automation: a proven track record applying AI, automation and ML to improve reliability, operational efficiency and developer productivity, for example AI-assisted alert triage, event grouping and incident response. 
 - Deep fluency in AWS across multi-account, multi-region and high-traffic environments, with a strong foundation in distributed systems and Infrastructure as Code (CloudFormation, CDK or Terraform). 
 - Demonstrable leadership in scaling SRE practices: CI/CD, observability, incident management, RCAs and blameless postmortems. 
 - Incident management experience: able to act as Incident Commander, write clear incident summaries, drive RCA, and coordinate resolution across teams under pressure. 
 - Strong understanding of CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins or equivalent), PR-based deployment workflows, and troubleshooting pipeline failures in distributed environments. 
 - Change management discipline: communicating changes proactively, documenting rollout strategies, and managing phased production deployments with rollback plans. 
 - Fluent in at least one scripting or programming language such as Python, Go, TypeScript, JavaScript, Ruby or Bash, with solid Linux and networking fundamentals. 
 - Experience with APM, monitoring and logging tools (Datadog, New Relic, Splunk, Prometheus, Grafana). 
 - Excellent communication skills and a track record of driving alignment across multi-disciplinary teams, plus a passion for mentoring and making things better for your peers. 
 - Experience with SDLC methodologies (preferably Agile). WAF and security exposure (strongly preferred; candidates with hands-on experience are prioritised)

- AWS WAF: rule authoring, rate-based rules, Bot Control integration, rule group management, and multi-product WAF sharing strategies (e. g. , managing rule limits across applications sharing the same WebACL). 
 - DDoS protection with AWS Shield Advanced, including moving endpoints from count to block mode and building observability (Lambda + CloudWatch alarms). 
 - CDN experience, ideally Amazon CloudFront, as part of a layered security posture with WAF and Shield. 
 - Bot mitigation strategies, including AWS Bot Control, token-based traffic classification, JA4+ASN fingerprinting, and evaluation of third-party vendors (e. g. , Datadome). Good to Have Skills

- Disaster recovery planning and execution: multi-region failover, DR runbooks, and RTO/RPO management. 
 - Experience managing API Gateways and ALBs as part of a layered security posture. 
 - Experience with APM, monitoring and logging tools (Datadog, New Relic, Splunk). 
 - Good understanding of containerization concepts: Docker, ECS, EKS, Kubernetes. 
 - Experience managing 3-tier application stacks. 
 - Understanding of basic networking concepts. 
 - Familiarity with risk assessment and management concepts and practices.

data.title: Senior Quality Control Manager
data.description:
> Role Objective: 

A key objective of this role is to oversee and ensure the implementation of Good Practices within the Quality Control Department. They will be responsible for maintaining standard operating procedures (SOPs), conducting testing in adherence to written procedures and managing the analysis of various samples. Additionally, they will play a crucial role in method validation, calibration of instruments, training of personnel, and ensuring compliance with regulatory standards. 

> Desired Candidate Profile: 

- Bachelor's or master's degree in Organic Chemistry or Biochemistry, with a focus on analytical chemistry with minimum 12-14 years of experience in pharmaceutical Quality Control/Medical Device, with expertise on comprehensive understanding of analytical instrumentation and Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP). 
 - Strong problem-solving abilities, excellent communication skills, and the capacity to work independently under pressure are essential qualities for this role. 

> Roles & Responsibilities: 

1. Good Practices Maintenance: 

- Ensure adherence to Good Practices in the Quality Control (QC) department. 

2. Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs): 

- Develop, implement, and follow SOPs in the QC department. Ensure all testing procedures comply with written protocols or compendial methods. 

3. Sample Management: 

- Plan and manage the daily analysis of samples, including raw materials, packaging materials, finished products, intermediates, in-process samples, stability samples, and routine analysis. Perform sampling, analysis, and report results as required. 

Oversee the proper destruction of leftover samples post-analysis. 

4. Analytical Methodology: 

- Conduct Analytical Method Transfer (AMT) and Analytical Method Validation & Verification (AMV) as needed. Prepare and maintain working standards, reference standards, and ensure their qualification. 

5. System Registration and Reporting: 

- Ensure timely registration of samples in the system and prepare monthly reports. Record raw data and analytical results accurately in analytical logs. 

6. Training and Compliance: 

- Provide on-the-job training to new QC team members. Ensure lab incidents, out-of-specification (OOS) results, out-of-trend (OOT) events, and any deviations are reported and logged for further investigation.
