data.title: Lead Full Stack Developer (.NET & Angular)
data.description:
Lead Full Stack Developer - AI-Forward Development (. NET & Angular)

Saisystems Health is hiring a Lead Full Stack Developer with 9+ years of . NET and Angular experience, a US healthcare background and a track record of AI-forward engineering to lead technical delivery on ECM, our enterprise claims management platform. 

About the role

The Lead owns technical direction and delivery quality for an ECM squad: setting architecture and coding standards, reviewing critical changes, mentoring developers, and still shipping hands-on code across Angular, . NET and T-SQL. Roughly half the role is hands-on engineering; the rest is design, review, planning and people leadership. 

The product. ECM manages the full claim lifecycle for US healthcare provider organisations: patient and encounter capture, coding and charge entry, eligibility, a configurable business-rules engine, clearinghouse claim transmission, ERA/835 payment posting, denial and AR work queues, patient statements, credentialing and executive reporting. 

The engineering problem. ECM is a mature, high-volume, multi-tenant SaaS platform with tens of millions of claim and transaction rows, external BI consumers on the same database, and scheduled automation alongside the API. The Lead decides how new features and modernisation - performance, observability, test coverage, security hardening and debt reduction - are sequenced in a system that cannot stop running. 

Why AI-forward. The Lead sets how the team uses AI: which tools and workflows are approved, how AI-assisted code is reviewed, and where AI measurably improves throughput and quality - while keeping PHI and secrets out of external tools. 

Key responsibilities

Technical leadership and architecture

- Own the technical design of features and modernisation work across Angular, ASP. NET Core and Azure SQL; write design notes and lead design reviews. 
 - Define and enforce coding standards, layering (controller → interface → service → stored procedure), API contracts and Angular/NgRx patterns. 
 - Lead decomposition of oversized services and components, and plan incremental refactoring without disrupting production. 
 - Drive database performance: indexing strategy, execution-plan analysis, Query Store regressions and locking against concurrent BI reads. 
 - Shape the architecture of healthcare integrations - X12 EDI (837, 835, 277CA, 999), clearinghouse SFTP, ERA auto-posting and payer interfaces. 

AI-forward engineering leadership

- Set the team's AI development practice: approved tools, prompting and context-management techniques, and agentic workflows for multi-file changes, test generation and migration. 
 - Define review standards for AI-assisted code, with added scrutiny for stored procedures, EDI processing and production data paths. 
 - Identify, prototype and measure AI use cases in the workflow and the product (for example, test-case design, code review assistance, denial analysis or document extraction) within approved, HIPAA-compliant tooling. 
 - Coach developers on effective, verified AI use and share reusable prompts and playbooks across teams. 

Delivery and quality

- Break down epics into estimable work with the Development Manager and product owners; own sprint technical commitments. 
 - Review pull requests on critical paths and run pre-merge impact assessment across develop → QA → UAT → staging → production. 
 - Raise unit and integration test coverage (xUnit, Moq, Jasmine/Karma) and partner with QA on regression strategy. 
 - Lead diagnosis of production incidents using Application Insights, logs and Query Store; run root-cause reviews and track fixes. 
 - Maintain a prioritised technical-debt backlog and balance it against feature delivery. 

People and collaboration

- Mentor and grow developers through pairing, code review and design feedback; contribute to hiring and onboarding. 
 - Act as the technical point of contact for US-based product and business stakeholders, translating requirements into clear designs and realistic estimates. 
 - Communicate status, risks and trade-offs clearly in writing for asynchronous, cross-time-zone work. 

Security and compliance

- Ensure HIPAA and secure-by-default practices are designed in: minimum-necessary data access, audit logging, secrets in Key Vault, least-privilege access and no PHI in logs, tickets or AI tools. 
 - Review designs for audit, access-control and data-retention requirements. 

Required qualifications

Experience

- 9+ years of professional software development, with deep full stack experience in . NET and Angular on production systems. 
 - 3+ years in a technical lead, tech lead or senior-lead role - owning design, code review and delivery for a team of developers. 
 - 3+ years working on US healthcare software - revenue cycle management, medical billing, claims, practice management, EHR or payer systems. 

. NET, database and architecture

- Expert C# and ASP. NET Core Web API (. NET 6 or later), with EF Core and/or Dapper; strong grasp of layered architecture, SOLID and dependency injection. 
 - Advanced SQL Server / T-SQL: designing schemas and indexes, tuning complex stored procedures, reading execution plans and resolving locking and blocking at scale. 
 - Proven experience refactoring and modernising a large, live codebase incrementally. 

Angular

- Expert Angular (12+) with TypeScript, RxJS and NgRx or another Redux-style store; able to set front-end architecture and standards for a team. 

AI-forward engineering

- Demonstrated daily use of AI development platforms - Claude / Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT / Codex, Cursor or similar - including agentic workflows on a large codebase. 
 - Experience introducing or standardising AI tooling for a team, with clear review and verification practices. 
 - Can show examples of measurable gains (throughput, test coverage, defect reduction) from AI-assisted work, and of catching flawed AI output. 

Healthcare domain

- Strong knowledge of the claim lifecycle: charge entry, claim submission, adjudication, remittance, denials and AR follow-up. 
 - Hands-on experience with HIPAA X12 transactions (837, 835, 277CA, 999) and CMS-1500 / UB-04 claim formats. 
 - Working understanding of the HIPAA Priv

Leadership and practice

- Git, pull-request workflow and CI/CD on Azure DevOps or similar; experience defining branching and release processes. 
 - Track record of mentoring developers and leading design and code reviews. 
 - Clear written and verbal communication with US-based stakeholders. 
 - Willing to work from the Pune office full time. 

Preferred qualifications

- Experience integrating LLM APIs (Azure OpenAI, Anthropic, OpenAI) into . NET applications - prompt design, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), structured output, evaluation and cost control - within HIPAA-compliant boundaries. 
 - Experience shipping AI features in RCM, such as denial prediction, coding assistance, document extraction or claim scrubbing. 
 - Deep Microsoft Azure experience: App Service, WebJobs, Blob Storage, Key Vault, Service Bus, Redis, Application Insights, Entra ID; infrastructure-as-code (Bicep or Terraform). 
 - Multi-tenant SaaS architecture, message-driven design and background-job orchestration. 
 - EDI tooling such as EdiFabric; clearinghouse onboarding and payer connectivity. 
 - Observability practice: structured logging (Serilog), distributed tracing, SLOs and alerting. 
 - Reporting or BI exposure (Power BI, SSRS) and designing for concurrent BI workloads. 
 - Certifications (any of): Azure Developer Associate (AZ-204), Azure Solutions Architect Expert (AZ-305), Azure AI Engineer Associate (AI-102), or healthcare coursework such as AAPC or HFMA. 

Education: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related field - or equivalent demonstrable professional experience. What you have built, shipped and led counts more than the credential. 

Core competencies and success measures

Leadership competencies

- Technical judgement - makes sound trade-offs between speed, quality and risk in a live, regulated system. 
 - Evidence over assertion - backs decisions on performance and impact with measurements. 
 - Production respect - weighs every change for its effect on live claims, payments and data. 
 - Multiplier mindset - raises the team's output through mentoring, standards and shared AI practice, not just personal output. 
 - Clear written communication - design notes, status and risk updates that work across time zones. 

Compliance, security and responsible AI use

- ECM processes Protected Health Information (PHI). All engineers complete HIPAA training and are bound by Saisystems Health security and confidentiality policies. 
 - The Lead is accountable for the team following these rules and for raising compliance risks early. 
 - No PHI, patient data, credentials, production connection strings or confidential business data is ever entered into an external or unapproved AI tool. 
 - AI is an accelerator, not a substitute for engineering judgement; accountability for correctness stays with the engineer and the reviewing Lead. 
 - AI-generated code is reviewed to the same standard as hand-written code, with added scrutiny for stored procedures, EDI processing and production data paths. 
 - Secure-by-default habits: no PHI in logs, tickets, screenshots or non-production data; least-privilege access; secrets in Key Vault, never in source. 
 - Employment is subject to a background check and a signed confidentiality agreement. 

Equal opportunity: Saisystems Health is an equal opportunity employer. HR to confirm the standard EEO statement and any compensation or benefits wording before posting.

The Connetic Account-to-Account organization owns high-value payment processing, instant payment processing and batch payment processing end to end. As Senior Manager, Software Engineering, you'll lead the teams who build and run it - on infrastructure that is cloud-native, with AI-assisted engineering practices built into how the organization works day to day, not treated as a separate initiative. 

What You'll Own

Our Tech Stack
You don't need full hands-on competency in this stack, but you should be fluent enough to review designs, make staffing calls, and comfortable enough to earn credibility with the team building on it.

- Containers & Kubernetes - working knowledge sufficient to evaluate infrastructure decisions across multiple teams

- Cloud platforms - working familiarity with Azure; exposure to AWS a plus

- CI/CD & DevOps - comfortable evaluating pipeline standards across teams, not just one

What You Bring
You don't need to check every box below to apply - if most of this resonates, we want to hear from you. 
- 9+ years of professional software engineering experience, including 2+ years managing other managers, tech leads, or multiple teams directly

- Strong critical thinking applied across a broader, less clearly-defined set of problems - you're comfortable when principles alone don't fully apply

- Strong systems thinking across multiple teams' systems, spotting where complexity crosses team boundaries

- Solid grounding in SaaS and cloud-native fundamentals, applied at a multi-team level

- Genuine curiosity that drives you to dig into problems that don't have a strategic direction yet

- A track record of leading through other leaders - developing managers and senior ICs, not just individual engineers

- Strong understanding of software architecture across multiple systems or domains

- Working familiarity with major cloud platforms, container orchestration, and CI/CD at a multi-team scale

- A track record of using AI-assisted engineering as a lever across a broader organization

- Demonstrated ability to persuade senior stakeholders in sensitive or complex situations while preserving relationships

- Excellent communication with executives, peers, and the teams several levels below you

Bonus Points
- Experience in payments, financial services, or another regulated industry

- Experience managing distributed or remote teams across multiple time zones

- A track record of turning around an underperforming team or function

- Experience owning a departmental budget

What We Offer
- Lead engineering for a platform processing mission-critical payment transactions for financial institutions worldwide

- Be part of a truly global product development organization - real centers of engineering excellence spread across multiple regions, organized around product families and technical capabilities rather than geography for its own sake, with engineers everywhere shaping our core products and technical direction

- A cloud-native, automation-first engineering culture that treats quality, security, and developer experience as competitive advantages, not compliance checkboxes

- Real leadership growth - ACI actively develops managers into senior engineering leaders; your trajectory here is yours to define

- An organization that holds managers accountable for AI adoption outcomes, not just tool advocacy - you'll have real latitude to drive that

- Hybrid model - typically 2-3 days in-office across ACI's global hub locations

- Some domestic and international travel (10-15%) for team meetings, conferences, or cross-site collaboration

- Flexible schedule, with occasional extended hours around critical releases or team needs

Equal Opportunity & Compliance
ACI Worldwide is an Equal Opportunity Employer; all qualified applicants are considered without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status. This role requires adherence to ACI's Code of Business Conduct and Ethics, and - given access to sensitive payment data - compliance with applicable security and data-protection standards (PCI-DSS, SOC 2, GDPR, CCPA). Comprehensive background screening is required. Responsibilities may evolve with business needs.

data.title: VP Engineer/CTO
data.description:
Indiranagar, Bengaluru

Reports to the Founder

6-10 years | Full-time, 

Founding leadership role

Build the tech that helps save lives on India's roads. 

India lost 1. 77 lakh lives on its roads in 2024, about 20 every hour (MoRTH). Lane exists to bring that number to zero. One journey takes each customer from first lesson to licence to first car: 5, 000+ learners, 60+ instructors and 50, 000+ hours taught since January 2025. Backed by Kae Capital, DeVC, Antler India, Panthera Peak and angels. 

Our next chapter is LaneBuddy. It turns a smartphone into a driving sensor, reading 150-200 data points a second to detect risky manoeuvres as they happen and coach the driver to correct them. What you build will be used by government, enterprises and, in time, millions of drivers. 

Backed by government: Karnataka Home Minister Priyank Kharge has publicly backed LaneBuddy

under the state's Urban Mobility Mission, and Bengaluru Traffic Police is working with us on it. The

stakes are high: it has to work, every time. 

What you'll own

- The entire stack: customer and instructor apps, RTO and licensing, car commerce, internal tools and LaneBuddy, joined into one customer record from first lesson to first car. 
 - Lane Buddy: grow it from detection model into products that correct risky habits before they become accidents, reward safe drivers through insurance and give authorities a clear view of road risk. 
 - The data layer: secure, reliable pipelines for high-frequency sensor and product data at scale, with DPDP-compliant consent and sharing, built to a standard governments and enterprises can depend on.

In 12 months: LaneBuddy's detection and intervention model is live in the customer and instructor apps, its first government and enterprise partnerships are running, and the platform and team are ready for scale. 

Who you are

- You have taken a product from scratch to scale in fast-moving startups and owned the customer journey end to end. 
 - You have built systems that process very large volumes of data, ideally high-frequency telemetry, and kept them reliable in production. 
 - You hold a high bar for quality and security; large customers or regulators have trusted your systems.

Staff Engineer - Trust, Controls & Safety

Location: Remote / India

About the Company

Our client is a fast-growing, AI-powered business operating system that gives agencies, entrepreneurs and SMBs the infrastructure to build, automate and scale. The platform supports over 1 million businesses across 150+ countries and has generated billions of dollars in ecosystem value for its customers. 

Behind the product is serious scale: billions of API hits and message events every day, hundreds of terabytes of distributed data, and 250+ microservices. The company is a global, remote-first organisation of 2, 000+ people across 10+ countries, built for speed and ownership. 

About the Team

Even a simple configuration error can lead to significant unintended usage. The Trust, Controls & Safety team builds the safeguards that protect customers and the platform from both accidental surges and intentional abuse. 

As Staff Engineer, you will lead the technical direction of a real-time platform that secures critical workflows: signups, SaaS checkouts, user management and global communication usage. The system processes 160M+ events and $4M+ in transactions every day. 

The challenge is to build a highly available, low-latency control plane that balances strict enforcement with a seamless user experience. By combining synchronous metering with asynchronous signal correlation, you will help the platform stay ahead of evolving fraud vectors while legitimate business activity continues without friction. Getting this right means customers stop receiving bills they never intended, and abuse stops being a cost the honest majority carries. 

What You'll Do

- Architecture: Set the technical direction for the trust and controls platform, including metering, rules and policy engines, velocity checks and enforcement. 
 - Data systems: Redesign and optimise data models, queries and indexing across MongoDB, Firestore and ElasticSearch. 
 - Search at scale: Own ElasticSearch reliability, covering ingestion, indexing, shard strategy and query performance across billions of documents. 
 - Reliability and performance: Eliminate bottlenecks, improve replication health, and keep query and index latency predictable. 
 - System design: Define data flows and integration boundaries between storage, cache and APIs, with clear contracts and fault isolation. 
 - Observability: Build visibility into every data path, including metrics, traces, slow-query logs, replication lag and cluster health dashboards. 
 - Quality: Enforce unit, integration and load testing standards across backend modules. 
 - Engineering culture: Drive RFCs, ADRs and design reviews, and codify patterns that make good engineering repeatable. 
 - Hands-on leadership: Write code, design systems and debug production issues. Lead by technical example. 
 - Mentorship: Level up engineers across squads, and partner with EMs, PMs, Finance, Risk, Support and channel teams. 

What We're Looking For

- 8+ years building high-scale, mission-critical backend systems where p99 regressions are unacceptable. 
 - Deep expertise in distributed systems: concurrency, event-driven architectures and consistency primitives such as CAS, atomic dry-runs and idempotency. 
 - Experience with systems where correctness has direct financial consequences: metering, ledgers, billing, payment gateways, reservations or similar transactional domains. 
 - Strong experience with relational and NoSQL data models, especially complex transactional data, plus working knowledge of streaming and analytical stores for time-windowed aggregation. 
 - Experience designing policy- or rules-driven systems that change through configuration rather than deploys, including versioning, safe rollout and rollback. 
 - Sound judgement on the enforcement trade-off: setting thresholds and actions that stop real harm without punishing legitimate customers, and measuring whether you got it right. 
 - Familiarity with monitoring, SLOs and root-cause analysis in production. 
 - A track record of technical leadership without formal authority: driving cross-team architecture to a decision and writing designs others build from. 
 - Excellent communication and collaboration with Finance, Risk and Support stakeholders. 
 - A pragmatic, hands-on approach that balances long-term vision with iterative execution. 

Preferred Experience

- Building fraud, abuse or adversarial defence systems at scale: rules engines, velocity checks, risk scoring. 
 - Hands-on production experience with Go and Node. js on latency-sensitive, high-throughput paths. 
 - Redis (including Lua), Kafka, Flink or Kafka Streams, and ClickHouse or BigQuery for real-time aggregation. 
 - Experience taking early architecture through to a load-bearing platform during hyper-growth. 
 - Exposure to billing and metered systems, and to AI tooling, including hallucination-mitigation approaches. 

Nice to Have

- ElasticSearch cluster management, multi-tenant indexing or lifecycle policies. 
 - OLAP systems such as ClickHouse. 
 - Open-source contributions or public technical writing on systems design or database performance.

data.title: Senior Backend Engineer
data.description:
Who We Are

ParamAIQ is an applied-AI company building NyaayOS, the reasoning layer for Indian law. We turn the primary sources of Indian law, from the BNS, BNSS and BSA to decades of Supreme Court and High Court precedent, into something any advocate can stand on. Work that took days takes minutes. 

India has more than 55 million pending cases, and the outcome for a litigant can turn on who they can afford. We're building the foundation that gives an independent lawyer the same analytical leverage as a partner at a leading firm, and we build it with practising lawyers, not just for them. 

Why This Role Matters

You own the platform every part of ParamAIQ is built on. The app, the AI features, the integrations for law firms: all of it runs through the API and services layer you build. When a lawyer trusts us with a confidential matter and expects it to be fast, correct, and private, your systems are what make that true. 

This is a senior, deeply hands-on role. You make the architectural calls, and you write the code that matters most. In legal software a bug is not cosmetic: it is a confidential matter exposed or a filing that fails, so we want senior people who get the foundations right the first time. 

What You'll Own

- The product API and services layer: The architecture and the code. 
 - AI feature systems: Long-running, sometimes-failing operations that still feel fast and reliable to a lawyer under deadline. 
 - Multi-tenant isolation: Strong enough that one firm's matters are provably invisible to another. In legal, a cross-tenant leak is the worst thing that can happen. 
 - Data models for legal work: Matters, drafts, versions, and audit trails that stay coherent as the product grows. 
 - Reliability, performance, and cost: As the system scales. 
 - The rest of the product surface: Authentication, billing, uploads, exports, and notifications. 

The Hard Problems You'll Take On

- Making unreliable, slow AI operations feel dependable: Model calls fail, time out, and cost money. The orchestration, idempotency, and graceful degradation that hide this from a lawyer is a real systems problem. 
 - Isolation you can prove: Not just separating tenants, but demonstrating and testing that separation across every path in the product. 
 - Getting the foundations right early: The data models, contracts, and access control you set now are the hardest to change later, and the most expensive to get wrong once real client data is flowing. 

What You Bring

- 4+ years of backend engineering in Python, with a framework like FastAPI, Django, or Flask
 - You design systems, not just features: you reason about scale, reliability, cost, and failure, and you defend your calls
 - You've built multi-tenant SaaS with real data isolation between customers
 - Strong API and service design: contracts, versioning, idempotency, rate limiting, backpressure
 - Solid PostgreSQL: schema, indexing, transactions, performance
 - Real command of auth: OAuth, OIDC, JWT, sessions, RBAC
 - You write careful code and test the paths that matter, because you know what a mistake costs here
 - Ready to work from our Mumbai office, full-time

Bonus Points

- 0-to-1 and early scale: you've taken a system from first version to real load and know what breaks first
 - Performance and reliability work: profiling, load testing, and finding the failure before it reaches a user
 - Async and background job systems (Celery, RQ) at scale
 - Payments and billing systems (Razorpay, Stripe, or similar) and their failure modes
 - Legal-tech, regtech, fintech, healthtech, or another regulated, trust-sensitive domain
 - DPDPA, Indian data residency, and security practice

What You Get

- Real ownership of the platform and the architectural calls behind it, from day one
 - The chance to get the foundations right on a product handling confidential legal matters
 - Work shoulder to shoulder with practising lawyers on a product built for real legal work
 - A hand in making justice more accessible in one of the largest judicial systems on earth

Company Description Original Marines S. p. A. is a well-established Italian company specializing in the production and distribution of casual wear and sportswear, with a strong focus on offering excellent value for money. Founded in 1983, the brand initially gained success with plain white T-shirts inspired by Marine uniforms, selling millions of pieces within a few years. Building on this success, Original Marines expanded into retail, opening its first single-brand store in 1993 and rapidly growing a large franchise network across Italy. Over the years, the company has continued to grow internationally, developing a broad presence in Europe, Asia, Africa, and South America. Today, Original Marines operates more than 600 single-brand stores worldwide, offering significant opportunities in a dynamic, global fashion environment. 

Role Description The QAM (Quality Assurance Manager) role at Original Marines S. p. A. is a full-time, on-site position based in Tiruppur. The role is responsible for overseeing quality assurance processes for apparel production, ensuring products meet company standards, customer expectations, and regulatory requirements. Day-to-day tasks include defining and implementing quality control procedures, performing inspections and audits at various stages of the production cycle, and monitoring compliance with technical specifications and brand guidelines. The QAM will collaborate closely with production, sourcing, and design teams to address quality issues, propose corrective actions, and support continuous improvement initiatives. This position also involves maintaining detailed documentation, preparing quality reports, and supporting training activities related to quality and best practices on the shop floor.

data.title: Security test engineer
data.description:
Position Overview

The Security Test Engineer will join the ITG CDF team (BNP Paribas Group) and focus on mobile security testing. The role involves performing penetration tests, static and dynamic analysis, and reverse‐engineering of Android and iOS applications, as well as supporting web‐ and API‐level assessments. 

Job Responsibilities

Direct Responsibilities

- Conduct Gray‐Box/Black‐Box penetration testing for Web, Mobile, API, and thick‐client applications. 
 - Perform hands‐on mobile testing (Android & iOS), covering both static (SAST) and dynamic (DAST) analyses of APKs/IPA files. 
 - Identify insecure storage, hard‐coded secrets, misconfigurations, runtime hooking, parameter tampering, etc. 
 - Reverse‐engineer mobile binaries, analyze native libraries (. so/. dylib), and bypass client‐side protections (root/jailbreak detection, SSL pinning, obfuscation, tamper checks) using tools such as Frida, Objection, Magisk, Cydia/Sileo/Zebra, Xposed. 
 - Stay current on evolving mobile threats and industry standards (OWASP MASVS/MASTG). 
 - Define and document test scope based on application security requirements. 
 - Execute documented security test scenarios and produce comprehensive findings reports. 
 - Collaborate with developers to explain vulnerabilities and recommend remediation. 
 - Escalate blockers to local management and on‐shore stakeholders when testing progress is impacted. 
 - Follow established assessment processes and ensure compliance with project guidelines. 

Contributing / Supporting Responsibilities

- Assist in source‐code assessment (SCA/SAST) where required. 
 - Participate in knowledge‐sharing sessions and continuous improvement initiatives within the security testing team. 

Required Education, Skills and Experience

- Education: Bachelor's degree (or equivalent) in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Security, or a related field. 
 - Experience: 4-6 years of hands‐on security testing, with a strong focus on mobile (Android & iOS) penetration testing. 

- Technical Skills: 
 - Proficient in OWASP Top 10 concepts. 
 - Expertise with tools/OS: Burp Suite, OWASP ZAP, Kali Linux, MobSF, JADX, dex2jar, ADB, Xcode, Frida, Objection, Apktool, otool, etc. 
 - Strong manual testing, security test design, and vulnerability validation abilities. 

- Behavioral Skills: 
 - Excellent verbal and written communication; strong presentation skills. 
 - Good analytical and time‐management capabilities. 
 - Independent, self‐motivated, flexible, and a collaborative team player. 

Preferred Education, Skills and Experience (nice to have)

- Certifications such as CSSLP, CEH, or equivalent. 
 - Experience with source‐code assessment (SCA/SAST) and related tooling. 
 - Familiarity with additional mobile security frameworks (e. g. , OWASP MASVS/MASTG) beyond the core requirements. Location: Mumbai, Bangalore

data.title: Head of AI Engineering & Center of Excellence (CoE)
data.description:
JOB DESCRIPTION

Head of AI Engineering

& Center of Excellence (CoE)

1. Role Overview

Our company is seeking a senior technology leader to establish and lead its AI Engineering Center of Excellence (CoE), driving the adoption of AI across enterprise engineering, insurance technology platforms, product development, and operational workflows. 

The Head of AI Engineering & CoE will define AI engineering strategy, establish reusable AI architectures and frameworks, enable AI-assisted software development, and deliver scalable, secure, measurable AI solutions. The role combines technical leadership, architecture governance, engineering enablement, and people development. 

A core objective is to turn individual AI experiments and isolated implementations into reusable enterprise capabilities that support Solartis's product-platform strategy. 

1. Key Responsibilities

A. AI Engineering Strategy and CoE Leadership

Establish the CoE charter, operating model, service offerings, engagement model, and delivery priorities. 

Develop an AI engineering roadmap aligned with product strategy, technology priorities, and business objectives. 

Identify opportunities to standardize AI capabilities and reduce duplicated implementations. 

Define reference architectures, reusable patterns, implementation guidelines, and approved technology frameworks. 

Partner with the CTO and engineering leadership to prioritize AI investments based on business value, feasibility, risk, and expected return. 

Establish processes to evaluate AI initiatives, productionize successful pilots, and retire ineffective or duplicated solutions. 

B. Enterprise AI Architecture and Shared Frameworks

Define scalable architectures for LLMs, SLMs, RAG, vector search, orchestration, and model integration. 

Design reusable AI services, APIs, SDKs, libraries, reference implementations, and deployment patterns. 

Establish patterns for model selection, prompt management, context engineering, embeddings, document processing, inference, and lifecycle management. 

Evaluate AI frameworks, models, infrastructure, and platforms for performance, cost, security, scalability, and maintainability. 

Define integration patterns for AI capabilities within existing platforms, services, applications, and development workflows. 

Guide build-versus-buy decisions across managed AI services, open-source models, and internally developed capabilities. 

C. AI-Assisted Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC)

Define and implement AI-assisted SDLC practices across requirements analysis, code generation, code understanding, test generation, code review, documentation, debugging, and maintenance. 

Establish standards for responsible use of AI coding assistants and developer productivity tools. 

Build reusable workflows and accelerators integrated with development environments, repositories, CI/CD pipelines, and quality processes. 

Measure impact on cycle time, defect rates, rework, code quality, and developer experience. 

Ensure AI adoption complements peer review, automated testing, security scanning, and release governance. 

Work with engineering leaders to drive adoption and develop team-level enablement plans. 

D. RAG, MCP, Agentic AI, and Reusable AI Services

Architect production-grade RAG solutions covering ingestion, parsing, chunking, metadata extraction, indexing, retrieval, reranking, and grounded generation. 

Establish reusable patterns for agents, tool orchestration, workflow automation, context management, and human-in-the-loop processing. 

Define appropriate Model Context Protocol (MCP) patterns for controlled access to enterprise tools, data, and services. 

Develop common components for model access, prompt/context management, retrieval, tool integration, evaluation, telemetry, and error handling. 

Define safeguards for permissions, data access, execution boundaries, auditability, failure recovery, and human approval. 

Apply agentic AI selectively where it delivers measurable value and avoid unnecessary complexity in deterministic workflows. 

E. AI-Assisted Insurance Content Processing and Parser Initiatives

Lead architecture for processing insurance documents, policy forms, underwriting guidelines, rating manuals, and related content. 

Guide pipelines that transform semi-structured and unstructured content into validated, structured insurance product definitions. 

Establish reusable capabilities for classification, parsing, extraction, semantic interpretation, rule identification, and structured output generation. 

Ensure extracted content is traceable to source documents and suitable for downstream product configuration and processing. 

Design human review and exception handling for ambiguous, incomplete, conflicting, or low-confidence outputs. 

Define evaluation datasets and measures for extraction precision/recall, completeness, rule interpretation, and downstream usability. 

Promote reusable parsers and validation components over isolated customer-specific implementations, in collaboration with insurance domain and platform teams. 

F. AI Engineering Standards, Quality, and Governance

Define standards for AI design, implementation, testing, deployment, monitoring, and maintenance. 

Establish evaluation frameworks for accuracy, groundedness, robustness, reliability, latency, cost, and use-case suitability. 

Implement safeguards against prompt injection, unauthorized data exposure, insecure tool execution, and other AI-specific threats. 

Define model and prompt versioning, traceability, observability, regression evaluation, and controlled production releases. 

Establish practices for sensitive data handling, access control, retention, audit logging, and external AI services. 

Partner with security, compliance, legal, and enterprise architecture stakeholders on applicable requirements. 

Ensure solutions have appropriate fallbacks, exception handling, human oversight, and production-readiness reviews. 

G. Technical Leadership, Mentoring, and Enablement

Provide technical leadership to AI architects and designated AI engineering teams, with accountability for architecture quality and capability development. 

Mentor existing architects in AI solution design, reusable architecture, model integration, evaluation, and production engineering. 

Establish architecture reviews, technical communities of practice, learning paths, workshops, and hands-on reference projects. 

Guide teams in evaluating alternatives, challenging assumptions, conducting impact analysis, and making sound technical decisions. 

Develop architecture decision records, implementation templates, reusable documentation, and engineering playbooks. 

Build internal capability so teams can implement AI solutions independently within agreed standards. 

H. Business Value, Delivery, and Continuous Improvement

Translate opportunities into prioritized initiatives with defined outcomes, milestones, resource needs, and success measures. 

Partner with product, engineering, and business teams to improve developer productivity, reduce manual effort, accelerate content processing, and strengthen platform scalability. 

Maintain visibility into AI initiative status, adoption, risks, operating costs, and realized benefits. 

Track production outcomes beyond proof-of-concept delivery and optimize duplicated capabilities, infrastructure, and model costs. 

Communicate progress, risks, decisions, and measurable outcomes to the CTO and senior leadership. 

3. Leadership and Decision-Making Expectations

Establish and execute the AI engineering roadmap within priorities agreed with the CTO. 

Own the technical direction and engineering standards of the AI CoE. 

Lead and develop AI architects and designated AI engineering resources. 

Make decisions within agreed enterprise architecture principles and delegated authority; escalate material cross-platform, security, and investment decisions as required. 

Challenge designs that introduce unnecessary customization, duplication, operational complexity, or technical risk. 

Balance innovation with engineering discipline, production readiness, maintainability, and measurable business outcomes. 

Influence teams beyond the direct reporting line and enable adoption across the organization. 

4. Required Qualifications and Experience

Bachelor's or master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, AI, Data Science, or a related discipline. 

Typically 15+ years of relevant software engineering, architecture, or technology experience, including substantial practical experience with AI/ML and modern AI application architectures. 

Demonstrated experience leading AI engineering initiatives, architecture practices, technical teams, or enterprise AI programs. 

Strong practical knowledge of LLM applications, RAG, embeddings, vector databases, prompt engineering, and model evaluation. 

Experience designing production-grade AI services, APIs, orchestration workflows, and reusable frameworks. 

Practical understanding of agentic AI, tool integration, workflow orchestration, and MCP where relevant. 

Experience with Python, APIs, distributed systems, CI/CD, automated testing, and cloud-based application deployment. 

Experience evaluating AI models and frameworks for quality, latency, cost, security, and operational complexity. 

Knowledge of AI application security, data protection, observability, model lifecycle management, and responsible AI practices. 

Demonstrated ability to mentor architects and engineers, influence technical direction, and establish standards across teams. 

Strong communication skills, including the ability to explain technical decisions to executives, business stakeholders, and engineering teams. 

5. Preferred Qualifications

Experience establishing an enterprise AI Engineering CoE or equivalent AI enablement function. 

Experience with comparable enterprise AI platforms and cloud-native AI services. 

Experience integrating AI-assisted software development tools into engineering workflows. 

Experience in insurance technology, policy administration, rating, product configuration, or document-intensive enterprise platforms. 

Experience with intelligent document processing, information extraction, rules extraction, or structured-content generation. 

Experience with enterprise knowledge systems, metadata-driven architectures, and reusable platform services. 

Familiarity with AI governance frameworks, evaluation methodologies, and production risk management. 

6. Leadership Profile

The ideal candidate combines deep technical credibility with the ability to establish a sustainable engineering practice. They can move between architecture design, hands-on problem solving, technical mentoring, organizational enablement, and executive communication. 

The candidate should build systems and teams that scale, establish standards without unnecessary bureaucracy, and translate emerging AI technologies into practical business capabilities. 

Ultimate expectation: Establish an AI Engineering CoE that strengthens Solartis's product-platform strategy, improves engineering effectiveness, accelerates AI adoption, and builds long-term organizational capability.

CustomerInsights. AI builds analytics and AI infrastructure for pharmaceutical commercial organizations. Our platform-led delivery model develops reusable data, analytics, and AI capabilities that help organizations reconcile fragmented data, strengthen data governance and lineage, and make complex commercial information accessible through scalable applications and intelligent workflows. 

  

Role Overview

CustomerInsights. AI is looking for a Principal Architect - Agentic AI Platform to help lead the next phase of architecture evolution for ciATHENA, our enterprise Agentic AI platform for Life Sciences Commercial. This is a hands-on architecture leadership role focused on evolving ciATHENA from a growing set of AI-enabled capabilities into a scalable, modular, secure and production-grade enterprise AI platform. 

We are specifically looking for a 0->1 product builder who has helped design and build SaaS and/or AI products from an early stage through production. The successful candidate is expected to move comfortably between whiteboarding, prototyping, code reviews, debugging and production architecture, and to work directly with engineering teams to implement key architectural changes. 

Key Responsibilities

- Own the current-state assessment and target-state architecture for ciATHENA. 
 - Define architectural principles and reference patterns across agent orchestration, multi-agent workflows, LLM/SLM integration, model abstraction and routing, RAG and enterprise knowledge architectures, memory/state, tool/function calling, human-in-the-loop workflows, AI evaluation, observability, security and governance. 
 - Drive architecture evolution of key platform capabilities including Agent Registry, Knowledge Spine, orchestration services and AI runtime components. 
 - Establish reusable platform patterns so new ciATHENA modules and client implementations do not require custom architecture each time. 
 - Define clear service boundaries, APIs, event patterns and integration standards across the platform. 
 - Design scalable and resilient patterns for multi-tenancy, session/state management, asynchronous processing, failure recovery, model fallbacks and distributed workloads. 
 - Work closely with existing Data Engineering and DevOps teams to ensure architecture is production-ready and deployable across CustomerInsights. AI-hosted and customer VPC environments. 
 - Define integration patterns with platforms such as Databricks, Snowflake, Veeva/Salesforce and enterprise data ecosystems.

 - Establish architecture standards around LLM independence and model portability, minimizing unnecessary dependency on any single model provider. 
 - Guide decisions around model selection, model routing, commercial LLMs, open-source models and smaller language models. 
 - Participate in architecture reviews and provide technical direction to AI, backend, platform and product engineering teams. 
 - Translate product and customer requirements into scalable platform capabilities rather than one-off implementations. 
 - Mentor senior engineers and help raise the architecture and engineering bar across the organization. 
 Must-Have Experience

- Demonstrated 0->1 experience building SaaS, AI or data products rather than only maintaining or modernizing mature platforms. 
 - Experience working in a startup, scale-up, founding/early engineering team, internal incubation group or entrepreneurial product environment with significant ownership over architecture and engineering decisions. 
 - Experience taking products from concept / prototype -> MVP -> production -> scale. 
 - 8-10 years of software engineering / architecture experience, including ownership of complex cloud-native or distributed systems. 
 - Strong hands-on engineering background with evidence of personally building, prototyping and troubleshooting production systems. 
 - Ability to make pragmatic architecture decisions balancing speed to market, scalability, technical debt, security, reliability and cost. 
 - Comfort operating in environments where requirements are evolving and architectural boundaries are still being established.

data.title: Platform Engineer (Mid / Senior / Lead)
data.description:
Role Title: Platform Engineer (Mid / Senior / Lead)

Department: Product Engineering

Location: Mumbai / Pune (Onsite)

Reports To: Engineering Manager

Experience: 5+ years, hiring across levels. Level is set by what you can own end to end, not by years on a resume. 

Employment Type: Full-time

About Scitara: Scitara is a global leader in digital transformation for scientific laboratories, enabling connectivity, automation, and data integrity across instruments, applications, and enterprise systems. Our cloud-based DLX platform is used by the world's top pharma, biotech, life sciences, and industrial R&D labs to modernize workflows and accelerate scientific outcomes. Lab informatics is growing 50 to 70% over the next five years, at the exact moment AI is being layered onto scientific data workflows. The software you build here decides how labs around the world adopt that wave. 

Role Summary: The DLX platform is a cloud-native, event-driven system of microservices that moves scientific data between instruments, lab applications, and enterprise systems, and increasingly runs AI agents over that data. It has a web UI, but most of the engineering is not web work: it is data processing, orchestration, integration, and backend connectivity in a distributed system. As a Platform Engineer you own features across that whole surface. One week that is a new orchestration capability in a NestJS service talking gRPC and Kafka; the next it is the React screens that expose it; the next it is an agent that acts on the data. You are a generalist by design, and you may bring a specialty on top of that. 

How Engineering Works Here: We are a small team with a large product. That shapes everything: You deliver features, not tickets. You get a goal and the context behind it. You work out the plan, the design, the tests, and the rollout. Nobody hands you a task list. AI is part of the job. We use agentic coding tools every day to design, generate, test, and document. You are expected to work this way and to be a sharp reviewer of what the tools produce. You own the result, not the tool. We are regulated. Our customers run validated GxP environments. Data integrity, traceability, and auditability are design constraints, not a checklist at the end. Thinkers and doers. The people who do well here notice problems, propose fixes, get them wrong sometimes, and get them right the next time. They bring ideas back to the team instead of waiting to be told. 

Key Outcomes (First 6 to 12 Months): Ship complete features into production: service, contract, data model, UI where needed, tests, documentation. Take a feature from a one-paragraph goal to a working plan and design without waiting for a task breakdown. Raise the quality of the services you touch: contracts, observability, test coverage, performance. Build or extend AI agent capabilities on the platform. Contribute to how the team uses agentic tooling: prompts, skills, review practices, automation. Senior / Lead: own the design of a platform capability end to end and set the bar for the engineers around you. 

Responsibilities: Responsibilities Design and build platform features across NestJS/Node. js microservices, gRPC contracts, Kafka event flows, MongoDB data models, and React UI. Build and integrate AI and agentic capabilities into the platform. Write code that meets the platform's data integrity and validation requirements. Use agentic development tools as the default way of working, and review their output critically. Participate in design reviews, code reviews, and Agile ceremonies as a contributor, not an attendee. Troubleshoot production and integration issues across service boundaries. Senior / Lead: lead technical spikes and architecture decisions; mentor and raise engineering standards. 

Must-Have: Strong TypeScript/Node. js and working React. You have built something beyond request/response web APIs: event-driven services, message queues, background processing, distributed data flows. If all you have shipped is Express CRUD, this role will be a hard adjustment. Daily, hands-on use of AI coding tools, and the judgement to know when they are wrong. A track record of delivering features you were given as goals, not as task lists. Solid engineering fundamentals: design, testing, debugging, reading unfamiliar code. Git and CI/CD in a team setting. 

Good-to-Have: Our stack specifically: NestJS, gRPC, CQRS, Kafka, MongoDB, Keycloak, AWS. This is a large plus. Building AI agents, working with MCP servers, or integrating LLMs into products. Regulated software: GxP, GAMP 5, 21 CFR Part 11, data integrity. Lab informatics or scientific software: LIMS, ELN, CDS, instrument data. Docker, Kubernetes, cloud-native operations. 

Success Indicators: Features reach production without needing the plan written for you. The services you touch are better than you found them. Your use of AI tooling makes you faster and your work more thorough, and your peers pick up what you learn. Colleagues in product, quality, and the connectors team trust your judgement. Senior / Lead: platform decisions get made well when the architect is not in the room. 

Why Join Scitara? Build the system that moves scientific data for the labs developing the next generation of therapies. Work in an engineering culture where AI-native development is the default, not an experiment. Real ownership: features, designs, and decisions are yours. Clear paths into technical leadership and architecture. A global team of engineers, scientists, and customers.

data.title: Technical Lead — Insurance Platform Implementation (React/Next.js · Node.js · AWS)
data.description:
BAJAJ CAPITAL LIMITED

Job Description

Technical Lead - Insurance Platform Implementation (React/Next. js · Node. js ·

AWS)

Gurgaon | Full-Time | Hands-on Tech Lead (~40-50% coding)

About the Role

Bajaj Capital is building its digital insurance platform - end-to-end buy journeys for Health, Life and Motor

insurance on the web, and a shared API layer that powers the same journeys in our mobile app. As Technical

Lead, you will own architecture and delivery across a blended team of in-house developers and implementation

vendors, code alongside them, integrate with multiple insurers, and run an AI-native engineering practice where

AI tools are used to build, test, deploy and operate the platform. 

Key Responsibilities

AI-Native Development & Delivery

● Build primarily with AI coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot or approved equivalents) across UI, API

and infrastructure code; set up AI-ready repos with shared agent instructions (CLAUDE. md/AGENTS. md), 

prompts and templates that vendors must also follow. 

● Use AI for spec-driven development, insurer API mapping, test generation, PR review in CI, IaC and pipeline

authoring, release notes, log analysis and incident RCA - with human review and ownership of every

change. 

● Enforce AI guardrails: approved tools only, no customer data, health declarations or secrets in prompts, no

unattended merges or deploys, and extra scrutiny on payments, pricing and data access. 

Insurance Buy Journeys (Web)

● Health: member and cover selection, quote comparison, medical/PED declarations, proposal, KYC, payment

and policy issuance. 

● Life: needs-based cover, term/savings quotes, benefit illustrations, proposal, e-KYC, medicals scheduling, e-

sign and payment. 

● Motor: vehicle lookup, IDV, NCB and add-ons, quote comparison, renewals, break-in inspection flows and

instant issuance. 

● Build in React/Next. js (TypeScript) with a shared design system, SSR/SEO, Core Web Vitals, accessibility, 

funnel analytics, drop-off recovery and A/B testing. 

API Platform & Integrations (Node. js)

● Design and build Node. js (NestJS/Fastify) APIs with OpenAPI contracts, reused by web and the mobile app, 

with versioning, security and backward compatibility. 

● Build an insurer integration layer that normalises quote, proposal, payment and policy APIs across insurers

and aggregators; handle timeouts, retries, idempotency and reconciliation. 

● Integrate payment gateways, CKYC/e-KYC, e-sign, communication services, CRM and the data warehouse; 

orchestrate long-running journeys (e. g. , AWS Step Functions). 

Vendor & Team Leadership

● Lead in-house developers and vendor teams as one engineering unit: define scope, acceptance criteria and

architecture guardrails; review vendor code to the same standards as in-house code. 

● Ensure Bajaj Capital owns code, IP and infrastructure; enforce documentation and knowledge transfer so

the platform is never vendor-locked. 

● Mentor in-house developers through pairing and reviews; own sprint planning, estimates and releases with

Product and Business. 

AWS, DevOps, Security & Compliance

● Own the AWS architecture (ECS Fargate/Lambda, API Gateway, Aurora PostgreSQL, S3, CloudFront, KMS, 

WAF) in Indian regions, fully in Terraform/CDK, with CI/CD, observability and on-call. 

● Build to OWASP ASVS/API Top 10 and PCI-DSS-aligned payment practices; protect health and personal data

per the DPDP Act 2023, IRDAI guidelines and SEBI CSCRF, with InfoSec and Compliance. 

● Maintain complete audit trails of quotes, disclosures, consents and proposals for regulatory and claims

needs. 

Technology Stack

● Web: React, Next. js, TypeScript, Tailwind/design system, TanStack Query, Playwright, Jest/RTL. 

● Backend & AWS: Node. js, NestJS/Fastify, PostgreSQL, Redis, SQS/SNS, Step Functions, ECS/Lambda, 

Terraform/CDK, GitHub Actions. 

● AI: Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, Amazon Q Developer, MCP integrations (Jira, GitHub, Figma, AWS), 

Amazon Bedrock. 

Required Qualifications

● 8-12 years in software engineering, including 3+ years with React/Next. js and 3+ years building production

Node. js/TypeScript APIs. 

● Has delivered high-conversion, transactional web journeys (insurance, lending, payments or e-commerce)

with third-party API integrations. 

● Hands-on AWS experience operating production workloads with infrastructure as code and CI/CD. 

● Demonstrable experience shipping production software with AI coding agents, with concrete examples of

workflows and results. 

● 2+ years as a Tech Lead who has managed vendor/implementation partners alongside in-house teams; still

codes regularly. 

● Strong grasp of web and API security, OAuth 2. 0/OIDC and handling of sensitive personal data. 

B. Tech/B. E. /MCA in Computer Science or equivalent. 

Good to Have

● Insurance broking, web aggregator or insurer tech experience; familiarity with insurer APIs and IRDAI

distribution requirements. 

● Experience with benefit illustration engines, underwriting rules, motor pricing or renewal journeys. 

● LLM features in products (e. g. , plan comparison assistants on Amazon Bedrock) with evaluations and

guardrails; AWS certification. 

Success in the First Year

● Health, Life and Motor buy journeys live on web and consumed by the mobile app, with multiple insurers

integrated and strong conversion. 

● A single in-house plus vendor team delivering through AI-assisted workflows, with full code ownership at

Bajaj Capital and no vendor lock-in. 

CTC - Max 25 lpa

Experience: (6-12 years)

Location - Gurugram ( Work from office)

Interested Candidate can mail their resume to ( Mannu. supriya@bajajcapita. com)

Regards

Mannu Supriya

Senior Director, Head of Engineering (Commercialization BI&T)

Job Profile

The Senior Director, Head of Engineering and Hyderabad Technology Centre leads the broader Commercialization engineering organisation and serves as the senior technology leader for the Commercialization BI&T teams in Hyderabad. 

This leader is accountable for the engineering outcomes of teams building the technology that supports commercial operations, including field engagement, customer experience, marketing, market access, medical, analytics, data and AI. The role sets the engineering strategy, builds strong engineering capabilities and ensures products and platforms are delivered securely, reliably and at enterprise scale. 

The Senior Director will develop Hyderabad into a strategic engineering hub with end-to-end ownership of global commercial platforms and capabilities. This is a true technology leadership role, requiring strong technical credibility, sound architectural judgement and proven experience leading global engineering organisations. 

Key Responsibilities

- Own the engineering strategy and operating model across Commercialization BI&T, including software, platform, integration, data, cloud and AI engineering. 
 - Lead the broader engineering organisation and hold engineering leaders accountable for delivery, quality, security, reliability, cost and business outcomes. 
 - Build scalable technology capabilities that support pharmaceutical commercial functions, including sales, field medical, marketing, market access, customer engagement and commercial analytics. 
 - Ensure engineering teams understand commercial business processes and translate product priorities into reliable, intuitive and production-ready solutions. 
 - Set the technical direction for core commercial platforms and ensure solutions are reusable, interoperable and aligned with enterprise architecture. 
 - Provide engineering leadership across platforms such as Veeva Vault CRM, Salesforce, Adobe Experience Cloud, Databricks, cloud services and enterprise integration platforms. 
 - Build the engineering capabilities required to support CRM, omnichannel engagement, customer data, content management, consent, orchestration, analytics and field-facing applications. 
 - Lead the development of AI-enabled commercial capabilities, including field enablement, customer engagement, intelligent orchestration, decision support and marketing automation. 
 - Establish clear engineering standards covering architecture, software development, APIs, testing, DevSecOps, CI/CD, observability and production operations. 
 - Ensure product and platform teams have end-to-end accountability from design and build through deployment, adoption, operations and modernisation. 
 - Hold teams accountable for realistic commitments, delivery predictability, engineering quality and measurable commercial value. 
 - Ensure commercial platforms are designed around connected customer and field experiences rather than isolated products or channels. 
 - Partner with Commercial, Medical, Market Access and other business leaders to understand priorities, adoption barriers and opportunities for measurable value. 
 - Work closely with product management and architecture to ensure commercial requirements are technically achievable, appropriately prioritised and delivered through sustainable solutions. 
 - Ensure platforms meet enterprise requirements for security, privacy, consent, regulatory compliance, auditability and responsible AI. 
 - Drive reuse and standardisation across brands, markets and commercial capabilities while accommodating justified local and regulatory requirements. 
 - Establish engineering metrics covering speed, quality, reliability, security, productivity, adoption, platform cost and business outcomes. 
 - Ensure strong production ownership, including service health, incident management, root-cause analysis and permanent remediation. 
 - Actively reduce technical debt, duplicated solutions, fragmented integrations and unnecessary customisation across the commercial technology landscape. 
 - Develop Hyderabad into a global engineering hub with clear decision rights and end-to-end ownership of strategic products and platforms. 
 - Build strong leadership and technical depth in Hyderabad across software engineering, data engineering, AI engineering, platform engineering, integration and quality engineering. 
 - Lead the insourcing of critical engineering capabilities and reduce long-term dependency on external partners. 
 - Own engineering workforce planning, organisational design, succession, capability development and recruitment. 
 - Recruit and develop senior engineering leaders, architects and technical talent capable of operating in a global product model. 
 - Manage the engineering budget and ensure technology investments, platforms and partners deliver measurable commercial and operational value. 
 - Represent engineering and Hyderabad in senior leadership forums, providing clear visibility into outcomes, risks, priorities and investment needs. 

Qualifications and Experience

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology or a related technical discipline. 
 - Significant experience leading software, platform, data, cloud or AI engineering in a complex global organisation. 
 - Proven experience leading large, multidisciplinary engineering organisations through senior engineering managers, architects and technical leaders. 
 - Strong technical credibility across modern software architecture, cloud platforms, distributed systems, APIs, enterprise integration, data engineering and production operations. 
 - Demonstrated accountability for engineering outcomes across the complete product lifecycle, from design and build through deployment, operation and modernisation. 
 - Experience engineering platforms that support complex customer engagement, sales, marketing, service or commercial business processes. 
 - Experience with major enterprise platforms such as Veeva, Salesforce, Adobe Experience Cloud, Databricks, AWS, Azure or comparable technologies. 
 - Strong understanding of CRM, customer data, content, consent, omnichannel engagement, decisioning, orchestration and commercial analytics. 
 - Experience building integrations across enterprise platforms, data environments, digital channels and customer-facing applications. 
 - Proven ability to set engineering strategy and standards while enabling product teams to deliver with speed and autonomy. 
 - Experience leading AI, machine learning, generative AI or agentic technology capabilities into production. 
 - Ability to challenge complex technical proposals, guide architectural decisions and manage trade-offs between speed, cost, quality and long-term sustainability. 
 - Proven success improving engineering quality, delivery performance, reliability, productivity and platform cost. 
 - Experience building or transforming a major technology centre, global capability centre or distributed engineering organisation. 
 - Demonstrated ability to develop engineering leaders, attract senior technical talent and establish strong technical career paths. 
 - Experience insourcing strategic engineering capabilities and transitioning ownership from external partners to internal teams. 
 - Strong commercial and financial acumen, including workforce planning, technology investment, vendor management and cost optimisation. 
 - Experience operating in a global, matrixed and regulated enterprise. 
 - Strong executive communication skills and the ability to explain technology decisions, risks and investment choices clearly. 
 - Pharmaceutical, healthcare or life sciences experience is preferred but not required. 
 - Experience in another regulated or data-intensive industry, such as financial services, consumer health, insurance or enterprise technology, would also be relevant. 
 - Knowledge of pharmaceutical commercial processes, regulatory requirements and customer engagement models would be a strong advantage. 

Leadership Profile

The successful candidate is a technology and engineering leader who creates outcomes through strong teams. They set the direction, build capable leaders, establish a high engineering bar and hold the organisation accountable for delivering reliable technology and measurable commercial value. 

They understand that commercial technology is not only about implementing platforms. It is about connecting customer data, content, channels, field workflows, analytics and AI into a coherent experience that changes how the business engages customers and operates. 

They remain close enough to the technology to challenge major decisions and understand critical risks, while empowering engineering leaders and teams to own execution.

data.title: Principal Firmware Engineer, High-Speed Ethernet
data.description:
Description

Invent the future with us. 

Ampere is a semiconductor design company for a new era, leading the future of computing with an innovative approach to CPU design focused on high-performance, energy efficient AI compute. 

As a pioneer in the new frontier of energy efficient high-performance computing, Ampere is part of the Softbank Group of companies driving sustainable computing for AI, Cloud, and edge applications. 

Join us at Ampere and work alongside a passionate and growing team - we'd love to have you apply!

About The Role

We are seeking a hands-on Principal Firmware Engineer to lead the architecture, design, development, integration, and validation of low-level firmware for high-speed Ethernet solutions, including Gigabit MAC/PCS/PHY-adjacent interfaces, PTP/gPTP timing, TSN features, DMA, QoS, and platform drivers. 

This role requires a technically strong engineer who can operate at both system and register level: define firmware architecture, develop production-quality drivers, diagnose hardware/software issues on silicon, guide firmware engineers, and collaborate closely with RTL, verification, silicon validation, applications, and customers. 

The successful candidate will own critical aspects of the Ethernet firmware stack from boot-time initialization through high-throughput data-path operation, time synchronization, traffic scheduling, error handling, diagnostics, and performance characterization. 

What You'll Achieve

Technical Architecture and Ownership

- Define firmware architecture for high-speed Ethernet subsystems supporting high speed gigabit Ethernet modes. 
 - Lead design of low-level drivers for Ethernet MAC, DMA, PCS, SerDes/PHY control interfaces, MDIO, interrupt controllers, clock/reset, and associated IP blocks. 
 - Define scalable driver state machines for initialization, configuration, link management, normal operation, diagnostics, fault recovery, and reset handling. 
 - Establish firmware interfaces and configuration models for Ethernet QoS, PTP, TSN, packet classification, DMA queues, and traffic scheduling. 
 - Identify hardware/software integration risks early and influence hardware architecture, register design, diagnostics, and verification requirements. 
 - Design firmware for high-throughput and low-latency operation for Gigabit Ethernet. 
 - Analyze and optimize CPU utilization, DMA bandwidth, memory bandwidth, interrupt load, cache behavior, and buffer utilization. 
 - Drive root-cause analysis for packet loss, descriptor corruption, DMA stalls, RX starvation, TX underflow, FIFO overflow, bus errors, and performance regressions. 
 - Ensure correct cache-coherency and memory-ordering behavior on Arm-based SoCs with coherent or non-coherent DMA. 

PTP / gPTP / Time Synchronization

- Develop and integrate firmware support for hardware timestamping and IEEE 1588 PTP / IEEE 802. 1AS gPTP. 
 - Configure and manage PTP clocks, timestamp units, clock adjustment, rollover handling, and TX/RX timestamp correlation. 
 - Support synchronization applications requiring deterministic timing and bounded timestamp latency. 
 - Develop diagnostics and performance characterization for time synchronization accuracy, offset, drift, jitter, timestamp loss, and synchronization recovery. 
 - Collaborate with system/software teams on PTP stack integration and time-domain requirements. 

TSN and Ethernet QoS

- Lead firmware enablement for relevant TSN and QoS capabilities
 - Define queue allocation, scheduling, buffer, and congestion-management policies for mixed traffic environments. 
 - Develop traffic test scenarios to validate latency, jitter, throughput, packet loss, fairness, and isolation under congested conditions. 

Bring-Up, Debug, and Validation

- Lead pre-silicon and post-silicon firmware bring-up for Ethernet subsystems. 
 - Debug complex hardware/firmware interactions
 - Develop fault-injection and negative-test scenarios
 - Drive technical resolution of customer and field escalations. 

Leadership and Collaboration

- Provide technical leadership and mentorship to firmware engineers. 
 - Lead architecture reviews, code reviews, debug reviews, and design-for-testability discussions. 
 - Establish reusable driver frameworks, coding patterns, debug utilities, and test infrastructure. 
 - Work closely with RTL, design verification, validation, software, systems, security, safety, product, and customer engineering teams. 
 - Guide junior and senior engineers toward independent ownership of firmware subsystems. 
 - Communicate technical risks, design choices, trade-offs, and milestones clearly to engineering leadership and cross-functional stakeholders. 

About You

- Bachelor's degree with 8 years or Master's degree with 6 years of experience in embedded firmware, device-driver, networking, or semiconductor software development experience
 - Proven hands-on experience developing low-level drivers for Ethernet MAC, DMA, PHY/PCS control, networking accelerators, or comparable high-performance peripheral IP. 
 - Strong understanding of Ethernet fundamentals including Ethernet frame format; MAC and PHY operation; VLAN / IEEE 802. 1Q; QoS / 802. 1p; link negotiation and management; MDIO/MDC; flow control; multicast and filtering. 
 - Strong experience with DMA architectures
 - Strong understanding of embedded C/C++ and low-level programming concepts: 
 - Strong Arm SoC knowledge of Cortex-A, Cortex-R, Cortex-M; 
 - Experience with IEEE 1588 PTP, gPTP, hardware timestamping, or time synchronization systems. 
 - Demonstrated ability to debug difficult system issues using hardware and software observability tools. 
 - Ability to lead technical design and influence teams across firmware, RTL, verification, and validation. 
 - Strong written and verbal communication skills. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with 25GbE, 10GbE, 40GbE, 50GbE, or other high-speed Ethernet MAC/PCS/SerDes-based systems. 
 - Experience with TSN features including IEEE 802. 1Qav, 802. 1Qbv, 802. 1Qbu, 802. 1Qci, IEEE 802. 3br, and IEEE 802. 1AS. 
 - Experience with Ethernet MACsec / IEEE 802. 1AE, MKA, replay protection, secure association management, or secure networking. 
 - Experience with high-speed packet test equipment, traffic generators, packet analyzers, and performance benchmarking. 
 - Experience with FPGA prototyping, emulation, pre-silicon firmware development, or post-silicon validation. 

What We'll Offer

At Ampere we believe in taking care of our employees and providing a competitive total rewards package that includes base pay, cash long-term incentive, and comprehensive benefits. 

Benefits Highlights Include

- Premium medical, dental, vision insurance, parental benefits including creche reimbursement, as well as a retirement plan, so that you can feel secure in your health, financial future and child care during work. 
 - Generous paid time off policy so that you can embrace a healthy work-life balance 
 - Fully catered lunch in our office along with a variety of healthy snacks, energizing coffee or tea, and refreshing drinks to keep you fueled and focused throughout the day. 

And there is much more than compensation and benefits. At Ampere, we foster an inclusive culture that empowers our employees to do more and grow more. We are excited to share more about our career opportunities with you through the interview process. 

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us. 

Ampere is an inclusive and equal opportunity employer and welcomes applicants from all backgrounds. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, national origin, citizenship, religion, age, veteran and/or military status, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, physical or mental disability, or any other basis protected by federal, state or local law.

data.description:
Work Schedule

Standard (Mon-Fri)

Environmental Conditions

Office

Engineer III, Software Test At Thermo Fisher, our mission is to cure cancer with genomic data. It is a close-knit, collaborative, cross-functional setting where we believe none of us is as smart as all of us and we each have something valuable to contribute toward our goal. The software services team is tasked with applying industry best practices to the design, development, and deployment of world-class software products. We are looking to hire individuals with experience with software development and test engineering in clinical and research settings, and who can help us solve the next wave of technical challenges using the latest cloud-based, big-data, and rich analytics toolsets. We are seeking enthusiastic Leader in Software Verification and Validation who will define scope, design, for automated and manual tests for highly advanced bioinformatics software. We require strong coding skills as well as a solid understanding of Quality Assurance principles and Continuous Integration methods. You will drive writing positive and negative smoke and regression test scripts to test product functionality and integration with dependencies. You will drive strategies for test APIs, user interfaces, web services, and/or web apps and write performance, load, and stress tests. You are excited and passionate about participating in an Agile/SCRUM setting to meet and exceed customer expectations and continuously drive towards quality improvements. You like the idea of partnering with users and other team members to brainstorm the best possible approaches to validating systems. You welcome the challenge of working in a fast-paced, discovery-oriented environment and will be genuinely excited about the prospect of creatively exercising your problem-solving skills continuously to ultimately improve the human condition. Essential Functions: 

- Develop and implement software testing Strategy, Methods and Best Practices that allow high quality NGS analytics and instruments software products to be designed, developed, and released into the regulated in-vitro diagnostics/ medical device space. 
 - Lead and mentor a group of bioinformatics and software test engineers. 
 - Establish software quality standards and KPI metrics to actively measure software and bioinformatics product quality. Implement software quality tracking tools and methodologies to provide on-going visibility and action during software product development lifecycle. 
 - Single point of contact while working with external partners to deliver state of the art Software products in market. 
 - Partner with software and bioinformatics leadership, functional and project managers to identify appropriate scope of software testing, verification and validation required for a project and managing the overall testing activities for projects. 
 - Partner with internal and external stakeholders to drive the requirements for regulated assays and software. Help software development team to understand the complex informatics and visualization requirements leading into design implementation Minimum Qualifications (must have): 
 - Masters/PhD preferred or Bachelors with minimum 06 years of work experience and strong track record of industry productivity
 - 06+ experience performing software verification and validation testing, preferably in the medical device/ biotech space
 - Strong understanding of NGS-based regulated software, IVD assay development practices and informatics data analysis pipelines. 
 - Strong leadership abilities and extensive experience managing the activities of software quality engineering and assurance teams. Experience leading cross-functional, multi-site teams preferred. 
 - Practical experience as a leader in the use of modern software development methodologies/ processes with an ability to direct the use of resources to meet department goals
 - Good understanding in design control for regulated products (e. g. US-IVD, IVD-D, IVD-R, China and Japan regulations) and knowledge of applicable regulations and standards used in IVD and medical device software development (e. g. ISO 13485, IEC 62304, and 21 CFR 820). 
 - Ability to work well with senior leadership. 
 - Experience working in a fast paced, dynamic environment.
