data.title: DCS Engineer
data.description:
Job Description

In this Role, Your Responsibilities Will Be: 

- Site walk-downs for data collection and I/O database preparation, database partitioning from Third Party DCS / PLC systems 
 - Design and implementation of power plant controls and protection Systems 
 - Process simulation & testing 
 - Design Review Meeting (DRM), Pre-FAT, Factory Acceptance Test (FAT) & cleanup after FAT 
 - Verification and functional testing of I/O interfaces to field devices and Supervision of control system installation, commissioning and start-up 
 - Compliance with internal and customer safety and security requirements and working with contractors / sub-contractors 
 - Encourage smooth partnership and communication with all project partners (internal project teams, customer, and on-site contractors)

Who You Are: 

You pursue everything with energy, drive and the need to finish. You deliver messages in a clear, compelling and concise manner and actively listens and checks for understanding. You lay out a detailed schedule and steps for achieving objectives and use landmarks to track and handle the progress of the work. 

For This Role, You Will Need: 

- 4 years bachelor's degree in ECE, EEE, I&C, E&I. 
 - Proven experience of 7 to 10 year of in Power Plant process, project engineering and commissioning. 
 - Process knowledge of HRSG, Boiler and BOP Control System. 
 - Control design, implementation, process sequencing and protection philosophies for sub-critical / super-critical fossil fired power plants and combined cycle power plants. 
 - Ability to interpret an extensive variety of technical instructions in mathematical or diagram form. 
 - Proficiency with ISA and SAMA logic symbols, Process & Instrumentation Diagrams (P&IDs), electrical, mechanical, and hydraulic schematics. 

Preferred Qualifications that Set You Apart: 

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills. 
 - Problem-solving, decision-making, and planning skills. 
 - Ability to write reports, business correspondence and commissioning documents. 
 - Ability to optimally present information and respond to queries from management, clients and customers. 
 - Experience with major Power Plant, HRSG / Boiler / BOP manufacturer or Controls vendor. 
 - Proficiency with one or more DCS/PLC platforms (e. g. , ABB Pro Control / Bailey INFI 90 / Symphony Harmony, Yokogawa Centum VP / CS3000, Siemens T3000 / TXP, GE Mark V / VI, Mitsubishi DIASYS Netmation, Invensys, Honeywell TDC3000, MaxDNA, MetsoDNA, Alstom Alspa320, Allen Bradley / GE-Fanuc / Schneider / Siemens PLCs & SCADA etc. ). 
 - Knowledge of datalinks (Modbus RTU / TCP-IP, ELC, Profibus, OPC). 

Our Culture & Commitment to You: 

At Emerson, we prioritize a workplace where every employee is valued, respected, and empowered to grow. We foster an environment that encourages innovation, collaboration, and diverse perspectives-because we know that great ideas come from great teams. Our commitment to ongoing career development and growing an inclusive culture ensures you have the support to thrive. Whether through mentorship, training, or leadership opportunities, we invest in your success so you can make a lasting impact. Cisco Validated Infrastructure Services (CVIS) establishes and proves the performance of large AI clusters before they are handed over to customers. As a Release Software Engineer, you will own the release lifecycle for CVIS/NVIS software across AI clusters. - AI cluster releases meet documented functional, performance, interoperability and reliability gates.

Release operations: Drive CVIS releases through each stage, from integration and automated Jenkins test runs to final readiness. Enforce release gates in Jenkins pipelines covering GPU, NCCL, network-fabric and workload validation, and keep release status transparent to all stakeholders.

data.description:
AI Tech Lead / AI Architect

India (Hybrid) | Data, Analytics & AI | Full-time | Hands-on GenAI Delivery Leadership

About the Role

We are seeking a hands-on  AI Tech Lead  to lead one or more Generative AI delivery pods for a financial-services client. The role sits between our Senior AI Engineers and the Engagement Manager. 

You own the technical direction and day-to-day delivery of your pod: you design the architecture, review the work and unblock it, and you are the technical voice with client architects, platform and security teams. You turn business asks into designs, plans and estimates, and you are accountable for

what goes to production. 

Key Responsibilities

Technical Leadership & Architecture

1.   Solution Architecture:   Own the architecture for GenAI applications (RAG, agentic workflows, document intelligence, evaluation and guardrails) on Azure: Azure OpenAI / AI Foundry, AI Search, Cosmos DB, Functions / App Service, APIM or an AI gateway. 

2.   Engineering Standards:   Set and enforce branching and PR reviews, testing, IaC (Terraform), CI/CD (GitHub Actions), observability, security and cost practices. 

3.   Trade-off Decisions:   Make and document the calls on model choice and routing, retrieval design, latency and cost, and build versus buy, so the team and the client can follow them. 

4.   Evaluation & Guardrails:   Build evaluation in from the start: golden datasets, regression gates on every prompt or code change, LLM-as-judge where it fits, content filters and human review for high-risk outputs. 

5.   Production Readiness:   Run release readiness: UAT support, release notes, rollback plans and production hand-off. 

People, Delivery & Client Leadership

●  Pod Leadership:   Lead a pod of 4-8 engineers (AI, backend, data, full-stack): plan sprints, allocate work, review code and designs, and grow each person. You are the first escalation point for your pod. 

●  Delivery Ownership:   Estimate, plan and track delivery; surface risks and dependencies early (environments, access, client approvals) and drive them to closure. 

●  Client Technical Lead:   Act as the senior technical point of contact with client architects, platform, security and governance teams; lead design walkthroughs, demos and technical decisions. 

●  Scoping & Communication:   Translate vague business asks into scoped solutions and phased plans, push back with options when a request is not feasible, and work with the Engagement Manager on scope, staffing and status. 

Required Experience and Qualifications

●  Overall Professional Experience:   8-12 years in software or data/ML engineering, with progressive technical leadership. 

●  AI/ML & GenAI Experience:   3+ years building and shipping Generative AI applications to production. 

●  Team Leadership:   At least 2 years leading engineers: allocation, reviews, mentoring and delivery accountability. Core Technical Competencies

●  Generative AI & LLMs:   Hands-on depth in LLM application patterns (RAG, hybrid search and re-ranking, agents and tools/MCP, structured outputs) and evaluation/observability tooling (RAGAS, LangSmith, Langfuse or similar). 

●  Azure AI Platform:   Production experience with Azure OpenAI / AI Foundry, AI Search, Cosmos DB, Functions / App Service, Key Vault, private networking and Entra ID / managed identity. AWS experience is acceptable with a clear path to Azure. 

●  Responsible AI & Security:   Content filters and guardrails, prompt-injection and data-leakage risks, PII handling, access

control and audit logging in a regulated (financial services) environment. 

●  Backend & DevOps:   Strong Python (FastAPI, AsyncIO), Docker, Terraform, CI/CD and environment promotion (dev / UAT / prod) with rollback. 

●  Communication:   Clear written and spoken communication with technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Title: Senior Backend Engineer

Location: Goregaon East, Mumbai

Job Type: Full time

We are looking for a hands-on backend engineer who has personally built and owned a complex, data-correct financial application, and can do it again. 

The product is an AI-assisted workbench for fund controllers. Think trial balances, multi-step approval workflows, reconciliation agents, and numbers that become booked accounting entries

downstream. 

Ideal domains: 

- Alternative asset management: private equity, private credit, real assets, hedge funds
 - Fund accounting, fund administration, portfolio accounting
 - Corporate accounting, ERP, general ledger, close-management software
 - Banking, capital markets, BFSI broadly

Ideal baseline knowledge: 

- Ledger & close: general ledger, journal entries, trial balance, period close
 - Valuation & fees: NAV, valuations and marks, accruals, fee calculations
 - Controls & audit: reconciliations, audit trails, maker-checker approvals

Technical Requirements

Application Design

- Python and Java. Built production services in Python (FastAPI, Pydantic, SQLAlchemy, PostgreSQL) and Java (Spring Boot, Maven). Comparable languages and frameworks are acceptable. 
 - Spec-driven development. Drove a spec-driven approach end to end through a product development lifecycle. The written spec led requirements, design, implementation, and verification, and it changed before the build did. 
 - Enterprise-grade web application development. Architected and owned a robust production web service: authentication/authorization, business logic, data models, data contracts, and application service boundaries. 
 - API and domain modeling. Designed contracts a UI and an agent can both consume: versioning, errors, idempotency, and role-based permissions. 
 - Correctness with numbers and dates. Handled currency, precision, rounding, negative values, periods, and timezones in production. 
 - Snowflake and database architecture. Owned the schema design and implementation for a large-data system. 
 - Infrastructure as code. Shipped IaC based application. 
 - Testing as a habit. Wrote unit and integration tests with mocked network calls, not "QA will catch it. "

Strong pluses: Experience with the Azure stack. 

AI Agent Design

- AI agent building. Built and owned a production agent end to end: an LLM with a deliberate model choice, a multi-step workflow, the tools it calls, context carried from step to step, and results stored in a database. 
 - Structured outputs. Returned a schema the caller can validate. 
 - Evals. Built a robust eval framework for a production agent. 
 - Human-in-the-loop. Put a stop in code before a journal entry or a submitted close. 
 - Deterministic numbers. Kept calculations in services. The agent retrieves, compares, and raises exceptions. 
 - Strong pluses: implementation of an MCP server into production, accounting based agentic workflows.

data.description:
Job Title: Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET), Versa Messaging Service (VMS) Platform

Location: Bangalore

Experience: 3 to 8 years

About Us

Versa Networks, Inc. is a vendor of a unified Secure Access Service Edge (SASE) platform. Versa's software-based approach gives enterprises and service providers agility, cost savings and flexibility, through a platform that is feature-rich, scalable and easy to use. 

Role Summary

We are looking for SDETs to join the quality engineering team for the Versa Messaging Service (VMS), a Kubernetes-based appliance that distributes identity, posture and threat-context data. VMS has a Go microservices data plane, a Java/Spring Boot control plane, and a gRPC/Protobuf streaming interface consumed by other Versa products. 

You will build and run the automation, test harnesses and tooling that tell us whether a VMS release is ready to ship. You will work closely with developers, DevOps and other product teams, and you will own test areas end to end, from design to automation to triage. 

Key Responsibilities

Test automation

- Build and maintain automated integration and end-to-end tests for the publish/subscribe path across record types, services and tenants. 
 - Write tests for the Go microservices and the Java/Spring Boot control plane, including API-level and gRPC streaming tests. 
 - Implement contract and schema-evolution tests for the gRPC/Protobuf interface so that deployed VOS clients stay backward compatible. 
 - Develop reusable test libraries, simulators, load generators and data generators in Go, Java or Python. Installation, upgrade and lifecycle testing

- Execute and automate the install and upgrade matrix: ISO and package installs, single-node and multi-node topologies, FIPS and non-FIPS builds. 
 - Automate in-place upgrade, rollback and database migration scenarios, including failure and recovery paths. 
 - Test shell-based installation and lifecycle scripts on Linux. Performance and resilience

- Design and run load, scale and soak tests; collect and analyze throughput, latency, resource-usage and memory-growth data. 
 - Run failover and recovery tests and record RTO and RPO results. 
 - Contribute to the capacity model and the documented supported limits. Security and compliance

- Support validation of FIPS builds and hardening (STIG or equivalent) requirements. 
 - Test TLS/mTLS, certificate and PKI scenarios, and authentication and integration protocols (RADIUS, SCIM, syslog). CI/CD and quality practices

- Integrate automated suites into CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins or GitLab CI) with automated quality gates. 
 - Triage failures, file high-quality defects with root-cause analysis, and track escaped defects. 
 - Work with developers to improve unit and component test coverage and promote shift-left practices. 
 - Contribute to release-readiness reporting across concurrent release branches. 
 - Coordinate with other product teams on cross-product compatibility testing. 

Required Qualifications

- B. E. /B. Tech. or higher in Computer Science, Information Technology, Electronics and Communication or equivalent. 
 - 3 to 8 years of experience in software testing, with a strong focus on test automation. 
 - Solid programming skills in Go or Java, plus Python or a similar scripting language. 
 - Working knowledge of Kubernetes (pods, services, ingress, storage, Helm or operators) and Docker. 
 - Good Linux knowledge and shell scripting skills. 
 - Working knowledge of gRPC and Protocol Buffers. 
 - Understanding of TCP/IP, HTTP and TLS, with hands-on experience debugging network and service issues. 
 - Experience with CI/CD pipelines such as Jenkins or GitLab CI. 
 - Strong analytical and debugging skills, and clear written and verbal communication. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience testing on-premises or appliance software, including ISO/package installation, upgrade and rollback. 
 - Exposure to Kafka or other messaging and streaming systems. 
 - Experience with performance testing tools and profiling (for example Locust, k6, JMeter, pprof). 
 - Exposure to FIPS, STIG or Common Criteria testing. 
 - Familiarity with mTLS, PKI, syslog, RADIUS, SCIM, SAML or OAuth2/OIDC. 
 - Familiarity with Prometheus and Grafana. 
 - Exposure to AWS, Azure or GCP.

data.title: Head of Process Engineering
data.description:
ZEISS in India is headquartered in Bengaluru and present in the fields of Industrial Quality Solutions, Research Microscopy Solutions, Medical Technology, Vision Care and Sports & Cine Optics. 

ZEISS India has 3 production facilities, R&D center, Global IT services and about 40 Sales & Service offices in almost all Tier I and Tier II cities in India. With 2200+ employees and continued investments over 25 years in India, ZEISS' success story in India is continuing at a rapid pace. 

This role will be accountable for building, leading and continuously upgrading the manufacturing engineering capability across both production factories. The role owns the robustness, stability and continuous improvement of critical production processes, from lens casting, lens surfacing and coating process, while driving industrialization of new products, new equipment and new technologies into serial production. 

This position is expected to act as a senior operational and technical leader: translating business targets into engineering priorities, improving first pass yield and process capability, reducing recurring defects and losses, accelerating automation and digital manufacturing initiatives, and ensuring that engineering standards, validation discipline, quality requirements and EHS expectations are consistently met. 

Job Description : 

1. Process Engineering Leadership

- Lead process engineering team in India for casting, surfacing, milling, polishing, hard coating, AR coating. 2. Leading FPY, OEE and Manufacturing Performance Improvement. 

- Build and govern a structured improvement pipeline linked to factory KPIs, including FPY, OEE, productivity, cost reduction, uptime and defect reduction. 
 - Use data-driven problem solving, SPC, capability analysis, root-cause analysis, DOE, Lean, Six Sigma and TPM methods to solve chronic production issues. 
 - Prioritize engineering resources based on business impact, customer risk, technical urgency and sustainability of countermeasures. 
 - Drive standardization and replication of proven improvements across lines, technologies and factories where applicable. 3. Quality, Customer Complaint and Compliance Support

- Partner with Quality to investigate customer complaints, internal nonconformities and high-impact quality events. 
 - Lead technical root-cause analysis and ensure corrective and preventive actions are robust, verified and sustained. 
 - Ensure engineering solutions comply with quality systems, EHS requirements, regulatory expectations and internal manufacturing standards. 
 - Promote prevention-oriented engineering practices rather than reactive issue handling. 4. New Product, Equipment and Technology Industrialization

- Support qualification, execute validation, and ramp-up and handover plans for new processes, equipment and automation projects. 
 - Ensure lessons learned, process risks, maintenance requirements, training needs and production controls are captured before serial release. 
 - Act as the factory engineering interface to Global Development and other global support functions to accelerate robust industrialization. 5. Automation, Digital Manufacturing

- Drive automation, Industry 4. 0, MES, IoT, data analytics and predictive-maintenance initiatives with clear business cases and execution discipline.

Here, you will find more than just a job-you will find purpose and pride. 

Job Summary

We are seeking a Development and Test Manager with 12+ years of experience leading software development, verification, and quality engineering for connected healthcare and regulated medical software. The manager will provide technical and people leadership across the complete product lifecycle-from requirements, architecture, design, and implementation through functional, automation, performance, reliability, and release-readiness testing. This role owns delivery of cloud-native applications, REST and GraphQL APIs, user interfaces, microservices, medical-device integrations, and EMR/EHR workflows within agreed quality, schedule, and budget commitments. The role combines engineering leadership, development and test governance, technical direction, stakeholder management, design-control compliance, and audit-ready delivery. 

What You'll Be Doing

- Define and continuously improve the integrated software development and test strategy in alignment with product roadmaps, business priorities, regulatory commitments, architecture direction, and release plans. 
 - Lead software developers, automation engineers, performance engineers, and functional verification engineers; manage capacity, hiring, onboarding, objectives, coaching, technical development, succession planning, and delivery accountability. 
 - Plan and lead engineering assignments involving the evaluation, selection, and adaptation of software designs, technologies, development methods, test approaches, tools, and engineering practices. 
 - Provide technical direction from product conception through requirements, architecture, detailed design, implementation, integration, verification, release, and sustaining activities. 
 - Establish software engineering governance covering estimation, design and code reviews, coding standards, branching and configuration management, unit and component testing, static analysis, code coverage, technical debt, defect management, and quality metrics. 
 - Ensure software architecture and implementation meet requirements for maintainability, security, scalability, performance, reliability, interoperability, observability, and supportability. 
 - Own delivery of cloud-native applications, microservices, REST and GraphQL APIs, web user interfaces, integration services, and data processing capabilities using appropriate C#/. NET and related technologies. 
 - Establish test governance, risk-based planning, entry and exit criteria, requirements traceability, defect management, quality dashboards, and release-readiness assessments. 
 - Own the roadmap and governance for reusable C#-based REST API and UI automation frameworks, including coding standards, test-data management, parallel execution, logging, reporting, and environment configuration. 
 - Ensure unit, component, integration, smoke, regression, performance, scalability, reliability, security, and release-level testing is incorporated into CI/CD pipelines with appropriate automated quality gates. 
 - Guide design, development, integration, and verification of HL7 ADT, FHIR resources, clinical workflows, EMR/EHR interfaces, connected medical devices, real-time communications, notifications, and downstream clinical systems. 
 - Implement configuration and change management throughout the complete product lifecycle, including design, development, verification, release, and sustaining phases. 
 - Partner with product, clinical, systems, architecture, DevOps, cybersecurity, quality, regulatory, service, manufacturing, and external integration teams to resolve dependencies, technical issues, and product risks. 
 - Drive root-cause analysis by correlating application behavior, source code, automated and performance results, logs, API traces, network data, database records, queues, container metrics, and infrastructure telemetry. 
 - Incorporate field issues, customer feedback, post-market learnings, and production trends into product design improvements, corrective actions, regression coverage, reliability testing, and performance validation. 
 - Ensure compliance with the product development process, design controls, Quality System requirements, software lifecycle procedures, cybersecurity expectations, and applicable regulatory standards. 
 - Maintain audit-ready requirements, architecture and design records, code and review evidence, plans, test cases, objective evidence, reports, approvals, and traceability in approved tools such as Jira, Jama, source-control platforms, and validated test-management systems. 
 - Develop project plans, engineering milestones, resource strategies, budgets, and delivery forecasts; identify and mitigate issues that could affect quality, cost, scope, or schedule. 
 - Manage external development partners, contractors, vendors, and third-party service providers, including technical direction, deliverable acceptance, and performance monitoring. 
 - Communicate development progress, quality status, technical risks, mitigation plans, resource needs, architecture decisions, test findings, and go/no-go recommendations to program and leadership forums. 

What You'll Bring

- 12-18 years of software engineering, software development, testing, verification, quality engineering, or performance engineering experience, including at least 5 years leading multidisciplinary technical teams in a regulated or safety-critical environment. 
 - B. E/B. Tech in Computer Science / Electronics & Communication / Electrical or related field 
 - Demonstrated experience managing the complete software development lifecycle, including requirements analysis, architecture, design, implementation, code review, unit testing, integration, verification, release, and sustaining engineering. 
 - Strong hands-on or technical leadership experience with C#/. NET, object-oriented design, design patterns, REST and GraphQL APIs, microservices, web applications, and distributed systems. 
 - Demonstrated ownership of functional and automation test strategy for REST APIs, web user interfaces, integration workflows, and end-to-end regression using Playwright, Selenium, NUnit, xUnit, MSTest, or comparable technologies. 
 - Experience with software architecture and engineering practices such as clean architecture, secure coding, static analysis, code quality, code coverage, configuration management, branching strategies, dependency management, and technical-debt reduction. 
 - Experience validating distributed microservices, event-driven systems, JSON/XML, SQL/PostgreSQL, authentication, authorization, RabbitMQ, Azure Service Bus, MQTT, or comparable technologies. 
 - Working knowledge of Azure, Docker, Kubernetes, autoscaling, service discovery, role-based access control, secrets management, service mesh, resilience, and cloud observability. 
 - Experience with CI/CD architecture, Git, build automation, automated quality gates, pipeline troubleshooting, artifact management, deployment practices, test reporting, and engineering dashboards. 
 - Healthcare domain expertise covering HL7 v2, ADT messages and acknowledgements, FHIR REST resources, EMR/EHR workflows, connected medical devices, data integrity, patient safety, privacy, and clinical risk. 
 - Knowledge of regulated healthcare software practices and standards such as IEC 62304, ISO 13485, ISO 14971, design controls, cybersecurity expectations, and formal verification evidence. 
 - Ability to manage complex projects and engineering programs within boundaries of quality, time, scope, and budget while balancing development and verification priorities. 
 - Strong people leadership, stakeholder influencing, conflict resolution, planning, prioritization, vendor coordination, risk management, and executive communication skills. 

Preferred Skills

- Experience with SIP, RTP, WebSocket, WebRTC, audio/video communication, Kamailio, FreeSWITCH, RTPEngine, or comparable real-time communication technologies. 
 - Experience with Grafana, Prometheus, Application Insights, APM platforms, centralized logging, packet analysis, database diagnostics, and automated performance-threshold evaluation.

 - Experience with Jira, Jama, validated toolchains, Agile/Scrum delivery, and formal release-readiness reviews.

data.title: AI Automation Engineer
data.description:
About the Role

Our client is looking for an AI Automation Engineer to design, build, and operate AI-powered automations that reduce manual effort across business and engineering workflows. 

This is a hands-on engineering role focused on converting ambiguous, human-in-the-loop processes into reliable, monitored, production-grade automations using LLMs, agentic frameworks, APIs, and workflow orchestration tools. 

Minimum Qualifications

- 3-5 years of professional experience in Software Engineering, Data Engineering, or Automation Engineering, including at least 1 year of hands-on LLM/AI experience. 
 - Strong Python development skills, including API integration, asynchronous programming, testing, packaging, and maintainable code. 
 - Practical experience using LLM APIs such as OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, Gemini, or Amazon Bedrock in production applications. 
 - Hands-on experience with at least one agentic AI/orchestration framework, such as LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, CrewAI, Semantic Kernel, or AutoGen. 
 - Demonstrated experience building RAG systems using vector stores such as pgvector, Pinecone, Weaviate, Qdrant, Milvus, or OpenSearch. 
 - Strong understanding of prompt engineering, context design, structured outputs, JSON schemas, tool/function calling, and validation. 
 - Familiarity with Model Context Protocol (MCP) and building MCP servers to expose internal systems as agent tools. 
 - Strong experience with REST/GraphQL APIs, OAuth, token-based authentication, webhooks, pagination, and rate-limit handling. 
 - Working knowledge of SQL and data modeling. 
 - Experience with Git, code reviews, and CI/CD. 
 - Cloud experience with AWS, Azure, or GCP, including compute, serverless functions, queues, secrets management, and managed AI services. 
 - Basic Docker/containerization knowledge. 
 - Strong stakeholder-management skills, including requirements gathering, prototyping, demonstrations, and expectation management. 

Key Responsibilities

- Build and deploy end-to-end AI automations and agentic workflows integrating LLMs with internal systems, APIs, and data sources. 
 - Design and implement RAG pipelines, including chunking, embeddings, vector search, re-ranking, and grounded response generation. 
 - Develop tool/function-calling integrations that allow AI agents to interact with ticketing systems, ERP platforms, document stores, and internal APIs. 
 - Build MCP servers to expose internal systems as tools for AI agents. 
 - Partner with stakeholders to identify high-value automation opportunities and prioritize an automation roadmap based on ROI and feasibility. 
 - Develop production-grade Python services and jobs, including API clients, data transformations, schedulers, and event-driven handlers. 
 - Build LLM evaluation frameworks using golden datasets, regression testing, accuracy checks, hallucination detection, and quality gates. 
 - Implement observability and tracing to monitor failures, costs, latency, and quality degradation. 
 - Design human-in-the-loop checkpoints, approval workflows, and safe fallbacks where full autonomy is not appropriate. 
 - Optimize AI applications for cost and latency through model selection, caching, batching, prompt optimization, and model routing. 
 - Document architecture, runbooks, and operational procedures and support automations after production deployment. 
 - Ensure AI solutions comply with security, privacy, responsible AI, access-control, and PII requirements. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with workflow automation platforms such as n8n, Zapier, Power Automate, Airflow, Temporal, Prefect, or Dagster. 
 - RPA experience with UiPath, Automation Anywhere, or Blue Prism. 
 - Experience with LLM observability and evaluation tools such as LangSmith, LangFuse, Arize, Braintrust, Ragas, or DeepEval. 
 - Experience designing multi-agent systems, including planner/executor and supervisor architectures. 
 - Experience with document intelligence, OCR, PDF parsing, table extraction, and multimodal/vision models. 
 - Frontend experience with React. js, Next. js, or TypeScript. 
 - Exposure to Terraform, CloudFormation, or Kubernetes. 
 - Experience with enterprise AI governance, including audit trails, data residency, AI risk reviews, and access-scoped retrieval. 
 - Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

data.title: Senior Software Engineer
data.description:
About Us

Elchemy is building the cross-border marketplace for specialty chemicals, a $800B industry that still runs on emails, spreadsheets, phone calls and personal relationships. We connect manufacturers across Asia with buyers across the US and Europe, and we're replacing that fragmented, opaque process with software. 

In 4 years, we've scaled to customers in 55+ countries and suppliers in 25+ countries, and we've done it on a proprietary technology platform that keeps manual work to a minimum. That platform is the product. Every quote, quality check, document, shipment and payment flows through systems we've built ourselves, which means we have deep, structured data on how global chemical trade actually works. 

Now we're building what comes next: the largest B2B chemicals marketplace, powered by AI agents. We believe that in the near future, agents will make a large share of procurement and sales decisions. Whoever builds the infrastructure those agents run on, with the data, trust and rails to transact across borders, will define how the industry works. We want to be that company, and we're early enough that the architecture is still being written. 

We're backed by Prime Venture Partners and Info Edge Ventures. Our team includes alumni of IITs, IIMs and NITs, plus people who have built and scaled startups and worked at global multinationals. 

What you'll do

- Design and build the Django backend that runs Elchemy's operations and powers our marketplace. You'll own architecture, data models and APIs from first design to production. 
 - Own features end to end. Turn ambiguous business problems into simple, shippable systems, and deploy and monitor them in production. 
 - Our systems handle multi-currency transactions, compliance documentation, supplier and product data, and shipments across borders. Data integrity and reliability matter here because real orders depend on them. 
 - Use AI coding tools to move faster, and review their output with a critical eye. Help us find where LLMs add real value in the product. 
 - Own deployment, monitoring and uptime on AWS, and find and fix performance bottlenecks before they hurt users. 
 - Lead through code reviews, clear documentation and sound engineering practices. Mentor engineers as the team grows, and have a real say in technical direction. 
 - Partner closely with product, design and frontend to decide what gets built and why, not just how. 

What we're looking for

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or related technical disciplines from a Tier-1/2 college. Strong CS fundamentals and good system design instincts. You can explain tradeoffs and design something that holds up as load and complexity grow. 
 - 5+ years building and running production backend systems, with strong Python and Django (including Django REST Framework). 
 - Solid fundamentals and proven experience of working with data pipelines, event driven architecture, and large-scale backend systems. 
 - Solid understanding of relational databases (e. g. , MySQL, PostgreSQL): schema design, query optimization, and keeping data correct as systems grow. 
 - Engineering Best Practices: Strong knowledge of Test-Driven Development (TDD) and experience with the full software development life cycle (SDLC) on a Linux platform. 
 - Production experience on AWS (such as EC2, RDS, S3, DynamoDB, Cloudfront, Lambda, Bedrock) or similar GCP services. 
 - Experience integrating LLMs into products (LangChain, OpenAI, Anthropic APIs) or working with third-party and open-source integrations. 
 - Strong code-reading and debugging skills. You can drop into an unfamiliar service and find what's wrong. 
 - Real fluency with AI coding tools: you know when to trust them, how to prompt them well, and how to trim and correct what they produce. 
 - An ownership mindset. You're comfortable in a small team without a dedicated QA function, and you take responsibility for quality, testing and reliability.

This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Principal QA Engineer / QA Manager based in India. 

The Principal QA Engineer / QA Manager will define and drive quality engineering practices across critical product areas, with a strong focus on test automation and performance engineering. You will take ownership of the testing lifecycle, ensuring that complex features and changes meet demanding reliability and release standards. The role involves designing automation frameworks, validating high-volume transactional systems, and identifying performance bottlenecks before they affect users. You will work closely with Engineering, Product, and DevOps teams to embed quality throughout the development and deployment process. You will also leverage AI-powered tools to improve test creation, analysis, and defect investigation. Alongside hands-on technical ownership, you will mentor QA engineers, influence testing standards, and provide data-driven recommendations on release readiness.

 - Mentor and support QA engineers through technical guidance, code reviews, and collaborative pairing sessions. 
 - Track and report quality metrics, including defect escape rates, critical-path test coverage, and release stability. 
 - Communicate quality concerns and release risks to the Director and relevant stakeholders early, using clear data and analysis to support decisions.

- 7+ years of experience in software Quality Assurance or test engineering, with a strong emphasis on test automation.

data.title: Reflections Info Systems - Lead AI/Agentic Platform Architect
data.description:
Job Description Include

Agentic AI Architecture & Platform Engineering : 

- Design and architect scalable, enterprise-grade agentic AI platforms and solutions. 
 - Define agent orchestration patterns, runtime architecture, workflows, and multi-agent communication mechanisms. 
 - Architect prompt engineering frameworks, tool calling, connectors, and model integration strategies. 
 - Design memory management, state persistence, and context management mechanisms. 
 - Evaluate and implement RAG architectures and vector database integrations wherever applicable. 

LLM & AI Integration

- Design and integrate LLM-based applications using leading commercial and open-source models. 
 - Establish model integration patterns, routing, fallback mechanisms, and model selection strategies. 
 - Define reusable components and frameworks for agent development and deployment. 
 - Optimize model performance, latency, scalability, and token consumption. 

AI Evaluation, Monitoring & Observability

- Define evaluation frameworks to measure agent accuracy, reliability, consistency, and performance. 
 - Establish mechanisms for testing prompts, tools, workflows, and end-to-end agent behaviour. 
 - Implement telemetry, monitoring, tracing, and observability for agentic systems. 
 - Define mechanisms to identify hallucinations, failures, and performance bottlenecks. 

AI Safety, Security & Governance

- Identify and address security and governance gaps in agentic AI architectures. 
 - Establish guardrails for responsible AI implementation, including access controls and data protection. 
 - Define policies for tool permissions, human-in-the-loop controls, and agent execution boundaries. 
 - Ensure appropriate compliance, auditability, and governance standards are incorporated into the architecture. 

Technical Leadership & Architecture Assessment

- Assess existing AI and agentic platform architectures and map technical dependencies. 
 - Identify architecture gaps, integration challenges, scalability risks, and opportunities for improvement. 
 - Recommend target-state architecture and implementation roadmaps. 
 - Collaborate with engineering, product, and business stakeholders to translate requirements into technical solutions. 
 - Provide technical guidance and architectural direction to engineering teams. 

Primary Skills

- 5+ years of experience in software architecture, AI engineering, platform engineering, or related technical roles, including recent hands-on experience building LLM-powered and agentic AI systems. 
 - Strong understanding of agent orchestration frameworks, agent runtimes, multi-agent systems, and workflow automation. 
 - Hands-on experience with LLM integrations, prompt engineering, function calling, and tool orchestration. 
 - Experience designing memory, state management, context handling, and RAG-based architectures. 
 - Knowledge of vector databases, embeddings, semantic search, and retrieval mechanisms. 
 - Experience implementing AI guardrails, evaluation frameworks, and observability solutions. 
 - Strong understanding of AI security, governance, data privacy, and responsible AI principles. 
 - Ability to assess complex architectures, identify dependencies, and recommend scalable technical solutions. 
 - Strong communication and stakeholder management skills. 

Secondary Skills

- Experience with frameworks and platforms such as LangChain, LangGraph, Semantic Kernel, AutoGen, CrewAI, or equivalent. 
 - Exposure to cloud-based AI ecosystems such as Azure OpenAI, AWS Bedrock, or Google Vertex AI. 
 - Experience with vector databases such as Pinecone, Weaviate, Qdrant, or Azure AI Search. 
 - Familiarity with agent evaluation tools, tracing, and monitoring frameworks. 
 - Experience designing enterprise AI platforms with security, scalability, and cost optimization considerations.

data.title: Principal Application Software Engineer
data.description:
Job Description

We're looking for exceptional engineers to join our team, with a strong foundation in distributed systems, microservices architecture, and modern technologies. This role presents a unique opportunity to design and build innovative, cloud-centric applications from scratch, and make a significant impact on our technical and business strategies. You'll enjoy autonomy and ownership in your work, and be part of a team that values diversity, inclusivity, and creativity. Our dynamic and flexible work environment is designed to support and encourage you to excel, and thrive in a culture that fosters innovation and growth. 

Responsibilities

About Us: 

At Oracle, we are transforming healthcare by modernizing Electronic Health Record (EHR) systems to empower front-line healthcare professionals. Our mission is to enable them to focus more on patient care and less on administrative tasks, achieving peak efficiency with the support of generative AI and modernized applications. By leveraging the power of generative AI and state-of-the-art applications, we aim to enhance efficiency and effectiveness in healthcare delivery. Our approach to modernization includes investing in cutting-edge AI capabilities, advancing user experience, and offering open APIs that enable customers and third parties to develop innovative, integrated solutions. We are dedicated to creating a seamless and intuitive healthcare experience that benefits patients, providers, payers, and the entire healthcare ecosystem. 

Our Mission: At Oracle Health, we prioritize humans in the healthcare experience-for patients, providers, payers, and the population. We advance healthcare and population-level health by making cutting-edge solutions practical and effective at the practitioner level. Our goal is to enable patients to receive care from anyone, anywhere, on any device by providing practitioners with comprehensive medical information. 

As a Principal Application Software Engineer on our team, you'll be responsible for and will lead efforts in designing and building scalable, distributed, and resilient software components and services to support health care platform, applications, and our end users. We believe in ownership and expect you to think long term, mentor, and empower other engineers. 

Qualifications and Experience: 

Technical Skills: 

- BS degree in Computer Science or related field (MS preferred) 
 - 10+ years distributed service engineering experience in a software development environment 
 - Expert in Java and an exceptional problem solver 
 - Deep understanding of object-oriented design and SDK development, specifically within a cloud environment 
 - Strong skills in data structures, algorithms, operating systems, and distributed systems fundamentals. 
 - Experience working closely with architects, principals, product and program managers to deliver product features on time and with high quality. 
 - Working familiarity with networking protocols (TCP/IP, HTTP) and standard network architectures. 
 - Experience with containers and container orchestration technologies (Kubernetes, Docker) 
 - Good understanding of databases, NoSQL systems, storage and distributed persistence technologies. 
 - Good understanding of Linux 
 - Demonstrable technical leadership and mentorship skills 
 - Knowledge of OCI or AWS, Azure, GCP, Public Cloud SaaS, PaaS Services and/or related technology is a plus 
 - Good to have hands-on experience designing, developing, and operating public cloud service control planes

Functional Skills: 

- Design and implement intuitive and seamless customer experiences. 
 - Proficiency in Agile methodologies, especially Scrum. 
 - Experience using ticket tracking systems such as JIRA. 
 - Ability to quickly translate wireframes into prototypes and production-ready interfaces. 
 - Quick learner with the ability to pick up new languages and technologies. 
 - Self-driven and able to work independently on projects, even as designs evolve. 
 - Passionate about learning and staying updated with new technologies and services. 
 - Strong communication skills, including cross-team collaboration. 
 - Ability to deliver basic functionality and iterate rapidly. 
 - Experience working with geographically distributed teams. 
 - Significant plus: Knowledge of healthcare and experience delivering healthcare applications. 

Career Level - IC4

About Us

Only Oracle brings together the data, infrastructure, applications, and expertise to power everything from industry innovations to life-saving care. And with AI embedded across our products and services, we help customers turn that promise into a better future for all. Discover your potential at a company leading the way in AI and cloud solutions that impact billions of lives. 

True innovation starts when everyone is empowered to contribute. That's why we're committed to growing a workforce that promotes opportunities for all with competitive benefits that support our people with flexible medical, life insurance, and retirement options. We also encourage employees to give back to their communities through our volunteer programs. 

We're committed to including people with disabilities at all stages of the employment process. If you require accessibility assistance or accommodation for a disability at any point, let us know by emailing accommodation-request_mb@oracle. com or by calling 1-888-404-2494 in the United States. 

Oracle is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability and protected veterans' status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Oracle will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records pursuant to applicable law.

About Simplotel

Simplotel is a Bangalore-based Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) company helping over 3, 000 hotels across 26 countries grow their direct business. We power e-commerce for some of the largest hotels in India. The name Simplotel comes from a combination of "Simple" and "Hotel". Our mission is to simplify the lives of hoteliers through technology. 

Simplotel is a "Shopify for Hotels". Founded in October 2013, Simplotel is funded by Go-MMT, India's largest online travel agency. 

Simplotel was awarded Best Startup in Travel & Hospitality for 2021 by Startup India, an initiative of the Union Ministry of Commerce & Industry in India. 

Your Opportunity

At Simplotel, you will understand our customers' unique business needs and develop features that help them grow their businesses. You will then design, implement, and maintain these features. Examples of key functionality include booking and search engines, template engines, rules engines, user management, and more. You will also leverage AI-based code generation and design tools to develop and deliver product features rapidly. We are building a global product from India, and you can be part of this opportunity!

Position : Senior Software Engineer

Roles And Responsibilities

- Design, build, and maintain high-performance, scalable full-stack services. 
 - Create clean APIs with solid test coverage and enforce and elevate code quality, resiliency, and engineering standards across the engineering team. 
 - Prototype and deploy AI-powered features, including LLMs, RAG over hotel and content data, agentic automations, and intelligent assistants, to production. 
 - Define prompts, guardrails, and evaluation criteria for AI systems. 
 - Measure and optimise the quality, latency, and cost of AI features in production. 
 - Integrate AI coding assistants such as Claude Code and Copilot into daily workflows to increase developer and team productivity. 
 - Own features end-to-end, from definition and prioritisation based on key business goals through implementation, deployment, and ongoing maintenance. 
 - Build and maintain integrations with third-party systems such as payment gateways, channel managers, and AI/LLM providers. 
 - Own production services through proactive monitoring, performance tuning, debugging, and incident response. 

Skills Required

- 5+ years of software engineering experience. 
 - Ability to work independently, manage priorities and deadlines effectively, and drive continuous improvements. 
 - Full-stack proficiency covering UI, API, and storage layers. 
 - Experience designing clean RESTful JSON APIs with defined SLAs. 
 - Hands-on experience with Java, Spring Boot, and the Spring ecosystem. 
 - Strong understanding of core data structures, algorithms, and database principles. 
 - Practical experience building with GenAI/LLMs, including model APIs, prompt design, RAG, embeddings, vector stores, and agent frameworks. 
 - Proficiency in using AI coding assistants such as Claude and Codex to accelerate development, with the judgement to evaluate, verify, and reject AI-generated code when necessary. 
 - Strong backend engineering and debugging skills, with experience designing and troubleshooting features in distributed systems and a solid understanding of web technologies. 
 - Working proficiency with Linux/Ubuntu, Git, and foundational AWS services. 

Good To Have

- Experience migrating services from Python to Java or working with polyglot backends. 
 - Exposure to messaging systems. 
 - Experience with Docker, CI/CD, and infrastructure-as-code. 
 - Prior experience in travel, hospitality, or high-traffic e-commerce.

data.description:
Job Description

- About the Company/Team

Oracle Health Data Intelligence (HDI) is a newly established organization within Oracle Health, created to revolutionize how healthcare and technology intersect. HDI is focused on building a next-generation platform to support modernized, automated healthcare through data-driven innovation and cloud-scale engineering. With the entrepreneurial spirit of a startup and the global impact of Oracle, the team is building the foundation for intelligent healthcare products that serve patients, providers, and partners worldwide. 

HDI's mission is to transform healthcare through intelligent data applications-enabling better decisions, operational efficiency, and clinical outcomes. This is a net-new line of business, providing a rare opportunity to shape its culture, engineering excellence, and technical direction from the ground up. 

- Job Summary

As a Senior Software Engineer, you will design, build, and scale complex cloud-based applications and services that power Oracle Health Data Intelligence products. You'll be responsible for defining system architecture, developing robust and secure applications, and mentoring junior engineers. This role demands a deep technical understanding, strong problem-solving abilities, and a passion for building impactful software that drives the healthcare industry forward. 

- Qualifications & Skills

Mandatory: 

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field. 
 - 5+ years of hands-on experience in software development. 
 - Proficiency in Java and any Major java script framework for application development. 
 - Strong experience with Relational Databases (SQL, MySQL). 
 - Experience designing and consuming RESTful APIs. 
 - Experience with Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) or other cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP). 
 - Knowledge of microservices architecture, CI/CD pipelines, and containerization (Docker, Kubernetes). 
 - Solid understanding of software design principles, distributed systems, and cloud-based architectures. 
 - Strong problem-solving and debugging skills. 
 - Excellent communication and collaboration abilities. 

Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

Application Software Development: 

- Drives medium features and quality improvements with measurable performance and reliability outcomes. 
 - Provides global production support for critical issues with minimal guidance; improves playbooks/alerts. 
 - Troubleshoots and debugs non-routine issues spanning application layers and common OCI services; proposes fixes. 
 - Partners with QA to define test strategy (unit/integration) for features; ensures consistency across modules. 
 - Considers trade-offs in existing architecture; proposes moderate design improvements. 
 - Translates ambiguous requirements into scalable designs and implementation plans. 
 - Defines and stabilizes API contracts and dependencies for the application area. 
 - Recommends build priorities within the team using data from incidents, telemetry, and customer feedback. 
 - Systematically incorporates external feedback (forums, live-site reports) into backlog refinement. 
 - Mentors junior engineers; coordinates cross-functionally on feature delivery. 

Software Development and Coding - Design, Testing, and Optimization: 

- Designs software solutions and analyzes and helps identify requirements to achieve business and operational goals, independently. 
 - Adheres to and suggests improvements to all phases of the software development lifecycle. 
 - Utilizes working knowledge to develop new software features and enhancements following design specifications and develops documents to clarify software design and code. 
 - Leads code reviews in designated areas to help drive improvements. 
 - Conducts debugging and troubleshooting to identify and fix moderately complex software issues. 
 - Develops fixes for identified issues. 
 - Implements software testing (e. g. , functional and non-functional testing), quality assurance processes, software error logging, monitoring, and observability for effective debugging, ensuring review by manager and/or lead throughout the process. 
 - Exercises judgment and discretion to conduct performance profiling and optimization of coding. 
 - Troubleshoots and resolves moderately complex issues related to application programming interface (API) functionality and integration. 
 - Implements moderately complex API versioning, lifecycle, and interoperability strategies. 

Software Architecture - Software System Structural Design: 

- Designs and develops software, systems, and services aligned to pre-defined system architecture. 
 - Develops working knowledge of software architecture decisions and best practices. 
 - Collaborates with team leads to review work to ensure alignment with software architecture. 
 - Implements moderately complex performance optimization and scalability strategies in software design. 

Issue/Defect Collaboration - Software Products Support: 

- Collaborates within and beyond immediate team to understand customer issues and align solutions. 
 - May provide technical guidance and support to customers regarding customer-reported issues, independently. 
 - Coaches, mentors, and guides others to advocate for customers' interests and suggests product enhancements based on feedback. 
 - Influences team to ensure customer satisfaction through timely resolution of issues and effective communication. 
 - Implements customer issue and/or defect handling and training processes, independently. 
 - Investigates and troubleshoots complex product maintenance issues to ensure customer agreement on short- and long-term solutions (e. g. , future enhancements). 

Practices and Standards Compliance - Security and Compliance: 

- Collaborates with the team to establish and follow development practices and coding standards. 
 - Exercises judgment and discretion to ensure code quality and adherence to broad acceptance criteria during development. 
 - Keeps up-to-date with industry best practices and applies them to software development processes. 
 - Implements secure coding practices to prevent security vulnerabilities. 

Development Operations - System Maintenance: 

- Performs periodic maintenance and testing operations for systems that require upgrading or patching (e. g. , for critical vulnerabilities). 
 - Exercises judgment and discretion to drive improvements, ensure automation, testing, and debugging of systems to ensure service/product availability, health, support, and reliability. 

Core Responsibilities

Planning & Execution: 

- Independently manages work, monitoring timelines and deliverables to ensure projects or initiatives stay on track and meet requirements. 
 - Proactively prioritizes work and adapts to resource or timeline shifts, suggesting adjustments to maintain project efficiency. 

Collaboration & Partnership: 

- Collaborates across teams to align on expectations and achieve shared objectives. 
 - Builds and maintains a comprehensive understanding of business, stakeholder, and/or customer needs to build and support effective partnerships. 
 - Actively listens to diverse perspectives and asks questions to ensure understanding of others. 

Problem Solving: 

- Independently identifies and addresses standard and non-standard issues in accordance with standard practices, escalating more complex issues as appropriate. 
 - Analyzes data and/or information from multiple sources to troubleshoot standard and non-standard errors. 
 - Contributes to knowledge sharing and best practices. 

Continuous Learning: 

- Embraces continuous learning by actively seeking to build knowledge and new skills and/or tools and staying current with industry trends and best practices. 
 - Seeks out and leverages feedback and training to improve skills. 
 - Contributes to a culture of continuous learning and knowledge sharing with team members. 

Continuous Improvement: 

- Develops ideas and recommends updates to increase the efficiency and effectiveness of processes, protocols, and workflows within a team. 
 - Seeks input from team members on alternative approaches and methods for improving work. 

About Us

Only Oracle brings together the data, infrastructure, applications, and expertise to power everything from industry innovations to life-saving care. And with AI embedded across our products and services, we help customers turn that promise into a better future for all. Discover your potential at a company leading the way in AI and cloud solutions that impact billions of lives. 

True innovation starts when everyone is empowered to contribute. That's why we're committed to growing a workforce that promotes opportunities for all with competitive benefits that support our people with flexible medical, life insurance, and retirement options. We also encourage employees to give back to their communities through our volunteer programs. 

We're committed to including people with disabilities at all stages of the employment process. If you require accessibility assistance or accommodation for a disability at any point, let us know by emailing accommodation-request_mb@oracle. com or by calling 1-888-404-2494 in the United States. 

Oracle is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability and protected veterans' status, or any other characteristic protected by law. data.title: Lead Validation Engineer - Audio
data.description:
Job Requirements

We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Audio Validation Engineering Lead to drive the testing, characterization, and validation of our next-generation wearable audio products. In this role, you will own the end-to-end audio validation strategy for devices such as true wireless stereo (TWS) earbuds, smartwatches, and augmented reality (AR) glasses. You will lead a team of validation engineers, define test methodologies, and work closely with cross-functional teams including acoustic design, digital signal processing (DSP), firmware, and product management to ensure our devices deliver exceptional, industry-leading audio quality . 

As the Audio Validation Engineering Lead, you will be responsible for defining performance targets, developing automated test frameworks, and managing state-of-the-art audio laboratory environments. Your expertise will be critical in validating complex audio features such as Active Noise Cancellation (ANC), Acoustic Echo Cancellation (AEC), beamforming microphone arrays, and spatial audio rendering

Work Experience

Key Responsibilities-

- Strategic Leadership: Define and execute the comprehensive audio hardware validation strategy for all wearable product lines from prototype (EVT/DVT) through mass production (PVT/MP). 
 - Team Management: Mentor, grow, and lead a team of audio test and validation engineers. Manage resource allocation, laboratory schedules, and project timelines to meet aggressive product launch milestones. 
 - Test Methodology Development: Design and implement rigorous test plans and procedures for characterizing loudspeakers, microphones, and complete acoustic systems. Ensure compliance with international audio standards (e. g. , IEC 60268, EN 50332, ITU-T). 
 - Advanced Feature Validation: Lead the objective and subjective evaluation of advanced audio algorithms, including feedforward/feedback ANC, transparency modes, voice call quality (AEC/noise suppression), and wind noise reduction. 
 - Automation & Tooling: Drive the development of scalable, automated audio test frameworks using Python, MATLAB, or LabVIEW to streamline regression testing and continuous integration (CI) pipelines. 
 - Cross-Functional Collaboration: Serve as the primary technical representative for audio validation in leadership reviews. Partner with acoustic, mechanical, and electrical engineers to root-cause hardware failures, mitigate acoustic artifacts (e. g. , rub and buzz), and optimize acoustic seals. 
 - Factory Support: Support contract manufacturers (CMs) during early builds. Transfer validation test limits and methodologies to factory production lines to ensure consistent manufacturing quality. 

Required Qualifications

- Education: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Acoustics, Physics, Computer Engineering, or a closely related field. 
 - Experience: 6-9 years of hands-on experience in audio hardware testing, acoustic measurement, or audio systems engineering, with at least 2+ years in a technical leadership or management role. 
 - Domain Expertise: Deep understanding of electroacoustics, transducer design principles (microphones and micro-speakers), and audio signal processing fundamentals. Proven track record of shipping high-volume consumer audio electronics, specifically wearable or hearable devices. 
 - Laboratory Proficiency: Extensive hands-on experience setting up and operating acoustic test environments, including anechoic chambers, isolation booths, and specialized audio measurement equipment. 
 - Automation Skills: Strong programming and scripting skills (Python, MATLAB, C++) for automating test equipment and analyzing large datasets. 
 - Analytical Skills: Exceptional problem-solving abilities with a data-driven approach to root-cause analysis and statistical process control. 

Tools and Test Environment Expertise

The ideal candidate must possess deep practical knowledge of the following industry-standard tools and laboratory environments: 

Required Tools & Equipment

- Audio Analyzers -Audio Precision (APx500 series), Listen Inc. SoundCheck, Klippel R&D System, HEAD acoustics ACQUA. 
 - Acoustic Simulators-Head and Torso Simulators (HATS) such as GRAS KEMAR or Brüel & Kjær (B&K) Type 4128, including IEC 711 ear simulators and artificial mouths. 
 - Test Environments - Anechoic and hemi-anechoic chambers, ETSI-compliant background noise simulation rooms (e. g. , HEAD acoustics 3PASS). 
 - Software & Automation-Python (PyAudio, SciPy, NumPy), MATLAB, LabVIEW for test automation and data visualization. 
 - Simulation (Preferred)-Familiarity with COMSOL Multiphysics or similar acoustic/mechanical simulation software.

data.description:
Job Title: Manual and Automation Test Engineer

Job Summary

We are looking for a highly skilled Automation Engineer with a strong background in manual and automation testing to join our dynamic QA team. The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience in designing, developing, and maintaining automation frameworks, along with expertise in various testing tools and technologies to ensure high-quality software delivery. 

Key Responsibilities

- Execution of manual testing using test design techniques and requirement analysis. 
 - End to End functional and technical understanding of application and its integrated 3rd party applications. 
 - Identification of test scenarios, create test cases, and ensure comprehensive test coverage. 
 - Develop, execute, and maintain UI automation scripts using Selenium WebDriver (Java) and TestNG, including test grouping, parallel execution, and reporting. 
 - Build robust UI and API automation frameworks from scratch using Java, Selenium, RestAssured, TestNG, Maven, and best practices in design. 
 - Design and implement Cucumber BDD frameworks for scalable, behavior-driven testing. 
 - Automate and validate REST and GraphQL APIs (queries, mutations, schema validation) using RestAssured. 
 - Execute cross-browser testing and automate database validation using SQL. 
 - Manage automated tests with TestNG, including parallel runs, grouping, parameterization, retry logic, and detailed reporting. 
 - Collaborate with developers and product owners to refine requirements and improve overall software quality. 
 - Integrate automation suites into CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, Maven) for continuous testing. 
 - Continuously enhance and maintain automation frameworks for scalability, reusability, and performance. 

Required Skills & Qualifications

- 5 years of experience in manual testing, execution tracking, and defect reporting. 
 - Experience using JIRA for defect tracking and Xray/Zephyr for test management
 - Proven hands-on experience of 2 years in Automation using Selenium WebDriver and Java. 
 - Experience building and maintaining Cucumber BDD frameworks. 
 - Strong expertise in API automation using RestAssured and GraphQL. 
 - Solid understanding of core Java, OOP principles, debugging, and clean code practices. 
 - Strong SQL skills for database validation and automation. 
 - Experience with TestNG, including annotations, execution management, and reporting. 
 - Hands-on experience with Git for version control. 
 - Working knowledge of CI/CD tools such as Jenkins. 
 - Excellent analytical, problem-solving, communication, and collaboration skills. 
 - Experience working in Agile/Scrum development environments. 

Preferred Skills (Good To Have)

- Experience with Playwright, Cypress, or other modern automation tools. 
 - Knowledge of Python scripting for automation utilities. 
 - Exposure to API contract/schema validation frameworks. 
 - Experience conducting performance testing using JMeter. 
 - Familiarity with Docker, cloud testing platforms (BrowserStack, Sauce Labs), or containerized test execution.

data.title: Senior Quality Analyst - Automation (Playwright)
data.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Quality Analyst - Automation (Playwright) based in India. 

As a Senior Quality Analyst, you will play a key role in ensuring the quality, performance, and reliability of web applications, APIs, and integrated systems. You will lead both manual and automated testing initiatives, with a strong focus on building and maintaining scalable automation frameworks using Playwright and other testing technologies. Working closely with development, product, and technical teams, you will help embed quality throughout the software development lifecycle. You will contribute to end-to-end testing, defect prevention, and continuous improvement across diverse technology platforms. This role offers the opportunity to work with modern development frameworks, backend systems, and telephony technologies. Join a remote-first engineering environment where technical expertise, analytical thinking, and quality excellence are highly valued. 

Accountabilities

- Design, develop, and execute comprehensive manual and automated test cases based on product requirements, technical specifications, and business needs. 
 - Build, maintain, and enhance robust automation frameworks for UI, API, and backend testing, with a particular focus on Playwright. 
 - Perform end-to-end testing of web applications, APIs, and telephony systems to ensure functionality, reliability, and seamless integration. 
 - Collaborate closely with developers, product managers, and other stakeholders to integrate quality assurance practices throughout the software development lifecycle (SDLC). 
 - Identify, document, track, and manage defects using tools such as JIRA, ensuring timely resolution and effective communication. 
 - Analyze test results, identify defect trends, and provide actionable insights and recommendations to development teams. 
 - Ensure adequate test coverage and compliance with performance and quality benchmarks before product releases. 
 - Participate in technical design discussions and code reviews to improve testability and ensure the quality of deliverables. 
 - Validate application functionality across different components and environments, identifying potential issues before deployment. 
 - Continuously improve QA processes, automation strategies, testing tools, and methodologies to increase efficiency and reliability. 
 - Support release readiness by providing comprehensive testing feedback and quality assessments. 

Requirements

- 10+ years of professional experience in Quality Assurance, combining manual and automation testing. 
 - Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related discipline, or a Master's qualification such as MCA or M. Sc. in Information Technology. 
 - Strong hands-on experience with test automation tools and frameworks, particularly Playwright, as well as Selenium, Cypress, Postman/Newman, Pytest, or equivalent technologies. 
 - Advanced scripting skills in Python, JavaScript, or Java for developing and maintaining automated test solutions. 
 - Experience testing web applications built with PHP, ReactJS, and Node. js. 
 - Strong expertise in RESTful API testing using Postman, Swagger, SoapUI, or custom automation scripts. 
 - Experience with UI, API, backend, and end-to-end testing methodologies. 
 - Familiarity with telephony systems, preferably Asterisk or similar Voice over IP (VoIP) platforms. 
 - Experience with version control and CI/CD tools such as Git and Jenkins. 
 - Solid understanding of Agile and Scrum methodologies and their application in software development environments. 
 - Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, combined with exceptional attention to detail. 
 - Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across technical and business teams. 
 - Ability to work independently, manage testing priorities, and deliver high-quality results in a fast-paced environment. 

Nice To Have

- Experience with performance and load testing tools such as JMeter, Gatling, or Locust. 
 - Familiarity with cloud platforms such as AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform (GCP). 
 - ISTQB certification or other recognized Quality Assurance certifications. 
 - Experience optimizing automation frameworks and integrating automated tests into CI/CD pipelines. 

Benefits

- Fully remote working arrangement within India. 
 - Full-time employment opportunity. 
 - Opportunity to work on diverse web applications, APIs, and integrated technology platforms. 
 - Exposure to modern automation technologies, including Playwright and other industry-leading testing frameworks. 
 - Opportunity to contribute to software quality strategy and continuous improvement initiatives. 
 - Collaboration with experienced professionals across engineering, product, and technology teams. 
 - Professional growth through challenging projects involving automation, API testing, cloud technologies, and telephony systems.

data.title: Principal AI or ML Engineer
data.description:
Optum is a global organization that delivers care, aided by technology to help millions of people live healthier lives. The work you do with our team will directly improve health outcomes by connecting people with the care, pharmacy benefits, data and resources they need to feel their best. Here, you will find a culture guided by inclusion, talented peers, comprehensive benefits and career development opportunities. Come make an impact on the communities we serve as you help us advance health optimization on a global scale. Join us to start Caring. Connecting. Growing together. 

Our enterprise AI organization builds platforms that govern and operate AI systems across the business, spanning intake and registration, automated governance gating, request routing, and runtime observability and monitoring. Today, these capabilities operate as distinct components across the AI lifecycle. We need to connect them end-to-end - linking pre-production governance to post-production monitoring, alerting, feedback, and containment - to meet enterprise AI risk management commitments and committed audit-related deliverables. 

As a Principal AI/ML Engineer, you will architect and build the end-to-end AI lifecycle governance system connecting intake/registration, automated governance gating, request routing, and runtime observability/monitoring. This is a system-design role: you will define how these capabilities integrate, close the loop between pre-production governance and post-production monitoring/containment, and build the technical foundation the current team does not yet have in place. You will work across teams to design the integration points and lead the hands-on engineering teams to deliver them. 

Primary Responsibilities

- Architect the end-to-end AI lifecycle governance system linking intake/registration, automated governance gating, request routing, and runtime observability/monitoring 
 - Design the technical integration connecting pre-production governance (intake, automated gating) with post-production monitoring, alerting, feedback, and containment 
 - Define data flows, interfaces, and contracts between system components to support lifecycle traceability 
 - Build and implement core integration components hands-on, not limited to design 
 - Lead low-level design activities and break down architecture into executable engineering tasks 
 - Lead and influence senior engineers and architects across teams to align on a shared technical direction, without formal reporting authority over those teams 
 - Drive architectural consensus across intake, governance, routing, and observability teams, resolving design disagreements between senior engineers where priorities conflict 
 - Serve as the technical point of escalation for cross-platform integration decisions, influencing senior stakeholders through sound design rationale rather than positional authority 
 - Work directly with teams owning intake/registration, automated governance gating, request routing, and observability/monitoring to align on integration design and sequencing 
 - Identify and close architectural gaps that put enterprise AI audit commitments at risk 
 - Set technical direction and review designs/code to maintain consistency across the integrated system 
 - Comply with all applicable Company policies, procedures, and business directives, changes including those relating to work location, team assignments, work schedules, and flexible work arrangements

Required Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree or higher in computer science or related field 
 - Solid hands-on experience in AI/ML engineering, including building and integrating production AI systems 
 - Experience designing systems involving governance, monitoring, or lifecycle management of software/AI systems 
 - Experience working across multiple engineering teams to align on and deliver shared architecture 
 - Demonstrated experience in AI platform architecture - designing systems that span multiple components/services 
 - Solid Python skills, including building production-grade services and integrations 
 - Demonstrated ability to lead and influence senior engineers and architects across teams through technical credibility, in the absence of direct reporting authority 
 - Demonstrated ability to operate independently on ambiguous, undefined problems - this role is building something that does not yet exist on the team

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with AI observability, evaluation (evals), or testing platforms 
 - Experience with automated governance gating or policy-as-code approaches to AI governance 
 - Familiarity with human-in-the-loop (HITL) review and feedback mechanisms for AI systems 
 - Familiarity with enterprise AI audit or risk management frameworks

At UnitedHealth Group, our mission is to help people live healthier lives and make the health system work better for everyone. We believe everyone-of every race, gender, sexuality, age, location and income-deserves the opportunity to live their healthiest life. Today, however, there are still far too many barriers to good health which are disproportionately experienced by people of color, historically marginalized groups and those with lower incomes. We are committed to mitigating our impact on the environment and enabling and delivering equitable care that addresses health disparities and improves health outcomes - an enterprise priority reflected in our mission.
