data.title: Staff, Forward Deployed Engineer
data.description:
About the Role: 

GSK's Enterprise AI team builds AI solutions that prove value fast and scale to production. The Director, Forward Deployed Engineering leads the FDE function - the front of the Enterprise AI delivery pipeline that proves AI ideas with the business through PoCs, PoVs, MVPs and (where appropriate) first production versions, before handing proven solutions off to the Solutions Engineer for scale-up. The pattern is proven by AI-native companies - Anthropic, Palantir, OpenAI - and this role brings that model to GSK. 

This Staff role leads the Forward Deployed Engineering function with direct line management of the FDE team (Lead, Senior, and Forward Deployed Engineers, flat reporting structure). The Staff sets FDE strategy and engagement priorities, owns Director-level BU sponsor relationships, and represents Enterprise AI on FDE matters to GSK leadership. The role continues to contribute technically at the frontier of AI-augmented engineering - humans steer, agents execute. 

Why This Role Exists: 

Enterprise AI's ability to build credibility with the business depends on engineers who can land inside BU problems, prove value quickly, and hand off cleanly. The Director, Forward Deployed Engineering builds and leads the function that makes this happen. 

- Leads the FDE function - setting strategy, building the team, and owning the standards that determine whether the function delivers credibly. 
 - Owns the BU senior relationships that bring AI use cases to Enterprise AI and sustain engagement through the delivery cycle. 
 - Continues to contribute technically on the most strategic FDE engagements - keeping the Director's judgement grounded in current AI engineering reality. 

Key Responsibilities: 

FDE Function Leadership: 

- Lead the Forward Deployed Engineering function - strategy, structure, hiring, development, and standards. 
 - Hire, mentor, and develop the FDE team - creating development paths from G8 through to G5. 
 - Set the standards for AI-native engineering practice within the function - agent workflows, prompt and pattern libraries, handoff hygiene. 

BU Engagement & Strategic Delivery: 

- Own relationships with Director and Senior Director-level BU sponsors across business units that bring AI use cases to Enterprise AI. 
 - Take on the most strategic FDE engagements personally - the ones that set precedents for the function. 
 - Make and defend portfolio-level kill/continue decisions across FDE engagements with BU and Enterprise AI leadership. 

Cross-Functional Leadership: 

- Coordinate with the Solutions Engineering and Operations Engineering functions on the delivery pipeline; represent FDE in Enterprise AI leadership forums. 
 - Influence vendor strategy and tooling choices for AI-native engineering practice within Enterprise AI. 

Governance & Reporting: 

- Ensure the FDE function operates within Code Orange, Responsible AI, and Accountability Report governance from the prototype stage onward. 
 - Provide regular reporting to Enterprise AI leadership on FDE function performance - engagement pipeline, outcomes, team development, and capacity. 

Required Functional Experience: 

- At least 18+ years of experience in software engineering and AI/ML engineering, with significant time leading senior engineering teams or functions. 
 - Demonstrated experience taking AI ideas from sketch to working software at speed, in customer-facing engineering roles. 
 - Strong technical depth in GenAI patterns: agents, multi-agent orchestration, RAG, and evaluation. 
 - Daily use of AI coding agents (Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Databricks AI Assistant) as the primary mode of development. 
 - Experience hiring, mentoring, and developing senior engineering talent. 
 - Track record of representing engineering functions to senior business stakeholders. 

Preferred Experience: 

- Prior leadership experience at an AI-native company (Anthropic, Palantir, OpenAI, or similar) - Head of Forward Deployed Engineering, Director of Solutions, or equivalent. 
 - Experience in regulated industries (pharma, healthcare, financial services). 
 - Experience setting AI engineering standards at organisational scale. 

Education: 

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent practical experience. Master's degree/ Ph D in Computer Science, Mathematics or statistics or related field is advantageous. 

Skills

Artificial Intelligence (AI), Artificial Intelligence Ethics, Artificial Neural Networks (ANNS), Classification Models, Deep Learning, Intelligent Automation (IA), Machine Learning (ML), Model Evaluation, Predictive Modeling, Python (Programming Language), Test Documentation

Why GSK?

Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. 

GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2. 5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases - to impact health at scale. 

People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we're committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. Our culture of being ambitious for patients, accountable for impact and doing the right thing is the foundation for how, together, we deliver for patients, shareholders and our people.

data.title: Lead Engineer, AI Platform
data.description:
About Us

Circle is building the world's leading AI-powered, all-in-one platform for digital businesses. We make it possible for creators, coaches, educators, and businesses to bring together their audience with engaging discussions, live streams, events, chat, courses, and payments - all in one place, all under their own brand. 

We're proud to be a fully remote company of around 270 (and growing!) team members from 30+ countries around the world. We seek exceptional individuals around the world, set them up to do the best work of their lives, and in turn, create a meaningful impact in their own lives. We don't track hours, but we do manage for high expectations very closely. We collaborate across time zones, are highly async, and like to document a lot. 

Every year, we bring the whole company together in beautiful places around the world for our company offsites. So far, we've hosted offsites in Turkey, Portugal, Mexico, Thailand, Colombia, Italy, Ireland, and more, with still more to come!

Check out our Careers page for more about working at Circle. 

About The Role

The AI Quality engineering team at Circle owns the foundation for measuring, diagnosing, and improving the quality of Circle's AI-powered features. This team focuses on building the infrastructure to measure, diagnose, and improve production AI systems, rather than ML research or model training. 

We're looking for a Lead Engineer to help us build out the evaluation frameworks, observability tooling, and diagnostic infrastructure that tell us whether our AI Agents are working well, where to improve them, and how to make them faster and more cost-efficient. 

This is a hands-on player-coach role. You'll also lead and manage the AI Quality engineering team, with an ambitious and growing roadmap. 

If you're excited about making AI systems work reliably, efficiently, and at scale, this is for you. 

What You'll Be Doing

- Build and own our evaluation infrastructure. Design the CI/CD pipelines, scorers, and datasets that tell us whether Circle's AI agents (planners, tool-callers, and sub-agents) are actually working, from a single tool call to a full multi-turn conversation. 
 - Diagnose exactly where quality breaks down. Trace failures across the agent pipeline including plan creation vs. execution, tool selection, tool trajectory in complex areas like workflows, site builder, and analytics. Turn what you find into prototypes that solve the issue or identify priorities for AI core engineering can help. 
 - Grow the datasets that make evaluation possible. Stand up annotation workflows and build out AI-generated and simulated conversations so we can cover more of the product faster than manual labeling alone. 
 - Run structured experiments across prompts, models, and the agent harness. Evaluate new and open-source models against our production baseline, build the framework we use to decide when to shift models, and chase cost and latency wins through model swaps, caching, and routing by plan complexity. 
 - Lead and grow the AI Quality engineering team. Set technical direction and manage day-to-day priorities, all while staying hands-on in the code yourself. 
 - Partner closely with AI Core engineering. Work with the engineers building Circle's AI products so they have real confidence that their changes are actually improving quality, not just shipping. 

What You'll Need To Be Successful

- 7+ years of experience building and shipping production software, ideally including LLM-powered agents that take real actions in a product. You've worked on complex, tool-using systems (multiple tools, planning or orchestration, sub-agents) not just simple, single-turn assistants, and you can walk us through something you shipped and how you knew it was actually working. 
 - Comfortable in Ruby on Rails / Python or ready to pick them up quickly. Ruby on Rails is our production system and the foundation that Circle's AI Agents are built on and proficiency in Python is a strong plus, especially for the data and evaluation side of the work. 
 - Experience building evaluation or observability infrastructure for ML/AI systems. You've built eval pipelines, scorers, dashboards, or CI/CD for evals before and have experience with evaluation frameworks like Braintrust, LangSmith, or similar. 
 - Experience designing datasets, annotation workflows, or labeling pipelines for ML/AI evaluation. You know how to turn raw examples into a dataset you can trust through human annotation, AI-generated data, or simulation. 
 - Learn fast, experiment aggressively, and thrive in a highly dynamic environment. You'll need to be comfortable running a lot of experiments and letting the results settle the argument, including the ones that don't work (which will be many of them in the beginning). 
 - Comfortable in a fast-paced environment with ambiguity. You'll need to learn and pick up new technologies when projects require it. 
 - Strong alignment with our company values. 
 - You are proficient in English (spoken, written, and reading) at a CEFR Level C2 / ILR Level 5. 

Compensation & Benefits

Circle offers U. S. -benchmarked compensation globally, equity in the company with ongoing refresh grants, and 35 days of paid time off each year. 

We're a remote-only team that comes together twice a year for company retreats in incredible destinations around the world. Alongside incredible flexibility and autonomy, we offer a benefits package that supports health, wellbeing, and professional growth. Learn more in our Candidate Hub. 

Learn more

- Candidate Safety & Interview Process Notice
 - Diversity, Equity & Inclusion
 - How We Use Candidate Data
 - Equal Employment Opportunity
 - Visit our Candidate Hub to learn more about working at Circle, our benefits, and our hiring process. 

Compensation Range: $170K

data.title: Lead Engineer – UAV Navigation & Aerospace Systems
data.description:
Lead Engineer - UAV Navigation & Aerospace Systems

INFOCORP® | Aerospace Research & Advanced Navigation Technologies

Employment: Full-time | On-site
Location: Bengaluru / Ernakulam, India
Experience: Minimum 7 years
Category: UAV Systems · Aerospace Engineering · Technical Leadership
Status: Immediate Opening | Featured

About INFOCORP®

INFOCORP® (Infocorp Fleet Management Solutions Private Limited) is an Indian research and engineering organisation advancing aerospace navigation and positioning technologies. 

Our activities encompass UAV and autonomous aerial systems, GNSS-supported navigation, and research into navigation resilience in environments where satellite-based positioning may be degraded or unavailable. 

We are expanding our engineering capabilities to develop, integrate and validate next-generation aerospace navigation technologies through rigorous research and practical engineering. 

Role Description

We are seeking an accomplished, hands-on Lead Engineer - UAV Navigation & Aerospace Systems to lead the development and integration of UAV navigation technologies and associated aerospace engineering systems. 

The successful candidate will play a central role in establishing and strengthening our engineering capabilities, translating technical objectives into executable development activities, and leading multidisciplinary engineering efforts towards functioning, demonstrable systems. 

This position requires practical engineering experience, sound technical judgement, proven system-delivery capabilities and the ability to lead engineers across multiple disciplines. 

Key Responsibilities

- Lead UAV navigation and aerospace systems engineering activities, from requirements definition through development, integration and validation. 
- Develop and evaluate system architectures involving navigation sensors, flight controllers, embedded systems, software and communication interfaces. 
- Guide engineering activities involving GNSS navigation, inertial sensing, sensor fusion and real-time localisation. 
- Coordinate multidisciplinary technical specialists and contribute to engineering team development. 
- Establish structured engineering workflows, design reviews, technical documentation and verification procedures. 
- Plan and supervise simulation, hardware integration, laboratory evaluation and field-testing activities. 
- Assess engineering alternatives, investigate technical challenges and recommend practical solutions. 
- Translate research objectives into measurable development milestones and functioning technology demonstrations. 
- Report technical progress, engineering risks, resource requirements and development outcomes to management. 

Essential Qualifications and Experience

- A degree in Aerospace Engineering, Avionics, Electronics, Robotics, Computer Science or a related discipline, or comparable demonstrable engineering experience. 
- At least seven years of relevant engineering experience, including substantial hands-on involvement with UAVs, autonomous platforms, navigation systems or closely related technologies. 
- Demonstrated experience developing, integrating or delivering functioning UAV or autonomous-system technologies. 
- Strong understanding of GNSS-based navigation, inertial sensors, embedded systems and system integration. 
- Practical experience with flight controllers and programming using C/C++ or Python. 
- Working knowledge of navigation algorithms, sensor fusion, state estimation or real-time localisation. 
- Experience leading technical development, resolving integration challenges and coordinating engineering activities. 
- Ability to produce and review engineering documentation, assess technical risks and communicate complex engineering matters clearly. 

Preferred Experience

- UAV manufacturing, aerospace systems integration, autonomous robotics or navigation technology development. 
- Familiarity with PX4, ArduPilot, ROS, MATLAB/Simulink or comparable engineering environments. 
- Hardware-in-the-loop simulation, structured verification, system testing or flight-test activities. 
- Experience with safety-critical engineering, reliability assessments or aerospace verification practices. 
- Exposure to advanced navigation research, alternative positioning techniques or emerging sensing technologies. 
- Experience establishing engineering teams, laboratory capabilities or early-stage technology development activities. 

What Makes This Role Distinctive

This is an opportunity to contribute directly to the development of INFOCORP's aerospace engineering capabilities. 

The appointed engineer will participate in shaping technical development priorities, establishing engineering practices, guiding specialist teams and converting ambitious research objectives into practical engineering achievements. 

We particularly welcome professionals who combine strong analytical capabilities with the practical experience required to build, troubleshoot, integrate and demonstrate real systems. 

How to Apply

Applicants should submit: 

- An updated CV outlining relevant experience and technical responsibilities. 
- A brief summary of previously completed engineering projects or functioning systems. 
- Examples of engineering achievements that may be disclosed without breaching confidentiality obligations. 
- Current location and availability to join. 

Shortlisted candidates may be invited to participate in a structured technical assessment and engineering discussion. 

Apply: careers@infocorp. co. in
Website: https: //www. infocorp. co. in

INFOCORP® is a registered trademark of Infocorp Fleet Management Solutions Private Limited.

data.description:
Job Description

About the Role

The Engineering Manager position entails the leadership of MCO global product development teams across the entirety of the software development life cycle. Key responsibilities encompass ensuring the quality of team outputs and optimizing customer experiences, along with maintaining strict adherence to coding standards and promoting automation initiatives. Moreover, the role involves mentoring and guiding engineers, proactively identifying and mitigating technical risks, and facilitating effective communication between engineering and other stakeholders. The manager oversees deployment processes, monitors system performance, and provides decisive technical leadership during incidents. Ultimately, this role aims to uphold the highest standards of professionalism and innovation in MCO software development practices. 

Job Requirements

Experiences and Skills

- 10+ years of experience (including up to 3 years in management) product development. 
 - Strong java full stack engineering experience in a product development environment
 - Maintain hands-on involvement with coding approximately 20% of the time
 - Expertise in architecture & design reviews, system design, code reviews, customer issues, troubleshooting, defect triage, etc. 
 - Strong problem-solving and analytical skills, with the ability to resolve complex issues. 
 - Demonstrates resilience and flexibility, consistently adapting while managing priorities with efficiency
 - A strong willingness to learn and a growth mindset. 
 - Excellent communication and servant leadership skill
 - Possess knowledge and experience of agile development methodology. (Scrum, AGILE and KANBAN)
 - Experience in a product driven SAAS or financial services company is a plus. Architect experience is a plus. 

Responsibilities

Job Responsibilities

- Own the effectiveness of the Scrum Agile process and adherence to good agile practices for the team. 
 - Be responsible for the quality of the teams' outputs and the customer experience of our products. 
 - Lead product development teams through all stages of the SDLC. 
 - Hands-on participation in all technical activities including architecture & design reviews, code reviews, coding, troubleshooting, defect triage
 - Define and enforce coding standards and best practices within the engineering team. 
 - Collaborate with cross-functional teams to translate product requirements into technical specifications. 
 - Conduct code reviews and ensure high code quality and adherence to engineering standards. 
 - Drive Automation in the engineering teams
 - Drive continuous improvement in development processes and tools to increase efficiency and quality. 
 - Mentor and coach engineers to foster their technical growth and career development. 
 - Identify technical risks and challenges early in the project lifecycle and propose mitigation strategies. 
 - Act as a technical liaison between engineering, product management, and other stakeholders. 
 - Coordinate with Platform Test teams to ensure thorough testing and validation of software products. 
 - Oversee deployment and release processes to ensure smooth and reliable product launches. 
 - Monitor system performance and address technical issues promptly to maintain product stability. 
 - Provide technical leadership during incidents and outages, facilitating root cause analysis and resolution. 
 - Foster a collaborative and innovative engineering culture focused on delivering high-quality software products

Spreetail propels brands to increase their ecommerce market share across the globe while improving their operational costs. Learn how we are building one of the fastest-growing ecommerce companies in history:   www. spreetail. com.     

The Software Engineer II for Ads builds the data, analytics, and product experiences that help Merchants and Brands understand how advertising is performing and decide where to invest next. This role will strengthen the Ads experience across the customer-facing Brand Experience platform and the internal Merchant Station platform by turning complex advertising data and business logic into clear, actionable insights. 

Ads, together with DART and margin calculators, is a critical input into day-to-day Merchant decisions. The current Ads experience is one of the lowest-used areas in Brand Experience because it does not yet provide essential data, including keyword-level detail, or a compelling explanation of performance. This engineer will help overhaul that experience, support rapid proofs of concept, and build scalable capabilities that contribute to Merchandising's goal of generating $1 million in additional programmatic Brand support across Ads, Promotions, and Pricing Support. 

What Success Looks Like

-     Delivers a significantly improved Ads experience in Brand Experience and Merchant Station, increasing engagement with a page that currently has the lowest usage on the platform

-     Provides Merchants and Brands with accurate, decision-ready advertising data, including keyword-level performance insights

-     Enables Merchants to audit advertising spend, explain the impact of Project Astra, and present a clear story about Spreetail's advertising strategy and results

-     Builds actionable recommendations that help Brands understand when and where additional advertising investment can create value

-     Runs focused proofs of concept quickly, incorporates feedback, and scales successful approaches into reliable product capabilities

-     Contributes to Merchandising's goal of securing $1 million in additional programmatic Brand support across Ads, Promotions, and Pricing Support

-     Improves the reliability, clarity, and usability of advertising data across both internal and Brand-facing workflows

Key Responsibilities

-     Design, build, test, and maintain full-stack features for Ads across Brand Experience and Merchant Station

-     Develop data services and visualizations that show advertising performance, spend, impact, and opportunities for action

-     Translate advertising strategy, Project Astra outputs, and complex business rules into clear product experiences for Merchants and Brands

-     Create keyword-level and other detailed views needed to diagnose performance and support investment decisions

-     Integrate advertising data into existing Merch Tech workflows while maintaining accuracy, freshness, and consistency

-     Partner with Merchants, Product, Design, Data, and engineering teammates to clarify user needs and prioritize the highest-value capabilities

-     Develop proofs of concept to test how Ads insights and storytelling can increase Brand engagement and support dollars

-     Improve deployment workflows so new data, metrics, and product enhancements can reach users faster and more safely

-     Apply strong engineering practices, including code reviews, automated testing, monitoring, documentation, and maintainable system design

-     Investigate production issues, resolve data or experience gaps, and continuously improve platform performance and usability

What experiences will help you in this role: 

-     Professional software engineering experience building and supporting production applications

-     Strong 3-5 years full-stack development skills, with experience connecting backend data services to intuitive front-end experiences

-     Experience developing analytics, reporting, or data-visualization products that help users make decisions

-     Experience working with APIs, data integrations, data quality checks, and modern software delivery practices

data.description:
Company Description FilterPixel is a reliability-first system built to support high-volume event photography under real-world pressure, tight timelines, and large crowds. The platform solves key pain points for photographers, event teams, and sponsors by transforming thousands of photos into structured, usable content. FilterPixel Studio enables fast, high-quality selections, on-the-fly editing, and same-day delivery for photographers. FilterPixel Live gives attendees instant photo access, brand-safe sponsor-ready galleries, and integrated social media engagement with measurable ROI. The team partners closely with conference organizers, corporate event teams, and high-volume photographers to build production-ready systems that consistently perform at scale. 

Role Description This full-time, remote Senior Software Engineer - Backend & Infrastructure role focuses on designing, building, and maintaining the backend systems that power FilterPixel Studio and FilterPixel Live. Responsibilities include developing scalable APIs and services, optimizing data pipelines and storage, and improving reliability and performance for high-volume image processing and delivery. The role involves collaborating with product and frontend teams to define technical requirements, implement secure integrations, and ensure system resilience under heavy load. You will also contribute to infrastructure automation, monitoring, and incident response, as well as code reviews, technical documentation, and mentoring other engineers. This position is ideal for someone who enjoys solving complex backend challenges and building robust systems that support demanding real-time event workflows. 

Qualifications

- Strong foundation in Computer Science, including data structures, algorithms, and systems design. 
 - Proficiency in Back-End Web Development and Software Development, with experience building and maintaining production services. 
 - Advanced Programming skills and hands-on expertise with Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) principles. 
 - Experience designing scalable, secure APIs and distributed systems for high-traffic or high-volume applications. 
 - Hands-on experience with cloud platforms (e. g. , AWS, GCP, or Azure) and infrastructure-as-code or automation tools.

data.title: Tech Lead Manager, Software Engineering
data.description:
ABOUT EARNINAs one of the first pioneers of earned wage access, our passion at EarnIn is building products that deliver real-time financial flexibility for people living paycheck to paycheck. Our community members access their earnings as they earn them, with options to spend, save, and grow their money without mandatory fees, interest rates, or credit checks.   We're fortunate to have an incredibly experienced leadership team, combined with world-class funding partners like A16Z, Matrix Partners, DST, Ribbit Capital, and a very healthy core business with a tremendous runway. We're growing fast and excited to bring on world-class talent to help shape the next chapter of our growth journey. 

EarnIn is becoming an AI-native company, embedding AI agents into how we build, analyze, and operate across every function. Teams use AI Agents to move from ideas to execution faster. By letting agents handle repetitive tasks, our people can focus on judgment, creativity, and hard problems. We pair this experimentation with the strict review and security guardrails our regulated financial environment requires, always keeping a focus on privacy and the people who rely on our products. 

As a company, we are becoming AI-native, and we encourage you to use AI tools throughout much of your interview process. If you use AI during the live interview, just say so; a quick, natural mention of how it helped and why you are using it is all we need. What we're evaluating is your judgment, reasoning, and ability to own and defend your work, not whether AI was involved. Some rounds, particularly those focused on your career history and past experiences, will not allow the use of AI, and we'll let you know of those in advance. When in doubt, ask your recruiter or interviewer directly. 

POSITION SUMMARY
We're on a mission to reinvent the financial system and make it work for people. We are looking for an experienced professional to lead a full-stack engineering team comprising backend and mobile engineers. As a hands-on Tech Lead Manager for one of our core services teams, you will have the unique opportunity to contribute to the design and development of some of our early-stage, innovative products. You will work with your cross-functional partners and team to shape the direction of these products and help make them significant drivers for the company.   This position is a hybrid role based in our Bengaluru office, with 2 days a week in the office as part of our expanding site. EarnIn provides excellent benefits, including healthcare, internet/cell phone reimbursement, a learning and development stipend, and potential opportunities to travel to our Mountain View HQ. Our salary ranges depend on role, level, and location. 
WHAT YOU'LL DO

At EarnIn, we believe that the best way to build a financial system that works for everyday people is by hiring a team that represents our diverse community. data.title: Senior/Staff Deep Learning Compiler Engineer
data.description:
Quadric is redefining edge AI with the industry's first General Purpose Neural Processing Unit (GPNPU), enabling developers to run both neural network inference and conventional C++ code on a single programmable architecture. Our technology powers intelligent edge devices across automotive, industrial, robotics, and embedded systems. 

Founded in 2016 and based in downtown Burlingame, California, Quadric is building the world's first supercomputer designed for the real-time needs of edge devices. Quadric aims to empower developers in every industry with superpowers to create tomorrow's technology, today. The company was co-founded by technologists from MIT and Carnegie Mellon, who were previously the technical co-founders of the Bitcoin computing company 21. 

The Opportunity

Quadric is building the world's first General-Purpose Neural Processing Unit (GPNPU) architecture, bringing high-performance AI, DSP, and ML compute to edge devices. As a Deep Learning Compiler Engineer, you will design and optimize the compiler stack (MLIR, TVM, LLVM) that bridges state-of-the-art neural network frameworks directly to our proprietary hardware architecture. You'll play a critical role in unlocking peak hardware performance, low latency, and memory efficiency for edge AI workloads. 

What You'll Do

Deep Learning Compiler Infrastructure & Optimization

- Design, implement, and maintain compiler optimization passes targeting Quadric's processor architecture using frameworks like MLIR, Apache TVM, or LLVM. 
 - Develop lowering pathways from high-level machine learning frameworks (PyTorch, TensorFlow, ONNX) down to optimized low-level kernel code. 
 - Optimize neural network performance for memory throughput, latency, compute unit utilization, and power consumption. 

Neural Network Model Parsing & Graph Transformation

- Implement graph-level optimizations, including operator fusion, layout transformation, quantization (INT8/FP16), and memory allocation strategies. 
 - Analyze novel deep learning model topologies (Transformers, CNNs, Vision-Language Models) and extend compiler support for new operators and primitives. 
 - Benchmark and profile end-to-end model performance to identify and resolve compiler bottlenecks. 

Hardware-Software Co-Design

- Collaborate closely with hardware and micro-architecture teams to define instruction set extensions, hardware acceleration features, and compiler requirements. 
 - Develop software simulators, functional models, and test benches to validate compiler correctness and generated binary performance. 
 - Participate in hardware bring-up and validation efforts on FPGA and ASIC platforms. 

What Success Looks Like

Within your first 6-12 months, you'll: 

- Successfully integrate support for key deep learning models (e. g. , modern Transformer architectures or Vision models) into Quadric's compiler pipeline. 
 - Implement custom graph and codegen optimization passes that deliver measurable performance improvements on target benchmarks. 
 - Partner with the architecture team to influence the next-generation micro-architecture definition through data-driven workload analysis. 

What We're Looking For

Required

- 8 years+ experience alongwith BS, MS, or Ph. D. in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related field. 
 - Hands-on experience developing deep learning compilers or compiler infrastructures (e. g. , MLIR, Apache TVM, LLVM, XLA, TensorRT, or Glow). 
 - Strong proficiency in C++ (14/17/20) and Python, with solid fundamentals in data structures, algorithms, and object-oriented design. 
 - Familiarity with modern AI/ML frameworks (PyTorch, TensorFlow, ONNX) and deep learning operator representations. 
 - Solid understanding of computer systems, memory hierarchies, parallel processing, and CPU/GPU/NPU instruction execution. 

Preferred

- Experience with low-level kernel optimization, SIMD/vector programming, and memory allocation strategy development. 
 - Knowledge of model quantization methodologies (INT8, FP8, mixed-precision) and post-training/QAT optimization techniques. 
 - Prior experience working on software stacks for custom AI accelerators, DSPs, or embedded architectures. 
 - Experience with FPGA bring-up, hardware emulation, or cycle-accurate simulator development. 

Quadric also offer a variety of benefits to support your needs. The benefits below reflect our India-based offerings; for roles in other locations, benefits vary and are shared during the hiring process. These include: 

- Medical, dental, and vision insurance
 - Equity with the business
 - Paid Parental Leave
 - PF Retirement Plan
 - Flexible PTO
 - Winter holiday shutdown
 - Catered lunch each day in our office
 - Downtown Pune office location, close to shops, cafes, and local amenities
 - Collaborative, low-ego culture with significant ownership and impact
 - A work culture focused on innovative disruption

If this role resonates with you, we encourage you to apply even if your experience does not perfectly match every qualification. We value potential, curiosity, and a willingness to learn just as much as direct experience. 

Equal Employment Opportunity

Quadric is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, medical condition, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law

E-Verify and Right to Work Notices

Quadric participates in the E-Verify program to confirm employment eligibility for U. S. -based roles. As part of this process, applicants may review the following notices, which explain your rights and our participation in E-Verify. These notices are provided in English and Spanish. 

- E-Verify Participation Notice (English | Spanish)

No action is required from candidates during the application process. These notices are provided for informational purposes only. 

Privacy

By submitting an application, you acknowledge that Quadric will collect and process your personal information as part of the hiring process. Please review our Privacy Policy to understand how we handle your data

data.title: QA Automation & Tier 2 Production Support Engineer
data.description:
We are seeking a strong QA Automation and Tier 2 Production Support Engineer to join a production support team. This is a hybrid role combining technical production support, incident investigation, troubleshooting, and QA automation. 

The selected candidate will provide Tier 2 support for production applications and serve as a backup for the QA team. The ideal candidate should be able to independently investigate issues, analyze logs and data, identify root causes, coordinate with technical and business teams, validate fixes, and improve regression coverage through automation. 

Note - This is not a basic help-desk role. It requires strong technical troubleshooting, QA knowledge, ownership, and communication skills. 

Key Responsibilities

Tier 2 Production Support

- Investigate production incidents escalated by Tier 1 support or business users. 

- Analyze application logs, API responses, database records, system behavior, and integration flows. 

- Reproduce reported issues and identify whether they are related to application code, data, configuration, environment, or integration dependencies. 

- Perform root-cause analysis and document findings clearly. 

- Resolve issues within the scope of the role and escalate complex code-level or infrastructure issues to development or Tier 3 teams. 

- Coordinate with developers, architects, DevOps, database teams, business users, and external partners to drive issues to resolution. 

- Monitor incidents through closure and provide timely status updates to stakeholders. 

- Support production deployments, smoke testing, post-deployment validation, and rollback verification. 

- Maintain incident documentation, troubleshooting guides, known-error records, and support procedures. 

- Identify recurring production issues and recommend preventive actions. 

Quality Assurance and Automation

- Design, execute, and maintain functional, integration, regression, API, database, and end-to-end test cases. 

- Develop and maintain automated tests using tools such as Selenium, Playwright, REST Assured, Postman/Newman, or similar technologies. 

- Convert recurring production issues into regression test scenarios to prevent future occurrences. 

- Validate defect fixes and ensure appropriate regression coverage before release. 

- Perform API and backend validation, including request and response verification, error handling, authentication, and data-flow testing. 

- Execute SQL queries to validate data, troubleshoot issues, and reconcile information across systems. 

- Support test planning, defect management, release-readiness assessments, and QA status reporting. 

- Integrate automated tests with CI/CD pipelines where applicable. 

- Serve as a backup for the QA team during critical releases, high-priority testing, or resource absences. 

Required Qualifications

- At least five years of experience in software quality assurance, application support, or a combined QA and production-support role. 

- Hands-on experience supporting production applications in a Tier 2 capacity. 

- Strong experience in incident triage, troubleshooting, defect analysis, and root-cause investigation. 

- Hands-on QA automation experience using Selenium, Playwright, REST Assured, or a comparable framework. 

- Strong API-testing experience using Postman, Swagger, REST Assured, SoapUI, or similar tools. 

- Working knowledge of SQL and database validation. 

- Ability to analyze application logs using tools such as Splunk, Grafana, Kibana, Dynatrace, Azure Application Insights, or similar platforms. 

- Understanding of web applications, APIs, microservices, integrations, and upstream/downstream data flows. 

- Experience with defect and incident-management tools such as Jira, Azure DevOps, ServiceNow, or similar platforms. 

- Understanding of Agile delivery, release management, and CI/CD processes. 

- Strong written and verbal communication skills. 

- Ability to work independently, manage priorities, and take ownership of issues through resolution. 

- Ability to collaborate effectively with technical teams, business stakeholders, and client leadership. 

- Willingness to provide support during critical releases or production incidents when required. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with Java, JavaScript, or TypeScript. 

- Knowledge of Linux commands and basic server troubleshooting. 

- Experience with cloud-based applications hosted on AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud. 

- Familiarity with performance monitoring and basic performance testing. 

- Experience supporting payment, telecom, aviation, healthcare, or other enterprise applications. 

- Experience working with distributed onshore and offshore teams.

data.description:
Description

Department/Project Description

We are seeking a Forward-Deployed AI Product Architect to work at the intersection of core product engineering, AI orchestration, and high-impact client deployment. In this role, you will bridge the gap between our core AI platform capabilities and the highly regulated, complex workflows of our enterprise clients (specifically across FinTech, Financial Services, and Enterprise SaaS). 

You are not just deploying a tool; you are embedding autonomous, intent-driven AI workflows into the client's product ecosystem. This role requires a hands-on builder, deep product architect, and first-principles thinker who can gain trust with client developers and justify product ROI to executive stakeholders. 

Requirements

Job Responsibilities

Domain-Specific AI Integration

Architect Intent-Driven Workflows: Design and deploy agentic AI workflows tailored to complex financial domain logic, ensuring systems can reliably process high-stakes data (e. g. , automated credit underwriting analysis, regulatory compliance checking, or algorithmic fraud intent mapping). 

Context-Aware RAG Pipelines: Build and optimize domain-specific Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) and vector database architectures that ingest massive, disparate financial data sources (e. g. , SEC filings, transaction ledgers, legacy ERP schemas) to feed localized AI agents. 

Bridge Legacy Core Systems: Design secure abstraction layers and Model Context Protocol (MCP) implementations that allow AI systems to interact seamlessly with legacy core-banking systems, monolithic financial ledgers, and rigid enterprise APIs. 

Product Delivery & SDLC Acceleration

Accelerate Product Feature Delivery: Partner directly with the client's product and engineering leadership to replace traditional, bottlenecked sprint cycles with autonomous delivery loops that generate domain-compliant code, comprehensive unit tests, and validation artifacts. 

Establish Guardrails & AI Governance: Implement deterministic controls, "human-in-the-loop" verification, and automated compliance checks within the AI pipeline to meet strict financial sector regulatory standards (e. g. , SEC, GDPR, SOC2). 

Measure Engineering Velocity: Define, track, and report on hard product metrics resulting from AI implementation, such as reduction in feature-to-production cycle time, code review velocity, and coverage of automated edge-case test generation. 

Forward-Deployed Customer Engagement

Embedded Engineering Leadership: Embed directly within client engineering teams as a trusted technical advisor, leading by example by writing code, evaluating architectures, and building working proofs of concept. 

Translate Intent to Architecture: Map high-level business goals from client Product Managers into technical AI specifications, ensuring the AI agents accurately understand product requirements and domain constraints. 

Executive Value Articulation: Present technical architectures, security postures, and measured business outcomes to both engineering teams and C-level executives (CTO, Chief Risk Officer, CPO). 

Hands on in Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG), Vector Databases, Evaluation Frameworks, Prompt Engineering, Tool Calling, Function Calling, Multi-agent orchestration, AI Observability

Job responsibilities

Must-Have Qualifications And Experience

Experience: 15+ years of experience in software engineering, enterprise product architecture, platform engineering, or solution architecture, with at least 5+ years spent delivering high-scale products within the Financial Services or Enterprise SaaS sectors. 

Technical Fluency: Deep, hands-on fluency with the modern AI stack. You must be able to build, evaluate, and debug AI development tools, agentic frameworks, and IDE-based assistants. 

Domain Expertise: Thorough understanding of financial technology standards, secure SDLC, DevSecOps, data privacy laws, and enterprise architecture patterns. 

Good-to-Have Skills

Direct experience with tools/frameworks like Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf, LangChain, AutoGen, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel, and vector databases. 

Background in customer-facing technical roles such as Forward-Deployed Engineer, Principal Solutions Architect, or Technical Advisor. 

What we offer

Exciting Projects: We focus on industries like High-Tech, communication, media, healthcare, retail and telecom. Our customer list is full of fantastic global brands and leaders who love what we build for them. 

Collaborative Environment: You Can expand your skills by collaborating with a diverse team of highly talented people in an open, laidback environment - or even abroad in one of our global centers or client facilities!

Work-Life Balance: GlobalLogic prioritizes work-life balance, which is why we offer flexible work schedules, opportunities to work from home, and paid time off and holidays. 

Professional Development: Our dedicated Learning & Development team regularly organizes Communication skills training(GL Vantage, Toast Master), Stress Management program, professional certifications, and technical and soft skill trainings. 

Excellent Benefits: We provide our employees with competitive salaries, family medical insurance, Group Term Life Insurance, Group Personal Accident Insurance , NPS(National Pension Scheme ), Periodic health awareness program, extended maternity leave, annual performance bonuses, and referral bonuses. 

Fun Perks: We want you to love where you work, which is why we host sports events, cultural activities, offer food on subsidies rates, Corporate parties. Our vibrant offices also include dedicated GL Zones, rooftop decks and GL Club where you can drink coffee or tea with your colleagues over a game of table and offer discounts for popular stores and restaurants!

About GlobalLogic

GlobalLogic, a Hitachi Group Company, is a trusted digital engineering partner to the world's largest and most forward-thinking companies. Since 2000, we've been at the forefront of the digital revolution - helping create some of the most innovative and widely used digital products and experiences. Today we continue to collaborate with clients in transforming businesses and redefining industries through intelligent products, platforms, and services.

data.title: Sr. Design Evaluation Engineer
data.description:
About Analog Devices

Analog Devices, Inc. (NASDAQ: ADI) is a global semiconductor leader that bridges the physical and digital worlds to enable breakthroughs at the Intelligent Edge. ADI combines analog, digital, AI, and software technologies into solutions that combat climate change, reliably connect humans and the world, and help drive advancements in automation and robotics, mobility, healthcare, energy and data centers. With revenue of more than $11 billion in FY25, ADI ensures today's innovators stay Ahead of What's Possible. Learn more at www. analog. com and on LinkedIn and X. 

Senior Design Evaluation Engineer - Automotive Networking

Role Overview

Analog Devices International is seeking an experienced Design Evaluation Engineer to join the Automotive Networking Evaluation team in Hyderabad, India. In this Senior technical role, you will lead the definition and execution of evaluation strategies for FPGA prototypes and automotive networking ASICs, from initial platform bring-up through system-level validation, characterisation, and release readiness. You will combine hands-on laboratory expertise with strong software development, test automation, data analysis, and technical leadership skills to deliver robust, repeatable, and high-quality evaluation solutions. 

You will work closely with design, verification, applications, systems, software, and product engineering teams to identify technical risks, resolve complex issues, and ensure that silicon and supporting platforms meet product and system requirements. As a Senior Engineer, you will provide technical direction, mentor engineers, and drive improvements in evaluation methodologies, tools, and laboratory practices. 

Key Responsibilities

- Execute comprehensive evaluation strategies, test plans, coverage goals, methodologies, and release criteria for FPGA prototypes and automotive networking ASICs. 
 - Translate product, architecture, and system requirements into measurable laboratory tests, including functional, performance, interoperability, robustness, and corner-case evaluation. 
 - Develop modular, maintainable test and automation software in C and Python, including instrument control, data acquisition, regression execution, result processing, and report generation. 
 - Execute and analyse complex silicon and FPGA test cases; debug failures across hardware, firmware, software, interfaces, and system boundaries. 
 - Perform electrical and functional measurements using oscilloscopes, logic analysers, protocol analysers, signal generators, power supplies, and other laboratory equipment. 
 - Lead structured root-cause investigations, clearly document findings, and work with cross-functional teams to drive issues to resolution. 
 - Evaluate automotive Ethernet and related networking functionality, including link behaviour, data-path performance, timing, error handling, diagnostics, and interoperability. 
 - Develop system-level hardware, embedded software, scripts, user guides, application examples, test procedures, and technical reports that enable internal and external product evaluation. 
 - Review evaluation results, identify coverage gaps and technical risks, and communicate evidence-based recommendations to engineering and programme stakeholders. 

Required Qualifications And Experience

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electronic Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant experience. 
 - Four or more years of relevant experience in design evaluation, silicon validation, product engineering, systems engineering, or a comparable role. 
 - Demonstrated experience evaluating FPGA prototypes and performing bench validation or characterisation of ASICs. 
 - Strong proficiency in C and Python, with experience developing reliable test, automation, or embedded software. 
 - Knowledge of embedded systems, digital hardware, laboratory measurement techniques, and hardware/software integration. 
 - Proven ability to diagnose complex problems using structured debugging, critical thinking, root-cause analysis, and evidence-based decision-making. 
 - Experience capturing, processing, interpreting, and presenting technical data, with a strong focus on accuracy, repeatability, and traceability. 
 - Working knowledge of Ethernet and networking concepts, together with experience using serial interfaces such as SPI, I2C, and UART. 
 - Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to produce clear technical reports and present complex findings to varied audiences. 
 - Demonstrated collaboration, ownership, and the ability to influence outcomes across cross-functional teams. 

Preferred Qualifications And Experience

- Familiarity with automotive networking architectures, zonal systems, software-defined vehicles, and relevant industry standards. 
 - Experience with Ethernet protocol analysis, network traffic generation, performance measurement, interoperability testing, or fault injection. 
 - Experience developing embedded firmware for microcontrollers and integrating host-side software with evaluation hardware. 
 - Experience with audio and video interfaces or data paths, including PDM and RGB8. 
 - Familiarity with source control, continuous integration, automated regression frameworks, requirements traceability, and issue-tracking systems.

C. 1324b(a)(3) - may have to go through an export licensing review process.

data.description:
Business and Unit Brief

Aditya Birla Group is building a pipeline of accomplished technica leaders across its process manufacturing businesses in India. The role will lead a large and complex technical and engineering mandate for a large manufacturing site with multiple manufacturing units within with end-to-end accountability for safe, reliable, sustainable and profitable performance. The specific Group company, business and plant location will be shared with shortlisted candidates at a later stage of the selection process. 

The operating environment may involve complex process technologies, multiple raw-material and product streams, demanding quality and service expectations, significant supply-chain and logistics interfaces, stringent statutory and environmental requirements, and a diverse workforce and stakeholder ecosystem. The successful leader will combine strategic orientation with strong execution, operating discipline, commercial judgement, stakeholder maturity and the ability to build a high-performing organisation. 

Role Details

Role Purpose: Lead the technical function of a large process manufacturing plant, with accountability for production planning and performance, operational efficiency, plant maintenance and availability, energy management, project execution, safety, sustainability, statutory compliance and technical capability building. 

Key Responsibilities

- Production and Operations Lay down production targets and schedules, review plant performance daily, and ensure operating parameters, consumption norms and marketing schedules are met within budgeted cost. 
 - Operational Efficiency Benchmark operating parameters against world-class standards, work with technology suppliers and internal technical experts to close performance gaps, and drive efficiency improvement plans tracked through management reviews, MIS and cost reports. 
 - Plant Maintenance and Availability Plan mechanical, electrical, instrumentation and civil maintenance in line with production requirements, run preventive and predictive maintenance systems, and analyse unscheduled downtime to sustain maximum plant availability. 
 - Planning, Budgeting and Cost Control Prepare the annual budget in line with customer requirements and value-creation targets, monitor maintenance expenditure, identify cost-saving opportunities, and build technical synergy across Group units through shared benchmarks and best practices. 
 - Energy Management and Statutory Compliance Conduct mandatory energy audits under applicable legislation, review daily power and energy consumption, implement energy-saving schemes, and ensure compliance with relevant statutory and regulatory directives in a power-intensive process environment. 
 - Project and Scheme Execution Evaluate block estimates and project feasibility, review detailed engineering schedules, monitor progress and de-bottleneck critical areas to deliver brownfield and greenfield projects on time and within budget. 
 - Safety, Sustainability and Manufacturing Excellence Ensure accident-free operations in a highly hazardous process environment, implement manufacturing excellence practices and periodic sustainability audits, and maintain full compliance with applicable factory, boiler, environmental and other statutory requirements. 
 - People Development Set KRAs and performance targets, conduct assessments and training-need identification, build capability and career plans for the team, and provide direction during crisis and emergency situations. 

Reporting Structure

Reports to: Unit Head

Reported by: Sectional heads across Production and Operations, Mechanical, Electrical, Instrumentation, Civil Maintenance and Utility Services

This role is part of the Global Manufacturing Leadership Program (GMLP). 

The Global Manufacturing Leadership Program (GMLP) is Aditya Birla Group's flagship leadership hiring initiative focused on building the next generation of manufacturing leaders. Designed for high-potential professionals with a proven track record in manufacturing and operations, GMLP offers accelerated career growth through challenging leadership roles across the Group's diverse businesses, including Cement, Metals, Chemicals, Carbon Black, Pulp & Fibre, Mining, and other global manufacturing operations. 

Through GMLP, selected candidates gain exposure to large-scale manufacturing environments, world-class technologies, cross-functional assignments, and mentorship from senior business leaders. The program is aimed at professionals who aspire to move beyond functional excellence and take on broader business and operational leadership responsibilities, while contributing to the long-term growth and transformation of one of the world's leading diversified multinational groups. 

Important Note

This is a pipeline position intended to identify leadership talent for current and future Unit Head opportunities within Aditya Birla Group. Application to this posting does not relate to a single disclosed vacancy. Business, company and location details will be discussed with relevant shortlisted candidates as the process progresses.

data.description:
About Millennium

Millennium is a global, diversified alternative investment firm, founded in 1989. Defined by evolution, innovation and focus, Millennium's mission is to deliver results for our investors. 

Our people are empowered with both independence and support: the autonomy to pursue ideas with conviction and the backing of a global network committed to collaboration, disciplined risk management and continuous learning. With opportunities to deepen expertise and accelerate development, talent at Millennium is equipped to adapt, evolve and build lasting impact over time. Discover how transformative growth accelerates impact. 

Meet the Team

Information Technology is core to the health and growth of Millennium's business; the firm's active, multi-manager model demands flexible, scalable technology and advanced proprietary systems, including the development of next-generation analytical and trading capabilities. Within this organization, the Systematic Platform Execution & Exchange Data (SPEED) team sits at the core of Millennium's Equities, Quant Strategies, and Shared Services Technology group, powering the firm's low-latency solutions for systematic and high-frequency trading. The team delivers the live trading and market-data platforms used by portfolio managers and risk systems, including Latency Critical Trading (LCT), DMA OMS (Client Direct), DMA market data feeds, packet capture (PCAPs), enterprise market data, and intraday data services spanning latency tiers from sub-100 nanoseconds to millisecond-sensitive workflows. By building and operating this execution and data infrastructure, SPEED enables portfolio managers and researchers to compete effectively in the most time-critical markets. 

What You'll Do

- Design and build low-latency infrastructure and system components for order entry and other execution-related features. 
 - Build convenience layer tools and services that support trading teams onboarding at MLP. 
 - Participate in a follow-the-sun (L2) support rotation for latency-critical systems, including real-time troubleshooting of production issues. 
 - Partner closely with the SPEED architect, quantitative researchers, and the business to deliver high-ROI solutions aligned with both platform and business strategy. 
 - Liaise with other MLP teams as needed, depending on project focus. 

What You Bring

- 5+ years of experience delivering production-grade, low-latency systems. 
 - Demonstrated expertise in C++ for production, low-latency environments. 
 - Strong grounding in computer science and software development fundamentals, including algorithms and data structures. 
 - Professional experience with Java, particularly in low-latency or No-GC environments, is a strong plus. 
 - Solid understanding of Linux internals and CPU architecture (caches, NUMA, branch prediction), along with performance profiling experience, is a plus. 
 - Cloud experience (AWS, GCP) is a plus. 
 - High accountability and ownership, with strong self-management, prioritization, and the ability to meet deadlines.

data.description:
About Business

JOB DESCRIPTION

Adani Group: Adani Group is a diversified organisation in India comprising 10 publicly traded companies. It has created a world class logistics and utility infrastructure portfolio that has a pan-India presence. Adani Group is headquartered in Ahmedabad, in the state of Gujarat, India. Over the years, Adani Group has positioned itself to be the market leader in its logistics and energy businesses focusing on large scale infrastructure development in India with O & M practices benchmarked to global standards. With four IG rated businesses, it is the only Infrastructure Investment Grade issuer in India. 

Job Purpose

The Shift In-Charge is responsible for overseeing all smelting activities during their assigned shift, including both operational management and safety compliance. This role focuses on maintaining the efficient execution of processes, managing manpower, and ensuring compliance with operational standards. The Shift In-Charge will also be responsible for managing cross-functional coordination with maintenance, production, and safety teams. 

Responsibilities

- Develop, implement, and maintain instrumentation systems that ensure accurate measurement, control, and automation of production parameters in the copper manufacturing process. 
 - Lead troubleshooting and root cause analysis of instrumentation-related issues to minimize downtime and enhance plant reliability. 
 - Plan and supervise preventive and predictive maintenance schedules for instrumentation equipment such as sensors, transmitters, control valves, analyzers, and PLC/DCS interfaces. 
 - Collaborate with production, maintenance, quality control, and safety teams to ensure instrumentation compliance with industry standards and regulatory requirements. 
 - Execute calibration procedures and maintain records to guarantee optimal performance and traceability of instrumentation devices. 
 - Support commissioning and start-up activities for new instrumentation installations or upgrades, ensuring smooth integration with existing systems. 
 - Analyze instrumentation data and generate reports to assist in process optimization, energy efficiency initiatives, and cost reduction strategies. 
 - Mentor and guide junior instrumentation engineers and technicians, fostering knowledge sharing and skills development within the team. 
 - Drive continuous improvement projects focused on instrumentation reliability, accuracy, and automation to support Adani's sustainability and innovation goals. 
 - Maintain an up-to-date understanding of emerging instrumentation technologies and industry best practices, recommending their adoption where beneficial. 
 - Ensure adherence to Adani's safety protocols and promote a culture of safety awareness in all instrumentation activities. 
 - Manage vendor relationships and coordinate with external service providers for specialized instrumentation maintenance and calibration tasks. 
 - Contribute to documentation, standard operating procedures (SOPs), and training programs related to instrumentation systems. 
 - Participate actively in internal and external audits to ensure compliance and identify areas for improvement

Qualifications

- B. E/B, Tech Instrumentation / E&I / C&I or related field 
 - Over 2 years of progressive experience in instrumentation engineering, preferably within the copper manufacturing or heavy process industry
 - Proficient in the design, installation, and maintenance of industrial instrumentation systems specific to copper manufacturing processes

About Us

The road to empowerment is the one that guards a country's stride onwards, keeping every hurdle that poses a threat to the constant pace of progress at bay. Yet another milestone in our growth story, is the business of Natural Resources. The scale of our business assures a steady availability of coal, extracted in the most responsible ways, which promises constant supply of power to both urban and rural geographies of India ensuring no hurdles are faced by the citizens in the path to achieving their dreams. The mining industry is considered a major contributor to the growth of the Indian economy. The mining business unit of the Adani group was established in 2007 as the last link in ensuring energy security for India. We are also developing and operating mines in Indonesia and Australia. 

In the past few years, we have transformed from a coal trading and importing company to a comprehensive integrated coal management company. We have a diversified trading portfolio and are involved in Coal and Coke trading.

data.description:
Location

Pune

Business Area

Data

Ref #

10054420

Description & Requirements

Bloomberg runs on data. Our products are fueled by powerful information. We combine data and context to paint the whole picture for our clients, around the clock - from around the world. In Data, we are responsible for delivering this data, news and analytics through innovative technology - quickly and accurately. We apply problem-solving skills to identify innovative workflow efficiencies, and we implement technology solutions to enhance our systems, products and processes - all while providing platinum customer support to our clients. 

The Team

Data Management & Operations (DMO) serves as the Chief Operations Office for Bloomberg Data, with the Quality Methods & Insights (QMI) team acting as its strategic analytics and methodology partner. QMI drives data quality, timeliness, and operational efficiency across Bloomberg's data products by establishing quality governance standards, optimizing workflows, delivering common reporting and analytics, applying decision science to support investments and operational change, and developing workflow telemetry and productivity measurement capabilities. We partner closely with Data Operations, Vendor Management, Product, and Engineering teams to ensure global data processes scale efficiently, predictably, and with measurable quality outcomes. 

The Role

In this role, you will lead a regional team of process engineers, data quality analysts, decision scientists, and analytics specialists who partner directly with APAC-based Data operations, Vendor Managers, and Product Engineering. You will act as the regional ambassador for QMI's methodologies, driving high-impact initiatives that range from operational workflow measurement and vendor quality governance to process redesign. Success in this position requires a balance of inspirational people leadership, rigorous analytical craft, and executive stakeholder management. You will champion a culture of "context over control, " empowering your team to solve complex problems independently while ensuring regional deliverables seamlessly align with QMI's global strategic objectives across London, Princeton, and New York. 

We'll Trust You To

- Lead, develop, and grow a high-performing APAC team, fostering a culture of continuous learning, innovation, accountability, and technical excellence. 
 - Build strategic partnerships with regional Data, Operations, Product, Engineering, and Vendor Management leaders to identify priorities, align on outcomes, and drive data-driven decision making. 
 - Drive operational excellence through workflow measurement, process optimization, productivity benchmarking, and scalable automation initiatives, including AI-enabled solutions. 
 - Oversee data quality governance and decision analytics capabilities, leveraging statistical methods, experimentation, and AI evaluation frameworks to improve quality, quantify impact, and reduce operational risk. 
 - Partner with global QMI and Technical Project Management teams to deliver governed analytics platforms, reusable frameworks, and disciplined project execution, ensuring measurable business impact and consistent technical standards. 

You'll Need To Have

- Bachelor's degree or higher in Statistics, Mathematics, Data Science, Operations Research, Engineering, Computer Science, Economics, or a related field. 
 - 5+ years of people leadership experience, with a proven track record of building, coaching, and developing high-performing analytical or technical teams. 
 - Strong analytical background in areas such as Applied Statistics, Decision Science, Data Quality, Operations Research, or a related discipline, with experience designing measurement frameworks and evaluating operational systems.

data.title: Senior AI Business Automation Engineer - Technology IT
data.description:
About Signant Health

At Signant Health, we help bring life-changing treatments to patients faster. We are a global evidence generation company that supports clinical trials with smart technology, scientific expertise, and hands-on operational support - so better data leads to better decisions in healthcare. We embrace AI and advanced technologies to enhance every aspect of what we do, from data analysis to operational efficiency. 

Our teams work at the intersection of science, technology, and patient experience, delivering digital solutions powered by AI innovation that make clinical trials more efficient, more accurate, and more accessible around the world. Trusted by leading pharmaceutical companies and CROs, our platforms and services support studies across more than 90 countries and have contributed to hundreds of new drug approvals. 

If you are motivated by meaningful work, global impact, and innovation in clinical research and digital health - including the opportunity to work with cutting-edge AI technologies - you will find purpose and opportunity at Signant Health. 

About The Role

Signant Health is seeking a Senior AI Business Automation Engineer who works in two complementary modes. In one mode, you embed directly with functional Subject Matter Experts - sitting shoulder-to-shoulder with the people doing the work, understanding their workflows including the workarounds and group knowledge that never appear in process documents, and then designing, prototyping, and delivering the custom technical solutions that transform how those teams operate. 

In the other mode, you work on a small, focused delivery squad - sometimes leading, sometimes contributing - tasked with shipping AI-driven automation into a business unit at pace. In both modes the discipline is the same: get close to the real work, find the highest-leverage process to reinvent, and put working code in front of real users quickly. 

The role lives inside IT and carries the full weight of our infrastructure, data, integration, automation, and information security standards required of a clinical-trial technology provider. Your measure of success is the number of workflows you have permanently transformed and the extent to which the business teams you work with start every task with an AI tool. 

What You Will Do

- Flex between two operating modes: embed directly with a cohort of business SMEs to surface the highest-leverage workflows to reinvent with an AI-first design; and contribute to or lead small, focused delivery squads tasked with shipping AI-driven automation into a business unit at pace. 
 - Design, prototype, and deliver working solutions - custom tools, AI agents, automations, and reusable skills - tailored to each engagement's specific workflows, using a cadence of regular incremental delivery against real workflow data. 
 - Coach and partner with the business users you work alongside, taking them through a progressive journey: from awareness, to first win, to regular AI integration, to full workflow transformation. 
 - Develop and deploy AI agents leveraging LLMs and Model Context Protocol (MCP) integrations, end-to-end automations across REST APIs, webhooks, and third-party SaaS, and secure data pipelines - built to enterprise standards. 
 - Build every solution for handoff from day one - technology choices, documentation, observability, and runbooks designed so other engineers can operate and evolve the solution without ongoing involvement from you. 
 - Recognise patterns across engagements and systematically scale what works - tools and transformation patterns made reusable for peers and documented for other engineers. 
 - Translate observed business problems into technical solutions and share wins visibly within your cohort and with leadership, with ROI, effort, and risk articulated to make prioritisation decisions easy. 
 - Participate in end-to-end testing and quality validation of AI, automation, and integrated solutions prior to production deployment. 
 - Use AI development tools fluently throughout the build lifecycle - AI coding assistants (e. g. Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot), eval harnesses, golden datasets, regression suites, and human-in-the-loop checkpoints - to validate accuracy, safety, and business alignment before production deployment. 
 - Ensure automation solutions meet enterprise standards for security, scalability, and maintainability, including SOC 2 and ISO 27001 compliance requirements for automation and data handling. 
 - Mentor both directions: upskill business users to build and maintain their own AI-assisted workflows, and support junior engineers by establishing reusable patterns, solution designs, and runbooks. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience. 
 - 5+ years of experience in enterprise automation, software development, or IT engineering. 
 - Hands-on experience designing and operating workflow automation (self-hosted or cloud) with REST API and webhook integrations across enterprise SaaS platforms. 
 - 2+ years of experience building with the modern AI development toolkit: LLM APIs (Anthropic, OpenAI, or equivalent), MCP servers and clients, agent frameworks, AI coding assistants used as a daily driver, structured prompt engineering, retrieval-augmented generation, and eval harnesses for production. 
 - Proficiency in JavaScript/TypeScript and Python; experience with Git, CI/CD pipelines, and cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP). 
 - Demonstrated ability to discover real workflows by working closely with practitioners - surfacing the workarounds, shared spreadsheets, and undocumented group knowledge that determine whether an AI solution works on real edge cases. 
 - Comfortable operating in small, high-velocity delivery teams - able to step into either a lead or contributor role on a squad of 2-4 engineers and hold a clear delivery line under time pressure. 
 - Ability to communicate technical solutions clearly to both engineering teams and executive stakeholders, with demonstrated experience authoring business cases, solution designs, and implementation roadmaps. 

Desired Qualifications

- Relevant professional certifications in IT service management, project management, or enterprise automation platforms (e. g. ITIL, PMP, or platform-specific certifications). 
 - Experience with iPaaS integration platforms (Boomi, MuleSoft, or Workato) connecting enterprise systems including ERP, HRIS, CRM, and ITSM tooling. 
 - Global experience collaborating with distributed teams to deliver enterprise technology initiatives. 
 - Experience using AI to discover and redesign workflows - analysing transaction histories, ticket logs, or content repositories with LLMs to surface bottlenecks, or building agentic prototypes to test a hypothesis before committing to a production build. Candidates must demonstrate depth in the track below

Track - General Enterprise

Essential: 

- Proven experience building and deploying enterprise platform extensions, custom scripting behaviours, and AI agent integrations in production service management and workflow environments. 
 - Proficiency in Groovy, in addition to JavaScript/TypeScript and Python, for scripting in enterprise automation platforms. 
 - Experience integrating AI/LLM APIs into production workflows across a broad set of enterprise SaaS platforms (Finance, Legal, HR, Operations, Commercial, or similar). Desirable: 

- Experience with platforms such as Boomi, UiPath, Salesforce, Snowflake, or Jira in cross-functional automation contexts. 

Why Signant Health?

At Signant Health, your work has real impact. Everything we build, support, and deliver helps advance clinical research and bring new treatments to patients faster - improving lives around the world. Our teams combine science, technology, and operational expertise to solve complex clinical trial challenges, and every role contributes to that mission. 

We offer a collaborative, global environment where you can grow your career while working alongside experts across clinical, technology, data, and operations, with opportunities to learn, take ownership, and drive meaningful innovation - not just maintain the status quo. 

If you are looking for purpose-driven work, smart colleagues, and the opportunity to help shape the future of clinical research and digital health, Signant Health is the place to do it. 

At Signant Health, accepting difference isn't enough - we celebrate it, we support it, and we nurture it for the benefit of our team members, our clients, and our community. We are proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and an affirmative action employer, committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or veteran status. Prior to their start date, all candidates are required to be verified through a thorough background check and identity verification to confirm eligibility for employment.
