data.description:
About Onit

We're redefining the future of legal operations through the power of AI. Our cutting-edge platform streamlines enterprise legal management, matter management, spend management and contract lifecycle processes, transforming manual workflows into intelligent, automated solutions. 

We're a team of innovators using AI at the core to help legal departments become faster, smarter, and more strategic. As we continue to grow and expand the capabilities of our new AI-centric platform, we're looking for bold thinkers and builders who are excited to shape the next chapter of legal tech. 

If you're energized by meaningful work, love solving complex problems, and want to help modernize how legal teams operate, we'd love to meet you. 

Position Summary

The Senior Software Engineer, Full-Stack builds substantial, interactive features inside Onit's enterprise legal operations platform, spanning enterprise legal management, matter management, spend management, and contract lifecycle management. Working across a Ruby on Rails backend and a modern JavaScript frontend, this individual contributor delivers data-dense, accurate, and resilient user experiences that fit seamlessly into the workflows legal teams rely on every day. The role partners closely with design, product, and the architecture team, owning features end to end from API to interface, with a strong focus on edge cases, performance, accessibility, and test coverage. 

Key Responsibilities

- Build substantial, interactive features inside an existing enterprise product, without disrupting the workflows they sit within. 
 - Implement data visualisations (line charts, comparison tables, range indicators) where the visual encoding carries real meaning and small inaccuracies mislead users. 
 - Build filtering and comparison controls that update complex views in real time. 
 - Implement every state the feature can be in: loading, error, empty, and the cases where there is insufficient data to show a comparison at all. These matter as much as the primary path. 
 - Build and extend Ruby on Rails APIs, consume APIs built by the architecture team, and push back early when a contract does not serve the interface well. 
 - Work closely with design, matching intent precisely and raising discrepancies rather than approximating. 
 - Make sure features load asynchronously and never block or slow the workflows they are embedded in. 
 - Build for accessibility and cross-browser consistency. 
 - Instrument features so the team can measure how they are actually used. 
 - Write tests that cover behaviour, including the degraded cases. 

Required Skills

- 6+ years building production web applications, with significant frontend ownership and hands-on backend development. 
 - Strong backend experience with Ruby on Rails: building and modifying APIs, data models, and services, not only consuming them. 
 - Strong proficiency with a modern JavaScript framework (React, Angular, or Vue) and solid JavaScript/TypeScript fundamentals, including a real understanding of rendering and state management, not just framework APIs. 
 - Experience building data-dense interfaces: charts, tables, dashboards, or comparison views where accuracy of presentation matters. 
 - Experience working inside large existing codebases: reading unfamiliar code, following established conventions, and avoiding regressions. 
 - Demonstrable care for edge cases, empty states, and error handling, backed by automated tests (e. g. , RSpec and frontend testing frameworks). 
 - Strong collaboration with designers and product managers; asks clarifying questions before building. 
 - Working proficiency with AI coding tools (e. g. , Claude, GitHub Copilot) to accelerate development, debugging, and test writing, with the judgment to review and validate AI-generated code before it ships. 

Benefits & Perks That Support You

Health Coverage: Employee and immediate family members. 

Time Away: Flexible paid time off and 10 company paid holidays annually. 

Family Support: Exceptional paid leave for birth parents, non-birth parents, and caregivers. Onit also offers surrogacy and adoption reimbursement.

We know that not everyone will check every box in a job description. At Onit, we value diversity, inclusion, and authenticity. If you're excited about this role but your experience doesn't align perfectly with every qualification, we encourage you to apply. You may be exactly who we're looking for.

Customer First - Customer success is our success. We deliver value, listen, and act on customer needs. 

Purposeful Innovation - Innovation fuels our growth. We harness creativity to solve problems and lead with the intentions and expertise. 

Win as One - Teamwork is how we win. We are accountable, act with integrity, and communicate openly.

data.description:
Senior Executive, CoE - Aseptic & Sterile Manufacturing

Lead sterile-manufacturing excellence and strengthen contamination control across sites. 

About the Role

Work with the Head of CoE to lead site CoE activities and drive consistent aseptic and sterile manufacturing practices across sites. You will provide technical leadership in sterility assurance, contamination control, risk management, and inspection readiness while building subject-matter expertise and supporting continuous improvement. 

Reporting to: Head, CoE - Aseptic & Sterile Manufacturing

Key Responsibilities

- Establish and harmonize aseptic manufacturing standards, including operator practices, interventions, contamination control strategies (CCS), and media fill governance. 
 - Lead site maturity assessments, identify sterility risks, and coordinate improvement plans with clear owners, milestones, and effectiveness checks. 
 - Provide technical review of critical deviations, investigations, and corrective and preventive actions (CAPAs); challenge unsupported risk acceptance and recurring failure modes. 
 - Support critical qualification activities, operational risk assessments, regulatory inspections, and closure of readiness gaps. 
 - Monitor sterile-manufacturing KPIs and trends, prioritize improvement initiatives, and ensure timely closure of CoE actions. 
 - Escalate critical sterility, contamination-control, patient-safety, data-integrity, and regulatory risks through established quality and management processes. 
 - Recommend proportionate controls or activity holds through approved site governance; final batch disposition and quality approvals remain with authorized functions. 
 - Coach subject-matter experts, lead technical forums and field coaching, and strengthen team capability and succession readiness. 
 - Collaborate with Manufacturing, Quality, Microbiology, Engineering, Validation, Regulatory Affairs, Projects, Digital, and Learning teams, and authorized external partners. 

Qualifications and Experience

- Bachelor's or master's degree in pharmacy
 - Typically, 12-15 years of experience in sterile pharmaceutical manufacturing, quality, sterility assurance, validation, microbiology, or engineering, including at least 3-5 years of team or cross-functional leadership. 
 - Strong technical knowledge of aseptic processing, barrier systems, CCS, media fills, environmental and personnel monitoring, sterilization and depyrogenation, sterile filtration and PUPSIT, cleaning and disinfection, airflow visualization, VHP, qualification, and process validation; terminal sterilization knowledge where applicable. 
 - Working knowledge of EU GMP Annex 1, FDA aseptic processing expectations, PIC/S GMP guidance, applicable pharmacopeial requirements, ICH Q9, and ICH Q10. 

Preferred Experience and Credentials

- Multi-site or corporate experience. 
 - Formal training or certification in quality risk management, Lean Six Sigma, project management, auditing, sterile manufacturing, microbiology, or validation. 

What You Bring

- Sound technical judgment and a risk-based approach to sterility assurance and patient safety. 
 - Structured investigation and problem-solving skills, with a focus on evidence and effective CAPAs. 
 - Ability to influence across sites, build cross-functional alignment, and communicate complex technical risks clearly. 
 - Strong execution discipline, data-driven decision-making, and accountability for action closure. 
 - A coaching mindset and commitment to developing technical expertise within teams. 

Work Environment and Travel

This role combines corporate and manufacturing-site work, with regular cleanroom and technical-area presence. Cross-site travel is required based on risk and business priorities. Extended support may be needed during critical investigations, media fills, shutdowns, project qualification, or regulatory inspections. All work must follow applicable site safety, gowning, data-integrity, confidentiality, and quality-system requirements. 

Compensation - up to 16 to 18 LPA

data.description:
About Analog Devices

Analog Devices, Inc. (NASDAQ: ADI) is a global semiconductor leader that bridges the physical and digital worlds to enable breakthroughs at the Intelligent Edge. Staff Design Evaluation Engineer - Automotive Networking

Role Overview

Analog Devices International is seeking an experienced Staff Design Evaluation Engineer to join the Automotive Networking team in Hyderabad, India. In this senior technical role, you will lead the definition and execution of evaluation strategies for FPGA prototypes and automotive networking ASICs, from initial platform bring-up through system-level validation, characterisation, and release readiness. You will combine hands-on laboratory expertise with strong software development, test automation, data analysis, and technical leadership skills to deliver robust, repeatable, and high-quality evaluation solutions. 

You will work closely with design, verification, applications, systems, software, and product engineering teams to identify technical risks, resolve complex issues, and ensure that silicon and supporting platforms meet product and system requirements. As a Staff Engineer, you will provide technical direction, mentor engineers, and drive improvements in evaluation methodologies, tools, and laboratory practices. 

Key Responsibilities

- Define and lead comprehensive evaluation strategies, test plans, coverage goals, methodologies, and release criteria for FPGA prototypes and automotive networking ASICs. 
 - Translate product, architecture, and system requirements into measurable laboratory tests, including functional, performance, interoperability, robustness, and corner-case evaluation. 
 - Architect, develop, bring up, and maintain hardware and software evaluation platforms, test fixtures, reference systems, and supporting infrastructure. 
 - Develop modular, maintainable test and automation software in C and Python, including instrument control, data acquisition, regression execution, result processing, and report generation. 
 - Execute and analyse complex silicon and FPGA test cases; debug failures across hardware, firmware, software, interfaces, and system boundaries. 
 - Perform electrical and functional measurements using oscilloscopes, logic analysers, protocol analysers, signal generators, power supplies, and other laboratory equipment. 
 - Lead structured root-cause investigations, clearly document findings, and work with cross-functional teams to drive issues to resolution. 
 - Evaluate Automotive Ethernet T1S and related networking functionality, including link behaviour, data-path performance, timing, error handling, diagnostics, and interoperability. 
 - Develop system-level hardware, embedded software, scripts, user guides, application examples, test procedures, and technical reports that enable internal and external product evaluation. 
 - Review evaluation results, identify coverage gaps and technical risks, and communicate evidence-based recommendations to engineering and programme stakeholders. 
 - Drive continuous improvement in test architecture, automation, data quality, traceability, repeatability, and laboratory efficiency. 
 - Provide technical leadership and mentoring, lead design and code reviews, and contribute to planning, estimation, and prioritisation activities. 

Required Qualifications And Experience

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electronic Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant experience. 
 - Typically seven or more years of relevant experience in design evaluation, silicon validation, product engineering, systems engineering, or a comparable role. 
 - Demonstrated experience evaluating FPGA prototypes and performing bench validation or characterisation of ASICs. 
 - Strong proficiency in C and Python, with experience developing reliable test, automation, or embedded software. 
 - Strong knowledge of embedded systems, digital hardware, laboratory measurement techniques, and hardware/software integration. 
 - Proven ability to diagnose complex problems using structured debugging, critical thinking, root-cause analysis, and evidence-based decision-making. 
 - Experience capturing, processing, interpreting, and presenting technical data, with a strong focus on accuracy, repeatability, and traceability. 
 - Working knowledge of Ethernet and networking concepts, together with experience using serial interfaces such as SPI, I2C, and UART. 
 - Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to produce clear technical reports and present complex findings to varied audiences. 
 - Demonstrated technical leadership, collaboration, ownership, and the ability to influence outcomes across cross-functional teams. 

Preferred Qualifications And Experience

- Experience with automotive Ethernet technologies, including 10BASE-T1S, single-pair Ethernet, MAC-PHY devices, Physical Layer Collision Avoidance, or related in-vehicle networking solutions. 
 - Familiarity with automotive networking architectures, zonal systems, software-defined vehicles, and relevant industry standards. 
 - Experience with Ethernet protocol analysis, network traffic generation, performance measurement, interoperability testing, or fault injection. 
 - Experience developing embedded firmware for microcontrollers and integrating host-side software with evaluation hardware. 
 - Experience with audio and video interfaces or data paths, including PDM and RGB8. 
 - Familiarity with source control, continuous integration, automated regression frameworks, requirements traceability, and issue-tracking systems. 
 - Experience mentoring engineers, leading technical reviews, or coordinating evaluation activities across multiple sites or disciplines.

Title: Manager Software Engineering - D365 CE

Management Level: Manager

Job Summary

Caterpillar is seeking a Manager Software Engineering - D365 CE to lead the technical delivery of Microsoft Dynamics 365 Customer Engagement (CE) solutions with strong integration into Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations (F&O). This role blends hands‐on technical expertise, solution architecture ownership, and people management to deliver enterprise‐scale CRM and ERP solutions. 

The successful candidate will act as a technical authority, guiding architectural decisions, building complex solutions, and managing engineering teams. This role requires close collaboration with product owners, functional consultants, integration teams, DevOps, cloud infrastructure, and enterprise architecture teams to ensure high‐quality, secure, and scalable solutions. 

What You Will Do

This role will lead the end‐to‐end design, development, and delivery of scalable enterprise solutions across Microsoft Dynamics 365 Customer Engagement and Finance & Operations. Responsibilities span multiple apps in CE, including Sales, Marketing, Customer services & Field services. The Solution Architect will be accountable for designing, building, and implementing complex solutions that integrate seamlessly across these Dynamics 365 applications like D365 F&O, ensuring scalability, performance, and business value. 

Key Responsibilities Include

Technical & Architecture Leadership

- Lead end‐to‐end design, development, and delivery of Dynamics 365 CE solutions (Sales, Customer Service, Marketing, Field Service) with integrations to D365 F&O. 
 - Define and own the technical architecture ensuring scalability, performance, security, and alignment with enterprise standards. 
 - Guide technical strategy for CE implementations, upgrades, customizations, and integrations. 
 - Partner with functional leads, PMs, and vendors to align technical delivery with business objectives. 

Hands‐On Development & Governance

- Maintain hands‐on involvement in CE customizations including: 
 - Plug‐ins, workflows, business rules, and forms
 - Model‐driven and canvas apps
 - Power Automate flows and custom APIs
 - Design and develop integrations and web services using C#, . NET, JavaScript/TypeScript, and modern frontend frameworks as required. 
 - Enforce code quality, performance optimization, upgrade‐safe practices, and D365 CE best practices through reviews and governance. 
Integration & Data Management

- Design and oversee integrations across CE, F&O, Power Platform, Azure services, and third‐party ISVs using: 
 - OData and REST/SOAP APIs
 - Azure Logic Apps, Service Bus, Data Factory
 - Dual Write / Dataverse integrations
 - Support and guide data migration and ETL strategies, acting as the technical SPOC where needed. 
 - Ensure security, compliance, and role‐based access are aligned with enterprise standards. 
DevOps, Release & Environment Management

- Own CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices using Azure DevOps. 
 - Manage CE and Power Platform environments across Dev, Test, UAT, and Production. 
 - Oversee Power Platform Admin Center (PPAC) activities including deployments and lifecycle management. 
 - Estimate development effort, monitor delivery progress, and manage technical risks. 

People Management & Team Leadership

- Manage and mentor D365 CE engineering teams, providing technical guidance, performance feedback, and career development. 
 - Drive consistent delivery through effective capacity planning, prioritization, and collaboration. 
 - Conduct technical workshops, solution reviews, demos, and stakeholder discussions. 
 - Foster a culture of accountability, innovation, and continuous improvement. 

Reusable Assets & Innovation

- Drive creation of reusable CE templates, accelerators, and frameworks. 
 - Promote automation and AI‐enabled capabilities using Copilot Studio and AI Builder. 
 - Stay current with Microsoft D365 CE, Power Platform, and Azure roadmap to influence future solutions. 

What You Will Have

Software Development

- Proven experience as a Technical Lead or Solution Architect in at least 8 full cycle Dynamics 365 CE implementations. 
 - Hands on expertise with CRM workflows, plug ins, Power Platform integrations, and customization of CE entities. 
 - Advanced proficiency in Azure services (Logic Apps, Service Bus, Functions, API Management) and Power Platform (Power Apps, Power Automate, Power BI). 
 - Skilled in front end frameworks such as React and Angular for custom UI development. 
 - Provides consulting on upgrade safe customizations and extensibility frameworks. 

Software Development Life Cycle

- Strong understanding of software development lifecycle (SDLC), Agile/Scrum, and SAFe methodologies. 
 - Exposure to PI planning, sprint execution, and DevOps practices. 
 - Interprets product development plans and functional documentation, ensuring alignment with business goals. 
 - Applies performance tuning strategies and continuous improvement practices. 

Software Integration Engineering

- Skilled in integration strategies between CE, F&O, Power Platform, Azure services, and third party ISVs. 
 - Designs and implements integrations using: 
 - OData
 - REST / SOAP APIs
 - DMF / Data Management Framework
 - Azure Logic Apps, Service Bus, Data Factory
 - Dual Write
 - Experienced in aligning CE with ERP and legacy systems for seamless data exchange. 
 - Supports ETL processes and data migration strategies, acting as the primary technical SPOC. 
Software Product Design / Architecture

- Deep understanding of CE architecture, design patterns, agile methodologies, and performance optimization. 
 - Provides guidance on strategic areas such as ALM, environment strategy, integration strategy, data migration strategy, and security strategy. 
 - Architects robust, scalable, and secure CE solutions aligned with business requirements. 

DevOps & Release Management

- Strong knowledge of DevOps pipelines, CI/CD, Git, and Azure DevOps practices. 
 - Manages build, release, and deployment activities across CE environments. 
 - Oversees Power Platform Admin Center (PPAC), managing code branches, build pipelines, and releases across Dev/UAT/Prod environments. 
 - Skilled in environment management, monitoring release dependencies, and ensuring compliance with Microsoft standards. 

Leadership & Communication

- Demonstrated experience managing technical teams and driving engineering excellence. 
 - Strong stakeholder communication skills across business, IT, and vendor teams. 
 - Ability to balance hands‐on technical contribution with people and delivery management. 

Considerations For Top Candidates

- Expert‐level experience with Dynamics 365 CE development and solution architecture. 
 - Expert‐level experience with Microsoft development stack (C#, . NET, JavaScript, TypeScript). 
 - Expert‐level experience with Azure DevOps, CI/CD pipelines, and Azure microservices. 
 - Extensive experience with Microsoft Fabric for data integration and analytics. 
 - Strong knowledge of integration strategies (OData, REST APIs, Dual Write, Azure Logic Apps, Service Bus). 
 - Working knowledge of Azure tenant and environment management for CE and Power Platform. 
 - Experience collaborating with ISVs and IPs, and integrating CE with F&O using Common Data Services (Dual Write). 
 - Proficient in customization, configuration, and development (plug‐ins, workflows, Power Automate, business rules). 
 - Familiarity with front‐end frameworks (React, Angular) for custom UI development. 
 - Hands‐on experience with automation, AI Builder, and Copilot Studio to enhance CE business processes. 

Experience

- 12-15+ years of demonstrated work experience in ERP technologies with 10+ years in Microsoft Dynamics 365 CE development and customization. 
 - Proven experience as a Technical Lead or Solution Architect in at least 8 full-cycle D365 CE implementation. 

Certifications (Preferred)

- MB-700: Solution Architect Expert (Optional)
 - MB-210, MB-220, MB-230 & MB-240
 - PL-600: Microsoft Power Platform Solution Architect
 - Experience with Power Pages (portals) or AI-powered Copilot Studio.

July 25, 2026 -

Our customers are our compass, authenticity thrives, bold ideas are welcome, and everyone can bring their unique selves to work - every day. We're in this together, sustaining the future of our customers, our company, and our planet. 

Join a team of passionate thinkers, innovators, and dreamers - and help us connect people and build communities to create economic opportunity for all. 

As a Senior Software Development Manager in the Customer Support Technology team, you will lead critical engineering initiatives that power eBay's global customer service experience. You will drive the design, development, and operational excellence of systems that enable efficient, intelligent, and personalized support across both digital self-service and especially in agent-assisted channels. 

This position is based in Bengaluru, India and will require active collaboration with global teams across North America, Europe, and APAC. Success requires a readiness to work across time zones and occasionally modify working hours to align with customers from different regions. 

You'll lead the creation and integration of scalable platforms that improve customer outcomes and support agent productivity-while developing a world-class engineering team focused on innovation, reliability, and measurable impact. 

It is expected that the candidate will have solid understanding of computer science fundamentals, especially on SDLC in distributed applications. It's essential that you will have strong software development experiences with SOA, SOAP web services, Restful APIs, and messaging solutions. This position would be a best fit for someone who has been a technical lead in the past in the development of complex distributed systems. You are expected to be self-motivated, produce high quality work and have strong communication skills in addition to being comfortable working in a matrix-ed environment, collaborating across globally distributed teams. 

Key Responsibilities

- Lead the design, development, and end-to-end ownership of scalable APIs, internal frameworks, batch processing programs, and email systems that power customer support actions, automate workflows, enable case resolution, and deliver personalized, timely, and compliant customer communications. 
 - Build, manage, and scale a high-performing, globally distributed engineering team, fostering a culture of technical excellence, collaboration, inclusion, and continuous learning. 
 - Provide strong technical and people leadership, guiding system architecture, implementation, and career development for team members. 
 - Drive seamless integration with world-class customer support platforms and tools, enabling robust workflows and extending internal capabilities with best-in-class SaaS solutions. 
 - Champion the adoption of AI and intelligent tooling to enhance developer productivity, improve code quality, and automate testing, monitoring, and deployment processes. 
 - Lead Agile software development practices, driving iteration, velocity, and alignment with evolving business goals. 
 - Establish and evolve DevOps practices, including CI/CD automation, observability, reliability engineering, and infrastructure management. 
 - Work closely with customers across Product, Design, Support Operations, and Infrastructure to align engineering priorities with strategic customer support objectives. 
 - Ensure all systems are secure, resilient, and scalable, with proactive monitoring, incident management, and high availability. 
 - Influence the long-term technical vision and roadmap for customer support technologies, contributing to platform strategy and innovation. 

What will you bring?

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science or a related field, with a minimum of 12 years of software development experience, including 6 years in engineering leadership and team management. Equivalent experience accepted.

data.title: GDS Consulting - AIA - AI Archictect- Manager
data.description:
At EY, you'll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we're counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all. 

AI Architect

Enterprise GenAI, Agentic AI and AI Platform Architecture

Career Family AIA - AI / GenAI / Agentic AI

Role Type Full Time

The opportunity

We are seeking an experienced AI Architect to lead the design and delivery of secure, scalable and production-ready enterprise AI solutions. The role combines hands-on architecture with consulting leadership across Generative AI, Agentic AI, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), AI/ML, cloud platforms and modern application engineering. The architect will translate business priorities into target-state architectures, reusable patterns and implementation roadmaps while guiding multidisciplinary teams from discovery through deployment and operationalization. 

The ideal candidate has delivered enterprise or client-facing AI solutions in pre-production or production environments and can explain the use case, architecture, personal contribution, controls, delivery approach and outcomes. Certifications, personal projects and demonstrations alone are not sufficient. 

Your Key Responsibilities

- Lead discovery and architecture workshops, clarify business outcomes and non-functional requirements, and convert them into scalable AI solution designs and delivery roadmaps. 
 - Architect LLM applications, copilots, RAG and Graph RAG solutions, autonomous agents, multi-agent workflows, tool/function calling, memory patterns and human-in-the-loop controls. 
 - Define reference architectures and reusable patterns for document ingestion, chunking, embeddings, vector and hybrid search, grounding, prompt workflows, model routing and enterprise integrations. 
 - Select fit-for-purpose models, cloud services, vector stores, orchestration frameworks and evaluation approaches based on security, quality, latency, cost, scalability and maintainability requirements. 
 - Design API-first, event-driven and microservices-based integrations with enterprise applications, data platforms, workflow systems and user experience layers. 
 - Establish AI evaluation and observability covering retrieval quality, groundedness, accuracy, hallucination risk, agent trajectories, tool execution, latency, cost and user experience. 
 - Embed Responsible AI, privacy, security and compliance controls including PII protection, access control, auditability, prompt-injection mitigation, content safety, secure tool execution and data-leakage prevention. 
 - Define cloud-native deployment and operations patterns using containers, Kubernetes or managed services, CI/CD, infrastructure as code, model/LLM operations, monitoring and release controls. 
 - Lead architecture reviews, technical design reviews, code reviews and production-readiness assessments; troubleshoot complex issues and guide performance optimization. 
 - Partner with business stakeholders, product owners, data scientists, engineers, UX teams, security and platform teams to ensure alignment from design through adoption. 
 - Contribute to proposals, RFP responses, estimates, executive presentations, accelerators, reusable assets and AI practice development. 
 - Lead and mentor architects and engineers, promote engineering standards, and build capability through coaching and knowledge sharing. 

Skills And Attributes

Professional experience

- 10+ years of experience in AI, data, analytics, software engineering or digital transformation, including significant responsibility for solution architecture and end-to-end delivery. 
 - Strong hands-on experience designing and deploying enterprise-scale AI/ML, GenAI, RAG or Agentic AI solutions in client-facing environments. 
 - Proven experience leading cross-functional teams, architecture governance, stakeholder engagement and complex delivery programs. 
 - Ability to communicate architecture decisions, trade-offs and business value to technical and executive audiences. 

Technical Skills

- Deep understanding of LLMs, prompt engineering, RAG, Graph RAG, Agentic RAG, embeddings, vector and hybrid search, knowledge graphs, model evaluation and fine-tuning approaches. 
 - Hands-on experience with agent frameworks such as Microsoft Agent Framework, LangGraph, LangChain, AutoGen, CrewAI or Google Agent SDK, and familiarity with Model Context Protocol (MCP). 
 - Strong experience with at least one enterprise cloud AI ecosystem: Microsoft Azure AI Foundry and Azure OpenAI; AWS Bedrock; or GCP Vertex AI and Gemini. Multi-cloud exposure is preferred. 
 - Experience with data and AI platforms such as Databricks, Azure AI Search, Microsoft Fabric, Synapse, BigQuery or equivalent enterprise data services. 
 - Strong proficiency in Python and SQL; working knowledge of REST APIs, FastAPI, JSON, asynchronous processing, microservices and event-driven architecture. 
 - Experience with vector databases, enterprise search, relational and NoSQL data stores, caching and analytics stores. 
 - Understanding of ML, deep learning, NLP, predictive analytics and the end-to-end AI lifecycle. 
 - Experience with Docker, Kubernetes or OpenShift, Git, CI/CD, automated testing, infrastructure as code, MLOps, LLMOps, observability and production support. 
 - Strong knowledge of enterprise architecture, data governance, model risk, Responsible AI, privacy, cybersecurity, accessibility and regulatory controls. 

Consulting And Leadership Skills

- Strong client engagement, workshop facilitation, stakeholder management, presentation and executive communication skills. 
 - Ability to translate complex business requirements into practical, high-quality technical architectures and phased implementation plans. 
 - Leadership in solution estimation, delivery governance, risk management, quality assurance, mentoring and capability building. 
 - Curiosity, structured problem-solving, commercial awareness and commitment to continuous learning. 

Education And Preferred Certifications

- Bachelor's or master's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics or a related quantitative discipline. 
 - Relevant certifications in Azure AI, AWS, Google Cloud, Databricks, AI/ML, Generative AI or enterprise architecture are preferred. 

Why join us

- Be at the forefront of AI-driven innovation across multiple client sectors. 
 - Work with global clients to deliver measurable business impact. 
 - Collaborate with AI experts, analytics leaders and industry specialists in a highly entrepreneurial environment. 

What We Offer

EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations - Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland and the UK - and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. 

- Continuous learning: You will develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next. 
 - Success as defined by you: We provide the tools and flexibility so you can make a meaningful impact, your way. 
 - Transformative leadership: We provide insights, coaching and confidence to help you become the leader the world needs. 
 - Diverse and inclusive culture: You will be empowered to use your voice and help others find theirs. 

EY | Building a better working world

EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets. 

Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate. 

Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

data.title: Senior Staff Software Engineer, Mobile (Android and iOS)
data.description:
About Outreach

Outreach, founded in 2014, is the only complete agentic AI platform for revenue teams. Outreach infuses agentic AI, conversation intelligence, and assistive AI to power hundreds of use cases across revenue motions. From new logo prospecting to expansions, deal acceleration, driving retention, and forecasting, Outreach AI automates workflows and frees sellers to focus on more strategic conversations and actions. Revenue leaders benefit from connected account visibility, performance insights, and higher forecasting accuracy across every GTM team. World leading enterprise organizations use Outreach to power their revenue teams, including Databricks, SAP, Siemens, and Verizon to name a few. 

About The Team

On the Mobile team, the goal is to give sellers everything they need to work their pipeline when they're away from their desk: their daily tasks, calls, email, SMS, meetings, deal insights and an AI assistant. We own Outreach's native iOS and Android apps end to end. That includes a voice dialer built on Twilio, CallKit and Android's Telecom framework, real-time messaging, conversation recordings, forecasting, and Ask Outreach, our AI assistant. Many of our customers are large enterprises that manage their devices with Microsoft Intune, so the bar on security, reliability and privacy is high. 

As our Senior Staff Engineer, you'll be the technical lead for mobile across both platforms. You'll guide the design of our feature work, estimate and plan it with product and engineering leadership, and drive it from kickoff to the App Store and Google Play. Both apps have grown fast, so you'll also set the technical direction: modern architecture, a predictable release process and quality you can measure, planned alongside the roadmap rather than instead of it. You'll help build a mobile engineering culture that the rest of Outreach can lean on. We have plenty of tough challenges which require creative minds like yours to help us solve!

Your Daily Adventures Will Include

- Partnering with mobile product manager, designers and stakeholders to understand how sellers work on the go, and turning roadmap ideas into features that serve those needs
 - Technically guiding and working hands-on for feature work across iOS and Android: shaping requirements into technical designs, reviewing designs and code, keeping the two apps consistent, and unblocking engineers on the hardest problems
 - Estimating and planning with product and engineering managers: breaking large features into milestones and units of work, sizing them, sequencing them across both platforms and dependent teams, and flagging risk early
 - Driving delivery from kickoff to store release: tracking progress against the plan, making scope and trade-off calls, reprioritizing when blockers appear, and keeping stakeholders informed on status and risk
 - Owning a predictable release process for both apps: one clear branching model, release cuts and promotion, regression and go/no-go, so everyone knows what's shipping and from where
 - Setting the multi-year technical direction for both apps, and planning modernization alongside the roadmap: Swift Concurrency and SwiftUI on iOS, a Jetpack Compose design system and modular Gradle builds on Android, and a consistent GraphQL client strategy with real caching on both
 - Defining the mobile delivery platform: automated code signing, CI test gates on every pull request, TestFlight and Google Play release automation, staged rollouts, and release-health metrics like crash-free sessions
 - Owning operational excellence for mobile, including crash symbolication, logging standards, release dashboards, on-call practices and incident reviews for mobile releases
 - Raising the bar on security, privacy, accessibility and localization, from secure credential storage and App Store privacy manifests to VoiceOver, TalkBack and Dynamic Type support
 - Coordinating with the Voice, Identity, Platform and Client Architecture teams on cross-cutting systems such as real-time calling, OIDC authentication, push notifications, feature flags and the GraphQL API, and building buy-in for technical choices
 - Working on one of the most visible parts of Outreach's product, to both our customers and the rest of our organization
 - Improving the team and company. You'll be an active participant in our culture through mentorship, technical reviews, interviewing and new initiatives. 

Basic Qualifications

- 10+ years of professional software development experience, with 8+ years building and shipping native mobile apps
 - Deep expertise in at least one native platform, iOS (Swift, UIKit, SwiftUI, Swift Concurrency) and Android (Kotlin, Jetpack Compose, Coroutines and Flow), and production experience on the other. Hands-on experience shipping on both. iOS is strongly preferred
 - A track record as the technical lead for feature teams: turning ambiguous product requirements into designs, estimates and plans, and delivering multi-quarter roadmaps on both platforms against committed dates
 - Experience planning and coordinating execution across multiple teams: managing dependencies, surfacing blockers early, reprioritizing and reporting status and risk to engineering and product leadership
 - A track record of leading the modernization of a large, long-lived mobile codebase: incremental architecture migrations, modularization and test strategy, delivered without stopping feature work
 - Strong knowledge of mobile release engineering: branching and release-train models, code signing, CI/CD, App Store and Google Play review, staged rollouts and crash monitoring
 - Strong knowledge of mobile security and privacy: OAuth/OIDC on device, secure storage (Keychain and Android Keystore), and store privacy requirements
 - Clear written and verbal communication: design docs, plans and trade-off write-ups that build buy-in with engineers, product managers and leadership
 - Ability to set and uphold technical and cultural standards for mobile engineering, including code quality, accessibility, performance, testing and operational excellence
 - Real-time voice on mobile, such as Twilio Voice, CallKit/PushKit or Android ConnectionService (plus)
 - Enterprise mobility, such as Microsoft Intune App Protection and MSAL (plus)
 - GraphQL clients at scale on mobile, such as Apollo iOS and Apollo Kotlin (plus)

Why You'll Love It Here

- Highly competitive salary
 - 25 days annual vacation time + sick time and casual leave

data.title: DevOps Engineer
data.description:
Role Overview

We are seeking an experienced DevOps Lead to take complete end-to-end ownership of our

AWS-based infrastructure and build the platform engineering function from the ground up. 

Today, this role entails leading a lean, agile team with a clear mission: maintaining high runtime

reliability, automating operations, and implementing AI-native infrastructure workflows. As our

organization scales, you will lay the architectural and operational foundation for an expanded

DevOps and SRE organization, balancing hands-on execution today with strategic leadership

for tomorrow. 

Key Responsibilities & Ownership Areas

1. End-to-End Infrastructure Architecture

● Architect, deploy, and manage multi-environment cloud infrastructure on AWS using

Terraform and infrastructure-as-code (IaC) best practices. 

● Own container orchestration (Kubernetes/EKS), networking, runtime resilience, and

deployment pipelines across staging and production. 

● Drive FinOps initiatives: monitor cloud usage, forecast spending, implement

cost-allocation tags, and optimize compute/storage costs without compromising reliability

or performance. 

2. Reliability Engineering & SRE Practices

● Define and implement meaningful Service Level Objectives (SLOs) and Service Level

Indicators (SLIs) aligned with customer-facing product experience. 

● Establish unified observability across metrics, distributed tracing, and log aggregation to

surface regressions before customers detect them. 

● Establish incident command procedures, blameless post-mortems, root cause analysis

(RCA), and sustainable on-call rotations designed to prevent engineer burnout. 

● Drive measurable improvements in platform reliability: reduce MTTR, lower incident

frequency, and eliminate repetitive firefighting. 

3. Continuous Automation

● Identify recurring manual operational tasks and replace them with reliable automation

across environment provisioning, preview branches, blue/green or canary rollouts, and

automated rollbacks. 

● Design and maintain robust CI/CD pipelines ensuring high developer velocity and

friction-free release cycles. 

4. AI-Native Operations & Tooling

● Integrate autonomous and semi-autonomous AI agents into daily infrastructure workflows

rather than treated as experimental prototypes. 

● Deploy agents for automated incident triage, root cause analysis, log pattern recognition, 

IaC drafting, and automated runbook execution. 

● Establish governance, access boundaries, safety guardrails, and audit logging to dictate

what AI agents can execute autonomously versus actions requiring human sign-off. 

5. Infrastructure Security & Compliance

● Collaborate closely with Security Engineering to enforce security best practices across

infrastructure boundaries. 

● Implement strict AWS IAM least-privilege policies, secret management (AWS KMS, 

Secrets Manager/Vault), and vulnerability scanning in CI/CD pipelines. 

● Maintain automated OS/AMI patching, container image lifecycle management, and assist

in infrastructure forensic investigations when required. 

6. Team Leadership & Roadmap Strategy

● Recruit, mentor, and foster the professional growth of a high-performing DevOps and SRE

team. 

● Define the multi-quarter platform roadmap: make disciplined "build vs. buy vs. retire"

technology evaluations aligned with company scale and budget. 

Candidate Profile & Qualifications

Required Experience: 

● Experience: 8-10 years of progressive hands-on experience in DevOps, SRE, or

Platform Engineering, including proven experience leading or mentoring engineers. 

● Scale & Scope: Proven track record owning complete production infrastructure for

high-traffic, consumer-facing products subject to substantial traffic spikes and strict

latency constraints. 

● Cloud & Tooling: Deep technical mastery of AWS services, Kubernetes (EKS), 

Terraform, Docker, and modern CI/CD tooling (e. g. , GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, ArgoCD). 

● Observability: Practical expertise building full observability stacks (Prometheus, Grafana, 

Datadog, OpenTelemetry, or ELK). 

● Security Foundations: Solid hands-on background in cloud security controls, VPC

architecture, IAM policies, encryption, and secure pipeline gating. 

● AI Integration: Active daily user of agentic development/ops tooling, with tangible

experience deploying automated workflows or agent-assisted tooling in an operational

setting. 

● Cost Optimization: Demonstrated track record of auditing and trimming substantial cloud

expenditures while sustaining or improving availability metrics. 

Preferred / Nice-to-Have: 

● Experience architecting and scaling GPU compute clusters, scheduling, and hardware

utilization. 

● Hands-on operational knowledge of LLM gateways (smart routing, token rate-limiting, cost

attribution, and multi-provider failover). 

● Experience operating in highly regulated compliance environments (e. g. , RBI digital

lending guidelines, DPDP, PCI-DSS, SOC 2, or ISO 27001). 

● Direct experience scaling an early-stage platform team through hypergrowth. 

Working Dynamics

This is a high-impact, hands-on leadership position reporting directly to Engineering Leadership. 

You will collaborate daily with Product, Backend, and Information Security teams to ensure

platform infrastructure accelerates developer productivity and delivers seamless customer

uptime.

data.description:
Company Description

It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. That moment inspired Fred to build a company that could do that for everyone-freeing people from busywork so they could focus on meaningful work. Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention. Our ServiceNow AI platform brings together any AI, any data, and any workflow- helping 85% of the Fortune 500® work smarter, faster, and better. We're building an AI-native culture where technology and talent are unstoppable together. And we're just getting started. 

Join us to put AI to work for people. 

Job Description

This role is for a software engineering director who leads a high-performing team of software engineers building AI-native and cloud-native applications on the ServiceNow platform. The Director combines deep technical credibility with strong people management capabilities, fostering a culture of innovation, ownership, and continuous learning. They are responsible for team performance, career development, hiring, and execution of key business initiatives. This role requires the ability to balance people development with business results, think strategically about AI integration and platform architecture, and influence across the organization to enable team success. The ideal candidate brings experience scaling AI-native teams and a passion for building leaders. 

What we do - Finance and Procurement teams are at the forefront of AI-native engineering at ServiceNow-building autonomous solutions for the world's largest enterprises that handle mission-critical financial and procurement operations at unprecedented scale. They continuously learn and integrate the latest AI and cloud-native technologies to deliver performant, resilient systems that transform how businesses manage supplier lifecycles, procurement workflows, payments, and receivables. 

Responsibility Area: People Leadership & Development

- Build, grow, and maintain a high-performing, diverse team of IC2-IC5 engineers; hire and develop talent at all levels
 - Set clear expectations for individual and team performance; establish metrics and goals aligned with business objectives
 - Conduct regular 1: 1s with direct reports; provide coaching, feedback, and career guidance tailored to each engineer's growth stage
 - Create a culture of psychological safety, learning, and ownership; encourage experimentation and learning from failures
 - Support engineers through career transitions-from IC2 to IC3, IC3 to IC4, and technical-to-management pathways
 - Identify high-potential engineers and invest in their development; prepare emerging leaders for increased responsibility
 - Address performance issues promptly and professionally; provide clear paths for improvement or transition
 - Sponsor team members for growth opportunities, stretch assignments, and leadership development programs
 - Celebrate wins and recognize contributions; foster a positive, collaborative team environment
 - Model vulnerability, continuous learning, and AI-native thinking; lead by example in your own growth

Responsibility Area: Hiring & Team Building

- Define hiring strategy and conduct recruitment for open positions; build a pipeline of qualified candidates
 - Lead technical interviews and assessments for engineering candidates at all IC levels; make hiring decisions
 - Partner with HR and recruiting teams on job descriptions, sourcing strategies, and candidate pipeline management
 - Evaluate cultural fit and potential; hire for values and growth potential, not just current skills
 - Onboard new engineers effectively; assign mentors and ensure smooth integration into the team
 - Build a team with diverse backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives; actively work to improve representation
 - Identify gaps in team capabilities (technical depth, domain expertise, AI/ML fluency) and address through hiring or development
 - Build relationships with external technical communities to attract and recruit top talent
 - Participate in employer branding and represent the organization at recruiting events and universities

Responsibility Area: Technical Strategy & Product Leadership

- Work with product, design, and cross-functional partners to define product roadmap and technical strategy aligned with business goals
 - Establish technical direction for the team; make architecture and technology decisions that balance innovation, quality, and delivery
 - Ensure the team's technical approach stays current with AI/ML advancements and ServiceNow platform evolution
 - Champion AI-native thinking across the team and organization; help teammates understand how to build with AI at the core
 - Lead architectural reviews and technical decision-making; provide guidance on complex technical trade-offs
 - Advocate for technical investments (refactoring, infrastructure, tooling) that improve team productivity and code quality
 - Set quality standards for code, testing, and security; establish practices that enable sustainable delivery
 - Partner with IC4/IC5 engineers to set multi-year technical roadmaps and long-term strategic initiatives
 - Represent the engineering team in product and executive discussions; influence organizational priorities

Responsibility Area: Team Execution & Accountability

- Drive team delivery of committed business objectives and product initiatives; maintain accountability for results
 - Establish clear sprint goals, work-item prioritization, and delivery timelines; remove blockers for team success
 - Track team metrics: velocity, quality, customer satisfaction, incident response, deployment frequency
 - Conduct regular retrospectives; identify process improvements and drive adoption of better practices
 - Manage team capacity; balance new feature development, technical debt reduction, and customer support
 - Ensure team participation in on-call rotation; monitor incident response and post-incident learning
 - Report on team progress, risks, and performance to senior leadership; provide transparent communication
 - Escalate critical issues or resource constraints; collaborate with peer managers to solve cross-team dependencies
 - Foster a culture of ownership where engineers take responsibility for quality, testing, and production outcomes
 - Lead team through organizational changes and initiatives; maintain morale and focus during transitions

Responsibility Area: Customer & Cross-Functional Engagement

- Build and maintain relationships with key customers and stakeholders; understand their needs and priorities
 - Participate in customer meetings, technical escalations, and business reviews; represent engineering capabilities and constraints
 - Work closely with product management, customer success, and other teams; ensure alignment on priorities and capabilities
 - Lead customer-critical incident response; ensure timely and professional resolution of critical issues
 - Gather customer feedback and translate into product improvements; communicate back to customers how feedback is addressed
 - Advocate for customers' needs within the engineering organization; ensure customer voice is heard in decision-making
 - Build trust and credibility with customers through transparency, responsiveness, and technical leadership
 - Participate in strategic customer discussions and technology roadmap reviews

Responsibility Area: Organizational Leadership & Culture

- Model the organization's values and desired behaviors; set tone for engineering culture within your team and across teams
 - Contribute to hiring and interview training of other managers; build bench strength in people leadership
 - Mentor junior managers or peers; contribute to manager development and leadership pipeline
 - Participate in engineering leadership meetings; contribute to organizational strategy and policy
 - Promote psychological safety, inclusion, and belonging; actively work to reduce barriers for underrepresented groups
 - Foster knowledge sharing across the organization; encourage your team to contribute to brown bags, documentation, and communities
 - Lead by example in work-life balance, continuous learning, and sustainable pace; prevent burnout
 - Encourage your team to engage with the broader tech community (conferences, open source, speaking, writing)

Responsibility Area: AI-Native Thinking & Innovation Leadership

- Develop deep understanding of AI/ML capabilities, limitations, and integration patterns; become a thought leader on AI-native development
 - Coach your team on AI-native thinking-how to build systems with AI at the core, not as an afterthought
 - Help engineers understand prompt engineering, retrieval systems, agentic workflows, and responsible AI principles
 - Establish practices for evaluation-driven development, hallucination detection, and model performance monitoring
 - Lead discussions on AI safety, data privacy, and responsible AI; ensure team builds with appropriate guardrails
 - Create learning opportunities for the team to stay current with AI/ML advancements and frameworks
 - Identify opportunities to apply AI to improve internal processes and team efficiency
 - Contribute to organizational conversations about AI strategy and responsible AI practices
 - Stay informed about LLM advancements, new models, and emerging techniques; share insights with your team

Qualifications

- 12+ years of professional software development experience, with 5+ years in AI-native systems, cloud-native architecture, or equivalent
 - 5+ years of people management experience leading software engineers; track record of developing talent and building high-performing teams
 - 3+ years managing application development on SaaS platforms (ServiceNow, Salesforce, or similar); deep understanding of platform architecture and constraints
 - 3+ years hands-on experience with AI/ML systems, LLM integration, prompt engineering, and responsible AI practices
 - Demonstrated expertise in hiring, team building, and organizational development; ability to attract and develop top talent
 - Expert-level understanding of modern software engineering practices: CI/CD, testing, security, deployment
 - Strong technical credibility; ability to engage in technical discussions with IC4/IC5 engineers; hands-on coding experience still valued
 - Proficiency in Python, Java, and JavaScript; understanding of ServiceNow scripting and platform APIs
 - Track record of delivering significant business results through engineering teams; ability to drive accountability and execution
 - Experience scaling teams and organizations; demonstrated ability to work at multiple levels of complexity
 - Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills; ability to influence across technical and non-technical stakeholders
 - Strong coaching and mentoring skills; ability to develop engineers across all career stages
 - Experience with Agile and Scrum methodologies; ability to adapt to team and organizational needs
 - Demonstrated understanding of data security, compliance, and responsible AI practices
 - Strong emotional intelligence; ability to navigate difficult conversations and build trust
 - Experience with performance management, feedback delivery, and difficult personnel decisions
 - Passion for building inclusive, psychologically safe teams where all engineers can thrive
 - Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, business, or related field
 - Experience leading teams through organizational change, technical migrations, or strategic initiatives
 - MBA or management certification is a plus; however, demonstrated people leadership capability is more important
 - Track record of developing talent into senior engineering leadership roles or managers
 - Active engagement with engineering and AI/ML communities; thought leadership through speaking, writing, or open source is a plus
 - Experience working with diverse teams and commitment to building inclusive organizations

Preferred Attributes

- Experience managing managers or leading multiple teams
 - Background in both individual contributor and manager roles (not just promoted from individual contribution)
 - Experience working in fast-paced startup or scale-up environments
 - Familiarity with data-driven decision making and analytics
 - Experience with customer-facing or go-to-market organizations
 - Understanding of product management and business metrics
 - Track record of improving team efficiency, reducing cycle time, or improving quality metrics
 - Experience mentoring individuals into management roles

Additional Information

Work Personas

We approach our distributed world of work with flexibility and trust. Work personas (flexible, remote, or required in office) are categories that are assigned to ServiceNow employees depending on the nature of their work and their assigned work location. Learn more here. To determine eligibility for a work persona, ServiceNow may confirm the distance between your primary residence and the closest ServiceNow office using a third-party service. 

Equal Opportunity Employer

ServiceNow is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, gender identity, veteran status, or any other category protected by law. In addition, all qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with legal requirements. 

Accommodations

We strive to create an accessible and inclusive experience for all candidates. If you require a reasonable accommodation to complete any part of the application process, or are unable to use this online application and need an alternative method to apply, please contact globaltalentss@servicenow. com for assistance. 

Export Control Regulations

For positions requiring access to controlled technology subject to export control regulations, including the U. S. Export Administration Regulations (EAR), ServiceNow may be required to obtain export control approval from government authorities for certain individuals. All employment is contingent upon ServiceNow obtaining any export license or other approval that may be required by relevant export control authorities.

Job Description

SRE at Goldman Sachs combines software and systems engineering to build run, and maintain high performant, distributed, fault tolerant systems. As a SRE Engineer you will be filling a mission-critical role ensuring that our systems are healthy, monitored, automated, and designed to scale. You will collaborate with engineering teams to continually improve our production services, facilitating fast delivery of new services, and reducing downtime. SRE utilizes automation, tools and solid engineering principles to optimize existing systems, build infrastructure and eliminate operational work. We are looking for passionate, curious, driven engineers who thrive on solving operational problems and improving efficiency and would like to apply their skills to Compliance Engineering SRE. 

Job Responsibilities

- Proactive management of our production services by measuring and monitoring availability, capacity and overall system health. 
 - Shaping software before go-live through activities such as system design consulting, capacity planning and launch reviews. 
 - Scaling and evolving systems by pushing for changes that improve capacity and reliability. 
 - Practicing sustainable incident management in a blameless postmortem culture. 
 - Identifying and building improvements to system behavior, control and monitoring tools. 
 - Defining and maintaining Service Level Indicators (SLIs) and Service Level Objectives (SLOs) to quantify and manage service reliability. 
 - Engineering solutions to reduce "toil" through advanced automation and self-healing system capabilities. 
 - Conducting capacity modeling and performance tuning to ensure systems meet future demand. 

Technical Skills

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR: 

- Experience in one or more of the following: Java, Python and Perl. 
 - Strong communication skills and the ability to clearly express ideas and arguments. 
 - Solid analytical and problem-solving skills with appreciation of technical risk. 
 - Experience with automated testing and SDLC concepts, developing applications in a Linux environment, and sound knowledge of algorithms, data structures and software design. 
 - Systematic problem-solving approach and a sense of ownership and drive. 
 - Ability to debug and optimize code and to automate routine tasks. 
 - Proficiency with Observability stacks, including distributed tracing, logging, and metrics (e. g. , Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, or OpenTelemetry). 
 - Deep understanding of containerization and orchestration technologies, specifically Docker and Kubernetes (K8s). 
 - Knowledge of networking protocols and load balancing strategies in a distributed systems environment. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, or a related technical field that involves programming. 
 - Experience in some of the following is desired: SRE experience, relational databases, Hadoop and big data technologies, knowledge of the financial industry or compliance/risk functions. 
 - Experience with Chaos Engineering principles and fault-injection testing to verify system resilience. 
 - Familiarity with cloud-native architecture and managed services (AWS, Azure, or GCP). 
 - Understanding of Error Budgeting and its application in balancing feature velocity with system stability. 
 - Hands-on experience with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) frameworks such as Terraform, Ansible, or CloudFormation. 

Interpersonal Skills

- Passionate about solving operational problems and constant improvement via automation. 
 - Highly motivated, pro-active and capable of working under pressure without compromising development processes. 
 - Strong, committed and reliable team player and strong communicator, able to take direction but also willing to contribute to discussions on design and strategy. 
 - Possess client-facing skills to be able to deal with and form good relationships with the business and other technology groups through day-to-day support and project work. 
 - Ability to multi-task and be effective working in a fast-paced environment. 
 - Interest in financial markets, technology and the ability to learn. 

About Goldman Sachs

The Goldman Sachs Group, Inc. is a leading global investment banking, securities and investment management firm that provides a wide range of financial services to a substantial and diversified client base that includes corporations, financial institutions, governments and individuals. Founded in 1869, the firm is headquartered in New York and maintains offices in all major financial centers around the world.

data.description:
Job Summary

Reporting to the Memory Validation leadership team, the Senior Silicon DDR/HBM Validation Engineer will be responsible for the bring-up, validation, characterization and debug of advanced memory subsystems used in next-generation AI compute platforms. 

The role will focus on DDR and HBM technologies, working closely with silicon design, firmware, characterization, platform and systems teams to ensure robust memory subsystem functionality, performance and reliability. The successful candidate will take ownership of significant validation activities, contribute to debug and root-cause analysis efforts, and help improve validation methodologies, automation and infrastructure. 

The Team

The Memory Validation team sits within the Validation organisation and is responsible for the bring-up, validation, characterization and debug of memory subsystems across Graphcore silicon and platform products. 

The team supports DDR and HBM validation activities throughout the product lifecycle, from first silicon through production readiness. Engineers work closely with architecture, RTL, firmware, characterization, systems and platform teams to ensure memory technologies meet functionality, performance, reliability and performance objectives. 

Responsibilities And Duties

- Execute validation and bring-up activities for DDR and HBM memory subsystems 
 - Verify memory bring-up software, firmware and scripts against defined project requirements 
 - Debug firmware, hardware and system-level issues and contribute to root-cause analysis activities 
 - Analyse system logs, validation data and characterization results to identify failures and performance issues 
 - Perform PHY characterization and analog-level analysis during stress testing and validation activities 
 - Develop and execute functional, stress, performance and corner-case validation tests 
 - Perform signal integrity, voltage, frequency and timing measurements using laboratory instrumentation 
 - Characterize memory bandwidth, latency, training behaviour and subsystem stability across operating conditions 
 - Develop Python-based automation, test infrastructure and reporting tools to improve validation efficiency 
 - Collaborate with architecture, RTL, firmware and platform teams to investigate and resolve technical issues 
 - Contribute to memory subsystem debug activities spanning silicon, firmware, board and system domains 
 - Support development of validation methodologies, debug procedures and reporting frameworks 
 - Contribute to continuous improvement of validation infrastructure and engineering processes 
 - Support silicon characterization, production readiness and qualification activities 
 - Document validation results and communicate findings to the wider engineering team

Candidate Profile

Essential

- Strong experience validating DDR, LPDDR, HBM or related DRAM technologies 
 - Deep understanding of DRAM architecture, memory subsystem operation and memory controller functionality 
 - Experience with firmware, BIOS and Embedded C development 
 - Strong programming skills in C and Python 
 - Hands-on experience using laboratory equipment including oscilloscopes and related measurement instrumentation 
 - Experience interfacing with low-speed peripherals including GPIO, SPI, I2C and UART/serial interfaces 
 - Experience performing functional testing and signal measurements including voltage, frequency and timing analysis 
 - Strong knowledge of embedded systems and microcontroller-based platforms 
 - Hands-on experience with board bring-up and hardware validation activities 
 - Experience debugging complex hardware, firmware and system-level issues 
 - Experience performing silicon characterization and analysing validation results 
 - Strong analytical, diagnostic and problem-solving skills 
 - Excellent communication and collaboration skills with the ability to work effectively across multidisciplinary teams

data.title: Automation QA Lead
data.description:
QA Lead - Performance & Load Testing (AI-DLC)

Key responsibilities

Performance and scalability engineering

- Define the performance test strategy for the 2x, 3x and 5x targets: workload model, test types (load, stress, soak, spike, scale-out) and pass criteria. 
 - Build realistic workload models from current claims patterns: nightly batch, EDI intake (837 claims, 277CA acknowledgements), real-time API calls and event traffic. 
 - Design and run load tests on a production-sized Azure environment, and prove horizontal scale-out to 5x by adding resources rather than changing code. 
 - Find and fix bottlenecks with the engineering pods across Go services, PostgreSQL, Kafka and the infrastructure. 
 - Set performance budgets per service (throughput, latency, batch duration, error rate) and enforce them in CI/CD. 
 - Publish load-test results as a go / no-go input to each production cutover. 

QA architecture across the pods

- Own test standards, the automation framework and QA oversight across all six delivery pods. 
 - Lead the Validation pod (2 Automation QA engineers). 
 - Build automated tests from Gherkin acceptance scenarios, including API, integration, end-to-end and regression suites. 
 - Design the parity tests that compare Prism's claim decisions with the legacy Que system, aiming for 99. 5 % decision match. 
 - Support parallel runs, reconciliation and UAT defect triage around each cutover. 

AI-driven delivery (AI-DLC)

- Use AI coding agents (GitHub Copilot and similar) to generate test cases, load scripts and synthetic test data from specifications. 
 - Set review standards and quality gates for AI-generated tests and code, so AI output is checked before it is trusted. 
 - Contribute to AI-DLC retrospectives: tune prompts, agents and the sizing model, and keep AI tool spend within budget. 

Data and compliance

- Work only with synthetic, non-production data offshore. No protected health information (PHI) reaches offshore staff or AI tools. 
 - Define synthetic data volumes and profiles that are realistic enough for 5x load tests and repeatable for every release. 

Experience

- 12+ years in QA, with 5+ years as a performance or QA architect on high-volume transaction systems (claims, payments, banking or similar). 
 - Hands-on load testing with k6 (preferred), JMeter, Gatling or Locust, including scripting, distributed load generation and results analysis. 
 - A track record of capacity and scale-out testing: has designed and run tests that proved a system at several times its current volume, and can show the results. 
 - Workload modelling from production patterns, covering both batch windows and real-time traffic. 
 - Performance analysis across the stack: APM and observability (Grafana, Prometheus, Datadog, Dynatrace or Azure Monitor), PostgreSQL query plans and tuning, Kafka throughput and consumer lag. 
 - Performance testing of containerised , cloud-native services on Azure or another major cloud, including autoscaling behavior . 
 - Test automation architecture: framework design, API testing, BDD with Gherkin, and test gates in CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions or Azure DevOps). 
 - Daily use of AI coding assistants (GitHub Copilot or similar) for test design, script generation or test data, with clear examples of reviewing and correcting AI output. 
 - Experience leading QA engineers and setting standards across several agile teams. 
 - Clear written and spoken English for daily work with US-based client stakeholders. 

Good to have

- US healthcare claims domain: claim lifecycle, payer submission, EDI X12 837 and 277CA, HIPAA. 
 - Legacy-to-cloud modernization, especially strangler-pattern migrations with parallel runs and data reconciliation. 
 - Parity or shadow testing that compares a new system's outputs with a legacy system's . 
 - Synthetic test data generation at volume. 
 - Performance testing of Go services. 
 - Chaos or resilience testing (failover, recovery, Kafka partition rebalancing). 
 - Security testing in CI/CD, such as SAST with SonarCloud . 
 - Certifications such as ISTQB Advanced (Test Analyst or Technical Test Analyst) or a cloud certification such as Azure Administrator or Developer.

- Create, Execute and Maintain test plans thoroughly to qualify product releases and features

Location:
