data.title: Marketing AI Engineer
data.description:
Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale - unleashing the potential of businesses and people. The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter. By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data - securing and protecting private information more effectively - Elastic's complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI. 

What is The Role: 

Elastic, makers of the hugely popular open source products Elasticsearch, Kibana, Logstash, and Beats, is growing very fast and so is our marketing team. As a key member of the Marketing AI, Operations and Automation team, you will play a hands-on, critical role in designing and building the automation infrastructure that powers marketing at scale. From connecting systems via APIs and webhooks to calling AI models for reasoning within live workflows, you will be the technical builder behind how marketing teams work smarter and move faster. 

Elastic is looking for a flexible and adaptable person with the ability to manage a variety of integration and automation challenges across a modern marketing tech stack. This is an ideal position for a self-motivated individual who has hands-on experience with no-code platforms and system integrations, is comfortable working directly with APIs and LLMs, and has the ability to work in a fast-paced, distributed environment. 

What You Will Be Doing: 

- Design and build automated marketing workflows using no-code and low-code platforms, connecting tools across the marketing tech stack so data flows reliably between systems without manual intervention. 
 - Integrate marketing platforms, AI content tools, and third-party services via APIs and webhooks, handling authentication, error states, and data formatting across each connection. 
 - Work with AI models and generative AI platforms to build structured, repeatable workflows that produce consistent outputs at scale, configuring prompts and agent behaviour at the system level. 
 - Call LLM APIs to trigger AI reasoning within workflows, constructing prompts programmatically, handling model responses, and routing outputs back to connected systems
 - Gather requirements from marketing teams across functions and translate them into workflow specifications, identifying opportunities for reuse and cross-team impact over single-team solutions. 
 - Own the reliability and maintainability of the workflows you build, writing documentation clear enough for non-technical stakeholders to understand what runs, why, and how. 
 - Evaluate new tools and integration patterns as the marketing tech stack evolves, recommending additions based on technical fit and organisational need. 
 - Collaborate with operations, regional marketing, content, demand generation, and other marketing teams to understand where automation removes friction and build accordingly. 

What You Bring: 

- 4+ years in marketing operations, marketing technology engineering, or a closely adjacent technical role focused on integrations and automation. 
 - Hands-on experience building multi-step workflows using no-code or low-code platforms such as Workfront Fusion, Zapier, Make, or n8n in a production environment. 
 - Practical experience working with APIs and webhooks: constructing authenticated requests, reading API documentation, handling errors, and passing data between systems reliably. 
 - Experience connecting marketing platforms (Workfront, Marketo, Google Workspace, or similar) to external tools and services through system-level integrations. 
 - Experience working with at least one AI model or generative AI platform in a workflow or integration context, including configuring system-level prompts and handling structured outputs. 
 - Experience calling LLM APIs to trigger AI reasoning within a workflow, including constructing prompts programmatically, handling responses, and routing outputs back to connected systems. 
 - Ability to gather requirements from non-technical stakeholders and convert them into buildable workflow specifications. 
 - Strong written documentation habits, with the ability to make complex automation logic understandable to others. 
 - Experience working across globally distributed teams spanning multiple time zones. 
 - Preferred experience with Workfront, Zapier, Marketo, Adobe Fusion, Google Suite. 

Bonus Points: 

- Google Apps Script, JavaScript, or Python for cases where no-code tools reach their limits. 

Additional Information - We Take Care of Our People: 

As a distributed company, diversity drives our identity. Whether you're looking to launch a new career or grow an existing one, Elastic is the type of company where you can balance great work with great life. Your age is only a number. It doesn't matter if you're just out of college or your children are; we need you for what you can do. 

We strive to have parity of benefits across regions, and while regulations differ from place to place, we believe taking care of our people is the right thing to do. 

- Competitive pay based on the work you do here and not your previous salary
 - Health coverage for you and your family in many locations
 - Ability to craft your calendar with flexible locations and schedules for many roles
 - Generous number of vacation days each year
 - Increase your impact - We match up to $2000 (or local currency equivalent) for financial donations and service
 - Up to 40 hours each year to use toward volunteer projects you love
 - Embracing parenthood with a minimum of 16 weeks of parental leave

Different people approach problems differently. We need that. Elastic is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating an inclusive culture that celebrates different perspectives, experiences, and backgrounds. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, ethnicity, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, disability status, or any other basis protected by federal, state or local law, ordinance or regulation. 

We welcome individuals with disabilities and strive to create an accessible and inclusive experience for all individuals. To request an accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please email candidate_accessibility@elastic. co. We will reply to your request within 24 business hours of submission.

We are seeking a Senior Automation Engineer to design, implement, execute, and maintain reliable automated tests for distributed applications and connected-service workflows. The Mortgage Loan Engineering Team within Global Banking & Markets (GBM Private) is responsible for designing, developing, and supporting robust, scalable applications for mortgage structured products on behalf of our businesses and clients. Your contributions will directly ensure structural and technical compliance with key regulatory bodies-such as the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) and the Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI)-while modernizing financial operations, leading legacy systems migration, integrating enterprise data lakes, and leveraging state-of-the-art AI-assisted development tools.

 - Drive technical preparation and map deliverables for internal and external IT audits, deploying real-time data reconciliation engines to secure clean, issue-free audit outcomes. 
 - Prepare and present IT operational, cybersecurity, and compliance metrics to the IT Strategy Board of Directors on a quarterly cycle. 
 - Manage recurring access certifications, capacity-utilization audits, and tracking of committed technical remediation deliverables.

 - Maintain robust, automated synchronization between core internal databases and external asset management or vendor systems.

Required Skills & Qualifications

- Min. 8 years of working experience and deep proficiency in Java or Python, with hands-on experience executing complex framework migrations. Familiarity with modern web technologies (such as HTML5, JavaScript, React/Redux, and JSON). 
 - Hands-on experience driving Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) efficiency using modern generative AI-assisted programming tools. 
 - Strong track record working with cloud ecosystem services, automated data-ingestion pipelines, secure file transfer protocols, and modern data lakehouse architectures. 
 - Experience building enterprise compliance portals and workflows using professional low-code development platforms.

data.title: Sr. Engineering Manager
data.description:
About Esper

Esper revolutionizes device management by redefining what it should be: a driver of business growth. With advanced and modern capabilities, automation replaces outdated workflows, re-provisioning becomes obsolete, and managing by exception transforms efficiency, resulting in increased efficiency, improved ROI, and bolsters security for device fleets of all sizes. Esper has been recognized as number 735 on Inc. Magazine's 2025 5000 fastest-growing private companies in America, and 133 on the 2024 Deloitte Technology Fast 500. Some of the world's most innovative brands, like Google, Doordash, Taco Bell, Clinical ink, SF 49ers, and Intelity, rely on Esper to deliver exceptional device experiences. Esper partners with the leading mobile device hardware manufacturers, solution providers, and distributors globally. 

About The Role

We are looking for a Senior Engineering Manager who brings a strong blend of technical depth, strategic thinking, and people leadership. 

In this role, you will lead multiple high-performing engineering teams, define and execute technical strategy, and drive the delivery of scalable, high-quality systems. You will play a critical role in shaping engineering culture, mentoring leaders and engineers, and aligning execution with business and customer outcomes. 

This role requires someone who can operate at both strategic and execution levels-comfortable influencing architecture, guiding managers, and partnering cross-functionally to deliver impactful products at scale. 

What You'll Do

- Build and Lead High-Performing Teams - Lead, mentor, and grow multiple engineering teams, including Engineering Managers and senior ICs. Define hiring standards, actively recruit top talent, and build a diverse, inclusive organization. Foster a culture of ownership, accountability, innovation, and continuous learning through regular 1: 1s, performance reviews, and career development planning. 
 - Drive Technical Strategy and Architecture - Define and execute the engineering roadmap aligned with company strategy and product vision. Guide architectural decisions across Android platform internals, device management (EMM/MDM), and cloud-native systems (AWS, GCP, Azure). Oversee the design of distributed systems, microservices, Kubernetes-based platforms, Kafka-based data pipelines, and REST/gRPC APIs, ensuring best practices in security, scalability, reliability, and performance. 
 - Own Delivery and Operational Excellence - Own end-to-end delivery from planning and design to deployment and live-site operations. Establish and track SLOs/SLAs, observability, and system health metrics. Drive predictable execution with clear milestones, risk management, and stakeholder alignment. Uphold high standards across design reviews, code quality, testing, release readiness, and CI/CD automation for fleet-scale deployments. 
 - Collaborate Cross-Functionally and Influence Strategy - Partner closely with Product, Program Management, QA, Security, DevOps, and Customer Success teams. Translate business needs into scalable technical solutions and influence company-wide decisions through data-driven insights and technical expertise. 
 - Champion Innovation and AI-Driven Engineering Practices - Stay current with emerging technologies and drive innovation in device management, IoT, and SaaS platforms. Drive adoption of AI-assisted development tools to improve engineering productivity, and establish best practices for responsible AI usage with strong validation, code review, and quality standards. 

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

- 9+ years of software engineering experience, with 4-6+ years in engineering leadership roles. 
 - Proven experience managing multiple teams and/or managers in a fast-paced product environment. 
 - Strong technical background with the ability to contribute to architecture and design decisions. 
 - Experience building and scaling cloud-native, distributed systems. 
 - Demonstrated success in delivering complex, high-impact software products. 
 - Strong collaboration skills with experience working cross-functionally. 
 - Excellent communication and stakeholder management abilities. 
 - Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or related field (or equivalent experience). 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience in device management, Android/iOS platforms, IoT, or enterprise SaaS. 
 - Familiarity with MDM/EMM frameworks and fleet-scale device operations. 
 - Hands-on experience with: 
 - 
 - Cloud platforms (AWS/GCP/Azure)
 - Kubernetes, Kafka, CI/CD tools (Jenkins, Git, etc. )
 - Programming languages such as Go, Python, or Java
 - Experience with Agile methodologies and modern engineering practices. 
 - Strong track record of developing engineering leaders and scaling teams. 
 - Familiarity with AI-assisted development tools and strong verification practices.

data.title: SDE II, EE Experiences, Progressive Discovery and Monetization
data.description:
Description

Everyday Essentials (EE) is a $100B+ business and one of the fastest-growing categories at Amazon - the household staples, health and personal care, grocery, and beauty products hundreds of millions of customers reorder. We're reinventing how customers discover, buy, and get more value from them, and we're looking for Software Development Engineers who want to build that future. 

The EE Experiences organization builds the shopping experience for the products customers come back for most. Our charter is Progressive Discovery and Monetization: helping customers find better products for their needs, complete their baskets, and improve EE business economics - and giving the world's largest consumer brands new and effective ways to reach those customers and grow with Amazon. We build a durable, profitable business at the intersection of the two, on the surfaces customers use every day. 

This is a space where the hardest problems don't have off-the-shelf answers. We're not polishing a solved product - we're inventing experiences that don't exist yet, and the decisions we make now shape a business with room to grow for years. You'll build discovery and recommendation features, brand-facing advertising surfaces, and the backend services that power them. Your work moves from whiteboard to production in front of a very large customer base, with visibility all the way to senior leadership. 

We're an AI-first team, and that shows up in two ways. We use AI throughout how we build software, and we expect our engineers to keep learning and applying the latest tools to move faster and raise the quality bar. AI is also at the core of what we build - the intelligence that helps customers find the right product is a modeling and engineering problem we work on hand in hand with scientists. If you're curious about AI, learn quickly, and like using it to solve real customer problems while keeping a clear head about where it helps and where it doesn't, you'll fit right in. 

Key job responsibilities

Design, build, and own software end to end - from customer research through design, code, testing, deployment, and production operations. 

Take on ambiguous problems where the goal is clear but the path is not, bring clarity, and deliver simple solutions that improve how customers find and buy everyday essentials. 

Partner closely with scientists, product managers, and designers to turn customer and brand problems into products that ship worldwide. 

Use generative AI tools and modern engineering practices to raise quality and velocity, and coach teammates on getting the most from them. 

Own operational health for your services - monitor metrics, drive root-cause fixes, and keep improving the experience for customers and brand partners. 

Raise the technical bar through code reviews, mentoring, and hiring for the best talent. 

A day in the life

Most days start with the customer problem in front of you: how to help someone find better everyday-essentials products faster, or how to give brands a more effective way to reach shoppers or how to improve the profitability of the business. You dig into data, sketch a design, and talk it through with product managers and scientists before writing any code. By the afternoon you might be prototyping an idea that didn't exist yesterday, reviewing a teammate's change, or debugging something in production. Because so much here is new, you won't just pick up tickets. You'll help decide what to build, push for the approach you believe in, and see your work reach customers in weeks, not quarters. 

About The Team

Our team owns how customers discover and buy the everyday essentials they rely on - and how the brands behind those products reach them. Our mission is to make restocking the things you need effortless, help customers find better options and to improve the business economics along the way. Day to day you'll work with fellow engineers and partner closely with product managers, designers, and scientists, who bring the customer and data insight that shapes what we build. We're a small, fast-moving group solving open-ended problems for hundreds of millions of shoppers - a place where you own problems end to end and your ideas reach customers fast. 

Basic Qualifications

- 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
 - 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
 - Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

Preferred Qualifications

- 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
 - Experience building complex software systems that have been successfully delivered to customers
 - Experience debugging, profiling, and implementing best software engineering practices in large-scale systems

About Purplle & Our Mission

Purplle is more than a beauty e-commerce destination; we are a technology-first platform redefining how digital scale is managed. We are currently in a transformative phase, moving from "manual intervention and firefighting" to an era of Systematic Resilience. 

Our mission is to build "Unbreakable Systems"-platforms that don't just survive failures but absorb them, self-heal, and scale with the business calmly and predictably. We are looking for engineers who want to stop "fixing" and start "architecting" at the highest level. 

THE PURPLLE WAY: AI-NATIVE ENGINEERING

We Believe That As a Business Scales, Technology Shouldn't Become More Fragile. We Have Redesigned Our Entire Engineering Lifecycle To Be AI-native, Moving Away From Manual Toil Toward a World Of Intelligent, Self-governing Systems

- Velocity without Fear (70% AI-Assisted): We ship fast because we've built the safety nets to do so. You won't just be a "coder"; you will be a system architect. We empower our engineers to use AI for the heavy lifting of development-aiming for 70% of Pull Requests to be AI-assisted-so you can focus on complex logic and high-level architecture. 
 - Built-in Guardrails & Self-Healing Systems: Security and quality aren't "extra steps"-they are baked into our "Golden Paths. " We build systems that use AI for automated rollbacks and deterministic fallback logic, ensuring the platform absorbs mistakes automatically and remains resilient under pressure. 
 - Intelligence by Default (Zero-Toil Operations): We embed AI across the entire lifecycle-Build, Test, Detect, and Operate. By utilizing AI agents to eliminate "Ops Toil, " we've created an environment where anomaly detection and incident diagnosis happen in minutes, not hours. 
 - Predictable Economics & Growth: We treat cloud costs and system performance as core engineering disciplines. Every engineer at Purplle understands the "unit economics" of their code, ensuring our infrastructure scales as efficiently as our business. 

THE PURPLLE ENGINEER: MINDSET & IMPACT

We Aren't Looking For "feature Factories"; We Are Looking For Owners Of a Resilient Ecosystem. At Purplle, Your Success Is Defined By Your Mindset And The Tangible Impact You Have On Our Platform

The Systems Thinker (Quality & Resilience): You hate fixing the same bug twice. You'd rather build a "self-healing" mechanism than perform a manual fix. Your goal is to maintain a Change Failure Rate of <1. 5% and help us reach a state of fewer than 2 Sev-1 incidents per quarter. The AI-Fluent Architect (High Velocity): You are already using AI tools to 10x your own productivity. You leverage these tools to drive a cycle time of <4 hours and maintain a high frequency of dailydeployments, moving code from commit to production with total confidence. 
 - The Data-Informed Engineer (Economic Discipline): You care about the "why" behind the code. You understand that latency and cloud spend are engineering disciplines, and you optimize your infrastructure so that our cost-per-order remains predictable as we scale. 
 - The Proactive Collaborator (Security & Governance): You thrive in a cross-functional environment (Eng, Data, DevOps, Security). You take ownership of the "Golden Path, " ensuring 100% of your repositories are gated and that zero critical vulnerabilities ever reach our production environment. 

YOUR SPECIFIC MANDATE

In This Role, You Will Be Directly Responsible For

- AI-Native Velocity: Lead the 70% AI-assisted PR mandate by mastering Cursor, Copilot, and Claude to accelerate delivery of Node. js (NestJS) and Golang microservices-while keeping human intelligence focused on high-level system design and architecture decisions. 
 - Unbreakable Backend Architecture: Architect high-throughput, event-driven microservices using Kafka and Redis, embedding resilience patterns like circuit breakers, health checks, and fallback mechanisms to handle massive traffic spikes without manual intervention. 
 - Data & Performance Ownership: Own the 'unit economics' of the data layer-optimize MySQL and MongoDB queries, design efficient schemas, and ensure sub-second p99 latencies with predictable infrastructure costs on GCP. 
 - End-to-End Golden Path Ownership: Drive features from design docs to Kubernetes deployment, ensuring high reliability through strong engineering practices and maintaining low change failure rates and minimal Sev-1 incidents. 
 - API & Service Design Excellence: Build clean, versioned, and backward-compatible APIs and modular microservices with a strong focus on maintainability, scalability, and clear service contracts. 
 - Cloud-Native Operations & Observability: Design and operate services on Kubernetes with robust logging, monitoring, and alerting; proactively debug production issues and ensure high availability. 
 - Scalability & Cost Efficiency: Continuously optimize system throughput, fault tolerance, and infrastructure utilization to support high growth while maintaining strict control over cloud costs. 
 - Technical Leadership & Collaboration: Lead design decisions, write clear RFCs, mentor engineers, and collaborate closely with Product, Frontend, Data, and DevOps teams to drive high-quality outcomes. 
 - Core Engineering Excellence: Apply strong fundamentals in distributed systems, concurrency, and data structures, combined with sharp problem-solving, debugging, and communication skills. 

TECH STACK

- Languages & Frameworks: Node. js (NestJS / Express), Golang

 - Infrastructure: Kubernetes, GCP / AWS, Docker

Experience

- SDE1 - 1-2 years of backend engineering experience
 - SDE2 - 2-5 years; strong ownership of production systems
 - SDE3 - 5-7 years; proven track record of designing distributed systems at scale

WHY JOIN PURPLLE TECH?

You will be joining a team that is actively moving away from the "chaos" of traditional scaling. At Purplle, we are building a tech culture that is "Operational, not Aspirational. "

We provide the tools, the AI-first environment, and the "Golden Paths" to let you do the best work of your career. If you want to build intelligent, unbreakable systems that scale with confidence, your journey starts here.

At Lilly, everything we do starts with patients. We unite caring with discovery to make life better for people around the world. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our global team of over 50, 000 employees work with urgency and purpose to discover and deliver life-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve. We bring our best to this work because people depend on it. If you're driven by purpose and determined to make a meaningful difference for patients, we invite you to bring your skill and your commitment to Lilly.

At Lilly, technology is not a support function. It is how a global medicine company operates, innovates, and delivers. Lilly in Bengaluru builds the capabilities that make this possible, cloud platforms, AI systems, and automation at enterprise scale, all in service of a purpose that makes this technology work genuinely distinctive, from advancing drug discovery to enabling connected clinical trials to keeping a global medicine company running at the standard patients deserve. 

About The Business Function

The Software Product Engineering (SPE) team is a specialized engineering group that delivers strategic solutions and differentiated capabilities. We take a forward-thinking approach, focusing on an enterprise platform and product mindset, ensuring that the solutions we build can be leveraged across Technology teams for broader impact and efficiency. 

What You'll Do

DevOps and Infrastructure

- Own and evolve the platform's delivery and runtime foundations across CI/CD, infrastructure-as-code, Kubernetes/EKS, and AWS services - ensuring platform components can be built, deployed, scaled, and rolled back safely. 
 - Design and maintain reliable deployment workflows using Jenkins, GitHub Actions, container registries, environment promotion strategies, and automated validation gates for application and data-platform services. 
 - Strengthen operational excellence through observability, logging, metrics, alerting, runbooks, and incident-response practices that improve service reliability, recoverability, and mean time to resolution. 

AI, Agents and MCP Tooling

- Design and build AI agents and intelligent automation tools that help research scientists and data engineers interact with the platform more effectively. 
 - Design and implement MCP (Model Context Protocol) integrations that connect AI agents to platform data sources, tools, and services - enabling seamless, tool-augmented workflows for end users. 
 - Evaluate and integrate emerging AI tools, frameworks, and patterns into the platform's development workflows - finding opportunities where AI-assisted development, code generation, or intelligent automation can meaningfully accelerate the team's delivery. 

Data Engineering And Platform Capabilities

- Bring enough familiarity with modern data-platform patterns to collaborate effectively with data engineering teams - including Airflow, Glue/Spark, Kafka/MSK, and Lakehouse oriented architectures. 
 - Apply platform engineering skills such as API design, service integration, automation, operational troubleshooting, and reusable tooling to strengthen the reliability and usability of data-platform capabilities. 

Crosscutting

- Contribute to platform documentation, technical design proposals - ensuring that AI integrations, MCP patterns, and cross-cutting platform capabilities are well-documented and accessible. 
 - Rotate into feature or platform squads as needed - this role is deliberately not siloed to a single domain. 
 - Platform engineering mindset: able to design reusable tooling, APIs, service integrations, self-service workflows, and automation that improve developer and user productivity. 

Required Qualifications

- Bachelor's or master's degree in computer science, Information Technology, or a related technical field - required. 
 - 6-10 years of professional experience in DevOps, platform engineering, infrastructure engineering, with demonstrated ownership of production systems. 
 - Strong hands-on Python proficiency for automation, APIs, AI tooling, scripting, operational workflows, and platform integrations. 
 - Hands-on experience building, operating, and troubleshooting CI/CD pipelines using tools such as Jenkins, GitHub Actions, automated validation gates, and deployment promotion workflows. 
 - Solid working knowledge of AWS, infrastructure-as-code, containerized workloads, and Kubernetes/EKS-based runtime environments.

 - Practical curiosity or hands-on experience with LLMs, AI agents, MCP, tool integrations, or AI-assisted automation; production AI experience is helpful but not required.

data.description:
Our Mission

You call. You wait. You call again. In every other part of your life, you book in seconds. In healthcare, you're blocked. 

We're here to give power to the patient. 

For nearly 20 years, we've built the leading healthcare marketplace - helping tens of millions of people find and book the care they need. Now, we're going further: building our infrastructure beyond Zocdoc's marketplace to power access to care wherever patients search, from provider websites and insurance directories to search engines, AI platforms, and more. 

Healthcare still lacks something every other major consumer industry takes for granted: a seamless way to go from seeking to getting. We don't want to own the front door to care; there isn't one. We want to make sure all of those doors open when patients are knocking. 

Fixing healthcare starts with fixing access to it. And we're still just getting started. 

Your Impact on Our Mission

As a QA Analyst, you will play a key role in strengthening Zocdoc's quality ecosystem by ensuring that every issue entering our engineering pipeline is accurate, validated, reproducible, and data-backed. 

Partnering closely with QA Engineers, Product Engineers, and cross-functional teams, you will transform raw triage data into actionable insights - improving product quality, accelerating issue resolution, and enabling better decision-making. 

By driving structured triage processes, reporting automation, and analytical insights within the Triage & Reporting Pod, you will directly impact the reliability of our product and the efficiency of our teams, ultimately helping patients access care with ease. 

You'll Enjoy This Role if You Are. . . 

- A detail-oriented, data-driven problem solver

 - Someone who enjoys structured processes and improving them
 - A strong communicator who thrives in collaboration
 - Excited about automation, reporting, and AI-assisted analysis Motivated by uncovering patterns, trends, and root causes

Join Us as Manager, Quality Engineering - AI Automation and Data!

Are you a hands-on quality engineering leader passionate about building high-performing teams and advancing automation through AI-assisted testing? Join ORBCOMM and play a critical role in ensuring the quality, reliability, and accuracy of connected-device and operational data across our products, platforms, and customer-facing applications. 

Why You'll Love Working Here

At ORBCOMM, you'll be part of a global leader in industrial IoT solutions, helping customers use data products to streamline operations, improve visibility, and perform more effectively. You'll collaborate with talented teams across engineering, product, data, and operations on systems that process high-volume, real-world device and operational data. 

This role will work onsite at our Hyderabad, India global hub. 

What You'll Do

Lead and Develop a High-Performing Quality Engineering Team

- Lead, mentor, and grow a team of Quality Engineers and SDETs through hiring, onboarding, coaching, performance management, and career development. 
 - Drive consistent quality engineering practices across multiple delivery teams. 
 - Foster a culture of technical excellence, accountability, continuous improvement, and innovation. 

Build AI-Assisted, Automation-First Quality Engineering Capabilities

- Build and govern reusable automation frameworks using Python, SQL, PyTest , and fit-for-purpose data quality tools. 
 - Leverage AI-assisted testing approaches to improve test coverage, efficiency, and scalability. 
 - Establish governance and best practices for intelligent automation and AI-assisted testing workflows. 

Validate End-to-End Data, Platform, and Application Quality

- Automate testing of product data flows, APIs, services, and batch, incremental, CDC, streaming, and near-real-time pipelines across ingestion, transformation, storage, semantic, reporting, and consumption layers. 
 - Validate source-to-target mappings, transformations, business rules, calculations, aggregations, data contracts, derived attributes, and API responses 
 - Reconcile customer-facing KPIs and business outcomes across data platforms, APIs, dashboards, reports, exports, alerts, and downstream applications 
 - Verify consistency between batch and live processing, including scenarios involving provisional or late-arriving data

Implement Data Quality Controls and Release Quality Gates

- Implement automated controls for data accuracy, completeness, consistency, validity, uniqueness, referential integrity, schema drift, freshness, lineage, tenant isolation, and authorized data usage. 
 - Monitor for anomalous data volumes, distributions, and quality trends throughout ingestion, processing, and consumption layers. 
 - Integrate automated testing and regression suites into Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, or equivalent CI/CD pipelines. 
 - Establish automated quality gates that support reliable and secure software releases. 

Who You Are

You are a technical quality engineering leader who combines strong people leadership with deep expertise in automation, data validation, and modern quality engineering practices. You excel at solving complex problems, building scalable frameworks, and improving confidence in data-driven products. 

If You Have

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science , Software Engineering, Data Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. 
 - 8+ years of experience in software quality engineering, test automation, SDET, data quality, or related technical roles. 
 - 3+ years of experience leading quality engineering, automation, or data quality teams. 
 - Demonstrated success hiring, coaching, and developing high-performing technical teams. 
 - Strong hands-on expertise with Python-based test automation, advanced SQL, reusable framework design, AI-assisted engineering workflows, source control, code review, and CI/CD integration. 
 - Deep understanding of ETL/ELT processes, data lakes, lakehouses , data warehouses, dimensional models, streaming or event-driven data, semantic layers, and large-scale data validation. 
 - Experience testing cloud data platforms such as Microsoft Fabric and Azure data services, or comparable platforms within AWS or Google Cloud. 
 - Strong API and integration testing experience, including REST APIs, JSON/XML schemas, authentication, contract validation, retry mechanisms, rate limiting, integrations, and API-to-data reconciliation. 

Preferred

- Experience with Microsoft Fabric, Azure Data Factory, Azure Data Lake, Synapse, Databricks, Delta Lake, Spark, or PySpark . 
 - Experience applying generative AI, machine learning, or intelligent automation to testing, data profiling, anomaly detection, log analysis, or defect triage. 
 - Experience validating telemetry, IoT, telematics, logistics, transportation, connected-device , or other high-volume operational data ecosystems. 
 - Experience with Power BI semantic models, KPI reconciliation, data governance, data catalogs, lineage, and business reporting controls. 
 - Experience establishing governance for AI-assisted testing and intelligent automation, including traceability, human review processes, and management of generated tests and recommendations. 
 - Leverage AI-enabled tools and automation to support daily tasks and productivity. 
 - Commitment to continuous learning in digital and AI literacy. 

Then we want to meet you!

The Benefits Of Working Here

A career with ORBCOMM offers a unique opportunity to grow your skills and expand your expertise in a collaborative, innovative environment. Beyond being part of an exceptional team, we provide a competitive, locally relevant benefits package designed to support our employees around the world. Benefits vary by location and include health and wellness coverage, paid time off, retirement or savings programs, flexible work arrangements, insurance coverage, lifestyle perks, and access to employee discounts-helping you thrive both professionally and personally. 

How We Hire

ORBCOMM uses technology-enabled tools, including artificial intelligence (AI), to support parts of the recruitment process. All hiring decisions are made by people, as part of our human-led, tech-enabled culture. 

About Us

At ORBCOMM, we're pioneers in IoT technology that drives innovation and empowers our clients to make data-driven decisions. Our industry-leading solutions enable customers to boost productivity, streamline operations, and increase their bottom line. With over 30 years of experience and the most comprehensive solution portfolio in the industry, we enable the management of millions of assets worldwide across diverse sectors, including transportation, heavy industries, satellite, and maritime. Discover how ORBCOMM is transforming industries and unlocking the potential of data to drive meaningful change at www. orbcomm. com !

Ready to Join Us?

We believe that our people are our greatest asset. Your skills and passion can help us achieve remarkable things! If you're seeking a thrilling career opportunity in a vibrant, growth-oriented environment, ORBCOMM is the perfect fit for you. 

We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace and appreciate all applicants for their interest in joining our team. Only candidates selected for an interview will be contacted. 

At ORBCOMM, we are also dedicated to ensuring accessibility and are pleased to offer accommodations for individuals with disabilities upon request throughout all aspects of the selection process.

Description

Love sports? Want to change the world? Prime Video is re-inventing the live sports experience by merging high-quality live streaming, immersive interactive features, and exclusive access to some of the world's most loved sports properties - including the NFL, NBA, English Premier League and UEFA Champions League soccer, Rolland-Garros (French Open), the US Open and more. Who We Are

We are deeply connected with the idea that live sports events are fundamentally different: there is only one shot at delivering the moment until it is forever lost. Our mission is to make sure that our customers never miss a single moment of the sports they love. As Prime Video has grown, we've increased the depth and breadth of video products we support, with a corresponding increase in the associated size and complexity of our engineering activity and the load on our services. Our goal is to adapt our architecture to maintain and improve our velocity of delivery for customers in the face of these changes, and for our services to be on and error-free 24/7, especially for high-profile, exclusive content. With AI as a transformative force, we're at an inflection point that enables us to unlock new opportunities in predictive analytics, automated defect analysis and mitigation, and automated operations that were previously beyond our reach.

data.title: Supervisor, Global Sample Solutions
data.description:
Position Summary

The Supervisor, Global Sample Solutions is responsible for overseeing and coordinating the day-to-day activities of the Global Sample Solutions Site Outreach team. The role ensures timely resolution of sample discrepancies, effective site outreach, accurate data investigations and discrepancy resolution. 

The Supervisor provides operational guidance, training, workload prioritization, and escalation support to Global Sample Solutions Specialists. This position monitors key performance indicators (KPIs), turnaround time (TAT), quality, and backlog aging while partnering with cross-functional stakeholders to drive continuous improvement and operational excellence. 

Essential Functions Of The Job

Team Leadership & Operational Oversight

- Lead, mentor, and support Global Sample Solutions Specialists responsible for site outreach, discrepancy resolution, and study support activities. 
 - This role will provide direct supervisory oversight for assigned team members. 
 - Coordinate daily workload assignments and priorities to ensure timely follow-up and closure of open discrepancies. 
 - Monitor team productivity, quality, KPIs, service-level expectations, and backlog aging; communicate risks and recovery plans to leadership. 
 - Serve as the primary escalation point for complex discrepancy investigations, customer communication challenges, and cross-functional operational issues. 
 - Provide onboarding, role-specific training, coaching, and ongoing development for team members. 
 - Conduct routine workload and quality reviews and identify opportunities to improve consistency, efficiency, and compliance. 
 - Partner with leadership to support resource planning, workload forecasting, and operational readiness. 
 - Role requires flexibility to support global time zones, including overlap with U. S. business hours as business needs require. 

Customer/Site Outreach, Discrepancy Tracking & Resolution

- Maintain global oversight of unresolved discrepancies identified by internal sample management teams for incoming and outgoing shipments. 
 - Ensure adherence to project-specific communication plans, established outreach timelines, documentation standards, and escalation procedures. 
 - Liaise with sites, sponsors, CROs, clients, and internal teams to obtain missing information and facilitate timely discrepancy resolution. 
 - Review complex or high-impact discrepancies and guide the team on appropriate resolution actions. 
 - Ensure resolution actions are clearly documented and communicated to meet customer and business deliverables for TAT. 
 - Monitor first, second, and final outreach activities, including shipment tracking information and response status, to ensure appropriate follow-up. 
 - Monitor discrepancy aging and trends and implement recovery or corrective action plans when performance is at risk. 
 - Provide oversight for study close-out activities, including data review, outstanding query resolution, reconciliation support, and sample disposition follow-up. 
 - Independently prioritizes daily workload, resolves routine operational issues, and escalates high-impact risks to leadership. 

Database Troubleshooting & Data Resolution Support

- Provide oversight for unresolved sample data requests, reconciliation queries, and database-related discrepancies. 
 - Coordinate with internal stakeholders to investigate, document, and implement approved corrections for data modifications or errors. 
 - Support reconciliation between source documentation, sample inventory systems, clinical databases, EDC systems, and client-provided data, as applicable. 
 - Ensure sufficient documentation and audit trails are maintained for data corrections and resolution activities. 
 - Escalate system or process issues that may affect data integrity, operational timelines, or customer deliverables. 

Quality Control & Compliance

- Ensure team activities comply with company SOPs, study-specific requirements, documented procedures, and applicable quality standards. 
 - Oversee or perform quality control reviews of outreach documentation, discrepancy resolution records, and data updates. 
 - Review quality findings and coordinate corrective actions, retraining, or process updates as needed. 
 - Maintain audit-ready documentation and support internal audits, client audits, and regulatory inspections, as required. 
 - Demonstrate behavior consistent with company values and promote a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement. 

Qualifications

Education

- Bachelor's degree in life sciences, clinical research, healthcare administration, business, or a related field preferred. 
 - An equivalent combination of education and relevant experience may be considered. 

Experience

- Six or more years of relevant experience in sample management, clinical trial operations, laboratory operations, data management, project coordination, or a related environment preferred. 
 - Two or more years of experience leading people, projects, workflows, or operational initiatives preferred. 
 - Experience with customer- or site-facing communications, discrepancy management, issue resolution, and cross-functional coordination. 
 - Experience working with biospecimen inventory systems, clinical databases, reconciliation activities, or operational reporting tools preferred. 

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

- Strong leadership, coaching, workload management, and team development skills. 
 - Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to manage sensitive or escalated customer interactions professionally. 
 - Strong analytical, investigative, and problem-solving capabilities with consistent attention to detail. 
 - Ability to manage multiple priorities, changing deadlines, and global stakeholders in a fast-paced environment. 
 - Ability to interpret operational data, identify trends, and translate findings into clear actions. 
 - Proficiency with Microsoft Excel, Microsoft Office applications, reporting tools, and operational dashboards. 
 - Strong knowledge of data integrity, documentation, and quality principles. 
 - Ability to work effectively across global teams and time zones.

data.description:
Circle (NYSE: CRCL) is one of the world's leading internet financial platform companies, building the foundation of a more open, global economy through digital assets, payment applications, and programmable blockchain infrastructure. Circle's platform includes the world's largest regulated stablecoin network anchored by USDC, Circle Payments Network for global money movement, and Arc, an enterprise-grade blockchain designed to become the Economic OS for the internet. Enterprises, financial institutions, and developers use Circle to power trusted, internet-scale financial innovation. Learn more at circle. com. 

What You'll Be Part Of

Circle is committed to visibility and stability in everything we do. As we grow as an organization, we're expanding into some of the world's strongest jurisdictions. Circle's Payments engineering organization builds the infrastructure that moves value across the Circle Payments Network (CPN) and Managed Payments, connecting banks, payment service providers (PSPs), and fintechs to fast, low-cost, always-on cross-border settlement in USDC and EURC. As Engineering Manager, Payments, you'll lead a team responsible for backend systems that power financial institution onboarding, payment orchestration, and bulk payment processing. You'll be accountable for the delivery, reliability, security, and financial correctness of systems that move customer funds at scale, while developing a high-performing engineering team and partnering closely with stakeholders across Circle.

- Lead the day-to-day execution of an engineering team, including planning, prioritization, delivery, and continuous improvement of team processes.

 - Partner with Product, Compliance, Risk, and Solutions Engineering to define roadmaps and deliver cross-border payouts, managed stablecoin settlement, and bulk payment capabilities. 
 - Own engineering delivery for key Payments initiatives, including regulated and managed payments expansion, while coordinating effectively across India- and US-based teams. 
 - Ensure the reliability, security, operational readiness, and financial correctness of payment-critical systems, including incident response and on-call practices. 
 - Recruit, coach, and develop engineers while owning performance management, career development, feedback, and promotion processes for direct reports. 
 - Drive engineering goals aligned to Payments business outcomes, including geographic expansion, transaction growth, customer experience, and reliable market launches across APAC and Africa. 

What you'll bring to Circle

Core Requirements

- 7+ years of software engineering experience, including 2+ years of experience managing or formally leading software engineering teams. 
 - Experience designing, building, and operating distributed, highly available backend systems in production environments. 
 - Experience building or operating payments, banking, or financial transaction systems such as payment orchestration, ledgers, reconciliation, or settlement. 
 - Strong hands-on technical leadership skills, including architecture reviews, system design, technical trade-off discussions, and code-level guidance. 
 - Proficiency in one or more backend programming languages such as Java, Go, or Kotlin. 
 - Experience recruiting, coaching, developing, and performance-managing engineers, including senior-level individual contributors. 
 - Strong cross-functional collaboration skills and the ability to partner effectively with Product, Compliance, Risk, and external financial partners. 

Preferred Requirements

- Experience with cross-border payments, correspondent banking, stablecoins, blockchain-based settlement rails, or integrations with banks and payment service providers.

Our flexible platform and innovative approach allows our customers to utilise our payments account instead of a traditional bank account. Our accounts come with a sort code and account number, access to payment systems (eg Faster Payments and Visa) and everything our customers need from a payments account. They can instantly open as many accounts as they need, automate how they make and receive payments as well as the reconciliation processes these create. All in real time, 24/7 through their own systems utilising our API that integrates into any platform. 

Our founding team has a wealth of experience in the payments industry and growing successful businesses. Modulr is backed by payments giants PayPal Ventures and FIS Ventures, as well as startup and scale up specialists Blenheim Chalcot, General Atlantic, Frog and Highland Europe which enables us to leverage their resources and expertise to drive our growth initiatives. These partnerships provide us with the necessary provisions to propel our business to new heights. 

Modulr values

- Building the extraordinary; going that extra mile. 
 - Owning the opportunity; be passionate and proud of the time you invest. 
 - Move at pace; reach goals faster whilst supported on your career journey. 
 - Achieve it together, working collaboratively and being a Modulite. 

The Role

The Full Stack Lead Engineer is a vital role within Modulr, where you will be responsible for building an autonomous, high performing engineering squad to foster an environment where decisions are delegated, made and communicated effectively. You will drive technical strategy with a strong emphasis on Python and FastAPI backend development while remaining deeply hands-on with core development. The role is a blend of hands-on Python development, technical leadership, mentoring, and operational excellence. You will lead

the architecture and implementation of robust, scalable backend systems using FastAPI, cloud infrastructure on AWS, and coordinate full-stack solutions with frontend teams. 

Specific duties

- Lead a squad of software engineers, driving technical excellence through code reviews, architectural guidance, pair programming, and mentoring with strong emphasis on Python and FastAPI best practices. 
 - Technically efficient to write production-quality Python code, designing high-performance REST APIs, managing databases, async operations, and establishing coding standards. 
 - Own backend architecture decisions and lead the design of scalable, robust systems using Python, relational databases (PostgreSQL/MySQL), caching layers, and message queues. 
 - Lead technical strategy for AWS cloud deployments, ensuring security, reliability, scalability, and operational excellence. 
 - Mentor team members to develop deep full stack expertise for both backend & frontend through 1-2-1s, code reviews, and pair programming, fostering their technical growth and career progression. 
 - Plan squad deliverables and delegate responsibilities clearly, ensuring the team has well-defined goals, unblocked paths to success, and regular progress tracking. 
 - Collaborate with Frontend, DevOps, and Product teams to deliver integrated solutions, ensuring seamless API integration between backend and frontend. 
 - Drive agile practices and conduct productive ceremonies (stand-ups, sprint planning, reviews, retros), promoting continuous improvement and team autonomy. 
 - Drive hiring and recruitment, conducting technical interviews, assessments, and candidate evaluations while representing Modulr's engineering culture and values. 
 - Report on squad progress, outcomes, and technical achievements to leadership; share knowledge and best practices across the broader Engineering organisation. 

About You

Must Have: 

- Expert-level proficiency in Python (9+ years), with deep knowledge of Python frameworks, async programming, and backend development best practices. 
 - Strong, hands-on experience with FastAPI, including building high-performance REST APIs, dependency injection, validation, and async operations. 
 - Solid experience with React and modern JavaScript/TypeScript, with understanding of full-stack integration and frontend-backend communication patterns. 
 - Hands-on experience designing, building and deploying systems on AWS (EC2, S3, Lambda, RDS, API Gateway, etc). 
 - Proven software development and technical team leadership experience, with a strong understanding of backend engineering practices and processes. 
 - Strong understanding of system design, microservices architecture, database design, and cloud-native application patterns. 
 - Experience with relational databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL) and understanding of data modeling, optimization, and migrations. 
 - Strong testing discipline (unit, integration, and end-to-end testing) with TDD mindset for backend systems. 
 - Demonstrated ability to mentor engineers and lead technical decision-making in a collaborative environment. 
 - Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, and container orchestration. 
 - Knowledge of DevOps practices, CI/CD pipelines, and Infrastructure as Code. 

Good to have: 

- Experience with caching solutions (Redis), message queues (RabbitMQ, Kafka), and async task processing. 
 - Experience in the fintech or payments domain. 

Key Attributes: 

- Strong problem-solver with deep analytical and critical thinking skills; ability to balance pragmatism with technical excellence. 
 - Excellent communication skills; ability to articulate complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. 
 - Self-directed and proactive, with a drive to continuously learn and innovate in Python and backend technologies. 
 - Passionate about code quality, performance optimization, and building scalable, maintainable systems. 
 - Team player with strong collaborative and leadership presence, comfortable guiding the team through technical decisions. 

ModInclusion

At Modulr, we are working hard to build a more positive diverse and inclusive culture that helps everyone to feel they belong and can truly bring their whole self to work. Not only is it the right thing to do for everyone in the Modulr team, it's also the right thing to do for our business, the community we operate in and attracting future talent. As part of our approach, we actively welcome applications from candidates with diverse backgrounds.

"

Job Description

Job summary

We are seeking a dedicated professional to lead team activities, supervise lab maintenance, and manage people within the upstream process development function of Biologics. This role involves ensuring on-time delivery of experiments for one/two biosimilar molecules, with a focus on drafting and timely closure of technical reports to meet team deliverables. 

Roles & Responsibilities

• You will be responsible for leading and managing the overall scientific, technical, and operational efforts of team members, including guiding teams for the successful execution of experiments, and ensuring the quality of data meets global expectations. 

• You will oversee lab operations and equipment maintenance, actively participate in lab meetings, contribute to troubleshooting potential causes for experimental failures, and coordinate upstream process development for one/two Biosimilar projects within the function. 

• You will be responsible for planning resource requirements to meet project deliverables providing guidance and direction to team members to ensure project schedules are met with quality technical success. You will be responsible for collaboration with various stakeholders within and across teams is crucial for meeting project timelines. 

• You will contribute to performance reviews of team members, identify their developmental needs, communicate them to the responsible authority, and maintain discipline within the team. 

• You will be responsible for data collation, analysis, and interpretation, drawing logical scientific conclusions, and generating technical presentations to communicate technical information within the function. 

• Your role includes drafting scientific reports for team deliverables, such as process development summaries, technical memos, and process description summaries, maintaining global quality and adhering to regulatory standards with support from team members and group leaders to fulfill functional requirements and support regulatory filings. 

• You will be responsible for assuming ownership of specialized process equipment, escalating lab issues for technical support, ensuring compliance with safety standards, supervising safety and lab systems, and verifying the appropriate following of protocols. 

• Additionally, you'll oversee inventory updating, troubleshoot problems related to equipment, and ensure smooth development work in the lab. 

Qualifications

Educational qualification: A Ph. D. or Master's degree (M. Sc. or M. Tech. or M. E. or M. Pharm. ) or Bachelor's degree (B. Tech. or B. E. or B. Pharm. ) in Biology, Chemical Engineering, Microbiology, Biotechnology, Biochemistry, Biochemical Engineering or other related disciplines of engineering or life sciences. 

Minimum work experience: 2 years of industrial experience with a Ph. D. , 6 years with a Master's, or 9 years with a Bachelor's

Skills & attributes: 

Technical Skills

• In-depth understanding of cell culture process development for Biotherapeutics/Biosimilars, stays informed about current trends in the Biopharma industry, and exhibits a basic understanding of the regulatory framework and IP (Intellectual Property) landscape. 

• Can perform comprehensive data analysis of processes and provide logical conclusions and recommendations. 

• Knowledge of bioreactor operation in batch/fed-batch/perfusion modes. 

• Understanding of chemical engineering principles applicable to biotechnology. 

• In-depth understanding of mammalian cell culture physiology and metabolism for Biosimilar product development. 

• Demonstrates Design of Experiments (DOE) and statistical analysis skills using various tools. 

• Understanding of FDA (Food and Drug Administration), EMA (European Medicines Agency), ICH (International Council for Harmonisation), and other regulatory bodies' guidelines for Biosimilar development. 

Behavioural skills

• Strong supervisory, team management, and motivational skills, effectively leading and guiding teams. 

• Strong learning orientation, staying updated with current practices in the subject area. 

• Good interpersonal skills, fostering positive relationships and effective communication. 

• Adaptability to a dynamic environment, showcasing flexibility and resilience in response to changes. 

Additional Information

About the Department

Biologics

Currently operates in the Global Biosimilars business - a segment that is poised for attractive and sustained growth over the next 10-15-year time horizon. 

With a robust portfolio of biosimilar products across key therapeutic areas, covering ~US$80+ Bn in innovator sales - future business pipeline covers a variety of product classes and therapy areas, and new modalities. Fully integrated organization with over two decades of experience in developing, manufacturing and commercializing multiple biosimilar products. 

With a Product Development engine that has end-to-end capabilities - in-house clone development, upstream and downstream process development, bioanalytical development and proprietary formulation. 

Supported by a Clinical and Regulatory team with experience in executing complex biosimilar programs with innovative global trial designs. 

We have a proven experience in commercial-scale manufacturing across a variety of technology platforms with global quality standards and a highly competitive cost structure

Rich experience of commercializing high-quality biosimilars in multiple markets with over 900, 000 patients having benefited from our products till date. 

Benefits Offered

At Dr. Reddy's we actively help to catalyse your career growth and professional development through personalised learning programs. 

The benefits you will enjoy at Dr. Reddy's are on par with the best industry standards. They include, among other things and other essential equipment, joining & relocation support, family support (Maternity & Paternity benefits), learning and development opportunities, medical coverage for yourself and your family, life coverage for yourself. 

Our Work Culture

Ask any employee at Dr. Reddy's why they come to work every day and they'll say, because Good Health Can't Wait. This is our credo as well as the guiding principle behind all our actions. We see healthcare solutions not only as scientific formulations, but as a means to help patients lead healthier lives, and we're always attuned to the new and the next to empower people to stay fit. And to do this, we foster a culture of empathy and dynamism. People are at the core of our journey over the last few decades. They have been supported by an enabling environment that buoys individual ability while fostering teamwork and shared success. We believe that when people with diverse skills are bound together by a common purpose and value system, they can make magic. 

For more details, please visit our career website at https: //careers. drreddys. com/#!/

data.description:
Our Mission

At Palo Alto Networks®, we're united by a shared mission-to protect our digital way of life. We thrive at the intersection of innovation and impact, solving real-world problems with cutting-edge technology and bold thinking. Here, everyone has a voice, and every idea counts. If you're ready to do the most meaningful work of your career alongside people who are just as passionate as you are, you're in the right place. 

Who We Are

In order to be the cybersecurity partner of choice, we must trailblaze the path and shape the future of our industry. This is something our employees work at each day and is defined by our values: Disruption, Collaboration, Execution, Integrity, and Inclusion. We weave AI into the fabric of everything we do and use it to augment the impact every individual can have. If you are passionate about solving real-world problems and ideating beside the best and the brightest, we invite you to join us!

We believe collaboration thrives in person. That's why most of our teams work from the office full time, with flexibility when it's needed. This model supports real-time problem-solving, stronger relationships, and the kind of precision that drives great outcomes. 

Job Summary

Job Summary

We are seeking a hands-on Senior Android Software Engineer who possesses in-depth knowledge of the Android ecosystem, a passion for security-first development, and a strong product commitment. In this role, you will be a key player in designing, developing, and securing new features for our primary Android mobile products. 

Key Responsibilities

- Technical Leadership: Drive the architecture, implementation, and maintenance of our core Android solutions, ensuring high performance, quality, and responsiveness. 
 - End-to-End Ownership: Oversee the development lifecycle from prototyping and implementation to testing, delivery, and ongoing maintenance. 
 - Security & Best Practices: Define and evangelize development best practices with a strict focus on code robustness, mobile security, scalability, and performance. 
 - Collaboration & Alignment: Work closely with Product Management, Sales, UX designers, and backend engineering teams to align on product roadmaps and backend API design. 
 - Customer & Field Support: Interface with Support and field teams to diagnose, troubleshoot, and resolve complex customer escalations in large-scale enterprise deployments. 
 - Mentorship: Lead brainstorming and design sessions, providing ongoing technical direction and code reviews for teammates across multiple global sites. 
 - Innovation: Stay ahead of the curve regarding evolving mobile technologies, Android OS updates, and relevant open-source libraries. 

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent practical experience. 
 - 5+ years of professional software development experience, with 3+ years dedicated to the Android platform and at least 2 years in a technical leadership or lead role. 
 - Strong proficiency in Kotlin and Java, alongside a deep understanding of core Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) concepts. 
 - Deep understanding of modern Android architecture patterns (MVVM, MVI, MVP) and UI patterns (including Material Design). 
 - Strong understanding of multithreading, concurrency, and asynchronous programming concepts. 
 - Experience with Android testing frameworks (Espresso, JUnit) and a solid understanding of Git workflows and CI/CD pipelines. 
 - Proven knowledge of code signing and distributing applications through the Google Play Store, as well as managing dependencies via Maven/Gradle. 
 - Solid understanding of Identity and Access Management (IAM) concepts, including OAuth 2. 0, OpenID Connect (OIDC), SCIM, and token-based authentication. 
 - Familiarity with user directory concepts like Active Directory, user groups, authentication/authorization mechanisms, and security policies. 
 - Understanding of Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA), PKI, certificate security, encryption, and secure data storage on mobile devices. 
 - Basic understanding or experience with cloud platforms, preferably Amazon Web Services (AWS) or Microsoft Azure (IaaS/PaaS). 
 - Understanding of no-schema (NoSQL) databases and local mobile data persistence. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Basic understanding of iOS development (Swift, Objective-C, XCTest) is a strong plus to help collaborate on cross-platform mobile initiatives. 
 - Working experience with Mobile Device Management (MDM) or Mobile Application Management (MAM) policies. 
 - Experience or interest in full-stack web development, Windows programming, or kernel-mode development. 
 - Exposure to global security compliance and privacy frameworks (e. g. , GDPR, SOX, PII, and PHI data handling). 
 - Experience working in a fast-paced Agile/Scrum environment across geographically distributed teams. 

Our Commitment

We're trailblazers that dream big, take risks, and challenge cybersecurity's status quo. It's simple: we can't accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together. 

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for all qualified individuals with a disability. If you require assistance or accommodation due to a disability or special need, please contact us at accommodations@paloaltonetworks. com. 

Palo Alto Networks is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity in our workplace, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or other legally protected characteristics. 

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

About Us

At Netwrix, our mission is to revolutionize data security by placing identity at the core - providing unparalleled visibility and control. Engineered and supported by over 900 highly talented, motivated employees and hundreds of trusted partners in nearly every geography, Netwrix solutions are relied upon daily by security professionals across more than 13, 500 organizations in over 100 countries around the world. 

Over the past two decades, Netwrix has expanded its market presence through innovation, organic growth, and strategic acquisitions, and are proud to be backed by renowned private equity firms, TA Associates and Centerbridge Partners. Netwrix maintains a global presence, fostering a remote-first work environment while encouraging and facilitating frequent face-to-face interaction with colleagues, customers, and partners. 

Position Overview

Netwrix is on a mission to help customers protect and secure their identity and data landscape through market-leading on-prem and SaaS products and integrated solutions. Netwrix Identity products provide leading identity security solutions to thousands of enterprise customers worldwide. 

We are seeking a highly skilled (Senior) Staff Software Engineer who will develop new features and capabilities for Netwrix Identity Recovery, our enterprise solution for backup and recovery of Active Directory, Microsoft Entra ID, and Okta environments. The person in this role will ensure scalable, secure, high-quality experiences for enterprise customers in both on-prem and SaaS environments. 

This is an exciting opportunity for an experienced technical leader to help shape the future of identity recovery. You will contribute to the advancement of Netwrix Identity Recovery and key technologies across the platform, with opportunities to integrate AI capabilities into our products and development process. Working closely with engineers and product leaders, you'll influence architectural direction, mentor engineers, and help deliver solutions that protect organizations worldwide against identity-based threats. 

Your home base is the Netwrix Identity Recovery team. You will work within a shared engineering platform and technology stack, with opportunities to contribute to other products across the Netwrix ITDR portfolio - such as PingCastle, Threat Prevention, and Threat Manager. 

This role requires proximity to Pune, India and availability in CET timezone. 

Key Responsibilities

- Write high-quality code and design scalable backend services for on-prem and SaaS environments, setting examples of technical excellence for the team and supporting key decisions on architecture, scalability, and integration
 - Develop and maintain recovery capabilities for Active Directory, Microsoft Entra ID, and Okta environments, ensuring broad identity coverage for enterprise customers
 - Integrate data and capabilities with Netwrix's cybersecurity product platform and other ITDR products
 - Contribute to the product's evolution toward SaaS and cloud deployment, including containerization and cloud-native service design
 - Promote and optimize the use of AI tools and capabilities to accelerate Netwrix product development
 - Utilize AI within Netwrix products to enable smarter recovery automation, anomaly identification, and predictive operations while ensuring accuracy
 - Partner with customers and customer-facing teams to triage and address issues, understand customer needs, and gather feedback on product features
 - Collaborate across functions with product management, platform and product teams, and engineering leadership to align technical direction with business needs
 - Mentor and support the growth of engineers while fostering a culture of innovation, security-first thinking, and technical excellence

Qualifications

Required Experience

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent experience
 - 10+ years of software development experience with a focus on enterprise software
 - Experience designing and delivering on-prem at scale is a must. SaaS software at scale is a strong plus
 - Familiarity with Windows systems programming and enterprise deployment patterns
 - Understanding of DevOps practices, CI/CD pipelines, and monitoring/observability

Technical Skills

- Solid understanding of Active Directory, Entra ID, Okta, or similar identity and directory systems
 - Strong proficiency in C# and the . NET ecosystem (. NET Core/. NET) - the primary managed language in this stack
 - Ability to understand and port existing C++ code modules providing core Windows services to the C#/. NET ecosystem
 - Experience with Windows systems programming: services, IPC, and Windows security APIs
 - Strong knowledge of distributed systems, modular architectures, and service-oriented design
 - Experience with SQL Server or comparable relational databases
 - Proficiency in designing RESTful APIs and asynchronous communication patterns
 - Familiarity with cloud platforms (Azure preferred), containerization, and infrastructure as code

Leadership & Soft Skills

- Excellent communication skills with the ability to collaborate effectively across teams
 - Proven ability to balance technical quality with business priorities and timelines
 - Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to tackle complex, ambiguous challenges
 - Experience mentoring or guiding engineers in technical growth

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with C++ on Windows, including COM, RPC, and Windows service development
 - Familiarity with Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD) and the Microsoft Graph API, or Okta APIs
 - Experience with Azure services: Azure Identity, Azure Key Vault, Azure Blob Storage, Azure Container Instances
 - Experience with containerization (Docker, Kubernetes) for cloud and SaaS deployment
 - Familiarity with modern high-performance languages such as Go for cloud-native service development
 - Understanding of disaster recovery, BCDR product categories, or identity security (ITDR)
 - Familiarity with threat detection methodologies, SIEM concepts, and security frameworks
 - Contributions to open-source projects or involvement in technical communities

Our Values

At Netwrix, Our Values Guide Every Action

- Next-Level Customer Focus -Customers first, always. We listen, protect, and go the extra mile- because their success is our mission. 
 - Excellence - We set high standards and take pride in delivering exceptional results. We celebrate wins, seek constant improvement, and address shortcomings professionally. 
 - Transparent Ownership - We celebrate our successes, own up to our mistakes, communicate openly, and face challenges head-on with a genuine commitment to doing the right thing. 
 - Winning with Clear Thinking - We value clarity, find straightforward solutions to complex problems, and make swift, effective decisions. 
 - Relentless Innovation - We continually seek better ways to serve our customers and stay ahead. We foster creative thinking, and we embrace new approaches. 
 - Industry-Leading Expertise - We take pride in our expertise and continuously seek to learn and share knowledge, striving to be the trusted experts our customers rely on. 
 - eXceptional Together - We believe in the power of collaboration and diverse perspectives. By valuing each other's strengths, we achieve outcomes that surpass individual contributions. 

Join us in a culture where integrity, respect, and hard work are foundational. Be part of a team dedicated to making a lasting impact. 

Why You'll Love Working at Netwrix

- Competitive Health Benefits
 - Continuous Learning and Development Opportunities
 - Team-Oriented, Collaborative, and Innovative Work Environment
 - Regular Company Town Halls to Keep You Informed
 - Opportunities for Career Growth and Advancement

We pride ourselves on a culture that truly values employee input across various backgrounds and experiences. We look forward to welcoming new talent who can help us further our mission. 

Netwrix Corporation and its wholly owned subsidiaries are Equal Opportunity Employers (EEO) and welcome all applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic under applicable law. 

Please let us know if you require any accommodation.

With 3, 000+ billing organizations, 240M+ invoices, and $38B+ in annual payment volume, we're investing heavily in AI to transform from a best-in-class payments processor into a Billing Intelligence Platform.
