data.title: Sales Team Lead
data.description:
Company Description

BrightCHAMPS is a global edtech platform dedicated to bridging the gap between traditional education and essential real-world skills. Through expert-designed courses in Coding, Financial Literacy, Math, Robotics, AI, and Communication, we empower the next generation of leaders. Operating in over 30 countries, BrightCHAMPS delivers more than 200, 000 live classes monthly and has secured $63M in funding with a valuation of $650M. Recognized with multiple awards including 'Startup of the Year, ' we are committed to making quality education accessible to every child, fostering a collaborative and high-impact work culture to inspire young minds globally. 

Role Description

This is a full-time on-site role for a Business Development Executive, based in Bengaluru. You will be responsible for identifying and developing new business opportunities, building relationships with clients, managing accounts, and driving revenue growth for BrightCHAMPS. Day-to-day responsibilities include lead generation, conducting research to identify potential clients, initiating connections, negotiating deals, and maintaining long-lasting partnerships while achieving business targets. 

Role Overview

We are looking for a high-energy, target-driven Sales Team Lead to lead and manage our India Sales team. The role will be responsible for driving revenue through effective lead management, parent counselling, team performance, and strong sales execution. 

The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience in K12 EdTech sales, strong team-handling skills, and a proven ability to coach sales executives to consistently achieve and exceed targets. 

Key Responsibilities

-Lead, manage, and motivate a team of Academic Counsellors / Sales Executives to achieve daily, weekly, and monthly revenue targets. 

-Own the team's sales funnel from lead allocation and follow-ups to counselling, conversion, and enrollment closure. 

-Conduct regular 1: 1s, performance reviews, call audits, and coaching sessions to improve individual and team productivity. 

-Monitor key sales metrics including connect rate, counselling-to-sale conversion, revenue per counsellor, follow-up efficiency, and overall team achievement. 

-Support team members in handling parent objections, improving pitches, and closing high-value enrollments. 

-Conduct or support parent counselling and product demos when required, ensuring a consultative and needs-based sales approach. 

-Track daily team performance through CRM and sales dashboards and take immediate corrective actions wherever required. 

-Ensure strong pipeline hygiene, timely follow-ups, and accurate CRM updates across the team. 

-Identify performance gaps and create actionable improvement plans for underperforming team members. 

-Work closely with the Talent Acquisition team for hiring, onboarding, and ramp-up of new sales team members. 

-Collaborate with Marketing to share insights on lead quality, campaign performance, and conversion trends. 

-Work with Academic/Curriculum teams to stay updated on BrightCHAMPS' programs and effectively communicate their value to parents. 

-Drive a high-performance, accountable, and target-oriented team culture. 

-Support leadership in implementing sales strategies, process improvements, and initiatives to improve revenue and conversion. 

-Track team-level costs and incentive metrics and ensure efficient utilization of sales resources. 

What We're Looking For

3-5 years of experience in Sales / Inside Sales / Business Development, preferably in K12 EdTech. 

Prior experience managing or leading a sales team is mandatory. 

Experience in parent counselling, B2C sales, inside sales, or consultative selling is highly preferred. 

Strong understanding of sales funnels and metrics such as conversion rate, connect rate, revenue achievement, average deal size, and productivity. 

Proven ability to coach, motivate, and drive a team toward aggressive sales targets. 

Strong communication, persuasion, negotiation, and objection-handling skills. 

Comfortable working with CRM and sales tools such as LeadSquared, Salesforce, Zoho, or similar platforms. 

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to make data-driven decisions. 

Ability to thrive in a high-intensity, target-driven startup environment. 

Bachelor's degree required; MBA is a plus. 

Willingness to work in a 6-day work environment with rotational week-offs, including weekends, as required by the business. 

If you have any questions or need further clarification, please feel free to contact me at 9059917512 (Sai). I'll be happy to assist you.

data.title: Technical Delivery Manager - Applied AI and Engineering Management
data.description:
Join Us!

At Google Operations Center we help Google users and customers solve problems and achieve their goals-all while enjoying a culture focused on improving continuously and being better together. We work hard, we play hard, and we want you to join us!

About The Team

We have outgrown traditional "Tools and Automation". Our new identity as the Applied AI and Engineering team reflects our bold vision: engineering a self-correcting, multi-agent ecosystem that pioneers the blueprint for the autonomous Google enterprise. 

The Applied AI and Engineering team is responsible for architecting, deploying, and scaling agentic workflows, production-grade intelligence systems, and self-healing systems across Google Operations using modern internal and external technologies (including Gemini, Vertex AI, and advanced foundational models). This team goes beyond isolated automations to design coordinated, self-correcting multi-agent architectures that fundamentally transform how Google runs its global operations. 

Role Overview

As a Technical Delivery Manager in the Google Operations Center, you'll play a critical role in overseeing the development and delivery of our essential internal tools and applications. You'll collaborate closely with engineering leads, product managers, and stakeholders across Google to define project scope, manage timelines, mitigate risks, and ensure successful execution. If you have a proven track record of delivering impactful solutions, a deep understanding of software development lifecycles, and exceptional communication and leadership skills, we encourage you to apply!

Position Responsibilities

- Organizational Leadership: Manage and develop a team of Developer Leads. Provide regular coaching, mentoring, and performance management to elevate their leadership capabilities and support their career growth. 
 - Workflow Oversight: Serve as the focal point of contact for internal and external project queries, ensuring that the team's actions remain in synergy with broader business goals. 
 - Strategic Alignment: Ensure the development teams' work aligns with the overall strategic goals and roadmap of the Google Operations Center. This includes understanding the big picture and translating it into actionable plans for the teams. 
 - Cross-Team Coordination: Work with domain experts, Full stack, UX, and PM to translate project requirements into technical tasks. 
 - Risk Management and Mitigation: Proactively identify and assess potential risks that could impact project delivery, develop mitigation strategies, and escalate issues as needed to ensure timely resolution. 
 - Dependency Management: Identify and manage dependencies between different projects and teams, ensuring that roadblocks are removed and projects are delivered efficiently. 
 - Process Optimization: Continuously analyze and improve development processes, workflows, and tools to enhance efficiency, productivity, and overall team performance. This could involve implementing Agile best practices, refining communication channels, or introducing new technologies. 
 - Project and Process Governance: Establish and enforce delivery frameworks across traditional and AI initiatives. For standard projects, drive SDLC compliance, quality gates, and SLA adherence; for AI projects, oversee model lifecycle governance, including validation, responsible AI standards, and drift monitoring. 
 - Stakeholder Management: Act as the primary liaison between engineering, product, operations, and executive leadership. Translate technical and AI constraints into business trade-offs, manage expectations via structured reporting, and align priorities across distributed teams. 

Minimum Requirements

- Experience: 12y+ in technical project management, with a focus on maintenance & core development with multiple dev models like agile / scrum / waterfall. 
 - People Management: 7y+ people management experience involving performance management . 
 - Strong Experience in Project Planning and Scheduling, Team Coordination, Stakeholder Management, Risk Management, Resource Management, and Quality Assurance
 - Excellent organizational skills to track project / scrum timelines, roadmaps, and deliverables. 
 - Strong Experience in end to end Software Development Life Cycle
 - Experience with multiple full lifecycles from Design & Architecture through Development, Testing, Deployment and Debugging production issues. 

Preferred Qualifications

Having as many of these specific qualifications is a plus, but transferable skills/experiences may be equally valuable: 

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience. 
 - Strong experience in SQL, Python, database concepts. 
 - 5y+ experience using GIT based continuous integration & delivery
 - Experience with Cloud Computing platforms such as GCP, Azure, AWS
 - Experience in Middleware development/design (remote procedure call based, publish subscribe based, etc. . . )

Benefits

- We support you with competitive wages and with comprehensive health care including medical, dental and vision coverage
 - We support your family with gender-neutral baby bonding leave, 26 week birth-parent maternity leave, and generous life, accident and disability insurance minimums
 - Employees who work onsite can enjoy free meals and snacks, and fun onsite experiences

Google Operations Center (GOC) is committed to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, creed, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or veteran status or any other basis protected by law. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. 

To ensure a barrier-free interview, please mention any required assistance or specific arrangements in your application and confirm them with your recruiter.

data.title: AEM Technical Architect
data.description:
About The Role

Adobe Consulting is seeking an experienced Technical Architect to join our team and lead the delivery of next-generation digital experience solutions for enterprise customers. 

As the Adobe Experience Cloud ecosystem evolves towards AI-powered and agentic experiences, we are looking for an AEM Architect who combines strong expertise in Adobe Experience Manager with an understanding of emerging AI capabilities and their application to digital experiences. 

The role goes beyond traditional AEM architecture. You will work closely with enterprise customers to define technology strategies, modernize digital experience platforms, and adopt emerging solutions such as Adobe Brand Concierge, AEM Co-worker and AI-powered content experiences. 

You will act as a trusted technology advisor to customers, lead complex solution architecture and guide multidisciplinary teams to deliver successful outcomes. 

What You'll Do

AEM and Digital Experience Architecture

- Be a recognized technical expert in Adobe Experience Manager, including AEM as a Cloud Service, Edge Delivery Services (EDS), Universal Editor and Document-based Authoring. 
 - Architect scalable, secure and high-performance digital experience solutions across CMS, DAM, personalization and composable architectures. 
 - Guide customers through modernization journeys, including migration from AEM 6. x, on-premise and other CMS platforms to AEM Cloud Service and EDS. 
 - Define architecture and engineering practices that improve performance, Core Web Vitals, scalability and content authoring productivity. 
 - Provide technical leadership across complex enterprise implementations and integrations. 

AI And Agentic Experience Adoption

- Understand and drive the adoption of emerging Adobe AI and agentic capabilities, including Adobe Brand Concierge, AEM Co-worker and other AI-powered Experience Cloud solutions. 
 - Identify opportunities to leverage Generative AI and Agentic AI to transform digital experiences and content operations. 
 - Architect solutions that integrate AI capabilities with existing AEM platforms, enterprise content, customer data and business systems. 
 - Guide customers on AI-powered content creation, personalization, asset management, content supply chain and workflow automation. 
 - Understand key AI architecture concepts such as LLMs, RAG, agent orchestration, APIs and MCP integrations, and their application in enterprise solutions. 
 - Advise customers on responsible AI adoption, including security, data privacy, governance and brand safety. 

Customer and Consulting Leadership

- Act as a trusted technology advisor to senior customer stakeholders, including CIOs, CTOs and digital business leaders. 
 - Lead customer workshops, architecture discussions, solution presentations and technology strategy conversations. 
 - Understand customer business challenges and translate them into effective technology solutions and transformation roadmaps. 
 - Shape consulting opportunities by defining solution approaches, contributing to proposals and articulating business value. 
 - Clearly communicate complex technology concepts and the business value of emerging AI capabilities to technical and non-technical audiences. 
 - Build strong relationships with customers, Adobe account teams, partners and product engineering teams. 

Technical and Delivery Leadership

- Provide end-to-end architectural leadership across large and complex customer engagements. 
 - Lead solution discovery, architecture definition, technical design and implementation oversight. 
 - Work closely with Delivery Managers and Project Managers to ensure successful project execution and customer outcomes. 
 - Lead and mentor architects, developers and multidisciplinary technical teams. 
 - Identify and resolve complex technical challenges and take ownership of architecture decisions. 
 - Develop reusable architecture patterns, accelerators and best practices, particularly around AEM, EDS and AI-enabled solutions. 
 - Stay current with Adobe Experience Cloud innovations and emerging AI technologies and share knowledge across the consulting community. 
 - Manage multiple customer engagements and provide technical leadership with minimal supervision. 

What You Need To Succeed

AEM and Digital Experience Expertise

- 12+ years of experience in enterprise technology consulting, architecture and software delivery, with strong hands-on experience in Adobe Experience Manager. 
 - Deep understanding of AEM architecture, including AEM as a Cloud Service, implementation, integrations, deployment and performance optimization. 
 - Practical experience or working knowledge of Edge Delivery Services, including block development, Document-based Authoring, Universal Editor and modern front-end practices. 
 - Experience with enterprise CMS, headless/hybrid CMS, DAM, composable architectures and digital experience platforms. 
 - Strong understanding of AEM Assets, content management, workflows, metadata and enterprise integrations. 
 - Familiarity with AEM Cloud Service tooling, Cloud Manager, CI/CD pipelines, Git workflows and Adobe App Builder. 

AI And Agentic Capabilities

- Good understanding of Generative AI and Agentic AI and their applications in digital experience platforms. 
 - Awareness of Adobe's emerging AI capabilities, including Brand Concierge, AEM Co-worker, Firefly, GenStudio and LLM Optimizer. 
 - Understanding of how AI agents can integrate with enterprise content, applications and business workflows. 
 - Working knowledge of LLMs, RAG, agent orchestration, APIs, MCP and prompt engineering. 
 - Ability to identify relevant customer use cases and architect solutions leveraging AI capabilities. 
 - Understanding of responsible AI principles, including security, privacy, governance, IP and brand safety. 

Technical And Architecture Skills

- Strong knowledge of Java, JavaScript/TypeScript, HTML, CSS and modern web technologies. 
 - Working knowledge of Python and APIs, microservices and enterprise integrations. 
 - Understanding of cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure or GCP. 
 - Knowledge of cloud-native architecture, Docker, Kubernetes, CDN and edge delivery. 
 - Strong understanding of enterprise architecture principles, including scalability, security, performance, capacity planning and infrastructure. 
 - Experience with Agile methodologies, DevOps and the complete enterprise software development lifecycle. 

Customer And Leadership Skills

- Proven experience leading enterprise consulting engagements and interacting with senior customer stakeholders. 
 - Excellent communication, presentation and stakeholder management skills. 
 - Ability to independently lead customer workshops, architecture reviews and executive presentations. 
 - Strong consulting mindset with the ability to understand business challenges and recommend appropriate technology solutions. 
 - Ability to articulate technology solutions and their business value to both technical and non-technical audiences. 
 - Experience leading and mentoring large, distributed and cross-functional teams. 
 - Ability to work independently, manage multiple engagements and take ownership of customer outcomes. 
 - Willingness to work onsite with customers when required and travel up to 50% on average. 

About Adobe

Adobe empowers everyone to create through innovative platforms and tools that unleash creativity, productivity and personalized customer experiences. Adobe's industry-leading offerings including Adobe Acrobat Studio, Adobe Express, Adobe Firefly, Creative Cloud, Adobe Experience Platform, Adobe Experience Manager, and GenStudio enable people and businesses to turn ideas into impact, powered by AI and driven by human ingenuity. 

Our 30, 000+ employees worldwide are creating the future and raising the bar as we drive the next decade of growth. We're on a mission to hire the very best and believe in creating a company culture where all employees are empowered to make an impact. At Adobe, we believe that great ideas can come from anywhere in the organization. The next big idea could be yours. 

Let's Adobe together

At Adobe, we believe in creating a company culture where all employees are empowered to make an impact. Learn more about Adobe life, including our values and culture, focus on people, purpose and community, Adobe for All, comprehensive benefits programs, the stories we tell, the customers we serve, and how you can help us advance our mission of empowering everyone to create. 

Adobe is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based on gender, race or color, ethnicity or national origin, age, disability, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic. Learn more. 

Adobe aims to make our Careers website and recruiting process accessible to any and all users. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation to navigate our website or complete the application process, email accommodations@adobe. com. 

AI Use Guidelines for Interviews: 

Our interviews are designed to reflect your own skills and thinking. The use of AI or recording tools during live interviews is not permitted unless explicitly invited by the interviewer or approved in advance as part of a reasonable accommodation. If these tools are used inappropriately or in a way that misrepresents your work, your application may not move forward in the process. 

At Adobe, we empower employees to innovate with AI - and we look for candidates eager to do the same. As part of the hiring experience, we provide clear guidance on where AI is encouraged during the process and where it's restricted during live interviews. See how we think about AI in the hiring experience.

Job Description

Exceptional Hospitality Starts with You

Picture yourself brightening someone's day. When you join our Hotels team, that's exactly what you'll do every time you come to work! As an Engineering Supervisor / Team Leader, you're not just overseeing the daily operations of physical building and systems maintenance and repairs - you're spreading the light and warmth of hospitality by delivering memorable experiences that make the stay for every guest. 

Responsibilities

Here's what you'll do during a typical day: 

- Ensure facility safety and compliance: Support the maintenance of the hotel's buildings, mechanical systems, electrical systems, HVAC, and life safety systems, ensuring compliance with local, state, and federal regulations
 - Supervise maintenance operations: Assign and oversee daily maintenance tasks, ensuring thorough documentation of completed work in the property management system. 
 - Supervise and develop the team: Train, schedule, and supervise maintenance team members, providing guidance and support to ensure high-quality work and performance
 - Oversee contractor work: Supervise external contractors and inspect completed work for quality and compliance
 - Respond to service requests: Ensure maintenance requests, guest concerns, and emergency situations are addressed promptly and efficiently
 - Supervise and develop the team: Train, schedule, and supervise maintenance team members, providing guidance and support to ensure high-quality work and performance
 - Equipment Maintenance & Efficiency: Repair and maintain all hotel systems and equipment, ensuring efficiency and informing management about deficiencies and stock control needs. 
 - Cost Management: Adhere to departmental operating expenses, evaluate products for reuse, monitor stock levels, and ensure the operation runs according to budgets and profit margins. 

Qualifications

At Hilton, our core values define what it takes to succeed here and guide the qualities we look for in every team member: 

A passion for spreading the light and warmth of Hospitality. Acting with Integrity and always doing the right thing. Inspiring others through Leadership. A belief that Teamwork drives the best outcomes. A sense of Ownership and accountability. And a focus on the Now, bringing urgency and discipline to every moment, knowing it can make a lasting impact. 

In Addition, This Role Requires The Following Minimum Qualifications

- HVAC, Electrical, or Plumbing/Gas Fitter trade-qualified advantageous
 - Must have sound general Engineering knowledge and trade background
 - At least 5 years in a Service Technician position or similar position with working experience in a 5-star hotel. 

About Us

Join an Award-Winning Workplace Culture

At Hilton, we don't just deliver exceptional experiences for our guests-we build an exceptional workplace for the Team Members who make it all possible. As a global leader in hospitality, we've welcomed more than 3 billion guests worldwide, all while staying true to our founding vision: to fill the earth with the light and warmth of hospitality. 

Our award-winning culture has earned us repeated recognition on the World's Best Workplaces list by Great Place to Work and Fortune. data.title: MANAGER, ENGINEERING
data.description:
About Armor Defense Inc

At Armor, we are committed to making a meaningful difference in securing cyberspace. Our vision is to be the trusted protector and de facto standard that cloud-centric customers entrust with their risk. We strive to continuously evolve to be the best partner of choice, breaking norms and tirelessly innovating to stay ahead of evolving cyber threats and reshaping how we deliver customer outcomes. We are passionate about making a positive impact in the world, and we're looking for a highly skilled and experienced talent to join our dynamic team. 

Armor has unique offerings to the market so customers can a) understand their risk b) leverage Armor to co-manage their risk or c) completely outsource their risk to Armor. 

Learn more at: https: //www. armor. com

Summary

The Manager, Engineering reports to the Director, Engineering and leads a team of software engineers who build and sustain the products Armor's customers depend on. This role combines engineering leadership, technical oversight, and delivery ownership, with responsibility for ensuring the team builds secure, scalable, reliable, and high-quality software. 

The Manager is expected to have a strong software engineering background and enough technical depth to effectively guide engineering decisions, challenge solutions, participate in architecture and design discussions, and ensure engineering standards are maintained. While this role does not require the Manager to serve as the team's primary technical mentor or write production code on a daily basis, the Manager must be technically credible and capable of working closely with senior engineers on complex technical challenges. 

Armor is looking for an engineering leader who understands modern software development, cloud technologies, AI-assisted engineering, architecture, and production operations and can translate business priorities into successful engineering execution. 

This is a full-time, in-office role based in Pune, India; on-site presence five days a week is required. 

Essential Duties And Responsibilities

Additional duties may be assigned as required. 

- Lead and manage a software engineering team with responsibility for team performance, engineering execution, and delivery. 
 - Own day-to-day engineering delivery for assigned product areas, ensuring priorities are understood, technical risks are identified early, and commitments are delivered with appropriate quality. 
 - Partner with senior engineers and technical leaders on architecture, system design, technical decisions, and engineering standards. 
 - Participate in technical design and architecture discussions, asking the right questions, challenging assumptions, and ensuring solutions meet requirements for security, scalability, reliability, maintainability, and performance. 
 - Ensure engineering teams follow strong software development practices, including code review, testing, source control, CI/CD, release management, documentation, and production readiness. 
 - Drive effective use of AI-assisted development tools across the engineering team and ensure appropriate standards are maintained for the quality, accuracy, security, and maintainability of AI-generated code. 
 - Evaluate emerging AI technologies, developer tools, cloud capabilities, and engineering practices and work with technical leaders to determine where they can improve engineering productivity and product capabilities. 
 - Own delivery of feature work, defects, technical improvements, and customer-impacting issues, balancing priorities based on business impact and engineering risk. 
 - Partner with Product and other stakeholders to translate business objectives and customer requirements into clear engineering priorities and executable work. 
 - Support release planning and readiness, including risk identification, dependencies, change management, rollback planning, and coordination with appropriate technical teams. 
 - Serve as an escalation point for production incidents and customer-impacting technical issues, ensuring the appropriate engineers are engaged, communication is clear, and corrective actions are completed. 
 - Ensure lessons from production incidents, defects, and customer escalations are incorporated into engineering practices and future development. 
 - Work with engineering teams to identify and reduce technical debt while balancing new development and business priorities. 
 - Lead hiring and team-building efforts, including technical interview participation, candidate evaluation, onboarding, and workforce planning. 
 - Collaborate with global and regional engineering teams to ensure alignment, knowledge sharing, consistent engineering practices, and effective execution across distributed teams. 
 - Support technology and vendor evaluations by assessing technical capabilities, platform usage, performance, cost, engineering impact, and alternatives. 
 - Maintain visibility into engineering delivery, technical risks, dependencies, capacity, and customer-impacting issues and provide clear updates to the Director, Engineering. 

Required Skills

- Demonstrated experience successfully leading and managing software engineering teams, with responsibility for team performance and delivery. 
 - Strong software engineering background with experience building and delivering production applications using modern programming languages and frameworks such as React, TypeScript, C#, Node. js, Java, Python, or Go. 
 - Strong software architecture and system design knowledge, with the ability to participate in architecture discussions, evaluate technical approaches, identify risks, and ensure solutions are scalable, secure, maintainable, and reliable. 
 - Production cloud experience with AWS, Azure, or another major cloud platform, with a solid understanding of cloud-native application architecture, deployment, scalability, reliability, and production operations. 
 - Experience with modern software engineering and DevOps practices, including Git, CI/CD, automated testing, code review, Docker, Kubernetes, and infrastructure-as-code technologies such as Terraform or Ansible. 
 - Experience with virtualization, infrastructure, and data protection technologies such as VMware vSphere, Proxmox, NSX-T, FortiMonitor, Zerto, and Rubrik. 
 - Cybersecurity experience covering XDR, MDR, SIEM, SOC tooling, endpoint detection and response, threat detection, incident response, or security monitoring. 

Preferred Skills

- Hands-on experience using AI-assisted software development tools such as Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Codex, or equivalent. 
 - Experience leading engineering teams that use AI-assisted development tools as part of their normal software development lifecycle. 
 - Understanding of AI/LLM technologies, foundation models, AI-enabled applications, and emerging AI development frameworks. 
 - Understanding of AI/LLM security risks, including prompt injection, data leakage, model limitations, and security considerations associated with AI-generated code and applications. 
 - Ability to critically evaluate AI-generated code and technical output for accuracy, maintainability, performance, and security implications. 
 - Experience with relational and non-relational databases, including SQL, NoSQL, data modeling, performance tuning, and scalable data architectures. 
 - Experience with AI-enabled data platforms, vector databases, RAG architectures, or other data technologies supporting AI applications. 
 - Experience managing feature delivery, defect prioritization, regression prevention, technical debt, and engineering quality. 
 - Experience supporting production incidents, customer escalations, root-cause analysis, and post-incident improvement. 
 - Experience with release management, production readiness, change management, and rollback planning. 
 - Experience working in SaaS, cloud-based, or other highly available production environments. 
 - Experience working closely with Product Management and translating business and customer requirements into engineering priorities. 
 - Experience participating in technical hiring, interviewing, candidate assessment, and engineering workforce planning. 
 - Experience working with globally distributed engineering teams and stakeholders across multiple time zones. 
 - Experience evaluating third-party technologies and vendors, including technical capabilities, cost, performance, and build-versus-buy considerations. 
 - Experience in a customer-facing environment and the ability to communicate technical issues and recommendations to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. 
 - Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or equivalent professional experience. 

WHY ARMOR

Join Armor if you want to be part of a company that is redefining cybersecurity. Here, you will have the opportunity to shape the future, disrupt the status quo, and be a part of a team that celebrates energy, passion, and fresh thinking. We are not looking for someone who simply fills a role - we want talent who will help us write the next chapter of our growth story. 

ARMOR CORE VALUES

- Commitment to Growth: A growth mindset that encourages continuous learning and improvement with adaptability in the face of challenges. 
 - Integrity Always: Sustain trust through transparency + honesty in all actions and interactions regardless of circumstances. 
 - Empathy In Action: Active understanding, compassion and support to the needs of others through genuine connection. 
 - Immediate Impact: Taking initiative with swift, informed actions to deliver positive outcomes. 
 - Follow-Through: Dedication to delivering finished results with attention to quality and detail to achieve the desired outcomes.

In this high-impact leadership role, you will architect ultra-low latency, concurrent backend microservices using Go (Golang) and engineer responsive, high-fidelity web experiences using React. js. As Team Lead, you will drive technical excellence, champion rigorous code quality and architectural governance, solve deep system performance cha

data.title: Lead Instrumentation Engineer
data.description:
Lead Instrumentation Engineer - Propulsion Testing

Location: Navi Mumbai, India (On-site)

Team: Propulsion Testing / AIT (Assembly, Integration & Test)

Experience: 3-5 years (electronics / electrical / instrumentation)

Type: Full-time

About Manastu

Manastu Space is a pioneering space technology company developing green propulsion systems, redefining space safety. We specialize in full-stack maneuverability solutions for satellites and upper stages of launch vehicles. 

As the number of satellites in orbit continues to grow, ensuring safe and reliable maneuverability has become critical for mission-success and long-term orbital sustainability. 

Our propulsion systems offer an agile and enhanced maneuvering, with its proprietary hydrogen peroxide-alcohol based novel green propellant; MS-289. This performance-enhancing and high reliability fuel replaces toxic propellants such as hydrazine, making it the future-ready choice for sustainable satellite propulsion. 

Designed for safety, rapid integration and operational efficiency, our systems provide the precision required for orbit-raising, station-keeping, collision avoidance and end-of-life deorbiting, helping operators safeguard assets while reducing the growing threat of space debris. 

Website: https: //www. manastuspace. com

LinkedIn: https: //www. linkedin. com/company/manastu-space/

Email: careers@manastuspace. com

Role Objective

Own the sensing, data acquisition, valve actuation and measurement backbone of the propulsion test facility end to end and build and lead the instrumentation team that runs it. The goal is a facility where every new rig is instrumented against a frozen requirement, every channel produces clean, calibrated and traceable data on every firing, test campaigns run round the clock without instrumentation delays, and the facility keeps pace with Manastu's growth through clear standards and a costed upgrade roadmap. 

Role Overview

Every firing, every pressure spike, every millisecond of thermal data that proves our thrusters work starts with the instrumentation. As the Lead Instrumentation Engineer in Propulsion Testing, you'll head our instrumentation team and own the sensing, data acquisition, actuation and measurement backbone of our propulsion test facility, building it up alongside the AIT team and standing at the console when the thrusters fire. 

This is a hands-on, high-ownership role at the heart of our test operations. You'll Collaborate with experts in space technology, propulsion and advanced engineering veteran who've spent careers building and firing propulsion systems, a rare chance to learn flight-grade test discipline directly from the people who wrote the playbook. Test windows don't always fall in business hours: hot-fire and qualification campaigns often run late, and you'll be there through them, making sure every channel captures clean, reliable data when it counts. 

Key Responsibilities

- Team leadership: Lead and build the instrumentation team, setting technical direction, mentoring engineers and technicians, allocating work across test campaigns, and growing the group as the facility scales. 
 - Shift cover: Organise round-the-clock (24-hour) test cover with a working shift roster, and train technicians to run set-ups unsupervised. 
 - Requirement analysis: Translate test objectives into a frozen instrumentation requirement for every new rig (measurement list, ranges, accuracy, sample rates, channel count and layout) before the rig is built. 
 - Facility integration: Coordinate closely with the AIT team and Collaborate with experts in space technology, propulsion and advanced engineering veteran propulsion experts to establish and integrate the test facility, defining instrumentation layouts, wiring diagrams and channel lists for hot-fire, cold-flow and qualification campaigns. 
 - DAQ architecture: Design, build and commission the instrumentation and data acquisition (DAQ) architecture for the propulsion test facility, from sensor selection through signal path to recorded data. 
 - Sensors and calibration: Select, install and calibrate sensors including pressure transducers, thermocouples, load cells, flow meters, strain gauges and accelerometers for propulsion and structural test articles. 
 - Valve actuation: Own the design of valve actuation for test rigs (currently handled by the avionics department): valve driver circuits, position and feedback sensing, and measurement and verification of actuation timing and valve state. 
 - Automation and control: Own the automation layer for valves and actuators: specify sequences, interlocks and safe-state behaviour, and evaluate PLC, SCADA and NI-based platforms rather than defaulting to NI alone. 
 - DAQ / LabVIEW software: Write the requirements and algorithms for DAQ and control software, direct the LabVIEW engineer through the build, and accept the software against a written acceptance test. 
 - Cabling and grounding: Design and implement power and signal cable layouts and instrument grounding schemes that control noise without compromising measurement accuracy, and issue them as facility standards. 
 - Signal conditioning and troubleshooting: Configure signal conditioning, verify calibration, and troubleshoot sensors, wiring, signal paths and control loops, often under live test conditions. 
 - Live test operations: Set up, operate and monitor instrumentation during live propulsion test campaigns, including night and off-hours shifts, and own abort criteria and test holds for instrumentation reasons. 
 - Facility upkeep: Operate and maintain the test facility and its equipment (power supplies, test and measuring instruments, and automation/feedback-based systems), keeping everything calibrated, safe and campaign-ready. 
 - Quick set-ups: Stand up quick instrumentation set-ups to meet urgent development-test requirements without cutting corners on safety or data quality. 
 - Safety and standards: Ensure every test configuration meets safety standards, which is critical when working with high-test peroxide propellants and high-pressure systems, and work to ECSS-aligned and AS9100 practices. 
 - Documentation and traceability: Own instrumentation documentation (control narratives, functional specs, channel lists, calibration records and post-test data validation reports) to a standard that holds up in an anomaly investigation or an AS9100 audit. Maintain a live baseline of active channels, calibration due dates, noise floors and spares. 
 - Procurement and spares: Generate equipment and instrument specifications based on test needs, drive procurement, and maintain essential spares through lean inventory management. 
 - Roadmap: Forecast future facility requirements, publish a costed upgrade roadmap, and adopt emerging technology to keep our test capability current and competitive. Experience & Background

Academic qualifications

- BE / B. Tech / M. Tech in Instrumentation, Electronics or Electrical Engineering. Experience and expertise

- 3-5 years of industrial experience in the above disciplines, handling a range of power supplies, testing instruments and measuring instruments; calibration of instruments; and automation involving feedback-based operations. 
 - Operation and maintenance of test facilities built around the above equipment and instruments. 
 - Setting up instrumentation facilities to industry standards and safety/environmental protocols, including writing measurement requirements and selecting the right range and accuracy of instruments for the test conditions. 
 - Specialisation in power and signal cable layout design and implementation, and in instrument grounding to control noise levels without affecting measurement accuracy during data acquisition. 
 - Hands-on configuration of NI DAQ hardware and LabVIEW-based systems; exposure to PLC and SCADA control platforms. 
 - Design of valve driver / actuation circuits and position or feedback sensing, including verifying actuation timing. 
 - Developing system-operation and facility-maintenance documentation, with calibration traceability. 
 - Ability to develop quick instrumentation test set-ups to meet urgent development-test requirements. 
 - Organising teams to meet round-the-clock (24-hour) testing requirements as and when required. 
 - Generating equipment / instrument specifications based on needs, driving procurement, and maintaining essential spares through lean inventory management. 
 - Forecasting future requirements and adopting changing technology to keep facilities up to date. 
 - Excellent communication skills, including concept presentation and demonstration, and guiding technicians to deliver seamless service. Bonus points for

- Experience instrumenting propulsion, engine or structural test rigs; harness fabrication and EMI/EMC awareness; exposure to aerospace quality standards (AS9100, ECSS); or hands-on time supporting hot-fire or qualification test campaigns. Ideal Candidate Profile

- Has written channel lists and chosen ranges personally, not just been handed them, and can state the range, accuracy and uncertainty of every instrument they have used. 
 - Has selected parts and drawn circuits themselves and can explain the trade-off behind each choice rather than naming a catalogue part. 
 - Backs grounding and shielding decisions with before/after noise numbers and a grounding scheme they drew. 
 - Has configured DAQ and control software personally, written specs and acceptance tests, and can argue for a control platform choice (NI, PLC or SCADA). 
 - Has sat the console on live firings and has called a hold when data quality or safety demanded it. 
 - Writes requirements instead of waiting for them and can get a design or spec changed when the rig cannot support the measurement. 
 - Builds people: has trained technicians to run set-ups unsupervised and has organised cover for 24-hour test windows. 
 - Raises problems early, even when it costs schedule, never signs off data they are not sure of, and leaves drawings and records behind. What we offer

Learn directly from experts in space technology, propulsion and advanced engineering veteran : flight-proven expertise you can't get from a textbook

Sit at the console for live thruster firings and own the data that decides whether hardware flies

Work on flight-proven, DRDO- and ISRO-validated green propulsion technology

Build and lead the instrumentation team from the ground up and shape how testing is done at Manastu

Comprehensive health insurance

High ownership and visibility, with direct access to leadership

Support for learning, conferences, and research exposure

Subsidized lunch plan

This team builds products by harnessing the potential of open-source technologies while pushing the boundaries on Systems and Silicon Architecture. As the Director of Software Engineering and Site Lead in India, you will lead a high-performing engineering organization responsible for SONiC development across platform enablement, manageability, control plane, and DevOps. You will partner closely with US-based engineering teams, grow technical talent, and help shape the future of open networking at a scale. 

- Lead engineering teams and managers deliver reliable SONiC capabilities across platform enablement, manageability, control plane, and DevOps.

Minimum Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in computer science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical field, plus 15+ years of professional software engineering experience. 
 - 5+ years of experience managing engineering managers or leading multiple software engineering teams. 
 - 5+ years of experience developing or operating network operating systems, distributed systems, cloud infrastructure, or control-plane/data-plane software. 
 - 3+ years of experience delivering production software on Linux using C++, Python, Go, or equivalent systems programming languages. 
 - Experience leading software delivery across multiple engineering components, including planning, execution, release, and operational support. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Master's degree in computer science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or related technical field. 
 - Experience with networking, SONiC, open networking, network operating systems, or cloud-scale infrastructure.

 - Experience leading geographically distributed engineering organizations of 50 or more employees. 
 - Contributions to open-source projects, industry standards, technical communities, patents, publications, or conference presentations. 

Why Cisco?

At Cisco, we're revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era - and beyond. We've been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. About

To ensure that we hire the best talent in the right way, we follow a strict hiring process and recently, Cisco has been made aware of fraudulent recruiters claiming to be from the company. Please be advised that any communication from Cisco about careers will:

Summary

Guidewire provides the industry platform that P&C insurers rely on to adapt and succeed in a time of accelerating change. We deliver software, services, and a partner ecosystem that help insurers run, differentiate, and grow their business. 

InsuranceNow is an all-in-one, cloud-based platform that unifies software, services, and ecosystem partners to power our customers' businesses. It provides core insurance capabilities such as policy, claims, and billing management, as well as analytics, reporting, and digital experiences. 

You will be part of the team that is scaling InsuranceNow to serve a growing roster of Tier 1 and Tier 2 insurers around the world, helping them launch new products faster, develop AI capabilities and scale their operations with confidence. 

We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer at our Bengaluru office with strong Java skills to design and build scalable, cloud-native solutions for Guidewire's InsuranceNow product. You will help evolve a successful product to its next-generation cloud architecture and scale it to more Tier 1 and Tier 2 insurance companies across the globe, enabling them to set up and grow their insurance businesses efficiently and reliably. This is a senior individual contributor role within Guidewire's Product Development organization. 

Job Description

What you will do: 

- Collaborate closely with product managers, architects, and senior engineering leadership across Product Development and Cloud Operations to design and deliver product features. 
 - Design and implement scalable, reliable, and secure cloud-native services and integrations for InsuranceNow, with a strong focus on Java-based solutions. 
 - Lead the architecture and development of integrations between InsuranceNow and third-party systems commonly used in the insurance industry. 
 - Design systems that can scale horizontally to support more Tier 1 and Tier 2 insurers, with clear focus on performance, resilience, observability, and operability. 
 - Apply cloud infrastructure and platform capabilities (primarily on AWS; Azure or GCP experience also welcome) to build robust, automated environments. 
 - Own CI/CD pipelines and automated testing for your services, ensuring high-quality, low-friction deployments. 
 - Use Infrastructure as Code to provision and manage cloud resources in a repeatable and auditable way. 
 - Troubleshoot complex production and pre-production issues across application, infrastructure, and data layers using strong analytical and problem-solving skills. 
 - Follow and improve secure SDLC practices in partnership with InfoSec and other stakeholders. 
 - Coach and mentor other engineers, providing technical leadership and helping the team deliver high-quality outcomes. 

What You Bring

- 8+ years of overall software or infrastructure development experience, including at least 3 years building applications on cloud architectures. 
 - Strong, hands-on experience with Java for backend application development, including object-oriented design and clean code practices. 
 - Experience designing and building distributed systems and services, ideally with microservices or event-driven architectures. 
 - Practical experience with at least one major cloud provider; AWS is highly preferred, but Azure or Google Cloud experience is also valuable. 
 - Solid understanding of cloud-native concepts such as zero-downtime deployments, blue/green or canary releases, and promotion of code from QA to staging to production. 
 - Strong knowledge of relational and/or non-relational databases and how to model, query, and tune them for scalable systems. 
 - Hands-on experience with Infrastructure as Code tools such as Terraform or AWS CloudFormation; experience with Chef, Ansible, or Puppet is also acceptable. 
 - Demonstrated ability to design systems for scale, performance, reliability, and maintainability, especially in multi-tenant SaaS environments. 
 - Proven logical, analytical, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to debug complex issues across multiple technical layers. 
 - Experience owning and improving CI/CD pipelines and automated testing strategies. 
 - Ability and desire to quickly learn new technologies and work in a fast-paced, collaborative environment. 
 - Proven ability to mentor others and provide technical leadership within an engineering team. 

Bonus Skills

- Experience building enterprise-grade integrations, including APIs, events, and messaging-based systems. 
 - Familiarity with API design (REST, event-based) and experience consuming or exposing business/application events. 
 - Understanding of authentication and authorization concepts (e. g. , SSO, OAuth, SAML, role-based access control). 
 - Experience in the P&C insurance domain or other complex, highly regulated industries. 

How We Work

We are guided by three core values: Collegiality, Integrity, and Rationality. 

- Collegiality: We value strong teams and professional equality. We work together respectfully, welcome contrary opinions, and continuously improve our processes while maintaining a sustainable work-life balance. 
 - Integrity: We insist on truthful, transparent relationships with customers, partners, investors, and each other in everything we do. 
 - Rationality: We communicate through clear arguments and make decisions based on factual evidence. We prefer calm, systematic, thoughtful solutions, believe in testing, and constantly look for ways to improve how we build software. 

If you are passionate about building scalable Java-based cloud systems, enjoy solving complex problems, and want to help Tier 1 and Tier 2 insurers modernize and scale their businesses, we would love to hear from you. 

About Guidewire

Guidewire is the platform P&C insurers trust to engage, innovate, and grow efficiently. We combine digital, core, analytics, and AI to deliver our platform as a cloud service. More than 540+ insurers in 40 countries, from new ventures to the largest and most complex in the world, run on Guidewire. 

As a partner to our customers, we continually evolve to enable their success. We are proud of our unparalleled implementation track record with 1600+ successful projects, supported by the largest R&D team and partner ecosystem in the industry. Our Marketplace provides hundreds of applications that accelerate integration, localization, and innovation. 

For more information, please visit www. guidewire. com and follow us on Twitter: @Guidewire_PandC. 

Guidewire Software, Inc. is proud to be an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer. We are committed to an inclusive workplace, and believe that a diversity of perspectives, abilities, and cultures is a key to our success. Qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, citizenship, marital status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, veteran status, or disability. All offers are contingent upon passing a criminal history and other background checks where it's applicable to the position.

data.description:
Toast is driven by building the restaurant platform that helps restaurants adapt, take control, and get back to what they do best: building the businesses they love. 

Are you bready* for a change?

Toast is looking for a Staff Software engineer to join our Payments team in Bangalore. This team will be responsible for building end to end 3rd party processors responsible for managing millions of transactions for our customers. 

About this roll* (Responsibilities)

- Design, build, deploy, and maintain highly resilient and scalable features
 - Lead complex projects that improve functionality and reliability for our customers and partners
 - Partner with a wide array of teams across Toast 
 - Ensure quality by building automated testing for changes
 - Roll* features out to customers and partners, including monitoring for success
 - Collaborate with UX and PM on the definition and design of features
 - Mentor and coach other engineers

Do you have the right ingredients*? (Requirements)

- A minimum of three year undergraduate degree in any related discipline
 - 9-13 years experience building backend services and APIs
 - Extensive experience working with an Object Oriented Language like Java or Kotlin, with a deep understanding of testing, quality, and best practices
 - Experience shipping production services and balancing getting things done with platform stability and reliability
 - Experience building backend services and APIs and scaling distributed systems
 - Experience building android applications with kotlin is a plus
 - Focused on delivering positive impact for Toast customers
 - Enjoys working in a team environment with a shared code-base
 - Excellent cross-team communication skills on complex technical topics

We are hiring individuals with a wide range of experience so if you have more or less than these exact roles, please still apply!

Our Tech Stack

Toast's products run on a stack that ranges from guest and restaurant-facing Android tablets to backend services in Java to internal, guest-facing and restaurant-facing web apps. Our backend services follow a microservice architecture written using Java 8 and DropWizard; we use AWS extensively, ranging from S3 to RDS to Lambda. We have our own platform for dealing with user management, service elevations and robust load balancing. Toast stores data in a set of sharded Postgres databases and utilizes Apache Spark for large scale data workloads including query and batch processing. The front-end is built primarily using React and ES6. The main Toast POS application is an Android application written in Java and Kotlin. For data between tablets and our cloud platform we operate RabbitMQ clusters as well as direct tablet communication to the back end. 

AI at Toast

At Toast, one of our company values is that we're hungry to build and learn. We believe learning new AI tools empowers us to build for our customers faster, more independently, and with higher quality. We provide these tools across all disciplines, from Engineering and Product to Sales and Support, and are inspired by how our Toasters are already driving real value with them. The people who thrive here are those who embrace changes that let us build more for our customers; it's a core part of our culture. 

Our Total Rewards Philosophy

We strive to provide competitive compensation and benefits programs that help to attract, retain, and motivate the best and brightest people in our industry. Our total rewards package goes beyond great earnings potential and provides the means to a healthy lifestyle with the flexibility to meet Toasters' changing needs. Learn more about our benefits at https: //careers. toasttab. com/toast-benefits. 

How Toast Uses AI In Its Hiring Process

Throughout the hiring process, our goal is to get to know you. We use AI tools to support our recruiters and interviewers with tasks like note-taking, summarization, and documentation of interviews to ensure they can be fully focused on your conversation. All hiring decisions are made by people. We ask that you complete interviews and assessments on your own, without real-time AI tools, recording, or transcription bots, unless we tell you otherwise in advance. To learn more: https: //careers. toasttab. com/ai-in-hiring

Our Approach to Hybrid Working

We embrace a hybrid work model that fosters in-person collaboration while valuing individual needs. Our goal is to build a strong culture of connection as we work together to empower the hospitality community, regardless of location. Please visit the Locations page on our career site to learn more about our in-office expectations by region: https: //careers. toasttab. com/locations-toast

People Are the Secret Ingredient in Our Recipe for Success

At Toast, our employees are our secret ingredient-when they thrive, we thrive. The restaurant industry brings together people with a wide range of backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives, and we value that same breadth at Toast. We strive to build a culture grounded in authenticity, respect, and humility, where every Toaster has a real opportunity to grow, contribute, and do their best work-raising the bar in delivering exceptional experiences for our customers and each other. 

Apply today!

Toast is committed to creating an accessible and inclusive hiring process. As part of this commitment, we strive to provide reasonable accommodations for persons with disabilities to enable them to access the hiring process. If you need an accommodation to access the job application or interview process, please contact candidateaccommodations@toasttab. com.

About Team

GDF (Global Data Foundation) is part of Walmart's AI & Data organization - the team building the

foundational data platforms that power AI, analytics, and decision-making across every Walmart banner

and geography, from supply chain and merchandising to customer experience and enterprise AI agents. 

Our newly created platform team is chartered with building next-generation data infrastructure at Walmart

scale: reliable, high-throughput data pipelines, distributed processing systems, and platform capabilities

that downstream teams across Walmart depend on every day. 

What You'll Do

- Design, build, and operate distributed platform services and APIs using Java and Python, applied

against Kubernetes or equivalent cloud-native infrastructure. 

- Apply domain-oriented design, system design, and low-level design (LLD) rigor to ambiguous platform

problems - evaluating dependencies, trade-offs, failure modes, scalability, cost, and long-term

durability before writing a line of code. 

- Flex into data engineering work when needed: contribute directly to Spark-based data pipelines and

processing jobs, working comfortably in GDF's data engineering codebase alongside platform work. 

- Build AI, GenAI, and agentic-powered platform capabilities: intelligent developer tooling, workflow

automation, agentic services, and AI-assisted operational tooling (monitoring, incident triage, capacity

planning). 

- Own platform reliability, scalability, and observability - service-level objectives, distributed tracing, 

alerting, and incident response for services you build, with a strong Operational Excellence /

Engineering Excellence discipline. 

- Guide architecture and system design decisions across microservices, event-driven systems, and

enterprise integrations, with an explicit eye toward how platform choices affect downstream data

engineering workloads. 

- Partner with data engineers, data scientists, and ML engineers to ensure platform services expose the

right primitives for data pipelines, feature stores, and model-serving paths. 

- Establish engineering standards through architecture reviews, design reviews, code reviews, and

production readiness reviews for a team building process from scratch. 

- As a Principal engineer, set technical direction and best practices across multiple teams and the

broader GDF platform without needing a management title - mentor other engineers and influence

GDF's broader platform engineering standards. 

- Continuously evaluate emerging platform, cloud, and AI/agentic technologies, adopting them

pragmatically where they improve reliability, productivity, or business value. 

What You'll Bring

- Genuinely hands-on coding: 12+ years of professional software engineering experience building and

operating large-scale distributed platforms; strong proficiency in Java and Python is required -

comfortable writing, reviewing, and debugging production code, not just directing others. Additional

experience with Go, C++, or Scala is a plus. 

- Operational Excellence (OE) and Engineering Excellence (EE) mindset is a required skill, not a

nice-to-have: SLO/SLA ownership, incident management and blameless post-incident reviews, 

proactive reliability and quality metrics, and continuous improvement built into how you ship, not

bolted on afterward. 

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field, or

equivalent practical experience. 

- Deep experience with microservices architectures, distributed systems, event-driven patterns, API

design, service contracts, and enterprise system integration - backed by strong system design, 

domain-oriented design (DDD), and low-level design (LLD) skills, with demonstrated ownership of

production code and the judgment to evaluate trade-offs, failure modes, scalability, and cost. 

- Deep understanding of cloud-native engineering practices - CI/CD, containerization, Kubernetes or

equivalent orchestration, infrastructure automation, and production operations. 

- Strong exposure to Big Data / data engineering technologies - Spark required at a working level, with

familiarity in Hadoop/HDFS, Hive, or Kafka - enough to flex into data engineering work confidently, not

just integrate with it from a distance. 

- Full exposure to AI and Agentic technologies: hands-on experience integrating model APIs and

GenAI/LLM tooling, building or operating agentic workflows (tool-calling agents, multi-step

autonomous systems), working with embeddings/vector search, and applying MLOps practices

(feature stores, model lifecycle, retraining pipelines) - not just conceptual awareness. 

- Strong knowledge of reliability engineering - observability, distributed tracing, logging, metrics, 

alerting, incident response, capacity planning, and fault tolerance for large-scale systems. 

- Strong grounding in security, privacy, and enterprise engineering practices, including authentication, 

authorization, data protection, and secure API design. 

- Proven ability to translate ambiguous technical/business problems into clear execution plans, 

particularly across a newly formed platform organization without fully established process. 

- Strong ownership mindset and technical judgment; comfortable operating with high autonomy in a

0-to-1 environment. 

About Walmart Global Tech

Imagine working in an environment where one line of code can make life easier for hundreds of millions of people. That's what we do at Walmart Global Tech. We're a team of software engineers, data scientists, cybersecurity expert's and service professionals within the world's leading retailer who make an epic impact and are at the forefront of the next retail disruption. Benefits

Beyond our great compensation package, you can receive incentive awards for your performance. Other great perks include a host of best-in-class benefits maternity and parental leave, PTO, health benefits, and much more. 

Belonging

We aim to create a culture where every associate feels valued for who they are, rooted in respect for the individual. Our goal is to foster a sense of belonging, to create opportunities for all our associates, customers and suppliers, and to be a Walmart for everyone. 

At Walmart, our vision is "everyone included. " By fostering a workplace culture where everyone is-and feels-included, everyone wins. Our associates and customers reflect the makeup of all 19 countries where we operate. By making Walmart a welcoming place where all people feel like they belong, we're able to engage associates, strengthen our business, improve our ability to serve customers, and support the communities where we operate.

We are seeking an expert Senior Azure Platform Engineer to develop, build, automate, and operate highly available, scalable, and secure cloud platforms on Microsoft Azure. The ideal candidate will possess strong expertise in cloud infrastructure, automation, platform reliability, DevOps practices, and production support. This role focuses on improving service reliability, performance, operational efficiency, and developer productivity through automation, Infrastructure as Code (IaC), and observability standard methodologies. 

Key Responsibilities

- Build, deploy, administer, and optimize Azure cloud infrastructure, including Compute, Storage, Networking, Security, and Kubernetes services (AKS). 
 - Manage and maintain Azure Virtual Machines, Storage Accounts, Virtual Networks, NSGs, Load Balancers, VPN Gateways, and ExpressRoute connectivity. 
 - Implement and lead IaC solutions using Terraform and ARM Templates. 
 - Build, enhance, and support CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps and Gitlab Actions to streamline software delivery and operational processes. 
 - Improve the entire service lifecycle from architecture and design through deployment, operation, monitoring, and continuous improvement. 
 - Lead availability, resource requirement planning , performance monitoring, and reliability initiatives for business-critical applications and platforms.

data.title: Senior Site Reliability Engineer
data.description:
Overview

We are looking for a reliability expert who is passionate about scaling Cloud services to join our growing Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) teams. You are someone who is aware of current industry trends (particularly those related to reliability) and who values working with a diverse set of partners, who can articulate the business impact of a problem and can also dive deep into the technical solution. 

Responsibilities

We'd love it if you brought a deep understanding of modern Cloud infrastructure, programming expertise, operational experience and a desire to change the status quo. 

We're looking for an engineer who can analyse and help improve our services and processes to get us to an even higher level of reliability, performance, scalability, and cost efficiency. You'll achieve this by crossing team and functional boundaries to advocate for reliability methodologies and will work with a variety of platform, product and SRE teams to both build reliability into our platform and drive adoption of those practices into our products. In other words, you'll be the driving force for change! You will report to a regional Senior Engineering Manager in SRE. 

Qualifications

We'll expect you to have: 

- Expert-level proficiency with 10+ years experience in one or more prominent languages such as Java, Go or Python. 
 - Expert-level proficiency with 7+ years experience in public cloud offerings (with at least 2+ years specifically on GCP). 
 - Expert-level proficiency with 7+ years experience in operating high-availability, fault-tolerant, scalable, distributed software in production: building monitoring into your code, tweaking dashboards, defining alerts, writing runbooks, etc. 
 - Excellent communication skills in written and verbal forms, and an ability to communicate complex technical issues to a range of technical and non-technical audiences (management, peers, clients). 
 - An ability and desire to mentor and coach engineers. 

It would be great, but not mandatory if you had: 

- Experience in datastores (RDBMS, time-series-database, NoSql, search, analytics). 
 - Experience in microservice architecture. 
 - Experience building web-services and clients using REST/GraphQL. 
 - Expertise in JVM, Garbage Collection, and Performance Tuning.

data.title: Senior Software Engineer
data.description:
Role: Senior Software Engineer

Function: Software Engineering

Location: Kolkata, India

Type: Full-time

Industry: AI, Medical SaaS, Dental Technology

About Company

The company builds medical AI SaaS for the U. S. dental market. 

Its all-in-one platform unifies analytics, scheduling, communications, payments, and marketing automation. Thousands of dental practices across North America rely on it daily. 

It automates admin busywork and gives teams real-time visibility into revenue and retention. Patients get a self-serve portal to book appointments, view history, and pay online. 

The company is mission-driven, execution-oriented, and operating in one of healthcare's most under-digitized verticals. 

Position Overview

This role owns significant components of the company's cloud-native SaaS platform - taking features from ambiguous requirements through design, implementation, and production operation. You'll build scalable backend services, event-driven workflows, and full-stack capabilities that serve thousands of dental practices daily. Beyond shipping, you'll raise the technical bar through architecture contributions, code reviews, and mentoring peers. 

Role & Responsibilities

- Design, build, and own end-to-end features and services across the platform - from requirements through production operation. 
 - Build scalable REST APIs, backend services, and event-driven workflows using Kafka-compatible messaging and async processing patterns. 
 - Contribute to frontend and full-stack development using React. js, Next. js, and TypeScript as needed. 
 - Translate ambiguous requirements into well-structured technical designs; participate in architecture discussions and document trade-offs clearly. 
 - Improve system observability through monitoring, logging, and alerting (OpenTelemetry, New Relic, CloudWatch); participate in on-call incident response. 
 - Write and review unit, integration, and automated tests; uphold high standards for code quality and operational readiness. 
 - Mentor junior engineers through pairing and code reviews; use AI-assisted development tools to improve delivery speed without compromising quality or security. 

Must Have Criteria

- 5-8 years of software engineering experience building and operating production-grade SaaS or web applications. 
 - Strong backend proficiency in Python with Django, Django REST Framework, or FastAPI; experience with SQLAlchemy/Alembic. 
 - Hands-on experience with event-driven architecture and Kafka (or Kafka-compatible systems: Redpanda, Amazon MSK) in production. 
 - Proven experience with AWS services: ECS/EKS/Fargate, Lambda, RDS, ElastiCache, S3, API Gateway, and CloudWatch. 
 - Solid experience with PostgreSQL - including database design, query optimization, and caching strategies with Redis. 
 - Demonstrated ability to own and deliver complex features independently, including debugging performance, scalability, and reliability issues. 
 - Experience with Docker, CI/CD pipelines, and infrastructure-as-code (Terraform). 

Nice to Have

- Experience building multi-tenant SaaS platforms or large-scale transactional/data-intensive workloads. 
 - Familiarity with Kubernetes for container orchestration. 
 - Experience building ETL/data pipelines or exposure to Databricks or similar analytics platforms. 
 - Exposure to healthcare technology or HIPAA-compliant application development. 
 - Track record of mentoring engineers and leading feature development across a team. 

What We Offer

- End-to-end ownership of meaningful platform components with clear, measurable impact on thousands of dental practices. 
 - Tight, cross-functional team with high autonomy and fast shipping cycles in a large, under-digitized healthcare vertical. 
 - Flexible scheduling and strong support for technical growth and continuous learning. 
 - Opportunity to work at the intersection of AI, medical SaaS, and real-world operational impact.

About Team

Sam's club is a membership-based retail warehouse club owned and operated by Walmart. With more than 600 physical clubs across different geographic region in US, Sam's Club chain serves more than 50 million US members and is rated among the top retailers in US. 

What You'll Do

You will work closely with Product and development teams to understand the requirements, design, architecture and develop software, working closely with senior leads and business team. 

Join our young, highly energetic and dynamic team, and take part in defining the new age e-commerce and in club shopping experience. You will also have challenging opportunities to cross-collaborate with inter- disciplinary product and engineering teams to solve some of the unique challenges

As a member of the team, you will be expected to code, test and deploy cutting edge solutions at scale, impacting millions of customers worldwide. 

Collaborate with senior members of the team to gather requirements, participate in design discussion, code, test and deploy the products to production

Interact with Walmart engineering teams across geographies to leverage expertise and contribute to the tech community. 

Develop and support the product developed e2e. 

What You'll Bring

- Bachelor's degree in computer science or related discipline with 3 to 6 years of core software product development experience. 
 - Strong computer science fundamentals in algorithms, data structures, databases, operating systems, etc. 
 - Hands on in developing web applications using REST, Messaging and SOA
 - 3 or more years of experience with Java, Databases (SQL, No-SQL), developing APIs. 
 - Experience with Cloud Computing platforms: Microsoft Azure, Google cloud or similar is a plus
 - A self-motivated learner and builder with strong customer focus and obsession to quality
 - Experience with dev-ops is a plus (CI/CD, Jenkins, Docker, Kubernetes)
 - Experience with popular front-end frameworks like React, Angular, or Next. js, and the ability to create custom components and widgets. 
 - Very good hands-on experience in Micro Services, Flask/Django, REST API, Python with DSA & Docker technical stack and API design principles, including versioning, authentication, and authorization. 

About Global Tech. 

Imagine working in an environment where one line of code can make life easier for hundreds of millions of people and put a smile on their face. Thats what we do at Walmart Global Tech. Were a team of 15, 000+ software engineers, data scientists and service professionals within Walmart, the worlds largest retailer, delivering innovations that improve how our customers shop and empower our 2. 3 million associates. To others, innovation looks like an app, service or some code, but Walmart has always been about people. People are why we innovate, and people power our innovations. Being human-led is our true disruption. We are people-led and tech-empowered. We train our team in the skillsets of the future and bring in experts like you to help us grow. We have roles for those chasing their first opportunity as well as those looking for the opportunity that will define their career. Here, you can kickstart a great career in tech, gain new skills and experience for virtually every industry, or leverage your expertise to innovate at scale, impact millions and reimagine the future of retail

Flexible Work

Walmart's culture sets us apart, and we know being together helps us innovate, learn and grow great careers. This role is based in our [Bangalore/Chennai] office for daily work, with the flexibility for associates to manage their personal lives. 

Belonging

We aim to create a culture where every associate feels valued for who they are, rooted in respect for the individual. Our goal is to foster a sense of belonging, to create opportunities for all our associates, customers and suppliers, and to be a Walmart for everyone. 

At Walmart, our vision is everyone included. By fostering a workplace culture where everyone is and feels included, everyone wins. Our associates and customers reflect the makeup of all 19 countries where we operate. By making Walmart a welcoming place where all people feel like they belong, were able to engage associates, strengthen our business, improve our ability to serve customers, and support the communities where we operate.

Beyond our great compensation package, you can receive incentive awards for your performance. Other great perks include a host of best-in-class benefits maternity and parental leave, PTO, health benefits, and much more.
