data.title: Quality Manager – Emergency Roadside Service (ERS)
data.description:
Position: Quality Manager -Emergency Roadside Service (ERS)

Location: Bengaluru

Department: Customer Success - ERS

Proposed Reporting Line: Senior Manager - Customer Success/Director Operations

Role Purpose

Lead quality operations for Bridgestone's Emergency Roadside Service, ensuring consistent, accurate, and empathetic customer support. Manage the Quality Analyst team and transform call evaluations and customer feedback into actionable insights across people, process, policy, and technology. 

The role goes beyond quality scoring to identify the causes of customer dissatisfaction, strengthen service delivery, and support reduced vehicle downtime through measurable improvements. 

Key Responsibilities

- Quality Strategy and Governance
 - 
 - Own the ERS quality framework, evaluation scorecards, audit methodology, and reporting cadence across supported fleets. 
 - Develop evaluations aligned with the customer journey: opening, verification, understanding the issue, acknowledgment, appropriate action, ETA communication, documentation, follow-up, resolution, and closing. 
 - Establish clear scoring guidelines and critical-error definitions, considering customer impact, compliance, and operational risk. 
 - Ensure representative audit coverage across fleets, shifts, channels, agent tenure, and interaction types, supplemented by targeted reviews of high-risk cases. 
 - Lead calibration sessions with Operations, Training, and relevant business partners to ensure consistent evaluation standards. 
 - Quality Team Leadership
 - 
 - Manage, coach, and develop Quality Analysts, setting clear expectations for audit accuracy, productivity, analytical depth, and stakeholder engagement. 
 - Review evaluation quality through regular audit-of-audit checks and resolve scoring disputes fairly. 
 - Build team capability in root-cause analysis, effective feedback, customer journey assessment, and business insight generation. 
 - Maintain audit plans, workload allocation, and timely completion of evaluations and feedback. 
 - Business Insights and Root-Cause Analysis
 - 
 - Establish a structured call-driver and defect taxonomy to identify recurring issues and their impact on customer experience and operational performance. 
 - Translate evaluation findings into insights across: 
 - People: Knowledge, communication, empathy, ownership, judgment, and coaching needs. 
 - Process: Dispatch, dealer coordination, ETA updates, handoffs, documentation, follow-up, and escalation gaps. 
 - Policy: Unclear guidelines, exceptions, or restrictions affecting resolution and customer effort. 
 - Technology: Tool usability, system errors, duplicate work, data gaps, and automation opportunities. 
 - Analyze detractor and passive feedback, repeat contacts, complaints, and delayed service events to identify underlying causes. 
 - Distinguish agent-controllable issues from dealer, process, policy, and system constraints. 
 - Present prioritized recommendations supported by evidence, frequency, customer impact, accountable owners, and expected outcomes. 
 - Coaching and Continuous Improvement
 - 
 - Partner with Team Leads and Training to convert quality findings into targeted coaching, refresher training, and knowledge updates. 
 - Track corrective actions through closure and validate effectiveness through subsequent evaluations. 
 - Identify successful behaviors from strong customer interactions and replicate them across teams. 
 - Lead improvement initiatives that reduce recurring defects, avoidable repeat contacts, and customer effort. 
 - Provide evidence-based feedback to technology teams on tool improvements and opportunities for AI-assisted evaluation and automation, with appropriate human validation. 
 - Reporting and Stakeholder Management
 - 
 - Publish weekly and monthly dashboards showing quality trends, major call drivers, customer pain points, and improvement progress. 
 - Connect quality findings with NPS, repeat contacts, complaints, and relevant service and downtime measures. 
 - Present concise business insights and recommendations to ERS leadership and stakeholders. 
 - Maintain reliable evaluation records and protect customer and employee information. 
Qualifications And Experience

- 
 - Bachelor's degree or equivalent relevant professional experience. 
 - Typically 7+ years of experience in contact centre operations or quality assurance, including 2+ years managing a quality team.

data.description:
Life at Plume

At Plume, we believe that technology isn't about moving faster, it's about making life's moments better. Which is why we've built the world's first, and only, open and hardware-independent service delivery platform for smart homes, small businesses, enterprises, and beyond. Our SaaS platform uses WiFi, advanced AI, and machine learning to create the future of connected spaces-and human experiences-at massive scale. 

We now deliver services to over 60 million locations globally and have managed over 3 billion devices on our platform. We're expanding rapidly, pioneering a new category, and we achieved our Series F funding in just four years. Our customers include many of the world's largest Internet Service Providers (ISPs) who look to Plume to help them evolve their smart home offerings while gleaning insights from their own data. 

With a bias for action and a love for being trailblazers, the team at Plume embodies a combination of relentless curiosity and imaginative innovation. We challenge ourselves to think in ways that other companies don't, work to do what should be done (rather than what can), and if we can't do it exceptionally well, we don't do it. It's how we've assembled a team of world-class builders, thinkers, and doers. And it's how we're reinventing what's possible every day. 

This is a work-from-office / In-Office role based in our Hyderabad, India location. 

What You Will Do

- Define and drive end-to-end QA and test strategies for core broadband, WiFi, and cloud-based solutions. 
 - Lead testing across firmware, cloud services, APIs, microservices, and network components. 
 - Design and execute comprehensive functional, integration, system, regression, performance, scalability, and reliability testing. 
 - Develop and maintain automated test frameworks and test infrastructure to improve test coverage and release confidence. 
 - Identify critical quality risks and establish appropriate test plans, quality gates, and release criteria. 
 - Collaborate closely with software engineers, architects, product managers, and other QA teams to ensure quality throughout the development lifecycle. 
 - Perform root-cause analysis of complex issues across distributed systems and drive defects to resolution. 
 - Mentor QA engineers and contribute to engineering best practices, automation standards, and quality processes. 
 - Provide technical leadership in improving testability, observability, CI/CD integration, and continuous quality engineering. 
 - Participate in architecture and design discussions, proactively identifying potential quality and reliability risks. 
 - Drive continuous improvements in test automation, defect prevention, test efficiency, and overall product quality. 
 - Acts as a technical quality leader for the Core Engineering organization. 
 - Operates with a high degree of ownership and independently drives complex, cross-functional quality initiatives. 
 - Influences engineering teams to adopt a quality-by-design and automation-first mindset. 
 - Mentors engineers and raises the overall technical capability of the QA organization. 
 - Serves as a subject-matter expert for complex quality and reliability challenges. 

What We Are Looking For

- 12+ years of experience in Software Quality Engineering, with 5+ years leading QA for embedded systems, broadband, networking, WiFi, or cloud-based platforms. 
 - Strong expertise in defining end-to-end test strategies across firmware, cloud services, APIs, microservices, and distributed systems. 
 - Hands-on experience in test automation using Python, Java, C++, or similar languages, with modern automation frameworks. 
 - Experience in functional, integration, regression, performance, scalability, and reliability testing. 
 - Strong understanding of networking concepts, including TCP/IP, DHCP, DNS, IPv4/IPv6, WiFi, and broadband gateway architectures. 
 - Experience with CI/CD pipelines, test automation infrastructure, and quality engineering best practices. 
 - Strong debugging and root-cause analysis skills across firmware, cloud, and networking environments. 
 - Proven ability to lead cross-functional quality initiatives, mentor engineers, and drive automation-first and quality-by-design practices. 
 - Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills. 

Preferred

- Experience with broadband, WiFi, or CPE platforms. 
 - Familiarity with RDK-B, OpenSync, PrplOS, Embedded Linux, or similar platforms. 
 - Experience testing cloud-native applications, APIs, microservices, and containerized environments (Docker/Kubernetes). 
 - Knowledge of Broadband Forum standards such as TR-069, TR-181, and TR-369 (USP). 
 - Experience with performance, reliability, and security testing, along with observability tools such as Grafana, Prometheus, or ELK. 
 - ISTQB or equivalent QA certification is a plus. 

Education

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Systems, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience. 

About Plume

As the creator of the only open, hardware-independent, cloud-controlled experience platform for ISPs and their subscribers, Plume partners with over 400 ISP customers, including some of the world's largest such as Charter, Liberty Global, and J: COM. 

Using OpenSync, the most widely supported open-source, silicon-to-cloud framework for smart spaces, Plume's software-defined network allows ISPs to decouple their service offerings from hardware and rapidly curate and deliver new services over a multi-vendor, open-platform architecture.

Bitwarden promotes better internet security and safety with the leading open source password management solution for individuals, teams, and business organizations. Our philosophy on security is that "we are all in this together" - we continue to offer a full-featured free version of Bitwarden so that everyone can be protected with strong password management. We also provide enterprise-grade solutions to some of the largest companies in the world, and will continue to innovate in the identity and authentication market as the world starts to grow beyond passwords. Read more on the Bitwarden blog. 

As a Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET) on Bitwarden's Autofill Coverage team, you will help make autofill work reliably on the sites people actually use, and keep it fast and unobtrusive as the product evolves. Autofill is the Bitwarden capability that fills logins, payment details, and identities into web forms across browsers. The Autofill Coverage team maintains and expands a curated dataset of site-specific autofill rules, builds automation that continuously checks autofill across popular websites, and builds lab-based measurement of autofill's performance in the browser. Every engineer on the team works across all of this, so we value curiosity and range over a perfect match to any single tool. This is a hands-on role. You will spend your time writing, reviewing, and shipping code, alongside your teammatesand in close partnership with the wider Autofill team. 

WHAT YOU WILL DO

- UI Automation: Build and maintain browser automation that checks autofill across popular real-world websites and purpose-built test pages. Keep suites stable as sites change, with reliable locators, sensible waits, and flakiness fixed at its root. 
 - Performance Testing: Run, extend, and maintain lab-based benchmarks that measure how autofill affects page responsiveness, rendering, and memory in the browser. Set up runs, review results, and investigate numbers that look wrong. 
 - Trustworthy Results: Make sure test and benchmark results can be relied on. Confirm that two runs did the same work before comparing them, and flag misleading metrics before anyone acts on them. 
 - Test Scenarios: Build and maintain test pages that recreate tricky real-world patterns, such as dynamic forms, shadow DOM, and iframes, so they can be tested repeatably. 
 - Failure Triage: Reproduce autofill failures found by automation, support, or internal reports. Document them clearly, hand dataset fixes to teammates, and route the rest to the right owner. 
 - Reporting and Observability: Publish results to dashboards, set up alerting on regressions, and report coverage and trends on a regular cadence. 
 - AI-Assisted Development: Use AI coding assistants effectively in daily engineering and exercise judgement about where they help and where they do not. Help keep test documentation and Claude skills current as new autofill code lands. 
 - Learning and Collaboration: Pair with senior engineers on hard problems, share what you learn, and review teammates' pull requests with care. 
 - Cross-Functional Partnership: Work closely with Software Engineer teammates, the Autofill team, Product, and Security on triage, test strategy, and release coordination. 

WHAT YOU BRING

- Overall Experience: 4-8 years in test automation, SDET, or software engineering roles, with hands-on UI automation of web applications and exposure to front-end performance testing. 
 - Technical Stack: We value strong automation fundamentals and a performance mindset over an exact tool match. Experience with load-testing tools such as JMeter or k6 is welcome, but this role centres on performance inside the browser. 
 - Expertise- UI automation with Playwright, Cypress, Selenium/WebDriver, or Puppeteer, including stable locators, waits, and handling flaky tests JavaScript or TypeScript, and Node. js HTML, the DOM, and CSS selectors Front-end performance testing with the Chrome DevTools Performance panel, Lighthouse, WebPageTest, or Core Web Vitals tooling
 - Experience- CI/CD with GitHub Actions, Jenkins, or similar, and running tests in Docker. Interpreting performance results: percentiles, variance, and comparing runs fairly Dashboards and alerting with Datadog, Grafana, New Relic, or similar. Data or API validation with JSON Schema, Postman, or similar AI-assisted development, preferably Claude Code
 - Familiarity- Chrome DevTools Protocol and browser Performance APIs (PerformanceObserver, Long Tasks, User Timing) Browser extensions and how they are tested (Manifest V3) Shell scripting
 - Engineering Mindset: Curious about why a test failed, not just that it failed. You treat a flaky test or a surprising number as something to understand rather than rerun until green, and you pick up new tools quickly. 
 - Practical experience with containerized environments, automated test frameworks (unit, integration, and end-to-end), CI/CD pipelines, and observability tooling. 
 - Secure Coding: Familiarity with secure coding practices and care in handling test credentials and sensitive data, with an interest in how security shapes product decisions in a zero-knowledge product. 
 - Collaborative Spirit: A highly collaborative and adaptable mindset, excited to work in rapid, outcome-driven feedback loops. 
 - Open Source Passion: Excitement and enthusiasm for open source, developer advocacy, and building a more secure internet. 
 - Problem-Solving: Excellent problem-solving skills, valuing written, clear documentation and using data to make technical decisions. 

Why Join Us

This is an opportunity to play a foundational role in shaping our India Engineering COE from the ground up. Our user community loves us and we love them. Come to work each day with a sense of purpose as we bring a more secure internet experience to everyone from our friends and family to the world's largest organizations. 

Become an expert. You'll get immersed in the prominent technology markets of security and open source software. You'll work alongside talented global teams, solve meaningful engineering challenges, influence how we scale our engineering organization & contribute to products used by customers around the world. 

If you're passionate about building exceptional teams, enabling engineering excellence, and making a lasting impact within a fast-growing engineering company, we'd love to hear from you. 

Equal Opportunity Employer

We are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace where everyone can do their best work. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and make employment decisions based on skills, experience, qualifications, and business needs.

Strong experience using AI tools to lead innovation initiatives. Education

Responsibilities

The Team Lead drives secure, scalable, and cost-efficient cloud and ML infrastructure while leading high-performing engineering teams aligned to Moody's strategic AI initiatives.

 - Design and oversee secure, scalable, high-performance, and cost-efficient AWS cloud and ML infrastructure, including EKS-based platforms supporting ML workloads, web applications, and high-frequency APIs

About The Team

Moody's Ratings' AI Analytics group develops advanced machine learning (ML) and generative AI solutions for high-profile data science initiatives. The successful candidate will strive to meet Moody's values: openness, diversity, inclusivity, respect, and a willingness to learn.

This includes giving candidates the ability to work on a real world application running on dedicated VMs with an online ADE built by HackerRank.  - Hire, mentor and grow engineers, and set clear career paths for each team member. 
 - Define how the team uses AI tools in development to improve quality and speed.

data.title: Specialist Software Engineer ( AI Architect , Developement )
data.description:
At NiCE, we don't limit our challenges. We challenge our limits. Always. We're ambitious. We're game changers. And we play to win. We set the highest standards and execute beyond them. And if you're like us, we can offer you the ultimate career opportunity that will light a fire within you. 

Senior Technical AI Architect & Builder (SPARK)

So, what's the role all about?

NiCE is building SPARK, a new internal incubation team that turns great ideas from across CX International into working AI solutions, and then into enterprise-grade tools that roll out to colleagues around the world. We are looking for the senior technical voice and hands-on builder at its core. 

As Senior Technical AI Architect & Builder, you will set the technical direction for SPARK and build alongside the team. You will advise on the tech stack, choose the patterns and tools we standardise on, and write the code for flagship prototypes yourself. You will also advise business and technology leaders on what is feasible, what is wise, and what to build next. 

This is a consultative and autonomous role. You are comfortable owning ambiguous problems end to end, making sound technical decisions with minimal supervision, and explaining your reasoning to engineers and executives alike. You will be the senior technical lead for the SPARK AI Architects & Builders. 

How will you make an impact?

You will own the technical architecture of SPARK and the quality of what it ships, from the first prototype to the enterprise-grade tool, working hands-on with the Technical AI Architect & Builder, the Business Analyst, and NiCE's platform, security, and architecture teams. 

Set Technical Direction

- Recommend and own the SPARK tech stack: models and providers, agent and orchestration frameworks, retrieval and vector storage, integration patterns, and developer tooling
 - Make build-versus-buy and platform-versus-custom decisions, and record them in clear architecture decision records
 - Define reference architectures and reusable patterns so every new idea starts from a paved path instead of a blank page
 - Track the fast-moving AI landscape and bring forward the models, tools, and protocols worth adopting
 - Ensure build allows tools to be migrated easily. 
 - Always ensure cost optimization is included into the design. 

Build Hands-On

- Design and build agentic AI solutions, including tool use, multi-step reasoning, memory, multi-agent coordination, and human-in-the-loop controls
 - Build RAG pipelines and integrations with enterprise systems such as Salesforce, ServiceNow, Workday, and Microsoft 365, using APIs and MCP
 - Ensure solution design incorporates NiCE guidelines on Ethics, Risk, compliance
 - Review data and infrastructure readiness of the solutions
 - Write clean, tested, documented code that others can pick up and extend
 - Turn ideas into working prototypes quickly, and into demonstrable value for the business teams who proposed them

Take Prototypes to Enterprise Grade

- Define what enterprise-grade means for SPARK: security, access control, privacy, reliability, scalability, observability, and cost
 - Harden prototypes for global rollout, including CI/CD, automated tests, evaluation pipelines, monitoring, and rollback
 - Establish LLM evaluation practices: test sets, regression tests, hallucination checks, and quality dashboards
 - Work with Security, Legal, and Architecture teams to embed responsible AI and data protection requirements into every design

Advise and Lead

- Act as trusted technical adviser to business teams, the Project Manager, and senior leaders on feasibility, trade-offs, effort, and risk
 - Review designs and code, mentor the Technical AI Architect & Builder, and raise the engineering bar across the team
 - Work with minimal supervision, flag risks early, and make good decisions when requirements are still moving
 - Collaborate with NiCE's internal/ external AI platform and architecture teams so SPARK solutions fit the wider enterprise AI strategy

Have you got what it takes?

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field (Master's preferred), or equivalent experience
 - 10+ years of software engineering experience, including 3+ years designing and delivering LLM-powered or agentic AI systems in production
 - Expert, hands-on skills in Python and/or TypeScript; you are still a developer who writes code every week
 - Deep experience with agent and orchestration frameworks (such as LangGraph, LangChain, AutoGen, or equivalent), tool-integration protocols such as MCP, and RAG architectures with vector databases
 - Strong working knowledge of LLM providers and APIs (Anthropic Claude, OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, Gemini, and open-source models), including prompt design, structured outputs, and evaluation
 - Experience with at least one major cloud AI ecosystem (Azure, AWS, or GCP) and with REST API, event-driven, and microservice design
 - Strong grasp of security, privacy, and responsible AI practices for enterprise systems
 - Proven ability to work independently, advise stakeholders, and own technical decisions in ambiguous situations
 - Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain complex AI concepts to executives and non-technical colleagues
 - Fluency in English

You will have an advantage if you also have: 

- Experience in an AI centre of excellence, innovation lab, or internal incubator
 - Experience with Cognigy, NiCE CXone, or other CCaaS and conversational AI platforms, including voice AI
 - Experience integrating with enterprise systems such as Salesforce, ServiceNow, Workday, Atlassian, and Microsoft 365
 - Experience with LLMOps: evaluation frameworks, observability (OpenTelemetry), prompt registries, and cost governance
 - Experience fine-tuning or evaluating open-source models
 - Experience with workflow applications such as N8N or similar
 - Have developed market ready software applications
 - Fluency in foreign language; German would be a plus, for close collaboration with Forward Deployment Cognigy team in Germany. 

What's in it for you?

SPARK is a chance to be a founding member of a brand-new team, and to shape how NiCE turns AI ideas into everyday tools used by colleagues around the world. 

Join an ever-growing, market-disrupting, global company where the teams, comprised of the best of the best, work in a fast-paced, collaborative, and creative environment! As the market leader, every day at NiCE is a chance to learn and grow, and there are endless internal career opportunities across multiple roles, disciplines, domains, and locations. If you are passionate about AI, innovative at heart, and excited to constantly raise the bar on what intelligent technology can do, you may just be our next NiCEr!

Enjoy NiCE-FLEX!

At NiCE, we work according to the NiCE-FLEX hybrid model, which enables maximum flexibility: 2 days working from the office and 3 days of remote work, each week. Naturally, office days focus on face-to-face meetings, where teamwork and collaborative thinking generate innovation, new ideas, and a vibrant, interactive atmosphere.

NICE Ltd. (NASDAQ: NICE) software products are used by 25, 000+ global businesses, including 85 of the Fortune 100 corporations, to deliver extraordinary customer experiences, fight financial crime and ensure public safety. Every day, NiCE software manages more than 120 million customer interactions and monitors 3+ billion financial transactions. 

Known as an innovation powerhouse that excels in AI, cloud and digital, NiCE is consistently recognized as the market leader in its domains, with over 8, 500 employees across 30+ countries. 

NiCE is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.

data.description:
Job Summary

We are looking for an experienced Lead Software Engineer to lead the design and development of scalable, secure, and highly available enterprise applications and middleware services and airline domain experience

The ideal candidate will have strong hands-on expertise in Java, Spring Boot, Microservices, REST APIs, Middleware/Integration technologies, and Google Cloud Platform (GCP). The role requires a combination of technical leadership, architecture/design ownership, hands-on development, troubleshooting, and mentoring. 

The engineer will work closely with architects, product owners, engineering teams, DevOps/SRE, and dependent systems to deliver reliable cloud-native solutions. 

Key Responsibilities

Technical Leadership & Architecture

- Lead technical design and implementation of Java/Spring Boot-based microservices and middleware applications. 
 - Translate business and functional requirements into scalable technical solutions using AI
 - Define service boundaries, API contracts, integration patterns, and application architecture. 
 - Conduct design and code reviews and establish engineering best practices. 
 - Evaluate technical trade-offs around scalability, performance, resiliency, maintainability, and cost. 
 - Provide technical direction to engineers and mentor junior and mid-level developers. 
 - Drive technical discussions across dependent application and platform teams. 

Java & Microservices AI Development

- Design and develop production-grade applications using Java 17/21, Spring Boot, Spring Framework, and Spring Cloud. 
 - Build and maintain RESTful APIs and event-driven services. 
 - Implement microservice patterns including: 
 - API Gateway
 - Circuit Breaker
 - Retry/Timeout
 - Service Discovery
 - Distributed configuration
 - Event-driven architecture
 - Idempotency
 - Caching
 - Distributed tracing
 - Apply appropriate design patterns and SOLID principles. 
 - Develop effective unit, integration, component, and contract tests using tools such as JUnit, Mockito, WireMock, and Testcontainers. 
Middleware & Integration

- Design integrations between enterprise applications using REST, JSON, XML, messaging, and event-driven patterns. 
 - Develop middleware services that transform, route, validate, and orchestrate requests across multiple systems. 
 - Work with technologies such as Kafka, Pub/Sub, JMS, API gateways, and service-to-service integrations. 
 - Handle high-volume synchronous and asynchronous transaction flows. 
 - Design appropriate error handling, retry, dead-letter, timeout, and recovery mechanisms. 
 - Troubleshoot complex issues across multiple applications and integration layers. 

GCP & Cloud-Native Engineering

- Design and deploy services on Google Cloud Platform (GCP). 
 - Hands-on experience with relevant GCP services such as: 
 - Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE)
 - Cloud Run
 - Pub/Sub
 - Cloud Storage
 - Cloud SQL
 - Secret Manager
 - IAM
 - Cloud Logging and Monitoring
 - Build containerized applications using Docker and Kubernetes. 
 - Implement secure workload identity, secrets management, and IAM-based access control. 
 - Design applications considering high availability, scalability, disaster recovery, and observability. 
DevOps, CI/CD & Observability

- Work with CI/CD pipelines using technologies such as GitHub Actions, Jenkins, GitLab CI, or equivalent. 
 - Implement automated build, test, security scanning, and deployment pipelines. 
 - Work with Infrastructure-as-Code solutions such as Terraform. 
 - Establish monitoring and observability using technologies such as OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Grafana, Splunk, or GCP Cloud Monitoring. 
 - Diagnose production problems using logs, metrics, traces, thread dumps, heap analysis, and application performance data. 

Engineering Quality & Security

- Ensure applications meet enterprise security and coding standards. 
 - Apply secure coding practices for APIs and microservices. 
 - Implement authentication and authorization using technologies such as OAuth 2. 0, OpenID Connect, JWT, and mTLS. 
 - Identify performance bottlenecks and drive application optimization. 
 - Ensure adequate automated test coverage and quality gates. 
 - Participate in production incident analysis and root-cause analysis. 

Experience

- 6+ years of software engineering experience, with substantial hands-on Java development. 
 - 4+ years working with Spring Boot and microservices architectures. 
 - Strong experience designing and developing enterprise middleware/integration solutions. 
 - Practical experience delivering applications on GCP or a comparable public-cloud platform, with hands-on GCP experience strongly preferred. 
 - Experience with distributed, high-volume, highly available systems. 
 - Prior experience functioning as a Technical Lead or Lead Engineer, including design/code reviews and mentoring. 
 - Experience taking services from design through development, testing, deployment, and production support. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience modernizing monolithic or legacy middleware applications into cloud-native microservices. 
 - Experience with API gateways and service mesh technologies such as Istio. 
 - Knowledge of asynchronous/event-driven architectures using Kafka or GCP Pub/Sub. 
 - Experience with performance engineering and JVM troubleshooting. 
 - Familiarity with 12-factor application principles and cloud-native application design. 
 - Experience working in Agile/Scrum engineering environments. 
 - GCP certification such as Professional Cloud Developer or Professional Cloud Architect is an advantage. 

Leadership Expectations

The Lead Software Engineer should remain strongly hands-on, rather than functioning only as a people or project lead. A reasonable expectation for the role is roughly 80% technical design/coding/review and 20% technical leadership, mentoring, cross-team coordination, and delivery ownership, depending on project phase. 

The Successful Candidate Should Be Able To

- Own a complex service or integration end-to-end. 
 - Break large requirements into implementable technical components. 
 - Guide engineers through complex design and production issues. 
 - Challenge designs constructively and propose practical alternatives. 
 - Communicate architectural decisions clearly to both engineering and non-engineering stakeholders. 
 - Drive technical issues to closure across multiple teams.

data.title: ASIC Physical Design, Manager
data.description:
Alternate Job Titles

- Physical Design Manager
 - ASIC PD Lead
 - Physical Implementation Manager
 - Backend Design Manager
 - Physical Design Engineering Manager

We Are

Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI-powered products. We deliver industry-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow. 

You Are

You have spent years in the trenches of ASIC physical design, and you know that tape out success is not about heroics at the end, it is about the flow you set up, the checks you automate, and the decisions you make when the schedule says one thing and the timing report says another. You have managed teams through multiple silicon cycles and learned that the best managers do not just delegate tasks, they clear blockers, teach judgment, and know when to dive into a floorplan yourself because it is faster than explaining it three times. 

You think in terms of flows, not just milestones. Setting up a robust RTL-to-GDSII methodology for a testchip team means anticipating where the pain will come from, whether that is a tricky timing path, a foundry DRC that changed mid-project, or a handoff that breaks because someone assumed too much. You are comfortable sitting with front-end designers to understand intent and then translating that into a physical implementation strategy that actually closes. 

Managing people energizes you. You hire well, you grow engineers into leads, and you know the difference between mentoring someone through a tough closure and doing it for them. At Synopsys, you will lead a team building testchips that prove out next-generation embedded memory IP, and what you deliver will directly enable customer products. 

What You'll Be Doing

- Lead a team of physical design engineers responsible for building and maintaining the complete PD flow and methodology for the Testchip team, from RTL handoff through GDSII delivery
 - Drive end-to-end execution of multiple testchip projects, managing timing closure, power optimization, and physical verification using tools like ICC2, Fusion Compiler, PrimeTime, and Calibre
 - Set up and continuously improve design automation flows across physical design stages, including scripting for repeatability, quality checks, and faster closure cycles
 - Collaborate with front-end design, silicon validation, and software teams to align on design intent, verify handoffs, and troubleshoot issues that span multiple domains
 - Manage project schedules, resource allocation, and risk mitigation to hit tape out dates while maintaining quality and design robustness
 - Serve as the technical point of contact for foundry interactions, translating foundry requirements into actionable design constraints and managing DRC/LVS closure
 - Mentor engineers on timing analysis, floorplanning, place and route strategies, and verification best practices, building depth and judgment across the team

The Impact You Will Have

- Deliver high-quality, high-performance testchips that validate Synopsys embedded memory IP and enable faster customer adoption of next-generation products
 - Accelerate time-to-market for Synopsys customers by ensuring robust, repeatable tape outs that meet performance, power, and area targets
 - Strengthen Synopsys technical reputation through successful project delivery, post-silicon support, and proactive customer engagement
 - Drive measurable improvements in physical design methodology, reducing closure time, improving PPA, and increasing automation across the testchip flow
 - Grow engineering talent within the organization by mentoring engineers into technical leads and building a culture of ownership and continuous learning
 - Influence future product direction by feeding silicon learnings back into IP development and strategic planning discussions
 - Build stronger foundry partnerships through technical collaboration, early engagement on process nodes, and clear communication during bring-up and debug

What You'll Need

- 8 to 14 years of hands-on experience in ASIC physical design, with at least 2 years leading teams or managing projects
 - Proven track record of multiple successful tape outs, ideally across different process nodes or design complexities
 - Deep expertise in physical design implementation, timing closure, power optimization, and physical verification using industry-standard EDA tools like Fusion Compiler, ICC2, PrimeTime, Tempus, Calibre, or equivalent
 - Strong understanding of the complete chip design flow from RTL to GDSII, including handoff points, verification stages, and common failure modes
 - Experience setting up design automation flows, scripting for physical design tasks, and improving methodology for timing closure and verification
 - Experience in front-end design or RTL methodologies is a significant plus and will help you bridge design intent with physical implementation
 - Demonstrated ability to manage people, projects, and cross-functional collaboration in a technical environment with competing priorities

Who You Are

- You lead by teaching, not just assigning. When an engineer is stuck on a timing path, you sit with them, walk through the analysis, and make sure they understand why the fix works, not just what to change
 - You communicate complex tradeoffs clearly. Whether it is explaining a floorplan decision to a front-end designer or a schedule risk to a program manager, you get to the point without losing the technical nuance
 - You are detail-oriented but not paralyzed by it. You know when to dig into a Calibre DRC violation yourself and when to trust your team to close it
 - You make decisions with incomplete information. Testchip schedules do not wait for perfect data, and you are comfortable making a call, documenting the rationale, and adjusting if new information changes the picture
 - You build teams that want to work with you. People stay on your projects because they learn, because you clear obstacles, and because you give credit where it belongs
 - You stay current. You know what is changing in physical design tools, foundry processes, and industry best practices, and you bring that knowledge back to improve how your team works

The Team You'll Be Part Of

Your recruiter will share more about the team structure and mission during the interview process. 

Rewards and Benefits

We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. Our total rewards include both monetary and non-monetary offerings. Your recruiter will provide more details about the salary range and benefits during the hiring process.

data.title: HMI Software Lead (VC++, MFC, WIN32, 6-10yrs)
data.description:
HMI Software Lead Developer- UAV Ground Control Systems (VC++, MFC, Win32)

Location: Hyderabad, India (Hybrid/On-site)

About the Role

We are seeking a highly technical and hands-on Software Lead to take ownership of our core Ground Control Station (GCS) and mission planning applications. In the mission-critical UAV sector, our ground control software acts as the central nervous system for flight operations, telemetry monitoring, and payload management. You will lead a dedicated engineering pod to architect, modernize, and scale our Windows-based applications, ensuring rock-solid reliability for complex flight profiles. 

What You Will Do

- Technical Leadership: Lead the architecture, design, and development of high-performance desktop applications used for UAV mission planning, live telemetry tracking, and payload control. 
 - Core Development: Write, review, and optimize complex multithreaded code using VC++, MFC, and Win32 APIs for Windows environments. 
 - Team Mentorship: Guide a team of software engineers, enforcing rigorous code quality, memory management practices, and peer review standards. 
 - Systems Integration: Interface ground software with UAV flight controllers and communication links using protocols like MAVLink, UDP/TCP, and custom serial interfaces. 
 - Safety & Compliance: Champion aerospace software standards (such as DO-178C guidelines where applicable) to ensure mission-critical reliability and fault tolerance. 
 - Legacy Modernization: Strategically decouple and refactor legacy MFC codebases into modular architectures to support future cross-platform or UI/UX scaling. 

What You Bring

- Experience: 6+ years of hands-on software development with a minimum of 2+ years in a technical leadership or team lead capacity. 
 - Core Stack: Deep, uncompromising expertise in C++, VC++, Microsoft Foundation Classes (MFC), and Win32 API. 
 - Concurrency: Strong command of multithreading, asynchronous I/O, IPC, and memory leak profiling in a Windows environment. 
 - Networking: Proven experience with network socket programming (TCP/UDP) for real-time, low-latency data streaming. 
 - Problem Solving: Exceptional debugging skills using Visual Studio tools, WinDbg, and performance profilers. 

Standout Qualifications (Nice to Have)

- Prior experience in the aerospace, defense, or UAV industry developing GCS or avionics software. 
 - Familiarity with geographic information systems (GIS), map rendering (GDAL, QtLocation), or 3D rendering (OpenGL/DirectX). 
 - Knowledge of aerospace safety-critical verification processes (DO-178C, DO-330). 

Why Join Us? You will be directly influencing the software that commands next-generation unmanned aerial systems. We offer a culture of high engineering rigor, competitive compensation, and the opportunity to build products that solve real-world logistical and defense challenges. 

How to Apply

Apply job here on LinkedIN. OR

Please send your resume to communications@qubistsolutions. com.

data.title: Senior Engineering Manager
data.description:
Senior Engineering Manager - Backend Engineering, Distributed Systems & AI

Location: Gurgaon

Experience: 11-15 Years

Function: Engineering / Technology

Role Overview

We are looking for a seasoned Engineering Manager - Backend Engineering & AI to lead the development and evolution of large-scale backend platforms and intelligent distributed systems. 

In this role, you will provide technical direction and engineering leadership to a high-performing team responsible for architecting, developing and scaling resilient backend services, cloud-native applications and event-driven systems. You will own the complete engineering lifecycle, from solution architecture and technical design to implementation, deployment and production excellence. 

The role demands a strong combination of architectural depth, technical expertise and people leadership. You will drive engineering excellence across microservices, distributed computing, asynchronous processing and cloud infrastructure, while identifying opportunities to leverage Generative AI, LLMs and agentic workflows to enhance platform capabilities, operational efficiency and engineering productivity. 

Working closely with Product, Architecture, Data, Platform and Operations teams, you will help shape a scalable, secure and reusable technology ecosystem, ensuring seamless integration with shared enterprise platform capabilities. 

Key Responsibilities

1. Engineering Leadership & Platform Ownership

- Lead, mentor and scale a high-performing backend engineering team, building a culture of technical excellence, accountability and ownership. 
 - Drive end-to-end engineering execution across architecture, development, testing, deployment and production support. 
 - Establish engineering roadmaps, technical priorities and delivery practices aligned with product and business objectives. 
 - Build reusable backend components, services and platform capabilities to accelerate product development. 2. Backend Architecture & Distributed Systems

- Drive the design and implementation of scalable microservices, distributed applications, RESTful APIs and asynchronous processing frameworks. 
 - Define architectural patterns for event-driven systems, service communication, data consistency and distributed transaction management. 
 - Ensure systems are designed for high availability, fault tolerance, scalability, low latency and high-throughput processing. 
 - Establish robust mechanisms for idempotency, retries, event ordering, duplicate prevention, failure recovery and data integrity. 
 - Drive architectural reviews and technical decision-making, ensuring solutions remain scalable, maintainable and cost-effective. 3. Cloud-Native Engineering & Technical Excellence

- Lead the development and deployment of cloud-native applications using AWS services, containerisation and modern infrastructure practices. 
 - Drive engineering standards across CI/CD, automated testing, Infrastructure as Code, application security and observability. 
 - Improve system performance through capacity planning, performance benchmarking, load testing and infrastructure optimisation. 
 - Establish strong production engineering practices covering monitoring, incident management, root-cause analysis and service reliability. 
 - Optimise cloud infrastructure and operational expenditure while maintaining performance and availability commitments. 4. AI Integration & Intelligent Engineering

- Identify and implement opportunities to integrate Generative AI, LLMs and AI-powered automation into platform workflows and engineering processes. 
 - Drive practical adoption of agentic AI patterns, intelligent orchestration and AI-enabled automation where they create measurable business value. 
 - Explore and implement LLM integrations using platforms such as AWS Bedrock, Vertex AI or equivalent technologies. 
 - Encourage AI-assisted software development, automated testing, developer productivity and intelligent operational workflows. 
 - Ensure AI-enabled capabilities are built with appropriate considerations for scalability, security, reliability and governance. 5. Cross-Functional Collaboration & Stakeholder Management

- Collaborate with Product Management, Enterprise Architecture, Data Engineering, Platform Engineering, Security and Operations teams. 
 - Translate complex business requirements into scalable technical solutions and engineering execution plans. 
 - Drive alignment across teams on architecture, technical dependencies, integration contracts and delivery commitments. 
 - Promote the adoption of shared data products and platform services, minimising redundant implementations. 
 - Communicate technical strategies, architectural decisions, delivery risks and engineering outcomes to senior stakeholders. 6. People Development & Engineering Culture

- Develop engineering talent through coaching, technical mentoring and structured performance management. 
 - Build strong technical leadership within the team by developing senior engineers and future engineering leaders. 
 - Establish clear ownership models, engineering accountability and predictable delivery processes. 
 - Foster a culture of continuous learning, innovation, collaboration and operational excellence. Required Technical Expertise

Backend Engineering & Programming

- Strong proficiency in Java and/or Python, with extensive experience building enterprise-grade backend applications. 
 - Deep understanding of object-oriented programming, concurrency, multithreading, asynchronous processing and API development. 
 - Strong experience designing microservices-based architectures, REST APIs and distributed applications. Distributed Systems & Event-Driven Architecture

- Extensive experience with distributed systems, messaging frameworks and event-driven architecture. 
 - Strong hands-on exposure to Apache Kafka or equivalent messaging technologies. 
 - Understanding of event streaming, message delivery semantics, schema evolution, event replay and failure recovery. 
 - Strong knowledge of caching, database optimisation, data consistency, fault tolerance and distributed processing. Cloud & DevOps

- Strong experience with AWS cloud services and cloud-native application development. 
 - Exposure to containerisation and orchestration technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes. 
 - Experience with CI/CD pipelines, Infrastructure as Code, automated deployments and production monitoring. 
 - Knowledge of cloud security, system observability and infrastructure optimisation. Database & Data Engineering

- Strong understanding of relational and NoSQL databases, data modelling and query optimisation. 
 - Experience with high-volume data processing and integration with enterprise data platforms. 
 - Exposure to BigQuery, Apache Spark, data contracts and schema governance will be advantageous. AI & Emerging Technologies

- Practical experience integrating LLMs and Generative AI capabilities into enterprise applications. 
 - Understanding of RAG architectures, AI orchestration frameworks, intelligent automation and agentic AI patterns. 
 - Exposure to AWS Bedrock, Google Vertex AI or similar AI platforms. 
 - Familiarity with AI-assisted development tools and engineering productivity solutions. Leadership & Experience Requirements

- 11-15 years of overall software engineering experience, with substantial experience in backend engineering and distributed systems. 
 - Demonstrated experience leading engineering teams, preferably in product engineering, enterprise platforms or large-scale technology environments. 
 - Strong technical foundation with the ability to drive architecture discussions and challenge complex engineering decisions. 
 - Proven track record of delivering highly scalable, business-critical backend platforms and production-grade applications. 
 - Experience managing engineering delivery, technical roadmaps, stakeholder expectations and cross-functional dependencies. 
 - Ability to balance hands-on technical involvement with people leadership and strategic engineering responsibilities. 
 - Excellent communication, problem-solving and stakeholder management skills. What Success Looks Like

- Building and scaling reliable, high-performance backend services for large-scale enterprise platforms. 
 - Establishing robust distributed architectures capable of handling complex, high-volume business workflows. 
 - Improving engineering productivity, deployment efficiency and production reliability. 
 - Accelerating adoption of AI-enabled capabilities with measurable business and operational impact. 
 - Developing a strong engineering team with clear technical ownership and sustainable delivery practices. Ideal Candidate Profile: An engineering leader who combines strong backend architecture expertise, distributed systems experience, cloud-native engineering capabilities and a forward-looking approach to AI adoption, with the ability to build and lead high-performing engineering teams.

Netskope (NASDAQ: NTSK) is a leader in modern security and networking for the cloud and AI era. We secure and accelerate cloud, data, and AI in real time, everywhere. Thousands of customers, including more than 30 of the Fortune 100, trust the Netskope One platform, its Zero Trust Engine, and the powerful NewEdge network to gain full visibility and control without performance trade-offs. 

At Netskope, our technology is driven by our greatest strength: our people. We believe that belonging powers innovation, and success is both personal and organizational. We embrace differences in gender, ethnicity, beliefs, ability, and identity, creating an environment where every voice is heard and respected. We empower our employees to bring their authentic selves to work, grow their careers through continuous education and mentorship, and lead with transparency and curiosity. Join a team where you belong, where you are encouraged to be an entrepreneur, and where together, we continue to redefine the landscape of security. 

Visit Careers at Netskope to learn more. Follow us on LinkedIn and Instagram. 

About The Role

Please note, this team is hiring across multiple levels and candidates are individually assessed and appropriately leveled based upon their skills and experience. 

The Netskope Data Security team is focused on providing unrivaled visibility and real-time data protection. Our products ensure that customers' data is protected wherever it lives. Our engineers design and deliver the next generation of highly scalable, effective, and high-performance data loss prevention solutions. You will have the opportunity to build best-in-class data security solutions using technologies including advanced algorithms, ML-based models, and AI-assisted development, while working with a talented and experienced team of software engineers in a dynamic and collaborative environment. 

What's In It For You

We are looking for software engineers who are passionate about developing cutting-edge software in C++, Golang, and Python. As a Principal Engineer on the Netskope Data Security team, you will provide technical leadership and design and deliver highly effective, scalable, and high-performance software solutions for the next generation of content inspection and data protection. 

What You Will Be Doing

- Developing software in C++, C, Golang, and Python. 
 - Architecting, designing, and developing systems as part of the data security services offering. 
 - Providing technical leadership for complex projects and driving solutions across multiple components. 
 - Using ML models and advanced data structures and algorithms to solve challenging problems. 
 - Using AI tools to assist with designing, building, testing, debugging, and troubleshooting software. 
 - Delivering solutions that prevent loss of sensitive or confidential data through deep content inspection. 
 - Developing highly scalable and high-performance software solutions. 
 - Mentoring engineers and helping drive engineering best practices across the team. 

Required Skills And Experience

- 12+ years of industry experience building high-performance, scalable, and secure dataplane services. 
 - Programming mastery of C++ with experience in Golang, Python, and C. 
 - Strong understanding of computer architecture, including multithreading, CPU scheduling, and memory management. 
 - Solid understanding of algorithms and data structures used in real-time inline data processing. 
 - Experience and knowledge of TCP, SSL/TLS, HTTP, SMTP, and REST services. 
 - Passion and hands-on experience developing data security solutions. 
 - Hands-on experience using AI-assisted engineering tools for designing, building, debugging, testing, and troubleshooting software. 
 - Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills using debuggers such as gdb and tools such as Valgrind. 
 - Experience with Docker and Kubernetes. 
 - Experience developing and deploying software to GCP, AWS, or Azure. 
 - Experience with CI/CD using tools such as Drone, Jenkins, or similar technologies. 
 - Knowledge of and solid experience with Linux, Windows, and/or macOS. 
 - Strong verbal and written communication skills. 
 - Demonstrated ability to provide technical leadership, mentor engineers, and drive complex technical initiatives. 
 - Innovative and out-of-the-box thinking to solve challenging problems. 

Education

- BSCS or equivalent required, MSCS or equivalent strongly preferred.

Netskope does not discriminate in employment opportunities or practices based on religion, race, color, sex, marital or veteran statues, age, national origin, ancestry, physical or mental disability, medical condition, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, genetic information, pregnancy (including childbirth, lactation and related medical conditions), or any other characteristic protected by the laws or regulations of any jurisdiction in which we operate.

data.title: Software Engineer, Platforms
data.description:
We are WisdomAI. 

We exist to help people unlock clarity from complexity. 

WisdomAI builds AI-powered analytics that put answers directly in the hands of the people closest to the business. Our platform doesn't just surface insights - it explains the why behind them, helping teams move from data to decisions with speed, confidence, and context. 

We're trusted by companies like Cisco, Patreon, and Rubrik - and we're just getting started. The problems here are hard, and the expectations are high. Our team is energized by both. If you're compelled by ambitious problems, high standards, and meaningful ownership, you'll thrive here. 

Role

We are looking for a backend/infrastructure engineer to join our founding team. We are working on building ML and data pipelines, which can be efficient, secure and highly scalable by design. As a platforms engineer you will be working on the deployments, observability and other aspects for scaling the production environment with customers. 

What You'll Do

Wisdom is at an inflection point, with strong product market fit and the traction of Fortune 100 customers. We are looking for an early-stage engineer to build out the deployment, observability, and scaling of our growing production environments. You will work closely with experienced members of the team and customers to build systems to surpass the bottleneck of onboarding customers of any shape and size. 

Job Responsibilities

- Owning the observability and deployments of Wisdom stack. 
 - Working with other software engineers and sales engineers to build the right processes and tooling for production change management. 
 - Work with modern cloud infrastructure to build cost efficient and scalable systems. 
 - Work closely with customers and founders to define the product and engineering roadmap. 
 - Shape up the engineering culture and tech stack for the company. 

Qualifications

- Experience building highly available and scalable cloud infrastructure. 
 - Experience with Kubernetes/Terraform/Python. 
 - Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science or related field. 
 - Experience working in startup/fast paced teams is highly desirable. 

Our CRAFT

CRAFT isn't a list of aspirational values. It's how we hire, how we promote, how we resolve hard calls, and how we stay honest with ourselves. 

C - Customer trust. Everything starts here. We listen carefully, act with integrity, and respond with urgency. Delight is downstream of trust - never the other way around. 

R - Relentless on outcomes. We move with urgency, take initiative, and see things through. Effort isn't the measure - results are. If something isn't working, we change the approach now. 

A - Authenticity. We say the hard things, directly and with respect. We also show up as full humans. That combination is how trust is earned and how we grow together. 

F - First principles, grounded in reality. We don't accept "that's how it's done. " We strip problems to what's actually true and build up from there - then validate quickly and let real-world results decide. 

T - Transparency. We share the why, not just the what. When something can't be shared, we say so. We're one team - information flows so we can do our best work and challenge each other when we're wrong. 

Equal opportunity employer

WisdomAI is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. We are committed to building a diverse, inclusive team where everyone can do their best work.

Responsibilities

- Design, deploy, and operate reliable and scalable systems across cloud and Kubernetes environments.

- Monitor system health and performance, and proactively identify areas for improvement. 

- Troubleshoot and resolve issues across development, test, and production environments. 

- Participate in incident response, root cause analysis, and reliability improvements. 

- Collaborate with engineering teams to improve system operability and deployment safety.

- 1-3 years of experience managing and operating production infrastructure and services in cloud environments such as AWS, Azure, or GCP.

- Experience working with containerized workloads and Kubernetes in real-world scenarios.

- Experience participating in on-call rotations, responding to production incidents, and performing root cause analysis.

- Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to debug complex production issues.

Nice to Have

- Experience operating systems at scale or in high-availability environments. 

- Exposure to on-prem or hybrid infrastructure. 

- Experience supporting data platforms, analytics, or AI/ML workloads. 

What We Value

- A focus on automation, reliability, and operational simplicity.

Mindset & Collaboration: 

- Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills with a proactive, systems-thinking mindset.

 - A collaborative team player who can influence, mentor, and lead through technical expertise.

data.description:
You will be writing real code, contribute to architecture decisions, and work closely with product, legal, and identity engineers to turn regulatory requirements into robust, maintainable systems. 

Responsibilities

- Design, build, and maintain consent UIs and preference centres - from custom OneTrust templates to fully bespoke web components when the platform doesn't cut it. 
 - Develop and maintain JavaScript/TypeScript SDKs and scripts for consent collection, propagation, and enforcement across web properties. 
 - Collaborate with identity engineers to align consent signals with user profiles and authentication flows. 
 - Contribute to the full delivery pipeline: local dev → SIT → UAT → production, including CI/CD hooks and automated testing for consent flows. 
 - Translate regulatory requirements (GDPR, CCPA/CPRA) into concrete technical specifications - working alongside legal and privacy teams, not waiting for them to hand you a ticket. 
 - Write clean functional and technical documentation: architecture decisions, API contracts, runbooks, and integration guides. 
 - Debug and resolve consent-related defects across the stack - from a misconfigured collection point to a broken SDK event. 

Requirements

- Strong front-end engineering skills: JavaScript/TypeScript (React/Vue), Node. js, HTML, CSS
 - Hands-on experience with the OneTrust platform (not a must), specifically the UCPM / Consent & Preference Management module - configuring templates, forms, consent attributes, and workflows. 
 - Experience consuming and integrating REST APIs; bonus if you've worked with OneTrust's own API surface. 
 - Familiarity with event-driven patterns for propagating consent signals across services (webhooks, queues, or event streams). 
 - Comfortable working across the stack - from crafting a consent banner interaction to wiring up a backend integration. 

Nice to have

- Experience with identity platforms (Auth0 / Okta CIC) and how consent integrates with CIAM flows. 
 - Familiarity with Java - part of our current backend stack is Java-based, and occasional cross-team collaboration may touch it. 
 - Experience with multi-region consent implementations across different regulatory jurisdictions. 
 - Familiarity with data governance concepts: data mapping, RoPAs, data inventories. 
 - Prior experience with a CDP or CRM platform (Salesforce, Segment, mParticle) from an integration standpoint

We offer

- Opportunity to work on bleeding-edge projects
 - Work with a highly motivated and dedicated team
 - Competitive salary
 - Flexible schedule
 - Benefits package - medical insurance, sports
 - Corporate social events
 - Professional development opportunities
 - Well-equipped office

About Us

Grid Dynamics (NASDAQ: GDYN) is a leading provider of technology consulting, platform and product engineering, AI, and advanced analytics services. Fusing technical vision with business acumen, we solve the most pressing technical challenges and enable positive business outcomes for enterprise companies undergoing business transformation. A key differentiator for Grid Dynamics is our 8 years of experience and leadership in enterprise AI, supported by profound expertise and ongoing investment in data, analytics, cloud & DevOps, application modernization and customer experience. Founded in 2006, Grid Dynamics is headquartered in Silicon Valley with offices across the Americas, Europe, and India.

data.title: Senior Software Engineer — Infra Agent Systems Remote
data.description:
About The Role

Together AI runs one of the largest GPU fleets in the world. The Infra Agent Systems team builds the software systems that power and automate that infrastructure. 

We develop production AI agents that diagnose hardware failures, investigate incidents, correlate signals across the fleet, and automate operational workflows. Alongside these agents, we build the platform they run on, including knowledge graphs, retrieval systems, orchestration frameworks, and developer tooling. 

You'll Work Across Two Areas

Infrastructure Agent Systems - Build production AI agents that help operate our GPU fleet by diagnosing failures, investigating incidents, gathering evidence from live systems, and assisting with remediation. These agents are used every day by our infrastructure and datacenter teams through APIs, CLI, dashboards, and Slack. 

Core Agent Platform - Build the platform that powers these agents, including knowledge graphs, search and retrieval, orchestration, evaluation, and the tooling that enables agents to reason, act, and continuously improve. 

We're working on something that hasn't really been done before: building knowledge graphs and self-improving AI agents that understand, operate, and continuously improve large-scale AI infrastructure. 

This is an opportunity to work at the intersection of AI agents, distributed systems, infrastructure, and automation, solving challenging engineering problems with real production impact. There's an enormous amount to build, learn, and shape as we define the future of autonomous infrastructure. 

responsible for delivering the software but also for operating and supporting it in production. 

Why this Role

You'll work on two hard problems at the same time: making AI agents trustworthy enough to operate production infrastructure, and building the knowledge, retrieval, and distributed systems that make those agents effective. 

You'll have the opportunity to build foundational systems from the ground up, work on infrastructure at massive scale, and help define how self-improving AI agents operate real-world AI infrastructure. 

Remote based in India

Responsibilities

 - Build the distributed services, orchestration framework, knowledge graph, and retrieval systems that power infrastructure agents.

 - Integrate with observability, incident management, ticketing, fleet inventory, source control, chat, and internal infrastructure systems through well-designed APIs.

 - Improve agent performance through evaluations, retrieval improvements, better tools, and production feedback loops. 
 - Turn what agents learn in production into reliable, reviewed software and automation. 

Requirements

- 5+ years of experience building production backend systems, distributed systems, or infrastructure platforms. 
 - Strong systems design skills and experience owning significant systems from design through production. 
 - Depth in at least one of the following: 
 - AI agent systems, orchestration, tool use, evaluation, or grounding

 - Comfortable working across languages such as Go, TypeScript, Python, or Rust.

- GPU infrastructure, datacenters, bare-metal systems, hardware failure modes, BMC/IPMI, or cluster schedulers

data.title: Senior Director, Manufacturing Software Engineering
data.description:
About Lumilens

At Lumilens, we're building the photonics infrastructure powering tomorrow's AI supercomputing. From chip-to-chip optical interconnects to scalable photonic engines, Lumilens is unlocking a new era of computing: faster, cooler, and massively more efficient. 

We are a well-funded startup backed by Mayfield and led by technology veterans. This is a ground-floor opportunity to rethink the optical layer from the silicon up. You'll join a team of world-class engineers tackling the hardest challenges in optics, systems, and scale. If you're looking for mission, momentum, and a chance to make a major impact, jump on the rocket ship-we're just getting started. 

Position Overview

Lumilens is seeking a Senior Director of Manufacturing Software Engineering to lead the strategy, development, and execution of software systems enabling high-volume manufacturing of next-generation optical transceivers (800G, 1. 6T, and beyond). You will build and scale manufacturing software infrastructure that drives yield, test, calibration, and production efficiency for our photonics manufacturing ecosystem. 

This is a critical leadership role at the intersection of software, manufacturing, and hardware systems. You will define and implement frameworks supporting end-to-end production-from wafer-level test and module assembly to system validation-ensuring high yield, reliability, and throughput at scale. 

The ideal candidate has deep experience in manufacturing software, test automation, and production systems in semiconductor, optical transceiver, or high-performance hardware environments, with a strong record supporting hyperscale customer deployments. 

Key Responsibilities

Manufacturing Software Strategy & Execution

- Define and lead the software roadmap for manufacturing systems supporting optical transceivers and photonic devices
 - Architect scalable test, calibration, and data infrastructure for new product introduction (NPI) and high-volume manufacturing (HVM)
 - Drive software solutions for wafer probe, module test, system-level validation, and final test
 - Ensure seamless integration with MES systems and factory automation platforms

Yield, Test & Production Optimization

- Develop software frameworks to improve yield, throughput, and cycle time across manufacturing lines
 - Lead implementation of data-driven yield analysis, failure detection, and root cause methodologies
 - Build and deploy automated test and calibration systems for optical modules, including DSP tuning and optical alignment
 - Partner with manufacturing and quality teams to reduce escapes, improve reliability, and optimize cost

Hyperscaler & Production Readiness

- Ensure manufacturing software meets the scale, quality, and traceability requirements of hyperscale customers
 - Support customer qualifications, audits, and production ramp readiness
 - Implement robust telemetry, logging, and traceability systems
 - Drive alignment between internal manufacturing systems and customer validation environments

Cross-Functional Leadership

- Partner closely with photonics, ASIC, hardware, systems, and operations teams to enable manufacturable product designs
 - Support NPI to HVM transitions with robust, production-ready software systems
 - Interface with foundries, OSATs, and contract manufacturers to standardize test and software infrastructure
 - Collaborate with supply chain and operations to ensure capacity and scalability

Organizational Leadership & Team Building

- Build, lead, and scale a high-performing software manufacturing and test engineering team
 - Establish best practices in software development, release management, and manufacturing deployment
 - Drive a culture of operational excellence, accountability, and continuous improvement
 - Mentor engineers across software, test, and manufacturing domains

Required Qualifications

- Bachelor's or advanced degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or related field
 - 15+ years of experience in software engineering with significant focus on manufacturing, test, or production systems
 - 5+ years of leadership experience managing engineering teams
 - Strong background in manufacturing software, test automation, and production systems for semiconductor, photonics, or hardware products
 - Proven experience supporting NPI to HVM, including yield ramp and production scaling
 - Experience working with contract manufacturers, OSATs, and/or global manufacturing partners
 - Strong programming experience (Python, C/C++, or similar) for automation, test, and data systems
 - Deep understanding of manufacturing KPIs: yield, throughput, cycle time, cost, and quality
 - Experience with MES systems, data pipelines, and manufacturing analytics

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with optical transceivers (QSFP, QSFP-DD, OSFP) and high-speed modules (400G, 800G, 1. 6T)
 - Background in silicon photonics, advanced packaging, or optical module manufacturing
 - Experience building factory automation systems and test infrastructure at scale
 - Familiarity with DSP-based systems, calibration flows, and optical performance tuning
 - Experience supporting hyperscalers or Tier 1 data center customers
 - Experience in fast-paced startup or high-growth environments

What we offer

- Competitive executive-level compensation, including meaningful equity participation
 - Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance
 - Opportunity to build and lead a critical engineering function at a rapidly scaling photonics company
 - Direct impact on next-generation AI and hyperscale infrastructure
 - Collaborative environment with world-class photonics and systems engineers
