data.title: Engineer/Senior Engineer - Building Automation, ELV/ICT
data.description:
The Team

Cundall is an award-winning global, multi-disciplinary consultancy with a strong and growing presence across the Asia-Pacific region. Our leadership in sustainable business was recognized when Cundall received the World Green Building Council's 2020 Business Leadership in Sustainability Award for the APAC region, reflecting our commitment to embedding sustainability into the way we work and the outcomes we deliver for the built environment. 

Sustainability underpins everything we do. We empower our people to drive positive change, decarbonize the built environment and create energy-efficient, resilient and climate-responsive buildings and communities. 

Our Building Services team delivers integrated, resilient and technology-led solutions for complex buildings and infrastructure. Our Building Automation, ELV and ICT specialists work across commercial, mission-critical, healthcare, hospitality and mixed-use developments, combining controls and systems-integration expertise with a practical understanding of construction, commissioning and building operations. 

The Role

This is an excellent opportunity for a Building Automation and ELV/ICT Engineer or Senior Engineer to join our Chennai office and contribute to projects across India, the Middle East and the wider Asia-Pacific region. 

We are seeking an engineer with strong consultancy design experience in Building Management Systems (BMS), building automation and controls, supported by capability in Extra-Low Voltage (ELV), Information and Communications Technology (ICT) and electronic security systems. 

The successful candidate will lead or develop coordinated controls and ELV designs from concept through construction and commissioning for commercial buildings, data centres and other complex facilities. 

The role requires confident engagement with clients, architects, MEP engineers, contractors, controls specialists, system integrators and vendors, together with sound engineering judgement and strong technical documentation, coordination and communication skills. 

Key Responsibilities

- Develop Building Management System and building automation designs, including controls philosophies, points schedules, sequences of operation, system architectures, network topologies, plant schematics, control-panel requirements, integration matrices and performance specifications. 
 - Design and coordinate controls for HVAC, central utility plants, electrical monitoring, energy metering, lighting and other building systems, with particular emphasis on mission-critical facilities and data centres. 
 - Define interfaces and data exchange between BMS, SCADA, EPMS, fire alarm, security, lighting control, lifts, packaged plant and other third-party systems using appropriate open protocols. 
 - Design ELV and ICT systems, including fire detection and alarm, voice evacuation/public address, CCTV, access control, intrusion detection, structured cabling, LAN/Wi-Fi infrastructure, intercom, and other specialist systems as applicable. 
 - Prepare design criteria, layouts, schematics, calculations, technical specifications, equipment schedules, bills of quantities, cost inputs and tender documentation. 
 - Coordinate automation and ELV requirements with architectural, electrical, mechanical, fire-and-life-safety, security, IT and structural disciplines, including sensors, control devices, panels, power supplies, containment, network infrastructure and equipment-space requirements. 
 - Review vendor submissions, shop drawings, control schematics, software and graphics proposals, material submittals, method statements and technical deviations for compliance with the design intent and project requirements. 
 - Support tender evaluations, value engineering, technical clarifications and assessments of controls contractors, OEMs and system integrators. 
 - Contribute to BIM-led coordination and work effectively with Revit and CAD technicians to deliver accurate, coordinated drawings and models. 
 - Manage assigned deliverables, budgets and programmes across multiple projects while maintaining Cundall's quality and safety expectations. 

The Skills

Qualifications and Experience: 

- Bachelor's degree or diploma in Electrical, Electronics, Electronics and Communication, Instrumentation, Controls, Mechatronics, Telecommunications or a related engineering discipline. 
 - Typically 4-8 years of relevant consultancy or design experience for Engineer/Senior Engineer level, with demonstrable building automation or BMS experience; candidates with stronger leadership experience may be considered for a more senior position. 
 - Proven experience developing BMS controls philosophies, points schedules, sequences of operation, system architectures, integration requirements and commissioning documentation is essential. 
 - Experience producing coordinated Building Automation and ELV/ICT designs for commercial, data centre, healthcare, hospitality, industrial or large infrastructure projects. 
 - Proficiency in AutoCAD is essential; working knowledge of Revit, Navisworks and BIM coordination workflows is strongly preferred. 
 - Ability to develop technical specifications, BOQs, design reports, calculations, schematics and tender packages with limited supervision. 
 - Experience coordinating with clients, architects, MEP consultants, contractors, OEMs, controls specialists and system integrators. 
 - Familiarity with applicable Indian codes and approvals, including NBC requirements, relevant BIS/IS standards and local fire-authority expectations, together with commonly used international standards. 
 - Relevant certifications or training in BMS platforms, Niagara Framework, networking, RCDD, CCNA/CCNP or security systems are advantageous but not mandatory. 

Technical Knowledge And Personal Attributes

- Strong technical knowledge of BMS, HVAC controls, direct digital control, instrumentation, control panels, field devices, plant optimisation and energy-management strategies. 
 - Ability to write clear and technically robust sequences of operation for air-side, water-side, electrical and mission-critical systems, including normal, failure, standby and recovery modes. 
 - Knowledge of BACnet, Modbus, KNX, LonWorks, MQTT, OPC and common API or gateway-based integration approaches, including network architecture, interoperability and cybersecurity considerations. 
 - Understanding of BMS, SCADA and EPMS boundaries, high-level interfaces, alarm management, trending, graphics, reporting, analytics and data-centre monitoring requirements. 
 - Strong knowledge of IP-based CCTV, video management systems, access control, intrusion detection, fire detection and alarm, VESDA, public address/voice evacuation and structured cabling systems. 
 - Understanding of copper and fibre cabling, equipment-room planning, racks, pathways, containment, power supplies and resilience requirements. 
 - Working knowledge of TCP/IP networking, VLANs, PoE, switches, servers, storage, virtualisation and cybersecurity principles relevant to connected building systems. 
 - Awareness of relevant BIS/IS, NBC, ECBC, ASHRAE, CIBSE, ISO/IEC, TIA/EIA, NFPA and BS/EN requirements commonly referenced on Indian and international projects. 
 - Clear written and verbal communication in English; additional Indian language capability is welcome. 
 - Strong analytical, organisational and problem-solving skills, with attention to detail and a collaborative approach. 
 - Ability to manage competing priorities, work independently when required and travel to project sites within India or internationally. 

If you are motivated by technically challenging projects and want to develop high-performance Building Automation solutions integrated with ELV and ICT systems for the buildings of the future, this could be the role for you. 

Job Description

Your career at Cundall

We know that to be the best at what we do we need a diverse workforce underpinned by an inclusive culture. Creating environments where everyone can find joy doing their best work is also great for everyone. That's why we positively welcome applications from people of all backgrounds and identities, and encourage, support, and celebrate the diverse voices of our people.

If you are passionate about industrial automation, PLC software development, and delivering advanced control systems for large-scale automation projects, this could be the ideal opportunity for you.

As a Senior Controls Engineer, you will lead the design, development, testing, and commissioning of Low-Level Controls (LLC) software for medium to large-scale automation systems. You will work closely with cross-functional engineering teams to deliver high-quality control solutions using Siemens PLC technologies while ensuring compliance with engineering standards and project timelines. 

Join our Controls Engineering team and contribute to the development of world-class automation solutions powering airports, warehouses, and parcel logistics systems across the globe. 

What You Will Do/Key Responsibilities

- Lead the design and development of LLC software using Siemens TIA Portal and Vanderlande's controls architecture. 
 - Develop PLC applications from scratch using Statement List (STL) programming. 
 - Design, configure, program, test, and document complex control applications and subsystems. 
 - Develop reusable control modules and enhance standard PLC software libraries. 
 - Create functional specifications and detailed technical documentation based on customer requirements. 
 - Apply engineering standards, software development procedures, and quality guidelines throughout the project lifecycle. 
 - Lead system integration, validation, and testing activities involving PLC, SCADA, Safety PLC, and Equipment Management systems. 
 - Develop diagnostic, simulation, and emulation tools to improve testing and commissioning efficiency. 
 - Independently manage commissioning activities in collaboration with site supervisors and project leaders. 
 - Ensure complete and high-quality Service Take Over (STO) documentation.

data.title: Systems Integration Specialist Advisor
data.description:
Req ID: 393282

NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward-thinking organization, apply now. 

We are currently seeking a Systems Integration Specialist Advisor to join our team in Noida, Uttar Pradesh (IN-UP), India (IN). 

The role requires strong expertise in API testing, automation framework architecture, microservices validation, integration testing, service virtualization, performance, security, and AI-enabled Quality Engineering. 

This is a senior customer-facing technical role responsible for assessing API landscapes, defining testing solutions, building reusable automation approaches, and guiding QA teams through implementation. 

Key Responsibilities

- Own the end-to-end API testing architecture and solutioning strategy across enterprise applications. 
 - Understand business and technical architecture and translate it into a comprehensive API Quality Engineering strategy. 
 - Define API testing approaches covering functional, integration, end-to-end, regression, negative, security, performance, and resiliency testing. 
 - Design scalable and reusable API automation frameworks for REST, SOAP, GraphQL, and microservices. 
 - Define automation solutions using tools/frameworks such as REST Assured, Karate, Postman/Newman, Python/PyTest, Java, ReadyAPI/SoapUI, or equivalent. 
 - Architect testing solutions for complex microservices and distributed API ecosystems. 
 - Define API validation strategies across UI → API → Microservices → Database → Downstream systems. 
 - Establish contract testing strategies using tools such as Pact and consumer/provider contract validation. 
 - Define testing approaches for synchronous and asynchronous APIs, including Kafka/event-driven architectures and messaging systems. 
 - Design service virtualization/mocking solutions where dependent APIs or downstream systems are unavailable. 
 - Define API test data management and synthetic data generation approaches. 
 - Establish API automation integration with CI/CD pipelines to enable continuous testing and quality gates. 
 - Define API performance and scalability testing approaches using tools such as JMeter, Gatling, K6, or equivalent. 
 - Establish API security validation covering authentication, authorization, OAuth 2. 0, JWT, API keys, data protection, and common API vulnerabilities. 
 - Define automation coverage, quality metrics, defect prevention strategies, and release-readiness criteria. 
 - Review existing QA frameworks and recommend modernization and automation improvements. 
 - Identify opportunities to use AI/GenAI in API testing, including test scenario generation, test data generation, automation script generation, defect analysis, and test optimization. 
 - Conduct PoCs and evaluate new QE tools, automation frameworks, and AI-assisted testing solutions. 
 - Lead technical discussions, solution walkthroughs, architecture reviews, and presentations with customers. 
 - Mentor QA Leads, SDETs, Automation Engineers, and API Testing teams. 

API Solutioning Responsibilities

The candidate should be capable of independently assessing a customer API landscape and developing a complete testing solution: 

Requirement Analysis → API Landscape Assessment → Risk Identification → Test Strategy → Automation Architecture → Tool Selection → PoC → Implementation → CI/CD Integration → Metrics & Continuous Improvement

The candidate should be able to answer questions such as: 

- How should APIs across hundreds of microservices be tested efficiently?
 - What should be automated at the API layer versus UI/E2E layer?
 - How can API regression execution time be reduced?
 - How should dependencies on unavailable downstream services be handled?
 - How can contract testing prevent integration defects?
 - How should asynchronous APIs and Kafka events be validated?
 - How can API automation be integrated into CI/CD quality gates?
 - How can AI improve API test design, automation, execution, and defect analysis?

Required Technical Skills

Strong hands-on experience with: 

API Testing & Automation

- REST API and SOAP Web Services
 - REST Assured
 - Postman/Newman
 - Karate
 - SoapUI/ReadyAPI
 - Python/PyTest
 - Java/TestNG/JUnit
 - JSON/XML validation
 - OpenAPI/Swagger

API & Integration Architecture

- REST/SOAP/GraphQL
 - Microservices architecture
 - API Gateway/API Management
 - Kafka/Event-driven architecture
 - Messaging systems
 - API contracts and schema validation
 - Database/backend validation

Advanced Testing

- Contract Testing
 - Service Virtualization/Mocking
 - API Performance Testing
 - API Security Testing
 - Integration Testing
 - Resiliency/Failure Testing
 - Test Data Management

DevOps & Cloud

- Jenkins/Azure DevOps/GitHub Actions
 - CI/CD and Continuous Testing
 - Docker/Kubernetes fundamentals
 - Azure/AWS/GCP exposure
 - Git and source-code management

AI-Assisted Quality Engineering

- GenAI/LLM-assisted test generation
 - AI-assisted automation development
 - Intelligent test selection
 - Synthetic test-data generation
 - Defect/root-cause analysis
 - GitHub Copilot or equivalent AI coding assistants

Architecture & Leadership Expectations

- Strong experience designing enterprise API automation frameworks from scratch. 
 - Ability to assess an existing testing ecosystem and propose a target-state QE architecture. 
 - Strong understanding of automation framework design, reusable components, maintainability, and scalability. 
 - Ability to conduct technical PoCs and tool/framework evaluations. 
 - Ability to estimate automation effort, resource requirements, timelines, and implementation roadmap. 
 - Strong customer-facing communication and presentation skills. 
 - Ability to explain technical solutions to both engineering teams and senior stakeholders. 
 - Experience leading multiple QA/Automation teams and providing technical governance. 

Experience

- 8+ years of overall Quality Engineering/Testing experience. 
 - 5+ years of strong API testing and automation experience. 
 - Demonstrated experience in API Test Architecture / Automation Architecture / QE Solutioning. 
 - Experience leading enterprise-level API testing and automation initiatives. 
 - Experience working directly with customers on QA transformation, solutioning, architecture, and implementation. 

Ideal Candidate Profile

The candidate should be able to demonstrate at least 2-3 large API testing solutions personally architected and implemented, explaining: 

Customer Problem → Current-State Assessment → Test Strategy → Automation Architecture → Tool Selection → PoC → CI/CD Integration → Implementation → Coverage Improvement → Business Outcome

The role requires a hands-on API Test Architect and Solutioning expert, not primarily a QA Project/People Manager. The individual should be capable of designing the solution, defending architecture decisions in front of customers, conducting PoCs when required, and guiding engineering teams through implementation.

data.title: QA Engineer
data.description:
Position Overview

We are seeking a skilled and proactive QA SDET - 2 to join our distribution team. This isn't your typical "just run the test cases" role. We need someone who can deeply understand our AI ecosystem, take ownership of quality across the product, and drive testing excellence through automation and first-principles thinking. You'll work autonomously in a remote environment, requiring strong self-direction, excellent communication, and genuine curiosity about both the product and the testing craft. 

You will be responsible for

- Design, develop, and maintain automated test suites with a goal of automating 80% of integration tests, ensuring comprehensive coverage and reliability. 
 - Go beyond surface-level testing by truly grasping how our AI product works, the user journey, edge cases, and potential failure modes. 
 - Identify quality risks early, surface issues before they reach production, and continuously improve our testing processes without waiting to be told. 
 - Build reusable test frameworks and components using modern testing tools and best practices. 
 - Break down complex testing challenges from the ground up, questioning assumptions and designing effective test strategies. 
 - Produce clear video demonstrations of issues, test scenarios, and product features, along with well-structured documentation for test cases, automation frameworks, and quality processes. 
 - Own the delivery of an entire software development test suites and framework 
 - Work closely with cross-functional stakeholders to understand requirements, provide quality insights early in the development cycle, and ensure testability is built into features. 
 - Articulate quality concerns, test results, and recommendations clearly in a remote environment through written updates, documentation, and team discussions. 

Requirements

- 2+ years of experience in QA/SDET roles with a strong focus on test automation and integration testing 
 - Proficiency in languages like JavaScript/TypeScript, Python, and Ruby for writing test automation 
 - Experience with tools like Playwright, Selenium, Jest, or similar frameworks for frontend and API testing 
 - Proven ability to design and implement comprehensive test strategies that cover complex user workflows 
 - Ability to break down problems from fundamentals, question assumptions, and design effective testing approaches rather than following rote processes 
 - Comfortable creating detailed documentation, test plans, bug reports, and asynchronous updates for a distributed team 
 - Takes initiative to identify issues, improve processes, and learn new technologies without constant direction 
 - Passion for understanding how things work, staying current with testing best practices, and diving deep into the AI/ML domain 
 - Proven ability to work effectively in a distributed team environment with minimal supervision

Job Title: Engineering Senior Manager

Location: Bangalore-Manyata Tech Park

Business & Team: Business Banking - EBB

We're building tomorrow's bank today, which means we need creative and diverse engineers to help us redefine what customers expect from a bank. Envisioning new technologies that are still waiting to be invented and reimagining products that support our customers and help build Australia's future economy. 

CommBank is recognised as leading the industry in IT and operations with its world-class platforms and processes, agile IT infrastructure, and innovation in everything from payments to internet banking and mobile apps. Our Software team are the brains behind Australia's number one banking app, Netbank, Cardless Cash, Comm Sec Pocket and Spend Tracker. We go beyond a passion for web and mobile development, creating reliable APIs at a unique scale in Australia. And you could be a part of that journey. 

Impact & Contribution: 

The CBA technology unit delivers the best digital banking services to Commonwealth Bank customers and to do so is responsible for digital delivery, group data and analytics, technology and technology infrastructure, cyber, fraud, physical security and business resilience for all divisions across CBA. It is also dedicated to delivering the best workplace technology experience for our over 53. 000 people across CBA and focused on providing the latest tools, technology, and resources to enhance the way we work together and empower our people to achieve more for our customers. 

We are looking for an Engineering Senior Manager (Platform, Cloud & Backend Engineering) to lead the design, build and evolution of a greenfield, modern engineering platform and associated backend services. 

This role is suited to an engineering leader with strong technical depth across cloud infrastructure, DevOps, platform engineering, distributed systems and modern Java-based backend architecture, combined with strong people leadership and delivery capability. 

The primary technical emphasis of the role is Infrastructure, Cloud, DevOps, Platform Engineering and Java-based distributed systems. A secondary area of capability is Data Engineering, particularly around event-driven architectures, streaming, operational data flows and integration with modern analytical platforms. 

The successful candidate will play a critical role in establishing the technical foundations, engineering practices, platform capabilities and team culture for a new technology landscape. The role will involve significantly more greenfield engineering than maintenance of legacy technologies. 

This role will report into the Engineering Executive Manager under EBB Technology. 

Roles & Responsibilities: 

- Build, lead and inspire an engaged, diverse team of Engineers, creating a culture of empowerment, autonomy, psychological safety, constructive challenge and continuous improvement. 
 - Coach and develop Engineers through personalised feedback, mentoring and peer-to-peer learning, understanding individual skill sets and enabling ongoing career and capability growth. 
 - Champion Engineering Practice standards and consistent ways of working across the domain and CBA, aligned with industry standards, while empowering teams to manage their work, resolve technical issues and continuously improve engineering quality. 
 - Provide strong technical and architectural leadership for a modern, cloud-native technology landscape, including Java-based backend platforms, APIs, services and distributed systems, establishing architecture principles that promote scalability, resilience, security, maintainability and developer productivity. 
 - Embed engineering excellence into delivery through security-by-design, observability, appropriate SLI/SLO/SLA practices, effective operational data flows, code reviews, refactoring and proactive management of technical debt and technology lifecycle. 
 - Own delivery outcomes across engineering teams, translating business objectives into executable technology roadmaps and proactively managing dependencies, technical constraints, engineering risks and platform evolution. 
 - Partner effectively with Product, Architecture, Data, Security, Operations, senior management and business stakeholders to remove blockers, enable execution and clearly communicate technology strategy, architectural decisions, trade-offs, delivery progress, risks and investment needs. 
 - Participate in On-Call rosters from time to time, taking ownership of critical issue resolution and supporting the reliable and seamless operation of systems, products and platforms. 

Essential Skills: 

Candidates should ideally have significant experience in engineering leadership roles involving complex, business-critical technology environments. The Senior Engineering Manager should be technically credible, capable of participating in architecture decisions, challenging senior engineers constructively, evaluating technology choices and helping establish pragmatic engineering standards. 

- Engineering Leadership and People Management
 - Proven leadership of high-performing engineering teams. 
 - Experience recruiting and developing engineers. 
 - Strong coaching and performance management capability. 
 - Experience managing senior technical contributors. 
 - Demonstrated ability to lead teams through ambiguity and change. 
 - Strong written and verbal technical communication. 
 - Delivery, Execution and Stakeholder Management: Must Have strong delivery ownership, Dependency management, Risk management, Prioritization, Ability to communicate technical trade-offs. 
 - Greenfield Engineering: Must Have a demonstrated experience building new platforms, products or systems, Ability to make architecture decisions, Ability to establish a practical path from MVP to scalable production architecture. 
 - Cloud Infrastructure and Platform Engineering: Strong working knowledge of Public cloud architecture - AWS, Azure and/or GCP, Kubernetes, Docker/containerization. IaC, Terraform, Networking fundamentals, Load balancing, DNS, IAM, Secrets management, Backup and disaster recovery, Cloud security, Infrastructure automation. 
 - Java and Backend Engineering: Strong conceptual and practical understanding of: Modern Java - Java 17/21+, Spring Boot, Spring Cloud, API design, REST, Service architecture.

Head of Engineering (Service Enablement Platforms)

Woolworths Group India is partnering exclusively with Zinnov Group to recruit for this position. 

About the role

The Head of Engineering is a senior technology leadership role accountable for the technical excellence, architecture execution, software delivery, and operational reliability across all Service Enablement, Observability, Applied AI, and Decision Intelligence platforms. This role unites disparate engineering functions into a modern, disciplined engineering powerhouse. 

Accountable for everything built, configured, integrated, and deployed across ServiceNow, Dynatrace, Splunk, PagerDuty, GCP BigQuery/Vertex AI, and enterprise agentic decision workflows, the role establishes rigorous DevSecOps practices, Automated Test Frameworks (ATF), CI/CD pipelines, and Service Management as Code (SMaC). Partnering closely with the Head of Service Enablement Platforms and the Head of Applied AI & Decision Intelligence, the Head of Engineering translates strategic capability roadmaps and architectural designs into high-velocity sprint execution across onshore and Woolworths India (GCC) delivery squads, driving rapid automation, zero-downtime platform upgrades, and world-class engineering craftsmanship. 

What you'll experience

- We champion modern, sustainable ways of working, featuring structured hybrid models, flexible hours, and family-friendly policies designed to support work-life harmony. 
 - We are committed to fostering an inclusive, equitable environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, psychological safety is actively cultivated, and every voice is heard. 
 - Access senior executive sponsorship, continuous leadership coaching, and clear pathways for ongoing professional advancement. 
 - Enjoy competitive performance bonuses, 20 days annual leave, comprehensive healthcare coverage for you and your dependants, and bespoke adjustment support throughout the hiring process. 

Key Responsibilities

Software Engineering & Technical Delivery Excellence

- Lead all development, configuration, integration, and automated testing across ServiceNow (ITSM, ITOM, CMDB, HAM/SAM), Observability (Dynatrace, Splunk), Incident Routing (PagerDuty), and Applied AI pipelines.

 - Institute DORA engineering metrics (Deployment Frequency, Lead Time for Changes, Change Failure Rate, Time to Restore Service) to benchmark and elevate engineering throughput. Applied AI & Decision Intelligence Engineering Execution

- Enable and scale local engineering delivery across the three capability pillars (Intelligence Engineering, Decision Intelligence, Applied AI). Translate the strategic direction established by the Head of Applied AI & Decision Intelligence (dotted line) into operational local execution. 
 - Lead local teams building high-velocity data pipelines (GCP BigQuery, Dataflow), dbt/Dataform semantic models, agentic workflows, and decision microservices integrated with ServiceNow and Observability stacks. 
 - Enforce enterprise code quality, CI/CD release gates, AgentOps telemetry, golden evaluation suites, and safety/security guardrails across all local builds. Service Management as Code (SMaC) & DevSecOps

- Shift ITIL and platform compliance left by delivering "Service Management as Code" (SMaC) pipelines, allowing developers across Group Technology to declare service topology, alert policies, and metadata via code. 
 - Build, maintain, and govern standardized RESTful/GraphQL APIs, webhooks, and Integration Hub spokes connecting core platforms to enterprise CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, Jenkins, Terraform). 
 - Embed automated security scanning, code quality analysers, and dependency checking directly into the platform release lifecycle. Automated Testing & Frictionless Platform Upgrades

- Own platform health, code upgradeability, and release engineering across all environments. 
 - Drive aggressive adoption and expansion of the Automated Test Framework (ATF), establishing continuous regression testing to validate platform integrity. 
 - Accountable for seamless, zero-incident bi-annual family release upgrades and monthly security patching across all ServiceNow instances, telemetry collectors, and AI runtime environments. Platform Reliability, SRE & Operations Engineering

- Partner with the CMDB/CSDM and Platform teams to build robust Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) practices, automated health monitors, and synthetic tests for core enablement platforms. 
 - Manage operational engineering squads dedicated to platform performance tuning, index optimization, agent collector health, and database hygiene. 
 - Provide Tier-3/Tier-4 engineering escalation support for platform-related major incidents, ensuring rapid root-cause remediation and long-term bug fixes. Global Capability Hub Engineering Stewardship

- Directly line-manage, inspire, and grow an elite global engineering team across Sydney and the Woolworths India (GCC) Capability Hub. 
 - Establish clear engineering career frameworks, code review rigor, pair programming practices, and active participation in technical communities of practice. 
 - Transition traditional contractor and third-party development workloads into sustainable, highly capable internal engineering squads. 

Capabilities

Demonstrated capabilities in the following: 

- Full-Stack & Platform Engineering Mastery: Proven technical depth leading complex engineering squads across ServiceNow (architecture, scripting, Flow Designer, Integration Hub, ATF), Observability engines (Dynatrace, Splunk, PagerDuty), and cloud-native infrastructure. 
 - Applied AI & Data Pipeline Engineering: Engineering leadership in data pipelines (GCP BigQuery, Dataflow, dbt, Cloud Run), model operationalization (Vertex AI, Python, Docker), and automated closed-loop remediation scripts. 
 - DevSecOps & CI/CD Pipelines: Deep expertise establishing GitOps workflows, automated testing frameworks, vulnerability scanning, and infrastructure/service as code. 
 - High-Scale Distributed Delivery: Demonstrated success orchestrating 50+ software, platform, and data engineers within a multi-disciplinary, dual-location (Sydney & GCC Bangalore) operating model. 
 - Technical Debt Elimination: Relentless dedication to Out-of-the-Box (OOTB) engineering principles, avoiding brittle customizations, and executing frictionless platform upgrades. 

Career Experience

- Significant experience (typically 18+ years) in progressive software engineering and substantial engineering leadership background (at least 5 years) leading multi-squad software or platform teams. 
 - Platform & Data Delivery Track Record: Proven history of leading major technical implementations, custom API integrations, AIOps correlation engine deployments, and high-volume data ingestion architectures. 
 - Agile Engineering Leadership: Mastery of Agile/Scrum/Kanban delivery frameworks, sprint forecasting, engineering throughput metrics (DORA metrics), and technical capability uplifts. 
 - Education: Bachelor's or Master's Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or related quantitative field. 
 - Certifications: Certified ServiceNow Implementation Specialist / Developer / Architect; GCP/AWS Solutions Architect or Data Engineer; Agile Certified Practitioner (PMI-ACP / SAFe Program Consultant); ITIL v4 Foundation.

LeadSquared is a rapidly growing SaaS platform powering high-velocity sales and customer engagement execution across global industries, including BFSI, Education, Healthcare, and Marketplaces. We build large-scale, mission-critical systems focused on performance, reliability, and innovation. As our platform and product portfolio expand including new AI-native capabilities we are looking for a Principal Architect to shape the technical foundation that will carry the business into its next phase of growth. 

Role Overview

We are looking for a Principal Architect for our Core Platform who combines deep technical architecture skill with a strong grasp of LeadSquared's technology, product, and business landscape. This is a senior individual-contributor role reporting directly to the CTO built around technical ownership and influence. 

You will own the target-state architecture of the core platform: defining where it needs to go to support the future direction of our products and business, and charting a credible, phased path to get there. Just as importantly, you will be a magnet and mentor for our most talented senior engineers raising the technical bar across the organisation and giving high-potential IC talent a compelling reason to grow and stay at LeadSquared. 

Key Responsibilities

Platform & Technical Strategy

- Build and maintain a deep working understanding of LeadSquared's technology stack, product portfolio, and the business/customer landscape across BFSI, Education, Healthcare, and Marketplaces. 
 - Define and drive the target-state architecture for the core platform covering scalability, multi-tenancy, extensibility, performance, security, Infra Cost and data architecture. 
 - Translate the future direction of product and business including emerging AI-native and agentic capabilities into a coherent, sequenced architecture roadmap. 
 - Establish architectural principles, standards, and guardrails across services, APIs, data, and integration layers, and ensure they are consistently applied. 
 - Evaluate new technologies, platforms, and patterns (cloud-native, data, AI/agentic where relevant) that keep the platform future-ready and competitively differentiated. 
 - Make and own architectural trade-off calls that balance paying down technical debt against the pace of new capability delivery. 

Cross-Functional & Business Alignment

- Partner closely with the CTO, Engineering and Product leadership, and business stakeholders to keep platform architecture aligned with product strategy and market direction. 
 - Represent core platform architecture in leadership forums, bringing a technical lens to business and product decisions. 
 - Assess build-vs-buy, platform consolidation, and modernisation choices through a business-outcomes lens, not just a technical one. 
 - Engage with customers and internal stakeholders as needed to validate that architectural direction holds up against real-world use cases. 

Talent Development & Mentorship

- Inspire and mentor senior engineers, tech leads, and architects across the organisation raising the overall quality of technical thinking and decision-making. 
 - Build structured mechanisms for coaching and knowledge-sharing design reviews, architecture forums/guilds, RFC and ADR processes that scale good architectural practice beyond any one team. 
 - Act as a magnet for senior IC talent: create a visible, credible technical growth path that improves engagement and retention of high-potential engineers. 
 - Champion engineering best practices design reviews, architecture decision records, documentation, and code quality as habits, not one-off exercises. 

Hands-On Technical Leadership

- Stay hands-on: prototype, review designs and code, and work directly alongside teams on the platform's hardest problems. 
 - Lead resolution of the most complex, cross-cutting architectural challenges such as scale, reliability, data consistency, and security. 
 - Set up lightweight governance (architecture review forums, a technology radar) that keeps the platform coherent as teams and services multiply. 

Required Skills & Experience

Technical Background

- 14-20 years of overall software engineering experience, with a significant and recent track record in architecture and technical leadership roles on large-scale, multi-tenant SaaS platforms. 
 - Proven experience owning target-state or reference architecture for a platform of meaningful scale and complexity. 
 - Strong, credible hands-on background across modern technology stacks (e. g. , Java/. NET, cloud-native services, microservices, distributed systems) deep enough to earn the respect of senior engineers. 
 - Solid understanding of database technologies (SQL & NoSQL) and system design trade-offs at scale. 
 - Working knowledge of cloud platforms (AWS/Azure/GCP) and cloud-native architecture practices. 
 - Familiarity with AI/ML and agentic architecture patterns (e. g. , RAG, LLM orchestration, vector search) is a strong plus, given LeadSquared's growing AI-native roadmap. 

Leadership & Influence

- Demonstrated ability to mentor and elevate senior engineers and architects without formal reporting authority - leading through influence and credibility. 
 - Excellent communication skills; able to explain architectural rationale clearly to the CTO, business leaders, and, where needed, customers. 
 - Strong stakeholder management, able to balance the sometimes-competing needs of product, business, and engineering. 
 - Genuine interest in coaching and teaching, with a track record of building technical culture that improves the quality and retention of senior talent. 

Why LeadSquared?

- Shape the target-state architecture of a global SaaS platform used by thousands of enterprises. 
 - A high-ownership, high-visibility role reporting directly to the CTO, with the freedom to set technical direction. 
 - The opportunity to build a lasting technical legacy both in the platform's architecture and in the engineers you mentor. 
 - Competitive compensation and the chance to work at the intersection of core platform, product, and emerging AI capabilities.

data.title: Lead Back End Engineer
data.description:
This is a leadership role in our engineering team - not just a cog in the wheel. 

This is not a "maintenance" role. This is engineering leadership-owning the backend architecture of a global, privacy-first communication platform. You'll lead by example, guide a high-calibre team, and ensure our backend systems remain blazing-fast, rock-solid, and uncompromising on security. You'll be at the intersection of code and leadership-mentoring engineers, driving architectural decisions, and setting engineering standards that define how a global product is built. 

Who are we?

We are a young product company scaling fast and outgrowing the startup tag-with global scale in our crosshairs. We don't do "okay. " We give everything we've got to build the best communication platform in the world. Our team includes engineers from IIT and other top institutions-people who care deeply about the craft, performance, and purpose. You'll learn more in 6 months here than most engineers do in 3 years elsewhere. We're intense. High-strung. Focused. Our team includes engineers from IIT and other top-tier

backgrounds. But what defines us is not our degrees-it's our refusal to compromise on quality, performance, or privacy. 

What are we building?

WrkTalk is the world's first zero-access, zero-spam enterprise communication product that operates on a structural privacy architecture. One that's already earned the trust of large enterprises like L&T Finance, Adani Group, and Kalyan Jewellers - just to name a few of our enterprise clients. This is not an MVP. This is production-grade software that secures communication for thousands-and soon, millions-of professionals worldwide. 

What's the role?

• Architect backend systems in NestJS and Golang to meet global scale and enterprise-grade performance. 

• Drive design for microservices, real-time comms (WebSockets, WebRTC), and data stores (PostgreSQL, Redis). 

• Lead code reviews, enforce coding standards, and maintain CI/CD discipline. 

• Mentor and upskill backend engineers. 

• Collaborate cross-functionally with frontend, DevOps, and product leaders. 

• Own technical problem-solving-anticipate bottlenecks, make hard calls, and prevent tech debt from being parked for "later. "

• Manage task allocation, workflow discipline, and ensure smooth collaboration with frontend and DevOps. 

The tech here is serious. 

We work on socket-driven comms infrastructure, distributed control towers, multi-category encryption, root detection, app kill-switches, dynamic guest access, device-level lockout, and OOO/ DND logic layered with smart whitelisting. This is not lightweight app dev. This is protocol-layer decision-making. 

Who should apply?

• 6-8+ years in backend engineering, with at least 2 years in a leadership role. 

• Expertise in Golang and Node. js (NestJS). 

• Strong database tuning skills (PostgreSQL, Redis). 

• Solid understanding of Docker, Kubernetes, and scalable deployment. 

• Experience building real-time systems at scale. 

• Proven ability to lead technical discussions and inspire engineering teams. 

• Track record of shipping production-grade, high-performance systems. 

Why should you join?

• Because you want to own backend architecture-not just follow it

• Because you'll work directly with established founders, not buried under layers

• Because you'll ship real, deeply engineered features used by large number of enterprise users

• Because you'll grow 10x faster here-in experience, learning, and impact

• And because if you walk this road with us for 3-4 years, it'll catapult you into a tech orbit or fame and glory you never imagined

Where are we located?

We're based in Navi Mumbai and building for the world.

data.title: Engineering Manager
data.description:
Who Are We?

Postman is the world's leading API platform, used by more than 45 million+ developers and 500, 000 organizations, including 98% of the Fortune 500. Postman is helping developers and professionals across the globe build the API-first world by simplifying each step of the API lifecycle and streamlining collaboration-enabling users to create better APIs, faster. 

The company is headquartered in San Francisco and has offices in Boston, New York, Austin, Tokyo, London, and Bangalore - where Postman was founded. Postman is privately held, with funding from Battery Ventures, BOND, Coatue, CRV, Insight Partners, and Nexus Venture Partners. Learn more at postman. com or connect with Postman on X via @getpostman. 

P. S: We highly recommend reading The "API-First World" graphic novel to understand the bigger picture and our vision at Postman. 

About The Team

Product Trust team ensures Postman is a safe and trusted platform for our customers. This team is responsible for building security features within the Postman ecosystem - from deciding what the product should look like to building and delivering it. Product Trust independently deliver solutions to address the security, compliance and governance needs of our customers. 

The Opportunity

We are looking for an exceptional Engineering Leader to build the next generation of our security offerings in the Postman product. You'll be accountable for strategy, technical roadmap and architecture of the platform. You should work with the team members and be involved in their professional growth path with best alignment for organization goals. You'll work with multiple teams within Postman overseeing and contributing to delivery and owning critical KPIs such as availability and uptime. 

The ideal candidate is a strategic leader with attention to detail and a relentless drive for quality. They should be comfortable being very hands on and at the same being able to uplevel and provide high level guidance for others to execute. They should also be strong communicators who can influence other leaders. Finally, they should have strong industry knowledge and bring best practices from the broader industry to the Postman's security and trust offerings. 

What You'll Do

- Engineering and Technical LeadershipProvide technical leadership for the architecture and help the teams build highly secure, scalable, reliable and performant systems that can cater to the needs of hundreds of millions of developersWork with Staff and principle engineers to to identify and review key technical designs to ensure consistency with architecture and support for the businessLead the team to deliver on multiple projects in collaboration with key stakeholdersBuild an operational center of excellence with effective observability, considerations for scale and performance and focus on quality
 - Prioritization and RoadmapPartner with other engineering leaders within the org and product leaders within the companyHelp the teams prioritize work and create a balanced roadmap
 - CollaborationWork closely with senior leadership to drive org design, set and execute the roadmap and influence the strategyCollaborate with cross functional teams to align on goals, drive engineering initiatives, and create broad organizational impactRegularly communicate progress, challenges, and strategic initiatives with senior leadership, providing updates on the team's success and security posture. 
 - People ManagementHave regular 1: 1s with team members, understand what motivates and challenges them and craft a professional growth path keeping in best alignment with organization goals. Provide regular feedback, coaching and support for team members to create maximum impact. Build a high performance and cohesive team. 

About You

- 10+ years of experience developing complex, distributed software applications at Postman's scale. Proficient with one or more programming languages (Javascript, NodeJS, Java)
 - 3 years of experience in leading, mentoring, and managing a team of engineers, providing technical guidance and fostering career development. 
 - Strong experience with security offerings such as vault store, token scanning, cryptography etc. 
 - Demonstrated experience leading cross-functional projects with a meaningful impact on the business
 - Exceptional problem solving, design, and analytical skills
 - Demonstrated experience designing highly scalable systems

If you're a leader with a strong passion for scaling engineering, eager to lead platform development, and ready to address the challenges of secure, high-performance infrastructure? Step into the role of Engineering Manager at Postman and play a pivotal part in shaping the future of API development for millions of developers and agents worldwide!

What Else?

In addition to Postman's pay-on-performance philosophy, and a flexible schedule working with a fun, collaborative team, Postman offers a comprehensive set of benefits, including full medical coverage, flexible PTO, wellness reimbursement, and a monthly lunch stipend. Along with that, our wellness programs will help you stay in the best of your physical and mental health. Our frequent and fascinating team-building events will keep you connected, while our donation-matching program can support the causes you care about. We're building a long-term company with an inclusive culture where everyone can be the best version of themselves. 

At Postman we value in person collaboration. We are in office 5 days a week for all roles based out of our hubs in San Francisco Bay Area, Boston, Austin, New York City, Tokyo and London. For roles based in Bangalore, employees currently work in the office three days a week and will transition to five days per week by the end of the year. We were thoughtful in our approach which is based on collaboration and grounded in feedback from our workforce, leadership team, and peers. The benefits of our in office model will be shared knowledge, brainstorming sessions, communication, and building trust in-person that cannot be replicated via zoom. 

Our Values

At Postman, we create with the same curiosity that we see in our users. We value transparency and honest communication about not only successes, but also failures. In our work, we focus on specific goals that add up to a larger vision. Our inclusive work culture ensures that everyone is valued equally as important pieces of our final product. We are dedicated to delivering the best products we can. 

Equal Opportunity

Postman is an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action Employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, or disability status. Headhunters and recruitment agencies may not submit resumes/CVs through this website or directly to managers. Postman does not accept unsolicited headhunter and agency resumes. Postman will not pay fees to any third-party agency or company that does not have a signed agreement with Postman.

data.title: Lead AI Product Engineer
data.description:
It's fun to work in a company where people truly BELIEVE in what they are doing!

We're committed to bringing passion and customer focus to the business. 

The role

Cogentiq I2C is Fractal's agentic AI Product for invoice-to-cash, covering Collections, Cash Application, Deductions, Invoice Management and Credit Risk. It runs on a Next. js front end, a FastAPI service layer, the Cogentiq agentic runtime, and a data tier on Azure Databricks with PostgreSQL. 

You own the AI side: the agents, the models and everything that makes them accurate and dependable in front of a finance team. You design it, you lead the team that builds it, and you write code yourself. 

What you will own

- Technical design of the AI side: agent decomposition, orchestration patterns, tool design, memory and context strategy. 
 - The agents across all five modules, from document extraction and matching through to the reasoning steps behind a recommendation. 
 - Accuracy and reliability. Evaluation sets, regression suites, and a defensible number for how well each agent performs before it ships. 
 - Guardrails and human oversight: confidence thresholds, escalation to a person, audit trails, and traceable reasoning for any decision touching cash. 
 - Predictive and machine learning models where they serve the product better than an agent does. 
 - Model strategy: choice of models, cost and latency per workflow, and the ability to switch providers without a rewrite. 
 - The interfaces between your side and the platform, agreed jointly with the engineering. 

How you will work

- Lead the AI and agent engineering team. Set standards, coach engineers, and keep the team unblocked. 
 - Stay in the code. Take the hardest agents yourself and set the patterns others follow. 
 - Work as a pair with the Engineering Lead. 
 - Work with product management on what an agent can realistically be trusted to do, so external commitments are grounded. 
 - Be able to explain an agent's behaviour to a finance stakeholder who will not accept "the model decided". 

What you must have

- Ten to fourteen years in AI, machine learning or software, with at least three leading a team. 
 - Track record of owning technical design, not only implementing someone else's design. 
 - Production experience with LLM and agentic systems: multi-step workflows, tool use, orchestration frameworks, and the failure modes that only appear at scale. 
 - Real evaluation discipline. Evidence that you have measured agent quality with something more rigorous than manual spot checks. 
 - Strong Python engineering. Your team ships production code, not notebooks. 
 - Document understanding and information extraction experience, ideally on messy real-world inputs such as emails, remittance advices and attachments. 
 - Classical machine learning depth alongside the generative work, and the judgement to know which problem needs which. 
 - Enough understanding of services, data and deployment to build agents that fit the platform and to hold your side of a design argument with the Engineering Lead. 
 - Product track record: AI built for many clients, not one-off delivery for a single engagement. 

Good to have

- Order-to-cash or accounts receivable domain knowledge: collections, cash application, deductions, remittance handling. 
 - Experience with agent observability and tracing tooling. 
 - Experience getting AI through enterprise risk, compliance or model governance review. 

If you like wild growth and working with happy, enthusiastic over-achievers, you'll enjoy your career with us!

Not the right fit? Let us know you're interested in a future opportunity by clicking Introduce Yourself in the top-right corner of the page or create an account to set up email alerts as new job postings become available that meet your interest!

data.title: Senior Engineering Manager
data.description:
About Suki

Suki is a leading technology company that provides AI voice solutions for healthcare. Its mission is to reimagine the healthcare technology stack, making it invisible and assistive to lift the administrative burden from clinicians. Its flagship product is Suki Assistant, an AI assistant that uses generative AI to automatically create clinical documentation by ambiently listening to patient-clinician conversations. Suki helps clinicians complete notes 72% faster on average, assists with other tasks including coding and answering questions, and generates incremental revenue for organizations, delivering a 9X ROI in year 1. Suki also offers its proprietary AI and speech platform, Suki Platform, to partners who want to create best-in-class ambient and voice experiences for their solutions. Clinicians that use Suki already spend over 70% less time on administrative tasks, and we're striving to do even better. Come and join us!

We are a user-driven company and are committed to making sure every pixel of our product is in service of the doctors. We're a team of technologists, clinicians, and industry experts working together to push the limits on technology used in medicine. We're confident enough to move fast and talented enough not to break things. 

Suki's AI handles that work across the full lifecycle of care. Before a visit, Suki reasons over the patient's chart to prepare a summary. During the visit, it writes the note and answers clinical questions through Suki Ask. After the visit, it codes, captures orders and fills forms, while background agents handle prior authorizations, referrals and follow-up for care teams to approve. 

We're bringing this together as Suki OS: modular AI building blocks that run in Suki's apps, inside EHRs like athenahealth and MEDITECH, and in 30+ partner products through our SDKs and APIs. 

What You'll Do

You'll lead an engineering team building Clinical AI capabilities and platforms for both internal and external use. 

- Lead and grow the team: Hire, mentor and retain strong engineers across platform, AI/ML infrastructure and data, and build a culture of ownership and high standards. 
 - Own backend architecture: Drive the design of distributed, high-throughput services and APIs (Go, Python, gRPC/REST) on Kubernetes and GCP, built for scalability, low latency and high availability. 
 - AI platforms and capabilities: Build the shared AI capabilities that Suki's products and partners run on, from experimentation and evaluation to model serving and the clinical knowledge graph that grounds Suki's reasoning and agents. 
 - Data platform: Own the pipelines, storage and governance for clinical and product data, built to HIPAA and SOC 2 standards. 
 - Agent and AI-native tooling: Provide the tooling to build, evaluate, deploy and monitor agents, and make AI coding agents, auto-verification and strong review practices part of how every team works. 
 - Reliability and operations: Own observability, CI/CD, incident response and on-call, and set SLOs for services that clinicians rely on live with patients. 
 - Execution and partnership: Own planning and delivery for your platforms, and work with product, ML, clinical and application teams to turn their needs into shared infrastructure. 

What We're Looking For

- 10+ years in software engineering, including 4+ years managing engineers
 - A track record of building ML, data or developer platforms that other teams depend on
 - Depth in AI/ML infrastructure: training pipelines, model serving, GPU orchestration and LLM tooling
 - Experience with data platforms (e. g. , BigQuery, Airflow, Spark, Kafka) and data governance
 - Strong programming background in Go or Python, with solid distributed systems fundamentals
 - Strategic and hands-on, comfortable with ambiguity, and data-driven in your decisions
 - Experience leading AI-native teams that use coding agents (e. g. , Claude Code, Cursor), including building auto-verification and self-improvement loops
 - Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science or a related field

Huge plus

- Knowledge graphs, ontologies or graph databases, especially with clinical terminologies (SNOMED CT, ICD-10, RxNorm, LOINC)
 - LLMOps tooling: prompt management, evaluation frameworks and model routing
 - Vector databases, feature stores and retrieval systems
 - Healthcare interoperability (FHIR, HL7) and handling PHI at scale

Tell Me More About Suki

- On a roll: Named by Fast Company as one of the most innovative companies, named Google's Partner of the Year for AI/ML, named by Forbes as one of the top 50 companies in AI . 
 - Great team: Founded, managed, and backed by successful tech veterans from Google and Apple and medical leaders from UCSF and Stanford. We have technologists and doctors working side-by-side to solve complex problems. 
 - Great investors: We're backed by Venrock, First Round Capital, Flare Capital, March Capital, Hedosophia and others. With more than $250M raised so far, we have the resources to scale. 
 - Huge market: Disrupting a massive, growing $30+ billion market for transcription, dictation, and order-entry solutions. Our vision is to become the voice user interface for healthcare, relieving the administrative burden on doctors instead of adding to it. 
 - Great customers: Our solutions are used in health systems and clinics across the country, supporting clinicians across dozens of specialties. Check out what one of our users says about how Suki has helped his practice. 
 - Impact: You'll make an impact from day one. You'll join a team working towards a shared purpose with a culture built upon deep empathy for doctors and passion for making their lives better. 

Suki is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are dedicated to building a company that fosters inclusion and belonging and reflects the diverse communities we serve across the country. We know we are stronger this way, and we look forward to growing our team with these shared values.

data.title: Engineering Manager (EM) – Full Stack Mobile/Web
data.description:
About the role

Engineering Managers (EMs) lead engineers across levels and diverse groups who are moving towards realizing Flipkart's vision. They set the direction and long-term vision for the team, and partner with product, business and other stakeholders to realize it. EMs partner with product teams on key business metrics, lead innovative solutions to complex domain problems, and drive agility in execution by leading by example. 

This role is for a full stack EM with a mobile/app development background: someone who can go deep on both the app (React Native, WebView) and the Backend for Frontend (BFF) layer in Java, and who builds frameworks that enable other teams rather than building one-off features for them. 

Job description

We are looking for a full stack Engineering Manager who thrives on challenging the status quo and driving innovation. You will lead high-impact engineering teams across mobile app development (React Native, WebView) and the Java-based BFF layer, fostering technical excellence, continuous improvement and customer-centric thinking. You will collaborate with product management, data science, UX/UI design and backend engineering to deliver experiences that redefine how customers shop, at Flipkart scale. 

A key part of the role is framework engineering: building reusable app frameworks, SDKs and tooling that let other engineers and teams ship faster and safer. We want an enabler mindset (building platforms others build on), not a service mindset (building features on request for other teams). 

What you'll do

- Lead, develop and provide hands-on leadership for top-notch engineers and Engineering Managers (EMs) across mobile and BFF. 
 - Own end-to-end delivery across the app (React Native, WebView) and the Java BFF, ensuring robust, scalable and performant solutions. 
 - Drive framework engineering: design and evolve reusable frameworks, SDKs and platform capabilities that enable other teams to self-serve. 
 - Set the strategy to move from a service model to an enabler/platform model, with clear contracts, documentation and adoption metrics. 
 - Architect app and BFF systems for complex use cases while keeping code simple, with a focus on app performance, startup time, stability and release quality. 
 - Create clear career paths for team members through regular, deep mentoring; attract and retain top talent with long-term goals in mind. 
 - Take accountability for key business metrics in your area and act as a thought partner to product, engineering and business operations teams. 
 - Drive agility in execution, build a culture of responsiveness by leading by example, and own prioritization decisions for better predictability. 
 - Actively participate in design and code reviews, and contribute individually to coding and prototypes. 
 - Use user feedback and data to improve app experience, with quick turnaround on feature development and bug fixes. 

What you'll need

- B. E / B. Tech or similar qualification with 10+ years of experience building cutting-edge products, including 2+ years in people management. 
 - Strong mobile/app development background, with deep hands-on expertise in React Native and WebView-based app architectures. 
 - Strong backend experience in Java, including building Backend for Frontend (BFF) services for high-volume, distributed, high-transaction systems. 
 - Proven track record in framework engineering: building and scaling frameworks, SDKs or platforms that other engineers and teams adopt, with an enabler (not service) mindset. 
 - Understanding of the full stack from the app layer to middleware and database layer, and experience architecting on cloud platforms such as AWS. 
 - Deep understanding of mobile app internals: performance, memory, networking, release and rollout practices, and common app design patterns. 
 - Strong partnership with product and business teams, with effective collaboration and communication across multiple stakeholders.

data.title: Executive Manager - Technology Modernisation
data.description:
Organization: 

At CommBank, we never lose sight of the role we play in other people's financial wellbeing. Our focus is to help people and businesses move forward to progress. To make the right financial decisions and achieve their dreams, targets, and aspirations. Regardless of where you work within our organisation, your initiative, talent, ideas, and energy all contribute to the impact that we can make with our work. Together we can achieve great things. 

Job Title: Executive Manager - Technology Modernisation

Location: Bangalore

Business & Team: 

ASB is one of New Zealand's leading banks and a wholly owned subsidiary of the Commonwealth Bank of Australia. This role sits within CBA India and is dedicated to ASB - you will build and lead ASB's India-based engineering capability, working shoulder to shoulder with ASB Technology leaders in NZ. ASB is mid-flight in a generational modernisation of its technology, data and digital estate. The agenda is set and owned by ASB's leadership in New Zealand; India's job is to bring the engineering depth that accelerates it. The portfolio spans migrating the core to SAP TRBK and simplifying the legacy HOST estate, modernising cards across issuing and acquiring, the full payments technology agenda, scaling Pega across decisioning, workflow, lending and financial crime, modernising the data estate onto a cloud data platform, and re-platforming integration. 

Underpinning all of it are CBA Group engineering foundations - cloud-first architecture, Golden Pathways and DevSecOps, automation-first testing, and AI-powered engineering at scale. This is not a support function. It is real engineering accountability, delivered from India. 

You will lead ASB's India-based engineering capability - engineers, platform and architecture specialists, testing, data and delivery talent - organised into squads that sit inside ASB's tribes and into chapters that hold the engineering craft. The teams operate as a genuine extension of ASB, not a resource pool: named outcomes, shared tribe governance and cadence, common engineering standards, and direct partnership with ASB tribe leads, product owners, architecture, risk and operations across both geographies. 

Impact & Contribution: 

As Executive Manager - Technology Modernisation, you lead the India engineering capability that delivers across ASB's modernisation portfolio - SAP TRBK core migration and legacy simplification, Cards Modernisation, the payments technology agenda, and the Pega estate - together with the cloud, integration, data and quality engineering that make them land. You will work in genuine partnership with the ASB New Zealand leaders who own the modernisation agenda, translating their roadmaps into executable engineering plans, mobilising squads inside ASB tribes, setting and holding the engineering bar, and carrying delivery, operational and regulatory risk for what India commits to. 

Success is a world-class engineering capability across these domains - one that measurably accelerates ASB's modernisation journey, delivers to committed timelines, holds the compliance and regulatory bar without exception, takes risk out of complex migrations, and does it at materially better cost. Alongside the immediate commitments, you will build the longer-term edge: automation-first quality engineering, AI-powered engineering, and the engineering depth that lets ASB retire legacy with confidence. 

Roles & Responsibilities: 

- Lead India's engineering capability across core banking, cards, payments, Pega, data and integration, translating ASB New Zealand's modernisation roadmap into clear, sequenced delivery plans with measurable outcomes. 
 - Build outcome-led engineering squads and chapters integrated with ASB tribes, with clear accountability across software, platform, cloud, data and quality engineering. 
 - Set and uphold engineering excellence, embedding cloud-first architecture, API-led and event-driven integration, Golden Pathways, DevSecOps, CI/CD automation, security controls and measurable engineering standards. 
 - Make automation and quality engineering a core strength, establishing reusable test frameworks and large-scale migration testing to reduce manual regression, accelerate delivery and protect customer outcomes. 
 - Drive major modernisation programmes, including SAP TRBK core migration, legacy HOST transformation, Cards Modernisation and enterprise Pega, while managing complex migration, cutover and cross-platform dependencies. 
 - Build a resilient, always-on payments capability spanning domestic and cross-border payments, real-time processing, switching, settlement, reconciliation, observability and incident readiness. 
 - Lead AI-powered engineering adoption, using generative and agentic AI for software development, testing, legacy comprehension, migration, knowledge discovery and operational support, with strong governance, responsible-use guardrails and measurable benefits. 
 - Own the India engineering operating model, including resilience, security, regulatory readiness, cost, risk, talent and capability building, while creating a high-performance culture and strong partnership across India and New Zealand. 

Essential Skills: 

- 15-18+ years of hands-on technology and engineering experience, built on a genuine engineering foundation rather than a purely programme or delivery-management career path. You should still be credible in an architecture or design review, able to read a solution design critically, and able to challenge an engineering or vendor decision on its technical merits. 
 - Deep, demonstrable delivery experience in at least one of: SAP core banking modernisation (TRBK or equivalent), Cards Modernisation, Payments, or enterprise Pega - evidenced by systems you have taken to production, not programmes you have governed. Credible working knowledge across at least two of these domains is required: depth in one is the gate, breadth is what makes this role work. 
 - Automation-first quality engineering: Proven experience building automated testing at scale across major migrations, including reusable frameworks, integration, performance, resilience and production validation, replacing manual regression with pipeline-driven automation. 
 - Core banking & legacy modernisation: Deep experience modernising complex banking platforms, including SAP HANA/core banking, large-scale data migration, reconciliation, dual-run, cutover, legacy decommissioning and AI-enabled legacy code discovery. 
 - Cards, payments & Pega expertise: Strong engineering depth across cards issuing/acquiring, payment rails and switching, settlement and reconciliation, alongside enterprise Pega platforms, workflow, decisioning and platform governance. 
 - Modern architecture & platform engineering: Strong command of cloud-native, domain-driven and event-driven architectures, microservices, APIs, distributed systems, Kubernetes, infrastructure as code and scalable platform engineering. 
 - DevSecOps, reliability & security: Advanced CI/CD, Golden Pathways, automated security controls, observability, SLOs, resilience, disaster recovery, threat modelling, vulnerability management and audit-ready technology controls.

At AMD, we believe technology has the power to solve the world's most important challenges. From advancing healthcare and scientific discovery to powering AI and the technologies people rely on every day, innovation at AMD is shaping the future.

We are looking for a dynamic, energetic Lead / Staff Software Engineer to join our growing team in AI (Artificial Intelligence) group. In this role, the individual will be responsible for developing AI/ML specific C/C++ kernels and dataflow schedules for AMD Ryzen Processors built on XDNA Neural Processor Units (NPU) to map LLMs, Stable Diffusion networks on NPU.  - Profile and analyze the performance of existing kernels.

 - Testing and Validation:

data.title: Principal Engineer – NPU Compiler & Architecture
data.description:
About The Role

We are seeking a highly experienced Compiler / Software Architect to join our NPU Hardware Architecture team and play a key role in the hardware-software co-design of next-generation AI inference accelerators. 

This is a unique role at the intersection of NPU hardware architecture, AI compilers, performance modeling, and software development. The position will work directly with hardware architects to define, evaluate, and prototype the software stack required to program current and future NPU architectures. 

Our NPU architecture is closely coupled with the compiler stack. Efficient utilization of the accelerator requires deep understanding of the hardware compute architecture, memory hierarchy, dataflow, scheduling, quantization, instruction set and execution model. The successful candidate will use this understanding to develop compiler and software proof-of-concepts, evaluate architectural proposals against real AI workloads, and influence the design of future NPU hardware. 

You will work closely with hardware architects, micro-architects, compiler engineers and AI software teams to answer a fundamental question: 

How should the NPU hardware and software be co-designed to deliver the best performance, power efficiency, programmability and scalability for real-world AI workloads?

What You Will Be Responsible For

Compiler & Software Architecture for NPU

- Develop compiler and software proof-of-concepts for current and next-generation NPU architectures. 
 - Define software abstractions and compiler flows that efficiently expose NPU hardware capabilities to AI workloads. 
 - Develop and evaluate compiler concepts including graph lowering, intermediate representations, operator mapping, scheduling, tiling, fusion, memory planning and code generation. 
 - Translate NPU architectural concepts into executable software models and demonstrate their feasibility using representative AI workloads. 
 - Develop lightweight compiler/runtime infrastructure to validate new hardware features before production software implementation. 
 - Analyze existing compiler limitations and identify architectural changes required to improve programmability and accelerator utilization. 

Hardware-Software Co-Design

- Work as an integral member of the hardware architecture team to co-design NPU hardware and software. 
 - Analyze how proposed hardware features can be effectively exposed through the compiler and software stack. 
 - Provide software-driven feedback on compute architecture, memory hierarchy, data movement, dataflow, scheduling, instruction set and accelerator programmability. 
 - Identify hardware features that provide meaningful benefits to real AI workloads and challenge features that add hardware complexity without sufficient software value. 
 - Define compiler requirements and software abstractions for new NPU capabilities. 
 - Participate in architecture and micro-architecture reviews and influence hardware decisions from a software and workload perspective. 
 - Evaluate architectural trade-offs considering performance, power, area, compiler complexity and software scalability. 

AI Workload & Performance Analysis

- Analyze representative AI models and workloads to identify compute, memory, bandwidth, scheduling and data-movement bottlenecks. 
 - Build software-based performance models and workload prototypes to evaluate architectural concepts. 
 - Develop experiments to quantify the impact of proposed hardware features on model performance and accelerator utilization. 
 - Investigate issues such as quantization, sparsity, operator fusion, tensor layouts, tiling, data reuse, memory bandwidth and scheduling efficiency. 
 - Correlate software/model-level performance with architectural and micro-architectural behavior. 
 - Use workload analysis to guide both current-generation optimizations and next-generation NPU architecture. 

Architecture Prototyping

- Rapidly prototype software solutions for architectural concepts that may be months or years away from production silicon. 
 - Develop functional models, compiler prototypes, simulators, emulators, reference implementations or runtime abstractions as needed to validate architectural ideas. 
 - Demonstrate end-to-end execution of representative AI workloads on proposed NPU architectures. 
 - Build proof-of-concepts that allow hardware architects to make informed architectural decisions before RTL implementation. 
 - Help establish software models and interfaces that can later evolve into production compiler components. 

Cross-Functional Leadership

- Work closely with NPU hardware architects, micro-architects, RTL designers and the production compiler/software organization. 
 - Bridge the communication gap between hardware and software teams and translate requirements in both directions. 
 - Participate in architecture definition from early concept through implementation and silicon bring-up. 
 - Mentor engineers and contribute to technical direction for compiler-driven hardware/software co-design. 
 - Influence the roadmap of future NPU architectures through workload and software-driven insights. 

Necessary Qualifications

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering or a related field. 

8+ years of experience in compiler development, systems software, computer architecture, AI accelerators, or a closely related area. 

Strong understanding of compiler architecture and compiler optimization techniques. 

Strong C++ programming skills and proficiency in Python. 

Strong understanding of computer architecture and familiarity with accelerator architectures, memory hierarchies and data movement. 

Experience analyzing AI/ML workloads and understanding performance bottlenecks. 

Ability to work across hardware and software boundaries and communicate effectively with hardware architects. 

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to rapidly prototype and evaluate architectural ideas. 

Good to have

- Experience developing compilers or software stacks for NPUs, GPUs, DSPs, TPUs or other AI accelerators. 
 - Experience with MLIR, LLVM, TOSA, StableHLO, Torch-MLIR or similar compiler infrastructure. 
 - Experience with accelerator-specific scheduling, tiling, memory management or code generation. 
 - Understanding of NPU architecture concepts such as dataflow, tensor engines, systolic/array-based compute, local SRAMs, DMA/data movement and accelerator instruction sets.
