Role overviewMogi I/O is hiring a Senior Backend and DevOps Engineer to own the Go services, streaming pipelines and on-premises Kubernetes infrastructure behind our video platform - live streaming, transcoding and secure content delivery at tens of millions of requests a day. 

About Mogi I/O: We build video infrastructure - live streaming, video-on-demand, transcoding and protected delivery - for media companies, creators and government projects. Our platform runs primarily on our own on-premises Kubernetes infrastructure, with GCP also in use, and our engineers own their systems end to end, from code to production. 

What you'll doYou will design, build and run the Go services and infrastructure that keep our streams fast, secure and available under heavy load. 

Backend & distributed systems

- Design and build high-throughput, concurrent Go services (goroutines, channels, context) that serve tens of millions of requests per day
 - Plan capacity and optimise services as traffic grows by an order of magnitude
 - Build safeguards against cascading failures - timeouts, retries, circuit breaking, rate limiting - so the platform holds up during traffic spikes
 - Build stateless, horizontally scalable APIs backed by PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis and RabbitMQStreaming & media

- Own live-streaming pipelines over RTMP/RTMPS, HLS and WebRTC, and push end-to-end latency down to a few seconds
 - Build and maintain transcoding and packaging pipelines with FFmpeg and Shaka Packager (CMAF, fMP4), tuned for low-bandwidth devices and fast startup
 - Build HLS encryption, URL signing and protected delivery through AWS CloudFront
 - Run re-streaming to third-party platforms such as YouTube and InstagramOn-prem infrastructure, Kubernetes & DevOps

On-prem Kubernetes

- Build and run highly available on-premises Kubernetes clusters (kubeadm, RKE2 or similar): multi-node control plane, etcd backup and restore, node lifecycle, zero-downtime upgrades
 - Own cluster networking: CNI (Cilium or Calico), MetalLB or BGP-based load balancing, ingress, VLANs, bonding, MTU tuning and DNS
 - Manage scheduling and capacity: resource requests and limits, node pools, GPU or high-memory nodes where needed, and capacity planning for traffic growth
 - Plan backup, disaster recovery and handle failoverLinux & storage

- Linux servers: basic performance tuning and troubleshooting
 - Manage disks and storage for the cluster: disk setup, persistent volumes, monitoring disk health and capacity, and handling disk failuresProxmox

- Provision and manage VMs and LXC containers, including their networking and storage
 - Build and maintain Proxmox clusters with high availability and live migration
 - Configure storage (LVM, ZFS, Ceph, NFS) and networking (bridges, VLANs)
 - Manage templates, backups and restores, and handle upgrades with minimal downtime
 - Run Kubernetes nodes as Proxmox VMs and troubleshoot performance issuesCloud & DevOps

- Support workloads on GCP (GKE) and troubleshoot issues as they come up
 - Manage infrastructure as code with Terraform across production and test environments
 - Ship through GitOps with Argo CD and CI/CD pipelines on Jenkins and Docker
 - Build serverless components on AWS Lambda where they fit, such as scheduling and EPG jobsReliability & performance

- Run distributed load tests (Locust) to validate performance and failure behaviour before launches

data.title: DevOps / Platform Engineer
data.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a DevOps / Platform Engineer based in India. 

The DevOps / Platform Engineer will take ownership of the cloud infrastructure powering an AI-native cybersecurity platform that processes terabytes of data every day. You will help build, maintain, and scale reliable production environments while improving deployment efficiency and operational performance. Working within a multidisciplinary engineering team, you will have significant autonomy and responsibility for critical infrastructure projects. The role combines cloud engineering, CI/CD ownership, observability, incident response, and AI-driven automation. You will also help build and operate production infrastructure for AI agents, with a focus on security, reliability, and cost control. This is an opportunity for a mid-to-senior engineer to make a direct impact in a remote-first, AI-focused engineering environment. 

Accountabilities

Responsibilities

As a DevOps / Platform Engineer, you will be responsible for the reliability, scalability, and continuous improvement of production infrastructure. You will own projects from initial requirements through implementation and delivery, collaborating with engineering colleagues and customers to achieve meaningful results. Your responsibilities will include: 

- Run, maintain, and scale production cloud infrastructure supporting a platform that processes terabytes of data daily. 
 - Own build, deployment, and release pipelines for Python, C++, and TypeScript applications. 
 - Design, build, and manage production infrastructure for AI agents, incorporating observability, guardrails, and cost controls. 
 - Lead observability practices and incident response activities to maintain platform reliability. 
 - Automate repetitive operational tasks and workflows using AI agents. 
 - Take end-to-end ownership of infrastructure and platform engineering projects, from identifying requirements to delivering solutions. 
 - Manage multiple priorities, including major engineering projects and smaller AI-driven initiatives. 
 - Communicate effectively with engineering teams and customers, ensuring technical issues are understood and resolved. 
 - Identify opportunities to improve infrastructure, engineering processes, and operational efficiency. 
 - Make informed decisions about priorities and adapt quickly to changing requirements while maintaining delivery quality. 

Requirements

The ideal candidate is a technically strong, autonomous engineer who combines hands-on cloud infrastructure expertise with a proactive approach to problem-solving. You should be comfortable taking responsibility for complex projects, using AI tools as part of your daily workflow, and delivering results in a collaborative remote environment. The following qualifications and competencies are expected: 

- Extensive hands-on experience managing production cloud infrastructure using AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform (GCP). 
 - Practical experience with Infrastructure as Code (IaC), particularly Terraform or equivalent technologies. 
 - Strong experience with Docker and containerized environments. 
 - Proven ownership of CI/CD pipelines, including build, deployment, and release processes. 
 - Experience implementing and managing observability, incident response, and robust security practices. 
 - Daily, hands-on experience using AI agents and advanced AI models in engineering workflows. 
 - Ability to use LLMs and AI agents independently to learn unfamiliar technologies, navigate new codebases, and manage multiple projects effectively. 
 - Demonstrated ability to own engineering projects from conception through delivery, rather than focusing solely on assigned tickets. 
 - Strong customer focus, including the ability to communicate directly with customers and take responsibility for resolving their problems. 
 - High sense of urgency and sound judgment when reprioritizing work to maximize impact. 
 - Ability to set priorities, make decisions, and deliver results independently without close supervision. 
 - Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to explain technical decisions and implementation approaches clearly. 
 - Growth mindset, openness to constructive feedback, and willingness to rethink existing code or approaches when necessary. 
 - Trustworthy and accountable working style, with strong attention to detail and the ability to identify and communicate problems early. 
 - Availability to work remotely during UK business hours. 

Nice to Have

- Experience with Microsoft Azure, particularly in cloud migration initiatives and Azure Marketplace integration. 
 - Familiarity with ClickHouse or other data-intensive platforms. 
 - Experience operating LLM or AI agent workloads in production environments. 
 - Scripting experience with Python or Go. 
 - Familiarity with SOC 2, GDPR, or other regulated environments. 

Benefits

- Fully remote, long-term employment opportunity. 
 - Opportunity to work on an AI-native cybersecurity platform operating at significant data scale. 
 - High degree of autonomy and end-to-end ownership of engineering projects. 
 - Collaboration with a multidisciplinary international engineering team. 
 - Exposure to advanced AI agents, cloud infrastructure, and modern platform engineering practices. 
 - Opportunity for professional growth in a remote-first environment that values employee development and well-being. 

How Jobgether Works

We use an AI-powered matching process to ensure your application is reviewed quickly, objectively, and fairly against the role's core requirements. Our system identifies the top-fitting candidates, and this shortlist is then shared directly with the hiring company. The final decision and next steps (interviews, assessments) are managed by their internal team. 

We appreciate your interest and wish you the best!

Why Apply Through Jobgether?

Data Privacy Notice: By submitting your application, you acknowledge that Jobgether will process your personal data to evaluate your candidacy and share relevant information with the hiring employer. This processing is based on legitimate interest and pre-contractual measures under applicable data protection laws (including GDPR). You may exercise your rights (access, rectification, erasure, objection) at any time. 

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

Job Title: R&D Member of Technical Staff II, Cloud Operations & Infrastructure

At AVEVA, we're all about limitless possibilities. Are you?

As part of the Research and Development function, the global Cloud Operations & Infrastructure team combines software development and cloud operations to provide continuous integration and delivery of cloud-enabled products and solutions, along with continuous monitoring to ensure various cloud-specific customer requirements/SLAs are met. 

As a Cloud Operations Engineer you will play a pivotal role in designing, developing, and implementing advanced cloud-based applications and services. Your work will focus on pushing the boundaries of what's possible in cloud computing, exploring new technologies, and developing innovative solutions that align with the company's strategic goals. 

Working closely with your development and portfolio colleagues, together you will bring new solutions to the cloud following a standard framework to ensure they are operationally secure, stable and scalable. 

The global, 24x7 nature of the team means there may be a requirement for occasional work outside of the standard day and to be on call as part of a shared team rota. 

Key Responsibilities

- Work on modern approaches to software development including the ability to develop microservices and leverage serverless functions. 
 - Work with development teams to advise and contribute to improvements to operational stability, security, cost management and reporting requirements for our cloud solutions. 
 - Continually develop and improve DevOps processes, adding value through optimization, automation, and effective reporting.

 - Oversee relevant Cloud deployments to ensure successful implementation, track and report progress, resolve or escalate release issues.

 - Ensure new services meet required operational readiness standards before being accepted into operations. 
 - Ensure on-going compliance to security practices and policies.

 - Maintain clear and accurate operational documentation.

Essential Requirements

 - Proficient in containerization technologies like Docker or Kubernetes. 
 - Knowledge of API, REST, microservices, serverless architecture. 
 - Knowledge of Cloud Authentication protocols such as OAuth, Identity Servers, OpenID Connect and SAML etc. . . 
 - Knowledge of Azure administration, Azure APIs, Azure Functions, Logic Apps, APIO Management, Service Bus, Event Grids, Storage Accounts and Key Vaults and tools. Or, equivalent AWS experience. 
 - Knowledge and experience of operational support, software development and deployment methodologies and principles. 
 - Strong written, verbal and presentation skills, able to convey information clearly and concisely to technical and non-technical audiences. 
 - Attention to detail, diligent and tenacious. 
 - Excellent analysis and dissemination skills. 
 - High degree of personal motivation and ability to self-manage. 
 - Maintains and develops relevant industry and technology knowledge. 

Desired Skills And Competencies

- Certifications in Azure and/or AWS. 
 - Hands-on experience working within an Information Security accredited framework e. g. ISO27001, 27017/18. 
 - Experience working in Agile software development such as Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe). 

R&D at AVEVA

Our global team of 2000+ developers work on an incredibly diverse portfolio of over 75 industrial automation and engineering products, which cover everything from data management to 3D design. AI and cloud are at the centre of our strategy, and we have over 150 patents to our name. 

Our track record of innovation is no fluke - it's the result of a structured and deliberate focus on learning, collaboration and inclusivity. If you want to build applications that solve big problems, join us. 

Find out more: aveva. com/en/about/careers/r-and-d-careers/

India Benefits include: 

Gratuity, Medical and accidental insurance, very attractive leave entitlement, emergency leave days, childcare support, maternity, paternity and adoption leaves, education assistance program, home office set up support (for hybrid roles), well-being support

It's possible we're hiring for this position in multiple countries, in which case the above benefits apply to the primary location. Specific benefits vary by country, but our packages are similarly comprehensive. 

Find out more: aveva. com/en/about/careers/benefits/

Hybrid working

We work in a hybrid way at AVEVA. Most roles are based at a local AVEVA office, with an expectation of being on-site 50% of your working hours to support collaboration and connection. Some positions are fully office-based depending on the nature of the work, and certain roles that support specific customers or markets may be remote. The working arrangement for this position will be confirmed during the hiring process. 

Hiring process

Interested? Great! Get started by submitting your cover letter and CV through our application portal. AVEVA is committed to recruiting and retaining people with disabilities. Please let us know in advance if you need reasonable support during your application process. 

Find out more: aveva. com/en/about/careers/hiring-process

About AVEVA

AVEVA is a global leader in industrial software with more than 6, 500 employees in over 40 countries. Our cutting-edge solutions are used by thousands of enterprises to deliver the essentials of life - such as energy, infrastructure, chemicals, and minerals - safely, efficiently, and more sustainably. 

We are committed to embedding sustainability and inclusion into our operations, our culture, and our core business strategy. Learn more about how we are progressing against our ambitious 2030 targets: sustainability-report. aveva. com/

Find out more: aveva. com/en/about/careers/

AVEVA requires all successful applicants to undergo and pass a drug screening and comprehensive background check before they start employment. Background checks will be conducted in accordance with local laws and may, subject to those laws, include proof of educational attainment, employment history verification, proof of work authorization, criminal records, identity verification, credit check. Certain positions dealing with sensitive and/or third-party personal data may involve additional background check criteria. 

AVEVA is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to being an exemplary employer with an inclusive culture, developing a workplace environment where all our employees are treated with dignity and respect. We value diversity and the expertise that people from different backgrounds bring to our business. AVEVA provides reasonable accommodation to applicants with disabilities where appropriate. If you need reasonable accommodation for any part of the application and hiring process, please notify your recruiter. It is the digital market leader in Singapore and has won numerous awards for marketing, customer service, and innovative product offerings beyond connectivity.

Job Title: Principal Engineer, SRE & Service Operations

About This Role

- Design, implement, and maintain highly available, scalable, and resilient cloud infrastructure across AWS, GCP, and OCI as the primary platforms. 
 - Provide technical leadership and architectural expertise in Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) practices - covering observability, incident management, chaos engineering, and reliability frameworks. 
 - Lead infrastructure automation initiatives using Terraform, Ansible, and Python to drive zero-touch provisioning and configuration management across multi-cloud 
 - Define and enforce SLOs, SLIs, and Error Budgets across critical services, ensuring reliability targets are met without compromising velocity. 
 - Architect and operate Kubernetes-based workloads (EKS, GKE, OKE) with a focus on scalability, cost optimisation, and platform resilience. 
 - Own observability and monitoring strategy using tools such as Grafana, Prometheus, CloudWatch, and Cloud Monitoring to ensure proactive detection and resolution. 
 - Collaborate with development and platform teams to embed reliability, security, and performance standards into the software delivery lifecycle. 
 - Lead incident response, post-mortem culture, and continuous improvement initiatives to reduce MTTR and eliminate repeat failures. 
 - Ensure infrastructure design and operations align with regulatory, compliance, and data sovereignty requirements across cloud regions. 
 - Evaluate and adopt emerging cloud-native technologies across AWS, GCP, and OCI to drive innovation and operational excellence. 

What You'll Do

- Design and architect resilient, scalable infrastructure across cloud and hybrid environments with an SRE-first mindset covering reliability, availability, and performance. 
 - Architect and operate Kubernetes platforms and container workloads with focus on self-healing, auto-scaling, and platform resilience. 
 - Develop and maintain infrastructure-as-code using Terraform, Ansible, and Helm across AWS, GCP, and OCI environments - driving zero-touch provisioning and configuration management. 
 - Conduct performance tuning, capacity planning, and load testing to proactively identify bottlenecks and ensure systems scale reliably under peak demand. 
 - Collaborate with development and platform teams to embed reliability, security, and operational standards into CI/CD pipelines and software delivery lifecycle. 
 - Drive chaos engineering and resilience testing initiatives to validate system behaviour under failure conditions and continuously harden the platform. 
 - Establish and enforce SRE best practices, runbooks, and playbooks standardising operational procedures and reducing toil through automation. 
 - Mentor and upskill junior engineers on SRE principles, automation practices, and cloud-native operations to build long-term team capability. 

What We Are Looking For

- 12+ years of overall experience with a minimum of 6 years in SRE Architecture, operating in large-scale, high-availability, and mission-critical environments. 
 - Proven track record in designing and maintaining comprehensive observability stacks using Prometheus, Grafana, New Relic, Dynatrace covering monitoring, logging, alerting, and distributed tracing. 
 - Expert in Kubernetes orchestration (EKS, GKE, OKE) cluster architecture, workload reliability, auto-scaling, and platform hardening across multi-cloud environments. 
 - Strong hands-on expertise across AWS, GCP, and OCI cloud-native architecture, hybrid cloud operations, and infrastructure optimisation at scale. 
 - Proficient in Infrastructure-as-Code and automation using Terraform, Ansible, and Helm driving zero-touch provisioning, configuration management, and GitOps workflows. 
 - Expert in incident management and reliability operations leading high-severity incident response, blameless post-mortems, RCA, and systematic elimination of repeat failures. 
 - Hands-on experience with chaos engineering and resilience validation proactively testing failure modes and hardening systems against real-world degradation scenarios. 
 - Proven ability to lead, mentor, and grow SRE teams - establishing engineering standards, runbooks, playbooks, and a culture of operational excellence. 
 - Hands-on experience with project and delivery management tooling such as JIRA, with strong ability to manage priorities across concurrent reliability initiatives. 
 - Outstanding analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills - ability to translate complex infrastructure challenges into clear architectural decisions and stakeholder narratives. 

Who You Will Work With

- Co-Founders and HODs
 - Engineering Teams
 - External customers/MNOs and vendors

Circles is committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace. We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, national origin, gender, disability or age. 

Data Protection and Privacy Statement

By submitting an application for this position, you, as the applicant, or your authorised representative(s), consent to Circles' Candidate Data Protection and Privacy Policy. You also agree to the collection, use, and/or disclosure of your personal data by us solely for recruitment purposes as specified in the Policy. You acknowledge that you have read and understood the Policy, are aware of your rights regarding your personal data, and accept the terms relating to international data transfers, where applicable. You further understand that you may withdraw consent at any time, which may affect our ability to consider your application. In instances where your personal data or application is submitted by a third party, it is understood that such third party has been duly authorised by you to disclose the relevant personal data and provide consent on your behalf, and that you have been made aware of this Policy. 

To all recruitment agencies: Circles will only acknowledge resumes shared by recruitment agencies if selected in our preferred supplier partnership program. 

Please do not forward resumes to our jobs alias, Circles, employees or any other company location. Circles will not be held accountable for any fees related to unsolicited resumes not uploaded via our ATS.

data.title: Software Development Engineer
data.description:
Software Development Engineer - Full Stack, Backend Focus

2-5 years' experience | Competitive compensation + potential ESOPs

About Auto Data Catalog

A business question rarely fits neatly inside one database. 

Auto Data Catalog (ADC) helps business users ask questions about their company's data in natural language and get reliable, explainable answers. Our platform builds an evolving knowledge graph of business data to give AI the context it needs to answer accurately. 

We're a small engineering team building a product already being used by customers. We're hiring two engineers to help tackle our next set of challenges: answering questions across multiple data sources and analyzing uploaded files. 

What you'll build

This is a full-stack role with approximately 80% of the work in Python backend development. Our frontend uses React, Next. js and Tailwind, supported by Django REST Framework APIs. 

In your first three months, your main focus will be: 

- Enabling users to ask questions that combine information across multiple data sources. 
 - Helping users upload files and analyze their contents through ADC. 

You'll own features from design through implementation and production, build database integrations and APIs, improve performance and reliability, and contribute to code reviews and technical decisions. You'll work closely with the founder and other engineers, with direct visibility into how customers use what you build. 

What we're looking for

- 2-5 years of software development experience, with hands-on experience building and maintaining backend applications. 
 - Strong programming fundamentals and the ability to reason through unfamiliar problems. 
 - Python proficiency, or strong backend experience in another language and a willingness to become productive in Python quickly. 
 - Experience working with APIs, SQL and relational databases. 
 - The ability to debug issues, write maintainable code and test the behavior that matters. 
 - Clear communication and ownership: you can take a problem, clarify what needs to happen and carry it through to a working solution. 

Frontend skills can be learned on the job. Experience with Django REST Framework, React, cloud platforms, Docker, data integrations or LLM applications would be useful. 

Why join ADC

- Own meaningful parts of an AI product early in its development. 
 - Work on practical problems involving AI, business context, databases and reliable software. 
 - See your work reach customers and use their feedback to improve it. 
 - Help shape engineering decisions and development practices as the team grows. 

Compensation

We offer competitive compensation tailored to your skills, experience and the impact you can bring to ADC. We assess each candidate individually, with flexibility for exceptional talent. Additional ESOPs are open for discussion for the right candidate. 

Location and work arrangements

- Gurugram: Our workspace is in Wazirabad, with three days per week in the office. 
 - Bengaluru: Candidates can initially work remotely. We may introduce a coworking arrangement as the local team grows. 
 - We plan to establish a dedicated Bengaluru workspace and move the team there in approximately one year. Gurugram hires should be willing to relocate to Bengaluru. 

Interview process

Two rounds of discussion covering your past work, technical problem-solving and the role. We're looking for candidates who can join within approximately one month. 

How to apply

Apply through the hiring form on autodatacatalog. com. Include a short example - around 150 words - of a backend feature or system you personally built or improved, explaining your contribution and the result. Public code or project links are welcome but optional. 

Please use the application form so we can review your application consistently. Applications sent by DM may be missed.

data.description:
About Us

Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid. 

At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale - tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world. 

Join Visa and do work that matters - to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you. 

Job Description

Role Summary: 

The Sr. Manager; Software Engineering leads a team responsible for reviewing business requirements and developing functional and technical design documentation. This role oversees the design and implementation of testing procedures for APIs, abstractions, and integration patterns to address distributed computing challenges, including end-to-end and integration testing. The Sr. Manager participates in design reviews, providing input on requirements, product designs, schedules, and potential issues, and works across the team to ensure productivity, predictability, and delivery of high-quality results. 

The position includes accountability for code review and the team's development and testing activities, as well as participation in proof of concepts and technical evaluations of new technologies. The Sr. Manager is expected to foster a collaborative environment, ensuring the team meets business needs and delivers robust solutions. 

All roles require digital fluency, including the ability to work with emerging technologies such as Generative AI tools (e. g. ChatGPT, Microsoft Copilot) to support everyday work. 

Essential Functions

People Leadership & Talent Development: 

- Hire, retain, and develop a diverse, high-performing team of software engineers across the Bangalore hub. 
 - Own performance management, career growth, and promotion pipelines; deliver concrete coaching and mentoring to grow engineers into senior/staff roles. 
 - Build a healthy, inclusive team culture with strong engagement and retention signals. 

Delivery & Execution Management

- Own end-to-end delivery for a product area - planning, prioritization, risk management, and predictable execution against roadmap commitments. 
 - Drive operational excellence: incident ownership, on-call health, code quality, and reduction of technical debt. 
 - Manage multiple competing initiatives and timelines, balancing scope, speed, and quality. 
 - Establish and track delivery metrics (on-time delivery, uptime, throughput, defect rates) and report progress to stakeholders. 

Technical Credibility & Hands-On Engagement

- Stay close enough to the technology to review code and designs, unblock engineers, and make sound technical calls - capable of going hands-on when needed. 
 - Participate in architecture and design reviews; provide informed technical judgment on trade-offs. 
 - Guide troubleshooting, defect triage, and root-cause analysis for critical issues. 

GenAI/LLM Leadership

- Champion the adoption of GenAI and modern engineering tooling within the team, driving practical, production use cases. 
 - Stay technically literate in GenAI/LLM concepts and evaluate opportunities to apply them to the product area. 
 - Partner with engineers building GenAI-enabled features; support experimentation while ensuring production rigor. 

System Design & Architecture Judgment

- Guide the team's architecture and technical direction for the product area, ensuring scalability, security, and resilience. 
 - Evaluate build-vs-buy and technology choices; set standards for APIs, microservices, and integration patterns (HTTP, REST, JSON, XML). 
 - Partner with architects and other engineering leaders to align designs with platform-wide standards. 

Stakeholder & Organizational Influence

- Collaborate cross-functionally with product, QA, DevOps, and global engineering teams to deliver complete solutions. 
 - Partner with business stakeholders on requirements, workflow design, and process re-engineering. 
 - Represent the team in cross-org planning and communicate status, risks, and trade-offs clearly to leadership. 
 - Collaborate across global, distributed teams and time zones to ensure alignment and consistent delivery standards. 

Visa requires at least 3 days in office, expectations of these days will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager. 

Qualifications

Preferred Qualifications: 

- 12 or more years of relevant work experience with a Bachelor's Degree or 10 or more years of relevant experience with an Advanced Degree, or 7 or more years of experience with a PhD. 
 - Proven experience leading and growing engineering teams - hiring, coaching, performance management, and driving retention. 
 - Track record of delivering a product area predictably, with metrics for on-time delivery, quality, and operational health. 
 - Hands-on coding experience in one or more modern programming languages (e. g. , Java, Python, C#, Node. js), with the depth to review code and engage in technical discussions. 
 - Expertise with container and cloud technologies (e. g. , Docker, Kubernetes, AWS, Azure, or GCP). 
 - Experience with observability stacks (e. g. , Prometheus, Grafana, ELK/OpenSearch, Datadog, or Splunk). 
 - Experience championing or driving adoption of GenAI/LLM technologies within an engineering team. 
 - Experience building and guiding teams that build microservices using HTTP, REST, JSON, and XML. 
 - Experience guiding system design and architecture decisions for a product or platform area. 
 - Experience managing incidents, production support, and operational excellence practices. 
 - Experience partnering with product, QA, DevOps, and Agile/Scrum teams in a distributed, global engineering organization. 
 - Strong verbal, written, and presentation skills, with the ability to communicate technical and business trade-offs to diverse stakeholders. 
 - Payment industry experience is highly desirable. 

The Skills You Bring

- Energy and Experience: A growth mindset that is curious and passionate about technology, and enjoys leading teams on challenging, global-scale projects. 
 - People-First Leadership: A genuine investment in developing engineers, with a track record of promotions, mentoring, and healthy team retention. 
 - Technical Credibility: Comfortable enough with the technology to review designs and code, and to earn the trust of senior engineers. 
 - Learner: A drive to stay current on emerging technologies such as GenAI, Kubernetes, Docker, and modern cloud-native patterns. 
 - Partnership: Experience collaborating with Product, Test, DevOps, and Agile/Scrum teams to deliver outcomes, not just output. 
 - Execution Discipline: Ability to manage multiple competing priorities and deliver predictably in a fast-paced environment. 

Visa is an EEO Employer

Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. Visa will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with EEOC guidelines and applicable local law.

About The Job

We are looking for an ETL QA Architect with strong experience in ETL testing, data quality validation, and large-scale data processing. The role focuses on validating data movement between source and target systems, ensuring data accuracy, completeness, and integrity, and identifying data quality issues across data pipelines.  - Advanced SQL query-writing skills and hands-on experience with Hive, Spark, Spark SQL, and the DataFrame API. 
 - Experience with Snowflake data warehousing.

 - Ability to document and present findings clearly and concisely. 
 - Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

data.title: Manager – Post silicon Validation
data.description:
WHAT YOU DO AT AMD CHANGES EVERYTHING

At AMD, our mission is to build great products that accelerate next-generation computing experiences-from AI and data centers, to PCs, gaming and embedded systems. Grounded in a culture of innovation and collaboration, we believe real progress comes from bold ideas, human ingenuity and a shared passion to create something extraordinary. When you join AMD, you'll discover the real differentiator is our culture. We push the limits of innovation to solve the world's most important challenges-striving for execution excellence, while being direct, humble, collaborative, and inclusive of diverse perspectives. Join us as we shape the future of AI and beyond. Together, we advance your career. 

MANAGER - Post Silicon SoC Validation and Power/Performance

The Role

As Manager-Post Silicon IP Validation in Embedded Group, you will own strategic planning, execution, and leadership for SoC enablement/validation, and power/performance attainment for highly leveraged embedded products. By managing both internal and external deliverables, you will work to ensure all embedded new products are executed and delivered on time. This critical and highly visible role provides an excellent growth opportunity for high performing individuals looking to make a difference and deliver a stand-out experience to customers of AMD. 

The Person

A successful candidate will have the ability to establish and drive to goals including plan of record, timelines, budget, scope, performance, and quality. A candidate must be self-motivated, must have a passion for working with a diverse team of creative engineers and senior executives, must be able to deftly manage both internal and external dependencies and ensure all embedded products are delivered on time. This role requires strong technical expertise in semiconductor systems, cross-functional collaboration, people management skills, and proven leadership in managing complex silicon validation programs. The candidate must be a team player with a commitment to meeting deadlines and an aptitude to thrive in a fast paced, multi-tasking environment. 

Key Responsibilities

- SoC Enablement/Validation/Debug Activities
 - Drive post-silicon IP enablement and functional/electrical validation activities
 - Identify and drive compliance activities with internal central teams and external labs
 - Ensure appropriate validation coverage across the IPs at various temperature range
 - Oversee critical debug and triage towards any Silicon related issues 
 - SoC Power and Performance Attainment
 - Drive the teams for the bounding box attainment and ensuring validation for power/performance across PVT conditions
 - Oversee EDC/TDC tuning, CaC validation, and comprehensive power and thermal characterization
 - Leadership & Team Development
 - Build and mentor a high-performing team across the various domains
 - Define team goals, priorities, and meet execution plans aligned with program milestones
 - Plan headcount and allocate resources effectively
 - Collaborate with multi-functional leaders to drive AMD's success

Role Summary

We are seeking an experienced embedded software engineer to lead the architecture, development, and integration of embedded platforms spanning MCU firmware, RTOS, embedded Linux, platform-management protocols, and hardware-backed security. 

This role combines system-level technical ownership with hands-on development and debugging. You will drive the design of secure, resilient, and recoverable platforms while guiding the translation of complex requirements into reusable, validated software solutions. 

Required Skills And Qualifications

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in a relevant engineering discipline, with 10+ years of embedded software experience and a demonstrated track record of technical ownership for complex platforms or subsystems.

 - Substantial expertise in one or more of the following areas: Zephyr OS, RTOS-based MCU development, or embedded Linux platform development, complemented by practical experience integrating firmware, drivers, middleware, and host-side software. 
 - Demonstrated implementation or architectural experience in at least one of the following domains: firmware development, secure boot, platform security, or specification-driven software development. 
 - Proven ability to lead complex debugging efforts, conduct architecture and code reviews, mentor engineers, and resolve technical trade-offs while remaining actively involved in implementation. 
 - Strong communication, technical documentation, planning, and cross-functional collaboration skills, with a proven ability to take ambiguous technical challenges from investigation through implementation and validation.

data.title: Principal Quality Assurance Engineer
data.description:
Deltek is seeking a Principal Quality Assurance Engineer who brings deep ERP and accounting domain expertise to ensure the correctness, reliability, and real-world fidelity of our Startpoint platform. 

This is not a traditional testing role - the primary value is domain authority, not test execution. You will act as the customer proxy, owning end-to-end correctness of the ERP system and elevating quality thinking across the entire engineering organization. 

The ideal candidate thinks like a real user navigating complex accounting workflows, surfaces issues that engineering wouldn't anticipate, and partners with Product and Engineering as a domain authority who can validate that the system behaves correctly for real-world ERP scenarios. 

If you have a deep background in accounting or ERP systems, can reason across full business workflows, and want to own quality from first principles rather than execute scripts, we invite you to join our team. 

Responsibilities: • Own end-to-end correctness of ERP workflows in Startpoint - from data entry to financial output - ensuring GAAP compliance and real-world fidelity. 

• Act as the domain authority and customer proxy, validating complex ERP scenarios that go beyond feature behavior: purchase order variations, billing workflows, payroll runs, multi-entity financials. 

• Identify gaps between specification and reality, feeding actionable improvements back to Product and Engineering. 

• Evaluate full-flow scenarios - not just UI or API behavior - including dataset correctness, cross-feature interactions, and data migration fidelity. 

• Serve as the quality catalyst for the team: raise the bar on quality thinking, help level up engineers and testers, and define what "good" looks like for ERP correctness. 

• Build and maintain a deep knowledge base of system behavior that can evolve into support readiness and product validation authority. 

• Collaborate with Product Managers, Engineers, and QE leads to define quality requirements grounded in real customer usage patterns and ensure they are consistently met. 

• Analyze defect trends, patterns, and root causes to identify systemic quality issues and drive improvements across the product. 

• Analyze fleet usage data to pinpoint future investment opportunities. Qualifications: 

• Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field. 

• Professional accounting qualification (CPA, ACCA, or equivalent) is a strong differentiator. 

• Relevant certifications in software quality or ERP systems are advantageous. 

Experience: 

• 8+ years of experience working with ERP systems - as a practitioner, implementer, consultant, or quality engineer with deep domain knowledge. 

• Proven expertise in at least two of: Project Accounting, Financial Accounting, Accounts Payable/Receivable, Payroll, Time & Expense, Purchasing, or Inventory. 

• Experience validating complex, real-world business scenarios end-to-end - not just feature-level test cases. 

• Track record of identifying systemic quality gaps and driving improvements at the process and engineering level. 

• Experience working in Agile/Sprint environments with globally distributed teams. 

• Prior experience with Ajera, Costpoint, Vantagepoint, or comparable AEC/GovCon ERP systems is highly desirable. Technical Qualifications: 

• Deep understanding of ERP data models, accounting transaction flows, and financial reporting logic. 

• Ability to write SQL queries for data validation and scenario verification - comfortable working directly with database outputs. 

• Familiarity with API testing concepts and tools (e. g. , Postman) to validate system integrations. 

• Ability to interpret and validate data migration results for schema comparison and record fidelity. • Familiarity with AI-assisted testing concepts or willingness to work within an AI native QE pipeline is a plus. 

• Basic understanding of version control (Git) and issue tracking (ADO/TFS or equivalent). 

Soft Skills: 

• Exceptional domain reasoning - can think through a complex accounting scenario from first principles, not just pattern-match to test scripts. 

• Strong communication skills: able to articulate correctness concerns clearly to engineers, PMs, and leadership. 

• Customer-zero mindset: naturally simulates real user behavior and surfaces the issues a real customer would encounter. 

• Proactive and self-directed - identifies what needs validating without being told. 

• High ownership mentality: comfortable being the sole domain authority on ERP correctness in a fast-moving product team. 

• Collaborative and constructive: elevates others' quality thinking rather than policing defects.

Senior QA Engineer(GCP)
data.description:
Senior QA Engineer (GCP)

Key Requirement: 4+ years of hands-on experience testing solutions on Google Cloud Platform (GCP) - this is non-negotiable. 

Role Summary

We are seeking a hands-on QA Engineer or QA Analyst to validate the GCP ingestion framework developed with Java, microservices, Google Cloud Platform (GCP), and Kubernetes. The successful candidate will define and execute a comprehensive quality strategy for enterprise data ingestion and downstream processing. 

This role will analyze the frameworks built, create traceable test coverage, and validate full loads, incremental loads, and partition-overwrite loads. The candidate will test framework reliability, data accuracy, error handling, alerting, and operational readiness, then provide evidence for signoff and support promotion through SIT, PRE-PROD, and PROD environments. 

Key Responsibilities

- Quality Strategy & Test Design
 - Collaborate with product and engineering to translate requirements into testable, risk-based strategies. 
 - Design comprehensive test plans, scenarios, and traceability matrices - from early design to release. 
 - Define clear entry/exit criteria, test data needs, and signoff evidence - ensuring quality is measurable and auditable. 
 - Functional & Data Validation
 - Validate end-to-end data ingestion: full, incremental, and partition-overwrite loads - including watermarking, deduplication, and restartability. 
 - Reconcile source and target data: counts, schemas, business keys, and field-level accuracy. 
 - Test edge cases: malformed records, nulls, duplicates, empty inputs, large files, and boundary conditions. 
 - Automation & CI/CD Integration
 - Build and maintain automated test suites (API, integration, data validation, regression, smoke) for Java/microservice systems. 
 - Integrate tests into CI/CD pipelines - publishing clear, actionable results and evidence. 
 - Manage reusable test data, mocks, stubs, and environment-agnostic setups for consistent, repeatable testing. 
 - Resilience, Observability & Non-Functional Testing
 - Test error handling, retries, idempotency, dead-letter handling, and recovery workflows. 
 - Validate Cloud Monitoring, logging, alerting, and dashboard reliability. 
 - Conduct performance, scalability, concurrency, soak, and recovery testing - especially for high-volume ingestion. 
 - Assess Kubernetes health (readiness/liveness probes, scaling, restart behavior) and cloud-native deployments. 
 - Verify security controls: IAM, secrets management, least-privilege access, and data protection. 
 - Defect Management & Release Readiness
 - Log clear, reproducible defects with business impact, logs, and evidence - and partner with teams to resolve them. 
 - Lead regression cycles, manage defect aging, and support release-readiness reviews. 
 - Produce test completion reports, quality dashboards, and formal signoff packages for SIT, PRE-PROD, and PROD. 

Required Qualifications

- 4+ years of hands-on QA experience - especially with enterprise data platforms, APIs, or ingestion systems. 
 - Proven ability to design and execute test strategies, plans, and traceability matrices. 
 - Experience testing Java apps, REST APIs, microservices, batch/streaming pipelines, and distributed systems. 
 - Strong GCP experience: Cloud Storage, BigQuery, Pub/Sub, Dataflow, Cloud Monitoring, etc. 
 - Deep familiarity with full-load, incremental-load, partition-overwrite, watermarking, reconciliation, and idempotency scenarios. 
 - Advanced SQL and data-validation skills: source-to-target checks, schema validation, control totals. 
 - Automation experience: CI/CD integration, test frameworks (Java-based), and test reporting tools. 
 - Comfort with Kubernetes/containerized apps: health checks, config, scaling, and deployment behavior. 
 - Ability to analyze legacy behavior, clarify ambiguous requirements, and communicate quality risks to stakeholders. 
 - Experience supporting testing across SIT, PRE-PROD, and PROD environments. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with ATLAS or similar enterprise ingestion frameworks (or legacy modernization projects). 
 - Hands-on with Docker, Kubernetes, Helm, Terraform, and cloud-native CI/CD pipelines. 
 - Familiarity with Apache Beam, data pipelines, schema evolution, and data-quality controls. 
 - Ability to build quality dashboards, validate alerts, and produce incident-response evidence. 
 - Performance testing experience: large-volume loads, recovery, and production-readiness reviews. 
 - Background in Agile teams: estimation, backlog refinement, and cross-functional collaboration. 
 - Knowledge of cloud security best practices: IAM, secrets, network boundaries, and least-privilege validation. 

Ready to help shape the future of enterprise data? We'd love to hear from you. 

Skills: sql, cloud monitoring, data validation, google cloud platform, rest apis, apache beam, helm, junit, dataflow, docker, ci/cd, pub/sub, terraform, bigquery, java, cloud storage, microservices, kubernetes, test automation, selenium

Senior Software Performance Engineer

6+ Years Experience | PAX India

About The Role

Help scale the performance engineering discipline across Blackbaud - building the tooling, practices, and expertise that let dev and ops teams do their own performance analysis, while staying hands-on enough to solve the hardest problems yourself and mentor others. 

Our core stack is Kubernetes/Azure-based microservices, though you'll occasionally support older, more monolithic systems too - the core skills (profiling, load testing, root-cause analysis) transfer directly. 

This is a hands-on coding role: most of your time goes to building and maintaining our load/synthetic test tooling (including AI-assisted testing) and integrating it into our SDLC. The rest is split between observability tooling and ad hoc performance analysis, with strong ownership of latency, throughput, and resource efficiency. 

What You'll Do

Load & Synthetic Test Tooling

- Build and maintain our synthetic/load-testing framework - test development (Playwright/Gatling), execution, and reporting. 
 - Apply AI capabilities to improve test development - AI-assisted authoring, scenario generation, result analysis. 
 - Integrate performance and synthetic tests into CI/CD pipelines so checks run continuously, not just ad hoc. 

Observability & Ad Hoc Performance Analysis

- Improve observability tooling (Splunk, Grafana, Honeycomb, App Insights, AppDynamics, New Relic): dashboards, alerting, SLIs/SLOs, instrumentation. 
 - Run load, stress, and soak tests to catch bottlenecks before production; profile CPU, memory, GC, I/O, and network in C#/. NET and/or Java services. 
 - Troubleshoot production performance issues (latency regressions, resource exhaustion, throttling) and tune resource usage in Kubernetes/AKS (requests/limits, autoscaling, kubectl diagnostics). 

Ongoing

- Build self-serve performance capabilities (dashboards, guardrails, docs) so teams can diagnose issues without escalating. 
 - Design and maintain C#/. NET and/or Java microservices with a focus on performance and scalability. 
 - Collaborate via Agile/GitHub workflows and mentor junior engineers on profiling and troubleshooting. 

What You'll Bring

- 6+ years of software engineering experience with meaningful exposure to performance, scalability, or reliability engineering. 
 - Strong C#/. NET and/or Java skills, plus strong Azure experience. 
 - Solid grasp of how compute resources (CPU, memory, I/O, network) drive performance/scalability, including tuning in containerized environments. 
 - Hands-on experience with a load-testing tool (k6, JMeter, Locust, Gatling) and a browser-automation tool for synthetic/end-to-end testing (Selenium, Cypress, Playwright). 
 - Experience with profiling tools (dotnet-trace, PerfView, App Insights profiler) and observability/APM tooling (Splunk, Grafana, Honeycomb, AppDynamics, New Relic). 
 - Some experience applying AI/LLM tools to dev workflows (AI-assisted coding, test generation, analysis). 
 - Experience integrating tooling/tests into CI/CD (Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions) and troubleshooting production performance issues. 
 - Working knowledge of Linux fundamentals and networking basics (DNS, TLS, routing) as they relate to performance. 
 - Experience with Agile/GitHub, strong documentation and communication skills, and comfort working across time zones. 

You'll Thrive in This Role If You

- Are self-motivated and comfortable driving your own investigations without step-by-step direction. 
 - Have systemic curiosity - you want to understand how a system behaves end-to-end, and think across layers from application code down through infrastructure and database. 
 - Question assumptions and keep digging until you find the actual root cause, not just the first plausible explanation. 

Nice to Have

- Gatling or Playwright experience specifically. 
 - AKS experience (cluster ops, node pools, scaling) with a performance/capacity lens. 
 - Front-end development experience using Angular/TypeScript. 
 - Database-layer performance troubleshooting (query plans, indexing, stored procedure tuning). 
 - Familiarity with distributed tracing (OpenTelemetry), capacity planning and cost/performance trade-off analysis. 

Quick Summary

"Backend-heavy engineer who codes daily, hunts down and fixes performance bottlenecks, and operates production systems; strong in C#/. NET and/or Java, Azure, compute/resource performance fundamentals, load testing, and observability. "

About The Role

We are seeking an experienced QA Lead to own test strategy, automation and release quality on a large-scale enterprise platform delivered for a global automotive client. 

The QA Lead will lead an offshore QA team within a distributed onsite/offshore model, partnering daily with US-based technical leads, developers and product stakeholders to ensure every release is well-tested, predictable and delivered on sprint commitments. 

What You Will Do

Define and own the test strategy, test plans, estimates and quality gates for platform releases. 

Design, build and maintain UI and API test automation frameworks (Selenium/Playwright, REST Assured) using Java or Python. 

Integrate automated test suites into CI/CD pipelines so that regression runs are fast, repeatable and trusted. 

Lead, mentor and allocate work across the offshore QA team; review test cases and automation code to keep the bar high. 

Drive functional, regression, integration, system and UAT test cycles, including backend and data validation using SQL. 

Run defect triage with developers and product, drive root-cause analysis and track fixes through to closure. 

Track and report quality metrics - coverage, defect leakage, pass rates - and provide clear go/no-go recommendations for releases. 

Participate in Agile ceremonies - sprint planning, backlog refinement, daily stand-ups and reviews - providing realistic QA estimates and flagging risk early. 

Document test approaches, frameworks and QA processes so that knowledge is transferable across the onsite and offshore team. 

Collaborate proactively across time zones with US-based leads, developers and product, communicating quality status and blockers without needing to be chased. 

A Note on Hands-On Leadership

This is a hands-on lead role. The QA Lead is expected to write and maintain automation alongside the team, not only coordinate testing. Candidates should be able to walk through a framework they personally built or maintained, explain the design choices behind it, and write or debug a test live. 

Required Qualifications

What We Are Looking For

8+ years of software QA experience, including 2+ years leading or mentoring a QA team. 

Proven ability to define test strategy, test plans and estimates for enterprise applications. 

Strong hands-on test automation with Selenium WebDriver, Playwright or Cypress using Java or Python. 

Solid API testing experience with Postman and REST Assured, including microservices-based systems. 

Experience with TestNG/JUnit and BDD frameworks such as Cucumber. 

Good SQL skills for backend and data validation against relational databases. 

Experience integrating tests into CI/CD tooling such as Jenkins, GitHub Actions or Azure DevOps, with Git-based workflows. 

Experience with defect and test management in Jira (Xray, Zephyr or similar). 

Experience delivering in Agile/Scrum teams within a distributed onsite/offshore model. 

Excellent written and verbal English communication, with the ability to work directly with US-based leads and stakeholders across time zones. 

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering or a related discipline. 

Preferred / Differentiating Qualifications

Performance and load testing experience with JMeter, Gatling or k6. 

Mobile test automation experience with Appium. 

Contract testing and microservices test approaches; exposure to Docker/Kubernetes. 

Experience testing on cloud platforms such as AWS or Azure. 

Awareness of security testing basics and test data management practices. 

Experience testing large-scale enterprise platforms; ISTQB certification (Foundation or Advanced Test Manager) is a plus. 

Characteristics of the Person We Are Looking For

Genuinely hands-on. Builds and maintains automation, not just test plans. 

A leader. Grows the team, sets standards and holds the quality bar without micromanaging. 

A clear communicator. Explains quality risk plainly in English, in writing and on a call, to onsite leads and non-engineers alike. 

Detail-oriented. Catches the edge cases others miss and insists on evidence before sign-off. 

A strong investigator. Reproduces issues reliably, reasons from logs and data, and pinpoints root cause with developers. 

Proactive across time zones. Surfaces risks and progress early rather than going quiet between stand-ups. 

Pragmatic. Balances test coverage against delivery reality and knows where risk-based testing is the right call. 

What Success Looks Like

A successful QA Lead delivers predictable, well-tested releases with low defect leakage. Automation coverage grows sprint over sprint, regression is fast and trusted, and quality status is clear and credible to onsite leads. The offshore QA team becomes a self-sufficient, high-performing unit rather than a bottleneck.

Role Overview

Nasuni is expanding the DryvIQ engineering team in Hyderabad. DryvIQ brings intelligent content discovery, classification, sensitivity detection, and policy-driven governance to enterprise unstructured data across cloud and on-premises repositories. 

We are seeking a Principal Software Engineer in Test (SDET) to lead the evolution of test automation architecture and engineering quality across Nasuni's DryvIQ Kubernetes-based distributed application environment. 

This is a hands-on principal engineering role with C#/. NET as the primary automation development stack. You will own critical architectural decisions, modernize and scale established automation frameworks, and establish engineering practices that improve reliability, testability, and release confidence across teams. 

We're looking for someone who can combine deep software engineering expertise with sound technical judgment and the ability to influence others. You do not need to have built an automation framework from scratch. What matters is demonstrated ownership of complex automation systems and measurable improvements to their architecture, scalability, and effectiveness. 

What You'll Do

- Own the technical direction and architecture of established C#/. NET automation frameworks, improving scalability, reliability, maintainability, and execution efficiency.

About Nasuni

Nasuni is the unstructured data foundation for enterprise teams-and the AI that supports them. We manage, protect, and activate the world's unstructured data so organizations can work smarter, spend wisely, and create safely without limits. 

As a Vista-backed SaaS data infrastructure company, Nasuni is transforming how enterprises manage file data with a next-generation, AI-ready platform-turning massive file stores into secure, actionable, AI-ready data for intelligent automation, analytics, and global collaboration. 

Why Work at Nasuni - Hyderabad

With Vista Equity Partners' backing, our Hyderabad team benefits from access to a global ecosystem of software leaders, cross-portfolio learning, leadership programs, and AI innovation communities-combining the pace of a growing product company with the scale and resources of a global technology investor. 

In this role, you'll help evolve and scale the automation foundation for an increasingly important enterprise product. You'll work at the intersection of cloud, Kubernetes, distributed systems, AI, content intelligence, data governance, and enterprise infrastructure while collaborating with DryvIQ and Nasuni engineering teams globally. 

Benefits At Nasuni Hyderabad

As part of our commitment to your well-being and growth, Nasuni offers competitive benefits designed to support every stage of your life and career:

 - Flexible time off and leave policies

Nasuni is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to fostering a diverse, inclusive, and respectful workplace where every team member can thrive. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, caste, color, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, disability, age, national origin, or any other status protected by applicable laws in India or the country of employment.

The successful candidate will define and execute a comprehensive quality strategy for enterprise data ingestion and downstream processing. 

This role will analyze the frameworks built, create traceable test coverage, and validate full loads, incremental loads, and partition-overwrite loads. The candidate will test framework reliability, data accuracy, error handling, alerting, and operational readiness, then provide evidence for signoff and support promotion through SIT, PRE-PROD, and PROD environments. 

Key Responsibilities

- Quality Strategy & Test Design

 - Design comprehensive test plans, scenarios, and traceability matrices - from early design to release.

 - Functional & Data Validation
 - Validate end-to-end data ingestion: full, incremental, and partition-overwrite loads - including watermarking, deduplication, and restartability. 
 - Reconcile source and target data: counts, schemas, business keys, and field-level accuracy. 
 - Test edge cases: malformed records, nulls, duplicates, empty inputs, large files, and boundary conditions.

 - Test error handling, retries, idempotency, dead-letter handling, and recovery workflows. 
 - Validate Cloud Monitoring, logging, alerting, and dashboard reliability. 
 - Conduct performance, scalability, concurrency, soak, and recovery testing - especially for high-volume ingestion. 
 - Assess Kubernetes health (readiness/liveness probes, scaling, restart behavior) and cloud-native deployments. 
 - Verify security controls: IAM, secrets management, least-privilege access, and data protection. 
 - Defect Management & Release Readiness
 - Log clear, reproducible defects with business impact, logs, and evidence - and partner with teams to resolve them.

Required Qualifications

- 4+ years of hands-on QA experience - especially with enterprise data platforms, APIs, or ingestion systems. 
 - Proven ability to design and execute test strategies, plans, and traceability matrices.

data.title: Senior QA Engineer(GCP)
data.description:
Senior QA Engineer (GCP)

Key Requirement: 4+ years of hands-on experience testing solutions on Google Cloud Platform (GCP) - this is non-negotiable. 

Role Summary

We are seeking a hands-on QA Engineer or QA Analyst to validate the GCP ingestion framework developed with Java, microservices, Google Cloud Platform (GCP), and Kubernetes. The successful candidate will define and execute a comprehensive quality strategy for enterprise data ingestion and downstream processing. 

This role will analyze the frameworks built, create traceable test coverage, and validate full loads, incremental loads, and partition-overwrite loads. The candidate will test framework reliability, data accuracy, error handling, alerting, and operational readiness, then provide evidence for signoff and support promotion through SIT, PRE-PROD, and PROD environments. 

Key Responsibilities

- Quality Strategy & Test Design
 - Collaborate with product and engineering to translate requirements into testable, risk-based strategies. 
 - Design comprehensive test plans, scenarios, and traceability matrices - from early design to release. 
 - Define clear entry/exit criteria, test data needs, and signoff evidence - ensuring quality is measurable and auditable. 
 - Functional & Data Validation
 - Validate end-to-end data ingestion: full, incremental, and partition-overwrite loads - including watermarking, deduplication, and restartability. 
 - Reconcile source and target data: counts, schemas, business keys, and field-level accuracy. 
 - Test edge cases: malformed records, nulls, duplicates, empty inputs, large files, and boundary conditions. 
 - Automation & CI/CD Integration
 - Build and maintain automated test suites (API, integration, data validation, regression, smoke) for Java/microservice systems. 
 - Integrate tests into CI/CD pipelines - publishing clear, actionable results and evidence. 
 - Manage reusable test data, mocks, stubs, and environment-agnostic setups for consistent, repeatable testing. 
 - Resilience, Observability & Non-Functional Testing
 - Test error handling, retries, idempotency, dead-letter handling, and recovery workflows. 
 - Validate Cloud Monitoring, logging, alerting, and dashboard reliability. 
 - Conduct performance, scalability, concurrency, soak, and recovery testing - especially for high-volume ingestion. 
 - Assess Kubernetes health (readiness/liveness probes, scaling, restart behavior) and cloud-native deployments. 
 - Verify security controls: IAM, secrets management, least-privilege access, and data protection. 
 - Defect Management & Release Readiness
 - Log clear, reproducible defects with business impact, logs, and evidence - and partner with teams to resolve them. 
 - Lead regression cycles, manage defect aging, and support release-readiness reviews. 
 - Produce test completion reports, quality dashboards, and formal signoff packages for SIT, PRE-PROD, and PROD. 

Required Qualifications

- 4+ years of hands-on QA experience - especially with enterprise data platforms, APIs, or ingestion systems. 
 - Proven ability to design and execute test strategies, plans, and traceability matrices. 
 - Experience testing Java apps, REST APIs, microservices, batch/streaming pipelines, and distributed systems. 
 - Strong GCP experience: Cloud Storage, BigQuery, Pub/Sub, Dataflow, Cloud Monitoring, etc. 
 - Deep familiarity with full-load, incremental-load, partition-overwrite, watermarking, reconciliation, and idempotency scenarios. 
 - Advanced SQL and data-validation skills: source-to-target checks, schema validation, control totals. 
 - Automation experience: CI/CD integration, test frameworks (Java-based), and test reporting tools. 
 - Comfort with Kubernetes/containerized apps: health checks, config, scaling, and deployment behavior. 
 - Ability to analyze legacy behavior, clarify ambiguous requirements, and communicate quality risks to stakeholders. 
 - Experience supporting testing across SIT, PRE-PROD, and PROD environments. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with ATLAS or similar enterprise ingestion frameworks (or legacy modernization projects). 
 - Hands-on with Docker, Kubernetes, Helm, Terraform, and cloud-native CI/CD pipelines. 
 - Familiarity with Apache Beam, data pipelines, schema evolution, and data-quality controls. 
 - Ability to build quality dashboards, validate alerts, and produce incident-response evidence. 
 - Performance testing experience: large-volume loads, recovery, and production-readiness reviews. 
 - Background in Agile teams: estimation, backlog refinement, and cross-functional collaboration. 
 - Knowledge of cloud security best practices: IAM, secrets, network boundaries, and least-privilege validation. 

Ready to help shape the future of enterprise data? We'd love to hear from you. 

Skills: sql, cloud monitoring, data validation, google cloud platform, rest apis, apache beam, helm, junit, dataflow, docker, ci/cd, pub/sub, terraform, bigquery, java, cloud storage, microservices, kubernetes, test automation, selenium

You will play a critical role in ensuring the quality and reliability of our products and services across diverse platforms and components.

 - Analyze test results, identify trends in defects, and provide actionable insights to development teams.

 - Participate in design and code reviews to ensure testability and quality of deliverables. 
 - Continuously improve QA processes, tools, and methodologies. 

Required Qualifications And Skills

- Education: Minimum Bachelor's degree in Engineering/Computer Science, MCA, or M. Sc (IT).

data.description:
This is where your work makes a difference. 

At Baxter, we believe every person-regardless of who they are or where they are from-deserves a chance to live a healthy life. It was our founding belief in 1931 and continues to be our guiding principle. We are redefining healthcare delivery to make a greater impact today, tomorrow, and beyond. 

Our Baxter colleagues are united by our Mission to Save and Sustain Lives. Together, our community is driven by a culture of courage, trust, and collaboration. Every individual is empowered to take ownership and make a meaningful impact. We strive for efficient and effective operations, and we hold each other accountable for delivering exceptional results. 

Here, you will find more than just a job-you will find purpose and pride. 

Your Role At Baxter

As a Sr SDET for software, you will be an integral part of the SW development - Verification & Validation team at Bangalore R&D that will play a vital role in strategic NPD activities and in sustaining and continuing software activities for legacy BardyDx products including investigations for customer complaints, project work to address software issues within the products, and product enhancements to meet changes in the competitive marketplace. You will work with cross functional BardyDx resources located in the US. You will work with cross functional BardyDx resources located in the US to implement the test strategies, techniques and processes to ensure that the products & solutions meet Baxter's quality goals and applicable regulatory requirements. 

What You'll Be Doing

- Collaborate with Product Owners, Business Analysts, Developers, QA, and DevOps teams to understand requirements, investigate issues, and identify root causes. 
 - Develop and execute test strategies, test plans, and test procedures across web applications, middleware, backend services, and system integrations. 
 - Design and implement automated test solutions using modern quality engineering practices, including BDD, TDD, and reusable automation frameworks. 
 - Drive manual, automated, and exploratory testing activities to ensure comprehensive functional and non-functional coverage. 
 - Partner with V&V and DevOps teams to integrate test automation, quality controls, and validation activities into CI/CD pipelines. 
 - Generate and maintain test results, traceability matrices, quality metrics, and validation documentation to support compliance and release readiness. 
 - Contribute to Agile delivery processes, including sprint planning, estimation, prioritization, and execution of testing activities. 
 - Ensure adherence to SDLC, IEC 62304, Agile, Lean, and Quality System requirements while delivering compliant and high-quality software solutions. 
 - Champion continuous improvement by identifying quality gaps, enhancing testing practices, and driving operational excellence across the development lifecycle. 

What You'll Bring

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field. 
 - 7-12 years of experience in Software Verification & Validation (V&V), Quality Engineering, or Testing of Web and Desktop Applications. 
 - Proven expertise in defining and executing test strategies, V&V plans, and automated testing frameworks for cloud-connected applications. 
 - Strong hands-on experience with modern test automation frameworks such as TestCafe, Robot Framework, Selenium, Postman, and Cucumber. 
 - Proficiency in JavaScript and Python, with experience developing scalable and maintainable test automation solutions. 
 - Experience working in Agile environments with a strong understanding of BDD, TDD, and Quality Engineering best practices. 
 - Hands-on experience with Azure DevOps, CI/CD pipelines, and integrating automated testing into the software delivery lifecycle. 
 - Strong understanding of cloud technologies (Azure/AWS) and testing distributed, web-based applications. 
 - Experience with test data management, quality metrics, defect analysis, and validation activities. 
 - Familiarity with code quality, security, and testing tools such as Coverity, Fortify, and related solutions. 
 - Healthcare, Medical Device, or other regulated industry experience is preferred. 
 - Strategic and results-driven professional with exceptional stakeholder management, communication, and influencing skills across global, cross-functional teams. Strong business acumen, customer focus, and a proven ability to drive execution, quality, and continuous improvement in complex, matrixed environments. 

Equal Employment Opportunity

Baxter is an equal opportunity employer. Baxter evaluates qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, gender, national origin, age, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, protected veteran status, disability/handicap status or any other legally protected characteristic. 

Reasonable Accommodations

Baxter is committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities globally. If, because of a medical condition or disability, you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the application or interview process, please click on the link here and let us know the nature of your request along with your contact information. 

Recruitment Fraud Notice

Baxter has discovered incidents of employment scams, where fraudulent parties pose as Baxter employees, recruiters, or other agents, and engage with online job seekers in an attempt to steal personal and/or financial information. To learn how you can protect yourself, review our Recruitment Fraud Notice.

Job Description

Moving our world forward by delivering what matters!

UPS is a company with a proud past and an even brighter future. Our values define us. Our culture differentiates us. Our strategy drives us. At UPS we are customer first, people led and innovation driven. UPS's India based Technology Development Centers will bring UPS one step closer to creating a global technology workforce that will help accelerate our digital journey and help us engineer technology solutions that drastically improve our competitive advantage in the field of Logistics. 

'Future You' grows as a visible and valued Technology professional with UPS, driving us towards an exciting tomorrow. As a global Technology organization we can put serious resources behind your development. If you are solutions orientated, UPS Technology is the place for you. 'Future You' delivers ground-breaking solutions to some of the biggest logistics challenges around the globe. You'll take technology to unimaginable places and really make a difference for UPS and our customers. 

Job Summary

This position provides mentorship and expertise in technologies and processes for Information Services Management (ISM) and Quality Assurance (QA). He/She maintains an awareness of emerging technologies to ensure a competitive advantage. This position automates test scenarios and expected outcomes. He/She provides expertise for UPS key business functions and supporting technologies. This position applies a comprehensive knowledge of technical skills, principles, practices, and procedures of testing methodologies and working knowledge in planning, designing, and conducting QA reviews and inspections. This position conducts comprehensive testing and risk-based assessments of the testing objects. He/She uses source documentation as input and contributes to the planning and implementation of testing activities. This position leads testing components of large and complex projects, assigns tasks, provides direction to resources, and reports progress to project stakeholders. He/She creates and selects tools and methodologies for review and approval by management. 

Responsibilities

- Responsible for testing and ensuring acceptance criteria on User Stories is met during the delivery sprints. 
 - Builds test plans and test scenarios. 
 - Creates functional and automation test cases and scripts. 
 - Executes and validates test set-up to ensure the environment is ready for testing. 
 - Testing experience with Functional, Regression, Stress, and performance Testing
 - Familiarity with Security testing
 - Need patriciate with End-to-End testing
 - Creates and maintains continuous testing jobs in CI/CD pipeline. 
 - Works closely with developers to test and drive quality attainment in-line with development. 

Skill Set

Power Automate Desktop, Selenium WebDriver, Playwright, Java, Groovy script, SoapUI, Git, Jenkins, JMeter, API, SQL, TFS

Additional Primary Skills

- Expert level with Structured Query Language (SQL)
 - Advance level in scripting and test automation
 - In-depth experience with test scenario, test case design, and test data identification
 - Experience working as part of an Agile/Scrum Team
 - Excellent written & verbal communication skills
 - Excellent attention to Detail
 - Desire to lead and mentor less experienced teammates

Additional Secondary Skills

- Mastery of test tools (e. g. , Power Automate Desktop, Selenium, JMeter, Cucumber, Appium, SoapUI, Postman)
 - Understanding of CI/CD and code automation (Jenkins, MS Azure DevOps)
 - Experience with data analysis using Microsoft Excel and/or Microsoft Power BI

Qualifications

- 5+ years of experience
 - Bachelor's Degree or International equivalent 
 - Experience with both web and client/server-based testing. 

Employee Type

Permanent
