At Trane TechnologiesTM and through our businesses including Trane® and Thermo King®, we create innovative climate solutions for buildings, homes, and transportation that challenge what's possible for a sustainable world. We boldly go.

Your primary focus will be on fostering an inclusive, collaborative, and innovative environment where team members can thrive. You will manage the full talent lifecycle, including setting clear objectives, conducting performance reviews, and creating robust development and growth plans for every engineer. 
 - Drive Project Execution & Excellence: You will be accountable for the team's successful delivery of engineering projects, ensuring they meet critical milestones for quality, on-time delivery, and cost. What You Will Bring: 

- Leadership & Experience: A mechanical engineering background with 13+ years of progressive industry experience, including at least 5 years in a direct people management role.

 - Innovative Mindset: A passion for staying current with emerging technology trends, including AI-driven generative design, design for additive manufacturing, AR collaboration, and IoT-driven design. 
 - Strategic Contribution: The ability to help shape the future of engineering design by experimenting with new technologies and contributing to the strategic roadmap. 
 - Exceptional Communication: Superb written and verbal communication skills in English, with the ability to articulate complex technical ideas clearly and effectively.

data.description:
Over the last 20 years, Ares' success has been driven by our people and our culture. Today, our team is guided by our core values - Collaborative, Responsible, Entrepreneurial, Self-Aware, Trustworthy - and our purpose to be a catalyst for shared prosperity and a better future. Through our recruitment, career development and employee-focused programming, we are committed to fostering a welcoming and inclusive work environment where high-performance talent of diverse backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives can build careers within this exciting and growing industry. 

Job Description

Ares is seeking a Corporate Technology India Lead, Engineering (Vice President) to join Corporate Technology in Mumbai, reporting to the global Head of Corporate Technology. This is a high-impact role serving as the senior Corporate Technology leader in India and a member of the Corporate Technology leadership team alongside the global Product and Engineering heads. The leader will provide local direction and connective leadership for up to 15 Mumbai-based employees supporting Human Resources, Legal & Compliance, Corporate Finance, and Corporate Services Technology - including colleagues aligned through dotted-line reporting - and support oversight of a comparable contractor workforce of approximately 15. While retaining direct accountability for engineering delivery and operational excellence, this individual will help create a cohesive local technology community of approximately 30 internal and external professionals. 

This is a build-and-scale opportunity for a leader who wants to shape how the India Corporate Technology organization engineers, operates, and adopts AI. The role has meaningful influence over engineering culture, talent strategy, delivery practices, process maturity, knowledge management, and the evolution of business-critical platforms. 

The ideal candidate is a hands-on full-stack engineering leader and credible technologist who combines deep technical judgment with strong people and organizational leadership. This person will operate as a player-coach: contributing directly to architecture, design, code reviews, prototypes, critical development, and production problem solving, while building a high-performing team. They will bring an AI-centric mindset and a practical record of using AI and automation to improve software delivery, business workflows, decision support, and team productivity within appropriate governance and control frameworks. 

Success requires exceptional written and verbal communication, strong executive presence, and the ability to create clarity across cultures, time zones, and matrixed reporting lines. The leader must be a trusted bridge-builder across Product, Engineering, Enterprise Architecture, Data, Information Security, Infrastructure, Service Management, and business-facing technology teams. They must be equally effective with engineers, product managers, senior business stakeholders, and enterprise technology partners, translating complex topics into crisp decisions, shared priorities, and measurable outcomes. 

Success in this role will be reflected in the strength, cohesion, and engagement of the India technology community; clear direction across direct and dotted-line teams; predictable, high-quality delivery; improved platform reliability and engineering productivity; responsible adoption of AI; and durable processes and knowledge assets that reduce key-person dependency and allow the organization to scale. 

Primary Functions And Essential Responsibilities

- Serve as the Corporate Technology site leader in Mumbai and a member of the Corporate Technology leadership team; contribute to technology strategy, portfolio priorities, workforce planning, operating model, and culture. 
 - Provide visible, day-to-day direction, prioritization, and connective leadership for up to 15 Mumbai-based Product and Engineering colleagues across Human Resources, Legal & Compliance, Corporate Finance, and Corporate Services, including individuals whose formal reporting lines sit with global leaders; align objectives, capacity, ways of working, development, and the local team experience in partnership with their direct managers.

Experience Required

data.title: Senior Director, Software Engineering
data.description:
About Team

Ads is the fastest-growing organization in Walmart, growing ~40% year over year, and is the 2nd largest retail media business in the industry. It operates the flywheel for Walmart's business. The AdTech engineering team in Chennai is a key part of this organization, building and running the technology that serves advertisers, suppliers and customers at scale. 

The AdTech team builds a best-in-class, in-house technology stack - including DSP, SSP, DMP and real-time auctioning - and solves problems at very high scale and complexity. The team is known for innovation and AI transformation, and operates with the agility of a nimble startup while delivering at Walmart scale. 

What You'll Do

Serve as the Site Lead for Ads and Walmart Plus (W+) in Chennai: set the site vision, culture and operating rhythm, attract and retain top talent, and represent the site with global leadership. 

Own functional leadership of Offsite Ads engineering from Chennai, defining the technical strategy, multi-year roadmap and architecture for DSP, SSP, DMP and real-time auctioning platforms. 

Partner with US product, business and engineering leaders to set organizational priorities, align roadmaps and drive cross-geography execution and accountability for business outcomes. 

Lead and scale the Chennai organization (~30 members today) through managers and senior technical leaders; build the leadership pipeline and succession plans. 

Drive operational excellence for platforms that serve ads in real time at very high scale - availability, latency, reliability, security, privacy and cost efficiency. 

Ensure robust large-scale data processing (batch and streaming) that powers targeting, measurement, attribution and reporting, with strong data quality and governance. 

Champion AI/ML-led innovation across the ad platforms and AI-first engineering practices to improve advertiser outcomes and developer productivity. 

Translate business strategy and advertiser needs into a prioritized portfolio of investments, using a consistent framework to assess business value. 

Establish engineering best practices - architecture reviews, quality, DevOps/SRE and responsible AI - and hold teams to a high bar. 

Drive the execution of multiple concurrent programs and business plans across teams, managing budgets, headcount and risks. 

Develop and leverage internal and external partnerships and networks to maximize the achievement of business goals, including sponsoring key community outreach and engagement initiatives. 

Drive continuous improvement by researching industry best practices and incorporating them into the way we build and operate. 

Create an inclusive, collaborative environment across geographies for delivering the best services to customers around the globe. 

What You'll Bring

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Engineering, Computer Science or a closely related discipline; advanced degree preferred. 

18+ years of experience in software engineering, including significant experience leading large, multi-layer engineering organizations (managers of managers) and distributed teams. 

Deep AdTech expertise across DSP, SSP and DMP platforms, real-time bidding and auctions, audience targeting, measurement and attribution; Offsite / programmatic experience is preferred. 

Proven track record of building and scaling high-throughput, low-latency real-time serving systems and large-scale batch and streaming data processing. 

Experience with big data and distributed computation technologies such as Spark, Kafka and NoSQL stores (e. g. , Cassandra), and strong DevOps/SRE fundamentals. 

Practical understanding of applying AI/ML in advertising (e. g. , bid optimization, relevance, personalization) and of using AI to improve engineering productivity. 

Demonstrated ability to set multi-year technical strategy, manage budgets and influence senior stakeholders with strong executive presence. 

Experience partnering with US/global leaders and leading teams across time zones; prior experience as a site or country leader is a plus. 

Track record of hiring senior talent, developing leaders and building an inclusive, high-performance culture. 

About Walmart Global Tech

Imagine working in an environment where one line of code can make life easier for hundreds of millions of people. That's what we do at Walmart Global Tech. We're a team of software engineers, data scientists, cybersecurity expert's and service professionals within the world's leading retailer who make an epic impact and are at the forefront of the next retail disruption. People are why we innovate, and people power our innovations. We are people-led and tech-empowered. 

We train our team in the skillsets of the future and bring in experts like you to help us grow. We have roles for those chasing their first opportunity as well as those looking for the opportunity that will define their career. Here, you can kickstart a great career in tech, gain new skills and experience for virtually every industry, or leverage your expertise to innovate at scale, impact millions and reimagine the future of retail. 

Work

Walmart's culture sets us apart, and we know being together helps us innovate, learn and grow great careers. This role is based in our Chennai office for daily work, with the flexibility for associates to manage their personal lives. 

Benefits

Beyond our great compensation package, you can receive incentive awards for your performance. Other great perks include a host of best-in-class benefits maternity and parental leave, PTO, health benefits, and much more. 

Belonging

We aim to create a culture where every associate feels valued for who they are, rooted in respect for the individual. Our goal is to foster a sense of belonging, to create opportunities for all our associates, customers and suppliers, and to be a Walmart for everyone. 

At Walmart, our vision is "everyone included. " By fostering a workplace culture where everyone is-and feels-included, everyone wins. Our associates and customers reflect the makeup of all 19 countries where we operate. By making Walmart a welcoming place where all people feel like they belong, we're able to engage associates, strengthen our business, improve our ability to serve customers, and support the communities where we operate. 

Equal Opportunity Employer

Walmart, Inc. , is an Equal Opportunities Employer - By Choice. We believe we are best equipped to help our associates, customers and the communities we serve live better when we really know them. That means understanding, respecting and valuing unique styles, experiences, identities, ideas and opinions - while being inclusive of all people. 

Minimum Qualifications. . . Outlined below are the required minimum qualifications for this position. If none are listed, there are no minimum qualifications. 

Option 1: Bachelor's degree in computer science, computer engineering, computer information systems, software engineering, or related area and 7 years' experience in software engineering or related area. 

Option 2: 9 years' experience in software engineering or related area. 4 years' supervisory experience. 

Preferred Qualifications. . . Outlined below are the optional preferred qualifications for this position. If none are listed, there are no preferred qualifications. 

Master's degree in computer science, computer engineering, computer information systems, software engineering, or related area and 5 years' experience in software engineering or related area. , We value candidates with a background in creating inclusive digital experiences, demonstrating knowledge in implementing Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2. 2 AA standards, assistive technologies, and integrating digital accessibility seamlessly. The ideal candidate would have knowledge of accessibility best practices and join us as we continue to create accessible products and services following Walmart's accessibility standards and guidelines for supporting an inclusive culture. 

Primary Location. . . Tower 1, Part Of 1st, 2nd To 4th Flrs, Intl Tech Park Radial Road (radial It Park Pvt Ltd), , India

Director of Engineering (Agentic AI)

OneAI · Gurgaon · Full-time

WHO WE ARE

Deutsche Telekom Digital Labs is the engineering hub of Deutsche Telekom, Europe's #1 telecom brand. We build the digital products that millions of customers across Europe use every day. AI-first by design, we don't just adopt new technology, we build with it. 

You will be part of Deutsche Telekom: 

- #1 most valuable telecom brand in the world, and #11 across all brands (Brand Finance Global 500, 2026)
 - Top 100 in the Fortune Global 500 (#72 in 2025)
 - EUR 119 billion Group revenue in 2025
 - 273 million+ mobile customers in 50+ countries

About The Team

This is where AI stops being a feature and becomes the product. OneAI builds the intelligence layer that powers customer-facing AI experiences across Deutsche Telekom, from conversational assistants to recommendation engines that actually understand context. If you want to work on AI that millions of people interact with every day, not in a lab, not in a demo, but in the real world at real scale, this is your team. We don't just deploy models. We build the systems that make them trustworthy, useful, and impossible to ignore. 

YOU ASK WHAT'S IN IT FOR YOU? WE SAY, 

- AI tools, on us - Every engineer ships with AI. Coding agents, token budgets and hackfests to build what's next. 
 - Grow faster - Free Coursera & Udemy access, certifications and internal mobility across teams. 
 - Time to recharge - Uncapped leaves, birthday leave, flexible hours, and sabbatical options. 
 - Family first - 9 months maternity on full pay, 15 days paternity, crèche support, infertility treatment and adoption leave. 
 - Health & wellness - Medical cover up to ₹15L for you and your family, unlimited free doctor consults, 24/7 counselling and free Cult. fit membership. 
 - Money & everyday - Flexi benefits for car, fuel and books. Free meals and snacks on campus. Monthly phone and broadband allowance, plus relocation support when you need it. 

What exactly is the objective of this role?

We're looking for a Director of Engineering Agentic AI to join OneAI. You will lead the engineering organisation behind our conversational, voice and generative AI products, turning product vision into reliable, scalable systems that deliver measurable value for customers. This role suits someone with around 15-20 years of relevant experience. 

What will be my Key Responsibilities?

- Lead multiple engineering pods, partnering with engineering managers to align team deliverables with the organisation's vision and to set a clear technical direction and roadmap for agentic AI, chatbots, voice AI and GenAI applications. 
 - Own delivery end to end: ensure milestones and commitments are met, risks are surfaced early, and the systems you are accountable for maintain high uptime and availability. 
 - Run retrospectives and root-cause reviews of incidents and downtime, and turn the findings into lasting improvements in reliability, observability and operational practice. 
 - Mentor and coach engineering managers and developers, building a culture of ownership, engineering craft and inclusive collaboration while improving productivity and operational efficiency. Hire, develop and retain strong talent and plan for succession. 
 - Work closely with product managers to understand the product vision, customer impact and the rationale behind features, and shape technical solutions that improve customer ROI and fit business needs. 
 - Oversee the development of chatbots, voice AI and GenAI applications, including agentic workflows, with clear standards for quality, evaluation, security, privacy and responsible AI use. 
 - Lead the scalability, maintainability, performance and cost optimisation of existing systems, balancing near-term delivery with sustainable architecture and managing technical debt. 
 - Drive new GenAI projects built on GenAI APIs, including bot-training and analysis workflows that use customer knowledge documents, and adopt AI tooling thoughtfully to raise team productivity. 
 - Bring proven experience developing GenAI products, including chatbots and voice AI applications, and AI technologies and tooling, particularly in the GenAI and bot-development space. 
 - Bring proven experience leading engineering teams across multiple pods, and managing and mentoring teams that include engineering managers and developers. 
 - Bring proven experience driving product development, scalability and performance improvements, and working closely with product teams to align technical solutions with business needs and customer impact. 
 - Hold a B. Tech or equivalent qualification. 

What will be nice to have?

- Experience building and enhancing AI-driven solutions on top of GenAI APIs, including evaluating model quality, latency and cost in production. 
 - A record of driving new GenAI projects with a focus on customer satisfaction and business impact. 
 - Strong problem-solving and decision-making skills, with the ability to execute efficiently under pressure. 
 - Experience working with cross-functional and distributed stakeholders to communicate technical trade-offs clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences. 

Why This Role?

- Build digital products from scratch on modern, cloud-native infrastructure. 
 - A real mandate to run lean and AI-first - not lip service, but how we actually operate. 
 - Influence at both ends - hands-on enough to matter in the detail, senior enough to shape strategy. 
 - A fast, agile culture where releases ship quickly and your judgment drives the roadmap. 

WITH THE RIGHT TEAM, ANYTHING IS POSSIBLE. 

If you're looking for an environment that's fun and friendly but incredibly fast-paced; a place where we measure the time between releases in days; a place where our focus begins and ends at the consumer, we'd love to have you!

JOIN US!

data.title: Senior AI Platform Engineer
data.description:
For over four decades, PAR Technology Corporation (NYSE: PAR) has been a leader in restaurant technology, empowering brands worldwide to create lasting connections with their guests. Our innovative solutions and commitment to excellence provide comprehensive software and hardware that enable seamless experiences and drive growth for over 100, 000 restaurants in more than 110 countries. Embracing our "Better Together" ethos, we offer Unified Customer Experience solutions, combining point-of-sale, digital ordering, loyalty and back-office software solutions as well as industry-leading hardware and drive-thru offerings. To learn more, visit partech. com or connect with us on LinkedIn, X (formerly Twitter), Facebook, and Instagram. 

Position Description

PAR is looking for a Senior AI Platform Engineer to be the technical cornerstone of our newly formed AI Platform team. You will design, build, and operate a production-grade, multi-tenant AI Platform on AWS using LLM orchestration services, tools and libraries, enabling engineering teams in PAR Restaurant group to build, deploy, and scale AI agents and agentic workflows that surface directly to customers. 

The ideal candidate is deeply technical with 7-8 years of hands-on ML/AI engineering experience, especially with building AI platform components, and equally effective as a communicator, team player and a collaborator. You write production code, define architectural standards, and can explain a policy-as-code framework, a RAG pipeline, and a team sprint plan with equal clarity. 

This is an ideal role for someone who is hands-on, obsessed with performance and scalability, and deeply experienced with productionizing multi-agent systems, from graph-based orchestration and real-time streaming to RAG pipelines and multi-model routing at production scale. 

Position Location: Gurugram / Jaipur, India (Hybrid)

Reports To: Director of AI and Analytics

What We're Looking For

AI Platform Engineering - Core Orchestration & Runtime

Build the PAR Restaurant AI Platform - a dual-purpose system that at build time gives product engineering teams the APIs, SDKs, tool registry, and knowledgebase services to author and deploy agents, and at runtime hosts those agents in production across all PAR product lines with multi-tenant isolation, security guardrails, content safety, governance, and compliance controls

Design and build production-grade GenAI microservices (e. g. FastAPI) and stateful multi-agent workflows, including selection of the appropriate orchestration pattern (model-driven, graph-based etc. ) based on auditability, latency, and complexity requirements of each agent class

Design and operate an automated content ingestion pipeline that includes content upload, chunking, embedding model selection, vector storage, and OpenSearch Serverless indexing - exposing knowledgebase retrieval as a fully managed, self-service capability for all product teams

AI Platform Engineering - Tooling & Developer Experience

Build and maintain the platform APIs and developer tooling, including MCP-compatible tool interfaces, real-time streaming APIs (SSE / WebSocket), and agent configuration SDKs, that allow engineers to create, deploy, run, and observe multi-agent workflows with configurable guardrails and content safety controls per agent class

Own internal AI SDK ergonomics for both audiences: agent-authoring engineers and application-backend engineers consuming the streaming invocation API

Build and maintain the Platform Onboarding Copilot (Slack-integrated); produce clear, actionable technical documentation and architectural decision records (ADRs); present platform strategy to non-technical stakeholders

Own the platform observability stack as a product, not an afterthought. Provides platform tools for engineers to fetch observability metrics, and distributed traces auto-provisioned on every agent deployment; an LLM eval suite (e. g. LangSmith, Ragas) that gates CI/CD on quality regressions; and per-tenant cost attribution with spend alerting giving every engineering team full visibility into their inference consumption

Define quality bars and eval suites per agent class; no agent reaches production without a documented, passing score threshold, thereby establish evaluation as a first-class engineering discipline across the team

Governance, Compliance, Multi-Tenancy

Design multi-tenant isolation from day one, including namespace isolation, tenant_id injection, and policy-as-code enforcement ensuring there is no cross-brand data or context pollution. 

Own the policy-as-code library for PAR-specific policy sets covering PAR Restaurant product lines while ensuring platform compliance with SOC 2 Type II, PCI DSS, GDPR, and CCPA; author and maintain the GDPR deletion pipeline

Define and implement content safety guardrails: grounding checks and content filtering mandatory for all customer-facing agents

Act as the quality and cost-economics gatekeeper for all agents entering pre-production, such as running standardised eval suites, enforcing agent best practices, and validating inference cost-per-run against approved thresholds before any agent is cleared for production deployment

Collaborate with DevOps (owners of CI/CD automation) through a well-defined infrastructure contract and build version promotion pipeline (e. g. GitHub Actions)

Unleash your potential: What you will be doing and owning: 

7-8 years of hands-on Machine Learning / AI Engineering experience, with at least 3 years focused on production GenAI or LLM systems

Master's in Computer Science, Machine Learning, or a closely related field

Demonstrated experience designing and building multi-tenant, production-grade ML platforms or developer-facing AI infrastructure

Proven track record of shipping ML systems end-to-end, from architecture and deployment through to operational observability, eval pipelines, and cost management

Technical Skills

AWS (Deep): API Gateway, Amazon Bedrock AgentCore, Lambda, S3, CloudFront, EKS (Kubernetes + IRSA), OpenSearch Serverless, KMS, SageMaker, Step Functions, WAF, PrivateLink, CloudWatch, IAM

GenAI & LLM Frameworks: LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, Hugging Face Transformers, OpenAI API, Anthropic API, AWS-native GenAI services

RAG & Knowledge Systems: Vector stores (FAISS, ChromaDB, Pinecone, Weaviate), OpenSearch Serverless - designing end-to-end ingestion, chunking, embedding, and hybrid retrieval pipelines

ML Ops: MLflow (tracking, model registry, job orchestration), Databricks (PySpark, Delta Lake, notebooks), automated retraining workflows

Programming: Expert-level Python (FastAPI / Flask / Django); proficient TypeScript / Node. js (Express / NestJS); clean code, OOP, scalable architecture

Data Stores: Delta Lake, Elasticsearch, Redis, NoSQL, columnar stores (Databricks, BigQuery)

CI/CD & DevOps Collaboration: GitHub Actions; familiarity with Terraform Cloud / HCP Terraform workflows; container-native development on EKS

Observability & Monitoring: CloudWatch (metrics, logs, dashboards, alarms), distributed tracing (AWS X-Ray or equivalent), LLM evaluation frameworks (LangSmith, Ragas, or similar)

Security & Policy: Policy-as-code frameworks, IAM policy design, multi-tenant namespace isolation, PCI DSS and GDPR technical controls

Soft Skills

Exceptional written and verbal communication - you can explain a policy-as-code enforcement model to a security auditor and a RAG pipeline to a product manager in the same meeting

Strong collaboration instincts - platform engineers serve internal customers; you measure success by adoption, not just uptime

Emerging leadership skills - you have mentored engineers, led design reviews, or owned a technical domain end-to-end

Comfort with ambiguity - this is a greenfield platform with real architectural decisions to make, not a maintenance role

Flexibility to occasionally collaborate with teams in California (PST) and Toronto (EST) for cross-time zone syncs

Bonus Points

Familiarity with restaurant, hospitality, or retail domains

Experience building or fine-tuning domain-specific LLMs or embedding models

Experience building enterprise-scale Text-to-SQL applications

Multi-agent orchestration and A2A protocols; familiarity with workflow automation tools (e. g. n8n) for MCP-compatible tool interoperability

Experience building LLM-specific observability beyond standard infra monitoring, e. g. hallucination tracking, groundedness scoring, per-session cost and cost attribution

Contributions to open-source ML or GenAI projects

Experience with policy-as-code frameworks for cloud access control at scale

Familiarity with defining and executing sprint plans, technical roadmaps, managing weekly standups and quarterly OKRs for a team

Prior people management or tech lead experience

Interview Process

Interview #1: Phone Screen with Talent Acquisition Team

Interview #2: Video interview with the Technical Teams (via MS Teams/F2F)

Interview #3: Video interview with the Hiring Manager (via MS Teams/F2F)

PAR is proud to provide equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability or genetics. We also provide reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities in accordance with applicable laws. If you require reasonable accommodation to complete a job application, pre-employment testing, a job interview or to otherwise participate in the hiring process, or for your role at PAR, please contact accommodations@partech. com. If you'd like more information about your EEO rights as an applicant, please visit the US Department of Labor's website.

The world is evolving fast, and organizations everywhere-from corporations to schools-are under immense pressure to provide flexible, work-from-anywhere solutions. They need IT infrastructure that empowers employees and customers to access applications from any device, on any cloud, all while maintaining top-tier security. That's where Omnissa comes in. 

The Omnissa Platform is the first AI-driven digital work platform that enables smart, seamless and secure work experiences from anywhere. It uniquely integrates multiple industry-leading solutions including Unified Endpoint Management, Virtual Apps and Desktops, Digital Employee Experience, and Security & Compliance through common data, identity, administration, and automation services. Built on the vision of autonomous workspaces - self configuring, self-healing, and self-securing - Omnissa continuously adapts to the way people work; delivering personalized and engaging employee experiences, while optimizing security, IT operations and costs. we're experiencing rapid growth-and this is just the beginning of our journey!

At Omnissa, we're driven by a shared mission to maximize value for our customers. Our five Core Values guide us: Act in Alignment, Build Trust, Foster Inclusiveness, Drive Efficiency, and Maximize Customer Value-all with the aim of achieving shared success for our clients and our team. 

As a global private company with over 4, 000 employees, we're always looking for passionate, talented individuals to join us. If you're ready to make an impact and help shape the future of work, we'd love to hear from you!

What is the opportunity?: 

Workspace ONE is a digital workspace platform that simply and securely delivers and manages any app on any device by integrating access control, application management and multi-platform endpoint management. It is available as a cloud service or for on-premises deployment. 

Our goal is to enable Workspace One-Unified End point Management platform to scale and manage billions of devices across various operating system platforms and device types. 

As part of the UEM Platform team you will be involved in writing code, design and development of scalable software. You will be owning engineering initiatives and champion a culture of high ownership, continuous improvement, and engineering excellence. 

Success in the Role: What are the performance goals over the first 6-12 months you will work toward completing?

- You will need to produce software design and execute them for new use cases for various platform business. 
 - You will need to produce design to scale the current system. 
 - You will be regularly evaluated on the quality of the product you create and the code you write to ensure continued advancement of your technical skills in an environment that looks to expand them. 
 - You will have to collaboratively work across other teams, design and contribute code to their code bases. 
 - You will look at the product as a whole and look for code/design/architecture gaps, scalability/usability/supportability challenges and propose/implement solutions for the identified gaps. 

What type of work will I be doing? What assignments or requirements* will I be performing on a regular basis? What are my deliverables?

- You will work on a distributed application built on the event driven architecture. 
 - You will work with C#, (Asp. Net and Net Core) on the server side
 - You will work with SQL/PostgreSQL/Open Search for the database. 
 - You will work with Kafka/Redis/RabbitMQ for inter and intra service communications. 
 - You will work with Asp. Net MVC and an Angular front-end. 

What will you bring to Omnissa?

- Bachelor's or master's degree in Computer Science or related field

Flexera One solutions are built on a set of definitive customer, supplier and industry data, powered by our Technology Intelligence Platform, that enables organizations to visualize their Enterprise Technology BlueprintTM in hybrid environments-from on-premises to SaaS to containers to cloud. 

We're transforming the software industry. We're Flexera. With more than 50, 000 customers across the world, we're achieving that goal. But we know we can't do any of that without our team. About the Role: 

At Flexera, we empower global enterprises by turning IT insights into action. We're seeking a Staff Data Engineer with deep expertise in architecting and optimizing big data platforms, with a strong focus on Databricks. You'll drive the core design and performance of our lakehouse, enabling analytics, AI/ML, and product innovation at scale. 

As a senior technical leader, you'll own key components of our data platform - collaborating with architects, data scientists, and engineers to deliver high-performance, scalable solutions. - Lead the architecture, design, and evolution of highly scalable, cloud‐native backend systems and APIs.

 - Design and optimize relational database schemas (PostgreSQL), including indexing, query tuning, and schema migration management. 
 - Drive technical strategy for reliability, scalability, performance, and cost efficiency across data‐intensive workloads. 
 - Own complex backend initiatives end‐to‐end, from design through production rollout and operational maturity. 
 - Own and maintain CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, Terraform) - deploying your own work to production, not handing off to a separate team. 
 - Debug across system boundaries - trace issues from API layer through database to data pipeline and back. 
 - Collaborate closely with data engineering, frontend, platform, and SRE teams to ensure cohesive system design and execution. 
 - Influence engineering standards and best practices around code quality, testing, CI/CD, observability, and operational excellence. 
 - Review and guide designs and implementations across teams, acting as a trusted technical advisor. 
 - Mentor senior and junior engineers, helping grow technical depth and leadership within the organization. 
 - Stay ahead of industry trends in backend systems, cloud platforms, and data engineering, applying them thoughtfully at scale. 

Required Qualifications

- Bachelor's or master's degree in computer science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience. 
 - 8+ years of backend engineering experience, with a proven track record of building and scaling complex production systems. 
 - Hands-on Python application/service development - building production APIs and services, not limited to PySpark notebooks or data science scripts. 
 - Strong RDBMS experience (PostgreSQL preferred) - schema design, complex query authoring and optimization, migration tooling (Flyway), and query-plan-level performance debugging. 
 - API development ownership - designing, building, deploying, and operating RESTful APIs (FastAPI, Flask, or equivalent). 
 - CI/CD pipeline ownership - building and maintaining deployment automation (GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, or similar), not relying on a separate platform team. 
 - Infrastructure-as-Code - Terraform, or similar. Comfortable provisioning cloud resources yourself. 
 - Experience building large‐scale data or analytics platforms. 
 - Strong background in observability, monitoring, and incident‐driven learning - distributed tracing, query profiling, and latency diagnosis (not just dashboard monitoring). 
 - Experience with security, compliance, and enterprise‐grade SaaS requirements. 
 - Prior experience in FinOps, cloud cost optimization, or enterprise SaaS platforms. 
 - Experience with AWS (ECS/Fargate, RDS, S3, IAM, Secrets Manager). 
 - Experience building AI‐powered backend systems, including LLM‐based or agent‐driven workflows. 

Preferred but not required: 

- Experience with Power BI Direct Lake mode and semantic modeling for lakehouse-based analytics. 
 - Familiarity with Mosaic AI, Databricks GenAI capabilities, or Feature Store implementations. 
 - Contributions to open-source Spark, Databricks community content, or certifications (e. g. , Databricks Certified Data Engineer Professional). 

Why Join Flexera

- Lead and shape mission‐critical backend platforms used by global enterprises. 
 - Work on complex, high‐impact problems at the intersection of cloud, data, and cost optimization. 
 - A collaborative, inclusive, and technically driven culture that values strong engineering judgment. 
 - Competitive compensation, flexible work arrangements, and clear growth paths for senior technical leaders.

About the product

MPS (Manufacturing Process System) is our platform for SMT (Surface Mount Technology) PCB assembly lines. It acquires real-time events from shop-floor equipment : solder-paste printers, solder-paste and optical inspection systems, pick-and-place placement machines and reflow ovens ; persists them, runs statistical and defect analysis, and presents dashboards and corrective suggestions to line operators. 

The role

You will build features across the whole stack: the database schema, the backend endpoints, and the dashboard the operator actually looks at. Features are delivered as vertical slices here rather than handed between a backend and a frontend team, which means you see your work reach a production line. 

What you will own

- End-to-end feature delivery : schema changes, backend endpoints, frontend screens and the tests that cover them. 
 - Visualisation of high-volume machine event and inspection data that stays responsive at realistic data sizes. 
 - Maintaining and extending the existing React dashboard modules. 
 - Participating in code review : both receiving it and giving it. What we need from you

- 3-5 years building and maintaining production web applications. 
 - Java 17 or newer with Spring Boot : REST endpoints, JPA, clean service layering. 
 - PostgreSQL and working SQL, including joins and aggregation you can reason about. 
 - React 18 with hooks, and practical state management using Redux Toolkit, React Query or an equivalent. 
 - TypeScript. 
 - A charting library in production : ECharts, Recharts, D3 or similar : with awareness of how they behave on large datasets.

- Python and FastAPI familiarity. 
 - Tailwind CSS and Vite. 
 - Building dense operational, industrial or monitoring dashboards. 
 - An instinct for designing UI that a non-technical user can read at a glance, under factory lighting, without training. 

Our technology stack

You will not need every item on this list, but this is the environment you will be working in: 

- Backend: Java 17, Spring Boot 3, PostgreSQL, JPA/Hibernate

This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Intermediate Backend Engineer, Authorization based in India. 

As an Intermediate Backend Engineer specializing in Authorization, you will contribute to building and maintaining the systems that control access to applications, data, and services across a large-scale DevSecOps platform. You will work on critical authorization infrastructure, ensuring that users, access tokens, and automated agents have the appropriate permissions while maintaining high standards of security and performance. Using Ruby on Rails, you will develop and improve permission models, access policies, and API authorization mechanisms. You will also contribute to the evolution of the platform's authorization architecture, including the integration of a new Rust-based policy engine. Working alongside experienced engineers in a fully remote and asynchronous environment, you will progressively take ownership of increasingly complex engineering projects. This is an opportunity to develop expertise in application security, distributed systems, and modern authorization technologies. 

Accountabilities

Responsibilities

In this role, you will help develop, maintain, and modernize authorization systems while ensuring that access controls remain reliable, secure, and performant. Your main responsibilities will include: 

- Implement authorization features and improvements within a Ruby on Rails monolithic application, ensuring that legitimate access is granted and unauthorized access is consistently denied. 
 - Deliver well-defined engineering projects, from feature-flagged implementation and rollout to validation of results, with guidance and code reviews from senior engineers. 
 - Develop and extend fine-grained permission models for access tokens and custom roles, expanding authorization coverage across additional resources. 
 - Improve authorization enforcement across GraphQL and REST APIs to ensure consistent application of permission rules. 
 - Refactor existing policy code incrementally while preserving established behavior and avoiding disruptions for existing customers. 
 - Investigate and resolve security vulnerabilities, reliability issues, and performance bottlenecks affecting authorization mechanisms. 
 - Contribute to the migration toward a modern authorization architecture combining the existing application framework with a Rust-based policy engine. 
 - Help validate that legacy and new authorization systems produce consistent permission evaluation results. 
 - Collaborate with authentication, platform, and AI engineering teams to define and document interface contracts supporting a shared authorization service. 
 - Participate in technical design discussions, prepare engineering documentation, contribute to merge requests, and review code asynchronously. 
 - Incorporate feedback from code reviews and ensure that technical decisions and implementation approaches are clearly documented. 

Requirements

The ideal candidate is a backend engineer with solid Ruby on Rails experience, an understanding of application security, and an interest in developing scalable authorization systems. You should be comfortable working with existing codebases, making incremental improvements, and collaborating in an asynchronous engineering environment. The following qualifications are expected: 

- Approximately 2-4 years or more of professional experience building and maintaining production Ruby on Rails applications. 
 - Hands-on experience with authorization concepts, including Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) and fine-grained permissions, gained through professional work or personal projects. 
 - Strong security mindset, with the ability to recognize authorization issues as potential security vulnerabilities and assess the impact of implementation changes. 
 - Experience modifying established codebases through incremental refactoring and feature-flagged deployments while maintaining backward compatibility. 
 - Familiarity with GraphQL and API authorization patterns. 
 - Understanding of application performance, particularly the impact of repeated permission checks on request processing. 
 - Ability to write clear technical documentation and communicate effectively in an asynchronous environment where decisions are primarily made through written discussions and merge requests. 
 - Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail, particularly when working on security-sensitive systems. 
 - Ability to collaborate with experienced engineers, incorporate feedback, and progressively take ownership of technical projects. 
 - Willingness to learn new technologies and contribute to the evolution of authorization infrastructure. 

Additional Experience That Would Be An Advantage

- Hands-on experience with PostgreSQL. 
 - Familiarity with Rust, gRPC, or Protocol Buffers. 
 - Knowledge of Cedar or other policy languages. 
 - Exposure to Zanzibar-style authorization systems. 
 - Experience with Go or service-oriented architecture. 
 - Background in identity management, policy engines, platform security, or related technical domains. 

Benefits

 - Flexible Paid Time Off (PTO). 
 - Equity compensation and Employee Stock Purchase Plan. 
 - Growth and Development Fund to support continuous learning and professional development. 
 - Parental leave benefits. 
 - Team Member Resource Groups that encourage inclusion, connection, and collaboration. 
 - Benefits designed to support employee health, financial well-being, and personal development. 
 - Opportunity to work with experienced engineers on large-scale, security-critical infrastructure. 
 - Exposure to modern technologies, including Rust-based authorization engines and advanced access control architectures. 
 - Fully asynchronous working environment that promotes flexibility, autonomy, and written collaboration. 
 - Opportunity to integrate AI tools into daily engineering workflows and improve productivity through emerging technologies.

Full-Stack Web Developer

We Are

Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI-powered products. We deliver industry-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow. 

You Are

You are an early-career developer who has moved past tutorials and built things that actually run in production or close to it. You know the difference between code that works on your laptop and code that someone else can deploy, maintain, and extend six months later. When something breaks, you dig in. When requirements are unclear, you ask the right questions instead of guessing or waiting. 

You have written enough JavaScript and TypeScript to know when a component is getting too complicated, and you care about that. Working across front-end, back-end, and database layers does not intimidate you because you have done it before, even if not at scale. You learn by building, not by collecting certifications. 

Small teams appeal to you because your work is visible and your contributions matter from day one. You want to be in a place where asking good questions is valued, where senior engineers actually review your code and explain the why, and where you can see the impact of what you ship. At Synopsys, you will work on internal platforms that employees across the company depend on, and the team you join operates like a high-trust startup inside a global organization. 

What You'll Be Doing

- Build and maintain full-stack web applications using the PANN stack: PostgreSQL, Angular, NestJS, and Node. js
 - Implement features across the entire application layer, from UI components in Angular to API endpoints in NestJS to database schema changes in PostgreSQL
 - Work with Prisma ORM to model data, manage migrations, and write clean database access logic

 - Containerize and deploy applications using Docker and orchestrate services in environments managed with Kubernetes, Nginx, and Apache

The Impact You Will Have

- Your code will power internal platforms used daily by employees across Synopsys to get work done faster and more securely
 - You will reduce manual effort and operational overhead by automating repetitive workflows and integrating disconnected systems
 - The features you build will improve how teams access organizational knowledge, make decisions, and collaborate across functions
 - Your contributions will help scale cybersecurity, compliance, and engineering operations across a 30, 000-person global organization
 - You will enable better data-driven decision-making by building intuitive interfaces that surface the right information at the right time
 - Working in a small, high-impact team means your individual work will be visible and valued, not lost in a backlog
 - You will help lay the foundation for scalable solutions that can be adopted across multiple business units as the platform grows

What You'll Need

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, or equivalent hands-on experience building and shipping web applications
 - 2 to 4 years of experience developing full-stack web applications, though stronger evidence of end-to-end delivery can matter more than years
 - Hands-on experience with the PANN technology stack: PostgreSQL, Angular, NestJS, and Node. js in real projects, not just side experiments
 - Solid working knowledge of JavaScript, TypeScript, HTML, CSS, and REST API design

 - Experience integrating systems through APIs and working with both relational and non-relational databases
 - Clear written and verbal communication skills, you can explain what you built, why you built it that way, and what tradeoffs you made

Who You Are

- You take ownership of your work and follow through, even when it means asking for help or clarification along the way
 - When you encounter a problem you do not immediately know how to solve, you research, test, and ask targeted questions instead of spinning or guessing
 - You write code with the next person in mind, whether that is a teammate doing a review or your future self debugging at 3pm on a Tuesday
 - You are comfortable working in a small team where accountability is high and your contributions are visible from day one
 - Curiosity drives you, especially around emerging technologies like AI, and you are eager to apply them to solve real business problems, not just experiment
 - You can collaborate effectively with people outside engineering, translating technical constraints into language that product and business stakeholders actually understand
 - You care about user experience and think through how the features you build will actually be used, not just whether they technically function
 - Results matter to you more than process for its own sake, you want to ship things that work and make a measurable difference

The Team You'll Be Part Of

Your team develops platforms and capabilities that help scale cybersecurity, compliance, engineering, and business operations across Synopsys. The team operates with a startup mindset, focusing on high-impact initiatives, rapid execution, and practical innovation. You will work closely with a small group of technical and domain experts to build solutions that enable automation, knowledge management, and data-driven decision making. data.title: AI Transformation Lead
data.description:
In a nutshell

Loylogic created the global rewards marketplace. Today, we are leading its evolution into the AI era - helping organizations recognize, reward and incentivize their most valuable customers, employees and partners with greater intelligence, relevance and impact. 

Loylogic is looking for a highly hands-on AI Transformation Lead to help redesign how work gets done across our company. This is not primarily an AI strategy, research or advisory role. We are looking for a builder with a strong business and process mindset: someone who can quickly understand how work happens today, challenge it, simplify it and then use AI agents, automation and modern technology to make the better way of working a reality. 

Working directly with the CEO and closely with the COO, you will have the opportunity to work horizontally across the organisation: Commercial - Sales, RevOps, Customer Success; Marketplace - Partnerships, Marketplace - Performance, Platform, and Corporate (Finance, PE, Legal). Our ambition is not to deploy AI for the sake of AI. 

It is to make Loylogic a genuinely AI-native company and materially improve how we work. 

Your mission

Your mission can be summarized in five words: 

DISCOVER → CHALLENGE → BUILD → IMPLEMENT → MEASURE

- Discover - Get close to our teams and rapidly understand how our most important work actually gets done. 
 - Challenge - Identify unnecessary work, bottlenecks and complexity. Determine what can be stopped, simplified, automated or fundamentally redesigned. 
 - Build - Personally prototype AI agents, automations and AI-enabled workflows rather than simply recommending what somebody else should build. 
 - Implement - Work with our functional teams and Technology to turn successful prototypes into solutions that become part of everyday work. 
 - Measure - Demonstrate what changed: capacity created, cycle times reduced, quality improved, revenue opportunities enabled, costs avoided and other measurable business outcomes. 

How we think about AI and work

We don't assume that every problem needs an AI agent. 

Before automating an existing process, we want to understand whether that process should exist in its current form at all. 

For the processes you work on, we expect you to think along the lines of: 

STOP → SIMPLIFY → AUTOMATE/AGENT → BOOST

- Stop: Does this activity actually need to be done?
 - Simplify: Can we make the process fundamentally simpler?
 - Automate/Agent: Which activities can AI agents or conventional automation perform reliably?
 - BOOST: Where should the person keep the work, with AI making them faster, sharper or better informed?
 - Where these changes create meaningful additional capacity, you will help quantify that opportunity so functional leadership can determine how it can best be redirected towards higher-value work. 

What you will do

You will: 

- Rapidly map and understand critical workflows across Loylogic. 
 - Work directly with functional leaders and the people performing the work. 
 - Identify and prioritise the highest-value AI and process-transformation opportunities. 
 - Challenge existing processes before automating them. 
 - Identify activities that can be eliminated, simplified, automated or AI-augmented. 
 - Personally prototype and build AI agents, automations and internal tools. 
 - Integrate solutions with existing systems, data and APIs where appropriate. 
 - Design appropriate human oversight and escalation into AI-enabled workflows. 
 - Work closely with Technology to move successful prototypes into secure, reliable and scalable production environments. 
 - Create reusable components and approaches rather than solving every problem from scratch. 
 - Help teams adopt new workflows and ways of working. 
 - Measure the impact of implemented solutions. 
 - Quantify capacity released and identify opportunities for higher-value use of that capacity. 
 - Maintain a prioritised pipeline of further transformation opportunities. 
 - Stay close to developments in agentic AI and rapidly experiment with relevant new capabilities. 
 - We expect you to build, not just recommend. 

What this could look like in practice

- You might redesign an RFP process so AI handles research, knowledge retrieval and first-draft creation, allowing Sales to spend more time developing the proposition and engaging the client. 
 - You could reduce the time Customer Success Managers spend preparing client reporting and QBRs, creating additional capacity for performance analysis, upselling and proactive client engagement. 
 - You might automate elements of supplier onboarding, catalogue enrichment, management reporting, CRM administration, reconciliation, contract analysis or internal knowledge retrieval. 
 - Sometimes the right answer will be an AI agent. 
 - Sometimes it will be conventional automation. 
 - Sometimes it will simply be a much better process. 
 - And sometimes the answer will be that a human should continue doing the work - but with much better AI support. 
 - We expect you to understand the difference. 

What you will do

We are deliberately not looking for an "AI guru. "

We want an energetic, curious, pragmatic and exceptionally resourceful person who enjoys understanding problems, building solutions and getting them into everyday use. 

You will probably have around 2-7 years of relevant professional experience, although demonstrated ability matters considerably more to us than years of experience. 

You should bring a combination of: 

- Strong business-process and problem-solving skills. 
 - Practical experience applying generative AI and LLMs to real business problems. 
 - Hands-on experience building AI agents and automated workflows. 
 - Ability to work with APIs, structured data and business systems. 
 - Working knowledge of Python or comparable scripting/development capabilities. 
 - Experience with modern automation/orchestration platforms and AI development tools. 
 - Understanding of RAG, tool/function calling, structured outputs, prompting and agentic architectures. 
 - An understanding of when human oversight is required in AI-enabled workflows. 
 - Enough technical depth to build independently while recognizing when enterprise engineering support is required. 
 - Strong commercial judgement and an ability to prioritize according to business value. 
 - Excellent communication skills and an ability to understand unfamiliar business areas quickly. 
 - A strong bias towards experimentation, prototyping and shipping. 
 - Experience in loyalty is not required. Experience in a fast-moving technology company, SaaS business, marketplace, fintech, scale-up, AI company or entrepreneurial environment would be particularly relevant. 

How you think

When someone explains a complicated process, your instinct is to ask: "Can you show me how you actually do this today?"

- You don't automatically assume AI is the answer. 
 - You first understand the problem, challenge the process and determine the best way of doing the work. Then you build. 
 - You are equally comfortable discussing a business problem with the CEO or COO, sitting with someone in Finance to understand a reconciliation process, or spending the afternoon building and testing an agent yourself. 
 - You like autonomy, speed and accountability. 

What this role is not

This is not a Chief AI Officer role. 

- It is not primarily about producing AI strategies, PowerPoint presentations, running innovation workshops or managing large transformation programs. 
 - Nor is success measured by how many AI agents we deploy. 
 - This is a hands-on role focused on redesigning work and delivering measurable business outcomes, using AI and automation wherever they are the best tools for the job. 

What success looks like

During your first 90 days, we would expect you to have developed a practical understanding of the highest-value transformation opportunities across Loylogic, created a prioritized pipeline, redesigned several meaningful workflows and already built and deployed the first AI-enabled solutions. 

From there, we will measure success through tangible outcomes including: 

- Productivity gained • cycle times reduced • quality improved • commercial capacity created • scalability increased • costs avoided or reduced • employee adoption • measurable revenue opportunities enabled
 - Ultimately, we want to combine great people, better processes and increasingly capable AI so that Loylogic can achieve materially more with the organization we have. 

What we offer

Loylogic is an international business with colleagues, clients and partners located across the world. We combine global scale with an entrepreneurial culture in which people are encouraged to contribute ideas, challenge established thinking and take ownership of meaningful outcomes. 

You will join a business shaping the future of AI-powered rewards and engagement, working with recognized global brands and sophisticated loyalty programs across multiple industries and markets. Our goodies for you

Our benefits include: 

- Highly-attractive bonus scheme
 - Competitive salary dependent on experience
 - Hybrid working model (mix of office and home office)
 - Own points-based incentive programAnd many more benefits.

data.description:
Role: Lead Engineer-Testing & Validation

To lead, design, and execute comprehensive testing and validation programs across industrial printing systems, CIJ printers, and emerging 
product verticals including consumer and medical devices. The role is pivotal in building a structured Verification & Validation (V&V) lab capability 
and establishing robust test engineering practices that ensure product quality, reliability, and regulatory readiness. 
Key Responsibilities 
A. Current Testing Operations 
• Lead system-level functional testing for Industrial Print & Apply printer systems 
• Design and execute reliability and regression test suites for CIJ printers 
• Conduct ink range and ink compatibility testing - ink-substrate-environment interactions 
• Maintain and improve existing test frameworks, fixtures, and test data documentation 
• Analyse test results, root-cause failures, and drive corrective actions with cross-functional teams 
• Own test traceability: requirements → test cases → results → defect tracking 
B. V&V Lab Build-Up (New Capability) 
• Establish a Verification & Validation lab for Industrial, Consumer, and Medical device product lines 
• Define V&V strategy, test plans, and protocols aligned with applicable standards (IEC, ISO, UL, CE, BIS, etc. ) 
• Develop test case libraries and standard operating procedures (SOPs) 
• Set up lab infrastructure: test benches, environmental chambers, fixtures, aware of data acquisition systems 
• Implement Design Verification Plan & Report (DVP&R) methodology for structured product validation 
• Collaborate with design, firmware, and manufacturing teams to ensure Design for Testability (DfT) 
C. Quality & Documentation 
• Maintain comprehensive test documentation: test reports, failure analysis reports, FMEA inputs 
• Ensure test processes are aligned with ISO 9001 / ISO 13485 quality system requirements where applicable 
• Support internal and external audits with test documentation and evidence packages 
• Track quality metrics: test escape rate, first-pass yield, MTBF, reliability indices, aware of DPMO 
D. Team & Stakeholder Management 
• Mentor and guide junior test engineers; build team competency in systematic testing 
• Interface with product management, R&D for test-driven development 
• Liaise with external labs, certification bodies, and vendors as required 
• Support customer discussions on testing methodologies, validation findings, and lab capabilities 
E. Capability Development 
• Support expansion of testing capabilities into packaging testing, electronics/PCB validation, and medical device testing 
• Assist in developing frameworks for Testing-as-a-Service (TaaS) to support internal and external testing engagements 
• Drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance test efficiency and reduce cycle time 
F. Future Scope - Compliance & Regulatory Testing (Note) 
• Serve as the internal subject matter expert for product compliance readiness: CE, BIS, UL, FCC, RoHS, REACH 
• Build awareness of regulatory requirements for Medical devices (IEC 60601, ISO 13485, MDR if applicable) (This scope may be retained 
within this role as the V&V lab matures,

ADVANCE YOUR CAREER. ADVANCE THE WORLD. 

At AMD, we believe technology has the power to solve the world's most important challenges. From advancing healthcare and scientific discovery to powering AI and the technologies people rely on every day, innovation at AMD is shaping the future. 

Whether you're designing next-gen processors, enabling AI breakthroughs, or bringing leading edge products to market, every role at AMD contributes to something bigger - technology that moves the world forward. Join us and, together, we'll advance your career. 

Robotics Lead Validation Engineer

About The Role

Join AMD's PAVS team as a Robotics Developer experience Usecases Validation Engineer where you will Validate and Execute diverse Robotics platforms, variants and customer usecases for advanced robotics systems across software, hardware, and integrated platforms. Your work will ensure safety, reliability, and performance through rigorous testing in simulation, Gazebo, Isaac sim, SIL/HIL environments, and real-world deployments. 

Key Responsibilities

- Validation Strategy & Usecases : Define Usecases and execute validation plans for robotics software stacks (perception, planning, control) and hardware subsystems.

 - Simulation & Scenario Testing: Build simulation environments (Gazebo/Ignition, Isaac Sim) for warehouse layouts; author scenarios for obstacle avoidance, dynamic traffic, and multi-robot coordination. 
 - SIL/HIL Validation: Set up Software-in-the-Loop and Hardware-in-the-Loop rigs for AMR controllers, LiDAR emulators, and safety sensors; automate provisioning and logging. 
 - Sensor QA: Validate LiDAR, depth cameras, IMU, wheel encoders, and odometry accuracy under varying conditions. 
 - Navigation & Fleet QA: Test SLAM, localization robustness, path planning, and fleet orchestration (traffic management, task allocation, VDA5050 compliance). 
 - Safety & Compliance: Execute safety protocols for AMRs (emergency stop, zone monitoring, speed limits) aligned with ISO 3691-4, ISO 13849, ANSI/RIA R15. 06. 
 - Performance & Reliability: Measure latency, throughput, and stability under high-load scenarios; validate battery management and docking behaviors. 
 - CI/CD Integration: Embed automated tests into pipelines for continuous validation; monitor KPIs like defect escape rate and scenario coverage. 
 - Leadership: Act as a strong individual contributor and mentor for robotics validation teams; collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders to ensure customer experience is prioritized. 

Required Qualifications

- 6-12 years in QA/Validation, with 7+ years in robotics or AMR systems.

 - Hands-on experience with ROS2, Nav2 stack, colcon, and simulation tools (Gazebo/Ignition, Isaac Sim).

 - Familiarity with fleet management systems, traffic control, and VDA5050 protocol. 
 - CI/CD experience with GitHub Actions/GitLab CI/Jenkins; Docker-based test environments. 
 - Knowledge of functional safety standards for mobile robots (ISO 3691-4, ISO 13849). 

Preferred Skills

 - Warehouse automation workflows, WMS integration, and OPC-UA.

- Automated coverage of navigation and fleet scenarios. 
 - Reduction in field defect escape rate. 
 - Stability and reliability under multi-robot deployments.

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Robotics, Electronics, Mechatronics, Computer Science, or a related field.

Are you passionate about software quality, test automation, and safety-critical engineering? Do you enjoy solving complex verification challenges and building automation solutions that improve engineering efficiency?

Join our team as a Lead Verification Engineer - Avionics V&V & Test Automation and help deliver high-quality avionics software through rigorous verification, intelligent automation, and industry-leading safety standards. 

The Opportunity

We are looking for a talented Software Engineer with 4-7 years of experience to contribute to software Verification and Validation (V&V) for safety-critical avionics systems. 

In this role, you will work across software verification, hardware-software integration, structural coverage analysis, resource margin analysis, and test automation. You will develop tools using C# and Python to streamline verification activities, improve test coverage, and drive greater automation across the software verification lifecycle. 

Working closely with cross-functional engineering teams, you will help ensure that avionics software meets stringent aerospace quality and certification requirements, including DO-178B/C. 

If you enjoy combining software engineering expertise with analytical problem-solving and automation innovation, this role offers an opportunity to make a meaningful impact on the technologies that power modern aviation. 

What You'll Do

- Drive safety-critical software verification: Perform software Verification and Validation activities in accordance with DO-178B/C guidelines and applicable project requirements. 
 - Lead hardware-software integration testing: Execute black-box integration testing using emulator-based environments to validate system behavior, interfaces, and functional performance. 
 - Ensure structural coverage and model quality: Perform structural coverage analysis and model coverage analysis to demonstrate verification completeness and support certification objectives. 
 - Analyze system resource margins: Conduct memory, stack usage, and timing margin analysis to assess software resource utilization and support reliable system performance. 
 - Build intelligent test automation: Develop and enhance verification tools using C# and Python to maximize test automation, improve repeatability, and reduce manual verification effort. Experience with NI LabVIEW will be an added advantage. 
 - Verify avionics communication interfaces: Work with communication protocols such as CAN, ARINC 429, AFDX, and Time-Triggered Protocol to support robust avionics system integration. 
 - Manage configuration and change control: Use engineering and configuration management tools such as Polarion, IBM DOORS, Synergy, and TortoiseSVN to maintain traceability, manage changes, and support controlled software development. 
 - Collaborate across engineering teams: Engage with Strategic Business Units (SBUs) and cross-functional stakeholders for technical discussions, issue resolution, reviews, and demonstrations. 
 - Contribute to Agile delivery: Participate in Agile engineering activities, including Scrum, Kanban, Program Increment planning, feature development, user story creation, and backlog tracking. 
 - Drive continuous improvement: Identify opportunities to strengthen verification processes, introduce new technologies, improve automation, and enhance engineering productivity. 
 - Embrace new technologies: Learn emerging tools and techniques quickly and apply them effectively with minimal dependency on others. 

What You'll Bring

Required Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Engineering or Technology (B. E. /B. Tech) in a relevant discipline. 
 - 4-7 years of overall relevant software engineering experience, with 4-7 years of hands-on Verification and Validation experience. 
 - Proficiency in software verification and validation for safety-critical systems, with practical exposure to DO-178B/C. 
 - Experience in black-box hardware-software integration testing and emulator-based verification. 
 - Hands-on experience performing structural coverage analysis and model coverage analysis. 
 - Experience conducting memory, stack, and timing margin analysis. 
 - Strong programming skills in C# and Python, particularly for developing verification and test automation tools. 
 - Knowledge of avionics communication protocols, including CAN, ARINC 429, AFDX, and Time-Triggered Protocol. 
 - Experience using configuration, requirements, and change management tools such as Polarion, IBM DOORS, Synergy, and TortoiseSVN. 
 - Understanding of Agile methodologies and experience working in an Agile development environment. 
 - Strong analytical thinking, debugging, troubleshooting, and problem-solving capabilities. 
 - Effective communication skills and the ability to collaborate with multidisciplinary teams. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience developing automation frameworks and tools to achieve high levels of verification automation. 
 - Familiarity with NI LabVIEW for test development and automation. 
 - Experience supporting avionics software certification and verification evidence preparation. 
 - Exposure to advanced hardware-software integration environments, simulators, and emulators. 
 - Experience with continuous improvement initiatives focused on test efficiency, coverage, and engineering quality. 
 - Ability to independently evaluate new technologies and translate them into practical engineering solutions. 

How You'll Make an Impact

Your work will directly contribute to the reliability, quality, and certification readiness of safety-critical avionics software. 

- Improve verification efficiency: Develop automation solutions that minimize repetitive manual effort and improve test execution consistency. 
 - Strengthen software quality: Apply rigorous verification methods to identify defects, validate requirements, and support robust software behavior. 
 - Support aviation safety: Contribute to engineering practices designed to meet demanding aerospace development and certification standards. 
 - Enable dependable system integration: Help validate interactions between software, hardware, and avionics communication interfaces. 
 - Advance engineering innovation: Introduce better tools, techniques, and workflows that enhance productivity and verification effectiveness. 
 - Collaborate with technical experts: Work with experienced engineers across software, systems, integration, and verification disciplines. 

Why Join Collins Aerospace?

At Collins Aerospace, you will be part of a team developing technologies that help make modern flight possible. 

Our culture brings together innovation, technical excellence, collaboration, and a strong commitment to safety. We encourage our people to share ideas, explore new approaches, develop their expertise, and contribute to solutions that matter. 

Benefits and Employee Support

Benefits and eligibility are subject to company policies and applicable terms. 

Ready to Redefine Aerospace?

If you are passionate about avionics software verification, test automation, and engineering excellence, this is your opportunity to turn your technical expertise into real-world impact. 

Bring your coding skills. Automate with intelligence. Help us build safer, more reliable aviation technologies. 

Join Collins Aerospace and be part of the team redefining aerospace every day. 

Apply now and help us take flight.
