data.description:
Come work at a place where innovation and teamwork come together to support the most exciting missions in the world!

Qualys is looking for a Lead QA Engineer to own quality for products in the Cybersecurity and Compliance domain used by thousands of enterprise customers. 

You will act as a senior individual contributor and technical mentor for QA and automation engineers. You will define the test strategy across UI, backend, and data pipelines, and drive the move toward AI-assisted, self-healing automation. This is a hands-on technical role: you set quality direction, influence release decisions, and actively write and review framework code. Candidates who have built or meaningfully enhanced AI-based self-healing automation tools will stand out. 

Responsibilities

QA Mentorship & Strategy

- Mentor and guide QA and automation engineers through technical coaching, code reviews, and knowledge sharing. 
 - Define and own the end-to-end test strategy for legacy components by improving automation coverage, while ensuring all new components are fully automated from the start. 
 - Act as the quality voice in sprint planning, design reviews, and release readiness; make data-backed go/no-go recommendations. 
 - Establish scalable QA processes: defect triage, severity/priority standards, regression tiers, test case management, and root-cause analysis for escaped defects. 
 - Track and report quality metrics (defect leakage, automation coverage, flaky-test rate, mean time to detect, release cycle time) to engineering and product leadership. 
 - Partner closely with Development, Product, Support, and Sustenance teams to shift quality left and reduce customer-reported issues. 

Test Automation (Hands-On)

- Architect and evolve automation frameworks across React/TypeScript front ends, Java/Spring Boot microservices, REST APIs, and Kafka-based pipelines. 
 - Own API and contract testing (REST Assured, Pact, Postman/Newman) covering OAuth2, JWT, token, and Basic auth flows, pagination, throttling, and vendor error handling. 
 - Own CI/CD quality gates in Jenkins or GitHub Actions with fast PR-level feedback and tiered regression runs. 

AI-Driven & Self-Healing Automation

- Lead the design and rollout of self-healing automation: automatic locator recovery, DOM-similarity scoring, element fingerprinting, and confidence-based fallback that keeps suites green through UI changes. 
 - Apply LLMs across the QA lifecycle - generating test cases from requirements and API specs, converting manual tests to automated scripts, summarizing failures, and suggesting root causes from logs. 
 - Build intelligent flaky-test detection, failure classification, and auto-quarantine to separate real regressions from environmental noise. 
 - Set guardrails for AI use in QA - validating AI-generated tests, measuring healing accuracy, and preventing false passes. 

Qualifications

Experience

- 8-10+ years in QA / test engineering, with at least 2 years leading or mentoring a QA team. 
 - Proven track record of building automation frameworks from scratch and owning release quality for a SaaS product. 
 - Hands-on experience building, extending, or productionizing an AI-based or self-healing automation solution, with the ability to explain how you measured its impact. 

Skills

Automation & Testing

- Robot, Playwright and/or Selenium 4; TestNG or JUnit 5; Cypress, Jest, or Vitest
 - API automation: REST Assured, Postman/Newman, schema validation
 - Contract testing (Pact), service virtualization, and mocking (WireMock or similar)
 - Performance testing with JMeter, k6, or Gatling
 - Visual regression and accessibility testing

Programming & Backend

- Python, Java(17+) and JavaScript/TypeScript
 - SQL and data validation on Oracle or similar
 - Familiarity with microservices, Spring Boot, and Kafka (or other event streaming systems)

AI in QA

- Self-healing locator strategies and intelligent element matching
 - LLM integration: prompt design, structured outputs, and embedding model calls into test tooling
 - AI-assisted test generation, failure clustering, and log/trace summarization
 - Familiarity with RAG or vector search over test artifacts is a plus
 - Working knowledge of AI testing platforms (Healenium, Applitools, mabl, Testim)

DevOps & Tooling

- CI/CD with Jenkins or GitHub Actions
 - Docker and Kubernetes fundamentals
 - Test management (Jira/Xray, TestRail, or Zephyr)
 - Observability tools (Grafana, Prometheus, ELK) for test and pipeline diagnostics

Technical Mentorship

- Strong ability to mentor engineers through technical guidance and code reviews
 - Clear communication with engineering, product, and leadership stakeholders
 - Data-driven decision-making on quality and release readiness

Preferred

- Background in cybersecurity - vulnerability management, Policy Compliance
 - Experience testing multi-tenant SaaS at large data volumes. 
 - Open-source contributions to testing or automation projects.

Job Summary

We are looking for a Agentic Solution Architect to lead the end-to-end architectural design of a next-generation agentic platform for Finance and Accounting operations. This is a foundational role - you will define how AI agents are designed, orchestrated, and governed across Purchase-to-Pay, Order-to-Cash, and Record-to-Report workflows, and you will own the architectural decisions that determine whether this platform can scale across dozens of client implementations without custom engineering work for each. 

This role demands a rare combination: deep hands-on experience with LLMs and multi-agent systems, strong enterprise software architecture credentials, and enough Finance and Accounting domain literacy to make architectural trade-offs that are grounded in how finance operations actually work. You will collaborate with a cross-functional engineering team, work directly with client stakeholders and delivery leadership, and set the technical direction that AI engineers, backend engineers, integration specialists, and frontend engineers all build toward. 

You will not just design on whiteboards - you are expected to be hands-on enough to validate architectural decisions through prototypes, review critical implementation choices, and course-correct when the team's execution drifts from the intended design. 

Key Responsibilities

- Own the end-to-end technical architecture of the agentic platform - including agent orchestration framework, HITL engine, exception routing, integration layer, intelligence services, canonical data model, and workflow state store - ensuring all components are cohesive and scalable by design. 
 - Define the multi-agent design patterns used across the platform - agent boundaries, tool use contracts, inter-agent communication protocols, confidence thresholds, fallback routing, and human handoff triggers - and govern their consistent application across all workflow implementations. 
 - Lead the design of the workflow state management architecture - covering execution context persistence, checkpointing, idempotent retries, long-running process patterns, and safe resume - ensuring finance workflows that span days or weeks behave correctly under failure conditions. 
 - Establish the observability and governance architecture - structured logging, distributed tracing, model performance monitoring, SLA tracking, audit trail design, and compliance logging - ensuring the platform meets the control requirements of regulated finance environments. 
 - Evaluate and select foundational technologies - LLM providers, agentic frameworks (LangGraph or AutoGen or CrewAI), orchestration engines (Azure Durable Functions or Temporal), vector databases, and messaging infrastructure - with clear justification for each choice. 
 - Lead technical design reviews and architecture governance - reviewing critical implementation decisions made by AI engineers, backend engineers, and integration engineers, and ensuring they align with the platform's intended design. 
 - Work directly with client technical stakeholders during pre-sales, solutioning, and delivery - explaining architectural decisions, assessing client infrastructure constraints, and adapting the platform design to client-specific requirements without compromising reusability. 
 - Define and enforce non-functional requirements across the platform - latency SLAs, throughput targets, availability requirements, disaster recovery posture, and security controls - and validate that the implementation meets them. 
 - Build and maintain the technical roadmap for the platform - sequencing capability development, managing architectural debt, and ensuring the platform evolves coherently as new workflows and client requirements are added. 
 - Mentor and technically grow the engineering team - establishing architecture decision record (ADR) practices, conducting design reviews, and developing engineering standards that the team follows consistently. 

Required Skills

- 12+ years of software architecture and engineering experience, with at least 3 years focused on AI/ML systems and at least 2 years hands-on with LLM-based or agentic applications in production. 
 - Deep expertise in multi-agent system design - agent orchestration, tool use, inter-agent communication, stateful agent patterns, and human-in-the-loop architecture using frameworks such as LangGraph, AutoGen, CrewAI, or equivalent. 
 - Proven experience architecting event-driven, distributed systems on Azure at scale - Azure Durable Functions, Azure Service Bus, Azure Event Grid, Azure Functions, Azure Container Apps (AKS), Azure API Management, Azure Database for PostgreSQL, and related services. 
 - Strong Python skills- sufficient to prototype architectural patterns, review implementation code critically, and validate that the team's code matches the intended design. 
 - Experience with MLOps and AI governance - model versioning, drift detection, evaluation pipelines, prompt management, and production monitoring for LLM-based services. 
 - Strong communication skills - able to explain complex architectural decisions to both engineering teams and non-technical client stakeholders, and to produce clear, concise architecture documentation. 
 - Demonstrated ability to make and defend technology selection decisions with clear trade-off analysis - including build vs. buy, framework selection, and infrastructure design choices. 
 - Hands-on experience delivering agentic or LLM-based systems in a finance, BPO, or shared services context - not just proof-of-concept projects but production deployments with real operational volume and compliance requirements. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Deep familiarity with Finance and Accounting operations - P2P, O2C, and R2R processes, exception patterns, compliance controls, and the operational metrics (STP rate, first-pass match rate, exception aging) that define platform success. 
 - Experience architecting RAG pipelines, vector search infrastructure, and document intelligence services for structured extraction from financial documents at scale. 
 - Experience with architecture governance frameworks - Architecture Decision Records (ADRs), architecture review boards, and technical standards documentation. 
 - Prior experience in a shared services, or F&A technology consulting context - understanding how finance operations teams work and what makes a platform adoptable by non-technical operations staff. 
 - Contributions to open-source AI/agentic projects or published technical writing on multi-agent system design.

We are looking for a hands-on AI Architect who can own the AI thought vision for the Client and personally drive AI-powered features from idea to production. 

This is a builder's role, not an advisory one - you will architect the AI infrastructure, write production code, integrate AI tools across our stack, and design systems that scale with our patient population. You will be the technical owner of every AI capability client ship. 

Indicative time split: 

- 80% Hands-On Technical Development
 - 20% Other (vision, architecture reviews, stakeholder alignment, tooling evaluation). 

Key Focus Areas

- AI Thought Vision - set the technical direction for how AI is applied across the Client's clinical, operational, and patient-facing workflows. 
 - Build AI Infrastructure - design and implement the foundational platform (model gateways, retrieval pipelines, prompt management, evaluation harness, observability). 
 - Full Execution / Hands-On - write production code, build prototypes, and ship AI features end-to-end. This is not a hands-off architect role. 
 - Integrate All AI Tools - bring together LLM APIs, vector stores, agent frameworks, AI voice/transcription, and AI-powered SaaS into a cohesive, well-governed stack. 
 - Build for Scalability - design systems that scale across thousands of patients and millions of interactions, with cost, latency, accuracy, and safety in mind. 

Roles and Responsibilities

- Own the architecture for all AI capabilities - conversational agents, summarization, clinical decision support, workflow automation, voice/transcription, and analytics. 
 - Take AI ideas from concept to production - prototype, validate, harden, and ship real applications used by patients and clinicians. 
 - Build the core AI infrastructure: model abstraction layer, prompt versioning, evaluation pipelines, retrieval (RAG) systems, agent orchestration, guardrails, and observability. 
 - Design and implement RAG pipelines over clinical and operational data with strong relevance, freshness, and privacy controls. 
 - Build and operate AI agents and tool-use workflows that interact with EHRs, telephony, messaging, and internal systems. 
 - Define and enforce evaluation methodology - offline eval sets, online metrics, regression detection, and accuracy/safety benchmarks for every AI feature. 
 - Drive responsible AI practices - PHI handling, prompt-injection defense, hallucination mitigation, audit logging, and HIPAA-aware design. 
 - Evaluate and integrate the best-of-breed AI tools, models, and platforms (OpenAI, Anthropic, open-source LLMs, vector DBs, agent frameworks, AI voice). 
 - Optimize for cost and latency - model routing, caching, batching, distillation, and rightsizing. 
 - Partner with the Technical Manager and engineering team to ship AI features cleanly into the production platform. 
 - Partner with Product, Clinical, and Operations leaders to identify the highest-value AI opportunities and convert them into shippable applications. 
 - Mentor engineers on AI engineering practices; raise the team's overall AI literacy and execution capability. 
 - Maintain a forward-looking view of the AI landscape and continuously bring proven advances into the product. 

Technical Requirements

- Proven hands-on experience taking AI ideas from prototype to real-time, productiongrade applications running at scale. 
 - Strong programming proficiency in Python and/or JavaScript/TypeScript, with the ability to write and ship production code independently. 
 - Deep, working knowledge of modern LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, and open-source models) - including function/tool calling, structured outputs, streaming, and cost/latency optimization. 
 - Hands-on experience designing and operating RAG systems - chunking, embeddings, vector databases (Pinecone, Weaviate, pgvector, or similar), hybrid retrieval, and reranking. 
 - Experience building agentic systems with tool use, planning, and multi-step workflows. 
 - Strong prompt engineering skills, including evaluation, versioning, and continuous improvement. 
 - Experience with AI evaluation frameworks - golden sets, LLM-as-judge, A/B testing, and regression tracking. 
 - Solid backend engineering fundamentals - REST APIs, asynchronous processing, queues, observability, and scaling patterns.

principles. We're looking for someone who can understand a problem end to end, question

design decisions, evaluate tradeoffs, and build reliable, scalable systems from the ground

up. 

What We're Looking For

- Hands-on production experience with Django, FastAPI, or Python-based microservices. You should be comfortable designing, building, debugging, and owning services independently. 
 - Deep database understanding: Strong knowledge of SQL, particularly MySQL, including indexing, query optimization, transactions, locking, concurrency, and database internals. 
 - Familiarity with Elasticsearch, time-series databases, and different data storage patterns is valuable. 
 - Experience handling schema changes, data migrations, or infrastructure migrations on live systems under significant traffic. 
 - Understanding zero-downtime strategies, backward compatibility, and rollback planning matters. 
 - Experience designing or maintaining scalable payment services. You should understand idempotency, retries, reconciliation, failure handling, and the challenges of building reliable financial transaction flows. 
 - Experience integrating external services and APIs, handling rate limits, timeouts, retries, webhooks, and failure scenarios. 
 - Strong understanding of caching, load balancers, CDNs, asynchronous processing, message queues, concurrency, and distributed systems fundamentals. 
 - Deep understanding of abstraction, modularity, separation of concerns, design patterns, and clean architecture. More importantly, knowing when and why to apply these principles in production, and when not to overengineer. 
 - Ability to take a requirement, understand the underlying problem, evaluate alternatives, design a solution, implement it, and take responsibility for how it behaves in production. 

Good to Have

- Hands-on DevOps experience or strong understanding of infrastructure, AWS, containers, deployments, networking, and production debugging. 
 - Experience building AI-powered microservices, LLM integrations, agent workflows, or AI orchestration systems. 
 - Understanding of API communication patterns and protocols, including REST, GraphQL, gRPC, and their underlying tradeoffs. 
 - Experience investigating and solving performance bottlenecks across application, database, and infrastructure layers.

data.description:
Founding Engineer (Backend, TypeScript)

AssureNode | Full time, permanent | Mumbai hybrid preferred; remote within India for the right candidate Reports to the founder | 4+ years of backend engineering with production ownership

Build and own the technology

AssureNode is building a continuous compliance and Governance, Risk and Compliance automation platform. It is designed to connect to cloud, code, identity and HR systems, collect evidence, and help organisations assess and demonstrate compliance with frameworks such as SOC 2 and ISO 27001, and requirements under India's DPDP Act. 

The platform is in development. We are looking for an in-house technical owner who can work with our engineering partner during development, independently assess the system, and lead our first design partner integration and transition into production. 

Your first 90 days

Handover, testing and integration will overlap. Priorities will depend on your joining date, module readiness and the design partner's needs. 

• Learn and verify the system: review the architecture and decision records, run it end to end, understand the development workflow, and establish company-controlled access to repositories, environments and deployment tooling. 

• Test as modules arrive: build and run a readiness plan covering tenant isolation, authentication, permissions, audit trails, evidence handling, exports and recovery. Track defects and work with the engineering partner to resolve them. 

• Lead integration and readiness: validate the integrations needed by the first design partner, rehearse releases and rollback, and recommend whether the platform is ready to launch. Agree the launch decision with the founder and technical reviewers. 

What you will own

• Backend development across compliance workflows, evidence collection, integrations, monitoring and policies. 

• Security and quality: customer data boundaries, access controls, database changes, code review and release checks. Support AssureNode's SOC 2 and ISO 27001 work through change records, access reviews and customer security questionnaires. 

• Reliable integrations that handle failures, retries, rate limits and changing third-party APIs. 

• Production operations: deployment, monitoring, incident response, runbooks and recovery testing, with support responsibilities agreed during handover. 

• Technical decisions, clear communication with the founder and clients, and helping hire the next engineers. 

How we work

You will help maintain a disciplined development workflow: written architecture decisions, automated checks and review before changes merge. The role requires challenging assumptions, reading code critically and testing security properties. Automated checks support engineering judgement; they do not replace independent review. 

  

What we are looking for

4+ years building backend services, including at least 2 years of TypeScript or Node. js in production, and experience as the senior or sole engineer responsible for a live product. 

• Strong PostgreSQL fundamentals: data modelling, migrations, indexing, transactions and query performance. 

• Experience with NestJS or a comparable Node. js framework, and practical AWS and CI/CD knowledge. 

• Sound security habits across authentication, authorisation, secrets management and application security testing. 

• The ability to find problems in code you did not write, prioritise risk and explain trade-offs to non-engineers. 

Useful experience includes multi-tenant SaaS and PostgreSQL Row-Level Security, Drizzle ORM, WorkOS, background workers, the outbox pattern, infrastructure as code, and B2B security or compliance products. You do not need every tool on this list. 

Our stack

TypeScript, Node. js, NestJS and Fastify; PostgreSQL with Row-Level Security and Drizzle ORM; WorkOS; AWS; Next. js; GitHub and GitHub Actions. 

Ownership and growth

You will work directly with the founder and have substantial responsibility for the platform and engineering standards. The role can grow into Head of Engineering and potentially CTO as the company grows, depending on performance, demonstrated leadership and business needs. 

Mumbai hybrid preferred; remote within India for the right candidate. Earliest start: 1 December 2026. Please share your availability. 

Working with the founder

The founder leads business and product. Founder is the ex-Head of Fintech Solutions at NPCI who drove the UPI and RuPay businesses in India. You will own the technology, work closely together on product decisions and build an engineering team over time. We will discuss workload expectations and support openly. 

Hiring process

A founder conversation covering the role, availability and compensation; a two-hour take-home code review exercise; a technical and architecture discussion; and a working conversation on ownership and collaboration. References and any agreed checks follow before an offer. We will confirm the technical reviewers and exercise instructions in advance. 

How to apply

Email contact@assurenode. com with your LinkedIn profile and, optionally, GitHub or another example of work you can share, notice period, and a short example of a production system you owned: your responsibilities, what broke, and what you did about it.

Job Description About the AI Technology Innovation Centre

We are establishing a world class AI research center called "AI Technology Innovation Center" (TIC) in Bengaluru. The TIC will drive research in frontier AI technology with top AI talent and state-of-the-art infrastructure. The research breakthrough will lead to commercialization of next generation AI solutions. The AI TIC is being strategically designed to establish a globally recognized leader in AI research and development, driving innovation and setting industry benchmarks. The TIC aims to attract, nurture, and retain top-tier AI talent in India by fostering a dynamic, inclusive, and high-impact work environment that encourages continuous learning and breakthrough thinking. 

By seamlessly integrating commercial agility with a pioneering scientific mindset, we will deliver scalable AI solutions that address real-world challenges while pushing the frontiers of technology. This ensures that our AI-TIC excels in cutting-edge research and translates discoveries into tangible business value, reinforcing our position as a hub for AI excellence. 

The Role Mandate

As the Principal Engineer of AI TIC, you'll own the end-to-end system architecture and design and delivery of production-grade agentic and Generative AI systems (on-premise/cloud). This is a highly hands-on role requiring deep architectural insight, coding proficiency, and an obsession with performance, scalability, and reliability. You'll architect secure, cost-efficient AI platforms, guide developers through complex debugging and optimization, and ensure all systems are observable, governed, and production ready. You will create a reference platform and AI pipeline on which TIC research will get translated to real product.

- Direct link to global products Carry frontier research into dependable, observable and secure deployed systems.

- Technical leadership without leaving code Mentor, review, debug and ship as a true principal engineer. 

The Larger Impact

- Determine whether empathic agents become dependable products rather than demonstrations. 
 - Create a secure, modular and cost-efficient platform for multimodal, memory-enabled, tool-using agents. 
 - Lead model adaptation, compression and optimisation for self-managed GPU environments. 
 - Create reusable SDKs, connectors, CI/CD templates, evaluation harnesses and observability. 
 - Set the engineering standards that become the Centre's technical reputation.

Create detailed design documents including flow/UML/sequence diagrams and AWS deployment topologies. Additionally, ensure architectures support advanced LLM training and inference workflows, incorporating distributed strategies for scalability.

 - Lead Debugging & Stability Efforts: Conduct deep-dive debugging, fix critical defects, and resolve production incidents; pair-program with developers to improve code quality and performance. Apply MLOps-driven stability practices, leveraging configuration management and automated recovery for high availability. 
 - Standardize Agentic Frameworks: Build reference implementations using Semantic Kernel (preferred), LangGraph, AutoGen, or CrewAI with strong schema validation, grounding, and memory management. 
 - Implement Observability & Monitoring: Set up distributed tracing, metrics, and logging via OpenTelemetry and Datadog. Standardize dashboards, alerts, and incident response workflows. 
 - Govern Evaluation & Rollouts: Build test and evaluation frameworks-golden sets, A/B experiments, regression suites, and controlled rollouts-to ensure consistent quality across releases. 
 - Establish Engineering Standards: Create reusable SDKs, connectors, CI/CD templates, and architecture review checklists to promote consistency across teams. 
 - Cross-Functional Leadership: Collaborate with product, data, and SRE teams for capacity planning, DR strategies, and post-incident RCA reviews. Mentor engineers to strengthen design and reliability practices How the Centre Works

The TIC follows a research-to-product operating model. Scientists and engineers work as one team across hypothesis formation, algorithm design, model development, evaluation, platform engineering and technology transfer. Every role combines technical depth with ownership, reproducibility, responsible AI and clear communication of outcomes. 

͏ Qualifications and Experience

Experience and leadership

- Education: Bachelor's/Master's from a top-tier institute (IIT/Tier-1) in Computer Science, AI, or related field. 
 - 7-10 years in software/AI engineering, including 4+ years in GenAI application development and 2+ years architecting agentic AI systems.

 - Hands-on experience with Semantic Kernel, LangGraph, AutoGen, or CrewAI or equivalent.

 - Deep understanding of AWS ecosystem: EKS, Bedrock, S3, SQS/SNS, RDS, ElastiCache, Secrets Manager, IAM/Okta, Kong API Gateway management and automated recovery for high availability. What Success Looks Like (18-24 Months)

- A hardened, observable agentic system and platform having custom models on on-premise infrastructure. 
 - Reference implementations, SDKs and CI/CD templates become the Centre default. 
 - Quality, safety, latency and cost are measurable and continuously improved. 
 - Research lands in production safely through a regular, governed release cadence. 
 - Production problems are detected early and converted into systemic improvements. ͏ Mandatory Skills: GenAI for Internet Software Products . 

  

Experience: 5-8 Years . 

  

Reinvent your world. We are building a modern Wipro. We are an end-to-end digital transformation partner with the boldest ambitions. To realize them, we need people inspired by reinvention. Of yourself, your career, and your skills. We want to see the constant evolution of our business and our industry. It has always been in our DNA - as the world around us changes, so do we. Join a business powered by purpose and a place that empowers you to design your own reinvention.

About ArcherA new regulatory change lands somewhere in the world every six minutes, and agentic AI is outpacing most teams' ability to govern it. At Archer, we help the enterprises powering the global economy turn that pressure into an advantage. 

Mandates like the EU AI Act and the SEC cybersecurity disclosure rules are driving the most significant GRC buying cycle we have seen in years. That demand is why we are growing this team. 

This is hard work that matters. Our customers span energy, utilities, financial services, pharmaceuticals, and the public institutions communities depend on. People choose Archer because they get to partner with the most trusted brands in the world, on work that protects the customers and communities those brands serve. 

If that sounds like your kind of work, let's chat. 

The RoleQuality is not something we inspect at the end of a release; it's something we build into every stage of engineering. As a Senior Quality Engineer, you will be responsible for elevating product quality through intelligent test strategies, automation, continuous validation, performance engineering, and close partnership with engineering and product teams. You'll help teams identify risks early, find defects quickly, and ensure every release meets high standards for functionality, performance, security, and reliability. This is an exciting opportunity to shape the future of quality engineering by leveraging modern CI/CD practices, AI-powered engineering tools, and data-driven decision making while collaborating with globally distributed teams

- Lead quality planning and risk assessment activities across product initiatives and releases.

data.title: Engineering Manager II
data.description:
Toast is driven by building the all-in-one restaurant platform that helps restaurants operate their business, increase sales, engage guests, and keep employees happy. Toast helps restaurants adapt, take control, and get back to what they do best : building the businesses they love. Toast connects employees, operations, and guests on a reliable, easy-to-use platform so restaurateurs can stay one step ahead of a rapidly evolving hospitality market. 

Are you bready* for a change?

We are hiring for the 'Enterprise Payments' team, which sits at the centre of Toast's global Enterprise growth strategy. We design, build, and scale the Fintech infrastructure that powers seamless commerce for Enterprise customers across the globe. 

Toast is looking for an Engineering Manager to lead our Enterprise Payments team. You will manage and develop a high-performing engineering team focused on delivering strategic capabilities for our enterprise customers and driving meaningful business impact. Leading with a global-first mindset, you will oversee the design and delivery of resilient, scalable payment systems that power enterprise growth across international markets. 

About this roll* (Responsibilities)

- Roadmap Execution : Partner with stakeholders to define, prioritise, and execute the Enterprise Payments team's roadmap and operational objectives, translating business priorities into measurable outcomes. 
 - Team Leadership: Support the professional and technical development of team members through coaching, mentorship, and career guidance, helping engineers grow as both technical contributors and leaders. 
 - Delivery: Establish accountability for execution and outcomes, ensuring the team delivers value with speed, quality, and reliability. 
 - Culture : Serve as a steward of an exceptional culture, encompassing both technical excellence and people‐centric values. 
 - Scale : Guide teams to build systems that will scale to the next order of magnitude of growth. 
 - Collaboration : Collaborate with stakeholders across the organization - including PMs, SEs, CS, QA, and UX - to help your teams get stuff done and deliver solutions that maximize value. 
 - Operational Excellence : Build and scale a customer-first operational support model that delivers timely issue triage, effective problem resolution, and exceptional service reliability for enterprise customers, while driving continuous improvements in operational efficiency and customer outcomes. 
 - Hiring : Hire and develop new team members, building a diverse team that wins together. 

Do you have the right ingredients? (Experience)

- Strong technologist with 12+ years of experience defining, architecting, and delivering highly scalable engineering solutions. 
 - 4+ years of experience managing, coaching, and developing high-performing engineering teams. 
 - Deep experience in the Fintech/Payments domains. 
 - A passion for building diverse, high-performing teams that collaborate effectively, win together, and place customer success at the centre of every decision. 
 - A bias for action and a pragmatic mindset, with the ability to balance execution velocity, technical excellence, and business outcomes. 
 - Experience shipping iterative value using agile or lean software delivery methods. 
 - Have strong understanding & hands-on experience of building fault-tolerant, highly-scalable & secure distributed systems. 
 - Proficiency with sql/nosql databases, strong understanding of distributed datastores and knowledge of when to use what. 
 - Proficiency in SDLC best practices and experience ensuring data integrity, quality, and consistency. 
 - A strong sense of empathy for customers and a desire to prioritize customer success. 
 - Strong interpersonal skills and a proven track record of building partnerships across engineering, product, customer success, and other stakeholders. 
 - You demonstrate humility, empathy and respectfulness. 

What we use to make our dish (Our Tech Stack)

- Backend services which follow a microservice architecture written using Kotlin, Java and DropWizard. 
 - Android apps built using Kotlin & Java. 
 - Event driven messaging & streaming using Apache Pulsar & RabbitMQ. 
 - Apache Camel for implementing Enterprise Integration Pattern. 
 - React & ES6 based Frontend SPAs leveraging Tailwind, GraphQL and Storybook. 
 - DynamoDb & Postgres as core persistence data-storage layers. 
 - Datadog & Sentry for system and application metric and monitoring. 
 - Splunk for log aggregation. 
 - FireHydrant for alerting. 

AI at Toast

At Toast, one of our company values is that we're hungry to build and learn. We believe learning new AI tools empowers us to build for our customers faster, more independently, and with higher quality. We provide these tools across all disciplines, from Engineering and Product to Sales and Support, and are inspired by how our Toasters are already driving real value with them. The people who thrive here are those who embrace changes that let us build more for our customers; it's a core part of our culture. 

Our Total Rewards Philosophy

We strive to provide competitive compensation and benefits programs that help to attract, retain, and motivate the best and brightest people in our industry. Our total rewards package goes beyond great earnings potential and provides the means to a healthy lifestyle with the flexibility to meet Toasters' changing needs. Learn more about our benefits at https: //careers. toasttab. com/toast-benefits. 

How Toast Uses AI In Its Hiring Process

Throughout the hiring process, our goal is to get to know you. We use AI tools to support our recruiters and interviewers with tasks like note-taking, summarization, and documentation of interviews to ensure they can be fully focused on your conversation. All hiring decisions are made by people. We ask that you complete interviews and assessments on your own, without real-time AI tools, recording, or transcription bots, unless we tell you otherwise in advance. To learn more: https: //careers. toasttab. com/ai-in-hiring

Our Approach to Hybrid Working

We embrace a hybrid work model that fosters in-person collaboration while valuing individual needs. Our goal is to build a strong culture of connection as we work together to empower the hospitality community, regardless of location. Please visit the Locations page on our career site to learn more about our in-office expectations by region: https: //careers. toasttab. com/locations-toast

People Are the Secret Ingredient in Our Recipe for Success

At Toast, our employees are our secret ingredient-when they thrive, we thrive. The restaurant industry brings together people with a wide range of backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives, and we value that same breadth at Toast. We strive to build a culture grounded in authenticity, respect, and humility, where every Toaster has a real opportunity to grow, contribute, and do their best work-raising the bar in delivering exceptional experiences for our customers and each other. 

Apply today!

Toast is committed to creating an accessible and inclusive hiring process. data.title: Staff Site Reliability Engineer
data.description:
About The Role

We're looking for a Staff Site Reliability Engineer who is equally at home writing production software and running the infrastructure it lives on - and who wants to take ownership of one of the hardest, highest-leverage problems on our platform: intelligently managing a large fleet of GPU-backed models. 

We run nearly 30 models across heterogeneous hardware, and keeping that fleet fast, reliable, and cost-effective is a serious engineering challenge. You'll build the GPU management and scheduling platform that sits at the center of it - collecting utilization and load metrics, interpreting what they actually mean, and using them to make real-time decisions about admission control and scaling. The goal: route and schedule inference calls so we use our capacity efficiently without exceeding it, and scale model replicas up and down automatically as demand shifts. 

This is a senior role for someone with a decade in the field who can move fluidly between systems engineering and software development, and who is excited to own a complex, evolving system end to end. 

What You'll Do

- Design and build our GPU management and scheduling platform - the system that decides when, where, and how inference calls run across a fleet of ~30 models on heterogeneous hardware
 - Build the metrics pipeline that collects GPU load and utilization data, and the logic that turns those signals into decisions
 - Implement admission control to protect capacity - deciding when to accept, queue, or shed inference requests so we operate within fleet limits
 - Build autoscaling that adjusts the number of model replicas in response to real-time demand and utilization
 - Develop cloud orchestration systems and operators in Python and Go to manage the model fleet
 - Architect and operate scalable, fault-tolerant, secure production systems on AWS, GCP, or Azure
 - Design and build infrastructure automation and deployment pipelines (Terraform, CI/CD) as first-class software
 - Stand up and maintain monitoring, logging, and alerting that keep the platform reliable and performant
 - Develop and enforce security and compliance policies appropriate to a healthcare AI platform
 - Partner with engineers and research scientists to diagnose and resolve complex infrastructure, deployment, and operational issues
 - Mentor engineers and raise the technical bar across the team

We value in-person teamwork and believe the best ideas happen together. Our team is expected to be in the office five days a week in Gurugram. This role will also require engaging with a US based team requiring some flexibility for overlapping hours with California. 

What You Bring

Must-Have

- 10+ years of professional experience across site reliability / DevOps engineering and software engineering
 - Computer Science Degree Required from a top CS program. 
 - Strong software engineering fundamentals - you build orchestration and scheduling systems in Python and/or Go, not just configure off-the-shelf tools
 - Experience designing systems that make decisions from operational metrics - collecting signals, interpreting them, and driving control loops such as autoscaling, load shedding, or admission control
 - Deep experience with infrastructure automation and CI/CD (Terraform, GitLab CI/CD, or similar)
 - Hands-on production experience with at least one major cloud platform (AWS, GCP, or Azure)
 - Strong knowledge of containerization and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes)
 - Experience with monitoring and logging stacks (ELK, Grafana, Datadog, or similar)
 - Familiarity with secrets management and security tooling (HashiCorp Vault, AWS KMS, Azure Key Vault)
 - Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to work both independently and collaboratively
 - Strong communication and interpersonal skills

Nice-to-Have

- Experience managing GPU fleets or scheduling workloads across heterogeneous accelerators
 - Familiarity with ML inference serving and model deployment (e. g. Triton, KServe, Ray Serve, or similar)
 - Experience with Kubernetes autoscaling internals (HPA/VPA, custom metrics, custom controllers)
 - Experience implementing HIPAA and SOC 2 compliance
 - Experience operating in an HPC environment
 - Bachelor's or Master's in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field

data.title: Telecaller Floor Manager
data.description:
Company Description Anytime Diesel is India's leading doorstep fuel delivery and fuel management company, transforming how businesses access and control their energy needs. Powered by advanced technology, including IoT-enabled systems, GPS tracking, geo-fencing, AI, and data-driven fuel intelligence, the company delivers safe, tamper-proof, and on-time diesel across India. Serving 10, 000+ clients in sectors such as infrastructure, healthcare, retail, hospitality, and residential complexes, Anytime Diesel focuses on reducing downtime, preventing fuel theft, and improving transparency. Its solutions include smart fuel storage tanks, Diesel Cube systems, and Fuelistic IoT logistics technology, creating an integrated fuel management ecosystem built for safety, compliance, and operational control. Through the Fuel for Trees initiative, Anytime Diesel aligns fuel delivery with environmental responsibility, supporting sustainable progress. 

Role Description The Tele caller Floor Manager is a full-time, on-site role based in the Greater Hyderabad Area, responsible for leading and managing a team of tele callers to ensure high-quality customer interactions and efficient call operations. This role oversees daily calling activities, monitors performance metrics, and implements call scripts and guidelines to improve conversion rates and customer satisfaction. The Tele caller Floor Manager coordinates call schedules, assigns targets, and provides regular coaching, feedback, and training to team members. The role also involves handling escalations, collaborating with sales and operations teams to align communication with business goals, and generating reports on call outcomes, lead status, and team productivity. The Tele caller Floor Manager maintains discipline on the floor, ensures adherence to company policies, and supports a positive, goal-oriented work environment. 

Key Responsibilities

1. Team Management & Floor Operations

● Lead, supervise, and motivate the telecalling team to achieve daily, weekly, and

monthly targets. 

● Allocate leads, customer follow-ups, and calling activities among team members. 

● Monitor attendance, punctuality, login hours, break schedules, and overall floor

discipline. 

● Conduct daily team briefings, performance reviews, and regular feedback sessions. 

● Support team members in handling difficult customer conversations and achieving

performance targets. 

● Identify training needs and improve individual and team productivity. 

2. Call Monitoring & Performance Management

● Monitor call quality, call recordings, customer interactions, and follow-up discipline. 

● Track key performance indicators such as daily calls, connected calls, qualified leads, 

conversions, and follow-up completion. 

● Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly performance reports for management. 

● Maintain team dashboards, calling reports, lead trackers, and customer databases. 

● Identify performance gaps and implement corrective actions to improve results. 

● Ensure adherence to calling scripts, communication standards, and company

processes. 

3. Customer Engagement & Lead Management

● Ensure timely follow-ups with prospective and existing customers. 

● Guide the team in explaining Anytime Diesel's services, fuel delivery process, pricing, 

and business benefits. 

● Improve lead qualification, customer activation, repeat business, and customer

retention. 

● Handle customer complaints, escalations, and service-related queries professionally. 

● Ensure accurate recording of customer requirements, call outcomes, and follow-up

commitments in the CRM or designated tracker. 

● Coordinate with the sales team to convert qualified leads into business opportunities. 

4. Sales & Business Coordination

● Drive team targets related to lead generation, customer onboarding, service adoption, 

and business conversion, as applicable. 

● Coordinate with Sales and Operations teams to address customer requirements and

delivery-related concerns. 

● Follow up on inactive customers, pending enquiries, and potential repeat orders. 

● Identify opportunities to improve customer engagement and increase business

through structured calling campaigns. 

● Ensure that customer commitments are communicated accurately and aligned with

operational feasibility. 

5. Process Improvement & Reporting

● Develop and standardize calling processes, scripts, escalation matrices, and follow-up

procedures. 

● Analyse calling data to identify bottlenecks and recommend process improvements. 

● Maintain accurate records of team performance, lead status, customer feedback, and

escalations. 

● Share daily performance updates and periodic MIS reports with the reporting manager. 

● Ensure compliance with company policies, customer data confidentiality, and

professional communication standards. 

Required Skills & Competencies

● Strong team leadership and floor management skills. 

● Excellent verbal communication and interpersonal skills. 

● Ability to manage targets, productivity, and performance metrics. 

● Strong customer handling, objection handling, and escalation management skills. 

● Proficiency in MS Excel or Google Sheets, CRM tools, and reporting dashboards. 

● Good analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making abilities. 

● Strong follow-up discipline, time management, and organizational skills. 

● Ability to work in a fast-paced, target-driven environment. 

Eligibility Criteria

● Minimum 5+ years of overall experience in tele calling, tele sales, customer support, or

call center operations. 

● At least 2+ years of team-handling or floor-supervision experience preferred. 

● Experience managing a team of tele callers in a target-driven environment. 

● Prior experience in B2B tele calling, lead generation, customer onboarding, logistics, 

fuel, mobility, or service operations will be an advantage. 

● Graduate in any discipline preferred. 

● Immediate joiners or candidates with a short notice period may be preferred, 

depending on business requirements. 

Why Join Anytime Diesel?

● Opportunity to work with a growing, technology-enabled fuel delivery business. 

● Exposure to B2B customer engagement and business operations. 

● Opportunity to lead a team and contribute directly to business growth. 

● Dynamic work environment with scope for professional development.

Technical Expertise

 - Experience defining automation architecture and toolchains across UI, API, integration, contract, performance, security, accessibility, mobile, and regression testing.

What You Will Do

 - Partner with Product, Engineering, Customer Success, Operations, Security, and Architecture teams to align quality objectives with business goals. 
 - Use customer feedback, support trends, and telemetry to improve product reliability, stability, usability, scalability, and performance.

The Quality Assurance & Quality Engineering organization ensures secure, reliable, scalable, high-quality products across the IP portfolio. Our goal is to enable Workspace One-Unified End point Management platform to scale and manage billions of devices across various operating system platforms and device types.

data.title: Manager, Engineering
data.description:
Life at Plume

At Plume, we believe that technology isn't about moving faster, it's about making life's moments better. Which is why we've built the world's first, and only, open and hardware-independent service delivery platform for smart homes, small businesses, enterprises, and beyond. Our SaaS platform uses WiFi, advanced AI, and machine learning to create the future of connected spaces-and human experiences-at massive scale. 

We now deliver services to over 60 million locations globally and have managed over 3 billion devices on our platform. We're expanding rapidly, pioneering a new category, and we achieved our Series F funding in just four years. Our customers include many of the world's largest Internet Service Providers (ISPs) who look to Plume to help them evolve their smart home offerings while gleaning insights from their own data. 

With a bias for action and a love for being trailblazers, the team at Plume embodies a combination of relentless curiosity and imaginative innovation. We challenge ourselves to think in ways that other companies don't, work to do what should be done (rather than what can), and if we can't do it exceptionally well, we don't do it. It's how we've assembled a team of world-class builders, thinkers, and doers. And it's how we're reinventing what's possible every day. 

This is a work-from-office / In-Office role based in our Hyderabad, India location. 

About The Team

Core Engineering builds the firmware and cloud platform that Plume's next-generation architecture is built on. We deliver the Plume Firmware Agent (PFA) across three reference platforms - RDK-B, prplOS / prplMesh, and OpenWRT / OpenSync - The highly scalable cloud core manages a fleet of connected devices over standards-based protocols. 

About The Role

We're hiring an Engineering Manager to lead one of Core Engineering's delivery teams. This is a hands-on-adjacent people-leadership role: you own the health, growth and output of a team of roughly 10-30 firmware, backend and QA engineers, and you are close enough to the technology to make real calls on scope, sequencing and trade-offs. 

You will not be the only voice in the room. Core runs with technical leads, TPMs, product owners and QA leads across multiple regions, and the manager who succeeds here is the one who makes that distributed system work. 

What You'll Do

Lead the team

- Manage, coach and grow a globally distributed team of firmware, cloud and QA engineers; run 1: 1s, career development, performance and compensation cycles. 
 - Own hiring for your team end to end - sourcing partnership, interview loop design, closing, and onboarding that gets new engineers productive on a complex embedded + cloud stack. 
 - Build a culture where code review, design review and demos are collaborative rather than transactional - our review norms deliberately keep PRs open for cross-region input, and that only works if managers protect it. 

Own delivery

- Drive sprint planning, review, demo and retrospective for your team on the CORE board; keep the backlog groomed, parented and honestly estimated. 
 - Take quarterly product requirements through grooming into epics and stories, in partnership with Product Management, Product Owners and the TPM - and push back early when scope, dependencies or capacity don't add up. 
 - Own release readiness for your area across Alpha, Beta and GA: entry/exit criteria, blocker triage, validation coverage, and a clear-eyed status your leadership can act on. 
 - Track and unblock cross-team dependencies with Product Engineering, Integration Engineering, Cloud/CSS, DevOps and InfoSec. 

Own technical direction with your leads

- Partner with technical leads and architects on platform strategy - the move from a stateful, driver-coupled OpenSync design toward stateless, standards-compliant, SDK-conformant operation over USP. 
 - Make and defend architectural trade-offs across three device platforms and the cloud services above them, including what gets upstreamed versus carried downstream. 
 - Raise the engineering bar on the things that quietly decide velocity: build times, branch hygiene, test automation, flaky testbeds, and observability. 

Leadership Skills

What we're looking for: 

- 12+ years in software engineering with 3+ years managing engineers directly, including hiring and performance management. 
 - Strong technical grounding in embedded Linux networking - Wi-Fi/networking firmware, an embedded build system (Yocto/OpenWrt/OpenEmbedded), C, and debugging on real hardware - or in distributed cloud services with genuine fluency in the device side. 
 - Demonstrated ownership of a release train: you have shipped firmware or platform software into production at scale; with QA and release gates you were accountable for. 
 - Experience leading a distributed team across time zones, and the operating discipline that requires - written communication, asynchronous decision-making, and deliberate inclusion of remote colleagues. 
 - Comfort operating in a matrixed organisation with technical leads, TPMs and product owners you influence but don't manage. 

Technical Skills

- Direct experience with one or more of RDK-B, prplOS/prplMesh, or OpenSync/OpenWrt. 
 - Working knowledge of Broadband Forum TR-369 (USP) and TR-181, and/or Wi-Fi Alliance EasyMesh. 
 - Background in the CPE / broadband gateway ecosystem - ODM and chipset vendor SDKs, operator certification, interop testing. 
 - Familiarity with the surrounding toolchain: Jenkins, GitHub-based workflows, Artifactory, containerised services, Kubernetes/EKS, MQTT, PKI and certificate management. 
 - Experience with test automation for embedded systems (e. g. Boardfarm, TDK, cloudless test harnesses) and with managing QA as a first-class discipline rather than an afterthought. 
 - Exposure to Wi-Fi 6/6E/7, MLO, and mesh performance work. 

About Plume

As the creator of the only open, hardware-independent, cloud-controlled experience platform for ISPs and their subscribers, Plume partners with over 400 ISP customers, including some of the world's largest such as Charter, Liberty Global, and J: COM. 

Using OpenSync, the most widely supported open-source, silicon-to-cloud framework for smart spaces, Plume's software-defined network allows ISPs to decouple their service offerings from hardware and rapidly curate and deliver new services over a multi-vendor, open-platform architecture. 

Plume is an equal opportunity workplace that maintains a continuing policy of nondiscrimination in all employment practices and decisions, ensuring equal employment opportunities for all qualified individuals without regard to race, color, creed, religion, sex, national origin, age, physical or mental disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, pregnancy, childbirth or related individual conditions, medical conditions (as defined by state law), military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local law.

Job Description

As part of the Development Engineering team, the Control Software Designer designs, supports, and troubleshoots control systems for Injection Molding Machines(IMM) and Mold controllers. This role operates in a fast-paced, innovative environment and focuses on developing creative, high-quality solutions to complex technical challenges. 

Key Responsibilities/Areas Of Accountability: 

- Design control systems for IMM and Mold controller applications including servo drive and servo-hydraulic controls, injection molding process control. 
 - Provide functional, design specifications and validation plans for new IMM and Mold controller functionality. 
 - Software development of machine sequences (PLC IEC 61131-3), process control, human-machine interface(HMI) in Windows environment. 
 - Troubleshoot and debug real-time and non-real-time software. 
 - Document software changes using resources such as TFS/VSTS and Azure DevOps. 
 - Document development, design changes and production design activities. 
 - Communicate design with other design groups and businesses. 

Requirements: 

- Bachelor's Degree or higher in Electrical & Electronics/ECE/Instrumentation/Software Engineering preferred, or equivalent. 
 - Minimum 5 years hands-on experience in automated control system design and troubleshooting preferred. 
 - Machine design/develop with Beckhoff, Siemens, GE, ABB and Allen Bradley products background are preferred. 
 - PLC structured text language design and programming using IEC 61131-3. 
 - Experience in programming using C, C++, C# or other high-level languages for HMI applications (Ruby). 
 - Strong knowledge of PC based control systems and embedded system. 
 - Strong Knowledge of control theory and model-based design principles. 
 - Knowledge of PLC's and motion controllers. 
 - Working knowledge of standard industrial communication networks and protocols such as RS232, RS485, Ethernet, CANOpen, Profibus, Profinet and EtherCAT. 
 - Ability to read control circuits using Eplan as a resource. 
 - Experience with Beckhoff TwinCAT3. 
 - Experience designing, debugging and deploying software in VSTS development environment. 
 - Machine design/develop with Beckhoff, Siemens, GE, ABB and Allen Bradley products background are preferred. 
 - Experience in Agile software design process and Test Driven Development methodologies. 
 - Familiarity and experience with AI and it's use in software development, ideation, and the creation of tools
 - Strong proficiency in English with effective verbal, written. 

Personal Qualifications: 

- Ability to communicate complex technical concepts clearly, verbally and in writing. 
 - A quick independent learner, able to digest and understand complex concepts. 
 - An intelligent thinker, able to formulate hypotheses, troubleshoot, analyze, and propose solutions. 
 - Highly creative with the ability to develop multiple concepts to resolve problems. 
 - Capable of Working in a multi-disciplined international team with excellent personal organization skills. 

Husky TechnologiesTM offers a competitive compensation and benefits package and excellent opportunities for growth and advancement. We are committed to equal employment opportunity and respect, value and welcome diversity in our workplace. Husky TechnologiesTM also values being a great place to work and strives to maintain a safe workplace. Accordingly, Husky TechnologiesTM conditions all offers of employment on satisfactory completion of background checks. No agency or telephone inquiries please.

data.title: POWER PLATFORM & COPILOT DEVELOPER
data.description:
Rockwell Automation is a global technology leader focused on helping the world's manufacturers be more productive, sustainable, and agile. With more than 28, 000 employees who make the world better every day, we know we have something special. Behind our customers - amazing companies that help feed the world, provide life-saving medicine on a global scale, and focus on clean water and green mobility - our people are energized problem solvers that take pride in how the work we do changes the world for the better. 

We welcome all makers, forward thinkers, and problem solvers who are looking for a place to do their best work. And if that's you we would love to have you join us!

Job Description

The Power Platform & Copilot Developer leads the design, delivery, and scaling of enterprise AI agents, chatbots, and low-code solutions using Microsoft Copilot Studio, Microsoft Power Platform, Agent OS, Azure AI Foundry, and Azure AI Search to support LCS strategic business use cases. 

This role serves as a technical and functional lead, providing architectural guidance, governance oversight, and mentorship while ensuring measurable business outcomes from AI investments. 

The role partners closely with business leaders, AI governance teams, and platform stakeholders to establish a scalable, governed low-code and agentic AI operating model, build Copilot Studio SME capability, and drive adoption across LCS. 

We are hiring for Pune and Noida locations. 

Key Responsibilities

AI & Copilot Technical Leadership

Lead the end-to-end architecture, design, and delivery of Copilot Studio solutions, AI agents, and chatbots. 

Define conversational and agentic AI patterns, standards, and reusable frameworks for enterprise adoption. 

Leverage Agent OS and Azure AI Foundry for agent orchestration and advanced AI use cases. 

Design enterprise knowledge and RAG solutions using Azure AI Search where applicable. 

Review solution designs to ensure scalability, security, performance, and maintainability. 

Drive continuous improvement of AI agents based on usage analytics, feedback, and business outcomes. 

Power Platform Solution Architecture

Lead development of complex Power Apps, Power Automate, Dataverse, and Copilot Studio solutions. 

Establish best practices for low-code/pro-code extensibility, integrations, APIs, and AI services. 

Enable integration across Power Platform, Agent OS, Azure AI Foundry, Azure AI Search, and enterprise systems. 

Ensure alignment with enterprise application architecture and data strategies. 

Governance, Security & Compliance

Own and enforce governance standards for Copilot, Power Platform, and enterprise AI solutions. 

Partner with security and compliance teams to ensure Responsible AI, data protection, and audit readiness. 

Guide environment strategy, DLP policies, access controls, and solution lifecycle management. 

Capability Building & Team Enablement

Act as a Copilot Studio SME and mentor, cross-training Power Platform developers into AI solution builders. 

Build team capability across Copilot Studio, Agent OS, Azure AI Foundry, Azure AI Search, and RAG. 

Support hiring, onboarding, and enablement of incremental Copilot development capacity. 

Contribute to a Center of Excellence / RCC delivery model, defining intake, prioritization, KPIs, and capacity planning. 

Stakeholder & Program Leadership

Partner with business owners and AI leadership to identify, prioritize, and roadmap high-value AI use cases. 

Provide executive-level updates on progress, risks, ROI, and adoption metrics. 

Represent the Copilot and low-code AI capability in enterprise forums such as AI2. 

Required Skills & Experience

Advanced hands-on experience with Microsoft Power Platform (Power Apps, Power Automate, Dataverse). 

Strong experience designing and delivering solutions using Microsoft Copilot Studio. 

Experience with AI agents, agentic workflows, and enterprise AI integration patterns. 

Working knowledge of Agent OS and Azure AI Foundry. 

Understanding of Azure AI Search, RAG, and enterprise knowledge grounding. 

Proven experience leading enterprise-scale low-code or AI initiatives. 

Strong understanding of conversational AI design, UX, and performance optimization. 

Experience with governance, security, Responsible AI, and compliance in enterprise environments. 

Strong leadership, mentoring, and stakeholder-management skills. 

Preferred Qualifications

Microsoft certifications in Power Platform, Copilot Studio, or Azure AI. 

Hands-on exposure to Azure AI Foundry, Azure AI Search, Azure OpenAI, and RAG architectures. 

Experience with agent orchestration and multi-agent architectures. 

Experience operating within a Center of Excellence (CoE) or shared services model. 

Experience defining and tracking KPIs, ROI, and adoption metrics for AI solutions. 

Familiarity with change management and enterprise adoption strategies. 

Success Measures

Successful delivery of high-impact AI agent and chatbot use cases. 

Adoption and reuse of standardized Copilot and agentic AI solutions across teams. 

Establishment and growth of Copilot Studio and AI SME capability. 

Compliance with enterprise governance and Responsible AI standards. 

Demonstrated ROI and measurable business value from AI initiatives. 

The Preferred - You Might Also Have

3 to 8 years of relevant work experience in a fast-paced business environment. 

Strong troubleshooting and technical support skills. 

Experience maintaining project documentation and managing system updates. 

Excellent stakeholder communication and relationship-building abilities. 

Familiarity with data governance and compliance standards. 

Skilled in creating engaging content and presentations. 

Comfortable with multi-channel communication platforms. 

What We Offer

Our benefits package includes . . . 

Comprehensive mindfulness programs with a premium membership to Calm

Volunteer Paid Time off available after 6 months of employment for eligible employees

Company volunteer and donation matching program - Your volunteer hours or personal cash donations to an eligible charity can be matched with a charitable donation. 

Employee Assistance Program

Personalized wellbeing programs through our OnTrack program

On-demand digital course library for professional development

- and other local benefits!

At Rockwell Automation we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace, so if you're excited about this role but your experience doesn't align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right person for this or other roles. 

Rockwell Automation's hybrid policy aligns that employees are expected to work at a Rockwell location at least Mondays, Tuesdays, and Thursdays unless they have a business obligation out of the office.

data.title: Specialist, Software-Cloud Engineering
data.description:
Job Description

Specialist, Software, Cloud Engineering

The Opportunity

- Based in Hyderabad, join a global healthcare biopharma company and be part of a 130- year legacy of success backed by ethical integrity, forward momentum, and an inspiring mission to achieve new milestones in global healthcare. 
 - Be part of an organisation driven by digital technology and data-backed approaches that support a diversified portfolio of prescription medicines, vaccines, and animal health products. 
 - Drive innovation and execution excellence. Be a part of a team with passion for using data, analytics, and insights to drive decision-making, and which creates custom software, allowing us to tackle some of the world's greatest health threats. 

Our Technology Centers focus on creating a space where teams can come together to deliver business solutions that save and improve lives. An integral part of our companys' IT operating model, Tech Centers are globally distributed locations where each IT division has employees to enable our digital transformation journey and drive business outcomes. These locations, in addition to the other sites, are essential to supporting our business and strategy. 

A focused group of leaders in each Tech Center helps to ensure we can manage and improve each location, from investing in growth, success, and well-being of our people, to making sure colleagues from each IT division feel a sense of belonging to managing critical emergencies. And together, we must leverage the strength of our team to collaborate globally to optimize connections and share best practices across the Tech Centers. 

Role Overview

The Technical Analyst / Systems Analyst acts as the primary link between business stakeholders, vendors, and engineering teams to deliver and support technology solutions across regulated environments. This role is responsible for evaluating business requirements, implementing commercial off-the-shelf (COTS) applications, designing integrations, supporting cloud deployments, and ensuring solutions meet quality, security, and compliance standards. 

The individual collaborates across product, engineering, validation, and business teams to drive solution delivery, manage vendor relationships, develop technical documentation, and support system implementations in AWS and on-premises environments. The role also contributes to DevOps automation, cloud infrastructure, test automation, and application lifecycle management while ensuring adherence to GxP, SDLC, and organizational compliance requirements. 

What Will You Do

- Cross-Functional Collaboration**

Collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver planned solutions

- **Product Management **

Understand business problems, use cases, and timelines to deliver commercial off-the-shelf (COTS) products or solutions. 

- **Vendors and Partners ** Document product capabilities, configuration requirements, architecture, security, installation prerequisites, and application support needs for AWS or on-premises deployments. 
 - **Engineering **

Contribute to the development, review, and approval of architecture artifacts. 

- **Quality and Computer System Validation **

Develop and review Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) artifacts for regulated applications operating under GLP or GCP. 

- **Business and End Users **

Support user acceptance testing (UAT) and production operations. 

Develop support contracts and transfer application knowledge. 

- Technical Solutioning**
 - Evaluate solution options, trade-offs, and feasibility with engineering teams. 
 - Contribute to system design discussions, integration strategies, and API contracts. 
 - Drive configuration, parameterization, and environment readiness for releases. 
 - Vendor and Partner Engagement**
 - Serve as the technical point of contact for vendors and partners. 
 - Document technical needs, integration requirements, and deployment prerequisites. 
 - Review vendor architectures, security and compliance artifacts, data models, and API specifications; identify gaps and mitigation actions. 
 - Coordinate technical due diligence, proof of concepts, and interoperability testing. 
 - Deploy vendor products in the environment and migrate them to higher environments, including SIT, UAT, and Production. 
 - Cloud Engineering and DevOps**
 - Design, build, and document CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions or similar tools for builds, tests, security scans, and deployments in the AWS environment. 
 - Design and build Terraform infrastructure as code (IaC) to provision, pause, and terminate AWS resources. 
 - Automate configuration management and provisioning with Ansible playbooks and roles. 
 - Implement guardrails such as branch protection, code review workflows, quality gates, and rollback strategies. 
 - Collaborate with platform teams on deployment standards, secrets management, and approvals. 
 - Custom Development and Integrations**
 - Design, build, test, and document custom scripts and components using Python and JavaScript. 
 - Integrate upstream and downstream applications using REST APIs. 
 - Test Automation and Quality Engineering**
 - Define test strategies across unit, integration, API, UI, and end-to-end testing. 
 - Collaborate with testing teams or build and maintain automated test suites using Robot Framework and Tosca. 
 - Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines, including reporting and quality gates. 
 - Documentation and Compliance**

Develop documentation and artifacts required by policies, including

- Security assessments
 - AI assessments, where applicable
 - Architecture documents
 - GxP SDLC documents
 - Application administration SOPs
 - Support models, structures, and SLAs

What You Should Have

- Education and Experience**
 - Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field; a master's degree is a plus. 
 - 3+ years of experience in a Technical Analyst or Systems Analyst role in a technology-driven environment. 
 - Core Skills**
 - Mission-driven mindset, with the ability to connect project work to company goals and customer outcomes. 
 - Self-directed and organized, with the ability to prioritize work, remove blockers, and deliver with minimal supervision. 
 - Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. 
 - Understanding of modern architectures, including microservices, APIs, cloud, and event-driven systems. 
 - Hands-on SQL experience; Python or scripting experience is an advantage. 
 - Familiarity with Agile methodologies, including Scrum and Kanban, and SDLC best practices. 
 - Experience with tools such as Jira or Azure DevOps, Confluence, Visio or Lucid chart, and Postman or Swagger. 
 - Cloud Engineering and DevOps**
 - Experience with AWS services used in delivery and operations, such as IAM, VPC, EC2/EKS, S3, RDS, CloudWatch, and Secrets Manager. 
 - Experience using GitHub Actions or similar CI/CD tools to orchestrate pipelines and environment-based deployments. 
 - Vendor and Partner Engagement**
 - Experience working with third-party vendors and partners on technical discovery, integration design, prerequisites, and go-live readiness. 
 - Ability to translate vendor documentation into internal requirements, playbooks, and runbooks. 
 - Development and Testing**
 - Python OR JAVA programming experience. 
 - JavaScript scripting experience. 
 - Experience building API endpoints. 
 - Robot Framework experience for API, UI, or end-to-end automation, including keywords, libraries, and reporting. 
 - Tosca experience with model-based test design, execution, and dashboards. 
 - Experience integrating automated tests into CI/CD and managing test data and environments. 

**Regulated Environment Experience**

- Experience delivering and validating applications under GLP and/or GCP. 
 - Knowledge of CSV, ALCOA/ALCOA+, documentation controls, and audit processes. 
 - Experience with data integrity, electronic signatures, access controls, and role-based permissions. 

AWS Certification

One Of The Following Is Preferred , 

**Preferred Experience**

- AWS Certified Solutions Architect - Associate or higher
 - AWS Certified DevOps Engineer - Professional
 - REST APIs and authentication. 
 - COTS products. 
 - Knowledge of LIMS products, such as Thermo Fisher Watson, Thermo Fisher Connect Enterprise, Thermo Fisher NextGen LIMS, Benchling, LabWare, or Xybion/Instem-Pristima. 
 - Knowledge of imaging products, such as Revvity, AIRA Matrix, or Indica Labs HALO. 
 - Knowledge of modeling products, such as Certara Phoenix, Certara Integral, or PUMAS AI. 
 - Healthcare, life sciences, clinical research, or enterprise SaaS domain knowledge. 

Soft Skills

data.description:
Position Overview

The Security Test Engineer will join the ITG CDF team (BNP Paribas Group) and focus on mobile security testing. The role involves performing penetration tests, static and dynamic analysis, and reverse‐engineering of Android and iOS applications, as well as supporting web‐ and API‐level assessments. 

Job Responsibilities

Direct Responsibilities

- Conduct Gray‐Box/Black‐Box penetration testing for Web, Mobile, API, and thick‐client applications. 
 - Perform hands‐on mobile testing (Android & iOS), covering both static (SAST) and dynamic (DAST) analyses of APKs/IPA files. 
 - Identify insecure storage, hard‐coded secrets, misconfigurations, runtime hooking, parameter tampering, etc. 
 - Reverse‐engineer mobile binaries, analyze native libraries (. so/. dylib), and bypass client‐side protections (root/jailbreak detection, SSL pinning, obfuscation, tamper checks) using tools such as Frida, Objection, Magisk, Cydia/Sileo/Zebra, Xposed. 
 - Stay current on evolving mobile threats and industry standards (OWASP MASVS/MASTG). 
 - Define and document test scope based on application security requirements. 
 - Execute documented security test scenarios and produce comprehensive findings reports. 
 - Collaborate with developers to explain vulnerabilities and recommend remediation. 
 - Escalate blockers to local management and on‐shore stakeholders when testing progress is impacted. 
 - Follow established assessment processes and ensure compliance with project guidelines. 

Contributing / Supporting Responsibilities

- Assist in source‐code assessment (SCA/SAST) where required. 
 - Participate in knowledge‐sharing sessions and continuous improvement initiatives within the security testing team. 

Required Education, Skills and Experience

- Education: Bachelor's degree (or equivalent) in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Security, or a related field. 
 - Experience: 4-6 years of hands‐on security testing, with a strong focus on mobile (Android & iOS) penetration testing. 

- Technical Skills: 
 - Proficient in OWASP Top 10 concepts. 
 - Expertise with tools/OS: Burp Suite, OWASP ZAP, Kali Linux, MobSF, JADX, dex2jar, ADB, Xcode, Frida, Objection, Apktool, otool, etc. 
 - Strong manual testing, security test design, and vulnerability validation abilities. 

- Behavioral Skills:
