data.title: Senior QA Engineer – ServiceNow
data.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior QA Engineer - ServiceNow based in India. 

We are seeking an experienced Senior QA Engineer to drive quality assurance and ensure the reliability, performance, and stability of enterprise ServiceNow solutions. In this role, you will lead testing strategies, develop automated testing frameworks, and validate complex platform implementations, integrations, and upgrades. You will work closely with architects, developers, administrators, business analysts, and product stakeholders to embed quality throughout the software development lifecycle. The position offers opportunities to leverage ServiceNow Automated Test Framework (ATF), modern DevOps practices, and CI/CD pipelines to improve testing efficiency and minimize production risks. You will also contribute to the validation of emerging AI-powered platform capabilities while helping establish consistent quality engineering standards. This is an excellent opportunity to join a global technology environment, collaborate with international teams, and contribute to enterprise-scale digital transformation initiatives. 

Accountabilities

- Define, develop, and execute comprehensive testing strategies for ServiceNow implementations, enhancements, integrations, platform upgrades, and software releases. 
 - Create and maintain test plans, test cases, test scripts, test data, and quality documentation covering functional, regression, integration, system, end-to-end, and user acceptance testing. 
 - Lead the design, implementation, and maintenance of automated test suites using ServiceNow Automated Test Framework (ATF) to support regression testing, release validation, and platform upgrades. 
 - Establish and promote testing standards, automation best practices, and quality gates across ServiceNow development teams. 
 - Validate ServiceNow modules and capabilities, including ITSM, ITOM, ITAM, CSM, HAM, SAM, CMDB, Discovery, and Service Mapping. 
 - Test integrations between ServiceNow and external systems using REST APIs, IntegrationHub, web services, middleware platforms, and third-party applications. 
 - Collaborate with engineering teams to integrate automated testing into GitHub-based development workflows, source control processes, and CI/CD pipelines. 
 - Validate code changes, update sets, application deployments, and release packages before production implementation. 
 - Identify, document, prioritize, and manage defects through resolution, working with engineering teams to investigate root causes and prevent recurring issues. 
 - Support release readiness assessments and ensure sufficient test coverage for platform enhancements, integrations, and defect fixes. 
 - Validate platform upgrades, patches, releases, and configuration changes to maintain system stability and minimize business disruption. 
 - Develop and maintain quality metrics, dashboards, and reports to track testing progress, defect trends, release readiness, and overall platform quality. 
 - Participate in Agile ceremonies, sprint planning, release coordination, and continuous improvement initiatives. 
 - Support performance, security, integration, and end-to-end testing activities as required. 
 - Contribute to the testing and validation of ServiceNow AI capabilities, including Now Assist, Control Tower, and other intelligent platform features. 

Requirements

- At least 5 years of professional experience in software quality assurance, quality engineering, or enterprise application testing. 
 - Minimum 3 years of hands-on experience testing ServiceNow implementations, configurations, and platform capabilities. 
 - Strong understanding of software testing methodologies, including functional, regression, integration, system, end-to-end, and user acceptance testing. 
 - Practical experience with ServiceNow Automated Test Framework (ATF), including creating, maintaining, and executing automated test suites. 
 - Experience testing ServiceNow modules such as ITSM, ITOM, ITAM, CSM, HAM, SAM, CMDB, Discovery, and Service Mapping, or related applications. 
 - Hands-on experience validating integrations through REST APIs, IntegrationHub, web services, and external platforms. 
 - Familiarity with Jira, Confluence, GitHub, or similar tools for Agile delivery, defect tracking, source control, and release management. 
 - Understanding of CI/CD pipelines, automated testing practices, and DevOps methodologies. 
 - Knowledge of the ServiceNow application development lifecycle, including source control integration, update sets, deployment processes, and release management. 
 - Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify complex issues and recommend effective solutions. 
 - ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA) certification. 
 - ITIL Foundation v3 or ITIL 4 certification. 
 - Experience testing ServiceNow AI capabilities, including Now Assist, Control Tower, and other platform intelligence features, is highly desirable. 
 - Excellent verbal and written English communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with global teams and stakeholders. 
 - Strong ownership, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple testing activities in a fast-paced enterprise environment. 

Benefits

- Flexible Working Culture: Benefit from a flexible-first working environment designed to support productivity and work-life balance. 
 - Global Collaboration: Work alongside international teams and contribute to enterprise technology initiatives serving organizations worldwide. 
 - Professional Development: Access mentorship, learning programs, leadership development opportunities, and educational support. 
 - AI and Technology Exposure: Gain experience working with AI-powered enterprise platforms and innovative digital technologies. 
 - Well-being Support: Access well-being resources and regionally tailored programs designed to support employees and their families.

data.description:
Siemens Digital Industries Software is a leading provider of solutions for the design, simulation, and manufacture of products across many different industries. data.description:
Work Schedule

Standard (Mon-Fri)

Environmental Conditions

Office

Location: Hyderabad, India

Division: Analytical Instruments Group, Materials & Structural Analysis Division

Organization: Semiconductor R&D

About The Team

Thermo Fisher Scientific's Materials and Structural Analysis Semiconductor R&D organization brings together around 400 engineers developing electron microscopy solutions and applications. Our global teams in Eindhoven, Brno, Hillsboro, Hyderabad, and Bordeaux combine expertise in hardware, software, and scientific applications to help customers make the world cleaner, healthier, and safer. 

Within this organization, the Cortex value stream develops software for semiconductor data workflows, including tools to organize, explore, and visualize microscopy data. We're looking for a Software Test Engineer to build quality into Cortex development and progressively establish an automated release-validation capability. 

How will you make an impact?

You'll work with developers, product owners, and other engineering partners to make quality part of the development process from the start. You'll design and maintain automated tests for critical user journeys, APIs, integrations, and regressions, and help the team understand product risk through clear evidence and coverage metrics. 

This is an ownership role: you'll investigate issues, challenge unclear requirements, and advocate for the customer and user experience throughout development-not only validate software after it is built. Your work will help the team release Cortex changes with greater confidence across Core and Contributor applications. 

What will you do?

- Build and maintain automated end-to-end tests for Cortex's critical user journeys. 
 - Develop API and integration tests that validate service behavior, data flows, and interactions between components. 
 - Create and maintain a reliable regression suite that supports frequent development and releases. 
 - Test compatibility across Cortex Core, Contributor applications, plugins, and relevant user workflows. 
 - Define and improve test strategy, test design, and automation practices in collaboration with developers and product owners. 
 - Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines and help establish quality gates for builds and releases. 
 - Support release validation by assessing test results, identifying risks, and communicating evidence-based recommendations. 
 - Track meaningful test coverage and quality metrics, using them to identify gaps and guide improvements. 
 - Investigate defects, reproduce issues, analyze logs and test evidence, and work with developers to identify root causes. 
 - Challenge ambiguous or incomplete requirements and help define clear, testable acceptance criteria. 
 - Advocate for customer and user needs, including usability and reliability across complex scientific workflows. 
 - Collaborate closely with developers throughout implementation so that testability and quality are considered early. 
 - Help improve test stability, execution speed, maintainability, and the signal-to-noise ratio of automated test results. 
 - Explore additional testing approaches, such as performance, contract, or distributed-system testing, where they address product risks. 
 - Learn the semiconductor domain and Cortex workflows, and test solutions in the environments used by the team, including virtual machines. 
 - Regularly reflect with the team on how to improve quality practices and delivery. 

You'll be part of a distributed Agile Scrum team working with colleagues in Bordeaux, Hillsboro, the Netherlands, and the Czech Republic. The role is based in Hyderabad and reports to the Functional Group Lead. 

How will you get here?

Education

- Bachelor's or master's degree in computer science, software engineering, computer engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience. 

Required Experience And Skills

- Professional experience in software testing, test automation, or quality engineering. 
 - Experience designing and implementing automated end-to-end tests using Cypress, Playwright, or a comparable framework. 
 - Experience with API testing and integration testing. 
 - Proficiency in TypeScript, Python, or an equivalent language used for test automation. 
 - Experience integrating automated tests into CI/CD pipelines. 
 - Strong test-design skills, including the ability to identify risks, select effective coverage, and build maintainable regression automation. 
 - Experience investigating defects and working with developers to determine root causes. 
 - Strong attention to detail and a curious, investigative approach to problem-solving. 
 - Ability to understand software from the customer and user perspective and challenge unclear requirements constructively. 
 - Strong collaboration and communication skills, with a commitment to quality across the development lifecycle. 
 - A sense of ownership and the ability to make data-informed recommendations about product quality and release readiness. 
 - Excellent written and spoken English. 

Preferred Experience

- Testing applications deployed to Kubernetes or other containerized environments. 
 - Performance or load testing. 
 - Testing . NET services or Angular applications. 
 - Contract testing or testing distributed systems. 
 - Experience validating plugins, extensible applications, or integrations across independently developed components. 
 - Familiarity with scientific software, imaging, data-intensive applications, or semiconductor workflows. 
 - Experience working in a distributed, cross-functional Agile team.

JOB DESCRIPTION

Head of AI Engineering

& Center of Excellence (CoE)

1. Role Overview

Our company is seeking a senior technology leader to establish and lead its AI Engineering Center of Excellence (CoE), driving the adoption of AI across enterprise engineering, insurance technology platforms, product development, and operational workflows. 

The Head of AI Engineering & CoE will define AI engineering strategy, establish reusable AI architectures and frameworks, enable AI-assisted software development, and deliver scalable, secure, measurable AI solutions. The role combines technical leadership, architecture governance, engineering enablement, and people development. 

A core objective is to turn individual AI experiments and isolated implementations into reusable enterprise capabilities that support Solartis's product-platform strategy. 

1. Key Responsibilities

A. AI Engineering Strategy and CoE Leadership

Establish the CoE charter, operating model, service offerings, engagement model, and delivery priorities. 

Develop an AI engineering roadmap aligned with product strategy, technology priorities, and business objectives. 

Identify opportunities to standardize AI capabilities and reduce duplicated implementations. 

Define reference architectures, reusable patterns, implementation guidelines, and approved technology frameworks. 

Partner with the CTO and engineering leadership to prioritize AI investments based on business value, feasibility, risk, and expected return. 

Establish processes to evaluate AI initiatives, productionize successful pilots, and retire ineffective or duplicated solutions. 

B. Enterprise AI Architecture and Shared Frameworks

Define scalable architectures for LLMs, SLMs, RAG, vector search, orchestration, and model integration. 

Design reusable AI services, APIs, SDKs, libraries, reference implementations, and deployment patterns. 

Establish patterns for model selection, prompt management, context engineering, embeddings, document processing, inference, and lifecycle management. 

Evaluate AI frameworks, models, infrastructure, and platforms for performance, cost, security, scalability, and maintainability. 

Define integration patterns for AI capabilities within existing platforms, services, applications, and development workflows. 

Guide build-versus-buy decisions across managed AI services, open-source models, and internally developed capabilities. 

C. AI-Assisted Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC)

Define and implement AI-assisted SDLC practices across requirements analysis, code generation, code understanding, test generation, code review, documentation, debugging, and maintenance. 

Establish standards for responsible use of AI coding assistants and developer productivity tools. 

Build reusable workflows and accelerators integrated with development environments, repositories, CI/CD pipelines, and quality processes. 

Measure impact on cycle time, defect rates, rework, code quality, and developer experience. 

Ensure AI adoption complements peer review, automated testing, security scanning, and release governance. 

Work with engineering leaders to drive adoption and develop team-level enablement plans. 

D. RAG, MCP, Agentic AI, and Reusable AI Services

Architect production-grade RAG solutions covering ingestion, parsing, chunking, metadata extraction, indexing, retrieval, reranking, and grounded generation. 

Establish reusable patterns for agents, tool orchestration, workflow automation, context management, and human-in-the-loop processing. 

Define appropriate Model Context Protocol (MCP) patterns for controlled access to enterprise tools, data, and services. 

Develop common components for model access, prompt/context management, retrieval, tool integration, evaluation, telemetry, and error handling. 

Define safeguards for permissions, data access, execution boundaries, auditability, failure recovery, and human approval. 

Apply agentic AI selectively where it delivers measurable value and avoid unnecessary complexity in deterministic workflows. 

E. AI-Assisted Insurance Content Processing and Parser Initiatives

Lead architecture for processing insurance documents, policy forms, underwriting guidelines, rating manuals, and related content. 

Guide pipelines that transform semi-structured and unstructured content into validated, structured insurance product definitions. 

Establish reusable capabilities for classification, parsing, extraction, semantic interpretation, rule identification, and structured output generation. 

Ensure extracted content is traceable to source documents and suitable for downstream product configuration and processing. 

Design human review and exception handling for ambiguous, incomplete, conflicting, or low-confidence outputs. 

Define evaluation datasets and measures for extraction precision/recall, completeness, rule interpretation, and downstream usability. 

Promote reusable parsers and validation components over isolated customer-specific implementations, in collaboration with insurance domain and platform teams. 

F. AI Engineering Standards, Quality, and Governance

Define standards for AI design, implementation, testing, deployment, monitoring, and maintenance. 

Establish evaluation frameworks for accuracy, groundedness, robustness, reliability, latency, cost, and use-case suitability. 

Implement safeguards against prompt injection, unauthorized data exposure, insecure tool execution, and other AI-specific threats. 

Define model and prompt versioning, traceability, observability, regression evaluation, and controlled production releases. 

Establish practices for sensitive data handling, access control, retention, audit logging, and external AI services. 

Partner with security, compliance, legal, and enterprise architecture stakeholders on applicable requirements. 

Ensure solutions have appropriate fallbacks, exception handling, human oversight, and production-readiness reviews. 

G. Technical Leadership, Mentoring, and Enablement

Provide technical leadership to AI architects and designated AI engineering teams, with accountability for architecture quality and capability development. 

Mentor existing architects in AI solution design, reusable architecture, model integration, evaluation, and production engineering. 

Establish architecture reviews, technical communities of practice, learning paths, workshops, and hands-on reference projects. 

Guide teams in evaluating alternatives, challenging assumptions, conducting impact analysis, and making sound technical decisions. 

Develop architecture decision records, implementation templates, reusable documentation, and engineering playbooks. 

Build internal capability so teams can implement AI solutions independently within agreed standards. 

H. Business Value, Delivery, and Continuous Improvement

Translate opportunities into prioritized initiatives with defined outcomes, milestones, resource needs, and success measures. 

Partner with product, engineering, and business teams to improve developer productivity, reduce manual effort, accelerate content processing, and strengthen platform scalability. 

Maintain visibility into AI initiative status, adoption, risks, operating costs, and realized benefits. 

Track production outcomes beyond proof-of-concept delivery and optimize duplicated capabilities, infrastructure, and model costs. 

Communicate progress, risks, decisions, and measurable outcomes to the CTO and senior leadership. 

3. Leadership and Decision-Making Expectations

Establish and execute the AI engineering roadmap within priorities agreed with the CTO. 

Own the technical direction and engineering standards of the AI CoE. 

Lead and develop AI architects and designated AI engineering resources. 

Make decisions within agreed enterprise architecture principles and delegated authority; escalate material cross-platform, security, and investment decisions as required. 

Challenge designs that introduce unnecessary customization, duplication, operational complexity, or technical risk. 

Balance innovation with engineering discipline, production readiness, maintainability, and measurable business outcomes. 

Influence teams beyond the direct reporting line and enable adoption across the organization. 

4. Required Qualifications and Experience

Bachelor's or master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, AI, Data Science, or a related discipline. 

Typically 15+ years of relevant software engineering, architecture, or technology experience, including substantial practical experience with AI/ML and modern AI application architectures. 

Demonstrated experience leading AI engineering initiatives, architecture practices, technical teams, or enterprise AI programs.

The role partners across the plant to strengthen compliance, prevent risk and continuously improve sanitation performance in line with GMP, HACCP, FSSC 22000/ISO 22000, regulatory and Mars Snacking standards. 

Key Responsibilities

Sanitation Program Leadership

- Lead and continuously improve sanitation programs across production, processing, storage, packaging and plant infrastructure areas. 
 - Own the Master Sanitation Schedule, ensuring daily, weekly and monthly activities are completed, verified and followed through with clear corrective actions. 
 - Plan plant thermal fogging and raw-material fumigation effectiveness checks, and ensure actions are completed to the required standard. 
 - Conduct daily GEMBA walks and regular program-effectiveness checks, using observations and data to strengthen standards and operational discipline. 

Food Safety, Monitoring and Compliance

- Plan and execute the environmental monitoring program, including cross-functional alignment, sampling, trend review and closure of non-compliances. 
 - Lead planned verification and validation activities, including annual pathogen verification, allergen validation and APC validation for production lines. 
 - Ensure compliance with GMP, HACCP, FSMA, FSSC 22000, ISO 22000, regulatory requirements and Mars Snacking food safety standards. 
 - Plan and coordinate water, steam and compressed-air testing with laboratories, ensuring samples are collected and analysed within agreed timelines. 
 - Maintain accurate sanitation records, cleaning schedules, verification evidence and regulatory documentation, ensuring audit readiness at all times. 

Pest, Supplier and External Partner Management

- Coordinate the plant pest management program with external service providers, monitor trends and thresholds, and drive timely action on internal or external sightings. 
 - Partner with suppliers and vendors to strengthen hygiene and infestation controls, including site visits, performance reviews and timely portal updates. 
 - Play an active role in internal, external, customer and regulatory audits and assessments, including the annual Regional/Internal Sanitation Gap Assessment. 

Risk Management and Continuous Improvement

- Investigate sanitation-related non-conformances and customer complaints, complete robust root-cause analysis, and implement effective CAPA. 
 - Partner with cross-functional teams on Management of Change, food safety risk assessments, hygienic design reviews and cleaning standards for new or existing equipment. 
 - Compile and communicate weekly and monthly sanitation, raw and packaging material, quality and food safety KPIs, translating insights into practical improvement plans. 
 - Champion continuous improvement initiatives that enhance food safety, sanitation effectiveness and operational efficiency. 

Capability, Collaboration and Resource Management

- Build sanitation capability across the site by training associates on SSOPs, personal and plant hygiene, allergen control, environmental monitoring and the Master Sanitation Program. 
 - Manage the plant Quality and Food Safety budget and maintain appropriate inventories of swabs, equipment and housekeeping chemicals. 
 - Contribute to regional and global sanitation Communities of Expertise and support other plant CoE priorities as allocated. 

Context and Scope

This is a hands-on, site-based role that combines technical sanitation expertise with strong cross-functional influence. The role works closely with the Plant Management Team, Quality & Food Safety, Operations, Engineering, Procurement, laboratories, suppliers, service partners and site associates to translate standards into consistent day-to-day execution. 

Success requires visible leadership on the shop floor, disciplined follow-through, confident challenge when standards are at risk, and the ability to turn audit, monitoring and performance data into sustainable improvements. 

Job Specifications/Qualifications

Education & Professional Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Food Technology, Microbiology, Food Science, Dairy Technology or a related discipline. 
 - 7-12 years of experience in sanitation or food safety within a food manufacturing environment. 
 - Working knowledge of cereal processing operations and food safety management systems is preferred. 

Knowledge / Experience

- Strong knowledge of GMP, HACCP, FSSC 22000/ISO 22000, sanitation verification and validation, environmental monitoring, allergen control and pest management. 
 - Practical understanding of cleaning chemicals, CIP/COP systems, SSOP development and hygienic equipment design. 
 - Demonstrated ability to investigate non-conformances, lead root-cause analysis and CAPA, and interpret sanitation and microbiological data. 
 - Experience coordinating audits, laboratories, suppliers and external service providers in a complex manufacturing environment. 
 - Strong planning, stakeholder management, communication and training skills, with confidence influencing cross-functional teams. 
 - Comfort working in a plant environment and spending significant time on the shop floor, including routine GEMBA walks and sanitation-effectiveness checks.

data.title: Sr SDET - Performance Testing
data.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Sr SDET - Performance Testing based in India. 

We are looking for an experienced Senior Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET) specializing in performance testing to strengthen the quality, scalability, and reliability of a large-scale, cloud-based platform. In this role, you will lead performance engineering initiatives, establish testing standards, and ensure critical services remain resilient under demanding workloads. You will design and implement automated performance testing frameworks, define performance benchmarks, and integrate regression testing into CI/CD pipelines. Working across distributed systems, microservices, APIs, databases, and cloud infrastructure, you will identify bottlenecks and drive meaningful improvements. You will collaborate closely with engineering, DevOps, and infrastructure teams to translate performance insights into actionable technical solutions. This is an opportunity to take technical ownership, mentor other engineers, and influence performance engineering practices within a fast-paced, globally distributed environment. 

Accountabilities

- Performance Strategy and Benchmarking: 
 - Establish performance baselines for critical services, defining Service Level Indicators (SLIs), Service Level Objectives (SLOs), and measurable targets for latency, throughput, and error rates. 
 - Develop realistic workload models based on production traffic patterns and actual customer behavior. 
 - Define performance testing strategies that support scalability, reliability, and continuous improvement across the platform. 
 - Conduct capacity planning to ensure systems can handle increasing traffic volumes and anticipated peak-demand events. 
 - Performance Testing Framework Development: 
 - Design, build, and maintain a shared performance testing framework that product engineering and SDET teams can use consistently. 
 - Create production-like testing environments using Kubernetes and cloud infrastructure, including appropriate test data and configurations. 
 - Evaluate emerging performance testing tools and technologies through proof-of-concept initiatives and recommend suitable solutions. 
 - Establish reusable testing standards and best practices to improve consistency and efficiency across engineering teams. 
 - Automated Testing and Continuous Integration: 
 - Integrate automated performance regression testing into CI/CD pipelines to identify performance degradation before production releases. 
 - Establish performance thresholds and automated pass/fail criteria to maintain service quality. 
 - Develop performance trend reports and monitoring mechanisms to identify emerging issues and track improvements over time. 
 - Execute load, stress, soak, and spike testing to evaluate system behavior under different operating conditions. 
 - Performance Analysis and Optimization: 
 - Investigate and identify performance bottlenecks across APIs, databases, message queues, and frontend applications. 
 - Conduct root cause analysis using distributed tracing, metrics, logs, and profiling tools. 
 - Collaborate with development, DevOps, and infrastructure teams to resolve performance issues and improve system efficiency. 
 - Translate complex performance metrics into clear engineering recommendations and influence technical decisions across teams. 
 - Evaluate distributed systems behavior, concurrency challenges, rate limiting, caching, and other factors affecting application performance. 
 - Technical Leadership and Mentorship: 
 - Take ownership of performance engineering initiatives and drive continuous improvements in testing methodologies. 
 - Mentor junior engineers and support their technical development through knowledge sharing, guidance, and code reviews. 
 - Contribute to capability-building initiatives and establish engineering practices that raise performance and reliability standards across the organization. 
 - Work collaboratively with cross-functional teams to ensure performance considerations are integrated throughout the software development lifecycle. 
Requirements

- At least 5 years of professional experience in performance testing, scalability engineering, reliability engineering, or a closely related discipline. 
 - Demonstrated experience identifying, investigating, and resolving performance bottlenecks in production-scale applications and distributed systems. 
 - Hands-on expertise with at least one modern performance testing tool, such as k6, Gatling, or Locust. 
 - Strong programming skills in at least one language, preferably Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, or Java. 
 - Experience designing realistic workload models and implementing distributed load generation for large-scale applications. 
 - Practical experience with observability and monitoring platforms such as New Relic, Prometheus, Grafana, or OpenTelemetry. 
 - Strong understanding of root cause analysis across API, database, and message queue layers using metrics, logs, distributed traces, and profiling techniques. 
 - Solid knowledge of REST API performance, distributed systems, microservices architecture, concurrency, caching, and common application performance bottlenecks. 
 - Experience integrating automated performance tests into CI/CD pipelines, including defining measurable performance thresholds and pass/fail criteria. 
 - Working knowledge of Kubernetes and hands-on experience with at least one major cloud platform, such as Google Cloud Platform (GCP), AWS, or Microsoft Azure. 
 - Ability to deploy, configure, troubleshoot, and maintain performance testing environments that closely reflect production infrastructure. 
 - Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to interpret performance results and turn findings into practical engineering recommendations. 
 - Excellent collaboration and communication skills, enabling effective partnership with software developers, DevOps engineers, infrastructure teams, and other stakeholders. 
 - Ability to take technical ownership, work independently, manage priorities, and contribute effectively in a fast-paced engineering environment. 
 - Experience mentoring junior engineers and promoting engineering best practices is highly valued. 

Nice-to-have Qualifications

- Experience with runtime profiling and thread or heap analysis for JVM or Node. js applications, including garbage collection behavior and event-loop latency. 
 - Knowledge of frontend performance optimization, including Core Web Vitals, Lighthouse, and Real User Monitoring (RUM). 
 - Experience using AI-assisted tools to improve test design, automate performance analysis, or interpret testing results. 
 - Familiarity with NoSQL databases, search technologies, and message brokers operating at scale. 
 - Experience with chaos engineering, resilience testing, and safe production testing techniques, including canary releases and shadow traffic. 

Benefits

- Fully remote working arrangement from India. 
 - Full-time opportunity within a globally distributed engineering organization. 
 - Opportunity to work on a large-scale, cloud-based platform supporting millions of businesses worldwide. 
 - Exposure to modern technologies, distributed systems, microservices, Kubernetes, and cloud infrastructure. 
 - Opportunity to lead performance engineering initiatives and influence technical standards across multiple engineering teams. 
 - Professional development through hands-on technical challenges and continuous learning. 
 - Opportunity to mentor engineers and contribute to the development of engineering capabilities. 
 - Collaborative, remote-first environment that encourages ownership, innovation, and technical excellence. 

How Jobgether Works

We use an AI-powered matching process to ensure your application is reviewed quickly, objectively, and fairly against the role's core requirements. Our system identifies the top-fitting candidates, and this shortlist is then shared directly with the hiring company. The final decision and next steps (interviews, assessments) are managed by their internal team. 

We appreciate your interest and wish you the best!

Why Apply Through Jobgether?

Data Privacy Notice: By submitting your application, you acknowledge that Jobgether will process your personal data to evaluate your candidacy and share relevant information with the hiring employer. This processing is based on legitimate interest and pre-contractual measures under applicable data protection laws (including GDPR). You may exercise your rights (access, rectification, erasure, objection) at any time.

We are looking for an experienced Senior QA Engineer / QA Lead with 5-8 years of hands-on experience in software quality assurance, with strong expertise in Manual Testing, API Testing, SQL/Database Testing, Automation, and Web Application Testing. 

The ideal candidate should have experience testing SaaS applications and working in an Agile product development environment. This role requires strong ownership of the complete QA lifecycle, from understanding requirements and creating test strategies to execution, defect management, regression testing, and production validation. 

The candidate should be technically strong, detail-oriented, and capable of guiding QA activities while working closely with Developers, Product Managers, and other stakeholders.

SaaS & Web Testing

- Test scalable SaaS-based web applications across different workflows and user roles.

 - Perform SQL/Database testing to validate data accuracy and backend processing.

Test Automation

 - Work with development and QA teams to improve test coverage and reduce repetitive manual testing. 

Agile & Release Testing

- Participate in Agile ceremonies such as sprint planning, daily stand-ups, reviews, and retrospectives. 
 - Work closely with developers and product teams to understand requirements and acceptance criteria. 
 - Perform regression and release testing before production deployment. 
 - Provide QA status, risks, defects, and release-readiness updates to stakeholders. 

QA Leadership & Ownership

- Take ownership of QA activities for assigned products, modules, or releases. 
 - Guide junior QA engineers and help improve testing practices. 
 - Review test cases and ensure adequate coverage of critical business workflows. 
 - Analyze production issues and support root-cause identification. 
 - Communicate quality risks clearly and ensure critical defects are properly addressed. 

Must-Have Skills

- 5-8 years of experience in Software Testing / Quality Assurance. 
 - Strong hands-on experience in Manual Testing. 
 - Experience testing SaaS applications. 
 - Strong API Testing knowledge. 
 - Good experience with SQL/Database Testing. 
 - Experience with Test Automation. 
 - Strong Web Application Testing experience. 
 - Good understanding of Agile/Scrum methodology. 
 - Strong QA leadership, ownership, and communication skills. 

Good to Have

- Experience in Mobile Application Testing. 
 - Knowledge of CI/CD pipelines and automated testing integration. 
 - Experience with multi-tenant SaaS applications. 
 - Understanding of RBAC (Role-Based Access Control) testing. 
 - Experience with subscription, billing, and plan-based testing. 
 - Experience with production validation and post-release testing. 

Ideal Candidate

The ideal candidate should be a hands-on QA professional and strong problem solver who can independently own testing activities, identify risks early, mentor team members, and ensure high-quality releases. Experience working in a fast-paced SaaS/product environment will be highly valuable.

data.description:
Hiring for: An AI-driven US healthcare technology company, recognised among the USA's Top 25 fastest-growing healthcare companies. 

Role: Principal AI Engineer - Scalable GenAI Systems- Chennai - 0 to 1 building

Positions: 1

Experience: 5 to 10 years

Work Shift: UK Shift 3. 30 PM - 12. 30 AM (In office, Chennai)

Location(s): Chennai

Type: On-site / Permanent

Salary: Best in Market

We are looking for a hands-on AI Architect who can own the AI thought vision for the Client and personally drive AI-powered features from idea to production. 

This is a builder's role, not an advisory one - you will architect the AI infrastructure, write production code, integrate AI tools across our stack, and design systems that scale with our patient population. You will be the technical owner of every AI capability client ship. 

Indicative time split: 

- 80% Hands-On Technical Development
 - 20% Other (vision, architecture reviews, stakeholder alignment, tooling evaluation). 

Key Focus Areas

- AI Thought Vision - set the technical direction for how AI is applied across the Client's clinical, operational, and patient-facing workflows. 
 - Build AI Infrastructure - design and implement the foundational platform (model gateways, retrieval pipelines, prompt management, evaluation harness, observability). 
 - Full Execution / Hands-On - write production code, build prototypes, and ship AI features end-to-end. This is not a hands-off architect role. 
 - Integrate All AI Tools - bring together LLM APIs, vector stores, agent frameworks, AI voice/transcription, and AI-powered SaaS into a cohesive, well-governed stack. 
 - Build for Scalability - design systems that scale across thousands of patients and millions of interactions, with cost, latency, accuracy, and safety in mind. 

Roles and Responsibilities

- Own the architecture for all AI capabilities - conversational agents, summarization, clinical decision support, workflow automation, voice/transcription, and analytics. 
 - Take AI ideas from concept to production - prototype, validate, harden, and ship real applications used by patients and clinicians. 
 - Build the core AI infrastructure: model abstraction layer, prompt versioning, evaluation pipelines, retrieval (RAG) systems, agent orchestration, guardrails, and observability. 
 - Design and implement RAG pipelines over clinical and operational data with strong relevance, freshness, and privacy controls. 
 - Build and operate AI agents and tool-use workflows that interact with EHRs, telephony, messaging, and internal systems. 
 - Define and enforce evaluation methodology - offline eval sets, online metrics, regression detection, and accuracy/safety benchmarks for every AI feature. 
 - Drive responsible AI practices - PHI handling, prompt-injection defense, hallucination mitigation, audit logging, and HIPAA-aware design. 
 - Evaluate and integrate the best-of-breed AI tools, models, and platforms (OpenAI, Anthropic, open-source LLMs, vector DBs, agent frameworks, AI voice). 
 - Optimize for cost and latency - model routing, caching, batching, distillation, and rightsizing. 
 - Partner with the Technical Manager and engineering team to ship AI features cleanly into the production platform. 
 - Partner with Product, Clinical, and Operations leaders to identify the highest-value AI opportunities and convert them into shippable applications. 
 - Mentor engineers on AI engineering practices; raise the team's overall AI literacy and execution capability. 
 - Maintain a forward-looking view of the AI landscape and continuously bring proven advances into the product. 

Technical Requirements

- Proven hands-on experience taking AI ideas from prototype to real-time, production grade applications running at scale. 
 - Strong programming proficiency in Python and/or JavaScript/TypeScript, with the ability to write and ship production code independently. 
 - Deep, working knowledge of modern LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, and open-source models) - including function/tool calling, structured outputs, streaming, and cost/latency optimization. 
 - Hands-on experience designing and operating RAG systems - chunking, embeddings, vector databases (Pinecone, Weaviate, pgvector, or similar), hybrid retrieval, and reranking. 
 - Experience building agentic systems with tool use, planning, and multi-step workflows. 
 - Strong prompt engineering skills, including evaluation, versioning, and continuous improvement. 
 - Experience with AI evaluation frameworks - golden sets, LLM-as-judge, A/B testing, and regression tracking. 
 - Solid backend engineering fundamentals - REST APIs, asynchronous processing, queues, observability, and scaling patterns. 
 - Working knowledge of cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure) and serverless/low-code environments. 
 - Strong understanding of data privacy, PHI/HIPAA constraints, and responsible AI practices. 
 - Good to have: experience with AI voice/transcription (Whisper, Deepgram, ElevenLabs, etc. ), AI-powered telephony, or conversational AI in regulated domains. 
 - Good to have: experience fine-tuning, distilling, or self-hosting open-source models. 
 - Good to have: experience working with healthcare data formats (HL7v2, FHIR, CCDA) and EHR integrations. 

Preferred candidate profile

- Demonstrated technical excellence and a strong portfolio of AI applications taken from idea to real-time production - not just prototypes or proofs of concept. 
 - Years of experience are secondary to proven ability to ship; we are optimizing for builders who can show concrete, scaled outcomes. 
 - Track record of architecting AI systems that handle real users, real data, and real reliability/cost constraints. 
 - First-principles thinker who can decompose ambiguous problems, evaluate trade-offs, and pick the simplest workable AI architecture. 
 - Strong ownership mindset and bias for shipping - comfortable with iteration, measurement, and continuous improvement. 
 - Excellent written and verbal communication; able to explain AI trade-offs clearly to engineering, clinical, and business stakeholders. 
 - Good to have: prior experience in healthcare AI, clinical NLP, or AI in regulated domains. 
 - Good to have: open-source contributions, published work, or talks demonstrating AI engineering depth. 
 - Willingness to work to align with US business hours.

data.title: Data Test Automation Engineer
data.description:
Job Description: Data Test Automation Engineer (Data Platform)

Location: Singapore/Bangalore

About Us

Dymon Asia Capital ("Dymon Asia"), founded in 2008, is a leading alternative investment firm with assets across public and private markets. The firm's flagship hedge fund product is the Multi-Strategy Investment Fund (MSIF), an Asia-focused multi-manager multi-strategy fund that seeks to generate absolute consistent uncorrelated returns from emerging and developed markets. 

Headquartered in Singapore, Dymon Asia operates from nine offices across the Middle East and Asia, including Hong Kong, Tokyo, Dubai, Shanghai, Mumbai, and Kuala Lumpur. Our platform is built on our people. We bring together diverse perspectives, expertise, and experience across our multi-strategy and private markets businesses. Maintaining a collaborative culture where our people are set up to do their best work is central to how we operate. 

We are looking for a Senior SDET / QA Automation Engineer to lead quality engineering across our data platform. This role is suited to a hands-on engineer who builds automation rather than executes manual tests, and who wants to ensure the data behind trading, risk and investment decisions is accurate, reliable and performant. 

Working closely with Data Architects, Data Engineers and Developers, you will embed automated testing within each sprint and validate large-volume pipelines built with Python, PySpark and modern Lakehouse technologies. 

Key Responsibilities

- Design and implement automated functional, regression, integration and performance tests for data platforms and pipelines. 
 - Develop and maintain test automation using Python and PySpark. 
 - Validate data ingestion, transformations and processing through data quality, source-to-target reconciliation and business-rule validation. 
 - Work closely with Data Architects and Developers to define test coverage and identify quality risks early in the development lifecycle. 
 - Deliver test automation within the sprint, alongside feature development. 
 - Build reusable, maintainable automation frameworks and integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines. 
 - Test large-volume data processing for performance, scalability and reliability. 
 - Investigate data discrepancies, defects and performance issues, working with engineering teams to identify root causes. 
 - Contribute to sprint planning, refinement and technical discussions, promoting testability and quality engineering practices. 

Job Requirements

- Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related discipline preferred. 
 - 6+ years of experience in SDET, QA Automation, Quality Engineering or a similar hands-on technical testing role, with a proven track record of developing automated tests rather than primarily executing manual testing. 
 - Strong experience testing data platforms, ETL/ELT pipelines, data warehouses/lakes or other data-intensive systems, including data quality, reconciliation and transformation validation. 
 - Strong programming and test automation skills in Python, with hands-on PySpark experience testing large datasets. 
 - Strong SQL skills for data validation and analysis. 
 - Experience building maintainable automated test suites and frameworks and implementing them within CI/CD pipelines; pytest or similar Python testing frameworks preferred. 
 - Experience across functional, regression, integration and performance testing, including scalability and high-volume data testing, within Agile teams using a shift-left, in-sprint automation approach. 
 - Strong analytical, debugging and problem-solving skills, with the ability to work independently while collaborating closely with Data Engineers, Developers and Architects. 
 - Domain exposure highly desirable: hedge funds, asset management, investment banking or capital markets, including familiarity with financial datasets such as trades, positions, market data, P&L and risk data. 
 - Exposure to Databricks and Lakehouse platforms, Delta Lake and Spark-based processing, Azure, AWS or GCP, data quality/observability or orchestration tools, and data governance, lineage and metadata concepts is a plus.

data.title: Senior Software Engineer II
data.description:
Apollo. io is the leading go-to-market solution for revenue teams, trusted by over 500, 000 companies and millions of users globally, from rapidly growing startups to some of the world's largest enterprises. Founded in 2015, the company is one of the fastest growing companies in SaaS, raising approximately $250 million to date and valued at $1. 6 billion. Apollo. io provides sales and marketing teams with easy access to verified contact data for over 210 million B2B contacts and 35 million companies worldwide, along with tools to engage and convert these contacts in one unified platform. By helping revenue professionals find the most accurate contact information and automating the outreach process, Apollo. io turns prospects into customers. Apollo raised a series D in 2023 and is backed by top-tier investors, including Sequoia Capital, Bain Capital Ventures, and more, and counts the former President and COO of Hubspot, JD Sherman, among its board members. 

Your Role & Mission

As a Senior Backend Engineer at Apollo, you'll be a critical part of a fast-growing company, working on a cross-functional team to build highly scalable systems and set the bar for how we engineer. The way we build has changed: this is an AI-native role. We're not looking for someone who also uses AI, we're looking for someone who thinks with it, forms their own hypotheses, pressure-tests what AI produces, catches its errors, and design more robustly than they could alone. 

You'll work in an open, collaborative environment, give and receive hands-on mentorship, and have real opportunities to grow. You'll interface daily with design, front-end, analytics, product, and teams beyond Engineering. You enjoy working cross-functionally to solve hard problems and make an impact. You strive for quality, are obsessed with improving it, automation, monitoring, squashing the bugs that sneak through and you're always investigating performance improvements and better ideas. 

Daily Adventures & Responsibilities

- Design and implement highly scalable, highly available backend services with proper monitoring and alerting in place
 - Ramp quickly into large, unfamiliar codebases, de-risk your changes, understand blast radius, and ship with confidence
 - Use AI as a core part of your workflow: generate and pressure-test approaches, verify and catch AI's mistakes, and stand behind the quality of the code you ship with it
 - Drive the full lifecycle of software development: product requirements, architecture, solution design, development, quality assurance, and maintenance, ownership doesn't end at deploy
 - Scope and reshape under-specified problems, and write clear design docs that satisfy real product needs
 - Partner closely with PMs: translate product intent into technical decisions, surface the technical realities they need to make good calls, and push back on the spec when reality changes the answer
 - Mentor others on best practices and effectively share knowledge to up-level the team
 - Communicate progress clearly to the product lead, engineering manager, and other stakeholders
 - Introduce new technologies and ideas when they earn their place
 - Give and receive technical and behavioral feedback; engage in scrum ceremonies, team culture, and collaborate with the team. 

What We're Looking For

- AI-native engineers. You use AI to raise your bar, not just move faster forming your own hypotheses, pressure-testing and verifying AI output, catching its errors, and taking full ownership of code quality regardless of how it was produced. You stay current with a fast-moving toolset. 
 - Comfort in unfamiliar code. You ramp fast into systems you didn't write, reason about blast radius, and de-risk changes rather than hoping they work. 
 - Architectural ownership & operational readiness. You design for scale and availability, anticipate failure modes, and build with monitoring and alerting from the start. 
 - Ownership start to finish. Just because a project has been deployed doesn't mean it's done. You own outcomes , think end to end in terms of product and are customer obsessed
 - Collaboration you can trust. You let others speak, seek to understand their viewpoints, and are the kind of teammate people want to build with. 
 - Product judgment. You care about the customer outcome, make the technical calls that produce a great product, and know when to challenge a spec. 
 - Growth & learning. You actively improve your craft, your team, and how you work. 
 - Proactivity. You act without being told, identify areas of improvement, and drive best practices. 
 - Comfort with ambiguity. You can operate without a fully-specified problem and bring structure to it. 
 - Organization & planning. You break large projects into smaller pieces that are easier to estimate and deliver. 
 - Strong communication. Clear in writing and in person, across technical and non-technical audiences. 

Qualifications

- Minimum 8+ years of industry experience in backend development, at least 3-4 years in senior positions, building large-scale applications with right observability. 
 - Solid computer science fundamentals, data structures, algorithms, and object-oriented design
 - Fluency using AI tools in real development work, plus the judgment to verify and pressure-test their output rather than trusting it blindly
 - Experience developing distributed web applications
 - Write code that is comprehensible, well-structured, and highly performant
 - Experience with database modeling (SQL or NoSQL both fine)
 - Experience using and designing RESTful services

Must have: Curiosity, AI-native engineering judgment, communication skills, problem solving. 

Nice to have: BS or MS in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or similar; GCP, Kubernetes, Docker, Mongo, Redis, Ruby on Rails, Microservices, Machine Learning

Apollo. io Tech Blog: deep dives into engineering, product design, and company-culture stories from the Apollo team - behind-the-scenes insight into how Apollo builds and scales its B2B sales platform. 

We are AI Native

Apollo. io is an AI-native company built on a culture of continuous improvement. We're on the front lines of driving productivity for our customers-and we expect the same mindset from our team. If you're energized by finding smarter, faster ways to get things done using AI and automation, you'll thrive here. 

Why You'll Love Working at Apollo

At Apollo, we're driven by a shared mission: to help our customers unlock their full revenue potential. That's why we take extreme ownership of our work, move with focus and urgency, and learn voraciously to stay ahead. 

We invest deeply in your growth, ensuring you have the resources, support, and autonomy to own your role and make a real impact. Collaboration is at our core-we're all for one, meaning you'll have a team across departments ready to help you succeed. We encourage bold ideas and courageous action, giving you the freedom to experiment, take smart risks, and drive big wins. 

If you're looking for a place where your work matters, where you can push boundaries, and where your career can thrive-Apollo is the place for you. 

Learn more here!

About Tilda

About Tilda Research, Inc. 

Tilda Research is reimagining how clinical trials are run by bringing AI-native tools and AI teammates into clinical research operations. Our technology works alongside sponsor, CRO, and research teams to simplify study management, improve data quality, support real-time oversight, and help accelerate trial timelines. 

We are building the future of clinical trial execution: one where research teams can spend less time on administrative bottlenecks and more time focused on patients, sites, and the work that moves new treatments forward. Tilda's mission is rooted in the belief that clinical research should be faster, more efficient, more scalable, and more accessible - without losing the human judgment and care that patients and research teams deserve. 

At Tilda, we are a team of builders, operators, researchers, and problem-solvers working at the intersection of healthcare, technology, and AI. We move quickly, think deeply, and care about building products and systems that create meaningful impact in the clinical research industry.

Tilda Research is looking for an experienced Automation Engineer / SDET with 4-10 years of experience to help improve the quality, reliability, and speed of our software delivery. 

We're looking for someone who is highly technical, hands-on, and experienced in building automation frameworks-not simply using existing ones. This person will also actively use AI-assisted engineering and testing tools to improve automation, test coverage, troubleshooting, and overall QA efficiency. 

What You'll Do

- Design, build, and maintain scalable automation frameworks for web applications, APIs, and backend services.

 - Proven experience designing and building automation frameworks from the ground up.

AI & Automation

We expect our engineers to actively use AI as part of their day-to-day work. Experience with tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, or similar AI development tools is highly valued. 

You Should Be Comfortable Using AI To

- Create and improve automated tests. 
 - Generate test scenarios and identify edge cases. 
 - Analyze logs and troubleshoot failures. 
 - Debug and maintain automation. 
 - Generate test data. 
 - Identify gaps in test coverage. 
 - Automate repetitive QA workflows. 

We are looking for someone who goes beyond simply using AI as a chatbot and can demonstrate how they use it to engineer, test, and ship better software faster. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience testing modern SaaS applications. 
 - Experience with AWS or other cloud environments. 
 - Exposure to Docker and Kubernetes. 
 - Experience with performance, security, or reliability testing. 
 - Experience testing AI-powered applications, LLM features, or agentic workflows. 
 - Experience with healthcare, clinical research, life sciences, or another regulated industry. 
 - Experience in a startup or high-growth technology environment. 

What Makes You a Strong Fit

You'll likely thrive at Tilda if you enjoy building automation rather than performing repetitive manual testing, can write production-quality code, actively use AI to improve your work, and enjoy solving complex technical problems in a fast-moving environment.

data.title: Senior Application Software Engineer - Testing
data.description:
Qualifications

JOB DESCRIPTION

- Bachelor's degree in computer science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field. 
 - Proven experience (3+ years) in software test automation, preferably in IC3 or complex software systems. 
 - Experience with test frameworks like Selenium, Jest, Mocha, Chai 
 - Experience with programming skills in languages such as Java, Python, JavaScript, or TypeScript 
 - Hands-on experience with test automation tools/frameworks such as Selenium, Cypress, Appium, JUnit, TestNG, or similar. 
 - Familiarity with continuous integration/continuous deployment (CI/CD) pipelines and tools like Jenkins or GitLab CI. 
 - Experience with version control systems such as Git. 
 - Knowledge of cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) and container technologies (Docker, Kubernetes) is a plus. 
 - Strong analytical, problem-solving, and debugging skills. 
 - Excellent communication skills and ability to work effectively in cross-functional teams. 
 - Familiarity with Agile/Scrum development methodologies. 

Responsibilities

- Develop, maintain, and enhance automated test scripts and frameworks to improve test coverage and efficiency for the SaaS application. 
 - Collaborate with software development and product teams to understand requirements and translate them into effective automated test cases. 
 - Integrate automated testing into CI/CD pipelines to enable continuous testing and rapid feedback. 
 - Execute automated test suites, analyze results, and identify defects or areas for improvement. 
 - Maintain and enhance existing automation frameworks for scalability, maintainability, and performance. 
 - Develop reusable test components and libraries to maximize automation efficiency. 
 - Perform root cause analysis of test failures and work closely with development teams to resolve issues. 
 - Stay updated with emerging testing tools, methodologies, and best practices relevant to cloud-based software systems. 
 - Generate and present detailed test reports, metrics, and documentation to stakeholders. 
 - Support manual testing efforts and provide automation support for regression, integration, and system testing. 
 - Ensure compliance with security, regulatory, and quality standards applicable to the IC3 software environment.

Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system. 

Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365-all within 90 seconds. 

Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1. 4B+ from the world's top investors-including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock-and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes. 

We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling. com addresses. 

About The Role

Benefits is one of Rippling's largest and most important product categories, and the Benefits Operations team is critical to getting companies enrolled in the right benefits. The team manages tens of thousands of enrollments every year.

data.title: Senior Full Stack Engineer
data.description:
Job Description

Ciklum is looking for a Senior Full Stack Engineer to join our team full-time in India. 

We are a custom product engineering company that supports both multinational organizations and scaling startups to solve their most complex business challenges. With a global team of over 4, 000 highly skilled developers, consultants, analysts and product owners, we engineer technology that redefines industries and shapes the way people live. 

About The Role

As a Senior Full Stack Engineer, become a part of a cross-functional development team engineering experiences of tomorrow. 

Responsibilities

- Take an initiative from an open problem to production: write the design, divide the work so several engineers can contribute, ship it, and support it after release
 - Partner with Product and Design on scope and timing. Say when a feature costs too much, and propose a cheaper path that still meets the outcome
 - Think through risks before the build starts. Escalate early when you find a surprise or the scope changes
 - Replace legacy Oracle ADF/JSF screens with React and TypeScript screens built on Holocron, Tangos shared design system
 - Design and build the Java APIs (Spring Boot) those screens need, so the same APIs can also serve integrations and AI agents later
 - Make pragmatic calls on where to rewrite and where to wrap. Accept a less-than-perfect solution when there is a good reason
 - Drive improvements to code health, test coverage, and long-term maintainability in the team's codebases
 - Take part in on-call and incident response. Lead or contribute to postmortems, and turn the learnings into better patterns
 - Fix security findings in the code you own. Ship through the paved-road CI/CD pipeline
 - Mentor and ramp up newer engineers through pairing, design reviews, and code reviews
 - Weigh in on technical decisions that affect the team. Take a position, and stay open to better ideas
 - Help the team improve how it works through retros
 - Build prompts, AI workflows, or lightweight agents that speed up the team's work, and teach others to use them well
 - Check AI-generated code with the same rigor as human code. Guard against over-reliance on it

Requirements

- You have owned the design, build, and rollout of a large feature or initiative in a production B2B application, including the coordination, documentation, and support that came with it (Typically 6+ years of professional software engineering)
 - You are fluent in Java on the server side, including Java EE and/or Spring Boot, and comfortable with relational databases. Oracle SQL and PL/SQL experience is a clear plus
 - You have shipped production React (ideally with TypeScript) and can build a screen against an API you designed
 - You have modernized or refactored a legacy system without stopping delivery, and you can explain the tradeoffs you made
 - You have mentored other engineers and made them measurably better
 - You use AI coding and research tools every day, you know their failure modes, and you can integrate an LLM API into a product when the problem fits

Desirable

- Experience with Oracle ADF or JSF
 - Experience with a shared component library or design system
 - AWS experience, especially infrastructure-as-code and CI/CD pipelines
 - Domain experience in real estate, facilities, maintenance, or workplace software (IWMS, CAFM, CMMS)

What's in it for you?

- Strong community: Work alongside top professionals in a friendly, open-door environment
 - Growth focus: Take on large-scale projects with a global impact and expand your expertise
 - Tailored learning: Boost your skills with internal events (meetups, conferences, workshops), Udemy access, language courses, and company-paid certifications
 - Endless opportunities: Explore diverse domains through internal mobility, finding the best fit to gain hands-on experience with cutting-edge technologies
 - Care: We've got you covered with company-paid medical insurance, mental health support, and financial & legal consultations

About Us

At Ciklum, we are always exploring innovations, empowering each other to achieve more, and engineering solutions that matter. With us, you'll work with cutting-edge technologies, contribute to impactful projects, and be part of a One Team culture that values collaboration and progress. 

India is a strategic innovation hub for Ciklum, with growing teams in Chennai and Pune leading advancements in EdgeTech, AR/VR, IoT, and beyond. Join us to collaborate on game-changing solutions and take your career to the next level. 

Explore, empower, engineer with Ciklum!

Interested already? We would love to get to know you! Submit your application. We can't wait to see you at Ciklum.

Job Description

As a Test Automation Engineer, you will design and implement automation solutions that validate system behavior across UI, APIs, and integrations. You will contribute to building a robust quality engineering ecosystem by integrating automated testing into CI/CD pipelines and supporting continuous delivery. 

In this role, you will translate requirements into effective test strategies, combining automation with manual, exploratory, and integration testing to ensure comprehensive quality coverage across all application layers. 

This role is ideal for an engineer who enjoys hands-on coding, solving complex validation challenges, and improving system quality at scale, while taking ownership of end-to-end quality outcomes and collaborating closely with cross-functional teams. 

Responsibilities

Automation Development & Framework Ownership

- Design, develop, and own scalable test automation frameworks and reusable components
 - Build automated test suites across: 
 - UI (Web/Mobile)
 - API and integration layers
 - Ensure automation solutions are maintainable, reliable, and extensible across teams

Test Strategy & Implementation

- Translate requirements into automation-ready test scenarios, test data, and validation strategies
 - Contribute to test strategy, coverage planning, and quality goals
 - Identify test gaps and proactively mitigate risks
 - Perform automation feasibility analysis to determine optimal test approach (manual vs automated)

Delivery & Execution Excellence

- Execute a balanced mix of automated and manual tests aligned with sprint goals, ensuring comprehensive validation across functional, integration, and edge-case scenarios. 
 - Contribute to task breakdown, estimation, and sprint commitments
 - Proactively raise risks, blockers, and testability concerns
 - Identify, log, prioritize, and track defects through resolution lifecycle
 - Perform root cause analysis and collaborate with development teams for fixes

Manual & Functional Testing

- Design, document, and execute detailed test cases and test scenarios
 - Perform functional, exploratory, and regression testing across features
 - Validate end-to-end workflows and business scenarios
 - Identify edge cases and usability issues through exploratory testing
 - Ensure test coverage for areas not suitable for automation

Quality, Standards & Engineering Practices

- Write clean, testable, and maintainable automation code
 - Participate in code reviews and continuous improvement of automation frameworks
 - Ensure adherence to Definition of Ready (DoR) and Definition of Done (DoD)
 - Take ownership of end-to-end quality outcomes across assigned areas
 - Follow established DevOps, security, and quality engineering practices

CI/CD & DevOps Integration

- Integrate automation into CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps preferred)
 - Enable continuous testing and shift-left quality practices
 - Monitor and improve pipeline stability, execution time, and reliability
 - Validate and troubleshoot system integrations, data flows, and error handling based on defined architectural designs and interfaces

Non-Functional Testing

- Contribute to performance, reliability, and resilience testing
 - Validate system behavior under load, stress, and failure scenarios

Observability & Debuggability

- Leverage logs, metrics, and traces to improve test reliability
 - Support root cause analysis of failures and improve system observability

Test Data & Environment Management

- Design and manage test data strategies and datasets
 - Ensure availability of stable, production-like test environments

Incident & Operational Support

- Assist in troubleshooting defects across environments
 - Support maintenance and continuous improvement of automation suites
 - Analyze and reduce flaky tests and unstable scenarios

Collaboration & Growth

- Collaborate with developers, QA, Product Owners, and Tech Leads
 - Actively learn and adopt new tools, frameworks, and best practices
 - Contribute to team knowledge sharing and a strong quality culture

Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in computer science, IT, or related field
 - 5+ years of experience in software testing with strong automation focus
 - Experience in designing and implementing test automation frameworks
 - Strong understanding of testing principles, SDLC, STLC, and Agile practices

Technical Skills

- Programming experience in one or more: C#, Java, Python, JavaScript, Swift
 - Experience with automation tools such as Selenium, Katalon, Playwright, Cypress
 - Experience with: 
 - API testing (REST, Postman, etc. )
 - Version control (Git)
 - CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps)
 - Familiarity with: 
 - Test data management
 - Test reporting and logging tools
 - Debugging and root cause analysis
 - Release Management
Assets

- Experience with: 
 - Performance testing tools (JMeter, k6)
 - Security testing (SAST, DAST, SCA)
 - Exposure to: 
 - Cloud platforms (Azure preferred)
 - DevSecOps practices
 - Experience using AI-assisted tools responsibly (e. g. , GitHub Copilot)
Key Expectations

- Drive an automation-first approach (target 60-80% regression automation), while ensuring critical flows and edge cases are validated through manual testing where automation is not feasible or cost-effective. 
 - Own and evolve automation frameworks and quality engineering practices
 - Ensure high reliability, scalability, and stability of automation pipelines
 - Take accountability for quality outcomes, not just test execution
 - Ensure alignment with organizational quality, security, and compliance standards

Why Husky?

data.title: Frontend Technical Lead
data.description:
Work Schedule

Standard (Mon-Fri)

Environmental Conditions

Office

Location: Hyderabad, India

Division: Analytical Instruments Group, Materials & Structural Analysis Division

Organization: Semiconductor R&D

About The Team

Thermo Fisher Scientific's Materials and Structural Analysis Semiconductor R&D organization brings together around 400 engineers developing electron microscopy solutions and applications. Our global teams in Eindhoven, Brno, Hillsboro, Hyderabad, and Bordeaux combine expertise in hardware, software, and scientific applications to help customers make the world cleaner, healthier, and safer. 

Within this organization, the Cortex value stream develops software for semiconductor data workflows, including tools to organize, explore, and visualize microscopy data. We're looking for a Frontend Technical Lead to shape Cortex's frontend architecture and guide a focused team delivering a consistent, scalable experience across our Core and Contributor applications. 

How will you make an impact?

You'll provide hands-on technical leadership for Cortex's frontend, setting direction for its architecture, shared UI, and user experience. Working with product owners, designers, scientists, architects, and engineering teams across multiple sites, you'll turn complex workflows and data into reliable, intuitive applications. 

You'll help establish frontend standards, guide design and code reviews, and support engineers across teams-including contributors working with technologies other than Angular. You'll partner closely with backend technical leads on APIs and integration, while keeping frontend quality, performance, and usability central to delivery. 

What will you do?

- Own the Cortex frontend architecture and help ensure a consistent, scalable user experience across Core and Contributor applications. 
 - Lead the design and development of key Cortex experiences, including Process Explorer, Tool Overview Dashboard, and File & Recipe UI. 
 - Guide the evolution of the Cortex Shell, shared UI, component library, and design-system practices. 
 - Define approaches for plugin integration and collaboration with contributor teams using different frontend technologies. 
 - Lead integration of 2D and 3D viewers to support exploration and visualization of advanced microscopy datasets. 
 - Set frontend standards for architecture, component design, state management, accessibility, maintainability, and performance. 
 - Establish and evolve the frontend testing strategy, including unit, integration, and end-to-end testing. 
 - Develop and review Angular applications and shared components, and support Blazor interoperability where needed. 
 - Integrate REST APIs and collaborate with backend technical leads on API design, data contracts, and end-to-end workflows. 
 - Diagnose and resolve frontend defects and performance issues across applications and supported environments. 
 - Work with product owners, scientists, designers, and engineering partners to refine requirements and deliver user-centered solutions. 
 - Influence technical decisions across teams, facilitate design and code reviews, and mentor engineers through feedback and knowledge sharing. 
 - Promote practices that improve code quality, test stability, maintainability, and the health of the software delivery process. 
 - Use AI-assisted development tools thoughtfully to improve productivity, quality, and delivery speed. 
 - Learn the semiconductor domain and Cortex workflows, and test solutions in the environments used by the team, including virtual machines. 
 - Regularly reflect with the team on how to improve collaboration and delivery. 

You'll be based in Hyderabad and report to the Functional Group Lead. The role is part of a distributed Agile Scrum team working with colleagues in Bordeaux, Hillsboro, the Netherlands, and the Czech Republic. 

How will you get here?

Education

- Bachelor's or master's degree in computer science, software engineering, computer engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience. 

Required Experience And Skills

- Significant professional experience building and supporting frontend applications, including technical leadership or ownership of frontend architecture. 
 - Expert-level experience with Angular and TypeScript. 
 - Strong knowledge of JavaScript, HTML, CSS, and RxJS. 
 - Experience designing component-based applications, shared UI libraries, and design systems. 
 - Strong understanding of frontend architecture, state management, and REST API integration. 
 - Experience improving frontend performance and diagnosing complex user-interface issues. 
 - Experience defining or applying unit, integration, and end-to-end testing practices. 
 - Demonstrated ability to influence technical direction, establish standards, and guide decisions across teams. 
 - Strong communication and stakeholder-management skills, including the ability to work effectively across sites and disciplines. 
 - A collaborative approach to mentoring, code and design reviews, and working with teams that use different technologies. 
 - Strong UX sensitivity and an ability to translate complex workflows into clear, usable interfaces. 
 - Excellent written and spoken English. 

Preferred Experience

- Microfrontend or plugin architectures, Web Components, or other approaches to integrating independently developed applications. 
 - Blazor interoperability or integration between Angular and . NET applications. 
 - Authentication and authorization, real-time web applications, or visualization frameworks. 
 - 2D or 3D viewers, scientific software, imaging, or data-intensive applications. 
 - Experience with large datasets, distributed systems, or performance-sensitive user interfaces. 
 - Familiarity with C#, . NET, Python, or enterprise data platforms. 
 - Experience using AI tools in day-to-day software development. 
 - Interest in semiconductor workflows, electron microscopy, or scientific research.

About The Company

Thermo Fisher Scientific Inc. (NYSE: TMO) is the world leader in serving science, with annual revenue of approximately $44 billion. Our Mission is to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner, and safer. Whether our customers are accelerating life sciences research, solving analytical challenges, growing efficiency in their laboratories, improving patient health through diagnostics, or developing and manufacturing life-changing therapies, we are here to support them.
