Our Innovative Laboratory technologies & Services makes it easier for customers. 

About Team: Antibody team

The antibody team is involved in engineering and development of antibodies, with a deep focus on reagent quality and specificity. The core activities of the team include design, development, purification, conjugation and testing of antibodies in a variety of immunoassay applications using pioneering tools and technologies. The goal of the program is advanced product development and creation of product specific information to promote research use. 

Role: 

To be an integral part of an antibody development team with a focus on performance and specificity using innovative molecular, protein, and cell biology methods. The successful candidate will be joining the Bangalore R&D leadership team for developing antibodies for the Thermo Fisher Scientific Antibody portfolio. This position involves people management, internal, external and cross function collaboration to drive technical strategies for execution in R&D projects involving state-of-art methods. 

Responsibilities: 

- Perform in a fast- paced environment towards antigen and antibody development
 - Lead team of scientists in matrix style operation, provide technical and operational supervision. 
 - Drive conceptualization within teams to enable development of successful protocols for antigen design and development
 - Mentoring and training junior scientists in research, designing and experimental execution, interpreting data and data presentation to the stakeholders
 - Partner with supporting functions such as product management, program management, operations, and business development to meet program goals. 
 - Good scientific writing skills, establishing technical protocols for effective transfer to operations teams. 
 - Good documentation practice is a must to maintain data integrity and accuracy. 
 - Delivering high quality results according to project schedule in support of product commercialization from concept to launch including early feasibility, development and validation phases. 
 - Support the manufacturing team for technical support and quality by providing technical guidance. 

Education & Experience needed: 

Applicants should have a Master's degree with 15+ years R&D experience or PhD with 7+ years experience in a life sciences field with a strong focus on protein biology. Minimum 3-4 years of Industrial experience is required. Prior people management experience is essential. 

Nature of experience: 

- Strong domain expertise
 - in the antibody development and engineering field including hybridoma, single B cell, and other recombinant antibody platforms
 - Expert in the field of peptide and protein design, expression, purification, and protein-protein interaction (Structure -function -relationship)
 - Thorough understanding of antigen/immunogen properties, design and development towards eliciting desired antibody response
 - Extensive experience in expression and purification of recombinant proteins from bacterial, yeast, insect and mammalian systems
 - Extensive experience in structural biology, antibody and protein engineering, computational modeling and rational design. 
 - Expertise in development of conjugation chemistries or performing antibody conjugations is desired
 - Broad knowledge and experience in molecular biology, cell biology, immunoassays, protein design, engineering, purification, and conjugation fields to enable successful delivery on program goals

 - Skills for identifying deviations from expected outcomes, problem solving and suggesting alternatives

 - Experience in leading product launches through knowledge and application of product commercialization processes including feasibility, development, and validation stages
 - Proven leadership skills and ability to work alongside colleagues from different backgrounds
 - Experience with leading and mentoring people with or without direct reporting structure
 - Strong, independent understanding of standard and emerging research protocols and techniques are preferred

data.description:
Calling all innovators - find your future at Fiserv. 

We're Fiserv, a global leader in Fintech and payments, and we move money and information in a way that moves the world. Any time you swipe your credit card, pay through a mobile app, or withdraw money from the bank, we're involved. If you want to make an impact on a global scale, come make a difference at Fiserv. 

Job Title

SDE

About Your Role

As a Senior SDE, you will design, build, and launch scalable software services that support reliable, high-performing customer and business experiences. You will work across engineering teams and technology stacks to solve complex technical problems, improve service quality, and accelerate delivery using strong engineering fundamentals. Your work will help strengthen platform reliability, improve cloud-native development practices, and deliver high-quality software at scale.

- Design, develop, and launch high-scale, highly available software services that support critical business and customer needs.

 - Build cloud-native applications and services using platforms such as Amazon Web Services (AWS), Microsoft Azure, Kubernetes, Kafka, Redis, and relational or NoSQL databases. 
 - Apply strong data structures, algorithms, and distributed systems concepts to solve complex engineering problems and improve service performance. 
 - Build and improve observability capabilities for services, including tracing, metrics, monitoring, and operational diagnostics.

 - Support front-end development needs when required, including work with technologies such as React or similar frameworks.

Experience You'll Need To Have

- 3+ years of experience in software engineering, software development, or related technical roles building and supporting production applications or services. 
 - 3+ years of experience developing services using Java, . NET, or similar programming languages in scalable application environments. 
 - Experience designing and launching high-scale, highly available services with strong performance, resilience, and operational quality. 
 - Experience with cloud development and architecture using AWS, Azure, or similar cloud platforms. 
 - Experience with Kubernetes, Kafka, Redis or similar caching technologies, and relational or NoSQL databases in distributed systems environments.

data.title: AI Operations & Optimization Manager
data.description:
About IntouchCX

IntouchCX is a global leader in digital customer experience management, back office processing, trust & safety solutions, and AI services. For over 25 years, we've scaled with soul, building trusted long-term partnerships and empowering our people to drive positive change. 

About The Job

The AI Operations Manager is responsible for leading the ongoing performance, quality, optimization, and evolution of digital and voice bot programs. This role serves as the primary partner-facing point of contact and leads a cross-functional team that may include Bot Quality Analysts, Data Analysts, Prompt Designers, and Bot Configuration and Development resources. 

The AI Operations Manager translates bot performance data, quality findings, operational feedback, and customer experience observations into clear insights and prioritized recommendations. They own the operating cadence for the program, coordinate enhancement delivery, manage the change backlog, and measure the impact of improvements over time. 

This role is both strategic and operational. The AI Operations Manager ensures that current bot performance is understood, issues are acted on, enhancements are delivered effectively, and a clear roadmap exists for future capability expansion. 

As AI Operations & Optimization Manager, You Will. . . 

- Serve as the primary partner-facing point of contact for all bot performance, quality, optimization, and enhancement activities while leading the overall operating rhythm (including weekly business reviews, monthly performance reviews, and quarterly executive reviews). 
 - Build strong working relationships with Client Partners, Operations, CX, Product, Technology, Analytics, and other key stakeholders, managing incoming partner requests and coordinating cross-functional support. 
 - Lead, direct, and set clear priorities for a multidisciplinary AI operations team (including Bot Quality Analysts, Data Analysts, Prompt Designers, and Configuration resources) to align effort toward common goals, continuous improvement, and measurable outcomes. 
 - Support the evaluation and calibration of Copilot, Agent Assist, RTG, and other AI-supported agent experiences across channels, partnering with Operations, CX, and Quality teams to align on standards. 
 - Diagnose whether performance opportunities are driven by persona and conversational behavior, prompt design, workflow configuration, knowledge sources, policies or operating procedures, system integrations, or data availability and quality. 
 - Prioritize recommendations and proposed backlog changes based on customer impact, business impact, risk, frequency, effort, expected benefit, and quantified operational metrics. 
 - Own and maintain the bot enhancement backlog. 
 - Coordinate enhancement delivery across Bot Quality, Prompt Design, Bot Configuration, Development, Analytics, Operations, and other support teams. 
 - Manage change control, approvals, release coordination, testing requirements, and stakeholder communication. 
 - Ensure enhancements are documented with clear objectives, expected outcomes, and success measures. 
 - Track recommendations from identification through approval, implementation, validation, and closure. 
 - Coordinate User Acceptance Testing with Bot Quality Analysts, Operations teams, and partner stakeholders. 
 - Establish and maintain reporting across bot performance, resolution, quality, experience, and compliance. 
 - Track key performance indicators such as containment and deflection, resolution rate, bot satisfaction and quality scores, intent-level performance, compliance, escalations, contact volume, and automation utilization. 
 - Monitor performance by intent, channel, use case, and customer journey to identify areas requiring additional attention. 
 - Measure performance before and after enhancements to determine whether recommended changes produced the expected outcome. 
 - Build trend reporting to demonstrate ongoing performance improvements and identify emerging opportunities. 
 - Manage the operating rhythm for bot governance. 
 - Leverage performance data, contact volume, customer intents, quality observations, and operational insights to build and maintain an AI optimization roadmap. 
 - Identify opportunities for expanding automation into new intents and customer journeys. 
 - Maintain a catalog of recommended future intents and automation opportunities. 
 - Assess prospects for expanded integrations, workflows, knowledge sources, personalization, and transactional capabilities. 
 - Partner with Product, Technology, Operations, and partner stakeholders to prioritize future bot capabilities. 
 - Balance short-term optimization with long-term AI strategy and capability expansion. 
 - Review agent operating procedures, policies, knowledge resources, FAQs, and other reference content used by bots and agents. 
 - Enhance bot knowledge coverage, accuracy, accessibility, and consistency. 
 - Recommend revisions to knowledge assets when inaccurate, incomplete, outdated, or unclear content impairs bot performance. 
 - Align bot workflows and knowledge repositories with current business processes and customer policies. 
 - Provide day-to-day guidance and direction to a multidisciplinary AI operations team. 

As AI Operations & Optimization Manager, You Need. . . 

- 5+ years of experience across BPO, customer experience (CX), operations, client services, quality assurance, analytics, continuous improvement, program management, or related disciplines. 
 - Proven track record of leading cross-functional teams and orchestrating initiatives across Operations, Quality, Analytics, Technology, Training, and Product. 
 - Strong client and executive stakeholder management experience, serving as a primary point of contact while managing expectations, strategic priorities, risks, and deliverables. 
 - Experience analyzing operational performance data to extract actionable insights, build business cases, and execute targeted intervention plans. 
 - Demonstrated ability to establish and drive an operational cadence, including weekly performance reviews, action tracking, KPI reporting, and Executive Business Reviews. 
 - Proven ability to prioritize competing initiatives based on customer impact, ROI, operational risk, and resource constraints. 
 - Advanced presentation and storytelling skills, with the ability to clearly articulate what happened, why it matters, recommended next steps, and measurable outcomes of interventions. 
 - End-to-end change management experience guiding initiatives from initial opportunity identification through operational rollout and impact measurement. 
 - Rigorous organizational skills and the ability to maintain clear ownership, manage interdependencies, and track timelines across complex workstreams. 
 - Ability to synthesize quantitative metrics, qualitative observations, stakeholder feedback, and technical diagnostic findings to uncover root causes and emerging trends. 
 - The capability to distill complex technical, AI, and analytical data into concise, high-impact narratives and recommendations tailored for diverse audiences. 
 - Strong leadership skills to cultivate trusted partnerships, resolve ambiguity, facilitate executive decision-making, and align cross-functional teams around shared KPIs. 
 - The capacity to balance competing roadmaps, resources, and dependencies to keep delivery teams focused on high-value, needle-moving initiatives. 
 - A deep sense of ownership and accountability to drive initiatives end-to-end from initial insight to verified business impact. 
 - An inquisitive mindset to challenge legacy assumptions, probe operational friction, test solutions, and iteratively drive continuous process optimization. 
 - A solid foundational understanding of conversational AI architecture, bot capabilities, dialogue workflows, knowledge bases, and AI quality metrics to effectively lead and coordinate technical and operational specialists. 

IntouchCX will never ask for payment, money, financial or banking information during the recruitment process. We only communicate through official channels. 

Should you receive a suspicious job offer, or posting, from anyone claiming to be an IntouchCX employee, please report it immediately to hr@intouchcx. com for review and validation.

data.description:
This is where your work makes a difference. 

At Baxter, we believe every person-regardless of who they are or where they are from-deserves a chance to live a healthy life. It was our founding belief in 1931 and continues to be our guiding principle. We are redefining healthcare delivery to make a greater impact today, tomorrow, and beyond. 

Our Baxter colleagues are united by our Mission to Save and Sustain Lives. Together, our community is driven by a culture of courage, trust, and collaboration. Every individual is empowered to take ownership and make a meaningful impact. We strive for efficient and effective operations, and we hold each other accountable for delivering exceptional results. 

Here, you will find more than just a job-you will find purpose and pride. 

About Baxter

Baxter provides a broad portfolio of essential renal and hospital products, including home, acute, and in-center dialysis; sterile IV solutions; infusion systems and devices; parenteral nutrition; surgical products and anesthetics; as well as pharmacy automation software and services. The company's global footprint, combined with the critical nature of its products and services, plays a vital role in expanding access to healthcare across both emerging and developed markets. Baxter employees around the world are building on the company's rich heritage of medical breakthroughs to advance the next generation of healthcare innovations, enabling improved patient care and outcomes. 

Your Role at Baxter

As a Verification Lead Engineer, you will play a critical role in ensuring the quality, reliability, and performance of Baxter's innovative healthcare technologies. You will lead verification activities throughout the product development lifecycle, collaborating closely with design, development, and cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality solutions that meet functional, regulatory, and customer requirements. Your expertise will help drive verification excellence, risk management, and continuous improvement while supporting the delivery of safe and effective products that positively impact patient care worldwide. 

What You'll Be Doing

- Lead the verification team in thoroughly understanding the design specifications, designing verification environments, and collaborating with design engineers to identify critical verification scenarios. 
 - Lead the development of test strategies and the creation of top-level and block-level test benches, test stimuli, and coverage metrics. 
 - Coordinate the debugging process for failing test cases in collaboration with the design team. 
 - Ensure the delivery of verified design blocks for sign-off, meeting defined functionality, performance, and coverage requirements. Drive continuous improvements in test execution, quality, and delivery. 
 - Lead the development and documentation of product test cases. 
 - Identify testing risks and own the associated risk mitigation plans. 
 - Work within an Agile team to deliver high-quality products through effective collaboration. 
 - Guide the team in adopting appropriate verification methodologies and approaches. 
 - Assist in and provide guidance for the authoring, review, and execution of verification test cases. 
 - Provide input to the Traceability Matrix to ensure that the traceability of requirements to test cases is maintained. 
 - Coordinate verification activities throughout the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC). 
 - Compile and deliver the Verification Test Summary Report upon completion of the formal verification phase for submission and review. 

What You'll Bring

- 12+ years of experience in Software Quality Assurance (QA), Verification and Validation (V&V), or Software Test Engineering, preferably within the medical device industry or other highly regulated environments. 
 - Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related field. 
 - Proven experience in leading and mentoring Quality Assurance (QA) and testing teams while driving technical excellence and continuous improvement initiatives.

 - Exposure to QA automation or scripting using Java, JavaScript, Python, or similar.

What You'll Bring

 - Ability to work collaboratively with QA, development, architecture, and business teams. 
 - Attention to detail and a quality-focused mindset.

Equal Employment Opportunity Statement

All employment decisions shall be made without regard to age, race, creed, color, religion, sex, national origin, ancestry, disability status, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, citizenship status or any other basis as protected by federal, state, or local law. 

What's it like to be a part of NeuraFlash, Part of Accenture?

- Remote & In-Person: Whether you work out of our HQ in Massachusetts, one of our regional hubs, or you're one of over half of our NeuraFlash, Part of Accenture Family who work remotely, we're focused on keeping everyone connected and unified as one team. 
 - Travel: Get ready to pack your bags and hit the road! For certain roles, travel is an exciting part of the job, with an anticipated travel commitment of up to 25%. So, if you have a passion for adventure and don't mind a little jet-setting, this opportunity could be your ticket to exploring new places while making a positive impact on clients. 
 - Flexibility: Do you have to take the dog to the vet, pick up the kids from school, or the in-laws from the airport? We know that a perfect 9-5 isn't possible. So you have to jump out to do any of those, no problem! We build a culture of trust and understanding. We value good work not the hours in which you get it done
 - Collaboration: You have a voice here! If you work with a team of smart people like we do, it's a no-brainer to take suggestions and feedback on how to keep NeuraFlash, Part of Accenture thriving. Our executive team holds town halls & company meetings where they address any suggestions or questions asked, no matter how big or small. 
 - Celebrate Often: We take our work seriously, but we don't take ourselves too seriously. Whether it is an arm wrestling contest, costume party, or ugly holiday sweaters our teams love to have fun. And while we work hard, we don't forget to slow down and celebrate the big things and the small things together.

data.title: Junior Software Engineer
data.description:
Cin7 is a fast-growing global software company that provides solutions for modern-day product sellers. We help these sellers keep track of their inventory at scale, and help them sell their products across multiple sales channels around the world. 

Cin7 is expanding very quickly with a mission to become the leading Inventory Management Software brand in the world, and we are looking for a motivated and driven individual to join the team. 

Cin7 India is proud of our culture and has been officially recognised with Great Place to Work® CertificationTM. 

How You'll Make An Impact

At Cin7, we are transforming the way businesses manage inventory, sales, and operations to make it cheaper, faster, and easier for businesses all over the world to get their products into their customers' hands. 

We're looking for a Junior Software Engineer to join our engineering team and grow with us. This role focuses on . NET development across . NET Framework, . NET, and ASP. NET MVC applications, with some frontend work using JavaScript, HTML, and CSS. You'll work on our cloud-based SaaS inventory management software, learn from experienced engineers, and use AI tools to help you work faster and build stronger skills. 

This position requires that you reside in Ahmedabad or Pune, India. 

What You'll Do

- Build and maintain features in our cloud-based SaaS inventory management software using . NET technologies. 
 - Work across the application, database, and frontend layers, including writing API-driven features, writing SQL queries, making UI updates, and working with forms and page layouts. 
 - Use AI tools to support code generation, debugging, testing, and code review, while ensuring you understand, validate, and take responsibility for the code you contribute. 
 - Collaborate with product managers, designers, and other developers to understand requirements and deliver solutions. 
 - Write and maintain unit and integration tests for the features you build. 
 - Participate in code reviews by reviewing other devs' code, learning from feedback, and gradually developing the ability to identify potential issues and suggest improvements. 
 - Learn from senior engineers and grow toward taking on more complex, end-to-end work over time. 
 - Participate in the exploration and implementation of AI-powered features alongside senior engineers. 

What You'll Bring

- A bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience. 
 - Some practical experience with software development through internships, personal projects, university projects, or professional work. 
 - Hands-on experience with C# and . NET, including ASP. NET MVC or . NET Framework applications. 
 - Familiarity with AI-powered development tools and an interest in using them to improve productivity and code quality. 
 - Working knowledge of SQL, including writing queries and working with relational databases such as SQL Server. 
 - Understanding of HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, including DOM manipulation and working with API responses. 
 - Familiarity with web fundamentals, including HTTP, REST APIs, and client-server communication. 
 - Basic understanding of unit testing and version control with Git. 
 - Strong communication skills and a willingness to ask questions and learn. 

It's a Nice To Have If You Bring

- Experience building or integrating AI or LLM-powered features, such as calling LLM APIs or working with retrieval-based workflows. 
 - Experience on cloud-based SaaS products, particularly on Microsoft Azure. 
 - Exposure to CI/CD pipelines or agile development environments. 

Why work at Cin7?

- We are a fast growing business going through a huge amount of growth. 
 - You'll have the opportunity to work on products that are used by our global customer-base and at the same time you'll be growing your career and developing new skills. 
 - Hybrid work environment
 - Work From Anywhere for 30 days in a six month period
 - Celebrate your birthday with a paid day off
 - A Global Cin7 Day celebrated companywide, providing you a dedicated holiday to focus on your own wellbeing. 
 - Recruitment referral bonus
 - Work for a Great Place to Work®

₹22, 00, 000 - ₹29, 00, 000 a year

Why CIN7?

CIN7 is a leader in one of the most exciting software verticals right now, and we're growing exponentially. We're looking to add people to our team who are passionate about working with a fast growth tech company. 

At CIN7, we make great products available to everyone. Every month, millions of sales orders flow through our platform reducing the cost, effort and time for product sellers so they can quickly get products to customers and build their brands without worrying about their operations. We pride ourselves on providing Inventory Management and Supply Chain software to help medium-large product businesses thrive in a highly competitive, digital world. CIN7 centrally manages inventory across multiple locations and channels, connecting 500+ systems to support receiving, selling and shipping stock. 

We value diversity at Cin7, and bring people into the heart of everything we do. We hire, recruit, and promote without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, pregnancy or maternity, veteran status or any other status protected by applicable law. We understand the importance of creating a safe and comfortable work environment and encourage individualism and authenticity in every member of our team. 

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

data.title: VP, Engineering
data.description:
PFI Innovation Centre India is an exciting new innovation center. We're building a future that helps people live better lives longer - and we're looking for bold thinkers and team players to help us do it. 

Here, you'll tackle complex challenges, collaborate with brilliant minds across the globe, and grow your career while helping millions achieve financial security. 

a Purpose Driven Company - 150 Years

While the PFI Innovation Centre brand is new to India, you'll be a part of the Prudential Financial, Inc. family. Founded in Newark, NJ, we serve 50 million customers across more than 50 countries. With $1. 334 trillion in assets, we're a global leader in institutional asset management. The 2nd largest life insurer in the US and the 9th largest institutional global asset manager. 

At the PFI Innovation Centre India, you'll find high-performance culture that's flexible, collaborative, and grounded in respect. We engage with candor, take calibrated risks, and hold ourselves accountable - always focused on delivering for our customers. It's the standard we choose every day as we grow, perform, and win as one team. We offer valuable leadership, mentoring and learning opportunities, paired with flexibility and support to help you thrive. 

Whether you're just starting out or ready to take your next step, we'll help you grow with purpose and do the best work of your career. 

What You Will Do

We are building a new AI-native, product-led engineering organization at Prudential Japan and are looking for VPs of Engineering who want to help define the future of technology, engineering talent, and business transformation. 

This role is responsible for leading one or more major functional remits within Japan Product Engineering. VPs of Engineering will lead Directors of Engineering, senior technical leaders, and product-aligned engineering teams to modernize legacy systems, redesign business workflows, and deliver AI-enabled capabilities that improve customer experience, operational efficiency, risk reduction, and business growth. 

This is not a traditional offshore delivery leadership role. We are looking for senior builder-leaders who combine engineering depth, product thinking, AI adoption, organizational leadership, and executive influence. The VP of Engineering will help establish the Global Capability Center (GCC) as a strategic extension of Prudential Japan Technology, building long-term engineering capability, talent density, and modern product engineering practices. 

What You Can Expect

Japan Technology Transformation & Business Growth

- Lead one or more major functional remits that accelerate Prudential Japan's Technology Transformation initiative
 - Partner with business, product, design, architecture, security, data, AI, platform, and technology leaders to modernize platforms, simplify legacy complexity, and improve how the business operates
 - Drive adoption of AI-enabled products and workflows that improve customer experience, employee productivity, distribution effectiveness, operational efficiency, and risk management

Product Engineering Leadership

- Own strategy, execution, talent, and engineering outcomes for one or more major functional domains
 - Lead Directors of Engineering, senior engineers, and technical leaders across product-aligned and platform-aligned teams
 - Define the engineering roadmap, operating model, delivery standards, and capability-building agenda for the assigned remit
 - Ensure teams focus on business outcomes, customer value, engineering quality, operational excellence, and long-term sustainability
 - Translate Japan business and technology priorities into scalable engineering plans that can be executed effectively from the GCC

AI-First Engineering

- Define and scale practical AI-first engineering practices across the functional remit
 - Drive adoption of AI throughout the software development lifecycle, including design, coding, testing, documentation, release management, observability, and operations
 - Help teams identify opportunities to embed AI into products, customer journeys, employee workflows, and business processes
 - Improve engineering productivity, quality, speed, and developer experience through responsible use of AI-assisted engineering
 - Foster an AI-native mindset where teams challenge legacy processes, redesign work, and continuously improve how technology is built and operated
 - Ensure AI adoption is balanced with security, compliance, privacy, model risk, and enterprise governance expectations

Engineering Excellence

- Establish and reinforce modern software engineering practices, including agile product delivery, DevSecOps, CI/CD, automated testing, observability, and secure-by-design development
 - Provide senior technical leadership across architecture, platform design, engineering standards, and production quality. 
 - Ensure solutions are scalable, resilient, maintainable, secure, and supportable in production
 - Drive measurable improvements in engineering productivity, system reliability, product quality, delivery predictability, and operational resilience
 - Balance speed, quality, risk, cost, and long-term technology sustainability

Build and Scale the GCC Engineering Organization

- Recruit, develop, and retain high-caliber engineering leaders and technical talent across full-stack, front-end, AI, cloud, data, platform, cybersecurity, and other engineering disciplines
 - Build a strong leadership bench of Directors of Engineering, technical leads, and future engineering managers
 - Establish scalable engineering operating rhythms, governance, metrics, and talent practices as the GCC grows
 - Create a culture centered on accountability, engineering excellence, continuous learning, innovation, customer outcomes, and responsible AI adoption
 - Help position the GCC as a strategic talent engine and execution partner for Prudential, not merely a delivery location

Talent, Culture & Leadership Development

- Build high-performing engineering teams with strong talent density, ownership, and product mindset
 - Coach Directors of Engineering and technical leaders to operate as product and technology leaders, not delivery managers
 - Develop future technical leaders and engineering executives for Prudential
 - Foster a culture aligned to Product Engineering's tenets: 
 - AI-First, Human-Led
 - Outcomes Over Projects
 - Standardize Before Customize
 - Builders Own the Outcome
 - Secure by Design
 - Raise the Bar Every Day

Delivery, Vendor & Workforce Transformation

- Support Prudential's strategy to reduce dependency on external vendors while increasing internal capability and institutional knowledge
 - Lead transition of selected work from external partners into sustainable internal engineering teams
 - Ensure vendors operate as integrated members of product and engineering teams, with clear accountability for shared outcomes
 - Improve engineering productivity, delivery predictability, quality, and vendor effectiveness
 - Build internal capabilities that allow Prudential Japan to move faster, retain critical knowledge, and reduce long-term operational risk

Experience

What you will bring: 

- 15+ years of technology leadership experience in large, complex organizations
 - Proven experience building and scaling high-performing engineering teams or organizations
 - Experience leading Directors, engineering managers, and distributed engineering teams
 - Strong track record delivering modern digital products, platforms, modernization programs, or enterprise technology transformation
 - Experience operating across global teams and partnering with business stakeholders, product teams, and other functions
 - Experience managing hybrid delivery models with internal teams and strategic vendor partners
 - Experience in financial services, insurance, or regulated industries preferred but not required

Technical Background

- Strong software engineering foundation with experience in one or more modern technology stacks
 - Experience with cloud-native technologies, APIs, microservices, and modern application architectures
 - Experience making architecture, platform, and technical design decisions for complex enterprise systems
 - Familiarity with DevOps, CI/CD, automated testing, observability, and software engineering best practices
 - Understanding of AI-assisted software development and emerging AI technologies
 - Experience building scalable, secure, and resilient enterprise systems

Capabilities

- Senior people leadership, coaching, and organizational development skills
 - Strong product and outcome-oriented mindset
 - Ability to connect engineering decisions to business value, customer outcomes, operational efficiency, and risk reduction
 - Strong executive communication, stakeholder management, and organizational influence
 - Ability to operate effectively in complex, fast-changing environments
 - Ability to build trust across teams, business stakeholders, and vendor partners
 - Passion for engineering excellence, responsible AI adoption, continuous improvement, and talent development

Culture and Leadership Expectations

What will set you apart?

- Act as One Prudential by collaborating across teams, geographies, and domains
 - Drive Change by challenging legacy ways of working and embracing modern engineering and AI-enabled practices
 - Be Highly Accountable for business outcomes, engineering quality, talent development, operational excellence, and customer impact
 - Engage with Candor through open communication, transparent decision-making, and constructive challenge
 - Demonstrate core values: Worthy of Trust, Customer Focused, Respect for Each Other, and Winning with Integrity
 - PFI Innovation Centre India welcomes all applicants, even if you don't meet every requirement. If your skills align with the role, we encourage you to apply.

data.title: Senior Quality Assurance Automation Engineer
data.description:
Senior SDET / SDET - II

Location: Bangalore, India

Experience: 4+ Years

Company Background

zenda is a financial technology partner to schools, colleges, and nurseries, building products exclusively for the education sector. We help institutions improve collection efficiency, digitise all payments, and offer flexibility to parents and guardians. 

Launched in 2021, zenda is present in 40% of all UAE K-12 schools and 500+ schools across markets, serving 150, 000+ parents across the Middle East and Southeast Asia, and on track to process USD 1B+ in transactions annually. We partner with leading global networks and are actively expanding across Europe and Southeast Asia. 

zenda is backed by leading VCs including the $1. 5bn Saudi Technology Venture and Global Founders Capital, and is seamlessly integrated with 70+ local, regional, and global SIS and ERP systems. 

The Role

We are looking for a highly skilled and hands-on Senior Automation Engineer / Senior SDET to build scalable automation solutions and drive quality engineering practices across enterprise applications and modern distributed systems. 

This role is ideal for someone passionate about automation, engineering excellence, developer productivity, and modern testing practices in fast-paced Agile environments. You will work closely with engineering, DevOps, product, and platform teams to ensure high-quality software delivery through automation-first and AI-assisted quality engineering approaches. 

We are a small, high-ownership engineering team. What you build here will directly shape the reliability and velocity of zenda's platform as we scale across new markets. 

Key Responsibilities

- Design and maintain scalable automation frameworks across web, mobile, APIs, and microservices
 - Drive automation coverage across functional, integration, regression, and end-to-end testing
 - Test APIs, microservices, and distributed/event-driven systems, including contract and integration validation
 - Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines and troubleshoot pipeline failures
 - Support performance, load, and reliability testing for enterprise applications
 - Leverage AI-assisted testing tools to improve test effectiveness and reduce manual effort
 - Contribute to engineering best practices and mentor junior automation engineers

Requirements

- 4+ years of experience in Test Automation, Software Testing, or Quality Engineering, with strong hands-on experience building and maintaining automation frameworks
 - Strong programming skills in Java, Python, TypeScript, JavaScript, or similar languages
 - Hands-on experience with automation tools such as Playwright, Cypress, Selenium, Appium, or equivalent

Description

The Experience

You will be a Senior Manager of Software Engineering leading a team of 8 to 10 engineers. Your team builds the "Anomaly Alerting" platform. This is a smart system that watches for strange changes in data and sends out warnings. Your job is to guide the people, own the system, and help make our warning alerts smarter and more automatic. 

What You'll Actually Be Doing

- Day-to-day work: You will make sure our alerting system is fast, strong, and does not break as it grows. You will lead projects that make the system do the hard work so other teams don't have to set up alerts by hand. 
 - Leading the way: You will manage 1 to 2 teams (8 to 10 engineers). You will build a happy, helpful culture where people work well together. 
 - Working together: You will partner with other tech teams and groups across Salesforce (like Slack and Sales Cloud) so they can find and fix problems much faster. You will also speak for your team in meetings and work closely with our teams in the US. 
 - Early goals & impact: In your first 60 to 90 days, you will learn the ropes, start leading in meetings, team up with the US groups, and make a real difference on our biggest goals. 

You're Our Person If. . . 

- You have experience being a manager and leading 8 to 10 software engineers. 
 - You know how to handle huge amounts of data and build data pipelines (ETL). 
 - You have experience running systems on big clouds like AWS or Google Cloud (GCP). 
 - You have worked with tools that monitor system health (Observability). 
 - You have some experience with Machine Learning and know how to spot strange patterns in data (Anomaly Detection). 
 - You are able to work in the office as the company requires (no travel is required for this role). 

Even Better If. . . 

- You have deep, hands-on experience building Machine Learning tools that send out alerts. 
 - You already know how to work with Salesforce products like Agentforce, Commerce Cloud, or Slack. 

Tech Stack

- Cloud & Compute: AWS, GCP, and Kubernetes (EKS/GKE) for stateless, scalable multi-cloud orchestration. 
 - Infrastructure as Code: Terraform for resilient, automated platform provisioning across environments. 
 - Edge Ingestion: OpenTelemetry (OTel) for standardized instrumentation, and Vector/Fluent Bit for high-throughput log routing. 
 - Message Buffering: Apache Kafka to ingest billions of telemetry events, ensuring durable, decoupled data pipelines. 
 - Stream Processing: Apache Flink for real-time log parsing, rolling aggregations, and anomaly detection before storage. 
 - Backend Languages: Java for building heavy stream-processing applications, supplemented by Go and Python for operators and tooling. 
 - Ad-Hoc OLAP Analytics: Apache Druid to power sub-second, interactive dashboard queries over massive historical datasets. 
 - Log & Trace Storage: ClickHouse for fast columnar event storage, natively tiered to AWS S3 / GCP Cloud Storage for cost-effective cold storage. 
 - Time-Series Metrics: VictoriaMetrics, M3DB, or Prometheus to ingest and compress millions of high-cardinality metric rollups. 
 - Visualization & Alerting: Grafana and Apache Superset for single-pane-of-glass UI, paired with Prometheus Alertmanager for incident routing. 
 - A demonstrated, genuine AI-first approach to engineering - using AI to move faster, build fluency across the stack, and contribute well beyond your core specialty. 
 - Experience using AI tools (e. g. , Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Codex, Cursor, etc. ) in development workflows. 
 - Advanced prompt engineering skills and the ability to write precise, structured prompts and cultivate the system context that makes AI outputs reliable, secure, and production-ready.

data.title: Senior Platform Engineer, Network Infrastructure
data.description:
Cloud Foundations Reliability (CFR) is part of NVIDIA's Global Network Infrastructure (GNI) organization. We deploy, integrate, and operate the Kubernetes-based platform and shared services used to provision, monitor, and operate NVIDIA's global network across data centers, colocation facilities, and cloud environments. The team owns the architecture and lifecycle of this platform, including cluster provisioning and upgrades, GitOps delivery, observability, capacity, and service enablement. We build software and automation to standardize how network platforms and services are deployed, scaled, and managed across environments. 

We are looking for a hands-on senior engineer to own the lifecycle and automation of the Kubernetes platform supporting GNI network systems. You will also provide production support for network services running on the platform, partnering with their engineering owners when issues or changes cross the platform boundary. You will take complex problems from design through production and remain accountable for the outcome. You will bring deep Kubernetes expertise and help establish consistent engineering practices across the US and Bangalore teams. This is a senior individual contributor role with end-to-end ownership and production responsibility. 

What You'll Be Doing

- Design, build, and operate the Kubernetes platform that powers GNI network automation, telemetry, and operations across data center, colocation, and cloud environments. 
 - Own the lifecycle management for GNI Kubernetes environments, including cluster onboarding, upgrades, capacity, availability, and recovery. 
 - Develop production-quality software and automation for cluster provisioning, validation, upgrades, remediation, and safe multi-cluster delivery through GitOps. 
 - Provide production support for network services hosted on the platform, working with Network Automation and service teams that retain ownership of application architecture, code, and features. 
 - Diagnose complex Kubernetes platform and hosted-service failures involving control-plane health, cluster networking, storage, scheduling, workload placement, and multi-cluster dependencies. Drive issues from initial signal through verified resolution. 
 - Define production-readiness and observability standards for the platform and hosted network services, including health signals, capacity, alerts, runbooks, and recovery. 
 - Participate in CFR's production on-call rotation, including scheduled after-hours and weekend coverage. Lead incident response and recovery, then drive corrective actions to completion. 

What We Need To See

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience. 
 - 8+ years of experience building or operating production Kubernetes platforms, network infrastructure, or distributed systems. 
 - Deep experience with Kubernetes at scale, including cluster lifecycle, upgrades, networking, storage, and recovery. 
 - Proficiency in at least one general-purpose programming language, such as Go or Python. 
 - Experience with GitOps, infrastructure as code, CI/CD, and automated production delivery. 
 - Experience deploying and supporting network automation or telemetry services on Kubernetes. 
 - Experience with production on-call, incident response, root-cause analysis, and driving corrective actions to completion. 

Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd

- Strong knowledge of IP routing, data center fabrics, and cloud networking is a great plus. 
 - Experience designing and operating large, multi-region Kubernetes fleets, including fleet-wide upgrades and recovery. 
 - Hands-on experience with Cluster API (CAPI) and Metal3 for bare-metal provisioning, cluster lifecycle, machine remediation, and upgrades. 
 - Experience building Kubernetes controllers or operators in Go using custom resources and reconciliation patterns. Experience designing or operating network automation and telemetry services on Kubernetes at global scale. 
 - Contributions to Cluster API, Metal3, or other open-source Kubernetes infrastructure projects. 

NVIDIA's deep learning platforms have made major impact to various fields is broadly used across leading academic institutions, start-ups, and industry, including the world's largest Internet companies. We need passionate, hard-working and creative people to help us take on more of these unique opportunities in deep learning cloud solutions. NVIDIA is widely considered to be one of the technology world's most desirable employers. We have some of the most forward-thinking and hard-working people in the world working for us. Are you creative and autonomous? Do you love a challenge? If so, we want to hear from you.

With more than 1, 000 customers worldwide, including a meaningful portion of the Fortune 100, Securonix operates at global scale. About The Role

We are looking for a hands-on Senior DevOps Engineer with 5+ years of experience to support customer lifecycle operations, release and feature rollouts, customer change management, and DevOps automation. The role is responsible for executing reliable production changes while improving operational efficiency through Python-based automation. The ideal candidate combines practical DevOps knowledge with disciplined execution, clear cross-functional communication, and ownership of customer-facing operational workflows. 

Key Responsibilities

- Coordinate and execute customer onboarding and offboarding activities from a DevOps perspective, including environment readiness, configuration, access enablement or removal, validation, and closure checklists. 
 - Plan and support customer release rollouts, feature enablement, minor upgrades, and production deployments with documented pre-checks, implementation steps, post-validation, and rollback plans. 
 - Manage customer change management workflows end to end, including change request creation, impact and risk assessment, approval tracking, maintenance-window scheduling, implementation evidence, and closure. 
 - Develop and maintain Python automation for repetitive operational tasks, customer lifecycle workflows, deployment orchestration, ticket updates, reporting, data validation, and health checks. 
 - Build, maintain, and improve CI/CD pipelines to make build, release, and deployment processes repeatable, traceable, and reliable. 
 - Collaborate with Engineering, QA, Release Management, Customer Success/TAM, Support, and Operations teams to coordinate changes and resolve rollout dependencies or blockers.

 - Identify manual steps and process gaps, propose improvements, and implement automation that reduces turnaround time and operational risk. 

Required Qualifications

- 5+ years of hands-on experience in DevOps, release engineering, deployment operations, platform operations, or a related role. 
 - Demonstrated experience supporting customer onboarding and offboarding activities in a SaaS, cloud, 

or enterprise software environment. 

- Experience executing release rollouts, feature enablement, upgrades, and production changes across customer environments. 
 - Working knowledge of customer change management processes, including approvals, risk assessment, maintenance windows, implementation plans, validation, rollback, and closure. 
 - Strong Python scripting and automation skills, including experience working with REST APIs, JSON/YAML, data processing, error handling, logging, and reusable modules. 
 - Experience with source control and CI/CD tools such as Git, Bitbucket/GitHub/GitLab, Jenkins, Harness, Azure DevOps, or similar platforms. 
 - Working knowledge of Linux, shell scripting, cloud platforms such as AWS/Azure/GCP, and container technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes. 
 - Good troubleshooting, analytical, documentation, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to manage multiple operational priorities. 
 - Clear communication skills and the ability to coordinate effectively with technical and customer-facing teams. 

What Success Looks Like

- Customer onboarding, offboarding, releases, and feature rollouts are completed accurately, on schedule, and with clear audit evidence. 
 - Change workflows consistently meet approval, communication, maintenance-window, validation, and closure requirements. 
 - Python automation measurably reduces manual effort, processing time, deployment risk, and repeat operational issues.

Job Overview

TE Connectivity's Signal Integrity Center of Excellence (SI COE) drives research and development to solve critical bandwidth and high-speed interconnect challenges. The SI COE delivers validated signal integrity solutions to product teams and customers through advanced simulation, rigorous analysis, and precision measurement. 

Core capabilities include detailed electrical modeling and simulation across connectors, cables, PCBs, semiconductor packages, and full systems - with a strong emphasis on model validation and correlation. The SI COE also establishes design guidelines, simulation methodologies, model quality standards, and reusable engineering workflows, while providing expert technical guidance to internal design teams and customers where signal integrity performance is paramount. 

Areas of expertise span electromagnetics, microwave/RF engineering, test and measurement, integrated circuits, packaging, and system-level simulation.

Team Leadership & Development

Technical Expertise

- Own the end-to-end solution architecture across business orchestration, warehouse execution, subsystem execution, real-time controls, UI standards, observability, and infrastructure concerns. 
 - Define the modular platform blueprint using domain-driven design, clear bounded contexts, stable APIs, and independently deployable services. 
 - Lead architectural decisions for Java and Spring Boot modernization, including migration from legacy Java technologies and reduction of technical debt. 
 - Define integration patterns between ERP/business systems, warehouse workflows, robotic subsystems, PLCs, Edge applications, HMI solutions, and the data-acquisition platform. 
 - Establish non-functional requirements for availability, scalability, latency, resilience, cybersecurity, maintainability, supportability, and upgradeability. 
 - Shape the service-based foundation, security architecture, CI/CD enablers, deployment topology, and runtime standards with the DevSecOps Lead. 
 - Provide architecture for KUKA-based robotic applications, controls interfaces, transport execution, safety-related integration, and rollout to product lines such as pallet ASRS. 
 - Guide data architecture for operational insights, KPI consumption, customer pilots, and compliant platform rollout. 
 - Produce architecture views, decision records, interface contracts, reference implementations, and modernization roadmaps. 
 - Chair design reviews and ensure that implementation teams conform to agreed principles without blocking pragmatic delivery. 
 - Evaluate technology choices and proof-of-concepts, identifying risks, dependencies, and migration paths. 
 - Mentor technical leads and developers and communicate complex trade-offs to product, delivery, operations, and business stakeholders. 

#Required experience and capabilities

- Minimum 12 years of software-engineering experience, including at least 4 years in a solution, software, or platform architecture role for distributed, industrial, automation, logistics, or similarly complex systems. 
 - Strong hands-on knowledge of Java, Spring Boot, REST/event-driven integration, modular architecture, and service decomposition. 
 - Demonstrated experience modernizing a large legacy platform through incremental releases rather than a single cutover. 
 - Strong understanding of cloud/on-premises or hybrid deployment, containers, CI/CD, observability, identity, secrets, and secure software design. 
 - Experience designing highly available systems that interact with equipment, PLCs, robotic controllers, or other operational technology is highly desirable. 
 - Working knowledge of Edge computing, web HMI, data platforms, and operational analytics. 
 - Ability to make and document architecture decisions, facilitate cross-team alignment, and balance roadmap goals with delivery constraints. 
 - Excellent written and verbal communication with both engineering and senior stakeholders. 

## Core technical skills

- Java, Spring Boot, REST APIs, messaging, and event-driven architecture
 - Microservices, modular monoliths, domain-driven design, and API governance
 - Distributed systems, integration patterns, high availability, and resilience
 - Containers, CI/CD, observability, identity and access management, and secure architecture
 - SQL/data modelling, operational data platforms, Edge computing, and web HMI concepts
 - Warehouse execution, robotic systems, PLC/control integration, and industrial automation concepts
 - Architecture modelling, technical roadmaps, interface specifications, and architecture decision records

## Success measures

- A coherent and approved target architecture with actionable transition states. 
 - Reduced coupling and technical debt while preserving operational continuity. 
 - Consistent interfaces and non-functional standards across workstreams. 
 - Architecture risks identified early and resolved before they affect pilots or releases. 
 - Successful adoption of the platform across robotic and warehouse product lines. 

## Preferred qualifications

- Bachelor's or master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Automation, or a related discipline. 
 - Experience in warehouse automation, material handling, robotics, industrial controls, or safety-related systems. 
 - Architecture or cloud certification is beneficial but not a substitute for relevant delivery experience.

The QA Manager will operationally support the daily activities including review and approval of procedures and documents for the analytical and microbiological activities, manage external audits from heath authorities and customers, support/execute internal audits, conduct check rounds to monitor the compliance of the laboratory areas and the performance of the processes and activities, review and approve quality investigations and change controls, provide quality metrics in support of quality reporting. data.title: Senior Engineer I, Software Test
data.description:
We are seeking an experienced System Integration HW & SW Test Engineer to qualify Building Management System (BMS) products and solutions, with a particular focus on system-level testing across connected, distributed, and cloud-enabled environments. 

The role combines hands-on hardware and software testing with the design and development of physical and hybrid system test environments. The successful candidate will build representative BMS test systems, integrate hardware and software components, develop structured test suites, and execute system-level qualification testing across controllers, field devices, networks, edge components, and cloud-connected services relevant to EcoStruxure Building Operation (EBO). 

The engineer will work closely with software development, hardware development, system engineering, product management, and certification specialists to identify issues early and ensure that products meet functional, system, integration, connectivity, and quality requirements. 

The role will initially have a strong focus on establishing the test environment and performing hands-on testing. Over time, the engineer will help develop repeatable test suites covering both on-premise and cloud-connected workflows, while identifying opportunities for test automation and broader regression coverage. 

Key Responsibilities

- Design, build, configure, and maintain physical system integration test environments for BMS products and solutions. 
 - Integrate hardware, software, controllers, networks, field devices, and other required system components into representative test configurations. 
 - Perform HW/SW system integration testing to verify functionality, interoperability, stability, and expected system behavior. 
 - Develop and maintain structured system-level test plans, test cases, and reusable test suites.

data.title: Sr. MLOps/GenAI Ops Engineer
data.description:
ELLKAY started out providing connectivity solutions to laboratories and within a few years, grew to also provide data management solutions to ambulatory organizations. ELLKAY is now a trusted data management partner in five healthcare segments. ELLKAY's solutions continue to serve laboratories and ambulatory practices and have expanded to empower hospitals and health systems, healthcare IT vendors, ambulatory practices, health plans, and other healthcare organizations with cutting-edge technologies and solutions that drive their growth and interoperability strategies. 

Today, ELLKAY remains true to our core values, building strong partner relationships and offering unparalleled service and support while providing innovative, scalable solutions to the challenges our customers face in today's data-rich world. 

ELLKAY's experience, customer-focused approach, and reputation for innovation, speed, and accuracy differentiate ELLKAY as a premier partner for your interoperability needs and data management strategy. 

Job Description

Ellkay is looking for an MLOps/GenAIOps Engineer to own the end-to-end machine learning operations lifecycle. This role focuses on automating model training, evaluation, deployment, and monitoring workflows while partnering closely with our Full Stack AI/ML Engineers to ensure seamless production deployment of foundation models and classical ML systems. You'll build the infrastructure that enables rapid, safe iteration on AI/ML solutions that impact patient care. 

Essential Duties & Responsibilities

AWS SageMaker Operations & Orchestration

- Design and implement SageMaker Pipelines with complex DAG authoring for end-to-end ML workflows including data preprocessing, training, evaluation, and deployment
 - Configure and optimize SageMaker Processing Jobs, Training Jobs (PyTorch/HuggingFace containers), and Managed Spot Instances for cost-effective model training
 - Manage SageMaker Model Registry with versioning, lineage tracking, and approval workflows for model governance
 - Implement sophisticated endpoint deployment strategies including blue/green traffic routing, canary deployments, and A/B testing configurations
 - Configure and maintain SageMaker Model Monitor for continuous data quality monitoring, model quality assessment, bias detection, and feature drift alerting

GenAI Model Lifecycle Management

- Build operational frameworks for Amazon Bedrock model deployments including provisioned throughput management, guardrail configuration, and usage monitoring
 - Implement automated evaluation pipelines for foundation model outputs with quality gates and human-in-the-loop review workflows
 - Design prompt versioning systems integrated with model registry for reproducible GenAI deployments
 - Monitor GenAI model performance including latency, cost per inference, hallucination rates, and guardrail trigger metrics

Model Lifecycle Automation

- Develop automated retraining trigger systems based on data drift, performance degradation, scheduled intervals, or manual triggers
 - Implement evaluation gates as code with configurable thresholds for metrics (F1, precision, recall, AUC, etc. ) before model promotion
 - Build automated model promotion workflows from dev → staging → prod with approval gates and rollback capabilities
 - Design rollback automation with traffic shifting strategies to quickly revert to previous model versions upon performance degradation

Training Data Engineering

- Build AWS Glue ETL pipelines for training corpus assembly, transformation, and feature engineering at scale
 - Design dataset versioning systems using S3 + manifest files ensuring reproducibility and lineage tracking across model training runs
 - Establish reproducibility patterns including seed management, environment pinning, and deterministic data splitting

Container Engineering & Registry Management

- Build optimized Docker containers for training and inference workloads with multi-stage builds, layer caching, and security scanning
 - Manage Amazon ECR repositories with lifecycle policies, image scanning, and vulnerability remediation workflows
 - Implement bring-your-own-container (BYOC) patterns for SageMaker supporting custom frameworks and dependencies
 - Optimize container startup times and resource utilization for cost-effective inference

ML Observability & Monitoring

- Design comprehensive CloudWatch dashboards for model health including accuracy, latency, throughput, error rates, and drift metrics
 - Implement custom CloudWatch metrics for business-specific KPIs (e. g. , clinical accuracy per condition, false positive rates for critical alerts)
 - Build alerting systems for accuracy regression, data drift, concept drift, and model staleness with appropriate escalation paths
 - Create observability frameworks that integrate with AWS X-Ray for end-to-end request tracing from API call through model inference

CI/CD for ML Artifacts

- Design and implement GitHub Actions or AWS CodePipeline workflows for automated ML artifact testing, validation, and deployment
 - Build multi-stage promotion pipelines (dev → staging → prod) with automated testing gates and manual approval checkpoints
 - Implement artifact versioning and lineage tracking for models, datasets, feature transformations, and deployment configurations
 - Create integration testing frameworks for ML APIs including performance benchmarking and regression testing

Infrastructure & Compliance

- Collaborate with Full Stack AI/ML Engineers to define infrastructure requirements and translate them into production-grade AWS CDK constructs
 - Implement HIPAA-compliant ML pipelines with appropriate encryption, access controls, audit logging, and data residency requirements
 - Design multi-tenant ML infrastructure with tenant isolation, resource quotas, and cost allocation
 - Ensure reproducibility and auditability of all ML experiments and deployments for regulatory compliance

Qualifications

Technical Skills

- AWS SageMaker Expertise: Deep hands-on experience with SageMaker Pipelines, Processing/Training Jobs, Model Registry, Endpoints, Model Monitor, and Managed Spot training
 - AWS Bedrock & GenAI Operations: Production experience managing Amazon Bedrock deployments including Claude family models, Titan Embeddings v2, and Bedrock Guardrails (PHI/PII detection); expertise in provisioned throughput vs on-demand capacity management, model evaluation automation, prompt versioning and registry integration, inference monitoring (latency, cost, token usage), and guardrail performance tracking; ability to build automated quality gates for foundation model outputs
 - AWS ML Services: Proficiency with AWS Glue ETL, Bedrock, S3, ECR, CloudWatch, and Step Functions
 - Container Technologies: Strong Docker skills including multi-stage builds, optimization techniques, and container orchestration
 - Python Programming: Proficient in Python for pipeline orchestration, data processing, and automation scripts (boto3, sagemaker SDK, pandas/polars)
 - CI/CD Tools: Experience with GitHub Actions, AWS CodePipeline, or similar CI/CD platforms for ML workflows
 - Infrastructure as Code: Familiarity with AWS CDK, CloudFormation, or Terraform for ML infrastructure provisioning
 - ML Fundamentals: Solid understanding of ML training concepts, evaluation metrics, hyperparameter tuning, and model validation techniques
 - Observability: Experience building custom metrics, dashboards, and alerting systems for production ML systems

Experience

- 8+ years of software/data engineering experience with at least 3 years focused on MLOps or production ML systems
 - Proven track record of building automated ML pipelines and deployment workflows at scale
 - Experience with model monitoring, drift detection, and automated retraining systems
 - Healthcare or regulated industry experience strongly preferred
 - Demonstrated ability to operationalize both classical ML and foundation model systems

Soft Skills

- Strong collaboration skills to work closely with Full Stack AI/ML Engineers, data scientists, and platform teams
 - Systems thinking with ability to design reliable, fault-tolerant ML infrastructure
 - Excellent troubleshooting and debugging skills for complex distributed systems
 - Commitment to automation, reproducibility, and engineering excellence
 - Strong documentation skills for runbooks, architecture decisions, and operational procedures

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with Amazon Bedrock operational patterns and GenAI model monitoring
 - Familiarity with PyTorch, HuggingFace Transformers, and deep learning training workflows
 - Knowledge of FHIR, HL7 v2, and healthcare data standards
 - Experience with cost optimization strategies for ML workloads (Spot instances, autoscaling, model optimization)
 - Contributions to open-source MLOps tools or frameworks
 - AWS certifications (Machine Learning Specialty, Solutions Architect, or DevOps Engineer)

Additional Information

ELLKAY is committed to fostering a collaborative and high-performance work environment that supports innovation, teamwork, and professional growth. Most roles are designed to operate from our office locations to encourage effective collaboration and engagement across teams. 

Any alternative work arrangements may be considered at the company's discretion based on role requirements and business needs. 

For more information about our company, please visit www. ELLKAY. com .

data.title: Lead QA (Test Automation, APIs, Robotics & Industrial Systems)
data.description:
Job Requirements

At Quest Global, it's not just what we do but how and why we do it that makes us different. With over 25 years as an engineering services provider, we believe in the power of doing things differently to make the impossible possible. Our people are driven by the desire to make the world a better place-to make a positive difference that contributes to a brighter future. We bring together technologies and industries, alongside the contributions of diverse individuals who are empowered by an intentional workplace culture, to solve problems better and faster. 

## Role purpose

The Lead QA will own the quality strategy and verification approach for the Next Generation Platform. The role leads risk-based testing across software services, robotic controls, PLC integration, Edge/HMI, data acquisition, deployment pipelines, and end-to-end warehouse workflows, ensuring releases are fit for pilot and production use. 

## Key responsibilities

- Define and maintain the program quality strategy, test architecture, quality gates, traceability model, and release-acceptance criteria. 
 - Lead QA planning across unit, component, contract, API, integration, system, end-to-end, regression, performance, resilience, security, usability, and upgrade testing. 
 - Establish automation frameworks and reusable test assets for Java/Spring Boot services, APIs, web HMI, data flows, and deployment validation. 
 - Design simulation, emulation, hardware-in-the-loop, and test-environment approaches for PLCs, robot controllers, material flow, and equipment-dependent scenarios. 
 - Validate robotic transport execution, controls integration, fault recovery, operational workflows, and safety-related interfaces in collaboration with controls and safety specialists. 
 - Build coverage for modernization risks such as behavioral compatibility, data migration, service extraction, API versioning, and mixed legacy/new deployments. 
 - Partner with Product and Engineering to make requirements testable and define clear acceptance criteria early. 
 - Manage defect triage, root-cause analysis, escape analysis, quality reporting, and corrective/preventive actions. 
 - Lead readiness assessments for pilots, product-line rollouts, customer deployments, and release stabilization. 
 - Integrate automated tests and evidence into CI/CD pipelines with the DevSecOps Lead. 
 - Mentor QA engineers and promote shared quality ownership across development teams. 
 - Ensure test evidence and documentation meet applicable organizational, customer, security, and safety expectations. 

## Required experience and capabilities

- Minimum 8 years of software quality-engineering experience, including at least 2 years leading QA for complex integrated products or platforms. 
 - Strong experience designing test strategies and automation for APIs, distributed services, UI applications, and data integrations. 
 - Proficiency with modern automated testing practices and CI/CD integration; ability to guide framework selection and write/review test code. 
 - Experience with performance, resilience, failure-recovery, and non-functional testing for operationally critical systems. 
 - Strong defect analysis, risk assessment, reporting, and stakeholder communication skills. 
 - Experience testing warehouse automation, robotics, PLC/control systems, embedded/Edge products, or other cyber-physical systems is highly desirable. 
 - Understanding of Java/Spring Boot architectures, service contracts, databases, messaging, observability, and secure-development practices. 
 - Ability to coordinate test teams, environments, equipment, and dependencies across multiple workstreams and releases. 

## Core technical skills

- Test strategy, risk-based testing, quality gates, and release-readiness assessment
 - API, UI, integration, system, end-to-end, regression, and data-validation testing
 - Test automation for Java/Spring Boot services, REST APIs, and web applications
 - Performance, resilience, recovery, security, and compatibility testing
 - CI/CD test integration, automated reporting, traceability, and defect analytics
 - Service virtualization, simulation, emulation, and hardware-in-the-loop testing
 - Robotics, PLC/control systems, Edge/HMI, warehouse workflows, and industrial integration concepts

## Success measures

- Release decisions supported by objective quality evidence and transparent residual risk. 
 - High automated regression coverage with reliable execution in delivery pipelines. 
 - Reduced escaped defects and faster detection and diagnosis of integration failures. 
 - Production-representative validation of equipment, controls, platform, HMI, and data workflows. 
 - Predictable pilot and rollout quality with effective stabilization and learning loops. 

## Preferred qualifications

- Bachelor's or master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Automation, or a related discipline. 
 - Relevant testing certification or equivalent practical experience. 
 - Familiarity with functional-safety validation boundaries; formal safety sign-off remains with appropriately qualified safety personnel. 

We are known for our extraordinary people who make the impossible possible every day. Questians are driven by hunger, humility, and aspiration. We believe that our company culture is the key to our ability to make a true difference in every industry we reach. We wholeheartedly believe in the diversity of thought that comes with fostering a culture rooted in respect, where everyone belongs, is valued, and feels inspired to share their ideas. We know embracing our unique differences makes us better, and that solving the worlds hardest engineering problems requires diverse ideas, perspectives, and backgrounds. We shine the brightest when we tap into the many dimensions that thrive across over 21, 000 difference-makers in our workplace.

data.description:
Quality Assurance Engineer

A Fortune 200 company building its Global Capability Centre (GCC) in India

Location: Remote (India)

About the Company

A Fortune 200 company is building its Global Capability Centre (GCC) in India and has partnered with Flexiple to hire a quality assurance engineer to protect release quality. You will be the last line of defence between a bug and a customer. Flexiple is a managed marketplace that helps global companies build high-performing teams and GCCs in India. 

Role Overview

We are seeking an experienced System Integration HW & SW Test Engineer to qualify Building Management System (BMS) products and solutions, with a particular focus on system-level testing and UL 864 certification readiness. 

The role combines hands-on hardware and software testing with the design and development of physical system test environments. The successful candidate will build representative BMS test systems, integrate hardware and software components, develop structured test suites, and execute system-level qualification testing. 

A key responsibility will be preparing products and systems for UL 864 certification through comprehensive pre-certification testing, as well as executing applicable self-certification and internal qualification testing. 

The engineer will work closely with software development, hardware development, system engineering, product management, and certification specialists to identify issues early and ensure that products meet functional, system, and certification requirements. 

The role will initially have a strong focus on establishing the test environment and performing hands-on testing. Over time, the engineer will develop repeatable test suites and identify opportunities for test automation, either implementing automation directly or working together with test automation and software development colleagues. 

Key Responsibilities

- Design, build, configure, and maintain physical system integration test environments for BMS products and solutions.

 - Perform HW/SW system integration testing to verify functionality, interoperability, stability, and expected system behavior. 
 - Develop and maintain structured system-level test plans, test cases, and reusable test suites. 
 - Perform pre-certification testing to identify issues before formal UL 864 certification activities. 
 - Execute applicable self-certification, qualification, and compliance test activities.

 - Reproduce, analyze, document, and communicate defects discovered during system testing.

 - Maintain test configurations and ensure that test setups are repeatable and representative of intended product configurations. 
 - Document test results and provide clear evidence of system behavior and compliance. 
 - Identify opportunities for test automation and develop test cases with automation in mind. 
 - Automate suitable system tests directly or collaborate with software developers and test automation engineers to implement automated testing.
