data.description:
About The Team / Role

As a Director, Data Platform Engineering, you will be the primary leader and visionary for the core data infrastructure that powers the entire enterprise. This is a "platform-as-a-product" role; your mission is to lead the team building the internal foundation-creating the high-performance engines, abstraction layers, and self-service frameworks that enable hundreds of other engineers to move faster. You will manage a team operating at the intersection of Systems Programming and Data Engineering, solving "hard-tech" problems like automated schema evolution, multi-engine compute optimization, and global data discovery. As a top-level technical leader, you will bridge the gap between long-term business strategy and engineering execution, ensuring WEX's data platform remains a competitive advantage. 

Is this role for you?

- YES, if: You are an Engineering Manager or Lead Backend/Software Engineer who loves leading teams that solve "Big Data" problems, build APIs for data discovery, and optimize distributed systems. 
 - NO, if: Your primary expertise is managing teams that write SQL queries, build Tableau dashboards, or manage ETL workflows without deep experience in Java or Python system architecture. 

How You'll Make An Impact

- Strategic Roadmap & Sovereignty: Define and execute the 3-5 year technical roadmap for the Data Lakehouse. You will guide your team in deciding how storage, compute, and metadata layers (e. g. , Apache Polaris, Unity Catalog or Datahub Catalog) interact at an elemental level. 
 - Platform-as-a-Product Delivery: Lead the development of internal SDKs, CLI tools, and automated orchestration frameworks. Your goal is to ensure your team abstracts away cloud complexity via Control Planes and Custom Operators, allowing Data Engineers to focus on business logic rather than infrastructure boilerplate. 
 - Internal R&D Management: Champion and resource prototyping and benchmarking of emerging technologies (e. g. , specialized Spark extensions) to keep the platform at the bleeding edge of performance and cost-efficiency. 
 - Global Governance & Security: Oversee the architecture of "compliance-by-design" systems. Ensure the team automates data lineage, PII masking, and fine-grained access control across petabyte-scale environments without sacrificing developer velocity. 
 - AI Governance Lake: Facilitate real-time data ingestion by implementing streaming support for Open Telemetry data from AI Agents into the Data Lake, drive the development of advanced AI evaluation metrics and reporting. 
 - Engineering Excellence & Delivery: Set the gold standard for code quality and system design across the company. You will oversee Cross-Functional Architecture Reviews and ensure your team effectively resolves the most complex system outages or performance bottlenecks. 
 - Team Leadership & Mentorship: Hire, mentor, and grow a world-class engineering team. Foster an "Engineering Community, " influencing the hiring bar and professional development paths for the entire data engineering organization. 

Experience You Will Bring

- Experience: 15+ years in software engineering and distributed systems, with at least 4 years of experience managing high-performing engineering teams delivering platform-scale initiatives. 
 - Core Technical Competencies (Software Engineering Focus): 
 - Strong Software Foundations: Deep understanding of software engineering, system architecture, and scalable production applications (Algorithms, Data Structures, and System Design). Experience in the Java/J2EE ecosystem (Spring Boot, Microservices) and Python. We are looking for a leader who ensures their team writes clean, testable, and high-performance code, not just scripts. 
 - Data as a Product: Experience managing or building the platforms / framework engines and APIs that power data movement, rather than just building the ETL/ELT pipelines themselves. 
 - Data Lakehouse Mastery: 
 - Deep understanding of Apache Iceberg, Hudi, or Delta Lake (metadata management, manifest files, and compaction strategies). 
 - Experience managing teams contributing to or deeply customizing open-source data projects (e. g. , Spark, dbt). 
 - Cloud & Infrastructure: 
 - Extensive experience with cloud architecture and services, including AWS (S3, EMR, Kubernetes, Lambda) and Azure. 
 - Deep understanding of CI/CD automation, modern development tools, Git Actions, Terraform and frameworks. 
 - AI-Driven Development & Productivity: 
 - AI Native Development: Experience leveraging AI Code Gen platforms into the software development lifecycle (SDLC) to automate code generation, reviews, generate unit tests, and perform root-cause analysis of system failures. 
 - LLM-Ops for Platform: Ability to guide the architecture of infrastructure required to support AI Agent development by enabling vector database integration. 
 - Leadership & Vision: 
 - Proven track record of driving adoption of new technologies across multiple autonomous teams. 
 - Ability to communicate complex architectural trade-offs (e. g. , "Latency vs. Consistency" or "Build vs. Buy") to C-suite executives and engineering teams alike. 
 - Education: 
 - Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science (Distributed Systems focus) preferred, or equivalent deep industry experience.

Software Engineer - Platform as a Service (PaaS)

Meet the Team

Your Impact

You will contribute across the full-stack lifecycle of our platform offerings. From implementing user-facing platform portals and dashboards to building backend services that support our middleware platforms, your work will directly improve developer experience and platform reliability. You will collaborate with senior engineers and cross-functional partners to deliver high-quality features, follow engineering best practices, and grow your skills in cloud-native platform development. 

- Full Stack Development: Build and enhance platform portals and dashboards using modern frontend frameworks (React or Angular) and backend services (Python and/or Go), delivering intuitive experiences for internal platform consumers.

Minimum Qualifications

- 3+ years of software engineering experience with hands-on full-stack development across frontend and backend technologies. 
 - Experience building web applications using React or Angular, with solid understanding of JavaScript/TypeScript, HTML, and CSS.

Experience with platform engineering, API Gateways (e. g. , Mashery, Mule), or messaging systems (Kafka).

Why Cisco?

At Cisco, we're revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era - and beyond. Who We Are

We believe that open-source software, open standards and APIs are the greatest transformational tools for organizations in the modern software development era. 

Our mission at Diagrid is to provide developers with APIs and tools that help them focus on their code and not on infrastructure. As online digital services need to handle more load and run on multiple clouds or on-premises environments, programming to higher level abstractions delivers consistent, secure and reliable code that is easily portable and helps organizations de-risk their projects. 

Diagrid is founded by the creators of the Dapr and KEDA open-source projects, and who led the user experience, design and development of hyper-scale infrastructure cloud services, serverless platforms and open-source projects at Microsoft. Dapr has now achieved graduated status within the CNCF, joining renowned projects like Kubernetes, Prometheus, and Istio. 

We are backed by top VC firms and supported with industry leading investors and advisors including Joe Beda (Kubernetes Co-Founder, former Co-Founder / CTO at Heptio) Matt Klein (Creator of Envoy, Lyft), Mark Russinovich (CTO, Microsoft Azure), William Morgan (Creator of Linkerd, CEO Buoyant), Seth Vargo (Senior Staff Engineer, Google), Adam Gross (Former CEO, Heroku), Sri Viswanath (Former CTO, Atlassian), Adam Frankl (Dev Marketing Expert, Neo4J & JFrog), and Roopak Venkatakrishnan (Head of platforms, Bolt). 

About Diagrid

At Diagrid, we're building the infrastructure that helps developers build, deploy, and operate reliable, secure, and scalable applications. 

Built on the foundation of Dapr, the CNCF-graduated open-source project, Diagrid is helping engineering teams simplify the complexity of distributed systems. As AI transforms how software is built and operated, we're extending that mission to help developers take AI agents from experimentation to production with confidence. 

We're a globally distributed team of engineers and builders who care deeply about solving complex technical problems, contributing to open source, and creating products developers love. 

About The Role

We're looking for a talented Fullstack Engineer with strong Node. js and TypeScript experience to join our growing AI & DevEx team, led by Casper Nielsen. 

You'll help build the next generation of Diagrid's AI infrastructure and developer tools, working across backend services, APIs, and user-facing applications. 

This is a hands-on engineering role for someone who enjoys building products end-to-end, solving complex technical challenges, and working in a fast-moving startup environment. 

You'll work closely with engineering and product leadership to turn ideas into production-ready capabilities, with a focus on performance, reliability, scalability, and developer experience. 

What You'll Do

- Build end-to-end product features: Design, develop, and maintain fullstack applications using TypeScript, Node. js, and modern frontend frameworks. 
 - Develop scalable backend services: Build APIs, integrations, and services that power Diagrid's AI infrastructure and developer-facing products. 
 - Work on AI infrastructure: Help develop the tools and services that enable developers to build, deploy, manage, and operate AI agents reliably in production. 
 - Own features from concept to production: Participate in technical design, implementation, testing, deployment, and ongoing improvements. 
 - Create great developer experiences: Build intuitive interfaces, APIs, and workflows that make complex distributed systems easier to use. 
 - Collaborate across teams: Work closely with AI, platform, product, and engineering teams to solve technical challenges and deliver customer value. 
 - Champion engineering quality: Write clean, maintainable, well-tested code, contribute to architectural decisions, and continuously improve engineering practices. 
 - Solve challenging technical problems: Work on distributed systems, asynchronous workflows, integrations, and the reliability challenges that come with production AI applications. 

What We're Looking For

- Strong professional experience developing production applications with TypeScript and Node. js. 
 - Experience building modern web applications using React or a similar frontend framework. 
 - Solid understanding of backend architecture, REST APIs, asynchronous programming, and service integrations. 
 - Experience working with databases such as PostgreSQL, MySQL, or similar technologies. 
 - Familiarity with cloud-native development, containerization, and modern deployment practices. 
 - Understanding of software engineering fundamentals, including testing, performance, security, and maintainability. 
 - Ability to independently own technical projects and deliver high-quality solutions. 
 - Strong problem-solving skills and comfort working in an environment where requirements evolve. 
 - Clear communication skills and experience collaborating with distributed engineering teams. 
 - A product mindset and genuine interest in understanding the problems developers and customers are trying to solve. 

Nice to Have

- Experience building AI-powered applications, AI agents, or LLM integrations. 
 - Familiarity with AI frameworks, orchestration tools, or agent development patterns. 
 - Experience with distributed systems, event-driven architectures, or microservices. 
 - Knowledge of Dapr, Kubernetes, Docker, or cloud infrastructure. 
 - Experience with real-time systems, messaging, or asynchronous workflows. 
 - Contributions to open-source projects or experience working with developer-focused products. 
 - Experience working in an early-stage or high-growth technology startup. 

Working Hours

Diagrid's team works across Europe and North America. 

Our India team's day typically starts around 12: 00 PM IST, with afternoons overlapping Europe and evenings overlapping the US. You'll need to be available for a core US overlap window of 8: 30 PM to 12: 00 AM IST; outside that, you can structure your day flexibly. 

What Makes This Opportunity Exciting

Build at the intersection of AI and distributed systems. Work on real engineering challenges involved in making AI agents reliable, secure, and production-ready. 

Make a meaningful impact. Join a growing engineering team where your ideas, technical decisions, and contributions directly influence the products we build. 

Own what you build. Take responsibility for features end-to-end, from initial design through production and continuous improvement. 

Work with experienced engineers. Collaborate with a globally distributed team building infrastructure for the next generation of software. 

Help shape what's next. Be part of an ambitious company working at the forefront of cloud-native and AI application development. 

Diagrid Benefits

- Competitive compensation
 - Company equity
 - Remote first & flexible work environment
 - Flexible paid time off
 - Comprehensive healthcare for you and your dependents
 - Choice of hardware
 - $1000 for home office setup
 - Monthly WFH stipend
 - Team events & gatherings
 - Chance to collaborate with industry-leading figures

Diagrid, Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, non-disqualifying physical or mental disability, national origin, veteran status, or any other basis covered by appropriate law. All employment is decided on the basis of qualifications, merit, and business need. We embrace and celebrate differences and diversity.

data.title: Sr AI Engineer
data.description:
Your role at Dynatrace

As part of a new team focused on accelerating AI adoption, the Sr AI Engineer will design and deploy AI-powered automation and intelligent agents embedded directly into business operations. This role takes AI capabilities proven in business-function POCs and scales them into governed, production-grade solutions, using Snowflake as the enterprise data foundation and a combination of cloud services and intelligent automation platforms for orchestration and execution. 

The position partners with Data, IT, and business teams to automate workflows, support decision-making, and improve operational efficiency. The focus is on applying AI to real business processes, not research or model training. 

Key Responsibilities

AI & Copilot Development

- Build internal AI assistants, copilots, and agents for support, operations, and business teams
 - Implement Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) using Snowflake data and curated metrics
 - Ground AI responses in modeled enterprise data rather than documents alone
 - Implement prompt strategies, guardrails, and response evaluation techniques

Workflow & Intelligent Automation

- Automate operational processes such as ticket triage, routing, approvals, and document handling
 - Combine LLMs and AI agents with intelligent automation platforms (Workato, Power Automate, UiPath) to automate business processes end to end
 - Develop AI-driven classification, summarization, and recommendation services
 - Implement human-in-the-loop workflows and exception handling
 - Continuously improve workflows based on business outcomes and user feedback

Production Engineering & Integration

- Scale proven AI POCs into production-ready, supportable solutions
 - Build and maintain AI-powered backend services, APIs, and microservices
 - Integrate AI capabilities with enterprise systems (ITSM, CRM, ERP, and internal applications)
 - Troubleshoot failures across data pipelines, orchestration, and model inference layers
 - Participate in technical design and architecture discussions

Data Platform Integration

- Utilize Snowflake as the trusted data source for AI decisions
 - Use dbt models as the semantic and business logic context for automation
 - Enable real-time and batch data-driven decision support
 - Ensure AI actions align with defined business metrics and data definitions

Cloud Orchestration & Observability

- Implement serverless workflows using AWS (Lambda, Step Functions, API Gateway, S3, EventBridge)
 - Monitor system performance, latency, and reliability
 - Track AI usage, accuracy, and cost efficiency
 - Implement logging, auditing, and traceability of AI decisions

What Will Help You Succeed

- 5+ years of software or ML engineering experience, including 2+ years building LLM-based systems in production
 - Expert-level proficiency in Python, plus TypeScript or Go for full-stack AI applications
 - Hands-on experience building production RAG systems, including vector or hybrid search and re-ranking strategies
 - Experience with LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, Azure OpenAI, Gemini) and AWS services (Lambda, S3, Bedrock, SageMaker)
 - Proven track record implementing AI observability, including tracking quality, latency, usage, and cost
 - Familiarity with CI/CD and MLOps tooling (MLflow, Weights & Biases, Snowflake ML Registry)
 - Demonstrated application of responsible AI practices on live deployments, including bias checks, output validation, and human-in-the-loop escalation
 - Experience managing production incidents and model rollbacks
 - Ability to explain AI concepts and engineering trade-offs clearly to non-technical stakeholders in business terms
 - A track record of evaluating and adopting new AI tools or frameworks that deliver measurable improvement

Preferred Qualifications

- Hands-on experience building MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers and clients
 - Snowflake Cortex Search, Snowpark, or external functions in Snowflake
 - Experience with intelligent automation and workflow platforms (Workato, Power Automate, UiPath, n8n) and orchestration tools (Airflow), including integrating them with LLMs and AI agents
 - Experience with enterprise SaaS platforms (ServiceNow, Salesforce, or similar)
 - Authentication and access control concepts (OAuth, RBAC, SSO)

Why you will love being a Dynatracer

- Dynatrace is a leader in unified observability and security. 
 - We provide a culture of excellence with competitive compensation packages designed to recognize and reward performance. 
 - Our employees work with the largest cloud providers, including AWS, Microsoft, and Google Cloud, and other leading partners worldwide to create strategic alliances. 
 - You'll get to work at the forefront of innovation with Dynatrace Intelligence-the industry's first agentic operations system. Bringing together deterministic and agentic AI, it helps teams understand what's happening, why it matters, and what to do next- automatically. 
 - Over 50% of the Fortune 100 companies are current customers of Dynatrace.

data.title: Test Development Engineer
data.description:
Meet the Team

Within Cisco's Product Operations, we transform engineering innovation into products that power the internet - from enterprise networks to the world's most demanding hyper-scaler AI infrastructure. Our Manufacturing Test Development team sits at the critical intersection of design engineering and global manufacturing, ensuring that Cisco's most complex systems are launched with the highest standards of quality, efficiency, and scale. We are a cross-functional, globally connected team collaborating closely with Hardware, Software, and Supply Chain partners across multiple time zones to bring next-generation products to life. Our work directly impacts the reliability and performance of Cisco's high-end router portfolio, including our latest AI-optimized hyper-scaler platforms. If you thrive on solving hard problems at the edge of what's technically possible, this is the team for you. 

Your Impact

- As a Manufacturing Test Development Engineer, you will lead the end-to-end test strategy from Design for Testability (DFT) assessments through mass production readiness. 
 - Drive the development and deployment of board and system-level automated functional test processes at contract manufacturing sites globally, ensuring maximum test coverage and manufacturing efficiency. 
 - Develop robust Python-based test automation scripts and leverage data analytics to continuously improve test capacity, yield, and overall product quality. 
 - Serve as the expert resource for product failure analysis and fault isolation, guiding debug processes at both component and system level to accelerate resolution. 
 - Collaborate with global cross-functional teams across Hardware, Software, and Supply Chain to coordinate proto-build support and ensure seamless production ramp. 

Minimum Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics & Communication, or Computer Science Engineering. 
 - 4-8 years of relevant experience in product test and validation. 
 - Basic understanding of hardware development processes from concept through end-of-life, including manufacturing test solutions such as ICT and Boundary Scan (BSCAN). 
 - Experience working with Ethernet technologies (10/100/400/800G) and hardware protocols including I2C, SPI, PCIe, and SerDes. 
 - Basic Python scripting skills with demonstrated experience developing automated test frameworks and analytics-driven improvement processes. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Hands-on experience specifying, developing, and procuring test fixtures and traffic test solutions including Spirent or IXIA for high-speed interface validation. 
 - Experience leading Design for Testability (DFT) assessments and defining risk mitigation plans in partnership with hardware and software engineering teams. 
 - Experience supporting proto-builds and driving mass production readiness across globally distributed contract manufacturing sites. 
 - Demonstrated ability to resolve technical conflicts and make data-driven decisions in a fast-paced environment. 
 - Dedicated and adaptable, with a track record of effective collaboration across global time zones. 

Why Cisco?

At Cisco, we're revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era - and beyond. We've been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint. 

Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you'll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

data.title: Senior Software Engineer (Dapr OSS) –  Lead
data.description:
Who We Are

We believe that open-source software, open standards and APIs are the greatest transformational tools for organizations in the modern software development era. 

Our mission at Diagrid is to provide developers with APIs and tools that help them focus on their code and not on infrastructure. As online digital services need to handle more load and run on multiple clouds or on-premises environments, programming to higher level abstractions delivers consistent, secure and reliable code that is easily portable and helps organizations de-risk their projects. 

Diagrid is founded by the creators of the Dapr and KEDA open-source projects, and who led the user experience, design and development of hyper-scale infrastructure cloud services, serverless platforms and open-source projects at Microsoft. Dapr has now achieved graduated status within the CNCF, joining renowned projects like Kubernetes, Prometheus, and Istio. 

We are backed by top VC firms and supported with industry leading investors and advisors including Joe Beda (Kubernetes Co-Founder, former Co-Founder / CTO at Heptio) Matt Klein (Creator of Envoy, Lyft), Mark Russinovich (CTO, Microsoft Azure), William Morgan (Creator of Linkerd, CEO Buoyant), Seth Vargo (Senior Staff Engineer, Google), Adam Gross (Former CEO, Heroku), Sri Viswanath (Former CTO, Atlassian), Adam Frankl (Dev Marketing Expert, Neo4J & JFrog), and Roopak Venkatakrishnan (Head of platforms, Bolt). 

About Dapr

Dapr (Distributed Application Runtime) is a graduated CNCF project that helps developers build distributed, cloud-native applications. It gives them APIs for the hard parts: durable workflows, actors, service invocation, state, pub/sub, scheduled jobs and secure service-to-service communication. Dapr runs in production at companies such as Zeiss, IBM, NASA, Bosch and Lufthansa. 

About The Role

You join Diagrid's Runtime team, the engineers who build Dapr and run it inside Diagrid Catalyst. Your work lands in public, in the Dapr open source project, and in the product our customers run in production. 

You will design and ship features in the Dapr runtime, review code from the community and from your team, and help keep releases stable. Much of the current work is in durable execution (Dapr Workflows, actors and the scheduler), where correctness under failure matters more than speed. 

We build with AI every day. We look for engineers who use AI to go further and who check what it produces: you read the diff, you test the failure path, and you own the result, whoever or whatever wrote the first draft. In an open source project, reviewing and verifying code matters as much as writing it. 

You are a full member of the team: the same ownership, the same voice in design, and the same chance to grow into a Dapr maintainer as everyone else. 

Working hours

Diagrid's team works across Europe and North America. 

Our India team's day typically starts around 12: 00 PM IST, with afternoons overlapping Europe and evenings overlapping the US. You'll need to be available for a core US overlap window of 8: 30 PM to 12: 00 AM IST; outside that, you can structure your day flexibly. 

What You Will Do

- Design and build features in the Dapr runtime, from proposal to release. 
 - Review pull requests from the community and from your team. Hold the bar on correctness, tests and API design. 
 - Find and fix bugs in distributed code: race conditions, retries, partial failures, and state that must survive a crash. 
 - Write proposals and design docs in public, and respond to review on them. 
 - Take part in Dapr releases: release candidates, patch releases and security fixes. 
 - Help users and contributors on GitHub and Discord, and mentor new contributors. 

What We Look For

- 5+ years of professional Go, with production code you can explain line by line. 
 - Experience designing and running distributed systems. You know how they fail, and you design for it. 
 - 2+ years with Kubernetes and containers. 
 - A strong computer science base: concurrency, networking and data consistency. 
 - Daily, practical use of AI coding tools, and the judgment to check their output before you ship it. 
 - Clear written English. Most of our work happens in GitHub issues, pull requests and design docs, read by people across many companies and time zones. 

Leading in India

You'll be our first engineer in India, and you'll help build the team that follows. Engineers who join in India will report to technical managers on their own teams, with a dotted line to you. Their managers own their day-to-day work and performance; you're their local lead and point of contact. 

- Help hire the India team: shape the hiring process, interview candidates and help us find the right people. 
 - Onboard new engineers and help them become productive in Dapr, our codebase and how we work. 
 - Be the go-to person in India for questions, feedback and support, and raise issues to their managers when needed. 
 - Build a strong engineering culture in India that matches how we work across Diagrid: ownership, quality and working in the open. 
 - Work with leadership on India-specific topics such as hiring plans, working hours and team setup. 
 - Represent Diagrid in the local engineering and open source community, through meetups, conferences and contributor outreach. 

This role stays hands-on. Most of your time goes to engineering work on the runtime, and the leadership side grows as the team does. 

Bonus

- Merged contributions to open source Go projects, especially CNCF projects. 
 - Experience as a maintainer of an open source project. 
 - Experience with Dapr, or with workflow and durable execution engines (Temporal, Azure Durable Functions, AWS Step Functions). 
 - gRPC and Protocol Buffers. 
 - One of the other languages Dapr has SDKs for: Java, Python, JavaScript, . NET or Rust. 

Diagrid Benefits

- Competitive compensation
 - Company equity
 - Remote first & flexible work environment
 - Flexible paid time off
 - Comprehensive healthcare for you and your dependents
 - Choice of hardware
 - $1000 for home office setup
 - Monthly WFH stipend
 - Team events & gatherings
 - Chance to collaborate with industry-leading figures

Diagrid, Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, non-disqualifying physical or mental disability, national origin, veteran status, or any other basis covered by appropriate law. All employment is decided on the basis of qualifications, merit, and business need. We embrace and celebrate differences and diversity.

- This is an opportunity for a driven Software Engineer to take on an exciting new career challenge
 - Day-to-day, you'll build a wide network of stakeholders of varying levels of seniority
 - It's a chance to hone your existing technical skills and advance your career
 - We're offering this role at associate vice president level

What you'll do

In your new role, you'll engineer and maintain innovative, customer centric, high performance, secure and robust solutions. You'll be working within a feature team and using your extensive experience to engineer software, scripts and tools that are often complex, as well as liaising with other engineers, architects and business analysts across the platform. 

You'll Also Be

- Producing complex and critical software rapidly and of high quality which adds value to the business
 - Working in permanent teams who are responsible for the full life cycle, from initial development, through enhancement and maintenance to replacement or decommissioning
 - Collaborating to optimise our software engineering capability
 - Designing, producing, testing and implementing our working code
 - Working across the life cycle, from requirements analysis and design, through coding to testing, deployment and operations

The skills you'll need

You'll need a background in software engineering, software design, architecture, and an understanding of how your area of expertise supports our customers. 

You'll Also Need

- Strong background in AWS Connect, cloud technologies and cloud-native architectures with 8+ years of experience. 
 - Practitioner knowledge of software engineering best practices including Agile and DevOps frameworks. 
 - Proven ability to produce high-quality software designs and technical standards. 
 - Strong programming and analytical skills, with the awareness to learn & apply AI-driven approaches to solve complex problems. 
 - Proven expertise in creating High-Level Solution Designs (HLSDs) and Detailed Solution Designs. 
 - Proficiency in Python for platform engineering, automation, and AI/ML solution development.

data.title: Specialist, Software Development Engineering
data.description:
Calling all innovators - find your future at Fiserv. 

We're Fiserv, a global leader in Fintech and payments, and we move money and information in a way that moves the world. We connect financial institutions, corporations, merchants, and consumers to one another millions of times a day - quickly, reliably, and securely. Any time you swipe your credit card, pay through a mobile app, or withdraw money from the bank, we're involved. If you want to make an impact on a global scale, come make a difference at Fiserv. 

Job Title

Specialist, Software Development Engineering

About Your Role

We are looking for a Mid-Level Backend Engineer to build and maintain core backend services for a modern banking platform. You will work on microservices, API integrations, event-driven processing, and production-grade engineering practices in a cloud-native environment. 

What You'll Do

- Develop and maintain backend services using Java/SpringBoot/Quarkus. 
 - Build asynchronous/event-driven services using Kafka. 
 - Implement and consume REST/gRPC APIs for internal and external integrations. 
 - Design robust processing flows with retries, error handling, and observability. 
 - Work with PostgreSQL-compatible databases (including distributed SQL setups) and schema migrations. 
 - Write unit, integration, and API tests; contribute to code quality and CI/CD standards. 
 - Participate in incident troubleshooting and continuous reliability improvement. 

Experience You'll Need To Have

- 4-6 years of backend engineering experience with strong Java fundamentals. 
 - Hands-on experience with Spring Boot for microservice development. 
 - Experience with microservices and REST API development. 
 - Practical knowledge of Kafka/event-driven architecture. 
 - Working knowledge of SQL and relational databases (PostgreSQL or similar). 
 - Experience with Liquibase (or equivalent migration tooling). 
 - Familiarity with Docker and Kubernetes/OpenShift basics. 
 - Experience with automated testing (JUnit and API testing tools). 

Experience That Would Be Great To Have

- Quarkus framework experience. 
 - gRPC exposure. 
 - Domain exposure to banking/payments/financial services. 
 - Apache Camel experience. 
 - BDD testing (Cucumber), Testcontainers. 

Thank You For Considering Employment With Fiserv. Please

- Apply using your legal name
 - Complete the step-by-step profile and attach your resume (either is acceptable, both are preferable). 

Our Commitment To Diversity And Inclusion

Fiserv is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, disability, protected veteran status, or any other category protected by law. 

Note To Agencies

Fiserv does not accept resume submissions from agencies outside of existing agreements. Please do not send resumes to Fiserv associates. Fiserv is not responsible for any fees associated with unsolicited resume submissions. 

Warning About Fake Job Posts

Please be aware of fraudulent job postings that are not affiliated with Fiserv. Fraudulent job postings may be used by cyber criminals to target your personally identifiable information and/or to steal money or financial information. Any communications from a Fiserv representative will come from a legitimate Fiserv email address.

Job Description

Title: IoT Software Developer - Device Engineering Team-Husky(India) Guindy, Chennai

Id: 20963

If you are attracted to bold goals, believe in uncompromising honesty, support mutual respect, care about environmental responsibility, have a passion for excellence and a desire to make a positive contribution - then we want you to join the Husky TechnologiesTM team!

IoT Software Developer

Do you want to work on software applications that connect industrial machines, edge devices, and cloud platforms?

As an IoT Edge Software Developer within the Device Engineering Team (DET), you will contribute to the development, maintenance, and support of software running on edge devices that collect machine data, communicate securely with cloud platforms, and enable remote management at scale. You will work with Windows-based edge devices, cloud-connected applications, and device lifecycle management processes that support customers worldwide. 

This role is ideal for a developer who enjoys hands-on software development, troubleshooting complex device and connectivity issues, and working at the intersection of industrial systems, edge computing, and cloud technologies. 

If you want to build software where industrial IoT, edge computing, and cloud technologies converge, the Device Engineering Team is where it happens.

 - Contribute to the development of reliable, maintainable, and secure code within the assigned scope. 
 - Apply agreed coding standards, patterns, and best practices in daily development work.

Delivery & Execution Excellence

 - Complete development work in alignment with sprint goals and delivery commitments. 
 - Contribute to task breakdowns and effort estimates for assigned work. 
 - Proactively raise risks, blockers, or implementation issues to the team. 

Quality, Standards & Engineering Practices

- Write clean, testable code and contribute to unit and integration tests. 
 - Participate in code reviews, incorporating feedback and learning from peers. 
 - Ensure individual contributions meet Definition of Ready (DoR) and Definition of Done (DoD) criteria. 
 - Follow established DevOps, security, and quality practices. 

Incident & Operational Support

- Assist in troubleshooting defects and issues in development and production environments. 
 - Support corrective (bug fixes) and evolutive (enhancements) maintenance of existing solutions. 

Collaboration & Growth

- Collaborate effectively with other developers, QA, Product Owners, and Tech Leads. 
 - Seek feedback and guidance to continuously improve technical skills. 
 - Actively learn the systems, tools, and technologies used by the team. 
 - Contribute positively to team culture and shared ownership of outcomes. 

Qualifications

- Bachelor or Master degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field
 - Proficiency in C# and the . NET platform
 - Working knowledge of Python or other scripting languages
 - Strong understanding of Test-Driven Development (TDD)
 - Hands-on experience with Azure DevOps, Git repositories, and CI/CD pipelines
 - Familiarity with DevSecOps concepts
 - Familiarity with device communication protocols such as MQTT, OPC-UA, or similar technologies
 - Experience using AI assisted coding tools (e. g. GitHub Copilot) responsibly, with full accountability for code quality, security, and compliance. 
 - Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
 - Fluency in English, both written and spoken

Assets

- Hands-on experience with IoT, industrial automation, edge computing, or device lifecycle management
 - Experience with Azure IoTHub, DPS, Azure Functions, Azure Storage, or Azure Data Explorer
 - Experience supporting Windows based machines
 - Familiarity with OTA software and firmware update mechanisms
 - Knowledge of cybersecurity and data privacy controls for IoT environments

Why Husky?

- Regulated Working Hours: Enjoy a structured work schedule that promotes a healthy work-life balance, allowing you to excel professionally while maintaining personal well-being. 
 - Visible Impact: Experience the satisfaction of seeing the direct outcomes of your work, as you contribute to projects that visibly enhance our company's technological capabilities and efficiency. 
 - Strategic Influence: Participate in architectural and technical reviews, contributing to the strategic direction of our cloud initiatives and making a tangible impact on our company's technological landscape. 
 - Empowered Involvement: Take an active role in decision-making processes and architectural reviews, where your expertise helps shape the future of our cloud solutions and overall business strategy. 
 - Valued Contributions: Be more than just a number in a large organization; at our company, every individual's input is valued and can lead to significant, tangible improvements in our operations and services. 
 - Impactful Role: Play a crucial part in both developing new applications and maintaining existing systems, ensuring their optimal performance and reliability. 
 - Cutting-Edge Projects: Work on innovative cloud solutions that are transforming our and our customer's business, giving you the opportunity to be at the forefront of technological advancements. 
 - Supportive Community: Work in an environment that recognizes and celebrates individual achievements, fostering a sense of community and mutual respect among team members. 
 - Collaborative Environment: Join a global team of skilled professionals around the globe where your ideas are valued, and collaboration is encouraged to solve complex challenges and drive success. 

Husky TechnologiesTM offers a competitive compensation and benefits package and excellent opportunities for growth and advancement. We are committed to equal employment opportunity and respect, value and welcome diversity in our workplace. Husky TechnologiesTM also values being a great place to work and strives to maintain a safe workplace. Accordingly, Husky TechnologiesTM conditions all offers of employment on satisfactory completion of background checks. No agency or telephone inquiries please.

data.title: Sr Mgr, Quality Assurance
data.description:
Renesas is one of the top global semiconductor companies in the world. We strive to develop a safer, healthier, greener, and smarter world, and our goal is to make every endpoint intelligent by offering product solutions in the automotive, industrial, infrastructure and IoT markets. Our robust product portfolio includes world leading MCUs, SoCs, Analog and power products, plus Winning Combination solutions that curate these complementary products. We are a key supplier to the world's leading manufacturers of electronics you rely on every day; you may not see our products, but they are all around you. 

Renesas employs roughly 21, 000 people in more than 30 countries worldwide. As a global team, our employees actively embody the Renesas Culture, our guiding principles based on five key elements: Transparent, Agile, Global, Innovative, and Entrepreneurial. Renesas believes in, and has a commitment to, diversity and inclusion, with initiatives and a leadership team dedicated to its resources and values. At Renesas, we want to build a sustainable future where technology helps make our lives easier. Join us and build your future by being part of what's next in electronics and the world. 

Job Description

Job Summary: 

We are looking for an individual to lead SQE (Supplier Quality Engineering) for Assembly sites (OSAT sites). 

Key Responsibilities: 

- Supplier Quality Management & Liaison: Act as the primary quality interface between suppliers and Renesas, ensuring alignment with quality requirements, business objectives, and customer expectations. Serve as the regional SQE focal point for assigned suppliers and manufacturing sites. 
 - Quality Excursion Management & Corrective Actions: Lead investigations of quality excursions across internal operations, suppliers, and customers using structured problem-solving methodologies (e. g. , 8D), and drive effective containment, corrective actions, and preventive actions to closure. 
 - Supplier Audit, Certification & Change Control: : Plan and execute supplier audit programs, lead supplier certification activities, and ensure effective management of process, material, and site changes. 
 - Supplier Assessment, Qualification & Performance Management: Lead supplier assessments and qualifications for new subcontractors, manage supplier quality rating and performance through KPIs and scorecards, and drive improvement actions to achieve Renesas quality objectives. 
 - Continuous Improvement Leadership: Lead quality improvement initiatives, analyze quality trends and systemic risks, manage supplier escalation activities, and influence cross-functional stakeholders to drive sustainable improvements across supplier operations. 
 - Training & Best Practice Deployment: Drive supplier quality capability development through training, coaching, and deployment of best-known methods and quality management practices. 

Qualifications

Qualifications and Skills: 

Must (Required)

- Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Materials Science, Mechanical Engineering, or a related technical discipline
 - Min 10 years of experience in the semiconductor industry, including supplier quality, manufacturing, process engineering, or quality engineering
 - Strong knowledge of semiconductor assembly processes and quality control methodologies
 - Hands-on experience with 8D, 5-Why, Fishbone analysis, and other structured problem-solving methodologies
 - Knowledge and practical application of ISO9001, IATF16949, and Automotive Core Tools (APQP, PPAP, FMEA, SPC, MSA)
 - Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to collaborate effectively across functions
 - Auditing experience based on ISO9001 and IATF16949 requirementsWant (Preferred)

- Certified Lead Auditor for ISO9001 and/or IATF16949
 - Experience with advanced semiconductor packaging technologies
 - Proven ability to influence suppliers and drive quality improvements
 - Experience in regional or global supplier quality management
 - Experience leading cross-functional quality initiatives
 - Experience coaching or mentoring engineers. 

Additional Information

Renesas is an embedded semiconductor solution provider driven by its Purpose, To Make Our Lives Easier. With a global team of over 21, 000 engineers and problem solvers in more than 30 countries, we offer the opportunity to work on world‐leading technology for Automotive, Industrial, Infrastructure, and IoT, shaping a safer, healthier, greener, and smarter future. 

At Renesas, TAGIE is our culture, grounded in being Transparent, Agile, Global, Innovative, and Entrepreneurial. It shapes how we work, grow and deliver on our purpose together. This collaborative spirit and mindset drive our semiconductor technology to transform industries and impact millions of lives. 

We believe in rewarding our employees with a competitive benefits package alongside their salary. More information will be provided during the hiring process. 

Are you ready to join our team and shape the future with us?

Renesas Electronics is an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer, committed to supporting diversity and fostering a work environment free of discrimination on the basis of sex, race, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, sexual orientation, military status, veteran status, or any other basis protected by law. For more information, please read our Diversity & Inclusion Statement.

data.title: Test Manager
data.description:
Join us as a Test Manager at Barclays where you will spearhead the evolution of our infrastructure and deployment pipelines, driving innovation and operational excellence. You will harness cutting-edge technology to build and manage robust, scalable and secure infrastructure, ensuring seamless delivery of our digital solutions. 

To be successful as a Test Manager, you should have experience with: 

- Proven ability to drive quality engineering practices, automation standards, code reviews, and testing governance. 
 - Strong grasp of software testing concepts, methodologies, test strategy, planning, defect management, and QA processes. 
 - Strong analytical, problem-solving, and investigative skills, with a keen eye for spotting quality risks early. 
 - Excellent stakeholder management, communication, and collaboration with development, business, and QA teams. 
 - Experience working in Agile/Scrum delivery models, using test management tools such as Jira. 
 - Experience testing applications across functional, regression, integration, and end-to-end cycles. 
 - Proven expertise in API and web services testing . 
 - Hands-on experience designing, developing, and maintaining automation frameworks for API, UI, and end-to-end testing. 
 - Experience integrating automated tests into CI/CD pipelines and DevOps delivery processes. 
 - Core Java, with a focus on automation framework development and test engineering best practices. 
 - Selenium WebDriver, Cucumber, Karate, and other modern test automation tools. 
 - SQL for backend validation and testing. 
 - Practical experience using AI tools such as Claude, Copilot, and GitLab to design and run every test and review the outcomes. 
 - Ability to mentor engineers and drive automation-first quality engineering culture across teams. 

Some Other Highly Valued Skills May Include

- Exposure to performance and resilience testing methodologies. 
 - Experience with modern test reporting, monitoring, and quality dashboards. 
 - Familiarity with Shift-Left testing, Test-Driven Development (TDD), and Behavior-Driven Development (BDD) practices. 
 - Exposure to non-functional testing strategies. 

You may be assessed on key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen, strategic thinking and digital and technology, as well as job-specific technical skills. 

The role is based out of Pune. . 

Purpose of the role

To design, develop and improve software, utilising various engineering methodologies, that provides business, platform, and technology capabilities for our customers and colleagues. 

Accountabilities

- Development and delivery of high-quality software solutions by using industry aligned programming languages, frameworks, and tools. Ensuring that code is scalable, maintainable, and optimized for performance. 
 - Cross-functional collaboration with product managers, designers, and other engineers to define software requirements, devise solution strategies, and ensure seamless integration and alignment with business objectives. 
 - Collaboration with peers, participate in code reviews, and promote a culture of code quality and knowledge sharing. 
 - Stay informed of industry technology trends and innovations and actively contribute to the organization's technology communities to foster a culture of technical excellence and growth. 
 - Adherence to secure coding practices to mitigate vulnerabilities, protect sensitive data, and ensure secure software solutions. 
 - Implementation of effective unit testing practices to ensure proper code design, readability, and reliability. 

Vice President Expectations

- To contribute or set strategy, drive requirements and make recommendations for change. Plan resources, budgets, and policies; manage and maintain policies/ processes; deliver continuous improvements and escalate breaches of policies/procedures. . 
 - If managing a team, they define jobs and responsibilities, planning for the department's future needs and operations, counselling employees on performance and contributing to employee pay decisions/changes. They may also lead a number of specialists to influence the operations of a department, in alignment with strategic as well as tactical priorities, while balancing short and long term goals and ensuring that budgets and schedules meet corporate requirements. . 
 - If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L - Listen and be authentic, E - Energise and inspire, A - Align across the enterprise, D - Develop others. . 
 - OR for an individual contributor, they will be a subject matter expert within own discipline and will guide technical direction. They will lead collaborative, multi-year assignments and guide team members through structured assignments, identify the need for the inclusion of other areas of specialisation to complete assignments. They will train, guide and coach less experienced specialists and provide information affecting long term profits, organisational risks and strategic decisions. . 
 - Advise key stakeholders, including functional leadership teams and senior management on functional and cross functional areas of impact and alignment. 
 - Manage and mitigate risks through assessment, in support of the control and governance agenda. 
 - Demonstrate leadership and accountability for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work your team does. 
 - Demonstrate comprehensive understanding of the organisation functions to contribute to achieving the goals of the business. 
 - Collaborate with other areas of work, for business aligned support areas to keep up to speed with business activity and the business strategies. 
 - Create solutions based on sophisticated analytical thought comparing and selecting complex alternatives. In-depth analysis with interpretative thinking will be required to define problems and develop innovative solutions. 
 - Adopt and include the outcomes of extensive research in problem solving processes. 
 - Seek out, build and maintain trusting relationships and partnerships with internal and external stakeholders in order to accomplish key business objectives, using influencing and negotiating skills to achieve outcomes. 

All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship - our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset - to Empower, Challenge and Drive - the operating manual for how we behave.

Designation AIOps Manager

Job Description

- Architect and implement enterprise-grade AIOps solutions to automate incident detection, root cause analysis, and remediation across cloud and hybrid environments. 
 - Lead the integration of telemetry data from tools like Prometheus, Grafana, AppDynamics, Dynatrace, and Azure Monitor into centralized AIOps platforms for unified observability and intelligent event correlation.

data.title: Senior QA Engineer – ServiceNow
data.description:
Be the one building AI-powered experiences where they matter most. 

At Genesys, we help organizations create better customer experiences through AI-powered experience orchestration. Our platform connects people, systems, data and AI to help organizations deliver more personalized service, improve operational efficiency and build stronger customer relationships. 

Help build, support and operate technology used by more than 8, 000 organizations in over 100 countries - moving AI from possibility to production in real-world enterprise environments every day. 

This role is responsible for ensuring the quality, reliability, performance, and stability of ServiceNow solutions across the enterprise. The Senior QA Engineer partners closely with architects, engineers, administrators, business analysts, product owners, and stakeholders to define testing strategies, validate business requirements, and ensure ServiceNow implementations meet functional, integration, security, and performance expectations. 

The Senior QA Engineer serves as a quality advocate throughout the software development lifecycle, driving test automation, continuous testing, and quality engineering practices while helping reduce production defects, operational risk, and release-related issues. This role plays a critical part in supporting DevOps and CI/CD practices, ensuring quality is embedded throughout the ServiceNow delivery lifecycle. 

Key Responsibilities

- Define, develop, and execute comprehensive test strategies for ServiceNow implementations, enhancements, integrations, platform upgrades, and releases. 
 - Create and maintain test plans, test cases, test scripts, test data, and quality documentation for functional, regression, integration, system, and user acceptance testing. 
 - Lead the design, implementation, and maintenance of automated test suites using ServiceNow Automated Test Framework (ATF) to support regression testing, release validation, and platform upgrades. 
 - Establish and promote testing standards, automation best practices, and quality gates across ServiceNow development teams. 
 - Validate ServiceNow solutions across multiple modules including ITSM, ITOM, ITAM, CSM, HAM, SAM, CMDB, Discovery, Service Mapping, and related platform capabilities. 
 - Test integrations between ServiceNow and external systems, including REST APIs, IntegrationHub, web services, middleware platforms, and third-party applications. 
 - Collaborate with engineers to integrate automated testing into GitHub-based development workflows, source control processes, and CI/CD pipelines. 
 - Validate code changes, update sets, application deployments, and release packages prior to production implementation. 
 - Identify, document, prioritize, and manage defects through resolution, working closely with engineering teams to ensure root causes are addressed. 
 - Support release readiness reviews and ensure adequate test coverage for platform enhancements, integrations, and defect fixes. 
 - Validate platform upgrades, patches, releases, and configuration changes to ensure stability and minimize business disruption. 
 - Develop and maintain quality metrics, dashboards, and reports to provide visibility into testing progress, defect trends, release readiness, and overall platform quality. 
 - Participate in sprint ceremonies, release planning, and continuous improvement initiatives. 
 - Support performance, security, integration, and end-to-end testing activities as required. 
 - Experience testing ServiceNow AI capabilities, including Now Assist, Control Tower, and other platform intelligence features, is highly desirable. 
 - Fluent English is mandatory, as the role requires daily collaboration with global teams and stakeholders. 

Minimum Requirements

- 5+ years of experience in software quality assurance, quality engineering, or testing enterprise applications. 
 - 3+ years of hands-on experience testing ServiceNow implementations and platform capabilities. 
 - Strong understanding of software testing methodologies, including functional, regression, integration, system, end-to-end, and user acceptance testing. 
 - Hands-on experience with ServiceNow Automated Test Framework (ATF), including creation, maintenance, and execution of automated test suites. 
 - Experience testing ServiceNow modules such as ITSM, ITOM, ITAM, CSM, HAM, SAM, CMDB, Discovery, Service Mapping, or related applications. 
 - Experience validating integrations using REST APIs, IntegrationHub, web services, and external platforms. 
 - Experience using Jira, Confluence, GitHub, or similar tools for Agile delivery, defect management, source control, and release management. 
 - Understanding of CI/CD pipelines, automated testing practices, and DevOps methodologies. 
 - Understanding of ServiceNow application development lifecycle, source control integration, update sets, and release management processes. 
 - Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills. 
 - ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA) certification. 
 - ITIL Foundation v3 or ITIL 4 certification. 

Additional Information

- Working Hours: This role requires 2 PM - 11 PM IST working hours

Working at Genesys

- AI at enterprise scale - Build, support and operate AI-powered technology used by more than 8, 000 organizations worldwide. 150+ new AI features were released in the last fiscal year
 - A flexible-first culture - Join a global team of nearly 7, 000 employees with flexible ways of working designed to help people do their best work

Learn more about our culture, AI innovation and sustainability commitments through our Careers site and Sustainability Report. 

What Happens After You Apply

After you apply, here's what you can typically expect: 

- Our Talent Acquisition team reviews your application with the hiring team
 - A Talent Acquisition Partner will review your application and, if your background is aligned, schedule a Zoom interview. 
 - Next, you'll meet the hiring manager and other members of the interview team
 - We aim to keep the process focused and respectful of your time, with no more than five interviews in most cases

Every application is reviewed by a person. Response times may vary by role and location, but our team will keep you informed throughout the process. 

Stay Connected

Stay connected to learn more about how we're applying AI to customer and employee experience challenges and get notified when relevant opportunities become available. 

Get notified about relevant opportunities. 

Be the one building what's next - where AI, experience and impact come together.

As a result, organizations can drive customer loyalty, growth and retention while increasing operational efficiency and teamwork across human and AI workforces. At Medallia, we are committed to creating a world where organizations are loved by their customers and their employees.

Bring your whole self. 

The Role and Team

As part of Medallia's Cloud Engineering Team, Core Infrastructure thrives on collaboration, mutual support, openness to new ideas, and solving problems at a deep, systemic level. 

This team is responsible for building and maintaining large distributed components that run Medallia's cloud. Our code serves millions of requests per second and does so with sub-second latency and fault tolerance. We handle everything from scale: compute, data storage, to synchronization and coordination of large server clusters, to providing a runtime environment for all Medallia's applications. 

We are looking for candidates who share a passion for tackling complexity and building platforms that can scale through multiple orders of magnitude.

 - Proactively monitor and manage the availability of infrastructure and applications. 
 - Be a part of the Cloud Infrastructure team on-call rotation for escalations. 
 - Design code and operate core backend software components to manage Infrastructure. Build automation to enable the cloud to be automatically maintainable. Code primarily using Golang, Python. 
 - Interface with application development teams to incorporate requirements. 
 - Work closely with other engineering teams to eliminate technical debt. 
 - Join the Cloud Infrastructure on-call rotation, collaborating with global teams to ensure 24/7 system availability and rapid incident resolution. 

Qualifications

- 5+ years experience operating a SaaS platform as DevOps engineer
 - Software Engineering Fundamentals: Foundation in software engineering principles. 
 - Software development experience in Python and/or Go
 - Experience managing Kubernetes clusters
 - Strong networking fundamentals
 - Experience with tooling to manage GitOps deployments (ArgoCD)

 - Proven experience in designing, developing, and executing automated test scripts using programming languages such as Java, Python, C#, or JavaScript. 
 - Strong proficiency with test automation frameworks and tools (e. g. , Selenium WebDriver, Cypress, Playwright, TestNG, JUnit, Postman, SoapUI). 
 - Solid understanding of software development methodologies, including Agile/Scrum. Experience with continuous integration/continuous delivery (CI/CD) pipelines and tools (e. g. , Jenkins, GitLab CI/CD, Azure DevOps). 
 - Strong knowledge of relational databases (e. g. , SQL Server, Oracle) and ability to write complex SQL queries for data validation. 
 - Experience with performance testing tools (e. g. , JMeter, LoadRunner) and security testing principles is a plus. 
 - Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex technical issues to both technical and non-technical audiences. 
 - Ability to work independently and as part of a team in a fast-paced, dynamic environment. ISTQB or other relevant quality assurance certifications are a plus. 

Preferences

- Hands-on experience with test automation tools such as Selenium, Cypress, Playwright, Appium, or Rest Assured. 
 - Experience testing Web, API, Mobile, and Cloud-based applications. 
 - Exposure to cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP. 
 - Experience with CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices using Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI/CD, or Azure DevOps. 
 - Familiarity with performance, security, and accessibility testing. 
 - Knowledge of containerization technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes.

Description

Amazon. com is seeking a Systems Development Engineer to join a Fulfillment Optimization team that helps promise, plan, and execute the delivery of millions of packages to customers worldwide - faster and cheaper each day - while providing an extraordinary customer experience from the website to doorstep delivery. Our systems handle millions of requests per second and make business recommendations that impact billions of dollars each year. We are looking for passionate, hard-working, and talented engineers who have experience supporting innovative, mission-critical, high-volume applications - and who are excited to apply AI and agentic automation to how large-scale systems are supported and operated. You will have an enormous opportunity to work across multiple systems: researching and identifying common issues, building AI-powered tooling that diagnoses and prevents them, and driving teams toward resolution to have a positive impact on the customer experience. Your solutions will impact our customers directly. This role requires you to hit the ground running; your ability to learn quickly and work on disparate and overlapping tasks will define your success. 

The ideal candidate is detail-oriented, has superior verbal and written communication skills and strong organizational skills, can juggle multiple tasks at once, works independently, and maintains professionalism under pressure. You must be able to identify problems before they happen and implement solutions that detect and prevent outages. Your ability to accurately prioritize work, make sound technical trade-offs, improve the customer experience, and get the right things done will have a direct impact on Amazon's Supply Chain Optimization and fulfillment-network efficiency. 

As a SysDE II on this team, you will work autonomously on difficult, team- and component-level problems, build resilient and well-tested solutions, and increasingly act as a force multiplier - enabling other builders through the tools, automation, and AI capabilities you deliver. 

Key job responsibilities

- Dive deeply into technical details to diagnose, reproduce, and root-cause issues across Amazon technology products (services, tools, data solutions, etc. ), and drive them to resolution or escalation. 
 - Design, build, and operate AI-powered and agentic support capabilities - diagnostic agents, automated root-cause analysis, anomaly detection, and self-healing/auto-remediation - that detect and prevent issues before they impact customers. 
 - Apply AI across the software development lifecycle (spec-driven and AI-assisted development, agentic workflows) to raise engineering velocity and quality. 
 - Automate repetitive operational tasks to increase efficiency and reduce manual toil, and build tooling that enables other engineers. 
 - Manage trouble tickets through to resolution or escalation using existing documentation, procedures, and tools, and improve those mechanisms over time. 
 - Use technology to monitor security vulnerabilities and eliminate risk; identify and mitigate reliability risks at the team and component level. 
 - Improve service resilience, performance, and operational metrics; define and apply operational-excellence practices for the team. 
 - Participate in a team on-call rotation, providing operational support for the services the team owns. 
 - Collaborate with partner teams, Technical Program Managers, and Product Managers to deliver on shared goals. 
 - Work in an Agile environment using the Scrum methodology. 

About The Team

The Fulfillment Optimization (FO) Support team plays a crucial role in Amazon's supply chain operations. We invent and deliver software solutions that facilitate Customer Promise Speed, Order Planning, and Fulfillment. 

The FO Support team leverages data, process improvement, and innovative technologies - including AI and agentic automation - to provide comprehensive engineering-excellence services and solutions across FO's product portfolios. The team is responsible for FO services as front-line support and plays a central role in the organization's success. 

Basic Qualifications

- 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
 - 2+ years of designing or architecting (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
 - Experience programming with at least one modern language such as C++, C#, Java, Python, Golang, PowerShell, Ruby
 - Knowledge of systems engineering fundamentals (networking, storage, operating systems)
 - Experience in automating, deploying, and supporting large-scale infrastructure

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience building services using AWS products
 - Experience with distributed systems at scale
 - Experience with Linux/Unix
 - Experience leveraging AI (Artificial Intelligence) agents for security review automation, spec-driven development practices, or adversarial red teaming
 - Experience building or integrating AI/GenAI-powered solutions (e. g. , LLM-based tools, agentic frameworks, automated diagnostics or remediation)
 - Ability to work independently and solve problems using knowledge of an object-oriented programming language

data.title: Senior Serviceability Engineer - Networking
data.description:
Hungry, Humble, Honest, with Heart. 

The Opportunity

Are you a hungry, humble, and honest individual with a passion for enhancing customer experiences through improved product serviceability? If so, joining our team as a Serviceability Engineer at Nutanix offers you the opportunity to collaborate across diverse functions, drive impactful serviceability improvements, and work closely with talented professionals dedicated to delivering exceptional support and usability for our innovative products. 

About The Team

The Serviceability Engineer role is part of the Service Strategy & Enablement team at Nutanix, based in Bangalore. This team is made up of passionate engineers dedicated to improving product serviceability, diagnostics, and the overall customer experience. 

Serving as a critical bridge between Support and Engineering, the Service Strategy & Enablement team ensures that serviceability and usability are embedded into every stage of product design and development. By analyzing support cases, monitoring field performance, and incorporating customer feedback, the team drives continuous improvements that enhance both product quality and the support experience. 

You will report to the Manager, Service Strategy & Enablement, whose leadership style fosters empowerment, collaboration, and continuous learning. The team operates in a hybrid work environment, encouraging in-person collaboration a few days each week to promote teamwork, innovation, and shared success. 

Your Role

The Senior Serviceability Network Engineer, will play a critical role in enhancing the serviceability, reliability, and diagnostic capabilities of Nutanix Network products. This role partners closely with Engineering, Product Management, and Support throughout the product lifecycle - from concept to release and post-deployment - to ensure products are designed, validated, and supported with serviceability at the forefront. 

- Develop and maintain comprehensive Business Requirement Documents (BRDs) defining serviceability and diagnostic improvements. 
 - Collaborate with Product Management and Engineering to embed serviceability requirements early in the New Product Introduction (NPI) cycle and across existing hardware product lines. 
 - Review, track, and drive resolution for critical and deferred defects, ensuring timely closure and cross-functional visibility. 
 - Partner with DevEx, QA, and Engineering teams to prioritize field issues, provide feedback on test plans, and ensure known gaps are covered in test automation and validation. 
 - Lead serviceability validation testing for upcoming software and hardware releases - including defining test plans, tracking bugs, and monitoring bug fix rates. 
 - Coordinate with Release Management and Portal teams to ensure proper documentation, readiness, and smooth rollout of releases. 
 - Act as a bridge between Support, Engineering, and Product Management to align on serviceability improvements and customer-impacting issues. 
 - Participate in PRD reviews and collaborate on developing troubleshooting guides and support readiness materials. 
 - Analyze post-release field data and lessons learned to identify opportunities for design and diagnostic enhancements. 
 - Champion serviceability best practices and promote a culture of customer-centric design across hardware development teams. 

The role involves performing duties requiring the application of professional expertise and the exercise of independent judgment/discretion, creativity, problem-solving, and decision-making in carrying out responsibilities, as applicable to the position. The specific responsibilities of the role may vary based on business needs and role requirements. Employees can refer to the applicable guidelines and career frameworks for additional information regarding role expectations and responsibilities. 

What Will You Bring

- Minimum 5+ years of experience in the technology industry, with a strong background in customer support, product quality, or serviceability. 
 - Bachelor's degree in, Computer Science, or a related technical discipline (or equivalent experience). 

Technical requirement

Virtualization & Hybrid Cloud

- Hypervisor Concepts: Good knowledge of VMware / KVM / Nutanix based virtualization. 
 - Public Cloud Networking: Familiarity with AWS VPCs, AWS Direct Connect, Azure Virtual Networks, and Azure ExpressRoute

Software-Defined Networking (SDN) & Network Virtualization

- Open vSwitch (OVS) & Open Virtual Network (OVN): OVS bridge chaining, virtual switch management, and OVN logical routers/switches. 
 - Overlay Networks: Knowledge of network encapsulation protocols, specifically VXLAN and Geneve, used with Virtual Private Clouds (VPCs) and Layer 2 network extensions. 
 - VMware NSX Architecture & Concepts: Conceptually equivalent to Nutanix Flow features. 

Core Networking (L2/L3) & Routing

- Switching Fundamentals: Strong understanding of VLANs, LACP, network bond modes, and MTU/Jumbo frames. 
 - Advanced Routing: Proficiency in dynamic routing protocols, especially BGP and OSPF, which are critical for configuring gateways and Layer 2 subnet extensions to external networks. 
 - Network Address Translation (NAT): Experience with SNAT and floating IPs within VPC environments. 

Network Security & Microsegmentation

data.description:
About Classcard

Classcard is a fast-growing SaaS platform that empowers academies and class-based businesses to streamline scheduling, bookings, payments, and student communications. From dance schools to sports clubs and tuition centers, we serve clients across the UAE, APAC, EMEA, and Africa. 

Our Mission: To simplify operations for educators and coaches so they can focus on what matters-inspiring students. 

Our Culture: Collaborative, data-driven, and customer-obsessed. We value creativity, ownership, and a growth mindset. 

Role Overview

As a QA Engineer, you will be responsible for ensuring the reliability, correctness, and performance of the Classcard platform across web, mobile, and API layers. Your core responsibility is to prevent regressions, validate critical business workflows, and embed quality into the product development lifecycle as the platform scales. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys breaking systems thoughtfully, improving processes, and acting as the quality gatekeeper for releases. 

What You'll Do

Manual Testing & Core Workflows (Core)

- Design and execute detailed test plans, test cases, and scenarios for web, mobile, and backend APIs
 - Perform hands-on manual testing of key workflows, including: 
 - Onboarding
 - Scheduling
 - Attendance
 - Invoicing
 - Payments
 - Reporting
 - Validate API behaviour, covering request/response contracts, edge cases, error handling, and data integrity
 - Identify, log, and track defects with clear reproduction steps, expected vs actual behaviour, and severity

Release Validation & Regression

- Review new features and bug fixes before release to prevent regressions
 - Execute regression testing for every release cycle across tenants and configurations
 - Verify fixes in staging and production environments
 - Provide QA sign-off on release readiness

Collaboration & Process

- Work closely with developers and product managers to clarify requirements and ensure test coverage aligns with acceptance criteria
 - Participate early in feature discussions to identify testing risks and gaps
 - Maintain clear QA documentation, including test cases, test data, and release checklists

Automation, Performance & Scale (Good to Have)

- Develop or maintain automated tests (API and/or UI) to improve regression coverage
 - Execute performance and load testing for high-traffic workflows
 - Test multi-tenant edge cases, including data isolation, role-based access, and institution-specific configurations
 - Support mobile app testing across iOS and Android platforms
 - Assist with validating production issues and hotfixes when required

What We're Looking For

- 2-3 years of experience in manual or hybrid QA roles
 - Strong understanding of web applications, APIs, and backend systems
 - Experience testing complex workflows rather than just UI flows
 - Attention to detail and strong bug-reporting discipline
 - Ability to collaborate closely with engineering and product teams
 - Comfort working in a fast-moving startup environmentNice to Have

- Experience in B2B SaaS or multi-tenant platforms
 - Exposure to test automation frameworks
 - Experience with performance or load testing tools
 - Prior experience testing mobile applications

Why Join Classcard?

- Own quality and release confidence, not just test cases
 - Work on real business-critical workflows used daily by customers
 - Collaborate closely with product, engineering, and founders
 - High ownership, fast learning, and visible impact
 - Fully remote, async-friendly culture
