Job Category

Software Engineering

Job Details

About Salesforce

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn't a buzzword - it's a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all. 

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You're in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce. 

The Experience

You will be a Senior Manager of Software Engineering leading a team of 8 to 10 engineers. Your team builds the "Anomaly Alerting" platform. This is a smart system that watches for strange changes in data and sends out warnings. Your job is to guide the people, own the system, and help make our warning alerts smarter and more automatic. 

What You'll Actually Be Doing

- Day-to-day work: You will make sure our alerting system is fast, strong, and does not break as it grows. You will lead projects that make the system do the hard work so other teams don't have to set up alerts by hand. 
 - Leading the way: You will manage 1 to 2 teams (8 to 10 engineers). You will build a happy, helpful culture where people work well together. 
 - Working together: You will partner with other tech teams and groups across Salesforce (like Slack and Sales Cloud) so they can find and fix problems much faster. You will also speak for your team in meetings and work closely with our teams in the US. 
 - Early goals & impact: In your first 60 to 90 days, you will learn the ropes, start leading in meetings, team up with the US groups, and make a real difference on our biggest goals. 

You're Our Person If. . . 

- You have experience being a manager and leading 8 to 10 software engineers. 
 - You know how to handle huge amounts of data and build data pipelines (ETL). 
 - You have experience running systems on big clouds like AWS or Google Cloud (GCP). 
 - You have worked with tools that monitor system health (Observability). 
 - You have some experience with Machine Learning and know how to spot strange patterns in data (Anomaly Detection). 
 - You are able to work in the office as the company requires (no travel is required for this role). 

Even Better If. . . 

- You have deep, hands-on experience building Machine Learning tools that send out alerts. 
 - You already know how to work with Salesforce products like Agentforce, Commerce Cloud, or Slack. 

Tech Stack

- Cloud & Compute: AWS, GCP, and Kubernetes (EKS/GKE) for stateless, scalable multi-cloud orchestration. 
 - Infrastructure as Code: Terraform for resilient, automated platform provisioning across environments. 
 - Edge Ingestion: OpenTelemetry (OTel) for standardized instrumentation, and Vector/Fluent Bit for high-throughput log routing. 
 - Message Buffering: Apache Kafka to ingest billions of telemetry events, ensuring durable, decoupled data pipelines. 
 - Stream Processing: Apache Flink for real-time log parsing, rolling aggregations, and anomaly detection before storage. 
 - Backend Languages: Java for building heavy stream-processing applications, supplemented by Go and Python for operators and tooling. 
 - Ad-Hoc OLAP Analytics: Apache Druid to power sub-second, interactive dashboard queries over massive historical datasets. 
 - Log & Trace Storage: ClickHouse for fast columnar event storage, natively tiered to AWS S3 / GCP Cloud Storage for cost-effective cold storage. 
 - Time-Series Metrics: VictoriaMetrics, M3DB, or Prometheus to ingest and compress millions of high-cardinality metric rollups. 
 - Visualization & Alerting: Grafana and Apache Superset for single-pane-of-glass UI, paired with Prometheus Alertmanager for incident routing. 
 - A demonstrated, genuine AI-first approach to engineering - using AI to move faster, build fluency across the stack, and contribute well beyond your core specialty. 
 - Experience using AI tools (e. g. , Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Codex, Cursor, etc. ) in development workflows. 
 - Advanced prompt engineering skills and the ability to write precise, structured prompts and cultivate the system context that makes AI outputs reliable, secure, and production-ready. 

Unleash Your Potential

When you join Salesforce, you'll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and be your best, and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can do your best. Together, we'll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future - but to redefine what's possible - for yourself, for AI, and the world. 

Accommodations

If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please submit a request via this Accommodations Request Form. 

Please note that Salesforce uses artificial intelligence (AI) tools to help our recruiters assess and evaluate candidates' resumes and qualifications throughout the recruiting process. Humans will always make any candidate selection and hiring decisions. Please see our Candidate Privacy Statement for more information about how we use your personal data and your rights, including with regard to use of AI tools and opt out options. 

Posting Statement

Salesforce is an equal opportunity employer and maintains a policy of non-discrimination with all employees and applicants for employment. What does that mean exactly? It means that at Salesforce, we believe in equality for all. And we believe we can lead the path to equality in part by creating a workplace that's inclusive, and free from discrimination. Know your rights: workplace discrimination is illegal. Any employee or potential employee will be assessed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications - without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender expression or identity, transgender status, age, disability, veteran or marital status, political viewpoint, or other classifications protected by law. This policy applies to current and prospective employees, no matter where they are in their Salesforce employment journey. Recruiting, hiring, and promotion decisions at Salesforce are fair and based on merit. Description

Not many teams aspire to zero. Welcome to the Worldwide Returns and ReCommerce team (WWR&R) at Amazon. com. 

WW R&R is an agile, innovative organization dedicated to 'making zero happen' to benefit our customers, our company, and the environment. The mission of WWR&R is to eliminate defects that cause returns (Zero defects), deliver Zero cost of returns for Amazon and send Zero product waste to landfill "the 3 Zeros". We do this by developing products and driving unparalleled operational excellence to help customers keep what they buy, recover returned & damaged product value, and create the best customer returns experience in the world. 

Amazon WW R&R is comprised of business, product, operational, program, software engineering and data teams that manage the life of a returned or damaged product from a customer to the warehouse and on to its next best use. Our work is broad and deep: we train machine learning models to automate routing and find signals to optimize re-use; we invent new channels to give products a second life; we develop world-class product support to help customers love what they buy; we pilot smarter product evaluations; we work from the customer backward to find ways to make the return experience remarkably delightful and easy; and we do it all while scrutinizing our business with laser focus. 

As a member of this team, your mission will be to design, develop, document and support massively scalable, distributed real time systems. Using C++, Java, object oriented design patterns, distributed databases and other innovative storage techniques, you will build and deliver software systems that support complex and rapidly evolving business requirements. 

We are looking for software engineers with 5+ years of solid Software engineering experience involving solving complex problems. They will get to work on some of the key initiatives planned to support our rapid evolution and growth and in the process solve some of the most challenging problems. These engineers will provide the technical leadership to the team, drive best practices, mentor other engineers and drive continuous improvements in engineering excellence. 

We are a group that has fun at work while driving incredible customer, business, and environmental impact. We are backed by a strong leadership group dedicated to operational excellence that empowers a reasonable work-life balance. As an established, experienced team, we offer the scope and support needed for substantial career growth. 

Amazon is earth's most customer-centric company and through WW R&R, the earth is our customer too. Come join us and innovate with the Amazon Worldwide Returns & ReCommerce team!

- Lead the end-to-end design, implementation, testing, deployment, and maintenance of software systems consisting of multiple features, ensuring solutions are scalable, extensible, and secure.

 - Collaborate with engineers on related teams to define system interfaces, resolve cross-team dependencies, and create the right checkpoints for successful delivery of multi-engineer projects. 
 - Drive adoption of engineering best practices across your team, including code quality standards, operational excellence through proper alarms, telemetry, and runbook processes, and effective use of generative artificial intelligence tools to augment productivity.

data.description:
About Whirlpool India

Whirlpool of India Limited, headquartered in Gurugram, is a leading home appliances company dedicated to enhancing life at home and inspiring generations through its trusted brands. The company operates three state-of-the-art manufacturing facilities in Faridabad, Pune & Puducherry, each reflecting Whirlpool's commitment to providing best-in-class consumer solutions. Further driving innovation, the company has a Technology & Engineering Center, where India's world-class talent architects the next generation of home innovation. In the 2024-25 fiscal year, Whirlpool of India reported approximately INR 8110 Cr in annual revenue and employed 2193 people. More information is available at www. india. whirlpool. in

About GTEC

Transforming Vision into Reality: The Global Technology & Engineering Centre. Where India's world-class talent architects the next generation of home innovation. 

The team you will be a part of

The Engineering team discovers, develops and evaluates new product ideas, enhancements, or strategic product extensions, and translates research discoveries into usable and marketable products. Leads, plans and tracks all phases of the product life cycle, from inception to introduction into the marketplace. Coordinates with various functions to ensure successful product development and implementation. 

This Role In Summary

This position will be responsible for improving the fluid and thermal performance of cooking products and projects through advanced CFD and 1D system simulations. Blending deep technical mastery in 3D CFD, thermal and 1D system performance modeling with strong people management, and will align simulation roadmaps with platform goals, foster innovation, and drive technical excellence across complex fluid-thermal engineering challenges. 

Your Responsibilities Will Include

Beyond individual technical mastery, you will build a Center of Excellence for simulation. You will be responsible for defining long-term simulation roadmaps, mentoring senior and junior engineers, and bridging the gap between theoretical physics, numerical modeling, and real-world physical testing. The ideal candidate will translate complex cooking thermal and fluid challenges into robust mathematical models, execute high-level optimizations, and ultimately deliver actionable, cost-effective design solutions that elevate our global cooking product portfolio. 

Strategic Leadership & People Management

- Scale and Direct a High-Performing Team: Lead a diverse group of 20+ CFD and System Modeling engineers. Define team structure, allocate project resources, and manage overall workload to ensure timely delivery of simulation milestones. 
 - Technical Mentorship & Capability Building: Act as the ultimate technical escalation point. Coach engineers on complex flow, thermal, and multiphase problems, and guide them in developing new simulation capabilities and advanced methodologies. 
 - Roadmap & Strategy Alignment: Partner with Platform Directors and R&D stakeholders to align the System Performance development roadmap with broader business objectives, ensuring simulation strategies proactively support future product pipelines. 
 - Performance & Culture: Conduct performance reviews, establish clear KPIs for simulation accuracy and turnaround time, and foster a culture of critical thinking, continuous learning, and accountability. 

Minimum Requirements

Education & Core Experience

- Academic Pedigree: Master's Degree or Ph. D. strictly in Mechanical Engineering, Thermal Engineering, or a closely related discipline. 
 - Domain Experience: 12 to 15+ years of progressive, hands-on experience in computational fluid dynamics, heat transfer, and systems engineering within a complex manufacturing or R&D environment. 
 - Leadership Experience: Demonstrated success in directly managing, mentoring, and scaling large technical teams (15-20+ engineers). 

Preferred Skills And Experiences

Software & Technical Proficiency

- CFD Solvers: Master-level, proven expertise in Ansys Fluent, FLOEFD, or OpenFOAM
 - 1D/System Modeling: Master-level expertise in Dymola and 1D system modeling, with a strong ability to formulate underlying mathematical equations from scratch. 
 - Pre-Processing/CAD: High proficiency in Ansys Workbench, SpaceClaim, Creo, and specialized meshing tools. 
 - Engineering Sciences: Deep theoretical understanding and practical application of Thermodynamics, Fluid Dynamics, Heat Transfer, and Systems Engineering principles. 
 - Quality & Optimization: Solid exposure to Six Sigma tools, Design of Experiments (DoE), and Response Surface Methodology (RSM). 
 - Expert in Product Development process. 
 - Expert in project planning & management. 
 - Exposure/experience of working in a global engineering team environment
 - Team player, flexibility in adapting to quickly changing business task/project priorities. 
 - Good business communication (written/verbal) and Presentation skills. 

Connect with us and learn more about Whirlpool India. See what it's like to work at Whirlpool by visiting Whirlpool Careers. Additional information about the company can be found on Facebook, Instagram and YouTube. 

At Whirlpool India, we value and celebrate diversity. Whirlpool India is committed to equal employment opportunity and prohibits any discrimination on the basis of race or ethnicity, religion, sex, pregnancy, gender expression or identity, sexual orientation, age, physical or mental disability, veteran status, or any other category protected by applicable law. 

Join the Powerhouse of Home Innovation. 

GTEC is more than an engineering centre; it is where the future of the home is being designed, tested, and perfected. We invite you to be part of a team that is not just witnessing the digital revolution but leading it-creating a lasting impact on everyday lives, one innovation at a time.

We are seeking a DevOps Engineer specialising in AWS and Kubernetes to join the Digital Engineering, Channels & Products function in Pune. You will design, implement and support secure, scalable and highly available cloud infrastructure and cloud-native services across production environments.

data.title: Tech S and T-Resilience and Reliability Engineer-Senior-GDSF02
data.description:
At EY, you'll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we're counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all. 

Senior Site Reliability Engineer (Senior level)

Description

Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) is a modern way of delivering IT Solutions by imbibing Software engineering principles in Service Delivery to reduce IT Risk to business, improve business resilience, attain predictability & reliability, optimize cost of IT Infra and Ops

A Site Reliability Engineer typically has deep software engineering experience encompassing design, build, deploy and manage / maintain an IT solution ensuring resilience, reliability, and performance. 

An SRE is a bridge between development and operations by applying a software engineering mindset to the development, deployment, and maintenance of applications to maximize system reliability & automation, while improving efficiencies by optimizing resources

Responsibilities

- Defining SLA/SLO/SLI for a product / service
 - Engineering in resilient design and implementation practices into solutions as they go through the product life cycle
 - Engineering out manual effort (Toil) through the development of automated processes and services (e. g. , Automated Management of Systems, CI/CD improvements)
 - Developing Observability Solutions to track, report, and measure SLA adherence
 - Help Optimize Cost of IT Infra & Operations - FinOps
 - Critical Situation management
 - SOP / Runbook automation, Toil reduction
 - Data Analytics & System trend analysis

Typical Skills And Background

- 7+ years of experience in software product engineering principles, processes and systems
 - Hands-on experience in Java / J2EE, one of web server (Apache Tomcat or IBM HTTP Server), one of the application servers (Tomcat/WebSphere), and any major RDBMS like Oracle
 - Hands-on experience in at least one CI-CD (Azure DevOps, GitLab CI/CD, Jenkins) and IaC tools (Terraform, AWS CloudFormation, Ansible etc. )
 - Experience in at least one cloud technology (AWS/Azure/GCP etc. and Docker, Pivotal, Kubernetes, OpenShift etc. ) and its reliability tools (Azure AppInsight, CloudWatch, Azure Monitor etc. )
 - Experience in Linux (RHEL) operating system performance monitoring parameters and their interpretation, commands used for monitoring
 - Experience in Observability - APM tools (Dynatrace, AppDynamics etc. ), metrics / log consolidation (Splunk) and ELK Stack
 - Defining NFRs and SLA/SLO/SLI agreement for a product / platform / services
 - Knowledge on queuing models used, thread pools, request servicing processes etc. 
 - Knowledge in Web Services, SOA, ESB (DataPower), RESTFul
 - Knowledge of application design patterns, J2EE application architectures, Microservices, Spring boot & Cloud native architectures
 - Proficiency in Java runtimes, Core Java, Garbage collection, JVM parameters tuning
 - Experience in performance tuning on Application Servers (Tomcat/WAS)
 - Experience in trouble shooting Performance / Scalability / Availability issues
 - Experience in Thread dump, heap dump generation & analysis
 - Knowledge on Query tuning and database designs & models
 - Knowledge at least one automation scripting language like Python
 - Mastery in collaborative software development using Git, Jira, Confluence etc. 
 - AI/ML & Data Analytics knowledge and experience is a desirable

EY | Building a better working world

EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets. 

Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate. 

Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

data.description:
This role is eligible for our hybrid work model: Two days in-office

Senior Software Engineer

Our Technology team is the backbone of our company: constantly creating, testing, learning and iterating to better meet the needs of our customers. If you thrive in a fast-paced, ideas-led environment, you're in the right place. 

Why This Job's a Big Deal

Join an Agile team of professionals that are instrumental in building the next generation of travel applications. We constantly explore new technologies and engineer better solutions for ever demanding business needs. Our team of engineers, at all levels, work with the business leaders in defining the product roadmap and come up with innovative solutions to grow the future of travel. We design and develop our back end systems and REST APIs that serve hundreds of millions of searches a day, collecting and parsing data across thousands of partners to get the best deals for our customers

In This Role You Will Get To

- Drive mission critical projects with direct impact on the evolution of Priceline's business. 
 - Innovate with a cross-functional agile team that continuously experiments, iterates and delivers on new product objectives. 
 - Showcase fluency and development skills of Java
 - Lead, mentor, and guide the team in best practices. 
 - Apply your programming skills towards building low latency and high throughput transactional services with continuous integration and automation testing. 
 - Implement SQL composition skills that collects and queries data for investigation and analysis in real time from our applications. 
 - The ability to quickly apply your experience to understand our codebase, systems and business requirements to effectively make changes to our applications. 
 - Influencer and communicator on team development efforts. Influence what the best solutions are and communicate your findings to key business stakeholders. 

Who You Are

- Bachelor's degree or higher in Computer Science or related field. 
 - 6+ years of experience in software engineering and development. 
 - Exceptional coding experience with Java. 
 - An interest in being a mentor and influencing best practices with less experienced developers. 
 - Strong grasp of SQL compositions skills for composing queries and analysis. 
 - Confident with the utilization of Spring Frameworks, Web Services and APIs. 
 - Experience with developing on Cloud, especially GCP. 
 - Experience in Microservices, Kubernetes (GKE preferable), and Dockers. 
 - Proven ability in Design and Architecture of complex, highly scalable and performance driven applications. 
 - Illustrated history of living the values necessary to Priceline: Customer, Innovation, Team, Accountability and Trust. 
 - The Right Results, the Right Way is not just a motto at Priceline; it's a way of life. Unquestionable integrity and ethics is essential. 

Who We Are

WE ARE PRICELINE. 

Our success as one of the biggest players in online travel is all thanks to our incredible, dedicated team of talented employees. Priceliners are focused on being the best travel deal makers in the world, motivated by our passion to help everyone experience the moments that matter most in their lives. Whether it's a dream vacation, your cousin's graduation, or your best friend's wedding - we make travel affordable and accessible to our customers. 

Our culture is unique and inspiring (that's what our employees tell us). We're a grown-up, startup. We deliver the excitement of a new venture, without the struggles and chaos that can come with a business that hasn't stabilized. 

We're on the cutting edge of innovative technologies. We keep the customer at the center of all that we do. Our ability to meet their needs relies on the strength of a workforce as diverse as the customers we serve. We bring together employees from all walks of life and we are proud to provide the kind of inclusive environment that stimulates innovation, creativity and collaboration. 

Priceline is part of the Booking Holdings, Inc. (Nasdaq: BKNG) family of companies, a highly profitable global online travel company with a market capitalization of over $80 billion. Our sister companies include Booking. com, BookingGo, Agoda, Kayak and OpenTable. 

If you want to be part of something truly special, check us out!

Flexible work at Priceline

Priceline is following a hybrid working model, which includes two days onsite as determined by you and your manager (ideally selecting among Tuesday, Wednesday, or Thursday). On the remaining days, you can choose to be remote or in the office. 

Perks & Benefits At Priceline

Our benefits are designed to support your health, wellbeing, and life inside and outside of work. Eligible Priceliners have access to: 

Health & wellness coverage including medical, dental, vision, and mental health resources

Generous time off including PTO, holidays, a company-wide Priceline Pause reset week, and paid volunteer days

Work/life support including the ability to work up to 4 weeks per year from anywhere, parental leave, dependent care and family support resources, Summer Fridays, and office perks like stocked kitchens and catered meals (varies by location)

Financial security programs such as retirement plans with company contributions, life and disability coverage, and tax-advantaged accounts

Signature travel perks including employee-only discounts on hotels and flights, VIP deals, and Big Deal Bucks credits

Additional perks & discounts like travel and partner discounts, tuition support, legal support, and pet benefits

A people-first culture with Employee Resource Groups (ERGs), social events, recognition programs, and service awards that help you connect, grow, and celebrate together

Specific benefits and programs vary by location. 

Inclusion is a Big Deal!

To be the best travel dealmakers in the world, we believe our team should reflect the broad range of customers and communities we serve. We are committed to cultivating a culture where all employees have the freedom to bring their individual perspectives, life experiences, and passion to work. 

Priceline is a proud equal opportunity employer. We embrace and celebrate the unique lenses through which our employees see the world. We'd love for you to join us and help shape what makes our team extraordinary. 

Applying for this position

We're excited that you are interested in a career with us. For all current employees, please use the internal portal to find jobs and apply. 

External candidates are required to have an account before applying. When you click Apply, returning candidates can log in, or new candidates can quickly create an account to save/view applications.

data.description:
Join us as we work to create a thriving ecosystem that delivers accessible, high-quality, and sustainable healthcare for all. 

Role Summary

Build software that helps athenahealth solve complex healthcare business challenges at scale. The Member of Technical Staff will develop and maintain backend services and cloud-based applications that support high-volume claim resolution workflows, improve operational efficiency, and contribute to reliable product experiences for customers and internal teams. This role is based in Chennai, India and follows a hybrid work model. The person in this role will collaborate with engineers, product partners, and other stakeholders to deliver maintainable, scalable solutions using modern software development practices. This position reports to the Manager, Engineering. 

Team Summary

Our Collector R&D teams are building new and evolving services for athenahealth customers. We work on solving complex business problems for a broad set of stakeholders, including customers, internal technology-enabled services teams, and multiple BPO vendors. Much of this work involves designing and implementing workflows that manage large volumes of claim resolution activity, with a focus on improving visibility, throughput, and operational consistency. 

These systems support work that may be completed manually by operations partners or automated to improve overall productivity. That means our teams build software that helps route work, manage exceptions, connect business rules to execution paths, and create a more efficient experience across revenue cycle operations. The engineering work often involves balancing scale, reliability, maintainability, and evolving business needs across distributed systems. 

As a Member of Technical Staff, this role contributes directly to the development of backend services and microservices that power these workflows. Success in this role requires solid software engineering fundamentals, experience working with service-based systems, and the ability to collaborate effectively across functions. The team values clear communication, practical problem solving, and thoughtful engineering that improves outcomes for customers and internal users. Source context: the Collector R&D team summary provided in your prompt and athenahealth engineering JD guidance on MTS back-end roles: 

Essential Job Responsibilities

- Develop backend applications and services using Java to support business-critical workflows and platform capabilities. 
 - Build and maintain scalable microservices that integrate with internal platforms and dependent systems. 
 - Implement cloud-based solutions on AWS with attention to reliability, security, and maintainability. 
 - Collaborate with engineers, product managers, and other stakeholders to translate business requirements into technical solutions. 
 - Create and enhance APIs and service integrations that support high-volume transactional workflows. 
 - Troubleshoot application and service issues, identify root causes, and deliver fixes that improve system stability. 
 - Contribute to code reviews, unit testing, and team engineering practices that improve software quality and consistency. 
 - Optimize application performance and service interactions to support scalability and operational efficiency. 
 - Use AI tools, where appropriate, to improve productivity in day-to-day engineering work, such as understanding unfamiliar code, drafting test cases, summarizing technical information, or exploring implementation options, while reviewing outputs carefully before applying them. 

Additional Job Responsibilities

- Document technical designs, implementation details, and service dependencies for shared understanding across the team. 
 - Participate in sprint planning, backlog refinement, and estimation activities. 
 - Support deployment, release validation, and post-release monitoring for assigned services or features. 
 - Assist in improving CI/CD workflows and development practices across the team. 
 - Contribute to monitoring and alerting improvements that help detect and resolve production issues. 
 - Partner with adjacent teams to align on API contracts, integration points, and shared dependencies. 
 - Share technical knowledge through walkthroughs, documentation, and collaborative problem-solving sessions. 
 - Identify opportunities to simplify workflows or reduce manual effort through service enhancements and automation. 

Expected Education & Experience

- 2 to 4 years of software engineering experience in backend development, distributed systems, or related application development work. 
 - Hands-on experience with Java for building and maintaining production applications. 
 - Experience developing or supporting microservices and service-based architectures. 
 - Working knowledge of AWS and cloud application deployment concepts. 
 - Experience building or consuming RESTful APIs and integrating with distributed systems. 
 - Understanding of software engineering fundamentals, including object-oriented design, testing, debugging, and version control. 
 - Experience working in Agile or iterative development environments with cross-functional teams. 
 - Ability to analyze technical issues, communicate clearly, and contribute practical solutions. 
 - Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience.

data.description:
Description

Are you looking for an opportunity to build a highly available, large scale, enterprise-wide software solution? Does it excite you to find patterns and build generic, composable software solutions to solve complex problems? Are you looking for inventing newer and simpler ways of building solutions? If so, we are looking for you to fill a challenging position in Amazon Payroll Technology team. 

Payroll Technology at Amazon is all about enabling our business to perform at scale as efficiently as possible with no defects. As Amazon's workforce grows, both in size and geography, Amazon's payroll operations become increasingly complex, and our customers are asked to do more with less. Process can only get them so far, and that's where we come in with technology solutions to integrate and automate systems, detect defects before payment, and provide insights. As an SDE II on our team, you will be responsible for leading the architecture, design, development and launch of some of the core product features. You will have significant influence on our overall strategy by helping define these product features, drive the system architecture, and spearhead the best practices to delivery high quality products. 

This position requires that you are a significant and autonomous contributor. Your work is consistently high quality. You solve complex problems, applying appropriate technologies and best practices. Your focus is on designing, developing and effectively applying automated solutions that test major portions of software (e. g. , significant component, set of features, mid-size application, service, etc. ). You prevent and find defects early. You apply software testing techniques, such as equivalence class partitioning, boundary value testing, etc. You build complete test and/or measurement solutions (e. g. , performance, load, scalability, usability, etc. ) You use data from testing, deployment, and production to measure quality and provide actionable improvement to the product. You write code that an SDE unfamiliar with the system can understand. You are proficient in a broad range of design approaches and know when it is appropriate to make trade-offs. Your solutions are pragmatic. You do things with the proper level of complexity the first time (or at least minimize incidental complexity). You consider the legacy of the code you produce, limiting the use of short-term workarounds. You create flexible software without over-engineering. You re-use where possible, while being judicious about introducing dependencies. You are efficient with resource usage (e. g. , designing to avoid impacting the system under test. )

This is an exciting opportunity for a seasoned engineer. In this position, you will play a leading role in the architecture, design, implementation and deployment of large-scale and complex financial applications. You will push your design and architecture limits by inventing and simplifying complex problems. You have strong verbal and written communication skills, are self-driven, and can deliver high quality results in a fast-paced environment. You will work with Amazon engineering and business teams across the globe in planning, designing, executing and implementing this new platform. 

Basic Qualifications

- 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
 - 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
 - Experience programming with at least one software programming language

Preferred Qualifications

- 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
 - Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

data.title: Senior Manager QA Engineering
data.description:
Overview

The Senior QA Engineering Manager leads quality engineering strategy and execution across one or more product portfolios, owning both the technical direction of test automation and the people leadership of a QA engineering organization. This leader partners closely with engineering, product, and delivery teams to embed quality throughout the software lifecycle, builds and scales high-performing automation and QA team - including offshore and distributed talent - and drives a zero-defect culture through rigorous metrics, root cause analysis, and continuous improvement. The role blends hands-on technical leadership in test automation architecture, CI/CD, and AI-based testing with senior people-management responsibilities such as hiring, coaching, and career development. 

Responsibilities

Quality strategy and automation leadership

- Define and own the test automation strategy across multiple products and portfolios, architecting scalable API-first and UI automation suites built on shared, reusable test libraries. 
 - Guide teams to evaluate and adopt new tools and technologies - including AI-based test automation frameworks, and RPA - to provide faster feedback to development teams. 
 - Establish the test strategy covering data management, pre-production/staging environments, system integration, and end-to-end testing. 
 - Drive CI/CD practices and cloud-based tooling (Azure/AWS) across the QA function. 
 - Oversee Quality Corrective Action Board (CAB) and Zero-Defect Planning (ZDP) processes; track defect leakage and lead root cause analysis (RCA) to continuously improve test coverage. 
 - Actively participate in sprint planning and estimation, providing effort and timeline estimates for automation and QA deliverables to support predictable, on-time releases. 
 - Define and report key quality metrics - including functional and automation test coverage, defect density, and test execution velocity - to drive data-driven quality decisions. 

Team leadership and people management

- Lead, coach, and grow a team of QA and automation engineers and QA leads - including offshore and distributed staff - fostering an inclusive, high-performing culture. 
 - Own hiring, onboarding, performance management, career development, and retention for the QA engineering organization. 
 - Set clear goals, provide regular feedback, and manage team knowledge-building and cross-training across key applications. 
 - Act as a change agent, championing quality ownership and continuous improvement across the QA program. 

Cross-functional partnership and reporting

- Partner with product management, engineering, delivery, and operations to translate roadmap priorities into achievable, quality-driven engineering plans. 
 - Develop effective relationships with key stakeholders - product owners, agile managers, business analysts, delivery teams, and technical working groups. 
 - Produce sprint-level activity reports and quality metrics for senior management; support release-readiness reporting and relevant New Product Development (NPD) phases. 
 - Communicate technical strategy, quality status, risks, and tradeoffs clearly to technical and non-technical audiences. 

Qualifications

- Bachelor's or master's degree in computer science, engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. 
 - 12 or more years of overall IT/software experience, including 10 or more years leading automation or QA engineering teams and 5 or more years of direct people management. 
 - Strong hands-on experience in Java and exposure to Python, with proven ability to architect and scale automation suites spanning API test automation (primary) and UI test automation, built on shared, reusable test libraries. 
 - Proficiency with RestAssured, TestNG, Playwright, and BDD-Cucumber, along with CI/CD tooling such as Jenkins, Gitlab, Nexus, and Maven. 
 - Experience with AI-based test automation and applying AI-driven development lifecycle (AIDLC) practices to accelerate test design, execution, and maintenance. 
 - Exposure to AWS cloud technologies and modern DevOps practices. 
 - Experience in healthcare, payer, or other regulated, data-intensive domains, including deidentified, HIPAA-compliant test data practices; US healthcare and EDI (e. g. , X12/HIPAA transactions) knowledge is a plus
 - Familiarity with data analytics platforms or machine learning systems is a plus. 
 - Strong understanding of Agile methodology and quality management best practices. 

Skills And Competencies

- Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to influence a wide range of audiences and win support without formal reporting authority. 
 - Strong organizational skills and adaptive to rapidly changing priorities and workloads. 
 - Comfortable partnering with remote and distributed team members across the US, India, and other geographies, within a matrixed organization. 
 - Results-oriented, empowering leader with strong emotional intelligence and a demonstrated ability to coach and develop talent. 
 - Innovative and self-motivated, with a strong sense of urgency and quality ownership. 
 - Exhibits behaviours consistent with Cotiviti values: Customer Driven, Accountability, Open, Collaborative.

data.description:
Overview

MCAPS-Core accelerates customer outcomes and business growth. The organization brings together planning, landing, execution excellence, services portfolio and delivery, and field activation across ATU, STU, and CSU to accelerate customer value, drive growth, and strengthen the end-to-end experience across every customer moment. 

This position is pivotal in shaping the next generation of learning through agentic experiences that make skilling more personalized, adaptive, and embedded in the flow of work. 

By combining agentic AI, machine learning, data, and automation, you will design and scale intelligent learning experiences that accelerate skill development, improve learner and customer outcomes, and strengthen organizational capability. 

The role goes beyond applying AI to existing learning processes. It will help reimagine how people discover, build, apply, and sustain skills, creating agentic experiences that understand context, orchestrate learning resources and actions, and continuously adapt to learner needs and business priorities. 

Microsoft's mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond. 

Responsibilities

Strategic Program Management

- Define and drive the AI, agentic systems, machine learning, data, and automation transformation strategy for L&D, aligning initiatives with business priorities and evolving customer needs. 
 - Lead programs from discovery and architecture through implementation, adoption, and ongoing optimization. 
 - Manage dependencies, risks, success measures, and cross-functional delivery. 

Advanced Analytics & Machine Learning

- Implement descriptive, diagnostic, predictive, and prescriptive analytics-including machine learning, and agentic AI to uncover skill gaps, forecast learning needs, and measure program impact. 
 - Build Microsoft Fabric data pipelines, lakehouses or warehouses, and Power BI reporting to support actionable insights and data-driven decisions. 
 - Establish data-quality controls and measurement frameworks to evaluate learning effectiveness and organizational capability. 

Agentic AI & Personalized Learning

- Design and deploy agentic AI solutions, including autonomous agents, adaptive learning systems, and intelligent tutoring experiences, with appropriate human oversight and operational safeguards. 
 - Integrate Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Search, Microsoft Copilot, and Azure Machine Learning to deliver personalized, scalable learning and knowledge experiences. 
 - Implement retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), grounding, evaluation, and feedback mechanisms to improve AI response quality and relevance. 

Document & Speech Intelligence

- Use Azure AI Document Intelligence to extract, classify, and validate information from structured and unstructured documents. 
 - Integrate Azure AI Speech capabilities, including speech-to-text and text-to-speech, into conversational, learning, and accessibility solutions. 
 - Develop workflows that convert documents and spoken interactions into searchable knowledge and actionable insights. 

Cloud Architecture & Application Development

- Architect secure, scalable Azure solutions using Azure App Service/Web Apps, Azure Functions, Azure Cosmos DB, and supporting cloud services. 
 - Develop applications, APIs, AI integrations, and data-processing components using Python and C#/. NET. 
 - Design data models, partitioning strategies, and secure access patterns for Azure Cosmos DB. 
 - Apply managed identities, role-based access control, secrets management, and monitoring across application environments. 

CI/CD & Automation

- Establish and maintain CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps, incorporating automated testing, security checks, and controlled deployments. 
 - Implement repeatable infrastructure and environment provisioning using infrastructure as code. 
 - Automate business and technical workflows using Power Automate, Azure Logic Apps, Azure Functions, and scripting. 
 - Improve delivery efficiency and operational reliability through reusable components and automated processes. 

Continuous Improvement

- Use real-time feedback, telemetry, and analytics to iterate on program and solution design. 
 - Monitor solution performance, reliability, adoption, and cost, ensuring sustained value in a fast-changing environment. 

Stakeholder Engagement

- Translate technical insights into clear recommendations for non-technical audiences. 
 - Collaborate with business leaders, subject-matter experts, engineering teams, and learning professionals. 
 - Foster a culture of data-driven decision-making and shared accountability for outcomes. 

Responsible AI & Change Management

- Champion fairness, transparency, privacy, security, and accessibility in AI-enabled learning and knowledge systems. 
 - Establish appropriate evaluation, human oversight, and governance for agentic AI solutions. 

Qualifications

Required/Minimum Qualifications: 

Master's Degree or equivalent 10+ year(s) experience in learning and development, relevant technical roles, business development, quota management, human resources (HR), customer success, collection management, research/restoration evaluation, industry, program/project management, or corporate education OR Bachelor's degree or equivalent AND 12+ years experience in learning and development, relevant technical roles, business development, field or sales, HR, customer success, collection management, research/restoration evaluation, industry, or program/project management, corporate education OR equivalent experience. 

Additional Required Qualifications

- Demonstrated experience in technical program/project management, learning and development, knowledge management, customer success, or a related technical role. 
 - Experience leading cross-functional initiatives and translating business requirements into technical solutions and measurable outcomes. 

Technical expertise

- Microsoft Azure: Hands-on experience designing and delivering secure, scalable cloud solutions, including identity, access management, monitoring, and application integration. 
 - Azure AI: Experience building AI-powered applications using Azure AI services, including Azure OpenAI and Azure AI Foundry, with an understanding of agentic workflows, RAG, evaluation, and responsible AI. 
 - Azure AI Document Intelligence: Experience implementing document extraction, classification, and validation workflows. 
 - Azure AI Speech: Experience integrating speech-to-text and text-to-speech into applications or automated workflows. 
 - Azure App Service/Web Apps: Experience developing, deploying, securing, and monitoring web applications and APIs. 
 - Azure Cosmos DB: Experience with NoSQL data modeling, partitioning, querying, and secure application persistence. 
 - Microsoft Fabric: Experience with data integration, engineering, and analytics using pipelines, lakehouses, and Power BI. 
 - Python and C#/. NET: Proficiency in developing APIs, AI integrations, data-processing components, and automation. 
 - CI/CD: Experience implementing build, test, and deployment pipelines using Azure DevOps. 
 - Automation: Experience automating workflows using Power Automate, Azure Logic Apps, Azure Functions, and scripting. 
 - Working knowledge of source control, automated testing, API integration, cloud security, and operational troubleshooting. 

Leadership and communication

- Strong analytical, problem-solving, stakeholder-management, and communication skills. 
 - Ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical audiences and influence decisions across organizational boundaries.

About Sirion

Sirion is the world's leading AI-native Contract Lifecycle Management (CLM) platform. With more than 7 million contracts and close to $800B in contract value under management, Sirion is recognized as a leader by Gartner, IDC, and Spend Matters. 

Power the Future of AI & Why This Role Matters

We are looking for an AI Automation Engineer with 4-6 years of Python development experience and hands-on experience building AI-powered and agentic automation solutions. The ideal candidate combines strong Python backend skills with practical knowledge of LLMs, AI agents, RAG, tool calling, and workflow orchestration. 

As part of Sirion's Automation team, you will design, build, and deploy intelligent automations in which AI agents reason over contracts and business data, call APIs and tools, and execute multi-step processes end-to-end, with appropriate human-in-the-loop controls. 

How You'll Make an Impact

- Design, develop, and deploy agentic AI automations that use LLMs, tool/function calling, memory, and multi-step reasoning to automate business processes end-to-end. 
 - Build agent workflows using frameworks such as LangGraph, LangChain, CrewAI, AutoGen, or similar. 
 - Build AI agents that interact with APIs, databases, documents, web applications, and external tools. 
 - Design and implement RAG-based solutions using embeddings, vector databases, and semantic search. 
 - Integrate OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, or other LLM APIs into production systems, including prompt engineering and structured outputs. 
 - Develop scalable backend services and APIs in Python using FastAPI, Flask, or Django REST Framework. 
 - Build human-in-the-loop checkpoints, guardrails, and error-handling/retry logic so automations run reliably in production. 
 - Develop asynchronous and event-driven workflows where required. 
 - Evaluate agent quality, accuracy, latency, and cost; monitor, troubleshoot, and optimize automations in production. 
 - Work with databases such as PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, or Redis. 
 - Deploy and maintain solutions using Docker and CI/CD pipelines. 
 - Write clean, maintainable, testable, production-ready Python code. 
 - Collaborate with product managers, architects, business stakeholders, and engineering teams to identify automation opportunities and translate requirements into technical solutions. 
 - Stay current with developments in Generative AI and Agentic AI. 

Skills & Experience You Bring to the Table

Python & Backend Development

- 4-6 years of professional experience in Python development. 
 - Strong understanding of OOP, data structures, exception handling, and concurrency (asyncio/threading). 
 - Hands-on experience with FastAPI, Flask, Django, or Django REST Framework. 
 - Strong experience developing and consuming REST APIs. 
 - Good understanding of SQL and relational databases (PostgreSQL/MySQL); MongoDB/Redis experience preferred. 

Agentic AI / GenAI

- Hands-on experience building LLM-powered applications beyond proofs of concept. 
 - Understanding of agentic AI architecture, including planning, tool use, memory, and autonomous multi-step workflows. 
 - Experience with one or more agent frameworks such as LangGraph, LangChain, CrewAI, or AutoGen. 
 - Experience with tool/function calling and integrating external APIs and tools with LLMs. 
 - Understanding of RAG, embeddings, vector databases, and semantic search. 
 - Experience with LLM APIs such as OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, or equivalent. 
 - Good understanding of prompt engineering and structured LLM outputs. 
 - Experience with MCP (Model Context Protocol) and AI tool integrations. 
 - Experience building multi-agent systems. 

Cloud & DevOps

- Experience with Docker and containerized applications. 
 - Understanding of CI/CD pipelines and tools such as Jenkins, GitHub Actions, or GitLab CI. 
 - Exposure to AWS, Azure, or GCP. 
 - Experience with logging, monitoring, debugging, and production deployments. 

Education & Soft Skills

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Electronics, Engineering, or a related field. 
 - Strong problem-solving and analytical skills. 
 - Ability to work independently and collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams. 
 - Strong communication and documentation skills. 

Good to Have

- Experience with RPA or workflow automation platforms such as UiPath, Automation Anywhere, Power Automate, or n8n. 
 - Experience with document AI: extracting and processing data from PDFs, contracts, or other unstructured documents. 
 - Exposure to Contract Lifecycle Management (CLM) or enterprise SaaS platforms. 
 - Experience with task and message queues such as Celery, RabbitMQ, or Kafka. 
 - Experience with Kubernetes. 
 - Experience working with open-source/local LLMs and Hugging Face models. 
 - Understanding of LLM evaluation, observability, guardrails, and cost optimization.

What We Are Looking For

The ideal candidate is strong in Python backend development and has built real AI/agentic automation solutions, not just theoretical knowledge of Generative AI. Candidates should be able to demonstrate projects that combine LLMs + tools/APIs + orchestration + backend services, preferably deployed in production.

Job Details

Job Description: 

The Role And Impact

As a GPU Validation Engineer, you will play a critical role in ensuring the functional accuracy, performance, and reliability of Intel's cutting-edge GPUs. You will define, develop, and execute robust validation methodologies to test interactions between GPU features across hardware and software layers. Your work will directly impact the quality and performance of Intel GPUs, enabling seamless integration into diverse systems and driving innovation in graphics and compute technologies. 

Business Group

You will be part of Intel's Data Center Group (DCG), which leads the development of technologies that power the world's data-centric infrastructure. This group focuses on shaping the future of cloud computing, AI, and high-performance computing by delivering solutions that advance Intel's leadership in data processing and connectivity. Joining DCG offers an exciting opportunity to contribute to groundbreaking products that support Intel's broader mission of enabling global progress through technology. 

Key Responsibilities

- Develop and execute functional validation plans for GPUs, ensuring comprehensive test coverage across hardware and software components. 
 - Analyze and debug silicon issues to identify root causes, resolve failures, and optimize GPU designs. 
 - Test and validate system-level interactions between GPU features using advanced validation infrastructure. 
 - Collaborate with architecture, design, verification, and manufacturing teams to refine validation methodologies and processes. 
 - Review proposed design changes to assess their impact on validation timelines, tasks, and performance goals. 
 - Design and implement post-silicon validation infrastructure, including behavioral checkers, performance monitors, and coverage tools. 
 - Publish detailed validation reports summarizing key findings, results, and recommendations. 
 - Maintain and improve validation strategies to support product specifications and enhance overall GPU functionality. 
 - Defines, develops, and performs functional validation for GPUs, focusing on validation of interaction of GPUs, media, display and system level features. Applies various hardware and software level tools and techniques to ensure validation coverage and that performance, power, and area goals are met. 
 - Reviews proposed design changes to assess impact on validation plans, tasks, and timelines. 
 - Develops GPU validation methodologies, executes validation plans, and collaborates with other engineers for design optimization, troubleshooting, and failure analysis. 
 - Performs silicon debug to identify root causes and resolves all functional and triage failures for GPU issues. Tests interactions between various GPU features using validation infrastructure. 
 - Develops post silicon validation infrastructure (e. g. , performance monitors, behavioral checkers, state space coverage) and test environment used in validation testing. 
 - Publishes GPU validation reports summarizing all validation activities performed, reviews results, and communicates to relevant teams. 
 - Works with architecture, design, verification, board, platform, and manufacturing teams to maintain and improve debug, validation test strategy, methodologies, and processes for graphics interfaces and to meet desired product specifications. 

Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in a relevant field and 9+ years of experience, or a Master's degree with 6+ years, or a Ph. D. with 4+ years working in GPU validation, silicon debugging, or related domains.

 - Experience with silicon debug processes, triage failure analysis, and system-level validation. 
 - Strong technical expertise in GPU architecture, media, and display technologies. 
 - Demonstrated ability to develop and execute validation plans aligned with design and performance goals. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Proven experience collaborating with cross-functional engineering teams to drive design optimizations and resolve technical challenges. 
 - Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a focus on continuous improvement in validation processes. 
 - Effective communication skills to present findings and recommendations through clear and concise reports. 
 - Passion for innovation and a proactive mindset to contribute to advancements in GPU technologies.

 - Strong understanding of server architectures, hardware components, and operating systems. 
 - Proficiency in scripting languages (e. g. , Python) for test automation, debugging, and test content development. 
 - Experience with validation, debugging, and test content development tools and frameworks (e. g. , Jenkins, GDB, WinDbg). 
 - Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail. 
 - Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively in a team environment. 
 - Familiarity with version control systems (e. g. , Git) and issue tracking tools (e. g. , JIRA). 
 - Knowledge of industry standards and best practices related to server reset, platform validation, debugging, and test content development.

data.title: AI Innovation Engineer
data.description:
Vestas is the global leader in sustainable energy solutions and a driving force in the wind energy industry. Our core business encompasses the development, manufacturing, sales, installation, and servicing of wind turbines worldwide. At Vestas, we are committed to accelerating the transition to renewable energy while creating innovative solutions that deliver value to our customers and stakeholders. 

Digital Solutions & Development > Digital Solutions > Autonomous Flows - IN

The Autonomous Flows Advisors team sits within Vestas' Digital Development Platform and accelerates the AI and automation transformation across the business. We act as internal advisors and enablers, partnering with product teams and business areas across the value chain (R&D, commercial, manufacturing, supply chain, services and business services) to help shape the AI strategy, scope high-impact solutions, and ensure responsible, scalable AI adoption. We work closely with cyber, legal, and data governance, and collaborate with both technical and non-technical stakeholders at all levels. As an AI Innovation Lead, you will support the redesign and operationalize frontline workflows using AI and automation. Working closely with the business teams, local technology leads, and global product teams, you will help translate business priorities into measurable workflow transformations and operational prototypes. You'll be responsible for implementing the local solutions while keeping in mind potential risks and opportunities to turn your solutions into global product features. This is not a research or purely strategic role. You will be expected to get into the details, challenge assumptions, and deliver tangible innovation. 

Responsibilities

As an AI Innovation Lead, you will play an instrumental role in our efforts to enable the Vestas AI transformation. You will be responsible for: 

- Supporting the mapping and redesign of frontline workflows together with the relevant business teams - Assessing data readiness, technical feasibility, and implementation complexity for proposed automation initiatives
 - Supporting the definition of success metrics and expected business outcomes for each AI initiative, in collaboration with stakeholders
 - Developing local automations in collaboration with business stakeholders and subject matter experts
 - Connecting automations to relevant enterprise data and systems using approved integrations and connectors
 - Testing deployed prototypes with live frontline data and iteratively improving solution quality based on structured SME feedback and evaluation results
 - Identifying recurring workflow patterns, reusable components, and enterprise-scaling opportunities
 - Translating learnings into a structured backlog for global solutions product owners

Qualifications

To be successful in this role, you need to be a highly motivated, energetic, and self-driven person, who can work independently and collaboratively with a diverse set of stakeholders. We imagine that you have most of the qualifications and competences below: 

- A relevant degree in a quantitative field (IT, physics, mathematics, etc. ), business transformation, or similar, combining strong technical understanding and excellent communication skills - At least 3 years of relevant experience in a similar role
 - Practical understanding of automation and AI use cases, limitations, and pitfalls
 - Hands-on experience building AI, automation, or software solutions using modern AI development tools
 - Experience with product discovery, business process redesign, automation, operational excellence, or digital transformation initiatives

Competencies

- Pragmatic and structured approach to problem solving, with a focus on value creation
 - Excellent communication skills, both oral and written - Ability to work across complex organizations and manage conflicting stakeholder interests
 - Ability to translate complex AI concepts into clear, actionable language for non-technical stakeholders
 - You seek to constantly acquire new knowledge, stay up to date within AI, and challenge yourself
 - Fluent spoken and written English is a prerequisite

What We Offer

- Purpose. An opportunity to impact climate change and the future of next generations through automation and AI. 
 - Steep learning curve. You will be joining a strong team of AI advisors with both broad and deep knowledge. That means that you will have somebody to learn from, just as we will invest in continuous learning, knowledge sharing, and upskilling. 
 - Strong relationships. We will strive to build an informal environment of mutual trust and a tightly knit team, where we can support and inspire each other to deliver great impact for Vestas. 
 - Opportunity to shape your role. We have been asked to scale and anchor the impact of AI and automation across Vestas. The rest is up to us. 
 - Healthy work life balance, with flexible working options. 
 - Commitment to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace. Everyone can thrive and bring their unique perspectives and skills to the team. 

Additional Information

Your primary location will be in Chennai, India

Please note: We do amend or withdraw our jobs and reserve the right to do so at any time, including prior to the advertised closing date. Please be advised to apply on or before 30th Nov 2026

Learn more about Vestas at www. vestas. com and follow us on our social media channels

Our commitment to a fair hiring. 

At Vestas, we evaluate all candidates solely based on their professional experience, education, and relevant skills. To support a fair recruitment process, we kindly ask that you remove any photos, dates of birth or graduation, gender pronouns, marital status, or other personal information not relevant to the role before submitting your CV/resume. Your CV/resume should focus on your professional and educational background, along with the necessary contact details (email and phone number). We train our hiring teams in inclusive evaluation and regularly review process outcomes to ensure fairness. 

DEIB Statement

At Vestas, we recognize the value of diversity, equity, and inclusion in driving innovation and success. We strongly encourage individuals from all backgrounds to apply, particularly those who may hesitate due to their identity or feel they do not meet every criterion. As our CEO states, "Expertise and talent come in many forms, and a diverse workforce enhances our ability to think differently and solve the complex challenges of our industry". Your unique perspective is what will help us powering the solution for a sustainable, green energy future. 

BEWARE - RECRUITMENT FRAUD

About Vestas

Vestas is the energy industry's global partner on sustainable energy solutions. We are specialised in designing, manufacturing, installing, and servicing wind turbines, both onshore and offshore. 

Across the globe, we have installed more wind power than anyone else. We consider ourselves pioneers within the industry, as we continuously aim to design new solutions and technologies to create a more sustainable future for all of us. With more than 200 GW of wind power installed worldwide and 40+ years of experience in wind energy, we have an unmatched track record demonstrating our expertise within the field. 

With 39, 000 employees globally, we are a diverse team united by a common goal: to power the solution - today, tomorrow, and far into the future. 

Vestas promotes a diverse workforce which embraces all social identities and is free of any discrimination. We commit to create and sustain an environment that acknowledges and harvests different experiences, skills, and perspectives. We also aim to give everyone equal access to opportunity.

At Baxter, we believe every person-regardless of who they are or where they are from-deserves a chance to live a healthy life. It was our founding belief in 1931 and continues to be our guiding principle. We are redefining healthcare delivery to make a greater impact today, tomorrow, and beyond.

Here, you will find more than just a job-you will find purpose and pride. 

We are seeking a Principal Automation Engineer to define automation architecture, technical roadmaps, and engineering standards for API, UI, integration, and end-to-end testing. The ideal candidate is a systems-oriented Quality Engineer who understands how products and services interconnect, sees the broader product architecture, and can decompose requirements to capture use cases holistically. This hands-on role will lead the development of scalable C#/. NET frameworks, establish CI/CD quality gates, guide cross-team adoption, and resolve complex automation and testability challenges across distributed products. 

What You'll Be Doing

- Own the enterprise-grade automation architecture and roadmap for C#-based REST API, UI, integration, and workflow testing. 
 - Design modular frameworks with reusable libraries for configuration, service clients, page or component objects, test data, parallel execution, retries, logging, reporting, and environment management. 
 - Define coding standards, branching and review practices, framework governance, versioning, documentation, and contribution models. 
 - Establish pipeline strategy for pull-request validation, daily smoke tests, staged regression, release qualification, and automated quality gates. 
 - Guide teams on automation suitability, testability, coverage modelling, risk-based selection, and reduction of flaky or low-value tests. 
 - Lead technical reviews, proofs of concept, framework migrations, tool evaluations, and resolution of complex cross-service failures. 
 - Define dashboards and metrics for coverage, reliability, execution time, defect containment, failure causes, and productivity gains. 
 - Partner with architecture, software, DevOps, cybersecurity, systems, and verification leaders to embed quality throughout delivery. 
 - Mentor automation engineers and build engineering capability through reusable assets, coaching, and technical communities of practice. 

What You'll Bring

- B. E. /B. Tech in Computer Science, Electronics & Communication, Electrical Engineering, or a related field. 
 - 10 years of experience defining automation architecture, technical roadmaps, and engineering standards for API, UI, integration, and end-to-end testing. 
 - Mandatory: Systems-oriented Quality Engineer with a strong understanding of how products, services, and components interconnect; able to see the broader product architecture and decompose requirements to capture use cases holistically. 
 - Mandatory: Hands-on Automation Architect with advanced C# and . NET skills and a strong understanding of software design principles, dependency injection, concurrency, asynchronous execution, and extensible architecture. 
 - Mandatory: Hands-on experience architecting and developing REST API automation frameworks using RestSharp. 
 - Mandatory: Strong hands-on experience with NUnit or Selenium or playwright for test automation. 
 - Mandatory: Working knowledge of GraphQL (GQL) and experience validating GraphQL APIs. 
 - Mandatory: Solid understanding of test data management principles, strategies, and reusable data provisioning approaches. 
 - Mandatory: Strong awareness of Kubernetes and containerized test environments. 
 - Good understanding of communication protocols, particularly SIP, and hands-on exposure to SIPp for protocol-level testing. 
 - Expertise in API contracts, distributed systems, microservices, event-driven integrations, databases, authentication, authorization, and service virtualization. 
 - Deep experience with Git, CI/CD architecture, parallel execution, automated reporting, and quality gates. 
 - Proven ability to improve framework reliability, diagnose flaky tests, optimize execution, and drive adoption across multiple teams. 
 - Strong technical leadership, stakeholder communication, mentoring, and architecture decision-making skills. 

Preferred Skills

- Experience with Allure reporting is preferred. 
 - Experience with Postman is good to have. 
 - Experience with Azure, Docker, infrastructure-as-code, message brokers, observability platforms, and cloud-native test environments. 
 - Experience validating healthcare platforms, HL7/FHIR integrations, connected devices, or regulated software products. 
 - Knowledge of security, accessibility, performance, reliability, and resilience testing within a unified automation strategy. 
 - Relevant Microsoft, cloud, architecture, or testing certification is advantageous. 
 - Knowledge of SIP infrastructure and media components such as Kamailio, FreeSWITCH, RTPEngine, SBCs, registrars, RTP, and WebRTC. 
 - Experience with Azure Key Vault, Azure App Configuration, Azure Cache for Redis, Azure Web PubSub, Terraform, KEDA, and container security tooling. 
 - Familiarity with IEC 62304, ISO 13485, risk management, cybersecurity expectations, and quality systems for regulated healthcare software. 
 - Experience with Jira, Jama, validated toolchains, Agile/Scrum delivery, and formal release-readiness reviews. 
 - Experience leading a team of automation testers toward a common goal. 

Equal Employment Opportunity

Baxter is an equal opportunity employer. Baxter evaluates qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, gender, national origin, age, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, protected veteran status, disability/handicap status or any other legally protected characteristic. 

Reasonable Accommodations

Baxter is committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities globally. If, because of a medical condition or disability, you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the application or interview process, please click on the link here and let us know the nature of your request along with your contact information. 

Recruitment Fraud Notice

Baxter has discovered incidents of employment scams, where fraudulent parties pose as Baxter employees, recruiters, or other agents, and engage with online job seekers in an attempt to steal personal and/or financial information. To learn how you can protect yourself, review our Recruitment Fraud Notice.

We are looking for an experienced Shopify Team Lead - AI-Enabled E-commerce to lead the architecture, development, integration, and delivery of scalable, high-performance Shopify e-commerce solutions for Shop LC. 

This role combines hands-on Shopify engineering expertise with technical leadership and AI-enabled software development practices. The ideal candidate should have strong experience in Shopify Plus, modern web technologies, custom application development, API integrations, event-driven architecture, and cloud-based services. 

In addition to leading engineering delivery, the candidate will drive the adoption of AI-assisted Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC) practices to improve developer productivity, code quality, automation, and overall engineering efficiency. 

The role requires a hands-on technical leader who can build and mentor a high-performing engineering team while establishing AI-first development practices and scalable engineering standards.

- Lead the development, enhancement, and maintenance of Shopify Plus and Shopify-based e-commerce platforms.

 - Collaborate with Product, Architecture, DevOps, QA, and Business teams to translate business requirements into effective technical solutions. 2. Custom Application Development & Integration

- Lead the design and development of custom applications and backend services supporting Shopify ecosystems.

 - Ensure application reliability, maintainability, security, and performance. 3. Event-Driven Architecture & Backend Engineering

- Design and implement reliable event-driven systems and asynchronous workflows between Shopify and backend applications. 
 - Work with Apache Kafka, including producers, consumers, topics, partitions, consumer groups, retry mechanisms, and error handling. 
 - Manage Shopify Webhooks, including registration, event processing, reliability, retries, idempotency, and monitoring. 
 - Leverage Redis for caching, session and token management, distributed locking, and performance optimization. 
 - Design and maintain reliable backend services and integrations with appropriate error handling and fault tolerance. 4. Database Management & Optimization

- Design, develop, and optimize database solutions using PostgreSQL and Microsoft SQL Server. 
 - Work with database schema design, stored procedures, complex queries, and transaction management. 
 - Ensure data consistency, concurrency management, and efficient database connectivity through connection pooling. 
 - Manage data migration, synchronization, and integration across multiple systems. 
 - Implement effective caching and database performance optimization strategies. 5. AI-Enabled Engineering & Development Lifecycle (ADLC)

- Drive the adoption of AI-assisted Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC) practices across the engineering team. 
 - Leverage AI coding assistants such as Cursor, Claude, GitHub Copilot, and equivalent tools to improve development productivity. 
 - Integrate AI into different stages of the development lifecycle, including: 
 - Requirement analysis and refinement
 - Technical solution and design generation
 - Code generation and development
 - Unit and integration test generation
 - Code reviews and debugging
 - Documentation and refactoring
 - Test automation and deployment support
 - Establish effective human-in-the-loop development practices to ensure quality, accuracy, and accountability. 
 - Define AI-assisted coding standards, engineering guardrails, and governance practices. 
 - Evaluate AI-generated code for security, performance, scalability, maintainability, and architectural compliance. 
 - Develop reusable prompts, coding patterns, AI agent workflows, and engineering standards. 
 - Explore and implement AI agents, agentic development workflows, and automated engineering processes. 
 - Drive AI adoption across the team to improve development speed, engineering quality, and overall delivery efficiency. 6. Team Leadership & Delivery Management

- Lead, mentor, and develop a team of Shopify engineers and full-stack developers. 
 - Translate business requirements into technical specifications, user stories, and development tasks. 
 - Provide technical direction, conduct architecture discussions, and oversee code and design reviews. 
 - Ensure timely delivery of high-quality, scalable, and maintainable solutions. 
 - Identify technical risks, dependencies, and opportunities for process improvement. 
 - Establish engineering best practices around coding standards, automation, testing, and observability. 
 - Provide technical guidance during production issues and incident resolution. 
 - Foster a culture of ownership, collaboration, continuous learning, and innovation. 

Required Technical Skills & Expertise

Technical Area - Required Skills

Shopify - Shopify Plus, Shopify APIs, GraphQL, Liquid

Shopify Development - Custom Apps, Extensions, Functions, Webhooks

Frontend Development - React. js, JavaScript, TypeScript

AI & Engineering Leadership Expectations

The candidate should demonstrate the ability to move beyond traditional software development and establish an AI-first engineering environment. 

They should understand how AI can be effectively integrated across the entire development lifecycle: 

Requirement Analysis → Solution Design → Development → Testing → Code Review → Deployment → Monitoring

The candidate should be capable of: 

- Identifying opportunities to automate repetitive engineering activities through AI.
