data.title: Associate Software Engineer - Data Path
data.description:
Associate Software Engineer, C++ Linux

Location: Nasuni Hyderabad IIC - Hybrid, 3 days in office

Role Overview

Nasuni is looking for an Associate Software Engineer to join our Datapath team in Hyderabad. This is an early-career engineering role for someone who wants to build strong foundations in C++, Linux, systems programming, debugging, and performance-sensitive software. 

You will contribute to the core data-path capabilities behind Nasuni's cloud-native file data platform - the software that helps enterprise customers access, move, protect, and manage file data across distributed environments. You will work with experienced engineers to implement well-defined code changes, fix defects, strengthen test coverage, investigate issues, and learn how reliable, scalable systems are built. 

This role is a strong fit for someone who enjoys low-level problem solving, wants to grow in C++/Linux engineering, and is curious about storage, networking, concurrency, file systems, and distributed infrastructure. It is not a fit for someone looking primarily for people management, senior architecture ownership, or general web application development without systems depth. 

Level & Scope Definition

You will own assigned tasks, defects, tests, and small implementation areas with guidance from senior engineers. You will participate in design discussions, code reviews, debugging sessions, sprint planning, and technical learning within the Datapath team. Your decision authority will grow as you demonstrate code quality, testing discipline, and understanding of Nasuni's platform. 

Responsibilities

- Implement, test, and maintain C++/Linux software for well-defined Datapath features, fixes, and tools. 
 - Debug issues in your code or assigned components using logs, tests, debuggers, and mentor guidance. 
 - Write unit tests, improve test coverage, and help reproduce product issues with QA and Performance Engineering. 
 - Learn and apply systems concepts involving memory, threading, file I/O, networking, latency, throughput, and reliability. 
 - Participate in code reviews, design reviews, and technical discussions with clear questions and thoughtful feedback. 
 - Use AI-assisted engineering tools for code exploration, test ideas, debugging hypotheses, and documentation while validating correctness, security, and maintainability before using outputs. 

Expected Outcomes and Impact

In your first year, you will deliver reliable assigned code changes, improve test coverage, resolve defects with increasing independence, build practical C++/Linux debugging skills, and develop trusted working relationships within the Hyderabad engineering team. 

Qualifications

Must-Have

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or related technical field, or equivalent practical experience. 
 - 0-2 years of software engineering experience, including internships, co-ops, academic projects, open-source work, or early professional experience. 
 - Foundational C++ or C programming experience on Linux. 
 - Understanding of data structures, algorithms, operating systems, and basic networking concepts. 
 - Basic debugging experience using tools such as gdb, logs, test output, Linux command-line tools, or similar diagnostics. 
 - Ability to write clear code, respond to code review feedback, and communicate task status clearly. 
 - Curiosity about using AI-assisted development tools responsibly with human review and validation. 

Preferred

- Internship, project, or coursework involving systems software, file systems, storage, distributed systems, databases, networking, or performance-sensitive software. 
 - Exposure to multi-threaded programming, memory management, file I/O, sockets, or Linux internals. 
 - Experience writing unit tests or using Python, Go, shell scripting, or similar tools for automation. 
 - Familiarity with Git, CI/CD workflows, Linux build tools, sanitizers, tracing, or profiling tools. 
 - Practical use of AI coding assistants for learning, test generation, documentation, or debugging with careful validation. 

Ideal

- Completed a meaningful C++/Linux systems project with measurable performance, reliability, or correctness goals. 
 - Demonstrated strong debugging discipline through internships, labs, open-source work, or personal projects. 
 - Known for learning quickly, asking good technical questions, and taking ownership of assigned work. 

Experience Guidelines

Most aligned candidates will have 0-2 years of total software engineering experience. Strong academic, internship, open-source, or project-based C++/Linux experience may substitute for professional experience. Candidates with more experience may be considered if they are motivated by Associate-level scope, mentorship, and hands-on systems learning. 

About Nasuni

Nasuni is the unstructured data foundation for enterprise teams and the AI that supports them. We manage, protect, and activate the world's unstructured data so organizations can work smarter, spend wisely, and create safely without limits. As a Vista-backed SaaS data infrastructure company, Nasuni is transforming how enterprises manage file data with a next-generation, AI-ready platform for intelligent automation, analytics, and global collaboration. This positioning aligns with Nasuni's 2026 brand language around people, data, AI, and the operational file layer where work happens. 

Why Work at Nasuni - Hyderabad / India

With Vista Equity Partners' backing, our Hyderabad team benefits from access to a global ecosystem of software leaders, cross-portfolio learning, leadership programs, and AI innovation communities. You'll work at the intersection of cloud, AI, and enterprise data infrastructure while collaborating with talented teams building platforms trusted by enterprises worldwide. Nasuni offers competitive compensation programs, flexible time off and leave policies, comprehensive health and wellness coverage, hybrid work arrangements, employee referral and recognition programs, professional development support, an inclusive team culture, modern office spaces, team events, and statutory benefits as per Indian regulations. 

This privacy notice relates to information collected (whether online or offline) by Nasuni Corporation and our corporate affiliates (collectively, "Nasuni") from or about you in your capacity as a Nasuni employee, independent contractor/service provider or as an applicant for an employment or contractor relationship with Nasuni.

data.title: Senior Software Engineer - Trusted Data Platform
data.description:
Overview

Working at Atlassian

Atlassians can choose where they work - whether in an office, from home, or a combination of the two. That way, Atlassians have more control over supporting their family, personal goals, and other priorities. We can hire people in any country where we have a legal entity. Interviews and onboarding are conducted virtually, a part of being a distributed-first company. 

This role can be based remotely or from an Atlassian office where eligible. Whatever your preference - working from home, an office, or in between - you can choose the place that's best for your work and your lifestyle. We call this TEAM anywhere . 

Responsibilities

As a Senior Software Engineer, you will play a critical role in designing, building, and optimizing high-performance, scalable, and resilient backend storage solutions on AWS cloud infrastructure. You will be responsible for developing distributed storage systems, APIs, and backend services that power mission-critical applications, ensuring low-latency, high-throughput, and fault-tolerant data storage. Your work will directly impact system reliability, scalability, and cost efficiency. 

You will collaborate closely with principal engineers, architects, SREs, and product teams to define technical roadmaps, improve storage efficiency, and optimize access patterns. You will drive performance tuning, data modeling, caching strategies, and cost optimization across AWS storage services like S3, DynamoDB, EBS, EFS, FSx, and Glacier. Additionally, you will contribute to infrastructure automation, security best practices, and monitoring strategies using tools like Terraform, CloudWatch, Prometheus, and OpenTelemetry. 

In this role, you will also be responsible for troubleshooting and resolving production incidents related to data integrity, latency spikes, and storage failures, ensuring high availability and disaster recovery preparedness. You will mentor junior engineers, participate in design reviews and architectural discussions, and advocate for engineering best practices such as CI/CD automation, infrastructure as code, and observability-driven development. Your contributions will directly impact the organization's ability to scale its storage infrastructure efficiently while maintaining security, reliability, and compliance with industry standards. 

Qualifications

Strong Backend Development Skills

- 8+ years of experience in backend software development
 - Proficiency in Kotlin or Java for backend development
 - Experience building high-performance, scalable microservices and APIs
 - Strong understanding of RESTful APIs, gRPC, and event-driven architectures

Experience With AWS Storage Technologies

- Hands-on experience with AWS S3, DynamoDB, EBS, EFS, FSx, and Glacier
 - Knowledge of AWS IAM, KMS, and data access policies for secure storage solutions
 - Understanding of AWS networking (VPC, PrivateLink, Route 53) for optimizing storage performance

Distributed Systems & Scalability

- Solid understanding of distributed databases, storage consistency models, and caching mechanisms
 - Experience with sharding, partitioning, and load balancing to scale storage-heavy applications
 - Familiarity with event-driven architectures using AWS SNS, SQS, Kinesis, or Kafka

Performance Optimization & Cost Efficiency

- Ability to profile and optimize storage performance, indexing strategies, and data retrieval latencies
 - Experience with cost-efficient storage solutions by implementing tiering, lifecycle policies, and data deduplication
 - Knowledge of benchmarking and monitoring tools (CloudWatch, OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Grafana)

Security & Reliability

- Experience implementing data encryption at rest and in transit using AWS KMS or TLS
 - Understanding of access control mechanisms (IAM roles, STS, fine-grained permissions)
 - Experience ensuring high availability and disaster recovery using AWS backup strategies and multi-region replication

Hands-On with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) & DevOps

- Experience using Terraform, AWS CloudFormation, or CDK to manage infrastructure
 - Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines for backend deployments using GitHub Actions, CodePipeline, or Jenkins
 - Experience with containerized deployments using Docker, Kubernetes (EKS), and serverless solutions (Lambda, Fargate)

Troubleshooting & Production Support

- Strong debugging skills for investigating storage failures, high-latency issues, and API bottlenecks
 - Experience using observability and tracing tools to monitor storage workloads
 - Ability to triage and resolve production incidents in large-scale backend systems

Collaboration & Engineering Best Practices

- Strong experience in code reviews, unit testing, and API contract enforcement
 - Ability to work cross-functionally with SREs, data engineers, and infrastructure teams
 - Good documentation habits for ensuring architecture decisions and design patterns are well-documented

Benefits & Perks

Atlassian offers a wide range of perks and benefits designed to support you, your family and to help you engage with your local community. Our offerings include health and wellbeing resources, paid volunteer days, and so much more. To learn more, visit go. atlassian. com/perksandbenefits . 

About Atlassian

At Atlassian, we're motivated by a common goal: to unleash the potential of every team. Our software products help teams all over the planet and our solutions are designed for all types of work. Team collaboration through our tools makes what may be impossible alone, possible together. 

We believe that the unique contributions of all Atlassians create our success. To ensure that our products and culture continue to incorporate everyone's perspectives and experience, we never discriminate based on race, religion, national origin, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, or marital, veteran, or disability status. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines. 

To provide you the best experience, we can support with accommodations or adjustments at any stage of the recruitment process. Simply inform our Recruitment team during your conversation with them. 

To learn more about our culture and hiring process, visit go. atlassian. com/crh .

data.title: Sr. Principal Engineer User Experience XIV
data.description:
Job Description

We are seeking a Senior Principal Engineer Software with a focus on UX architecture and front-end technical leadership for KVM&S products and platforms. This role is responsible for defining and evolving the user experience architecture and front-end engineering approach for complex product capabilities, ensuring that solutions are usable, accessible, consistent, secure, maintainable, and aligned with product and customer needs. The candidate will work closely with Product Management, UX/design, software development, QA, architecture, DevOps, and other corporate functions to translate user and product requirements into robust user experiences and scalable front-end solutions. The role combines strategic UX technology direction with hands-on technical guidance, design governance, mentoring, and cross-team collaboration. 

- Own and evolve the UX and front-end architecture for assigned KVM&S products, defining patterns, frameworks, component structures, and integration approaches that support consistent user experiences. 
 - Translate customer workflows, product requirements, and usability needs into clear technical designs and front-end implementation strategies. 
 - Partner with Product Management, UX/design, and engineering stakeholders to evaluate user journeys, information architecture, interaction patterns, and design trade-offs. 
 - Establish and maintain reusable UI components, design-system practices, front-end standards, and guidelines that improve consistency, maintainability, and development efficiency. 
 - Guide front-end implementation for complex product capabilities, ensuring responsive behavior, accessibility, performance, security, and compatibility with supported browsers and devices. 
 - Define integration patterns between UI applications and backend services/APIs, addressing error handling, data flow, state management, authentication, and system responsiveness. 
 - Lead technical design reviews and evaluate proposed solutions for scalability, maintainability, testability, performance, and alignment with the broader product architecture. 
 - Drive modernization of legacy user interfaces and front-end frameworks, balancing customer continuity, usability improvements, technical risk, and long-term platform sustainability. 
 - Work closely with Development and Test/QA teams to define UI testability, automation strategy, regression coverage, and quality criteria for end-to-end user workflows. 
 - Lead investigation and resolution of complex UX and front-end issues, including performance bottlenecks, accessibility gaps, integration defects, and customer-impacting usability problems. 
 - Mentor engineers and technical leads in front-end architecture, UI engineering practices, code quality, design-system adoption, and effective collaboration with UX/design teams. 
 - Collaborate across product teams to align UI patterns and shared capabilities, reduce duplication, and improve consistency across the KVM&S product portfolio. 
 - Support Agile execution by clarifying technical scope, identifying UX and integration dependencies early, contributing to estimation, and helping teams deliver predictable outcomes. 
 - Identify opportunities to improve engineering productivity through UI automation, reusable tooling, AI-assisted development, and improved design-to-development workflows. 
 - Contribute to front-end technology roadmaps, architecture standards, proof-of-concepts, innovation initiatives, and long-term product experience strategy. 

Qualifications

Minimum Qualifications: 

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Human-Computer Interaction, or equivalent practical experience. 
 - Extensive software engineering experience with demonstrated expertise in front-end architecture and delivery of complex, production-grade web applications. 
 - Experience defining reusable UI components, front-end architecture patterns, application structure, state management, and API integration strategies. 
 - Demonstrated understanding of usability, responsive design, accessibility, browser compatibility, and web application performance. 
 - Experience with front-end testing approaches, including unit, component, integration, and end-to-end testing. 
 - Experience with Git-based source control, code review practices, build systems, and CI/CD workflows. 
 - Understanding of web application security, authentication/authorization integration, secure coding, and handling of sensitive data in user interfaces. 
 - Strong debugging and problem-solving skills, including the ability to investigate complex UI, API, and cross-component issues. 
 - Demonstrated technical leadership, architecture/design review, mentoring, and cross-functional collaboration capabilities. 
 - Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain technical trade-offs to design, product, and engineering stakeholders. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with enterprise software, infrastructure-management products, access appliances, device-management platforms, or related KVM&S solutions. 
 - Experience working with UX designers and product teams to establish design systems, interaction standards, user workflows, and usability validation practices. 
 - Experience modernizing legacy front-end applications and introducing reusable component libraries or shared UI platforms. 
 - Knowledge of web accessibility standards and practices, including WCAG, and experience improving accessibility in enterprise applications. 
 - Experience integrating complex web applications with REST/gRPC services, authentication systems, event-driven updates, and large or frequently changing datasets. 
 - Experience with front-end performance profiling, observability, browser developer tools, and systematic UI troubleshooting. 
 - Experience with automated UI testing tools and frameworks, and integrating them into CI/CD pipelines. 
 - Experience collaborating with distributed development, QA, DevOps, product, and architecture teams. 
 - Experience applying AI-assisted engineering, workflow automation, or design-to-code tools to improve UX engineering productivity. 
 - Experience leading technical initiatives across multiple teams and influencing front-end technology direction and engineering standards. 

About Us

data.title: Senior Software Engineer - Trusted Data Platform
data.description:
Overview

Working at Atlassian

Atlassians can choose where they work - whether in an office, from home, or a combination of the two. That way, Atlassians have more control over supporting their family, personal goals, and other priorities. We can hire people in any country where we have a legal entity. Interviews and onboarding are conducted virtually, a part of being a distributed-first company. 

This role can be based remotely or from an Atlassian office where eligible. Whatever your preference - working from home, an office, or in between - you can choose the place that's best for your work and your lifestyle. We call this TEAM anywhere . 

Responsibilities

As a Senior Software Engineer, you will play a critical role in designing, building, and optimizing high-performance, scalable, and resilient backend storage solutions on AWS cloud infrastructure. You will be responsible for developing distributed storage systems, APIs, and backend services that power mission-critical applications, ensuring low-latency, high-throughput, and fault-tolerant data storage. Your work will directly impact system reliability, scalability, and cost efficiency. 

You will collaborate closely with principal engineers, architects, SREs, and product teams to define technical roadmaps, improve storage efficiency, and optimize access patterns. You will drive performance tuning, data modeling, caching strategies, and cost optimization across AWS storage services like S3, DynamoDB, EBS, EFS, FSx, and Glacier. Additionally, you will contribute to infrastructure automation, security best practices, and monitoring strategies using tools like Terraform, CloudWatch, Prometheus, and OpenTelemetry. 

In this role, you will also be responsible for troubleshooting and resolving production incidents related to data integrity, latency spikes, and storage failures, ensuring high availability and disaster recovery preparedness. You will mentor junior engineers, participate in design reviews and architectural discussions, and advocate for engineering best practices such as CI/CD automation, infrastructure as code, and observability-driven development. Your contributions will directly impact the organization's ability to scale its storage infrastructure efficiently while maintaining security, reliability, and compliance with industry standards. 

Qualifications

Strong Backend Development Skills

- 8+ years of experience in backend software development
 - Proficiency in Kotlin or Java for backend development
 - Experience building high-performance, scalable microservices and APIs
 - Strong understanding of RESTful APIs, gRPC, and event-driven architectures

Experience With AWS Storage Technologies

- Hands-on experience with AWS S3, DynamoDB, EBS, EFS, FSx, and Glacier
 - Knowledge of AWS IAM, KMS, and data access policies for secure storage solutions
 - Understanding of AWS networking (VPC, PrivateLink, Route 53) for optimizing storage performance

Distributed Systems & Scalability

- Solid understanding of distributed databases, storage consistency models, and caching mechanisms
 - Experience with sharding, partitioning, and load balancing to scale storage-heavy applications
 - Familiarity with event-driven architectures using AWS SNS, SQS, Kinesis, or Kafka

Performance Optimization & Cost Efficiency

- Ability to profile and optimize storage performance, indexing strategies, and data retrieval latencies
 - Experience with cost-efficient storage solutions by implementing tiering, lifecycle policies, and data deduplication
 - Knowledge of benchmarking and monitoring tools (CloudWatch, OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Grafana)

Security & Reliability

- Experience implementing data encryption at rest and in transit using AWS KMS or TLS
 - Understanding of access control mechanisms (IAM roles, STS, fine-grained permissions)
 - Experience ensuring high availability and disaster recovery using AWS backup strategies and multi-region replication

Hands-On with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) & DevOps

- Experience using Terraform, AWS CloudFormation, or CDK to manage infrastructure
 - Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines for backend deployments using GitHub Actions, CodePipeline, or Jenkins
 - Experience with containerized deployments using Docker, Kubernetes (EKS), and serverless solutions (Lambda, Fargate)

Troubleshooting & Production Support

- Strong debugging skills for investigating storage failures, high-latency issues, and API bottlenecks
 - Experience using observability and tracing tools to monitor storage workloads
 - Ability to triage and resolve production incidents in large-scale backend systems

Collaboration & Engineering Best Practices

- Strong experience in code reviews, unit testing, and API contract enforcement
 - Ability to work cross-functionally with SREs, data engineers, and infrastructure teams
 - Good documentation habits for ensuring architecture decisions and design patterns are well-documented

Benefits & Perks

Atlassian offers a wide range of perks and benefits designed to support you, your family and to help you engage with your local community. Our offerings include health and wellbeing resources, paid volunteer days, and so much more. To learn more, visit go. atlassian. com/perksandbenefits . 

About Atlassian

At Atlassian, we're motivated by a common goal: to unleash the potential of every team. Our software products help teams all over the planet and our solutions are designed for all types of work. Team collaboration through our tools makes what may be impossible alone, possible together. 

We believe that the unique contributions of all Atlassians create our success. To ensure that our products and culture continue to incorporate everyone's perspectives and experience, we never discriminate based on race, religion, national origin, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, or marital, veteran, or disability status. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines. 

To provide you the best experience, we can support with accommodations or adjustments at any stage of the recruitment process. Simply inform our Recruitment team during your conversation with them. 

To learn more about our culture and hiring process, visit go. atlassian. com/crh .

data.title: Software Engineer- Software Test Engineer – IOS XR | Python Automation | L0/L1 Optical Testing 8 - 10 years
data.description:
Meet the Team / Who You'll Work With

The Cisco IOS XR Routing Test Team ensures the reliability, scalability, performance, and resiliency of Cisco's carrier-grade routing platforms. We work closely with software developers, architects, product managers, and customer-facing teams to deliver comprehensive, end-to-end validation across platforms, Optics, Layer 0, Layer 1 optical, routing, subscriber-management, and network-service technologies for service providers, hyperscalers, Optical and web-scale customers operating some of the world's largest and most demanding networks. Exciting career opportunities open for enthusiastic and experienced Software professionals in India

Our team values technical depth, automation-first engineering, continuous learning, collaborative problem-solving, and responsible adoption of AI-assisted development practices. 

Your Impact

Cisco provides you an excellent opportunity to take your career aspirations forward. You will bring your unique talents to the group that works on Cisco's routing technology, which large enterprises now consider to be the transport medium of choice for critically important networks. In your role as a Software Test Engineer, you will own the quality validation of IOS XR routing - Platform infra, Optics, Layer 0, Layer 1 capabilities. You will design test strategies, develop automation, validate complex customer scenarios, investigate system-level failures, and provide data-driven release recommendations. 

Your work will help ensure that Cisco delivers stable, scalable, and production-ready networking solutions. You will also mentor junior engineers, improve test frameworks, and use modern AI-assisted tools to accelerate engineering and solving workflows. 

What You Will Do

- Design and implement functional, system, regression, scale, performance, interoperability, resiliency, and high-availability tests for IOS XR routing - Platform Infra/Optics, L0/L1 test features. 
 - Develop reusable and scalable test automation using Python and frameworks such as pyATS, Genie, or equivalent tools. 
 - Build and maintain physical, virtual, containerized, and cloud-based test environments using Linux, Docker, Kubernetes, clustering technologies, VMware, OpenStack, and network simulation platforms. 
 - Solve complex issues using IOS XR logs, protocol traces, packet captures, telemetry, RADIUS transactions, crash information, and system-resource data. 
 - Validate model-driven interfaces and telemetry using YANG, NETCONF, RESTCONF, gNMI, gRPC, OpenConfig, and native IOS XR models. 
 - Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines, code reviews, version control, and regression testing. 
 - Use approved AI coding assistants and engineering agents for test generation, automation development, log analysis, defect triage, and documentation. 
 - Apply foundational knowledge of generative AI, AI agents, MCPs, reusable AI skills, prompt and context management, and responsible validation of AI-generated output. 
 - Collaborate across engineering teams, review test designs and automation code, mentor junior engineers, and communicate product-quality risks and release readiness. 
 - Work on Network automation, algorithmic thinking and Analytics applications derived from customer use cases
 - Strong in Software engineering test methodology and process knowledge

Minimum Qualifications

- Bachelor's or master's degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Telecommunications, or a related technical field. 
 - Eight or more years of experience in software engineering, network product testing, test automation, or quality engineering. 
 - Experience configuring and solving Cisco IOS XR or another carrier-grade network operating system. 
 - Advanced Python programming skills for test automation, scripting, API interaction, data analysis, and troubleshooting. 
 - Experience developing system, scale, performance, resiliency, and high-availability test scenarios. 
 - Strong Linux or Unix skills and experience with Git, code reviews, debugging, and CI/CD pipelines. 
 - Working knowledge of cloud, containerization, virtualization, and clustering technologies, including Docker, Kubernetes, VMware, and OpenStack. 
 - Familiarity with AI coding assistants such as GitHub Copilot or equivalent tools. 
 - Basic understanding of generative AI, AI agents, MCP, reusable skills, and responsible AI practices. 
 - Strong knowledge of software development life cycle. 
 - Strong analytical, solving, communication, and multi-functional collaboration skills. 
 - Deep understanding of customer deployments, operations and the ability to translate brown field/green field deployments into test strategy with high efficacy
 - Quick learner with an open mind to "grey box" testing, bringing in strategic on-the-box, off-the-box views that reflect the state of IOS-XR systems. 
 - Experience in test engineering concepts and methodologies including test planning, test case design, test execution and test automation
 - Excellent experience in Layer-0, Layer-1 traffic generators and analysers (e. g. Viavi, Agilent, Spirent, IXIA, etc. )
 - Strong written, verbal communication, and interpersonal skills
 - Results oriented with a high degree of accountability, dedication and responsibility
 - Industry certification such as CCNA/CCNP/CCIE/JCNA/JCIE will be a huge plus

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience testing Optical and routing capabilities on Cisco IOS XR platforms such as Cisco 8000, ASR 9000, NCS 5500/5700 and NCS1K
 - Experience with traffic generators and subscriber-simulation tools such as IXIA or Spirent or Viavi or JDSU. 
 - Strong knowledge of Layer 0 , Layer 1 testing along with platform & optics test skills. 
 - Experience with Datapath, model-driven telemetry, and network programmability. 
 - Familiarity with scale and performance characterization. 

Expectations

The successful candidate will operate as an experienced individual contributor who can independently own a significant routing or BNG feature area, develop production-quality automation, lead complex technical investigations, identify product and test risks, and provide evidence-based release recommendations. 

The engineer is also expected to influence test strategy, improve engineering practices, mentor junior team members, and use AI-assisted tools responsibly while maintaining security, accuracy, and engineering accountability. 

Why Cisco

At Cisco, you will work on technologies that power some of the world's largest networks. You will collaborate with experienced engineers, solve complex technical problems, and contribute to products with global impact. 

Cisco provides an inclusive environment, opportunities for continuous learning, and the ability to grow across networking, cloud, automation, and AI technologies. 

#WeAreCisco

Why Cisco?

At Cisco, we're revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era - and beyond. We've been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint. 

Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you'll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere. 

We are Cisco, and our power starts with you. 

Disclaimer

About

To ensure that we hire the best talent in the right way, we follow a strict hiring process and recently, Cisco has been made aware of fraudulent recruiters claiming to be from the company. Please be advised that any communication from Cisco about careers will: 

- be in direct response to an application you have submitted through the company career site
 - begin with screening or an interview
 - originate from a Cisco email address, and
 - be conducted across email, phone, or WebEx

Cisco will never make a job offer without conducting an interview process or ask you for money in any way. If you have been requested to apply for a role or have received an offer from a site other than https: //careers. cisco. com or cisco. wd5. myworkday. com, do not provide any personal identifying information, including your Aadhaar or other personal identifying number, birth certificate, banking information, driver's license, or passport. 

If you are the target of a recruiting scam, consider filing a report with your local law enforcement authorities. Cisco bears no responsibility, and cannot be held liable, for any claims, damages, expenses, or other inconvenience resulting from or in any way connected to recruiting scams.

We're looking for an experienced Principal Engineer, Firmware Verification Engineering to join our organization in Bengaluru, India. In this leadership role, you will drive the verification strategy and execution for complex firmware and embedded systems. The ideal candidate will bring deep technical expertise in firmware verification methodologies, strong analytical capabilities, and a proven track record of leading high-performing engineering teams to deliver robust, reliable products. est Architect - SSD Firmware & Feature Validation (FVT) Role Summary Define validation strategy, test methodologies, automation framework and test architectures to validate SSD firmware for NAND-based systems and solutions. Test areas will span across Feature and design level FW verification. The candidate will be responsible for architecting comprehensive validation solutions for enterprise SSD products, ensuring robust feature coverage across the FE, FTL and NIL FW modules. The role requires good expertise in NVMe/PCIe specifications, NVMe Cloud SSD specifications, OCP requirements, and customer-specific deployment scenarios. As a Test Architect, you will drive validation strategy from product definition through customer deployment, identifying coverage gaps, defining qualification criteria, improving product quality, and reducing customer issue escape rates. You will work closely with Firmware, Hardware, Systems Engineering, Product Management, Quality, and Hyperscale/Datacenter customers throughout the product lifecycle. The role requires the ability to communicate validation strategies, architecture decisions, risks, quality metrics, program status, and executive-level summaries effectively. The successful candidate must thrive in ambiguous environments, influence cross-functional teams, and drive complex technical initiatives with minimal direction. 

Experience

- 14+ years of experience in Embedded Firmware development/validation or 10+ years of SSD FW Verification with strong firmware and hardware debugging expertise. 
 - Strong hands-on experience in debugging and driving complex issues to closure
 - Good understanding on NVMe and PCIe protocol including Cloud SSD specification
 - Good understanding on SSD/NAND architecture
 - Proven experience in defining test strategies, qualification methodologies, and validation plans covering: Host Interface layer (HIL), Flash Translation Layer (FTL), NAND Management, Error Handling and Recovery Flows, Power Loss Protection (PLP), Reliability and Endurance Validation
 - Extensive experience architecting Feature Validation Test (FVT) coverage for Garbage collection, Wear levelling, Bad block management and Error injections
 - Good to have experience in developing validation plans for AI-centric storage workloads including: Model Training, Checkpointing, KV Cache, Inference, Agentic AI Workloads
 - Experience in test development and coding in Python
 - Experience translating product requirements and customer use cases into scalable validation architectures, test plans, coverage matrices, and automation frameworks. 
 - Prior experience validating SSD firmware and storage solutions for Datacenter, Enterprise, AI Compute, and Hyperscale environments. 
 - Define, develop, and implement new validation methodologies, automation frameworks, and tools to improve test effectiveness, coverage, and execution efficiency. 
 - Drive feature-level risk assessments and ensure validation completeness through requirements traceability and coverage analysis. 
 - Collaborate with architecture, firmware, and system teams to influence product design for testability and quality. 
 - Lead root-cause investigations by analyzing protocol captures, firmware logs, telemetry data, system traces, and performance metrics. 
 - Drive critical issues to closure by interfacing with Firmware, ASIC, Hardware, Systems, Reliability, and Customer Engineering teams. 
 - Own and scale the test infrastructure, improving test repeatability and coverage to accelerate the qualification cycle for next-generation NAND technologies. 
 - Demonstrated experience of leading big initiatives spanning multiple teams and organizations and leveraging deep domain expertise to influence product roadmap
 - Passionate about exploring and deploying noble methods to improve coverage, debugging, and efficiency of our FW releases. 

Qualifications

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electronics Engineering, or equivalent. 
 - Good knowledge of NVMe, PCIe and Datacenter SSD specifications
 - Strong understanding of SSD and FW architecture. 
 - Strong understanding of end-to-end storage stack interactions, including: CPU, Memory, PCIe, NVMe, Drivers, Operating Systems, Firmware, Virtualisation Layers, AI Accelerators (GPU/TPU)
 - Deep understanding of Feature Validation methodologies, test architecture design, coverage modelling, qualification metrics, defect escape prevention, and validation sign-off criteria. 
 - Strong expertise in Windows and Linux operating system debugging. 
 - Strong programming and automation skills using Python, including framework development
 - Experience building test frameworks, CI/CD-integrated validation solutions, automated reporting systems, and quality dashboards. 
 - Experience with AI infrastructure platforms, GPU-attached storage environments, and large-scale datacenter storage validation is highly desirable. 
 - Strong problem-solving, analytical, communication, technical leadership, and project management skills. 
 - Demonstrated capability to mentor engineers and provide technical leadership across multiple validation teams. 
 - Expert planning and execution skills with a strong focus on quality, efficiency, risk mitigation, and predictable project delivery. 
 - Highly skilled in leveraging AI-assisted tools for code generation, test creation, log analysis, root-cause identification, defect triage, coverage analysis, and automated report generation.

data.title: ETL Testing - SDET II
data.description:
Summary

Position Summary

Artificial Intelligence & Engineering

AI & Engineering leverages cutting-edge engineering capabilities to help build, deploy, and operate integrated/verticalized sector solutions in software, data, AI, network, and hybrid cloud infrastructure. These insights are powered by engineering for business advantage, helping transform mission-critical operations. 

Join our AI & Engineering team to help transform technology platforms, driving innovation, and help make a significant impact on our clients' achievements. You'll work alongside talented professionals reimagining and re-engineering operations and processes that could be critical to businesses. 

Position Summary: 

Role: SDET II

As an SDET II at Deloitte Consulting, you will deliver high-quality testing outcomes across ETL, data warehouse, and data migration initiatives. In this role, you will translate functional and nonfunctional requirements into structured test scenarios, execute testing activities, document and triage defects, and support timely delivery across project milestones. You will also contribute to quality assurance practices, collaborate with cross-functional teams, and help drive consistent, scalable testing approaches across engagements. 

Work you'll do

As an SDET II on the Engineering as a Service team, you will be responsible for

- Analyze business, functional, and nonfunctional requirements to design ETL, integration, and data migration test scenarios, test cases, and traceability artifacts. 
 - Execute ETL, integration, and data validation testing, document defects, support defect triage, and track issues through resolution. 
 - Validate data mappings, transformation logic, and pipeline outputs to help ensure accuracy, completeness, and consistency across source and target systems. 
 - Create and maintain test data, test documentation, and test result reports, including performance testing outputs where applicable. 
 - Participate in Agile ceremonies, collaborate with onshore and offshore teams, escalate risks or blockers, and contribute to continuous improvement and test automation efforts. 

The team

Engineering as a Service provides complete design, implementation, and technology operations, leveraging our core engineering expertise. We transform engineering teams, modernize technology, and deliver complex programs with a product engineering approach. Our flexible delivery models-traditional teams, pools, or pods-are tailored to each client's needs, offering engineering-led advisory, implementation, and operational capabilities to accelerate innovation. 

Location: Hyderabad/Bengaluru/Pune/Chennai

Shift Timings: 11 AM to 8 PM and 2 PM to 11 PM

Qualifications

Required: 

- 3-6 years of hands-on experience in testing data validation scenarios and Data ingestion, pipelines, and transformation processes. 
 - Hands-on experience on Cloud platform like AWS, Azure, GCP etc. 
 - Hands On experience and strong knowledge of complex SQL queries including aggregation logic. 
 - An understanding of big data engineering tools and how they can be used strategically (e. g. Spark, Hive, Hadoop, Dask). 
 - Experience in analyzing Data Mappings, Functional requirements and converting them into test scenarios / cases. 
 - Experience in different test phases with standardized QA Processes
 - Experience with QA specific tools for test management, test execution progress, defect tracking and triaging. 
 - Experience in different SDLC/STLC lifecycles and methodologies. 
 - Understanding of Test Strategy & Test Planning
 - Experience in defect logging, tracking, and closing defects
 - Experience in test status reporting and managing a small team of 2-3 members (for tenured consultants)
 - Strong understanding of different software development life cycles (Agile, waterfall) and contemporary software quality assurance processes and automated tools
 - Knowledge and 3+ year experience with modern testing development practices and integrated testing products such as Pyspark based automation, Market tools like (QuerySerge, Talend, ETL Validator etc. ) and their integration with tools such as Gitlab, etc. 
 - Experience with scripting languages like Unix Shell or Python for automating ETL testing. 
 - Hands-on experience on data modelling and data profiling tool. 
 - Perform analysis of data migration from various sources to target system in Cloud platform/ On prem environment. 
 - Flexibility to adapt and apply innovation to varied business domain and apply technical solutioning and learnings to use cases across business domains and industries

Preferred : 

- 2+ yrs. of experience in API testing (JSON, XML), API automation, creation of virtualized services, service virtualization testing using any of the industry tools like CA Dev Test/Parasoft/ CA Lisa
 - Ability to perform estimation of test activities using quantitative methods
 - Knowledge and experience working with Microsoft Office tool
 - Experience on analyzing slow performing database queries / execution plan analysis. 
 - 3-6 years of experience working with ETL testing and Data migration testing. 

Our purpose

Deloitte's purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities. 

Our people and culture

Our inclusive culture empowers our people to be who they are, contribute their unique perspectives, and make a difference individually and collectively. It enables us to leverage different ways of thinking, ideas and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients' most complex challenges. This makes Deloitte one of the most rewarding places to work. 

Professional development

At Deloitte, professionals have the opportunity to work with some of the best and discover what works best for them. Here, we prioritize professional growth, offering diverse learning and networking opportunities to help accelerate careers and enhance leadership skills. Our state-of-the-art DU: The Leadership Center in India, located in Hyderabad, represents a tangible symbol of our commitment to the holistic growth and development of our people. Explore DU: The Leadership Center in India . 

Benefits To Help You Thrive

At Deloitte, we know that great people make a great organization. Our comprehensive rewards program helps us deliver a distinctly Deloitte experience that helps that empowers our professionals to thrive mentally, physically, and financially-and live their purpose. To support our professionals and their loved ones, we offer a broad range of benefits. Eligibility requirements may be based on role, tenure, type of employment and/ or other criteria. Learn more about what working at Deloitte can mean for you. 

Recruiting tips

From developing a stand out resume to putting your best foot forward in the interview, we want you to feel prepared and confident as you explore opportunities at Deloitte. Check out recruiting tips from Deloitte recruiters.

data.description:
Summary

Position Summary

USI UK Digital Innovation - Quality Analyst - Senior - Hyderabad/Bengaluru

Deloitte Tax Services India Private Limited ("Deloitte Tax in India") commenced operations in June 2004. Since then, nearly all of the Deloitte Tax LLP ("Deloitte Tax") U. S. service lines and regions have obtained support through Deloitte Tax in India. Deloitte Tax in India offers you opportunities to learn, support and practice taxation, a much sought-after career option. In recent years, member firms, such as Australia, Belgium, Canada, Germany, the Netherlands, the United Kingdom, etc. have obtained support in their tax practices through the Deloitte Tax in India. 

At Deloitte, we are leading clients through the tax transformation taking place in the marketplace. We offer a broad range of fully integrated tax services and add greater impact to clients by combining technology and tax technical resources to uncover insights and smarter solutions for navigating an increasingly complex global environment. 

Work you'll do

Perform quality assessment of applications developed using modern web technologies such as ASP. net and Angular. You will use hands-on quality engineering combining practical manual testing with AI-assisted testing to help the team expand reliable automation and reusable QA assets and capabilities. Working as a collaborative peer, you will partner with QA colleagues, developers, and product leads to improve testability, accelerate feedback, and ensure deliverables meet business requirements and quality standards. 

Key Responsibilities: 

- Perform hands-on functional, exploratory, regression, integration, system, and end-to-end testing for assigned applications. 
 - Design, develop, maintain, and troubleshoot reliable UI automation using Playwright and an appropriate programming language. 
 - Identify stable, repeatable manual scenarios suitable for automation and convert them into maintainable automated tests. 
 - Build reusable QA assets such as test-data utilities, API helpers, fixtures, reporting tools, templates, and environment checks. 
 - Contribute automated tests to CI/CD pipelines and investigate flaky tests, test failures, and pipeline issues. 
 - Perform API testing and create automated service-level checks where appropriate. 
 - Collaborate with developers and product leads to clarify requirements and acceptance criteria, improve testability, investigate defects, and validate fixes. 
 - Own defined testing workstreams, including planning, execution, defect management, evidence, reporting, and release-readiness inputs. 
 - Pair with QA colleagues to convert repeatable manual tests into automation and share engineering practices through working sessions, examples, documentation, and code reviews. 
 - Contribute to repository structure, automation standards, quality metrics, and continuous-improvement initiatives. 
 - Prototype small AI-assisted QA utilities or agents, such as test-scenario generation, defect summarization, test-data preparation, or failure triage, using approved tools and appropriate human review. 
 - Support releases, participate in Agile ceremonies, and communicate progress, risks, defects, dependencies, and quality outcomes clearly. 
 - Continue to apply manual and exploratory testing where automation is not suitable or where human judgment provides greater value. 

A successful candidate should: 

- Be a hands-on practitioner who is comfortable moving between thoughtful manual testing, automation code, and defect investigation. 
 - Enjoy pairing with colleagues and sharing knowledge without relying on formal authority. 
 - Demonstrate curiosity and a practical learning mindset toward new automation, engineering, and AI-assisted testing approaches. 
 - Write and communicate clearly with QA colleagues, developers, product leads, project teams, and business stakeholders. 
 - Be proactive, analytical, and comfortable challenging issues constructively using evidence. 
 - Demonstrate sound judgment, attention to detail, and a practical approach to prioritising quality risks. 
 - Be self-motivated, adaptable, and able to manage assigned work across locations and time zones. 
 - Explain technical issues and trade-offs clearly to both technical and nontechnical audiences. 

Qualifications & Skills: 

- Bachelor's degree in Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related discipline. 
 - Two to five years of experience in software testing, quality assurance, or quality engineering. 
 - Strong foundation in manual testing, including functional, exploratory, regression, integration, system, and end-to-end testing. 
 - Hands-on experience building and maintaining UI automation using Playwright. 
 - Working programming ability in C#, TypeScript, or JavaScript, with the ability to write clear, modular, and maintainable test code. Knowledge of other languages such as Python would be advantageous. 
 - Experience testing REST APIs using tools or code-based frameworks. 
 - Working knowledge of Git, branching, pull requests, and code-review practices. 
 - Ability to diagnose failures using logs, traces, screenshots, network requests, application behaviour, and test evidence. 
 - Understanding of test design, defect management, quality risk, SDLC, STLC, and Agile delivery. 
 - Preferred: Experience integrating automated tests into Azure DevOps. 
 - Preferred: Experience creating reusable test utilities, fixtures, test-data generators, mocks, stubs, or reporting components. 
 - Preferred: Familiarity with BDD, contract testing, accessibility testing, performance testing, or regression testing. 
 - Preferred: Working knowledge of SQL. 
 - Preferred: Exposure to AI-assisted development or testing tools, with an understanding of validation, security, privacy, traceability, and human-review requirements. 
 - Preferred: Evidence of learning through practical projects, prototypes, internal accelerators, or open-source contributions. 

Required Experience: 2 to 5 years

At Infotek [i-TEK RFID], we specialize in delivering smart, connected embedded solutions for industrial, logistics, and infrastructure applications. Experience- 10+years

We are seeking an experienced Senior Embedded Systems Engineer to lead the architecture, development, and deployment of our RFID-enabled IoT devices. The ideal candidate will bring strong expertise in Embedded C, Linux system programming, and Python scripting, along with leadership skills to guide a small team of developers. You will be responsible for low-level firmware, Linux-based system components, and backend integration using MQTT and related IoT protocols. - Design and develop embedded applications in C and system-level software for Linux-based SBCs (ARM64, x86_64).

 - Hands-on experience with UART, RFID module integration, or similar peripherals.

 - Strong debugging and performance analysis skills (e. g. , GDB, dmesg, perf, strace).

data.description:
Role Summary

The Applications Development Technical Lead Analyst is a senior engineering and architectural leadership role based in India, operating as a key regional anchor within the global Position Management technology organization. 

In this capacity, you will serve as the principal designer, systems architect, and hands-on lead engineer for mission-critical, low latency, and high-throughput platform. This platforms powers real-time controls, intraday position aggregation, P&L, commissions, anomaly detection, and live risk enforcement across global trading desks. 

As an engineering leader, you will collaborate extensively with other global teams and stakeholders across Asia, Europe, and Americas. You will champion modern engineering practices - actively designing, building, and prototyping using AI-augmented tools such as GitHub Copilot, Devin to accelerate development of lifecycles, elevate code quality, and modernize enterprise architectures. Additionally, you will serve as the primary regional and global technical contact for Risk Managers, Product Owners, Front-Office Trading Desks, and cross-functional technology partners. 

Key Responsibilities

- Architecture, System Design & Core Engineering (Hands-on)
 - Architect & Design: Lead the end-to-end technical architecture and low-level design for distributed, fault-tolerant, high-concurrency risk calculation and position management engines supporting global trading sessions. 
 - Hands-on Development: 10+ years of experience to actively write, review, and optimize high-performance, multi-threaded production code primarily in C++, with targeted high-performance/low-latency modules in Java and exploring Rust where ultra-low latency memory safety and deterministic execution are required. 
 - AI-Augmented Engineering: Champion the adoption of modern AI development workflows (e. g. , GitHub Copilot, Devin, AI-driven code review, and automated test generation) to enhance developer productivity, modernize legacy components, and accelerate time-to-market. 
 - Middleware & Event Streams: Design resilient, low-latency, event-driven pipelines using enterprise messaging backbones such as Apache Kafka, Solace PubSub+, and other low-latency middleware fabrics. 
 - Relational Databases: Proficiency in SQL writing queries and improve efficiency
 - Performance Tuning: Profile, benchmark, and optimize CPU usage, memory layout, network serialization, and IPC for low latency. 

Global Stakeholder Collaboration & Technical Advisory

- Key Technical Liaison: Act as a technical contact and subject matter expert (SME) for Risk Managers, Product Owners, Trading Desks, Quantitative Analysts, and Operations across APAC and global hubs. 
 - Global Team Alignment: Partner closely with regional and global engineering pods across Singapore, London, New York, and other tech centers to ensure seamless platform rollouts, operational stability, and cohesive architecture standards. 
 - Cross-Technology Coordination: Interface closely with upstream Order Management Systems (OMS), Execution Management Systems (EMS), Market Data feeds, and downstream Clearing/Settlement and Regulatory reporting platforms across multiple asset classes (FX, Equities, Rates, Commodities, Credit). 
 - Requirement Translation: Translate complex quantitative risk models, margin methodologies, and regional/global regulatory requirements into scalable, deterministic technical architecture

Mentorship & Regional/Global Leadership

- Lead, coach, and mentor junior engineers in regional teams in distributed systems design, clean code practices, and modern AI-assisted engineering techniques. 
 - Lead architectural design reviews and rigorous peer code reviews to ensure reliability, security, and maintainability across distributed codebases. 
 - Partner with engineering managers and Scrum Masters across time zones on sprint planning, technical estimations, dependency resolution, and milestone delivery. 

Technical Proficiencies: 

- Java: Practical experience or working knowledge of Java for performance-critical, memory-safe, or low-latency system components and cross-language interoperability
 - C++: Proficiency in modern C++, memory management/profiling, lock-free data structures, concurrent programming, and low-latency tuning in Linux platforms. 
 - SQL: Hands-on experience writing SQL procedures, and practical knowledge of indexes

Education: 

- Bachelor's degree / University degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, or equivalent STEM discipline. 
 - Master's degree (Desirable) in Computer Science, Financial Engineering, or related quantitative field

data.title: Senior Automation Engineer - Assistant Vice President
data.description:
About The Role

We are seeking a highly skilled and hands-on QA Engineer to drive modern quality engineering practices within our teams. You will be instrumental in ensuring the highest software quality by leveraging test automation, TDD, BDD, trunk-based development, security testing, and modern ways of working. 

This role requires deep technical expertise in automation frameworks, system design for testing, and vulnerability assessment to build reliable, scalable, and secure applications. 

Key Responsibilities

Quality Engineering & Automation

- Design and implement automated test strategies for functional, integration, performance, and security testing. 
 - Drive test-first development approaches such as TDD (Test-Driven Development) and BDD (Behavior-Driven Development). 
 - Develop and maintain high-quality automated test scripts using modern testing frameworks (e. g. , Selenium, Cypress). 
 - Develop and execute comprehensive test plans, test cases, and test scripts to ensure product quality and reliability. 
 - Ensure unit, API, and end-to-end test coverage to maintain product reliability. 
 - Integrate automated tests within CI/CD pipelines for continuous validation. 

Engineering Excellence & Best Practices

- Champion trunk-based development, ensuring testing is embedded throughout the development lifecycle. 
 - Collaborate closely with developers to conduct code reviews with a focus on testability, security, and performance. 
 - Perform vulnerability assessments and implement security testing best practices. 
 - Enhance observability by integrating real-time monitoring, logging, and reporting into the QA process. 

Technical Leadership & Collaboration

- Partner with software engineers, architects, and product teams to design scalable, testable, and resilient systems. 
 - Mentor junior QA engineers, fostering a culture of continuous learning and quality-first mindset. 
 - Work closely with DevOps teams to optimize automated test execution in cloud environments. 
 - Define and implement modern ways of working, driving innovation in testing methodologies. 

Skills And Qualifications

Must-Have Skills: 

- Strong hands-on experience in test automation using tools like Selenium, Cypress, Playwright, or similar.

 - Experience in trunk-based development and continuous testing within CI/CD pipelines.

The Senior QA Analyst will drive end-to-end testing strategies, BDD automation, UAT certification, and production readiness across critical clearing functions supporting global Futures and Options (F&O) business lines.

data.title: Co-Founder & Chief Technology Officer (CTO)
data.description:
About StudilyXRStudilyXR is building an integrated XR, AI, and humanoid robotics simulation and training ecosystem designed to transform how students, researchers, and engineers learn, experiment, and develop intelligent robotic systems. 

Our vision is to create an environment where users can interact with virtual humanoid robots, capture human movements, simulate real-world tasks, train robotic behaviours using AI, and eventually transfer validated skills to compatible physical humanoid robots. 

We aim to bring together Extended Reality (XR), Physical AI, robotics simulation, motion capture, and intelligent robot learning into one integrated platform. 

The Opportunity

We are looking for a highly capable and entrepreneurial Co-Founder & CTO to lead the technical vision, architecture, and development of the StudilyXR platform. 

This is not a conventional software development position. We are looking for someone who wants to own a deep-tech venture, build its core technology from the ground up, and shape its long-term product and engineering strategy. 

You will work closely with the founding team to transform the vision into a functional, scalable technology platform. 

Key Responsibilities
 - Architect and lead the development of an integrated XR, AI, and humanoid robotics simulation platform. 
 - Develop immersive virtual environments using Unity or Unreal Engine. 
 - Integrate NVIDIA Isaac Sim and Isaac Lab for physics-based humanoid simulation and AI training. 
 - Design robotics middleware and communication systems using ROS 2. 
 - Integrate VR headsets, haptic gloves, motion-capture systems, and omnidirectional treadmills. 
 - Develop human-to-robot motion retargeting and motion-processing pipelines. 
 - Explore imitation learning, reinforcement learning, robot behaviour training, and sim-to-real workflows. 
 - Develop interfaces between virtual humanoids, AI training systems, and compatible physical robots. 
 - Establish the technical roadmap, development standards, and software architecture. 
 - Build and lead the engineering team as the venture grows. 

Technical ExpertiseWe are particularly interested in candidates with experience in one or more of the following areas: 

Robotics & Simulation

- NVIDIA Isaac Sim, Isaac Lab, Omniverse. 
 - ROS 2, robotics middleware, robot kinematics, and dynamics. 
 - Humanoid robotics, robot control, motion planning, and simulation. AI & Machine Learning

- Python, C++, PyTorch. 
 - Reinforcement learning and imitation learning. 
 - Computer vision and embodied AI. 
 - Motion retargeting and sim-to-real transfer. XR & Immersive Technologies

- Unity 3D or Unreal Engine. 
 - OpenXR and Meta Quest development. 
 - VR interaction systems and immersive simulation. 
 - Hardware and sensor integration. Hardware Integration

- Motion capture systems such as Rokoko. 
 - Haptic gloves and hand-tracking systems. 
 - VR locomotion systems such as KAT VR. 
 - Robotics hardware, sensors, and actuators. 
 - 
Candidates do not need to be experts in every technology. We value strong systems architecture, problem-solving ability, technical depth, and the capacity to bring multiple technologies together. 

Initial Technology EcosystemThe proposed development ecosystem includes: 

- NVIDIA Isaac Sim and Isaac Lab. 
 - Unity / Unreal Engine and OpenXR. 
 - Meta Quest 3S. 
 - HIGVR Haptic Gloves. 
 - Rokoko Motion Capture Suit. 
 - KAT Walk C2 Core VR Treadmill. 
 - ROS 2 and Python-based integration services. 
 - Humanoid robotics and AI training frameworks. 

The selected CTO will have the opportunity to evaluate, refine, and lead the final technology architecture. 

Who Should Apply?We would particularly welcome applications from: 

- Robotics and AI engineers interested in entrepreneurship. 
 - Technical architects with experience in robotics simulation. 
 - XR technology leaders with hardware integration experience. 
 - AI/ML engineers working in embodied AI or robot learning. 
 - Founders or early-stage technical leaders interested in building a deep-tech venture. Most importantly, we are looking for someone with a founder's mindset: someone who can take ownership, make technical decisions, solve challenging problems, and build a team around a long-term vision. 

Compensation & EquityWe are open to discussing a flexible compensation structure with the right candidate. 

- Competitive salary based on experience and responsibilities. 
 - Meaningful equity participation for the right co-founder. 
 - Opportunity to join at the founding stage and shape the company's technical direction. 
 - Long-term leadership opportunity in an emerging deep-tech venture. The exact salary, equity structure, and terms will be discussed transparently based on the candidate's experience, commitment, and mutual expectations. 

How to ApplyIf you are excited about the intersection of humanoid robotics, Physical AI, XR, and intelligent simulation systems, we would love to connect. 

Please apply through LinkedIn with your updated profile and, ideally, links to relevant projects, GitHub repositories, research, or technical work. 

Let's build the next generation of humanoid robotics and AI learning with StudilyXR.

IntegriChain is the data and application backbone for market access departments of Life Sciences manufacturers. We deliver the data, the applications, and the business process infrastructure for patient access and therapy commercialization. More than 250 manufacturers rely on our ICyte Platform to orchestrate their commercial and government payer contracting, patient services, and distribution channels. ICyte is the first and only platform that unites the financial, operational, and commercial data sets required to support therapy access in the era of specialty and precision medicine. With ICyte, Life Sciences innovators can digitalize their market access operations, freeing up resources to focus on more data-driven decision support. With ICyte, Life Sciences innovators are digitalizing labor-intensive processes - freeing up their best talent to identify and resolve coverage and availability hurdles and to manage pricing and forecasting complexity. 

We are headquartered in Philadelphia, PA (USA), with offices in: Ambler, PA (USA); Pune, India; and Medellín, Colombia. For more information, visit www. integrichain. com, or follow us on Twitter @IntegriChain and LinkedIn. 

Job Description

- Work alongside AI agents as co-workers within our AI-SDLC framework - using Anthropic Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, and AWS Bedrock throughout design, development, testing, deployment, and maintenance cycles

 - Participate actively in Agile ceremonies - sprint planning, stand-ups, retrospectives, and backlog refinement - to keep delivery on track and priorities aligned

 - Design and govern JMeter performance test plans covering both application and data layers - pipeline throughput, load-window adherence, and large-volume query response; analyse results and drive remediation with development teams
 - Design data validation pipelines/complex SQL queries in PostgreSQL and Snowflake
 - Serve as the go-to QA engineer for the harder test challenges - the person the team relies on when complexity, regulatory risk, or system ambiguity is highest
 - Produce clear test strategy documents, defect trend analyses, and quality reports that inform team and stakeholder decisions; communicate quality status and risk effectively to both technical and non-technical audiences
 - Incorporate pharma manufacturer client needs and regulatory requirements into test coverage decisions; participate actively in incident responses and quality reviews that have direct client impact
 - Apply strong analytical and problem-solving skills to diagnose complex test failures - anticipating system failure modes and designing test coverage for them proactively rather than reactively; evaluate quality trade-offs and drive decisions with appropriate rigour
 - Demonstrate full accountability for your own work and the team's quality output - holding yourself answerable to team-level quality outcomes, not just individual test deliverables; proactively managing risks, communicating progress, and owning quality end-to-end
 - Lift the overall quality output of the team - through proactive test design collaboration, knowledge sharing, unblocking, and consistently raising the bar on what the team ships
 - Stay current with the team's evolving test toolset - including AI-augmented testing practices, Playwright updates, BDD patterns, and biopharma regulatory developments - and actively bring relevant updates into team practices
 - Partner effectively across backend developers, UI/UX developers, product analysts, and domain stakeholders - communicating clearly within a geographically distributed team
 - Mentor junior QA engineers and champion quality best practices across the team
 - Evaluate and integrate AI-powered testing tools into the QA workflow

Qualifications

- Hands-on professional QA engineering experience at a senior level, with a strong automation focus - 5+ years of strong expertise in Test requirement understanding, test data, test plan & test case designing. Develop detailed test cases and test data to ensure business functionality is thoroughly tested - Automation & Manual. 
 - Expert Python testing skills - pytest, test framework design, fixtures, and reporting
 - Strong hands-on experience with Playwright in production test suites - 3+ years of test automation - UI and API testing - Creating, execution and maintenance of automated test cases with Selenium web-driver (v3+)/playwright and Postman/ Python requests, with programming experience in Python (MUST)
 - Deep BDD expertise - framework design, Gherkin authoring, step library architecture, living documentation
 - Strong expertise in database SQL queries (MUST) - complex joins, aggregations, window functions, data validation and reconciliation - with hands-on experience on Snowflake and other databases such as Postgres/ MySQL/ RDS
 - JMeter experience - test plan design, distributed execution, and results analysis (Good to have)
 - Hands-on experience working in an AI-augmented or agentic development/testing environment (e. g. Claude Code, Copilot, AWS Bedrock, or equivalent)
 - Solid experience working in an Agile/Scrum environment, including sprint planning and iterative delivery
 - Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a track record of owning quality outcomes end-to-end - accountable to team-level quality outcomes, not just individual deliverables
 - Influences technical decisions on the team through well-supported proposals and demonstrated expertise; beginning to shape team practices through example and mentorship
 - Excellent written and verbal communication skills within a geographically distributed, cross-functional team

Additional Information

What does IntegriChain have to offer?

- Mission driven: Work with the purpose of helping to improve patients' lives! 
 - Excellent and affordable medical benefits + non-medical perks including Flexible Paid Time Off and much more!
 - Robust Learning & Development opportunities including over 700+ development courses free to all employees

IntegriChain is committed to equal treatment and opportunity in all aspects of recruitment, selection, and employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, ethnicity, age, sex, marital status, physical or mental disability, gender identity, sexual orientation, veteran or military status, or any other category protected under the law. IntegriChain is an equal opportunity employer; committed to creating a community of inclusion, and an environment free from discrimination, harassment, and retaliation.

data.title: Principal Engineer
data.description:
We are seeking an experienced Cloud Architect with deep expertise in AWS and a strong hands-on software development background. This role combines cloud architecture with active engineering, requiring the ability to design, build, and deliver scalable cloud-native solutions. 

The ideal candidate is a pragmatic, delivery-focused professional who can translate architectural designs into production-ready systems while actively contributing to development. They should possess a strong balance of technical leadership and hands-on coding skills, driving best practices, mentoring engineering teams, and ensuring successful delivery of high-quality cloud solutions. 

Your role

Key responsibilities in your new role: 

- Define and own end-to-end cloud architecture for large-scale distributed systems on AWS. 
 - Design microservices-based architectures, API-driven platforms, and event-driven systems. 
 - Ensure solutions meet scalability, reliability, security, and cost-efficiency requirements. 
 - Establish reference architectures, design patterns, and best practices. 
 - Contribute to end-to-end development and delivery of solutions Hands-on Development 
 - Actively develop backend services using Node. js - Build and maintain REST APIs and microservices 
 - Write clean, maintainable, and testable code using TDD practices - Perform code reviews and guide teams on best practices

Your profile

Qualifications And Skills To Help You Succeed

- 10-15+ years of software engineering experience, including 6-10+ years of hands-on AWS architecture and development expertise. 
 - Strong experience in AWS, Node. js, Microservices, REST APIs, Distributed Systems, Cloud-Native Architectures, and Event-Driven Design. 
 - Proven ability to design and deliver scalable, secure, highly available, and enterprise-grade cloud solutions. 
 - Design, develop, and deploy cloud-native applications, backend services, microservices, and RESTful APIs on AWS. 
 - Architect and optimize distributed systems using AWS services such as Lambda, API Gateway, EC2, S3, DynamoDB, RDS, EKS, ECR, IoT Core, CloudWatch, and Bedrock. 
 - Build API-first and microservices-based platforms with a focus on scalability, performance, reliability, and maintainability. 
 - Contribute extensively to hands-on development (60-70%) while providing architecture, design, and technical leadership (30-40%). 
 - Drive engineering excellence through TDD, code reviews, automated testing, CI/CD pipelines, and modern software development practices. 
 - Establish architecture standards, reusable design patterns, governance frameworks, monitoring strategies, and cloud cost optimization practices. 
 - Implement secure cloud solutions using IAM, encryption, compliance controls, network security, and industry best practices. 
 - Hands-on experience with CI/CD, Kubernetes/EKS, containerization, observability, monitoring, and DevOps integration. 
 - Collaborate closely with engineering, product, architecture, and DevOps teams to deliver high-quality cloud solutions. 
 - Provide technical mentorship and guidance on AWS, cloud-native development, microservices, and distributed system architecture. 
 - Experience with IoT platforms, connected devices, AWS Bedrock, Generative AI/LLM applications, and performance optimization is highly desirable. 
 - Strong hands-on engineer with a solution-oriented mindset, capable of seamlessly transitioning between architecture, development, and deployment. 
 - Passionate about building production-grade cloud platforms and driving successful solution delivery as a Principal Engineer-level individual contributor. 

#WeAreIn for driving decarbonization and digitalization. 

As a global leader in semiconductor solutions in power systems and IoT, Infineon enables game-changing solutions for green and efficient energy, clean and safe mobility, as well as smart and secure IoT. Together, we drive innovation and customer success, while caring for our people and empowering them to reach ambitious goals. Be a part of making life easier, safer and greener.
