data.title: Senior Principal Software Engineer
data.description:
Careers that change lives start here. Medtronic is a global leader in healthcare technology with a Mission to alleviate pain, restore health, and extend life. Our 95, 000 employees work across more than 150 countries to put patients first - developing innovative medical technologies that improve the lives of 72+ million patients each year. Your unique talents will help shape the future of healthcare while building a career grounded in purpose, growth, and impact. 

A Day in the Life

At Medtronic, we are committed to driving software engineering excellence that delivers transformative impact in healthcare and beyond. As a Sr. Principal Software Engineer with a focus on Software Engineering Capabilities, Excellence Metrics, and Patient Safety, you will be at the forefront of ensuring that our software systems meet the highest standards of quality, safety, and efficiency. You will be working with software teams in Cardiaovascular, Medical Surgical and Neuroscience portfolios at MEIC, and will play a key role in promoting best practices, driving continuous improvement, and ensuring that our software solutions align with both technical and regulatory requirements. This is a leadership role responsible for setting and monitoring software excellence deliverables, ensuring patient safety standards, and fostering a culture of innovation and collaboration across the organization. Reports to the Director of Software Technology. Collaborates with cross-functional teams (business analysts, developers, end-users) to understand requirements and deliver solutions. 

Responsibilities may include the following and other duties may be assigned

Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with engineering, product management, and quality teams to assess project progress and ensure alignment with software excellence metrics, quality goals, and maturity standards. 

Software Maturity & KPIs: Drive software maturity initiatives, tracking KPIs such as defect density, technical debt, and code quality. Implement frameworks to ensure reliability, scalability, and maintainability across the software lifecycle. 

DevOps Integration: Oversee the integration of DevOps practices, optimizing CI/CD pipelines, automating testing, and improving deployment processes to enhance efficiency and system reliability. 

Optimizing Tools & Processes: Lead the evaluation and optimization of software tools and development processes, ensuring teams use the most effective solutions for code analysis, automation, and collaboration. 

Technical Reviews: Conduct critical reviews of software components to ensure best practices, code quality, and adherence to industry standards. Guide teams in optimizing development cycles and improving testing strategies. 

Regulatory Compliance & Patient Safety: Ensure software meets regulatory requirements and patient safety standards by driving initiatives like Design for Reliability and Manufacturability (DRM) and Quality Improvement Plans. Mentorship & Skill Development: Provide technical leadership and mentorship, fostering a culture of continuous learning and ensuring the team stays current with industry trends and best practices. 

Leveraging Reusable Solutions: Promote the reuse of software components and frameworks across teams, enhancing efficiency and consistency while reducing development time. 

Continuous Improvement: Analyze performance data to identify areas for improvement, leading initiatives to enhance software quality, safety, and user experience. Implement process improvements through regular assessments and industry benchmarking. 

Stakeholder Communication: Regularly update stakeholders on progress, software maturity, and quality metrics, providing strategic recommendations for process improvements and alignment with business objectives. 

Required Knowledge And Experience

- B-Tech/BE in Computer Science, Electronics, or related field with 20+ years of experience in Software and Systems Engineering, OR
 - ME/M-Tech with 18+ years of relevant experience. 
 - Proven experience leading the development and delivery of enterprise-scale software systems with a focus on quality, reliability, and maintainability. 
 - Expertise in defining and implementing software quality metrics and ensuring adherence to best practices in software development and testing. 
 - Deep understanding of software engineering processes, including agile methodologies, continuous integration/continuous delivery (CI/CD) pipelines, and DevOps practices. 
 - Experience driving software process improvement initiatives, leveraging data to enhance software development efficiency and product quality. 
 - Hands-on experience with Design for Reliability and Manufacturability (DRM) principles, driving their integration into the software product lifecycle. 
 - Familiarity with patient safety standards and industry regulations such as ISO 13485 and IEC 62304 for safety-critical systems, particularly in healthcare or medical device industries. 
 - Demonstrated ability to lead technical reviews, conduct code analysis, and ensure alignment with regulatory and industry standards. 
 - Preferrable experience in developing software systems for regulated industries such as healthcare, aerospace, or automotive, where safety and quality are critical. 
 - Preferrable expertise in statistical process control, Six Sigma, or other process improvement methodologies to drive quality improvement initiatives. 
 - Preferrable experience working with cloud-native or distributed systems, particularly in optimizing their reliability and scalability. 
 - Preferrable hands-on experience with software maturity models, such as CMMI, and their application in driving software excellence and continuous improvement. 
 - Preferrable previous leadership roles in driving cross-functional quality improvement initiatives, particularly in environments requiring stringent safety and regulatory compliance. 

Physical Job Requirements

The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by employees assigned to this position, but they are not an exhaustive list of all the required responsibilities and skills of this position. 





Recruitment Fraud Alert

We are aware of phishing scams targeting job seekers. Please keep the following in mind: 

Apply only through official Medtronic channels. All legitimate Medtronic recruiting communications come from approved Medtronic platforms and official @medtronic. com email addresses. 

Medtronic will never ask for payment or sensitive personal information (such as bank account or Social Security details) during early stages of the hiring process. Any such requests are not legitimate. 

If you receive a suspicious message claiming to be from Medtronic, do not respond, click links, or open attachments. 

If you have any questions, concerns regarding the authenticity of a communication alleged to have been made by or on behalf of Medtronic, please contact us immediately at AskHR@medtronic. com. 

Benefits & Compensation

Medtronic offers a competitive Salary and flexible Benefits Package

A commitment to our employees lives at the core of our values. We recognize their contributions. They share in the success they help to create. We offer a wide range of benefits, resources, and competitive compensation plans designed to support you at every career and life stage.

data.title: Senior IoT System Architect (Pune/Gurugram/Pondicherry)
data.description:
Requisition ID: 72762

About Whirlpool India

Whirlpool of India Limited, headquartered in Gurugram, is a leading home appliances company dedicated to enhancing life at home and inspiring generations through its trusted brands. The company operates three state-of-the-art manufacturing facilities in Faridabad, Pune & Puducherry, each reflecting Whirlpool's commitment to providing best-in-class consumer solutions. Further driving innovation, the company has a Technology & Engineering Center, where India's world-class talent architects the next generation of home innovation. In the 2024-25 fiscal year, Whirlpool of India reported approximately INR 8110 Cr in annual revenue and employed 2193 people. More information is available at www. india. whirlpool. in

The Team You Will Be a Part Of

The Software Engineering team designs, develops or coordinates development/troubleshooting or debugging of moderately complex software programs for enhancements and new products. Performs high-level design/modeling to convert stakeholder needs into software solutions. Develops software and tools in support of design, infrastructure and technology platforms. Determines hardware compatibility and/or influences hardware design. Develops the architectural guidelines, specifications, and technical standards and communicates to stakeholders. 

This Role In Summary

We are looking for a Senior IoT System Architect to define, design and govern the technical blueprint for our next-generation smart connected appliances. In this role, you will be the primary technical authority owning the end-to-end IOT architecture-from low-level appliance microcontrollers and local wireless mesh networks to cloud telemetry pipelines and mobile API interfaces. You will translate product requirements into secure, scalable, and low-latency physical-to-digital systems, ensuring our appliance fleet is built for massive global scale. 

Your Responsibilities Will Include

End-to-End Product Architecture & Topology

- System Design: Define and document the comprehensive edge-to-cloud system architecture, defining state machines, data flow topologies, and Interface Control Documents (ICDs) across hardware, firmware, cloud, and applications. 
 - Hardware & Component Evaluation: Lead the technical evaluation and selection of microcontrollers (MCUs), System-on-Chips (SoCs), and RF modules based on strict memory, power-budget, thermal, and Bill of Materials (BOM) cost constraints. 
 - Edge Intelligence: Architect localized data processing and edge computing strategies on the appliance to handle real-time sensor analytics, predictive maintenance, and fault-detection algorithms. 

Embedded Control & Smart Home Ecosystems

- OS & Bus Governance: Oversee the integration of Real-Time Operating Systems (FreeRTOS, Zephyr) with low-level appliance application loops running on ARM Cortex-M/A or ESP32 chipsets via internal buses (I2C, SPI, UART). 
 - Ecosystem Interoperability: Architect native support for industry-standard smart home ecosystems (Apple HomeKit, Google Home, Amazon Alexa) with a heavy focus on the deployment of the Matter protocol over Thread and Wi-Fi networks. 
 - Northbound Protocols: Define and enforce message styling and data schemas utilizing MQTT (with Device Shadows), CoAP, WebSockets, and REST APIs for appliance control and telemetry reporting. 

Scalable Cloud Integration & Data Architecture

- Cloud Fleet Management: Architect device-to-cloud ingestion pathways targeting AWS IoT Core, Azure IoT Hub, or Google Cloud, ensuring maximum availability and connection persistence for millions of active units. 
 - Containerized Microservices: Guide backend teams on building high-performance, containerized microservices architectures using Docker and Kubernetes running on Node. js, Python, or C#. 
 - Telemetry Data Infrastructure: Structure scalable data streaming and ingestion pipelines capable of feeding Time-Series Databases, SQL, and NoSQL (Redis) for long-term machine performance analysis. 

Advanced Security, Provisioning & Lifecycle

- Hardware-Rooted Security: Implement an absolute zero-trust device security architecture utilizing Secure Boot, hardware-based cryptographic elements (HSMs, STSAFE), and mutual authentication (mTLS). 
 - Fail-Safe OTA: Architect robust, dual-bank Over-the-Air (OTA) firmware update mechanisms with built-in rollback capabilities to eliminate the risk of bricking appliances in the field. 
 - Lifecycle Management: Define production-line device provisioning workflows and frictionless end-user Wi-Fi/BLE onboarding procedures. 

Minimum Requirements

Education & Experience: 

- Education: Bachelor's or Master's Degree (MS/MTech highly preferred) in Electrical Engineering (EE), Electronics & Communication Engineering (ECE), Computer Engineering, or Computer Science or Internet of Things (IoT) Technologies. 
 - Minimum 10+ years of experience in product development, with at least 7+ years specifically focused on IoT system architecture or integration for physical hardware/appliances. 

Technical Skills

- Firmware/Hardware: Master-level competency in Bare-metal C/C++, RTOS environments, and debugging using digital electronics principles (interpreting schematics, scopes, logic analyzers). 
 - Cloud & DevOps: Deep expertise in containerized environments (Docker/K8s), serverless components, and microservices patterns. 
 - Methodologies: Experience with Operational Excellence (OPEX) frameworks, continuous integration pipelines (CI/CD), and Git-based workflow models. 

Preferred Skills And Experiences

Technical Leadership & Compliance

- Multidisciplinary Liaison: Act as the central architectural bridge aligning Hardware Engineering, Embedded Firmware, Cloud/DevOps, QA, and Product Management teams. 
 - Technical Mentorship: Drive architectural reviews, mentor senior engineering staff, and advocate for Agile/Scrum development best practices and robust version control. 
 - Regulatory Compliance: Ensure the systemic architecture natively supports global regulatory certifications, safety standards, and energy efficiency metrics IEC 60335, BEE, GDPR. 

Core Traits

- Exceptional problem-solving skills and a systemic approach to troubleshooting complex, distributed bugs. 
 - Strong communication skills to articulate complex architectural decisions to non-technical stakeholders. 
 - Project Management Certification; 
 - OPEX Knowledge and Experience; 
 - Understanding of electrical and electronic engineering principles, including circuit design, power systems, digital electronics, hardware, software and sensor technologies; 
 - Problem-solving skills; 
 - Understanding of industry standards, safety regulations, and energy efficiency requirements applicable to home appliances. Knowledge of certification processes (e. g. , UL, IEC) is beneficial; 
 - Collaboration skill to work within a multidisciplinary team, including engineers, designers, and technicians; 
 - Ability to work in a fast-paced environment with shifting priorities and tight deadlines; 
 - Effective time management skills to ensure timely completion of tasks and projects. 

What We Offer

N/A

Connect with us and learn more about Whirlpool India. See what it's like to work at Whirlpool by visiting Whirlpool Careers. Additional information about the company can be found on Facebook, Instagram and YouTube. 

At Whirlpool India, we value and celebrate diversity. Whirlpool India is committed to equal employment opportunity and prohibits any discrimination on the basis of race or ethnicity, religion, sex, pregnancy, gender expression or identity, sexual orientation, age, physical or mental disability, veteran status, or any other category protected by applicable law.

data.description:
JOB PURPOSE

Senior Manager, QMS supports the implementation of ISO, ISAGO and other Standards in addition to ensuring continuous improvement in operations and support functions with consistency in processes which support the mission, vision and objectives of AISATS. 

Senior Manager, QMS interacts with Senior Management and staff as well as external agencies to define, acquire, monitor and validate QMS performance. He/ She also manages a team of talents who are accountable for the delivery of data, information and knowledge about AISATS. 

SPECIFIC RESPONSIBILITIES

Senior Manager - QMS shall be responsible for the successful management of one or more Audits within the BU. He/she shall monitor the QMS and Service excellence levels to ensure compliance of the Operations with the regulators policies, ISAGO, ISO Standards and other company requirements. He/she shall also hold the responsibility and role of a Management Representative and Lead Auditor to ensure compliances to the above mentioned standards. 

- Responsible for every aspect of the QMS/QC function from Audit Planning, Conduct of Audits, & Implementation, Corrective Action & Closure, Monitoring & Verification, Feedback/follow up and re audit where necessary
 - Converts data collected during internal audits into information and provide necessary statistics to Senior Management for Management Review. 
 - Responsible for strategizing and defining the Internal Audit Plan and review the implementation of the Annual Plan across the company while streamlining the Audits to minimize disruptions/duplications on operations. 
 - Assist the BU Head to implement the Quality Policy, Quality Manual and measureable Quality Targets in accordance to ISO 9001: 2015 that is appropriate to AISATS goals and supports strategies devised by the senior management to achieve those policies. 
 - Implement and maintain the processes needed for seamless QMS functioning. 
 - Monitor measure and analyze the QMS within the organization and make continuous improvements to suit AISATS operations and changing environment/policies. 
 - Initiate and implement process/certification projects involving continual improvement and best industry standards. 
 - Ensure implementation of an effective system of document and record controls. 
 - Ensure development of a system of identification and traceability of process and records. 
 - Implement the internal audit program to verify that the QMS conforms to planned arrangements. 
 - Coordinates audit follow-up and closure activities, to see that recommendations have been implemented or otherwise resolved. 
 - Perform Internal Audits at other stations as and when asked to. 
 - Analysis of the data collected on the effectiveness of the QMS and evaluate where the continuous improvement of the QMS can be made. 
 - Manage the Quality Management team in carrying out routine activities and persuading reluctant employees within AISATS to change their way of working to incorporate quality methods. 
 - Ensure that Quality Control mechanism is in place such that operation functions have an active process of conducting self-audits to ensure compliance/conformity to various standards. 
 - Overlooks the Safety Audits performed at the station and ensures that the Safety function is performing as required. 
 - Ensure the protection of data archives and the integrity, security, confidentiality and privacy of data, information and knowledge of AISATS. 
 - Support Senior Management- AISATS, in ensuring smooth functioning of the internal Audit department and document the Internal Audit monthly report for providing an update to the AISATS Senior management on Internal Audit activities and challenges. 
 - Responsible for managerial review and approval of the audit report, Discusses audit results with management to ensure recommendations are understood, accepted and appropriate corrective action is proposed. Assures that appropriate auditee responses to the audit report are received. 
 - Developing programs to support the effective implementation of QMS as stated in the Quality Manual and Process Manual. 
 - Translate documented requirements into functional specifications. 
 - •Perform any other functions as required by the BU Head
 - Responsible and accountable for overall quality, safety and security of operations. 
 - You will be responsible and accountable to make necessary operational decisions related to safety and security matters at all times whilst on duty. 

EDUCATIONAL QUALIFICATIONS

- Master's/University Degree with minimum 10 years of working experience of which at least 02 years in a managerial/supervisory capacity in the Aviation Industry
 - Certified Internal Auditor with an in-depth knowledge of the auditing field. 

RELEVANT EXPERIENCE

Senior Manager , QMS should possess the following experiences: 

- 2- 4 years in Quality Assurance / Quality control (operations) environment, successful management of multiple projects involving multi-cultural teams. 
 - Have demonstrated ability in preparing senior management reports and data analysis. 
 - Have the appropriate skill set, to set and manage priorities. 
 - Exceptional command over Ms Office and QMS (ISO 9001: 2015), ISAGO norms. Business Statistics would be an advantage. 
 - Excellent command over written and spoken English with the ability to document operational business case scenarios, develop process flow documentation. 
 - In-depth knowledge on the ISO 9001: 2015, ISAGO guidelines and QMS functioning. 

PERSONAL CHARACTERISTICS & BEHAVIOUR

For a successful role as Senior Manager, QMS, he/she should have the following traits: 

- Demonstrate excellent managerial and leadership skills
 - Good communicator and able to relate to all levels of staff
 - A team player and leader at handling cross-sectional teams
 - Comprehend and translate complex data and its relationship to trends and observations
 - Must be a good decision maker to come out with practical solutions
 - Must have good interpersonal skills and maintain good relations with stakeholders involved.

data.description:
Who Are We?

Postman is the world's leading API platform, used by more than 45 million+ developers and 500, 000 organizations, including 98% of the Fortune 500. Postman is helping developers and professionals across the globe build the API-first world by simplifying each step of the API lifecycle and streamlining collaboration-enabling users to create better APIs, faster. 

The company is headquartered in San Francisco and has offices in Boston, New York, Austin, Tokyo, London, and Bangalore - where Postman was founded. Postman is privately held, with funding from Battery Ventures, BOND, Coatue, CRV, Insight Partners, and Nexus Venture Partners. Learn more at postman. com or connect with Postman on X via @getpostman. 

P. S: We highly recommend reading The "API-First World" graphic novel to understand the bigger picture and our vision at Postman. 

About The Team

Automation Testing builds how developers test and automate their APIs, from local runs and CI pipelines to scheduled and large-scale runs in the cloud. 

About The Role

You'll lead a few areas within Automation Testing and own the end-to-end product experience, from what we build to how it ships and runs. You'll stay hands-on, working alongside the staff and senior engineers who shape the technical direction. 

What You'll Do

- Own the end-to-end experience of your areas, across engineering, product and design
 - Set technical direction with staff and senior engineers, and grow senior engineers into leads
 - Hire, coach and grow engineers
 - Own delivery and operational health: planning, commitments, on-call, incidents and customer escalations
 - Partner with product, design, platform and customer-facing teams

What We're Looking For

- 8+ years in software engineering, including 2+ years managing engineers
 - A record of building products and scaling them: in users, in reliability and in the team behind them
 - A keen product and design eye: you care how the experience works end to end, not just whether it ships
 - Hands-on with AI-native engineering: you use agents in your own work, and have brought them into how a team builds and operates
 - Experience leading teams that include experienced senior engineers
 - A strong individual-contributor background in backend or distributed systems, or developer tools

Nice to have

- Experience building products for developers or other engineers
 - Experience with API testing, developer tools or test automation

What Else?

In addition to Postman's pay-on-performance philosophy, and a flexible schedule working with a fun, collaborative team, Postman offers a comprehensive set of benefits, including full medical coverage, flexible PTO, wellness reimbursement, and a monthly lunch stipend. Along with that, our wellness programs will help you stay in the best of your physical and mental health. Our frequent and fascinating team-building events will keep you connected, while our donation-matching program can support the causes you care about. We're building a long-term company with an inclusive culture where everyone can be the best version of themselves. 

At Postman we value in person collaboration. We are in office 5 days a week for all roles based out of our hubs in San Francisco Bay Area, Boston, Austin, New York City, Tokyo and London. For roles based in Bangalore, employees currently work in the office three days a week and will transition to five days per week by the end of the year. We were thoughtful in our approach which is based on collaboration and grounded in feedback from our workforce, leadership team, and peers. The benefits of our in office model will be shared knowledge, brainstorming sessions, communication, and building trust in-person that cannot be replicated via zoom. 

Our Values

At Postman, we create with the same curiosity that we see in our users. We value transparency and honest communication about not only successes, but also failures. In our work, we focus on specific goals that add up to a larger vision. Our inclusive work culture ensures that everyone is valued equally as important pieces of our final product. We are dedicated to delivering the best products we can. 

Equal Opportunity

Postman is an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action Employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, or disability status. Headhunters and recruitment agencies may not submit resumes/CVs through this website or directly to managers. Postman does not accept unsolicited headhunter and agency resumes. Postman will not pay fees to any third-party agency or company that does not have a signed agreement with Postman.

data.title: Head of Quality Assurance
data.description:
Designation : Head, Quality Assurance

Function : EPC

Location : Head Office, Mumbai (South). Extensive travel to project sites

Reports to : COO

Team : QA function across all projects

Experience : 14 to 20 years

Education : B. E. Civil. Post-graduation or certification in Quality Management preferred

Build and own the quality system

- Author, get approved and implement the QA/QC plan and Quality Manual for the organisation, covering both horizontal and vertical projects. 
 - Own the annual quality budget. 
 - Formulate SOPs, checklists, method statements and inspection test plans for every major work activity, and standardise them across every site. Hand the inspection test plans to the Head, Quality Control for execution. 
 - Set up quality induction and mobilisation protocols for new sites so that a project starts with the system already in place. 
 - Own document control for quality: approved drawings, specifications, material submittals and revision tracking at site. 
 - Align the quality system to recognised management system standards and keep it audit ready. Design and specification assurance

- Review drawings, specifications and bills of quantities for buildability and quality intent before work is released to site. 
 - Set the approved material and make list, and the acceptance criteria for each work item. 
 - Raise design and specification risks early, with the project and design teams, before they become rework. Site assurance and audit

- Run periodic quality audits at all project sites on a published calendar, covering both process compliance and workmanship. 
 - Standardise the audit process and scoring so results are comparable across sites, regions and project types. 
 - Recommend and close out corrective and preventive action on quality problems, with root cause traced rather than symptom fixed. 
 - Maintain a live view of non-conformances, ageing and closure across the portfolio. 
 - Build a lessons-learned loop so a failure at one site changes the standard at every site. Contractor, vendor and material quality

- Evaluate all new contractors, vendors and suppliers on quality capability before empanelment, and make quality a gate in that process. 
 - Rate contractors on quality performance through the life of each contract and feed the rating into award and payment decisions. 
 - Hold contractors and employees to company quality norms, statutory regulations and approved work practices. 
 - Set the framework for material approval, third party testing and site laboratories, which the Head, Quality Control operates. Handover and customer quality

- Define the handover quality standard, including the final inspection and snag closure process for plots, common infrastructure, and apartments and commercial areas. 
 - Track post-handover defect reports as a quality input and take them back into specifications and audits. 
 - Keep quality records complete for statutory and regulatory requirements, including RERA obligations. Cost of quality

- Minimise material and work rejection at sites. 
 - Minimise rework arising from substandard workmanship. 
 - Track cost of poor quality as a measured number and drive it down. Capability building

- Identify skill and capability gaps in the quality and execution teams. 
 - Design and run quality training for supervisors and engineers, including at new sites. 
 - Build a QA team that can scale with the project pipeline. Governance

- Provide inputs to management on process and system improvement. 
 - Report quality performance to the COO and leadership with data, not narrative. 

Candidate Profile

Must have

- B. E. Civil, 14 to 20 years of experience
 - Experience across the full construction cycle, not a single stage or a single project type. 
 - Demonstrated implementation of quality management plans at project sites
 - Strong working knowledge of quality management systems, audit methods, root cause analysis and corrective action. 
 - Willingness to travel extensively to project sites. 

Preferred

- Post-graduation or certification in Quality Management, or lead auditor training. 
 - Exposure to both large scale horizontal or township developments and high-rise residential construction. 
 - Experience setting up a quality function or SOP framework from scratch.

At Renesas, we want to build a sustainable future where technology helps make our lives easier. Join us and build your future by being part of what's next in electronics and the world. 

Job Description

Job Summary: 

We are seeking a highly experienced and deeply hands-on Staff Validation Engineer to join our dynamic Silicon Validation team in Bengaluru. In this critical role, you will serve as a technical lead and mentor, driving the post-silicon validation of cutting-edge DC-DC converter products. Your profound expertise in power electronics, silicon validation methodologies, and PCB design will be instrumental in ensuring the quality, performance, and reliability of our next-generation power management ICs. You will not only lead complex validation efforts but also guide and technically ramp up junior validation engineers, fostering a culture of technical excellence. 

Job Description: 

- Technical Leadership & Architecture: 
 - Technical lead for post-silicon validation of complex DC-DC converter products (e. g. , LDO, Buck, Boost, Buck-boost, Drivers, Controllers, etc. . . ). 
 - Develop comprehensive validation test plans and methodologies from silicon bring-up to characterization, focusing on performance, reliability, and robust operation across various load and environmental conditions (including load transient, ripple, parasitic effects). 
 - Drive the definition and implementation of validation techniques, including automated test development and data analysis. 
 - Hands-on Validation & Debug: 
 - Perform hands-on initial silicon bring-up, debugging, and characterization on the bench using advanced lab equipment (oscilloscopes, multimeters, logic analyzers, power supplies, SMUs, spectrum analyzers, network analyzers, thermal chambers, etc. ). 
 - Lead root cause analysis of complex silicon issues, collaborating closely with design, system, and test engineering teams to drive timely resolutions. 
 - Develop custom test setups, validation boards (PCB schematics and layout review), and fixtures to thoroughly test DC-DC converter performance. 
 - Mentorship & Guidance: 
 - Provide technical mentorship and guidance to junior validation engineers on DC-DC converter principles, validation methodologies, test planning, debugging techniques, and best practices. 
 - Foster a technical learning environment within the team, promoting knowledge sharing and continuous improvement. 
 - Test Development & Automation: 
 - Define requirements for, and potentially contribute to, the development of automated test scripts and frameworks for efficient validation execution. 
 - Contribute to the selection, adoption, and optimization of validation tools and infrastructure to improve overall team efficiency. 
 - Cross-Functional Collaboration: 
 - Act as a lead between the Silicon Validation team and cross-functional teams including IC Design, System Design, Firmware, Product Engineering, and Application Engineering. 
 - Drive effective communication of validation findings, risks, and recommendations to various stakeholders. 
 - Quality & Compliance: 
 - Ensure validation activities adhere to rigorous quality standards, functional safety requirements, and operational protocols (e. g. , ESD, safety). 
 - Contribute to the continuous improvement of validation processes (e. g. , SWIFT process adoption) and documentation standards. Required Skills & Experience: 

- 9+ years of extensive, hands-on experience in Electrical/Electronic Post-Silicon Validation, with a significant focus on DC-DC converters and power management ICs. 
 - Strong technical experience in DC-DC converter topologies (e. g. , Buck, Boost, Buck-Boost, LDOs, Gate Drivers), control schemes, and their critical performance parameters (efficiency, ripple, load transient, stability, EMI/EMC). 
 - Good proficiency in PCB schematics, layout review, and design considerations for high-frequency, high-current power circuits. Experience with validation board design is a significant plus.

Our culture is built for people who want to do ambitious, meaningful work alongside exceptionally talented teammates. We think like owners, move with urgency, and take pride in solving hard problems that truly matter to our customers and the future of private markets. We believe the best ideas come from open debate, deep collaboration, and diverse perspectives, which is why we believe transparency is the default and feedback makes us stronger. If you're energized by high standards, rapid growth, and the opportunity to help define a category at a pivotal moment, come join us!

Juniper Square offers employees a variety of ways to work, ranging from a fully remote experience to working full-time in one of our physical offices. We invest heavily in digital-first operations, allowing our teams to collaborate effectively across 27 U. S. states, 2 Canadian Provinces, India, Luxembourg, and England. We also have physical offices in San Francisco, New York City, Mumbai and Bangalore for employees who prefer to work in an office some or all of the time. 

About Your Role

As a QA Automation Lead for Data Engineering at Juniper Square, you will be the primary owner of data quality and reliability for your project. You are expected to drive the end-to-end data testing strategy, ensuring the integrity, accuracy, and performance of our data pipelines and analytical platforms, and oversee release readiness. You will collaborate closely with data engineering, product, and data science teams to help define and drive our manual and automated testing efforts. You must be detail-oriented, passionate about data accuracy, and a strong advocate for high-quality data products and the end-user experience. 

What You'll Do

- Quality Roadmap & Planning: Partner with Data Engineering and Product leadership to define the data validation and automation strategy for data platform features and new architecture releases. 
 - Backend & Pipeline Testing: Design and execute complex test cases targeting backend data systems, focusing on data integrity, distributed systems logic, data transformation consistency, and asynchronous batch or stream processing. 
 - AI-Augmented Testing: Leverage AI-powered tools like Cursor or Augment to rapidly prototype, scaffold new test suites, diagnose failures, and generate advanced data validation test scenarios. 
 - Data Automation Excellence: Develop, maintain, and extend scalable data automation frameworks and data quality monitoring suites by leveraging LLMs. 
 - Governance & Standards: Establish and enforce data QA best practices, coding standards, and rigorous code review processes for the automation team. Foster a culture of technical excellence and proactive problem-solving. 
 - Advocate for Automation: Champion an automation-first approach to data quality, minimizing reliance on manual data reconciliation, and partner with data engineering to systematically decrease manual testing effort. 

Qualifications

- Education: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Data Engineering, or equivalent professional experience. 
 - Experience: 7-10 years in Software Quality Assurance, including demonstrated ability to lead end-to-end testing efforts across the full software and data lifecycle. 
 - Database Engineering & SQL: Knowledge of relational databases and strong proficiency in SQL with the ability to write complex queries for data validation, reconciliation, and root cause analysis. 
 - Data Infrastructure & Concepts: Solid understanding of data engineering concepts including data pipelines, ETL/ELT workflows, data warehouse architecture, and OLAP technologies (e. g. , Redshift, Snowflake, BigQuery, or equivalent). 
 - Programming Skills: Strong proficiency in Python including the ability to read, understand, and debug data pipeline code. 
 - QA Automation Frameworks: Proven experience in QA automation, including designing and implementing automated test frameworks, test suites, and CI/CD-integrated testing pipelines. 
 - AI-Augmented Development: Proactive in using AI-powered tools (e. g. , Augment, Cursor, Gemini) to accelerate test authoring, assist in debugging automation scripts, and optimize data documentation workflows. 
 - Release Ownership: Experience managing the full release cycle for data features, from scoping testing requirements to final "Go/No-Go" delivery decisions. 
 - Soft Skills: Excellent analytical and problem-solving abilities, exceptional attention to detail, and the ability to work independently in fast-paced Agile development teams with minimal supervision. 
 - Communication: Strong written and verbal communication skills in English

AI & LLM Testing Experience

- Proactively leverage AI tools (e. g. , Cursor, Gemini) to accelerate test authoring, debugging, and maintenance of data automation frameworks. 

Benefits

- Health, dental, and vision care for you and your family
 - Life insurance
 - Mental wellness coverage
 - Fertility and growing family support
 - Flex Time Off in addition to company-paid holidays
 - Paid family leave, medical leave, and bereavement leave policies
 - Retirement savings plans
 - Allowance to customize your work and technology setup at home
 - Annual professional development stipend

 - Expertise in DOCSIS/CMTS and broadband access network technologies.

data.title: Quality Assurance - Lead
data.description:
Do you want your voice heard and your actions to count?

Discover your opportunity with Mitsubishi UFJ Financial Group (MUFG), one of the world's leading financial groups. Across the globe, we're 150, 000 colleagues, striving to make a difference for every client, organization, and community we serve. We stand for our values, building long-term relationships, serving society, and fostering shared and sustainable growth for a better world. 

With a vision to be the world's most trusted financial group, it's part of our culture to put people first, listen to new and diverse ideas and collaborate toward greater innovation, speed and agility. This means investing in talent, technologies, and tools that empower you to own your career. 

Join MUFG, where being inspired is expected and making a meaningful impact is rewarded. 

Position Details

The Test Lead - AVP/Manager will lead end-to-end quality validation for complex applications, ensuring complete test coverage, backend data validation, traceability, and audit-ready deliverables in support of regulatory and control requirements. This role supports both SIT and UAT and works closely with developers, business stakeholders, and test teams to validate system integrations, manage defects, and strengthen quality outcomes in a regulated banking environment. Strongly preferred candidate is a QE SME with domain experience in AML, sanctions compliance, credit risk, and financial operations / general ledger processes. Candidate should also pose deep knowledge and experience in QE tooling including automation and AI experience

- Lead the design and execution of automated testing using Playwright, with a focus on improving speed, coverage, and reliability. 
 - Drive adoption of AI-assisted (agentic) testing practices to reduce manual effort and improve test quality. 
 - Work closely with development teams to ensure testing is embedded in the delivery lifecycle, supporting fast and stable releases. 
 - Act as a hands-on leader, building automation frameworks while guiding the team on modern testing practices

Roles And Responsibilities

- Review requirements and design documents to define risk-based SIT/UAT test coverage. 
 - Design, execute, and document test cases with full traceability to requirements, defects, and results. 
 - Validate backend processing, integrations, data flows, and SQL-based reconciliations across critical systems. 
 - Lead defect triage, root cause analysis, resolution tracking, and retesting. 
 - Provide SIT/UAT status reporting, risk escalation, and audit-ready testing deliverables. 
 - Design and implement Playwright-based automation frameworks for UI, API, and end-to-end testing. 
 - Lead the development of agentic testing workflows, including: 
 - Generating test cases from requirements using AI
 - Automating test script creation using tools like Copilot
 - Using AI to analyze failures, logs, and test outputs
 - Build and maintain a scalable test harness, including reusable components, fixtures, and test data setup. 
 - Drive automation-first testing, reducing reliance on manual regression. 
 - Use Playwright capabilities to improve quality: 
 - Faster execution with parallel testing
 - Better stability using built-in waits and isolation
 - Debugging with traces, screenshots, and logs 
 - Use CLI-based workflows (e. g. , Copilot CLI) to: 
 - Run and manage large test suites
 - Analyze failures and flaky tests
 - Improve test execution efficiency 
 - Ensure test scripts stay aligned with application changes and requirements. 
 - Mentor team members on automation best practices and AI-driven testing techniques. 
 - Track and report on key testing metrics (coverage, execution time, defect leakage). 
Job Requirements And Experience

- 8-13 years of experience in Quality Engineering / Test Automation for complex enterprise applications in regulated environments. 
 - Strong hands-on experience with Playwright or similar modern automation frameworks. 
 - Experience building and maintaining automation frameworks (not just writing tests). 
 - Exposure to AI-assisted testing or automation tools (e. g. , Copilot, test generation tools). 
 - Solid understanding of: 
 - UI and API testing
 - Test automation design patterns (e. g. , page object model)
 - Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail. 
 - Ability to work closely with developers and business teams. 
 - Strong knowledge of STLC, testing methodologies, control validation, and regulated banking environments. Strong SQL, ETL, backend testing, and data reconciliation skills across high-risk data flows and integrations. 
 - Experience with relational databases such as Oracle, SQL Server, and PostgreSQL. Strongly preferred: domain experience in AML, sanctions compliance, credit risk, and financial operations / general ledger processes. 
 - Strong communication, risk escalation, and cross-functional stakeholder coordination skills. 
Tools & Technologies

- Automation Frameworks: Playwright (primary tool)
 - AI / Agentic Testing
 - GitHub Copilot (IDE and CLI)
 - AI-assisted test generation and execution workflows
 - Debugging & Observability: Playwright trace viewer, screenshots, logs, and video capture 
 - Languages: JavaScript / TypeScript (preferred). Java / Python (optional)
 - Test Design: Page Object Model, Modular test frameworks and reusable components
 - Experience with test management tools such as Jira (Xray/Zephyr) and ALM. 
 - Experience with reporting and dashboard tools such as Tableau and Power BI. 
 - Experience with CI/CD tools such as Jenkins and Git. 

Education Level

- Bachelor's degree in computer science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related discipline required; a master's degree is preferred. 
 - Advanced certifications in software testing, quality assurance, project delivery, or relevant technology domains are strongly preferred. 

Mitsubishi UFJ Financial Group (MUFG) is an equal opportunity employer. We view our employees as our key assets as they are fundamental to our long-term growth and success. MUFG is committed to hiring based on merit and organsational fit, regardless of race, religion or gender.

data.title: QA Automation Engineer
data.description:
Eurofins Scientific is an international life sciences company, providing a unique range of analytical testing services to clients across multiple industries, to make life and our environment safer, healthier and more sustainable. From the food you eat, to the water you drink, to the medicines you rely on, Eurofins laboratories work with the biggest companies in the world to ensure the products they supply are safe, their ingredients are authentic and labelling is accurate. 

The Eurofins network of companies believes that it is a global leader in food, environment, pharmaceutical and cosmetic product testing and in discovery pharmacology, forensics, advanced material sciences and AgroScience contract research services. It is also one of the market leaders in certain testing and laboratory services for genomics, and in the support of clinical studies, as well as in biopharma contract development and manufacturing. It also has a rapidly developing presence in highly specialised and molecular clinical diagnostic testing and in-vitro diagnostic products. 

In over 37 years, Eurofins has grown from one laboratory in Nantes, France to over 65, 000 staff across a decentralised and entrepreneurial network of more than 950 laboratories in over 1, 000 companies across 59 countries. Eurofins companies offer a portfolio of over 200, 000 analytical methods to evaluate the safety, identity, composition, authenticity, origin, traceability and purity of biological substances and products. 

In 2024, Eurofins generated total revenues of EUR 6. 95 billion; and has been among the best performing stocks in Europe over the past 20 years. 

Job Description

Role: QA Test Engineer

Location: Bengaluru, India

Department: Eurofins IT Solutions - BioPharma Product Testing (BPT)

Experience: 2-5+ Years

About the Role

We are looking for a highly skilled QA Test Engineer to join the eLIMS-BPT team. The candidate will play a critical role in ensuring the quality, reliability, compliance, and performance of our Laboratory Information Management System (LIMS) and related applications used by global BioPharma laboratories. 

The role requires strong expertise in functional testing, test automation, release validation, root cause analysis, and collaboration with cross-functional teams in an Agile environment. 

Key Responsibilities

Quality Assurance & Testing

- Analyze requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria to identify test scenarios. 
 - Create, maintain, and execute comprehensive test plans, test cases, and test data. 
 - Perform Functional, Integration, Regression, Smoke, and UAT support testing. 
 - Validate complex business workflows across eLIMS-BPT and integrated applications. 
 - Ensure complete test coverage and traceability between requirements and test evidence. Test Automation

- Design, develop, and maintain automation frameworks and automated test suites. 
 - Improve automation coverage to reduce manual testing effort and increase release confidence. 
 - Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines. 
 - Analyze automation failures and continuously improve test reliability. Defect Management

- Identify, document, prioritize, and track defects through closure. 
 - Perform detailed root cause analysis for escaped defects. 
 - Work closely with developers and business stakeholders to validate fixes. Release & Validation Support

- Support release planning, validation activities, and controlled deployments. 
 - Participate in release readiness reviews and risk assessments. 
 - Ensure required evidence is generated and maintained for regulated environments. 
 - Support audit and compliance activities when required. Collaboration & Leadership

- Collaborate with Product Owners, Developers, Business Analysts, Functional Analysts, and Support teams. 
 - Mentor junior QA engineers and guide testing best practices. 
 - Participate actively in grooming, sprint planning, sprint reviews, and retrospectives. 
 - Drive process improvements to improve product quality and team efficiency. Quality Engineering

- Define and track quality metrics such as defect leakage, automation coverage, and test effectiveness. 
 - Recommend improvements in testing strategies, tools, and processes. 
 - Promote a quality-first mindset across delivery teams. Required Skills & Experience

Technical Skills

- 2-5+ years of experience in Software Quality Assurance. 
 - Strong experience in Functional and Regression Testing. 
 - Experience with Test Automation tools such as WebDriverIO, Selenium, Playwright, or equivalent. 
 - Good understanding of API testing using Postman or similar tools. 
 - Experience with SQL and database validation. 
 - Knowledge of Agile/Scrum methodologies. 
 - Experience using Azure DevOps or similar ALM tools. 
 - Understanding of CI/CD concepts and release management practices. Domain Knowledge

- Experience in Healthcare, Life Sciences, Laboratory Systems, LIMS, ELN, or regulated environments is preferred. 
 - Understanding of validation concepts and evidence generation in regulated systems is an advantage. 
 - Familiarity with GxP, GMP, GLP, CSV, or related compliance processes is desirable. Soft Skills

- Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities. 
 - Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills. 
 - Ability to work independently and take ownership. 
 - Mentoring and leadership capabilities. 
 - Strong attention to detail and quality mindset. Nice to Have

- Experience with Performance Testing. 
 - Experience with Azure services and cloud-based applications. 
 - Experience working on enterprise-scale distributed systems. 
 - Knowledge of security testing concepts. Key Success Measures

- Low defect leakage to production. 
 - Improved automation coverage. 
 - High-quality release validation. 
 - Effective collaboration across teams. 
 - Timely delivery of testing activities. 
 - Continuous improvement initiatives contributing to overall product quality. 

Qualifications

MCA or Bachelors in Engineering, Computer Science or equivalent. 

Additional Information

Personal Skills: 

- Customer-service oriented with a problem-solving attitude; 
 - Strong attention to detail and accuracy is essential; 
 - Entrepreneurial thinking and flexibility to change; 
 - Very good English communication skills (concise writing and orally convincing); 
 - Structured and clear writing skills; 
 - Proven ability to solve complex business problems using analytical reasoning; 
 - Demonstrated positive attitude, self-motivated, team player. PERFORMANCE APPRAISAL CRITERIA: Eurofins has a strong focus on Performance Management system. This includes quarterly calibrations, half-yearly reviews and annual reviews. The KPIs shall be set and may vary slightly between projects. These will be clearly communicated, documented during the first 30 days of your joining.

data.title: Senior Engineer (Backend), Automation Testing
data.description:
Who Are We?

Postman is the world's leading API platform, used by more than 45 million+ developers and 500, 000 organizations, including 98% of the Fortune 500. Postman is helping developers and professionals across the globe build the API-first world by simplifying each step of the API lifecycle and streamlining collaboration-enabling users to create better APIs, faster. 

The company is headquartered in San Francisco and has offices in Boston, New York, Austin, Tokyo, London, and Bangalore - where Postman was founded. Postman is privately held, with funding from Battery Ventures, BOND, Coatue, CRV, Insight Partners, and Nexus Venture Partners. Learn more at postman. com or connect with Postman on X via @getpostman. 

P. S: We highly recommend reading The "API-First World" graphic novel to understand the bigger picture and our vision at Postman. 

About The Team

Automation Testing builds how developers test and automate their APIs, from local runs and CI pipelines to scheduled and large-scale runs in the cloud. 

About The Role

You'll work across Automation Testing, starting with performance testing: load-testing APIs at scale. As a senior engineer, you're the lead for your area, and you own the engineering and the product together. You'll stay close to the customers who use it, most of whom are engineers. 

What You'll Do

- Own your area end to end: decide what to build and why with product, then design, build and ship it
 - Work directly with customers, and turn their problems into product and technical decisions
 - Own the architecture, reliability and performance of your area, and turn ambiguous goals into designs you deliver
 - Make test runs fast, reliable and easy to debug, at multi million VU scale. 
 - Mentor engineers and raise the bar for quality on the team
 - Represent your area with design, platform and customer-facing teams

What We're Looking For

- 6+ years building and shipping production software
 - Experience leading an area as its technical owner, from design through delivery and quality in production
 - A record of building customer-facing products, ideally for developers or other engineers
 - Product judgment: you weigh what to build as well as how, and own outcomes like adoption and reliability
 - Strong backend engineering in Node. js/TypeScript, Go or Java
 - Experience with enterprise needs such as private networks, security reviews and access control

Good to have

- Experience with load-testing tools such as k6, JMeter, Gatling or Locust
 - Experience with API testing, developer tools or test automation

What Else?

In addition to Postman's pay-on-performance philosophy, and a flexible schedule working with a fun, collaborative team, Postman offers a comprehensive set of benefits, including full medical coverage, flexible PTO, wellness reimbursement, and a monthly lunch stipend. Along with that, our wellness programs will help you stay in the best of your physical and mental health. Our frequent and fascinating team-building events will keep you connected, while our donation-matching program can support the causes you care about. We're building a long-term company with an inclusive culture where everyone can be the best version of themselves. 

At Postman we value in person collaboration. We are in office 5 days a week for all roles based out of our hubs in San Francisco Bay Area, Boston, Austin, New York City, Tokyo and London. For roles based in Bangalore, employees currently work in the office three days a week and will transition to five days per week by the end of the year. We were thoughtful in our approach which is based on collaboration and grounded in feedback from our workforce, leadership team, and peers. The benefits of our in office model will be shared knowledge, brainstorming sessions, communication, and building trust in-person that cannot be replicated via zoom. 

Our Values

At Postman, we create with the same curiosity that we see in our users. We value transparency and honest communication about not only successes, but also failures. In our work, we focus on specific goals that add up to a larger vision. Our inclusive work culture ensures that everyone is valued equally as important pieces of our final product. We are dedicated to delivering the best products we can. 

Equal Opportunity

Postman is an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action Employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, or disability status. Headhunters and recruitment agencies may not submit resumes/CVs through this website or directly to managers. Postman does not accept unsolicited headhunter and agency resumes. Postman will not pay fees to any third-party agency or company that does not have a signed agreement with Postman.

The role includes monitoring quality assurance activities across Wet Chemistry and Dry Chemistry sections, ensuring technical validity of results, maintaining accreditation requirements, coordinating audits, and driving continual improvement initiatives. 

  

Key Responsibilities

Quality Management System

- Ensure compliance with ISO/IEC 17025: 2017 , ISO 45001: 2018 & ISO 9001: 2015 and NABL accreditation requirements. 
 - Maintain and update Quality Manual, SOPs, formats, procedures, and records. 
 - Control distribution, revision, and archiving of quality documents. 
 - Monitor implementation of laboratory policies and quality objectives. Technical Quality Assurance

- Review analytical test records and reports for technical accuracy. 
 - Monitor quality control practices including blanks, standards, reference materials, duplicate analysis, and control charts. 
 - Verify method validation, verification, and measurement uncertainty studies. 
 - Monitor equipment calibration, intermediate checks, and maintenance records. NABL Compliance Activities

- Coordinate NABL assessments, surveillance audits, and reassessments. 
 - Ensure timely closure of NABL and internal audit observations. 
 - Monitor compliance with NABL-specific requirements and policies. 
 - Maintain personnel competency records and training matrices. Internal Audits & CAPA

- Plan and conduct internal audits as per established schedules. 
 - Investigate non-conforming work, customer complaints, and deviations. 
 - Perform root cause analysis and implement Corrective and Preventive Actions (CAPA). 
 - Monitor effectiveness of corrective actions. Proficiency Testing & Quality Control

- Coordinate participation in Proficiency Testing (PT) and Inter-Laboratory Comparison (ILC) programmes. 
 - Evaluate PT/ILC results and recommend corrective actions where required. 
 - Maintain quality indicators and performance metrics. Continuous Improvement

- Support risk assessment and opportunity analysis activities. 
 - Identify areas for system improvement and process optimization. 
 - Assist management during Management Review Meetings (MRM). 

Educational Qualification

- B. Sc. / M. Sc. in Chemistry, Analytical Chemistry, Environmental Science, Food Science or related scientific discipline. Experience

- Minimum 2-5 years of experience in a NABL accredited testing laboratory. 
 - Freshers are welcome. 
 - Experience in Wet Chemistry and Dry Chemistry testing environments. 
 - Working knowledge of ISO/IEC 17025: 2017 requirements is essential. Required Skills

- Strong understanding of NABL accreditation requirements. 
 - Knowledge of method validation and measurement uncertainty. 
 - Familiarity with Proficiency Testing (PT) and Inter-Laboratory Comparisons (ILC). 
 - Internal auditing skills. 
 - Excellent documentation and report review skills. 
 - Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities. 
 - Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

- Successful maintenance of NABL accreditation. 
 - Timely closure of audit findings and CAPAs. 
 - Successful participation in PT/ILC programmes. 
 - Compliance with document control requirements. 
 - Reduction in non-conformities and quality incidents. 
 - Timely completion of internal audits and management reviews. Preferred Certification

- ISO/IEC 17025 Internal Auditor Training. 
 - NABL Awareness Training. 
 - Quality Management System (QMS) training. Compensation & Benefits

- Salary: INR 18, 000 per month (PF & ESI deductions included) for freshers, Higher salary will be based on experience. 
 - Initial designation: Trainee Analyst (1 year) → Confirmation as Quality Analyst based on performance. 
 - Opportunity for career growth in compliance-driven, research-focused environments. 
 - Supportive team culture fostering learning and professional development.

MCA or Bachelors in Engineering, Computer Science or equivalent.

Where Ambition Meets Innovation

At LPL's Global Capability Center, you'll find a collaborative culture where your voice matters, integrity guides every decision, and technology fuels progress. Your skills, talents, and ideas will redefine what's possible. LPL's success reflects its exceptional employees, who together pursue one noble purpose: empowering financial advisors to deliver personalized advice for all who need it. We're proud to be expanding and reaching new heights in Hyderabad. 

Join us as we create something extraordinary together. 

Job Overview

We are seeking an experienced Senior QA Engineer to define, build, and scale our quality assurance strategy across web applications/openAPI, and data-intensive systems. This role combines test automation leadership, data validation expertise, and modern QA practices-including AI-assisted testing and cloud-native test environments. 

You will establish testing standards, and ensure reliable releases through robust automation, synthetic test data management, and end-to-end quality coverage. 

Responsibilities

Test Automation

- Design and maintain Playwright-based UI and API automation frameworks
 - Implement and govern Behave (BDD) test suites with clear Gherkin scenarios and reusable step definitions
 - Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines with reliable, parallel execution

Data & Database Testing

- Validate data integrity, transformations, and reporting using SQL across relational and warehouse databases

 - Use Delphix for data virtualization, masking, and provisioning of non-production test environments

We're looking for strong collaborators who deliver exceptional client experiences and thrive in fast-paced, team-oriented environments. Our ideal candidates pursue greatness, act with integrity, and are driven to help our clients succeed. We value those who embrace creativity, continuous improvement, and contribute to a culture where we win together and create and share joy in our work. 

Requirements

Preferences

data.title: Engineer - Industrial Automation
data.description:
What You'll Do

The Engineer - Industrial Automation will support the assessment, design, development, integration and commissioning of industrial automation solutions across manufacturing operations. The role combines hands-on knowledge of robotics, mechanical automation, controls, vision, material handling and industrial connectivity to improve productivity, quality, safety and equipment reliability. The engineer will work with cross-functional teams, equipment suppliers and system integrators to deliver scalable automation solutions from concept through FAT, SAT, ramp-up and handover. 

"

- Assess manufacturing processes and benchmark robotics, cobots, automated material handling (AGV/AMR), automated storage, machine vision and flexible automation cells. 
 - Analyze workflows and identify automation opportunities that improve throughput, quality, safety and equipment utilization while reducing manual effort and downtime. 
 - Translate operational needs into user requirements, technical specifications, cell concepts, layouts, mechanical designs, control requirements and equipment connectivity/data requirements. 
 - Support end-to-end automation project execution covering concept development, design reviews, supplier coordination, build, integration, pre-FAT, FAT, SAT, commissioning, ramp-up and handover. 
 - Develop and validate mechanical automation elements, including robot cells, end-of-arm tooling, fixtures, conveyors, part nests, sensor and actuator integration, guarding and safety interlocks. 
 - Support robot, PLC, HMI/SCADA, motion-control and vision-system integration, programming, troubleshooting and cycle-time optimization. 
 - Perform offline simulation and validation for reach, collision, cycle time, layout and tooling feasibility, as applicable. 
 - Support integration of automation equipment with industrial networks, IIoT platforms, MES and data-acquisition systems for work-order, routing, traceability, quality and performance data. 
 - Prepare and maintain schematics, specifications, standard operating procedures, validation protocols, commissioning checklists, code documentation and training material. 
 - Ensure automation solutions comply with applicable machine-safety, risk-assessment, electrical and industrial standards, including LOTO and required documentation. 
 - Collaborate with plants, cross-functional engineering teams, equipment suppliers and system integrators to achieve safe, timely and cost-effective delivery. 
 - Evaluate emerging automation technologies, develop proof-of-concept demonstrators and contribute to reusable standards, templates and lessons learned for deployment across plants. "

Qualifications

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Mechanical, Electrical, Electronics, Mechatronics, Robotics, Industrial Engineering or a related engineering discipline. 

3+ years of industrial experience in the development, integration or commissioning of manufacturing automation solutions. 

Skills

- "
 - Practical knowledge of industrial automation project lifecycle from requirements and concept development through design, build, FAT/SAT, commissioning and handover. 
 - Experience assessing automation applications for assembly, material handling, wiring, inspection, labeling, torqueing and end-of-line testing processes. 
 - Knowledge of robotics and cobots from suppliers such as FANUC, ABB, KUKA, Universal Robots, Yaskawa, Omron/TM or equivalent, including frames, tooling, safe zones and basic programming/troubleshooting. 
 - Knowledge of mechanical automation design including robot-cell design, EOAT, fixtures, conveyors, part nests, sensor/actuator integration, pneumatics, guarding and safety interlocks. 
 - Working knowledge of PLC, motion, HMI and SCADA platforms such as Rockwell, Siemens, Omron, Schneider, Beckhoff or Mitsubishi, including IEC 61131-3 fundamentals. 
 - Familiarity with offline programming and simulation tools such as RoboDK, Visual Components, DELMIA, RobotStudio, ROBOGUIDE, KUKA. Sim or Process Simulate. 
 - Familiarity with machine-vision systems such as Keyence, Cognex, IDS or SICK for presence, orientation, barcode/OCR and dimensional inspection applications. 
 - Understanding of industrial communication protocols and data connectivity, including EtherNet/IP, PROFINET, EtherCAT, Modbus/TCP, OPC-UA and MQTT. 
 - Basic understanding of MES, ERP or PLM integration, work-order/routing/serial/quality data mapping, traceability, OEE, FPY and SPC data requirements.

Job Overview: 

- We are seeking a Technical Lead - Data & Analytics to lead the design and delivery of enterprise-grade capabilities across enterprise data and analytics initiatives. The role requires strong grounding in data concepts, modern data engineering and analytics, metadata and governance, semantic and ontology-driven solutions, and cloud-native delivery practices. The successful candidate will provide technical direction, guide engineering teams, own design quality, and contribute directly to implementation.

- Technical Leadership: Lead solution design and delivery across Data & Analytics workstreams; translate business requirements into scalable technical designs; conduct design and code reviews; define engineering standards; mentor developers and data engineers; manage technical risks and dependencies.

 - Cloud & Platform Engineering: Design and deploy cloud-native solutions on Azure, AWS or GCP; select fit-for-purpose managed services; apply security, networking, identity, resilience, cost and operational best practices.

- 7-10+ years of overall experience, primarily in Data & Analytics, with experience leading technical delivery teams or workstreams.

 - Hands-on experience designing and building enterprise-scale data solutions using Python, SQL and relevant data engineering frameworks. 
 - Experience with at least one major cloud platform: Microsoft Azure, Amazon Web Services (AWS) or Google Cloud Platform (GCP). 
 - Practical experience with Git-based development, continuous integration and delivery, automated testing, release automation and environment promotion. 
 - Hands-on exposure to Docker and Kubernetes-based deployment, including configuration, secrets, scaling, monitoring and troubleshooting. 
 - Working exposure to Agentic AI, Generative AI, LLM-based applications, RAG, vector search, knowledge graphs or multi-agent workflows. 
 - Experience with Snowflake architecture and development, including data pipelines, security, governance and performance optimization. 
 - Ability to independently own technical design, guide engineers, review implementation quality and resolve complex delivery issues. 
 - Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain technical decisions to both engineering and business stakeholders. 

Preferred Experience: 

- Experience with Databricks, Microsoft Fabric or equivalent modern data and AI platforms. 
 - Exposure to business glossaries, semantic models, ontologies, entity resolution and enterprise knowledge graphs. 
 - Experience with orchestration or agent frameworks such as Lang Graph, Lang Chain, Semantic Kernel or similar technologies. 
 - Understanding of vector databases, model serving, prompt engineering, AI evaluation and responsible AI controls. 
 - Experience with Infrastructure as Code and platform automation using Terraform, Bicep, CloudFormation or equivalent tools. 
 - Prior experience delivering metadata-driven, governance-led, self-service or AI-enabled data platforms.

data.title: Associate Manager, Content & Data
data.description:
About MediaRadar

MediaRadar, equips marketing, sales and analytics leaders with the intelligence they need to stay ahead. 

Our platform delivers always-on, AI-enabled Creative, Competitive, Commercial and Market

Intelligence-spanning ad strategy, media spend, creative assets and brand messaging across 30+ media

channels and five million brands. 

With deep insights into more than 35 million ad and campaign assets and $280 billion in media spend, 

MediaRadar provides a single, interoperable source of truth that plugs seamlessly into enterprise

analytics and AI systems. The result: faster, cleaner and more actionable intelligence that drives

competitive advantage. 

Job Summary: 

As an Associate Manager, Data Operations, you will own the day-to-day performance of a team of Data

Associates across our classification, attribution, and product-catalog workflows. You will sit where human

judgment meets machine learning-turning targets into daily execution, coaching your associates from

task-executors into data-driven critical thinkers, and acting as the first line of defense for quality, 

throughput, and SLAs. You will operate within the operating plan set by your Manager, run it relentlessly

on the floor, and surface the insights and improvement ideas that make the plan better. 

We are looking for a hands-on operations leader and a force-multiplier for the Manager of Data

Operations. 

Requirements

Primary Responsibilities and Impact Drivers: (not limited to)

- Supervise, coach, and develop a team of 15-20 Data Associates responsible for classification, 

attribution, and product catalog management. 

- Monitor and manage team performance against KPIs, including throughput, accuracy, and quality

benchmarks. 

- Serve as the first point of escalation for workflow or process-related issues
 - Conduct regular quality reviews and provide actionable feedback to ensure data accuracy and

consistency. 

- Identify workflow inefficiencies and partner with managers, automation teams, and governance

specialists to improve processes. 

- Coordinate team scheduling, task assignment, and workload balancing to meet daily and weekly

targets. 

- Ensure compliance with governance standards, documentation, and reporting requirements
 - Train new hires and ensure associates are up to date on classification guidelines, tools, and

processes. 

- Report team status, coverage, productivity, and quality metrics to management
 - Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement
 - Proactively identify and address problems before they escalate, while recognizing opportunities

for efficiency, automation, and quality improvements. 

Role Mandate - How You Will Move The Needle

You start your day in your team's real-time utilization dashboards and queue metrics. You read the data to

anticipate bottlenecks before they form, check the health of in-flight work, and make rapid, high-judgment

calls on how to reallocate associates across queues to protect SLAs. 

Through the morning, you are on the floor with your associates. You run quality reviews, give specific, 

example-based feedback (what, why, and the rule behind it), and coach your team to do root-cause

analysis on their own defect and throughput data so the same error doesn't come back twice. 

In the afternoon, you connect outward: you partner with Quality, Training, Governance, and your peer

Associate Managers to close process gaps, pilot improvements within your workflows, and feed clear, 

evidence-backed recommendations up to your Manager for anything that needs a roadmap-level decision. 

You keep the "voice of the client" in view, validating that your team's output holds up in the real world. You

end the day by reviewing throughput and quality, recognizing your best performers, and making sure your

cross-trained, fungible team is positioned to clear tomorrow's volume. 

Success Measures: 

- Accuracy: Team maintains 98%+ accuracy in ad classification, attribution, and catalog updates
 - Productivity: Team consistently processes assigned workloads against defined productivity

targets and SLA requirements. 

- Quality Assurance: Less than 2% of team output requires rework due to errors
 - Team Development: Regular coaching and training lead to measurable improvement in associate

performance. 

- Process Improvement: Implements at least two documented workflow or tool improvements per

quarter. 

- Collaboration: Builds strong working relationships with peers in automation, governance, and

data quality functions. 

Short-Term Deliverables (First 90 Days): 

- Baseline your team's skill sets and identify single points of failure and coverage gaps across the

media types you support. 

- Stand up a rigorous, data-driven feedback loop with your associates using specific defect

examples and root-cause analysis ahead of weekly syncs. 

- Deeply understand your production queues and utilization metrics to optimize the balance

between Core Production (value-add) and Administrative Shrinkage within your team. 

Long-Term Deliverables (6 months - 1 year and beyond): 

- Establish a seamless, highly efficient operational flow across time zones that eliminates

geographical friction. 

- Successfully manage the operational integration of new datasets, media channels, or M&A

expansions without linearly increasing headcount. 

- Successfully groom your top Team Leads to be ready for Manager-level responsibilities

Qualifications: 

- Bachelor's degree in business, operations, information systems, or a related field
 - 4+ years of professional experience in data operations, data quality, content processing, or

shared-services roles. 

- 2+ years directly leading or managing a team, with a proven ability to coach, develop, and hold

people accountable. 

- Demonstrated experience managing high-volume, detail-oriented workflows to tight quality and SLA

standards. 

- Data Fluency: You can use raw data (advanced Excel, PowerBI, Looker) to track performance, spot

bloat, and drive behavioral change in your team. 

- You anticipate challenges, resolve issues fast, and balance daily tactical delivery with a steady

drumbeat of continuous improvement. 

- You actively mentor and elevate associates, guide them through ambiguous operational change, 

build actionable growth plans, and cultivate critical thinkers rather than task executors. 

- You treat accuracy as the baseline, not the goal. You uphold and strengthen QA frameworks-even

with legacy tools-so that high-fidelity classification and first-time-right execution are

non-negotiable. 

- (Good to have) Industry Context: Experience in media intelligence, ad-tech, data tagging, taxonomy

management, or content moderation is a strong plus. 

Benefits

At MediaRadar, we are committed to creating an inclusive and accessible workplace where everyone can thrive. We believe that diversity of backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences makes us stronger and more innovative. We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer and make employment decisions without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation, or gender identity), national origin, age, disability, genetic information, or any other legally protected status. 

In accordance with the EEO-1 reporting requirements, we collect demographic data as part of our efforts to ensure fair and equitable hiring practices across all levels of our organization. 

We are committed to ensuring our recruitment process is accessible to all applicants. If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or interview process, please contact us at careers@mediaradar. com . 

We're excited to meet people who share our values and want to build the future with us!
