data.title: Engineering Manager - Data Science
data.description:
Engineering Manager - Data Science

Job Overview

As an Engineering Manager, AI & ML (Data Collection), you will play a vital role in executing the company's AI and machine learning initiatives with a strong focus on data collection technologies. This position will require deep technical expertise in unstructured data processing, data collection pipeline engineering, and a hands-on approach to managing and mentoring engineers. Your leadership will ensure that AI & ML data collection systems are developed and operationalized at the highest standards of performance, reliability, and security. You will be working closely with individual contributors, ensuring that projects align with broader business goals and AI/ML strategies. 

This role requires deep engagement in the design, development, and maintenance of AI & ML models, solutions, architecture, and services. You will need to provide strong technical direction, problem-solve complex technical challenges, and ensure that the team consistently delivers high-quality, scalable solutions. You will leverage your deep knowledge in areas such as advanced natural language processing (NLP), generative AI (GenAI) and large language models (LLMs), ML Operations (MLOps), data architecture, data pipelines, and cloud-managed services. 

Your leadership will ensure that our AI/ML systems align with global business strategies, maintaining seamless integration and high-performance standards. You will oversee the end-to-end lifecycle of AI/ML data systems-from research and development to deployment and operationalization. 

You will be responsible for mentoring team members, resolving technical challenges, and fostering a culture of innovation and collaboration while ensuring they have the right tools, frameworks, and guidance to succeed. This role offers a unique opportunity to drive impactful change in a fast-paced, dynamic environment, where your efforts will directly contribute to the success of our AI/ML initiatives globally. Your ability to collaborate with cross-departmental stakeholders, provide leadership across locations, set high standards for the team, and hire, train, and retain exceptional talent is foundational to your success. You will solicit feedback, engage others with empathy, inspire creative thinking, and help foster a culture of belonging, teamwork, and purpose. 

Team Overview

You will lead a multidisciplinary team of engineers and data scientists responsible for building AI & ML solutions and services as part of robust data collection pipelines handling large volumes of unstructured data. Your team will focus on building scalable and reliable systems to process and categorize data that is essential for downstream data collection processing. 

Duties and Responsibilities: 

- AI & ML Data Collection Leadership: Drive the execution of AI & ML initiatives related to data collection, ensuring that the team's efforts are aligned with overall business goals and strategies. 
 - Technical Oversight: Provide hands-on technical leadership in the engineering of ML models and services, focusing on unstructured data, NLP, and classifiers. Oversee and contribute to the implementation of scalable solutions that meet high standards of reliability and efficiency. 
 - Team Leadership & Development: Lead, mentor, and develop a high-performing team of engineers and data scientists, fostering a culture of innovation and continuous improvement. Ensure effective communication and coordination within your team and across geographically dispersed teams. 
 - NLP Technologies: Contribute to the development and application of NLP techniques, including classifiers, transformers, LLMs, and other methodologies, to efficiently process and categorize unstructured data. Ensure these models are integrated seamlessly into the broader AI/ML infrastructure. 
 - Data Pipeline Engineering: Design, develop, and maintain advanced data collection pipelines, utilizing orchestration, messaging, database, and data platform technologies. Ensure pipelines are optimized for scalability, performance, and reliability. 
 - Cross-functional Collaboration: Work closely with other AI/ML teams, data collection engineering teams, product management, and others to ensure data collection efforts support broader AI/ML goals and product objectives. 
 - Innovation & Continuous Improvement: Continuously explore and implement new technologies and methodologies to enhance the efficiency and accuracy of data collection and processing systems. Stay at the forefront of advancements in NLP and data processing. 
 - System Integrity & Security: Ensure that all data collection systems meet the highest standards of integrity, security, and compliance. Implement best practices for data governance and model transparency. 
 - Talent Acquisition & Retention: Play an active role in recruiting, training, and retaining top engineering talent. Foster an environment where team members are encouraged to innovate, feel valued, and achieve their full potential. 
 - Process Improvement: Apply Agile, Lean, and Fast-Flow principles to improve team efficiency and the delivery of high-quality data collection solutions. 
 - Support Company Vision and Values: Model and promote behaviors that align with the company's vision and values. Participate actively in company-wide initiatives and projects as required. 

Experience, Skills and Qualifications

- Bachelor's, Master's, or PhD in Computer Science, Mathematics, Data Science, or a related field. 
 - 6+ years of experience in software engineering, with a focus on AI & ML technologies, particularly in data collection and unstructured data processing. 
 - 3+ years of experience in a leadership role managing individual contributors. 
 - Strong expertise in NLP and machine learning, with hands-on experience in classifiers, large language models (LLMs), and other NLP techniques. Additionally experience in Gen AI, RAG, Agentic AI is essential
 - Extensive experience with data pipeline and messaging technologies such as Apache Kafka, Airflow, and cloud data platforms (e. g. , Snowflake). 
 - Expert-level proficiency in Java, Python, SQL, and other relevant programming languages and tools. 
 - Strong understanding of cloud-native technologies and containerization (e. g. , Kubernetes, Docker) with experience in managing these systems globally. 
 - Demonstrated ability to solve complex technical challenges and deliver scalable solutions. 
 - Excellent communication skills with a collaborative approach to working with global teams and stakeholders. 
 - Experience working in fast-paced environments, particularly in industries that rely on data-intensive technologies (experience in fintech is highly desirable).

About The Team

Walmart Fulfillment Services (WFS) Technology delivers scalable fulfillment solutions for third-party sellers, integrating transportation, inventory, warehouse operations, billing, and delivery. The team bridges Marketplace and Walmart's supply chain, collaborating with Product, Business, Operations, Supply Chain, and Transportation partners. Combining the agility of a growth business with the scale of a global retailer, the team drives innovation and expands fulfillment capabilities into new models and international markets. This environment emphasizes technical excellence and cross-functional collaboration to develop impactful solutions that enhance the seller fulfillment experience. 

Role Overview

Distinguished Engineer is one of the most coveted technical IC titles at Walmart - and this role lives up to it. As a Distinguished Engineer on the WFS team within Growth Tech, you will be developing services that helps millions of sellers to leverage Walmart Fulfilment Services. You will write code, design systems, review architectures, and solve the problems that are complex. Your world-class expertise in distributed systems, API design, and platform engineering will be paired with a Al-forward mindset. 

This is a high-impact role sitting at the intersection of scale, commerce, and platform engineering. You will own the technical vision and execution for a portfolio of mission-critical, cross-cutting services that enables Seller through Seller Center UI and APIs. You will be the technical standard-setter across all of it. 

What You'll Own Technically

The Walmart Fulfilment Services team is essential to the Marketplace ecosystem, responsible for designing and scaling the global platform that supports the complete seller fulfilment within Walmart marketplace journey. The team develops robust global workflows, and complex multi-platform integrations connecting cloud microservices, seller portals, and AI-driven analytics. You will own Architecture, design, development and delivery of Seller journey, addressing distributed systems challenges, optimize APIs, and establish architectural standards to enable international marketplace growth. 

What You'll Do

Architecture & System Design

- Lead end-to-end technical design for complex initiatives involving from API contracts, UI interfaces and data models to distributed system topologies and cross-cutting concerns. 
 - Drive platform standardization by defining and documenting reference architectures, design patterns, and implementation guardrails that teams adopt
 - Evaluate and select technologies, frameworks, and cloud-native patterns with a clear-eyed understanding of trade-offs at Walmart's operational scale
 - Author and review RFCs and architecture decision records (ADRs) that become the technical canon for the platform

Hands-On Engineering

- Write production-grade code and not prototypes or proof-of-concepts, test and deploy them to production
 - Solve complex problems considering performance, reliability and scalability
 - Prototype new solutions rapidly using Al-augmented development workflows and then drive them to production quality
 - Conduct deep-dive code reviews that raise the technical bar of the team. 
 - Own the full software development lifecycle for your initiatives involving design, development, testing, deployment, observability

Complex Problem Solving

- Solve the hardest and complex problems and enable the team while doing so
 - Lead technical investigations for P0/P1 incidents affecting platform services; own the root cause analysis and define permanent fixes
 - Challenge technical assumptions early in the design process before they become expensive production mistakes
 - Navigate ambiguity with confidence by breaking down underspecified problems into structured technical approaches and drive alignment across stakeholders

Platform Reliability & Operational Excellence

- Design for resilience from first principles. Define and own the platform's non-functional requirements
 - Instrument systems to be deeply observable and use the signals to drive continuous improvement
 - Build runbooks and operational playbooks that enable the broader team to operate the services confidently

Al & Innovation

- This role is Al-forward by design and needs someone who actively shapes how it is used and pushes the frontier of what Al-augmented engineering looks like at scale. 

Day-to-Day Al Fluency

- Proficient with GitHub Copilot, Wibey, and LLM-based tooling as active, daily parts of your development workflow
 - Use Al to compress every phase of the engineering loop: schema design validation, code generation and review, test coverage acceleration, documentation, drafting, incident root-cause analysis, and API design feedback
 - Identify where Al can replace toil, then build the automation yourself

Al-Native Platform Thinking

- Architect and build Al-native capabilities like intelligent API health monitoring, Al-assisted seller onboarding flows, smart alerting and anomaly detection
 - Evaluate and integrate Al/ML capabilities into services where they create measurable seller value
 - Stay current on the fast-moving AI tooling landscape and bring high-signal, opinionated recommendations to the team

Al Advocacy & Enablement

- Model Al-augmented engineering practices for the team through live demos, pairing sessions, and written guides
 - Work with engineering leadership to identify and prioritize investments where Al creates the most leverage across teams
 - Contribute to the broader Walmart engineering community's understanding of how to build and operate Al-augmented systems responsibly

What You'll Bring

Distinguished Engineers at Walmart lead through technical gravity. Your impact multiplies across teams. 

- Raise the floor - your code reviews, design feedback, and written standards lift the quality of every engineer in the team
 - When a team is stuck on a systems design challenge or a production crisis, you are the person who helps unblock
 - Your architectural decisions today shape the technical capabilities and codebase for the future
 - Grow technical depth across the org through tech talks, design reviews, RFCs, and hands-on pairing, you are a force multiplier for technical growth across Growth Tech
 - Bridge platform and product translate complex technical constraints into clear trade-offs that inform product decisions; translate product ambitions into technically sound, phased engineering strategies
 - Pioneer Al adoption - model what Al-augmented engineering looks like at the Distinguished level and create the patterns, playbooks, and tooling that the broader team follows

About Walmart Global Tech

Imagine working in an environment where one line of code can make life easier for hundreds of millions of people. That's what we do at Walmart Global Tech. We're a team of software engineers, data scientists, cybersecurity expert's and service professionals within the world's leading retailer who make an epic impact and are at the forefront of the next retail disruption. People are why we innovate, and people power our innovations. We are people-led and tech-empowered. 

We train our team in the skillsets of the future and bring in experts like you to help us grow. We have roles for those chasing their first opportunity as well as those looking for the opportunity that will define their career. Here, you can kickstart a great career in tech, gain new skills and experience for virtually every industry, or leverage your expertise to innovate at scale, impact millions and reimagine the future of retail. 

Work

Benefits

Beyond our great compensation package, you can receive incentive awards for your performance. Other great perks include a host of best-in-class benefits maternity and parental leave, PTO, health benefits, and much more. 

Belonging

We aim to create a culture where every associate feels valued for who they are, rooted in respect for the individual. Our goal is to foster a sense of belonging, to create opportunities for all our associates, customers and suppliers, and to be a Walmart for everyone. 

At Walmart, our vision is "everyone included. " By fostering a workplace culture where everyone is-and feels-included, everyone wins. By making Walmart a welcoming place where all people feel like they belong, we're able to engage associates, strengthen our business, improve our ability to serve customers, and support the communities where we operate. 

Equal Opportunity Employer

data.description:
Senior Staff Engineer - C++

Let's be unstoppable together!

Circana is a leading provider of technology, AI, and data solutions for consumer packaged goods companies, manufacturers, and retailers. Our predictive analytics and Liquid Data® platform help clients measure market share, uncover consumer behavior, and drive growth-powered by six decades of expertise and an expansive, high-quality data set. 

At Circana, we are fueled by our passion for continuous learning and growth, we seek and share feedback freely, and we celebrate victories both big and small in an environment that is flexible and accommodating to our work and personal lives. We're a global company dedicated to fostering inclusivity and belonging. We value and celebrate the unique experiences, cultures, and viewpoints that each individual brings. By embracing a wide range of backgrounds, skills, expertise, and beyond, we create a stronger, more innovative environment for our employees, clients, and communities. With us, you can always bring your full self to work. Join our inclusive, committed team to be a challenger, own outcomes, and stay curious together. Circana is proud to be CertifiedTM by Great Place To Work®. This prestigious award is based entirely on what current employees say about their experience working at Circana. Learn more at www. circana. com. 

Role Overview: 

We are seeking Senior Staff Engineer to drive design, evolution, and execution of our next-generation, massively parallel processing (MPP) clustered database engine (Whitebox) that currently powers large-scale retail and consumer analytics solutions across Circana clients in 22+ countries and serving millions of queries every day in real-time against massive data sets . This is a highly technical role for an expert who bridges the gap between High-Performance Computing (HPC) and Big Data systems engineering and low-latency machine learning infrastructure and involves database internals, distributed systems, performance engineering, data processing at scale. 

In this role, you will be one of the primary designers and developer responsible for building low-latency, high-throughput distributed database kernels. You will design bare-metal optimized software layers, ensuring our database product fully exploits modern multi-core, vectorized hardware and distributed network fabrics to process terabyte/petabyte-scale datasets and where appropriate, seamlessly executes highly performant analytics and in-database ML inference directly on relational and the occasional vector datasets. 

Job Responsibilities: 

- Architecture & Design: Play a key role in core architectural choices and roadmap for our distributed database kernel, including query execution engines, custom/hybrid columnar storage layers, distributed transaction managers, and cluster coordination protocols. 
 - Low-Level Development: Write, optimize, and maintain highly performant, production-ready backend code utilizing modern C++ (C++20/23). 
 - Parallel Execution Planning: Architect MPP execution engines that distribute, schedule, and execute queries across several dozens to hundreds of nodes using MPI and hybrid OpenMP models. 
 - Hardware Optimization: Profile and eliminate execution bottlenecks by implementing explicit SIMD vectorization (AVX-512, ARM Neon, SVE) and ensuring absolute cache locality (L1/L2/L3). 
 - Distributed Memory & Networks: Design ultra-low latency cluster communication subsystems utilizing RDMA, RoCE, or kernel-bypass tech (DPDK). 
 - In-Database ML Framework Design: Architect and implement a native, highly performant, zero-copy ML execution framework directly inside the MPP engine to eliminate data serialization and transport bottlenecks between the database and external AI pipelines. 
 - Functional & High-Performance Algorithms: Develop mathematically rigorous, cache-oblivious, and highly vectorized algorithms for real-time statistical computations, matrix operations/manipulations on clustered data
 - Vector & Embedding Infrastructure: Design and optimize or embed/reference distributed high-dimensional vector storage subsystems, custom SIMD-accelerated indexing structures (e. g. , HNSW, IVF-PQ), and parallelized approximate nearest neighbor (ANN) search algorithms. 
 - Be comfortable working in a cross country/multi time zone team of elite systems engineers, implementing as well as conducting rigorous peer design and development reviews
 - Collaborate with cross-functional teams in defining and developing new platform capabilities. 
 - Actively participate in architecture reviews, code reviews, and technical mentoring. 
 - Investigate and resolve complex performance and scalability issues. 

Required Technical Qualifications: 

- Minimum - 4 years Computer Science engineering degree from a reputed institute. Masters in HPC (high performance computing) and Bigdata engineering areas preferred for Senior staff engineer and above roles
 - Modern C++ Expertise: 8+ years of production experience writing hands-on, low-level systems in C++ (C++17/20/23 preferred). Mastery of template metaprogramming, concepts, coroutines, and custom memory allocators is key. 
 - HPC Parallelism: Very good to expert-level knowledge of cluster-scale distributed programming using MPI (Message Passing Interface) paired with shared-memory thread-level programming via OpenMP and MapReduce frameworks. 
 - Hardware-Aware Engineering: Documented experience with microarchitectural optimization, loop vectorization, pointer-aliasing constraints, and manual SIMD intrinsics programming. 
 - Concurrency Mechanics: Deep understanding of OS internals, memory barriers, lock-free data structures, and atomics (std: : atomic). 
 - Database Internals: Practical experience designing core database subsystems (e. g. , vectorized query operators, LSM-trees, B-trees, custom buffer pools, columnar serialization frameworks and query plan optimizers). 
 - Strong debugging, performance tuning, and problem-solving skills. 
 - Proficiency in one or more leading memory and compute monitoring/performance tools (such as Valgrind, Purify, Intel/AMD/ARM diagnostics etc. )

Bonus Qualifications: 

- Track record contributing to open-source or work experience on proprietary distributed engines (e. g. , ClickHouse, DuckDB, Doris, CockroachDB, RocksDB, ScyllaDB, or Velox). 
 - Experience with cloud-native distributed, elastic environments, object storage tiering (S3/GCS), or zero-copy networking. 
 - Experience integrating heterogeneous acceleration (NVIDIA CUDA / ROCm) into big data workloads and hybrid CPU/GPU setups. 
 - Vector & Graph Algorithmic experience: Experience building or modifying high-performance vector index/search engines, graph-based indices, or localized quantization frameworks. 
 - Functional domain awareness - CPG, Retail, Pharma verticals

What We Offer

- Work on the bleeding edge of data infrastructure, tackling next gen big data engineering problems to support real time querying and analytics against some of the largest data sets at high concurrency
 - Challenging engineering problems - all the way from functional/data science algorithm implementations on a HPC setup to bare metal/close to OS kernel level programming involving handling of hundreds of billions of records to support real-time analytics at scale. 
 - Plenty of valuable exposure to broader BI/Analytics/Bigdata ecosystem including great opportunity to functionally better understand CPG, Retail and related domains. 

Stimulating work environment and a great Circana work culture that allows members to bring their best daily. 

Circana Behaviors: 

Beyond technical skills, experience, and role-specific attributes, these shared behaviors are fundamental to our culture and success. We seek individuals who consistently demonstrate and champion these behaviors in their daily work: 

- Stay Curious: Being hungry to learn and grow, always asking the big questions. 
 - Seek Clarity: Embracing complexity to create clarity and inspire action. 
 - Own the Outcome: Being accountable for decisions and taking ownership of our choices. 
 - Center on the Client: Relentlessly adding value for our customers. 
 - Be a Challenger: Never complacent, always striving for continuous improvement. 
 - Champion Inclusivity: Fostering trust in relationships engaging with empathy, respect, and integrity. 
 - Commit to each other: Contributing to making Circana a great place to work for everyone. 

Location: 

This position can be located in the following area(s): Bangalore

Prospective candidates may be asked to consent to background checks (in accordance with local legislation and our candidate privacy notice ) Your current employer will not be contacted without your permission.

data.title: Senior DevOps Engineer
data.description:
Quick Facts About the Role

Role: Senior DevOps Engineer

Location: Coimbatore

YOE: 5 - 7 years

Skills: Deep expertise in Infrastructure as Code (IaC), CI/CD pipeline architecture, configuration management, and strong hands-on expertise in AWS (Azure/GCP familiarity is a plus). 

Benefits: Learn more about our perks below

Compensation: Competitive compensation as per industry standards

Who we are

We are Foxsense Innovations - a bunch of passionate developers that love solving complex business problems through products and tools we build from scratch. Weʼve been at it for over 7 years now, and weʼve serviced over 50 happy customers around the world, while also building several in-house micro-SaaS tools for the market (all of this while being bootstrapped and profitable). Our team is rapidly growing, and weʼre in an exciting phase of our 1-10 journey. This is an opportunity for anyone who wants to experience this journey with us. 

About the role: 

As a Senior DevOps Engineer at Foxsense Innovations, you will drive the design and evolution of our AWS-based infrastructure that supports our software development and deployment processes. You'll partner closely with cross-functional teams and engineering leadership to set technical direction for scalability, security, and reliability - while mentoring engineers and raising the bar for operational excellence across the org. 

Responsibilities: 

Infrastructure as Code (IaC): 

- Architect and own AWS infrastructure using Terraform or CloudFormation, establishing reusable modules and standards adopted across teams. 
 - Drive decisions on scalability, security, and performance across core AWS services (EC2, ECS/Fargate, RDS, S3, VPC, API Gateway, Lambda), anticipating growth and failure modes. Continuous Integration/Continuous Deployment (CI/CD): 

- Design and own CI/CD pipeline architecture end-to-end (e. g. , CodePipeline/CodeBuild, GitHub Actions, or Jenkins deploying to AWS), setting standards for automated software delivery across multiple teams/projects. 
 - Identify and resolve systemic bottlenecks in build and deployment workflows; lead optimization initiatives with development teams. Configuration Management: 

- Own configuration management strategy for application servers, databases, and infrastructure using tools like Ansible or Puppet, in AWS environments. 
 - Define and enforce consistency and reliability standards across environments, including for newly onboarded projects. Monitoring and Logging: 

- Design monitoring and observability strategy using AWS-native tools (CloudWatch, X-Ray) and/or third-party platforms (DataDog, Grafana). 
 - Own logging infrastructure architecture, ensuring efficient troubleshooting, analysis, and alerting at scale. Collaboration & Mentorship: 

- Act as a technical bridge between development and IT operations, influencing architectural decisions early in the SDLC. 
 - Mentor junior and mid-level DevOps engineers; review their IaC/pipeline work and raise technical standards. 
 - Provide senior-level technical support and act as an escalation point for production system issues. Security: 

- Implement AWS security best practices - IAM least-privilege design, Secrets Manager, security groups/NACLs, WAF, and encryption at rest/in transit. 
 - Lead security audits and vulnerability assessments on AWS workloads, and own remediation roadmaps. 

Requirements: 

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field. 
 - 5+ years of proven experience as a DevOps Engineer or similar role, with deep, hands-on production experience specifically in AWS (this is a must-have, not a nice-to-have). 
 - At least 1-2 years in a technical leadership or mentorship capacity. 
 - Strong scripting skills (e. g. , Bash, Python) for automation, with a track record of building internal tooling. 
 - Deep proficiency with containerization technologies like Docker and orchestration tools such as Kubernetes (EKS experience preferred), including production troubleshooting experience. 
 - Strong command of version control systems (e. g. , Git) and collaborative development workflows, including branching strategy design. 
 - Demonstrated experience designing AWS infrastructure or pipeline architecture from scratch, not just maintaining existing systems. 
 - AWS certifications (Solutions Architect, DevOps Engineer Professional) strongly preferred. 

Bonus Skills: 

- Strong technical portfolio with examples of AWS architecture decisions and their tradeoffs. 
 - Advanced AWS security practices - zero-trust design, cross-account access patterns, Secrets Manager/KMS at scale. 
 - Familiarity with Azure or Google Cloud as a secondary platform. 
 - Experience mentoring engineers or leading a small DevOps/platform team. 

Why work with us

When you work with Foxsense Innovations, you donʼt just work a boring job. Our goal is to create a work environment that makes you want to brag about your work to your friends!

Hereʼs why youʼll love working with us: 

- Unlimited sick leave policy, and a generous paid leave plan to ensure you get time off work whenever you need it
 - A competitive and rewarding start-up culture that motivates you from day one, along with regular team-building activities
 - Delicious lunch along with snacks and refreshments at office, so that hunger pangs never affect your A-game
 - We have a yearly annual retreat for the team to unwind and enjoy - we went to Kodaikanal this year, who knows where we will go next year!

If that's not enough, there's always more!

- Need a breather? Game with Foxes at the TT. There's a scoreboard!
 - Our wholesome health care plans care for you - whenever, wherever. 
 - Embrace growth! Learn & grow from peers - You'll find budding freshers, seasoned veterans - you name it. 
 - We take unwinding as seriously as we do hustling - game nights are our way of downtime. 
 - Collaboration is vital for us - your value isn't limited to your responsibilities! Feel free to lurk in other departments and share your thoughts!

Weʼre glad youʼve made it this far! If you're passionate about building scalable and impactful software while growing in a dynamic environment, we'd love to have you on board.

OpenSearch Anchor Expertise | Enterprise Architecture | Distributed Systems | Automation | Strategy

Level

Principal DBRE

Primary Focus

Enterprise technical direction anchored in OpenSearch, distributed-systems reliability, automation platforms, cross-domain architecture, and multi-year strategy

We are seeking a hands-on Principal DBRE to serve as the highest individual-contributor technical authority for enterprise data-platform reliability and architecture. OpenSearch/Elasticsearch is the required anchor expertise. The role also requires strong breadth across distributed and relational data technologies, automation, observability, capacity, resilience, and technology strategy. 

The Principal DBRE defines multi-year direction, resolves consequential cross-domain architecture issues, establishes enterprise engineering principles, and influences senior engineering and executive leadership. The role guides domain specialists without requiring the individual to be the deepest expert in every database engine. 

- Level Scope and Leadership Expectations

Principal DBRE is an executive-adjacent individual-contributor technical leadership role. The Principal establishes enterprise direction across multiple platform domains, resolves the most consequential architecture and reliability problems, and creates standards and investment priorities that scale across the organization. 

Dimension

 - Lead workload-relevant evaluation of emerging technologies, including operability, failure behavior, migration risk, performance, and total cost.

data.description:
Principal Engineer - ELV & IBMS (Data Centres)

Location: Noida, India

Build the intelligent infrastructure behind tomorrow's data centres. 

As data centres continue to scale in capacity, complexity and criticality, the need for intelligent, resilient and seamlessly integrated building management systems has never been greater. 

We are looking for a Principal Engineer - ELV & IBMS to play a pivotal role in shaping the design and integration of mission-critical infrastructure for hyperscale and colocation data centre projects. 

This is an opportunity to take technical ownership of complex ELV and Integrated Building Management Systems (IBMS) solutions, influence engineering standards, work closely with multidisciplinary teams and contribute to the development of next-generation data centre infrastructure. 

If you enjoy working at the intersection of engineering, technology, systems integration and technical leadership, this role offers an opportunity to make a significant impact. 

What you'll be doing

As the Principal Engineer, you will act as the technical authority and systems architect for ELV and IBMS design, taking ownership from concept development and system architecture through detailed design, integration and commissioning support. 

1. Lead system architecture and integration

- Develop end-to-end ELV and IBMS architectures for hyperscale and colocation data centres across various IT load capacities. 
 - Define integration strategies covering BMS, EPMS, DCIM, CCTV/VMS, access control, perimeter security, Fire Alarm Systems (FAS), VESDA and PA/VA systems. 
 - Establish system redundancy, resilience and network architecture aligned with mission-critical uptime requirements and Tier III/IV principles. 
 - Develop integrated HVAC monitoring and control strategies, electrical power monitoring interfaces and operational workflows. 

2. Drive engineering excellence and technical design

- Lead the development of Design Basis Reports (DBRs), system architecture narratives, sequence of operations, I/O schedules and cause-and-effect matrices. 
 - Define PLC architecture, server redundancy, control philosophy and integration protocols, including BACnet, Modbus, IEC 61850 and OPC UA. 
 - Coordinate BMS interfaces with electrical, mechanical, fire safety, security and IT infrastructure disciplines. 
 - Develop control strategies covering HVAC systems, chillers, CDUs, thermal management, emergency shutdowns and load shedding. 
 - Review and approve ELV/IBMS schematics, network topology drawings, equipment schedules and BIM/Revit models up to LOD 350. 

3. Own technical coordination and client engagement

- Lead technical discussions with clients, consultants, contractors and system integrators. 
 - Drive design reviews, technical evaluations, vendor selection and engineering submittal approvals. 
 - Define integration testing strategies, review commissioning procedures and validate system interoperability and redundancy. 
 - Ensure designs align with relevant industry standards, including TIA-942, ISO 27001 requirements for physical security and applicable local fire safety standards. 

4. Shape and develop the engineering team

- Provide technical leadership and mentorship to ELV engineers, system integrators and network specialists.

data.description:
About Smart Working

At Smart Working, we believe your job should not only look right on paper but also feel right every day. This isn't just another remote opportunity - it's about finding where you truly belong, no matter where you are. From day one, you're welcomed into a genuine community that values your growth and well-being.   Our mission is simple: to break down geographic barriers and connect skilled professionals with outstanding global teams and products for full-time, long-term roles. As a DevOps / Platform Engineer, you will play a key role in supporting and scaling the cloud infrastructure behind an AI-native cybersecurity platform that processes terabytes of data daily. You will take end-to-end ownership of critical infrastructure and contribute to the reliability, scalability and operational efficiency of the platform. 

You will join an engineering team of 14+ professionals across Backend, DevOps, Endpoint, Frontend and Design, reporting to the VP of Engineering and AI. The team operates with a flat structure and a single-owner model, where engineers independently own their discipline within each project while collaborating closely with others. 

This role suits a mid-to-senior engineer who thrives on autonomy, embraces AI-assisted engineering and wants to deliver high-impact solutions. 

Responsibilities

- Run, maintain and scale production cloud infrastructure supporting a platform that processes terabytes of data daily

- Own build, deployment and release pipelines for Python, C++ and TypeScript applications

- Deep, hands-on experience managing production cloud infrastructure, with expertise in AWS, Microsoft Azure or Google Cloud Platform (GCP)

- Proven ownership of CI/CD pipelines, including build, deployment and release processes

- Experience implementing and managing observability, incident response and rigorous security practices

- Daily, hands-on use of AI agents and frontier AI models as part of engineering workflows

data.title: Senior Software Engineer C++ | Low Latency Trading Systems
data.description:
About BestEx Research

BestEx Research is a financial technology and research firm specializing in building sophisticated execution algorithms and transaction cost modeling tools servicing multiple asset classes. The firm provides high-performance algorithmic execution services to hedge funds, CTAs, asset managers, and banks through a traditional electronic broker and in a broker-neutral Software as a Service (SaaS) model. 

Its cloud-based platform, Algo Management System (AMS), is the first end-to-end algorithmic trading solution for equities and futures that delivers an entire ecosystem around execution algorithms, including transaction cost analysis (TCA), an algorithm customization tool called Strategy Studio, a trading dashboard, and pre-trade analytics in a single platform. The platform is currently live for U. S. , Europe, and Canadian equities and global futures trading. 

BestEx Research is disrupting a $100 billion industry by challenging the status quo of stale, black-box solutions from banks and offering next-generation execution algorithms that combine performance improvement with transparency and customization. BestEx Research uses leading-edge technology to support its low-latency, highly scalable research and trading systems, with its backend in C++, research libraries in C++/Python and R, and web-based technologies for delivering its front-end platforms. 

BestEx Research's mission is to become the leader in automation and measurement of execution across asset classes globally and significantly reduce transaction costs for our clients. 

Visit for more information about our mission, products, research, and services. 

Why Join Us?

BestEx Research's Bangalore office is not an "offshore center. " It's a core engineering and research hub, working on the exact same problems and projects as our U. S. team. You will be part of the global brain trust, solving some of the hardest problems in trading, systems, and data science. 

What You'll Love: 

- Zero bureaucracy, zero silos-engineers directly collaborate with traders, researchers, and the management team
 - Direct ownership of subsystems
 - Daily opportunity to learn from pioneers in HFT, low-latency systems, and algo trading
 - A high-trust environment, where performance speaks louder than hierarchy. 
 - Competitive compensation in India, including equity and cash bonuses
 - Ability to transition between various teams and projects, whether related to trading systems, algorithmic trading or system tooling
 - 5-week structured training program: 
 - Market microstructure and trading mechanics
 - Algorithmic execution and strategy design
 - Exchange simulators and performance testing
 - Market data systems and real-time analytics
 - Hands-on exercises using production research data
 - Continuous professional development, with refresher courses, advanced sessions, and on-demand training tailored to your growth
 - Global exposure: Opportunities to collaborate with, visit, or relocate to our U. S. , Singapore, or London offices, based on performance and business needs

Your Role: Build What Most Engineers Never Get to Touch

You'll be part of a lean, focused team building ultra-low-latency trading systems, real-time exchange simulators, execution algorithms, and alpha forecasting models. Our engineers own the stack-from C++ nanosecond-sensitive infrastructure to Python-based research platforms. 

This role is ideal for someone who thrives at the intersection of research and engineering-comfortable building systems, testing hypotheses, and working directly with data that moves markets. 

What You'll Work On

Designing and developing system architecture: 

- Core trading systems and algorithmic trading frameworks
 - High-performance execution algorithms for global markets
 - Exchange simulators and tick-level backtesting frameworks
 - Market data adaptors and exchange connectivity adaptors

Building from scratch: 

- Trading systems for new asset classes and execution algorithms
 - Performance optimizations for low-latency, high-throughput systems

Enhancing existing systems: 

- Add support for new features and improve scalability and reliability

Collaborating closely with: 

- A global team of quants, traders, and senior engineers to design cutting-edge solutions

Analyzing and optimizing system performance: 

- Across application, OS, and hardware layers to achieve industry-leading performance
 - Work primarily with C++17 in a high-impact, low-bureaucracy environment

Requirements

You Should Have: 

- Bachelor's or Master's from a top-tier CS or Engineering program (IIT/NIT/BITS preferred but not required)
 - At least 5+ years software development experience with C++
 - Expert-level knowledge of C++ and excellent software design skills
 - Expert-level knowledge of TCP/IP and multithreading
 - Excellent problem solving and analytical skills
 - Excellent communication skills and ability to articulate ideas
 - An attitude of constant curiosity and growth, as well as the ability and desire to mentor others
 - While domain experience is a plus, we welcome strong engineers from other industries

Bonus Points For

- Database optimization and experience with research or market data pipelines
 - Prior work on trading platforms, FIX engines, or exchange protocols
 - Contributions to open-source C++/Python performance tools, ability to work with large datasets
 - Prior experience developing trading systems or execution algorithms
 - Knowledge of relational databases, database optimizations, and SQL
 - Experience with Python/R

data.title: Global Quality Front-End Central Quality Assurance Engineer/Sr Engineer – (GQ FECTQA MOI)
data.description:
Our vision is to transform how the world uses information to enrich life for all. 

Micron Technology is a world leader in innovating memory and storage solutions that accelerate the transformation of information into intelligence, inspiring the world to learn, communicate and advance faster than ever. 

Global Quality Front-End Central Quality Assurance Engineer/Sr Engineer - (GQ FECTQA MOI)

Our vision is to transform how the world uses information to enrich life for all. 

Join an inclusive team passionate about one thing: using their expertise in the relentless pursuit of innovation for customers and partners. The solutions we build help make everything from artificial intelligence to advanced memory technologies possible. We do it all while committing to integrity, innovation, collaboration, and operational excellence. Because doing so fuels the next generation of semiconductor technology. 

Job Description

As a Global Quality Front-End Central Quality Assurance Remote Operation Control (GQ FECTQA ROC) Engineer at Micron Technology, Inc. , you will be part of a global organization responsible for centralized quality operations supporting Micron wafer fabrication sites across Asia and the United States. You will play a critical role in safeguarding product quality through automated quality screening, lot disposition, statistical risk assessment, and operational excellence initiatives. 

In this role, you will leverage advanced statistical analysis, semiconductor process knowledge, automation, and data-driven decision-making to identify quality and reliability risks, recommend appropriate product dispositions, and drive network-wide quality improvements. You will collaborate closely with Site QA, Product Engineering, Reliability, Manufacturing, and Global Quality teams to ensure consistent execution of quality control strategies and defect containment actions across the Micron network. 

You Will

Design and Develop Quality Screening and Disposition Systems

- Develop quality screening strategies, business rules, and disposition plans for deployment in Micron's centralized quality systems. 
 - Configure and maintain automated lot hold, disposition, and containment workflows. 
 - Collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders to establish risk-based quality control methodologies. 
 - Support implementation and validation of quality system enhancements and screening improvements. 
 - Ensure robust controls and interlocks are implemented to minimize quality escapes and operational risks. 

Execute Wafer Lot Disposition and Quality Risk Assessment

- Evaluate wafer lots impacted by planned or unplanned manufacturing deviations. 
 - Assess quality and reliability risks using electrical test data, physical characterization results, process history, and statistical analysis. 
 - Interpret outlier signals, defect signatures, and excursion indicators to determine appropriate disposition actions. 
 - Support disposition activities related to Fab Conversions, Quality Deviations, Special Work Requests, and Manufacturing Excursions. 
 - Document disposition decisions and provide technical justification to stakeholders. 

Perform Advanced Data Analytics and Statistical Monitoring

- Analyze large manufacturing datasets to identify abnormal signatures, trends, and potential quality risks. 
 - Develop statistical models and methodologies for outlier detection, screening optimization, and excursion monitoring. 
 - Perform distribution analysis, SPC review, baseline trending, and risk assessment activities. 
 - Create dashboards, metrics, and reporting solutions to improve operational visibility and decision-making. 
 - Drive data-based continuous improvement opportunities across Micron's manufacturing network. 

Drive Automation and Digital Transformation Initiatives

- Support AI, machine learning, and advanced analytics initiatives for quality monitoring and disposition automation. 
 - Reduce manual intervention by implementing fail-safe controls, automated workflows, and decision-support systems. 
 - Partner with software development teams to define requirements and deploy scalable automation solutions. 
 - Continuously identify opportunities to enhance system capability and throughput. 

Collaborate Across Global Quality Organizations

- Partner with Site QA teams to ensure consistent quality execution across all manufacturing locations. 
 - Participate in global alignment teams focused on quality standards, operational excellence, and best practice sharing. 
 - Support root cause investigations and corrective/preventive action (CAPA) development. 
 - Communicate technical findings, recommendations, and business impacts to diverse stakeholders. 
 - Contribute to the development and publication of global quality metrics and performance indicators. 

Support Operational Excellence and Continuous Improvement

- Identify process gaps and propose innovative solutions to improve quality operations. 
 - Lead or participate in cross-functional projects focused on productivity, quality, and automation. 
 - Develop and maintain operational procedures, business process documentation, and training materials. 
 - Support audits, compliance reviews, and quality system assessments. 
 - Drive standardization and scalability of centralized quality operations. 

Education

- Required: Bachelor's Degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Material Science, Statistics or related technical discipline. 
 - Preferred: Master's Degree in Electrical or Electronics Engineering, Statistics, Data Analytics, or related field. 

Required Qualifications

- 3-5 years of experience in Semiconductor manufacturing, product engineering, quality, reliability, test engineering, or related industry experience. 
 - Strong understanding of statistical methodologies, including: 
 - Statistical Process Control (SPC)
 - Outlier Detection
 - Distribution Analysis
 - Trend Analysis
 - Data Visualization
 - Risk Assessment Methodologies
 - Knowledge of semiconductor manufacturing processes, wafer fabrication, probe testing, and parametric testing methodologies. 
 - Understanding of quality systems, risk management, and defect containment processes. 
 - Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to interpret complex manufacturing datasets. 
 - Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English. 
 - Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively across global and cross-functional teams. 
 - Ability to manage multiple priorities while maintaining a high level of quality and attention to detail. 
 - Self-motivated with strong ownership, accountability, and continuous improvement mindset. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience in quality engineering, reliability engineering, or semiconductor product disposition. 
 - Knowledge of memory products, including DRAM, NAND, HBM, or emerging memory technologies. 
 - Familiarity with machine learning, predictive analytics, or AI-based manufacturing applications. 
 - Experience developing dashboards using Tableau, Power BI, Spotfire, or similar platforms. 
 - Exposure to enterprise automation, workflow systems, and digital transformation projects. 
 - Knowledge of quality methodologies such as FMEA, CAPA, 8D, Six Sigma, or Lean Manufacturing. 
 - Experience supporting global operational teams across multiple manufacturing sites. 

About Micron Technology, Inc. 

We are an industry leader in innovative memory and storage solutions transforming how the world uses information to enrich life for all. With a relentless focus on our customers, technology leadership, and manufacturing and operational excellence, Micron delivers a rich portfolio of high-performance DRAM, NAND, and NOR memory and storage products through our Micron® and Crucial® brands. Every day, the innovations that our people create fuel the data economy, enabling advances in artificial intelligence and 5G applications that unleash opportunities - from the data center to the intelligent edge and across the client and mobile user experience.

data.title: Senior Quality Assurance Automation Engineer
data.description:
About us

Camascope is a fast-growing technology company, now part of PCS, focused on empowering the care and medication sector with technology. Our ecosystem connects pharmacies, care homes and doctors to improve the lives of many. 

PCS Care is used by care professionals every day, so reliability matters. We are a team of talented, caring and ambitious people who love solving real problems and are committed to building the highest-quality solutions. 

What you will work on

As a Senior QA Automation Engineer on PCS Care, you will be an integral part of the Bengaluru team that develops, enhances and expands QA test coverage at scale for our care and medication product. As a core contributor you will work with cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality QA automation approaches and tooling as we add features to PCS Care, and you will help mentor and guide the engineers who join the team. We want an experienced, adaptable engineer who can start lean, iterate towards well-architected solutions, help raise the standard for how we test, and use AI-assisted tooling, including AI-assisted test case generation, to raise coverage and speed up delivery. You will work in TypeScript, Playwright and Appium, which our existing web and mobile app automation already uses. 

Reporting and team structure. 

You will report to the Engineering Manager for the Bengaluru PCS Care team, with a dotted-line relationship to the QA Manager in the UK. The Bengaluru manager sets your priorities, supports your growth and handles day-to-day management. The UK QA Manager sets testing standards and approach, and helps you stay aligned with the wider PCS QA practice. 

You will work daily with the Bengaluru developers, the TPM and product counterparts, and regularly with the UK engineering and QA teams, so you should be comfortable working across time zones. 

Responsibilities

- Design, develop and maintain test cases for both manual and automated testing
 - Perform functional, regression, integration, UI and exploratory testing across mobile, web and APIs to identify defects and ensure high-quality software delivery
 - Create and maintain automated test scripts and frameworks, and run them as part of the CI/CD pipeline
 - Participate in the evolution of the test automation framework and approach for PCS Care
 - Identify, document and track defects using JIRA, collaborating closely with developers to resolve issues
 - Troubleshoot and debug test automation issues, working with the team to identify root causes
 - Collaborate with developers on complex issue investigation
 - Work in an agile team-oriented environment, collaborating with other Engineers, Designers and Product Managers to achieve product outcomes. 
 - Mentor and provide guidelines to engineers joining the team, and stay aligned with the UK QA Manager on testing standards
 - Report clearly on test results, coverage and open defects
 - Keep our customers and care home patients at the heart of everything we build. 

Requirements

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering or similar
 - 6 to 10 years of industry experience in software testing, with strong hands-on experience in test automation
 - Solid experience in manual testing and validation
 - Experience with a modern language for test automation, such as C#, JavaScript or TypeScript (TypeScript preferred, as used in our existing automation)
 - Experience designing and building test automation frameworks for mobile and web applications, ideally with Playwright and Appium, which our existing automation uses (transferable experience with similar tools is welcome)
 - Experience testing REST APIs with tools such as Postman, and familiarity with SQL and NoSQL database testing
 - Experience with a cloud device platform such as BrowserStack for running mobile and cross-browser tests
 - Experience with BDD practices and tooling such as Cucumber
 - Experience using AI tools such as GitHub Copilot to generate test cases and automation code, with the judgement to review and validate what they produce
 - Strong troubleshooting and debugging skills with a fix-forward and learn mindset
 - Capable and comfortable working with Agile/Scrum methodologies
 - Experience mentoring other engineers, and excellent communication with colleagues in Bengaluru and the UK. 

Bonus points

- Having worked in healthcare or pharmacy tech previously
 - Experience running test automation in CI/CD pipelines, and with Azure or AWS environments
 - Unit testing and test-driven development experience
 - Experience with test management tools such as Testmo
 - Exposure to or use of feature flags, ideally Harness FME
 - Experience working on large-scale multi-tenant SaaS systems. 

What we offer

- Competitive salary based on experience
 - The chance to shape QA practice in a new, growing Bengaluru team, working closely with colleagues in the UK
 - Meaningful work: your testing directly supports care professionals and the people they look after.

data.description:
Job Overview: 

We are seeking a skilled and detail-oriented Salesforce Test Automation Engineer to join our dynamic team. The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience in testing Salesforce Sales and Service Clouds, along with strong automation and API testing skills using industry-standard tools. You will play a critical role in ensuring the quality and reliability of our Salesforce applications through manual and automated testing, API validation, CI/CD pipelines, and collaboration with cross-functional teams. 

Key Responsibilities: 

- Design, develop, and execute manual and automated test cases for Salesforce Sales Cloud and Service Cloud functionalities. 
 - Develop and maintain automation suites using Copado Robotic Testing (CRT), ensuring robust and reusable test scripts. 
 - Build automation frameworks and scripts using tools such as Selenium, Provar, Playwright, CRT, and TestNG, following Page Object Model (POM) and best practices. 
 - Perform comprehensive testing including functional, regression, integration, and API testing across Salesforce modules. 
 - Validate Salesforce configurations, workflows, triggers, custom objects, Lightning components, and integrations with external systems via APIs (SOAP, REST). 
 - Conduct API testing to validate external and internal API integrations, including API response validation, data correctness, and security checks. 
 - Collaborate with Salesforce admins, developers, and business stakeholders to understand requirements and translate them into test strategies. 
 - Manage and execute testing within CI/CD pipelines using tools such as Copado, Azure DevOps, and Jenkins. 
 - Track, report, and verify defects using Jira, ADO, or other test management tools, ensuring timely resolution. 
 - Participate in Agile ceremonies, review test cases, and provide QA insights during sprint cycles. 
 - Maintain comprehensive documentation of test plans, cases, scripts, and results. 
 - Ensure adherence to best practices in test automation, quality standards, and release processes. 
 - Support release readiness activities, including post-deployment validation. 

Qualifications & Skills: 

- Experience: 3-8 years of QA/testing experience with a focus on Salesforce platforms. 
 - Salesforce Expertise: Proven experience testing Salesforce Sales Cloud and Service Cloud; knowledge of Lightning Experience, Lightning Web Components (LWC), workflows, validation rules, triggers, and APIs. Automation Skills: 
 - Hands-on experience with Selenium, Provar, Playwright, CRT, TestNG, and frameworks following POM best practices. 
 - Automation Suite Development: Experience developing and maintaining automation test suites using Copado Robotic Testing. 
 - Manual Testing: Strong manual testing skills with an in-depth understanding of Salesforce configurations and data validation. 
 - API Testing: Proficiency in API testing - including validating SOAP and REST APIs, checking response data, response times, error handling, and security aspects. CI/CD & DevOps: Experience integrating testing workflows with Copado, Azure DevOps, Jenkins, or similar tools. 
 - Programming & Scripting: Strong hands-on experience in coding and scripting with at least one programming language such as Java, JavaScript or Python. 
 - Candidates must be comfortable developing automation scripts and have demonstrated coding proficiency. 
 - Salesforce Certification: Salesforce Administrator certification required; additional badges and certifications (Platform Developer I, Experience Cloud, etc. ) are a plus. 
 - Test Management Tools: Experience with Jira, Azure DevOps, TestRail, or equivalent. Other Skills: Strong analytical, debugging, and problem-solving skills; excellent communication and collaboration abilities. 

Mandatory Skills: 

- Experience in Salesforce Automation Testing (Selenium/Playwright)
 - Strong experience on SOQL queries. 
 - Hands on with Sales Cloud & Service Cloud. 
 - Good communication. 

Preferred: 

- Knowledge of other Salesforce clouds is optional but beneficial. 
 - Salesforce certifications (Administrator, Developer, Consultant badges).

data.title: App Experience Analyst
data.description:
Life Pharmacy is the UAE's largest retail pharmacy chain, with 600+ stores. It runs the region's No. 1 pharmacy app, which serves thousands of customers every day with medicines, wellness, beauty and fast home delivery. Life Pharmacy is part of Life Group, which also includes Life Medical Centre and Life GP Clinics. 

The role

We're looking for someone whose full-time job is to use the Life Pharmacy app as our most demanding customer would. You'll find what's broken, confusing or costing us sales, and turn it into clear recommendations that our product and tech teams act on. You'll report directly to the Head of eCommerce in Dubai. 

What you'll do

- Test the core app journeys daily on iOS, Android and web: search, product pages, cart, checkout, prescription upload, Click & Collect and order tracking
 - Check our top-searched products every day for correct results, pricing, offers and stock
 - Benchmark Life Pharmacy against leading UAE apps such as Noon, Amazon, Talabat and InstaShop
 - Track app store reviews and spot recurring customer pain points
 - Test every new app release and campaign before and after launch
 - Send a weekly report of the top 10 issues and ideas, ranked by customer and sales impactWhat we're looking for

- 2-4 years in e-commerce app QA, UX research, product operations or catalog quality
 - A sharp eye for detail: you notice a wrong price or a broken filter before anyone else
 - Clear, structured written English, with screenshots, impact and a suggested fix for every finding
 - A heavy user of shopping and delivery apps who naturally compares experiences
 - Comfortable with Excel or Google Sheets, Jira or similar trackers, and screen recording toolsNice to have

- B. Pharm or a pharmacy background
 - Experience with UAE or GCC shopping apps
 - A basic understanding of app analytics: funnels, conversion and search data

data.title: Senior Test Automation Engineer
data.description:
Job Title: Senior Associate- Test Automation

Notice Period: Immediate to 30 days

Experience Required: 5+ Years

Job Location: Pune/Hybrid

About Accelirate

Accelirate is a leading agentic AI and automation firm, building intelligent agents that transform enterprise operations. We're a certified partner of UiPath, Microsoft, and Salesforce, with 1500+ processes automated annually across industries. Honored as a Top Workplaces USA winner five years in a row, we're known for delivering scalable, agent-driven solutions that empower humans, agents, and robots to work smarter together. 

About the role

We are looking for a hands-on Senior Test Automation Engineer to own Playwright + Python UI automation for our web applications. You will build maintainable pytest-based frameworks, run them in CI on Azure Pipelines, keep the suite fast and reliable, and mentor junior engineers. 

What you will do

- Design and extend a Playwright + Python framework on pytest, using Page Object Model, fixtures and reusable utilities. 
 - Automate end-to-end UI tests from user stories and acceptance criteria, across Chromium, Firefox and WebKit. 
 - Build stable locator strategies and keep the flaky-test rate under 2%. 
 - Integrate suites into Azure Pipelines with parallel runs (pytest-xdist) and useful failure artifacts (traces, screenshots, videos). 
 - Track tests and defects in Azure Boards and Test Plans, linked to user stories for traceability. 
 - Triage failures daily and report coverage, pass rate, execution time and flakiness each sprint. 
 - Review peers' automation code and mentor 1-3 junior engineers. What you bring

- Playwright (Python): built or substantially extended a framework; strong with the sync/async APIs, auto-waiting, locators, browser contexts, network interception/mocking, auth via storage state, and Trace Viewer. 
 - Python: OOP, type hints, decorators, context managers, exception handling, virtual environments; clean, modular code checked with Ruff or Flake8 and Black. 
 - pytest: fixtures and scopes, conftest. py, markers, parametrization, pytest-playwright plugin, pytest-xdist, HTML/JUnit reporting. 
 - Azure DevOps and Git: Git in Azure Repos (branching, pull requests, code reviews, conflict resolution); YAML Pipelines, Boards and Test Plans; publishes test results to pipelines. 
 - Testing fundamentals: test pyramid, test design techniques, risk-based prioritisation, basic SQL, Agile/Scrum. 
 - Clear communication and ownership; can explain a failure to a developer and a risk to a product owner. Good to have

- API testing with Python (requests, httpx or Playwright's APIRequestContext). 
 - GitHub and GitHub Actions workflows. 
 - Migration from Selenium to Playwright. 
 - BDD with pytest-bdd or Behave. 
 - Docker, Azure cloud basics, Allure reporting. 
 - Visual regression and accessibility testing (axe-core). 
 - AI-assisted testing: GitHub Copilot, Playwright MCP. 
 - ISTQB certification. Education

B. E. /B. Tech/MCA in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent experience.

data.title: Senior Engineering Manager
data.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Engineering Manager based in India. 

This is an opportunity to lead two critical engineering teams responsible for building and maintaining the technology foundations that power a growing software platform. As Senior Engineering Manager, you will oversee Platform and Integrations, shaping their technical direction, product roadmaps, and delivery strategies. You will ensure engineering infrastructure, developer tooling, CI/CD, observability, identity systems, and third-party integrations remain reliable, scalable, and efficient. Reporting directly to the CTO, you will combine strategic leadership with hands-on technical involvement, contributing to architecture decisions and code when needed. You will also develop engineering talent, strengthen team performance, and foster a culture of ownership and continuous improvement. The role is suited to an experienced engineering leader who thrives in a distributed, fast-moving environment and enjoys balancing technical excellence with business priorities. 

Accountabilities

You will lead the Platform and Integrations engineering teams, ensuring their technical roadmaps align with organizational priorities while maintaining high standards of software quality, delivery, and team development. 

Execution & Delivery

- Act as product owner for Platform and Integrations initiatives, gathering requirements from product teams and external partners. 
 - Prioritize requests, define objectives, and translate business and technical needs into clear roadmaps. 
 - Break down requirements into well-scoped, sequenced tasks and establish delivery milestones for both teams. 
 - Monitor progress and team health throughout the software development lifecycle, identifying bottlenecks and improving delivery processes. 
 - Coordinate with other engineering squads to ensure alignment and effective collaboration. 
 - Communicate roadmaps, priorities, trade-offs, dependencies, and risks clearly to Product, Engineering, and other stakeholders. 

Technical Leadership

- Define and drive the technical vision for both teams in alignment with broader business objectives and long-term scalability needs. 
 - Own technical roadmaps, including strategic technical debt, evaluating its impact, cost, and benefits to guide prioritization. 
 - Remain hands-on by writing and reviewing code in Java, Python, or Go when required. 
 - Contribute to system design, API contracts, architectural decisions, and scalability trade-offs. 
 - Collaborate closely with Infrastructure and DevOps teams on cloud environments, Kubernetes, CI/CD pipelines, monitoring, and reliability. 
 - Participate in production incident reviews and root cause analyses, helping prevent recurring issues. 
 - Establish and maintain engineering quality standards, including pull request reviews, test coverage, deployment rollback plans, monitoring, and alerting. 
 - Balance development speed with long-term maintainability, reliability, and code quality. 

People Management & Team Development

- Lead and develop two engineering teams, providing regular one-on-one meetings, coaching, feedback, and performance reviews. 
 - Support career progression through clear expectations, development plans, and appropriate delegation of ownership. 
 - Manage headcount planning, recruitment, interviewing, and onboarding. 
 - Monitor and improve engineering productivity, delivery velocity, and software quality. 
 - Build a collaborative environment that encourages accountability, continuous learning, and constructive feedback. 
 - Introduce and improve management and engineering practices to support team growth and effective execution. 

Requirements

The ideal candidate combines substantial software engineering experience with proven people management, product ownership, and infrastructure expertise. You should be comfortable making decisions in ambiguous environments, managing multiple teams, and remaining technically engaged while supporting engineers' professional growth. 

Technical & Professional Experience

- At least 5 years of experience developing software as an individual contributor. 
 - Strong hands-on programming experience in Java, Python, or Go, with a continued interest in coding. 
 - At least 3 years of experience managing engineering teams of approximately 10-15 people. 
 - Experience managing two teams simultaneously is a strong advantage. 
 - Demonstrated product management experience, including roadmap ownership, stakeholder prioritization, and scope trade-offs. 
 - Practical experience with DevOps and infrastructure technologies, including cloud platforms, Kubernetes, CI/CD, and monitoring. Experience collaborating closely with DevOps engineers is also relevant. 
 - Proven experience applying Lean and Agile management practices. 
 - Track record of successfully delivering several large-scale projects within the past three years. 
 - Advanced English proficiency, particularly in written and spoken communication. 

Leadership & Management Skills

- Ability to manage engineers with different technical specializations and levels of experience. 
 - Strong communication skills, including setting clear expectations and providing regular, constructive feedback. 
 - Experience facilitating effective one-on-ones, team discussions, planning sessions, and retrospectives. 
 - Ability to identify high-value initiatives, prioritize effectively, and keep teams focused on meaningful outcomes. 
 - Strong ownership and decision-making skills, including the ability to create clarity and alignment in ambiguous situations. 
 - Ability to develop processes, remove obstacles, and improve team execution. 
 - Comfortable adapting to changing priorities, organizational structures, and evolving responsibilities. 
 - Empathetic, direct, and thoughtful approach to communication and feedback. 
 - Experience recruiting, interviewing, and onboarding engineers at different seniority levels. 
 - Data-driven prioritization skills and confidence challenging decisions when necessary. 
 - Sound judgment when balancing code quality, technical debt, and development speed. 

Additional Experience That Would Be An Advantage

- Previous experience working in Platform Engineering, Infrastructure, or Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) teams. 
 - Experience building or managing integrations, including public APIs, partner integrations, webhooks, and event-driven systems. 
 - Familiarity with messaging technologies such as RabbitMQ and Kafka. 
 - Experience leading engineering teams in startups or high-growth environments. 
 - Experience introducing engineering and people-management practices, such as code reviews, performance evaluations, career levels, and development frameworks.

data.title: Lead - Battery Systems Engineer
data.description:
Company Description

Hastin Energy is a battery design, development, and manufacturing company specializing in advanced battery solutions for high-performance applications. The organization serves UAV/AGV, automotive, and energy storage sectors, integrating hardware and software for reliable energy systems. Its in-house Battery Management System (BMS), enables intelligent monitoring, control, and optimization of battery performance. Team members collaborate across disciplines to deliver safe, efficient, and scalable battery technologies. The company offers opportunities to work at the intersection of electrochemistry, electronics, software, and data analytics. 

Role Description

The Lead - Battery Systems Engineering will be responsible for the electrical system architecture, design, development, and integration of advanced lithium-ion battery systems and associated power distribution systems. 

The role involves designing Power Distribution Units (PDUs), integrating Battery Management Systems (BMS), selecting and qualifying critical electrical components, and ensuring seamless integration of battery systems with end applications such as UAVs, eVTOLs, electric vehicles, robotics, and energy storage systems. 

The individual will take ownership of system-level electrical engineering, from component selection and circuit design to prototype development, testing, validation, and final product integration. Additional responsibilities include documenting system designs, maintaining configuration baselines, improving processes and standards, and mentoring junior engineers in best practices for battery systems engineering. 

Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree (B. E. /B. Tech) in Electrical Engineering, Electrical and Electronics Engineering, Electronics and Communication Engineering, or a related discipline. 
 - Master's degree (M. E. /M. Tech) in Power Electronics, Electrical Engineering, Embedded Systems, or a related field is preferred but not mandatory. 
 - Relevant industry experience in battery systems, electric vehicles, power electronics, automotive electrical systems, or aerospace electrical systems will be an advantage. 
 - 2-3 years of relevant experience in electrical systems design, battery systems engineering, EV systems, or power distribution engineering. 
 - Demonstrated experience in designing and developing electrical power distribution systems, including HV and LV PDUs. 
 - Hands-on experience with battery pack electrical architecture, BMS integration, and battery-to-application integration. 
 - Experience in selecting, sizing, and integrating electrical protection components such as contactors, relays, fuses, pre-charge circuits, current sensors, and connectors. 
 - Experience in electrical schematic development, wiring design, component qualification, and prototype development. 
 - Experience in system-level electrical testing, troubleshooting, and validation. 

Responsibilities

- PDU Design & Development: Design and develop HV/LV Power Distribution Units (PDUs), including electrical architecture, schematics, protection circuits and power distribution systems. 
 - Component Selection: Identify, evaluate and shortlist critical electrical components, including contactors, relays, fuses, pre-charge circuits, current sensors, connectors and protection devices. 
 - BMS Integration: Lead BMS integration with battery packs, including sensing, protection, contactor control, fault management and communication interfaces. 
 - Electrical System Architecture: Develop battery electrical architectures, wiring diagrams, interconnection designs and interface specifications for different battery applications. 
 - End-Application Integration: Integrate battery systems with UAVs, eVTOLs, EVs, robotics and other applications, ensuring compatibility with controllers, power electronics and auxiliary systems. 
 - Testing & Validation: Plan and execute electrical testing, functional validation and troubleshooting of battery systems, PDUs, BMS and associated components. 
 - Technical Documentation: Prepare electrical schematics, BOMs, component specifications, design reports, test procedures and engineering documentation. 
 - Technical Leadership: Lead electrical engineering activities, coordinate with mechanical, firmware and testing teams, review designs and drive engineering deliverables through development and validation.

We thrive in challenges. We challenge assumptions. We execute with speed and ownership. If you view obstacles as signals to step forward - not backwards - you'll feel right at home here. 

Our Moonshot is bold: Unlock $100B in customer value by 2035, and redefine how global industry works. Join us in this venture where AI and data meet ingenuity, and together, we will forge the path to a smarter, more connected industrial future. 

About The Role

We're seeking a Senior Software Engineer who excels at building high-performance distributed systems and thrives in a fast-paced startup environment. - Platform Ownership: Design, build, and operate the core serverless execution engine and Workflows orchestration layer that serve as foundational primitives for CDF's AI and automation capabilities.

 - Cost Efficiency (Bonus): Model compute and storage costs for functions execution; identify and implement optimizations that reduce cloud spend without sacrificing reliability. 

The Impact you bring to Cognite

- 6-8 Years of Engineering: Proven track record building and operating production backend services at scale.
