As part of Client Technology, you'll work with technologists and business experts, blending EY's deep industry knowledge and innovative ideas with our platforms, capabilities, and technical expertise. As a catalyst for change and growth, you'll be at the forefront of integrating emerging technologies from AI to Data Analytics into every corner of what we do at EY. That means more growth for you, exciting learning opportunities, career choices, and the chance to make a real impact. 

EY Technology: 

Technology has always been at the heart of what we do and deliver at EY. We need technology to keep an organization the size of ours working efficiently. We have 250, 000 people in more than 140 countries, all of whom rely on secure technology to be able to do their job every single day. Everything from the laptops we use, to the ability to work remotely on our mobile devices and connecting our people and our clients, to enabling hundreds of internal tools and external solutions delivered to our clients. Technology solutions are integrated into the client services we deliver and is key to us being more innovative as an organization. 

EY Technology supports our technological needs through three business units: 

Client Technology (CT) focuses on developing new technology services for our clients. It enables EY to identify new technology-based opportunities faster and pursue those opportunities more rapidly. 

Enterprise Workplace Technology (EWT) - EWT supports our Core Business Services functions and will deliver fit-for-purpose technology infrastructure at the cheapest possible cost for quality services. EWT will also support our internal technological needs by focusing on better user experience. 

Information Security (Info Sec) - Info Sec prevents, detects, responds and mitigates cyber-risk, protects EY and client data, and our information management systems. 

The opportunity

We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Cloud Engineer with a minimum of 5 years of experience in cloud engineering, infrastructure management, and cloud operations. In this role, you will be responsible for designing, developing, and optimizing cloud-based platforms, applications, and infrastructure solutions leveraging AWS services, EKS (Kubernetes), AWS Lambda, cloud databases, and modern CI/CD practices. The role requires strong troubleshooting capabilities across cloud infrastructure, Kubernetes environments, networking, security best practices, and performance optimization. As a senior engineer, you will work independently to solve complex technical challenges, take up technical initiatives, and champion engineering best practices. 

The successful candidate will be passionate about solving pain points for the developer community, enabling operational excellence, and delivering innovative cloud-native solutions that accelerate business outcomes. 

Your Key Responsibilities

 - Track record of driving innovation and staying updated with the latest AI research and advancements. 

Good to Have Skills:

 - Collaborate seamlessly with software engineering and operations teams for efficient AI model integration and deployment.

To qualify for the role, you must have

 - Experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines. 
 - Strong troubleshooting skills across cloud infrastructure, networking, security, and performance.

 - Understanding of cloud governance, cost optimization, and operational resilience. 
 - Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, IT, Engineering, or related field.

Ideally, you'll also have

What We Look For

What Working At EY Offers

Our comprehensive Total Rewards package includes support for flexible working and career development, and with FlexEY you can select benefits that suit your needs, covering holidays, health and well-being, insurance, savings and a wide range of discounts, offers and promotions. - Strong knowledge of HVAC&R product and component testing and validation standards. 
 - Ability to manage psychrometric laboratory operations, testing priorities, and execution schedules.

 - Experience in instrumentation selection, commissioning, and integration with data acquisition systems.

B. Tech Mechanical, 3+ Years of experience in HVAC&R Product Testing.

data.description:
Lead Design Engineer - Solar Rooftop  

Job Title: Lead Design Engineer / Solar Engineering Lead (Rooftop PV)

Department: Engineering & Projects (EPC)

Experience Required: 6 - 10+ years (with a strong portfolio in C&I

rooftop projects)

Education Qualification: B. E. / B. Tech or M. Tech in Electrical/Renewable/Civil Engineering

Location: New Delhi (with occasional travel to project sites across India)

Role Overview

The Lead Design Engineer will head the rooftop solar design division from the New Delhi corporate

office. This individual will steer the engineering team, approve complex system designs, and drive

the technical execution of Residential, Commercial, and Industrial (C&I) solar projects. The role

combines technical mastery in PV system sizing, structural/electrical compliance, on-site technical

validation, and team leadership to optimize costs and maximize energy yield. 

Key Responsibilities

● Site Surveys & Engineering Assessments: Lead critical on-site technical surveys and feasibility assessments for complex or high-capacity C&I rooftops; validate physical roof integrity, shading obstructions, and point of grid interconnection. 

● Project Engineering Discussions: Lead strategic technical consultations and engineering alignments with corporate clients, project management consultants (PMCs), structural checkers, and state utility officials. 

● Team Leadership & Quality Assurance: Direct, mentor, and review the output of a team of solar design engineers and CAD drafters. Establish design standards, engineering workflows, and comprehensive review checklists. 

● Advanced System & Structural Design: Oversee and finalize complex electrical layouts including LT/HT panels, net-metering integration, transformer selection, and system protection schemes. Review and sign off on custom Module Mounting Structure (MMS) configurations for atypical roofs. 

● Simulation & Yield Optimization: Approve finalized PVsyst energy yield assessments, PR estimations, shadow analyses, and comprehensive technical-commercial proposals for high-value contracts. 

● Cross-Functional & Vendor Management: Collaborate with the Procurement team to vet, test, and onboard standard components (modules, inverters, structures) and optimize Balance of System (BOS) costs. 

Technical Skills & Software Mastery

Design & Analysis Software: Expert-level command over AutoCAD, PVsyst, HelioScope, SketchUp, and specialized drone mapping or structural modeling software. 

Electrical Infrastructure: In-depth understanding of HT/LT switchgear, protection relays, earthing calculations, and grid-tied/hybrid central and string inverter technologies. 

Regulations & Standards: Thorough knowledge of Indian Electricity Rules, CEA regulations, state-specific net-metering/open-access guidelines, and international safety codes (IEC, IS). 

Desired Leadership Attributes

● Proven Leadership: Demonstrated track record of managing engineering teams and scaling up C&I solar project portfolios. 

● Mobility & Flexibility: Readiness for occasional short-notice travel to project locations across India to conduct critical surveys and resolve on-site engineering challenges. 

● Strategic Value Engineering: Strong focus on cost-reduction strategies, material optimization, and maximizing client ROI without compromising safety or compliance.

data.title: Senior Engineer - Reliability
data.description:
About River

River is a design company building personal transportation for livelihood. We focus on creating multi-utility products for those independently carving their own path. We're building from the ground up, bringing together design, engineering and technology to solve real, everyday problems. Our signature two-wheeler, Indie - The SUV of Scooters, is built to be a dependable companion for getting things done. 

Today, we're 1, 500+ people strong, headquartered in Bengaluru, and have raised our Series C. 

River is backed by leading global automotive OEMs, international tech investors, and top institutional asset managers, including Yamaha Motor, Al-Futtaim Automotive Group, Toyota Ventures, Mitsui & Co. , Marubeni Ventures, Lowercarbon Capital, Maniv Mobility, Elev8 Venture Partners, Claypond Capital, Trucks Venture Capital, 360 ONE Asset, HDFC AMC, Singularity AMC, Anicut Capital, and JIF Capital. 

Key Responsibilities

- Familiar with reliability spec ( ISO, IEC, GM3172, MIL Std etc. )
 - Determine reliability requirements of components and systems to achieve company targets
 - Recommends experiment designs or test methods, prepares samples and reliability test plans and own data collection, analysis & reporting
 - Requires extensive experience in testing of modules and systems, performing statistical analysis of the experimental data, and presenting status updates and reports
 - Recommend new design fixtures and follow up with suppliers to secure the test setup within the deadlines
 - Develop failure modes and effects analysis and fault tree analysis. Advises design engineering on selection, application and test of mechanical, electrical, electronic and electro-mechanical parts & systems
 - Develop standard methods, training's and methodologies and ensure implementation within organization for competence development, share lessons learnt and develop best practice guidelines
 - Participate in the product design process to understand product features, functions and life cycle events to plan for reliability assessment along with DFMEA knowledge
 - Identification, evaluation and prioritization of risks in early project stage/phase
 - Lead failure analysis efforts of test and field failures for root cause identification and implementation using problem solving techniques like 8D, 5WHYs/FRACAS

Ideal Candidate

- Overall 6 to 9 years of experience in Reliability testing & Validation
 - BE/ B. Tech in electrical or mechanical engineering or a related subject
 - Working knowledge of data visualization tools & techniques ( e. g. Reliasoft, Weibull, MS excel etc. )
 - Knowledge of statistical methods used for reliability analysis & design of validation test regimes
 - Weibull analysis, Failure rate, MTTF, MTBF, Reliability & critical parts prediction and minitab software for data visualization and analysis
 - Familiar with the design, operation and environment of automotive electrification
 - Design For Reliability (DFR) techniques
 - Experience in applying Reliability & safety processes and tools e. g. Fault Tree analysis (FTA), Failure Modes Effects & Criticality Analysis (FMECA), failure reporting analysis and corrective action system (FRACAS) along with Reliability block diagrams (RBD)
 - Reliability demonstration Testing, Optimization of Test samples size and Test duration by using various aging laws to define Reliability/Durability Testing, QALT (Quantitative accelerated Life Testing), HALT (Highly Accelerated Life Testing), HASS (Highly Accelerated Stress screening), FEA & Physics of Failure (PoF) techniques
 - Hands-on experience in testing under various loads like Vibration, Thermal, Bumps, Ingress protection, Solar radiation, Flammability etc. 
 - Able to communicate effectively, work flexibility in a multi-disciplinary team and on own initiative

data.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Software Development Engineer in Test - AI based in India. 

We are looking for a forward-thinking Software Development Engineer in Test specializing in AI to drive quality, reliability, and innovation across AI-powered applications and intelligent systems. In this role, you will go beyond traditional software testing by designing advanced evaluation frameworks for LLMs, AI agents, copilots, and RAG-based applications. You will combine strong automation engineering skills with hands-on AI expertise to validate complex workflows, improve system performance, and ensure safe and reliable AI outputs. Working closely with Engineering, AI/ML, Platform, Product, and DevOps teams, you will help integrate intelligent testing solutions throughout the software development lifecycle. You will also explore emerging AI frameworks, agentic architectures, and automation technologies to accelerate engineering productivity. This is an exciting opportunity to shape next-generation quality engineering practices in a collaborative, innovation-driven, and globally distributed environment. 

Accountabilities

- AI/LLM Quality Engineering: Design, implement, and optimize testing strategies for AI-powered applications, chatbots, copilots, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines, and autonomous AI agents. 
 - AI Evaluation Frameworks: Develop and maintain AI evaluation (Evals) frameworks to assess hallucinations, groundedness, toxicity, bias, response quality, contextual relevance, prompt regressions, output consistency, and safety guardrails. 
 - Automated AI Validation: Build automated validation pipelines for LLM-generated outputs using structured assertions, semantic scoring, embeddings, and evaluation metrics. Create synthetic and benchmark datasets to validate different AI scenarios. 
 - Agentic Systems Testing: Validate multi-agent orchestration workflows, agent planning and execution, memory retention, context management, tool calling, function calling, and structured outputs. Test MCP (Model Context Protocol) integrations and interoperability. 
 - Prompt and Context Engineering: Contribute to prompt engineering, context engineering, and prompt optimization strategies to improve AI response quality, reliability, and consistency. 
 - Performance and Cost Optimization: Evaluate AI application latency, token consumption, throughput, scalability, and model usage costs to ensure efficient system performance. 
 - Automation Engineering: Develop and maintain scalable UI and API automation frameworks using Python, with tools such as Robot Framework, Playwright, Selenium, and Cypress. Build reusable testing libraries, utilities, and AI-assisted testing workflows. 
 - API and Application Testing: Automate testing across REST APIs, GraphQL APIs, event-driven systems, streaming services, webhooks, microservices, and micro-frontend architectures. 
 - RAG and AI Platform Validation: Validate RAG architectures, including document chunking strategies, embedding quality, retrieval accuracy, reranking, and vector search relevance. Work with vector databases such as Pinecone, Weaviate, ChromaDB, Qdrant, and FAISS. 
 - AI Agent Frameworks: Build, test, and validate AI agents using frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen, Semantic Kernel, and OpenAI SDKs. 
 - DevOps and CI/CD Integration: Integrate automated testing and quality gates into CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions, Jenkins, GitLab CI/CD, or Azure DevOps. 
 - Cloud and Infrastructure Testing: Work with Docker, Kubernetes, and cloud environments across AWS, Azure, OCI, and GCP to validate application reliability, scalability, and deployment quality. 
 - Observability and Reliability: Monitor AI application behavior using logging, tracing, and observability platforms. Validate distributed systems reliability, identify performance bottlenecks, and contribute to shift-left quality engineering practices. 
 - Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with engineering, AI/ML, product, platform, and DevOps teams to embed quality throughout the development lifecycle and continuously improve testing standards. 

Requirements

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, or a related field. Equivalent practical experience and demonstrable technical projects are also highly valued. 
 - Strong programming skills in Python, with the ability to develop automation frameworks, reusable testing utilities, and complex validation workflows. 
 - Solid understanding of software testing principles, quality engineering methodologies, and modern test automation practices. 
 - Hands-on experience with AI/LLM testing, prompt engineering, context engineering, AI evaluation frameworks, RAG architectures, and AI agents. 
 - Practical experience designing and validating AI-powered workflows, including automated output evaluation, hallucination detection, response quality assessment, and safety validation. 
 - Experience with API testing and automation, microservices testing, UI automation, and data validation using SQL. 
 - Familiarity with AI agent frameworks and technologies such as LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, CrewAI, Semantic Kernel, and MCP (Model Context Protocol). 
 - Experience integrating automated testing into CI/CD pipelines and working with Docker, Kubernetes, and cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, OCI, or GCP. 
 - Strong debugging, analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving abilities, with the capacity to investigate complex technical issues independently. 
 - Experience working in Agile or Scrum environments and collaborating effectively with multidisciplinary engineering teams. 
 - Demonstrated curiosity about emerging AI technologies, with the ability to rapidly learn and experiment with new frameworks, tools, and architectures. 
 - Strong communication and collaboration skills, combined with a proactive mindset and passion for innovation, automation, and developer productivity. 

Good To Have

- Experience with Robot Framework and Playwright for scalable test automation. 
 - Hands-on familiarity with AI development tools such as Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Claude, Gemini, and OpenAI APIs. 
 - Experience working with vector databases, embeddings, and semantic search technologies. 
 - Exposure to MLOps workflows and machine learning lifecycle testing. 
 - Knowledge of performance testing, security testing, and AI governance or compliance requirements. 
 - Experience with contract testing, chaos testing, resilience engineering, and distributed systems validation.

Bonus Skills - High Impact

You will also spearhead the integration of AI agents into testing workflows, transforming how test scenarios are generated, executed, and evaluated. This is an opportunity to tackle challenging systems-level engineering problems while shaping the future of intelligent, automated software quality. 

Accountabilities

- Quality Strategy and Test Architecture: Define and own the overall quality strategy for the distributed database platform, including test architecture, coverage models, release criteria, and risk-based testing priorities. Drive quality across server components, client SDKs, database operators, backup tools, and management interfaces. 
 - Distributed Database Testing: Design and execute comprehensive testing strategies covering replication, rebalancing, partitioning, sharding, consistency models, transactions, isolation, secondary indexes, query planning, compaction, backup and restore, snapshots, and cross-datacenter replication. 
 - Fault-Injection and Reliability Testing: Validate cluster behavior under production-like failure conditions, including node crashes, network partitions, clock skew, disk failures, latency, rolling upgrades, mixed-version deployments, and long-running stress tests. 
 - Advanced Debugging and Root-Cause Analysis: Investigate complex system-level defects involving memory access, serialization, encoding and decoding, compression, checksums, and consistency violations. Reproduce issues at source-code level, identify potential root causes, and provide engineering teams with minimal reproducible test cases and actionable technical reports. 
 - Test Automation and Framework Development: Build, maintain, and improve scalable automated testing frameworks using Python, pytest, custom test harnesses, API testing, and end-to-end automation. Ensure reliable execution across shared testing infrastructure and CI/CD environments such as GitHub Actions and Jenkins. 
 - Regression and Infrastructure Reliability: Strengthen regression coverage, reduce flaky tests, investigate inconsistent test results, and develop testing strategies across unit, integration, API, contract, end-to-end, performance, scalability, upgrade/downgrade, and soak testing. 
 - AI-Agent Integration: Lead the integration of AI agents into existing testing frameworks, enabling automated test planning, execution, log inspection, metrics analysis, defect reporting, and failure triage. Integrate agents with pytest, custom testing harnesses, and MCP-style tool servers. 
 - AI Evaluation and Quality Assurance: Establish evaluation frameworks using golden datasets, graders, and regression suites to measure the reliability, accuracy, and consistency of AI-generated outputs while maintaining appropriate human oversight. 
 - Cross-Functional Collaboration: Participate in product requirement discussions, feature reviews, technical design reviews, and client specification assessments to establish testability requirements early in the development lifecycle. 
 - Technical Leadership and Mentorship: Lead complex debugging and defect-resolution initiatives across quality, client, and server engineering teams. Mentor senior QEs and SDETs, promote effective debugging practices, and establish reusable engineering standards without requiring direct people-management responsibilities. 
 - Continuous Quality Improvement: Convert production incidents and pre-release defects into permanent regression tests, monitoring checks, and preventive measures to improve overall platform reliability. 

Requirements

- Professional Experience: 10-18 years of experience in Software Quality Engineering, SDET, or Systems Engineering, with demonstrated Staff or Principal-level technical impact and a strong focus on building quality systems. 
 - Distributed Database Expertise: Extensive hands-on experience testing distributed databases or storage systems, preferably NoSQL platforms such as Cassandra, ScyllaDB, MongoDB, Couchbase, Redis, DynamoDB, or HBase. Experience with distributed relational databases such as CockroachDB, TiDB, YugabyteDB, or Spanner-style systems is also relevant. 
 - Database Testing Knowledge: Strong experience validating replication, partitioning, sharding, consistency, transactions, secondary indexes, backup and restore, and cross-datacenter replication. 
 - Distributed Systems Fundamentals: Deep understanding of replication protocols, consensus mechanisms, quorum reads and writes, strong and eventual consistency, split-brain scenarios, clock synchronization issues, and failure-recovery semantics. 
 - Systems-Level Debugging: Ability to read, analyze, and debug server-side code written in C, C++, Go, Rust, or Java, tracing complex defects to specific functions and identifying underlying technical causes. 
 - Protocol and Serialization Knowledge: Understanding of communication protocols, serialization formats, and edge cases involving wire formats, MessagePack, Protocol Buffers, Thrift, and compression codecs. 
 - Programming and Automation: Strong Python programming and software automation skills, with proficiency in at least one systems programming language. 
 - Fault-Injection Experience: Practical experience with fault injection, GDB, chaos-style testing, process termination, network partitions, latency and packet-loss injection, disk failures, corrupted inputs, version incompatibilities, and boundary-value testing. 
 - Comprehensive Testing Expertise: Experience across multiple testing layers, including unit, integration, API, contract, end-to-end, performance, scalability, upgrade/downgrade, and long-running soak testing. 
 - CI/CD and Test Infrastructure: Strong experience with CI/CD platforms such as GitHub Actions, Jenkins, or equivalent tools, including managing and improving shared testing infrastructure. 
 - AI-Agent Testing: Practical experience integrating AI agents into software testing workflows, including agent orchestration, tool integration, prompt design, evaluation methodologies, and integration with real-world testing frameworks. 
 - Technical Communication: Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to produce clear technical documentation, defect reports, investigation summaries, RFCs, and cross-functional engineering discussions.

data.title: Staff Post-Silicon DDR Characterization Engineer
data.description:
Job Overview

Join Arm's Bengaluru Silicon Characterization team to validate and characterize next-generation Arm SoCs and help customers bring products to market. 

As a Staff Post-Silicon DDR Characterization Engineer, you will focus on DDR/LPDDR memory subsystems, characterizing silicon across process, voltage, temperature, and frequency (PVTF) conditions. You will identify and debug complex silicon issues, analyze electrical and performance margins, and collaborate with cross-functional engineering teams to improve silicon power, performance, stability, and reliability. 

Education & Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in electrical/Electronic Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. Master's degree preferred. 

Crucial Skills & Experience

- Minimum of 8 years of strong hands-on experience in post-silicon DDR/LPDDR characterization, validation, silicon debug, and root-cause analysis of complex memory subsystem issues. 
 - Good understanding of DDR4/DDR5 and/or LPDDR4/4X/LPDDR5/5X architectures, memory controllers, PHY operation, training, calibration, and timing requirements. 
 - Experience identifying, reproducing, and debugging complex silicon bugs, including memory instability, training failures, timing issues, and data corruption. 
 - Hands-on experience using Mixed Signal Oscilloscopes (MSOs), high-bandwidth oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, and other laboratory debug equipment. 
 - Experience with DDR/LPDDR eye margining, Vref characterization, voltage/frequency shmoo testing, and timing margin analysis. 
 - Ability to characterize silicon power, performance, reliability, and operating limits across PVTF conditions. 
 - Strong programming and automation skills in Python, C/C++, Arm assembly, or related scripting languages. 
 - Strong analytical skills with the ability to investigate complex failures, interpret measurement data, and communicate technical findings. 

Desired Skills & Experience

- Experience with DDR4/DDR5/DDR6, LPDDR4/4X, LPDDR5/5X, or related memory technologies. 
 - Knowledge of High Bandwidth Memory (HBM), Package-on-Package (PoP), on-package memory, or advanced memory packaging. 
 - Understanding signal integrity, power integrity, jitter, noise, DQ/DQS timing, and high-speed interface behavior. 
 - Experience characterizing memory bandwidth, latency, read/write performance, power consumption, and stability. 
 - Experience with DDR controller/PHY debugging, ECC errors, memory stress testing, and failure analysis. 
 - Familiarity with Arm-based SoCs, CPU memory hierarchies, interconnects, and system-level memory behavior. 
 - Experience developing automated characterization frameworks, performing data analysis, and correlating silicon results with design or manufacturing test data. 

Responsibilities

- Define and execute DDR/LPDDR post-silicon characterization plans covering performance, power, functionality, electrical margins, and reliability. 
 - Identify, reproduce, debug, and drive root-cause analysis of complex silicon and memory subsystem issues. 
 - Perform eye margining, timing analysis, voltage/frequency shmoo characterization, and electrical measurements using MSOs and other laboratory equipment. 
 - Analyze DDR/LPDDR controller, PHY, and system-level behavior to identify performance bottlenecks and operating limitations. 
 - Develop reusable Python/C++ automation for characterization, instrumentation, data collection, and reporting. 
 - Collaborate with Arm architecture, design, PHY, firmware, verification, and platform teams to resolve silicon issues and improve characterization methodologies. 
 - Provide technical leadership, mentor engineers, and communicate characterization findings and recommendations to stakeholders. 

Our 10x Mindset

At Arm, we believe progress happens when people are empowered to think bigger and push beyond what seems possible. Our 10x mindset is about curiosity, ambition and creating impact that will be used by millions. We learn fast, prioritise collaboration and turn bold ideas into real technology. To note, by sending us the requested information, you consent to its use by Arm to arrange for appropriate accommodations. Although this is not an exhaustive list, examples of support include breaks between interviews, having documents read aloud, or office accessibility. Hybrid Working

data.title: Expert Senior Manager, AI Engineering
data.description:
What Makes Us a Great Place to Work  

We are proud to be consistently recognized as one of the world's best places to work. We are currently the top ranked consulting firm on  Glassdoor's Best Places to Work list  and have earned the #1 overall spot a record seven times. Extraordinary teams are at the heart of our business strategy, but these don't happen by chance. They require intentional focus on bringing together a broad set of backgrounds, cultures, experiences, perspectives, and skills in a supportive and inclusive work environment. We hire people with exceptional talent and create an environment in which every individual can thrive professionally and personally. 

  

About Bain AI, Insights & Solutions (AIS)

Bain's  AI, Insights & Solutions (AIS) team  works with clients to design and deliver AI-powered solutions that create measurable business impact. You'll operate in multidisciplinary teams alongside Bain consultants, other experts in product, design, architecture and engineering, and client stakeholders, translating ambiguous business problems into robust AI applications that can be piloted, scaled, and adopted. 

  

The Impact You'll Have

Bain works with clients on board-level and executive priorities, helping deliver step-change results across growth, productivity, and resilience. In that context, AI is rarely a point solution. The most meaningful outcomes come from building AI as part of an integrated system that combines technology with redesigned processes, operating model changes, and adoption at scale across the organization.   

  

As an AI Engineering leader in AIS, you will support the building of the technical core within these transformations and work as part of broader Bain consulting teams to move solutions from prototype to real adoption. The result is measurable impact at the company or enterprise level and, in many cases, helps clients set new performance standards for their industries. 

  

The Role  

The Expert Senior Manager AI Engineer will architect, build, and scale next-generation generative AI systems and agentic solutions for Bain's clients. As a leader in the practice, you will sit at the intersection of advanced engineering, applied AI research, product strategy, and responsible AI governance. You will own the full lifecycle - from research and experimentation to production deployment and ongoing optimization - and guide teams across engineering, product, data science, ethics, and client stakeholders. 

  

You will have opportunities to work with major AI ecosystem partners through Bain's partnerships, collaborating on real client deployments and helping shape how emerging capabilities are applied in enterprise settings. 

  

Bain offers significant learning and growth opportunities through the breadth and depth of problems we solve, the level of impact we help clients achieve, and our apprenticeship model. You will learn while doing, with support from other experienced teammates, frequent feedback, and increasing responsibility over time. 

  

What You'll Do    

- Design, build, and deploy end-to-end generative AI systems, including multi-agent workflows and production-grade AI applications. 
 - Architect multi-component pipelines, including: 
 - Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)
 - Fine-tuning and parameter-efficient tuning
 - Embedding generation and optimization
 - Hybrid retrieval strategies (vector, graph, keyword)
 - Integrate reasoning, tool use, function calling, and orchestration across complex workflows
 - Engineer advanced agentic systems, ensuring clear separation of concerns, robust memory architecture, and scalable tool ecosystems
 - Lead everything from early-stage research, model experimentation, and evaluation design to production system deployment
 - Oversee API development, microservices, CI/CD pipelines, observability, and cloud-native deployment
 - Build scalable GenAIOps processes for automated testing, regression evaluation, latency monitoring, and continual improvement
 - Balance performance, safety, responsible AI principles, and cost across system design: 
 - Implement guardrails, fallbacks, red-teaming strategies, and human-in-the-loop (HITL) workflows
 - Partner with global ethics teams to ensure alignment with Bain's Responsible AI standards
 - Build automated evaluation suites integrating user signals, continual learning cycles, and ongoing model updates
 - Design and implement evaluation frameworks covering: 
 - Hallucination rate and factual consistency
 - Relevance and precision/recall
 - Latency, throughput, and system-level performance
 - Cost tracking and efficiency
 - Partner closely with product, engineering, data science, ethics, and infrastructure teams to build robust, compliant AI systems
 - Act as a thought partner to executives and clients on AI strategy, architecture decisions, emerging capabilities, and implementation roadmaps
 - Mentor and upskill technical teams on best practices including RAG, agents, prompt engineering, and AI safety  

What We're Looking For

- 8-12+ years in software engineering, ML engineering, or applied AI roles with significant hands-on building responsibilities
 - Demonstrated experience leading complex, multi-stack generative AI programs from conception through production
 - Strong executive communication skills with the ability to translate highly technical concepts to business stakeholders
 - Track record of leading engineering teams, mentoring technical talent, and collaborating with diverse cross-functional groups
 - Advanced prompt engineering, context engineering, and conversation design
 - Strong expertise in evaluation design, experimentation frameworks, and data labeling strategies for LLM apps
 - Deep experience with: 
 - Advanced RAG architectures (vector, hybrid, graph-based retrieval)
 - Agentic architectures (multi-agent systems, tool selection, routing, memory, planning, reflection)
 - ReAct, RLAIF, and other HITL + feedback loops. 
 - AI-Specific Tools & Frameworks - Orchestration frameworks, Vector and graph databases and Model + API ecosystems
 - Strong background in system design, architecture, and production-grade deployment
 - Deep familiarity with cost optimization and computational tradeoffs for LLM workloads
 - Comfort operating in high-ambiguity environments with collaborative cross-functional teams
 - Clear ability to lead, mentor, and inspire technical teams
 - Experience in client-facing consulting or enterprise transformation environments is a strong plus Working Model & Travel

- This role requires a minimum of three days per week working together in person, either at a client location or at your Bain home office. 
 - Travel is required beyond your home office / primary working location. Frequency and destination vary by project needs.

RF Optimization Engineer - 5G/LTE Small Cell

Location- Remote, India

We are seeking an RF Optimization Engineer with hands-on experience in 5G/LTE optimization, small cell networks, and post-integration performance validation. The ideal candidate must be proficient in Ericsson ENM and command-line operations. 

This opportunity involves optimizing newly integrated cells and frequency layers, improving LTE/VoLTE KPIs, and troubleshooting network performance issues across multi-layer 4G and 5G networks. 

Required Skills & Experience

• Mandatory hands-on experience with Ericsson ENM and command-line operations. 

• Mandatory small cell RF optimization experience. 

• Experience with multi-layer cluster optimization across 5G and LTE networks. 

• Strong understanding of ENDC profiles, baseline parameters, and LMS parameters. 

• Experience supporting L600, L2100, NR2500/NR41, and NR600 layers. 

• Strong LTE/VoLTE KPI analysis and RF Layer 3 troubleshooting skills. 

• Ability to investigate handover failures, throughput degradation, dropped calls, and access/RACH failures. 

• Experience reviewing daily KPI reports and identifying sites with performance degradation. 

Desired Skills & Experience

• Experience supporting L600 and Anchor optimization projects. 

• Experience generating and interpreting TrueCall plots to assess coverage changes. 

• Experience implementing new features and tuning LTE radio network parameters. 

What You Will Be Doing

Support post-integration validation and optimization of new cells and layers, ensuring parameter alignment and stable network performance. Analyze KPIs, investigate network quality issues, and implement improvements across small cell and multi-layer LTE/5G networks. 

Tech Breakdown

• Networks: 4G LTE, VoLTE, and 5G NR. 

• Layers: L600, L2100, NR2500/NR41, and NR600. 

• Tools: Ericsson ENM, command-line interfaces, and TrueCall. 

• Focus Areas: ENDC, LMS parameters, Layer 3 analysis, and small cell optimization. 

Daily Responsibilities

• Perform post-integration checks for new 5G cells and layers. 

• Enable and validate ENDC profiles on the Master Node for NR600. 

• Validate and optimize newly integrated L2100, NR2500, and NR600 layers. 

• Align baseline and LMS parameters following L600 carrier integration. 

• Monitor and optimize LTE/VoLTE KPIs after L600 and Anchor deployments.

 - Strong knowledge of Microsoft Azure and cloud-native architecture, with experience designing scalable, secure, resilient, and maintainable solutions.

 - Strong knowledge of SQL Server, database design, data access patterns, and application performance considerations. 
 - Strong engineering quality and security mindset, including automated testing, secure coding, authentication/authorization, dependency risk, and vulnerability remediation. 
 - Proven ability to make architectural and technical decisions by evaluating scalability, performance, security, maintainability, and delivery trade-offs. 
 - Strong technical leadership skills, including mentoring engineers, conducting design/code reviews, defining engineering standards, and collaborating across Development, DevOps, Security, Product, and R&D teams.

Desired Skills And Competencies

About Rippling

Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system. 

Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365-all within 90 seconds. 

Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1. 8B+ from the world's top investors including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.

The Tax Payment team is powering the tax remittance of $30 billion+ to 5000+ tax agencies. We ensure taxes are paid on the time. We ensure billions of tax payment across 40+ countries get get remitted on time through automated systems.

data.title: Thermal Protection Systems Lead
data.description:
Mission Overview

At AlgoForge Aerospace, reusability is an absolute mandate, not a secondary goal. As the Thermal Protection Systems (TPS) Lead, you are responsible for ensuring the AF-Series launch vehicles survive the searing heat of hypersonic reentry. 

You are the ultimate barrier between our primary composite airframe and the destructive plasma of the atmosphere. Your mandate is to engineer advanced, flight-weight TPS architectures that require zero refurbishment between flights, enabling high-cadence orbital operations. 

Operational Objectives

Take extreme ownership of the vehicle's thermal shield, architecting advanced reusable TPS (C-C, C-SiC, TUFI tiles) and targeted ablators for peak heating zones. 

Execute rigorous aero-thermal load analyses to define thermal margins, utilizing high-fidelity CFD and Thermal solvers (ANSYS, Fluent, Star-CCM+). 

Drive aggressive material qualification campaigns, leading high-enthalpy arc-jet testing to characterize ablation rates and thermal soak-back. 

Collaborate intimately with the Structures team to integrate TPS directly onto the primary carbon-composite airframe without compromising dry mass. 

Pioneer automated inspection and rapid recertification protocols, ensuring the heat shield is flight-ready within a 24-hour turnaround window. 

Mission Prerequisites

BS/MS/PhD in Aerospace Engineering, Materials Science, or Mechanical Engineering with a proven track record in high-temperature R&D. 

Deep, hands-on expertise with extreme-environment composites (Carbon-Carbon, Ceramic Matrix Composites) and advanced insulation blankets. 

Uncompromising mastery of heat transfer (conduction, convection, radiation), hypersonic aerothermodynamics, and plasma physics. 

Direct experience executing material test campaigns in arc-jet facilities or high-temperature wind tunnels. 

Expertise in industry-standard thermal analysis suites (Thermal Desktop, SINDA/FLUINT, or advanced custom Python solvers). 

- Deployment Benefits -

Technical Authority

Total ownership of the vehicle's survival boundary. 

Reusability Mandate

data.title: Lead Software Test Engineer
data.description:
The QA Lead is responsible for defining and driving the test strategy, planning, execution, automation, and overall quality assurance activities for assigned projects. 

This is a hands-on technical leadership role requiring strong expertise in software testing, test automation, and modern Quality Engineering practices. The QA Lead will independently create and maintain test artefacts, provide clear quality insights and recommendations to project stakeholders, and take ownership of overall test delivery and release readiness. 

The role also has line management responsibility for software test engineers, supporting their performance, career development, mentoring, and technical capability growth. 

In addition, the QA Lead will contribute to the continuous development and evolution of the wider testing capability within CACI India, including standards, processes, automation practices, and quality engineering approaches. 

The role reports to the Head of Engineering, India, and works closely with the Automation Practice Lead, India, as well as project teams and testing stakeholders across CACI UK and India. 

Key Responsibilities

Test Leadership & Delivery

Collaborate with senior stakeholders within the CACI India Testing Practice and project teams across the UK and India to define, maintain, and own the Test Strategy for assigned projects. 

Lead and coordinate end-to-end testing activities across functional, integration, system, regression, performance, and user acceptance testing, as appropriate to the project. 

Plan and manage testing activities throughout the software development lifecycle, ensuring appropriate test coverage, environments, resources, and timelines. 

Independently Create, Review, And Maintain High-quality Test Artefacts, Including

Test Strategies

Test Plans

Test Scenarios and Test Cases

Test Execution Reports

Test Completion/Closure Reports

Assess and communicate release readiness, providing clear recommendations for go-live based on test coverage, outstanding defects, risks, test completion, and overall quality. 

Identify quality risks early and work proactively with delivery teams and stakeholders to define and implement appropriate mitigation strategies. 

Manage the defect lifecycle, ensuring defects are appropriately prioritised, tracked, communicated, and resolved within agreed timelines. 

Provide accurate and timely test status reporting, metrics, quality insights, and recommendations to project and senior stakeholders. 

Test Automation & Quality Engineering

Design, develop, maintain, and enhance automated test frameworks and test suites to improve test coverage, quality, reliability, and delivery efficiency. 

Identify suitable opportunities for automation and drive the adoption of automated testing across project teams. 

Integrate automated testing into CI/CD pipelines to support continuous testing and earlier identification of quality issues. 

Promote modern Quality Engineering practices, including shift-left testing, risk-based testing, continuous testing, and appropriate automation strategies. 

Contribute to the selection and evaluation of testing tools, frameworks, and approaches where required. 

Support the continuous improvement of testing processes, standards, frameworks, and automation capability across CACI India. 

People Leadership & Development

Provide line management for software test engineers, supporting workload planning, performance management, career development, onboarding, and capability building. 

Mentor and support junior and less experienced testers, helping them develop their technical skills and testing expertise. 

Promote consistent testing standards, engineering practices, knowledge sharing, and continuous professional development within the testing community. 

Contribute to the development of the wider CACI India testing capability through coaching, knowledge sharing, standards, reusable assets, and communities of practice. 

Stakeholder Management

Build effective working relationships with project managers, developers, business analysts, product owners, technical leads, and senior stakeholders. 

Communicate complex testing and quality issues clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences. 

Provide constructive challenge where appropriate and ensure quality considerations are incorporated into project planning and delivery decisions. 

Represent the testing and Quality Engineering function confidently across CACI UK and India. 

Skills & Experience

At least 8 years' experience in software testing, Quality Assurance, or Quality Engineering, including at least 3 years in a Test Lead, QA Lead, or equivalent technical leadership role. 

Proven experience independently defining and managing Test Strategies and Test Plans. 

Strong experience in designing, executing, and reporting on functional, integration, system, regression, and user acceptance testing. 

Strong hands-on experience in test automation, including the development, maintenance, and enhancement of automation frameworks and test suites. 

Experience with automation technologies such as Selenium, Playwright, Cypress, Appium, REST API automation, or equivalent technologies. 

Good programming or scripting skills relevant to test automation. 

Experience integrating automated tests into CI/CD pipelines and working within DevOps environments. 

Good understanding of Agile delivery methodologies and modern Quality Engineering practices. 

Experience with defect management, test metrics, quality reporting, and release readiness assessments. 

Experience mentoring, coaching, and developing software testers. 

Experience of line management or demonstrable experience leading and developing testing teams. 

Strong stakeholder management, communication, analytical, organisational, and problem-solving skills. 

Ability to work effectively across geographically distributed teams, including collaboration with colleagues in the UK and India. 

Key Attributes

Self-driven, proactive, and comfortable working with minimal supervision. 

Strong ownership and accountability for quality outcomes. 

Hands-on technical mindset with a passion for test automation and Quality Engineering. 

Able to balance technical delivery with effective people and stakeholder leadership. 

Strong Mentor Who Actively Supports The Development Of Others. 

Collaborative team player who builds effective relationships across engineering and delivery teams. 

Committed to continuous improvement and the adoption of effective testing practices. 

Able to communicate quality risks and recommendations clearly and confidently. 

Committed to delivering high-quality, reliable software solutions. 

More About The Opportunity

The Lead Software Test Engineer is an excellent opportunity, and CACI Services India reward their staff well with a competitive salary and impressive benefits package which includes: 

- Learning: Budget for conferences, training courses and other materials
 - Health Benefits: Family plan with 4 children and parents covered
 - Future You: Matched pension and health care package

We understand the importance of getting to know your colleagues. Company meetings are held every quarter, and a training/work brief weekend is held once a year, amongst many other social events. 

CACI is an equal opportunities employer. Therefore, we embrace diversity and are committed to a working environment where no one will be treated less favourably on the grounds of their sex, race, disability, sexual orientation religion, belief or age. We have a Diversity & Inclusion Steering Group and we always welcome new people with fresh perspectives from any background to join the group

An inclusive and equitable environment enables us to draw on expertise and unique experiences and bring out the best in each other. We champion diversity, inclusion and wellbeing and we are supportive of Veterans and people from a military background. We believe that by embracing diverse experiences and backgrounds, we can collaborate to create better outcomes for our people, our customers and our society.

The ideal candidate will have strong programming skills in C#, hands-on experience with MSTest/FlaUI, expertise in Azure DevOps CI/CD pipelines, and practical experience leveraging GitHub Copilot to accelerate test automation development, improve code quality, and enhance engineering productivity. 

Key Responsibilities

- 6-10 years of experience in software testing, test automation, or quality engineering, with substantial hands-on development experience. 
 - Design, develop, and maintain scalable, reusable, and maintainable test automation frameworks using C# and FlaUI for Desktop Based application which is also enabled in Browser based. 
 - Integrate automated tests with Microsoft Test Platform and compatible test runners. 
 - Troubleshoot test failures, debug application behavior, and resolve automation framework issues. 
 - Use GitHub Copilot to accelerate the development of test scripts, reusable automation utilities, and test framework components. 
 - Leverage AI-assisted coding to generate test scenarios, test data variations, assertions, and negative test cases. 
 - Use GitHub Copilot to assist with code refactoring, debugging, documentation, and unit test development. 
 - Design, implement, and maintain Azure DevOps YAML pipelines for automated test execution. 
 - Integrate automated test suites into CI/CD workflows to enable continuous validation. Experience with Git

Preferred Skills

- Experience with Microsoft Test Platform, VSTest, and automated test execution tools. 
 - Knowledge of REST API automation using Postman or equivalent tools. 
 - Experience with Selenium, Playwright, or other UI automation frameworks. 
 - Knowledge of SQL and database validation. 
 - Experience with PowerShell scripting for automation setup, execution, and reporting. 
 - Experience with Azure DevOps REST APIs, pipeline artifacts, and test reporting. 
 - Familiarity with parallel execution, distributed test environments, and regression optimization. 
 - Understanding of AI-assisted software development, prompt engineering, and AI-generated code validation. 
 - Experience measuring engineering productivity and automation effectiveness. . 

Measurable Performance Outcomes

Performance will be assessed against agreed project baselines and delivery objectives. 

- Automation coverage: Increase automated coverage of prioritized regression scenarios. 
 - Execution efficiency: Reduce regression execution time through optimization and parallelization where feasible. 
 - Test reliability: Reduce flaky tests, false failures, and recurring automation issues. 
 - CI/CD integration: Ensure agreed test suites execute reliably through Azure DevOps pipelines with published results. 
 - AI-assisted productivity: Demonstrate measurable improvements in test development or maintenance efficiency using GitHub Copilot. 
 - Code quality: Maintain reusable, reviewable, secure, and maintainable automation code. 
 - Defect detection: Improve early identification of critical defects and regressions. 
 - Knowledge sharing: Contribute to code reviews, technical documentation, and mentoring. 

Educational Qualifications

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. 
 - Relevant software testing, automation, or Microsoft technology certifications are desirable but not mandatory.

data.title: PC -1526 - Sr. QA Engineer/QA Lead
data.description:
QA Engineer - Manual + Automation

Role Summary

We are looking for a skilled QA Engineer (Manual + Automation) to join the engineering team at Softobiz supporting the Pickles web transformation project. You will be responsible for designing and executing comprehensive test strategies that span manual, automation, API, regression, and release validation testing across the platform. 

The ideal candidate brings strong hands-on experience with both manual testing practices and modern test automation frameworks, with a solid understanding of CI/CD integration, API testing, and end-to-end quality assurance across web applications. You will collaborate closely with developers, product managers, and DevOps engineers to ensure the highest levels of product quality and a reliable, release-ready codebase throughout the development lifecycle. 

Key Responsibilities

Manual Testing

- Design, write, and execute detailed test cases and test plans for functional, regression, integration, and exploratory testing of web applications. 
 - Perform cross-browser and cross-device compatibility testing to ensure consistent user experiences. 
 - Conduct end-to-end manual validation of user stories and acceptance criteria, working closely with product and design stakeholders. 
 - Identify, document, and track defects using issue-tracking tools (e. g. , Jira), ensuring clear reproduction steps, severity classification, and timely resolution. 
 - Participate in sprint ceremonies including backlog grooming, sprint planning, and retrospectives to ensure quality is built into every stage of the process. 

Automation Testing

- Design, develop, and maintain scalable test automation frameworks for web applications using tools such as Playwright, Selenium, Cypress, or equivalent. 
 - Write clean, reusable, and maintainable automated test scripts in TypeScript or JavaScript. 
 - Integrate automated test suites into CI/CD pipelines (e. g. , GitHub Actions) to enable continuous testing on every build. 
 - Monitor and analyze automated test results, investigate flaky tests, and maintain a high level of automation coverage across critical user journeys. 
 - Contribute to test strategy discussions and advocate for automation-first approaches where appropriate. 

API Testing

- Design and execute comprehensive API test suites for RESTful services using tools such as Postman, Rest Assured, or equivalent. 
 - Validate request/response payloads, status codes, authentication flows, and error handling across API contracts. 
 - Collaborate with backend developers to review API specifications and flag potential issues before implementation. 
 - Automate API test collections and integrate them into the CI/CD pipeline for continuous API quality validation. 

Regression Testing

- Own and maintain the regression test suite, ensuring comprehensive coverage of core platform functionality. 
 - Execute full and targeted regression cycles ahead of each release, clearly documenting scope, results, and sign-off status. 
 - Identify areas of the application most susceptible to regression risk and priorities automation coverage accordingly. 
 - Track and report regression metrics over time to support continuous quality improvement. 

Release Validation

- Act as the quality gate for each release, coordinating release validation activities across environments (dev, staging, production). 
 - Prepare and execute release checklists, smoke tests, and sanity checks to confirm production readiness. 
 - Work with DevOps and engineering leads to validate deployments and sign off on go-live readiness. 
 - Document release test outcomes and communicate clearly to stakeholders on quality status and any outstanding risks. 

Quality Engineering & Collaboration

- Collaborate with developers, product managers, and designers to define acceptance criteria and establish a shared definition of done. 
 - Champion a quality-first culture within the team through proactive defect prevention, shift-left testing practices, and continuous feedback. 
 - Maintain up-to-date test documentation, including test plans, test reports, and traceability matrices. 
 - Mentor junior QA team members and contribute to QA best practices and internal knowledge sharing. 

Required Technical Skills

DomainSkills & TechnologiesMust / Preferred Manual Testing Test case design, exploratory testing, UAT, regression, cross-browser testing Must Automation Framework Playwright, Cypress, or Selenium; Page Object Model (POM); reusable test architecture Must Languages TypeScript, JavaScript Must API Testing Postman, RestAssured or equivalent; REST API validation, contract testing Must CI/CD Integration GitHub Actions or equivalent; integrating test suites into build pipelines Must Defect Management Jira or equivalent; defect lifecycle, severity classification, reporting Must Test Management TestRail, Zephyr, or equivalent; test plans, traceability matrices, test reporting Must Regression Testing Regression suite ownership, coverage strategy, scheduled regression cycles Must Release Validation Release checklists, smoke/sanity testing, environment validation, go-live sign-off Must Performance Testing JMeter, k6, or equivalent for load and performance validation Preferred Security Testing Basic OWASP awareness, vulnerability scanning basics Preferred Cloud & DevOps AWS or Azure - deployment environments; Docker basics for local test environments Preferred AI / Dev Tools AI-assisted test generation (Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor) Preferred Observability Log analysis, AppInsights, or ELK stack for identifying failures post-deploy Preferred

Qualifications & Certifications

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, or equivalent practical experience. 
 - 4-7 years of hands-on QA experience covering both manual and automation testing in production web application environments. 
 - Demonstrable experience building and maintaining automation frameworks using Playwright, Cypress, or Selenium. 
 - Hands-on experience with API testing using Postman or equivalent - this is a mandatory requirement. 
 - Proven ownership of regression test suites and release validation activities in an agile delivery context. 
 - Experience working in agile, cross-functional product teams - ideally in a global or client-facing delivery context. 

Preferred Certifications

- ISTQB Foundation Level or Advanced Level (Test Analyst / Technical Test Analyst)
 - Playwright or Cypress official certifications (where available)
 - Any relevant cloud or DevOps certifications (AWS, Azure, GitHub Actions)

Soft Skills & Cultural Fit

- Strong written and verbal communication skills - able to articulate test findings, risk assessments, and quality status clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. 
 - Comfortable working independently during IST hours while collaborating with international clients and team members across different time zones. 
 - High sense of ownership over quality outcomes - proactively identifies gaps and drives issues to resolution without constant supervision. 
 - Collaborative team player who actively participates in sprint ceremonies, code reviews, and cross-functional quality discussions. 
 - Curious, growth-oriented mindset - proactively upskills on new testing tools, frameworks, and AI-enabled QA practices. 

What We Offer

- Opportunity to work on real-world product engineering for Pickles - one of Australia's leading vehicle remarketing platforms. 
 - Exposure to modern web architectures and the full software delivery lifecycle in a fast-moving, collaborative engineering team. 
 - Technically strong team with a culture of code quality, continuous improvement, and knowledge sharing. 
 - Competitive compensation, professional development support, and access to emerging AI development tools. 
 - Flexible working arrangements - hybrid options available depending on location. 

About Softobiz

Softobiz is a technology firm. We build software and run dedicated offshore teams - Global Capability Centres - for a portfolio of international clients across multiple markets. We are looking for an Operations Manager to run the operations of the whole business: the delivery

engine behind our GCCs, and the day-to-day running of the company itself. Just as important, we want someone who treats operations as something to be continuously sharpened - not just kept running. A core part of this role is reviewing how we work, redesigning processes that are manual or inefficient, automating them, and bringing AI deeply into how the operation runs. We are a technology company and we expect our operations to reflect that. Strategy and commercials sit with leadership; your job is to make the operation run, make it run better over time, report on it clearly, and escalate the right things at the right time. You will have an operations support resource handling day-to-day administrative and coordination tasks beneath you. 

For more information about our solutions and organization, visit www. softobiz. com, Follow us on Twitter, Facebook, and LinkedIn.

About This Role

The Senior Software Engineer, Product and Front-end will help build Prudential Japan's next

generation Product Engineering capabilities as part of the Japan Technology Transformation

initiative. 

This role is responsible for designing, building, and operating digital products and platforms that support customer journeys, sales journeys, policy administration experiences, and business workflows across Prudential Japan's end-to-end journey of life insurance value streams. 

As part of a newly established Product Engineering organization, this role offers the opportunity not only to build products, but also to help establish engineering practices, standards, and ways of working that will shape the future of technology delivery at Prudential Japan. 

What You Could Work On

We allocate after offer, across multiple domains. Customer servicing, portals used by our

employees as well as customers to view policy information and execute certain business

workflows. Sales Enablement, portal used by our sales team to manage leads and maintain

regulatory records. 

Key Responsibilities

- Design and build customer-facing journeys, and the internal tools staff use when a customer cannot complete one alone. 
 - Model identity, consent and authority as first-class concepts, including the cases where one person acts on anotherʼs behalf. 
 - Work directly with the staff who handle these requests today, watching real cases rather than reading summarised tickets. 
 - Design for users of every age and confidence level, treating accessibility as a design constraint rather than an audit term. 
 - Instrument journeys so drop-off, error and abandonment are visible, then act on what they show. 
 - Share the APIs your journeys need together with their backend owners, rather than accepting whatever exists. 
 - Work closely with systems engineers, architects and business partners to ensure the quality and reliability of the product, and to deliver on business objectives. 
 - Work alongside long-lived legacy systems and decide, case by case, what to wrap, what to replace and what to leave alone. 
 - Engage with broader product considerations and planning across ideation, design, development, testing, business engagement and team leadership. 
 - Carry on-call for what you own, and run incident reviews that look for causes rather than for someone to blame. 

Qualifications

General

- You do not need insurance experience. We will teach the domain. 
 - Five or more years in product engineering with genuine front-end depth, TypeScript and a
 - modern framework. 
 - Demonstrated accessibility practice, with examples of what you changed and why. 
 - Experience in designing workflow and state and not only screens. 
 - User research or direct observation as a normal part of how you work. 
 - Advantageous: contact center or telephone integration, identity, consent or KYC workflows, 
 - and designing for older or less confident users. 
 - Degree in relevant field or equivalent practical experience. 

Technical

We run on AWS. We are not dogmatic about languages or frameworks and we do not screen

on keyword matches: we care that you have gone deep in at least one stack and can pick up

another. Depth in one column beats a shallow tick in all of them. 

- AI assisted development: Claude, Codex, Copilot or Cursor. Knowing how to build Agent skills
 - is an advantage. 
 - Frontend: TypeScript with React, and a framework such as Next. js. Strong CSS and layout
 - skills
 - Testing: component and end-to-end testing as a habit. Playwright, Vitest or Jest and
 - accessibility checks in the pipeline. 
 - Design systems: consuming one, contributing to one, and knowing when to break it. 
 - Backend for frontend: API gateway with lambda or a small service, enough to own the layer
 - your journeys depend on. 

AWS ecosystem

Nice to have: analytics and session instrumentation (such as Amplitude), design tooling

fluency (such as Figma), and telephony and contact centre integration such as Genesys

telephony or Amazon Connect. 

Language

English: Fluent to Native

Japanese: Working level. JLPT N2 or native is an advantage. 

Culture and Leadership Expectations

- Act as One Prudential for customers by building integrated products across business
 - domains
 - Drive Change by modernizing legacy systems and improving engineering practices
 - Be Highly Accountable for code quality, delivery, reliability, and production outcomes
 - Engage with Candor through open collaboration and constructive technical discussion
 - Demonstrate core values: Worthy of Trust, Customer Focuused, Respect for Each Other, and Winning with Integrity.

Our Global Accounting Process Excellence team is a small, high-impact team working at the intersection of finance operations and cutting-edge technology. We build real solutions - Python scripts, RPA workflows, AI agents - that save our global accounting teams hours of manual work every week.

data.title: Full Stack Engineer
data.description:
Company Description Aventis is an ERP-native cross-border B2B payments platform that uses stablecoins and AI-driven routing to make international B2B and supplier payments faster, cheaper, and fully automated from existing finance systems. The platform helps enterprises and mid-market companies reduce cross-border payment costs through lower network fees and improved FX, while cutting settlement times from days to minutes or same-day where supported. Aventis is designed for CFOs, controllers, and AP leaders who want modern, API-like cross-border payments instead of slow, opaque traditional banking processes. 

Location: Bangalore or Hyderabad, India

What you'll do: 

- Design, build and operate Go services that orchestrate multi-step transactions across internal systems and third-party providers. 
 - Make every operation safe to repeat: idempotency keys, deduplication and exactly-once effects on top of at-least-once delivery. 
 - Implement automated retries with exponential backoff and jitter, timeouts and clear handling of terminal failures. 
 - Build secure webhook ingestion (signature verification, replay protection, durable queuing) and reliable outbound webhook dispatch to partners. 
 - Own reconciliation, both scheduled batch jobs and event-driven checks, so that internal records always match provider and ledger state. 
 - Design OLTP schemas in PostgreSQL and keep queries fast through sound indexing, query planning and transaction design. 
 - Build product features in Next. js and React, with typed contracts shared across the stack. 
 - Define and evolve infrastructure on AWS ECS and RDS using the AWS CDK in TypeScript. 
 - Review code, write clear technical designs and help keep patterns consistent across the codebase. 

How we build: 

- We favour simple, modular design with consistent, repeatable patterns. You'll fit in well if you value: 
 - Clean domain boundaries - each module owns its data and exposes a small, explicit interface. 
 - Readable code - written for the next engineer, not to show off. 
 - Predictable structure - a new service or feature looks like the last one. 
 - Restraint - no clever abstractions or speculative generality; we add complexity only when a real problem demands it. 

What you bring: 

- 4-5 years of professional software engineering experience, with full-stack ownership of production systems. 
 - Expertise in Go for building backend services. 
 - Expertise in TypeScript, React and Next. js. 
 - Expertise in PostgreSQL, including OLTP schema design, indexing and query performance tuning. 
 - Hands-on experience with: 
 - Service orchestration across multiple internal and external systems
 - Idempotency and safe handling of duplicate requests
 - Automated retries with backoff
 - Secure webhook ingestion and dispatch
 - Reconciliation, both scheduled and event-driven
 - A track record of choosing simple, consistent designs over clever or over-engineered ones. 
 - Clear written and verbal communication, especially in design docs and code review. 

Nice to have: 

Experience in fintech or payments, such as payment rails, ledgers, settlement or PSP integrations. 

Experience with stablecoins (a plus, not a requirement). 

How we work: 

- We hire builders: people who solve hard problems, ship work they're proud of and don't wait to be told what to do. 
 - Ownership over permission. You'll take a problem from a blank page to production and keep owning it once it's live. If you see something broken, you fix it. 
 - More responsibility than feels comfortable. We give people real scope early and back them to grow into it. This is a place to do the best work of your career. 
 - Impact over titles. Good ideas win on merit, not seniority. What you ship matters more than what your title says. 
 - Hands-on, everyone. Nobody is too senior to write code, debug a production issue or talk to a customer. 
 - Only build what matters. If it doesn't make cross-border payments faster, cheaper or more reliable for our customers, we don't build it. 
 - Speed with rigour. We move fast in short cycles, but we're moving money, so correctness is never negotiable. 
 - Talented peers. You'll work alongside a small, high-calibre team that raises your bar every day.

data.title: Member of Technical Staff - Microarchitectural Validation
data.description:
About Architect Labs

Architect is a frontier AI lab for custom silicon. We partner with frontier labs, clouds / neoclouds, physical AI companies, and advanced fabs to tape-out custom chips co-designed for next-generation AI workloads. Our goal is to compress end-to-end software to silicon timelines, and maximize intelligence per watt and per dollar for the world. We are a small exceptional team across silicon, systems, software and frontier AI. Our team have led research teams at nearly every frontier AI lab, and at some of the most complex SoCs in the world. 

What You'll Do

As a Member of the Technical Staff on the Design Verification & Validation team at Architect, you'll own the verification strategy behind AI-generated designs taping out on leading foundries. You'll work at the intersection of rigorous hardware verification and AI-driven design automation. 

- Review AI-driven test plan, and validation strategy for internal and external SoC projects. 
 - Provide domain-specific expertise to our AI/ML teams, including architectural and microarchitectural checks, validation modularity, checkers, coverage models, and interface protocols - helping encode DV best practices into our AI-driven flows. 
 - Independently define, drive, and coordinate validation, verification, and integration flows across multiple IPs, including checkpoints and collateral handoffs. 
 - Collaborate with architecture, design, and AI/ML leads to generate simulation- and emulation-ready collateral that scales across projects. 
 - Track emerging trends in semiconductor verification and AI-driven design automation to keep our methodology cutting-edge in quality, scalability, and throughput. 

What We'd Like to See

Qualifications & Skills: 

- Degree: Bachelor's, Master's, or PhD in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a closely related field. 
 - Tapeout Experience: 5+ years (10+ preferred) working on advanced-node tapeouts at top chip companies or fast-moving silicon startups. End-to-end silicon delivery is a strong plus. 
 - Verification Expertise: Deep expertise in verification/validation, emulation, and architectural and system-level verification of industry-standard IPs. Proven track record defining microarchitectural checkers and monitors, modeling IP and SoC validation platforms, and developing modular, reusable validation collateral. 
 - Coding: Strong skills in SystemVerilog, UVM, and C/C++ for test environments. Python strongly preferred. 
 - Subsystem Depth: Hands-on verification experience in at least one of the following areas: 
 - ARM/AMBA protocols (APB, AHB, AXI, and ideally ACE for coherent CPU interfaces)
 - CPU subsystems - boot, interrupts, debug, coherency
 - Memory controllers and PHY - LPDDR/DDR interfaces, controller-level verification
 - On-chip interconnect / NoC - routing, arbitration, QoS, bandwidth
 - NPU / ML accelerator cores - datapath, scratchpad memory, DMA engines
 - Security IPs and/or working with secure enclaves
 - Methodology: Hands-on experience with simulation and emulation flows and methodologies. Experience mapping IP and SoC designs to FPGA prototypes for fast functional verification. 
 - Execution: Excellent problem-solving, collaboration, and communication skills with strong attention to detail. Ability to work independently and drive cross-functional alignment. 
 - Leadership: Ability and desire to lead the DV function over time as the team scales. 

Expected Exposure (beyond the baseline above): 

Candidates should also bring hands-on exposure to most of the following: 

- Microarchitecture: Working knowledge of the architecture and microarchitecture of complex digital subsystems, such as CPUs, XPUs, cache-coherency fabrics (NoCs/switches), memory hierarchies, and high-speed I/O (HSIO) protocols. 
 - Advanced Pre-Silicon Verification: Experience contributing to coverage-driven verification using advanced UVM environments, formal verification, and emulation to validate microarchitectural boundary conditions and corner cases. 
 - Post-Silicon Debug: Participation in post-silicon triage and debug, mapping observed silicon behavior back to RTL using logic analyzers, oscilloscopes, and internal debug hooks. 
 - End-to-End Debug: A track record of isolating and resolving hard HW/FW/SW interaction bugs, performance bottlenecks, or protocol violations, in pre-silicon environments and/or post-silicon bring-up. 

Bonus: 

- SoC-level DV experience - bringing up full systems with memory controller + PHY + CPU connectivity, validating top-level integration. 
 - Deep experience with AMBA protocols, specifically ACE for coherent CPU-memory access. 
 - FPGA prototyping experience (ideally Xilinx Vivado/Vitis). 
 - Verification experience spanning multiple of: interconnects, CPU subsystems, ARM AMBA, memory controllers, NPUs. 
 - Tapeout experience at frontier AI chip startups (MatX, Groq, Cerebras, d-Matrix, etc. ) or tier-1 silicon companies (Apple, NVIDIA, Google, Qualcomm, Broadcom, AMD). 

What We Offer

- Competitive salary and meaningful equity stake
 - Fast-paced startup with autonomy and visible impact
 - Cutting-edge challenges at the intersection of AI and silicon design
