data.description:
Description

If you want to apply machine learning and generative AI to a problem where accuracy has a dollar value, this is the role for you. Transportation Financial Systems (TFS) builds the technology that records, reconciles and posts the accounting for Amazon's transportation invoices and payments across 16+ transportation modes. Today, month-end close depends on people tracing breaks across ten or more systems, one case at a time. The Accounting Insights team replaces that with software. We detect anomalies in financial data with machine learning, find the root cause of a break with generative AI, produce explanations and insights for controllers and accountants, and automate the standard operating procedures (SOPs) that run the close. You will lead a team of engineers, own the roadmap with product management and Accounting partners. 

Key job responsibilities

What will you own?

You will manage a team of engineers and grow them through long-term technical problems their team solves. 

You will own the technical roadmap for your area with TFS Product Management, Accounting and Controllership partners. 

You will own operational excellence for your services: operational load, security, resiliency and compliance at Amazon scale. 

You will set the bar for taking AI into a controlled financial process, with audit evidence, approval steps and separation of duties built in. 

What interesting engineering problem will you solve?

You will build machine learning models that detect anomalies in reconciliation, balance and posting data before close, with precision you can measure. 

You will build generative AI agents that trace a break to its owning system and team and propose a permanent fix, with human confirmation before it is submitted. 

You will build a generative AI assistant that answers balance and variance questions from reconciled figures and attaches the supporting evidence. 

You will automate close SOPs as versioned, auditable procedures that AI helps author and run, replacing spreadsheets and individual knowledge. 

What large scale program opportunities will you have?

You will own the partner relationship with Accounting, Controllership and Audit, and influence their roadmap as well as yours. 

You will work with principal product managers and business leaders to prioritize work and deliver it with quality. 

You will make sure open issues and debated topics reach the right forums, so your team's roadmap stays protected. 

What Think Big exists for you?

You can move month-end close from a monthly investigation to a continuous, automated certification. 

You can turn each one-off root-cause investigation into a permanent fix, so the same class of break stops recurring. 

Basic Qualifications

- 8+ years of leading the definition and development of multi tier web services experience
 - 3+ years of engineering team management experience
 - 7+ years of engineering experience

 - Knowledge of engineering practices and patterns for the full software/hardware/networks development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, certification, and livesite operations

Description

Amazon's Everyday Essentials (EE) Science team is looking for a Software Development Manager to lead the engineering team that brings our science into production. Our team builds the intelligence behind how customers find, reorder, and discover everyday products - using Generative AI, large language models (LLMs), and machine learning to power recommendations, substitutions, subscriptions, personalization, and next-generation AI-powered shopping experiences across Amazon. 

Key job responsibilities

- Lead and develop a team of software engineers, building individualized growth plans, coaching engineers toward their aspirations, and hiring to raise the bar. 
 - Own technical strategy and architecture for production ML systems, including real-time inference services, batch ML pipelines, and the data foundations underneath them. 
 - Build and scale production LLM systems, including model management, fine-tuning, retrieval, evaluation, and observability. 
 - Partner with applied scientists to take models from prototype to production, and build the experimentation, evaluation, and feedback infrastructure that shortens the path from idea to measured customer impact. 
 - Expose ML-powered intelligence through well-designed APIs and integrations that partner teams can adopt with minimal bespoke work. 
 - Drive operational excellence for production services, including availability, latency, on-call health, and cost efficiency. 
 - Foster an inclusive, high-performing culture where diverse perspectives thrive
 - Integrate EE Science intelligence into Amazon's central systems and agentic experiences, exposing it through APIs and agent tools that partner teams can adopt with minimal bespoke work. 
 - Drive operational excellence for services that partner teams depend on, including availability, latency, on-call health, and cost efficiency. 
 - Foster an inclusive, high-performing culture where diverse perspectives thrive and work/life harmony is sustainable. 

A day in the life

You'll lead a team of software engineers who work closely with applied scientists. Your team owns the production systems behind our science: real-time services and APIs, large-scale ML and LLM pipelines, the evaluation and feedback infrastructure that keeps our models improving, and the integrations that deliver our intelligence into core Amazon shopping experiences. 

The problems are hard and the field is moving fast: 

- How do you serve ML models at scale through APIs with the latency and reliability a shopping page demands?
 - How do you take LLM-powered personalization from prototype to production, with model management, fine-tuning, retrieval, and monitoring for quality and cost at Amazon scale?
 - How do you build a feedback loop that captures how customers respond to every recommendation and routes that signal back, so every model improves on its own?
 - How do you build AI-powered systems that enhance the shopping experience and make them trustworthy enough to act on a customer's behalf?

The Impact You'll Have

Production ML at Amazon scale: You'll own the services that deliver our science to customers - from real-time APIs serving high-throughput traffic worldwide, to low-latency retrieval over large product catalogs. 

LLM and GenAI systems: You'll build and run the platform that makes LLM work production-grade - including model management, fine-tuning, quality evaluation, and robust monitoring. 

AI-powered shopping experiences: You'll help shape the next generation of intelligent shopping experiences, exposing ML capabilities through APIs that teams across Amazon can integrate into customer-facing products. 

Broad reach: Your team's work powers experiences across multiple Amazon surfaces and marketplaces, so a single launch can reach customers at scale. 

About The Team

Our team transforms everyday essentials shopping through Generative AI and advanced machine learning. We build reusable intelligence about products and customers, and deliver it into the systems that reach customers across Amazon. The Bangalore team brings applied scientists and software engineers together in one organization, and partners closely with science teams in Seattle and Vancouver. We value curiosity, scientific rigor, and developing each team member's career

Basic Qualifications

- 3+ years of engineering team management experience
 - 7+ years of engineering experience
 - 8+ years of leading the definition and development of multi tier web services experience
 - Knowledge of engineering practices and patterns for the full software/hardware/networks development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, certification, and livesite operations
 - Experience partnering with product or program management teams

data.title: Lead Software Engineer
data.description:
Our Purpose

Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we're helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential. 

Title And Summary

Lead Software Engineer

Position Overview

The Business Experimentation and Optimization (BE&O) teams within Mastercard's Services organization are building industry-leading software that empowers business users around the world to make data-driven decisions through advanced analytics and experimentation. As we expand our product offerings and modernize our technology stack, we are reimagining how we deliver scalable, cloud-native solutions to our clients. 

We are seeking a hands-on, technically strong Lead Software Engineer to drive the architecture, design, and development of our next-generation experimentation platform. In this role, you will help define and evolve system architecture and non-functional requirements-such as scalability, performance, security, and reliability-ensuring our solutions meet the highest engineering standards. As a technical leader, you will guide cross-functional teams in building scalable services, APIs, and analytical capabilities that power our platform, leveraging technologies like Databricks and cloud platforms such as AWS and Azure. You will collaborate closely with your immediate team and partner with other development teams across programs to align on shared goals, define cross-cutting initiatives, and deliver cohesive, enterprise-grade solutions. You will also mentor engineers, work across global time zones, and champion engineering excellence through best practices in software development, observability, and continuous delivery. 

Our teams are small, agile, and empowered to choose the processes that work best for their goals. Every engineer contributes to the full development lifecycle-from ideation and design to implementation and testing-fostering a culture of ownership, innovation, and continuous improvement. 

We are seeking passionate and talented technologists who share our vision of empowering customers to make smarter, data-driven decisions. Join us and help shape the future growth of our team. 

Who is Mastercard?

Mastercard is the global technology company behind the world's fastest payments processing network. We are a vehicle for commerce, a connection to financial systems for the previously excluded, and a technology innovation lab. We ensure every employee has the opportunity to be a part of something bigger and to change lives. We believe as our company grows, so should you. 

Position Responsibilities

At Mastercard Services, you will serve as a senior technical leader and hands-on engineer for BE&O's next-generation experimentation and analytics platform. As a Lead Software Engineer, you will lead through technical influence, architectural judgment, and execution excellence to help modernize our platform and deliver scalable, secure, cloud-native capabilities for global business users. 

Lead the technical design and delivery of complex, data-intensive software solutions that enable advanced analytics, experimentation, and data-driven decisioning for Mastercard clients. 

Define and drive technical strategy for modernization initiatives, including evolution of legacy systems toward scalable, cloud-native, API-driven, and service-oriented architectures. 

Lead system design across multiple levels of detail, including platform architecture, high-level design, detailed technical design, integration patterns, non-functional requirements, and implementation approach. 

Serve as a hands-on technical contributor, designing, coding, testing, debugging, and delivering production-quality software across the full engineering lifecycle. 

Build and evolve scalable services, APIs, data pipelines, and analytical capabilities using modern engineering practices, cloud platforms, and data technologies such as AWS, Azure, Databricks, Spark/PySpark, and related frameworks. 

Partner closely with product managers, engineering teams, architects, data scientists, QA, security, and operations teams to translate business and functional requirements into robust technical solutions. 

Coordinate and lead technical execution across globally distributed engineering teams, ensuring alignment across regions, time zones, dependencies, design decisions, and delivery milestones. 

Drive architecture and design reviews, code reviews, technical decision-making, and engineering tradeoff discussions to ensure solutions are secure, resilient, observable, performant, maintainable, and aligned with enterprise standards. 

Identify opportunities to improve platform scalability, reliability, developer productivity, operational readiness, and speed of delivery through modernization, automation, reusable patterns, and engineering best practices. 

Provide technical mentorship to junior and mid-level engineers through design guidance, code review, pairing, knowledge sharing, and modeling strong engineering judgment. 

Navigate ambiguity in complex initiatives by clarifying technical direction, decomposing large problems, identifying risks, and driving alignment across stakeholders. 

Champion a culture of engineering excellence, continuous improvement, ownership, collaboration, and high-quality delivery across the team and partner organizations. 

Ideal Candidate Qualifications

8+ years of software engineering experience delivering scalable, high-performance, and reliable software in an agile environment. 

Strong hands-on experience designing and building distributed systems, microservices, RESTful APIs, and cloud-native applications. 

Strong experience with data-intensive applications and analytics platforms; experience with Databricks, Spark, or PySpark, ML is highly desirable. 

Proven expertise leading system architecture, high-level design, detailed design, and end-to-end technical delivery of complex software solutions. 

Experience driving technology modernization initiatives, including cloud adoption, platform transformation, and modernization of legacy applications. 

Hands-on experience with Java/Python, AWS and/or Azure, CI/CD, containerization, Kubernetes, observability, and modern software delivery practices. 

Demonstrated technical leadership as an individual contributor, influencing architecture decisions, driving technical strategy, and leading large cross-team initiatives. 

Ability to translate business and product requirements into scalable, secure, and maintainable technical solutions. 

Excellent collaboration and communication skills, with a proven ability to work effectively across engineering, product, architecture, data science, QA, and operations teams. 

Experience leading and coordinating technical initiatives across globally distributed teams spanning multiple regions and time zones. 

Passion for mentoring and developing engineers through technical guidance, design reviews, and knowledge sharing. 

Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to work through ambiguity, make sound technical decisions, and drive results through hands-on execution. 

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field; advanced degree is a plus. 

Mastercard is an equal opportunity employer that values diversity and inclusion. Applicants will be considered and treated without regard to gender, gender identity, race, color, ethnicity, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, veteran or disabled status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. 

Corporate Security Responsibility

All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must: 

- Abide by Mastercard's security policies and practices; 
 - Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed; 
 - Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
 - Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard's guidelines.

data.title: System Development Engineer, TFS-Onboarding
data.description:
Description

Are you passionate about building automation solutions that transform financial operations at scale? Join Transportation Financial Services (TFS) at Amazon, where you'll develop critical systems that power financial reporting and migrations across our global transportation network. In this role, you'll tackle complex challenges in financial data processing, creating automated solutions that enable accurate book closures and seamless migrations. 

As a SysDE on the TFS team, you'll work on high-impact projects that directly improve how Amazon manages transportation finances. You'll design device automations for large-scale migrations, build metric-generation systems that provide financial visibility, and create mechanisms that proactively address customer issues. Your work will enable business teams to operate more efficiently while ensuring the accuracy and timeliness of financial operations that support millions of deliveries worldwide. 

As an ideal candidate, you have experience in developing automation and operating complex systems in a production environment. You apply system engineering and development practices to ensure your automation is both reliable and correct. Your technical knowledge includes Linux systems and networking. 

Key job responsibilities

Design and implement automated solutions for device migrations and financial system transitions, ensuring minimal disruption to ongoing operations

Develop metric generation systems and reporting tools that enable accurate financial book closures and provide visibility into transportation financial operations

Write clean, maintainable code using optimal data structures and algorithms while considering tradeoffs, limitations, and performance constraints

Troubleshoot and resolve technical issues by addressing support tickets, diagnosing system problems, and implementing solutions that improve customer experience

Enhance existing features and build new capabilities that simplify adoption for internal customers and improve the overall reliability of financial systems

You should be able to triage situations quickly and work well with other engineers. We want you to be the best version of yourself - to continuously evolve and improve

A day in the life

You'll start your day reviewing support tickets and prioritizing issues that impact financial reconciliation and ledger posting configurations accuracy. You might spend developing automated solutions for upcoming migrations, ingestions then collaborate with partner teams to enable new reports needed for monthly and quarterly book closures. You could be enhancing system features to make data adoption easier for business teams or debugging a complex issue in the metric generation pipeline. Throughout the day, you'll participate in code reviews, learn from experienced engineers, and contribute to technical discussions that shape the future of transportation financial systems. 

About The Team

Transportation Financial Services (TFS) is at the heart of Amazon's transportation operations, building the systems that track, report, and analyze financial data across our global delivery network. Our team combines software engineering expertise with financial domain knowledge to create solutions that ensure accuracy, compliance, and operational efficiency. We value collaboration and knowledge-sharing, with team members ranging from early-career engineers to seasoned technical leaders. 

We're focused on modernizing financial operations through automation and building scalable systems that support Amazon's growing transportation business. Our team culture emphasizes mentorship, continuous learning, and taking calculated approaches to solving complex problems. You'll have opportunities to work on meaningful projects that directly impact business decisions while developing your technical skills in cloud computing, data processing, and financial systems. 

Basic Qualifications

- 1+ years of systems development experience
 - Experience in automating, deploying, and supporting infrastructure
 - Experience programming with at least one modern language such as Python, Ruby, Golang, Java, C++, C#, Rust
 - Experience with Linux/Unix

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with CI/CD pipelines build processes

data.description:
Our Purpose

Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we're helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential. 

Title And Summary

Manager, Product Development - EMV and Payment Technology

Overview

Mastercard delivers robust, high quality, and fully approved technology products that enable issuers, acquirers, and partners to bring secure and innovative payment solutions to market. 

Within the Chip Engineering organization, the Product Approval Team plays a critical role in ensuring that these products-ranging from cardholder and acceptance devices to Wallet UIs, mobile applications, and back end systems-meet Mastercard standards and are delivered on time. 

This role provides the opportunity to work globally across a wide spectrum of products, including device-based solutions, wearables, mobile payment applications, cloud based payment systems, transit solutions, and backend services. 

________________________________________

Major Responsibilities

Operational Management

- Lead and manage operations related to Mobile Payment Applications, Wallet UI, Wearables, and Back-End Server Approvals. 
 - Ensure full compliance with Mastercard testing, branding, approval processes, and operational rules. 
 - Oversee the execution of global approval processes and associated requirements for: 
 - Wallet UI and Wearables
 - Merchant Presented QR (MPQR)
 - Cloud-Based Payments (MCBP)
 - Token Service Providers (TSP)
 - Trusted Service Managers (TSM) for SE/TEE-based solutions

Vendor, Partner & Customer Engagement

Data, Reporting & Process Automation

 - Visual Basic developments to automate workflows and accelerate approval operations. 
 - Provide management with quarterly reports covering SLAs, approval volumes, KPIs, and key statistics.

Regional Support

- Support Mastercard Regional teams regarding product approval processes and product migration topics. 

________________________________________

Required Skills & Experience

Education

- University degree in Engineering or equivalent practical experience; advanced degree preferred. 

Professional Background

- 9+ years' experience in quality assurance, project management, or business process engineering. 
 - Industry exposure in one or more of the following: software development, financial services, telecom/mobile, e commerce. 

Technical & Domain Expertise

- Strong understanding of digital payment systems. 
 - In depth knowledge of chip card technology and EMV specifications. 
 - Familiarity with testing and approval methodologies is essential. 
 - Strong proficiency in Microsoft Office, especially Access; Visual Basic development experience required. 

Core Skills

- Excellent analytical and business writing skills. 
 - Strong project management capabilities with the ability to lead cross-functional initiatives without direct authority. 
 - Ability to manage multiple concurrent projects and global stakeholder relationships. 
 - Business acumen and ability to provide solutions while managing customer expectations. 
 - Strong presentation and communication skills, with clarity in explaining concepts and processes. 
 - Self motivated with a strong record of success in team-based environments. 
 - Excellent command of English (Mandarin if possible), both spoken and written. 

Corporate Security Responsibility

All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must: 

- Abide by Mastercard's security policies and practices; 
 - Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed; 
 - Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
 - Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard's guidelines.

data.description:
ETAP empowers customers to make informed decisions throughout the life cycle of their projects with innovative software solutions for electrical systems. By applying ETAP solutions, customers experience continuous intelligence during design and engineering and into operations and maintenance using a unified electrical digital twin platform. ETAP supports customers in their digital transformation and sustainable energy transitions for a green and smart future, helping them to prioritize safety, maximize reliability, and stay resilient. 

Our employees' passion for excellence, innovation, and customer satisfaction is our most-prized resource. If you share that passion - and want to be part of a company that leads the energy transition towards a cleaner and more resilient world for future generations - we invite you to join us!

ETAP is committed to creating a diverse work environment and is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. 

ETAP

Job Description

Job Title: Team Lead - R&D

Location: Delhi, India

Employment Type: Full-time

The job

We are looking for an R&D Technical Lead to lead software development and R&D activities for ETAP Real-Time products. The role focuses on SCADA, ADMS, real-time power-system applications, communication protocols, product testing, and engineering solutions. You will work closely with global R&D, Product Management, QA/Testing, and Project Engineering teams to develop innovative solutions, improve product quality, and address evolving market and customer requirements. This position will contribute to strengthening ETAP's local R&D capabilities in India and supporting software localization and innovation initiatives. 

Key Responsibilities

- Lead and coordinate R&D and product development activities, providing technical guidance, reviewing solutions, mentoring developers, and resolving technical challenges. 
 - Coordinate verification and validation (V&V), functional, integration, and regression testing, ensuring defects and Incident Reports (IRs) are investigated, tracked, and resolved. 
 - Manage development tasks, testing activities, defects, and priorities in Jira, monitor progress against timelines, and communicate risks, blockers, and dependencies. 
 - Evaluate new technologies, communication protocols, and market requirements; develop proofs of concept (PoCs) and contribute to product performance, reliability, scalability, and usability improvements. 
 - Collaborate with global R&D, Product Management, QA/Testing, and Project Engineering teams on technical reviews, release planning, product demonstrations, troubleshooting, and technical documentation. 

Essential Requirements

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Electrical Engineering, Electronics, Instrumentation, or a related technical field. 
 - Typically 3-6 years of relevant experience in software development, R&D, or engineering software, preferably involving SCADA, real-time systems, industrial automation, or power-system applications. 
 - Strong programming knowledge in C#, . NET, or . NET Framework; experience with software design, debugging, performance analysis, and system integration. 
 - Working knowledge of databases and development tools, including SQL, PostgreSQL or SQL Server, REST APIs, Git, and Visual Studio. 
 - Experience coordinating technical activities or guiding development teams, with good problem-solving, planning, communication, and team coordination skills. 

Desired Skills And Competencies

- Knowledge of SCADA, EMS, DMS, OMS, ADMS, FEP, FLISR, real-time monitoring, HMI, alarms, events, trends, and historical data. 
 - Familiarity with industrial communication protocols such as OPC UA/DA, IEC 60870-5-104, DNP3, Modbus, and IEC 61850, along with power-system operation and protection fundamentals. 
 - Experience with V&V, product testing, Jira and Incident Report management, troubleshooting, root-cause analysis, and release coordination; knowledge of C++, Java, Python, Node. js, MongoDB, or AI/ML concepts is an advantage. 
 - Demonstrates technical leadership, curiosity, and a continuous-improvement mindset, with a strong focus on innovation, customer impact, accountability, and collaboration across local and global teams. 

ETAP requires all successful applicants to undergo and pass a comprehensive background check before they start employment. Background checks will be conducted in accordance with local laws and may, subject to those laws, include proof of educational attainment, employment history verification, proof of work authorization, criminal records, identity verification, credit check. Certain positions dealing with sensitive and/or third party personal data may involve additional background check criteria. 

ETAP is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to being an exemplary employer with an inclusive culture, developing a workplace environment where all our employees are treated with dignity and respect. We value diversity and the expertise that people from different backgrounds bring to our business. 

Come and join ETAP to create the transformative technology that enables our customers to engineer a better world.

data.description:
INSPIRE | EXHILARATE | DELIGHT

For over seven decades, Chalhoub Group has been a partner and creator of luxury experiences in the Middle East. In its pursuit to excel as a hybrid luxury retailer, the Group has curated a portfolio of over 10 owned brands and strengthened its distribution and marketing expertise for over 400 international names across luxury fashion, beauty, jewellery, watches, eyewear, and art de vivre categories. 

Every step at Chalhoub Group is taken to build a future where luxury dreams become reality - bridging cultures and crafting memorable experiences for our consumers. Be it by constantly reinventing itself, committing to innovation, or embracing new technologies, the Group is shaping the future of luxury retail. It delivers seamless omnichannel experiences across more than 950 stores, online platforms, and mobile apps. Driving this innovation journey is The Greenhouse - the Group's innovation hub, incubator, and accelerator for startups and emerging businesses, regionally and globally. 

Chalhoub Group fosters a people-at-heart culture rooted in diversity, equity, and inclusion, and a workplace catalysed by forward thinking and future-proofing. Today, it brings together over 16, 000 talented professionals across eight countries in the Middle East, with a presence in LATAM. 

Sustainability is at the core of the Group's strategy, guided by a clear commitment to people, partners, and the planet. Chalhoub Group is proud to be a member of the United Nations Global Compact, a signatory of the Women's Empowerment Principles, and to have pledged to reach Net Zero by 2040. 

What You'll Be Doing

Own the Quality Governance capability, defining enterprise quality standards, managing release quality gates, and tracking defect metrics to continuously improve delivery quality across engineering teams. 

- Define and own enterprise quality standards and QA methodologies across engineering teams, ensuring consistent, high-quality delivery. 
 - Manage release quality gates, governing entry and exit criteria so releases meet defined quality and business requirements before go-live. 
 - Track and analyze defect metrics and quality analytics using tools such as TestRail to identify trends and drive continuous improvement. 
 - Own release management from a quality perspective, ensuring quality sign-off and release readiness across releases. 
 - Own UAT readiness, quality sign-off, and post-release defect triage for major launches, ensuring business and technical stakeholders have clear entry and exit criteria. 
 - Lead and develop the QA team, set technical direction, mentoring engineers, and building QA capability. 
 - Report quality posture, release risk, and defect trends to engineering leadership through concise dashboards and agreed improvement actions. 
 - Partner with engineering and product teams to embed quality practices early in the SDLC and report on quality posture to leadership. 
 - Drive continuous improvement of QA processes, incorporating AI-assisted defect analytics and predictive quality insights to prioritize testing effort. 
 - Plan, design, execute, and document functional, integration, end-to-end, and regression testing for assigned scope. 

What You'll Need To Succeed

- 10+ years of hands-on experience in quality engineering and QA, including defining quality standards and managing release quality gates. 
 - Strong command of QA standards, QA methodologies, release management, and defect analytics, with hands-on experience using tools such as TestRail. 
 - Proven experience leading or mentoring QA engineers and driving continuous improvement in delivery quality. 
 - Understanding quality metrics and reporting to support data-driven quality decisions. 
 - Experience supporting quality governance in ecommerce or retail technology environments with complex integrations, releases, and business cutovers
 - Familiarity with AI-assisted defect analytics and predictive quality insights to enhance testing effectiveness. 
 - Experience with organizing testing for multiple integrated systems

What We Can Offer You

With us, you will turn your aspirations into reality. We will help shape your journey through enriching experiences, learning and development opportunities and exposure to different assignments within your role or through internal mobility. Our Group offers diverse career paths for those who are extraordinary, every day. 

We recognise the value that you bring, and we strive to provide a competitive benefits package which includes health care, child education contribution, remote and flexible working policies as well as exclusive employee discounts. 

Using GenAI in Your Application Process

To support a fair and consistent experience for all candidates, we ask that assessments and interviews are completed independently and without assistance from generative AI tools. This ensures we understand your strengths, your thinking, and how you approach real situations. 

We Invite All Applicants to Apply

It Takes Diversity Of Thought, Culture, Background, Differing Abilities and Perspectives to truly Inspire, Exhilarate and Delight our customers. At Chalhoub Group, we are committed to inclusion and diversity. 

We welcome all applicants to apply and be part of our exciting future. We ensure equal opportunity for all our applicants without regard to gender, age, race, religion, national origin or disability status.

We are looking for an experienced engineer to join our Trading Systems team at our firm's offices in Bengaluru, Hyderabad, or Gurugram. The team builds and maintains critical infrastructure supporting the firm's trading applications, including an in-house messaging middleware platform that delivers latency in the tens of microseconds while processing hundreds of thousands of messages per second, and a firmwide monitoring and alerting framework for front-office technology applications and systems. In this senior individual contributor role, you will serve as the technical authority for both platforms, driving architectural direction, developing performance-critical code, and ensuring their reliability and scalability across trading teams. 

WHAT YOU'LL DO DAY-TO-DAY: 

In this role, you will design, develop, and optimize high-performance systems using Java, with Python and C++ for client libraries and tooling. You will drive architectural decisions involving scalability, sharding, fault tolerance, durability, failover, and real-time data streaming while diagnosing complex production issues related to memory leaks, network connections, message delivery, latency, and alerting. You will also lead critical production changes, releases, disaster recovery exercises, and operational readiness initiatives while minimizing trading impact. Additionally, you will collaborate with trading, feeds, and infrastructure teams to understand requirements, support platform adoption, and resolve technical escalations. You will contribute to engineering excellence through code and design reviews, improved test coverage, mentoring engineers, and developing tools to enhance observability and production diagnostics. 

WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR: 

The ideal candidate should hold-

Basic qualifications: 

- 5 - 6. 5 years of hands-on software engineering experience, with demonstrated ownership of production systems
 - Excellent computer science fundamentals, including data structures, algorithms, operating systems, networking, concurrency, and memory management, with the ability to reason about system performance
 - Expertise in at least one programming language, preferably Java, with an exceptional understanding of JVM internals, garbage collection, and multithreading
 - Experience designing distributed, fault-tolerant, low-latency, or high-throughput systems, with excellent high-level and low-level design skills
 - Exceptional analytical and problem-solving abilities, with experience diagnosing complex production issues and driving them to resolution
 - Sound technical judgment, attention to detail, and the ability to balance system performance, reliability, and operational risk
 - Excellent communication and stakeholder engagement skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across teams and influence technical decisions

Preferred qualifications: 

- Experience with distributed messaging middleware or event-streaming systems
 - Familiarity with monitoring and observability frameworks, including metrics, tracing, dashboards, and alerting
 - Programming experience in Python or C++
 - Experience developing LLM-based or agentic tools and automation frameworks

data.title: Head of Quality & Automation
data.description:
INSPIRE | EXHILARATE | DELIGHT

Chalhoub Group's Capability Hub is our technology and innovation hub set up with the vision to unite exceptional talent to build technology and capabilities that elevate luxury experiences and define the future of luxury retail. 

For over seven decades, Chalhoub Group has been a partner and creator of luxury experiences in the Middle East. In its pursuit to excel as a hybrid luxury retailer, the Group has curated a portfolio of over 10 owned brands and strengthened its distribution and marketing expertise for over 400 international names across luxury fashion, beauty, jewellery, watches, eyewear, and art de vivre categories. 

Every step at Chalhoub Group is taken to build a future where luxury dreams become reality - bridging cultures and crafting memorable experiences for our consumers. Be it by constantly reinventing itself, committing to innovation, or embracing new technologies, the Group is shaping the future of luxury retail. It delivers seamless omnichannel experiences across more than 950 stores, online platforms, and mobile apps. Driving this innovation journey is The Greenhouse - the Group's innovation hub, incubator, and accelerator for startups and emerging businesses, regionally and globally. 

Chalhoub Group fosters a people-at-heart culture rooted in diversity, equity, and inclusion, and a workplace catalysed by forward thinking and future-proofing. Today, it brings together over 16, 000 talented professionals across eight countries in the Middle East, with a presence in LATAM. 

Sustainability is at the core of the Group's strategy, guided by a clear commitment to people, partners, and the planet. Chalhoub Group is proud to be a member of the United Nations Global Compact, a signatory of the Women's Empowerment Principles, and to have pledged to reach Net Zero by 2040. 

What You'll Be Doing

Own the Quality Governance and Automation capability, defining enterprise quality standards, managing release quality gates, and leading test automation and robotic process automation (RPA) to continuously improve delivery quality and operational efficiency across engineering squads. 

- Define and own enterprise quality standards and QA methodologies across engineering squads, ensuring consistent, high-quality delivery. 
 - Manage release quality gates, governing entry and exit criteria so releases meet defined quality and business requirements before go-live. 
 - Track and analyze defect metrics and quality analytics using tools such as TestRail to identify trends and drive continuous improvement. 
 - Own test automation strategy, building and governing automated regression and CI/CD testing frameworks (Selenium / Playwright) to enable shift-left testing and continuous delivery. 
 - Lead the Automation capability, directing the RPA engineers (UiPath) who automate finance, logistics, and HR workflows, and governing bot reliability, error handling, and process digitization standards. 
 - Own UAT readiness, quality sign-off, and post-release defect triage for major launches, ensuring clear entry and exit criteria for business and technical stakeholders. 
 - Lead the adoption of AI in QA and RPA, introducing agentic testing and AI-powered workflows to improve testing and automation. 
 - Lead and develop the quality and automation squad, setting technical direction, mentoring engineers, and building QA, test automation, and RPA capability. 
 - Report quality posture, release risk, and defect trends to engineering leadership, and drive continuous improvement incorporating AI-assisted defect analytics and predictive quality insights. 
 - Remain hands-on: plan, design, execute, and document functional, integration, end-to end, and regression testing, and organize testing across multiple integrated systems for assigned scope. 

What You'll Need To Succeed

- Minimum 9 years of experience in quality engineering, test automation, and QA leadership, including defining quality standards and managing release quality gates. 
 - Strong command of QA standards, QA methodologies, release management, and defect analytics, with hands-on experience using tools such as TestRail. 
 - Expertise in test automation frameworks (Selenium/ Playwright), automated regression, and CI/CD testing, with experience leading RPA delivery (UiPath). 
 - Proven experience leading and mentoring QA and automation engineers and driving continuous improvement in delivery quality. 
 - Experience supporting quality governance in ecommerce or retail technology environments with complex integrations, releases, and cutovers; familiarity with AIassisted defect analytics. 
 - Knowledge of Retail and Digital space. Previous experience with Web, Mobile and Retail oriented Quality Assurance. 

What We Can Offer You

With us, you will turn your aspirations into reality. We will help shape your journey through enriching experiences, learning and development opportunities and exposure to different assignments within your role or through internal mobility. Our Group offers diverse career paths for those who are extraordinary, every day. 

We recognise the value that you bring, and we strive to provide a competitive benefits package which includes health care, child education contribution, remote and flexible working policies as well as exclusive employee discounts. 

Using GenAI in Your Application Process

To support a fair and consistent experience for all candidates, we ask that assessments and interviews are completed independently and without assistance from generative AI tools. This ensures we understand your strengths, your thinking, and how you approach real situations. 

We Invite All Applicants to Apply

It Takes Diversity Of Thought, Culture, Background, Differing Abilities and Perspectives to truly Inspire, Exhilarate and Delight our customers. At Chalhoub Group, we are committed to inclusion and diversity. 

We welcome all applicants to apply and be part of our exciting future. We ensure equal opportunity for all our applicants without regard to gender, age, race, religion, national origin or disability status.

data.title: Sr. Embedded Test Engineer
data.description:
Your role

As a Senior Embedded Test Engineer at Atlas Copco Group, you will play a critical role in ensuring the quality and reliability of embedded software across a range of advanced industrial products. Your responsibilities include comprehensive verification of embedded software through manual and automated testing, collaboration with cross-disciplinary engineering teams to refine requirements, and the development of Python-based automation to expand regression coverage and enhance testing efficiency. 

You will be embedded within a multidisciplinary team responsible for cutting-edge products such as PLC controllers utilizing CODESYS and Straton, vacuum pump controllers, industrial communication modules, and EtherCAT-based devices. This role demands hands-on expertise in setting up and executing functional, integration, and system tests, managing test artifacts within tools such as Jira Xray, and advancing automated testing frameworks integrated with continuous integration pipelines like TeamCity and Jenkins. 

Your day-to-day tasks will also include thorough analysis of test failures through logs and system behavior observations, defect tracking and retesting, and contributing to the continuous improvement of QA practices and automation tools. You will provide technical guidance and mentorship to peers, influencing quality standards and methodologies across projects. 

Technical and Product Environment

You will work with embedded operating systems, network stacks, industrial communication protocols (such as Modbus, EtherNet/IP, EtherCAT, CANopen), hardware interfaces, and automated test systems. This environment balances both legacy and modern technologies, providing a stimulating setting for innovation and technical growth. 

Key Responsibilities

- Collaborate with product owners and developers during sprint planning to ensure test coverage aligns with acceptance criteria. 
 - Create, maintain, and execute detailed test plans and cases, both manual and automated, ensuring traceability to requirements. 
 - Develop and enhance Python-based automation frameworks and scripts to increase regression test efficiency and reliability. 
 - Perform embedded system testing on physical hardware and hardware simulators, including hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) testing. 
 - Analyze, document, and report identified defects, facilitating resolution through close cooperation with the development team. 
 - Integrate automated tests into continuous integration workflows to provide rapid feedback on software quality. 
 - Provide technical leadership in QA best practices, contributing to process improvements, and coaching junior QA engineers. 
 - Maintain detailed test documentation and contribute to project documentation to support compliance and audit requirements. 

To succeed, you will need

- Minimum five years of experience in software testing, with proven expertise in embedded systems and Python automation. 
 - Strong capability in defining and executing functional, integration, and regression test suites based on user requirements. 
 - Experience with test management tools such as Jira Xray, defect tracking, and continuous integration systems like TeamCity or Jenkins. 
 - Ability to independently lead QA activities, prioritize tasks effectively, and provide technical mentorship. 
 - Familiarity with embedded hardware, communication protocols, and debugging methodologies. 

In return, we offer

- Join a prestigious global industrial leader with a legacy spanning over 150 years, committed to innovation and excellence. 
 - Empower your professional growth through a culture that encourages autonomy in research and development initiatives. 
 - Engage in challenging projects developing next-generation embedded systems using advanced technology. 
 - Experience global exposure and career development opportunities through Atlas Copco's extensive internal mobility network. 
 - Benefit from a workplace culture that emphasizes mutual care, sustainability, and social responsibility. 
 - Enjoy a competitive total rewards program, including comprehensive insurance coverage, educational support, and flexible working arrangements to promote work-life balance. 

Job location

This position is based in Pune, India, with a hybrid working model. You will have the flexibility to work partly from our Atlas Copco Group, GECIA premises, and partly remotely. This arrangement supports a healthy work-life balance while maintaining effective collaboration with the onsite team. 

Uniting curious minds

Behind every innovative solution, there are people working together to transform the future. With careers sparked by initiative and lifelong learning, we unite curious minds, and you could be one of them.

data.title: SDET
data.description:
Company Overview

Docusign brings agreements to life. Over 1. 5 million customers and more than a billion people in over 180 countries use Docusign solutions to accelerate the process of doing business and simplify people's lives. With intelligent agreement management, Docusign unleashes business-critical data that is trapped inside of documents. Until now, these were disconnected from business systems of record, costing businesses time, money, and opportunity. Using Docusign's Intelligent Agreement Management platform, companies can create, commit, and manage agreements with solutions created by the #1 company in e-signature and contract lifecycle management (CLM). 

What you'll do

We are seeking a skilled and independent Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET) at the P3 (Career) level to join our Quality Engineering team in Bengaluru. In this role, you will design, develop, and maintain scalable test automation frameworks across enterprise SaaS platforms - including Salesforce, Oracle ERP, MuleSoft integrations, and UiPath workflow automation - ensuring the highest levels of product quality across the end-to-end digital and direct customer journey. A critical differentiator of this role is your ability to independently apply AI testing methodologies - including LLM evaluation, prompt testing, hallucination detection, and AI-assisted STLC practices - to ensure quality for both traditional and AI-powered product features. You will leverage Docusign's internal AI quality tooling (including the Quality Agent powered by CrewAI) and evaluator frameworks (such as Arize AX) to accelerate test delivery and improve coverage consistency. 

This is an individual contributor role reporting to the Senior Manager, SDET. 

Responsibility

- Design, develop, and maintain scalable and reusable test automation frameworks for enterprise applications across Salesforce Sales, Service & Experience Clouds, Oracle ERP, and MuleSoft integrations
 - Independently own test coverage across multiple product components including UI, API, backend, data validation, integration, and regression testing
 - Develop and execute comprehensive test plans, test cases, and test scripts for end-to-end business flows aligned to acceptance criteria
 - Drive shift-left quality practices by partnering with developers and platform architects early in the SDLC to identify testability gaps and integrate quality into design
 - Own test coverage metrics, dashboarding, and quality reporting to leadership
 - Perform exploratory, functional, SIT, regression, and UAT testing for critical releases; support production smoke testing and hypercare post go-live
 - Identify requirement gaps, provide robust edge cases and error-handling scenarios beyond documented functionality, and contribute to continuous quality improvemen
 - Apply Docusign's AI testing framework to evaluate LLM-powered features and agentic AI workflows (e. g. , Quality Agent, XDR Agents, Leads Agent)
 - Design and execute prompt test suites to validate LLM output accuracy, consistency, tone, and alignment with expected outcomes across diverse input scenarios
 - Conduct hallucination detection and post-processing fact-checking for LLM-generated content; validate that AI outputs are grounded in retrieved context
 - Validate training/validation datasets for missing values, data leakage, class imbalance, duplicates, and biased sampling
 - Execute model quality testing using metrics such as accuracy, precision/recall, F1, ROC-AUC, and regression error (MAE/RMSE) as applicable to the model type
 - Verify model behavior under noisy, incomplete, adversarial, or out-of-distribution inputs
 - Validate prompt-injection resistance, jailbreak detection, harmful/toxic content filtering, and secure handling of sensitive data and PII
 - Implement AI evaluator frameworks using tools such as Arize AX for offline evaluation (datasets, experiments) and online testing (tracing, drift monitoring, confidence scoring)
 - Track hallucination rates, latency variability, token cost, and model confidence thresholds in collaboration with MLOps teams
 - Apply human-in-the-loop (HITL) evaluation practices to systematically assess AI output quality - helpfulness, correctness, compliance - where automated metrics are insufficient
 - Leverage Docusign's internal Quality Agent (CrewAI-powered, Azure OpenAI-backed) to accelerate test case generation from Jira user stories, reducing manual effort and improving STLC throughput
 - Test retrieval relevance, semantic search accuracy (Azure AI Search), context window utilization, and end-to-end response quality for RAG-based AI features
 - Build and maintain robust, reusable automation suites for functional, regression, integration, performance, and data validation testing
 - Automate end-to-end business flows using UiPath or equivalent low-code/RPA automation platforms; build solutions that reduce manual effort for repetitive processes
 - Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines (GitLab CI or equivalent) to support rapid, reliable releases and continuous quality gates
 - Develop and maintain data validation automation scripts; perform source-to-target validation, data quality checks (accuracy, completeness, consistency, timeliness), and business rule validations on platforms such as Snowflake
 - Implement performance and load testing strategies (e. g. , JMeter, k6) for high-volume data operations and enterprise application integrations
 - Conduct code reviews with a focus on test quality, reliability, and maintainability; contribute to continuous improvement of the automation system
 - Partner closely with product managers, business analysts, developers, and platform architects to align testing strategy to business outcomes and delivery goals
 - Participate in requirements workshops, sprint ceremonies, change management processes, and go-live support activities
 - Proactively communicate quality risks, test coverage gaps, defect trends, and improvement recommendations to team and leadership
 - Mentor junior SDET and QA team members in automation best practices, AI testing tools, and low-code platform usage
 - Contribute to standardizing quality practices and reporting on overall application quality metrics and KPIs across programs (Digital, Direct, Customer Success, GTM)

Job Designation

Hybrid: Employee divides their time between in-office and remote work. Access to an office location is required. (Frequency: Minimum 2 days per week; may vary by team but will be weekly in-office expectation)

Positions at Docusign are assigned a job designation of either In Office, Hybrid or Remote and are specific to the role/job. Preferred job designations are not guaranteed when changing positions within Docusign. Docusign reserves the right to change a position's job designation depending on business needs and as permitted by local law. 

What you bring

Basic

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field (Master's preferred)
 - 5+ years of experience in QA/SDET roles (or 3+ years with a Master's degree), with at least 3 years focused on test automation for enterprise SaaS applications
 - Strong proficiency in Python for building automation frameworks and AI evaluation scripts
 - Hands-on experience with UI automation tools (UiPath, Selenium, Playwright) and API testing tools (Postman, RestAssured)
 - Hands-on experience with Salesforce platform testing, including Apex testing across Sales, Service, and Experience Clouds
 - Experience integrating automation into CI/CD pipelines (GitLab CI or equivalent) with Git-based version control
 - Strong SQL proficiency for data validation, source-to-target testing, and business rule verification
 - Working knowledge of AI/LLM testing fundamentals: prompt testing, hallucination detection, model quality metrics (F1, accuracy, precision/recall), and AI safety testing concepts
 - Strong understanding of QA best practices, testing methodologies, and Agile/Scrum frameworks
 - Proven experience with Jira and Zephyr Scale for test management and traceability

Preferred

- Hands-on experience with Arize AX or similar LLM observability/evaluation platforms (offline datasets, experiments, online tracing, and drift monitoring)
 - Experience with CrewAI, LangChain, or similar agentic AI orchestration frameworks and approaches to testing multi-agent workflows
 - Familiarity with RAG pipeline testing: retrieval relevance evaluation, vector database validation (Azure AI Search), and semantic search quality assessment
 - Experience leveraging Docusign's internal Quality Agent for AI-assisted test case generation and STLC automation
 - Knowledge of MLOps principles and testing methodologies for validating and monitoring ML models in production (e. g. , data drift detection, model bias testing, A/B evaluation)
 - Experience with performance testing tools such as JMeter, k6, Gatling, or Blazemeter
 - Active Salesforce certifications (e. g. , Platform Developer I, Administrator)Strong defect triage, debugging, and root cause analysis skills

Life at Docusign

Working here

Docusign is committed to building trust and making the world more agreeable for our employees, customers and the communities in which we live and work. You can count on us to listen, be honest, and try our best to do what's right, every day. At Docusign, everything is equal. 

We each have a responsibility to ensure every team member has an equal opportunity to succeed, to be heard, to exchange ideas openly, to build lasting relationships, and to do the work of their life. Best of all, you will be able to feel deep pride in the work you do, because your contribution helps us make the world better than we found it. And for that, you'll be loved by us, our customers, and the world in which we live. 

Accommodation

Docusign is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities in our job application procedures. If you need such an accommodation, or a religious accommodation, during the application process, please contact us at accommodations@docusign. com. 

If you experience any issues, concerns, or technical difficulties during the application process please get in touch with our Talent organization at taops@docusign. com for assistance.

data.description:
The Opportunity

Customer Experience Orchestration (CXO) is a key part of Adobe's strategy to help enterprises deliver personalized and connected customer experiences at scale. 

We are looking for an Engineering Manager to lead a strong engineering team within Adobe Campaign, with a primary focus on driving the product's security strategy and initiatives while providing broader technical and people leadership. 

The Challenge

As an Engineering Manager, you will lead technical execution, people development, and strategic engineering initiatives. Your role will focus on: 

- Security Leadership: Own and drive key security initiatives for Adobe Campaign, working closely with Security and engineering teams to identify risks, prioritize remediation, and continuously strengthen the product's security posture. 
 - Technical Leadership: Drive architecture and technical decisions for complex, scalable, and reliable systems. 
 - People Leadership: Mentor and develop engineers, support career growth, and build a high-performing engineering team. 
 - Engineering Excellence: Drive high standards across software quality, reliability, performance, operational excellence, and engineering practices. 
 - Product Leadership: Partner with Product, Architecture, Quality Engineering, Security, and other stakeholders to translate business and customer needs into effective technical solutions. 

Roles & Responsibilities

- Lead, mentor, and develop a team of software engineers. 
 - Own and drive the security charter for Adobe Campaign, including security improvements, vulnerability remediation, and collaboration with internal security organizations. 
 - Provide technical direction and oversight across the team's engineering initiatives. 
 - Drive scalable, reliable, and maintainable solutions through strong engineering practices and technical decision-making. 
 - Partner with cross-functional teams to define priorities, manage execution, and deliver high-quality outcomes. 
 - Identify and address technical, operational, and architectural challenges. 
 - Drive continuous improvement across engineering processes, systems, and team practices. 
 - Participate in hiring and career development of engineers. 
 - Work effectively with geographically distributed teams in a fast-paced Agile environment. 

Required Skills & Expertise

- 8+ years of software engineering experience, including experience managing engineering teams. 
 - Strong understanding of microservices, distributed systems, cloud architecture, design patterns, and frameworks. 
 - Strong computer science fundamentals and system design experience. 
 - Application security & vulnerability management for enterprise SaaS: Experience with threat modelling, secure code review, source/sink/escaper taint analysis, and remediation of OWASP Top 10 and related vulnerability classes, including injection, broken authentication/authorization, CSRF, SSRF, XXE, XSS, and multi-stage pre-auth RCE chains across native C++, server-side JavaScript, web, and SOAP/REST surfaces. 
 - AI engineering leadership: Strong understanding of LLMs, agentic AI, and AI-assisted software development practices, with the ability to leverage AI to improve developer productivity, code quality, and security review throughput. 
 - Experience with AWS and/or Azure and modern engineering tools and practices. 
 - Strong programming experience in C++, Java, Python, or similar languages. 
 - Experience building scalable and reliable enterprise software. 
 - Strong communication, collaboration, and problem-solving skills. 
 - Bachelor's degree or equivalent in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience driving security initiatives for enterprise software products. 
 - Familiarity with security scanning, CVE remediation, threat modeling, authentication/authorization, or security compliance. 
 - Experience working with large-scale enterprise SaaS products.

Let's Adobe together

Learn more about Adobe life, including our values and culture, focus on people, purpose and community, Adobe for All, comprehensive benefits programs, the stories we tell, the customers we serve, and how you can help us advance our mission of empowering everyone to create. 

Adobe is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based on gender, race or color, ethnicity or national origin, age, disability, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic. Learn more.

AI Use Guidelines for Interviews:

data.title: Supervisor III, Applications Development
data.description:
The Opportunity

Oversees day-to-day operational objectives through the supervision of a team of application development engineers, ensuring efficient software build, release, deployment, and configuration management. Sets objectives that directly impact operational plans, contributing to the implementation of new applications, deployment frameworks, automation processes, and software quality standards. Evaluates and refines work methods, recommending enhancements to improve software implementation effectiveness, deployment efficiency, and system stability. Works on technical challenges that require data analysis, troubleshooting, and strategic consideration of infrastructure dependencies. Communicates regularly with internal teams, including QA, IT, and cloud operations, to align release strategies with organizational priorities. Engages external partners, vendors, and stakeholders to ensure smooth coordination in deployment efforts and software updates. 

About The Role

We are converting this position from contract to full-time. Sanjay built the automation layer that now vets every release. We need someone who owns the quality strategy, manages a small team of test engineers, and keeps our AI-driven test infrastructure running as product demands grow. 

You will report to the Senior QA Manager, Development team. You will work with product, platform, and DevOps teams. You decide what "good enough to ship" means for our applications; you build the systems that prove it. 

What You'll Own

Automation architecture. Design and maintain test frameworks on the Appvance AI Quality Platform. You decide how tests get structured, how data flows through them, and where they plug into our release pipeline. 

- Team management. Directly manage 2-4 test automation engineers. Set their weekly priorities. Review their pull requests. Run 1: 1s. Write their annual performance reviews. You decide who takes which feature area. You decide whether their work meets our standards before it merges. 
 - AI application testing. Build test suites that validate LLM-based features. Test prompt regression. Verify RAG workflows. Detect hallucinations. Validate agent behavior. Use LangChain and LangSmith. 
 - Scripting and tooling. Write and review Appvance Designer Scripts. Write JavaScript/TypeScript code. Build API test suites for REST and GraphQL. You set the coding standards others follow. 
 - CI/CD integration. Wire tests into GitHub Actions, Jenkins, and AWS deployments. When a build fails, your tests tell us why within minutes. 
 - Cross-platform coverage. Ensure web, mobile, desktop, and API layers each have appropriate automated coverage. Cover functional, regression, smoke, integration, end-to-end, security, performance, and database scenarios. 
 - Quality metrics. Track failure rates, flakiness, coverage gaps, and release-blocking defects. Present these to leadership in plain language. 
 - Hiring and growth. Interview candidates for automation roles. Write growth plans for your reports. Push them toward harder problems. Do not let them stay comfortable. 
 - Incident support. Join production release calls. Respond to critical incidents when automation uncovers-or misses-something that hits customers. 

What You've Done Before

- 2-3 years hands-on with the Appvance AI Quality Platform, including Appvance Designer Scripting. 
 - You write clean JavaScript ES6+ and TypeScript. You read production-grade code and you write it. 
 - You tested AI-powered applications with LangChain and LangSmith. You validated prompts. You checked response accuracy. You verified RAG pipelines. 
 - You built or maintained test frameworks for UI, API, database, and cross-browser scenarios. 
 - You integrated test suites into Git, GitHub, Jenkins, GitHub Actions, AWS, and CI/CD workflows. 
 - You worked with SQL (MySQL, PostgreSQL, SQL Server) and NoSQL (MongoDB) data stores. 
 - You know REST APIs, GraphQL, JSON/XML, OAuth 2. 0, JWT. 
 - You worked in Agile/Scrum. You know SDLC, STLC, and defect lifecycle. 
 - You managed or mentored at least one other engineer, even informally. 
 - Bachelor's or master's in CS, IT, or equivalent. 

How You Work

- You debug like a detective. When a test fails, you do not re-run it and hope. You trace the failure to its source. 
 - You write code others can read. Your scripts have clear structure. You comment where needed. Your naming stays consistent. 
 - You communicate across roles. You explain a flaky test to a product manager. You explain a coverage gap to a director. 
 - You care about shipping speed. You know the difference between a test that catches real bugs and a test that slows releases but adds no value. 
 - You give direct feedback. Your reports know where they stand because you tell them. 

Work Environment

- Hybrid, following our Coimbatore office policy. 
 - Primarily computer-based work. 
 - Availability for production releases and critical incidents as needed.

 - Balance short-term delivery needs with long-term maintainability. 
 - Understand trade-offs and make pragmatic engineering decisions.

data.description:
Who We Are

Applied Materials is the global leader in materials science and engineering solutions that are at the foundation of virtually every new semiconductor chip and advanced display in the world. The equipment that we create and service is essential to advancing AI and accelerating the commercialization of next-generation semiconductor chips. Join us and push the boundaries of materials science and engineering in a company at the foundation of the electronics industry. The work we do together advances the world's technology. 

What We Offer

Location: 

Bangalore, IND

You'll benefit from a supportive work culture that encourages you to learn, develop, and grow your career as you take on challenges and drive innovative solutions for our customers. We empower our team to push the boundaries of what is possible-while learning every day in a supportive leading global company. Visit our Careers website to learn more. 

At Applied Materials, we care about the health and wellbeing of our employees. We're committed to providing programs and support that encourage personal and professional growth and care for you at work, at home, or wherever you may go. Learn more about our benefits. 

As a Software Engineer at Applied Materials, you'll dive deep into ground-breaking technologies-like machine learning and AI-to craft novel software solutions that solve our customers' high-value problems. Our Software Engineers are responsible for designing, prototyping, developing, and debugging software solutions for semiconductor equipment components and devices to ensure quality and functionality. You'll develop software documentation and test procedures, troubleshoot software problems, and communicate with internal customers to understand project requirements. As part of our team, you'll contribute your expertise in intricate systems, deciphering code, and anticipating software behaviors to ensure Applied remains the leader in the semiconductor and display sectors. 

Our Team

The YTG group develops, builds, and ships advanced test systems for the display and packaging industry. These systems leverage high-speed electron beam microscopes and custom electronics to acquire signals and images, enabling complex data analysis and image processing to detect defects in memory and processor chips. The software team controls the electron beam and acquires/processes data and images, collaborating across Germany and India. 

Your Opportunity

Join us to shape the next generation of our products by driving end-to-end solutions that span software and hardware. You'll collaborate with experts in Germany and cross-functional teams in Bangalore to deliver customer-focused outcomes, accelerate time-to-market, and uplift engineering efficiency. 

Roles and Responsibilities

- Systems & Architecture Ownership: Lead design discussions and produce architecture artifacts for modules spanning software + hardware interfaces (device I/O, data acquisition, algorithms, GUI/UX). 
 - Hands-on Engineering (C++/Python on Linux): Implement performant, maintainable components and services; define clear interfaces/contracts; contribute to reviews and refactoring. 
 - Build/Run & DevOps Collaboration: Partner with DevOps on CI/CD, artifact hygiene, and observability (logging/metrics/tracing); contribute to reliability. 
 - Performance & Reliability: Design for resilience and rollback; strengthen test strategies (unit/integration/system). 
 - Cross-geo Collaboration: Work closely with engineering counterparts across globe. 

Our Ideal Candidate

- Solution-First Mindset: Think beyond programming languages-own the customer problem and the end-to-end solution across software, hardware, and operations. 
 - Strong Systems Design: Experience designing systems that integrate software + hardware (sensors, motion/controls, device drivers, embedded/RT interactions). 
 - AI-Assisted Development: Comfortable using AI-assisted developer tooling and prompt-based workflows to accelerate design documentation, code scaffolding/refactoring, test generation, and troubleshooting-while verifying outputs and following responsible-use guidelines. 
 - DevOps & Computing Curiosity: Keen to engage with CI/CD, artifact management, containerized build environments, and performance/compute trade-offs. 
 - Collaboration & Communication: Clear communicator who aligns cross-functional stakeholders and documents decisions effectively. 

Qualifications

Education: B. Tech/M. Tech in Computer Science, Electronics, or related fields. 

Experience: Typically, 14-18 years in relevant roles (exceptional candidates outside this range welcome with demonstrated system design depth). 

- Proficiency in C++ (modern standards) and Python on Linux. 
 - Experience with system design and integration across software + hardware platforms. 
 - Familiarity with build tools (e. g. , CMake/Make) and toolchains (gcc/clang); strong debugging/profiling on Linux. 
 - Exposure to testing frameworks and code quality practices (unit/integration, static analysis, formatting/linting). 

Domain Plus: Background in semiconductor is a strong advantage. 

Additional Qualifications (Nice To Have)

- Experience with Qt for GUI/controls. 
 - Exposure to real-time/embedded OS and multi-processor systems. 

Location & Travel

Primary location: Bangalore, India

Skills Matrix

Must-Have

- C++ (modern) and Python on Linux
 - Systems design across software + hardware
 - Linux build & toolchains (CMake/Make, gcc/clang)
 - Testing & code quality practices
 - AI-assisted development (prompt-led, responsible use)

Nice-to-Have

- Qt GUI/controls
 - Real-time/embedded OS experience
 - DevOps collaboration (CI/CD, observability)
