data.title: Supervisor III, Applications Development
data.description:
The Opportunity

Oversees day-to-day operational objectives through the supervision of a team of application development engineers, ensuring efficient software build, release, deployment, and configuration management. Sets objectives that directly impact operational plans, contributing to the implementation of new applications, deployment frameworks, automation processes, and software quality standards. Evaluates and refines work methods, recommending enhancements to improve software implementation effectiveness, deployment efficiency, and system stability. Works on technical challenges that require data analysis, troubleshooting, and strategic consideration of infrastructure dependencies. Communicates regularly with internal teams, including QA, IT, and cloud operations, to align release strategies with organizational priorities. Engages external partners, vendors, and stakeholders to ensure smooth coordination in deployment efforts and software updates. 

About The Role

We are converting this position from contract to full-time. Sanjay built the automation layer that now vets every release. We need someone who owns the quality strategy, manages a small team of test engineers, and keeps our AI-driven test infrastructure running as product demands grow. 

You will report to the Senior QA Manager, Development team. You will work with product, platform, and DevOps teams. You decide what "good enough to ship" means for our applications; you build the systems that prove it. 

What You'll Own

Automation architecture. Design and maintain test frameworks on the Appvance AI Quality Platform. You decide how tests get structured, how data flows through them, and where they plug into our release pipeline. 

- Team management. Directly manage 2-4 test automation engineers. Set their weekly priorities. Review their pull requests. Run 1: 1s. Write their annual performance reviews. You decide who takes which feature area. You decide whether their work meets our standards before it merges. 
 - AI application testing. Build test suites that validate LLM-based features. Test prompt regression. Verify RAG workflows. Detect hallucinations. Validate agent behavior. Use LangChain and LangSmith. 
 - Scripting and tooling. Write and review Appvance Designer Scripts. Write JavaScript/TypeScript code. Build API test suites for REST and GraphQL. You set the coding standards others follow. 
 - CI/CD integration. Wire tests into GitHub Actions, Jenkins, and AWS deployments. When a build fails, your tests tell us why within minutes. 
 - Cross-platform coverage. Ensure web, mobile, desktop, and API layers each have appropriate automated coverage. Cover functional, regression, smoke, integration, end-to-end, security, performance, and database scenarios. 
 - Quality metrics. Track failure rates, flakiness, coverage gaps, and release-blocking defects. Present these to leadership in plain language. 
 - Hiring and growth. Interview candidates for automation roles. Write growth plans for your reports. Push them toward harder problems. Do not let them stay comfortable. 
 - Incident support. Join production release calls. Respond to critical incidents when automation uncovers-or misses-something that hits customers. 

What You've Done Before

- 2-3 years hands-on with the Appvance AI Quality Platform, including Appvance Designer Scripting. 
 - You write clean JavaScript ES6+ and TypeScript. You read production-grade code and you write it. 
 - You tested AI-powered applications with LangChain and LangSmith. You validated prompts. You checked response accuracy. You verified RAG pipelines. 
 - You built or maintained test frameworks for UI, API, database, and cross-browser scenarios. 
 - You integrated test suites into Git, GitHub, Jenkins, GitHub Actions, AWS, and CI/CD workflows. 
 - You worked with SQL (MySQL, PostgreSQL, SQL Server) and NoSQL (MongoDB) data stores. 
 - You know REST APIs, GraphQL, JSON/XML, OAuth 2. 0, JWT. 
 - You worked in Agile/Scrum. You know SDLC, STLC, and defect lifecycle. 
 - You managed or mentored at least one other engineer, even informally. 
 - Bachelor's or master's in CS, IT, or equivalent. 

How You Work

- You debug like a detective. When a test fails, you do not re-run it and hope. You trace the failure to its source. 
 - You write code others can read. Your scripts have clear structure. You comment where needed. Your naming stays consistent. 
 - You communicate across roles. You explain a flaky test to a product manager. You explain a coverage gap to a director. 
 - You care about shipping speed. You know the difference between a test that catches real bugs and a test that slows releases but adds no value. 
 - You give direct feedback. Your reports know where they stand because you tell them. 

Work Environment

- Hybrid, following our Coimbatore office policy. 
 - Primarily computer-based work. 
 - Availability for production releases and critical incidents as needed. 

Disclaimer

The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by employees assigned to this classification. They are not intended to be construed as an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties and skills required of employees assigned to this position. Avantor is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. 

Why Avantor?

Dare to go further in your career. Join our global team of 14, 000+ associates whose passion for discovery and determination to overcome challenges relentlessly advances life-changing science. 

The work we do changes people's lives for the better. It brings new patient treatments and therapies to market, giving a cancer survivor the chance to walk his daughter down the aisle. It enables medical devices that help a little boy hear his mom's voice for the first time. Outcomes such as these create unlimited opportunities for you to contribute your talents, learn new skills and grow your career at Avantor. 

We are committed to helping you on this journey through our diverse, equitable and inclusive culture which includes learning experiences to support your career growth and success. At Avantor, dare to go further and see how the impact of your contributions set science in motion to create a better world. Apply today!

data.title: Assistant Manager - Profee Quality
data.description:
Job Family

Coding Quality OP (India)

Travel Required

Up to 25%

Clearance Required

None

What You Will Do

- Plans, monitors, direct and evaluate QA production on a daily basis. Ensures that daily schedules are met and communicates with Director, and Coding Operations if situations occur that hinder meeting deadlines. If system issues or other emergencies delay QA, an implement measures/schedules to return to established schedules at the earliest possible time. This should be done closely with each quality specialist to ensure the needs are met and that satisfy our client requirements. 
 - Responsible for ensuring that the QA communicates a valid, workable schedule for his or her client each week. Accurate, sensible & on-time. **If this doesn't happen properly, it's the responsibility of the Lead QA Specialist to make it happen promptly. 
 - Review medical record documentation for accuracy in code assignment of the primary/secondary diagnosis and procedures using ICD-9-CM and CPT-4 coding conventions. Sequence the diagnosis and procedures using coding guidelines. When applicable, ensure MS-DRG/APC assignment is accurate. Abstract and compile data from medical records for appropriate optimal/complaint reimbursement for hospital and/or professional charges. This involves reviewing code assignments that are not straightforward or the documentation in the record is inadequate, ambiguous, or unclear for coding purposes. 
 - Answers queries from the quality staff on a day to day basis and escalating to the Director of Coding as necessary. 
 - Meets agreed sampling targets and accuracy. 
 - Keeps abreast of coding guidelines and reimbursement reporting requirements. 
 - Documents QA data on teams of QA/coders and records findings in the QA system (Guide Audit), which will be for reporting to the client, identifying risk areas, development of training and education programs and development/implementation of standardization within the organization. This also involves guidance and mentorship of coders. 
 - Helps to ensure that continuing education is planned, scheduled and completed for all coding/QA teams through the coordination of the US. 
 - Coordinates scheduled quality meetings with the QA and production staff. 
 - Brings identified concerns to Guidehouse's coding compliance management for discussion. 
 - Project Launch - Active involvement in project launch sessions along with team leaders to understand the coding process. 
 - Have a rotational arrangement and is flexible to work with any given team as assigned. 
 - Abides by the Standards of Ethical Coding as set forth by the American Health Information Management Association and adheres to official coding guidelines. -
 - Maintain a thorough understanding of anatomy and physiology, medical terminology, disease processes and surgical techniques to effectively apply ICD-9-CM and CPT-4 coding guidelines to inpatient and outpatient diagnoses and procedures. 
 - Assist with research and development and presentation of continuing education programs on areas of specialization. 
 - Assist with special projects as required. Example: Focused audits; client launches, etc. 
 - Shall understand and abide by the organizations' information security policy and protect the confidentiality, integrity and availability of all information assets. 
 - Shall report incidents related to security of information to concerned authorities. 

What You Will Need

- Key Skills: Medical Coding 
 - Exp. Level: 8+years
 - Qualifications: Accredited medical coders (CCA, CCS, CPC, CPC-H) with at least 6+ years' experience. 
 - Ensure data collection capability in relevant systems and business processes
 - Strong analytical, research, and organizational skills required. 
 - ICD-10-PCS coding systems, ensuring accuracy and compliance with all regulatory and reimbursement requirements

What Would Be Nice To Have

- Superior problem-solving abilities
 - Experience mentoring and training Team Leader and Associates. 
 - A flexible mindset to learn. 
 - Excellent detail-oriented skills and a highly reliable work ethic. 
 - Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Word, Outlook, Excel). 
 - Ready to invest in Automation opportunities for process/business improvement. 

About Guidehouse India

At Guidehouse India, we're redefining what's possible by creating opportunities that change lives. Guidehouse is a global professional services firm that delivers advisory, technology, and managed services to clients across both the commercial and public sectors. Our teams turn bold ideas into solutions that transform industries, strengthen communities, and drive meaningful impact worldwide. 

Across our Chennai, Trivandrum, and Gurugram locations, you'll find opportunities where your passion and curiosity help shape what comes next. With cutting edge benefits, innovative learning and development programs, and a people first culture, we empower our people to lead with purpose. 

We continue to expand our teams and capabilities across India, investing in state-of-the-art offices and high impact work. Here, you'll collaborate with experts from around the world, build deep expertise, explore new domains, and accelerate your professional growth while making a real impact. 

What We Offer

At Guidehouse India, we are committed to supporting the well-being of our people and their families at every stage of life. We offer competitive compensation and a comprehensive benefits package designed to help you thrive both inside and outside the workplace. 

Our benefits include resources such as in house physician consultations, nutritious food options at the workplace, and confidential counseling through our Employee Assistance Program, along with other wellness focused offerings that support your overall well being. 

Our comprehensive learning and development programs ensure you're continuously upskilled and ready to tackle what's next, so you can shape your own career path while contributing to meaningful, purpose driven work. 

Important Fraud Notice

All official recruitment communications from Guidehouse will come from email addresses ending in @guidehouse. com or @myworkday. com. Guidehouse never charges fees, requests money transfers, or collects payments from educational institutions for recruitment events. Please do not share banking or personal financial information with anyone claiming to represent Guidehouse for hiring purposes. 

Contact Us

If you have visited our website to explore career opportunities or to apply for a position and have questions, please contact the Guidehouse Recruiting team at IndiaRecruiting@guidehouse. com. All information you provide will be kept confidential and used only as required to support the recruitment process. 

To learn more about Guidehouse in India, visit www. guidehouse. com/india. 

Guidehouse does not accept unsolicited resumes through or from search firms or staffing agencies. All unsolicited resumes will be considered the property of Guidehouse and Guidehouse will not be obligated to pay a placement fee.

Join us and push the boundaries of materials science and engineering in a company at the foundation of the electronics industry. The work we do together advances the world's technology.

Location: 

Bangalore, IND

We empower our team to push the boundaries of what is possible-while learning every day in a supportive leading global company. Visit our Careers website to learn more. 

At Applied Materials, we care about the health and wellbeing of our employees. We're committed to providing programs and support that encourage personal and professional growth and care for you at work, at home, or wherever you may go. Learn more about our benefits. 

Manager IV, Manufacturing Engineering

OMS Center of Excellence (OMS COE)

ORGANIZATION

~50 engineers, technical leads & managers

PORTFOLIO

Multiple Business Units & product lines

LEADERSHIP

Manager-of-managers; multi-level structure

Position Summary

The Manager IV, Manufacturing Engineering leads the OMS organization across multiple Business Units and is accountable for manufacturing documentation readiness, operational performance, digital transformation, and organizational capability. The role leads approximately 50 engineers through managers and technical leaders and partners with Manufacturing, NPI, Engineering, Quality, Supply Chain, and Operations leadership. 

Key Responsibilities

- Lead and develop a multi-level organization of Manufacturing Engineering Managers, technical leads, engineers, and contractors; own workforce planning, succession, engagement, and leadership development. 
 - Own end-to-end OMS/iOMS delivery across multiple BUs for NPI, HVM, supplier and contract manufacturing, and field installation programs. 
 - Align OMS priorities, capacity, and execution plans with product roadmaps, factory requirements, build schedules, and customer commitments. 
 - Drive OMS readiness, mapping readiness, FTR, OTTC, SLA adherence, productivity, quality-escape reduction, and NC/redline closure performance.

Mechatronics and Process Controls Engineer with 5-8 years of experience in developing and optimizing control solutions for temperature, pressure, flow, and vacuum systems used in semiconductor equipment and advanced industrial automation. Key Responsibilities

 - 5-8 years of experience in process controls, automation, instrumentation, or semiconductor equipment.

data.title: Performance Engineer
data.description:
Job Description

Be part of something bigger. Decode the future. 

At Electrolux, as a leading global appliance company, we strive every day to shape living for the better for our consumers, our people and our planet. We share ideas and collaborate so that together, we can develop solutions that deliver enjoyable and sustainable living. 

Come join us as you are. We believe diverse perspectives make us stronger and more innovative. In our global community of people from 100+ countries, we listen to each other, actively contribute, and grow together. 

Join us in our exciting quest to build the future home. 

All About The Role

As Performance Engineer, you will report directly to the Platform Engineering and SRE Engineering Manager. 

The Performance Engineer will be part of our Cloud Native organization, will work closely with our Product teams in eCommerce, Digital Marketing and other Consumer solutions and be involved in the full Software Lifecycle. We already have a solid, modern Engineering foundation and want to continuously improve in a dynamic, iterative manner. 

You'll own how we prove that our consumer platforms perform at scale: from understanding how customers really use our systems, through designing realistic load and performance tests, to finding bottlenecks and seeing the fixes through. This is both a creative and a detail-oriented role in a very multicultural environment. We want you to be bursting with opinions and passionate about sharing, as well as executing them in a collaborative way. 

About The CDI Experience Organization

The Consumer Direct Interaction Experience Organization is a Digital Product Organization responsible for delivering tech solutions to our end-users and consumers across both pre-purchase and post-purchase journeys. We are organized in 15+ digital product areas, providing solutions ranging from Contact Center, E-commerce, Marketing, and Identity to AI. 

At CDI XO, Electrolux Group's Consumer Direct Interaction Organization, we are transforming everyday life through digital innovation. 

Our engineers help design and build solutions, big and small, to enable a range of highly connected Consumer Market solutions in a modern distributed landscape. Our new team members will be working at the cutting edge of Cloud Native technology and patterns. We strive to develop, build, deploy and run intelligently. 

What You'll Do

- Gather and analyse performance requirements and architectural dependencies with product teams, architects and business stakeholders. 
 - Build workload models from production evidence (observability data, gateway logs, real user monitoring) so that tests reflect how customers actually use our platforms. 
 - Design, develop, execute and monitor the full range of performance tests: load, stress, soak, spike and scalability, at both API and client side. 
 - Create and maintain performance testing frameworks, and integrate them into CI/CD pipelines so performance is checked continuously, not just before a release. 
 - Automate manual and repetitive performance testing activities, and treat test scripts, configuration and dashboards as code (no point and click). 
 - Analyse application, infrastructure and database performance issues, find complex bottlenecks, and drive tuning initiatives through to completion. 

Work across a stack that includes: 

- Observability platforms such as Datadog, Dynatrace, and Azure Monitor. 
 - Enterprise SaaS and PaaS systems in the eCommerce, Finance and Logistics arenas. 
 - Cloud-native architectures on Microsoft Azure, including Kubernetes and microservices. 
 - Build performance dashboards, prepare reports and give clear, evidence-based updates to technical and non-technical stakeholders. 
 - Manage test environments and test data, and make the gaps between test and production environments visible. 
 - Work with SRE colleagues to tie performance targets to SLOs and SLIs, and use test results to protect Error Budgets. 
 - Identify risks and issues early, and give actionable recommendations. 
 - Collaborate with developers, architects, DevOps teams and business stakeholders to choose the right design solutions and make sure performance objectives are met. 
 - Mentor engineers in performance engineering practices, and stay current with tools and industry trends. 

But. . . the most important thing is that you are genuinely passionate about performance engineering and continuous improvement. 

Who Are You

- 5 to 8 years of experience in performance testing and engineering. 
 - 4+ years of hands-on experience with Apache JMeter. 
 - 2+ years of hands-on experience with BlazeMeter. 
 - Strong monitoring experience with Dynatrace and Datadog. 
 - Hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure. 
 - Proficiency in scripting with Java, Python and/or JavaScript. 
 - Strong experience automating performance testing, with CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices. 
 - Good knowledge of SQL and databases such as PostgreSQL. 
 - Experience with client-side performance testing and performance monitoring dashboards. 
 - Proven ability to identify complex performance bottlenecks and give optimisation recommendations. 
 - Knowledge of Kubernetes, microservices and cloud-native architectures. 
 - Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments, including requirement gathering, stakeholder management and sprint-based delivery. 
 - Experience working with customers to understand deployment architectures and use cases. 
 - Strong analytical, troubleshooting and communication skills; self-driven, flexible and able to work independently in a fast-paced environment. 
 - Computer Science/Software Engineering related degree. 
 - Fluent English, written and spoken. 

Desirable Qualifications And Experience

- Knowledge of AWS. 
 - Heap dump and thread dump analysis. 
 - Experience with Git. 
 - Experience with SAP systems, particularly SAP Commerce Cloud. 
 - Strong understanding of Datadog RUM. 

Where you'll be

This is a full-time position, based in Bangalore, India. Immediate joiners are preferred. 

Benefits Highlights

- Flexible work hours and a hybrid work environment
 - Discounts on our award-winning Electrolux products and services
 - Family-friendly benefits
 - Extensive learning opportunities and a flexible career path

About The Role

Grade Level (for internal use): 

11

Role

Lead DevSecOps Engineer - Enterprise Developer Platform and Toolchain

The Team

The Enterprise Developer Platform & Toolchain team owns the platforms, tools and capabilities that support software engineers across S&P Global. Our remit spans DevOps, DevSecOps, FinOps, Platform Engineering, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) and Developer Experience (DevEx). We partner with divisional DevOps/TechOps teams and Information Security (InfoSec) to establish consistent controls and governance across the software development lifecycle (SDLC). As a globally distributed team, we build services, policies and automated controls that secure the developer toolchain while keeping our platforms simple, consistent and engineer friendly. 

The Impact

As Lead DevSecOps Engineer, you will set the direction for how S&P Global secures the way its software is built and delivered. You will own the SDLC security strategy, policy framework and roadmap, lead a team of DevSecOps engineers, and turn policy into automated, sustainable controls across the developer toolchain. Working closely with platform and SRE leaders, divisional DevOps/TechOps teams, InfoSec and Business Information Security Officers (BISOs), you will raise the organisation's security posture and audit readiness - without slowing engineers down. 

What's In It For You

- Enterprise-scale ownership: Lead end-to-end delivery of security controls across GitHub Enterprise, GitHub Actions, OIDC, Checkmarx, SonarQube, Wiz, Artifactory/Xray, Vault, Okta/SailPoint and Splunk. 
 - Emerging technology: Shape governance for AI-assisted development (Copilot controls, MCP, agent guardrails) and software supply chain security (SBOM, signing, SLSA). 
 - Visibility and influence: Engage directly with senior leaders and auditors on high-profile initiatives tied to company strategy, across frameworks including SOX, SOC 2, ISO 27001 and NIST SSDF. 
 - Growth: Build and grow a team, and access innovation projects, training, knowledge sharing and support for security certifications such as CISSP, CISM and CSSLP. 

Responsibilities

Strategy and Leadership

- Own the SDLC security strategy, policy framework and roadmap, aligned with InfoSec and audit requirements. 
 - Lead, mentor and grow a team of DevSecOps engineers, and drive delivery of toolchain hardening programmes. 
 - Report on security posture, risk and remediation progress to senior stakeholders. 
 - Partner with platform, SRE and engineering leaders to ensure controls are automated, sustainable and widely adopted. 

Security Engineering and Tooling

- Define and implement baseline security policies and automated guardrails across source control and CI/CD environments. 
 - Integrate, manage and tune code quality and application security tools, including SonarQube, Checkmarx and Wiz, within developer workflows. 
 - Harden build infrastructure and software supply chain controls, including artifact management with JFrog Artifactory/Xray. 
 - Provision, secure and optimise AWS services supporting the developer platform, including EC2, ECS/EKS, Lambda, S3, IAM and CloudFormation/CDK. 
 - Lead security architecture reviews and incident response for toolchain security events. 

Governance, Risk and Compliance

- Govern application security and supply chain tooling, including exception management and remediation service-level agreements (SLAs). 
 - Triage security findings, prioritise vulnerabilities by risk and track remediation to closure. 
 - Establish governance for credentials, secrets and non-human identities across the developer toolchain. 
 - Define governance for AI-assisted development tools and developer endpoint security. 
 - Monitor sensitive configuration changes, implement alerting and own audit readiness and compliance evidence. 

What We're Looking For

Experience and Leadership

- 8+ years of experience in DevSecOps, application security or security engineering, including leading teams or programmes. 
 - Proven ability to define security policy and standards, translate them into technical enforcement, and drive adoption across a large organisation. 
 - Strong knowledge of compliance frameworks (e. g. , SOX, SOC 2, ISO 27001) and identity governance. 
 - Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence engineering teams and senior leaders. 

Technical Skills

- Deep expertise in designing, automating and securing enterprise-scale CI/CD pipelines, including common pipeline and source control threats. 
 - Hands-on knowledge of GitHub Enterprise Cloud, GitHub Actions, runners, rulesets and policies. 
 - Strong understanding of repository lifecycle management and Git practices, including Conventional Commits, semantic versioning, trunk-based development/GitFlow and pull request workflows. 
 - Hands-on experience with static application security testing (SAST), software composition analysis (SCA), secrets scanning and cloud security tooling. 
 - Knowledge of identity and access management, including single sign-on (SSO), role-based access control (RBAC) and least privilege. 
 - Proficiency with infrastructure as code (Terraform, CloudFormation or CDK) and familiarity with configuration management tools. 
 - Experience with AWS compute, networking, storage, IAM and container orchestration (ECS/EKS), including AWS security best practices. 
 - Strong scripting and automation skills in Python or Bash; familiarity with TypeScript/Node. js. 
 - Understanding of configuration management databases (CMDBs) and ITIL-aligned change management, including approvals and audit trails. 
 - Awareness of AI tool governance and developer endpoint security, including mobile device management (MDM). 

Nice to Have

- Experience with AI-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot and Cursor, and with developer agents/MCP integrations. 
 - Contributions to open-source Backstage plugins or internal developer platform (IDP) ecosystems. 
 - Familiarity with compliance as code and policy engines such as OPA or Sentinel. 
 - Experience with software supply chain frameworks and practices such as SLSA, SBOM generation and artifact signing. 
 - Security certifications such as CISSP, CISM, AWS Certified Security - Specialty. 
 - Cloud or Kubernetes certifications such as AWS Solutions Architect, AWS DevOps Engineer, CKA or CKAD. 

Technical Environment

Area

Tools and Practices

Source Control & CI/CD Security

GitHub Enterprise security features, GitHub Actions hardening, OIDC and GitHub Apps

Application Security

SAST/SCA tooling, including Checkmarx, SonarQube and GitHub Advanced Security (GHAS)

Cloud & Container Security

Wiz or similar cloud security posture management (CSPM) and vulnerability tools

Software Supply Chain

JFrog Artifactory/Xray or similar, software bills of materials (SBOMs) and artifact signing

Secrets & Identity

HashiCorp Vault or other secrets managers, Okta/SailPoint and non-human identity governance

Runners & Endpoints

Runner hardening tools and mobile device management (MDM)

AI Governance

GitHub Copilot controls, MCP and agent guardrails

Monitoring

Splunk or similar security information and event management (SIEM) tooling

Automation & Cloud

Python, Bash, Terraform and AWS security services (IAM, KMS)

Leadership

Policy frameworks, risk reporting and audit engagement

Preferred Qualifications

Bachelor's degree or higher in Computer Science, Information Security or a related technology field, or equivalent practical experience. 

What's In It For You?

Our Mission

Advancing Essential Intelligence. 

Our People

We're more than 35, 000 strong worldwide-so we're able to understand nuances while having a broad perspective. Our team is driven by curiosity and a shared belief that Essential Intelligence can help build a more prosperous future for us all. From finding new ways to measure sustainability to analyzing energy transition across the supply chain to building workflow solutions that make it easy to tap into insight and apply it. We are changing the way people see things and empowering them to make an impact on the world we live in. We're committed to a more equitable future and to helping our customers find new, sustainable ways of doing business. Join us and help create the critical insights that truly make a difference. 

Our Values

Throughout our history, the world's leading organizations have relied on us for the Essential Intelligence they need to make confident decisions about the road ahead. We start with a foundation of integrity in all we do, bring a spirit of discovery to our work, and collaborate in close partnership with each other and our customers to achieve shared goals.

Smarsh is a global leader in digital communications compliance and intelligence. We help the world's most regulated industries - financial services, healthcare, government - capture, archive, and analyse communications at scale. Our Cognition Engineering organisation is at the heart of this mission, building the AI and ML capabilities that power Smarsh's next generation of products

About the role

We are looking for an experienced Engineering Manager to lead and grow the Cortex team. This is a hands-on leadership role: you will manage a talented team of ML and delivery engineers, drive technical delivery of AI service initiatives, and help define the direction of Smarsh's AI platform capability. 

You will report directly to a Senior ML Engineering Manager and will be the primary engineering leader for the Cortex team on the ground in Bangalore. You will work closely with Smarsh's Applied Machine Learning team - who build and train our in-house models - as well as Product Management, Technical Program Management (TPM), the Fabric platform organization, and sister Cognition teams: Cognition Logic and Cognition Analytics, all part of the wider Enterprise Conduct organisation. 

This role is AI-first. You will be expected to champion and actively use AI-powered engineering productivity tools - including Windsurf and Claude Code - and embed these practices into the team's day-to-day ways of working. 

What You Will Do

Team Leadership & People Management

- Lead, mentor and grow a team of 4 ML Engineers and 1 Delivery Engineer across India and the UK. 
 - Run effective 1: 1s, performance conversations, and career development planning. 
 - Foster a high-trust, high-performance team culture grounded in continuous improvement. 
 - Manage hiring, onboarding, and team capacity planning as Cortex expands. 

Technical Delivery & Model Operations

- Own end-to-end delivery of Cortex initiatives - from planning and scoping to production release and post-go-live operational support. 
 - Drive delivery of new capabilities including Audio Analytics as a Service, In App Translation and Intelligent Agent Review. 
 - Work closely with the Applied ML team to take in-house models from research handoff through to production-grade deployment - managing integration, validation, and operational readiness. 
 - Own and evolve Cortex's gated model deployment pipeline: ensuring models progress through automated quality gates, shadow mode, canary, and full rollout stages with clear promotion and rollback criteria. 
 - Establish model evaluation and monitoring frameworks - tracking quality, performance drift, and SLO compliance in production. 
 - Maintain and improve Cortex's operational SLOs, reliability posture, and incident response process. 
 - Ensure engineering practices, code quality, and architectural decisions meet Smarsh engineering standards. 

AI-First Ways of Working

- Actively use and champion AI productivity tooling: Windsurf, Claude Code, and similar tools. 
 - Set the standard for how the team leverages AI-assisted development to increase velocity and code quality. 
 - Identify and help to introduce new AI tooling where it adds measurable value to the team. 

Technical Strategy, Stakeholder Management & Developer Experience

- Contribute to the Cortex technical roadmap, working with engineering leadership, Product Management, and TPM to align delivery to business priorities. 
 - Build strong working relationships with the Applied Machine Learning team - acting as a bridge between model development and production AI service deployment. 
 - Partner closely with sister Cognition teams - Cognition Logic and Cognition Analytics - to align on shared platform patterns, APIs, and service contracts within the Enterprise Conduct organisation. 
 - Engage proactively with the Fabric organisation on infrastructure, platform standards, and shared tooling dependencies. 
 - Represent Cortex in cross-team forums, architecture reviews, and planning sessions - advocating for Cortex consumers' developer experience. 
 - Help to drive the AI Service Catalogue vision: discoverable, well-documented, and operationally excellent services that product engineers across Smarsh can consume with confidence

What You Bring

- 2+ years of engineering management experience, ideally in an AI/ML, platform, or MLOps context. 
 - Solid track record of delivering production ML or AI services at scale. 
 - Experience working at the interface between applied research or ML teams and production engineering - you understand how to take a model from handoff to a reliable, monitored service. 
 - Experience managing distributed teams across geographies and time zones. 
 - Demonstrated ability to build trusted relationships with Product, TPM, and platform stakeholders - translating business priorities into engineering plans and vice versa. 
 - Experience with COGs analysis and FinOps practices for AI/ML workloads - you understand how to track, attribute, and optimise infrastructure and inference costs, and can make informed build vs. buy decisions on managed services. 
 - Solid release management and planning experience - you can own a release calendar, coordinate cross-team dependencies, manage risk gates, and ensure smooth, well-communicated production deployments. 
 - Hands-on engineering background - you can credibly engage with technical design decisions and code reviews. 

Technical Skills

- Proficiency in Python; familiarity with Kotlin or JVM-based frameworks is a plus. 
 - Experience with cloud-native AI/ML infrastructure: AWS (Bedrock, SageMaker, EKS), Kubernetes, and Kafka. 
 - Solid understanding of audio and NLP model architectures - specifically Parakeet (ASR), NeMo framework, and XLM-R based multilingual models. 
 - Solid MLOps foundations with practical production experience across the full model lifecycle - including experiment tracking, model registry management, gated deployment strategies (shadow mode, canary, blue/green with automated quality gates), drift detection, rollback handling, and SLO-linked promotion criteria. 
 - Understanding of ML model serving patterns, including inference optimisation and managed inference platforms (e. g. Triton Inference Server). 
 - Solid understanding of modern AI/ML architectures and system design patterns - including transformer-based models, agentic workflows, RAG, and multi-agent orchestration - with the ability to engage credibly in technical design discussions and evaluate trade-offs. 
 - Comfort with operational excellence practices: SLOs, observability, incident management, and on-call culture. 

AI Productivity & Tooling

- Active user of AI-powered coding assistants (Windsurf, Claude Code, or similar). 
 - Genuine conviction that AI tooling meaningfully accelerates engineering teams - and a desire to prove it. 
 - Ability to coach engineers on effective use of AI tools and to separate hype from practical value. 

Leadership & Communication

- Clear, direct communicator - able to translate complex technical topics for non-technical stakeholders. 
 - Data-driven approach to engineering decisions and team health. 
 - Comfortable with ambiguity and capable of bringing structure to new problem spaces. 
 - Collaborative leader who builds trust quickly across cultures and time zones. 

Why Smarsh?

Smarsh hires lifelong learners with a passion for innovating with purpose, humility and humor. Collaboration is at the heart of everything we do. We work closely with the most popular communications platforms and the world's leading cloud infrastructure platforms. We use the latest in AI/ML technology to help our customers break new ground at scale. We are a global organization that values diversity, and we believe that providing opportunities for everyone to be their authentic self is key to our success. Smarsh leadership, culture, and commitment to developing our people have all garnered Comparably. com Best Places to Work Awards. Come join us and find out what the best work of your career looks like

The Director of DevOps & Platform Engineering Gracenote India will be central to the success of our infrastructure, cloud platform, and engineering enablement teams across geographies. Responsibilities

Qualifications

- Bachelor's/Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering. 
 - 12+ years of experience working in DevOps, Cloud Infrastructure. 
 - Proven track record in people management, team building, and leading multi-disciplinary DevOps teams in a global environment. 
 - 8-10 years of hands-on experience with cloud infrastructure, CI/CD tools, Infrastructure as Code (e. g. , Terraform, CloudFormation), and scripting (Python, Shell, Go, etc. ). 
 - 5+ years of dedicated experience managing production AWS environments at scale, specifically focusing on Amazon EKS and AWS native managed services (AWS Glue, MSK, EMR, S3, RDS, DynamoDB). 
 - Deep expertise in open-source and custom observability tools, particularly Grafana, Loki, Prometheus, OpenTelemetry, or ELK stack. 
 - Proven track record in FinOps-managing cloud budgets, identifying cost inefficiencies, implementing auto-scaling/spot instances, and tracking cloud spend metrics. 
 - Strong foundation in Kubernetes architecture, containerization, microservices deployment, and networking/security policies. 
 - Good understanding of enterprise workflow and business tools such as JIRA, Confluence, OpsGenie, Gitlab, and CI/CD tools (e. g. , Jenkins, GitLab CI). 
 - Strong critical thinking, incident response leadership, and analytical problem-solving skills. 
 - Sense of curiosity, operational discipline, and high attention to detail. 

Additional Information

Please be aware that job-seekers may be at risk of targeting by scammers seeking personal data or money. Nielsen recruiters will only contact you through official job boards, LinkedIn, or email with a nielsen. com domain. Be cautious of any outreach claiming to be from Nielsen via other messaging platforms or personal email addresses. Always verify that email communications come from an @nielsen. com address. data.title: Staff Software Engineer, Developer Experience
data.description:
Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human

Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence. 

This is an opportunity to do career-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk. 

About the Team  Authentication tells you who someone is. Authorization decides what they can do, and doing that well at scale is hard. Role-based access breaks down as applications grow, and AI agents are changing who, and what, asks for access. Auth0 FGA solves this with fine-grained authorization. Its engine is OpenFGA, a CNCF incubating open source project that Okta maintains with contributors from other companies, and Auth0 FGA runs that same engine as a managed service. 

FGA DevEx owns how developers experience both: our SDKs, CLI, IDE plugins, Helm charts and docs, all developed in the open. The FGA group owns its product end to end, from infrastructure to docs, so we move quickly and see our work reach developers. 

Our guiding principle: one developer experience, many deployment models. 

About the role  We're hiring a Staff Engineer to set the technical direction for everything the team owns, and to mentor the senior engineers who build it, starting with our SDKs in Go, JavaScript, . NET, Python, Java and more. From there, you'll shape where the developer experience goes next, from how our SDKs evolve to new surfaces like MCP servers. You'll partner with the Core team on API design, so every new capability feels natural in each language. 

This is an individual contributor role. You'll work closely with the engineering manager, who owns people and delivery

ResponsibilitiesSet the direction: 

- Define and drive the technical direction for FGA DevEx across open source and SaaS, and turn it into a roadmap with the engineering manager and the product team. 
 - Build support for that direction across the team, the FGA group and open source community  
 - Mentor the team's senior engineers, and raise the level of everyone around you. 
 - Establish how a new team builds software, from design reviews and coding standards to how we test and ship, and set the quality bar. 
 - Make the calls that are hard to undo: when an API is ready to ship across every language, how it evolves, and when to deprecate. 
 - Be the voice of developer experience across FGA: partner with the Core team on API design and with internal teams such as Integrations, and flag developer friction wherever you see it. Own the Platform:   

- Architect our SDKs in Go, JavaScript, . NET, Python and Java, including the generator every client is built from. 
 - Set the standards every SDK follows, from authentication and error handling to retries and rate limiting. 
 - Shape the tooling and content around the SDKs: the CLI, IDE integrations, Helm charts, GitHub automation, docs and examples. 
 - Drive the release and versioning strategy across all divisions  
 - Grow our open source community: build the contributor and maintainer base beyond the team today, and make it easy for outside developers to contribute. Requirements
 - 8+ years as a software engineer, including time leading the technical direction of a team or a significant area, with or without the title. 
 - Strong proficiency in at least one of Go, JavaScript/TypeScript, C#/. NET, Python or Java, and the curiosity to work across several. 
 - Experience building software other developers use: SDKs, API clients, libraries, developer platforms, CLIs or tooling. 
 - A strong sense of API design and ergonomics, and of how an interface should feel in different languages. 
 - Clear communication and a track record of influencing decisions across teams and with outside contributors, without relying on authority. Nice to have

- Contributing to, maintaining or leading open source projects. 
 - Building with code generation tools such as OpenAPI Generator and templating frameworks. 
 - Designing resilient clients: authentication flows, retries and rate limiting. 
 - Setting up GitHub Actions and release automation. 
 - Working in authorization or identity, such as OAuth, RBAC or ReBAC. #P24600_3385570

  

The Okta Experience

- Supporting Your Well-Being  
 - Driving Social Impact  
 - Developing Talent and Fostering Connection + CommunityWe are intentional about connection. Our global community, spanning over 20 offices worldwide, is united by a drive to innovate. Your journey begins with an immersive, in-person onboarding experience designed to accelerate your impact and connect you to our mission and team from day one.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, ancestry, marital status, age, physical or mental disability, or status as a protected veteran. We also consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and convictions records, consistent with applicable laws.

Here, we feel empowered, supported, and inspired to grow. 

Are you ready to love your job?

The adventure begins right here, with you, at SITA. 

About The Role & Team

As Senior Software Developer, please focus on our customers to give them a secure, reliable, system. You will be working with a diverse team of like-minded people trained in various other technologies. We work together to deliver valuable software changes efficiently. We use automation, and the latest technologies to improve our productivity, without sacrificing quality. We use continuous-improvement feedback loops to streamline our software development.

 - Help the team estimate the complexity of technical work.

ABOUT YOUR SKILLS

- A graduate in computer sciences or engineering is essential, with at least 5 years of experience in C#

 - Good experience of microservice architecture and JSON REST APIs.

 - Solid knowledge of the defect life cycle: why, what, and when we should test. 
 - Solid knowledge of how to write and design object-oriented code. If you have used design patterns, that would be advantageous.

We're all about diversity. We operate in 200 countries and speak 60 different languages and cultures. We're really proud of our inclusive environment. You will experience these qualities of passion, pride and aspiration in many ways - from a rich set of career development programs to support of community service projects to social events that foster fun and relationship building across our global community. 

The Role

The driving force behind our success has always been the people of AspenTech. Founded more than 30 years ago by the best and brightest engineers at MIT, we continue to tackle the most complex challenges in process manufacturing. Our aspenONE software enables our customers to achieve operational excellence by increasing capacity, improving margins, and reducing costs, while becoming more energy efficient, ensuring safety, and shrinking their carbon footprint. This is a place where people are fiercely passionate about technology and have a desire to make a difference through the application of engineering and software technologies to solve real business problems. As a Software Developer with focus on software packaging and deployment, you will build and maintain software deployment solutions for our aspenONE software and push the deployment technology to make it easier for our customers to adopt our latest technologies. Based in our Pune, India office you will collaborate closely with other members of geographically dispersed Products teams, coordinating closely with colleagues focused on delighting customers via delivering robust products. 

Your Impact

We are seeking an experienced Software Developer with 8-12 years of software development experience to design, develop, test, and maintain high-quality software solutions across desktop, web, cloud, and deployment environments. 

The ideal candidate will have strong programming and software engineering skills, a solid understanding of the end-to-end software development lifecycle, and experience with software architecture, design, development, testing, build, and deployment. The candidate should be a strong problem solver and communicator who can collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams to deliver reliable, scalable, secure, and maintainable software. 

The successful candidate should also be proficient in leveraging AI-assisted development tools to improve development efficiency, accelerate coding and troubleshooting, enhance testing and documentation, and improve overall software quality while applying sound engineering judgment to validate AI-generated solutions. 

- Design, develop, test, and maintain high-quality software solutions across desktop, web, cloud, and deployment environments.

 - Participate in all phases of the software development lifecycle, including requirements analysis, architecture and design, implementation, code review, testing, deployment, troubleshooting, and maintenance. 
 - Contribute to software architecture and technical design, evaluating alternatives and making sound technical decisions based on scalability, reliability, security, performance, and maintainability.

 - Experience with version control and software configuration management systems, including Git and/or Perforce. 
 - Experience with container technologies, such as Docker and Kubernetes.

Job Description

We are looking for a Senior Full Stack Engineer with deep expertise in backend application development and Microsoft Azure deployment engineering. The role will primarily own backend services, APIs, integrations, data access, application security, CI/CD, cloud hosting, observability, and production readiness. The ideal candidate will also have working exposure to AWS and/or Google Cloud Platform and enough frontend understanding to collaborate effectively with React and TypeScript engineers. 

Responsibilities

- Backend Engineering and API Ownership

Develop and maintain scalable backend services using . NET, C#, and ASP. NET Core. 

Build secure REST APIs, integrations, and core business logic. 

Implement authentication and authorization using OAuth 2. 0, OpenID Connect, and Microsoft Entra ID. 

Design and optimize data models, repositories, and data access layers. 

Develop resilient integrations with internal and external systems using secure and asynchronous patterns. 

- Azure Deployment and Platform Engineering

Design, deploy, and maintain cloud solutions on Microsoft Azure. 

Build and manage services using Azure App Service, Functions, API Management, Storage, SQL, and Key Vault. 

Develop CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps and GitHub Actions. 

Implement monitoring, security, configuration management, and production readiness practices. 

Contribute to containerization and Infrastructure as Code using Docker, Bicep, Terraform, or similar technologies. 

Apply Azure best practices for security, scalability, reliability, and cost optimization. 

- Multi-Cloud and Full Stack Collaboration

Apply cloud architecture principles across Azure, AWS, and GCP. 

Contribute to cloud deployment, security, and operational practices. 

Collaborate with frontend teams to integrate backend services with React and TypeScript applications. 

Support end-to-end application integration, troubleshooting, and AI-enabled solutions. 

- Architecture, Quality, and Deliver

Contribute to solution design, architecture, and technical estimations. 

Develop high-quality, secure, and maintainable code following engineering best practices. 

Perform code reviews and contribute to technical standards and reusable solutions. 

Implement automated testing and support performance, security, and reliability. 

Support end-to-end delivery, deployment, and production operations. 

Qualifications

Must Have Qualifications

6-8 years of software engineering experience with a strong backend focus. 

Strong hands-on experience with C#, . NET, ASP. NET Core, RESTful APIs, and backend design patterns. 

Proven experience designing, deploying, and supporting applications on Microsoft Azure. 

Strong understanding of CI/CD, infrastructure automation, observability, and application security. 

Experience with Azure App Service, Functions, API Management, Storage, Azure SQL, Key Vault, and Entra ID. 

Experience with Git, automated testing, containers, and agile engineering practices. 

Working knowledge of React, TypeScript, JavaScript, and modern web application architecture. 

Experience with microservices, messaging, asynchronous processing, and distributed system integration patterns. 

Hands-on exposure to AWS and/or GCP services, deployment models, and operational practices. 

Experience with Kubernetes or managed container platforms. 

Preferred / Nice-to-Have Skills

Experience implementing cloud architecture and deployment patterns across multiple cloud platforms. 

Experience with event-driven architecture and serverless application development. 

Exposure to AI-enabled applications, Azure AI services, LLM integrations, or Python-based services. 

Experience building enterprise SaaS products or solutions for public-sector or regulated environments. 

Exposure to GIS / geospatial features, map APIs, or document-driven platforms. 

Ideal Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate is a backend-oriented engineer with full-stack awareness who can independently own services, APIs, data, security, Azure deployments, and operational readiness. The candidate should be comfortable making sound technical decisions and collaborating closely with frontend, AI, cloud, and architecture teams. Azure expertise is the primary requirement; AWS and/or GCP exposure provides additional value and broader cloud perspective.

data.description:
The driving force behind our success has always been the people of AspenTech. What drives us, is our aspiration, our desire and ambition to keep pushing the envelope, overcoming any hurdle, challenging the status quo to continually find a better way. You will experience these qualities of passion, pride and aspiration in many ways - from a rich set of career development programs to support of community service projects to social events that foster fun and relationship building across our global community. 

The Role

The driving force behind our success has always been the people of AspenTech. Founded more than 30 years ago by the best and brightest engineers at MIT, we continue to tackle the most complex challenges in process manufacturing. Our aspenONE software enables our customers to achieve operational excellence by increasing capacity, improving margins, and reducing costs, while becoming more energy efficient, ensuring safety, and shrinking their carbon footprint. This is a place where people are fiercely passionate about technology and have a desire to make a difference through the application of engineering and software technologies to solve real business problems. As a Software Developer with focus on software packaging and deployment, you will build and maintain software deployment solutions for our aspenONE software and push the deployment technology to make it easier for our customers to adopt our latest technologies. Based in our Pune, India office you will collaborate closely with other members of geographically dispersed Products teams, coordinating closely with colleagues focused on delighting customers via delivering robust products. 

Your Impact

We are seeking an experienced Senior Software Developer with 4-7 years of professional software development experience to design, develop, test, and maintain high-quality software solutions across desktop, web, and cloud environments. 

The ideal candidate will have strong programming and problem-solving skills, a solid understanding of software design and architecture, and hands-on experience throughout the software development lifecycle, including requirements analysis, design, implementation, testing, deployment, troubleshooting, and maintenance. The candidate should be able to independently deliver complex software features and components while collaborating effectively with developers, architects, QA, DevOps, product teams, and other cross-functional stakeholders. 

The successful candidate should also have experience leveraging AI-assisted development tools to improve development efficiency and software quality, including accelerating coding, debugging, testing, code review, troubleshooting, and documentation, while applying sound engineering judgment to validate AI-generated solutions. 

- Design, develop, test, deploy, and maintain high-quality software applications, services, and components across desktop, web, and cloud environments. 
 - Write clean, efficient, secure, maintainable, and well-tested code following established software engineering standards and best practices. 
 - Participate in all phases of the software development lifecycle, including requirements analysis, technical design, implementation, code review, testing, deployment, troubleshooting, and maintenance. 
 - Contribute to software design and architecture, evaluating technical alternatives and developing solutions that consider scalability, reliability, performance, security, and maintainability. 
 - Develop software applications, services, APIs, utilities, and automation using technologies such as C#, C++, and other appropriate programming and scripting languages. 
 - Develop and maintain desktop and web applications using modern development technologies, frameworks, and application architectures. 
 - Develop and support applications and services for cloud environments, including AWS and Azure. 
 - Develop and maintain unit, integration, and automated tests to ensure software quality, reliability, and regression prevention. 
 - Leverage AI-assisted development tools to improve efficiency across software design, coding, debugging, testing, code review, refactoring, troubleshooting, and technical documentation. 
 - Critically review and validate AI-generated code and technical recommendations to ensure correctness, security, performance, quality, and maintainability. 
 - Collaborate effectively with developers, architects, QA, DevOps, product teams, and other stakeholders to understand requirements, develop technical solutions, and resolve complex issues. 
 - Participate actively in technical design reviews, code reviews, technical discussions, and knowledge sharing within the development team. 
 - Integrate software development and delivery processes with version control systems such as Git and Perforce and automated CI/CD pipelines. 
 - Work with container technologies, such as Docker and Kubernetes, to support modern application development and deployment environments. 
 - Work with SQL and NoSQL database technologies as required by application designs and product architectures. 
 - Troubleshoot complex software issues, perform root-cause analysis, and implement effective and sustainable solutions. 
 - Apply Agile development practices to deliver high-quality software in a timely and predictable manner. 
 - Provide technical guidance and share software development best practices with less-experienced developers. 
 - Identify opportunities to leverage AI, automation, and modern development tools to reduce repetitive work, streamline development workflows, and improve engineering productivity and software quality. 

What You'll Need

- 4-7 years of professional software development experience, with demonstrated experience designing, developing, testing, and maintaining production software. 
 - Strong programming and coding skills, with the ability to independently design, implement, test, debug, and maintain complex software components and features. 
 - Strong proficiency in C# and/or C++, with a solid understanding of object-oriented programming and modern software development practices. 
 - Strong understanding of software engineering principles, object-oriented design, design patterns, data structures, algorithms, and software design concepts. 
 - Solid understanding of software architecture principles and the ability to translate product and technical requirements into effective software designs. 
 - Strong understanding of the end-to-end software development lifecycle, including requirements, design, development, testing, deployment, and maintenance. 
 - Experience developing desktop and/or web applications, including services and APIs. 
 - Experience developing and deploying software in cloud environments, preferably AWS or Azure. 
 - Experience with software testing and quality engineering practices, including unit testing, integration testing, automated testing, debugging, and defect resolution. 
 - Experience effectively leveraging AI-assisted software development tools to improve coding, debugging, testing, code review, refactoring, troubleshooting, documentation, and overall development efficiency. 
 - Ability to critically evaluate and validate AI-generated code and technical recommendations, applying sound engineering judgment to ensure correctness, security, performance, quality, and maintainability. 
 - Experience with CI/CD, build automation, and modern software development and delivery practices. 
 - Experience with version control systems, such as Git and Perforce. 
 - Experience with container technologies, such as Docker and Kubernetes. 
 - Solid understanding of SQL and/or NoSQL database technologies and their use in software applications. 
 - Working knowledge of Windows and/or Linux operating systems. 
 - Experience working within an Agile software development environment. 
 - Strong analytical, debugging, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to independently investigate complex technical issues and develop effective solutions. 
 - Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to clearly communicate technical concepts, designs, decisions, issues, and solutions. 
 - Strong collaboration and teamwork skills, with the ability to work effectively across development teams and with cross-functional stakeholders.

data.title: Full-Stack Developer
data.description:
Join Revun as a Full-Stack Developer to scale web applications using cutting-edge technology. Build robust API integrations and enhance coding with AI tools, working in a fast-paced environment. 

About Revun

Revun is the software platform and infrastructure layer behind modern property operations. Where other tools solve one piece of the puzzle, Revun unifies leasing, payments, maintenance, communications, compliance, reporting, and brokerage workflows into a single operating system. Owners, property managers, brokerages, leasing teams, maintenance companies, and REITs all operate from the same connected platform, with role-based experiences that adapt to each stakeholder. Based in Toronto, Ontario, Canada. 

About The Role

As a Full-Stack Developer at Revun, you'll be at the forefront of scaling our web applications. Your day-to-day tasks include reviewing sprint tasks, refactoring backend logic in Laravel, and designing responsive frontends using Tailwind CSS. You will engage with third-party API integration and leverage AI coding assistants to enhance your workflows. 

Working closely with the Lead Developer and reporting to the Technical Lead/Founder, your responsibilities include delivering clean, modular code, ensuring zero-downtime deployments, and accelerating development velocity through AI tools. Your success will be assessed by your ability to meet sprint deadlines and ship functional code features consistently. 

Within the first 90 days, you'll focus on successfully integrating APIs and leveraging AI tools to accelerate development while maintaining strong code standards. A successful candidate is resourceful, embraces modern coding tools, and communicates progress effectively. 

What you will do

- Deliver clean, modular, and scalable code using Laravel and Tailwind CSS or any other modern frontend framework to enhance web application performance and client project outcomes. 
 - Review sprint tasks, manage pull requests, and refactor backend logic in collaboration with the team, ensuring consistency and quality. 
 - Write and refactor both backend logic in Laravel and design responsive frontend layouts using Tailwind CSS and Blade components. 
 - Test and debug third-party API connections, handle complex payloads, and manage error logs effectively. 
 - Leverage AI coding assistants to draft boilerplate structures, write unit tests, and iterate on feature implementation rapidly. 
 - Complete assigned feature sprints, conduct code reviews, and test API endpoints to ensure stability and performance. 
 - Optimize database queries, perform security audits of input validations, and update documentation for integrated modules to maintain system integrity. 
 - Successfully integrate APIs and leverage AI tools within the first 90 days to accelerate development velocity while maintaining rigorous code standards. 
 - Troubleshoot unforeseen API documentation errors and resolve merge conflicts or unexpected breaking changes efficiently. 

What we are looking for

- At least 4 years of hands-on experience in web development with SaaS or client applications. 
 - In-depth experience with PHP and the Laravel framework for building robust applications. 
 - Strong proficiency in full-stack Laravel development, including backend services and frontend frameworks such as Vue. js or any similar JavaScript framework. 
 - Hands-on experience integrating REST APIs, payment gateways, and CRM systems like Zoho. 
 - Solid understanding of MySQL, database schema design, and Git version control workflows. 
 - Fluent in English, with excellent spoken and written communication skills. 
 - Clear communication skills in providing progress updates and resolving development issues. 

Nice to have

- Experience in software development within the IT sector. 
 - Proficiency in AI-assisted development tools like Cursor, Claude, and OpenAI APIs to enhance coding speed and quality. 
 - Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field. 

What we offer

CAD $18, 000 to $30, 000 per year. 

Benefits

- Remote work flexibility
 - Professional development opportunities

Schedule

Monday to Friday, 9: 00 AM - 5: 00 PM (EST Timezone). 

What happens next

Our recruitment partner will be in touch with you about your application. 

If you meet the requirements for the role, they will send you a link to an online video interview that you complete in your own time - there is no appointment to book and nothing to install. 

Your completed interview is then shared with us to review alongside your application, and we will let you know what happens next.

This role combines platform architecture, engineering execution, and people leadership, with accountability for secure, reliable, and cost-efficient shared capabilities. You will own the platform engineering roadmap, delivery governance, and team development, partnering with product, architecture, security, and business leaders to improve engineering productivity and deliver measurable business outcomes across client engagements.

Technology & Architecture Leadership

- Own the platform engineering strategy and architecture roadmap, aligning cloud infrastructure, shared services, and modernization priorities with business and product goals. 
 - Lead the design and evolution of secure, resilient cloud-native platforms, including container orchestration, networking, identity, secrets management, and standardized environments. 
 - Establish engineering standards, reference architectures, infrastructure-as-code patterns, and automated guardrails for consistent provisioning and operation of platform services. 
 - Enable application, data, and AI/ML workloads through reusable platform capabilities, APIs, integration patterns, and scalable compute and storage services. 
 - Own CI/CD and release engineering capabilities, including automated testing, security checks, artifact management, deployment strategies, and rollback readiness. 
 - Provide technical leadership for critical incidents, architectural reviews, and complex engineering decisions; drive root-cause analysis and durable corrective actions. 

Delivery & Operational Excellence

 - Define and track service-level indicators and objectives, agreed SLAs, and engineering delivery metrics to improve reliability, deployment performance, and recovery times. 
 - Drive capacity planning, performance optimization, and FinOps practices; manage platform budgets and vendors to improve cost efficiency without compromising reliability. 
 - Partner with security and governance teams to embed access controls, vulnerability remediation, auditability, data protection, and compliance requirements into platform operations. 

Team Leadership & Talent Management

- Lead and scale multidisciplinary platform engineering teams spanning cloud infrastructure, DevOps, SRE, and automation; develop engineering managers and technical leads. 
 - Build a high-performance, inclusive engineering culture grounded in accountability, collaboration, continuous learning, and measurable outcomes. 
 - Own workforce planning, hiring, performance management, succession planning, and capability development aligned with the platform roadmap. 
 - Coach managers and engineers on technical judgment, execution discipline, stakeholder engagement, and career growth; delegate effectively while maintaining accountability. 

Business & Stakeholder Management

- Partner with product teams, enterprise architects, security leaders, finance transformation stakeholders, and clients to translate business needs into platform priorities. 
 - Balance platform investment, delivery capacity, risk, and business value; align stakeholders on trade-offs, service expectations, and measurable outcomes. 
 - Support solutioning, proposals, and client discussions with platform architecture, delivery estimates, operating models, and cost considerations. 
 - Communicate roadmap progress, investment needs, service health, delivery risks, and business impact clearly to executive stakeholders. 

Platform & Product Mindset

- Manage the platform as an internal product, using developer feedback and adoption metrics to prioritize capabilities that reduce friction and accelerate delivery. 
 - Build self-service workflows, reusable infrastructure modules, service catalogs, and standardized delivery paths with clear documentation and onboarding. 
 - Measure platform value through adoption, developer satisfaction, onboarding time, delivery lead time, and reduced operational toil; enable secure analytics and AI use cases. 

Qualifications

Education & Experience

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. 
 - 12+ years of experience across software engineering, cloud infrastructure, platform engineering, or SRE, including substantial architecture and delivery ownership. 
 - 5+ years of engineering people-management experience, with a demonstrated track record of leading multiple teams and developing engineering managers or technical leads. 

Technical Expertise

 - Experience with CI/CD, GitOps, observability, and automation using relevant tools and languages (e. g. , GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, Argo CD, OpenTelemetry, Python, or Go). 
 - Strong understanding of APIs, microservices, distributed systems, and shared platform services; experience enabling data platforms and integration workloads.

Operational & Delivery Skills

Domain & Functional Knowledge

Quality Control Manager

  

Role Summary

We are seeking a technically strong and system-driven Quality Control Manager who can lead inspections, ensure quality compliance, handle defect analysis, resolve problems, and drive continuous improvements. Fastener industry experience and hands-on operation of QC equipment is required. 

Key Responsibilities

• Ensure product quality meets drawing requirements, standards, and customer specifications. 

• Lead incoming, checklists, in-process, and final inspections for all fastener products. 

• Conduct defect analysis, root cause analysis (RCA), and drive corrective actions (CAPA). 

• Maintain quality documentation, reports, calibration records and QA data. 

• Operate and supervise use of Profile Projector, Hardness Testing Machine, Metallurgy Setup, and Calibration Tools. 

• Improve quality processes, strengthen SOPs, and ensure systematic quality checks. 

• Coordinate with production and customer teams for issue resolution. 

• Lead internal audits and support external/customer audits. 

• Ensure all measuring instruments are calibrated and functioning accurately

• Continuously improve Products and Processes

Technical Skills

• Strong knowledge of fastener quality assurance processes

• Hands-on experience with QA equipment such as Profile Projector, Hardness Tester, Metallurgy testing, and gauges

• Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings and technical specifications

• Knowledge of inspection methods, defect analysis, and quality documentation

Soft Skills

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills

Nice to Have

 - Experience with AI-assisted development tools (GitHub Copilot, Cursor IDE) and developer agents/MCP integrations. 
 - Hands-on experience building developer productivity metrics and dashboards (DORA, SPACE frameworks). 
 - Contributions to open-source Backstage plugins or IDP ecosystems.

 - Familiarity with compliance-as-code and policy engines (OPA, Sentinel).
