data.title: Digital Technology Specialist - DevOps Engineering
data.description:
Would you like to help shape and implement our Digital Technology teams' strategic direction?

Are you passionate about helping improve observability and digital operations?

Join our Digital Technology team!

We operate at the heart of Baker Hughes digital transformation journey. Our team delivers enterprise observability and AIOps capabilities that help technology teams detect issues earlier, troubleshoot faster, and improve service performance across cloud, infrastructure, and application environments. 

Partner with the best

As a DevOps Engineer you will support the implementation, enhancement, onboarding, and day-to-day operations of observability platforms, with a focus on Elastic Stack capabilities and practical SRE-driven operational outcomes. 

As a Senior AI Ops Engineer, you will be responsible for: 

- Implement and manage the life cycle of enterprise observability platform based on elastic tech stacks [not limited to] Kibana, Logstash, Beats, Elastic Agent, Fleet, Elastic APM components, etc. 
 - Onboard full suite of 20, 000 plus devices under observability umbrella
 - Onboarding infrastructure, cloud services, applications, and platforms into observability and monitoring solutions. 
 - Building and maintaining dashboards, visualizations, alerts, and operational reports for technology teams. 
 - Configuring log, metric, trace, uptime, and APM data collection across supported environments. 
 - Assisting with data ingestion, parsing, enrichment, and retention activities. 
 - Supporting incident investigation, troubleshooting, and root cause analysis using observability data. 
 - Collaborating with cloud, infrastructure, application, and SRE teams to improve system reliability and service visibility. 
 - Contributing to automation initiatives using scripting, Infrastructure as Code, and repeatable deployment practices. 
 - Participating in observability platform upgrades, patching, performance tuning, and operational support activities. 
 - Creating and maintaining runbooks, knowledge articles, dashboards standards, and operational runbooks related documentation. 
 - Contributing to continuous improvement of observability practices, monitoring coverage, and operational readiness. 

Fuel your passion

- Have 7+ years - SRE/DevOps experience in enterprise-scale or mission-critical environments
 - Have 5+ years - Cloud / Application / Platform operations and administration (AWS, Azure, hybrid or multi-cloud)
 - Have 5+ years - Automation, CI/CD, and scripting proficiency (Python, Bash, PowerShell, Ruby, or equivalent)
 - Have 5+ years - Exposure to containers and cloud-native platforms such as Docker, Kubernetes, Prometheus, or Grafana. 
 - Have 3+ years - Proven experience administering Elastic Observability platforms across the full lifecycle, including deployment, maintenance, upgrades, patching, and capacity scaling. 

Preferred Qualifications

- AWS or Azure Associate-level certification, or equivalent practical cloud operations experience. 
 - Elastic Certified Engineer or equivalent observability platform certification
 - Familiarity with infrastructure as code (GitHub Actions, CloudFormation, Terraform, Ansible) for repeatable automation
 - Exposure to cloud-native observability frameworks (Open Telemetry, service meshes)
 - Experience documenting runbooks, playbooks, and consumption guides for SMEs
 - Process knowledge such as Agile and/or ITIL

Must Have Technical Skills

- Strong background in observability platforms (Elastic. io stack preferred: Elasticsearch, Kibana, Logstash, Beats, Elastic APM, and Fleet/Elastic Agent)
 - Telemetry Fundamentals: Strong, practical understanding of fundamental observability concepts, including the collection and analysis of logs, metrics, traces, and synthetic monitoring. 
 - Experience with administration of leading observability platforms (Grafana, Graylog, Splunk, Sumo Logic, Tanzu, or open-source equivalents) including lifecycle management (Kubernetes, Docker, Prometheus, and Grafana installation, patching, upgrades, scaling). 
 - Strong knowledge of distributed infrastructure domains (network, servers, VMs, AWS, Azure, databases) from an observability perspective. 
 - Proven ability to design and tune scalable ingestion pipelines for diverse, globally distributed data sources. 
 - Flexibility to adapt and evolve observability standards per domain needs while ensuring consistency across the enterprise. 
 - Operational ownership mindset - accountable for uptime, reliability, and lifecycle management of the hosted observability platform. 
 - Incident management and SRE practices: monitoring, alerting, troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and postmortems. 
 - Proficiency in automation and scripting (Python, Bash, PowerShell, Ruby, etc. ) for ingestion, upgrades, and operational tasks. 
 - Familiarity with REST APIs and tools like Postman, plus DevOps constructs (GitHub, Jenkins, CI/CD pipelines, serverless technologies). 
 - Configuration Proficiency: Demonstrated proficiency in managing system configurations using YAML-based configurations. 
 - Knowledge of infrastructure as code (Terraform, Ansible) for repeatable automation. 
 - Strong understanding of AWS/Azure services relevant to ingestion and enrichment (e. g. , Kinesis, Event Hub, Lambda, Functions). 
 - Data Presentation: Extensive experience in performance optimization, advanced data visualization, and sophisticated dashboarding using Kibana (or similar platforms). 
 - Ability to document and enable SMEs with clear runbooks, onboarding guides, and consumption standards. 
 - Collaboration skills to guide Infra domain SMEs on onboarding data sources and consuming observability outputs. 

Good-to-Have

- Exposure to cloud-native observability frameworks (Open Telemetry, service meshes). 
 - Basic understanding of shared infrastructure services (DNS, DHCP, Active Directory, SSL, load balancing). 
 - Experience with hybrid deployments (on-prem + cloud) and handling data sovereignty/regulatory considerations in global industries. 
 - Security monitoring and compliance awareness relevant to IT domains. 
 - Contribution to observability best practices (dashboards, alerting strategies, operational standards). 
 - Mentoring and cross-training skills to expand in-house observability expertise. 
 - Process knowledge like Agile and/or ITIL. 
 - AWS Professional-level certification, or the ability to demonstrate equivalent functional knowledge and expertise. 

Desired Characteristics

- Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills. 
 - Clear written and verbal communication skills. 
 - Ability to collaborate with application, infrastructure, cloud, and operations teams. 
 - Self-motivated with a passion for learning new technologies. 
 - Customer-focused mindset and commitment towards operational excellence. 
 - Ability to work independently and as part of a globally distributed team. 
 - Proactive approach to maintaining documentation, fostering knowledge transfer, and supporting continuous service improvement. 

Work in a way that works for you

We recognize that everyone is different and that the way in which people want to work and deliver at their best is different for everyone too. In this role, we can offer the following flexible working patterns: 

- Working flexible hours - flexing the times when you work in the day to help you fit everything in and work when you are the most productive

Working with us

Our people are at the heart of what we do at Baker Hughes. We know we are better when all of our people are developed, engaged and able to bring their whole authentic selves to work. We invest in the health and well-being of our workforce, train and reward talent and develop leaders at all levels to bring out the best in each other. 

Working for you

Our inventions have revolutionized energy for over a century. But to keep going forward tomorrow, we know we have to push the boundaries today. We prioritize rewarding those who embrace change with a package that reflects how much we value their input. Join us, and you can expect: 

- Contemporary work-life balance policies and wellbeing activities

We are an energy technology company that provides solutions to energy and industrial customers worldwide. Built on a century of experience and conducting business in over 120 countries, our innovative technologies and services are taking energy forward - making it safer, cleaner and more efficient for people and the planet.

data.description:
#RunwiththePack

At Arctic Wolf, we're on a mission to end cyber risk. 

We are a global leader in security operations, helping organizations stay resilient against evolving cyber threats through industry-leading security operations, threat intelligence, and a people-first approach to cybersecurity. 

More than 3, 000 Pack members across the world work together every day to protect our customers and empower security teams with new levels of speed, accuracy, and intelligence at scale. What sets us apart is our relentless focus on our customers, innovation at scale, and a collaborative culture where talented people can do meaningful work that truly makes a difference. 

We're constantly looking for talented people to join the Pack and help us take our performance to the next level. 

About The Position

Our mission is simple: End Cyber Risk. We're looking for a Software Developer 2, to be part of making that happen. 

Position Overview And Objective

The Software Developer 2 supports Arctic Wolf's Engineering organization by helping ensure the quality, reliability, and performance of Aurora Endpoint Security and our cloud-based services. This person partners closely with Engineering and Product teams to drive test automation, improve release confidence, and strengthen engineering productivity through modern quality engineering and AI-assisted development practices. 

As a Developer 2, Quality Engineering at Arctic Wolf, you will: 

What You'll Do

- Design, build, and maintain a Python-based automation framework that validates product functionality, reliability, and quality across Windows, macOS, and Linux environments
 - Develop and grow a Pytest-based test infrastructure as the core of the automation framework, writing clean, reusable, and maintainable Python code
 - Build automation for product deployment, upgrade, and validation workflows, using Python as the primary language and Ansible and Terraform to support infrastructure and configuration tasks
 - Write Python-based CLI tools and endpoint validation scenarios that extend the framework's coverage and usability across platforms
 - Use AI-powered engineering tools to speed up framework design, automation development, and debugging
 - Work closely with engineering, product management, and cross-functional teams to identify quality risks, refine requirements, and ensure the framework delivers comprehensive test coverage throughout the software development life cycle
 - Investigate, troubleshoot, document, and track product defects, partnering with teammates to drive timely resolution and root cause analysis
 - Contribute to the ongoing evolution of the automation framework, improving product quality, test coverage, and release confidence over time

What We're Looking For

- 2-5 years of professional automation development experience, with real framework-building work, not just script writing
 - Strong Python skills, with hands-on experience designing automation frameworks, Pytest-based test suites, CLI tools, and endpoint validation scenarios
 - Comfort building and running automation across Windows, macOS, and Linux, with an understanding of how platform differences affect framework design
 - Experience designing, developing, and maintaining automation solutions that improve product quality, reliability, and engineering efficiency
 - Working knowledge of AWS, including EC2 launch types, S3, CloudWatch logs, metrics, and alarms, and IAM roles, policies, and security controls
 - Familiarity with Microsoft Azure services and cloud infrastructure
 - Experience with CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins, GitHub Actions, or similar tools
 - Familiarity with Docker-based development and build environments
 - Strong debugging and troubleshooting skills, with the ability to perform effective root cause analysis and drive issues to resolution

Nice to Have

- Ansible for fleet configuration and provisioning
 - Exposure to cybersecurity products, distributed systems, or SaaS platforms
 - Experience with databases and SQL queries, or Bazel
 - Experience with VMware, Hyper-V, or AWS or Azure infrastructure

Benefits

All wolves receive compelling compensation and benefits packages, including: 

- Equity for all employees 
 - 18 days annual leave, flexible holidays & festivals, and paid volunteer days 
 - Training and career development programs 
 - Comprehensive private benefits plan including medical insurance for you and your family, life insurance (3x compensation), and personal accident insurance. 
 - A modern workplace in Helios Business Park in Bengaluru

Security Requirements

At Arctic Wolf, protecting our people, customers, and data is fundamental to how we operate. All employees are expected to uphold our commitment to security, privacy, and compliance by following internal information security policies, standards, and controls designed to safeguard the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of business, customer, employee, and other confidential information and to support compliance with applicable legal and regulatory requirements. 

Depending on the role and where permitted by applicable law, employment may be subject to background verification and additional regulatory, security, or compliance requirements, including obligations related to data protection and export control laws, and authorization requirements where applicable. 

Your next big opportunity starts here - apply today and help us end cyber risk.

As a Senior Software Engineer in ENS India, you will design and ship security and enterprise features that land broadly across the Windows ecosystem. You'll work closely with partner teams (including engineering counterparts in Redmond) to build secure-by-design, reliable-by-default solutions that meet the bar for global deployment.

Work on security and enterprise capabilities that protect billions of Windows users and the enterprises that depend on Windows.

As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond. 

Responsibilities

 - Build features across foundational areas such as hardware-backed security, cryptography, identity/authentication, and enterprise management experiences.

- Produce robust, testable, maintainable code with strong engineering rigor, including diagnostics and operational readiness suitable for global rollout.

Full-time

Description

Location: Noida, India

About Us  

Procurement Partners builds easy-to-use software that lets healthcare organizations automate their purchasing, inventory management, invoicing, and payments processes. We help thousands of facilities and their staff reduce their expenses and time spent procuring items so they can direct more time and effort toward caring for their patients and residents. About the Role  

The Engineering Manager leads a team of engineers and testers to deliver high-quality, reliable SaaS products with predictable execution. This role combines strong technical leadership with accountability for engineering delivery, software quality, and production stability while balancing feature development with modernization and technical debt reduction. 

You'll develop high-performing engineers and technical leads, foster a culture of ownership and continuous improvement, and ensure engineering teams deliver sustainable solutions to complex business problems. 

What You'll Do

Drive Quality and Delivery  

- Own engineering execution from technical refinement through development, testing, and production release, ensuring predictable delivery and quality outcomes. 

- Ensure technical readiness before development by validating solution approaches, dependencies, edge cases, and implementation risks. 

- Drive realistic estimation, manage dependencies, proactively identify delivery risks, and adjust execution plans as priorities or circumstances change. 

- Drive CI/CD best practices, automated testing, and release quality gates to ensure reliable, repeatable, and efficient software delivery. 

- Track engineering performance through delivery predictability, defect trends, rework, automation coverage, and release reliability, driving improvements where needed. 

- Lead production incident resolution, blameless postmortems, root cause analysis, and preventive actions to address recurring issues. 

Guide Technical Direction  

- Provide technical leadership in system design and complex implementations, reviewing architecture decisions and challenging technical solutions where necessary. 

- Establish coding standards, design patterns, API design, data modeling, and performance practices that support scalable, maintainable systems. 

- Partner with architects and senior engineers to guide legacy modernization, manage technical debt, and contribute to the technology roadmap. 

- Evaluate technical trade-offs and recommend pragmatic solutions that balance business needs, maintainability, performance, and operational stability. 

- Partner with DevOps to improve build and deployment pipelines, environment consistency, and engineering automation. 

Lead and Develop People  

- Manage hiring, onboarding, performance reviews, regular 1: 1s, and individual development plans. 

- Set clear expectations, build accountability, and develop engineers and technical leads to independently own technical solutions and delivery. 

- Foster an inclusive, collaborative culture that encourages technical rigor, ownership, and continuous learning. 

- Promote responsible AI-assisted development practices to improve engineering productivity and quality. 

Partner Cross-Functionally  

- Partner with Product, QA, Architecture, and DevOps to align requirements, technical solutions, and delivery priorities. 

- Collaborate with Product on estimates, scope, dependencies, and delivery trade-offs based on engineering capacity. 

- Communicate delivery status, risks, and technical decisions clearly to stakeholders. 

- Manage engineering resources, vendor relationships, and technology costs within team scope. 

  

What You'll Bring  

Required

- 10+ years of software engineering experience, including 6+ years of hands-on full-stack development and 3+ years of direct engineering people management. 

- Strong technical proficiency in . NET/C#, React/Angular, MySQL/SQL Server, and AWS or Azure, with the ability to review designs and guide complex implementations. 

- Proven experience leading engineering teams delivering enterprise SaaS products, with accountability for delivery, software quality, and production stability. 

- Strong understanding of software architecture, distributed systems, API design, database performance, and legacy application modernization. 

- Strong understanding of CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, deployment strategies, and modern software delivery practices. 

- Demonstrated technical judgment in evaluating complex solutions, identifying risks, and making sound engineering trade-offs. 

- Proven people leadership skills, including coaching, performance management, and developing technical leads. 

- Experience improving engineering quality through automated testing, code reviews, defect analysis, and continuous improvement. 

- Practical AI fluency, with experience using AI-assisted development tools and guiding their effective adoption. 

Preferred

- Experience with healthcare, procurement, supply chain, or financial workflow software. 

- Experience leading geographically distributed engineering teams, including US and India/offshore teams. 

- Experience modernizing legacy SaaS applications while maintaining ongoing feature delivery and production stability.

data.title: SDET Analyst
data.description:
Job Description

Summary of This Role

Performs and participates in application development and testing to apply continuous quality and testability of code throughout the software development lifecycle. Builds quality within the software development process with automated testing suites providing a comprehensive view from code quality to functionality. Uses quality paradigms to provide real time quality with use of automation and frequent regression testing. Designs / develops and maintains automation frameworks and automation test suites and scripts with continuous integration, testing, deployment and delivery. Conducts performance, load, security and service virtualization testing. 

What Part Will You Play?

- Participates in all steps of the software development life cycle and is accountable for producing quality code. Participates within a collaborative software development approach to identify and recommend practices for quality assurance at the source using automation. Conducts basic impact analysis, evaluates and identifies affects to regression test suites, testability of code, and application performance to reduce negative influences on continuous testing. Performs quality checks along with updating of automation scripts. Identifies and designs basic testing suites for test driven development (TDD) and behavior driven development (BDD) to allow early and frequent testing as the software is developed. 
 - Writes and executes moderately complex application tests at the source code level to prevent hidden errors (i. e. , white box testing) within unit and component testing. Identifies and suggests moderate improvements for code quality to improve deficiencies from functionality through structure of code for performance and maintainability. Builds, maintains and reviews mid-level unit and component test suites and conducts automated white box tests. Identifies basic improper coding and code quality issues. Integrates white box test suites with continuous integration (CI) tools. Programs and creates basic to mid-level test cases using unit and component testing tools for code level testing. 
 - Develops standard software tools, frameworks and utilities for validation / verification activities and end-to-end functional testing of software. Identifies and recommends tools and frameworks for testing and creates automated tools for generic use and maintainability. Writes standard code that uses / exercises non-user interface (UI) components like application program interface's (API's), representational state transfer API (RESTful API), and web services similar to the end user to develop frameworks for testing. Integrates automated suites with continuous integration (CI) tools for frequent execution. 
 - Installs and uses basic to moderately complex CI frameworks in continuous testing and continuous deployment / delivery. Builds, customizes, and deploys basic to moderately complex test environments and test automation frameworks. Performs basic to moderately complex scripting, data generation, and other methods to maintain automation infrastructure throughout the development. Integrates CI tools with other testing infrastructure and develops basic to moderately complex reporting / metrics on CI. 
 - Uses performance, load, security, and service virtualization testing tools to conduct basic testing, analysis and results interpretation. Builds, scripts, and generates data used in testing. Analyzes moderately complex system performance and responses during loads. Applies a basic knowledge of procedures, methodology and/or application standards to include payment card industry and security related compliance to testing activities using automation. Applies knowledge of service virtualization concepts and its applicability for application testing. 
 - Works with stakeholders, business, developers and other analysts to develop test plans, conditions and cases (set of inputs, execution preconditions, and expected outcomes developed for a particular objective, such as to exercise a particular program path or to verify compliance with a specific requirement) to be used in testing, and learns to perform test data conditioning and execution of test sets. Begins to build a base knowledge of using multiple environments to validate test conditions and reviews data values while learning the various components of the systems and the applications. Reports, tracks defects and defect resolutions, closure and participates in root cause analysis. 
 - Acts as a single point of contact for assigned small, less complex client projects with regard to test activities. Coordinates the test activities assigned to the test team to include, reviewing of client test plans cases and scripts, prioritizing test execution when necessary and providing feedback to internal and external clients. 
 -

What Are We Looking For in This Role?

Minimum Qualifications

- Bachelor's Degree - Software Engineering, Information Systems or other Technical degree; additional experience in lieu of degree will be considered
 - Typically Minimum 2 Years Relevant Exp - Professional experience with software testing, coding, designing, and developing

Preferred Qualifications

- Master's Degree - Software Engineering, Information Systems or other Technical degree
 - Typically Minimum 4 Years Relevant Exp - Experience developing automated testing strategies in a variety of environments and frameworks

What Are Our Desired Skills and Capabilities?

- SKILLS / KNOWLEDGE - Developing professional expertise, applies company policies and procedures to resolve a variety of issues. 
 - JOB COMPLEXITY - Works on problems of moderate scope where analysis of situations or data requires a review of a variety of factors. Exercises judgment within defined procedures and practices to determine appropriate action. Builds productive internal/external working relationships. 
 - SUPERVISION - Normally receives general instructions on routine work, detailed instructions on new projects or assignments. 
 - Software Development Life Cycle / Testing Methodologies - Agile - Scrum, Kanban, Test Driven Development, Behavior Driven Development, etc. 
 - Programming Languages - Java, selenium, C#, Perl, Python, Groovy, Oracle, SQL, etc. 
 - Testing tools - Application Lifecycle Management, Unit Testing, Security, Application Programming Interface, Mobile, Continuous Integration, harness, Service Virtualization, etc.

What will you be responsible for?

We are looking for an experienced Data Engineering Lead with strong expertise in Oracle Fusion Data Intelligence (FDI), Oracle Analytics Cloud (OAC), Oracle Data Integrator (ODI), and enterprise data engineering. In this role, you will lead the design, development, integration, and support of scalable data and analytics solutions that enable reliable, high-quality data for business reporting and decision-making. 

The ideal candidate will combine strong hands-on technical expertise with technical leadership and will work closely with business, functional, engineering, analytics, and product teams to translate complex requirements into scalable and maintainable solutions. The role requires a strong focus on engineering excellence, data quality, performance, operational reliability, modernization, and continuous improvement. 

- Data Engineering & Solution Design: Design and deliver scalable end-to-end data engineering and analytics solutions using Oracle FDI, OAC, ODI, Oracle databases/ADW, SQL, PL/SQL, and related cloud technologies. 
 - FDI & Analytics Solutions: Design, develop, enhance, and support Oracle FDI and OAC solutions, including FDI extensions, semantic models, datasets, dashboards, reporting solutions, and custom data requirements to address business and reporting gaps. 
 - Data Integration & Pipeline Engineering: Design and develop robust ETL/ELT pipelines and integration solutions using ODI and related technologies to enable reliable movement and transformation of data across Oracle Fusion, enterprise data platforms, analytics systems, and downstream applications. 
 - Data Warehousing & Modeling: Design and maintain data warehouse structures, dimensional and semantic models, tables, views, and reusable data layers that support scalable analytical and reporting requirements. 
 - Data Processing & Quality: Design full and incremental data-load processes with appropriate transformation, validation, reconciliation, error handling, logging, and data-quality controls to ensure accurate and reliable data delivery. 
 - Performance & Scalability: Optimize SQL, PL/SQL, data pipelines, integrations, data models, and analytics solutions for performance, scalability, reliability, and maintainability. 
 - Production Support & Troubleshooting: Lead troubleshooting of complex production issues across data pipelines, FDI, OAC, ODI, databases, and reporting layers. Perform root-cause analysis and drive sustainable solutions and preventive improvements. 
 - Testing, Release & Deployment: Lead technical activities across development, testing/UAT, and production environments, including data validation, regression and incremental-load testing, deployments, migrations, upgrades, and production stabilization. 
 - Collaboration & Stakeholder Engagement: Collaborate with business, functional, application, engineering, analytics, cloud/platform, and product teams to understand requirements, resolve dependencies, and ensure technical solutions align with business objectives. 
 - Technical Leadership: Provide technical guidance to engineers, participate in architecture and design reviews, conduct code reviews, mentor team members, establish engineering standards, and promote reusable and maintainable solutions. 
 - Modernization & Innovation: Contribute to modernization of legacy data and reporting solutions by evaluating and adopting modern cloud-based data engineering and analytics capabilities. Exposure to Oracle AI Data Platform (AIDP), Snowflake, and emerging AI-enabled data engineering capabilities is an advantage. 
 - Documentation & Knowledge Sharing: Maintain solution designs, data mappings, operational documentation, technical standards, and support procedures while promoting knowledge sharing and engineering best practices across the team. 

Who are we looking for?

- 6-8 years of hands-on experience in Data Engineering, Data Warehousing, Business Intelligence, Analytics, Data Integration, or related areas. 
 - Strong hands-on expertise in Oracle Fusion Data Intelligence (FDI), Oracle Analytics Cloud (OAC), and Oracle Data Integrator (ODI) with experience delivering enterprise-scale data and analytics solutions. 
 - Strong experience with Oracle Database and/or Oracle Autonomous Data Warehouse (ADW) and advanced proficiency in SQL and PL/SQL. 
 - Strong understanding of ETL/ELT architecture, data pipelines, data integration, data transformation, orchestration, and full/incremental data-load patterns. 
 - Experience working with Oracle Fusion application data, FDI extensions, enterprise reporting requirements, and custom data integrations. 
 - Strong understanding of data warehousing, dimensional modeling, semantic modeling, data integration architecture, and analytical/reporting architectures. 
 - Experience with data validation, reconciliation, data-quality controls, source-to-target mapping, logging, monitoring, and observability. 
 - Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills with experience in production support, root-cause analysis, performance tuning, and resolution of complex data and analytics issues. 
 - Experience supporting development through production lifecycle activities, including design, development, testing, UAT, deployment, upgrades, releases, migrations, and production stabilization. 
 - Understanding of cloud data architecture, data sharing, security, governance, metadata, performance, and operational reliability. 
 - Familiarity with software and data engineering best practices, including Git/version control, code reviews, development standards, documentation, and CI/CD concepts. 
 - Ability to lead technical discussions, guide developers, review technical designs, identify technical risks and dependencies, and drive solutions across multiple teams. 
 - Strong collaboration and communication skills with the ability to translate business requirements into technical solutions and communicate complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. 
 - Good-to-have knowledge or hands-on exposure to Oracle AI Data Platform (AIDP) and modern AI-enabled data engineering and analytics capabilities. 
 - Good-to-have experience with Snowflake, including data ingestion, transformation, SQL development, data modeling, data sharing, and cloud data-engineering concepts. 
 - Exposure to OCI, REST APIs, Power BI, Apache Iceberg, modern/open data architectures, and AI-assisted engineering is an added advantage. 
 - Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, or a related field.

For more than 30 years, SonicWall  has delivered a partner-first unified cybersecurity portfolio that helps SMBs, MSPs, and IT teams consolidate network security, endpoint security, security service edge (SSE), and threat response across hybrid environments. By bringing connected technology, real-time threat intelligence, automation, and expert services together, SonicWall helps organizations simplify security operations, achieve better security outcomes, and lower total cost of ownership. Backed by a global ecosystem of more than 17, 000 partners, SonicWall delivers enterprise-grade protection built for SMB and mid-market realities.   

For more information, visit www. sonicwall. com or follow us on X, LinkedIn, Facebook, and Instagram.   

Role OverviewWe are looking for an experienced and technically strong Senior QA Manager to own end-to-end quality for cloud applications, cloud security products, and associated services. 

This is a high-impact leadership role responsible for defining the quality strategy, driving automation and test infrastructure investments, and partnering closely with Product Management, Engineering, DevOps, Cloud Infrastructure, Security, Release Engineering, and Support teams to ensure high standards of reliability, scalability, security, and customer trust. 

The role requires a strong understanding of cloud applications and distributed systems, along with good networking and security fundamentals. You will help shape how quality is built into the product lifecycle, from requirements and architecture reviews through continuous testing, release readiness, production validation, and post-release improvements. 

Key ResponsibilitiesQuality Strategy & Release Ownership
 - Define and continuously improve QA and Quality Engineering strategy for cloud applications and cloud security products.

 - Convert production and customer learnings into preventive quality improvements. People Leadership & Stakeholder Influence

 - Lead and scale geographically distributed QA/Quality Engineering teams. 
 - Set clear expectations, career paths, technical growth plans, and performance goals. 
 - Develop technical and leadership capabilities within the QA organization. 
 - Influence Engineering, Product Management, DevOps, Cloud Infrastructure, and Security leadership to prioritize quality and customer impact. 
 - Represent QA in leadership forums, customer escalations, incident reviews, and cross-functional initiatives. 
 - Foster a culture of ownership, engineering excellence, automation, and continuous improvement. Required Skills & Experience

data.title: Lead Validation Engineer
data.description:
Job Description Summary

Responsable de la conception, du développement et du test des logiciels intégrés (micrologiciels), des plates-formes et des systèmes contrôlant et fonctionnant sur des périphériques devant être adaptés aux besoins du matériel qu'ils doivent contrôler et sur lequel ils doivent s'exécuter (c'est-à-dire qui contrôle directement les fonctions en temps réel d'un dispositif physique tel que des moteurs, des alternateurs, des vannes, des ventilateurs et d'autres dispositifs et produits). Cela nécessite généralement une compréhension approfondie des caractéristiques du périphérique physique contrôlé, des fonctions en temps réel qu'il est censé exécuter, ainsi que la capacité de concevoir, de développer, d'implémenter et de tester la logique et les logiciels nécessaires à l'exécution de la fonctionnalité temps réel. Habituellement adapté aux produits et services de divers comptes de résultat. Exerce une influence sur les opérations département et est responsable de la planification et/ou de l'exécution. Ce rôle jouit d'une certaine autonomie, mais est axé sur l'exécution d'activités au sein d'une discipline opérationnelle couverte par les pratiques et procédures fonctionnelles standard. Un certain discernement peut être nécessaire, mais généralement dans le cadre d'une orientation. 

Job Description

Rôles et responsabilités

- Conçoit, design et/ou programme/développe un petit module ou un grand composant, une fonctionnalité, un ensemble de fonctionnalités, une zone de fonctionnalités complète ou un produit logiciel intégré complet. Les domaines d'expertise peuvent inclure, sans toutefois s'y limiter, les réseaux, les systèmes d'exploitation, la cybersécurité, les bases de données ou les applications. Peut être responsable de la création d'un produit entier. [Les petites équipes utiliseront ce rôle pour inclure toutes les phases du cycle de conception/développement jusqu'à la sortie]
 - Développer une connaissance approfondie d'une discipline technique. Se fonde sur une expérience antérieure et une expertise technique acquise pour mettre en œuvre une politique/stratégie. 
 - Compréhension approfondie des principaux facteurs opérationnels ; utilise cette compréhension pour accomplir son propre travail. Compréhension approfondie de la manière dont le travail de sa propre équipe s'intègre aux autres équipes et contribue à son domaine. 
 - Fait preuve de discernement et est en capacité de proposer différentes solutions en dehors des paramètres définis, dans le cadre d'une orientation. Se fonde sur une expérience antérieure et la formation professionnelle pour résoudre des tâches simples. Possède les compétences techniques et l'esprit d'analyse nécessaires à la résolution de problèmes. Peut utiliser plusieurs sources internes en dehors de sa propre équipe pour prendre des décisions. 
 - Un poste à ce niveau est susceptible d'être un contributeur individuel, avec des compétences interpersonnelles éprouvées ou un People Leader capable d'embaucher et de développer des talents. Fournit des conseils informels aux nouveaux membres de l'équipe. 

Qualifications De Base

- 
 - Pour les rôles en dehors des États-Unis - Ce rôle nécessite une expérience significative de la fonction et de la station de travail audio numérique. Connaissances de niveau équivalent à une licence dans une université accréditée (ou un baccalauréat avec une expérience dans un domaine pertinent). 
 - Pour les rôles aux États-Unis - Licence d'une université accrédité (ou diplôme d'études secondaires et/ou diplôme d'étude général avec au moins 4 ans d'expérience dans la fonction). 

Caractéristiques souhaitées

- Solides compétences en communication orale et écrite. Solides compétences relationnelles et de leadership. Capacité à influencer les autres et à diriger de petites équipes. Mener des initiatives d'envergure et d'impact modérés. Capacité à coordonner plusieurs projets simultanément. Identification efficace des problèmes et compétences en résolution de problèmes. Capacités d'analyse et d'organisation prouvées. Remarque : Pour se conformer aux exigences légales américaines en matière d'immigration et autres, il est nécessaire de préciser le nombre minimum d'années d'expérience requis pour tout poste basé aux États-Unis. Pour les rôles en dehors des États-Unis, pour assurer la conformité avec la législation applicable, les juristes doivent mentionner le niveau d'expérience requis et non PAS un nombre minimum d'années. Cette description de poste a pour but de fournir un guide détaillé du rôle. Toutefois, il n'est pas prévu de modifier ou de restreindre et/ou d'élargir de quelque manière que ce soit les tâches requises de chaque employé, telles qu'elles sont définies dans leur contrat de travail respectif et/ou convenues d'un commun accord entre un employé et son responsable. 

Additional Information

Relocation Assistance Provided: Yes

data.description:
Job Description

Shape ZenseAI. QI and ZenseAI. AssureAI

- Architect and evolve the platform suite across both engines: the 18-agent ZenseAI. QI stack (DeepSpeci, CaseGeni, Auto-PlayPilot, DataGeni, Secure-Xi, Perf-Xi, Insights360, RIA and Accessibility Intelligence) and the four-pillar ZenseAI. AssureAI framework (Data Quality, Model Evaluation, Trustworthiness, and Scalability & Security).

 - Keep the platforms LLM-agnostic and deployable on any client stack - on-prem, cloud or hybrid - as model-mixing and constant provider churn become the market norm. 
 - Own technical roadmap decisions for accelerators such as the Agentic Foundry (a 25-blueprint reference matrix) and the curated, swap-ready tooling ecosystem around each archetype. 

Lead Evaluation-Driven Development

- Build and govern eval suites - ground-truth Q&A sets, LLM-as-judge rubrics, frozen baselines - that gate every release rather than validate it after the fact. 
 - Own trajectory grading, red/purple/blue-team probes and safety attestations for agentic and generative systems, and drift monitoring and fairness audits for classical ML. 
 - Translate evaluation results into release decisions: eval-threshold gates, red-team severity floors, canary and shadow deployments, and rollback rehearsals. 
 - Bring evaluation-driven development practice into client engagements - showing, not just telling, how a live harness beats a one-time audit. 

Own Presales and Client Proposals

- Respond to RFPs, RFIs and client proposals across both engines, translating client requirements into a defensible solution architecture and commercial structure. 
 - Architect engagements across the full ladder - AI QA Assessment, AI QA Transformation, Managed AI QA - and fast-starts such as the LLM Health Check, Agent Stress Test and Compliance Sprint.

Present and Articulate Value to Clients

- Present the ZenseAI. QI and ZenseAI. AssureAI value proposition directly to client stakeholders - from QA Directors and Heads of AI/ML Engineering to CTOs, Chief Risk Officers and Chief AI Officers - adapting the narrative to each audience.

BETSOL is a cloud-first digital transformation and data management company offering products and IT services to enterprises in over 40 countries. BETSOL's open source backup and recovery product line, Zmanda (Zmanda. com), delivers up to 50% savings in total cost of ownership (TCO) and best-in-class performance. 

BETSOL Global IT Services (BETSOL. com) builds and supports end-to-end enterprise solutions, reducing time-to-market for its customers. 

BETSOL offices are set against the vibrant backdrops of Broomfield, Colorado and Bangalore, India. 

We take pride in being an employee-centric organization, offering comprehensive health insurance, competitive salaries, volunteer programs, and scholarship opportunities. Office amenities include a fitness center, cafe, and recreational facilities. 

Learn more at betsol. com

Job Description

BETSOL is looking for a Network Lead Engineer to own how that network is designed, secured and evolved. This is a design and build role. You will set the network architecture and standards, lead projects from requirements through cutover, and make the technical calls on routing, segmentation, security and cloud connectivity. Day-to-day monitoring, ticket handling and first- and second-line troubleshooting with our IT and NOC teams; you are the engineering authority they escalate complex design problems to, and the person who removes the root causes so those problems stop recurring. 

Key responsibilities

Architecture and design

- Own the end-to-end network architecture across BETSOL offices, data center and colocation sites, and cloud environments, including target-state designs and a multi-year roadmap. 
 - Design LAN, WAN and SD-WAN topologies, routing (BGP, OSPF), segmentation and high-availability patterns, and document them as reference architectures and high- and low-level designs. 
 - Design hybrid and multi-cloud connectivity for Azure and AWS: VNet/VPC architecture, hub-and-spoke and transit designs, ExpressRoute or Direct Connect, site-to-site VPN and private endpoints. 
 - Define network standards: addressing and IP management, naming, configuration baselines, hardware and software lifecycle, and capacity planning. 

Network security and zero trust

- Design and own next-generation firewall policy architecture, micro-segmentation and secure remote access. 
 - Lead the move toward a zero trust and SASE model, including secure web gateway and private access services, in partnership with the security team. 
 - Build network controls and evidence that satisfy ISO/IEC 27001 audits and customer security reviews, and remediate network findings from vulnerability scans and penetration tests. 
 - Design DNS, DDoS protection, web application firewall and load-balancing patterns for internet-facing services. 

Project leadership and delivery

- Lead network projects such as office build-outs, data center migrations, SD-WAN rollouts, firewall refreshes and cloud landing zones, from requirements and design through implementation and cutover. 
 - Write implementation and rollback plans, lead change reviews, and execute or supervise high-risk changes during planned windows. 
 - Evaluate vendors and technologies, run proofs of concept, and produce build-versus-buy recommendations with cost estimates. 
 - Work with cloud, DevOps, security and application teams so network design is part of solution design from the start, not an afterthought. 

Automation and engineering excellence

- Automate configuration, compliance checks and provisioning using Python, Ansible and Terraform, and manage network configuration as code with version control. 
 - Define observability for the network (telemetry, flow data, synthetic checks and meaningful alerts) so operations teams detect issues before users do. 
 - Act as the final technical escalation point for complex design-level problems, lead root cause analysis, and drive permanent architectural fixes. 
 - Mentor network engineers, review their designs and changes, and build runbooks and knowledge so the operations team can run the network independently. 

Qualifications

Required qualifications

- 8+ years of network engineering experience, including at least 2 years in a lead or architect capacity owning designs and projects end to end. 
 - Deep expertise in routing and switching (BGP, OSPF, VLANs, VRFs, QoS) and enterprise WAN or SD-WAN design. 
 - Hands-on design experience with next-generation firewalls such as Palo Alto, Fortinet or Cisco, including policy architecture and segmentation. 
 - Practical cloud networking experience in Azure and/or AWS, including hybrid connectivity. 
 - Network automation skills with Python and Ansible or Terraform. 
 - CCNP Enterprise or CCNP Security, or an equivalent professional-level certification. 
 - Strong written design documentation and the ability to explain trade-offs, cost and risk to technical and non-technical leaders. 
 - Network Certifications such as CCNP, CCIE, CCDE or equivalent (Azure Network Engineer Associate, AWS Advanced Networking etc. ). 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with zero trust and SASE platforms such as Zscaler, Prisma Access or Netskope. 
 - Experience with Kubernetes networking, service mesh or cloud load balancers. 
 - Familiarity with ISO/IEC 27001, SOC 2 network controls and audit evidence. 
 - Experience in an IT services or managed services company supporting multiple customer environments.

Overview

We are looking for a Product Architect for our Image recognition solution, responsible for the end-to-end technical architecture of the product. You will bridge product strategy and engineering execution, defining how the product scales across markets, integrates with enterprise systems, and evolves with AI/CV innovation. This role works in close partnership with the Global Lead, mobile/SDK engineering team, Backend engineering, data science teams, and S&T leadership. You will own architecture decisions across mobile, backend, cloud infrastructure, ML inference, and data pipelines - ensuring the platform meets global security, compliance, and performance standards while remaining agile enough to support continuous market deployments. 

Responsibilities

Platform Architecture & Design

- Define and maintain the end-to-end technical architecture for the IR product across mobile, API, ML pipeline, and cloud layers
 - Design scalable, multi-region cloud infrastructure on Azure (API Management, Blob Storage, Azure Functions, Cosmos DB, KubeRay/Ray Serve)
 - Lead architecture decisions for mobile app features, edge/cloud validation modes, and offline-first mobile scenarios
 - Ensure architecture supports high-volume concurrent field usage for global markets
 - Define data contracts, API schemas, and integration patterns between mobile app, SDK, backend services, and Salesforce apps

AI/CV Integration & Innovation

- Architect the ML inference pipeline for computer vision models including SKU detection, planogram compliance, and share-of-shelf measurement
 - Design model deployment and versioning strategies using KubeRay/Ray Serve or equivalent orchestration platforms

Mobile & Integration Architecture

- Define iOS and Android architecture standards for geo-fencing, image capture, local caching, and sync behaviour
 - Establish mobile contractor technical standards, code review frameworks, and platform-specific constraints documentation
 - Design Salesforce integration patterns for field rep workflows, task assignments, and audit result reporting
 - Architect authentication, session management, and device-level security controls for global field deployments

Infrastructure, Reliability & Security

- Own infrastructure architecture for reliability, fault tolerance, and disaster recovery - including GCS fault tolerance and Redis integration for KubeRay head pod stability
 - Define storage architecture and lifecycle policies to address accumulation issues (zip files, image blobs, log data) at scale
 - Conduct root cause analysis (RCA) for critical infrastructure incidents and produce executive-grade escalation documentation
 - Ensure infrastructure architecture meets GDPR, India DPDP Act, and market-specific data privacy regulations for GPS and biometric data

Data Governance & Compliance Architecture

- Design privacy-by-design data flows for GPS location data, field rep identifiers, and store imagery in compliance with GDPR, DPDP, and other applicable frameworks
 - Define data residency, data minimisation, and retention policies across global cloud deployments
 - Establish security architecture standards for mobile app communications, API authentication, and cloud storage access controls

Stakeholder Engagement & Documentation

- Produce clear, executive-facing architecture documentation, TRDs (Technical Requirements Documents) in partnership with the Global PM
 - Present architecture proposals and trade-off analyses to leadership and cross-functional stakeholders
 - Mentor Engineering team on product architecture standards and best practices
 - Maintain a living architecture registry - covering system diagrams, ADRs (Architecture Decision Records), and integration maps

Qualifications

Experience

- 12-15+ years in software/product architecture roles, with at least 3 years in mobile-first or AI/ML-integrated platforms
 - Proven experience architecting cloud-native platforms on Azure (API Management, Functions, Blob Storage, Cosmos DB)
 - Hands-on experience with ML inference infrastructure - KubeRay, Ray Serve, TorchServe, or equivalent
 - Strong background in mobile architecture for iOS and/or Android, including offline-first design patterns
 - Experience with computer vision, image recognition, or retail execution platforms strongly preferred
 - Prior exposure to FMCG, CPG, or retail technology platforms is a significant advantage

Technical Skills

- Cloud: Azure (primary), AWS/GCP (secondary) - infrastructure design, cost optimisation
 - Mobile: iOS (Swift/Objective-C), Android (Kotlin/Java), cross-platform considerations (React Native, Flutter)
 - ML/AI: Model serving pipelines, MLOps practices, CV model deployment (object detection, classification)
 - Integration: REST APIs, event-driven architectures (Kafka, Service Bus)
 - Data: Cosmos DB, PostgreSQL, Data bricks, cloud storage lifecycle management, data governance frameworks
 - DevOps: Kubernetes, Docker, CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure monitoring and alerting

Soft Skills & Behaviours

- Exceptional ability to translate complex technical architecture into clear, business-relevant narratives for executive audiences
 - Strong cross-functional collaborator - equally effective with product managers, data scientists, field operations leads, and compliance teams
 - Demonstrated ownership mindset - proactively identifies risks, escalates with solutions, and drives resolution end-to-end
 - Comfortable operating in ambiguous, multi-market environments with competing priorities
 - Excellent written communication - capable of producing publication-quality TRDs, PRDs, and architecture decision records

Job Title: Head of Data Science, India GSC

- We are looking for a principal-level developer who still wants to build and cares deeply about design. You will develop the user experience, APIs and supporting services for an internal platform that helps people across Asset Management understand the data behind business processes and improve its quality. Based in the Data and Analytics Office, you will work closely with business users and collaborate with data, AI and Technology colleagues to turn ideas into useful software. Technology leads production deployment and ongoing service operation, so you will build in partnership with them to the standards required for a secure, scalable and supported product. 

In This Role, You Will

This role suits you if you: 

- build complete web applications with modern TypeScript front ends (whether Angular, React or Vue) and Python services behind them, deployed through pipelines to the cloud; 
 - have shipped applications to production that people use, and can show the results; 
 - care about design as much as code, and simplifying things is your instinct; 
 - are comfortable developing within a business-led data team while collaborating closely with Technology to bring applications into production; 
 - have a history of building and launching things, at work or in your own time, and a portfolio that shows it. 
 - It is unlikely to suit you if your recent role has been mainly architecture or oversight rather than hands-on coding, if you have not built Python back-end services, or if you have worked on only one side of the stack. Experience beyond the core profile is welcome, but it cannot replace it. 

Build data applications end to end

- Design and build the platform from interface to data layer, including TypeScript front ends (Angular or React), Python services and APIs (FastAPI ), and the data access, integration and transformation code behind them. 
 - Translate loosely defined business and user needs into pragmatic designs and working software, iterating with users from prototype to pilot and, with Technology, into supported production services. 
 - Architect for scale and change with clean service boundaries, performance under real load, and code that stays easy to extend as the platform grows. 
 - Work with Technology colleagues on cloud deployment (Google Cloud), automated CI/CD pipelines, monitoring and the requirements for a secure and supported production service. 
 - Build reusable components, API patterns and templates that make each subsequent platform capability faster to deliver. 

Design Experiences People Want To Use

- Own UX and UI end to end. Understand business users' needs, sketch and test flows, and take designs from wireframe to polished interface without depending on a separate design team. 
 - Simplify relentlessly, turning business processes, metadata, ownership, lineage, data-quality rules and exceptions into clear, intuitive views, and personalise experiences to each user's role and needs. 
 - Design iteratively, using usage analytics and user feedback to measure engagement and refine what works. 
 - Establish a design system and front-end patterns, built to accessibility standards (WCAG 2. 2 AA). 

Work with data , technology and AI colleagues

- Work with Data Architecture and Governance and Data Product Owners so platform capabilities reflect agreed data models, definitions, ownership and controls. 
 - Partner closely with Technology architects, engineers and service colleagues on solution design, integration, security, deployment and support. Technology will lead production readiness, controlled release and ongoing service operation. 
 - Bring the work of data scientists and AI specialists into the platform where it adds value, with appropriate APIs, guardrails and telemetry. 

Lead agentic development practice

- Build day to day with GitHub Copilot and Claude Code, working in a spec-first way. Agree the plan, let agents implement in small increments, then review, test and refine. 
 - Set up and maintain the team's AI development workflow, including repository instruction files (for example CLAUDE. md, AGENTS. md or Copilot custom instructions), reusable agent skills, custom agents and subagents, and MCP connections to approved tools. 3 PUBLIC 
 - Build guardrails into the workflow, such as hooks and CI checks that enforce tests, linting and security scanning on AI generated code, and make sure no confidential data leaves approved boundaries. 
 - Mentor colleagues in using these tools with judgement, including recognising when an agent's output should not be trusted. 

Engineer to production standard

- Work within the bank's software development lifecycle, including version control, code review, automated testing, CI/CD, security scanning, clear API specifications (OpenAPI) and documentation. 
 - Design for enterprise requirements from the outset, including authentication and authorisation , auditability, resilience and supportability, and meet data protection, information security and AI risk requirements. 
 - Agree engineering standards, interfaces and production requirements with Technology colleagues so capabilities developed within the Data and Analytics Office can be deployed and supported through Technology-led processes. 
 - Set development standards and reference patterns for colleagues contributing to application development, lead design and code reviews, and mentor others to deliver to a consistent standard. 

To Be Successful You Will

- You should be able to evidence all of the following, through your portfolio and from roles in the last few years. 
 - A track record of shipping web applications to production that real users adopted, with evidence of usage or engagement. 
 - Experience at senior, staff, principal or lead level while remaining an active developer, with most of your recent time spent designing and writing code. 
 - Expert TypeScript front-end development in at least one modern component framework (we use Angular and React; Vue is also relevant), with the depth to move comfortably between them, including state management, component design, testing 
 - and performance. 
 - Production experience building and securing Python APIs, ideally with FastAPI (Flask or Django also relevant), including Pydantic validation, asynchronous programming and API design. 
 - Strong UX and UI design ability, shown through interfaces that make complex workflows or data simple to use, and the ability to design and prototype your own interfaces. 
 - Well-architected, scalable code with sound application design, performance tuning and code that others can maintain. 
 - Advanced SQL, data modelling and experience integrating multiple data sources and APIs into a coherent application. 
 - Hands-on cloud experience (Google Cloud, Azure or AWS), including Docker, deploying through CI/CD pipelines, and running applications in production. 
 - Engineering discipline covering Git, code review, automated testing (for example pytest, Playwright or framework test tools) and secure coding, including OAuth 2. 0 and OpenID Connect. 
 - Hands-on use of agentic coding tools (for example Claude Code, GitHub Copilot or Cursor) beyond autocomplete, including planning work for agents, giving them the right context through instruction files, skills or custom agents, and reviewing and testing what they produce. 
 - A working understanding of metadata, data lineage, data quality and semantic layers, and why they matter to users. 
 - Experience collaborating across business-led data teams and Technology to move software from rapid development into secure, supported production services. 
 - Clear written and spoken English, and confidence working with senior stakeholders across time zones. 
 - Exceptional design for data applications. You make dense, complex information feel simple and obvious, and your interfaces are as polished as they are useful. 
 - Iterative, evidence-led design. You test with users, instrument usage and refine designs based on how people actually behave.

data.description:
Job description

Position Overview: 

We are looking for an experienced Manager New Product Development (Appliances) to lead the end-to-end development and launch of new home and kitchen appliance products. The ideal candidate must have strong hands-on experience in the appliances category, including product development, vendor/OEM management, product specifications, sampling, testing, costing, compliance, commercialization and new product launches. The role will work closely with vendors and internal cross-functional teams to bring innovative, reliable, safe and commercially viable appliance products to market. 

Key Responsibilities: 

- Appliances Category Development: Drive new product development specifically for home and kitchen appliances, with a strong understanding of product functionality, consumer use cases, category trends, and technical requirements. 
 - Market Research & Consumer Insights: Conduct market research, analyze customer feedback, ratings, reviews, complaints and category trends to identify new product opportunities and improvements to existing products. 
 - New Product Launch Management: Own and coordinate end-to-end new product launches from concept identification and product specification through sampling, validation, commercialization and market launch. 
 - Product Specification Development: Define detailed product specifications including wattage, voltage, capacity, material, motor or heating performance, safety features, accessories, functionality and user requirements. 
 - Competitive Benchmarking: Benchmark competitor appliances across features, specifications, technology, performance, design, price points, customer ratings, reviews and pain points to develop differentiated products. 
 - Vendor / OEM / ODM Development: Identify, evaluate, onboard, and manage domestic and international appliance manufacturers, OEMs, and ODM partners based on capability, quality, cost, capacity, compliance and delivery performance. 
 - Vendor Management & Coordination: Maintain strong vendor relationships, follow up on development timelines, resolve technical and commercial issues, and ensure timely completion of samples, tooling, pilot production and bulk production. 
 - Sample Development & Validation: Manage multiple sample iterations, coordinate testing, capture feedback, drive design and engineering corrections, and ensure final golden-sample approval before commercialization. 
 - Technical Evaluation & Product Testing: Work closely with QA and vendors to evaluate product performance, durability, electrical safety, usability, reliability and functional consistency prior to launch. 
 - Compliance & Certification: Coordinate applicable regulatory and compliance requirements for electrical appliances, including BIS/ISI, product safety, testing, labeling, packaging and other statutory requirements as relevant. 
 - Costing & Commercial Negotiation: Work with vendors on BOM understanding, target costing, tooling and mould costs, MOQ, lead time, payment terms and commercial negotiations to achieve desired cost and margin targets. 
 - Pilot & Mass Production Readiness: Coordinate pilot batches, pre-production validation, manufacturing readiness, quality checkpoints and smooth transition from development to mass production.

As we scale toward our next chapter, we are looking for high-performers who want to do the best work of their careers at the intersection of AI and Cybersecurity.

Safe is not a typical corporate environment. We are a high-intensity, mission-driven team. We value builders who want to define a category and work alongside people who are equally committed to excellence. 

- Extreme Ownership: We don't do "not my job. " We hire people who see a gap and own the solution from start to finish.

We want our team to feel like owners because they are owners. We trust our people to manage their results and their time.

 - Analyze production issues and implement preventive measures to improve application stability, reliability, and performance. Collaboration

Drive architecture for AI observability, safety, and evaluation (precision, recall, F1, hallucination detection, cost metrics).

 - Mentor & Multiply: Guide AI and backend engineers on architectural design, experimentation methodologies, and prompt optimization. Collaborate with product leaders to translate abstract AI goals into measurable engineering deliverables. 

Minimum Qualifications: 

- Experience: 12+ years total experience in software engineering, including 4+ years building AI/ML systems or large-scale data/LLM infrastructure. 
 - MLOps & Infra: Familiar with model versioning, CI/CD for ML, and performance optimization for real-time inference. 
 - Applied AI Focus: Practical understanding of evaluation metrics, hallucination detection, RAG reliability, and enterprise AI safety.

- Strong programming fundamentals in Python, Go, or TypeScript
 - Deep understanding of LLM-based architectures, prompt engineering, and RAG pipelines
 - Hands-on experience with LangChain, LlamaIndex, or equivalent orchestration frameworks
 - Vector databases (FAISS, Pinecone, Weaviate, Redis Vector, or Milvus)

Preferred Qualifications: 

- Experience integrating AI into cybersecurity or risk management products
 - Familiarity with multi-agent systems and autonomous workflows (CrewAI, LangGraph, AutoGen)

 - Knowledge of knowledge graphs, semantic search, or retrieval pipelines
 - Exposure to data governance, compliance, or SOC2/ISO 27001 environments
 - Published research, open-source contributions, or prior leadership of AI teams is a strong plus

If you're passionate about cyber risk, thrive in a fast-paced environment, and want to be part of a team that's redefining security, we want to hear from you! 🚀

Software Engineering Manager, AI Migrations (Forward Deployed)

Location: Pune, India

At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don't just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset - who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done. 

Snowflake is about empowering enterprises to achieve their full potential - and people too. With a culture that's all in on impact, innovation, and collaboration, Snowflake is the sweet spot for building big, moving fast, and taking technology - and careers - to the next level. 

Snowflake redefined the data landscape over a decade ago, and our biggest opportunity is also our customers' biggest challenge: migration. For every enterprise ready to harness the AI Data Cloud, there is a complex web of legacy systems that can take years and millions of dollars to untangle. We believe generative AI is the key. We are building products that don't just move data, but understand and rewrite the logic of entire data applications. 

We are hiring a Software Engineering Manager, AI Migrations (Forward Deployed) to work at the intersection of customer delivery and product engineering. In this hybrid role, you will lead a team of Forward Deployed Engineers who work directly with customers and partners on complex migrations, while also driving the development of AI-powered migration tools and products. Your team will be the bridge between field realities and product innovation, turning hard-won migration patterns into scalable, automated solutions. 

AS A SOFTWARE ENGINEERING MANAGER, AI MIGRATIONS AT SNOWFLAKE, YOU WILL: 

Lead and develop the team

- Manage and mentor a team of Forward Deployed Engineers, giving clear feedback and building growth paths
 - Recruit, hire and onboard engineers who can succeed in both customer delivery and engineering
 - Grow technical delivery leads and engineering leaders, including staff-level engineers
 - Foster a culture of creativity, innovation and practical decision-making

Deliver customer migrations

- Lead complex migrations from legacy platforms such as Oracle, Teradata, Netezza and SQL Server to Snowflake
 - Provide strategic oversight so projects align with customer objectives and Snowflake's goals
 - Act as the primary escalation point for delivery, working closely with customers and system integrators
 - Stay hands-on in strategic projects to assess quality and unblock teams
 - Partner with sales teams to scope opportunities, estimate effort, develop proposals and support account strategy

Build AI-powered migration products

- Drive the design, development and iteration of AI-powered migration tools based on real customer needs
 - Guide the team in building AI-first products, including code translation, developer co-pilots and semantic validation
 - Turn field insights into engineering roadmap items and product improvements
 - Partner with Engineering and Product Management to align priorities and deliver high-quality solutions
 - Develop and share best practices, utilities and accelerators that speed up migrations and feed back into the product

Drive cross-functional impact

- Influence go-to-market strategy and lead improvements across Sales and Engineering
 - Encourage knowledge sharing between field engineers and product engineering teams
 - Present migration strategy, product vision and business outcomes to technical and executive audiences

OUR IDEAL SOFTWARE ENGINEERING MANAGER WILL HAVE: 

- A university degree in computer science, engineering, mathematics or a related field, or equivalent experience
 - 7+ years of experience in technical roles spanning customer-facing delivery and engineering
 - 5+ years of people management experience, mentoring and developing technical teams
 - 3+ years of experience building and delivering enterprise software products, ideally involving AI/ML or developer tools
 - A proven track record of leading teams through complex data platform migrations and cloud transformations
 - A strong foundation in databases, data warehousing and data processing, with hands-on experience on large-scale systems such as Oracle, Teradata, Netezza, SQL Server, Greenplum or Hadoop
 - A deep understanding of cloud platforms (AWS, Azure or GCP) and the full data analytics stack, including ETL, data platform design and BI
 - Extensive hands-on expertise in SQL and scripting (Python, Perl or Bash)
 - Experience scoping engagements, including delivery estimates, proposals and project plans
 - The flexibility to step into product manager, program manager or architect roles when needed
 - Excellent presentation skills for technical and executive audiences

BONUS POINTS FOR: 

- Experience with data integration and transformation tools such as Informatica, DataStage, Talend, Matillion or dbt
 - Experience with BI tools such as Tableau, MicroStrategy or Business Objects
 - Experience building GenAI-powered developer tools, such as code translation or co-pilots

Snowflake is growing fast, and we're scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake. 

How do you want to make your impact?
