At MiniMed, you can begin a lifelong career of exploration and innovation, while helping make a difference in the lives of people living with diabetes around the globe. You'll lead with purpose, breaking down barriers to innovation for a more connected, compassionate world. 

About The Role

The Cloud Engineer designs, builds, and operates core cloud platform capabilities with a primary focus on AWS, while supporting Azure and Google Cloud Platform (GCP) where required. This role is responsible for delivering standardized, automated, and reusable cloud foundations-such as account provisioning, identity integration, networking baselines, and deployment pipelines-that enable application teams to move quickly without compromising security, governance, or reliability. 

The Cloud Engineer works closely with Cloud Engineering, Architecture, Security, and Operations to translate architectural standards into durable platform services. The emphasis is on automation-first delivery, infrastructure-as-code, and building platforms that scale through consistency rather than manual effort. 

#BetterDaysStartNow

Principal Cloud Engineer

The Cloud Engineer designs, builds, and operates core cloud platform capabilities with a primary focus on AWS, while supporting Azure and Google Cloud Platform (GCP) where required. This role is responsible for delivering standardized, automated, and reusable cloud foundations-such as account provisioning, identity integration, networking baselines, and deployment pipelines-that enable application teams to move quickly without compromising security, governance, or reliability. 

The Cloud Engineer works closely with Cloud Engineering, Architecture, Security, and Operations to translate architectural standards into durable platform services. The emphasis is on automation-first delivery, infrastructure-as-code, and building platforms that scale through consistency rather than manual effort. 

Cloud Engineering & Delivery

- Design, engineer, and operate foundational cloud services primarily on AWS, with support for Azure and GCP as part of a multi-cloud strategy. 
 - Build and maintain standardized platform components including account provisioning, identity and access integration, networking foundations, and shared services. 
 - Translate architectural standards and guardrails into reusable, production-grade platform implementations. 

Infrastructure as Code & Automation

- Develop and manage Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Terraform to ensure repeatable, auditable, and version-controlled deployments. 
 - Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines using GitHub and GitHub Actions to support platform automation and safe change delivery. 
 - Reduce manual effort and operational toil through automation and self-service patterns. 

Observability & Reliability

- Implement and maintain monitoring, logging, and alerting standards for platform services using native cloud tooling and approved third-party observability platforms. 
 - Partner with SRE and Operations teams to improve reliability, resilience, and recovery of platform components. 
 - Participate in incident response and post-incident reviews for platform-related services, driving corrective and preventative improvements. 

Security, Governance & Compliance Enablement

- Partner with Architecture, Security, and Governance teams to enforce identity, access, tagging, and compliance guardrails across cloud environments. 
 - Ensure platform services are secure-by-default, auditable, and aligned with regulatory and enterprise standards. 
 - Support policy-as-code and guardrail automation where applicable. 

Documentation & Enablement

- Contribute to platform blueprints, reference architectures, and technical documentation. 
 - Publish clear guidance and patterns that enable application teams to consume platform services consistently. 
 - Share knowledge and best practices across the engineering organization. 

Minimum Qualifications

- 8+ years of experience in cloud engineering, Cloud Engineering, or DevOps roles. 
 - Strong hands-on experience with AWS; exposure to Azure and/or GCP strongly preferred. 
 - Proven proficiency with Infrastructure as Code, preferably Terraform. 
 - Hands-on experience building CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions or similar tooling. 
 - Solid understanding of core cloud services including IAM, networking, compute, storage, and monitoring. 
 - Experience with container platforms and orchestration (e. g. , ECS, EKS, AKS, or GKE). 
 - Ability to work effectively in an Agile environment and collaborate across engineering, security, and operations teams. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience supporting multi-cloud or hybrid cloud environments. 
 - Familiarity with cloud governance constructs such as AWS Organizations and Control Tower, Azure management groups and policies, or GCP projects and folders. 
 - Exposure to FinOps practices, cost optimization techniques, or automated remediation tooling. 
 - Relevant certifications such as AWS Solutions Architect (Associate or Professional), Azure Solutions Architect, or Google Professional Cloud Engineer. 
 - Strong written communication skills with the ability to produce clear technical documentation and platform standards. 

What Success Looks Like

- Platform services are reliable, repeatable, and consumed broadly by application teams. 
 - Cloud environments launch with consistent security, networking, and governance baselines. 
 - Manual effort decreases as automation and self-service increase. 
 - Platform standards are implemented in code, not enforced through meetings. 
 - Application teams can move faster because the platform "just works. "

Physical Job Requirements

The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by employees assigned to this position, but they are not an exhaustive list of all the required responsibilities and skills of this position. 

Benefits & Compensation

MiniMed offers a competitive salary and flexible benefits package

At MiniMed, we put people first. A commitment to our employees lives at the core of our values: We recognize their contributions. They share in the success they help create. We offer a wide range of benefits, resources, and competitive compensation plans designed to support you at every stage of your career and life. 

About MiniMed

We want to make every day a better day for people living with diabetes. Our team of creative innovators around the globe share a passion for finding the simplest solutions to the problems that people with diabetes face on a daily basis. For more than 40 years, we've been redefining what's possible, from intelligent dosing systems designed for real life to predictive insights that stay a step ahead, and we're dedicated to continuing to support our customers through every step of their journey - meeting them where and how they need it.

JOB DESCRIPTION

Control Design Engineer - Transformer & Switchgear

Company: Virginia Transformer Corp

Department: Engineering

Function: Control Design

Location: Hyderabad / Delhi / Vadodara

Experience: 4-10 Years

Employment Type: Full-Time

Working Hours: 11: 00 AM - 8: 30 PM

Reporting To: Engineering Manager

About Virginia Transformer

Virginia Transformer is the largest U. S. -owned manufacturer of power transformers in North America, with over 50 years of experience delivering engineered-to-order transformer solutions across Data Center, Utility, Industrial, and Renewable Energy markets. 

Following significant growth, we are expanding our engineering team in India to support our next phase of expansion. 

Role Overview

We are seeking skilled and experienced Control Design Engineer with strong technical expertise in the design and development of control systems for Power Transformers, Auto Transformers, and Switchgear. 

The selected candidates will be responsible for developing control schematics, RTCC and OLTC control systems, cooling fan controls, wiring diagrams, control panel designs, and engineering documentation while ensuring compliance with customer specifications and applicable industry standards. 

Key Responsibilities

- Design and develop electrical control systems for Power Transformers, Auto Transformers, and Switchgear. 
 - Prepare control schematics, wiring diagrams, and detailed engineering drawings for transformer control panels. 
 - Design and develop RTCC (Remote Tap Changer Control) panels and OLTC (On-Load Tap Changer) control circuits. 
 - Develop control circuits for transformer cooling fans, temperature monitoring, alarms, and protection systems. 
 - Work with Current Transformers (CT), auxiliary circuits, and associated control and protection components. 
 - Support integration of transformer control systems with SCADA and PLC-based automation systems. 
 - Perform electrical load calculations, wire sizing, and selection of circuit protection devices. 
 - Review customer specifications, technical requirements, and engineering documentation. 
 - Prepare Bills of Materials (BOM), component specifications, and design notes. 
 - Select appropriate electrical components, control devices, relays, and accessories. 
 - Ensure designs comply with applicable IEEE, ANSI, IEC, and customer-specific requirements. 
 - Coordinate with Electrical Design, Mechanical Design, Manufacturing, Quality, and other engineering teams. 
 - Provide technical clarifications and engineering support to the USA manufacturing facilities. 
 - Ensure design accuracy, timely completion of engineering deliverables, and adherence to quality standards. 
 - Support engineering improvements, design standardization, and technical documentation. 

Qualifications & Experience

- Bachelor's Degree or Diploma in Electrical Engineering, Electrical & Electronics Engineering, or a related discipline. 
 - 4-10 years of relevant experience in transformer control design, switchgear engineering, or electrical control panel design. 
 - Hands-on experience in transformer control schematics, RTCC panels, OLTC controls, and panel wiring. 
 - Knowledge of electrical control circuits, protection systems, and electrical engineering drawings. 
 - Understanding of SCADA and PLC integration will be an added advantage. 
 - Experience in Power Transformer or Auto Transformer control design is preferred. 
 - Familiarity with relevant industry standards and engineering practices. 

Preferred Technical Skills

- Power Transformer Control Design
 - Auto Transformer Control Systems
 - RTCC & OLTC Control Circuits
 - Control Panel Design & Engineering
 - Transformer Cooling Control Systems
 - SCADA & PLC Integration
 - Electrical Wiring Diagrams & Schematics
 - Current Transformer (CT) Circuits
 - Load Calculations & Wire Sizing
 - Circuit Protection & Component Selection
 - Bill of Materials (BOM) Preparation
 - CAD / Electrical Design Software
 - IEEE / ANSI / IEC Standards

Key Competencies

- Strong Technical Knowledge
 - Engineering Judgment & Analytical Thinking
 - Problem-Solving & Decision-Making
 - Attention to Detail & Design Accuracy
 - Ownership & Accountability
 - Teamwork & Cross-Functional Collaboration
 - Effective Communication
 - Design Quality & Process Discipline
 - Learning Agility & Adaptability
 - Timely Engineering Delivery

Why Join Virginia Transformer?

- Global Exposure: Work closely with USA-based engineering and manufacturing teams. 
 - Engineering Excellence: Contribute to technically challenging engineered-to-order transformer projects. 
 - High-Growth Environment: Be part of an organization expanding into its next 3X growth phase. 
 - Career Development: Opportunities for technical advancement and professional growth. 
 - Innovation: Contribute to engineering improvements, automation, and design standardization. 

Ready to Power Your Career?

Join Virginia Transformer Corp - The Commitment Company. 

We are looking for motivated engineering professionals with strong technical expertise, ownership, problem-solving capabilities, and a commitment to engineering excellence. 

Company Website: www. vatransformer. com

data.title: Team Lead - Cargo Operations & Capacity Planning
data.description:
Job Purpose

Supervises and coordinates the daily activities of the Cargo Operations and Load Planning team to ensure efficient, accurate, and compliant cargo operations across the network. The role supports operational excellence by overseeing load planning, monitoring team performance, providing guidance to planners, and ensuring adherence to safety, regulatory, and operational standards. 

Key Result Responsibilities

- Supervise the planning and coordination of daily cargo operations, including general cargo, courier, special cargo, and interline shipments. 
 - Plan and manage team rosters to ensure adequate staffing levels, operational coverage, and compliance with duty time requirements. 
 - Ensure accurate load plans are prepared and released to Ground Handling Agents (GHAs), maintaining full compliance with operational, safety, and regulatory requirements. 
 - Monitor load planner performance and provide coaching, feedback, and on-the-job training to maintain and improve operational standards. 
 - Optimize aircraft belly space utilization while prioritizing safety, weight and balance limitations, and regulatory compliance. 
 - Oversee intra-country trucking coordination as assigned and interline cargo connections to ensure seamless cargo movement. 
 - Ensure critical system changes (cargo reservations, weight amendments, HS codes, AWB corrections) are accurately executed in a timely manner. 
 - Monitor EDI messaging accuracy (FFM, FWB, FHL) and initiate corrective actions where discrepancies are identified. 

Key Result Responsibilities - Continued

- Identify operational backlogs, discrepancies, or delayed flights, and coordinate effective recovery and mitigation plans. 
 - Ensure accurate documentation and reporting of operational deviations, incidents, and corrective actions. 
 - Collaborate closely with internal stakeholders including Station Operations, Flight Operations, Revenue Management, and Cargo Sales to ensure smooth and efficient cargo operations across the network. 

People Management

- Provides direction, coaching and guidance to team members for their career and professional development. 
 - Creates a conducive working environment to build and sustain a performance driven, engaged, and committed team. 
 - Ensures people management responsibilities are handled effectively in line with company procedures. 

Qualifications (Academic, Training, Languages)

- Bachelor's degree in Aviation, Logistics, Supply Chain Management, or related field preferred. Certification in Air Cargo Operations, Load Planning, or Dangerous Goods regulations is a plus. 
 - Strong computer literacy, including Microsoft Office and cargo system applications. 
 - Ability to work under pressure in a 24x7 operational environment with shift schedules. 
 - Fluent in English; additional languages a plus. 
 - Strong understanding of cargo operations, load planning principles, and airline operational procedures. 
 - Ability to supervise, mentor, and coordinate a team of planners effectively. 
 - Analytical and problem-solving skills to optimize load planning and operational efficiency. 
 - Excellent communication, coordination, and stakeholder management abilities. 

Work Experience

- 4 - 6 years of experience in air cargo operations, with at least 2 years in a supervisory or team leading role.

Skills And Experience

 - Branch Banking Systems

 - Professional Memberships; relevant memberships to be agreed

About Standard Chartered

We're an international bank, nimble enough to act, big enough for impact. For more than 170 years, we've worked to make a positive difference for our clients, communities, and each other. data.title: Supervising Associate For Netting And Settlement
data.description:
At EY, you'll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we're counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all. 

Supervising Associate - Netting and Settlement

Finance and Accounting: Controlling

Role purpose. 

Lead the day-to-day delivery of the NetPay netting and settlement process, ensuring accurate reconciliation of intercompany balances, timely settlement, strong controls and a consistent service experience for participating EY member firms. The role combines operational ownership with people leadership, member-firm onboarding, stakeholder management, escalation management and continuous improvement. 

Key Responsibilities

- NetPay operations and settlement delivery
 - Own and coordinate daily NetPay operations across participating member firms, ensuring activities are completed accurately, on time and in line with agreed controls and service expectations. 
 - Oversee the review and matching of intercompany invoices and open positions across AP and AR, ensuring completeness, consistency and timely resolution of discrepancies. 
 - Coordinate the identification and exchange of missing documents and support member firms in correcting mismatches, disputed invoices and other exceptions. 
 - Review periodic netting and payment calculations and confirm that settlement outputs are complete, accurate and appropriately validated before circulation. 
 - Monitor member-firm payment execution and support the correct application and clearing of receipts and payments. 
 - Maintain operational trackers, reconciliations, evidence and process documentation to support transparency, control and audit readiness. 

- Member-firm onboarding and adoption
 - Partner with member firms to onboard them into NetPay, from initial engagement and process assessment through readiness, testing, implementation and transition to business-as-usual operations. 
 - Explain NetPay requirements, roles, timelines, controls, data and documentation expectations to local Finance, AP, AR, Treasury and Controlling stakeholders. 
 - Develop onboarding plans, track dependencies and risks, and coordinate actions across the central netting team and member-firm stakeholders. 
 - Facilitate onboarding workshops, process walkthroughs and knowledge-transfer sessions; provide post-go-live support and stabilize operations. 
 - Monitor adoption and compliance after onboarding, address gaps and promote consistent use of the standard NetPay process. 

- Team management and capability development
 - Provide day-to-day direction, work allocation and prioritization for the Netting and Settlement team, balancing operational deadlines, onboarding activity and improvement initiatives. 
 - Review team output for quality, completeness and timeliness; provide practical coaching and feedback to strengthen technical and stakeholder-management capability. 
 - Ensure adequate coverage, effective handovers and clear ownership of recurring activities, exceptions and follow-ups. 
 - Create an inclusive, collaborative environment that encourages accountability, knowledge sharing, continuous learning and proactive problem solving. 
 - Identify training needs, maintain process knowledge and support the development of subject-matter expertise and succession capability within the team. 

- Stakeholder and escalation management
 - Act as the primary operational point of contact for participating member firms and central stakeholders on NetPay, netting and settlement matters. 
 - Build effective working relationships across geographies and functions, align expectations and provide clear, concise updates on operational status, risks, issues and decisions required. 
 - Manage escalations relating to unmatched items, missing documents, disputed invoices, delayed payments, process non-compliance and service delivery concerns. 
 - Perform root-cause analysis, agree corrective actions with relevant stakeholders and monitor actions through closure. 
 - Escalate material risks and unresolved issues to leadership promptly, supported by facts, impact assessment and recommended next steps. 

- Quality, controls and process improvement
 - Drive a strong quality and control culture through defined review checks, exception monitoring, ageing analysis and timely corrective action. 
 - Identify recurring issues, control gaps, manual effort and process bottlenecks; translate observations into practical improvement initiatives. 
 - Lead or support standardization, simplification and automation opportunities that improve accuracy, cycle time, transparency and stakeholder experience. 
 - Define and monitor relevant operational measures, quality indicators and action plans; use data and trends to prioritize improvement opportunities. 
 - Maintain standard operating procedures, process maps, control documentation and other governance materials so they remain current and usable. 
 - Support internal and external audit requirements relating to intercompany netting and settlement, including timely provision of evidence and resolution of observations. 

- Reporting and governance
 - Prepare and review weekly operational reporting for participating member firms, providing visibility of invoice status, exceptions, ageing, pending actions and key risks. 
 - Provide regular management updates covering delivery performance, onboarding progress, escalations, quality, improvement initiatives and decisions required. 
 - Facilitate operational governance calls and ensure actions, owners and target dates are clearly documented and followed through. 
 - Ensure compliance with applicable accounting requirements, EY policies, legal requirements and locally agreed operating procedures. 
To qualify for the role, you must have

- Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration or a related field. 
 - Relevant experience in intercompany accounting, AP, AR, financial accounting, netting, settlement, treasury operations or a comparable finance process. 
 - Demonstrated experience coordinating or supervising a team, including work allocation, quality review, coaching and delivery oversight. 
 - Experience managing stakeholders across countries, functions and levels, with confidence in handling operational escalations and competing priorities. 
 - Working knowledge of ERP and accounting systems; experience with SAP is preferred. 
 - Strong understanding of reconciliations, transaction matching, exception management, payment flows and financial controls. 
 - Ability to analyze operational data, identify root causes and translate findings into sustainable process improvements. 
 - Good written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain complex issues clearly and drive actions to closure. 
 - Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively in a global, cross-cultural team environment. 

What We Look For

- People who combine finance process knowledge with sound judgment, service orientation and the confidence to lead through operational complexity. 
 - Professionals who are curious, collaborative and willing to challenge existing ways of working while protecting quality and control. 
 - Individuals who can create trusted relationships with member firms and motivate a team to deliver reliable outcomes. 

What We Offer

EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic global delivery network. In this role, you will collaborate with EY teams across geographies and contribute to a process that supports accurate, timely and transparent intercompany settlement. 

- Continuous learning: Develop the mindset and skills to navigate what comes next. 
 - Success as defined by you: Use the tools and flexibility available to make a meaningful impact. 
 - Transformative leadership: Build the insight, coaching capability and confidence needed to lead effectively. 
 - Diverse and inclusive culture: Use your voice, value different perspectives and help others contribute at their best. 

EY | Building a better working world

EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets. 

Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate. 

Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

data.title: Consulting Manager
data.description:
Role Overview

OFI Services is seeking a Technical Consulting Manager to lead the architecture and delivery of enterprise-grade solutions across cloud, data, AI and automation platforms. You will define how solutions are designed and built, choose the right platforms and services for each concern, and ensure that teams deliver them to a high engineering standard. You will own technical direction and delivery quality, guide a team of engineers and consultants, and act as the escalation point for complex architecture, integration and performance challenges. 

This is a design-and-lead role, not an individual-contributor build role. The ideal candidate has a track record of architecting large solutions that teams then build and operate, and remains technical enough to challenge designs, review code and make sound platform choices. You will also grow into broader team and client leadership. 

Key Responsibilities

Solution Architecture and Design

- Define the end-to-end technical architecture for enterprise solutions, from requirement gathering and discovery through design, build, testing, deployment, hypercare and production support. 
 - Select and justify platforms and services (build, buy or configure) against client needs, cost, security and scalability, using standard or custom platforms as appropriate. 
 - Review and approve solution designs, data models and code produced by the team; set engineering standards, architecture decision records and peer-review practices. 
 - Produce reference architectures, patterns and reusable accelerators that can be applied across engagements. Cloud, Platform and DevOps Engineering

- Architect solutions on GCP, Microsoft Azure and the wider Microsoft ecosystem (for example Microsoft Fabric, Power Platform, Entra ID and Microsoft 365), selecting best-in-class services for each need. 
 - Establish Infrastructure as Code, CI/CD and DevOps standards (for example Terraform or Bicep with GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps or Cloud Build) with automated testing, environment promotion and release governance. 
 - Design identity and access management, secrets management and security controls, including role-based access, single sign-on, least-privilege and audit trails. 
 - Define observability, monitoring, alerting and incident management practices across applications, data pipelines and AI workloads (for example OpenTelemetry, Azure Monitor and Google Cloud Operations). 
 - Guide non-functional design: performance, resilience, disaster recovery, cost management (FinOps) and compliance. Data Engineering and Knowledge Platforms

- Oversee the design and optimisation of data platforms and pipelines: ingestion, ETL/ELT, orchestration, data modelling, data quality and lineage. 
 - Lead integration with enterprise applications such as SAP ECC/S/4HANA, Oracle, Salesforce and ServiceNow, ensuring data quality, scalability and performance. 
 - Design knowledge graph solutions (for example Neo4j and other graph or semantic technologies) and ontologies that connect enterprise data for analytics, search and AI use cases. 
 - Set standards for data governance, security, access control and data validation. AI, Automation and Enterprise Platforms

- Design AI solutions that use large language models appropriately, including hosted models such as Claude and self-hosted or open-weight models run through tools such as Ollama, with attention to retrieval, agents, guardrails, evaluation, data privacy and cost. 
 - Architect extensions and integrations on SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP), including the use of SAP Joule and AI capabilities within SAP landscapes. 
 - Lead intelligent automation design using UiPath and related tools such as Power Automate, combining RPA, APIs and AI in governed, scalable operating models. 
 - Oversee process intelligence solutions, including Celonis (PQL, object-centric process mining, Action Flows and AI features), where these form part of the client solution. Delivery and Team Leadership

- Own delivery of engagements end to end: scoping, estimation, planning, solution delivery, hypercare and handover to production support. 
 - Lead, coach and develop a team of consultants and engineers; run staffing, performance reviews and career development. 
 - Mentor the team, run technical training and support certification paths across cloud, data and platform skills. 
 - Manage engagement financials, including budgets, utilisation, forecasting and margin. 
 - Build reusable assets, templates and best practices, and set delivery quality standards for the team. Client and Practice Leadership

- Act as the senior technical contact for business sponsors, process owners and IT leadership; manage expectations, risks, scope and escalations. 
 - Support pre-sales and solutioning: discovery workshops, architecture proposals, demos, proofs of value, sizing and statements of work. 
 - Track the technology landscape and vendor roadmaps (cloud, SAP, AI and automation) and share new capabilities with the team and clients. 
 - Represent OFI in client steering committees and internal practice forums. Required Skills and Experience

Architecture and Delivery

- Proven experience designing and delivering enterprise-scale solutions, where the team builds to your architecture and you own design quality and delivery outcomes. 
 - Ability to evaluate standard versus custom platforms and make clear, defensible technology choices. 
 - Ability to estimate effort, manage technical risk and lead delivery across multiple concurrent workstreams. Cloud and Engineering Practices

- Strong working knowledge of GCP and/or Azure, and of Microsoft platforms and tools. 
 - Hands-on grounding in Infrastructure as Code, CI/CD, DevOps, identity and access management, and observability, with the judgement to choose best-in-class tooling for each. Platforms, AI and Automation

- Experience with SAP BTP and SAP Joule, UiPath, and LLM platforms such as Claude and Ollama. 
 - Experience with knowledge graphs (Neo4j and similar technologies), including data modelling and query languages such as Cypher. 
 - Working knowledge of Celonis or other process mining platforms is an advantage (see Good to Have). Data Engineering

- Good understanding of data engineering tools and concepts: ETL/ELT, orchestration, data warehouses and lakehouses, streaming and batch processing, data modelling, governance and quality. 
 - Working knowledge of SQL and Python (Spark is a plus), sufficient to review designs and code and guide the team. 
 - Experience integrating enterprise applications such as SAP, Oracle, Salesforce and ServiceNow. Required Qualifications

- 10+ years of experience in software, data or cloud engineering, solution architecture or technology consulting, with at least 5 years architecting enterprise solutions and at least 3 years leading teams or workstreams. 
 - Proven record of delivering enterprise programmes across at least two industries or business domains (for example finance, supply chain, procurement or manufacturing). 
 - Excellent communication, stakeholder management and executive presentation skills. 
 - Strong problem-solving ability and comfort working with ambiguity. 
 - Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science or a related field (Master's or MBA preferred). Good to Have

- Hands-on experience with Celonis, including PQL and object-centric process mining. 
 - Exposure to AWS in addition to GCP and Azure. 
 - Experience with agentic AI patterns, the Model Context Protocol (MCP) and AI governance frameworks. 
 - Experience with Task Mining or other process intelligence tools.

About Our Company

Ameriprise India LLP has been providing client based financial solutions to help clients plan and achieve their financial objectives for 20 years. data.description:
Req ID: 387939

NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward-thinking organization, apply now. 

We are currently seeking a Salesforce Architect to join our team in Bangalore, Karnātaka (IN-KA), India (IN). 

"Key Responsibilities

- Own end-to-end solution architecture across Agentforce, Salesforce CPQ and Revenue Cloud Advanced. 
 - Architect agent-assisted and agentic workflows across opportunity, configuration, pricing, quoting, contracting, ordering and revenue lifecycle processes. 
 - Design agent orchestration patterns, including tool/function calling, workflow delegation, multi-agent patterns, state management and memory. 
 - Architect integration of Agentforce with Salesforce automation, Apex, Flow, APIs, MuleSoft and external enterprise services. 
 - Define appropriate use of LLMs, deterministic logic, workflow engines and traditional automation, rather than defaulting all use cases to generative AI. 
 - Design context engineering and retrieval strategies, including structured/unstructured grounding, retrieval depth, metadata filtering and relevance optimization. 
 - Establish secure agent action patterns using least-privilege access, guardrails, validation, approval checkpoints and human-in-the-loop mechanisms. 
 - Define AI evaluation frameworks covering answer quality, grounding, hallucination, task completion, tool selection, latency and business outcomes. 
 - Establish observability across agent reasoning paths, actions, integration failures, token/credit consumption and operational performance. 
 - Assess model and platform trade-offs across quality, latency, context window, cost, privacy and enterprise constraints. 
 - Architect resilient action layers and transactional integration patterns for revenue processes where consistency and recoverability are critical. 
 - Advise programs on consumption-based economics, AI credit/token optimization and architectural approaches to control run-time cost. 
 - Lead architecture reviews, design authorities and technical governance across global delivery teams. 
 - Mentor technical architects, developers and Agentforce specialists. 

Required Technical Expertise

- Salesforce Agentforce and associated agentic architecture concepts. 
 - Salesforce CPQ and Revenue Cloud Advanced / Revenue Lifecycle Management. 
 - Salesforce Sales Cloud and core platform architecture. 
 - Agent orchestration and tool/function calling. 
 - Multi-agent architectures, delegation and coordination patterns. 
 - Agent state, short/long-term memory and session/context management. 
 - MCP and agent-to-agent interoperability concepts/patterns. 
 - RAG, semantic/vector search, embeddings, chunking and retrieval optimization. 
 - Context engineering beyond basic prompt engineering. 
 - Evaluation frameworks and AI observability. 
 - AI safety, grounding, guardrails and least-privilege action design. 
 - LLM model selection and architectural trade-offs. 
 - Classic NLP concepts including intent classification, entity extraction, semantic similarity and ranking. 
 - Apex, Lightning Platform, Flow, APIs and enterprise integration patterns. 
 - Strong understanding of asynchronous processing, transaction boundaries, resiliency, retries and idempotency. 
 - Security architecture including sharing, CRUD/FLS, permission models and data protection. 

Preferred Qualifications

- 15+ years overall technology experience; 10+ years in Salesforce CPQ / Revenue Cloud architecture. 
 - Proven experience architecting enterprise CPQ / Quote-to-Cash implementations. 
 - Salesforce Application/System/Technical Architect credentials strongly preferred. 
 - Agentforce and Revenue Cloud-related certifications or demonstrable implementation experience. 
 - Experience with MuleSoft and large enterprise integration landscapes preferred. 
 - Ability to communicate architectural decisions to both engineering teams and senior business stakeholders. "

ABOUT THE ROLE: 

- Own the Architecture of Customer Truth
 - The Data Architect, CDP owns the end-to-end architecture of T-Mobile's Customer Data Platform - the system of record for 100M+ customer profiles, now moving to Google Cloud to deliver real-time customer context, near-real-time signals, and sub-50ms API access. Any agent, store associate, or digital channel should see a customer's prior conversation and continue from there. 
 - You will architect how clickstream, care, store, and network data flows into Cloud Spanner (low-latency store), BigQuery (analytics), and a knowledge graph exposed via GraphQL and MCP servers - while leading coexistence with the Azure estate (Databricks, Snowflake, Data Factory, Event Hubs, Cosmos DB) to reuse proven ETL. 

RESPONSIBILITIES: 

What You'll Do: 

Platform Architecture & Real-Time Customer Context: 

- Own the end-to-end CDP architecture across Spanner, BigQuery, Pub/Sub, Dataflow, and the Azure lakehouse; define what lives in Spanner (current state), BigQuery (history), and the lakehouse
 - Design the unified customer profile and interaction-context model and own Spanner as the low-latency system of record (keys, hotspots, multi-region, change streams, DR) at sub-50ms reads

Streaming, Clickstream & Pipeline Architecture: 

- Design NRT ingestion with Pub/Sub and Dataflow (Beam) into Spanner and BigQuery, with data contracts, schema evolution, exactly-once semantics, and replay patterns
 - Codify reusable CDC, SCD Type 2, and late-arriving-data patterns; partner with NBA and T-Engage to cut signal latency to sub-five minutes

Hybrid-Cloud Migration: 

- Architect Azure-to-GCP data movement with STS and BigQuery-Spanner sync to reuse existing Databricks, Data Factory, and Snowflake ETL; lead the phased plan to migrate or retire Cosmos DB, Redis, Event Hubs, and Functions with dual-run and rollback criteria

Knowledge Graph, GraphQL & MCP: 

- Architect the customer knowledge graph on Spanner (ontology, identity resolution, Customer 360), the sub-50ms GraphQL API, and secure MCP servers on Cloud Run for AI agent access to CDP data

Governance, Operations & Technical Leadership: 

- Define data quality, lineage, and access standards (Dataplex, Unity Catalog, TISS-310), IAM/VPC-SC/CMEK controls, and standards for compute (Cloud Run, Dataproc, Dataflow, Composer), SLOs, FinOps, Terraform, and CI/CD
 - Serve as architectural authority - lead design reviews, maintain the runbook and ADRs, mentor engineers, and partner with product, analytics, and AI/ML teams

QUALIFICATIONS: 

What You'll Bring - Required Experience: 

- Overall (8+ years): Bachelor's in Computer Science or related field (or equivalent); 8+ years in data engineering and architecture, 4+ as a data architect or principal engineer owning a large-scale production platform. 
 - Google Cloud data platform (3+ years): Production data platforms on GCP, including IAM, VPC Service Controls, and cost governance. 
 - Cloud Spanner (2+ years): Schema and primary key design, interleaving, indexes, hotspot avoidance, change streams, and multi-region capacity planning. 
 - BigQuery (3+ years): Partitioning and clustering, reservations and cost control, Spanner federation, and BigQuery-to-Spanner (reverse ETL) data movement. 
 - Streaming & NRT pipelines (3+ years): Pub/Sub, Dataflow (Beam), Kafka, Event Hubs, or Spark Structured Streaming with exactly-once semantics, watermarking, and clickstream ingestion at scale. 
 - APIs & low-latency serving (3+ years): Designing REST/gRPC services, including 2+ years with GraphQL (schema design, federation, caching) against p99 targets under 50ms. 
 - Graph & identity resolution (2+ years): Knowledge-graph or property-graph modeling (Spanner Graph, Neo4j, or Cosmos DB), ontology design, and entity/identity resolution for Customer 360. 
 - AI & MCP integration (1+ year): Building or securing MCP servers, LLM/agent tool integrations, or Vertex AI-based data access patterns. 
 - Databricks, Spark & Delta Lake (4+ years): Spark internals and tuning, Delta Lake, Delta Live Tables, Unity Catalog, and medallion architecture, to reuse and migrate existing ETL. 
 - Azure & Snowflake (3+ years): Data Factory, Event Hubs, Cosmos DB, Redis, Functions, and App Service, plus Snowflake architecture, to lead a hybrid-cloud migration. 
 - Data modeling & ETL (5+ years): Dimensional, Data Vault, and medallion models; idempotent ETL/ELT (CDC, SCD Type 2); expert SQL and advanced PySpark. 
 - Platform engineering (3+ years): Terraform/IaC, CI/CD, Cloud Run, Dataproc, and Composer or Airflow; SLOs, observability, and FinOps. 
 - Leadership (3+ years): Leading architecture decisions across engineering, analytics, and product teams, with strong communication to technical and executive audiences.

data.description:
At EY, you'll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we're counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all. 

EY GDS - RCT

Manager - Data, Cloud & AI Engineering

Manager - Technology Consulting

Experience: Strictly 8+ years

Mandatory eligibility: 

Candidates must have 8 or more years of relevant professional experience, including hands-on Python, advanced SQL, cloud, AI, and Financial Crime Compliance domain experience. Candidates below 8 years or without any mandatory capability are not eligible. 

The opportunity

Lead the delivery of data, cloud, and AI-enabled Financial Crime solutions for global financial services clients. This Manager role combines technical depth with delivery leadership, stakeholder management, team development, and end-to-end ownership. The successful candidate will shape solutions across KYC, AML, Transaction Monitoring, Sanctions, and Fraud while remaining close enough to the technology to guide architecture, review critical designs, resolve delivery risks, and assure quality. 

Role Overview

We are seeking an experienced Manager with strong Python and advanced SQL capability, practical cloud and AI delivery experience, and broad Financial Crime Compliance knowledge. The role owns outcomes from discovery and estimation through design, build, testing, deployment, transition, and production stabilization. It also includes team leadership, work planning, governance, financial oversight, client communication, and development of reusable assets and delivery standards. 

Key Responsibilities

- Lead end-to-end delivery of Financial Crime technology workstreams, programs, or managed-service outcomes. 
 - Own solution scope, delivery plans, milestones, dependencies, risks, issues, quality, resource needs, and stakeholder commitments. 
 - Provide technical direction for Python applications, advanced SQL solutions, cloud architecture, data pipelines, APIs, analytics, and AI components. 
 - Translate KYC, AML, Transaction Monitoring, Sanctions, and Fraud requirements into scalable technical solutions and delivery roadmaps. 
 - Partner with compliance SMEs, product owners, architects, engineering teams, data teams, model-risk stakeholders, QA, infrastructure, and operations. 
 - Lead design reviews, code and SQL quality reviews, architecture decisions, defect triage, performance tuning, release readiness, and production stabilization. 
 - Ensure appropriate security, privacy, auditability, explainability, data lineage, model governance, monitoring, and regulatory-control considerations. 
 - Drive automation, reusable components, engineering standards, knowledge assets, and continuous improvement across the delivery lifecycle. 
 - Prepare and present status, decisions, risks, dependencies, and recovery plans to senior client and internal stakeholders. 
 - Support proposals, solutioning, effort estimation, staffing, capability development, and account growth activities. 

Deliverable ownership

- Accountable for agreed deliverables, acceptance criteria, delivery schedule, quality, and business outcomes across assigned workstreams. 
 - Build and maintain integrated delivery plans covering requirements, design, data readiness, engineering, testing, deployment, transition, and support. 
 - Establish governance routines, delivery metrics, RAID management, change control, escalation paths, and executive reporting. 
 - Validate estimates, capacity, sequencing, dependencies, and release scope; act early on slippage, quality gaps, or unresolved decisions. 
 - Ensure traceability from business and compliance requirements to technical design, test evidence, deployment artefacts, and operational handover. 
 - Coordinate cross-team dependencies and secure timely sign-offs from business, compliance, technology, model-risk, security, and operations stakeholders. 
 - Own defect closure, production-readiness checks, go-live decisions, warranty support, and lessons learned for assigned deliveries. 

Team management and leadership

- Lead multidisciplinary teams of software engineers, data engineers, analysts, QA professionals, and domain specialists. 
 - Define team structure, roles, goals, operating model, work allocation, and individual accountability for delivery outcomes. 
 - Provide regular coaching, technical mentoring, feedback, recognition, and career-development support. 
 - Monitor capacity, utilization, skills coverage, onboarding, knowledge transfer, succession needs, and delivery continuity. 
 - Foster a collaborative, inclusive, quality-focused environment with clear standards for ownership and communication. 
 - Resolve delivery conflicts, remove blockers, manage escalations, and support sound decisions under competing priorities. 
 - Identify capability gaps and create targeted upskilling plans across Python, SQL, cloud, AI, and Financial Crime domain knowledge. 

Mandatory Technical Skills

- Python: Strong hands-on experience designing and reviewing production-grade Python solutions, including object-oriented design, data processing, APIs, testing, logging, exception handling, security, and performance optimization. 
 - Advanced SQL: Expert-level capability in complex joins, common table expressions, window functions, stored procedures, query optimization, large-volume analysis, reconciliation, data profiling, and investigation queries. 
 - Cloud: Mandatory delivery experience with Microsoft Azure, AWS, or GCP, covering solution design, deployment, data services, security, monitoring, integration, scalability, and operational support. 
 - AI: Mandatory practical experience delivering AI or machine-learning capabilities, including generative AI or predictive analytics, model or prompt evaluation, API integration, responsible AI controls, security, explainability, and production monitoring. 
 - Engineering leadership: Ability to guide architecture, review code and designs, define standards, oversee CI/CD, manage non-functional requirements, and resolve complex technical issues. 
 - Data and integration: Experience with data pipelines, APIs, batch processing, data quality, lineage, metadata, and integration across enterprise platforms. 

Mandatory Financial Crime domain knowledge (2 or more mandatory)

- KYC / CDD / EDD: Customer onboarding, identity and document checks, customer risk rating, beneficial ownership, periodic review, remediation, and enhanced due diligence. 
 - AML: Financial crime risk indicators and typologies, alert and case workflows, investigations, escalation, regulatory reporting concepts, and control effectiveness. 
 - Transaction Monitoring (TM): Scenario and rule logic, thresholds, segmentation, alert generation, tuning, back-testing, false-positive reduction, and data-quality controls. 
 - Sanctions: Customer and payment screening, watchlists, potential-match handling, disposition workflows, screening effectiveness, and data quality. 
 - Fraud: Fraud indicators, transaction and event analysis, rules or models, alert prioritization, investigation workflows, case outcomes, and prevention controls. 

AI leadership expectations

- Identify and prioritize AI use cases for alert triage, investigation support, entity resolution, anomaly detection, document analysis, quality assurance, and engineering productivity. 
 - Ensure human oversight, explainability, privacy, security, bias assessment, auditability, model-risk alignment, and appropriate use of regulated data. 
 - Define measurable acceptance criteria and monitoring for accuracy, grounding, latency, reliability, operational risk, and business value. 
 - Use AI-assisted engineering tools responsibly for code, testing, documentation, and analysis while maintaining review and security controls. 

Good to have

- Actimize: Experience delivering, enhancing, integrating, or supporting NICE Actimize solutions for Transaction Monitoring, AML, sanctions, fraud, alerting, or case management. 
 - SAS: Experience with SAS programming, SAS AML, SAS Fraud Management, analytics workflows, data preparation, or migration and modernization initiatives. 
 - Exposure to Spark, Databricks, Kafka, Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, Airflow, Azure Data Factory, or equivalent modern data and DevOps tooling. 
 - Experience supporting proposals, commercial estimates, statements of work, delivery financials, and senior client presentations. 

Experience And Education

- Experience: Strictly 8+ years of relevant professional experience in technology delivery, software or data engineering, cloud, AI, analytics, or Financial Crime Technology. 
 - Leadership: Demonstrated ownership of complex deliverables and experience managing multidisciplinary teams and senior stakeholders. 
 - Mandatory combination: Python, advanced SQL, cloud, AI, and practical experience across the Financial Crime Compliance domain are required. 
 - Education: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, Data Science, or a related field. 

What Success Looks Like

- Predictable delivery with clear ownership, transparent governance, controlled risk, strong quality, and timely stakeholder decisions. 
 - Scalable Python, SQL, cloud, and AI solutions aligned to Financial Crime controls and operational needs. 
 - A high-performing team with clear accountability, stronger capability, and sustainable delivery practices. 
 - Client confidence built through technical credibility, concise communication, proactive escalation, and measurable outcomes. 

What Working At EY Offers

You will lead meaningful Financial Crime Technology assignments in an interdisciplinary environment that values quality, practical learning, collaboration, responsible innovation, and knowledge exchange. The role provides opportunities to shape client outcomes while growing teams and capability across data engineering, cloud, AI, and Financial Crime Compliance. 

Apply only if you meet the 8+ years requirement and all mandatory technical, leadership, and domain criteria. 

EY | Building a better working world

EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets. 

Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate. 

Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

data.title: Senior Staff Software Engineer
data.description:
Strength in Trust

OneTrust's mission is to enable innovation through the responsible use of data and AI. We believe that ensuring data is trusted shouldn't slow teams down-it should accelerate what's possible. This led us to develop the first technology platform for responsible data use in 2016. Today, with AI representing the latest and most impactful expansion of data yet, OneTrust is once again redefining what responsible innovation looks like. OneTrust, the AI‐Ready Governance PlatformTM, unifies regulatory intelligence, automation, and connected governance workflows so businesses can continue to move at the speed of AI while ensuring good governance to prevent data misuse at scale. Trusted by thousands of organizations worldwide, OneTrust is shaping the future where trusted data becomes a transformative force for business and society. 

The Challenge

- As Senior Staff Software Engineer develop strategic methods and principles to improve the technical stability and efficiency of the company's products/services. 
 - You lead and influence several teams and initiatives. 

Your Mission

- Has deep knowledge of entire system and can jump into code in any component and fire fight and contribute. Makes decisions on product direction and internals based on deep subject matter knowledge. 
 - Sets product direction and has ownership over large components. Thinks both strategically and tactically, keeping in mind both technical goals and company goals. 
 - Given long term strategic goals, can lay out a path across many versions. Participates in and supports initiatives outside of main area of responsibility. Provides technical leadership for projects including 3-4 individuals. 
 - Builds strong relationships in their own team and across the company. Understands multiple points of view and drives a process to conclusions in a timely and respectful manner. 
 - Mentor others with high-level technical guidance. Improve the company's technical prowess. Put customers first and set strategic short-term targets. Take up open-ended problems. 
 - Designing, coding, and debugging software. 
 - Improving the performance of existing software. 
 - Providing training to other engineers. 
 - Maintaining and upgrading existing software. 
 - Recommending new technologies that can help increase productivity. 
 - Supervising and overseeing the technical aspects of projects. 
 - Investigating software-related complaints and making necessary adjustments to ensure optimal software performance. 
 - Regularly attending team meetings to discuss projects, brainstorm ideas, and put forward solutions to any issues. 
 - Work with testing team to develop performance test plans and cases. 
 - Research and collect product information and support the development of specifications and requirements for consideration. 

You Are

- High technical and/or technological competence
 - Strong documentation, analytical and problem-solving skills
 - Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related technical field 
 - Minimum of 10+ years of hands-on experience with Java based development projects using RESTful APIs, SpringBoot, Micro services. 
 - Strong analytical skills. 
 - Good communication skills. 
 - Excellent organizational and leadership skills
 - Proven experience in high-level programming languages, like Java. 
 - Proven experience in software development methodologies. 
 - Proven experience building complex web systems. 

Extra Awesome

- Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related technical or business field
 - Expertise with running web services at scale. 

Where we Work

We are embracing an office-first culture, encouraging three days a week in office for most roles, with meaningful opportunities to collaborate and celebrate in person. 

Each role may have specific requirements or flexibility depending on the scope of the position, so we encourage you to verify this with your recruiter during your first interview. 

Benefits

As an employee at OneTrust, you will be part of the OneTeam. That means you'll receive support physically, mentally, and emotionally so that you can do your best work both in and out of the office. This includes comprehensive healthcare coverage, flexible PTO, equity RSUs, annual performance bonus opportunities, retirement account support, 14+ weeks of paid parental leave, career development opportunities, company-paid privacy certification exam fees, and much more. Specific benefits differ by country. For more information, talk to your recruiter or visit onetrust. com/careers. 

Resources

Check out the following to learn more about OneTrust and its people: 

- OneTrust Careers on YouTube
 - @LifeatOneTrust on Instagram

Your Data

You have the right to have your personal data updated or removed. You also have the right to have a copy of the information OneTrust holds about you. Further details about these rights are available on the website in our Privacy Overview. You can change your mind at any time and have your personal data removed from our database. In order to do this you must contact us and let us know you wish to be removed. The request should be made on the Data Subject Request Form. 

Recruitment fraud warning: OneTrust is aware of scams involving false offers of employment with our company. The fraudulent jobs, interviews and job offers use fake websites, email addresses, group chat and text messages. Be aware that we never ask candidates for personal information, IDs or bank information during the interview process. We do not interview prospective candidates via instant message or group chat, and do not require candidates to purchase products or services, or process payments on our behalf as a condition of any employment offer. Please note that any legitimate interview availability requests will come directly from a OneTrust recruiter with an "@onetrust. com" email address. You may also receive legitimate emails from "@us. greenhouse-mail. io". Recruiters will only reach out to candidates who have applied for a role through our ATS (Greenhouse) or prospects via LinkedIn InMail. Job offers will come from a recruiter and may have a "@docusign. net" email address. For more information or if you have been targeted please reach out to askrecruiting@onetrust. com. 

Our Commitment to You

When you join OneTrust you are stepping onto a launching pad - the countdown has begun. The destination? A career without boundaries working alongside a diverse and inclusive crew who is passionate about doing meaningful work. As a pioneer, your voice and expertise will help chart the direction of an entirely new category. Our commitment to putting people first starts with you. Your growth is part of the mission. Our goal is to give you the power to embark on the next phase of your uniquely, unique career. 

OneTrust provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by local laws.

data.title: Senior AI Engineer - Chat & Agent Systems
data.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior AI Engineer - Chat & Agent Systems based in India. 

We are looking for an experienced AI Engineer to take a leading technical role in the development of advanced chat and agent-based systems. In this hands-on position, you will shape technical direction, own system design, and contribute directly to production Python development. You will translate product requirements into reliable, maintainable solutions while raising engineering standards across the team. You will also mentor junior engineers, guide architectural decisions, and strengthen code quality through thoughtful reviews. A key part of the role will be advancing the team's use of AI coding agents throughout the software development lifecycle. This is an opportunity to combine strong software engineering fundamentals with practical expertise in building and operating production-grade agentic applications. 

Accountabilities

Responsibilities

You will lead the technical design and delivery of chat-team projects while remaining closely involved in implementation. Your responsibilities will include: 

- Own the technical design, architecture, and delivery of chat-team projects. 
 - Help define engineering priorities, standards, and day-to-day technical decisions. 
 - Translate product requirements into simple, scalable, and maintainable system designs. 
 - Write high-quality production Python code and develop clear abstractions without unnecessary complexity. 
 - Review pull requests, assessing correctness, maintainability, test coverage, and overall design quality. 
 - Mentor junior developers, providing practical guidance on programming fundamentals, system design, and code quality. 
 - Diagnose production issues across application code, agent workflows, prompts, models, data, and infrastructure. 
 - Improve system reliability, observability, latency, and operating costs. 
 - Promote effective use of AI coding agents across exploration, planning, implementation, testing, debugging, and code review. 
 - Identify opportunities to automate and improve engineering workflows while maintaining accountability for code quality. 
 - Help the team adopt responsible, effective agentic coding practices and become more AI-native. 

Requirements

The ideal candidate combines strong software engineering fundamentals with hands-on experience building LLM-powered applications and using AI coding agents. The following qualifications and skills are expected: 

- Approximately 4-5 years of professional software engineering experience. 
 - Strong proficiency in Python, including idiomatic, typed, testable, and maintainable production code. 
 - Solid programming fundamentals and consistently sound engineering judgment. 
 - Experience designing, delivering, and operating production systems. 
 - Strong understanding of API design, data modeling, concurrency, error handling, and observability. 
 - Ability to create useful abstractions while keeping systems simple and understandable. 
 - Experience writing automated tests using tools such as pytest. 
 - Ability to conduct meaningful code reviews and clearly explain technical recommendations. 
 - Experience mentoring junior developers and helping improve their engineering capabilities. 
 - Strong ownership, initiative, problem-solving skills, and the ability to drive improvements across a team. 
 - Clear written and verbal communication skills. 

Agentic Systems Experience

Hands-on experience building LLM-powered or agentic applications is required. Relevant experience includes: 

- Building tool-calling or multi-step workflows using LangGraph or comparable agent frameworks. 
 - Designing conversation state, context management, and execution flows. 
 - Working with model APIs, structured outputs, retrieval, and grounding techniques. 
 - Supporting streaming responses and asynchronous execution. 
 - Evaluating prompts, models, and end-to-end agent behavior. 
 - Instrumenting and debugging LLM applications with Langfuse, LangSmith, or similar observability platforms. 
 - Managing the reliability, latency, and cost of production LLM systems. 

Expertise in every named tool is not expected. A strong understanding of the underlying engineering principles and the ability to adapt as the ecosystem evolves are more important. 

Agentic Coding Experience

data.title: Principal AI Engineer
data.description:
Our Engineering organisation is scaling its AI Engineering capabilities under new leadership, creating an opportunity to build the next generation of AI at Rapid7. We're looking for Principal AI Engineers to join us and help shape what comes next by defining and influencing the technical direction of our LLM and agentic AI systems. As a Principal AI Engineer, you'll raise the bar for engineering standards, and build truly cutting edge greenfield solutions that deliver real impact for our Global customers. Through your technical leadership and mentoring, you'll help shape our product and platform investments and influence how we build and scale AI across the organisation. 

About The Team

AI is reshaping cybersecurity on both sides. Attackers can use AI to strike at machine speed, and only AI-powered defense can keep up. At the same time, organizations can only adopt AI with confidence if it is secure. Rapid7 sits at the intersection of security and AI, and we are building industry-defining products for this new era. 

Rapid7's AI Engineering team builds the AI that powers our security platform. We are AI engineers and applied scientists who take models from research to production, combining open-source and frontier LLMs, AI agents, and fast predictive models with more than 20 years of Rapid7 security expertise. Our work drives core use cases across Detection and Response, such as alert triage, threat investigation, and automated response, and Exposure and Remediation, such as vulnerability prioritization, attack surface risk assessment, and guided remediation. Together, these help customers stop threats faster and fix what matters most. 

About The Role

As a Principal AI Engineer, you will set the technical direction for how Rapid7 builds, tunes and serves LLMs and agentic systems across its security products. You understand LLMs from the ground up, from transformer internals and training to fine-tuning and inference optimization, and you stay hands-on with the hardest problems. You know where LLMs shine and where they fall short, and you treat them as one tool in the AI toolbox, alongside predictive AI and classical ML, choosing the right approach for each problem. Specifically your focus will be to: 

- Define the architecture and technical roadmap for LLM and agentic AI systems across Detection and Response and Exposure and Remediation
 - Lead model strategy: when to use frontier or open-source models, and when to fine-tune, distill, or post-train
 - Fine-tune, distill and post-train open-source LLMs on security data, from data curation through training, evaluation and deployment
 - Set engineering standards for context engineering, inference optimization, and evaluation across teams
 - Optimize LLM inference at scale with techniques such as speculative decoding, KV-cache management, continuous batching, quantization and custom kernels, balancing quality, latency and cost
 - Establish evals as the release gate for every AI system we ship
 - Lead design reviews and resolve the hardest technical trade-offs
 - Stay hands-on: prototype and build critical model, training and inference code yourself
 - Mentor Staff and Senior engineers and shape product and platform investment

The Skills And Qualities You'll Bring Include

- 12+ years of software or ML engineering experience, including 2+ years building production LLM or agentic AI systems. A PhD in Computer Science, Machine Learning, AI or a related field is preferred, or equivalent depth of expertise demonstrated through industry experience and technical contributions
 - A track record of building scalable, production-grade AI systems used across multiple teams or products with a strong history of organization-wide impact through technical leadership, mentoring, and shared platforms and standards
 - LLMs from first principles: deep understanding of transformer architecture, attention, tokenization and positional encodings, and how models are trained and served, with the ability to implement core components from scratch
 - PyTorch: expert-level, including custom model code, training loops, mixed precision and distributed training (e. g. , FSDP, DeepSpeed)
 - Fine-tuning and post-training: hands-on full and parameter-efficient fine-tuning (LoRA, QLoRA) of open-weight LLMs, distillation, and preference or RL-based methods (e. g. , DPO, GRPO)
 - Context engineering: retrieval, memory, and context management for long-running agent workflows
 - Inference optimization: deep knowledge of prefill and decode, KV-cache management (e. g. , PagedAttention, prefix caching), continuous batching, speculative decoding, FlashAttention and quantization, and serving at scale with vLLM, SGLang or TensorRT-LLM
 - Evals: defining evaluation strategy and benchmarks for LLM and agent systems
 - Strong predictive AI and classical ML fundamentals, and the judgment to choose between them and LLMs based on accuracy, latency and cost
 - Strong distributed systems and Python fundamentals
 - Takes ownership of significant technical outcomes across multiple teams, proactively identifying and addressing risks, driving complex challenges to resolution and ensuring solutions deliver against agreed technical and customer objectives
 - Strong communicator with the ability to explain technical trade-offs to engineering, product, and leadership audiences
 - Builds strong cross functional partnerships across Engineering, Product, and other teams to align on technical direction and deliver shared outcomes
 - Connects customer needs and business priorities to technical decisions, evaluating the value, cost and trade-offs of AI solutions to ensure investments deliver measurable customer and business outcomes
 - Embody our core values to foster a culture of excellence that drives meaningful impact and collective success

Preferred Skills And Experience

- Experience pre-training or training LLMs from scratch
 - Experience writing GPU kernels (CUDA or Triton) and profiling GPU workloads
 - Security domain experience, such as detection engineering, SOC/MDR, or vulnerability management
 - Experience running AI workloads on AWS at scale
 - Publications, patents, or open-source contributions in AI

We know that the best ideas and solutions come from multi-dimensional teams. That's because these teams reflect a variety of backgrounds and professional experiences. If you are excited about this role and feel your experience can make an impact, please don't be shy - apply today. 

About Rapid7

At Rapid7, our vision is to create a secure digital world for our customers, our industry, and our communities. We do this by harnessing our collective expertise and passion to challenge what's possible and drive extraordinary impact. We're building a dynamic and collaborative workplace where new ideas are welcome. 

Protecting 11, 500+ customers against bad actors and threats means we're continuing to push the envelope just like we' ve been doing for the past 20 years. If you 're ready to solve some of the toughest challenges in cybersecurity, we're ready to help you take command of your career. Join us.

 - Drive automation initiatives to improve operational efficiency and reduce manual effort.

The DFT Architect will be responsible for defining, driving, and governing the complete Design-for-Test (DFT) strategy for complex SoCs delivered under a turnkey/outcome-based engagement model. · Create DFT specifications, test architecture documents, and implementation guidelines. 

· Establish hierarchical DFT methodology across IP, Subsystems, and SoC. 

· Drive testability requirements into architecture and micro-architecture reviews. 

· Define scan partitioning, test access mechanisms, compression strategy, and test modes.

ATPG & Coverage Closure

· DFT CDC requirements

data.description:
Use Your Power for Purpose

Every day, our unwavering commitment to quality ensures the delivery of safe and effective products to patients. Our flexible, innovative, and customer-oriented culture is rooted in science and risk-based compliance. Whether you are engaged in development, maintenance, compliance, or research analysis, your contributions have a direct impact on patient care. By being part of our team, you help uphold a quality culture that adapts and evolves to meet the needs of patients, ensuring that every product we deliver meets the highest standards of safety and efficacy. 

What You Will Achieve

In this role, you will: 

- Perform method transfers/ validations / method verifications to the complex analytical techniques
 - Interpret and evaluate data for accuracy, precision, trends, and potential cGMP impact, recommending appropriate corrective actions. 
 - Ensure all documentation and quality records comply with Good Manufacturing Practices and Good Laboratory Practices and are filed according to existing policies. 
 - Review and revise Standard Operating Procedures, analytical methods, and related documents to keep them current. 
 - Conduct analyses on finished products, raw materials, and components, including data entry, review, and approval in a computerized database. 
 - Contribute to the completion of complex projects, manage time effectively to meet targets, and develop plans for work activities within a team, while exercising judgment with reliance on supervisor and working under their direction. 

Here Is What You Need (Minimum Requirements)

- Master's degree in chemistry/ pharmacy with 8-10 years of experience in Analytical Method Transfer / Validation)
 - Qualified in multiple analytical techniques (HPLC-with Empower, GC, IC, ICP-MS, Potentiometry, UV‐Vis, FTIR, Karl Fischer, and pH meters)
 - Demonstrated technical skills in method validation and testing
 - Ability to read and understand applicable compendial methods, Standard Operating Procedures, technical procedures, and governmental regulations
 - Conduct analytical method validation in accordance with ICH Q2 (R1/R2), USP, and EP standards, encompassing protocol preparation, execution, approval of validation summaries, and coordination with cross‐functional teams. 
 - Conduct test method GAP assessments against USP, EP, BP, and JP requirements for New Product Introduction (NPI). 
 - Execute and document analytical method verification and method transfer activities. 
 - Demonstrate knowledge of ICH Q9 (Quality Risk Management) and apply risk‐based principles for identifying, assessing, controlling, communicating, and reviewing quality risks throughout the product lifecycle. 
 - Handling of OOS and OOT through QMS. 
 - Perform identification, assay, purity, and related analytical tests using validated methods. 
 - Monitor critical process parameters (CPPs) and critical quality attributes (CQAs). 
 - Support process validation and troubleshooting activities; communicate analytical results promptly to Production and QA to ensure effective process control. 
 - Manage working standards in compliance with established procedures. 
 - Handle change control activities and ensure timely implementation and closure of related CAPA actions. 
 - Knowledge of Good Manufacturing Practices and its application standards, processes, and policies. 
 - Excellent organizational skills and strong ability to multi-task
 - Strong written and verbal communication skills
 - Proficiency with unique Quality Control instruments to meet accuracy specifications for sample management, retains management, interpretation, and evaluation

Bonus Points If You Have (Preferred Requirements)

- Experience with laboratory work, particularly using analytical HPLC (High Pressure Liquid Chromatography), GC, IC, ICP-MS techniques
 - Proven track record in leading continuous improvement projects
 - Strong knowledge of lean manufacturing principles, six sigma methodologies, and statistical analysis
 - Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail
 - Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines. 
 - Excellent interpersonal skills and the ability to communicate effectively with colleagues at all levels

Job Title: Sr. Manager - Quality and Sourcing | Home Appliance

Location: Rama Road, Kirti Nagar, Delhi

About the Role

We are seeking an experienced and industry-seasoned Product Head to lead New Product Development (NPD), Existing Product Enhancement, Sourcing, and Quality Excellence for our kitchen and home appliances portfolio. 

This role is not only responsible for launching new products but also for continuously upgrading and improving our existing product line - through better design, improved specifications, feature enhancements, packaging upgrades, cost engineering, and quality optimization. 

The ideal candidate must have deep experience in the kitchen & home appliances industry, strong understanding of manufacturing and sourcing ecosystems (India & China), and a proven track record of building scalable product systems and high performing teams. 

Key Responsibilities

Strategic Leadership & Team Management

• Lead, mentor, and manage the Sourcing Manager, Quality Manager, and associated executives. 

• Build and strengthen cross-functional collaboration with supply chain, merchandising, design, and production teams. 

• Instill ownership, accountability, and proactive execution within the sourcing and quality teams.

New Product Development (NPD)

Product Line Expansion & Portfolio Growth

Systems, SOPs & Process Institutionalization (High Priority)

- Are you curious, excited by experimentation, and always looking for a better way of doing things?

We are looking to hire ambitious, and value-adding talent to join Modulr, the fastest growing payments business in the UK and Europe. In this role you will work in a cross-functional team who are asked to solve a problem, rather than be handed a task to do. At Modulr our mission is to move money efficiently to power business productivity. We are building a new digital payments service to make money flow more efficiently through businesses and the economy. This is a new type of payments account that is built for businesses that need faster, easier and more reliable ways to move money. 

Our flexible platform and innovative approach allows our customers to utilise our payments account instead of a traditional bank account. Our accounts come with a sort code and account number, access to payment systems (eg Faster Payments and Visa) and everything our customers need from a payments account. They can instantly open as many accounts as they need, automate how they make and receive payments as well as the reconciliation processes these create. All in real time, 24/7 through their own systems utilising our API that integrates into any platform. 

Our founding team has a wealth of experience in the payments industry and growing successful businesses. Modulr is backed by payments giants PayPal Ventures and FIS Ventures, as well as startup and scale up specialists Blenheim Chalcot, General Atlantic, Frog and Highland Europe which enables us to leverage their resources and expertise to drive our growth initiatives. These partnerships provide us with the necessary provisions to propel our business to new heights. 

Modulr values

- Building the extraordinary and going that extra mile
 - Owning the opportunity, be passionate and proud of the time you invest
 - Move at pace, reach your goals faster with us supporting you each step of the way
 - Achieve it together, working as a team and being a Modulite

The Tech Team

At Modulr we are focused on building autonomous squads that are focused on working in the best possible way. We operate in a tribes and squad model with each area focused on a particular growth area. Each squad is small and cross-functional. We have big ambitions and have many interesting challenges ahead.
