Adani Green Energy Limited (AGEL): AGEL is part of the Adani Group's promise to provide a better, cleaner, and greener future for India. Driven by the Group's philosophy of Growth with Goodness', the Company develops, builds, owns, operates, and maintains utility- scale grid-connected solar, wind farm and energy storage (Hydro PSP and Battery) projects. The electricity generated is supplied to central and state government entities and government- backed corporations. On the back of long-term Power Purchase Agreements (PPAs) with central and state government entities, AGEL has leveraged its capabilities and expanded its presence across 12 Indian states. With the integration of pump storage and battery storage projects with large solar & wind portfolio, AGEL shall be best placed amongst peers to supply round-the-clock green power to India's grid. The Company continuously adopts and deploys the latest technologies in its projects. With the target of 50 GW renewable energy capacity by 2030, AGEL is driving India on its renewable energy journey. 

Job Purpose: Associate - Quality (Civil) is responsible for supporting quality assurance and control activities for civil components in renewable energy projects by ensuring adherence to quality plans, specifications, and standards. This role is responsible for conducting field inspections, coordinating with contractors and vendors, resolving quality issues, and maintaining documentation, contributing to the overall project quality, compliance, and safety standards for civil works. 

Responsibilities

Quality Assurance and Documentation: 

Ensure QA requirements are developed and aligned with technical specifications and project standards for all civil components in renewable energy projects. 

Prepare, review, and update Site Quality Plans (SQPs), Site Field Quality Plans (SFQPs), and Quality Inspection Reports (QIRs) for civil structures across wind, solar & hybrid projects. 

Maintain comprehensive documentation and ensure adherence to QA protocols and inspection requirements. 

Complete all inspections within 12 hours of receiving a Inspection call from vendor and Issue Material Dispatch Clearance Certificates (MDCC) after acceptance of materials, supporting the timely supply to project sites. 

Field Inspections And Audits

Conduct regular inspections and site audits for civil structures to ensure compliance with SFQPs and project standards. 

Identify and document non-conformities (NCs), work on root cause analysis (RCA), and implement corrective and preventive actions (CAPA) to eliminate recurring issues. 

Coordinate with inspection agencies or team members for efficient scheduling and completion of on-site civil inspections.

Work closely with contractors and vendors to communicate and enforce QA standards and inspection requirements. 

Conduct vendor assessments and evaluate the quality of materials, concrete, rebar, foundations, and other civil works components. 

Provide on-site technical guidance to contractors to enhance understanding and execution of quality requirements. 

Issue Resolution And Continuous Improvement

Ensure timely identification and resolution of quality issues on-site by liaising with the Field Quality Assurance (FQA) team. 

Contribute to the preparation of "lessons learned" reports to facilitate continuous improvement and update QA protocols for future projects. 

Support quality-related improvement projects, such as Kaizen initiatives, to enhance project execution and field inspection quality. 

Compliance And Safety Assurance

Ensure compliance with safety regulations, environmental guidelines, and quality standards at project sites. 

Promote a safety-oriented culture by following organizational protocols and conducting quality-related safety checks during field inspections. 

Report on QA performance and inspection status to support compliance with internal and external audits. 

Reporting And Communication

Compile monthly Quality Assurance reports, including status updates, audit findings, and inspection results. 

Communicate inspection outcomes and issues effectively to internal and external stakeholders to ensure alignment and timely actions. 

Support team members and share knowledge on best practices in civil quality assurance for continuous capability enhancement. 

Key Stakeholders - Internal

Project Team

Procurement and Supply Chain Department

Safety Department

Construction Site Teams

Key Stakeholders - External

Contractors and Subcontractors

Vendors and Material Suppliers

Third-Party Inspection Agencies

Regulatory Authorities and Compliance Auditors

Qualifications

Educational Qualification: 

Bachelor's Degree in Civil Engineering or related field. 

Certifications in Quality Assurance, Civil Construction Standards, or related quality management practices preferred. 

Work Experience

7+ years of experience in quality assurance within civil construction, with a focus on renewable energy projects (wind, solar & hybrid). 

Hands-on experience with site inspections, audits, and quality control processes for civil engineering works. 

Strong understanding of quality protocols, root cause analysis (RCA), and corrective action/preventive action (CAPA) for civil structures. 

Knowledge of industry standards such as ISO, IEC, and relevant construction codes.

Our team is comprised of the hospitality industry's most innovative and entrepreneurial leaders, and together we form the fastest growing business unit of a $4B+ global technology company. Candidates who join our team must thrive in fast-paced, entrepreneurial environments and be committed to serving the needs of our hospitality customers around the globe. If this sounds like you, we welcome the opportunity to get to know you better. 

Position Summary

The Connectivity Certifications organization at Aven Hospitality (AH) defines and delivers a compelling connectivity value proposition that enables high impact business outcomes for our customers. The team operates in a highly consultative manner, serving as both product and technical experts, while partnering with Sales and Account Management, Product and Engineering teams to design and deliver optimal connectivity solutions. 

The Connectivity Certification Analyst will perform review, testing, troubleshooting and certification of new system interfaces utilizing XML and JSON API specifications for our Property Connect (fulfillment) and Channel Connect (distribution) interfaces to the SynXis Central Reservation System (CRS) platform. The primary responsibilities will be reviewing message formats and system specifications for new interfaces being developed between vendors, customers, and internal staff and providing vendor and technical support for these certifications. The Connectivity Certification Analyst will also interact extensively with our product, development and QA teams and will be expected to participate in technical discussions about integration issues as well as product directions and strategies. This individual should have knowledge in a variety of technical areas including familiarity with hospitality technology standards including Open Travel, HTNG, XML, JSON, reading technical specifications, client and server systems, networking concepts and an understanding of programming concepts and tools. 

Key Responsibilities

Facilitate custom API solutions across customers, partners, and internal teams. 

Onboard new API connectivity partners and customer, ensuring consistent certification standards and best practices. 

Ensure the ongoing success and performance of existing integrations while ensuring adherence to commercially-agreed upon standards. 

Collaborate with Sales and Account Management to support new and existing partner opportunities. 

Work closely with Product and Engineering teams to troubleshoot integration product functionality, testing and defect remediation. 

Deliver customer and partner satisfaction through strong collaboration, transparency, and technical leadership. 

Strengthen adoption of the Aven Hospitality Platform by ensuring integrations deliver measurable business value. 

Key Knowledge And Skill Requirements

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills

Proven experience in API quality assurance and certification processes, including functional and integration testing of SOAP and REST services, with proficiency in XML and JSON payload validation. 

Experience with SaaS solutions

Excellent verbal and written communication skills

Familiar with technical specifications

Strong experience with OTA, HTNG, Opera OHIP and OXI standards is preferred

The individual should be able to work as part of a team or work independently on assigned tasks, and the ability to handle multiple assignments simultaneously

Knowledge of software development life cycle and release process would be helpful

Hotel Operations and Property Management System (PMS), Central Reservation Systems (CRS), Customer Relation Management (CRM) or 3rd party channel experience is ideal

Proficient with relational databases such as Oracle or SQL

Qualifications / Experience

4+ years of API and integration experience

Four-year college degree or relevant experience in a related field

Experience In Hospitality Or Travel Distribution Industry Preferred

At Securonix, we're on a mission to secure the world by staying ahead of cyber threats and reinforcing all layers of our platform with AI capabilities. Our Securonix Unified Defense SIEM provides organizations with the first and only AI-reinforced solution built with a cybersecurity mesh architecture on a highly scalable data cloud. Enhanced by Securonix EON's AI capabilities, our innovative cloud-native solution delivers a seamless CyberOps experience, empowering organizations to scale their security operations and keep pace with evolving threats. 

Recognized as a five-time Leader in the Gartner Magic Quadrant for SIEM and highly rated on Gartner Peer Insights, our award-winning Unified Defense SIEM provides organizations with 365 days of "hot" data for rapid search and investigation, threat content-as-a-service, proactive defense through continuous peer and partner collaboration, and a fully integrated Threat Detection, Investigation, and Response (TDIR) experience all within a single platform. Built on a cloud-native architecture, the platform leverages the Snowflake Data Cloud for unparalleled scalability and performance. 

Securonix is proud to be a cybersecurity unicorn and to be featured in CRN's 2024 Security 100 list. Backed by Vista Equity Partners, one of the largest private equity firms, with over $100 billion in assets under management, we have a unique advantage in driving innovation and growth. With a global footprint, we serve more than 1, 000 customers worldwide, including 10% of the Fortune 100. Our network of 150+ partners and Managed Security Service Providers (MSSPs) enables us to deliver unmatched security solutions on a global scale. 

At Securonix, we are driven by our core values and place our people at the heart of everything we do: 

- Winning as One Team: We work together with universal respect to achieve aligned outcomes. 
 - Customer-Driven Innovation: We innovate to stay ahead of the market and create value for our customers. 
 - Agility in Action: We embrace change and remain unified in our purpose and objectives. 

We are looking for a Senior Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET) to drive quality engineering and automation across Securonix products, including SIEM, ThreatQ (Threat Intelligence Platform/TIP), and associated cloud, microservices, data, and security capabilities. 

Role Overview: 

As a Senior SDET, you will design and build scalable automation solutions across API, UI, backend, integration, and end-to-end workflows. The ideal candidate will have strong programming skills in Python, hands-on experience with Pytest and Playwright, and a solid understanding of API and microservices testing. You will work closely with Engineering, Product, DevOps, and QA teams to embed quality throughout the software development lifecycle. 

Key Responsibilities: 

- Design, develop, and maintain scalable automation frameworks using Python and Pytest. 
 - Build and maintain modern UI and end-to-end automation using Playwright. 
 - Develop automated test suites for API, UI, backend, integration, regression, and end-to-end testing. 
 - Drive an API-first automation strategy for microservices and platform capabilities. 
 - Validate REST APIs, service-to-service integrations, authentication, data contracts, error handling, and distributed workflows. 
 - Validate data-processing pipelines and data integrity using Python, SQL, and API-based validation. 
 - Test complex workflows across Securonix products, including SIEM and ThreatQ/TIP. 
 - Develop reusable automation libraries, utilities, fixtures, test-data management, and reporting capabilities. 
 - Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines and enable continuous testing. 
 - Analyze automation failures, application logs, API responses, and backend data to perform root-cause analysis. 
 - Participate in design and architecture discussions to improve testability, observability, reliability, and product quality. 
 - Identify regression risks and ensure appropriate automated coverage for new features and production defect fixes. 
 - Mentor QA/SDET engineers on automation design, coding standards, debugging, and testing best practices. 
 - Explore AI-assisted testing and automation to improve test coverage, productivity, and defect detection. 

Required Technical Skills: 

- 5-8 years of experience in Quality Engineering, Test Automation, or SDET roles. 
 - Strong programming experience in Python. 
 - Strong hands-on experience with Pytest, including fixtures, parametrization, reusable libraries, and framework design. 
 - Strong hands-on experience with Playwright for UI and end-to-end automation. 
 - Strong experience in REST API automation and testing. 
 - Experience designing or contributing to scalable automation frameworks-not only individual test scripts. 
 - Strong understanding of microservices and distributed architectures. 
 - Experience with SQL and backend/data validation. 
 - Experience testing complex integration and end-to-end workflows. 
 - Experience integrating automation with CI/CD systems such as Jenkins, Harness, GitHub Actions, or GitLab CI. 
 - Good understanding of Git, Linux/Unix, debugging, logging, and defect-management tools such as JIRA. 
 - Strong understanding of software-testing principles, test-design techniques, regression strategies, and Agile development practices. 

What We're Looking For: 

- Strong problem-solving, troubleshooting, and debugging skills. 
 - Ability to take end-to-end ownership of quality for a feature or product area. 
 - Ability to understand complex product architectures and identify appropriate testing strategies. 
 - Strong collaboration skills for working with Engineering, Product, DevOps, and other QA/SDET teams. 
 - Passion for automation, cybersecurity, AI, and modern quality engineering. 

Why Join Securonix?

Work at the intersection of cybersecurity, AI, automation, cloud, and large-scale data platforms while building quality-engineering solutions for products used by global enterprises. This role provides significant ownership of automation strategy and an opportunity to influence how quality is engineered across Securonix product lines. 

Benefits: 

As a full-time employee of Securonix, you will be eligible for the following benefits: 

- Health insurance with a total sum insured of INR 7, 50, 000. 
 - Coverage for self, spouse, two children, and dependent parents or parents-in-law. 
 - Personal accident insurance with a total sum insured of INR 10, 00, 000. 
 - Term life insurance coverage equal to five times the employee's fixed base pay.

Intelligent Automation Engineer

Our talent matters: 

At Zurich, we are passionate about cultivating our talent. Our culture creates an environment where everyone is encouraged to get involved and be inspired at every stage of your career. 

- Zurich is committed to developing a sustainable workforce - we support employees to explore opportunities that will enhance their talents - we have career pathways

The adventure we're on at Zurich: 

We take pride in uniting our people within an energized culture that empowers everyone to focus on what matters most to our customers, partners and each other. This is an exciting time to be at Zurich as we empower our people to fuel innovation and collaborate across diverse teams. At Zurich we encourage everyone to be curious, courageous and responsible as we seek out new opportunities to deliver value and delight for our customers. We know we can achieve great things when we put our mind to it. Zurich is a place that you can truly belong and thrive!

About the business: 

The Intelligent Automation team within [insert relevant business segment/unit] focuses on scaling secure, enterprise grade automation and AI driven solutions across the organization. 

We use the Microsoft Power Platform and Microsoft AI Services to digitize manual processes, improve customer and employee experiences, and support more efficient, risk aware and data driven operations. The team works closely with business stakeholders, IT, data and risk functions to deliver practical, sustainable automation outcomes. 

About this role: 

A great opportunity exists as Intelligent Automation Engineer, reporting to Chapter Lead - Intelligent Automation Engineering. 

In this hands on engineering role, you design, build and support automation and AI solutions using Microsoft Power Platform, Azure, PowerFX, SQL and AI Builder. You translate business requirements into secure, robust and maintainable applications, workflows and AI enabled agents, working within an Agile delivery squad. 

You focus on operational delivery rather than defining overall strategy. Your work enables business teams and citizen developers to safely use low code tools within established governance and architectural guardrails, helping the organization scale intelligent automation in a controlled, sustainable way. 

Key responsibilities: 

- Design, develop and deploy solutions on Microsoft Power Platform (Power Apps, Power Automate, Copilot Studio, Dataverse) to digitize and automate business processes. 
 - Implement AI enabled features using AI Builder and Azure AI capabilities (e. g. Azure OpenAI, Azure Cognitive Services, Azure AI Studio) to enhance applications and workflows with intelligent capabilities. 
 - Build and maintain integrations between Power Platform solutions and enterprise data/systems (e. g. Snowflake, SQL, Azure services, CRM/ERP, REST APIs) in line with security and compliance requirements. 
 - Provide operational support for existing automations, including monitoring, incident resolution, minor enhancements and performance tuning. 
 - Apply secure by design principles, Application Lifecycle Management (ALM) and CI/CD practices, using tools such as Azure DevOps for version control and deployments across environments. 
 - Produce and maintain clear technical documentation (designs, runbooks, support guides) to support audit, handover and ongoing maintenance. 
 - Collaborate in Agile squads with product owners, business analysts, developers and other stakeholders to refine requirements, estimate effort and deliver against agreed priorities. 
 - Contribute reusable components, patterns and guidance to support citizen development and ensure solutions built by business users respect agreed guardrails. 
 - Stay up to date with new capabilities in Power Platform and Azure (including PowerFX, AI Builder and related services) and suggest improvements or new use cases where they add value. 
 - Ensure the wellbeing of team members and proactively work to identify and manage workplace exposures which may precipitate workplace stress, bullying, harassment, and discrimination. 

Important to your success: 

- Practical, hands on experience with Microsoft Power Platform in an enterprise context, including Power Apps (canvas and/or model driven), Power Automate and Copilot Studio; experience with Dataverse is highly valued. 
 - Exposure to AI Builder and Azure AI capabilities (e. g. Azure OpenAI, Azure Cognitive Services, Azure AI Studio) and an understanding of how to embed AI capabilities into business applications and workflows within responsible AI and governance frameworks. 
 - Good understanding of software engineering fundamentals: modular design, reusability, maintainability, error handling, logging and testing. 
 - Experience with CI/CD, ALM and DevOps practices for low code solutions, ideally using Azure DevOps and Git for version control, pipelines and environment management. 
 - Foundational knowledge of data and integration concepts, including REST APIs, JSON, OAuth and integration with data platforms such as Snowflake, SQL or other cloud data stores. 
 - Familiarity with cloud concepts and relevant Azure services (e. g. Azure Functions, Logic Apps, Key Vault, messaging services) used alongside Power Platform. 
 - Experience working in Agile teams (Scrum/Kanban), with the ability to translate business requirements into user stories and technical designs, and to communicate clearly with both technical and non technical stakeholders. 
 - Strong sense of ownership, reliability and attention to detail, with the ability to balance new development work and ongoing support for existing solutions. 
 - Curiosity and willingness to learn new Power Platform and AI features, share knowledge, and contribute to communities of practice and continuous improvement initiatives. 
 - We are here to support your needs
 - As a leader in the insurance industry, we embrace the development needs of our employees to ensure they can achieve success and thrive in the workplace. 
 - Zurich is committed to ensuring that our process is fair and accessible for all candidates. If you require special accommodations to participate in our recruitment process, we encourage you to let us know at the time of your application. 
 - A new Zurich adventure awaits you
 - If you're interested in being part of our adventure that will build a brighter future together, and feel a sense of togetherness, then we look forward to you starting your adventure with us!

Job Description

As part of the Development Engineering team, the Control Software Designer designs, supports, and troubleshoots control systems for Injection Molding Machines(IMM) and Mold controllers. This role operates in a fast-paced, innovative environment and focuses on developing creative, high-quality solutions to complex technical challenges. 

Key Responsibilities/Areas Of Accountability: 

- Design control systems for IMM and Mold controller applications including servo drive and servo-hydraulic controls, injection molding process control. 
 - Provide functional, design specifications and validation plans for new IMM and Mold controller functionality. 
 - Software development of machine sequences (PLC IEC 61131-3), process control, human-machine interface(HMI) in Windows environment. 
 - Troubleshoot and debug real-time and non-real-time software. 
 - Document software changes using resources such as TFS/VSTS and Azure DevOps. 
 - Document development, design changes and production design activities. 
 - Communicate design with other design groups and businesses. 

Requirements: 

- Bachelor's Degree or higher in Electrical & Electronics/ECE/Instrumentation/Software Engineering preferred, or equivalent. 
 - Minimum 5 years hands-on experience in automated control system design and troubleshooting preferred. 
 - Machine design/develop with Beckhoff, Siemens, GE, ABB and Allen Bradley products background are preferred. 
 - PLC structured text language design and programming using IEC 61131-3. 
 - Experience in programming using C, C++, C# or other high-level languages for HMI applications (Ruby). 
 - Strong knowledge of PC based control systems and embedded system. 
 - Strong Knowledge of control theory and model-based design principles. 
 - Knowledge of PLC's and motion controllers. 
 - Working knowledge of standard industrial communication networks and protocols such as RS232, RS485, Ethernet, CANOpen, Profibus, Profinet and EtherCAT. 
 - Ability to read control circuits using Eplan as a resource. 
 - Experience with Beckhoff TwinCAT3. 
 - Experience designing, debugging and deploying software in VSTS development environment. 
 - Machine design/develop with Beckhoff, Siemens, GE, ABB and Allen Bradley products background are preferred. 
 - Experience in Agile software design process and Test Driven Development methodologies. 
 - Familiarity and experience with AI and it's use in software development, ideation, and the creation of tools
 - Strong proficiency in English with effective verbal, written. 

Personal Qualifications: 

- Ability to communicate complex technical concepts clearly, verbally and in writing. 
 - A quick independent learner, able to digest and understand complex concepts. 
 - An intelligent thinker, able to formulate hypotheses, troubleshoot, analyze, and propose solutions. 
 - Highly creative with the ability to develop multiple concepts to resolve problems. 
 - Capable of Working in a multi-disciplined international team with excellent personal organization skills. 

Husky TechnologiesTM offers a competitive compensation and benefits package and excellent opportunities for growth and advancement. We are committed to equal employment opportunity and respect, value and welcome diversity in our workplace. Husky TechnologiesTM also values being a great place to work and strives to maintain a safe workplace. Accordingly, Husky TechnologiesTM conditions all offers of employment on satisfactory completion of background checks. No agency or telephone inquiries please.

It involves overseeing the full software development lifecycle, ensuring high-quality and timely delivery, while leading and inspiring large, diverse engineering teams. The position also carries ownership of budgeting, resource allocation, vendor management, and continuous process improvement. A strong focus on change management, stakeholder influence across functions, and fostering a high-performance, innovative culture is critical. The ideal candidate brings extensive experience in product engineering leadership, deep technical expertise, and a proven track record of delivering complex products on time and within budget, along with exceptional communication, people management, and strategic thinking capabilities. 

About The Role

- Define and execute the product engineering strategy, aligning with overall business objectives and market needs. 
 - Oversee the entire software development lifecycle, from concept to deployment, ensuring adherence to quality standards and timelines. 
 - Manage and mentor a diverse team of software engineers and project managers, fostering a culture of collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement. 
 - Develop and manage the product engineering budget, optimizing resource allocation and ensuring cost-effectiveness. 
 - Lead change management initiatives within the engineering organization, effectively communicating changes and ensuring smooth transitions. 
 - Drive group problem-solving efforts, leveraging diverse perspectives to overcome technical challenges and deliver innovative solutions.

 - Strong ability in Group Problem Solving and leading teams to successful resolutions.

 - Expertise in People Management, including hiring, coaching, and performance management. 
 - Demonstrated success in Project Delivery, consistently bringing products to market on time and within budget. 
 - Deep understanding of Software Development principles and practices. 
 - Extensive experience in Software Engineering, including architecture, design, and implementation. 
 - Familiarity with various project management methodologies, including the Waterfall Model. 
 - Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.

data.title: Lead Back End Engineer
data.description:
This is a leadership role in our engineering team - not just a cog in the wheel. 

This is not a "maintenance" role. This is engineering leadership-owning the backend architecture of a global, privacy-first communication platform. You'll lead by example, guide a high-calibre team, and ensure our backend systems remain blazing-fast, rock-solid, and uncompromising on security. You'll be at the intersection of code and leadership-mentoring engineers, driving architectural decisions, and setting engineering standards that define how a global product is built. 

Who are we?

We are a young product company scaling fast and outgrowing the startup tag-with global scale in our crosshairs. We don't do "okay. " We give everything we've got to build the best communication platform in the world. Our team includes engineers from IIT and other top institutions-people who care deeply about the craft, performance, and purpose. You'll learn more in 6 months here than most engineers do in 3 years elsewhere. We're intense. High-strung. Focused. Our team includes engineers from IIT and other top-tier

backgrounds. But what defines us is not our degrees-it's our refusal to compromise on quality, performance, or privacy. 

What are we building?

WrkTalk is the world's first zero-access, zero-spam enterprise communication product that operates on a structural privacy architecture. One that's already earned the trust of large enterprises like L&T Finance, Adani Group, and Kalyan Jewellers - just to name a few of our enterprise clients. This is not an MVP. This is production-grade software that secures communication for thousands-and soon, millions-of professionals worldwide. 

What's the role?

• Architect backend systems in NestJS and Golang to meet global scale and enterprise-grade performance. 

• Drive design for microservices, real-time comms (WebSockets, WebRTC), and data stores (PostgreSQL, Redis). 

• Lead code reviews, enforce coding standards, and maintain CI/CD discipline. 

• Mentor and upskill backend engineers. 

• Collaborate cross-functionally with frontend, DevOps, and product leaders. 

• Own technical problem-solving-anticipate bottlenecks, make hard calls, and prevent tech debt from being parked for "later. "

• Manage task allocation, workflow discipline, and ensure smooth collaboration with frontend and DevOps. 

The tech here is serious. 

We work on socket-driven comms infrastructure, distributed control towers, multi-category encryption, root detection, app kill-switches, dynamic guest access, device-level lockout, and OOO/ DND logic layered with smart whitelisting. This is not lightweight app dev. This is protocol-layer decision-making. 

Who should apply?

• 6-8+ years in backend engineering, with at least 2 years in a leadership role. 

• Expertise in Golang and Node. js (NestJS). 

• Strong database tuning skills (PostgreSQL, Redis). 

• Solid understanding of Docker, Kubernetes, and scalable deployment. 

• Experience building real-time systems at scale. 

• Proven ability to lead technical discussions and inspire engineering teams. 

• Track record of shipping production-grade, high-performance systems. 

Why should you join?

• Because you want to own backend architecture-not just follow it

• Because you'll work directly with established founders, not buried under layers

• Because you'll ship real, deeply engineered features used by large number of enterprise users

• Because you'll grow 10x faster here-in experience, learning, and impact

• And because if you walk this road with us for 3-4 years, it'll catapult you into a tech orbit or fame and glory you never imagined

Where are we located?

We're based in Navi Mumbai and building for the world.

data.title: Development Manager
data.description:
Development Manager

Location: Kaplan India

Reports to: Head of Applications, Engineering & Architecture

Employment type: Full-time

Role summary

Kaplan International Pathways is a leading provider of global education, centered around our students. 

Technology is at the heart of what we do, and delivery discipline matters because we operate across

multiple platforms, partners, and time zones. 

We are seeking a strategic and technical Development Manager to join our Application Engineering and

Architecture Team. This role is unique: you will own the "production line" of our software delivery. 

While we have multiple distributed development teams shipping code, we need to eliminate friction and

ensure seamless integration. 

You will not just be managing people; you will be the architect of our flow. You will coordinate teams

to optimise cadence, professionalise our release capability, and ensure that our delivery ordering

prevents technical debt. You will be the guardian of our platform's integrity and the driver of our

engineering velocity. 

As the Development Manager you will work intimately with the QA Manager, Solution Architects, 

Partners, and the Portfolio Delivery Team. Your mission is to streamline our development cycle through

lightweight governance, automation, and artificial intelligence. 

Detailed responsibilities

Release Management: 

• Enforce the Operational Readiness Review (ORR). You have the authority to say, "No Go. "

• Ensure that before code goes live, Service Level Objectives (SLOs) are met, telemetry is active

and run books are updated. 

• Coordinate release schedules across concurrent, distributed development teams to prevent

environment contention and deployment collisions. 

• Act as the conductor of the "Release Train, " ensuring it runs on time, in the correct order, and

that inter-team dependencies are resolved before deployment day. 

• Partner with the QA Manager to enforce the Release-Confidence (RC) Score as a hard gate in

your pipelines, preventing low-quality code from blocking the flow for other high-performing

teams

Pipeline Governance & Policy-as-Code: 

• Own the definition and evolution of our CI/CD pipeline standards. 

• Drive the implementation of "Policy-as-Code" and automated quality gates to catch issues early

(Shift Left), ensuring that no non-compliant build ever reaches production. 

• Work with Solution Architects to define and operationalise "Green Lane" patterns, our

automated, low-friction paths for low-risk changes. 

• Move us away from heavy manual governance for standard changes, enabling high-trust teams

to bypass red tape and increasing our overall DORA metrics/velocity. 

Operational Excellence & Incident Command: 

• Act as the primary Incident Commander for major deployment failures or outages. 

• Lead the Root Cause Analysis (RCA) process, ensuring we don't just fix the bug, but

systematically prevent the recurrence of the failure scenario. 

You'll also carry out other duties, within the broad scope and spirit of your role, as requested by your

manager. Our business continuously evolves, so your role will too. 

What you'll bring to the role

Essential Skills & Experience

• Demonstrable experience managing software delivery in a complex, multi-team environment

(e. g. , managing interdependencies between distinct Scrum teams or 3rd party vendors). 

• Deep understanding of modern branching strategies (GitFlow vs. Trunk-Based Development), 

semantic versioning, and the ability to resolve complex merge/deployment conflicts. 

• Practical, hands-on experience with CI/CD tooling (ArgoCD/Jenkins, Azure DevOps, GitHub

Actions) and Infrastructure-as-Code (Terraform/Bicep). You understand how to build the pipes, 

not just use them. 

• A proven track record of reducing cycle time (lead time for changes) and deployment failure

rates through automation and process re-engineering. 

• Strong ability to negotiate with Dev Leads and Project Managers to ensure adherence to our

governance standards. 

Desirable Skills & Experience

• Experience enforcing code quality and release standards on external/offshore development

partners. 

• with Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) concepts, specifically implementing SLOs and Error

Budgets to govern release velocity. 

• Experience using tools to visualise flow metrics (e. g. , DORA metrics) to drive continuous

improvement. 

Our Tech Stack

You will be working within a modern, diverse ecosystem that includes the following and much more: 

• Version Control: GitHub, Bitbucket. 

• CI/CD & DevOps: ArgoCD, Azure DevOps Pipelines, GitHub Actions. 

• Infrastructure: Infrastructure-as-Code (Terraform, Bicep). 

• Cloud Providers: AWS and Azure ecosystems. 

• Observability: OTEL (OpenTelemetry), RED method monitoring. 

• Platforms: Salesforce (and satellite services), Microsoft 365, Standard Web Applications.

Role Definition

Monitors and improves the maintenance of the production unit by overseeing maintenance staff and equipment; ensures employees comply with safety procedures and standards. 

Responsibilities

 - Managing the erection & commissioning, ensuring completion of project in minimum turnaround time and effective resource utilization to maximize the output.

 - Monitoring the maintenance budget; identifying cost-effective alternatives for current maintenance activities.

data.title: Engineering Manager
data.description:
Responsibilities

Job purpose

People Leader, accountable for providing leadership for Process Engineers within the Engineering & Process Technology group through creating shared vision & values, developing and utilising talent and driving performance. Leads and directs programs with the objective to enhance engineering productivity and efficiency. 

Principal Accountabilities

Leadership

Manage EHS through management of change, behavioural safety and ensuring a safe work environment and compliant with Business and Group operating standards, procedures and systems. 

Drive results through aligning the team with business strategy and goals, establishing clear standards of engineering excellence, and setting clear direction and accountabilities through performance management whilst providing balanced feedback at the most critical times to maintain momentum and a strong sense of ownership. 

Act as a change agent, lead, support and contribute to change programmes, driving and championing the implementation, gaining acceptance to enable an agile and engaged team. 

Feed into workforce plans to ensure the right resourcing requirements for current and future business needs. This includes understanding current and future capability needs and addressing those through development interventions. 

Lead succession planning to ensure a strong talent pipeline and to mitigate critical skills gaps. 

Inspire growth through career conversations, developing talent and ensuring the team has the skills and experiences to deliver, develop and progress careers within JM - Honeywell. 

Ensure all team members have up to date Personal Development Plans, which are reviewed on a regular basis and provide input into training planning to ensure team members have access to relevant and appropriate training opportunities. 

Provide input to Engineering resource planning to ensure developmental objectives are known and addressed. 

Support team development and ensure team are appropriately aligned to the technical career path based on their capability and business need. Provide input to the Grade Review Process. 

Responsible for allocating resource to basic engineering/development projects according to business demands. 

Instil trust and value differences, generating confidence and safety with others through openness and authenticity, modelling high standards of honesty, transparency and integrity whilst promoting a team environment that values, encourages, and supports differences. 

Develop employee engagement strategy for the team to motivate and drive engagement. 

Facilitate collaboration with shared values for engineering to partner across teams and functions to create high performing teams to achieve common goals. 

Provide input and recommendations on reward and benefits processes for team e. g. annual review. 

Carry out people and business processes within HR and Business systems (e. g. Workday process initiation, leave & expense approvals, etc). 

In conjunction with other Engineering Managers, establish and maintain engineering capability across CT's offices. 

Execution & Delivery (Program Management)

Maintain and enhance the capabilities and productivity within the Engineering & Process Technology function. 

Initiate and lead major transformation projects to scale and grow engineering capacity and capability for the organization. 

Deputise for the Engineering Management Director, as required. 

Drive L&D/training requirements and transition into an Engineering Academy. 

- Monitor and assess the training requirements of new starters and current engineering staff. 
 - Developing training programs to address training needs. 
 - Identify training themes to address and initiate the preparation and presentation of courses with the objective of building a library of training material (recorded presentation, how-to guides, interactive training tools, etc) that support the engineering functions. 
 - Identify internal and external training providers working alongside Learning and Development.

- Responsible for recruitment of permanent and contingent engineering staff. Manage relationships with engineering service providers. 
 - Work with the Talent Acquisition team to develop recruitment campaigns to attract new hires. 
 - Set the standard for competencies and capabilities required for new hires, and methodology for assessment. 
 - Review CVs, interview candidates and recommend outcomes. 
Engineering Tasks

- Approve BEP engineering documentation as required. 
 - Approve basic engineering package execution strategy and engineering hour estimation. 
 - Ensure procedures are reviewed and updated as required. 
 - Identify and prepare new procedures/guidance as required by Engineering. 
 - Identify improvements to Engineering tools and methodologies, implementing improvement programs as required. 
 - Support Lead Engineers in project execution. 
To take on any other duties which are within the employee's skills and abilities whenever reasonably instructed. 

Scope

Primary interactions are within CT E&PT Leadership team and CT's engineering service providers. 

Planning horizon 1-3 months tactical, 3-36 months for S&OP process resourcing, 5 years for strategic engineering footprint. 

People leadership & development. 

Special factors

Geography global. 

Up to 25% international and domestic travel on average can be expected. 

Flex work patterns to accommodate working across different time zones, when required. 

Qualifications

Person specification

This describes what is required to do the job, it may not describe the current job holder but should describe the typical attributes or traits needed for success in the position. 

Qualifications/ Knowledge/ Experience

(Technical/ professional knowledge and skills competency)

Degree In Chemical Engineering Or Equivalent Experience Essential

Understanding of technology development, engineering and licencing Essential

Member of a recognised Professional Institution Desirable

Personal Skills And Key Competencies

Leaderships Skills - ability to lead and motivate a technical team Essential

People Development - support individuals to learn and develop continuously to meet their career goals and organisations goals Essential

Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written - ability to explain complex issues clearly & technical concepts to a non-technical audience Essential

Ability to influence key stakeholders to achieve business objectives & effective decision making Essential

Ability to collaborate across function lines to drive required decisions and outcomes Essential

Innovative approach to engineering execution Essential

Excellent planning skills - goal setting, task breakdown, prioritisation, realistic scheduling and resource allocation Essential

Organisational Awareness Essential

Ability to build effective teams and instil trust Essential

Strategic Thinking & Direction Setting Essential

Strong focus on continuous improvement, driving innovation and ability to facilitate change and deliver change programmes Essential

A global mindset and experience of working in a multi-cultural environment Essential

About Us

Honeywell Technologies is a global, pure-play automation company with a legacy of innovating to help solve the world's most mission-critical challenges, enhancing the quality of life for people and communities around the world. We serve the building, industrial and process sectors with a broad portfolio of services, solutions and products, underpinned by our Honeywell Technologies Accelerator operating system and Honeywell Technologies Forge intelligence layer. By combining the deep domain expertise of our more than 50, 000 employees with decades of data from our global installed base, we are uniquely positioned to lead the industrial sector's transition from automation to autonomy.

Job Description

Help shape the future of mobility. 

Imagine a world with zero vehicle accidents, zero vehicle emissions, and wireless vehicle connectivity all around us. Every day, we move closer to making that world a reality. Aptiv's passionate team of engineers and developers creates advanced safety systems, high-performance electrification solutions and data connectivity solutions so that automakers can bring advanced capabilities to more people around the globe. This is how we enable sustainable mobility and help to prevent accidents caused by human error. 

We're hiring an Electrical/Electronics Engineer to design and develop our automotive products in the areas of Active Safety and User-Experience. This position is located in TCI. 

Advanced Software Engineer

Position Summary: Contribute feasibility estimates and safety implementation risks. Refine software safety requirements, detailed design and verification cases. Implement, review, integrate and document safety-related software. Execute tests, coverage and anomaly closure; provide release evidence. Support safety-impact analysis and controlled maintenance fixes. 

Your Role: 

- Implement safety mechanisms, diagnostics, monitoring, fault handling and safe-state logic. 
 - Create detailed design, code, unit tests and required analysis evidence. 
 - Apply defensive programming, coding guidelines and freedom-from-interference controls. 
 - Perform static analysis, structural coverage and fault-injection support as applicable. 
 - Maintain traceability and resolve safety anomalies with documented impact analysis. 

Your Background: 

- Exp Level 8Yrs to 16Yrs
 - B. E. /B. Tech or M. E. /M. Tech in Computer Science, Electronics, Electrical, Instrumentation, or a related engineering discipline
 - Embedded C/C++, microcontrollers, AUTOSAR/RTOS and debugging experience. 
 - ISO 26262 Part 6 fundamentals, MISRA C/C++, unit testing and static analysis. 
 - Requirements traceability, configuration management and Automotive SPICE. 
 - Understanding of watchdogs, memory protection, communication monitoring and diagnostics. 

Preferred Competencies

- Model-based development, MC/DC, fault injection, safety analysis and certified functional-safety training. 

Expected outputs / measures of success

- Detailed safety design 
 - Production code 
 - Unit and coverage evidence 
 - Traceability 
 - Safety anomaly resolution 
 - NOTE- Only apply if you meet the basic criteria w. r. t experience & skill. 

Why join us?

Are you a passionate developer with an agile mindset? And would you like to be a strategically important part of the organization in one of the world's leading software providers within the Fintech industry? Then you should join SimCorp as a C# & APL Senior/Lead Software Engineer!

WHO WE ARE?

For over 50 years, we have worked closely with large and global investment and asset managers to become the world's leading provider of integrated investment management solutions. We are 2, 500+ colleagues with a broad range of nationalities, educational backgrounds, professional experiences, ages, and backgrounds in general. 

SimCorp is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a culture where diverse perspectives and expertise are integrated in our everyday work. We believe in the continual growth and development of our employees, so that we can provide best-in-class solutions to our clients. While striving to deliver client value, we believe it is vital to consider our people and our planet in every business decision we make. Acting responsibly is not optional. It is essential. 

WHY THIS ROLE IS IMPORTANT TO US

We are building and evolving Investment Foundation, a top-priority project for SimCorp right now and we are building this area to meet our strategic decisions and deliver more outcomes. We are looking for an experienced Software Engineer with expertise in C#, a deep understanding of its ecosystems and a strong background in object-oriented programming. The ideal candidate should be familiar with the . NET framework, skilled in designing and implementing architectural patterns. Additionally, proficiency in automated testing platforms, unit tests, and Git for code versioning, along with experience in Azure environments, is highly desirable. You will be part of an engineering team, contributing to everything from architecture and component design to performance and accessibility and responsible for delivering functionality that enables clients to make investment decisions with our back-office applications. The ideal candidate should have an eagerness to learn APL (A Programming Language). Prior experience with APL isn't required, we provide comprehensive training and a supportive environment to help you succeed. Our company also partly owns Dyalog APL, ensuring the language remains actively maintained and relevant. For now, the most of our work is done in APL. 

WHY SIMCORP, WHY NOW

Simcorp is growing rapidly in the market and we see increasing demand from existing and potential clients. That's why SimCorp is investing in creating a development area Area that is placed uniquely in our Product development ecosystem to meet our top priority strategic decisions and deliver valuable outcomes for our clients. You would be working on topics that touch different areas of Simcorp Dimension which places you in a unique position to view

What You Will Be Responsible For

As a Senior/Lead Engineer, you will help drive both technical excellence and team execution, end-to-end: 

- Lead design and development of backend systems in APL (current core). 
 - Architect scalable, secure, high-performance solutions as we move toward cloud-native approaches on Microsoft Azure. 
 - Mentor and guide engineers through code reviews, technical planning and agile ways of working. 
 - Partner closely with Product and engineering peers to deliver outcomes that matter, fast feedback, reliable delivery and maintainable code. 
 - Drive code quality and reliability via unit testing, integration testing, CI/CD and pragmatic engineering standards. 
 - Identify performance bottlenecks and bugs and devise sustainable solutions. 
 - Use Git-based workflows and work effectively in a continuous integration environment. 
 - Collaborate with cross-located teams and contribute to shared ways of working across sites. 
 - Require excellent business and communication skills and to be able to understand client specific requirements. 

Note: Designation Might vary based on the interview & the Expereince level. 

Your Qualifications

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in computer science, information technology, or a related field. 
 - 5+ years of software development experience. 
 - Strong engineering fundamentals: object-oriented design, architecture patterns, clean code, and pragmatic problem solving. 
 - Solid experience in C#/. NET (Core/Framework) and building backend systems (APIs, services, integrations). 
 - Familiarity with APIs (REST/streaming patterns) and messaging concepts (e. g. , service bus patterns). 
 - Proficient understanding of code versioning tools such as Git. 
 - Experience with automated testing and CI/CD, plus strong code review habits. 
 - Acquaintance with AI tools and ML is a plus 
 - Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to work independently and as part of a team. 
 - Comfortable collaborating with multiple stakeholders and communicating clearly in an international environment. 

APL READINESS

- You don't need prior APL experience. What matters is curiosity and willingness to learn. We provide training and a supportive environment to help you succeed, and SimCorp partly owns Dyalog APL, helping ensure the language remains actively maintained and relevant. 

NICE-TO-HAVE

- FinTech / regulated-industry experience. 
 - Exposure to vector-based or functional languages (helpful for ramping up in APL).

Benefits

Benefits Competitive salary, bonus scheme, and pension are essential for any work agreement. However, at SimCorp, we believe we can offer more. Therefore, in addition to the traditional benefit scheme, we provide an excellent work & life balance: flexible work hours, and a hybrid workplace model. On top of that, we have IP sprints where you have time you can spend on mastering your skills as well as contributing to the company's development. There is never just only one route, we practice an individual approach to professional development to support the direction you want to take. 

NEXT STEPS

Please click below to apply or get in touch with Aditya Gurijala, Recruitment Consultant or you may send an email to aditya. gurijala@simcorp. com to learn more about the vacancy and what SimCorp has to offer regarding salary, benefits, and perks. Applications are continuously assessed, so please send your CV in English as soon as possible. If you are interested in being a part of SimCorp but are not sure this role is the right fit, submit your CV anyway. SimCorp is on an exciting growth journey, and our Talent Acquisition Team is ready to help you discover the right role for you. The approximate time to consider your CV is three weeks. data.description:
Role: Senior Site Reliability Engineer (SRE) / DevOps Engineer

Location: Viman Nagar, Pune (Work From Office)

Experience: 10+ Years

Timings: 3: 00 PM - 12: 00 AM (Monday - Friday)

About The Role

On-Call Rotation Required (24/7 Production Support)

We are seeking a highly experienced Senior Site Reliability Engineer (SRE) / DevOps Engineer responsible for ensuring the reliability, scalability, security, observability, and performance of mission-critical production systems. This role combines strong DevOps automation expertise with true SRE ownership, including incident management, on-call participation, reliability engineering, observability, root cause analysis, and proactive system improvements. 

The ideal candidate will have deep expertise in Microsoft Azure, Kubernetes, OpenTelemetry, Golden Signals monitoring, and modern SRE practices. They should be capable of balancing incident response with long-term engineering initiatives that improve reliability, reduce operational toil, and strengthen system resilience. 

Key Responsibilities

1. Incident Response & On-Call Ownership

- Participate in 24/7 on-call rotation for production systems. 
 - Rapidly diagnose, mitigate, and resolve high-severity production incidents. 
 - Lead Root Cause Analysis (RCA) and post-mortem documentation. 
 - Implement corrective and preventive actions to avoid recurrence. 
 - Drive improvements in Mean Time to Recovery (MTTR). 
 - Maintain and improve SLAs, SLOs, and reliability objectives. 

2. Reliability Engineering & SRE Practices

- Implement and champion Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) best practices. 
 - Define, measure, and improve SLIs, SLOs, SLAs, and Error Budgets. 
 - Engineer solutions to eliminate repetitive operational work (toil reduction). 
 - Conduct reliability reviews and capacity planning exercises. 
 - Improve system redundancy, failover strategies, and disaster recovery readiness. 
 - Continuously improve service availability, latency, and operational excellence. 

3. Cloud & Infrastructure Engineering

- Design, manage, and optimize infrastructure on Microsoft Azure (Mandatory). 
 - Manage Azure Virtual Machines, Networking, Storage, IAM, Azure Monitor, and cloud-native services. 
 - Experience with AWS services such as EC2, S3, RDS, IAM, VPC, and CloudWatch is preferred. 
 - Exposure to Google Cloud Platform (GCP) is a plus. 
 - Administer and optimize Kubernetes clusters and containerized workloads. 
 - Manage Helm deployments and Kubernetes-based applications. 
 - Implement Infrastructure as Code (Terraform preferred). 
 - Support Git-based workflows using GitHub, GitLab, or Azure Repos. 

4. Monitoring, Observability & Performance Engineering

- Design and implement observability solutions using OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, CloudWatch, and Azure Monitor. 
 - Build and maintain distributed tracing frameworks using OpenTelemetry. 
 - Establish monitoring based on Golden Signals: 
 - Latency
 - Traffic
 - Errors
 - Saturation
 - Design symptom-based alerting focused on user impact. 
 - Analyze performance bottlenecks and optimize application and infrastructure performance. 
 - Improve logging, tracing, and monitoring strategies across distributed systems. 

5. AI & Cloud-Native Workloads (Good to Have)

- Support deployment and operations of Azure AI Services and AI Foundry solutions. 
 - Assist in infrastructure design for RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) workloads. 
 - Ensure scalability, reliability, and observability of AI/ML systems in production. 

6. Security & Compliance

- Apply cloud security best practices including IAM, network segmentation, and secrets management. 
 - Support vulnerability remediation and security initiatives. 
 - Collaborate with development and security teams to meet compliance requirements. 

Required Technical Skills

Core Engineering

- Strong scripting/programming skills in Python and Bash. 
 - Good knowledge of Go (Golang) is a plus. 
 - Deep understanding of Linux systems administration. 
 - Strong networking fundamentals (DNS, TCP/IP, Load Balancing, SSL/TLS). 
 - Experience managing highly available production environments. 

Cloud & Infrastructure

- Microsoft Azure (Mandatory)
 - Kubernetes and container orchestration
 - Terraform (Infrastructure as Code)

Monitoring & Observability

- OpenTelemetry
 - Prometheus

 - Datadog
 - Azure Monitor
 - CloudWatch
 - Distributed Tracing
 - Metrics, Logs, and Observability Best Practices

SRE & Reliability

- Incident Response
 - On-Call Operations
 - Root Cause Analysis (RCA)
 - SLI / SLO / SLA Management
 - Error Budgets
 - Golden Signals Monitoring
 - Capacity Planning

Preferred Qualifications

 - Experience supporting AI/ML workloads in cloud environments. 
 - Familiarity with Azure AI Services and AI Foundry. 
 - Experience building observability frameworks using OpenTelemetry.

What We're Looking For

data.title: Senior Software Engineer
data.description:
Pattern is a leading eCommerce data and growth company headquartered in the Silicon Slopes tech hub in Lehi, Utah, with global offices in Europe, China, Australia, the Middle East, and Canada. Named to the Inc. 500 list of the fastest-growing companies in the US, Pattern has made its mark in the industry. Some of the biggest consumer brands - including Skullcandy, Nestle, Clorox, Kong, Panasonic, Tumi, and PopSockets - trust Pattern with their business, and Pattern has recruited talent from Amazon, eBay, Adobe, PepsiCo, Apple, Google, and Oracle. 

Pattern values data and the engineering required to take full advantage of it. As a Senior Software Engineer on the AI Platforms team, you will build the systems that turn Pattern's data into automated, accountable action for our brand partners. 

Essential Duties And Responsibilities

- Platform services: design, build and run the backend services that receive events, track cases, decide whether an agent should run, and resume work when a person responds. 
 - Correctness: own the platform's correctness guarantees: 
 - idempotency; 
 - deduplication of repeated signals; 
 - locking against concurrent runs; 
 - recovery from crashed or stuck runs; 
 - a complete audit trail of what each agent did. 
 - Agents: build and evolve agents that follow business SOPs. Decide which steps belong in deterministic code, which need the model's judgement, and which must stay with a person. 
 - Tools: build MCP tool servers that give agents safe, well-described access to internal data and services, with clear input and output schemas. 
 - Human-in-the-loop: integrate approval flows: request approvals, verify signed callbacks, handle partial approval, rejection and expiry, and make sure only approved work is executed. 
 - Evaluations: write evals for agents and tools (golden datasets, regression suites, trace review) and use them as the gate for shipping prompt, model and tool changes. 
 - Observability and cost: instrument services and agents with tracing, metrics and logs. Track model cost per case, and keep agents from running when nothing has changed. 
 - Safety: apply guardrails, including: 
 - treating external content as untrusted input; 
 - keeping money and policy rules in code, not in prompts; 
 - never automating systems Pattern policy forbids. 
 - Cross-team work: make changes across service boundaries with the teams that own sensors, task management, approvals and the Pi web app, including in a second language (Python or Ruby on Rails) when the work requires it. 
 - Requirements: translate business requirements (SOPs, approval rules, escalation paths) into clear designs, tickets and runnable systems. 
 - Production support: support production, including on-call triage when an automation misbehaves. 
 - Leadership (Senior): mentor other engineers, review their designs and code, and help set engineering standards for AI work on the team. 
What We Expect

Senior Software Engineer (5-7 years)

- 3+ years of production experience in your primary backend language. 
 - Designs new components end to end, such as the case-tracking service, and takes ambiguous problems to a clear design. 
 - Owns a production service, including being on call. 
 - Has shipped and measured an LLM-powered feature they owned. 
 - Mentors engineers and reviews designs and code. 

Required Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, a related field, or equivalent professional experience. 
 - 5-7 years of professional software engineering experience, mostly on backend systems. 
 - Primary skill set (one of the following): 
 - TypeScript and Python , with production experience in TypeScript (3+ years) and solid working experience in Python; or 
 - TypeScript and Ruby on Rails , with production experience in either (3+ years) and solid working experience in the other. 
You should be comfortable reading and making changes in the language you use less. 

- Experience designing APIs and webhooks, including authentication and signature verification. 
 - Has shipped at least one LLM-powered feature in production: tool or function calling, structured outputs, and a way to measure whether it works. 
 - Comfort with AWS (ECS or containers, S3, IAM at minimum) and with Docker. 
 - Production ownership, monitoring, alerting, incident response and root-cause analysis. 
 - Excellent engineering practice: version control, code review, automated testing, and small, reviewable changes. 
 - Strong written and spoken communication, including turning ambiguous business processes into clear technical designs. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with PostgreSQL in production: data modelling, transactions, indexing, and concurrency control (row locking, optimistic versioning, unique constraints). 
 - Experience with background jobs and queues (for example BullMQ, Sidekiq, Celery, SQS or Kafka), including retries, idempotency and dead-letter handling. 
 - Experience building agents or agent platforms: multi-step workflows, human approval steps, memory or state across runs. 
 - Experience building or consuming MCP servers, or similar tool-integration layers. 
 - Experience with LLM evaluation and observability tools such as Opik, Langfuse, LangSmith, Braintrust or Promptfoo. 
 - Familiarity with agent frameworks and SDKs (for example the Vercel AI SDK, OpenAI Agents SDK or LangGraph), and with LLM gateways or routers. 
 - Experience with durable workflow or event-driven patterns: transactional outbox, leases, Temporal, Step Functions or event sourcing. 
 - Experience with OpenTelemetry tracing. 
 - eCommerce or marketplace domain experience (Amazon, Walmart, Shopify or similar). 
 - Experience working productively with AI coding agents (for example Claude Code) on a large existing codebase. 

Your first 90 days

- Days 1-30: 
 - Learn the platform end to end: follow one automation from sensor detection to approved, completed work. 
 - Ship small fixes in the agents platform and a tool server. 
 - Be able to explain how a repeat signal is prevented from creating duplicate work. 
 - Days 31-60: 
 - Own a component, such as part of the case-tracking service, an approval integration or a set of MCP tools. 
 - Add an evaluation suite that catches a real regression. 
 - Close one reliability gap, for example concurrent events or stuck runs. 
 - Days 61-90: 
 - Lead the delivery of a new automation use case across sensors, agent, tools and approvals (Software Engineer II: own a major part of it). 
 - Ship it with the evaluations, monitoring, shadow-mode run and rollback plan that make it safe to leave running. 
 Our core values

- Data Fanatics: Our edge is always found in the data 
 - Partner Obsessed: We are obsessed with partner success 
 - Team of Doers: We have a bias for action 
 - Game Changers: We encourage innovation

Why Pattern?

- The company is a rocket ship experiencing phenomenal growth 
 - We have tailwinds and a long runway; we're barely scratching the surface 
 - We have big opportunities that will get you energized and excited 
 - Great benefits including time off, insurance, competitive pay

data.title: Application Developer-AWS Cloud FullStack
data.description:
Introduction

A career in IBM Consulting is built on long-term client relationships and close collaboration worldwide. You'll work with leading companies across industries, helping them shape their hybrid cloud and AI journeys. With support from our strategic partners, robust IBM technology, and Red Hat, you'll have the tools to drive meaningful change and accelerate client impact. At IBM Consulting, curiosity fuels success. You'll be encouraged to challenge the norm, explore new ideas, and create innovative solutions that deliver real results. Our culture of growth and empathy focuses on your long-term career development while valuing your unique skills and experiences. 

Your Role And Responsibilities

As an Application Developer: AWS Cloud FullStack, you will design and develop scalable, resilient, and cloud-native applications using modern technologies and methodologies. You will work in an Agile environment, delivering high-quality solutions through continuous release and improvement cycles. 

Your Primary Responsibilities Will Include

- Develop Rich UI Applications: Design and develop rich user interface applications using Single Page Applications (SPA) or microfrontends, utilizing frameworks such as ReactJS or Angular. 
 - Develop Scalable Backend Microservices: Develop scalable and resilient backend microservices based on 12-factor principles, exposing functionality via API and event interfaces, using programming languages such as Java, NodeJS, or Python. 
 - Implement Cloud-Native CI/CD: Implement cloud-native Continuous Integration and Continuous Deployment (CI/CD) pipelines for change release, ensuring seamless delivery of applications and services. 
 - Manage AWS Services: Run and manage services on AWS, including PaaS, content delivery, routing services, databases, event-driven applications, and observability tools. 
 - Ensure DevSecOps Practices: Implement DevSecOps practices using AWS services such as CodeBuild, CodeDeploy, CodePipeline, and CodeCommit, ensuring secure and efficient application delivery. 

Preferred Education

Master's Degree

Required Technical And Professional Expertise

- Cloud-Native Application Development: Experience with designing and developing scalable, resilient, and cloud-native applications using modern technologies and methodologies, including microservices-based modular designs and API-driven microservices. 
 - Full Stack Development: Experience with developing rich UI applications using Single Page Applications (SPA) or microfrontends, and scalable backend microservices based on 12-factor principles, using frameworks such as ReactJS, Angular, Springboot, and programming languages such as Java, NodeJS, or Python. 
 - AWS Services Management: Experience with running and managing services on AWS, including PaaS, content delivery, routing services, databases, event-driven applications, and observability tools, such as EKS, ECS, Fargate, Lambda, CloudFront, API Gateway, and CloudWatch. 
 - Cloud-Native CI/CD: Experience with implementing cloud-native Continuous Integration and Continuous Deployment (CI/CD) pipelines for change release, using tools such as CodeBuild, CodeDeploy, CodePipeline, and CodeCommit. 
 - Event-Driven Architecture: Experience with developing event-driven applications using messaging and streaming services, such as Kafka, SQS, SNS, and Kinesis Streams. 

Preferred Technical And Professional Experience

- Proficiency in Additional Frameworks: Exposure to Quarkus, Django, or Express Js frameworks for developing scalable and resilient backend microservices. 
 - Knowledge of No-SQL Modelling: Experience working with modern No-SQL modelling techniques for data model development. 
 - Familiarity with GraalVM: Exposure to GraalVM runtime for developing scalable and resilient backend microservices.

data.title: Sr. Software Engineer-  AI
data.description:
P-1700

At Databricks, we are passionate about helping enterprises that build ML models and AI agents deliver high-quality AI to production fast. Founded by engineers, and customer obsessed, we leap at every opportunity to tackle technical challenges, from designing great developer experiences to building reliable systems at global scale. And we're only getting started. 

Our team builds the MLOps and LLMOps platform that millions of AI developers and ML practitioners use to track model training experiments, manage model registry, observe and evaluate AI agents. We're the team behind MLflow, the most widely adopted open-source AI engineering platform with more than 30 million package downloads per month, and its managed service used by thousands of organizations globally. We're now expanding to Bengaluru, India, and building our first AI engineering team there from scratch to work on this platform. 

As a Senior Software Engineer and a founding member of the Bengaluru team, you'll design and build the backend systems behind these products and take them from design through production. This is an excellent opportunity for a hands-on engineer who thrives in a fast-paced environment. 

Check out our recent blog post: coSTAR: How we ship AI agents at Databricks fast, without breaking things

The Impact You Will Have

- Design and implement core services and APIs for the platform, ensuring scalability, reliability, and operational excellence. 
 - Build systems that ingest, store, and query traces, metrics, and artifacts from training runs and production agents. 
 - Develop evaluation and monitoring capabilities, such as LLM judges and quality metrics, that catch regressions before they reach production. 
 - Optimize the scalability and cost of the platform as usage grows across customers and cloud regions. 
 - Work with product, research, and customers on what we build next. 
 - Establish best practices for code quality, testing, and operational readiness, and mentor other engineers. 

What We Look For

- BS (or higher) in Computer Science, or a related field. 
 - 5+ years of experience developing large-scale distributed systems, scaling infrastructure, or building platforms and developer tools for other teams. 
 - Strong foundation in algorithms, data structures, and system design. 
 - Strong experience with backend technical stacks such as Scala or Java. 
 - Experience with cloud technologies, e. g. AWS, Azure, GCP, Docker, Kubernetes. 
 - Engineering maturity in security, correctness, and operational excellence. 
 - Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate across teams. 
 - Experience with ML or LLM systems is a plus. 

About Databricks

Databricks is the Data and AI company. More than 20, 000 organizations worldwide - including adidas, AT&T, Bayer, Block, Mastercard, Rivian, Unilever, and 70% of the Fortune 500 - rely on the Databricks Data + AI Platform to build and scale data and AI apps, analytics and agents. Headquartered in San Francisco with 30+ offices around the globe, Databricks offers a unified platform that includes Genie, Lakebase, Agent Bricks, Lakeflow, Lakehouse, and Unity Catalog. To learn more, follow Databricks on LinkedIn, X, YouTube, and Instagram. 

Benefits

At Databricks, we strive to provide comprehensive benefits and perks that meet the needs of all of our employees. For specific details on the benefits offered in your region click here. 

Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

At Databricks, we are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive culture where everyone can excel. We take great care to ensure that our hiring practices are inclusive and meet equal employment opportunity standards. Individuals looking for employment at Databricks are considered without regard to age, color, disability, ethnicity, family or marital status, gender identity or expression, language, national origin, physical and mental ability, political affiliation, race, religion, sexual orientation, socio-economic status, veteran status, and other protected characteristics.

data.title: Senior AI Engineer
data.description:
Senior Full Stack Engineer

Position Overview: Build and scale Visteon's AI products end to end, from the user interface to the backend services and the cloud systems they run on. Own features from design through production, and make sure our applications stay fast, secure and reliable as usage grows. Work closely with AI/ML, product, design and QA teams, and stay hands-on in solving complex engineering problems. 

Key Objectives of this Role: 

- Build complete web or mobile applications, from the first screen to release, using any modern frontend stack. 
 - Turn designs into fast, accessible and easy-to-use screens that work well on all screen sizes. 
 - Build and maintain shared UI components and manage app state and data flow in a clean, predictable way. 
 - Design and build APIs and backend services that are secure, well documented and easy to use. 
 - Design databases that stay fast as data grows and choose the right storage for each need (SQL, NoSQL, cache or file storage). 
 - Use caching, background job queues and message queues to reduce load and keep systems responsive. 
 - Build secure login and access control and protect data in storage and in transit. 
 - Deploy applications to the cloud (AWS, Azure or GCP) using containers and set up systems that scale with traffic. 
 - Find and fix performance problems across the full stack, from slow screens to slow queries and overloaded servers. 
 - Set up logging, monitoring and alerts so problems are found and fixed quickly. 
 - Take part in code reviews, design discussions and technical decisions, and help keep cloud costs under control. 

Key Performance Indicators: 

- On-time delivery of features with high quality and few production issues. 
 - Application performance, uptime and ability to handle growing traffic. 
 - Test coverage and reliability of releases. 
 - Reuse of shared components, services and deployment patterns across the team. 
 - Feedback and satisfaction from product, design and AI teams. 

Key Year One Deliverables: 

- Deliver multiple features end to end, from design through production. 
 - Improve backend performance and scaling for at least one key product. 
 - Build or improve reusable UI components and backend service templates. 
 - Set up or strengthen CI/CD pipelines, monitoring and alerting for owned services. 
 - Document architecture and deployment practices so others can build on them. 

Qualification, Experience and Skills: 

- bachelor's or master's degree in computer science, Engineering, or a related discipline. 
 - 5+ years of hands-on experience in full stack development. 
 - Strong skills in at least one modern frontend technology (web or mobile) and at least one backend language. 
 - Solid knowledge of relational databases, SQL, caching, REST APIs, authentication and application security. 
 - Hands-on experience deploying and running applications on a cloud platform using containers (Docker or similar). 
 - Proven experience scaling backend systems, such as handling higher traffic, load balancing or improving database performance. 
 - Ability to learn a new language or framework quickly when needed. 
 - Good to have: Kubernetes, Terraform, CI/CD pipelines, monitoring tools (Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog), microservices, and experience with AI products such as LLM apps, AI agents, vector databases or model deployment. 

Key Behaviours: 

- Critical Thinking
 - Collaboration
 - Ownership
 - Result Orientation

Visteon Culture: If you thrive in a fast-paced, organizational culture that requires agility, adaptability, and a growth mindset from its employees to thrive and stay ahead of the curve Visteon is the place. We value high performance and a drive for results. Innovation, risk-taking, and continuous learning help us keep up with the ever-changing landscape of our industry and be Market leaders. At Visteon you can be more.
