data.title: Manager, Customer Identity, Security Engineering
data.description:
Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human

Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence. 

This is an opportunity to do career-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk. 

Get to know Okta

Okta is The World's Identity Company. We free everyone to safely use any technology-anywhere, on any device or app. Our Workforce and Customer Identity Clouds enable secure yet flexible access, authentication, and automation that transforms how people move through the digital world, putting Identity at the heart of business security and growth.   

At Okta, we celebrate a variety of perspectives and experiences. We are not looking for someone who checks every single box - we're looking for lifelong learners and people who can make us better with their unique experiences.   

Join our team! We're building a world where Identity belongs to you. 

The Role

We seek a technical, research-minded Security Engineering Manager to lead security engineering teams within Auth0 Customer Identity. Your teams' work spans two areas. The first is threat protection: providing general and AI-driven threat intelligence in partnership with Identity Security, and researching how attackers leverage AI, how we build AI-assisted defenses, and how we protect AI workloads across our products, infrastructure, and customer tenants. The second is software development for security: building micro-services and tooling that secure Customer Identity products and infrastructure, including how secrets are generated, stored, distributed, rotated, and retired. 

This role leads teams embedded within the Customer Identity product unit and works across multiple functions to deliver proactive threat intelligence, get ahead of emerging attack vectors, and build the security software that protects our platform, supporting the growth of our global Customer Identity business. 

We are an engineering-focused organization that seeks to stay on the cutting edge of security technology and the threat landscape. In this role you will set direction for teams that don't just assess our current security posture - they research what we should be protecting customers from one to two years ahead, build the software that delivers those protections, and help put AI-assisted defenses and secure-by-default secrets handling into the hands of the teams and customers who protect their tenants. 

You will lead a globally distributed group of talented engineers who share a passion for security and enjoy solving complex problems at scale. This role works closely with and alongside the broader Okta Security team in support of Okta's company-wide security strategy and Okta's Secure Identity Commitment. 

You will stay technical enough to challenge designs, evaluate research, review software architecture, and earn the respect of strong engineers, while spending most of your time on leadership: hiring, growing, and retaining your teams and shaping their roadmaps. 

Responsibilities: 

- Hire, lead, coach, and develop globally distributed teams of security engineers (Senior through Staff), building a culture of research discipline, technical excellence, and ownership
 - Define and execute a multi-quarter roadmap for your teams, aligned with Customer Identity business goals and Okta's company-wide security strategy, and balance investment and prioritization across them
 - Lead the delivery of scalable, reliable micro-services and automation that secure Customer Identity products and infrastructure, including secrets storage, rotation, access control, auditing, and workload identity
 - Drive adoption of secure-by-default secrets handling across Auth0 engineering teams, and reduce the risk from hard-coded, long-lived, or over-privileged credentials
 - Research the emerging AI threat landscape and translate it into a forward-looking (12-24 month) view of what we need to protect ourselves and our customers from, then prioritize investments in detection, tooling, and protections to get there
 - Direct research and protections against emerging general and AI-driven security threats targeting Auth0 and Auth0's customers - including traditional identity attacks as well as adversarial ML, prompt injection, abuse of agentic protocols (MCP, A2A, UCP), and data poisoning - as they apply to identity systems and customer tenants
 - Guide the review and hardening of Auth0's AI security offering, using analysis of past incidents to drive improvements such as new detection signals, heuristic updates, and data labeling enhancements, while identifying gaps and recommending mitigations before they're exploited
 - Partner with the identity security teams to help customers strengthen their own tenant security posture through comprehensive defenses and security countermeasures
 - Partner across Product, Engineering, and Identity Security leadership to turn research into shipped protections for customer tenants, both proactively (hardening posture before an attack) and during active incidents (accelerating detection, triage, and response)
 - Drive adoption of scalable security solutions and automation that operationalize threat defenses and secrets protections at scale
 - Own and influence high-impact security architecture decisions across Auth0 and Okta Customer Identity infrastructure to support long-term threat resilience
 - Collaborate with the Okta Security team on security operations and, where relevant, support investigations, root cause analysis, and remediation
 - Advise stakeholders on mitigation strategies for security risks, including end-of-life software and vulnerabilities, in support of the teams that own patching
 - Communicate risk, progress, and trade-offs clearly to senior leadership, and turn research into clear guidance for engineering and product teams
 - Manage team health, prioritization, and delivery across time zones, including IndiaWhat this position is not:   

- Dedicated application security, line-by-line code review, or compliance-focused leadership
 - Owning reactive patch and vulnerability management as a primary function - this role is about getting ahead of threats, not chasing them
 - A purely people-management role without technical depthRequirements: 

- You have 8+ years of experience in security engineering, with a strong foundation in cloud infrastructure and/or product security
 - You have 3+ years of experience managing security or software engineering teams, with a track record of hiring, developing, and retaining strong engineers
 - You have a hands-on development background - Go / Node preferred - sufficient to guide the design and review of micro-services, evaluate prototypes, and steer the building of security tooling and AI-powered defenses
 - You have hands-on experience with AI/ML security - attacking, defending, or both (e. g. , adversarial ML, LLM/prompt-injection attacks, agentic-system or model abuse), and an interest in using AI to build defenses, not just to study attacks
 - You have working knowledge of secrets management and cryptographic key handling (e. g. , vaulting, rotation, short-lived credentials, workload identity)
 - You have working knowledge and hands-on experience with one or more of the following: 
 - AWS and/or Azure security
 - Kubernetes
 - You have strong knowledge of OWASP security standards and frameworks (including the OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications) and secure coding best practices
 - You have a strong foundation in secure software development lifecycle best practices
 - You have a proven record of setting technical vision, defining multi-quarter strategy, driving architectural consensus, and influencing cross-organizational security initiatives
 - You have strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to turn research into clear guidance for engineering, product, and executive audiences
 - You have experience leading a globally distributed and remote team, ideally across multiple time zones including IndiaBonus points if: 

- You have published threat research, CVEs, or conference talks in AI/ML security or identity security
 - You have built or led teams building AI/ML-powered security tooling or defensive automation in a production environment
 - You have experience building or operating secrets management platforms (e. g. , HashiCorp Vault, cloud KMS and secret managers) at scale
 - You have working knowledge and experience with one or more of the following: 
 - Adversarial ML, model red-teaming, or AI safety research
 - The AI agent / MCP ecosystem and its security implications
 - Identity and access management
 - Full-stack engineering
 - Site reliability engineering
 - Vulnerability and threat management
 - Governance, risk and compliance

data.title: Platform Software Engineer - Core Infrastructure
data.description:
Nexthink is the leader in digital employee experience management software. The company provides IT leaders with unprecedented insight allowing them to see, diagnose and fix issues at scale impacting employees anywhere, with any application or network, before employees notice the issue. As the first solution to allow IT to progress from reactive problem solving to proactive optimization, Nexthink enables its more than 1, 500 customers to provide better digital experiences to more than 25+ million employees. Dual headquartered in Lausanne, Switzerland and Boston, Massachusetts, Nexthink has 9 offices worldwide. 

Nexthink helps IT teams delight people at work. Behind that promise sits a platform that takes in trillions of events a day from more than 15 million devices, running on a cell-based architecture that spans AWS regions around the world. The Core Infrastructure team builds and runs the AWS foundation that the whole of engineering depends on. The company has grown from on-prem to cloud and is now making room for new kinds of work, including AI and agent workloads, so there is plenty of genuinely interesting work to do on the layer underneath it all. 

Job Description

What you will do

- Design, deploy, and run AWS infrastructure from end to end: from the edge and networking through to the multi-account cell architecture and the EKS platform. 
 - Move between operational work, automation, requests from other engineering teams, and greenfield design, depending on what the platform needs that week. 
 - Automate as much as sensibly possible: the infrastructure-as-code and GitOps that provision, upgrade, and keep the whole estate consistent and free of drift. 
 - Work closely with the product and feature teams, turning what they need into self-service capabilities and helping them stay autonomous. 
 - Keep the platform reliable, secure, and cost-effective: upgrades, autoscaling, observability, and security hardening and compliance (FedRAMP, FIPS). You will share the on-call rotation with the rest of the team. 
 - Help the architecture grow: design new capabilities and take the platform to the next level of scale, resilience, and new kinds of workload. How we work

A few things that are true about this team and, we think, make it a good place to build: 

- It is a team with real ownership. You look after your own areas and make the call on what is best for the platform, rather than working through a queue of tickets someone else has written. 
 - We do not work in a silo. We spend a lot of time with the teams who build on us, including a good deal of design work together, so the platform grows around what people genuinely need. 
 - The scale keeps it interesting. A cell-based setup across several regions on modern AWS tooling is a good deal more involved, and more rewarding, than a single-region estate. 
 - We are improving something that already works. The platform is live and doing its job. Our task is to take it from good to really good, so the problems are about pushing things further rather than wiring up the basics. 
 - Like everyone here we use AI tools day to day, and we are steadily moving the more repetitive operational work onto automation. We would rather have engineers than operators, and we do the automation carefully, because infrastructure is not somewhere to be careless. 

Qualifications

Who you are

This matters to us more than any single item on the list below. We are looking for someone who: 

- Works well on their own. You can join a call, understand what a team really needs, and come back with a sensible plan. You think about the problem rather than wait to be told what to do. 
 - Communicates clearly and enjoys working with people. Requests come from a lot of directions, and you are comfortable with that. If you have done this in a smaller company or a lean team, that experience counts for a great deal here. 
 - Is pragmatic and cares about quality. You know when something needs doing now and when it needs doing properly, and you can juggle a few things at once without dropping any of them. What you will bring

The essentials

- A solid cloud infrastructure background and good software-engineering habits, usually around 5+ years as a Platform, DevOps, Software, or Site Reliability Engineer. 
 - A degree in Computer Science, Engineering or related field; or the equivalent in real experience. 
 - Strong hands-on AWS across networking, edge, and compute (for example VPC, CloudFront, API Gateway, EKS). 
 - Solid Kubernetes (ideally Amazon EKS) and infrastructure as code (Terraform or OpenTofu), with a GitOps mindset. 
 - Comfortable moving between operational work, automation, requests from other teams, and new design, and prioritising sensibly across them. 
 - A production mindset: you care about uptime, security, and efficiency. And you communicate clearly in English. Nice to have

- Experience in or near a compliance-driven environment (FedRAMP or FIPS is a real plus). 
 - Building self-service internal developer platforms with modern tooling. 
 - Working with cell-based or multi-region architectures at scale. 

Additional Information

Have a look at how Nexthink scales to trillions of events per day with Amazon MSK, powers real-time alerts with Amazon Managed Service for Apache Flink, and builds enterprise AI agents with fine-tuned LLMs on Amazon SageMaker. 

We are the pioneers and trailblazers of a global IT Market Category (DEX) that is shaping the future of how the world works, giving our customers' IT Teams total digital visibility across their enterprise. Our innovative solutions integrate real-time analytics, automation, and employee feedback across all endpoints. This enables our IT teams to solve complex technical challenges, create ever more productive workplaces, and deliver happy, satisfied employees in the digital workplace. 

With over 1200 employees across 5 continents, Nexthink operates as One Team, connecting, collaborating and innovating to continuously grow. We call our employees 'Nexthinkers' and our commitment to diversity, inclusion, and equity is second to none. We currently have over 75 nationalities working with us, from all cultures and backgrounds, speaking many different languages

If you are looking for a change and like a nice atmosphere, lots of challenges, and having fun while working, this is a great opportunity for you!

Check what we offer: 

- 💼 Permanent Contract and a competitive compensation package. 
 - 🩺 Health insurance through our partnership with Bajaj, including OPD coverage for dental, vision, health check-ups, consultations, and pharmacy expenses. 
 - 🏡 Hybrid work model balancing office and remote work, with a structured approach for new hires to foster connections and onboarding. 
 - 🏖️ Flexible Hours and unlimited vacation (employees have unlimited paid time off on top of the 22 days of holidays we offer). Plus, company-paid bank holidays (12), sick days (10-30), bereavement leave (5), and 3 days per year for volunteering. 
 - 📚 Free access to professional training platforms to explore your interests and enhance your skills. 
 - 🛡️ Stay covered against accidents, bodily injuries, and disabilities with our personal accident insurance policy, providing assurance with coverage up to three times your annual CTC. 
 - 🍼 New mothers are entitled to up to 26 weeks of maternity leave, with the flexibility to use up to 8 weeks before the expected delivery and the remaining 18 weeks after. Birth fathers can take 6 weeks of paternity leave, while adoptive parents are eligible for 26 weeks of leave for mothers and 6 weeks for fathers. 
 - 💰 Under the Payment of Gratuity Act, receive gratuity at the rate of 15 days of basic pay for every completed year of service, provided you've been employed by the company for a minimum of 5 years. Gratuity is payable at retirement or resignation based on your last drawn basic pay. 
 - 📣 Bonuses for referring successful hires after three months of continuous employment. 

Please note that not all the benefits listed above are available for temporary, contract, and internship roles. To ensure you have the most up-to-date information, we recommend checking with your Recruitment Partner.

About Snapmint

Founded by IIT Bombay alumni (Nalin Agrawal, Anil Gelra, Abhineet Sawa), Snapmint is building India's most loved payment brand. We pioneered Pay in 3 through UPI and are also home to India's leading 0% EMI e-commerce app - giving millions of Indians the freedom to shop now and pay in monthly instalments, with no extra cost and no credit card required. 

Today, Snapmint has crossed 50M+ app downloads and is the preferred payment partner for 2, 000+ leading consumer brands, including Zepto, ixigo, Adani, District Store, Titan and many more. We're on a mission to make fair, transparent credit accessible to Young India - and make payments simple, enjoyable and worry-free. 

Headquartered in Mumbai, with offices across major metros including Bengaluru, Gurugram, Delhi and Jaipur, we're building at the intersection of commerce, credit, technology and culture. If you want to work on a product used by millions, build a brand people genuinely love, and help redefine how the next generation of India pays and spends you'll fit right in. 

Come build Snapmint and help us change how India pays. 

About the Role

We are looking for a SDE 3 / Staff Engineer to build and scale Snapmint's Search & Discovery platform across its e-commerce ecosystem. The role will own search relevance, query understanding, indexing, and ranking systems, enabling fast, personalized, and highly relevant product discovery at scale. 

- Role Title: SDE 3 / Staff Engineer

What You Own

- Own the architecture and evolution of high-scale, low-latency Search & Discovery services, serving millions of search requests with strong reliability and performance. 
 - Build query understanding systems covering spell correction, synonym expansion, transliteration, multilingual search, intent detection, query rewriting, and attribute extraction. 
 - Own near-real-time catalog indexing pipelines to keep search indexes synchronized with catalog, pricing, inventory, and merchant updates.

 - Drive architecture, scalability, observability, performance optimization, and production excellence for the Search platform. 

What You Bring

- 5+ years of experience building scalable backend systems using modern programming languages. 
 - Strong hands-on experience with Elasticsearch, OpenSearch, or Apache Solr. 
 - Deep understanding of Information Retrieval, including inverted indexes, analyzers, tokenization, BM25, faceting, query parsing, indexing, and relevance tuning. 
 - Experience building query understanding systems, including spell correction, synonym expansion, query normalization, transliteration, and attribute extraction. 
 - • Experience designing scalable search APIs and near-real-time indexing pipelines for large product catalogs. 
 - Understanding semantic search, embeddings, and hybrid lexical semantic retrieval. 
 - Experience with Learning-to-Rank or ML-based ranking models in production search systems. 
 - Strong understanding of distributed systems, caching, search performance optimization, and low-latency system design

Good to Have

- Experience building e-commerce or marketplace search systems. 
 - Experience using LLMs for query understanding, query rewriting, or conversational search. 
 - Experience running online experiments and A/B testing to improve search relevance and business metrics. 

Why Snapmint

- Be Part of a 10X-100X Journey - Help build and scale and be part of a high-growth story. 
 - Raise the Bar - Learn from people who raise the bar. 
 - Solve Hard Problems - Work on meaningful, high-impact challenges. 
 - Own the Outcome - Take ownership and make things happen. 
 - Move Fast, Build Fast - Turn ideas into action, not backlogs. 
 - Make Real Impact - See your work reach millions of customers. 
 - Grow with Snapmint - Take on bigger challenges as we scale

data.title: Manager – R&D, Regulatory & Quality (Nutraceuticals)
data.description:
Salary - 7. 5 - 10. 5 LPA

Company: BetterHerbs

Location: Sec 58, Noida

Experience: 5 - 7 Years

Employment: Full-time

BetterHerbs is a fast-growing D2C wellness brand building clean, science-backed nutrition products for kids and mothers. Trusted by 2, 50, 000+ customers across India, our portfolio spans pregnancy nutrition, lactation, child development, focus, and hormonal wellness. We combine Ayurvedic wisdom with modern nutritional science to create products designed for the modern Indian family. 

We are looking for a hands-on R&D, Regulatory & Quality Manager who can take ownership of products from idea → formulation → manufacturer → compliance → quality → commercial launch. 

Key Responsibilities

1. Product R&D & New Product Development

- Work on new nutraceutical, functional nutrition and Ayurvedic product formulations. 

- Convert product briefs into technically feasible and commercially viable formulations. 

- Research ingredients, dosage levels, bioavailability, safety and scientific evidence. 

- Evaluate proteins, vitamins, minerals, herbal extracts, DHA, probiotics and other functional ingredients. 

- Coordinate formulation trials, sampling, flavour/taste optimization and pilot batches with manufacturers. 

- Review and improve existing formulations for efficacy, ingredient quality, taste, cost and clean-label positioning. 

- Coordinate stability and shelf-life studies and ensure products meet specifications throughout shelf life. 

2. FSSAI & Regulatory Compliance

- Ensure formulations comply with applicable FSSAI regulations, permitted ingredients and dosage/RDA requirements. 

- Review product labels, ingredient lists, nutritional information, warnings and mandatory declarations. 

- Review product claims, website communication, packaging and marketing claims from a regulatory perspective. 

- Maintain regulatory documentation and product dossiers for all SKUs. 

- Track changes in FSSAI regulations and proactively highlight risks or required changes. 

- Coordinate with regulatory consultants/labs/manufacturers wherever required. 

3. Quality Assurance & QC

- Define and review specifications for raw materials and finished products. 

- Review COAs, microbiological reports, heavy-metal reports and other relevant test reports. 

- Develop product-wise testing protocols and ensure periodic testing through NABL/FSSAI-recognised laboratories where applicable. 

- Investigate quality complaints, batch deviations and product inconsistencies and drive corrective/preventive actions. 

- Maintain batch-wise quality documentation and ensure consistency across production batches. 

- Conduct/coordinate manufacturer and supplier quality audits. 

4. Manufacturer & Vendor Management

- Identify and evaluate suitable third-party manufacturers and ingredient suppliers. 

- Evaluate vendors on quality, technical capability, compliance, pricing and scalability. 

- Coordinate trials, quotations, MOQ negotiations, commercial batches and production timelines. 

- Maintain ingredient/vendor specifications and qualification documentation. 

- Work closely with manufacturers to resolve formulation, production and quality issues. 

- Develop alternate vendors for critical ingredients and products to reduce supply risk. 

5. Product Commercialisation

Own the technical side of the complete launch cycle: 

Product Brief → Ingredient Research → Formulation → Costing → Sampling → Stability/Testing → FSSAI Compliance → Packaging Review → Pilot Batch → Commercial Production → QC Release

Work closely with Founders, Marketing, Operations, Procurement, Designers and Manufacturing Partners to launch products within agreed timelines. 

Ideal Candidate

- B. Tech/M. Tech Food Technology / M. Sc Food Science, Nutrition, Biotechnology / B. Pharma/M. Pharma or related discipline. 

- 5-7 years of relevant experience in nutraceuticals, dietary supplements, functional foods or nutrition products. 

- Strong practical understanding of FSSAI nutraceutical/health supplement regulations, labelling and claims. 

- Hands-on exposure to product formulation and third-party/contract manufacturing. 

- Understanding of raw-material specifications, COAs, stability studies and finished-product testing. 

- Experience dealing with ingredient suppliers, laboratories and manufacturers. 

- Strong documentation, analytical and project-management skills. 

Preferred

Experience working with products such as: 

Protein powders | Vitamins & Minerals | Kids Nutrition | Pregnancy/Lactation Nutrition | Herbal/Ayurvedic Supplements | Drops/Liquids | Gummies | Probiotics

What We're Looking For

We don't need someone who only coordinates with vendors. 

We want a person who can question a formulation, understand the science behind ingredients, identify regulatory risks, challenge manufacturers on quality and independently drive a product from concept to commercial production.

data.title: Engineering Director
data.description:
Dezerv's next chapter runs on AI, data, and architecture that can scale with us and the person who leads that build will shape what this platform becomes. 

Engineering here isn't executing a roadmap someone else wrote. It's deciding what gets built, what gets killed, and where AI actually changes the game for a platform handling sensitive financial data at real scale. 

About Dezerv

Dezerv is a house of investing solutions for India's high-net-worth and affluent families, co-founded by Sandeep Jethwani, Vaibhav Porwal, and Sahil Contractor who between them have run over USD 7 billion in assets across JP Morgan, UBS, and BNP Paribas. We're backed by Premji Invest, Accel, Elevation, and Matrix, and our clients have trusted us with over ₹17, 000+ crore of their wealth. 

Investing is stressful. Building wealth is slow and unforgiving. We're building the platform that fixes that deep investment expertise, paired with technology, minus the cost and anxiety of a traditional advisory relationship. We've grown fast because we're genuinely good at this, transparent on fees, and modern in how we build. 

What are we trying to solve/mission?

We are passionate about helping Indians invest better. We manage investments with active oversight to help both sophisticated and new investors build long-term wealth across various market conditions. 

About the Role

We're looking for a Senior Engineering Manager to lead independently across ambiguous business and technology domains at a pivotal moment for Dezerv. This is a Business Partner level role: you'll own the strategic direction of an entire business or multiple businesses irrespective of product boundaries, managing multiple teams or a significantly large single team - of senior engineers and the managers who lead them. 

Our roadmap ahead is ambitious scaling core platform capabilities, deepening our data and decisioning infrastructure, and embedding AI into how we build and how our product works. You'll set that direction, not just execute against it, partnering with founders and department heads to shape what Dezerv's platform becomes next. 

What You'll Own

Team Leadership & People Growth

- Manage multiple teams (or a significantly large single team) spanning multiple job families, composed of senior engineers (SDE-3 and Tech Leads) and the engineering managers who lead them
 - Grow senior engineers into principal engineers consistently, and develop engineering managers into independent leaders creating new opportunities and areas for your most senior people to grow further
 - Hire senior and principal engineers independently, and build the team structures, communication channels, and accountability mechanisms that bring predictability to execution across the organisation
 - Instill a culture of high ownership, technical rigor, innovation, and intellectual honesty about tradeoffs where teams take calculated risks without fearing failure. 
 - Build structured feedback loops, development plans, and career paths that help engineers grow, not just deliver. 

Technical & Business Direction

- Own the overall business vision and annual (1-year+) roadmap in partnership with business, product, and design and drive the decisions required to achieve it independently, even where the business opportunity and architectural strategy are both unknown
 - Understand the strategic importance of technology to the business and influence larger priorities and trade-offs build vs. buy vs. outsource vs. AI-assisted and decide the future of a product or architecture (improve, invent, deprecate, simplify)
 - Champion the responsible adoption of AI across the engineering org from AI-assisted development workflows (code generation, review, testing) to evaluating where LLMs and agentic systems can meaningfully improve our product and internal tooling
 - Define aspirational goals for the operational state of the overall architecture, and enable teams to create and evolve architectures independently
 - Spot opportunities and bottlenecks in architecture and team structures, and drive best practices across the organisation
 - Dive deep into code when it matters debugging, reviewing critical paths, unblocking engineers on hard problems while maintaining high standards for system design, performance, observability, and reliability across a fintech-grade platform handling sensitive financial data. 

Execution & Influence

- Establish the team structures, communication channels, tracking, and accountability mechanisms that bring predictability to execution across the organisation. 
 - Identify large risks and opportunities, unlock customer value, and influence other teams to collaborate with yours to solve for them. 
 - Demonstrate high judgement on high-cost, high-risk decisions, finding two-way-door approaches that let the organisation innovate and move forward. 
 - Drive strategic communication between senior leadership across the organisation irrespective of team or function boundaries and lead external communication with partners, vendors, and beyond. 
 - Consistently reduce the cost and effort spent on products and business areas already built and in operation
 - Bring a data-driven lens to engineering decisions, using AI-powered tooling to increase team velocity and code quality without compromising rigor. 
 - Partner closely with product managers to shape problem statements, not just execute solutions, ensuring engineering output translates directly into business outcomes and a better client experience. 

What We're Looking For

- 12+ years of total software engineering experience, with 5+ years managing teams of 20+ engineers spanning multiple teams led by multiple engineering managers. 
 - A track record of leading independently in ambiguous business and technology domains, owning strategic direction across an entire business not a single product. 
 - Demonstrated ability to grow senior engineers into principal-level talent and to develop other engineering managers. 
 - Strong technical depth in one or more of: distributed systems, backend architectures, API design, data infrastructure with the ability to simplify and evolve architecture across multiple systems for scale, performance, and reduced maintenance
 - Proven high judgement on high-cost, high-risk decisions, including buy vs. build vs. outsource trade-offs and decisions on the future of products and architectures. 
 - Hands-on experience integrating AI/LLM-based tools into engineering workflows or product surfaces you understand both the potential and the limits
 - Experience shipping products at scale in fast-paced, high-growth tech organizations (fintech preferred). 
 - Strong communication skills and the ability to align and influence cross- functional stakeholders including founders, department heads, and external partners. 
 - A builder's mindset pragmatic, comfortable with complete ambiguity, and genuinely curious about where new - age tech is headed in software engineering. 

Why Dezerv

- Shape the technology behind an industry-defining investing platform, at a stage where your architectural and AI adoption decisions will compound. 
 - Own the strategic direction of an entire business with real autonomy to decide the future of major products and architectures. 
 - Work alongside an ambitious, high-calibre engineering, product, and design team and directly with founders who've built and scaled before. 
 - A fast-paced, learning-driven culture that rewards initiative, technical excellence, and genuine curiosity about what's next.

data.title: QA Engineer Quality, Compliance & Security
data.description:
Kuvaka Tech · Indore (on-site) · Full-time · ₹3-4. 5 LPA · 1-2 years · Immediate Joiners Preferred

What We're Building

Kuvaka Tech builds AI software for healthcare in India, for hospitals, clinics and public health programmes. 

Much of the work in an Indian hospital still happens on paper, from memory or over the phone. Patientsqueue to register and repeat their symptoms at every desk. Doctors write notes after the consultation. 

Insurance claims get rejected because the record is incomplete, and patient calls go unanswered. 

We build the products that take this work off doctors and hospital staff: AI that takes a patient's history, documents consultations and surgeries, prepares medical coding and insurance claims, and handles patient calls and follow-ups, along with a complete hospital management system that also connects to the software hospitals already use. Everything works by voice, in the languages doctors and patients actually speak, so a patient who can't read can use it as easily as a specialist in a metro hospital. 

The Role

You'll own quality, compliance and security across the whole platform. In healthcare, a bug can mean a wrong medical record or exposed patient data, so you decide when something is ready to ship. 

How We Work

• We work in pods. Each pod has a Forward Deployed Engineer who owns the product and a Founder's Office member who acts as delivery manager. 

• QA is a shared team across all pods, so you test what every pod builds. 

• You plan testing around each pod's release timelines and set priorities when several pods ship at once. 

• Developers test their own code first. You go deeper. 

What You'll Own

• Testing: write test plans and cases, run manual and regression testing before every release, and

sign off releases. 

• Automation: build and maintain automated tests for web, mobile and APIs (Playwright or Selenium, Appium, Postman or similar). 

• Voice AI testing: check accuracy across Indian languages, accents and noisy settings, and verify

that records match what was actually said. 

• Load and performance testing: find what breaks when a busy hospital uses the platform at once

(JMeter, k6 or Locust). 

• UAT: prepare UAT scripts, run UAT with the pod's delivery manager, and track sign-off. 

• Compliance: keep the platform aligned with the DPDP Act 2023 and ABDM standards (consent, 

data retention, access logs), check automated calling against TRAI rules (DLT, DND, calling hours), and maintain audit evidence. 

• Security: test against the OWASP Top 10, run basic VAPT, check access control and secrets handling, and coordinate external security audits. 

• Bug tracking: write clear reports and follow every issue through to a verified fix. 

You'll Fit If You

• Have 1-2 years of experience in software testing. 

• Have written automated tests in Python or JavaScript and tested APIs with Postman or similar. 

• Understand the OWASP Top 10 and have done some hands-on security testing. 

• Can read a regulation like the DPDP Act and turn it into a practical checklist. 

• Write bug reports a developer can act on without asking you a question. 

• Live in Indore or are open to relocating.

data.title: Resiliency Test Engineer
data.description:
Are you ready to make an impact at DTCC?

Do you want to work on innovative projects, collaborate with a dynamic and supportive team, and receive investment in your professional development? At DTCC, we are at the forefront of innovation in the financial markets. We are committed to helping our employees grow and succeed. We believe that you have the skills and drive to make a real impact. We foster a thriving internal community and are committed to creating a workplace that looks like the world that we serve. 

The Information Technology group delivers secure, reliable technology solutions that enable DTCC to be the trusted infrastructure of the global capital markets. The team delivers high-quality information through activities that include development of essential, building infrastructure capabilities to meet client needs and implementing data standards and governance. 

Pay And Benefits

- Competitive compensation, including base pay and annual incentive
 - Comprehensive health and life insurance and well-being benefits, based on location
 - Pension / Retirement benefits
 - Paid Time Off and Personal/Family Care, and other leaves of absence when needed to support your physical, financial, and emotional well-being. 
 - DTCC offers a flexible/hybrid model of 3 days onsite and 2 days remote (onsite Tuesdays, Wednesdays and a third day unique to each team or employee). 

The Impact You Will Have In This Role

The Enterprise Test Engineering ("ETE") family is responsible for ensuring that all applications and systems meet defined quality standards. The ETE family encompasses three major areas including (a) functional testing, (b) non-functional testing, and (c) test architecture and enablement. Other key focuses include: regression testing, browser testing, performance testing, capacity and stress testing, resiliency testing, environment management services, and infrastructure testing. Develops, conducts, and evaluates testing processes, working closely with developers to remediate identified system defects. In-depth knowledge of automated testing tools, and quality control and assurance approaches including the creation of reusable foundational test automation framework for the entire organization. The Resiliency Test Engineering role is responsible for the validation of non-functional requirements for resiliency testing. 

Your Primary Responsibilities

- Deepen understanding of the DTCC Software Delivery Process and proactively identify opportunities for improvement within assigned responsibilities. 
 - Execute performance test scenarios based on user stories, requirements, and application architecture. 
 - Develop, maintain, and enhance performance test scripts using Apache JMeter and other automation frameworks. 
 - Design and implement test automation solutions to support performance, scalability, and resiliency validation. 
 - Create and maintain Jenkins CI/CD pipelines to automate performance test execution, reporting, and continuous validation. 
 - Develop and maintain Groovy-based Jenkins pipeline scripts for test orchestration and automation workflows. 
 - Execute and manage performance tests using BlazeMeter, including test scheduling, execution, analysis, and reporting. 
 - Analyze test results, identify performance bottlenecks, and provide actionable recommendations to development and engineering teams. 
 - Track execution of performance test scenarios and communicate findings, risks, and recommendations to stakeholders. 
 - Build knowledge of Delivery Pipeline components and recommend enhancements to improve automation, efficiency, and reliability. 
 - Develop a strong understanding of the products, applications, and business processes being delivered. 
 - Follow DTCC performance engineering standards, policies, and procedures in day-to-day activities. 
 - Demonstrate strong technical ability to develop scripts, write code, and automate testing processes. 
 - Align risk and control processes with daily responsibilities to monitor, mitigate, and appropriately escalate risk. 

Qualifications

- Minimum of 2 years of experience in Performance Engineering, Test Automation, Software Development, or a related field. 
 - Bachelor's degree preferred or equivalent practical experience. 
 - Hands-on experience developing and executing performance tests using Apache JMeter. 
 - Experience using BlazeMeter for performance test management, execution, reporting, and analysis. 
 - Experience building and maintaining Jenkins CI/CD pipelines. 
 - Experience developing automation solutions using Groovy scripting. 
 - Strong programming experience in Java and object-oriented design principles. 
 - Experience with Python for automation, test engineering, scripting, and data processing. 
 - Familiarity with source control tools such as Git/Bitbucket. 
 - Understanding of Agile, DevOps, CI/CD, and Continuous Testing practices. 

Talents Needed for Success

- Strong collaboration skills and ability to work effectively within and across teams. 
 - Excellent verbal and written communication skills. 
 - Ability to review deliverables and ensure quality, accuracy, and adherence to standards. 
 - Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. 
 - Experience with Java development, including APIs, multithreading, Spring Boot, and enterprise application frameworks. 
 - Experience developing and maintaining Groovy scripts for Jenkins pipeline automation. 
 - Experience integrating JMeter and BlazeMeter within CI/CD pipelines. 
 - Experience with Python development for automation and tooling. 
 - Experience with React development, including building and maintaining modern web-based applications and dashboards. 
 - Ability to troubleshoot application and performance issues using logs, metrics, and monitoring tools. 
 - Understanding of performance engineering concepts including: - Load Testing
 - Stress Testing
 - Endurance/Soak Testing
 - Scalability Testing
 - Capacity Planning
 - Performance Tuning
 - Bottleneck Analysis

Preferred Skills

- Experience working with enterprise-scale distributed systems and cloud-based applications. 
 - Knowledge of observability and monitoring tools such as Grafana, Splunk, Dynatrace, AppDynamics, or similar platforms. 
 - Experience supporting high-volume transactional applications in financial services environments. 
 - Familiarity with resiliency testing, failure mode analysis, and non-functional requirements (NFR) validation

Actual salary is determined based on the role, location, individual experience, skills, and other considerations. We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.

Job Description

Spclst , Process Automation. 

The Opportunity

- Based in Hyderabad, join a global healthcare biopharma company and be part of a 130- year legacy of success backed by ethical integrity, forward momentum, and an inspiring mission to achieve new milestones in global healthcare. 
 - Be part of an organisation driven by digital technology and data-backed approaches that support a diversified portfolio of prescription medicines, vaccines, and animal health products. 
 - Drive innovation and execution excellence. Be a part of a team with passion for using data, analytics, and insights to drive decision-making, and which creates custom software, allowing us to tackle some of the world's greatest health threats. 

Our Technology Centers focus on creating a space where teams can come together to deliver business solutions that save and improve lives. An integral part of our company's IT operating model, Tech Centers are globally distributed locations where each IT division has employees to enable our digital transformation journey and drive business outcomes. These locations, in addition to the other sites, are essential to supporting our business and strategy. 

A focused group of leaders in each Tech Center helps to ensure we can manage and improve each location, from investing in growth, success, and well-being of our people, to making sure colleagues from each IT division feel a sense of belonging to managing critical emergencies. And together, we must leverage the strength of our team to collaborate globally to optimize connections and share best practices across the Tech Centers. 

Role Overview

This position requires a technical specialist who owns the Distributed Control System (DCS) lifecycle and understands the complexities of biopharmaceutical manufacturing. The ideal candidate possesses deep hands-on expertise with Siemens PCS7 batch architecture, PLC/SCADA systems, and GAMP 5 Computer System Validation (CSV). 

Unlike traditional IT or generic industrial automation roles, the Process Automation Specialist must seamlessly bridge the gap between process engineering, quality control, and automated software workflows, ensuring continuous compliant operation of clinical and commercial manufacturing lines. 

What Will You Do In This Role

- Automation System Ownership
 - Oversee the daily operation, continuous maintenance, and system lifecycle of Siemens PCS7, PLCs, and SCADA platforms across GMP manufacturing suites. 
 - Manage hardware and software upgrades, patches, and system expansion to support changing manufacturing requirements. 
 - Maintain system backups, disaster recovery protocols, and business continuity planning for all plant floor automation assets. 
 - Team Leadership & Development
 - Lead, mentor, and develop a high-performing team of automation engineers, system administrators, and third-party system integrators. 
 - Oversee resource scheduling to ensure uninterrupted 24/7 technical and plant floor troubleshooting support for active GMP manufacturing campaigns. 
 - Establish career development pathways, clear performance expectations, and technical training programs for team members. 
 - CapEx & Technology Transfer
 - Direct the automation engineering scope for capital expenditure (CapEx) projects, facility expansions, and facility debottlenecking. 
 - Lead automation activities for New Product Introductions (NPI), collaborating with MS&T (Manufacturing Science & Technology) to configure process control recipes, phase classes, and unit operations. 
 - Manage automation vendors and system integrators from initial User Requirement Specifications (URS) through Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT) and Site Acceptance Testing (SAT). 
 - Regulatory Compliance & Computer System Validation (CSV)
 - Enforce data integrity policies across all OT (Operational Technology) systems aligned with 21 CFR Part 11, EudraLex Annex 11, and ALCOA+ principles. 
 - Author, review, and approve validation lifecycle deliverables, including URS, Functional Specifications (FS), Design Specifications (DS), Risk Assessments, and IQ/OQ/PQ protocols. 
 - Maintain computerized systems in an audit-ready state, acting as the primary Automation Subject Matter Expert (SME) during internal audits and regulatory agency inspections (FDA, EMA, etc. ). 
 - Deviation & CAPA Resolution
 - Lead complex technical investigations for automation-related deviations and process upsets. 
 - Use systematic root-cause analysis methodologies to identify underlying issues and implement robust Corrective and Preventive Actions (CAPAs) to prevent recurrence. 
 - Manage automation-related change control processes to ensure modifications are assessed, tested, validated, and documented prior to deployment. 
 - Digital Plant Initiatives
 - Drive integration projects bridging plant floor control layers (Level 1/2) with Level 3 systems, such as Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES) (Syncade, Werum PAS-X) and enterprise data historians (OSIsoft PI). 
 - Support automated batch record release initiatives by optimizing data flow between control systems and MES. 

What You Should Have

Educational Background

- Minimum Requirement B Tech in Electrical/Instrument Engineering, Bioengineering, Computer Science, or a related technical discipline. 
 - Preferred M. S. in Engineering or a related technical discipline. 

Professional Experience

- Experience 5+ years of hands-on process automation experience in a cGMP biopharmaceutical manufacturing environment. 

Technical & Bioprocess Acumen

- Strong understanding of biological unit operations, including mammalian cell culture bioreactors, fermentation, Tangential Flow Filtration (TFF) skids, chromatography purification columns, Clean-In-Place (CIP/SIP) systems, and Water-for-Injection (WFI) utility networks. 
 - Deep knowledge of configuring and troubleshooting automated process control loops, fieldbus protocols (Profibus, Foundation Fieldbus, DeviceNet, Modbus TCP), and industrial network switches.

Biotechnology

We are known as Merck & Co. , Inc. , Rahway, New Jersey, USA in the United States and Canada and MSD everywhere else. For more than a century, we have been bringing forward medicines and vaccines for many of the world's most challenging diseases. Today, our company continues to be at the forefront of research to deliver innovative health solutions and advance the prevention and treatment of diseases that threaten people and animals around the world. 

What We Look For

Imagine getting up in the morning for a job as important as helping to save and improve lives around the world. Here, you have that opportunity. You can put your empathy, creativity, digital mastery, or scientific genius to work in collaboration with a diverse group of colleagues who pursue and bring hope to countless people who are battling some of the most challenging diseases of our time. data.title: Lead Performance QA Engineer
data.description:
Come work at a place where innovation and teamwork come together to support the most exciting missions in the world!

Performance Engineering Lead

Location: Pune / Hybrid (3 days in office)

Experience: 7+ Years

Employment Type: Full-Time

About The Role

We are looking for an experienced and highly motivated Performance Engineering Lead to drive performance validation, scalability assessment, and performance optimization across a modern cloud-native platform. The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in distributed microservices architectures, Kubernetes environments, messaging systems, APIs, big data workloads, and performance troubleshooting. 

The role requires both hands-on technical excellence and leadership capabilities to plan, execute, analyze, and drive performance initiatives across release cycles while collaborating closely with development, architecture, operations, and customer-facing teams. 

Key Responsibilities

Performance Strategy & Leadership

- Own performance engineering activities across multiple releases and product roadmaps. 
 - Define performance testing scope, objectives, workload models, success criteria, and capacity planning requirements. 
 - Plan, track, and deliver performance testing activities within release timelines. 
 - Provide regular performance status updates, risk assessments, and recommendations to stakeholders. 
 - Mentor and guide performance engineers and establish performance engineering best practices. 
 -

Performance Testing & Engineering

- Design and execute performance, load, stress, endurance, scalability, spike, and capacity tests. 
 - Validate performance of cloud-native applications running on Kubernetes (K8s). 
 - Build realistic workload models that simulate production-scale traffic and customer usage patterns. 
 - Establish performance baselines and continuously improve system scalability and reliability. 

Microservices Performance Analysis

Perform detailed root cause analysis and optimization recommendations for applications leveraging: 

- Kubernetes-based microservices
 - Kafka-based event-driven architectures
 - REST and GraphQL APIs
 - Redis caching layers
 - Oracle databases
 - Elasticsearch clusters
 - Spark-based batch and streaming workloads

Analyze system behavior across: 

- CPU utilization
 - Memory consumption
 - Thread utilization
 - Garbage collection
 - Network latency
 - Resource contention
 - Database bottlenecks
 - Cache efficiency
 - Message processing delays

Kafka & Messaging Performance

- Design and execute load testing for Kafka-based service-to-service messaging systems. 
 - Analyze consumer lag, throughput, partition distribution, batching efficiency, and message processing latency. 
 - Tune Kafka producer, broker, and consumer configurations to optimize performance. 
 - Identify bottlenecks and provide recommendations to engineering teams for scalability improvements. 

API Performance Engineering

- Validate latency, throughput, concurrency, error rates, and service-level objectives (SLOs). 
 - Perform end-to-end performance analysis across distributed API ecosystems. 
 - Identify bottlenecks in service interactions and recommend optimizations. 

Spark Performance Optimization

- Analyze Spark batch and streaming job performance. 
 - Investigate executor utilization, partitioning strategies, shuffle operations, memory management, and query execution plans. 
 - Recommend performance improvements to reduce execution time and infrastructure costs

Performance Diagnostics & Optimization

- Conduct deep-dive investigations into production and pre-production performance issues. 
 - Collaborate with developers to identify root causes and implement fixes. 
 - Review architecture and code changes from a scalability and performance perspective. 
 - Recommend improvements in application design, infrastructure configuration, caching, database queries, and messaging patterns. 

Customer issues: 

- Investigate customer-reported performance and scalability issues. 
 - Reproduce production scenarios and provide actionable recommendations. 
 - Work with support and engineering teams to ensure timely resolution of customer-impacting performance problems. 

Test Data & Automation

- Design and develop scalable test data generation frameworks. 
 - Create automation utilities and performance engineering tools. 
 - Develop scripts and utilities using Python, Java, or similar programming languages to support performance testing and analysis. 

Experience

Required Skills & Qualifications

- 7+ years of experience in Performance Testing and Performance Engineering. 
 - Proven experience leading performance initiatives for enterprise-scale applications. 
 - Strong understanding of distributed systems and cloud-native architectures. 

Technical Expertise

- Kubernetes (K8s) and containerized environments
 - Microservices architecture
 - Apache Kafka
 - API performance testing and diagnostics
 - Redis
 - Oracle Database
 - Elasticsearch
 - Apache Spark
 - Linux system performance analysis

Performance Testing Tools

Experience with one or more: 

- JMeter
 - Gatling
 - LoadRunner
 - k6
 - Locust
 - BlazeMeter

Monitoring & Observability

Hands-on experience with: 

- Grafana
 - Prometheus
 - Kibana
 - Elastic Stack
 - Dynatrace
 - AppDynamics
 - OpenTelemetry

Programming & Automation

Strong scripting/programming experience in: 

- Python
 - Java

data.description:
This is where your work makes a difference. 

At Baxter, we believe every person-regardless of who they are or where they are from-deserves a chance to live a healthy life. It was our founding belief in 1931 and continues to be our guiding principle. We are redefining healthcare delivery to make a greater impact today, tomorrow, and beyond. 

Our Baxter colleagues are united by our Mission to Save and Sustain Lives. Together, our community is driven by a culture of courage, trust, and collaboration. Every individual is empowered to take ownership and make a meaningful impact. We strive for efficient and effective operations, and we hold each other accountable for delivering exceptional results. 

Here, you will find more than just a job-you will find purpose and pride. 

We are seeking a Principal Automation Engineer to define automation architecture, technical roadmaps, and engineering standards for API, UI, integration, and end-to-end testing. The ideal candidate is a systems-oriented Quality Engineer who understands how products and services interconnect, sees the broader product architecture, and can decompose requirements to capture use cases holistically. This hands-on role will lead the development of scalable C#/. NET frameworks, establish CI/CD quality gates, guide cross-team adoption, and resolve complex automation and testability challenges across distributed products. 

What You'll Be Doing

- Own the enterprise-grade automation architecture and roadmap for C#-based REST API, UI, integration, and workflow testing. 
 - Design modular frameworks with reusable libraries for configuration, service clients, page or component objects, test data, parallel execution, retries, logging, reporting, and environment management. 
 - Define coding standards, branching and review practices, framework governance, versioning, documentation, and contribution models. 
 - Establish pipeline strategy for pull-request validation, daily smoke tests, staged regression, release qualification, and automated quality gates. 
 - Guide teams on automation suitability, testability, coverage modelling, risk-based selection, and reduction of flaky or low-value tests. 
 - Lead technical reviews, proofs of concept, framework migrations, tool evaluations, and resolution of complex cross-service failures. 
 - Define dashboards and metrics for coverage, reliability, execution time, defect containment, failure causes, and productivity gains. 
 - Partner with architecture, software, DevOps, cybersecurity, systems, and verification leaders to embed quality throughout delivery. 
 - Mentor automation engineers and build engineering capability through reusable assets, coaching, and technical communities of practice. 

What You'll Bring

- B. E. /B. Tech in Computer Science, Electronics & Communication, Electrical Engineering, or a related field. 
 - 10 years of experience defining automation architecture, technical roadmaps, and engineering standards for API, UI, integration, and end-to-end testing. 
 - Mandatory: Systems-oriented Quality Engineer with a strong understanding of how products, services, and components interconnect; able to see the broader product architecture and decompose requirements to capture use cases holistically. 
 - Mandatory: Hands-on Automation Architect with advanced C# and . NET skills and a strong understanding of software design principles, dependency injection, concurrency, asynchronous execution, and extensible architecture. 
 - Mandatory: Hands-on experience architecting and developing REST API automation frameworks using RestSharp. 
 - Mandatory: Strong hands-on experience with NUnit or Selenium or playwright for test automation. 
 - Mandatory: Working knowledge of GraphQL (GQL) and experience validating GraphQL APIs. 
 - Mandatory: Solid understanding of test data management principles, strategies, and reusable data provisioning approaches. 
 - Mandatory: Strong awareness of Kubernetes and containerized test environments. 
 - Good understanding of communication protocols, particularly SIP, and hands-on exposure to SIPp for protocol-level testing. 
 - Expertise in API contracts, distributed systems, microservices, event-driven integrations, databases, authentication, authorization, and service virtualization. 
 - Deep experience with Git, CI/CD architecture, parallel execution, automated reporting, and quality gates. 
 - Proven ability to improve framework reliability, diagnose flaky tests, optimize execution, and drive adoption across multiple teams. 
 - Strong technical leadership, stakeholder communication, mentoring, and architecture decision-making skills. 

Preferred Skills

- Experience with Allure reporting is preferred. 
 - Experience with Postman is good to have. 
 - Experience with Azure, Docker, infrastructure-as-code, message brokers, observability platforms, and cloud-native test environments. 
 - Experience validating healthcare platforms, HL7/FHIR integrations, connected devices, or regulated software products. 
 - Knowledge of security, accessibility, performance, reliability, and resilience testing within a unified automation strategy. 
 - Relevant Microsoft, cloud, architecture, or testing certification is advantageous. 
 - Knowledge of SIP infrastructure and media components such as Kamailio, FreeSWITCH, RTPEngine, SBCs, registrars, RTP, and WebRTC. 
 - Experience with Azure Key Vault, Azure App Configuration, Azure Cache for Redis, Azure Web PubSub, Terraform, KEDA, and container security tooling. 
 - Familiarity with IEC 62304, ISO 13485, risk management, cybersecurity expectations, and quality systems for regulated healthcare software. 
 - Experience with Jira, Jama, validated toolchains, Agile/Scrum delivery, and formal release-readiness reviews. 
 - Experience leading a team of automation testers toward a common goal. 

Equal Employment Opportunity

Baxter is an equal opportunity employer. Baxter evaluates qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, gender, national origin, age, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, protected veteran status, disability/handicap status or any other legally protected characteristic. 

Reasonable Accommodations

Baxter is committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities globally. If, because of a medical condition or disability, you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the application or interview process, please click on the link here and let us know the nature of your request along with your contact information. 

Recruitment Fraud Notice

Baxter has discovered incidents of employment scams, where fraudulent parties pose as Baxter employees, recruiters, or other agents, and engage with online job seekers in an attempt to steal personal and/or financial information. To learn how you can protect yourself, review our Recruitment Fraud Notice.

data.title: QA Engineer II
data.description:
Toast Overview: 

Toast is a rapidly growing SAAS product company building the first all-in-one restaurant management software platform. Toast's Android tablet based system helps restaurants operate more efficiently and connect with their customer base in new and innovative ways. We're growing fast and have a customer base comprised of cafes, restaurants, bars and nightclubs across the country. We work hard and care about our customers' success and we have a lot of fun doing it. As a company, we move fast and have a lot of opportunities for career growth, so if you're passionate about your work and want to be in a fun and growing industry, join us! You will be helping Toast to grow our business internationally. 

Bready to make a change?

We're not your traditional tech company and we don't aim to be. Going against the grain is in our DNA. Building a revolutionary product begins with revolutionary thinking. That's why we value diversity of thought, background and lived experience. Together, we empower restaurants of all sizes to build great teams, increase revenue, improve operations, and delight their guests. We pair our deep understanding of the restaurant industry with powerful cloud based software and restaurant-grade hardware to deliver an intuitive all-in-one platform. Join us on our mission to empower the restaurant community to delight guests, do what they love, and thrive. 

We are Toasters

Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion is Baked into our Recipe for Success. At Toast our employees are our secret ingredient. When they are powered to succeed, Toast succeeds. 

The restaurant industry is one of the most diverse industries. We embrace and are excited by this diversity, believing that only through authenticity, inclusivity, high standards of respect and trust, and leading with humility will we be able to achieve our goals. 

Baking inclusive principles into our company and diversity into our design provides equitable opportunities for all and enhances our ability to be first in class in all aspects of our industry. Toast is named as One of the Best Places to Work in 2024 by Glassdoor. 

Are you bready* for a change?

Toast is scaling rapidly and with that growth comes an exciting new opportunity to join one of our earliest and impactful lines of business in Bangalore. Toast is looking for a Quality Assurance Engineer to join its team focused on building impactful capabilities that empower restaurants to drive Guest engagement, retention and growth. The team will help shape the future of how restaurants use technology to connect with their guests - increasingly through AI-powered tools and experiences that drive automation, personalization and smarter decision-making. You will be a key part of a high-impact, high-ownership engineering team solving complex challenges in a fast-moving product space. 

You will enable restaurants by playing a critical role in testing features in this domain. The Toast platform processes tens of millions of requests per day, and this number grows constantly as we add new locations , integrations , partners to our ecosystem and expand to new geographies. You will be one of the impactful technologists , accountable for business growth in the Guest integration team. This is a mission-critical system on which our restaurants rely for their livelihood, so Quality , Reliability and Scalability are paramount. 

About this roll*: 

As a QA-II on our team, you will be: 

- Collaborating with Product , Design(UI) and Development stakeholders to understand the requirements. 
 - Creating and implementing comprehensive test plans. 
 - Conducting and participating in test plan and test strategy reviews. 
 - Testing new features and regressions across our suite of hardware and software products. 
 - Create defects for requirement deviations, assign priority and severity and escalate if needed. 
 - Collaborating and assisting the project teams to triage and reproduction of defects, debugging of customer issues, validate fixes and attending sprint ceremonies. 
 - Work with other QA engineers and developers to adapt a test automation strategy. 
 - Increase Automation test case coverage by developing reusable scripts, brining test efficiency by using automation for release testing. 
 - Actively contribute towards product design and roadmap discussions by pitching ideas from a quality perspective. 
 - Keeping current with tools such as Jira, Confluence, TestRail, automation products etc. 

Do you have the right ingredients*?

- 4+ years of experience in Quality Assurance. 
 - Ability to learn and understand complex business logic and find creative ways to test it. 
 - Design and deliver test plans for a significant component, set of features, mid-size application, or service. 
 - Have a solid understanding of the test strategies and methodologies used in your technology domain (and how to best apply them). Example API testing using postman, Web Application testing (Desktop, Toast Hardware and Mobile Apps), Automated testing using Selenium , Playwright etc. 
 - Possess an appetite for automation and are aware of automation frameworks, methodologies & tools
 - Your test plan, scripts and test case reviews tend to be rapid and uneventful. You provide useful feedback for changes submitted by others. 
 - Your automation test scripts are maintainable and reusable, identify bugs and do not produce false positives. 
 - You make improvements to your team's testing processes and question the defined set of tests. 
 - You have established good working relationships with team members and peers working on related software. 
 - Commitment to quality, user experience, and using your "get unblocked" attitude for continuous learning and problem solving. 
 - Ability to thrive in a dynamic environment. 

Special Sauce* (Extra Ingredients)

- Strong familiarity with Test Automation frameworks for backend and frontend tech stacks. 
 - Understanding and hands on experience with testing of Fintech, Payments Products and services. 

Our Tech Stack

Toast's products run on a stack that ranges from Guest and restaurant-facing Android tablets to backend services in Java to internal, guest-facing and restaurant-facing web apps(Single Page Applications). Our backend services follow a microservice architecture written using Java 8 and DropWizard. Many of our services use REST and GraphQL architectures. We use AWS extensively, ranging from S3 to RDS to Lambda. We have our own platform for dealing with user management, service elevations and robust load balancing. Toast stores data in a set of sharded Postgres databases and utilizes Apache Spark for large scale data workloads including query and batch processing. The front-end is built primarily using React and ES6. The main Toast POS application is an Android application written in Java and Kotlin. For data between tablets and our cloud platform we operate RabbitMQ clusters as well as direct tablet communication to the back end. 

What You'll Need To Thrive (Requirements)

AI at Toast

At Toast, one of our company values is that we're hungry to build and learn. We believe learning new AI tools empowers us to build for our customers faster, more independently, and with higher quality. We provide these tools across all disciplines, from Engineering and Product to Sales and Support, and are inspired by how our Toasters are already driving real value with them. The people who thrive here are those who embrace changes that let us build more for our customers; it's a core part of our culture. 

Our Total Rewards Philosophy

We strive to provide competitive compensation and benefits programs that help to attract, retain, and motivate the best and brightest people in our industry. Our total rewards package goes beyond great earnings potential and provides the means to a healthy lifestyle with the flexibility to meet Toasters' changing needs. Learn more about our benefits at https: //careers. toasttab. com/toast-benefits. 

How Toast Uses AI In Its Hiring Process

Throughout the hiring process, our goal is to get to know you. We use AI tools to support our recruiters and interviewers with tasks like note-taking, summarization, and documentation of interviews to ensure they can be fully focused on your conversation. All hiring decisions are made by people. We ask that you complete interviews and assessments on your own, without real-time AI tools, recording, or transcription bots, unless we tell you otherwise in advance. To learn more: https: //careers. toasttab. com/ai-in-hiring

Our Approach to Hybrid Working

We embrace a hybrid work model that fosters in-person collaboration while valuing individual needs. Our goal is to build a strong culture of connection as we work together to empower the hospitality community, regardless of location. Please visit the Locations page on our career site to learn more about our in-office expectations by region: https: //careers. toasttab. com/locations-toast

data.title: Senior Core Infrastructure Engineer
data.description:
Job Description

Designs, implements, and optimizes components in distributed systems with an emphasis on scalability, resiliency, and operability. Delivers features and load/performance tests; leverages data plane platforms and distributed state tools for high-volume retrieval, storage, and processing; and reviews peers' implementations for scalability compliance. Builds fault-tolerant paths (redundancy, replication, automatic failover), applies recovery‐oriented principles, and implements retries, circuit breakers, and timeouts. Proactively detects and mitigates issues via tests, alarms, dashboards, and telemetry; authors runbooks and participates in incident response and RCAs. Implements standard replication and synchronization, develops automation/IaC for troubleshooting and maintenance, and applies advanced security controls (encryption, access, remediation) while ensuring change, compliance, and documentation standards are met. 

Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

System Design & Architecture - System Scalability: 

-Implements and contributes to the development for components of distributed systems that support horizontal and vertical scaling including leveraging distributed state management tools. 

-Optimizes code and/or systems for large-scale data processing in large-scale systems. 

-Implements scalability requirements for assigned components and reviews implementation of team members. 

-Leverages components of data plane platforms to handle large-scale data retrieval, storage, and processing. 

-Implements performance and load testing. 

System Design & Architecture - System Reliability Design: 

-Collaborates with team to build fault-tolerant components capable of withstanding in-service updates by implementing redundancy, replication, and automatic failover mechanisms. 

-Applies recovery oriented computing principles to design components that effectively handle service disruptions. 

-Implements retry mechanisms, circuit breakers, and timeouts to help handle network unreliability. 

System Design & Architecture - System Reliability Performance: 

-Implements tests and alarm configurations to proactively detect and address issues/failures. 

-Supports efforts to recover from failures by drafting and executing runbooks and operational procedures. 

-Builds and customizes dashboards, telemetry systems, and alerting mechanisms to monitor component health. 

System Design & Architecture - Correctness / Availability: 

-Designs and implements functional requirements and testing for assigned features within an existing system. 

-Implements tests scenarios (e. g. , fault-injection, brown-out) to evaluate system correctness. 

-Implements standard data replication and synchronization techniques to maintain data integrity and availability. 

Operational Troubleshooting & Incident Management: 

-Diagnoses, debugs, and resolves issues in system components to support ongoing operation. 

-Implements basic strategies to prevent interruptions, ensuring no maintenance windows are required for customers and users when resolving issues. 

-Designs and implements automation scripts and tooling used to troubleshoot operational issues. 

-Participates in operational support rotations, assisting in incident responses and root cause investigations. 

Compliance & Security: 

-Applies advanced security measures to protect data and applications in multi-tenant environments, including encryption and access controls. 

-Implements remediation plans to continuously improve security. 

-Collaborates with the team to ensure cloud infrastructure complies with relevant industry standards and regulations and that documentation is up-to-date

Automation & Change Management: 

-Maintains automation scripts and tools (e. g. , Infrastructure as Code (IaC)) for managing cloud infrastructure. 

-Adheres to change management plans for patching, updating, and rolling back applications. 

Core Responsibilities

Planning & Execution: 

-Track timelines with minimal supervision, ensuring work is completed in a timely manner and is in alignment with project requirements. 

-Prioritize and adjust work as resources or timelines change, with some guidance

Collaboration & Partnership: 

-Collaborates across teams to align on expectations and achieve shared objectives. Builds and maintains a comprehensive understanding of business, stakeholder, and/or customer needs to build and support effective partnerships. Actively listens to diverse perspectives and asks questions to ensure understanding of others. 

Problem Solving: 

-Independently identifies and addresses standard and non-standard issues in accordance with standard practices, escalating more complex issues as appropriate. Analyzes data and/or information from multiple sources to troubleshoot standard and non-standard errors. Contributes to knowledge sharing and best practices

Continuous Learning: 

-Embraces continuous learning by actively seeking to build knowledge and new skills and/or tools, and staying current with industry trends and best practices. Seeks out and leverages feedback and training to improve skills. Contributes to a culture of continuous learning and knowledge sharing with team members. . 

Continuous Improvement: 

-Develops ideas and recommends updates to increase the efficiency and effectiveness of processes, protocols, and workflows within a team. Seeks input from team members on alternative approaches and methods for improving work. 

About Us

Only Oracle brings together the data, infrastructure, applications, and expertise to power everything from industry innovations to life-saving care. And with AI embedded across our products and services, we help customers turn that promise into a better future for all. Discover your potential at a company leading the way in AI and cloud solutions that impact billions of lives. 

True innovation starts when everyone is empowered to contribute. That's why we're committed to growing a workforce that promotes opportunities for all with competitive benefits that support our people with flexible medical, life insurance, and retirement options. We also encourage employees to give back to their communities through our volunteer programs. 

We're committed to including people with disabilities at all stages of the employment process. If you require accessibility assistance or accommodation for a disability at any point, let us know by emailing accommodation-request_mb@oracle. com or by calling 1-888-404-2494 in the United States. 

Oracle is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability and protected veterans' status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Oracle will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records pursuant to applicable law.

Role Summary/Purpose
