data.title: Global Network Performance Lead, Emerging Product & GenAI
data.description:
Responsibilities
About the team
The Emerging Products and Gen AI Partner Portfolio Performance team (EP) is responsible for implementing the Emerging Products content moderation BPO strategy and for maintaining a strong, steady, and performing portfolio of vendors and footprint of sites. This team also supports the internal risk assurance frameworks across the vendor ecosystem. 

About the role
As the Global Network Performance Lead (GNPL), you will drive performance, quality, and operational excellence across the EP network, spanning both in-house (IH) teams and outsourced BPO partners. The role focuses on building strong, long-term stakeholder relationships, ensuring consistent delivery against company standards, and enabling scalable, high-performing operations. 

You will monitor network performance, support escalation and recovery where required, and act as a key connector between TikTok, internal teams, and external partners. The objective is to optimise network-wide performance, maximise value, and support sustainable growth through aligned operating models. 
This role is accountable for supporting and managing TikTok's EP network, including IH teams and external partners. Responsibilities include overseeing the outsourcing of EP lines of business, ensuring strong collaboration with IH teams, and driving performance, compliance, and value creation through effective relationship and contract management. 

The GNPL must be a highly effective communicator with strong relationship-building skills and experience in operations and programme management. A passion for continuous improvement is essential, along with the ability to operate in a fast-paced, cross-functional, multi-geographical environment and navigate both IH and partner dynamics. 

The role requires the ability to manage multiple initiatives, adapt to change, and influence across Partner Management, IH operations, and Trust & Safety. The successful candidate will report to the Global Head of Emerging Products and GenAI Operations, provide business leadership across the EP network, and support both IH teams and outsourcing partners. Regular travel will be required. 

Responsibilities
1. Strategy
- Execute the Emerging Products content moderation BPO global strategy, ensuring a steady, scalable, and high-performing Partner portfolio. 
- Drive the global footprint strategy, enabling regional flexibility, resilience, and growth through site launches, expansions, and new lines of business. 
- Support business growth and new initiatives by shaping operating models and capability development. 
- Identify opportunities to expand existing Partner relationships in line with business and platform needs. 

2. Operations
- Drive operational excellence across sites, improving quality, delivery, efficiency, and moderator experience while reducing friction and complexity. 
- Monitor and manage performance against KPIs, including quality, delivery, pricing adherence, and compliance. 
- Analyse operational and performance data to inform planning, optimisation, and leadership decisions. 
- Serve as the primary point of contact between internal stakeholders and external Partners, ensuring alignment and accountability. 
- Collaborate with global, cross-functional teams to design and implement scalable Partner solutions. 

3. Sourcing & Contracts
- Lead and support end-to-end RFP processes, including requirements definition, Partner engagement, evaluation, and recommendations. 
- Partner with Procurement, Legal, Finance, and stakeholders on BPO contract negotiations, covering pricing, commercial terms, SLAs, and protections. 
- Own contract lifecycle management, including renewals, amendments, scope changes, site changes, and onboarding new lines of business. 
- Drive cost transparency and financial discipline through Partner cost analysis, pricing governance, and performance tracking. 

4. Risk & Governance
- Identify and mitigate operational, financial, and compliance risks through performance management, footprint analysis, capacity planning, and workforce oversight. 
- Conduct regular business reviews and support audits and governance assessments to ensure contractual and regulatory compliance. 
- Analyse business processes and controls to identify risks, gaps, and improvement opportunities. 
- Provide clear performance, risk, and financial reporting to EP leadership, including insights and recommended actions. 

5. Innovation & Industry Expertise
- Maintain strong end-to-end operational expertise to enable effective challenge and optimisation. 
- Stay current on Trust & Safety and BPO industry trends, including GenAI-enabled solutions. 
- Partner with stakeholders and vendors to explore, pilot, and scale innovations that enhance quality, efficiency, and platform safety. 

Qualifications
Minimum Qualification: 
- Fluent in English
- Bachelor's degree or higher. 
- 5+ years' experience in operations or programme management, with proven oversight of global In House and BPO partners operations across multiple regions, including performance and governance. 
- Demonstrated ability to design and deliver innovative solutions that support partner and business operations. 

Preferred Qualifications: 
- Strong capability to operate effectively in cross-functional, global environments, working both independently and as part of a team. 
- Highly organised, with a proven ability to manage high workloads and tight deadlines in fast-paced settings. 
- Strong interpersonal, motivational, and intercultural skills, with the ability to represent the company confidently with external partners. 

Trust & Safety
Content that this role interacts with includes images, video, and text related to every-day life, but it can also include (but is not limited to) bullying; hate speech; child safety; depictions of harm to self and others, and harm to animals. Hence, it is possible that this role will be exposed to harmful content on a daily basis. 

TikTok recognises that keeping our platform safe for the TikTok communities is no ordinary job which can be both rewarding and psychologically demanding and emotionally taxing for some. This is why we are sharing the potential hazards, risks and implications in this unique line of work from the start, so our candidates are well informed before joining. 

We are committed to the wellbeing of all our employees and promise to provide comprehensive and evidence-based programs, to promote and support physical and mental wellbeing throughout each employee's journey with us. We believe that wellbeing is a relationship and that everyone has a part to play, so we work in collaboration and consultation with our employees and across our functions in order to ensure a truly person-centred, innovative and integrated approach. 

About TikTok
TikTok is the leading destination for short-form mobile video. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. TikTok's global headquarters are in Los Angeles and Singapore, and we also have offices in New York City, London, Dublin, Paris, Berlin, Dubai, Jakarta, Seoul, and Tokyo. 

Why Join Us
Inspiring creativity is at the core of TikTok's mission. Our innovative product is built to help people authentically express themselves, discover and connect - and our global, diverse teams make that possible. Together, we create value for our communities, inspire creativity and bring joy - a mission we work towards every day. 
We strive to do great things with great people. We lead with curiosity, humility, and a desire to make impact in a rapidly growing tech company. Every challenge is an opportunity to learn and innovate as one team. We're resilient and embrace challenges as they come. By constantly iterating and fostering an "Always Day 1" mindset, we achieve meaningful breakthroughs for ourselves, our company, and our users. When we create and grow together, the possibilities are limitless. Join us. 

Diversity & Inclusion
TikTok is committed to creating an inclusive space where employees are valued for their skills, experiences, and unique perspectives. Our platform connects people from across the globe and so does our workplace. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. To achieve that goal, we are committed to celebrating our diverse voices and to creating an environment that reflects the many communities we reach. We are passionate about this and hope you are too.

Software Architecture - Software System Structural Design:

Development Operations - System Maintenance:

Planning & Execution:

data.title: QA Automation - Manager
data.description:
Role purpose

You'll design, build and maintain automated end-to-end tests for a multi-year programme modernizing a large portfolio of middle-office applications and moving them to AWS. This is a hands-on engineering role: most of your time is spent writing test code with modern automation frameworks and running it in CI/CD pipelines. You'll help prove that modernized and migrated applications behave the same as, or better than, the legacy systems they replace. You'll use AI coding tools to speed up writing and maintaining tests. 

Key responsibilities

End-to-end UI test automation

- Design and build a scalable UI automation framework using Playwright, Cypress, Selenium WebDriver or WebdriverIO, with the Page Object Model or Screenplay pattern, fixtures and reusable helpers. 
 - Write automated end-to-end tests for ReactJS applications that cover critical user journeys in trade processing, reconciliation, settlement and operations. 
 - Test real-time features delivered over WebSockets and Server-Sent Events, such as live updates, reconnection and message ordering. 
 - Make tests reliable and fast: stable locators, smart waits, parallel execution (e. g. Selenium Grid or cloud grids like BrowserStack/Sauce Labs) and fixing flaky tests. 
 - Cover cross-browser, accessibility (axe-core) and visual regression testing (Applitools, Percy or Playwright snapshots) where it adds value. 

Behaviour-driven and component testing

- Write BDD scenarios with Cucumber (Java or JS) or SpecFlow-style tools, so business analysts and subject-matter experts can read and confirm test coverage. 
 - Support component-level testing with React Testing Library, Vitest/Jest or Cypress Component Testing, working with developers. 

API, contract and integration testing

- Automate REST API tests using REST Assured, Karate, Postman/Newman or Playwright API testing. 
 - Write consumer-driven contract tests with Pact, and validate against OpenAPI specifications. 
 - Test event-driven integrations (Kafka/MQ) by publishing test messages and checking downstream results, using tools such as Testcontainers. 
 - Use mock servers and service virtualisation (WireMock, MockServer) to test components independently. 

Migration and data validation

- Build automated comparison tests that check outputs from legacy and modernized systems match during parallel runs (reports, files, database results). 
 - Validate batch and end-of-day processing results, and support reconciliation with data engineers. 
 - Manage test data, including masking and creating realistic financial test data sets. 

Performance testing

- Build and run load and performance tests with k6, JMeter or Gatling to confirm modernized services meet or beat current response times and batch windows. 

CI/CD and reporting

- Run test suites in Harness, GitHub Actions or Jenkins pipelines as quality gates on every build and deployment. 
 - Run tests in containers and on cloud test infrastructure for speed and scale. 
 - Publish clear test reports, traces and dashboards (Allure, ExtentReports or framework-native reports) for engineers and release managers. 

AI-assisted testing

- Use GitHub Copilot, Claude Code and/or Devin to generate test cases, page objects and test data, and to analyse failures. 
 - Use AI to draft test scenarios from requirements and from legacy application behaviour, then review them with business analysts. 
 - Review all AI-generated tests carefully for real coverage and meaningful checks, not just passing tests. 

Collaboration

- Work with developers, business analysts and subject-matter experts to agree acceptance criteria and test coverage. 
 - Take part in code reviews and promote testable design and shift-left practices. 
 - Support cutover rehearsals, release testing and early-life support. 

Required Experience And Skills

- 5+ years in test automation or software engineering in test. 
 - UI automation: strong hands-on experience with at least one of Playwright, Cypress, Selenium WebDriver or WebdriverIO, and working knowledge of at least one other. 
 - Programming: strong coding skills in TypeScript/JavaScript and/or Java; tests are treated as production code. 
 - API testing: experience automating REST API tests with REST Assured, Karate, Postman/Newman or similar. 
 - BDD: experience writing and maintaining Cucumber (or similar) scenarios. 
 - Web testing: solid understanding of modern ReactJS applications, the DOM, browser dev tools and network inspection. 
 - CI/CD: running automated tests in pipelines (Harness, GitHub Actions or Jenkins). 
 - SQL: ability to write queries to set up and check test data. 
 - Git, Docker and agile delivery. 
 - Regular use of AI coding assistants in professional work. 

Preferred

- Experience with several UI frameworks and migrating test suites between them (e. g. Selenium to Playwright). 
 - Contract testing with Pact and service virtualisation with WireMock. 
 - Performance testing with k6, JMeter or Gatling. 
 - Experience testing WebSocket, SSE, Kafka/MQ or batch processing. 
 - Testing migration or modernization programmes, including parallel runs and data reconciliation. 
 - Experience in financial services, ideally trading, settlement, collateral or accounting. 
 - ISTQB Advanced Test Automation Engineer or equivalent certification. 

Success measures (first 12 months)

- A standard automation framework and patterns adopted across all modernization teams, with critical user journeys automated. 
 - UI, API and contract test suites running as quality gates in CI/CD for every application in scope. 
 - Low flaky-test rate and fast feedback times, measured against an agreed target. 
 - Automated parallel-run comparisons supporting cutover sign-off. 
 - Fewer defects escaping to UAT and production, compared with a baseline.

data.title: DevOps Engineer - Manager
data.description:
Role purpose

You'll build and run the CI/CD pipelines which build state of the art application platforms and deploy AWS infrastructure for a multi-year programme moving a large portfolio of middle-office applications to AWS. This is a hands-on engineering role: most of your day is spent writing pipeline code, Terraform and scripts, and fixing builds and deployments. You'll work closely with full-stack application teams (ReactJS and Java), database engineers and SRE. 

Key responsibilities

Build tooling

- Set up and maintain front-end builds with npm and pnpm, vite, babel etc including workspaces/monorepos, dependency caching, lockfile management and private registries. 
 - Set up and maintain Java builds with Maven and Gradle, including multi-module projects, dependency management and build performance. 
 - Publish and version artifacts through Artifactory (or similar), and keep builds reproducible. 

CI/CD pipelines

- Design and build pipelines in Harness and GitHub Actions for build, test, security scanning and deployment across all environments. 
 - Create reusable pipeline templates so application teams can onboard quickly and consistently. 
 - Add quality and security gates: unit tests, code coverage, SAST/SCA scanning, container image scanning and approval steps. 
 - Support blue/green and canary deployments, automated rollback and release tracking that meets State Street change management requirements. 

Infrastructure as code and AWS

- Write and maintain Terraform modules for AWS: VPC, IAM, EC2, ECS/EKS, ALB, S3, RDS and related services. 
 - Manage Terraform state, module versioning and policy checks; detect and fix configuration drift. 
 - Build and run container platforms (Docker, ECS/EKS) for application workloads. 
 - Integrate secrets management (HashiCorp Vault/CyberArk) into pipelines and runtime environments. 

Linux

- Build, harden and automate Linux servers and container images for applications moving off Solaris and Windows. 
 - Write Shell and Python scripts for automation, troubleshooting and operational tasks. 
 - Support migration of batch jobs and file transfers to the target platform (e. g. AutoSys, MFX/SFTP). 

Reliability and collaboration

- Work with SRE to add logging, metrics and alerting (e. g. Dynatrace, Splunk) to pipelines and environments. 
 - Troubleshoot build, deployment and environment issues for application teams. 
 - Document runbooks and standards, and use AI assistants (e. g. GitHub Copilot) to speed up pipeline, Terraform and script development, with review. 

Required Experience And Skills

- 5+ years in DevOps, build or platform engineering roles. 
 - Front-end builds: practical experience with npm and pnpm for React/TypeScript projects. 
 - Java builds: strong experience with Maven and Gradle. 
 - Terraform: writing production modules and managing state for AWS. 
 - AWS: hands-on experience with core compute, networking, IAM, containers and managed services. 
 - CI/CD: building pipelines in Harness and/or GitHub Actions; Jenkins experience is a plus. 
 - Linux: strong administration, hardening and scripting (Bash, Python). 
 - Docker and Kubernetes/ECS/EKS. 
 - Git, branching strategies and pull-request workflows.

data.title: QA Automation - Manager
data.description:
Role purpose

You'll design, build and maintain automated end-to-end tests for a multi-year programme modernizing a large portfolio of middle-office applications and moving them to AWS. This is a hands-on engineering role: most of your time is spent writing test code with modern automation frameworks and running it in CI/CD pipelines. You'll help prove that modernized and migrated applications behave the same as, or better than, the legacy systems they replace. You'll use AI coding tools to speed up writing and maintaining tests. 

Key responsibilities

End-to-end UI test automation

- Design and build a scalable UI automation framework using Playwright, Cypress, Selenium WebDriver or WebdriverIO, with the Page Object Model or Screenplay pattern, fixtures and reusable helpers. 
 - Write automated end-to-end tests for ReactJS applications that cover critical user journeys in trade processing, reconciliation, settlement and operations. 
 - Test real-time features delivered over WebSockets and Server-Sent Events, such as live updates, reconnection and message ordering. 
 - Make tests reliable and fast: stable locators, smart waits, parallel execution (e. g. Selenium Grid or cloud grids like BrowserStack/Sauce Labs) and fixing flaky tests. 
 - Cover cross-browser, accessibility (axe-core) and visual regression testing (Applitools, Percy or Playwright snapshots) where it adds value. 

Behaviour-driven and component testing

- Write BDD scenarios with Cucumber (Java or JS) or SpecFlow-style tools, so business analysts and subject-matter experts can read and confirm test coverage. 
 - Support component-level testing with React Testing Library, Vitest/Jest or Cypress Component Testing, working with developers. 

API, contract and integration testing

- Automate REST API tests using REST Assured, Karate, Postman/Newman or Playwright API testing. 
 - Write consumer-driven contract tests with Pact, and validate against OpenAPI specifications. 
 - Test event-driven integrations (Kafka/MQ) by publishing test messages and checking downstream results, using tools such as Testcontainers. 
 - Use mock servers and service virtualisation (WireMock, MockServer) to test components independently. 

Migration and data validation

- Build automated comparison tests that check outputs from legacy and modernized systems match during parallel runs (reports, files, database results). 
 - Validate batch and end-of-day processing results, and support reconciliation with data engineers. 
 - Manage test data, including masking and creating realistic financial test data sets. 

Performance testing

- Build and run load and performance tests with k6, JMeter or Gatling to confirm modernized services meet or beat current response times and batch windows. 

CI/CD and reporting

- Run test suites in Harness, GitHub Actions or Jenkins pipelines as quality gates on every build and deployment. 
 - Run tests in containers and on cloud test infrastructure for speed and scale. 
 - Publish clear test reports, traces and dashboards (Allure, ExtentReports or framework-native reports) for engineers and release managers. 

AI-assisted testing

- Use GitHub Copilot, Claude Code and/or Devin to generate test cases, page objects and test data, and to analyse failures. 
 - Use AI to draft test scenarios from requirements and from legacy application behaviour, then review them with business analysts. 
 - Review all AI-generated tests carefully for real coverage and meaningful checks, not just passing tests. 

Collaboration

- Work with developers, business analysts and subject-matter experts to agree acceptance criteria and test coverage. 
 - Take part in code reviews and promote testable design and shift-left practices. 
 - Support cutover rehearsals, release testing and early-life support. 

Required Experience And Skills

- 5+ years in test automation or software engineering in test. 
 - UI automation: strong hands-on experience with at least one of Playwright, Cypress, Selenium WebDriver or WebdriverIO, and working knowledge of at least one other. 
 - Programming: strong coding skills in TypeScript/JavaScript and/or Java; tests are treated as production code. 
 - API testing: experience automating REST API tests with REST Assured, Karate, Postman/Newman or similar. 
 - BDD: experience writing and maintaining Cucumber (or similar) scenarios. 
 - Web testing: solid understanding of modern ReactJS applications, the DOM, browser dev tools and network inspection. 
 - CI/CD: running automated tests in pipelines (Harness, GitHub Actions or Jenkins). 
 - SQL: ability to write queries to set up and check test data. 
 - Git, Docker and agile delivery. 
 - Regular use of AI coding assistants in professional work. 

Preferred

- Experience with several UI frameworks and migrating test suites between them (e. g. Selenium to Playwright). 
 - Contract testing with Pact and service virtualisation with WireMock. 
 - Performance testing with k6, JMeter or Gatling. 
 - Experience testing WebSocket, SSE, Kafka/MQ or batch processing. 
 - Testing migration or modernization programmes, including parallel runs and data reconciliation. 
 - Experience in financial services, ideally trading, settlement, collateral or accounting. 
 - ISTQB Advanced Test Automation Engineer or equivalent certification. 

Success measures (first 12 months)

- A standard automation framework and patterns adopted across all modernization teams, with critical user journeys automated. 
 - UI, API and contract test suites running as quality gates in CI/CD for every application in scope. 
 - Low flaky-test rate and fast feedback times, measured against an agreed target. 
 - Automated parallel-run comparisons supporting cutover sign-off. 
 - Fewer defects escaping to UAT and production, compared with a baseline.

data.description:
Principal Engineer - Data Security & Cloud Protection

Meet The Team

Cisco Security Business Group (SBG) is at the forefront of developing solutions for addressing the security challenges of our customers. With an annual revenue exceeding $2B, it is one of the fastest growing businesses at Cisco. As Cisco is transforming its business model aggressively to a software and recurring revenue model, security business is leading this journey with 40%+ YoY growth in software recurring revenue. 

The Cloud Security group within SBG focuses on developing cloud delivered security solutions (SaaS based) in a platform centric approach. This group is an autonomous group within the business group, and operates like a Startup to nurture innovation in a highly disruptive and high growth domain. This group was formed a year back by combining some of existing cloud assets Cisco had with two hugely successful acquisitions - OpenDNS and CloudLock. Our vision is to build the most complex security solutions in a cloud delivered way with utmost simplicity - disrupt industry's thinking around how deep and how broad a security solution can be while keeping it easy to deploy and simple to manage. We are at an exciting stage of this journey with 100% YoY growth, and looking for a passionate, innovative and action-oriented engineering leader for our Product Engineering group to help us scale our business. 

Why is cloud security relevant? Because today's world has changed. The way we work has fundamentally changed. There is more roaming users than ever with rapid growth of BYOD. Business applications have moved to cloud. Enterprise's critical infrastructure has been moving to public/private cloud. At the same time, threat landscape has drastically changed with increased sophistication of attacks. The notion of traditional perimeter-based security is being disrupted. Since users, apps and infrastructure have all moved to cloud, security must too. Welcome to the team of geeks passionate about solving this very problem and making world a better place. . . a secure place. 

We have a highly scalable cloud infrastructure spread across 25 data centers where we run our cloud security applications that operate at massive scale - 100B+ requests per day from 65M daily active users. 

Your Impact

As a Principal Engineer, you will shape the technical direction of Cisco Secure Access at the intersection of AI, application intelligence, SaaS security, and cloud-scale architecture. You will define the architecture and roadmap for core CASB and Application Visibility and Control (AVC) capabilities that help enterprises gain deeper visibility, enforce granular application policies, and protect data across today's SaaS and AI-driven environments. 

You will lead the transformation of application discovery and classification through AI-assisted intelligence, improving automation, accuracy, data freshness, and the speed at which new applications and threats can be identified. You will also help embed responsible AI across the product development lifecycle, using AI to accelerate engineering productivity, quality, testing, troubleshooting, and delivery. 

What You Will Do

The Principal Engineer will lead the architecture and technical direction for Cloud Access Security Broker (CASB) and Application Visibility and Control (AVC) capabilities within Cisco Secure Access. 

- Define the architecture and roadmap for application discovery, granular application controls, SaaS tenant controls, and offline or API-based DLP and malware scanning of SaaS content. 
 - Lead the broader use of AI in the product, including AI-powered security capabilities, controls for generative AI applications, and responsible use of AI across the product development lifecycle. 
 - Own the technical strategy for the internal CASI application-intelligence platform, including data quality, confidence scoring, human validation, model monitoring, update speed, and scaling with traffic and application growth. Lead the AI-assisted transformation of application discovery and classification. 
 - Guide critical feature designs and establish foundations for security, privacy, performance, scalability, resilience, observability, quality, troubleshooting, and cost efficiency. 
 - Translate customer needs, emerging threats, and product priorities into scalable capabilities in partnership with product management, security research, architects, and engineering teams. 
 - Provide cross-team technical leadership and mentorship, resolve complex architectural issues, and raise engineering standards without becoming a design-review bottleneck. 

Minimum Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in computer science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. 
 - Typically, 12+ years of software engineering experience, including architecture and technical leadership across multiple teams. 
 - Direct experience with CASB, AVC, SSE/SASE, Secure Web Gateway, DLP, malware protection, or SaaS tenant security.

data.title: Full Stack Developer - Manager
data.description:
Role purpose

You'll build cloud-native services and user interfaces for a multi-year programme modernizing a large portfolio of middle-office applications and moving them to AWS. This is a hands-on development role with a strong back-end focus. You'll design and build Java microservices and APIs on AWS, and also contribute to ReactJS/TypeScript front ends. You'll use AI coding tools such as GitHub Copilot, Claude Code and Devin every day to deliver faster, while staying fully accountable for the quality and security of the code. 

Key responsibilities

Back-end Development (primary)

- Design and build Java/Spring Boot microservices and REST APIs for trade processing, accounting, reconciliation and settlement functions. 
 - Build event-driven integrations with Kafka and IBM MQ, including message design, error handling, retries and idempotency. 
 - Write efficient data access against Oracle (JPA/Hibernate and SQL), working with database engineers on schema design and performance. 
 - Rebuild legacy business logic as clean, testable services, working with business analysts and subject-matter experts to confirm behaviour. 
 - Write unit, integration and contract tests, and help with performance and resilience testing. 

AWS

- Build and deploy services on AWS: ECS/EKS, Lambda, API Gateway, S3, SQS/SNS, RDS, CloudWatch and IAM. 
 - Design services for scalability, high availability and security, following AWS Well-Architected principles. 
 - Work with DevOps on Terraform, Docker and CI/CD pipelines (Harness/GitHub Actions) so your services deploy automatically. 

Front-end development (secondary)

- Build and maintain ReactJS/TypeScript screens and components for data-heavy enterprise applications that replace legacy desktop UIs. 
 - Connect front ends to back-end APIs, handling authentication (SSO/MFA), state management and error handling. 
 - Write maintainable JavaScript/TypeScript and component tests (Jest/React Testing Library). 

AI-assisted development

- Use GitHub Copilot for inline code completion, chat-based refactoring, test generation and pull-request summaries. 
 - Use Claude Code for agentic, multi-file work in the terminal: understanding unfamiliar codebases, refactoring across modules, generating tests and fixing failing builds. 
 - Work with Devin (or similar autonomous agents) on well-defined tasks: write clear task specs, review its pull requests and correct its output. 
 - Use AI to analyse legacy code (Java EE, Sybase SQL, PowerBuilder, COBOL) and draft specs for subject-matter experts to confirm. 
 - Write good prompts and context files (e. g. README files, coding standards, agent instruction files) so AI tools produce code that follows team standards. 
 - Review all AI-generated code for correctness, security, performance and licence compliance before merging. You stay accountable for every line. 
 - Share effective prompts, patterns and lessons learned with the team. 

Ways of working

- Take part in code reviews, design discussions and agile ceremonies. 
 - Support production releases, cutovers and early-life support, and fix issues quickly. 
 - Follow State Street secure coding, information security, data classification and approved-AI-tool policies. 

Required Experience And Skills

- 6+ years in software development, mostly on the back end. 
 - Java: strong in Java 17+, Spring Boot, Spring Data/JPA, REST API design and multithreading. 
 - Messaging: practical experience with Kafka and/or IBM MQ. 
 - AWS: good hands-on knowledge of core services (ECS/EKS or Lambda, S3, SQS/SNS, RDS, IAM, CloudWatch). 
 - Databases: strong SQL; experience with Oracle or another enterprise relational database. 
 - ReactJS/TypeScript/JavaScript: good working knowledge of React hooks, component design, TypeScript and modern JavaScript (ES6+). 
 - AI tools: proven, regular use of at least one of GitHub Copilot, Claude Code or Devin in professional delivery, including the ability to judge when AI output is wrong. 
 - Engineering practices: Git, CI/CD, Docker, automated testing (JUnit, Mockito) and clean code principles. 
 - Experience working in agile delivery teams. 

Preferred

- Hands-on experience with all three of GitHub Copilot, Claude Code and Devin, and a view on which tool suits which task. 
 - Experience with MCP servers or giving AI agents context from Jira, Confluence or code repositories. 
 - Experience in financial services, ideally investment servicing or middle-office areas (trade lifecycle, settlement, collateral, reconciliation or accounting). 
 - Experience modernizing legacy applications (e. g. Java EE/EJB on Payara or WebSphere, Sybase). 
 - Experience with Terraform and infrastructure-as-code. 
 - AWS Developer Associate or Solutions Architect certification. 

Success measures (first 12 months)

- Delivered production-ready services and front-end features for modernized applications, on schedule. 
 - Services meet agreed standards for test coverage, performance, security and observability. 
 - Measurable productivity gains from AI tools (e. g. cycle time, test coverage), with no rise in defects or rework. 
 - Contributed reusable prompts, agent instructions or patterns that the wider team uses. 
 - Became a trusted contributor in design and code reviews across the team. 

About State Street

Across the globe, institutional investors rely on us to help them manage risk, respond to challenges, and drive performance and profitability. We keep our clients at the heart of everything we do, and smart, engaged employees are essential to our continued success. 

We are committed to fostering an environment where every employee feels valued and empowered to reach their full potential. As an essential partner in our shared success, you'll benefit from inclusive development opportunities, flexible work-life support, paid volunteer days, and vibrant employee networks that keep you connected to what matters most. Job Purpose: This role is responsible to manage the continuous availability, reliability, and functionality of DCS and PLC systems. This includes scheduling and performing regular system backups, maintenance, and troubleshooting, as well as coordinating with OEMs for system upgrades. The role also involves managing hardware and software resources, network integrity, and cybersecurity measures to prevent data loss and system vulnerabilities. 

Responsibilities

Lead - DCS_PLC (Distributed Control System_ Programmable Logic Control)

System Reliability And Maintenance

Ensure the availability and functioning of all control loops in auto mode, maintaining reliability of equipment protection under BTG. 

Schedule and execute regular backups of DCS and PLC systems to prevent data loss. 

Perform routine maintenance and troubleshooting of DCS and PLC hardware to minimize downtime. 

Monitor system alarms daily and ensure the healthiness and redundancy of systems. 

Coordinate with Original Equipment Manufacturers (OEMs) for annual maintenance activities and system upgrades. 

Manage the proper functioning of Operator Workstations (OWS) and Engineering Workstations (EWS). 

Maintain periodical backups and availability of historian systems for data integrity and recovery. 

Hardware And Software Management

Manage the availability of DCS and PLC hardware and software, including necessary spares for emergency replacements. 

Maintain up-to-date DCS and PLC licenses and manage renewals to avoid operational disruptions. 

Conduct patch updates of DCS and PLC software to address vulnerabilities and enhance system performance. 

Upgrade DCS and PLC systems proactively to prevent obsolescence and maintain compatibility with new technologies. 

Network And Cybersecurity

Manage the storage, backup, and restoration of systems in compliance with cybersecurity policies. 

Ensure the healthiness and redundancy of the DCS and PLC network, preventing single points of failure. 

Oversee the transfer of data to third-party systems, such as Pi servers, ensuring secure and reliable communication. 

Review and strengthen network security measures to protect against cyber threats and unauthorized access. 

Business Sustainability

Implement and Follow IMS, AWMS, DISHA and CHETNA guidelines within the department. 

Promote the safety of personnel and equipment through rigorous training and strict adherence to safety protocols. 

Implement risk management practices to mitigate potential hazards and ensure operational continuity. 

Develop and maintain emergency response plans to address potential incidents swiftly and effectively. 

Ensure adherence to statutory compliances and regulations. 

Implement MoC (Management of Change) protocols to ensure safe and compliant modifications to equipment and processes. 

Provide support for Root Cause Analysis (RCA), Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (FMEA), Zero Forced Outage (ZFO) to enhance system reliability. 

Implement field related ZFO action items and AWMS for continuous improvement in maintenance practices. 

Digitization And Automation

Execute comprehensive digitization strategies and automation solutions to optimize operational efficiency. 

Implement process and system improvements, adopting newer technologies and innovative ideas. 

Drive the implementation of digital transformation initiatives. 

Analyse data trends and system performance to identify opportunities for automation and digitization enhancements.

Vendor

A Network Operations Engineer on our team supports the design, deployment, and operations of a large-scale global Oracle cloud computing environment (Oracle Cloud Infrastructure - OCI). Primarily focused on operation and support of RDMA/RoCE/InfiniBand network fabrics and systems, through a combination of a deep network understanding and automation skills to operate a production environment. At EY, you'll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we're counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all. 

Wealth & Asset Management (WAM) - AWS Data Engineer Manager/Architect: 

Consulting - WAM -Technical-AWS Data Engineer Manager/Architect: Manager

At EY, we're all in to shape your future with confidence. 

We'll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go. 

Join EY and help to build a better working world. 

About Global Delivery Services

Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY's strategy by ensuring effective support to EY's growth agenda. 

Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80, 000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom. 

Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy & Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high-quality, value-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service. 

Enablement Services provides cost-effective, high-skilled, and innovative services to support EY's global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services. 

Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation. 

The Opportunity

Role Summary

The Lead AWS Data Engineer provides technical leadership and hands on execution for enterprise data platforms hosted on Amazon Web Services (AWS). This role leads the design, migration, modernization, and operation of cloud native data architectures supporting mission critical financial, advisor payout, mobility, and corporate analytics platforms. 

The Lead AWS Data Engineer owns end to end technical decision making for AWS data platforms, including architecture, security, orchestration, and production readiness. The role requires deep expertise in AWS data services, Python and PySpark development, workflow orchestration, data lake design, infrastructure as code, and operational excellence, along with the ability to mentor engineers and partner effectively with infrastructure, IAM, and database teams. 

Role: AWS Data Engineer Manager/Architect

Experience: 8-10 years

Domain: Wealth Management, Asset Management, Capital Markets, Investment Banking, Financial

Your Key Responsibilities

Technical Leadership & Platform Ownership

- Serve as the technical lead and design authority for AWS data engineering initiatives across multiple enterprise platforms. 
 - Own architectural decisions related to scalability, reliability, security, and cost optimization of AWS data platforms. 
 - Define and enforce engineering standards, coding patterns, and operational best practices for cloud data pipelines. 
 - Provide hands on technical guidance, design reviews, and code reviews for data engineers. 

AWS Data Platform Engineering

- Lead the design, development, and support of cloud native data pipelines using Amazon S3, AWS Glue (PySpark), MWAA (Apache Airflow), and AWS Step Functions. 
 - Drive on premises to AWS data platform migrations, including reverse engineering of legacy ETL workflows and re implementation using AWS native services. 
 - Re architect legacy Oracle Data Integrator (ODI)-based ETL processes into scalable PySpark based Glue jobs. 
 - Optimize Spark workloads for performance, memory usage, and cost efficiency in AWS Glue environments. 

Data Lake, Iceberg & Architecture Design

- Architect and implement enterprise AWS data lakes using Medallion architecture (Bronze, Silver, Gold). 
 - Design and manage Apache Iceberg tables to support incremental processing, schema evolution, and efficient data lake operations. 
 - Establish standardized ingestion, transformation, and consumption patterns across financial, mobility, and corporate datasets. 
 - Ensure data quality, reconciliation, lineage, and auditability across all layers of the data platform. 

Workflow Orchestration & Automation

- Lead orchestration strategy using MWAA (Managed Workflows for Apache Airflow). 
 - Design and implement Airflow DAGs in Python to orchestrate end to end workflows, including Glue jobs, validations, and downstream dependencies. 
 - Implement scheduling, retry logic, monitoring, and failure handling to ensure resilient and scalable pipelines. 
 - Integrate orchestration workflows with AWS services such as S3, Glue, Athena, Iceberg based data lakes, and downstream systems. 

Security, Infrastructure & AWS Networking

- Drive implementation of AWS security best practices, including IAM role design, least privilege access, encryption using AWS KMS, and secrets management. 
 - Lead configuration of AWS networking components such as VPC Endpoints (VPCE) to enable secure service to service communication. 
 - Manage infrastructure provisioning using Terraform, ensuring repeatable and auditable deployments across DEV, QA, and PROD environments. 
 - Coordinate with IAM, network, DevOps, and DBA teams to resolve access, firewall, and Oracle database connectivity challenges. 

Production Readiness, Operations & Support

- Own production readiness for AWS data platforms, including configuration, secrets, access controls, and deployment planning. 
 - Act as the escalation point for complex production issues, performing root cause analysis and permanent fixes. 
 - Implement logging, metrics, and alerting using Amazon CloudWatch to meet enterprise SLAs and availability targets. 
 - Support parallel run and hybrid architectures during migration phases to ensure business continuity. 

Automation, Compliance & Regulatory Enablement

- Design and oversee Python based automation solutions supporting operational efficiency and compliance initiatives (e. g. , file retention and document processing). 
 - Ensure pipeline designs meet regulatory, audit, and enterprise governance requirements, including traceability and controlled data handling. 

Collaboration & Stakeholder Engagement

- Partner closely with data architects, DevOps teams, infrastructure teams, and business stakeholders to deliver AWS data solutions aligned with enterprise strategy. 
 - Translate business and platform requirements into scalable technical designs and execution plans. 
 - Produce technical documentation and support knowledge transfer to enable long term platform sustainability. 

Preferred Domain Experience

- Strong preference for candidates with experience in: 
 - Wealth Management
 - Asset Management
 - Capital Markets
 - Investment Banking
 - Financial Services
 - Exposure to: 
 - Portfolio & Investment Management
 - Securities & Holdings Data
 - Trade & Transaction Processing
 - Risk & Compliance Reporting
 - Market & Reference Data
 - Client Reporting Platforms
 - Regulatory Reporting
Skills And Attributes For Success

Preferred skills: 

- AWS Data Engineering Services (Glue, EMR, Step Functions, S3, CloudWatch)
 - Apache Airflow
 - Iceberg
 - Data Architect
 - DWH/ETL
 - Python
 - Pyspark
 - Medallion Architecture
 - SQL
 - IaC (Devops, Terraform)
 - Data Modelling
 - WAM Domain Knowledge
 - Github Copilot, Claude

Nice To Have Qualifications (Not Mandatory)

- Exposure to analytics or BI platforms (e. g. , ThoughtSpot, Tableau). 
 - Exposure to Oracle databases or legacy ETL tools (e. g. , ODI). 
 - Experience in financial services or regulated enterprise environments. 
 - Familiarity with CI/CD practices for data engineering workloads. 
 - AWS Certification (Data Analytics, Solutions Architect, or Developer Associate). 

Required Qualifications

What we look for

- Bachelor's degree in computer science, Engineering, or related field (or equivalent practical experience). 
 - 8-10 years of experience in Data Engineering with strong AWS exposure. 
 - Extensive hands on experience designing and leading AWS data engineering solutions. 
 - Proven experience leading or owning on premises to AWS data platform migrations. 
 - Advanced proficiency in Python and PySpark for data processing, automation, and orchestration. 
 - Strong experience with AWS Glue, Amazon S3, MWAA (Airflow), Step Functions, CloudWatch, and related services. 
 - Experience with Infrastructure as Code, preferably Terraform. 
 - Strong understanding of data engineering principles including ETL design, data modelling, and pipeline optimization. 
 - Demonstrated experience supporting enterprise, production grade data platforms. 
 - Good understanding of AI technologies, agentic systems, and tools such as Microsoft Copilot and Claude, with the ability to leverage AI-driven capabilities for solution development and delivery. 

What We Offer You

At EY, we'll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We'll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more. 

Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today. 

To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability-related adjustments or accommodations you may need. 

Our Commitment: As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost. 

Professional Development: From entry-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship. 

People and Culture: In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing. 

Benefits: Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development. 

How to Apply: If you are passionate to join us and are aligned with our commitment to building a better working world, we invite you to apply by completing our user-friendly form with personal and professional information and by providing your consent to data privacy. 

Successful candidates advance to a competency-based interview. If mutual interest persists, a job offer awaits. 

"We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to Diversity, Equity & Inclusion". 

EY | Building a better working world

EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets. 

Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate. 

Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

Description

The Position

We are seeking an experienced and passionate Engineering Manager to lead a team of Fullstack Engineers responsible for building and maintaining scalable, high-performance applications and platforms that serve both internal teams and external partners. 

As an Engineering Manager, you will be responsible for leading a team of engineers while driving the successful delivery of enterprise-grade SaaS products and platform capabilities. You will partner closely with Product Managers, Architects, Designers, and Engineering leaders to execute against product roadmaps, improve engineering effectiveness, and ensure high-quality software delivery. 

This role requires a strong technical foundation in Python, React, cloud-native technologies, and modern software architecture principles. You will provide technical leadership, facilitate technical discussions, guide engineering decisions, and help teams build scalable, maintainable, and secure solutions. 

You will play a critical role in balancing business priorities, customer needs, technical investments, and team development. Success in this role requires strong people leadership, operational excellence, strategic thinking, and the ability to build and grow high-performing engineering teams. 

You will independently own team execution, delivery outcomes, engineering excellence, and employee development while fostering a culture of accountability, collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement. 

We Expect Our Team Members To

- Act with integrity, even when it's hard
 - Always stay curious and ready to learn
 - Work to meaningful outcomes, mindful of each step
 - Operate as a unified team, made stronger by uniqueness

Responsibilities & Skills

You should: 

- Be excited to work with talented, committed people in a fast-paced environment. 
 - Lead, mentor, and grow a high-performing team of 5+ software engineers across multiple experience levels. 
 - Foster a culture of ownership, accountability, collaboration, inclusivity, and continuous improvement. 
 - Provide regular coaching, performance feedback, career development guidance, and growth opportunities for team members. 
 - Drive engineering execution across multiple concurrent initiatives while ensuring alignment with business goals and product priorities. 
 - Partner closely with Product Managers, Architects, Designers, and stakeholders to define scope, priorities, delivery plans, and technical strategy. 
 - Support project planning, resource allocation, estimation, and prioritization to maximize business impact. 
 - Balance customer commitments, operational support needs, platform investments, technical debt reduction, and new feature development. 
 - Champion engineering excellence through code quality, automated testing, security, observability, and operational best practices. 
 - Ensure timely delivery of high-quality software with strong attention to scalability, reliability, performance, maintainability, and security. 
 - Promote Agile development practices and continuously improve team processes and delivery effectiveness. 
 - Identify risks early, remove blockers, and proactively mitigate challenges impacting delivery or team productivity. 
 - Keep teams aligned with long-term product and platform strategy while effectively managing near-term commitments. 
 - Understand business objectives and ensure engineering decisions support company goals and customer outcomes. 
 - Lead by example through technical credibility, sound judgment, and a solutions-oriented mindset. 
 - Demonstrate excellent written and verbal communication skills. 
 - Be exceptionally self-motivated, proactive, and capable of thriving in a fast-paced environment. 

Required Skills (Frontend - React & Angular)

- Have 12+ years of industry experience delivering enterprise-grade software products, including 3-5 years in an engineering leadership role. 
 - Have experience building or scaling enterprise SaaS platforms, APIs, and customer-facing applications using Python and React. 
 - Possess strong knowledge of software architecture, design patterns, and scalable microservices-based systems. 
 - Have experience coding with Python and modern frontend frameworks such as React and/or Angular. 
 - Demonstrate strong understanding of cloud-native architectures, security principles, reliability, and cost optimization. 
 - Have hands-on experience with AWS and/or GCP cloud platforms and core cloud services. 
 - Understand CI/CD practices, deployment automation, Infrastructure as Code, and DevOps principles. 
 - Have experience with containerization and orchestration technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes. 
 - Be familiar with monitoring, logging, alerting, and observability tools such as Datadog, Grafana, and CloudWatch. 
 - Demonstrate strong analytical, evaluative, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to diagnose and resolve complex technical challenges. 
 - Be proficient with Jira, Confluence, and modern engineering collaboration tools. 

Required

The following experiences are not required, but you'll stand out from other applicants if you have any of the following, in our order of importance: 

- Experience with Databricks, Data Lakes, BigQuery, or modern data platform technologies. 
 - Experience working in a SaaS or product-led software organization. 
 - Experience with Infrastructure as Code tools such as Terraform. 
 - Experience with event-driven architectures and serverless technologies. 
 - Experience building reusable platform services, frameworks, or shared engineering capabilities. 
 - Experience contributing to engineering strategy, organizational planning, and budgeting. 
 - Experience managing globally distributed engineering teams. 
 - Experience working in the Utility, Energy, or Sustainability domain. 

Qualifications

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.

At Uplight, We're Not Just Offering a Job - We're Offering a Chance To Be Part Of The Solution To One Of The World's Biggest Challenges. As a Certified B Corporation, We're Deeply Committed To Both Social And Environmental Responsibility. Here's Why You Should Join Our Team Of Passionate Uplighters

data.title: Senior Staff Engineer, Analog Design
data.description:
Renesas is one of the top global semiconductor companies in the world. We strive to develop a safer, healthier, greener, and smarter world, and our goal is to make every endpoint intelligent by offering product solutions in the automotive, industrial, infrastructure and IoT markets. Our robust product portfolio includes world leading MCUs, SoCs, Analog and power products, plus Winning Combination solutions that curate these complementary products. We are a key supplier to the world's leading manufacturers of electronics you rely on every day; you may not see our products, but they are all around you. 

Renesas employs roughly 21, 000 people in more than 30 countries worldwide. As a global team, our employees actively embody the Renesas Culture, our guiding principles based on five key elements: Transparent, Agile, Global, Innovative, and Entrepreneurial. Renesas believes in, and has a commitment to, diversity and inclusion, with initiatives and a leadership team dedicated to its resources and values. At Renesas, we want to build a sustainable future where technology helps make our lives easier. Join us and build your future by being part of what's next in electronics and the world. 

Job Description

Looking for a 12+ years experienced Engineering Manager with in-depth understanding of Analog concepts, experience of design of complex Analog I/Ps & sub-blocks, integrating I/Ps and sub systems and ownership, experience of fully owning smaller ICs (Point of loads, Single Converters) and owning major I/Ps in large PMICs, to join the 2. 6B$ Power Business Unit. The candidate will get to work on a wide range of exciting products such as PMICs, Linear and Switching DC-DC converters powering the next generation of Renesas processors. This is an early-stage growth opportunity where in the candidate will get to learn, build and over time contribute and influence the charter for Renesas's massive Power product portfolio. 

Essential Functions: 

- Must be proficient in designing and owning complex I/Ps like +ve/-ve Charge Pumps, Buck Converters, Source-Sink LDOs, Ultra-low power Oscillators (including Relaxation type), Temperature Sensor, Current Sense, SAR ADCs, Protection (Thermal, Under-Voltage, Over-Voltage, Over Current etc) and analog blocks including Bandgap references, V2I, Analog Buffers, Op-Amps, Comparators, High speed level shifters etc. 

- Must have in-depth Understanding of and should be able to implement & compensate the Control Loops, Analog feedback loops and should know trade-offs between various compensation strategies. 

- Should be able to build/support Block level spec break down from Top level chip requirements and independently own, design complete switching converter e. g. Buck, Boost, Buck-Boost etc and LDOs. Must be able to do block level error budgeting depending on the block requirements. 

- Must be aware of relative differences of various control loop architectures (Constant Freq, Constant ON/OFF Time, Current mode etc) and decide/implement the best option to meet converter level performance specifications and other system requirements. 

- Must be able to bring in innovative ideas to improve designs to meet challenging specifications. 

- Should have in-depth knowledge of Analog layouts and be able to work closely with layout lead from floor planning till Chip Top completion and verification and do trade-offs based on desired performance

- Must be conversant with the standard design, extraction and simulation flows & tools, speed, convergence, accuracy trade-offs and should be able to optimize setups based on Pre/Post (with/without) Parasitic using simulator options, debug and navigate through tool related challenges. 

- Should be able to setup design flows and methodologies including checklists, reviews to ensure quality designs and take them all the way to Silicon success. 

- Should be able to mentor Freshers and Junior engineers for upscaling their technical skills as well as other skills needed for better efficacy. 

- Should have experience of end-to-end IC development flow, Silicon debugs, and taking ICs to production

- Should be able to lead/manage a small group of Engineers and navigate through all stages of IC development while handling and mitigating challenges, ensuring high quality silicon while adhering to the schedules based on business needs. 

- Should have in-depth understanding of ESD, LU and other IC level issues and be able to define protection for the I/O ring for the IC

Qualifications

Minimum Requirements: 

- Bachelor's or master's degree in electrical engineering

- 12+ years in Analog Circuit Design experience

- Solid understanding and design experience of complex analog designs with full ownership. 

- Chip design, Verification, Silicon validation, debugs, Qual support and taking ICs to production. 

- Must be a technical leader and natural team player, mentor and should strive towards fostering a highly creative and productive working environment

Additional Information

Renesas is an embedded semiconductor solution provider driven by its Purpose, To Make Our Lives Easier. With a global team of over 21, 000 engineers and problem solvers in more than 30 countries, we offer the opportunity to work on world‐leading technology for Automotive, Industrial, Infrastructure, and IoT, shaping a safer, healthier, greener, and smarter future. 

At Renesas, TAGIE is our culture, grounded in being Transparent, Agile, Global, Innovative, and Entrepreneurial. It shapes how we work, grow and deliver on our purpose together. This collaborative spirit and mindset drive our semiconductor technology to transform industries and impact millions of lives. 

We believe in rewarding our employees with a competitive benefits package alongside their salary. More information will be provided during the hiring process. 

Are you ready to join our team and shape the future with us?

Renesas Electronics is an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer, committed to supporting diversity and fostering a work environment free of discrimination on the basis of sex, race, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, sexual orientation, military status, veteran status, or any other basis protected by law. For more information, please read our Diversity & Inclusion Statement.

data.title: Manager, Compiler Engineering - GPU
data.description:
We are now seeking a SW Engineering Manager with strong leadership and mentoring skills to join our GPU Compilers Team. We craft outstanding compilers that realise the potential of NVIDIA's GPUs designed for solving worlds most complex problem. Our Compiler team is responsible for constructing and emitting the highest performance GPU machine instructions for Graphics (OpenGL, Vulkan, DX) and Compute (CUDA, PTX, OpenCL, Fortran, C++). This team is comprised of worldwide leading compiler engineering experts who provide leading edge performance and capabilities for NVIDIA's current and future complex parallel SIMT architectures. 

In this role you will solve critical problems working alongside an outstanding engineering team with vision in Compiler technology and systems software, doing what you enjoy! Our compiler organisation makes its mark on every GPU and SoC product that NVIDIA builds. Would you like to be part of this outstanding organisation?

data.title: Principal Rust Engineer – Language Runtime
data.description:
We are Progress (Nasdaq: PRGS) - the trusted provider of software that enables our customers to develop, deploy and manage responsible, AI-powered applications and experience with agility and ease. 

We're proud to have a diverse, global team where we value the individual and enrich our culture by considering varied perspectives because we believe people power progress. Join us as a Principal Rust Engineer and help us do what we do best: propelling business forward. Know more about us. 

We are building a production language runtime in Rust - compiler, virtual machine, wire protocol client, and application server. You will join as a long-term technical owner of this system, working alongside experienced platform architects and a second FTE Rust engineer. 

In This Role, You Will

Runtime & VM

- Implement and optimize an async register-based virtual machine with cooperative scheduling and built-in function dispatch. 
 - Translate language semantics from a reference C implementation into idiomatic, correct Rust. 

Compiler

- Extend a multi-stage compiler pipeline (lexer, parser, AST, IR, codegen). 
 - Deliver new language features end-to-end with conformance and property-based tests. 

Protocol & Data Layer

- Extend a binary wire protocol implementation reverse-engineered from C source. 
 - Own TLS, authentication, and connection pooling. 

Async & Networking

- Maintain a Tokio-based async runtime handling thousands of concurrent requests with shared state and admission control. 
 - Contribute to HTTP, WebSocket, and gRPC server layers. 

Engineering & Build

- Manage a large multi-crate Cargo workspace - dependency hygiene, CI performance, and release engineering. 

Team Enablement

- Mentor senior engineers (20+ years platform experience) adopting Rust - teaching-oriented code reviews, pair programming, and progressive ownership handoff. 
 - Document architecture decisions and maintain design docs as first-class deliverables. 

Your Background

- Overall 10+ years of Software Engineering Experience
 - 5+ years production Rust in systems software (runtimes, compilers, databases, or networking). 
 - Compiler or language runtime experience - at least one of: parser, AST/IR, bytecode compiler, VM, or interpreter. 
 - Async Rust at scale - Tokio, shared-state concurrency, cancellation safety. 
 - Large multi-crate workspace fluency. 
 - Ability to read large C codebases and derive correct Rust implementations. 
 - Mentorship mindset - patience, clear communication, progressive handoff. 
 - Long-term ownership orientation - multi-year commitment. 
 - Excellent written and verbal English. 
 - CS degree or equivalent (data structures, algorithms, OS, compilers)

Additionally, It Would Be Beneficial If You Have

- VM design - opcode dispatch, cooperative scheduling, register allocation. 
 - Binary protocol reverse-engineering and zero-copy parsing. 
 - Property-based testing (proptest, quickcheck). 
 - Concurrent data structures - DashMap, Moka, lock-free patterns. 
 - Axum / Tower / WebSocket server experience. 
 - Developer tooling protocols (LSP, DAP). 
 - Observability - tracing, OpenTelemetry, Prometheus. 
 - Database connectivity - pooling, transactions, schema resolution. 
 - Experience onboarding engineering teams into Rust. 
 - AI-assisted development tools (Copilot, Claude). 

Compensation

If this sounds like you and fits your experience and career goals, we'd be happy to chat. What we offer in return is the opportunity to experience a great company culture with wonderful colleagues to learn from and collaborate with, and also to enjoy: 

- Competitive remuneration package

data.title: Staff / Principal engineer -Multi-Die Advanced Tech PPA Methodology Automation
data.description:
Job Overview

Arm is at the forefront of advanced silicon and multi-die system design. As part of the Solutions Engineering team, you will drive sub-2nm technology PPA enablement for high-performance and low-power products. 

In this role, you will work closely with architecture, RTL, IP, physical design, DTCO, foundry, EDA, and package/board teams to optimize technology-node entitlement across performance, power, area, utilization, routability, reliability, and design convergence. The role focuses on translating advanced-node technology capabilities into practical implementation methodologies, automation, and production-ready flows. 

You will help define and deliver end-to-end Technology - PA solutions for future Arm products, including advanced-node SoCs, ultra-low voltage designs, and multi-die systems. 

Responsibilities

- Drive technology PPA enablement for sub-2nm and future process nodes, with focus on performance, power, area, utilization, routability, and PPA convergence. 
 - Develop scalable methodologies and automation to evaluate and optimize technology-node tradeoffs across libraries, memories, routing resources, power delivery, clocking, design rules, and implementation constraints. 
 - Drive cross-functional analysis of technology PPA limiters, including congestion, IR/EM, thermal, timing, leakage, dynamic power, area efficiency, and physical verification closure. 
 - Deliver multi-die and 2. 5D/3D implementation enablement where technology-node, package, power, and thermal tradeoffs impact product PPA. 
 - Hand-on execution and delivery demonstrating achieving goals. 
 - Build AI-assisted automation and analytics to accelerate PPA exploration, recipe optimization, debug, and design closure. 
 - Partner with IP, DTCO, foundry, EDA, architecture, design, and physical implementation teams to identify technology entitlement gaps and drive improvements. 
 - Support production execution by converting technology learnings into repeatable flows, checks, dashboards, and sign-off readiness criteria. 

Required Skills and Experience

- Strong expertise in advanced-node SoC physical implementation, technology PPA optimization, and implementation methodology development. 
 - Strong understanding of technology-node tradeoffs, including libraries, memories, routing resources, utilization, power delivery, clocking, congestion, timing, leakage, dynamic power, and physical verification constraints. 
 - Solid programming and scripting skills, including Python, C, EDA tools, version control systems such as Git, and distributed processing/debug environments. 
 - Hands-on experience with low-power design methodologies, UPF-based design, chip finishing, and physical verification flows in advanced process technologies. 
 - Excellent problem-solving, communication, and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively across globally distributed teams. 
 - Proven ability to lead technical initiatives and collaborate with internal engineering teams, foundries, EDA providers, and ecosystem partners. 

Nice to Have

- Deep understanding of advanced clocking structures, power delivery optimization, and physical verification convergence techniques. 
 - Familiarity with AI-assisted design automation and methodology optimization flows. 

Our 10x Mindset

At Arm, we believe progress happens when people are empowered to think bigger and push beyond what seems possible. Our 10x mindset is about curiosity, ambition and creating impact that will be used by millions. We learn fast, prioritise collaboration and turn bold ideas into real technology. We look for people who are inspired by this way of working and want to grow in an environment where bold ideas are welcomed. Discover how the 10x mindset shapes life at Arm: https: //careers. arm. com/10x-mindset

Use of AI in Your Application

At Arm, we embrace the benefits AI can bring, including in recruitment. You may use AI to support your preparation, such as improving the clarity of written responses, practicing interview questions, or learning more about our industry. However, your application and interview responses must reflect your own thinking, experience, and abilities. We want to understand your authentic perspective, creativity, and approach to problem solving. As such, you may not use AI to complete assigned tasks as part of any assessments. If you plan to use AI-supported or assistive technologies as part of a reasonable adjustment, please contact accommodations@arm. com so we can support you. 

Recruitment Adjustments and Accommodations

At Arm, we want to build extraordinary teams. If you need an adjustment or an accommodation during the recruitment process, please email accommodations@arm. com . To note, by sending us the requested information, you consent to its use by Arm to arrange for appropriate accommodations. All accommodation or adjustment requests will be treated with confidentiality, and information concerning these requests will only be disclosed as necessary to provide the accommodation. Although this is not an exhaustive list, examples of support include breaks between interviews, having documents read aloud, or office accessibility. Please email us about anything we can do to accommodate you during the recruitment process. 

Hybrid Working

Arm's approach to hybrid working is designed to create a working environment that supports both high performance and personal wellbeing. We believe in bringing people together face to face to enable us to work at pace, whilst recognizing the value of flexibility. Within that framework, we empower groups/teams to determine their own hybrid working patterns, depending on the work and the team's needs.
