data.title: NoC Design Lead
data.description:
(×2 openings) Location: Bangalore, India

|

Company: LTSCT - L&T Semiconductor Technologies Limited Reporting To: Chandra - Senior Architect, DC HW Systems

|

Experience: 10+ years (mandatory) Role Summary We are hiring two NoC Design Leads to own the stacked Network-on-Chip that forms the data backbone of xPU - 4 physical planes delivering 12 TB/s cross-section bandwidth. You will architect and implement coherency, routing, QoS, and bandwidth allocation across the BFOS arrays, banked SRAM, HBM controllers, UCIe links, and the host interface. This role is central to sustaining the extreme bandwidth and latency targets the compute architecture demands. Key Responsibilities

- Architect and implement the 4-plane stacked NoC delivering 12 TB/s cross-section bandwidth across all on-chip and off-chip endpoints. 
 - Define topology, routing algorithms, virtual channels, and arbitration to guarantee deadlock-free, high-throughput data movement. 
 - Design QoS and bandwidth-allocation mechanisms balancing traffic between dual BFOS arrays, 512 SRAM banks, HBM controllers, UCIe, and host. 
 - Own the on-chip coherency protocol and its interaction with SRAM, HBM, and the host-interface coherency layer. 
 - Drive micro-architecture, RTL, and integration of routers, network interfaces, buffers, and clock-domain crossings. 
 - Model and analyze latency, bandwidth, and congestion via cycle-accurate simulation and traffic generators; close performance targets. 
 - Collaborate with PD on floorplan-aware NoC partitioning across the 4 physical planes and with DFT/verification on coverage. 
 - Define QoR/performance metrics, mentor engineers, and represent NoC in architecture and integration reviews. Required Skills & Experience
 - 10+ years designing on-chip interconnects/NoCs or coherent fabrics for high-performance SoCs. 
 - Deep understanding of NoC topologies (mesh, torus, crossbar, stacked/multi-plane), routing, flow control, and QoS. 
 - Strong grasp of cache-coherency protocols (MESI/MOESI-class, directory-based) and memory-consistency models. 
 - Expertise in RTL design (SystemVerilog) of routers, arbiters, buffers, and asynchronous/CDC interfaces. 
 - Hands-on performance modeling and analysis - cycle-accurate simulation, traffic modeling, bandwidth/latency closure. 
 - Experience with commercial or in-house NoC generators/IP and their integration methodology. 
 - Familiarity with high-bandwidth memory (HBM) and chiplet interconnect (UCIe) traffic characteristics. 
 - Proficiency in scripting (Python/Perl) for performance analysis and verification support. 
 - Strong micro-architecture, specification, and documentation skills. 
 - Demonstrated technical leadership and cross-team collaboration. Preferred Qualifications
 - Experience with multi-plane or 3D-stacked NoC architectures. 
 - Background in AI accelerator or GPU dataflow interconnects. 
 - Familiarity with formal verification of coherency/deadlock properties. 
 - M. Tech/MS in EE/ECE/CS or equivalent.

data.title: Team Lead, ADM Operations
data.description:
Who We Are

Addepar is a global data and AI platform empowering investment professionals to turn complex financial information into actionable intelligence. Addepar unifies portfolio, market and client data in a total portfolio view and delivers AI-powered insights within investment and client workflows. More than 1, 500 firms in 60 countries use Addepar to manage and advise on nearly $10 trillion in assets. Its open platform integrates with 650 software, data and consulting partners to power end-to-end investment operations across firms of all sizes and levels of complexity. Addepar supports clients worldwide with offices in New York City, Salt Lake City, São Paulo, London, Edinburgh, Geneva, Warsaw, Dubai, Pune and Singapore. 

The Role

Addepar has just launched an Alternatives Product offering that gives Addepar clients the option to have their Private Funds data extracted, processed, validated, and ingested directly from Private Fund documents for a more automated end-to-end solution for handling Alternatives on the platform. This white-glove solution combines proprietary machine learning technology that automatically extracts data from Private Funds documents and human-in-loop review to validate any documents that fail to pass confidence and data quality checks. 

As part of the broader Addepar Data organization, the Alternatives Data Ops team is responsible for the human-in-loop review of Private Funds documents, ensuring clients' Alternatives data is processed, validated, and available in Addepar in a timely manner. This role will include managing a team and reviewing Private Fund statements, modifying data that has been incorrectly extracted by our machine learning models, and reprocessing the data within SLAs. The Alternatives Data Ops team plays a critical role in the success of Addepar's Alternatives offering and requires daily communications with the Alternatives Product Team, Machine Learning Operations, clients, data providers (GPs and Fund Admins), and additional personnel across the organization. 

Applicants must have legal authorization to work in the country where this role is based on the first day of employment. Visa sponsorship is not available for this position. 

What You'll Do

- Lead and manage a team of Analysts & Senior Analysts ensuring effective work allocation, timely delivery. 
 - Act as a Subject matter expert & support the team on complex document processing
 - Guide and oversee the team in troubleshooting complex Private Fund statement processing exceptions
 - Perform quality reviews and assist the team in modifying incorrectly extracted data

data.title: Robotics & Automation Engineer
data.description:
Job Summary

We are seeking a Robotics & Automation Engineer to design, develop, and test robotic mechanisms, motion-control systems, sensor integration, and semi-autonomous positioning capabilities for Eco-Scanner. 

The candidate will work on intelligent mechanical movement, motorized alignment, sensor feedback, automated calibration support, and hardware-software integration to help transform the existing prototype into a reliable, intelligent diagnostic platform. 

Key Responsibilities

•

Design and develop robotic mechanisms and automation systems for medical-device positioning and alignment. 

•

Integrate servo motors, stepper motors, actuators, encoders, IMUs, proximity sensors, and other suitable sensing components. 

•

Develop closed-loop motion-control algorithms for accurate and repeatable positioning. 

•

Implement sensor-assisted alignment of imaging components within predefined mechanical and safety limits. 

•

Develop semi-autonomous positioning and correction functions based on sensor feedback and system measurements. 

•

Build operator-guidance features that detect positioning errors and recommend appropriate corrective actions. 

•

Integrate motor controllers, microcontrollers, embedded processors, and robotics software with the Eco-Scanner hardware platform. 

•

Develop calibration routines, motion sequences, homing procedures, and fault-detection mechanisms. 

•

Implement safety interlocks, movement limits, emergency-stop functionality, and appropriate collision-prevention measures. 

•

Evaluate system repeatability, positioning accuracy, mechanical stability, response time, and operational reliability. 

•

Collaborate with embedded systems, mechanical design, AI/ML, and biomedical engineering teams to improve system performance. 

•

Develop simulation models, prototypes, test procedures, technical documentation, and engineering reports. 

•

Support the development of future robotic accessories and modular automation capabilities for diagnostic applications. 

Required Qualifications

•

B. Tech/B. E. or M. Tech in Robotics, Mechatronics, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Communication Engineering, Automation, or a related discipline. 

•

Foundational knowledge of robotics, kinematics, sensors, actuators, and motion-control systems. 

•

Programming proficiency in Python, C++, or embedded C. 

•

Understanding of feedback control, motor drivers, microcontrollers, and hardware-software integration. 

•

Ability to troubleshoot electromechanical systems and conduct practical experiments. 

•

Strong analytical, problem-solving, and multidisciplinary collaboration skills. 

Preferred Skills

•

Experience with ROS 2, MoveIt, Gazebo, or other robotics simulation and development frameworks. 

•

Familiarity with PID control, encoder feedback, coordinate transformations, and trajectory planning. 

•

Experience with STM32, ESP32, ARM-based systems, PLCs, or industrial motion controllers. 

•

Knowledge of computer vision, sensor fusion, IMUs, depth sensing, or machine-vision-based alignment. 

•

Familiarity with CAD tools, rapid prototyping, 3D printing, and electromechanical assembly. 

•

Exposure to medical robotics, imaging systems, laboratory automation, or safety-critical automation. 

Key Development Objectives

The engineer will contribute to: 

1. 

Sensor-guided positioning and alignment of relevant imaging components. 

2. 

Semi-autonomous correction of detected positioning errors within validated limits. 

3. 

Automated calibration assistance and system-status monitoring. 

4. 

Reliable motion control with operator override and safety interlocks. 

5. 

Integration of robotics and automation features into the Eco-Scanner modular platform. 

Ideal Candidate

We are looking for a hands-on engineer who enjoys building real robotic systems, integrating sensors and actuators, developing control algorithms, and converting experimental prototypes into functional engineering solutions. 

Fresh graduates with strong robotics projects, competition experience, internships, or working prototypes are encouraged to apply. 

What We Offer

•

An opportunity to develop robotics and automation technologies for a healthcare innovation. 

•

Hands-on involvement in prototype development, motion control, intelligent sensing, and system integration. 

•

Collaboration with multidisciplinary hardware, AI, software, and biomedical teams. 

•

Opportunities to take ownership of engineering projects and grow with the company. 

•

Performance-based salary increments and promotion opportunities within six months, subject to performance evaluation and company policy. 

Application Requirements

Applicants should submit a resume describing relevant robotics projects, automation systems, control algorithms, embedded programming, CAD designs, or working prototypes. 

Safety Considerations

All automated movement and alignment functions must operate within validated mechanical and operational limits. Medical imaging workflows must include appropriate safety interlocks, operator supervision, and applicable radiation-safety controls. Autonomous movement must not compromise patient safety or imaging quality.

Job Description

The Principal Software Engineer on this Experience team drives the visual modernization of an established application with a Vue front end backed by PHP, where newer pages are built in Vue and legacy pages remain in jQuery, as part of isolved's Suite Experience initiative. This is a hands-on senior development role focused on refreshing and elevating the user interface of a live product: modern, responsive, and accessible interfaces delivered within the application's existing technology stack. This is a visual modernization effort, not a ground-up rewrite. You will improve the experience of a running application where it lives, which means you pair strong, transferable front-end engineering fundamentals with real depth in the application's stack. A significant part of the work is modernizing legacy jQuery pages into modern, component-based Vue. 

This role requires strong architecture thinking, but the day-to-day is hands-on coding, not high-level design from a distance. The expectation is that you design solutions and then implement them yourself. Our modernization strategy is built on hiring fewer, highly senior engineers who use AI-assisted development as a force multiplier, and we expect you to leverage agentic coding, spec-driven development, and AI-augmented code review as a core part of how you work, including to ramp quickly on an unfamiliar codebase. You will partner closely with product management and UX to translate experience goals into performant, consistent, and maintainable interfaces, and you will integrate cleanly with isolved's evolving service architecture. 

Core Job Duties

- Refreshing and elevating the interface within a Vue and PHP application, including modernizing legacy jQuery pages into modern, component-based Vue, while preserving existing behavior Building modern, responsive, and accessible UI improvements with a focus on performance and consistency
 - Establishing and elevating front-end quality across the team, including component structure, CSS architecture, state management, and performance
 - Performing code reviews to ensure front-end implementations meet quality standards and follow established patterns
 - Collaborating with product management and UX design to translate experience goals into scalable technical solutions
 - Identifying and resolving performance bottlenecks in the UI layer, including load times, rendering performance, and client-side resource management
 - Integrating cleanly with backend services through RESTful APIs
 - Raising the bar on modern front-end development practices across the team through code reviews, pairing, and leading by example
 - Using AI-assisted development tools, including agentic coding, spec-driven development, and AI-augmented code review, as a core part of your daily workflow to maximize velocity and code quality, and to ramp quickly on unfamiliar legacy code

Job Complexity

data.title: SW QA Engineer - Simcenter Flightstream
data.description:
We are Siemens

Siemens Digital Industries Software is a leading provider of solutions for the design, simulation, and manufacture of products across many different industries. Formula 1 cars, skyscrapers, ships, space exploration vehicles, and many of the objects we see in our daily lives are being conceived and manufactured using our software. 

Siemens Digital Industries Software is seeking a talented and driven Software Quality Assurance Engineer to join our Quality Assurance team and contribute to the continued growth and development of our industry-leading CAE/CFD solutions. 

In this role, you will contribute across the software development lifecycle of Simcenter Flightstream, helping ensure the quality, accuracy, reliability, and robustness of capabilities used for aerodynamic, hydrodynamic, and multidisciplinary analysis. 

As a key member of the Quality Assurance team, you will independently design, develop, and execute manual and automated test cases, validate software capabilities delivered by the Development team, and analyze complex technical results. You will combine strong engineering knowledge with a quality mindset to identify issues, assess risks, improve test coverage, and continuously enhance testing tools and processes. 

The ideal candidate has a strong foundation in aerodynamics, CFD, or aircraft design, combined with excellent analytical thinking, attention to detail, problem-solving skills, and programming ability. 

Key Responsibilities

- Validate complex engineering capabilities: Design and develop comprehensive test cases to evaluate aerodynamic, hydrodynamic, and multidisciplinary capabilities, ensuring software results are accurate, reliable, and consistent with expected engineering behavior. 
 - Develop automated regression testing: Create, maintain, and improve automated regression tests to identify unintended changes and ensure the stability of Simcenter Flightstream capabilities across software releases. 
 - Analyze and communicate technical results: Analyze test results, investigate unexpected behavior, and prepare clear technical reports using visualizations, key performance indicators, and other relevant data. 
 - Ensure release quality: Thoroughly test software releases, assess quality and technical risks, document test execution results, and communicate findings and recommendations to relevant stakeholders. 
 - Investigate and manage defects: Identify, reproduce, document, and track software defects; communicate risks effectively and collaborate with Development teams to support timely investigation and resolution. 
 - Improve quality engineering practices: Identify opportunities to improve test coverage, automation, tools, and processes, contributing to the continuous improvement of the overall QA approach. 
 - Collaborate globally: Work effectively with a globally distributed and cross-functional team, contributing technical expertise and participating in projects across Quality Assurance, Development, and other engineering functions. 

Qualifications

- Master's degree in Aeronautical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Ocean Engineering, or a related technical discipline. 
 - Strong academic background or professional experience in Computational Fluid Dynamics (CFD), aerodynamics, hydrodynamics, aircraft design, or related engineering disciplines. 
 - Solid understanding of aerodynamics and CFD workflows, including the ability to analyze engineering results and identify unexpected or potentially incorrect behavior. 
 - Knowledge of panel methods, vortex-lattice methods, or other reduced-order aerodynamic methods. 
 - Experience designing, executing, or analyzing complex engineering test cases, simulations, or validation studies. 
 - Programming or scripting experience using Python, C++, Java, or similar languages, with the ability to develop or maintain automated testing and analysis solutions. 
 - Strong analytical, problem-solving, and attention-to-detail skills, combined with excellent verbal and written communication skills in English. 

Preferred Skills

- Hands-on experience with Simcenter Flightstream and/or Simcenter STAR-CCM+, including the ability to create, configure, analyze, and troubleshoot complex simulation cases. 
 - Experience with software quality assurance, validation, verification, or regression testing of engineering or scientific software. 
 - Experience managing or troubleshooting Windows and Linux test environments. 
 - Experience creating technical reports, visualizations, and engineering performance indicators. 
 - Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively in a globally distributed and matrix organization. 
 - Strong ownership mindset, self-motivation, and commitment to continuous learning and technical development. 

Why Us

At Siemens Software, flexibility is how we work - hybrid by default, built on trust and autonomy. Together, 30, 000 people across more than 200 countries build technology that shapes the real world. You'll grow through real projects, strong technical peers, and global mobility, backed by the scale and benefits of an industrial software leader. We're committed to equality and inclusion, and we hire based on merit, skills, and impact. Bring your curiosity and creativity and help us shape tomorrow!

data.title: Principal Software Architect
data.description:
About The Role

We are looking for a technically strong software engineering leader to own software quality, architecture and integrated delivery across our India software organisation. Our robots depend on multiple software disciplines working together reliably. You will help shape technology strategy and organisational direction, and translate that into sound architectural decisions, strong engineering practices and dependable execution. This is a hands-on leadership role combining technical depth, people management and accountability for outcomes. 

Location: Bengaluru, Karnataka, Reports to: Chief Technology Officer

- Experience: 10+ years

About Us

We are building robots to maintain, organise and reset common public and commercial spaces - offices, campuses, venues and other high-traffic facilities. We are building a hybrid end-to-end architecture where classical and modern methods work together for maximum reliability and robustness, with R&D in Bengaluru and Wellington, New Zealand. 

What You Will Do

Technology direction and architecture: help shape technology strategy and drive architecture decisions across robot software, cloud services, data processing and model training infrastructure. Own system-level requirements - latency, compute and memory budgets, end-to-end reliability. Establish clear interfaces and component ownership, and resolve technical trade-offs across the stack. 

Software quality, security and engineering practices: set and embed standards for code quality, testing, documentation, observability and secure development. Own the software security review and audit process across robot and cloud systems, working with specialists where needed. Build quality into everyday development through effective reviews, automated validation and measurable acceptance criteria. 

Integrated software delivery: own delivery across teams, turning product priorities into realistic plans with clear commitments, dependencies and milestones. Resolve execution bottlenecks and hold teams accountable for working software and demonstrated robot behaviour. 

Integration, resilience and release readiness: own integration and release readiness across robot software, cloud services, and data and training pipelines, including Kubernetes. Define and validate behaviour during connectivity loss, service degradation and component failures, including safe fallback, recovery and rollback. Establish reproducible builds and simulation, hardware-in-the-loop, on-robot and cloud testing. 

Hands-on technical leadership: stay close to implementation through critical design and code work, complex debugging and direct involvement in the most consequential technical problems. 

People and team development: lead and develop engineers and technical leads; build capability through hiring, coaching, clear performance expectations and stronger technical ownership. 

Cross-team alignment: bring teams together around shared technical decisions and delivery outcomes, including teams outside your reporting line. 

Experience

- At least 10 years in robotics or AI, including technical leadership roles
 - Strong understanding of autonomy systems such as VLA/VLM models, SLAM, planning, perception and ML-based decision-making
 - Python, C++, ROS, and ML stacks such as PyTorch or TensorFlow
 - Experience with robotics, embedded systems, autonomous systems or comparable products where software interacts with physical hardware
 - Practical experience improving automated testing, continuous integration, release processes and production reliability
 - Evidence of delivering programmes spanning multiple teams, including teams outside your reporting line
 - Experience architecting and operating cloud platforms, containerised workloads, and large-scale data processing or model training pipelines

What Success Looks Like

- Teams deliver predictably against a shared plan, with clear ownership and fewer late integration surprises
 - Architecture supports product goals and makes the software easier to extend, test and maintain
 - Releases produce measurable improvements in robot behaviour and reliability
 - Recurring failures, escaped defects and avoidable engineering rework decrease
 - Engineers and technical leads grow in capability, ownership and execution independence

Skills: - Robotics, Software architecture, Autonomy systems, ROS, C++, Python, Kubernetes, Cloud platforms, CI/CD, Software security, Engineering leadership and Hardware-in-the-loop testing

L'ingénierie des systèmes est une discipline d'ingénierie interfonctionnelle axée sur une approche, un état d'esprit et un processus. Processus allant du concept à l'exploitation en passant par la production.

data.title: Sr Construction & Commissioning Manager HVDC
data.description:
Job Description Summary

The Senior HVDC Construction and Commissioning Manager is accountable for the strategic oversight, technical leadership, and overall management of site execution teams. This role provides technical and project leadership for the planning, coordination, construction, installation, testing, and commissioning of High Voltage Direct Current (HVDC) projects. The position requires periodic travel to project sites, particularly during critical construction & commissioning phases and major shutdown or outage events. 

This role ensures that project execution is delivered safely, on schedule, within budget, and in compliance with technical specifications, quality standards, and contractual requirements. 

Job Description

Construction Management

- Support on-site construction activities for HVDC converter stations, substations, cable systems, and associated infrastructure with primary responsibility of managing commissioning. 
 - Coordinate site managers, subcontractors, and suppliers to achieve commissioning milestones. 
 - Oversee installation of major equipment such as converters, transformers, valves, reactors, GIS/AIS equipment, cooling systems, and control/protection systems. 

Technical Leadership

- Development of the work methodology and detailed day-to-day execution plan for the refurbishment of HVDC components (Valves and Control Systems) in alignment with the approved outage schedule. 
 - Oversee commissioning of HVDC converter systems, transformers, valves, switchgear, smoothing reactors, cooling systems, AC/DC yard equipment, and control/protection systems. 
 - Lead troubleshooting and root-cause analysis for issues encountered during testing and energization. 
 - Ensure technical compliance with design documents, grid code requirements, contractual specifications, and industry standards. 
 - Support engineering teams in resolving design changes, non-conformances, and site technical queries. 

Commissioning Management

- Development of pre-commissioning and commissioning documentation, checklists, and reporting formats. 
 - Plan and manage pre-commissioning, commissioning, energization, and performance testing activities for HVDC systems. 
 - Coordinate system integration and interface testing between electrical, control, protection, telecom, and SCADA systems. 
 - Ensure commissioning procedures, test protocols, and acceptance criteria are developed, reviewed, and approved. 
 - Lead troubleshooting and resolution of technical issues during testing and energization. 
 - Support handover of commissioned systems to the client and operations team. 

Environment, Health, & Safety (EHS) and Quality

- Promote and enforce a strong safety culture across all site activities. 
 - Ensure compliance with EHS regulations, permit-to-work systems, lockout/tagout procedures, and project-specific safety requirements. 
 - Ensure all construction and commissioning work meets applicable quality standards, codes, and contractual obligations. 

Stakeholder Coordination and Reporting

- Serve as the main point of contact for commissioning-related matters with the client, project management, OEMs, and grid operators. 
 - Participate in progress reviews, readiness assessments, and milestone meetings. 
 - Report commissioning progress, issues, risks, and recovery plans to project leadership. 
 - Support final acceptance testing, handover, and project closeout activities. 

Documentation and Compliance

- Ensure site documentation is complete and up to date, including inspection records, test reports, punch lists, and as-built documentation. 
 - Verify compliance with grid codes, customer specifications, and applicable international standards. 
 - Support factory acceptance tests (FAT), site acceptance tests (SAT), and final project documentation closure. 

Required Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Power Engineering, or a related technical discipline. 
 - Extensive experience in HVDC, substations, power transmission, or large utility-scale electrical infrastructure projects. 
 - Strong experience in both construction management and commissioning of high-voltage electrical systems. 
 - Proven knowledge of converter stations, protection and control systems, testing procedures, and energization processes. 
 - Proven ability to manage multi-disciplinary teams in a remote/distributed capacity. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience managing large, complex EPC or turnkey HVDC projects. 
 - Knowledge of LCC and/or VSC HVDC technologies. 
 - Experience working with multinational teams, contractors, and clients across multiple geographies. 
 - Ability to interpret technical drawings, specifications, and commissioning procedures. 
 - Strong data analysis skills for reporting project performance, risks, and recovery plans. 

Typical Experience Profile

- 15+ years of experience in power transmission, substation, or HVDC projects
 - 8+ years in a site leadership, construction management, or commissioning leadership role

data.title: Senior CQV Engineer
data.description:
At Jacobs, we're challenging today to reinvent tomorrow by solving the world's most critical problems for thriving cities, resilient environments, mission-critical outcomes, operational advancement, scientific discovery and cutting-edge manufacturing, turning abstract ideas into realities that transform the world for good. 

Your impact

The Sr. CQV Engineer will be responsible for leading the efforts for commissioning, qualification, and validation of equipment/ systems, and processes in the production of Drug substances/ Drug Product/ Sterile Facilities/ API/ OSDs, as well as the Utility system, HVAC system and Area. 

The role will require the leadership of an experienced, energetic, and committed Senior CQV person with broad experience in C&Q, particularly biopharmaceuticals. 

The person should have experience of leading a team of CQV engineers for a project and managing the C&Q documentation and execution lifecycle from SLIA generation through to OQ completion. The lead will work closely with cross-functional teams, including engineering, quality assurance, and manufacturing, to support the successful delivery of projects. 

Key Responsibilities

- Lead and coordinate CQV projects, ensuring timely execution and compliance with industry regulations. 
 - To prepare C&Q plans in line with the strategic goals of the client and manage timely and compliant delivery of the plan. 
 - Ensure all commissioning and qualification procedures are implemented and adhered to at office and at site level. 
 - Track progress of C&Q activities as required and provide regular project updates and status reports to stakeholders. 
 - Ensure effective resource planning, including coordinating materials, spares and consumables for commissioning and qualification activities. 
 - Identify and mitigate project risks while ensuring project deliverables meet required quality and compliance standards. 
 - Provide leadership in team meetings and facilitate problem-solving discussions to ensure project milestones are met. 
 - Act as the primary point of contact between clients, internal teams, and external vendors to drive project success. 
 - Management of Contractors and Vendors, document control, punch list management. 
 - Participate in design, constructability, and commissioning reviews to ensure technical aspects are covered in the Commissioning Plan and schedule. 
 - Well versed with risk-based approaches to C&Q (e. g. , ASTM E2500, ISPE)
 - Conduct risk assessments and gap analysis for process equipments/ systems, facilities and utilities, to identify critical process parameters and control strategies. 
 - Developing system boundaries for the system at an early stage of C&Q. 
 - Complete the development, review and execution of validation plans, URSs/DQ/TMs/FATs/SATs/IQ/OQ protocols/reports. 
 - Experienced in commissioning and qualifying CIP & SIP systems. 
 - Participate in design document reviews and ensure that quality aspects are included in design. 
 - Review vendor documents (CTOPs/ VTOPs) to support commissioning and qualification requirements. 
 - Ensures C&Q non-conformances or deviations are minimized during execution of CQV activities. For issues that do arise ensure they are closed out in a timely manner. 
 - Track and confirm closure of actions items identified through FAT, HAZOP, Design Qualification and other reviews. 
 - Perform shakedown during commissioning and qualification of systems on site. 
 - Field Walkdowns of systems as part of transfer of ownership of the system from Construction. 
 - System Startup activities

Working Conditions

- The position requires travel and/ or deputation to other sites or manufacturing facilities. 
 - Ability to work in a cleanroom environment and adhere to gowning requirements. 
 - Flexibility to work outside of regular business hours as needed to support project timelines

Here's what you'll need

- Bachelor's degree in engineering, Life Sciences, or a related field. Advanced degree preferred. B. Pharm. , M. Pharm. , B. Tech or BE or MSc. 
 - 10-15 year's experience in CQV within the pharmaceutical or biotechnology industry, specifically in drug substance manufacturing. 
 - Candidates must have proven experience of carrying out commissioning and qualification activities on multiple projects. 
 - Have functioned as CQV Lead level for at least one Project. 

Technical Skills

- Experience with paperless validation software such as KNEAT and/ or Valgenesis. 
 - In-depth knowledge of cGMP, FDA, EMA, and other relevant regulatory requirements. 
 - Strong project management skills with the ability to handle multiple priorities across national and international locations. 
 - Experience with process validation and computer system validation. 
 - Experience on DCS/ PCS system such as Delta-V, 800xA, etc. 
 - Familiarity with Construction management software such as EIDA, PIMS, Aconex, is an advantage. 
 - Familiarity with paperless validation software such as KNEAT and Valgenesis is an advantage. 

Soft Skills

- Strong problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and a results-oriented mindset. 
 - Strong project management and organizational skills. 
 - Effective communication and interpersonal skills. 
 - Ability to work independently and as part of a team. 

At Jacobs we value people. Having the right balance of belonging, career and lifestyle enables us to consistently deliver and exceed clients' expectations. 

Working alongside industry leaders, you will have the opportunity to develop your career working on key projects in an environment which encourages collaboration, knowledge sharing and innovation. To support your professional growth, Jacobs flexible working arrangements, extended leave options and a host of social, health and wellbeing events and initiatives will underpin our commitment to you. 

At Jacobs it's all about what you do, not where you are, which counts!

We value collaboration and believe that in-person interactions are crucial for both our culture and client delivery. We empower employees with our hybrid working policy, allowing them to split their work week between Jacobs offices/projects and remote locations enabling them to deliver their best work. 

Your application experience is important to us, and we're keen to adapt to make every interaction even better. If you require further support or reasonable adjustments with regards to the recruitment process (for example, you require the application form in a different format), please contact the team via Careers Support.

data.title: FMI Lead Program Integrator
data.description:
Job Description Summary

We are seeking a hands-on FMI/Recall Program Leader who can independently take complex field-action programs from initiation through closure in a highly regulated environment. This individual will convert ambiguity into clear execution plans, drive global cross-functional alignment, maintain control of schedule, cost, risk, compliance and closure readiness, and deliver predictable program outcomes with minimal leadership intervention. 

The successful candidate combines strong program execution with sound judgement, effectively distinguishing issues that can be resolved within the team from those requiring escalation. When escalation is necessary, they bring clear recommendations, decision options and business impact assessments rather than simply reporting issues. 

In addition to program delivery, this role is expected to continuously improve the FMI/Recall operating model through Lean thinking, data-driven management, workflow simplification, digital enablement and responsible use of AI-enabled tools. 

GE HealthCare is a leading global medical technology and digital solutions innovator. Our mission is to improve lives in the moments that matter. Unlock your ambition, turn ideas into world-changing realities, and join an organization where every voice makes a difference, and every difference builds a healthier world. 

Job Description

Core responsibilities: 

FMI / Recall Program Leadership (85%)

- Own End-to-End Program ExecutionLead assigned FMI and Recall programs from initiation through applicable F5/F6 closure Milestones in accordance with approved Quality Management System procedures and program plans. Maintain complete accountability for execution, closure readiness and program outcomes. 
 - Develop and Execute Integrated Program PlansEstablish and maintain program plans, critical paths, milestones, resource forecasts, budget outlooks, governance mechanisms and execution strategies. Drive alignment across global stakeholders to deliver approved commitments. 
 - Lead Cross-Functional ExecutionServe as the primary program leader across Engineering, Quality, Regulatory Affairs, Service, Supply Chain, Product and regional stakeholders. Drive decisions, approvals, issue resolution and milestone achievement through influence and collaboration. 
 - Manage Risk, Ambiguity and EscalationsProactively identify risks, issues, dependencies and changes. Demonstrate sound judgement in determining when leadership escalation is required. Present clear recommendations, recovery options, business impacts and decision requirements to enable timely action. 
 - Drive Closure Readiness and ComplianceEnsure completion of reconciliation activities, objective evidence, approvals and regulatory-closure documentation. Maintain audit-ready program records and compliance with approved procedures. 
 - Operate a Disciplined Execution Management SystemLead a consistent Heartbeat operating rhythm using dashboards, program linearity, action ageing, visual management and fact-based performance reviews. Maintain accurate schedule, cost, quality, risk and closure-readiness information as the program source of truth. 
 - Lead Resources and Continuous ImprovementCoordinate execution priorities across Closure Analysts, consultants and external partners. Develop resource forecasts, manage utilisation and identify productivity, cycle-time and cost-to-serve improvements through Lean methodologies. 
 - Provide Leadership Visibility and Decision SupportDeliver concise, decision-oriented program updates, risk assessments, recommendations and recovery plans to functional and business leadership. Drive program to closure with minimal leadership intervention. 

Digital Enablement and Process Transformation (approximately 15%)

- Identify and prioritise opportunities for workflow simplification, automation, analytics and improved operational visibility across FMI/Recall processes. 
 - Partner with Digital, Software, Data, AI, Cybersecurity, Quality and Validation teams to define requirements and support solution deployment. 
 - Champion adoption, training, value realisation and responsible use of approved digital and AI-enabled solutions. 
 - Track and communicate measurable operational benefits from digital initiatives. 

Key performance outcomes

- Predictable achievement of approved field-action milestones and closure commitments. 
 - Improved program linearity, action ageing, risk visibility and escalation effectiveness. 
 - Complete, accurate and audit-ready execution and closure documentation. 
 - Clear program ownership with reduced leadership intervention in routine execution. 
 - Effective delivery and oversight of internal, consultant and partner resources. 
 - Measurable cycle-time, productivity, quality, cost or user-experience improvements from Lean and digital initiatives. 

Key Stakeholder Groups

- Collaborates across Engineering, Quality, Regulatory, Service, Operations, Finance, Digital, business leadership, and relevant external partners to drive program execution and closure

Educational Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Science, Business, Operations or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant experience where permitted by local policy. 

Required Skillsets

- At least 9+ years of experience in engineering, service, quality, operations, program/project management or a related field, including at least 5 years leading cross-functional projects or programs in a regulated environment. 
 - Demonstrated experience managing schedules, risks, actions, resources, budgets and stakeholder communication across complex programs. 
 - Strong execution discipline, organisational capability and ability to manage multiple concurrent priorities. 
 - Effective written and verbal communication, including presenting program status, risks and recommendations to leadership. 
 - Ability to influence without direct authority in a global, matrixed organisation. 
 - Fluent written and spoken English. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Working knowledge of medical-device Quality Management Systems, product lifecycle, risk management, ISO 13485, ISO 14971 or applicable post-market regulatory expectations. 
 - Experience supporting medical-device field actions, recalls, post-market programs, quality programs or regulated service deployments. 
 - Experience with Computed Tomography, Molecular Imaging, installed-base operations or software/service deployment. 
 - Experience overseeing consultants, contractors, closure analysts or external engineering/service partners. 
 - PMP, PMI-ACP, SAFe, Lean/Six Sigma or equivalent program-management or continuous-improvement certification. 
 - Experience supporting workflow automation, analytics, digital process improvement or AI-enabled business initiatives. 

Tools and systems

- Proficiency with Microsoft 365 collaboration and reporting tools. 
 - Experience with program planning, action tracking, dashboards or data-visualisation tools. 
 - Familiarity with quality, service, product lifecycle, installed-base or document-management systems is desirable. 
 - Ability to use approved digital and AI-enabled tools responsibly for productivity and decision support; software development expertise is not required. 

Leadership Expectations

- Takes ownership for outcomes, not activities. 
 - Demonstrates sound judgement in complex, ambiguous and time-sensitive situations. 
 - Influences across a global matrix organisation without formal authority. 
 - Creates clarity, alignment and momentum in highly cross-functional programs. 
 - Drives work to closure through disciplined execution and accountability. 

Inclusion and Diversity

GE Healthcare is an Equal Opportunity Employer where inclusion matters. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, national or ethnic origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, protected veteran status or other characteristics protected by law. 

We expect all employees to live and breathe our behaviors: to act with humility and build trust; lead with transparency; deliver with focus, and drive ownership - always with unyielding integrity. 

Our total rewards are designed to unlock your ambition by giving you the boost and flexibility you need to turn your ideas into world-changing realities. Our salary and benefits are everything you'd expect from an organization with global strength and scale, and you'll be surrounded by career opportunities in a culture that fosters care, collaboration and support.

You will own the pre-silicon development lifecycle-including driver development for CAN/CAN-FD/CAN XL stacks -using high-performance enterprise emulation environments and ensures hardware-software co-design that satisfies strict ISO 26262 safety and high-quality engineering frameworks up to ASIL-D. 

What You'll Achieve

Technical Leadership & Hardware Co-Design

- Drive firmware architecture and technical roadmaps for in-house microcontroller/ SOCs. 
 - Align development milestones with SoC architecture, RTL design, verification, and post-silicon validation teams. 
 - Provide technical mentorship and enforce rigorous coding standards (MISRA C/C++). 
 - Author comprehensive design specifications, firmware architecture documentation, and test strategies. 

Pre-Silicon Validation & Emulation

- Develop early boot code, low-level drivers, and runtime firmware targeting pre-silicon environments. 
 - Lead virtual bring-up and hardware-software co-verification using both enterprise emulation platforms like Cadence Palladium/ Synopsys ZeBu. 
 - Optimize firmware execution speed
 - Debug complex, deep-silicon anomalies using JTAG/SWD debuggers, logic analysers, and internal emulator trace features. 

Communication Drivers & Protocols

- Design, implement, and optimize highly robust peripheral drivers for CAN, CAN-FD, and CAN XL. 
 - Develop and maintain critical application layer protocols, featuring standard diagnostics (ISO 14229), network management, and heavy-duty diagnostic framing fault handling. 
 - Design, implement and Integrate communication driver stacks into industry standard layers (e. g. , AUTOSAR MCAL interfaces). 
 - Deep knowledge of priority-based identifier arbitration, bit-stuffing mechanisms, and cyclical redundancy check (CRC) validation

Safety & Quality Compliance

- Enforce absolute compliance with ISO 26262 safety requirements. 
 - Participate in safety analyses (FMEA, root cause analysis) to ensure driver-level fault-handling routines are deterministic. 

About You

- Bachelor's degree with 8 years or Master's degree with 6 years of experience in embedded firmware development, specifically within the embedded semiconductor or safety-critical industry
 - 3+ years acting as a Technical Lead or Principal Engineer guiding architectural decisions and mentoring engineering teams. 
 - Expert proficiency in Embedded C with strict adherence to MISRA guidelines. 
 - Deep knowledge of embedded MCU/SoC architectures, including ARM Cortex-M/R or multi-core safety architectures. 
 - Direct hands-on experience with hardware emulation platforms, specifically Cadence Palladium and/or Synopsys ZeBu systems
 - Authoritative understanding of industrial fieldbus architectures (ISO 11898 standard family), physical/data link layers, priority-based identifier arbitration, bit-stuffing mechanisms, and diagnostic implementations
 - Proficient with professional embedded pipelines, including ARM compiler toolchains, JTAG debuggers (e. g. , Lauterbach), and emulation control scripts
 - Experience with ISO 26262 functional safety requirements up to ASIL-D
 - Understanding of HSM/SHE concepts and secure boot requirements
 - Experience building automated testing setups using Python and continuous integration tools (e. g. , Jenkins)

What We'll Offer

At Ampere we believe in taking care of our employees and providing a competitive total rewards package that includes base pay, cash long-term incentive, and comprehensive benefits. 

Benefits Highlights Include

- Premium medical, dental, vision insurance, parental benefits including creche reimbursement, as well as a retirement plan, so that you can feel secure in your health, financial future and child care during work. 
 - Generous paid time off policy so that you can embrace a healthy work-life balance 
 - Fully catered lunch in our office along with a variety of healthy snacks, energizing coffee or tea, and refreshing drinks to keep you fueled and focused throughout the day. 

And there is much more than compensation and benefits. At Ampere, we foster an inclusive culture that empowers our employees to do more and grow more. We are excited to share more about our career opportunities with you through the interview process. 

Ampere is an inclusive and equal opportunity employer and welcomes applicants from all backgrounds. data.description:
Astera Labs (NASDAQ: ALAB) provides rack-scale AI infrastructure through purpose-built connectivity solutions. By collaborating with hyperscalers and ecosystem partners, Astera Labs enables organizations to unlock the full potential of modern AI. Astera Labs' Intelligent Connectivity Platform integrates CXL®, Ethernet, NVLink, PCIe®, and UALinkTM semiconductor-based technologies with the company's COSMOS software suite to unify diverse components into cohesive, flexible systems that deliver end-to-end scale-up, and scale-out connectivity. The company's custom connectivity solutions business complements its standards-based portfolio, enabling customers to deploy tailored architectures to meet their unique infrastructure requirements. Discover more at www. asteralabs. com. 

TechLead- Verification Methodology / CAD / Automation Engineer

Experience - 6-12 years

Job Summary

We are looking for a Tech Lead - Verification Methodology/CAD/Automation Engineer to drive verification infrastructure, methodology, automation, and productivity across IP and SoC verification teams. 

The candidate will build scalable verification frameworks, automate verification workflows, improve regression infrastructure, and partner with design verification teams to establish efficient and reusable methodologies. 

Key Responsibilities

- Own and drive verification methodology and infrastructure across projects. 
 - Develop scalable frameworks for simulation, regression, coverage, debug, and verification signoff. 
 - Build and maintain verification CAD/automation flows. 
 - Develop automation scripts and tools using Python, Tcl, Perl, Shell, and/or C++. 
 - Automate test generation, compilation, regression execution, result collection, coverage analysis, and reporting. 
 - Develop infrastructure for large-scale UVM/SystemVerilog verification environments. 
 - Improve simulation and regression turnaround time through parallelization and optimization. 
 - Integrate simulation, lint, CDC/RDC, formal, coverage, and other verification tools into common workflows. 
 - Develop dashboards and metrics for verification quality, coverage, regression health, and project status. 
 - Debug infrastructure and tool-flow issues and provide rapid support to verification teams. 
 - Establish reusable verification components, scripts, libraries, and methodology guidelines. 
 - Drive adoption of best practices across multiple verification teams. 
 - Evaluate new verification technologies and tools and recommend improvements. 
 - Work closely with EDA vendors to troubleshoot tool issues and improve flows. 
 - Support migration and integration of new EDA tool versions and methodologies. 
 - Develop documentation and training for verification teams. 
 - Mentor verification CAD/methodology engineers and provide technical leadership. 

Required Technical Skills

- Strong experience in verification methodology, CAD, and automation. 
 - Strong programming/scripting skills in Python, Tcl, Perl, Shell, and preferably C/C++. 
 - Strong understanding of SystemVerilog/UVM. 
 - Experience with simulation tools such as VCS, Xcelium, Questa, or equivalent. 
 - Experience building and maintaining regression infrastructure. 
 - Strong knowledge of coverage collection and analysis. 
 - Understanding of verification flows including: 
 - Simulation 
 - UVM 
 - Lint 
 - CDC/RDC 
 - Formal 
 - Code/functional coverage 
 - Regression 
 - Debug 
 - Strong Linux/Unix environment experience. 
 - Excellent automation and problem-solving skills. 

Preferred Experience

- Experience with large-scale SoC/IP verification environments. 
 - Experience integrating multiple EDA tools into a unified verification flow. 
 - Experience with CI/CD infrastructure such as Jenkins, GitLab CI, or equivalent. 
 - Experience with distributed/parallel regression infrastructure. 
 - Experience with cloud-based or scalable compute environments. 
 - Knowledge of databases, dashboards, APIs, or web-based verification infrastructure is an advantage. 
 - Experience working with EDA vendors and managing tool-flow issues. 

Leadership Expectations

- Act as the technical owner for verification methodology and automation. 
 - Identify opportunities to improve verification productivity, quality, and turnaround time. 
 - Define and enforce verification methodology standards. 
 - Mentor engineers and drive adoption of common frameworks. 
 - Work across multiple projects and teams to solve infrastructure challenges. 
 - Strong ability to balance immediate project requirements with long-term methodology improvements. 

Education

B. E. /B. Tech/M. E. /M. Tech in Electronics, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Computer Engineering, VLSI, or a related discipline. 

We know that creativity and innovation happen more often when teams include diverse ideas, backgrounds, and experiences, and we actively encourage everyone with relevant experience to apply, including people of color, LGBTQ+ and non-binary people, veterans, parents, and individuals with disabilities.

data.title: NPDI Lead Engineer - Liquid Cooling (TCS/SFN)
data.description:
Job Description

NPDI Lead Engineer - Liquid Cooling (TCS/SFN)

Seeking a NPDI Lead Engineer - Liquid Cooling (TCS/SFN) with expertise in Technical Cooling Systems (TCS) / Secondary Fluid Networks (SFN) or broader piping and fluid systems to lead NPDI projects for TCS/SFN and drive the development of next-generation liquid cooling distribution solutions. The role is responsible for setting design standards, leading the team and projects globally, ensuring integration across NPDI, Application Engineering, and ETO, and mentoring engineers to build global consistency. The position requires deep technical skills in fluid and piping systems, expert proficiency with Creo, strong PLM experience, and the ability to define and own tools and processes that streamline layout creation, quoting, and product development. 

Key Responsibilities

- Lead TCS/SFN design deliverables through all NPDI stages, from concept to product launch, ensuring technical robustness and manufacturability. 
 - Define and develop standard TCS/SFN modules (headers, manifolds, valves, fittings, hoses, expansion tanks, filters, quick disconnects) for reuse across platforms. Create and manage PTC Creo models, design libraries, and assemblies for TCS/SFN components and systems. 
 - Perform system sizing and validation, flow balancing, pressure drop, NPSH margin, valve Cv selection, and pump/loop analysis. 
 - Oversee prototype builds, validation test plans, and test execution (pressure, leak, flow/thermal, cleanliness, condensation/dew point). 
 - Work in PLM systems (e. g. , Oracle PD Cloud, Windchill) to manage BOMs, drawings, engineering changes, and product documentation. 
 - Collaborate cross-functionally with global engineering, operations, supply chain, and quality to align TCS/SFN design with product roadmap goals. 
 - Ensure integration across Application Engineering, NPDI, and ETO projects to drive consistency, reuse, and customer alignment. 
 - Drive supplier engagement, define specifications, support RFQs, and validate supplier designs for manufacturability and cost effectiveness. 
 - Provide technical ownership of future configurator and rapid layout tools (e. g. , CPQ-Creo integration, Revit) to streamline quoting and design processes. 
 - Mentor mechanical engineers and review custom order learnings to feed back into NPDI modules and roadmap planning. 
 - Ensure adherence to ASME/ASHRAE standards and internal design guidelines for liquid-cooled piping systems. 

Required Qualifications

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Mechanical Engineering. 
 - 10+ years of experience in piping and fluid systems, preferably in data center liquid cooling, HVAC, hydronics, or process cooling, with direct experience in Technical
 - Cooling Systems (TCS) / Secondary Fluid Networks (SFN) highly desirable. 
 - Expert proficiency with PTC Creo for assemblies, layouts, routing, and detailed drawings. 
 - Strong working knowledge of PLM systems (e. g. , Oracle PD Cloud, Windchill) for BOM management, engineering change control, and design lifecycle management. 
 - Proven record of leading NPDI projects using Stage Gate or equivalent processes, ensuring integration across application engineering, NPDI, and ETO workflows. 
 - Hands-on validation experience including pressure/leak testing, flow and thermal testing, cleanliness protocols, and condensation/dew point checks. 
 - Knowledge of ASME and ASHRAE guidelines for liquid cooling and piping systems. 
 - Deep expertise in DFM/DFA principles, weld/braze methods, and supplier fabrication processes. 
 - Strong documentation skills, including preparation of PFDs, P&IDs, test reports, engineering change orders, and sustaining handoffs. 
 - Excellent English communication skills (written and verbal). 
 - Demonstrated ability to work effectively with global engineering teams across regions. 
 - Strong leadership, organizational, and collaboration skills. 
 - Proven ability to define and own engineering tools and configurators that enable rapid layout creation, quoting, and design reuse. 

Preferred Skills

- Direct experience with TCS/SFN systems for high-density data centers, AI, or HPC applications. 
 - Experience with hydraulic modeling for loop balancing, pressure-drop analysis, and system sensitivity studies. 
 - Exposure to CFD or other thermal/fluid simulation tools. 
 - Experience with sanitary or high-cleanliness stainless-steel piping, orbital welding, flushing, passivation, and contamination control. 
 - Experience with PP-R/PP-RCT or other engineered polymer piping systems. 
 - Experience overseeing prototype builds, FAT/SAT, commissioning, and validation reporting. 
 - Experience with modular/prefabricated liquid-cooling systems, CPQ tools, Creo automation, or Revit workflows.

data.description:
Skillset: Java, Spring boot, Microservices, Distributed Systems, DS/Algo, System Design

About Team

GDF (Global Data Foundation) is part of Walmart's AI & Data organization - the team building the foundational data platforms that power AI, analytics, and decision-making across every Walmart banner and geography, from supply chain and merchandising to customer experience and enterprise AI agents. Our newly created platform team is chartered with building next-generation data infrastructure at Walmart scale: reliable, high-throughput data pipelines, distributed processing systems, and platform capabilities that downstream teams across Walmart depend on every day. 

What You'll Do

- Design, build, and operate distributed platform services and APIs using Java and Python, applied against Kubernetes or equivalent cloud-native infrastructure. 
 - Apply system design and low-level design (LLD) rigor to platform problems - evaluating dependencies, trade-offs, failure modes, scalability, and cost before writing a line of code, with support from Staff/Principal engineers on the most ambiguous or cross-team problems. 
 - Flex into data engineering work when needed: contribute to Spark-based data pipelines and processing jobs, working directly in GDF's data engineering codebase alongside platform work. 
 - Build AI, GenAI, and agentic-powered platform capabilities: intelligent developer tooling, workflow automation, agentic services, and AI-assisted operational tooling (monitoring, incident triage, capacity planning). 
 - Own reliability, scalability, and observability for the services you build - service-level objectives, distributed tracing, alerting, and incident response - with a strong Operational Excellence / Engineering Excellence discipline. 
 - Contribute to architecture and system design decisions across microservices, event-driven systems, and enterprise integrations, with an eye toward how platform choices affect downstream data engineering workloads. 
 - Partner with data engineers, data scientists, and ML engineers to ensure the services you own expose the right primitives for data pipelines, feature stores, and model-serving paths. 
 - Participate actively in architecture reviews, design reviews, code reviews, and production readiness reviews for a team building process from scratch. 
 - As a Senior engineer, bring strong technical judgment to design and code reviews within your immediate team and area of ownership, mentor early-career engineers, and help raise the bar for engineering quality - without needing a formal management title. 
 - Stay current on emerging platform, cloud, and AI/agentic technologies, and propose where they could pragmatically improve reliability, productivity, or business value within your team's scope. 

What You'll Bring

- Genuinely hands-on coding: 5+ years of professional software engineering experience building and operating distributed platforms; strong proficiency in Java and Python is required - comfortable writing, reviewing, and debugging production code. Additional experience with Go, C++, or Scala is a plus. 
 - Operational Excellence (OE) and Engineering Excellence (EE) mindset is a required skill, not a nice-to-have: SLO/SLA ownership, incident management and blameless post-incident reviews, proactive reliability and quality metrics, and continuous improvement built into how you ship, not bolted on afterward. 
 - Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience. 
 - Solid experience with microservices architectures, distributed systems, event-driven patterns, API design, service contracts, and enterprise system integration - backed by solid system design and low-level design (LLD) skills, with demonstrated ownership of production code and the judgment to evaluate trade-offs, failure modes, scalability, and cost for the components you own. 
 - Solid understanding of cloud-native engineering practices - CI/CD, containerization, Kubernetes or equivalent orchestration, infrastructure automation, and production operations. 
 - Working exposure to Big Data / data engineering technologies - Spark required at a working level, with familiarity in Hadoop/HDFS, Hive, or Kafka - enough to flex into data engineering work confidently. 
 - Full exposure to AI and Agentic technologies: hands-on experience integrating model APIs and GenAI/LLM tooling, building or operating agentic workflows (tool-calling agents, multi-step autonomous systems), working with embeddings/vector search, and applying MLOps practices (feature stores, model lifecycle, retraining pipelines) - not just conceptual awareness. 
 - Solid knowledge of reliability engineering - observability, distributed tracing, logging, metrics, alerting, incident response, capacity planning, and fault tolerance for large-scale systems. 
 - Solid grounding in security, privacy, and enterprise engineering practices, including authentication, authorization, data protection, and secure API design. 
 - Proven ability to translate reasonably well-scoped technical/business problems into clear execution plans, particularly within a newly formed team - escalating cross-team ambiguity to Staff/Principal engineers as needed. 
 - Strong ownership mindset and technical judgment; comfortable operating with autonomy within your team in a 0-to-1 environment. 

About Walmart Global Tech

Imagine working in an environment where one line of code can make life easier for hundreds of millions of people. That's what we do at Walmart Global Tech. We're a team of software engineers, data scientists, cybersecurity experts, and service professionals within the world's leading retailer who make an epic impact and are at the forefront of the next retail disruption. People are why we innovate, and people power our innovations. We are people-led and tech-empowered. 

Benefits

Beyond our great compensation package, you can receive incentive awards for your performance. Other great perks include a host of best-in-class benefits - maternity and parental leave, PTO, health benefits, and much more. Walmart's culture sets us apart, and we know being together helps us innovate, learn, and grow great careers. This role is based in our [Bangalore/Chennai] office for daily work, with the flexibility for associates to manage their personal lives. 

Belonging

We aim to create a culture where every associate feels valued for who they are, rooted in respect for the individual. Our goal is to foster a sense of belonging, to create opportunities for all our associates, customers and suppliers, and to be a Walmart for everyone. At Walmart, our vision is "everyone included. " By fostering a workplace culture where everyone is - and feels - included, everyone wins. 

Equal Opportunity Employer

Walmart, Inc. , is an Equal Opportunities Employer - By Choice. We believe we are best equipped to help our associates, customers and the communities we serve live better when we really know them. That means understanding, respecting and valuing unique styles, experiences, identities, ideas and opinions while being inclusive of all people.

data.title: Software Architect
data.description:
We don't need an architect who draws boxes and walks away. We need one who ships the design and carries the pager. 

Techdome is a profitable, product-driven engineering company with 80+ engineers building healthcare, fintech, AI, and SaaS products. Our systems store sensitive patient data and move real money for large user bases. We're looking for a senior technical leader who thinks of production as the true test of any design and takes responsibility for the result.

data.title: Senior Software Architect/Technical Lead
data.description:
Schedule: Monday to Friday, 4: 00 AM-1: 00 PM EST

Compensation: C$54, 000-C$78, 000 annually, based on experience and qualifications

About Revun

Revun is the software platform and infrastructure layer behind modern property operations. 

The platform brings together CRM functionality, leasing workflows, maintenance operations, payments, owner and vendor payouts, communications, compliance, reporting, AI automation, staff dashboards, tenant/owner/vendor portals, third-party integrations, and multiple user roles into one connected operating system. 

We are looking for a highly experienced Senior Software Architect / Technical Lead to take technical ownership of the platform, lead the engineering team, evaluate the existing technology, strengthen the architecture, and help move the product toward a stable commercial launch. 

About The Role

This is not a purely advisory architecture position. 

You will be expected to understand the existing application at a deep technical level, challenge weak technical decisions, lead developers, review engineering quality, identify technical and architectural risks, and determine what should be retained, improved, refactored, replaced, or rebuilt. 

You will serve as a senior technical authority for the platform and work directly with company leadership and product management. 

The right candidate will combine deep hands-on engineering experience with architecture expertise and engineering leadership. 

How to Apply

Apply with your resume. If your background aligns with the position, you'll receive an email with a link to complete a short pre-recorded video interview within 24-48 hours of applying. 

What You Will Do

- Take technical ownership of the architecture, engineering quality, technical audit, and launch readiness of Revun. 
 - Conduct a detailed assessment of the existing frontend, backend, databases, APIs, integrations, AI workflows, infrastructure, security, permissions, financial workflows, deployment processes, and overall codebase. 
 - Determine what should be retained, improved, refactored, replaced, or rebuilt based on technical risk, business impact, development effort, and long-term scalability. 
 - Identify technical debt, architectural weaknesses, security vulnerabilities, scalability risks, data-integrity issues, incomplete workflows, development problems, and launch blockers. 
 - Lead and provide technical direction to remote frontend, backend, integration, AI/automation, DevOps/cloud, and QA engineering resources. 
 - Evaluate developer capabilities, technical output, estimates, code quality, productivity, and ability to execute assigned work. 
 - Review code and pull requests, challenge weak engineering decisions, resolve technical blockers, and ensure developers follow established architectural and development standards. 
 - Translate product and business requirements into scalable technical solutions and engineering plans. 
 - Work closely with the Technical Product Manager to evaluate technical feasibility, dependencies, complexity, timelines, and trade-offs before development begins. 
 - Strengthen platform architecture across APIs, databases, authentication, authorization, role-based access control, audit logging, permissions, workflow automation, and system integrations. 
 - Review financial-system reliability across payments, owner/vendor payouts, ledger activity, reconciliation, transaction history, audit trails, and reporting. 
 - Evaluate AI/LLM functionality for reliability, structured outputs, hallucination risk, privacy, security, monitoring, cost control, and measurable business value. 
 - Improve integration reliability through APIs, webhooks, queues, retries, rate-limit handling, logging, monitoring, idempotency, and failed-sync recovery. 
 - Establish and enforce engineering standards covering code reviews, branching, testing, QA, CI/CD, deployments, documentation, monitoring, incident response, and production release controls. 
 - Provide leadership with clear assessments of technical risks, engineering performance, development progress, architecture decisions, resource requirements, and launch readiness. 

What We Are Looking For

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, Information Technology, or a closely related technical field. 
 - 12+ years of professional software engineering experience, with significant hands-on development experience. 
 - 4+ years in software architecture or senior technical leadership, such as Senior Software Architect, Technical Architect, Principal Engineer, Staff Engineer, Technical Lead, Lead Engineer, or equivalent. 
 - Demonstrated experience architecting and leading the development of complex, production SaaS applications. 
 - Strong backend and platform architecture expertise, including databases, APIs, distributed systems, authentication, authorization, RBAC, security, scalability, performance, and data integrity. 
 - Strong understanding of modern frontend architecture and the ability to evaluate frontend engineering decisions and code quality. 
 - Experience inheriting an existing software platform and determining what should be retained, refactored, replaced, or rebuilt. 
 - Experience leading and technically managing multidisciplinary engineering teams, including frontend and backend developers. 
 - Ability to evaluate developer capability, challenge estimates, identify weak engineering practices, and hold technical resources accountable for their work. 
 - Strong experience designing and integrating APIs, webhooks, asynchronous processing, queues, retries, logging, monitoring, rate-limit handling, and failure-recovery mechanisms. 
 - Strong experience with cloud infrastructure, CI/CD, observability, production deployments, QA processes, incident management, security, and launch readiness. 
 - Experience with complex SaaS, CRM, workflow automation, marketplace, fintech/payment, PropTech, field-service, or other multi-user operational platforms. 
 - Practical experience integrating AI/LLM functionality into production applications, including evaluation, monitoring, privacy, hallucination risk, human review, and cost management. 
 - Ability to move between high-level architecture and detailed technical investigation when necessary. 
 - Excellent English communication skills and the ability to explain complex technical issues, trade-offs, risks, and recommendations clearly to non-technical leadership. 

Nice to Have

- Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related technical discipline. 
 - 15+ years of software engineering experience. 
 - Previous experience as a Principal Engineer, Senior Architect, Technical Architect, Engineering Lead, or similar senior technical authority.

data.description:
Company: 

Qualcomm India Private Limited

Job Area: 

Engineering Group, Engineering Group > Systems Engineering

General Summary: 

Job Overview: 

You will be part of System Performance team that is responsible for profiling and optimizing the System Performance on Snapdragon chipsets. This role will require a strong knowledge of AI/ML performance using NPU cores. The knowledge of CPU, DDR, NoCs will be an added advantage. 

Skills Required: 

- A deep understanding of NPU, CPU and DDR architecture internals like
 - NPU: Understanding of NPU micro-architecture, including its specialized processing elements for operations like matrix multiplications and convolutions. 
 - A strong grasp of deep learning fundamentals, including neural network architectures like Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs), transformers, GenAI etc. 
 - Understanding the distinction between the compute-intensive training of a model (often done on GPUs) and running inference (making predictions) on NPUs. 
 - Knowledge of Model optimization and compression techniques (Quantization, Pruning, Distillation etc. )
 - CPU caches (L1, L2, L3), instruction pipelines, branch prediction, memory hierarchy (including register, cache, and main memory) and multi-core/multi-threaded processing. You need to understand how memory access, instruction dependencies, and contention for shared resources can impact performance. 
 - DDR: Understanding of JEDEC specifications LPDDR4, LPDDR5, LPDDR6, including command and timing parameters (e. g. , tCL, tRCD, tRP), memory organization (rows, columns, banks), and basic view of training and initialization sequences, how a memory controller works and its specific features like command queue, port arbitration, and various control schemes. 
 - Familiarity with frameworks like TensorFlow Lite, PyTorch Mobile, and ONNX Runtime for preparing models for deployment. Experience with NPU-specific compilers, such as those from Qualcomm (QNN), Arm (Vela), Intel (OpenVINO), to optimize and orchestrate AI workloads. 
 - Evaluating hardware and software to determine the best fit for specific AI tasks and measure performance metrics like TOPS/W (trillions of operations per second per watt). 
 - Using tools like the Windows Performance Toolkit and Qualcomm's Snapdragon Profiler to analyze and optimize NPU and system-level performance
 - A core understanding of how to use parallel processing architectures for efficient AI computations. 
 - Expertise in how operating systems manage processes, threads, memory, MMU, and interrupt handling. This knowledge is crucial to understanding software for the kernel scheduler and system-level bottlenecks. 
 - Good understanding of Benchmarks CPU (like GeekBench, SpecInt, CoreMark etc) and DDR (like lat_mem, stream, bw_mem etc. ) and how they exercise the underlying CPU/GPU/DDR architecture. 
 - Experience with a variety of performance monitoring tools like Intel VTune, Linux perf, and Utilities like top, vmstat, iostat, and netstat to monitor system resources like CPU, memory, and I/O. Experience with software tools to monitor system hotspots, command bus utilization, and identify memory traffic patterns is critical. This includes validating that the traffic generated by software is as expected. 
 - Good understanding of memory allocation policies, prefetching, and caching to minimize latency and maximize bandwidth. Understanding how an application accesses memory is vital. Skills in profiling code to analyze memory access patterns and then optimizing the code for better data locality. 
 - Analyzing large datasets from performance tests requires strong statistical skills. This can involve creating histograms of transaction latencies and deriving performance metrics to understand a system's behavior. 

Responsibilities Include: 

- Drive Performance analysis on silicon using various System and Cores (i. e. NPU, AI/ML, CPU, Memory) benchmarks like Dhrystone, GeekBench, SPECInt, CNN/GenAI ML networks etc.

 - Analyzing Perf KPIs of SoC subsystems like NPU, CPU, Memory, and corelate performance with projection
 - Evaluate and characterize performance at various junction temperatures and optimize running at high ambient temperatures. 
 - Analyze and optimize the System performance parameters of SoC infrastructure like NoC, LP5 DDR, etc. 
 - Collaborate with cross-functional global teams to plan and execute performance activities on chipsets as well as make recommendations for next generation chipsets.

 - Experience working on any ARM/x86 based platforms, mobile/automotive/Data center operating systems and/or performance profiling tools.
