data.title: SSD Firmware & Software Lead/Architect (10-15+)
data.description:
Company Description ChipSilica is a specialized technology company focused on PCIe and related high-speed interconnect protocols, including CXL, UALink, Ethernet, DDR and UCIe. The team supports customers in designing and developing switches, retimers, and SoCs that rely on advanced PCIe-based architectures. By combining deep protocol expertise with practical implementation experience, ChipSilica helps organizations build reliable, high-performance solutions. The company collaborates closely with clients to address complex design challenges and accelerate product development. 

Role: Lead / Architect - SSD Firmware & Software Engineering

Experience: 10-15+ years (relevant hands-on experience)

Location: Bangalore, India

Employment Type: Full-time

Role Description

We are looking for an experienced SSD Firmware & Software Architect to lead the complete firmware and software development of a next-generation SSD controller. 

The candidate will own the end-to-end software stack, covering device-side firmware, host-side drivers, low-level hardware interfaces, system software and software validation. 

The role involves close collaboration with our RTL Design, Design Verification, FPGA, Physical Design and DFT teams to develop and validate the SSD controller, starting from FPGA-based prototyping and progressing towards silicon bring-up and production. 

This is a hands-on technical leadership position. The candidate will be responsible for defining the software architecture, establishing development methodologies and eventually building and leading the firmware and software engineering team. 

Key Responsibilities

- SSD Controller Firmware Development: Architect, develop and lead device-side firmware for SSD controllers. Develop low-level firmware for controller initialization, hardware configuration, command processing and device management. 
 - Host-Side Software & Driver Development: Develop and integrate host-side software for SSD controller interfacing. Experience with PCIe-based host-controller communication and device enumeration. Develop, customize and debug Linux device drivers and kernel-level interfaces wherever required. 
 - Low-Level Software & Hardware Bring-up: Develop bare-metal firmware and/or RTOS-based embedded software. 
 - FPGA Prototyping & Validation: Lead firmware and software development for FPGA-based SSD controller prototypes
 - Silicon Bring-up & Productization: Lead firmware bring-up on first silicon in collaboration with RTL, PD and DFT teams. Develop initial boot firmware and hardware initialization sequences. Debug silicon-level issues involving PCIe, NAND interfaces, memory controllers, DMA and other controller subsystems. 
 - Architecture & Technical Leadership: Define the complete SSD software architecture and technology roadmap

Required Technical Skills

Strong experience in embedded firmware development using C and C++. 

Strong understanding of computer architecture, microcontrollers, SoCs and hardware-software interfaces. 

Hands-on experience with bare-metal firmware and/or RTOS-based development. 

Strong understanding of PCIe and NVMe protocols. 

Experience with SSD controller firmware or storage subsystem development. 

Understanding of NAND Flash architecture and flash management techniques. 

Experience with Linux kernel, device drivers and storage subsystems. 

Strong understanding of DMA, interrupts, memory-mapped I/O and low-level peripheral interfaces. 

Experience in firmware debugging, hardware bring-up and system-level integration. 

Ability to work with RTL, DV and FPGA teams during hardware-software co-development.

data.title: Staff Software Engineer, Security Foundations
data.description:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster. 

The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software. 

- Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab. 

An Overview Of This Role

As a Staff Software Engineer, you'll help lead two important areas for GitLab Security: the data layer behind our vulnerability and dependency management capabilities, and our move toward services outside the GitLab monolith. You'll design and develop systems that ingest, store, index, and query security report data, including integrations with key third-party systems. With a strong focus on PostgreSQL and scalable backend design, your work will support security features delivered by teams across GitLab. 

You'll take ownership of large deliverables from early ideas through implementation, working directly with product, design, frontend, and engineering partners to shape the technical and product roadmap. You'll stay hands-on across GitLab's Ruby on Rails application and newer services, including greenfield projects, while helping the team build its expertise in modular service design. 

What You'll Do

- Lead large technical deliverables from initial problem definition through delivery, often across multiple months or quarters. 
 - Design and develop backend systems for vulnerability and dependency management, including security report ingestion, storage, indexing, querying, and integrations with key third-party systems. 
 - Build and improve systems using Ruby on Rails and PostgreSQL, and contribute to newer services using technologies such as Go or Rust where appropriate. 
 - Shape technical plans, break down complex work, and help other engineers deliver effectively. 
 - Work directly with product, design, frontend, and engineering partners to make clear decisions, resolve constraints, and deliver measurable progress. 
 - Influence the team's product and technical roadmap through hands-on investigation, clear proposals, and iterative delivery that demonstrates progress in each monthly release cycle. 
 - Apply a security mindset when designing systems, including considering how GitLab identifies and handles malicious or vulnerable software packages. 
 - Define patterns for modular services, provide technical leadership when vulnerability management work spans multiple GitLab areas, and share that expertise across GitLab Security. 

What You'll Bring

- Experience leading complex backend projects from idea through delivery while remaining hands-on with design and development. 
 - Strong PostgreSQL experience, including evidence of query optimization, table optimization, and write-ahead log management in data-intensive systems. 
 - Strong professional experience with Ruby on Rails or Go and comfort working in Ruby on Rails day to day. Experience with large monoliths is helpful, along with an interest in working across languages and services. 
 - Experience shaping delivery plans, guiding technical decisions, and supporting the work of other engineers. 
 - The ability to collaborate with a range of partners and explain technical trade-offs clearly. 
 - Experience communicating with leaders, leading peers through complex delivery, identifying constraints, and moving work forward. 
 - Experience using security tooling for activities such as vulnerability triage and remediation, or professional experience building vulnerability management, dependency management, or related security products. 
 - Experience with large-scale data systems or established software products. We welcome transferable experience from outside the security domain. 
 - Fluency in using artificial intelligence tools to improve delivery while applying sound engineering judgment. 

About The Team

The Vulnerability Management team contributes to GitLab's move toward modular services and will help other Security teams adopt these patterns over time. Today, we include two Staff Software Engineers, two Senior Software Engineers, and one Intermediate Software Engineer across the United Kingdom, Poland, the Netherlands, and India. You'll work closely with us, product partners, and engineering leaders across GitLab. 

We work with clear goals and shared priorities. You'll receive clear context and outcomes, then have the space to own delivery, communicate decisions and progress, ask for help early, and work directly with the partners needed to get the job done. 

How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees

- Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being
 - Flexible Paid Time Off 
 - Team Member Resource Groups
 - Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan
 - Growth and Development Fund
 - Parental Leave

Additionally, studies have shown that people from underrepresented groups are less likely to apply to a job unless they meet every single qualification. If you're excited about this role, please apply and allow our recruiters to assess your application. 

Country Hiring Guidelines: GitLab hires new team members in countries around the world. All of our roles are remote, however some roles may carry specific location-based eligibility requirements. Our Talent Acquisition team can help answer any questions about location after starting the recruiting process. 

Privacy Policy: Please review our Recruitment Privacy Policy. Your privacy is important to us.

data.title: SRE Engineer
data.description:
Role Overview

The selected SRE and DevOps professional will be responsible for maintaining highly available production systems, managing cloud infrastructure, improving observability, and supporting reliable deployment and operations practices. The role combines hands-on engineering with incident response, infrastructure automation, performance optimization, and continuous reliability improvement. 

The ideal candidate should have experience working in production-critical environments where system availability, quick incident resolution, effective monitoring, and preventive engineering are essential. 

Key Responsibilities1. Site Reliability and Production Operations

- Monitor production systems and maintain service availability, performance, and operational stability. 
 - Participate in production support and scheduled on-call rotations, including the resolution of critical incidents. 
 - Investigate system failures, perform root cause analysis, document post-incident findings, and implement preventive measures. 
 - Identify recurring operational issues and reduce manual intervention through automation. 
 - Improve service reliability using measurable indicators, service objectives, availability targets, and error-budget practices. 
 - Contribute to capacity planning, disaster recovery, high availability, redundancy, and failover strategies. 
 - Cloud Infrastructure and Platform Engineering
 - Manage and optimize cloud infrastructure across Microsoft Azure, Amazon Web Services (AWS), and/or Google Cloud Platform (GCP). 
 - Work with cloud compute, storage, networking, access management, monitoring, and cloud-native services. 
 - Support containerized applications and manage Kubernetes-based infrastructure, including AKS, EKS, GKE, or equivalent platforms. 
 - Troubleshoot cluster health, application workloads, resource utilization, scaling, networking, and deployment-related issues. 
 - Work with Helm and other relevant deployment tools to maintain consistent application releases. 
 - Infrastructure Automation and DevOps
 - Develop and maintain Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Terraform. 
 - Support automated infrastructure provisioning, configuration management, and repeatable deployment processes. 
 - Work with Git-based development workflows, including GitHub, GitLab, Azure Repos, or equivalent platforms. 
 - Contribute to CI/CD pipelines and improve deployment reliability through automation. 
 - Develop scripts using Python and/or Bash to simplify operational activities and eliminate repetitive tasks. 
 - Monitoring, Observability and Performance
 - Build and maintain monitoring, logging, metrics, tracing, and alerting solutions for production environments. 
 - Work with observability platforms such as OpenTelemetry, Datadog, Prometheus, Grafana, Azure Monitor, Golden Signals(including Latency, errors, traffic, saturation), AWS CloudWatch, and GCP Cloud Monitoring. 
 - Apply the four Golden Signals-latency, traffic, errors, and saturation-to monitor service health and identify performance issues. 
 - Improve distributed tracing and establish meaningful alerts that reflect actual system health and user impact. 
 - Investigate performance bottlenecks across infrastructure, applications, networks, and distributed systems. 
 - Linux, Networking and Security
 - Troubleshoot Linux-based systems and production infrastructure issues. 
 - Apply networking fundamentals, including DNS, TCP/IP, load balancing, SSL/TLS, and connectivity troubleshooting. 
 - Follow cloud security best practices for identity and access management, network segmentation, and secrets management. 
 - Support vulnerability remediation, security improvements, and compliance-related activities in collaboration with relevant teams. 

Technical Environment

The role involves cloud infrastructure, Kubernetes, Terraform, scripting, production support, monitoring, and modern reliability engineering practices. Experience with one major cloud platform is important, while exposure to multiple cloud environments can be beneficial. 

Additional exposure to Go (Golang), OpenSearch, ELK Stack, AI/ML production platforms, Azure AI services, AI Foundry, RAG-based workloads, and enterprise observability frameworks would be advantageous. 

Skills: github, sre, production engineering, incident management, troubleshooting, capacity planning, sla, sre & production operations, mttr, gitlab, aws, kubernetes & containerization, error budgets, opentelemetry, iac, terraform, toil reduction, ms azure, rca, cloud infrastructure, python, golang, 24/7 production support, sli, golden signals, slo, gcp, linux system, devops

data.title: Staff Engineer, Software V&V
data.description:
Work Schedule

Standard (Mon-Fri)

Environmental Conditions

Office

Staff Engineer, Software V&V At Thermo Fisher, our mission is to cure cancer with genomic data. It is a close-knit, collaborative, cross-functional setting where we believe none of us is as smart as all of us and we each have something valuable to contribute toward our goal. The software services team is tasked with applying industry best practices to the design, development, and deployment of world-class software products. We are looking to hire individuals with experience with software development and test engineering in clinical and research settings, and who can help us solve the next wave of technical challenges using the latest cloud-based, big-data, and rich analytics toolsets. We are seeking enthusiastic Leader in Software Verification and Validation who will define scope, design, for automated and manual tests for highly advanced bioinformatics software. We require strong coding skills as well as a solid understanding of Quality Assurance principles and Continuous Integration methods. You will drive writing positive and negative smoke and regression test scripts to test product functionality and integration with dependencies. You will drive strategies for test APIs, user interfaces, web services, and/or web apps and write performance, load, and stress tests. You are excited and passionate about participating in an Agile/SCRUM setting to meet and exceed customer expectations and continuously drive towards quality improvements. You like the idea of partnering with users and other team members to brainstorm the best possible approaches to validating systems. You welcome the challenge of working in a fast-paced, discovery-oriented environment and will be genuinely excited about the prospect of creatively exercising your problem-solving skills continuously to ultimately improve the human condition. Essential Functions: 

- Develop and implement software testing Strategy, Methods and Best Practices that allow high quality NGS analytics and instruments software products to be designed, developed, and released into the regulated in-vitro diagnostics/ medical device space. 
 - Lead and mentor a group of bioinformatics and software test engineers. 
 - Establish software quality standards and KPI metrics to actively measure software and bioinformatics product quality. Implement software quality tracking tools and methodologies to provide on-going visibility and action during software product development lifecycle. 
 - Single point of contact while working with external partners to deliver state of the art Software products in market. 
 - Partner with software and bioinformatics leadership, functional and project managers to identify appropriate scope of software testing, verification and validation required for a project and managing the overall testing activities for projects. 
 - Partner with internal and external stakeholders to drive the requirements for regulated assays and software. Help software development team to understand the complex informatics and visualization requirements leading into design implementation Minimum Qualifications (must have): 
 - Masters/PhD preferred or Bachelors with minimum 10+ years of work experience and strong track record of industry productivity
 - 10+ experience performing software verification and validation testing, preferably in the medical device/ biotech space
 - Strong understanding of NGS-based regulated software, IVD assay development practices and informatics data analysis pipelines. 
 - Strong leadership abilities and extensive experience managing the activities of software quality engineering and assurance teams. Experience leading cross-functional, multi-site teams preferred. 
 - Practical experience as a leader in the use of modern software development methodologies/ processes with an ability to direct the use of resources to meet department goals
 - Good understanding in design control for regulated products (e. g. US-IVD, IVD-D, IVD-R, China and Japan regulations) and knowledge of applicable regulations and standards used in IVD and medical device software development (e. g. ISO 13485, IEC 62304, and 21 CFR 820). 
 - Ability to work well with senior leadership. 
 - Experience working in a fast paced, dynamic environment.

Job Description

Title: Engineering Team Leader - Mechanical Tooling-Husky(India) Guindy

Id: 21204

Type: FullTime

Location: Chennai, India

At Husky TechnologiesTM, our success is based on your success. Our ability to keep our customers in the lead is based on building the strongest team possible. 

Husky TechnologiesTM has a strong foundation built on innovation, close customer relationships and a unique culture and values. We are dedicated to offering our customers the highest quality products and services and are looking for people with the inspiration and talent to develop with us as we pursue our ambitious growth strategy. We are a leader in developing state-of-the-art technology and it is this technology base that uniquely positions us to serve customers who seek differentiation through solutions that provide speed, flexibility and maximum productivity. This capability is at the core of our mission and competitive strategy. 

Husky TechnologiesTM offers a wealth of opportunity for personal growth and development. Most importantly, Husky Technologies TM offers an opportunity to work with - and be challenged by - a team of great people. Our success is possible because of the creativity, intelligence and passion of our people around the world and their desire to lead change. At the same time, we are not afraid to expect a lot and strive for leadership in all of our key markets. We are a company taking on new challenges and for the right people this means exceptional career development opportunities, the chance to be part of a team that is the best in the world at what we do and the experience that comes from working in an environment that demands constant transformation and innovation. 

Husky TechnologiesTM is an exciting company with tremendous potential. We have a great team and great expectations. If you are attracted to bold goals, believe in uncompromising honesty, support mutual respect, care about environmental responsibility, have a passion for excellence and a desire to make a positive contribution - then we want you to join the Husky TechnologiesTM team!

Job Description

Plan, organize and lead a design team for new product development with adherence to Product Development Process, Husky Standards and Stage Gate. Responsibilities include estimating effort and cost and ensuring delivery meets time, cost and quality targets. Implementation of continuous improvement activities including metrics, root cause analysis and implementation of improvement. 

Responsibilities

- Leadership of engineering design team through Product Development Process. Specifically, supervising and supporting team members regarding: 
 - Marketing support, product definition, specification, scoping and VOC
 - Concept development, evaluation and recommendation
 - Risk mitigation through past service issue research, risk identification and formal DFMEA
 - System level design with high attention to detail and adherence to Husky standards
 - Engineering analysis using hand calculation, spreadsheet and CAE formats
 - Design execution with high attention to detail in engineering quality
 - Validation plan development
 - Design document discipline
 - Preparation for Product Release Process
 - Team member development through: providing challenging goals, coaching, mentoring, providing technical leadership opportunity, performance management, individual development planning, interviewing and hiring
 - Team support in developing innovative environment; both formal (tools) and informal
 - Development of open communication amongst team, across disciplines, outside engineering
 - Project and resource plan development
 - Proactive management of project budgets, status, execution timeline and mitigation as required
 - Proactive communication of team status to management
 - Continuous development of team output to a high quality standard
 - Weekly facilitation of team design reviews and team planning whiteboards
 - Technical support for Sales and Service

Qualifications: 

- Strong knowledge of Product Development Process, Stage Gate, Husky Standards
 - Understands Quality function deployment processes
 - Strong knowledge of specific supporting discipline
 - Strong knowledge of Husky products and customer base
 - Strong project, time management skills and ability to delegate tasks and projects
 - Strong leadership skills with the ability to motivate and develop/mentor a team
 - Strong decision-making and judgment
 - Excellent communication skills (verbal, written, interpersonal and presentation)
 - Strong sense of integrity
 - Demonstrates high degree of flexibility and embraces changing priorities
 - Previous hands on design experience
 - Education: Bachelor's degree in Engineering preferred, or 5 to 10 years of equivalent professional experience. 
 - Engineering Experience: 10+ years. 
 - Proven leadership experience. 
 - Previous project management experience an asset
 - Solid design engineering skills. 

Husky TechnologiesTM offers a competitive compensation and benefits package and excellent opportunities for growth and advancement. We are committed to equal employment opportunity and respect, value and welcome diversity in our workplace. Husky TechnologiesTM also values being a great place to work and strives to maintain a safe workplace. Accordingly, Husky TechnologiesTM conditions all offers of employment on satisfactory completion of background checks. No agency or telephone inquiries please.

data.title: Staff Engineer, Software V&V
data.description:
Work Schedule

Standard (Mon-Fri)

Environmental Conditions

Office

Staff Engineer, Software V&V At Thermo Fisher, our mission is to cure cancer with genomic data. It is a close-knit, collaborative, cross-functional setting where we believe none of us is as smart as all of us and we each have something valuable to contribute toward our goal. The software services team is tasked with applying industry best practices to the design, development, and deployment of world-class software products. We are looking to hire individuals with experience with software development and test engineering in clinical and research settings, and who can help us solve the next wave of technical challenges using the latest cloud-based, big-data, and rich analytics toolsets. We are seeking enthusiastic Leader in Software Verification and Validation who will define scope, design, for automated and manual tests for highly advanced bioinformatics software. We require strong coding skills as well as a solid understanding of Quality Assurance principles and Continuous Integration methods. You will drive writing positive and negative smoke and regression test scripts to test product functionality and integration with dependencies. You will drive strategies for test APIs, user interfaces, web services, and/or web apps and write performance, load, and stress tests. You are excited and passionate about participating in an Agile/SCRUM setting to meet and exceed customer expectations and continuously drive towards quality improvements. You like the idea of partnering with users and other team members to brainstorm the best possible approaches to validating systems. You welcome the challenge of working in a fast-paced, discovery-oriented environment and will be genuinely excited about the prospect of creatively exercising your problem-solving skills continuously to ultimately improve the human condition. Essential Functions: 

- Develop and implement software testing Strategy, Methods and Best Practices that allow high quality NGS analytics and instruments software products to be designed, developed, and released into the regulated in-vitro diagnostics/ medical device space. 
 - Lead and mentor a group of bioinformatics and software test engineers. 
 - Establish software quality standards and KPI metrics to actively measure software and bioinformatics product quality. Implement software quality tracking tools and methodologies to provide on-going visibility and action during software product development lifecycle. 
 - Single point of contact while working with external partners to deliver state of the art Software products in market. 
 - Partner with software and bioinformatics leadership, functional and project managers to identify appropriate scope of software testing, verification and validation required for a project and managing the overall testing activities for projects. 
 - Partner with internal and external stakeholders to drive the requirements for regulated assays and software. Help software development team to understand the complex informatics and visualization requirements leading into design implementation Minimum Qualifications (must have): 
 - Masters/PhD preferred or Bachelors with minimum 10+ years of work experience and strong track record of industry productivity
 - 10+ experience performing software verification and validation testing, preferably in the medical device/ biotech space
 - Strong understanding of NGS-based regulated software, IVD assay development practices and informatics data analysis pipelines. 
 - Strong leadership abilities and extensive experience managing the activities of software quality engineering and assurance teams. Experience leading cross-functional, multi-site teams preferred. 
 - Practical experience as a leader in the use of modern software development methodologies/ processes with an ability to direct the use of resources to meet department goals
 - Good understanding in design control for regulated products (e. g. US-IVD, IVD-D, IVD-R, China and Japan regulations) and knowledge of applicable regulations and standards used in IVD and medical device software development (e. g. ISO 13485, IEC 62304, and 21 CFR 820). 
 - Ability to work well with senior leadership. 
 - Experience working in a fast paced, dynamic environment.

At the same time, we are not afraid to expect a lot and strive for leadership in all of our key markets. We are a company taking on new challenges and for the right people this means exceptional career development opportunities, the chance to be part of a team that is the best in the world at what we do and the experience that comes from working in an environment that demands constant transformation and innovation. 

Husky TechnologiesTM is an exciting company with tremendous potential. We have a great team and great expectations. If you are attracted to bold goals, believe in uncompromising honesty, support mutual respect, care about environmental responsibility, have a passion for excellence and a desire to make a positive contribution - then we want you to join the Husky TechnologiesTM team!

Job Description

As a Test Automation Engineer, you will design and implement automation solutions that validate system behavior across UI, APIs, and integrations. You will contribute to building a robust quality engineering ecosystem by integrating automated testing into CI/CD pipelines and supporting continuous delivery. 

In this role, you will translate requirements into effective test strategies, combining automation with manual, exploratory, and integration testing to ensure comprehensive quality coverage across all application layers. 

This role is ideal for an engineer who enjoys hands-on coding, solving complex validation challenges, and improving system quality at scale, while taking ownership of end-to-end quality outcomes and collaborating closely with cross-functional teams. 

Responsibilities

Automation Development & Framework Ownership

- Design, develop, and own scalable test automation frameworks and reusable components
 - Build automated test suites across: 
 - UI (Web/Mobile)
 - API and integration layers
 - Ensure automation solutions are maintainable, reliable, and extensible across teams

Test Strategy & Implementation

- Translate requirements into automation-ready test scenarios, test data, and validation strategies
 - Contribute to test strategy, coverage planning, and quality goals
 - Identify test gaps and proactively mitigate risks
 - Perform automation feasibility analysis to determine optimal test approach (manual vs automated)

Delivery & Execution Excellence

- Execute a balanced mix of automated and manual tests aligned with sprint goals, ensuring comprehensive validation across functional, integration, and edge-case scenarios. 
 - Contribute to task breakdown, estimation, and sprint commitments
 - Proactively raise risks, blockers, and testability concerns
 - Identify, log, prioritize, and track defects through resolution lifecycle
 - Perform root cause analysis and collaborate with development teams for fixes

Manual & Functional Testing

- Design, document, and execute detailed test cases and test scenarios
 - Perform functional, exploratory, and regression testing across features
 - Validate end-to-end workflows and business scenarios
 - Identify edge cases and usability issues through exploratory testing
 - Ensure test coverage for areas not suitable for automation

Quality, Standards & Engineering Practices

- Write clean, testable, and maintainable automation code
 - Participate in code reviews and continuous improvement of automation frameworks
 - Ensure adherence to Definition of Ready (DoR) and Definition of Done (DoD)
 - Take ownership of end-to-end quality outcomes across assigned areas
 - Follow established DevOps, security, and quality engineering practices

CI/CD & DevOps Integration

- Integrate automation into CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps preferred)
 - Enable continuous testing and shift-left quality practices
 - Monitor and improve pipeline stability, execution time, and reliability
 - Validate and troubleshoot system integrations, data flows, and error handling based on defined architectural designs and interfaces

Non-Functional Testing

- Contribute to performance, reliability, and resilience testing
 - Validate system behavior under load, stress, and failure scenarios

Observability & Debuggability

- Leverage logs, metrics, and traces to improve test reliability
 - Support root cause analysis of failures and improve system observability

Test Data & Environment Management

- Design and manage test data strategies and datasets
 - Ensure availability of stable, production-like test environments

Incident & Operational Support

- Assist in troubleshooting defects across environments
 - Support maintenance and continuous improvement of automation suites
 - Analyze and reduce flaky tests and unstable scenarios

Collaboration & Growth

- Collaborate with developers, QA, Product Owners, and Tech Leads
 - Actively learn and adopt new tools, frameworks, and best practices
 - Contribute to team knowledge sharing and a strong quality culture

Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in computer science, IT, or related field
 - 5+ years of experience in software testing with strong automation focus
 - Experience in designing and implementing test automation frameworks
 - Strong understanding of testing principles, SDLC, STLC, and Agile practices

Technical Skills

- Programming experience in one or more: C#, Java, Python, JavaScript, Swift
 - Experience with automation tools such as Selenium, Katalon, Playwright, Cypress
 - Experience with: 
 - API testing (REST, Postman, etc. )
 - Version control (Git)
 - CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps)
 - Familiarity with: 
 - Test data management
 - Test reporting and logging tools
 - Debugging and root cause analysis
 - Release Management
Assets

- Experience with: 
 - Performance testing tools (JMeter, k6)
 - Security testing (SAST, DAST, SCA)
 - Exposure to: 
 - Cloud platforms (Azure preferred)
 - DevSecOps practices
 - Experience using AI-assisted tools responsibly (e. g. , GitHub Copilot)
Key Expectations

- Drive an automation-first approach (target 60-80% regression automation), while ensuring critical flows and edge cases are validated through manual testing where automation is not feasible or cost-effective. 
 - Own and evolve automation frameworks and quality engineering practices
 - Ensure high reliability, scalability, and stability of automation pipelines
 - Take accountability for quality outcomes, not just test execution
 - Ensure alignment with organizational quality, security, and compliance standards

Why Husky?

- Regulated Working Hours: Enjoy a structured work schedule that promotes a healthy work-life balance, allowing you to excel professionally while maintaining personal well-being. 
 - Visible Impact: Experience the satisfaction of seeing the direct outcomes of your work, as you contribute to projects that visibly enhance our company's technological capabilities and efficiency. 
 - Strategic Influence: Participate in architectural and technical reviews, contributing to the strategic direction of our cloud initiatives and making a tangible impact on our company's technological landscape. 
 - Empowered Involvement: Take an active role in decision-making processes and architectural reviews, where your expertise helps shape the future of our cloud solutions and overall business strategy. 
 - Valued Contributions: Be more than just a number in a large organization; at our company, every individual's input is valued and can lead to significant, tangible improvements in our operations and services. 
 - Impactful Role: Play a crucial part in both developing new applications and maintaining existing systems, ensuring their optimal performance and reliability. 
 - Cutting-Edge Projects: Work on innovative cloud solutions that are transforming our and our customer's business, giving you the opportunity to be at the forefront of technological advancements. 
 - Supportive Community: Work in an environment that recognizes and celebrates individual achievements, fostering a sense of community and mutual respect among team members. 
 - Collaborative Environment: Join a global team of skilled professionals around the globe where your ideas are valued, and collaboration is encouraged to solve complex challenges and drive success. 

Husky TechnologiesTM offers a competitive compensation and benefits package and excellent opportunities for growth and advancement. We are committed to equal employment opportunity and respect, value and welcome diversity in our workplace. Husky TechnologiesTM also values being a great place to work and strives to maintain a safe workplace. Job Description

Title: Control Software Designer-PLC-Husky (India) Guindy, Chennai

Id: 21587

Type: FullTime

Location: Chennai, India

At Husky TechnologiesTM, our success is based on your success. Our ability to keep our customers in the lead is based on building the strongest team possible. 

Husky TechnologiesTM has a strong foundation built on innovation, close customer relationships and a unique culture and values. We are dedicated to offering our customers the highest quality products and services and are looking for people with the inspiration and talent to develop with us as we pursue our ambitious growth strategy. We are a leader in developing state-of-the-art technology and it is this technology base that uniquely positions us to serve customers who seek differentiation through solutions that provide speed, flexibility and maximum productivity. This capability is at the core of our mission and competitive strategy. 

Husky TechnologiesTM offers a wealth of opportunity for personal growth and development. Most importantly, Husky Technologies TM offers an opportunity to work with - and be challenged by - a team of great people. Our success is possible because of the creativity, intelligence and passion of our people around the world and their desire to lead change. At the same time, we are not afraid to expect a lot and strive for leadership in all of our key markets. We are a company taking on new challenges and for the right people this means exceptional career development opportunities, the chance to be part of a team that is the best in the world at what we do and the experience that comes from working in an environment that demands constant transformation and innovation. 

Husky TechnologiesTM is an exciting company with tremendous potential. We have a great team and great expectations. If you are attracted to bold goals, believe in uncompromising honesty, support mutual respect, care about environmental responsibility, have a passion for excellence and a desire to make a positive contribution - then we want you to join the Husky TechnologiesTM team!

Job Description

As part of the Development Engineering team, the Control Software Designer designs, supports, and troubleshoots control systems for Injection Molding Machines(IMM) and Mold controllers. This role operates in a fast-paced, innovative environment and focuses on developing creative, high-quality solutions to complex technical challenges. 

Key Responsibilities/Areas Of Accountability: 

- Design control systems for IMM and Mold controller applications including servo drive and servo-hydraulic controls, injection molding process control. 
 - Provide functional, design specifications and validation plans for new IMM and Mold controller functionality. 
 - Software development of machine sequences (PLC IEC 61131-3), process control, human-machine interface(HMI) in Windows environment. 
 - Troubleshoot and debug real-time and non-real-time software. 
 - Document software changes using resources such as TFS/VSTS and Azure DevOps. 
 - Document development, design changes and production design activities. 
 - Communicate design with other design groups and businesses. 

Requirements: 

- Bachelor's Degree or higher in Electrical & Electronics/ECE/Instrumentation/Software Engineering preferred, or equivalent. 
 - Minimum 5 years hands-on experience in automated control system design and troubleshooting preferred. 
 - Machine design/develop with Beckhoff, Siemens, GE, ABB and Allen Bradley products background are preferred. 
 - PLC structured text language design and programming using IEC 61131-3. 
 - Experience in programming using C, C++, C# or other high-level languages for HMI applications (Ruby). 
 - Strong knowledge of PC based control systems and embedded system. 
 - Strong Knowledge of control theory and model-based design principles. 
 - Knowledge of PLC's and motion controllers. 
 - Working knowledge of standard industrial communication networks and protocols such as RS232, RS485, Ethernet, CANOpen, Profibus, Profinet and EtherCAT. 
 - Ability to read control circuits using Eplan as a resource. 
 - Experience with Beckhoff TwinCAT3. 
 - Experience designing, debugging and deploying software in VSTS development environment. 
 - Machine design/develop with Beckhoff, Siemens, GE, ABB and Allen Bradley products background are preferred. 
 - Experience in Agile software design process and Test Driven Development methodologies. 
 - Familiarity and experience with AI and it's use in software development, ideation, and the creation of tools
 - Strong proficiency in English with effective verbal, written. 

Personal Qualifications: 

- Ability to communicate complex technical concepts clearly, verbally and in writing. 
 - A quick independent learner, able to digest and understand complex concepts. 
 - An intelligent thinker, able to formulate hypotheses, troubleshoot, analyze, and propose solutions. 
 - Highly creative with the ability to develop multiple concepts to resolve problems. 
 - Capable of Working in a multi-disciplined international team with excellent personal organization skills. 

Husky TechnologiesTM offers a competitive compensation and benefits package and excellent opportunities for growth and advancement. We are committed to equal employment opportunity and respect, value and welcome diversity in our workplace. Husky TechnologiesTM also values being a great place to work and strives to maintain a safe workplace. Accordingly, Husky TechnologiesTM conditions all offers of employment on satisfactory completion of background checks. No agency or telephone inquiries please.

The company also serves rural markets with micro insurance products and provides a comprehensive set of wellness services. Role Description The Front Line Sales Manager role at Care Insurance is a full-time, on-site position based in Bargarh. data.title: Software Engineering, Staff
data.description:
Overview

Medallia is the pioneer and market leader in Experience Management. Our award-winning SaaS platform, Medallia Experience Cloud, leads the market in the management of experiences, insights, and actions for candidates, customers, employees, patients, and residents alike. 

We believe that every experience is a memory that can last a lifetime. Experiences shape the way people feel about a company. And they greatly influence how likely people are to advocate, contribute, and stay. At Medallia, we are committed to creating a world where organizations are loved by their customers and their employees. 

We empower exceptional people to create extraordinary experiences together. 

Bring your whole self. 

The Role and Team

At Medallia, our Platform team builds and operates the critical backend services that power how surveys are executed, distributed, processed, and collected across our platform. 

Our systems sit at the core that support large-scale, highly available workloads across many enterprise customers. The team owns services and capabilities related to survey execution, distribution, response processing, webhooks, messaging integrations, and the streaming pipelines that turn raw collection events into reliable, reportable data. 

As our platform continues to scale, we are evolving these systems to improve performance, reliability, scalability, and operational efficiency while building out key parts of the platform from the ground up on a modern, cloud-native stack. 

We are looking for a Staff Software Engineer who enjoys solving challenging backend and distributed systems problems, working with high-throughput streaming services, and building reliable software that operates at enterprise scale. 

You will work closely with experienced engineers, Product Management, QA, and other platform teams to design and deliver capabilities that directly impact how millions of surveys and responses are processed across the platform. 

This role is based remotely in Pune. Candidates for this position are required to reside within the Pune metropolitan area. Relocation support is not available at this time. 

Responsibilities

- Drive resolution on open, cross-cutting architectural questions - Nexus has several live ones at any given time (e. g. , which store owns a given workload and why, how a materialization strategy should be chosen and validated, how a new enrichment type should integrate without violating existing invariants). You're expected to drive these to a documented, defensible decision - not just have an opinion on them. 
 - Own the integrity of the platform's core data invariants across teams - multi-tenant isolation via the composite entity key model, the rule that enrichments never rewrite interaction data, and that row-level access is enforced on views rather than scattered through application logic. When a new feature threatens one of these, you're the engineer who catches it before it ships. 
 - Design the pipeline and schema evolution patterns other teams build against - e. g. , how a dataset schema can evolve without migrations or downtime, how a new interaction type gets onboarded, how an enrichment's output reaches reporting without duplicating or destabilizing existing views. Lead technical design for major cross-team initiatives - examples at this scale: extending the platform to ingest data originating from Medallia's existing products (MEC) alongside Nexus-native data, designing how AI agents (survey-building assistants, conversational feedback collection) integrate with the core data model via MCP/A2A without becoming a second, inconsistent source of truth. 
 - Evaluate and make build-vs-buy and store-selection decisions with real stakes - e. g. , assessing whether a given workload belongs on a relational store, a wide-column store, or an OLAP engine, and what the actual operational and consistency trade-offs are, backed by a POC or benchmark rather than a hunch. 
 - Mentor senior and mid-level engineers on distributed systems design, data modeling for multi-tenant correctness, and how to reason about trade-offs in a system where "simple and wrong" fails silently and expensively. 
 - Represent engineering in architecture and design reviews across team boundaries, and be a primary author of the architecture documentation the rest of the organization builds against. 
 - Get hands-on when it matters - staff-level scope doesn't mean stepping back from code. You'll personally build the hardest, highest-leverage pieces of a cross-cutting initiative, especially where the design risk is too high to hand off before it's proven out. 
 - Improve how the platform is operated at scale - reliability, observability, and incident response patterns that work across both the application and data layers, not just within one service's boundary. 
 - Use AI-assisted development tools responsibly, and set the bar for how your teams evaluate AI-generated code for correctness, security, and long-term maintainability. 

Qualifications

Minimum Qualifications: 

- 8+ years of professional software engineering experience, with a track record of technical leadership beyond your own individual contributions - driving decisions, designs, or initiatives that other engineers and teams built on top of. 
 - Deep expertise in distributed systems - you can reason rigorously about consistency models, failure modes, data consistency guarantees, and the real trade-offs behind an architectural decision, not just the vocabulary. 
 - Strong backend engineering background, ideally spanning more than one language/stack (e. g. , Java and TypeScript/Node. js, or equivalent) - this role operates across Nexus Core and the Data Platform, and needs to be credible in both. 
 - Demonstrated experience with event-driven and streaming architectures (Kafka or equivalent, plus a stream processor such as Flink, Spark Streaming, or Kafka Streams). 
 - Deep experience with relational and/or wide-column data stores at scale, including schema design for systems that can't tolerate downtime or destructive changes. 
 - Proven experience designing for multi-tenant SaaS correctness - tenant isolation, authorization models, and the discipline required when a design mistake doesn't just cause a bug, it causes a data leak between customers. 
 - A track record of making and defending hard technical trade-off decisions in writing - RFCs, design docs, or equivalent - and bringing skeptical stakeholders to alignment. 
 - Experience mentoring senior engineers and influencing technical direction without direct management authority. 
 - Excellent written and verbal communication - at this level, your technical judgment is only as useful as your ability to convey it clearly to engineers, product, and leadership. 

Preferred Qualifications: 

- Experience designing row-level or policy-based authorization systems, especially ones enforced at the data/view layer rather than purely in application code. 
 - Experience with identity resolution systems - matching, merging, and the operational cost of getting profile/entity resolution wrong at scale. 
 - Experience integrating LLM-based agents or tools into a production platform, especially using protocols like MCP (Model Context Protocol) or agent-to-agent (A2A) coordination. 
 - Experience leading a platform migration or hybrid-integration effort - e. g. , bringing a legacy system's data into a new platform without forcing customers through a disruptive migration. 
 - Background in customer experience management, survey platforms, or voice-of-customer systems. 
 - Experience as a technical lead on a greenfield platform build, with scars to show for the early architectural bets that worked and the ones that didn't. 

At Medallia, we celebrate diversity and recognize the value it brings to our customers and employees. Medallia is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age (40 and over), disability, genetic information, veteran status or military service, or any other status protected by state or local law. Individuals with a disability who need an accommodation to apply please contact us at ApplicantAccessibility@medallia. com. For information regarding how Medallia collects and uses personal information, please review our Privacy Policies. Applications will be accepted for 30 days from the date this role was posted or until the role has been filled.

data.title: Principal Software Engineer
data.description:
About PSG-CP

Pearson is the world's lifelong learning company, and PSG-CP (Pearson Software Group - Content Platform) is the organization powering how that learning gets created, enriched, delivered, and measured. PSG-CP's focus is on content. We handle authoring, semantic enrichment, transformation, delivery, assessment, and analytics, serving every Pearson line of business and millions of learners worldwide. We are reshaping the platform around AI in a serious way, and this Principal Engineer role is pivotal in shaping the vision, strategy, and execution of technology and architecture. 

This is a high-impact, hands-on technical leadership role focused on improving engineering effectiveness, accelerating delivery, and ensuring technical excellence across the organization. You will not be embedded within a single team; instead, you will work across teams on PSG-CP initiatives, complex technical challenges, and architectural decisions. 

You will partner closely with Engineering Managers, Staff Engineers, Product, and DevOps to assess technical feasibility, and drive architecture decisions for future high-impact, AI-native PSG-CP capabilities. 

Key Responsibilities: 

- Lead technical feasibility reviews and share architecture for enterprise-scale AI-native PSG-CP capabilities

- Provide hands-on technical leadership across multiple squads, focusing on high-impact initiatives and critical path work

- Unblock complex technical challenges that span systems, teams, or domains

- Lead and contribute to architecture and system design decisions, ensuring scalability, simplicity, and long-term maintainability

- Drive technical consistency and best practices across teams (design patterns, standards, tooling)

- Partner with the Engineering Manager and Staff Engineers to support delivery without taking on people management responsibilities

- Contribute directly to code when needed, especially in high-risk or high-priority areas

- Mentor and guide senior engineers and technical leads through coaching, design discussions, and knowledge sharing

- Partner with internal and external stakeholders to identify, assess, and co-develop Ai-native innovative capabilities to PSG-CP

Required Skills and Competencies: 

- Prior experience building content authoring / management platforms is a must

- Full-Stack Engineering, Modern Development Tools (Advanced): Build and prototype end-to-end across frontend, backend, and infrastructure. Experience with at least one of the following: Front End like React, Angular; Back End like Java, Spring, Node JS, Python

- Cloud Computing, API Management, DevOps, Data Security, Information Security (Advanced): Lead technical execution and ensure compliance. Prior working experience in a cloud computing environment like AWS/GCP is highly desired

- Collaboration, Innovation, Cross-Functional Working, Technical Acumen, Problem Solving (Advanced): Influence across teams and partners, shape ideas, and drive differentiated solutions. 

- Comfort with Ambiguity, Builder Mindset (Advanced): Operate effectively in undefined, fast-moving, early-stage environments. 

- Ability to operate as a force multiplier across teams, elevating overall engineering quality and speed

- Strong architectural thinking with a focus on scalability, simplicity, and business impact

- Excellent communication skills, with the ability to influence without authority both technical and non-technical stakeholders

- Self-starter who thrives in a fast-paced, and evolving environment

- Demonstrated ability to work with global teams across time zones

Qualifications (Education & Experience): 

- Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent experience

- 15+ years of experience building and scaling full-stack applications

- Proven experience operating at a staff or principal level, influencing multiple teams or large systems

- Strong background in system design, distributed systems, and API architecture using event driven microservices

- Demonstrated ability to solve ambiguous, cross-cutting technical problems

- Experience driving technical strategy, standards, and architecture across teams

#LM-AM

Who we are: 

At Pearson, our purpose is simple: to help people realize the life they imagine through learning. We believe that every learning opportunity is a chance for a personal breakthrough. We are the world's lifelong learning company. For us, learning isn't just what we do. It's who we are. To learn more: We are Pearson. 

Pearson is an Equal Opportunity Employer and a member of E-Verify. Employment decisions are based on qualifications, merit and business need. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, ethnicity, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, national origin, protected veteran status, disability status or any other group protected by law. We actively seek qualified candidates who are protected veterans and individuals with disabilities as defined under VEVRAA and Section 503 of the Rehabilitation Act.

Bonus Points If You Have (Preferred Requirements): 

- Master's degree
 - Relevant experience in the pharmaceutical industry
 - Strong background in Manufacturing, Technical Services, Materials Management, QA/QC, and Engineering

 - Excellent interpersonal and communication skills
 - Ability to work collaboratively in a team environment

Demonstrated curiosity for exploring how these tools can improve outcomes and understanding of responsible AI practices, including risk management and ethical use

data.title: Technical Lead (Fullstack)
data.description:
About Juniper Square

Private markets are one of the largest, most complex, and most underserved corners of global finance. Our mission at Juniper Square is to unlock their full potential. We're the Operations Partner trusted by 2, 300+ GPs, unifying technology, data, and fund administration services into a single platform that helps GPs move faster, make better decisions, and scale with precision. With $300B+ under administration and 700, 000+ LPs on platform, we've built the scale to match our ambition. And with JunieAI, our purpose-built AI platform, we're reimagining how private markets operate, embedding intelligence across every workflow. Founder-led since 2014, backed by $350M+ in funding, and now 1, 000+ employees strong, we're building a company designed to shape the future of private markets for decades to come. 

Our culture is built for people who want to do ambitious, meaningful work alongside exceptionally talented teammates. We think like owners, move with urgency, and take pride in solving hard problems that truly matter to our customers and the future of private markets. We believe the best ideas come from open debate, deep collaboration, and diverse perspectives, which is why we believe transparency is the default and feedback makes us stronger. If you're energized by high standards, rapid growth, and the opportunity to help define a category at a pivotal moment, come join us!

Juniper Square offers employees a variety of ways to work, ranging from a fully remote experience to working full-time in one of our physical offices. We invest heavily in digital-first operations, allowing our teams to collaborate effectively across 27 U. S. states, 2 Canadian Provinces, India, Luxembourg, and England. We also have physical offices in San Francisco, New York City, Mumbai and Bangalore for employees who prefer to work in an office some or all of the time. 

About Your Role

We are seeking a highly skilled Full Stack Technical Lead to architect, design, and oversee the development of scalable web applications and distributed systems. The ideal candidate brings strong backend expertise in Python (FastAPI preferred) or Java, combined with solid frontend development experience using ReactJS and TypeScript. 

This role will lead the design and delivery of end-to-end systems-from user-facing applications to backend services and cloud infrastructure. You will guide engineering teams, drive architectural decisions, and ensure best practices across the full software development lifecycle. 

Experience leveraging AI tools and building AI-driven solutions will be a significant advantage, especially for developing intelligent features, automation, and data-driven capabilities within products. 

What You'll Do

Technical Leadership

data.description:
Description

Join a team revolutionizing how millions of customers shop globally on Amazon as a Senior Software Development Engineer for Cross Border Shopping Experience. We're building next-generation AI-powered solutions that enable customers worldwide to easily discover and purchase products across Amazon's global marketplaces through sophisticated marketing, personalization, and localization technologies. 

This Is An Opportunity To

- Drive the technical design and implementation of global e-commerce features that make international shopping feel local and effortless
 - Build highly scalable solutions that help customers worldwide access Amazon's vast selection of products
 - Work on challenging problems in distributed systems, personalization, and real-time decisioning at massive scale
 - Collaborate with world-class engineers and influence technical direction across teams

If you're passionate about solving complex technical challenges at global scale and building systems that create exceptional customer experiences, we want to hear from you. Join us in transforming how the world shops across borders. 

We are looking for a Software Development Engineer (SDE) to join the Cross Border Customer Experience team. In this role, the SDE will design, write, and maintain user experience software for Amazon shopping pages used by millions of customers around the world. The engineer will collaborate with product managers to define the future direction of customer experience throughout the entire shopping journey (Search, Detail Page, All Offers Display, Cart, Checkout, Order Details Page) and will apply the best engineering practices to deliver working solutions for international Amazon customers. The SDE will work on customer's international shopping journey including personalized recommendations and displaying relevant cross-border shopping information (pricing, delivery, legal) in order to enable customers to shop efficiently and with confidence while delivering on business goals. The SDE will adhere to best practices of software development in large-scale distributed systems while innovating and experimenting in an agile fashion. You will participate in the entire software lifecycle from concept, design, development, through testing, release, and maintenance. You will be mentored by tenured Amazon engineers and you will be expected to coach and mentor others around you. 

Key job responsibilities

Design, develop, test, and deploy highly scalable and reliable software systems for cross-border shopping experiences used by millions of customers daily

Build technical solutions for personalized recommendations, marketing, and localized experiences supporting multiple languages, currencies, and payment methods

data.title: Assistant Manager / Manager – Quality Control (QC)
data.description:
Job Overview

We are looking for an experienced and detail-oriented Assistant Manager / Manager - Quality Control to oversee daily analytical testing, instrument compliance, and quality operations across our pharmaceutical laboratories (API/Formulation). In this role, you will lead a team of QC analysts, manage chromatographic data integrity, direct laboratory investigations (OOS, OOT, CAPA), ensure pharmacopeial compliance (USP, EP, BP, IP), and represent the QC function during customer and regulatory audits. 

Key Responsibilities

- Laboratory Operations & Release: Direct daily QC testing workflows to ensure the timely testing, review, approval, and analytical batch release of raw materials, intermediates, and finished products. 
 - Data Review & Audit Trails: Oversee electronic chromatographic data systems (Empower, Chromeleon, LabSolutions, OpenLab), conducting thorough data reviews, audit trail assessments, and user access management to maintain strict 21 CFR Part 11 / data integrity compliance. 
 - Laboratory Investigations: Spearhead root-cause investigations for Out of Specification (OOS), Out of Trend (OOT), laboratory incidents, and deviations; formulate and track robust Corrective and Preventive Actions (CAPA). 
 - Method Validation & Transfer: Guide and review analytical method validation (AMV), verification, method transfers, and long-term stability study protocols and execution. 
 - Equipment Qualification & Calibration: Supervise laboratory compliance programs, including instrument qualification (IQ/OQ/PQ), routine calibration, preventive maintenance, and chemical reference standard management. 
 - Audit & Inspection Readiness: Face and support customer audits, internal laboratory audits, and regulatory inspections, ensuring prompt closure of audit observations. 
 - Team Leadership & cGLP Training: Mentor, manage, and upskill laboratory chemists on cGLP practices, advanced analytical techniques, and regulatory compliance standards. 

Qualifications & Requirements

- Education: M. Sc. (Chemistry), M. Pharm, or B. Pharm in a relevant scientific discipline. 
 - Experience: Minimum 8-10 years of hands-on experience in pharmaceutical Quality Control laboratories handling API and/or Formulation products. 
 - Analytical Expertise: Deep practical knowledge of analytical techniques, including HPLC, GC, UV, FTIR, ICP-MS, Dissolution testing, and Wet Chemistry. 
 - Chromatography Data Systems (CDS): Proven experience managing and reviewing data in systems such as Empower, Chromeleon, LabSolutions, or OpenLab, including audit trail reviews, user management, and data integrity enforcement. 
 - Investigations & CAPA: Proven expertise in leading laboratory failure investigations (OOS, OOT), deviations, and implementing effective CAPAs. 
 - Methodology & Stability: Solid background in analytical method validation (AMV), method transfer, method verification, and ICH stability studies. 
 - Regulatory & Pharmacopeia Standards: In-depth familiarity with pharmacopeial requirements (USP, EP, BP, IP), cGMP/cGLP guidelines, and global regulatory inspection expectations. 
 - Audits & Compliance: Proven track record of successfully handling client quality audits, internal assessments, and regulatory agency inspections. 
 - Leadership: Strong team management and operational capabilities to drive timely laboratory testing, report approvals, and data release.

data.title: Java Software Engineer -Vice President - Parametric
data.description:
About Morgan Stanley

Morgan Stanley is a leading global financial services firm providing a wide range of investment banking, securities, wealth management and investment management services. With offices in more than 41 countries, the Firm's employees serve clients worldwide including corporations, governments, institutions and individuals. For further information about Morgan Stanley, please visit www. morganstanley. com. 

About Parametric

Parametric is part of Morgan Stanley Investment Management, the asset management division of Morgan Stanley. We partner with advisors, institutions, and consultants to build portfolios focused on what's important to them and their clients. A leader in custom solutions for more than 30 years, we help investors access efficient market exposures, solve implementation challenges, and design multi-asset portfolios that respond to their evolving needs. We also offer systematic alpha and alternative strategies to complement clients' core holdings. 

This role is part of Parametric's hybrid working model, which includes working in the office 3 days a week and choosing to work remotely or in the office the remaining days of the week. 

About The Team

The Investment Systems team at Parametric: 

We are building financial software that solves for some of the world's most complex financial opportunities. This includes building solutions to provide customized direct index exposure while making tax sensitive asset selection to improve overall after-tax portfolio returns. 

We design and build scalable multi-asset portfolio management solutions, secure platforms for creating financial applications and low-code workflows, and a core data platform that delivers trusted financial data. 

About The Role

We are looking for individuals that have a strong curiosity and passion for learning new things, while continuously challenging oneself to build things better and more scalable. 

The Principal Software Engineer is responsible for providing both technical and people leadership, project delivery, process development, training and support. The role partners across the Equity Investments and Client Activities team, Core Services, and the externally facing Digital Team to design and develop technology solutions that support Direct Indexing business priorities and improve business processes. The role spans multiple services within the team, building out underlying components that provide critical services to the Equity Portfolio Management Platform. These services help streamline rule-based portfolio analytics, order generation and straight through processing enabling exception driven portfolio management. 

This position will report into the Investments & Innovation Platform team and work closely with team leads across Technology teams, Business Analysis as well as Business Partners. In this role, you will lead developers and projects and provide mentoring opportunities to the development team. 

A critical objective for this role is to support the architecture and deliver scalable enterprise solutions, leveraging AWS cloud native technologies, designing and implementing micro-services and a relentless focus on performance and resilience. 

Primary Responsibilities

- Design and develop proprietary solutions for the Equity Direct Indexing portfolio management teams
 - Provide technical leadership by directly managing a team of engineers, guiding and mentoring them to achieve their highest potential while collectively advancing the goals and projects of the engineering team. 
 - Drive vision and strategy for the team while exemplifying strong leadership skills, including communication, consensus building, elevated standards, ownership, accountability, and project management. 
 - Design, develop, and maintain services and API to support various business needs
 - Leverage scalable and distributed computing principles to build the next generation of services
 - Ensures that software solutions remain integrated, efficient, and appropriate for a highly regulated industry. 
 - Create unit/integration/functional/performance tests
 - Conduct code reviews of other developers
 - Share experience, knowledge, and ideas to the team to improve processes and productivity
 - Maintain regular collaboration with teams and stakeholders in the US West Coast time zone, including flexibility to support overlapping working hours when needed. 

Job Qualifications

Required Experience: 12+ years

Skill set: Software design / Dev/ Java / J2EE / relational database

Primary Skills

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or related area of study
 - 12+ years of hands-on development experience managing all aspects of technical projects with a proven track record of delivering well architected and well written software solutions. 
 - 3+ years of managing software development teams and providing direct guidance, mentorship, project leadership, and team development while fostering an engaging, collaborative environment and building strong cross-team relationships
 - Strong Java and Spring Boot experience
 - Experience with microservices and distributed systems
 - Strong debugging and troubleshooting skills Strong aptitude for highly efficient data structures and algorithms
 - Cloud native development experience a plus: AWS is preferred
 - Exposure to event-driven architecture (e. g. , Kafka)
 - Working knowledge of SQL , RDBMS , NoSQL database engines such as Redis & DynamoDB
 - Experience using enterprise AI development tools, including GitHub Copilot Enterprise and GitHub Spec Kit, to enable AI-powered Specification-Driven Development. 
 - Proven track record of becoming a subject matter expert in areas related to current assignments. 
 - Demonstrated initiative, ownership, and a results-oriented approach to solving complex business and technology challenges. 
 - Demonstrated sound judgment, integrity, and a commitment to delivering high-quality outcomes in a collaborative environment. 
 - Strong communication, collaboration, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence technical and business stakeholders. 
 - Familiarity with AI and related technologies, with the ability to apply them in a business or technical context

Good To Have Skills

- Experience with React or modern front-end frameworks
 - Strong knowledge of relational databases and SQL
 - Asset management experience
 - Experience governing enterprise AI agents through secure access, auditability, human oversight, and emerging standards. 

Parametric believes each member of our organization makes a significant contribution to our success. That contribution should not be limited by the assigned responsibilities. Therefore, this job description is designed to outline primary duties and qualifications. It is our expectation that every member of our team will offer his/her/their services wherever and whenever necessary to ensure the success of our client services. 

What You Can Expect From Morgan Stanley

At Morgan Stanley, we raise, manage and allocate capital for our clients - helping them reach their goals. We do it in a way that's differentiated - and we've done that for 90 years. Our values - putting clients first, doing the right thing, leading with exceptional ideas, committing to diversity and inclusion, and giving back - aren't just beliefs, they guide the decisions we make every day to do what's best for our clients, communities and more than 80, 000 employees in 1, 200 offices across 42 countries. At Morgan Stanley, you'll find an opportunity to work alongside the best and the brightest, in an environment where you are supported and empowered. Our teams are relentless collaborators and creative thinkers, fueled by their diverse backgrounds and experiences. We are proud to support our employees and their families at every point along their work-life journey, offering some of the most attractive and comprehensive employee benefits and perks in the industry. There's also ample opportunity to move about the business for those who show passion and grit in their work. 

To learn more about our offices across the globe, please copy and paste https: //www. morganstanley. com/about-us/global-offices into your browser. 

Morgan Stanley is an equal opportunity employer committed to building and maintaining a workforce that is diverse in experience and background. Our recruiting efforts reflect our strong commitment to a culture of inclusion, where individuals are hired, developed, and advanced based on their skills and talents. 

Our workforce reflects a broad cross-section of the global communities in which we operate, bringing a variety of backgrounds, talents, perspectives, and experiences. 

For more information, please visit: https: //www. morganstanley. com/people-opportunities/eeo.

At Charles Schwab, our purpose is simple: we champion client's goals with passion and integrity.
